text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
Whata great meal it was fantastic


Quick service and enjoyed the atmosphere. I had a great rueben and root beer
name: Michael

text:
Wonderful neighborhood place just outside the quarter. Unique breakfast selections such as "crabby wife". Crab cakes with eggs and crawfish ettouffe. Pulled pork on a waffle. Nice and comfy spot for a breakfast. Their lunches are also very good. Outdoor seating and pet friendly. 
****Update****  The lady owner or manger is a complete bitch. I was seated a few minutes before my wife (only be cause she got lost in the 2 block walk) and she berated the guy who sat me without my entire group. I live right around the corner and enjoy their food but I will not return based on her actions. She actually came and asked the two tables next to me how their food was and did not ask about our experience.  I apologized to the man who sat us and he reassured me all was fine. But based off of her actions toward our table, it was obvious they weren't. If she had the courage to ask me why the rest of my party wasn't present, I'm sure it could've been handled differently.
name: Justin

text:
My favorite place to go for a burger in South Tampa. The best!!! When I want something lighter, I always go for the "Crisp & Fresh Salad." I'm always impressed with how fresh the food is at Mad Dogs.  

Always friendly and effiicient service. The laidback atmosphere is part of why I love Mad Dog's. And there's Hugo, a Mad Dog's staple, who is always pleased to chat with you at the bar. Come to think of it...I should sit at the bar more often because you can always meet someone interesting sitting at the bar at Mad Dog's.

Also a favorite place for a late night snack!
name: Lisa

text: Really nice customer service plus they always make everything fresh when you order it!!
name: Willow

text: This place in all honestly has the Best tasting coffee In all of Idaho . Probably the best I have ever had anywhere! Not to mention the beautiful coffee shop on its own but everything about it . They deliver coffee too ! I love it here.
name: Laura

text: My most recent visit, I ordered my food to go. Apparently the girl at the register didn't listen to me when I said this, so when my buzzer went off and I saw my food on plates, I said, this is to go. The girl did a big sigh and said in a sarcastic voice, making it awkwardly obvious she was annoyed, "Oh, you didn't mention that!" She then proceeds to package my food up as haphazardly as possible & touching it with her bare hands, that she's touching cash & people's cc with. She was acting so inconvenienced & rude and it ruined my experience. I can't say that I'll be rushing back. Being treated that way is unacceptable & makes me sorry I tipped so well to begin with. There are several Pizzerias in town, as well as, other purveyors at The Market that I'd rather give my business to. Definitely ones that wouldn't put the blame on the customers & make an issue of something as simple as getting a "here" or "to-go" wrong.
name: Ashley

text:
Reasonably priced chain BBQ restaurant.  I liked the military theme and the fact that they did the Star Spangled Banner at noon.  The whole restaurant stopped and stood up.  

Overall the pulled pork was good and the fries were banging.  I would go back.
name: Kevin

text: This place really sucked ordered a 2 pieces combo,it came with a leg & thigh of chicken. I wanted 2 thighs.they told me they can't sell it that way, nor just let me  pay an up charge or buy an extra piece that I wanted.  How is it that they sell chicken? but won't allow you to buy the pieces that you want Or maybe substitute one piece. even if you offer to pay extra kind of ridiculous ,guess I'll have to settle for POPEYE'S or KFC. On top of that they had one person taking order and it took 20mins to place my order.SMH !!!
name: Shalimar

text: This is our favorite Mexican restaurant as the food is delicious. The chips and salsa and pico de gallo are awesome and they have a fantastic bartender who knows how to make a great strawberry daquiri and excellent margaritas. We always leave full after a great experience.
name: Meg

text: The dark chili salsa is amazing and the black bean Queso is great worth a second delivery! However, the hot chicken taco with queso on top was way to heavey and it was hard to taste anything but the queso dip. I will not buy this taco again.
name: Erica

text: Came here twice during my trip.  Had the roast beef po-boy which was pretty good given that I am usually not a fan of roast beef.  Was able to try some of the Voodoo chips that I saw online here.  During my second visit, I had the shrimp po-boy and it was really good!  Lots of shrimp and it lived up to the expectation.  The boudin balls are great!! They took a little longer to come out bc they were made to order.  They were piping hot and really tasty, even though I'm still not quite sure what is in it.  The rice&beans and the gumbo were only meh to me.  The line moves pretty quickly but the only downside is CASH ONLY!
name: Jess

text: Excellent made to order burgers and perfectly fried fish. Great salad. Good live music.
name: Lulu

text: We have eaten Santucci's for many years. We have tried this location at least 10 times over the past 2 1/2 years. The last time we ordered had to be 6 months ago because the pizza is not as good as other locations. We figured we would give it 1 last chance. We ordered 2 pizzas and asked for them to be not well done. Well, what we received was the complete opposite.  It was so well done it was far from enjoyable. I will never go here again. It was horrible. If I want to eat Santucci's,  I'll go to the location at 10th & Christian where they listen and actually make a delicious pizza.
name: V

text:
The vegetable korma and garlic naan are outstanding and the saag paneer is ok. 

Good portions and quick service for takeout.
name: Kerin

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. For a busy night they handled it okay. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: service was nice, kitchen was just moving kinda slow. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. It was crowded but still moved along. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
We could not be more disappointed with our Martabak experience. We've been waiting to go for a while and finally made the trip tonight. First we get there and are informed they don't have chicken. Ok, no problem. We'll take a plain one with corn instead as I don't eat beef. We're then told it'll be 20 minutes so we go for a walk since it's an uncharacteristically beautiful August night in Philly. We get back, order is ready- great! Head home and open it up only to find that the vegetarian dish we ordered is actually full of beef and in the 10 minute walk home it was already cold. 

2 stars for service and overall experience. My husband says the beef dish is 4 stars worthy but I doubt we'll be back.

EDIT to ONE STAR- after my husband reheated leftovers for lunch today he found an enormous, black hair baked into the food. That's now two meals ruined. Never again.
name: Leigh

text:
Great atmosphere. Delicious food. Weird service. 
We thought the layout was beautiful. Calm, but not overly uptight. The food, was plated beautifully and was delicious. Service was subpar. We'll probably return for lunch, not dinner.
name: Jasmine

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Just not for me. It looked better online than it did in person. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: lives upto the hype, good chicken w/ spicy as you want it. giving 4stars instead of 5 cos we found Gus chicken (Memphis) tastier. waited 45 mins on a weekday non-busy time in line lol but overall worth it. V friendly and quick service
name: Raakesh

text: Delish!!!   My salad was wonderful and the portion size was awesome!!  Pizza was generous with the pepperoni, which we liked!!  Owners are very nice, look forward to returning.
name: Chris

text:
Came here because of the name. Ordered Med. Hot chicken on a bed of mashed potatoes, with gravy on top. The best combo for hot chicken I've had! Don't know how Nashville people eat their chicken with just white bread. 

+ We're from out of town so when I asked our server, Kimberly (? Sorry if wrong) about cheerwine, She explained it as like a cherry Dr. Pepper. Then promptly went to get us some to try. She was right. It was so good my friend ordered a cup too. 

Would def come back again.
name: Zach

text:
On a Friday night, we ordered delivery and were told an hour. We accepted the hour wait. However, that turned into 1 hour and 45 minutes. We called twice and they kept telling us that the food would be here soon. However, 45 minutes late and cold pizza was not what we expected from this place. No call back from the manager, after the person on the phone said they would talk to the manager. When the delivery guy showed up, he barely got out of his car and made me walk out in to the rain to get my cold pizza and he didn't even say, "hey, sorry for the delay."

We had to put the pizza in our oven to heat up the pizza and still waiting to eat it.
name: Brett

text: This was my first order with ban ban and I'm quite pleased.  Delivery was on time. Food was spicy but good.  Korean ribs were meaty and excellent. Yom tum soup rich. It had only one shrimp but it was large. I'll definitely order order. Pleased to find good delivery near me.
name: Leslie

text: Love it.  Second trip to New Orleans and sad cuz the French quarter location is closed but the original is nice a trolley ride.  Great burger.
name: Rebecca

text: This is one of our favorite places to eat in Brandon. The menu has a great selection of "regular" items (and they are ALL fantastic), as well as a page of creative specials. A comfortable setting, great service, wonderful food, always makes this a top choice of places to go in Brandon. (You HAVE to save room for the Salted Caramel Cheese Cake......oh my, my)
name: David

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Just not for me. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was good and came out fast. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
FYI: They do have an all you can eat meat option, but only on the weekdays!!

PROS: Y'ALL....I AM IN LOVE. Like I know their soup bases are pretty famous for being super flavorful but I was not expecting the flavor punch and beautiful richness that blessed my taste buds. Sauces are not required because like seriously...you don't need it. Their hot pot items were also nicely presented and prepared. They make sure to properly thaw/cut every item before putting it in front of you. The staff there was also very attentive and nice. Loved every bit of it.

CONS: Yeah...weekend prices are a bit steep. Every item is priced differently and the costs do add up. But for 4 people to eat their fill, I think our total wasn't terrible and was pretty much the same as a 4 person dinner at any other nice restaurant.
name: Sherry

text: Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Would probably stop in again if nearby. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was good and came out fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Best bagels around and they are baked fresh everyday. Their breakfast sandwiches are delicious and everything is grilled on the spot, no microwaves eggs here. Whole grain everything bagel is amazing! Only complaint is that they should have a separate pickup line so you don't have to wait in their long lines for a sandwich that is ready and waiting for you.
name: Rebecca

text:
My niece and I ate here for breakfast this morning. She had eggs, bacon, potatoes, and a chocolate chip pancake. I know she really enjoyed her pancake.
I had the corned beef plate with the cheese sauce on the side. Unfortunately, I can't say I enjoyed mine. I swear, it tasted like somebody accidentally switched their salt for sugar. My corned beef was incredibly sweet. I tried using the cheese sauce to see if the added saltiness would balance it out, but it didn't help.

Service was good, and everybody was pleasant. I'm not opposed to trying this place again, but I definitely won't have the corned beef again.
name: Henry

text: I was in Reno for graduation at UNR and had the entire extended family with us. They took in 20 of us easily and were polite with all of us. The food is good standard diner food in my opinion.
name: Brandon

text: Yeah, I'm aware of the recent health code violations, but I still love this place. They're open 24 hours, the staff is friendly, and the food is good (it's diner food, so nothing super fancy), but it's good comfort food or post-show food. My whole family loves to go here any time we're in Fountain Square for a local show. The service is a bit slow, so if you're in a hurry you might be frustrated, but if you have time, it's worth a visit.
name: Emily

text: Whoever is in charge of decorations here is beyond amazing. The Halloween decor was on point. From the doll heads to the hanging baby bodies to the hands coming out of the wall. Incredible! It was nostalgic for me to have an ecto cooler drink!! It would have gotten 5 stars, but due to the fact that the drinks were grossly overpriced for 6oz plastic cups. I would make a visit once for the season but probably no more than that.
name: Jen

text: This place is a little hidden gem on Mass! I tried it the other night. They offer authentic Greek food for a great price. I got the chicken kabobs with rice and a side salad. The taziki sauce was amazing! The portions are very generous and they are open later than most restaurants in the area. I highly recommend!
name: Chasity

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. So yeah, the leftovers held up okay the next day.. Idk, solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. So yeah, not terrible, just not something i'd want again soon. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. For the price I expected more than this. idk I'd try something else next time. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: I tried Fausto's for the first time last night to celebrate my birthday with friends.  It was by far the best meal I have had in a long time.  From appetizers, to soup to entree, each one was better than the rest.  I can't wait to come back.
name: Art

text: I expected more flavor from such esteemed creators but I found the flavor lacking. The ambiance is cool and they took care of us being a very large group but it just didn't blow me away. Glad I can say I went tho!
name: Daniel

text: Push you hard to buy more food. Khobedeh was dry. Since we split food, they charged extra $3... what? Made no sense.  If this place was in any where else but Reno, you know what authentic mediterrnian taste like. table was so unstable - all my water spilled. Don't know why people are raving about this place.
name: Venny

text: It's not the best( as we can expect from IV food) and pretty expensive. But it can satisfy sushi cravings when you don't want to go downtown! The wait time is insane on weekends tho.
name: Ela

text: I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food was fresh and service was quick. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Pretty happy with it overall. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: The energetic feel of Suzy Wongs is unmatched! I came here with a group of 5 ladies from Chicago. We loved every second of it. We all really enjoyed our food! The breakfast burrito was everything I hoped it would be. Balanced flavor & just the right size! I wish I could have taken it home! The side of potatoes was very flavorful. The dishes complimented each other perfectly. The scrambled eggrolls were AMAZING as well! The show was very entertaining! Perfect for a girls trip brunch. I do wish the restaurant was more open, as when the dancer moved to the other side of the room, you could not see them. I also wish we knew ahead of time to bring singles to tip the dancers. All in all, the service was great, food incredible, & YAAAS QUEEN the dancers were on point.
name: Toni

text:
Was told about this place about a month ago and finally made it to Angelo's Pizza and the food was delicious!
5 The Communion - Fresh chicken cutlet, spinach, mushrooms, covered in white cheese sauce. Everything was Devine.
5 Upside Down Jawn w/Pepperoni- Thick Crust square pie pizza w/sauce on top of the cheese
name: Kathryn

text: Worth the wait.  Always a line, but great food.  Sweet potato pancakes and omelet, killer combo
name: Kyle

text: The food and service was awesome! I would highly recommend if you're looking for something to eat. I got the pasta bayou and it was truly delicious. And can we talk about the carrot soufflé, mannnn that thing was amazing! My group had a variety of everything on the menu and it was all great! The wait on a Friday afternoon was only about 15 mins for a party of 7. And the bow wow punch is truly all you'll need to get a good feeling going for the day
name: Taylor

text: My cousin made a really good selection today when choosing Riccobonos The crowd was behing me as we walked in as the lunch crowd started to flow in. My Mom was in the mood for Breakfast and after hearing about the Special, "Chili cheese  Omelet " so was I. Home made Chili was not the thick kind but very flavorful. The Potatoes were cut thick and were crisped up on the grill before serving. Honestly I would go back for the Potatoes. Maybe add some cheese sour cream and a  bit of that Chili. I don't know if that's on the Menu  but it should be. I had them to put the Biscuit on the grill, and if you get to this spot you should do the same. You can thank me later. My Mom had Fish and grits. An ample serving of Catfish from what I saw. I tasted the fish and to be honest it was nothing special but she enjoyed it . She doctored up her own Grits, which honestly is how it should be done. Service got slower as the crowd poured in but it was understandable.  I've never had to wait to pay that long before lol. Nice neighborhood place that is a bit out of the way for Tourists but loved by locals. I would go back in a heart beat!
name: Brian

text: Eat here and don't think twice. Cute atmosphere with really good food. I had the crab omelette and the BF had Montana breakfast and we split the the pain perdu which was amazing. I went with the biscuit over the toast which was homemade and amazing.
name: Stacy

text: Their menu talks a big game but it just wasn't a good experience. The Hoppy Trails beer was flat and tasted like something I made in my Mr. Beer kit ten years ago. The bean burger was mushy. No one else at the table was impressed with the food or beverages. The servers need better training too. The hosts were awkward and the server struggled with simple questions about the drinks. Our order had mistakes and it took too long to run our card. The atmosphere is nothing to get excited about either. I had been excited about another brewery in town, but I won't go back. There are better options.
name: Willi

text: I mean.... It's bowling.... I don't know what else to say about it lol
name: Melody

text: Tamale masa so good you can taste the corn. Next time, I'm ordering the fish tacos because everyone in the restaurant was eating them. Corn tortillas are homemade. Coming back next time I'm in Tucson.
name: David

text:
Little Donut House is definitely a good description not only for serving mini donuts but because the menu for donuts here is little lol. This is a modern cafe that just happens to also serve little donuts. The choices are predefined so there is no make your own options.

The staff is very friendly and I like that they offer the free 3 pack. However it did take a while for me to get my 3 donuts. I didn't order anything else, it wasn't busy and the person who ordered after me got a drink and sandwich order completed before me. However I didn't complain because, hey it was free, and maybe that person called ahead. I also rationalized that the donuts were being freshly prepared so it'd be worth the wait.

When I did get my donuts I have to say I wasn't that impressed. My cinnamon sugar donut was cold, still tasty, but it made me think if the donuts weren't fresh why it took so long. The other two donuts - Reese's and Cookie Dough - were packed with toppings so much so that honestly I didn't even taste the donut base. All in all it wasn't bad but I think there could be some tweaks made. I'm giving three stars for the decor, nice staff, and the lunch/breakfast items looks good enough to give a try.
name: Phylisha

text: Great experience at the Tucson Cheesecake Factory tonight!  We were seated within minutes.  Our server Catarina was very attentive!  She did an exceptional job!  I ordered the California Guacamole Salad and my husband ordered the Cajun Chicken Fingers.  Both meals were fantastic!  We will definitely be returning to this restaurant!
name: Lisa

text: Unbelievably great food in a really unassuming place. Had the Louie burger - delicious, high quality patty seared to perfection. The Rip fries are also amazing. Go here. Do it. Do not delay.
name: Jennifer

text: Great prices here for excellent food! This will be my got-to Mediterranean restaurant! They even didn't hesitate to substitute the pita chips for cucumbers. Excellent service.
name: Apple

text:
Just the other day I tried Poke King for the first time. I must say I really enjoyed it! 
Being my first time I didn't know anything from what I'm allowed of what's offered, but the staff were very nice and knowledgeable I got everything I wanted in my bowl and it was FRESH! 
Next time I will get a regular size bowl, because the large was waaay to much unless you plan on sharing or have starved yourself for such much food! 
This place is highly recommended for its flavor and hospitality. 
Price wise ... it's dependent on the market for fresh fish I'd say. You want good quality food you might as well be paying for it too.
name: Jeremy

text:
Our first visit may be our last. Most things weren't bad (some were) but the ones that weren't bad were unremarkable.
The good:
The staff. Friendly and efficient.
The pulled pork was decent. Nothing wrong with it, but nothing outstanding, either. No unique or outstanding flavor. Just...decent. The sweet tea was such-in-your-cheeks sweet, and that's exactly how my wife likes it. The hush puppies were good. I liked them just fine. My wife thought there were pieces of onion that were too big. Either way, they were tasty. The potato salad was fair -nothing to write home about. The Brunswick stew was tasty, but more of a loose soup than a stew. 
The bad:
The smoked turkey. A little bit of smoke flavor, but unless someone with knowledge can prove me wrong, this was lunchmeat turkey (think Boar's Head) cut thick, not natural turkey breast. The texture was rubbery and off-putting. 
The sauces: The sauces we're at a "sauce bar" - no sauces at the table. There flavors were okay. Hard to review, as this is up to the individual pallette. The sweet was sweet, the smoky was smoky, etc. However, the bar is a fail to me. I had to wait behind someone who was getting little cups of a few sauces to try - no biggie, I was going to do the same. But I had to wait while this guy finished, the person behind me had to wait for me to finish...if they had been busier, I can't imagine how long the wait would get for a bunch of people that just want to eat. Everyone else I can think of puts their sauces on the table. There's a reason. It works.
Overall, this wasn't bad, but there just wasn't anything that would compel us to go back, and a few things that would compel is not to. As with any business, I wish them well, but this isn't for me.
name: James

text:
(English) 
Drago's Seafood Restaurant is well known for their charbroiled oysters, which are pretty good, but not the best I have had. 

If you are going to Drago's you for sure need to try the Creamy Seafood Pasta is an amazing shrimp and crabmeat cooked in a delicate cream sauce with angel pasta and sprinkled with Parmesan & Romano cheese. (I bet your mouth is dripping right now because mine is!) Is a pretty large plate, so probably you can share one dish for two people. 

(Español)
Drago's Seafood Restaurant es muy conocido por sus otras a la brasa, que son bastante buena, pero no las mejores que he probado.

Si vas a ir a Drago's te recomiendo la pasta de mariscos (Seafood Pasta) cocinada con camarón y carne de cangrejo con una delicada salsa de crema con pasta de àngel y espolvoreada con queso partisano y romano. (Apuesto que ahora tu boca esta babeando porque la mía si!) Es un plato bastante grande, así que dependiendo de tu hambre puedas compartir un plato para dos personas.
name: Isabella

text:
No pizza specials. Decided to try this place again after 20 years of avoiding it b/c of the rudeness. Pizza was awesome the first day, went back next day to check the consistency of the pizza and was completely different than day 1. The pizza was decent to borderline good on day 2. 

Pizza is an art. Needs to be consistent. Can't have everyone making pizza their way...let's get back to Day 1 awesome and have a training with all the pizza guys or gals in the back. 

Btw, no specials. Did I mention that? People like pizza specials. Found it a little rude again. Probably why I stayed away 20 years. 

Has the potential though for outstanding pizza, but no one wants to buy two pizzas & pay close to $30 for two pies.
name: Johnny

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The staff seemed tired but still polite. It was crowded but still moved along. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Worth checking out. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
Harvest is our favorite restaurant in Newtown. 
Hands-down the healthiest and tastiest around with great service!
name: Mary

text:
I'm genuinely sad to write this review because I really want this place to be successful. The concept is fantastic, but extremely unfortunately, the follow through misses the mark altogether.
I've visited Butcher & Bee three times now, literally every time I've been in Nashville in the last two years, because the food is that high quality, and memory stays with you beyond the meal (hello whipped feta, I'm looking at you).
HOWEVER. The host & wait staff needs a massive overhaul. The haughty attitude I've encountered at this place is ridiculous and does NOT fit the atmosphere. As a quick example, my last meal here was this weekend, and Sarah completely forgot about us. I had one glass of wine prior to my meal, and my empty glass was taken from the table without inquiring if I'd like another one. This is vacation and mama wanted another sparkling beverage!
Shortly thereafter, our food was delivered, and we were never checked in on. She walked past our table several times, never making eye contact, and I watched amazed as she visited with a table next to us (I'm assuming they had a higher bill than our measly $65??) while our water ran dry.
I finally flagged down the host to ask if we could please get some attention, or at least water, and when she did come over, blamed another server for not checking in on us. 
The restaurant was half full, at best.
Again, this is just one example, the entire attitude needs a quick adjustment, as every time I've come, I've gotten the impression that they're doing me/my guests a favor by letting us dine in their better than establishment.
I truly hope the mgmt behind Butcher & Bee will take these reviews to heart (I've seen a few similar to the one I'm writing), and make a big change. In fact, Butcher & Bee, if you're reading this, please let me know when that change is made, because I doubt you'll be on my trip agenda a fourth time if things don't change.
Wishing for the very best and a swift turnaround!
name: Allison

text:
My second visit to Cozara after a first really good experience.  Can you believe it was even better the second time around?  Thanks to Jimmy, the manager, and our server (darn his name escapes me, young, good-looking male, good spirit and helpful).

Anyhow, it's about the food right..... come hunger, come with friends and stay and enjoy stepping out of reality for a while.

We started with the red dragon roll and a spicy crunchy tuna roll, both so fresh and full of flavor; however, the dragon roll for me was the winner of the 2.  And talk about a plated presentation, WOW.

My wife and I then shared an order of the Pork Gyoza, steamed with Chili Soy; was okay, wouldn't get again.  Just didn't have the wow factor.

The large fat pig ramen-- pork belly, black garlic oil, soft egg--- on the other hand, was a solid winner. We so very enjoyed the full flavor.  

We will be back again next time in that part of Philly.
name: Brian

text: Been to first watch for 20 years and their menu items are always good. This is a new location, on a weekend, parking will be a challenge because of small parking lot.  Instead of getting the usual, ordered two new items and they are very good and healthy.
name: M

text: Pizza is soooo good. Atmosphere is good too. It is the go to Friday night date spot! I could literally drink the ranch sauce. Definitely worth the experience!
name: Jordan

text: Still thinking about the white pizza I had last Friday. It was yummy. Scrumptious, in fact. Hit the spot. 10/10. Would go back.
name: Jess

text:
The food here is great. Burgers. Brussel sprouts. Fries. And even these new donut holes are fantastic. 

But the real reason they get 5 stars is because of their customer service. Long story short, there was a mishap which occurred and management offered me and my family a free meal. The manager Sarmad made sure my family and I wanted to return. The cashier gal Mira was a joy. 

We'll be back
name: Jay

text: Service and food was excellent on a beautiful summer night.  From the blood orange mojito, to the tomato, strawberry and watermelon gazpacho to the trout to the scallops special.  All outstanding in a beautiful setting.
name: Geoff

text: First night in Indy spent very well!! Delicious food, awesome drinks and some of the best service I've ever had! Thanks Kyler!
name: Emily

text: Excellent service & the food was delicious! I enjoyed the chicken Marsala, it's a sweet Marsala which was new to me, but a welcome experience! I liked the feel of the restaurant and would encourage anyone on the fence to give it a try!
name: Madison

text: This is the closest Vietnamese restaurant around my area. Pho is great for the price. The rice dishes are also great. I love there Thai tea, very tasty and sweet.
name: Phi

text: Ew, I do not want to be here. This casino is gross and the employees are the worst with customer service. Will never come back.
name: Ashley

text: Great atmosphere. Decor is perfect for NOLA. Godzilla soft shell crab and cornbread are amazing. Crawfish etoufee was good but a little pricey.
name: paul

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Hands down the best Cuban sandwich around! Marcus and his family run a great business and are very friendly. They have several sandwiches to choose from, as well as sides, sweets, and espresso if you need the extra boost. Definitely give them a try! You'll be hooked!
name: Josh

text: I have found my new favorite breakfast spot ! Shelly's was amazing. The customer service was spot on and made me feel super welcomed. The food was amazing and delicious! I came for the the beignet's and I was not disappointed at all! I highly recommend Shelly's !!!
name: Brittni

text: Johnny Grits is a really nice little place down town Main Street. They have all of types of different dishes. Their main dish of course are grits. You can add a number of things to the grits and it's very inexpensive. If you like grits that's the place to go
name: Ren

text: Longest line I've ever waited on, but it was worth the wait. Also the waiter ( don't remember his name) but he was very handsome and pleasant!!
name: Amanda

text: Excellent service and as always the best subs around. Fresh and delicious Jersey Mike's is my go to place for subs
name: Jamex

text: I used to love staying here.  The rooms are nice. But the new food court sucks ass.  Nothing but a bunch of low quality chain food places. Just like the food court in any mall in this country.  Pure Crap.  There used to be a couple of neat cafes and restaurants there before they fucked it up.  Very d
name: Ricky

text:
You have to park in the back when you get there. Only seating is outside. We ordered the two meat plates. I had white chicken is was a bit dry. This is why it was a 4* rating. I ordered the pulled pork to go with it. The sides I got was potato salad and collard greens. I shared a small cornbread. I got the tea which was good. I had peach cobbler for desert. The pulled pork comes with a bun and chicken with a slice of bread  truly an awesome soul food experience.  The other plate was Mac and cheese, coleslaw, ribs beef brisket, and sweet potato pie. Everything was very good the mac and cheese could have been just a bit better but was better than what I have had before. 
The plates were $11. + had to buy deserts extra, and cornbread. The beef brisket and ribs came with bread also. They have very reasonable prices for the amount of food you get!  I will definitely go back again!!!
name: Keith

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Not bad for a quick meal. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Had the Cubano sandwich and it was excellent.  Seemed slightly over priced for the amount of food.  I appreciated that the cook was very interested in my opinion of the sandwich but I could not tell him that it was very greasy.
name: Paul

text: Twisty menu! Props!Lots of flavor, yet simplistic menu. I never went back after my salad was unedibly swimming in dressing. To be fair, I probably should have asked for it on the side.
name: Kirsten

text: Waited about 10 minutes for someone to take our order. No one was up there that whole time. When three of the workers finally came out they took the order of a person who came in after we did. We even tried to call while we were sitting inside there. No one answered. A few minutes after we called another person called and someone came running out to sender that phone call. Very disrespectful. Worse service I've had.
name: Annabelle

text: We absolutely love dining here. Food was phenomenal, drinks even better and the service exceeded our expectations. We enjoyed a late brunch and look forward to returning soon!
name: Amy

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. Honestly, really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. maybe I just came on an off day.
name: User

text: The chicken fried chicken blew me away. The ribs were good. I liked this restaurant enough to go back a 2nd time while on vacation in Nashville. Then we tried the piggy Mac and the brisket cheesesteak. Both were fantastic.
name: Jed

text: Over the Christmas holiday, we went to a play that ended at 8:45 pm. The play gives you a 10% discount for the Weber Grill, so we decided to take advantage of the discount and we are SO glad we did. We got to sit in a really comfortable booth in the bar area. It was so cozy and comfortable. We had filet mignon and beer can chicken, both of which came with garlic mashed potatoes. My husband had a wonderful Chicago beer and I had a really great brewed coffee. We also had pretzel rolls with cheddar butter. The meal was sooooo good. Our waiter was one of the best we've had in a long time. We will definitely return to eat here!!
name: Deborah

text: This place is a great little gem the wife and I found. They have many coffee drinks to choose from. Frozen, iced, hot, it is all your choice. They also offer different food items including unique popcorn flavors. I have gotten the frappe with the super long name both times and really enjoyed it (I can't remember the name exactly but you will know what I am talking about as soon as you see the list.) The lady behind the counter is super friendly and the store has a great coffee shop atmosphere. If you are ever in the area I suggest you give this place a look.
name: Ronald

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It was crowded but still moved along. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: Holy! moly! this place is amazing! big portions and the take out containers are clean and microwavable, The staff are friendly and make the experience well worth the visit. The hummus is creamy and the platters are plentiful , with lamb and steak. Taztiki sauce was thick i wasn't too keen on it but the hummus was spot on and the pita bread was grilled nicely. the stuffed grape leaves were alsd fantastic. On a Saturday they got pretty busy early and they still handled the rush well. I was waiting for this place to open and i must say i was impressed they didn't dissapoint.
name: Julio

text: Albeit a 'fast' food restaurant, exceptional flavor/quality. I had the double beef burger with fries/lemonade. My companion had the same, all for $20.  Hard to beat.  Going to give the barbecue a try next time.
name: R

text: We ordered dinner to be delivered to our hotel. Spare ribs (much too sweet and five-spice overpowering the ribs) egg rolls (fine), steamed dumplings (flavorless) and a few mains that were  nothing special. The food was delivered hot but since they forgot napkins and utensils (really!!) we had to scrounge for them downstairs while the food cooled. We agreed that there would be no reason to try New China again.
name: B.

text: My wife and I took a tour of St. Louis Cemetery No. 1, which you can't see without a tour guide. Robert, from French Quarter Phantoms, was entertaining, incredibly knowledgeable, and able to answer every question our group through at him. I can't recommend tours with him highly enough. Great time.
name: Dan

text: I had the seafood risotto, it was alright.. For a cocktail I went with the Blackberry Smash, it was really strong and I couldn't taste anything other that the vodka. It looked pretty but wowza with the taste. My husband has the lasagne and he said it tasted like Chef Boyardee and the portion size was for a skinny woman. They seated us right away and we sat on the patio with a heater. That part was nice.
name: erica

text: While the reservation was easily made and we were seated quickly, the crowded array of tables made the surprisingly high price tag a surprise. This was our first time visiting and will probably be the last.  It's primarily a bar for those who equate price with quality.  The food is very ordinary and exceedingly over priced, especially since you rub elbows with the next table's occupants.  The cocktails were equally expensive and watery.  The wine, while good, was served in a small glass that was barely 1/3 full; OK for a big glass, but not for the one I received, especially at $12.00. If you don't get an appetizer, you will leave hungry.  The place is pretentious.
name: JD

text:
They have a large raw bar display in the middle of the restaurant. It is not a large place and it did get a bit noisy although you could still hear table conversation. 
The table next to us got the raw bar sampler which came out in a 3-tiered plate and looked quite impressive. They seemed to enjoy it. 
I had the shrimp and grits which was excellent and the Flammenkuchen, which was like an onion pizza - it was actually quite good, but a bit much for one person. The bread they serve is freshly made. The service was quite attentive and the waiter made excellent suggestions for dinner. 
The bread pudding was also excellent for dessert.
name: Joe

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I left full, which at least counts for something. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: i was staying Florida for a nice winter vacation and i ordered this pizza and it took two hours for them to get me my pizza! the Stromboli wasn't even cooked all the way!! the women didn't even go to the correct building, my pizza was cold, it was expensive also, then i had to warm it back up before i could even eat it! very unprofessional!!
name: Catie

text: I've heard about this place from someone at work. Been wanting to try it for a long time. So glad I did. Pizza was excellent. Had an opportunity to speak with the owner. What a great guy! Will definitely be back.
name: Constance

text: Best breakfast I had in years. Homemade bread is the best. Very friendly staff. Great variety . Very affordable. Will be back for sure.
name: Marta

text: Nneoma was our waitress and she's such a sweet heart. Fast service. Eggs were a little cold. But other than that great place
name: Gianna

text: For the price I expected a little more care. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Food was good and came out fast. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Got the best tender smoked chicken breast, greens, yams and Mac and cheese. Everything was seasoned to perfection. Def coming back here weekly!!!!
name: Tara

text: Everything was delicious! First of all, free and delicious chips and salsa is always a win in my book. I had the grapefruit shandy which was amazing and I tried my friends blood orange margarita which was also amazing! Then I had the carne asada tacos which were so good and flavorful and paired well with my drink! I love the patio area in the warmer months. Would 100% recommend and I look forward to going back!
name: Krystalynn

text: Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better online than it did in person. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: All the guys were in the mood for burgers, so we ended up at this hipster burger joint. The atmosphere and decor was spot on. Two of the guys ordered Bison burgers and they loved them. I ordered the Thai Chia with an impossible burger instead of the quinoa. Everyone at that the table was completely satisfied. I would highly recommend it if you in the Midtown area. The only reason for the 4 stars is because it's definitely a little over priced.
name: Having

text:
After year end closes out at my company each year I'm in charge of planning the party to celebrate. This year I chose a private dinner at Anthony's Chophouse. According to myself and my co-workers this was the best event we've had for our year end celebration since I've been in charge of the planning! 

Anthony's Chophouse requires a limited menu if you have over 15 guests. We had 20 so we had to go with the limited menu. I think some of us were disappointed in that because we had our hearts set on items that were off menu, but understandably it is a more efficient way to provide great customer service. 

We started with a few appetizers - the Broiled Goat cheese, pickled tempura cauliflower, and bread & butter. All of them were delicious but the tempura cauliflower was the real winner for me! So delicious!! Next were the salads. I went with the wedge salad and it was very filling. I enjoyed the different textures within the salad. 

On to the entree - We had the choices of the Petite Filet, Salmon, or Ribs. I went with the filet but apparently the ribs were the real star of the show. My co-worker said they were the best ribs she's ever tasted. The filet was very delicious, almost melted in your mouth. It was cooked perfectly. As sides we had the mushrooms & spinach, smashed yukons, and creamy mac. The spinach and mushrooms could have used a touch more seasoning, but the smashed yukons and creamy mac were so tasty. 

Finally we ended with the bread pudding and I thought it was delicious. I'm reading on the menu that it comes with whipped cream - we didn't get any of that with ours. But the bourbon salted caramel was perfect with the bread pudding. My only complaint was that there wasn't enough sauce. I will note that while I thought the bread pudding was good, about half of our group said it was horrible. 

Now onto the BAR! First off, the bar upstairs in the private event room is such a cute antique. I'm obsessed with it. The bartender was so great and patient, we really worked him! The cocktails were great, but the wine selection was even better. 

Overall, the food was good, service and atmosphere were excellent. I will definitely be back!
name: Kristin

text: One of the best places in STL!!! Such a fun and welcoming environment, every time I come here I try something new and never once have I had a bad experience- food or customer service wise!! The food is soooo good, like so good. The staff is beyond amazing, if you're looking for a nice little bar/restaurant I HIGHLY recommend CPG. Always on point with specials. The beer list is always changing with new fun beers around STL and don't even get me started on the cocktails... absolutely incredible!! Huge whiskey/bourbon selection if you're a fan! Definitely check them out if you haven't!
name: Sarah

text: 3 Star food particularly for the $$$. Knocking off one star since I got food poisoning from the raw tuna. So painful!! I'll admit I have a weak stomach though but still, the quality here is suspect and I will never return.
name: Tony

text:
So well done.
Love the pink lantern lights.
Love the communal business model, with the  unique ( and so playful!)  ice cream spot and Dune Coffee  Cafe ( Yay, coffee is present!).  
Very warm and cozy inside. Outside table area is whimsical and comfortable too. 
Excellent, attentive service. I really appreciate the  friendly smile of the guy who took my order the other night.  He was so calm,  it was easy to forget the long line behind me for a moment!
On super busy days/nights the seating ( you seat yourself) is  a bit challenging,  but there is a good flow and before you know it, you and your pals will be digging into steaming beautiful bowls.
Menu is clear and pretty simple. Not too much. Wonderful that there is a lot of organic, local, and sustainable. If you eat meat and seafood, you are set here. A few vegetarian/vegan options. Coconut rice  comes in cute little wood huts.   But I do wish there were a few more  menu options for people who do not eat much meat or coconut.  I would be here  a lot more often! 
But,  bravo. Very, very, well done.
name: Felice

text: I only come to this Bdubs because it's the only one somewhat close. Terrible service every time.
name: Steve

text:
I have passed this place a couple times but never had the time to stop for lunch.
Thank goodness that changed, and I dropped on in.
Located on double R Blvd, in a industrial park, parking was a breeze.
Lunch at this restaurant is very busy. There are about 13 tables and a bar area with stool seating.
There was a line the whole time we were there.
When you enter, you proceed to the the front counter , where the menu board is hanging.
When you order, and pay you proceed to the seating area and your meal is brought out.
I ordered a combo of a enchilada and chile relleno.
The chicken enchilada was delicious with just the right amount of red sauce. The chicken and cheese inside were wrapped in a corn tortilla.
The chile relleno was also delicious. It was huge. It seriously could have been a meal by itself.
The chile was very mild but full of flavor and cheesy goodness.
This is totally a blue collar workers restaurant, but I love it.
Definitely will be back
name: Peter

text: Cute little joint with super friendly staff, good food and cold beer. We had the croquetas which we a perfect salty and crunchy snack to go with our beer. I highly recommend. Wish we had room for more of their food as it all looks good. If your adventurous they have beef tongue on Saturdays!
name: Emily

text: If they had 10 stars I would give it!  I had a good size catering order on the 3rd of July that was phenomenal...hands down best Chicago style chicken around...and they had it ready on time!  What?!?!! For those who love to host but don't want to cook everything...there is a known stress that comes with planning and timing food for pickup.  You know having everything go as planned a 1/2 hour before 'go time' is virtually unheard of...the fact that they were so helpful and made sure every was correct for us really goes a long way.  I will definitely use them again for catering our events; there will be a repeat appearance at our annual fireworks party next year for sure
name: Ro

text:
The margarita pizza in Sicilian style: dough is thick but soft, nice crispy bottom and side crust. Good amount of tomato sauce. Very filling.

Veggie pizza: good amount of veggies and not overly cheesy.
Cheese pizza: good amount of cheese.
Both has nice crust, not hard or dry.

Garlic Parmesan wings are delicious: the Parmesan gives an umami flavor. 

Chicken salad is pretty big. Good amount of chunky chicken. Chicken was juicy and tender.
name: Retna

text:
Biscuit Love offers good southern biscuits.  And while I liked the biscuits and the friendly service, I'm not sure if I'd wait in a 30-minute line again for the biscuits.  

We tried the East Nasty biscuit sandwich, which is a biscuit with fried chicken, cheese and sausage gravy--the sausage gravy was so good and may have been my favorite part of the dish.  I also ordered an a la carte biscuit, which is apparently a different kind of biscuit (the "family reserve" biscuit rather than the "buttermilk" biscuit served with the East Nasty) than the biscuits served with the sandwiches, which was good, but I'd say that I liked the buttermilk biscuit better than the a la carte family reserve biscuit--the family reserve biscuit wasn't quite as big or crispy.

As for the line, we arrived a few minutes before 9 a.m., waited in line and then ordered at the counter about 30 minutes later.  Our food then came out about five minutes after we ordered.
name: Jackie

text: Continually impressed by this place. We've been for dinner and brunch now and both experiences were wonderful. The service is great, atmosphere is relaxed and quieter than most Nashville restaurants which is nice when you want to have a conversation over dinner. And the food is delicious. Can't wait to return!
name: Kristy

text: I was hanging in Trendy East Passyunk.  I guess trendy means you're trying to separate yourself from the traditional Philadelphia cheesesteak stereotypes. Plenty Cafe had the closest thing to a cheesesteak so I went in there. Much to my surprise and delight they serve alcohol. I excited so I was having a hard time using my inside voice. Apparently excited loud talking at the end of the bar in a small cafe is more offensive than breastfeeding in the middle of a small cafe. It was a very good sandwich. Their version of coleslaw was tangy, tasty and plentiful. The baguette was crispy. The brisket was good but not a whole lot of it. My beer was $8. Overall good experience. I got to have lunch with my younger daughter. Almost forgot my side/garnish salad was amazing with their version of coleslaw on it.
name: James

text: This place is right on the Pinellas Trail, making it a favorite stop for bicycling groups and individuals.  There is outdoor seating (good for sweaty people).  Dogs are given water bowls.  The smells coming out of this place draw you in...so delicious!  The food has a Mediterranean lean with roasted peppers and feta cheese and oregano..so good!  A frequent stop for me.
name: Su

text: Absolutely loved this place.  The lasagna was one of the best I've ever had.  Creme Brule was perfect.  The healthy choice shinny pasta with chicken was fabulous.  The service was a bit slow, but they were busy.  Gave us a chance to enjoy the atmosphere.  Left singing "Our Italian Restaurant".  Will definitely be back!
name: Tami

text: Excellent! Wine list is solid. Service is attentive. The Osteria Salad is almost a meal and not to miss. The Tortelloni may be one of the best dishes of the year for me. The calamari is unique and super spicy. This was a great choice!
name: Craig

text:
Awesome place to watch an Eagles game or enjoy a bite to eat with a group of friends. The Tradesman's somehow makes classic barbecue feel upscale and refined in a subtle way. 

The atmosphere is boisterous and fun, and the food is even better. We had the cheese plate to start. It featured 3 delicious cheeses, sour cherry jam, local honey, apples, crostinis, and pickled red onion. The pairings were delicious. 

We also ordered the ribs, pulled pork, Mac and cheese, and potato salad. The highlights were definitely the ribs and the Mac and cheese. The ribs were perfectly tender and fall-of-the-bone. I appreciate that they provide a basket of different sauces to put on the meat. The combination of the sweet sauce and the Carolina vinegar was killer on the ribs. The Mac and cheese is perfectly creamy. 

They have a pretty extensive draft list, with lots of happy hour specials. This is a great edition to the Philly food scene!
name: Ally

text: I'm a dietitian so I may be little biased, but this place is amazing!! I've gotten the chicken teriyaki bowl and the breakfast bowl. I've also tried the edamame dumplings and the kale guacamole. Everything was perfectly seasoned and also the perfect portion. Absolutely delicious and I love how Dr Weil (the founder of the chain) is so dedicated to quality of food he serves. Can't wait to go back!! Tip-the valet can get pretty backed up, which leads to long waits. Just park in the garage.
name: Christi

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: I went in for lunch... i love supporting new food spots and i always wondered about the location. My thoughts while looking over the menu was "High high priced catfish". It was good, perfectly dusted and fried... but the minimum item on the menu is $17. I just can't do that... especially when there are no other specialty items on the menu. Naa. 4 stars because they are what they say they are.
name: Tquari

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: I placed an order To Go for a Lobster Salad and Fish & Chips. The salad had approx 1/4 cup of Langostingo; no dressing and no bread. The chips in the fish & chips were cold and hard. All this for $38! I will NEVER go back and highly recommend that you don't waste your money or your time. There are other restaurants in Reno that serve much better seafood.
name: L

text:
First off the name of this spot is too good! I love a good pun! 

If you're planning on visiting, make sure to get there early because the donuts sell out FAST. They open at 6 am and my party and I arrived at around 8:30 or so and most of the donut were already sold out. Thankfully we did get some of the most popular flavors and they were delicious! 

Chocolate chocolate chip: chocolate cake donut, with chocolate chips and chocolate drizzle. If you're not a fan of rich chocolate then I wouldn't recommend this one. It's pretty sweet and the donut part is quite dense. Still delicious- especially since I love chocolate! 

Blueberry cheesecake: this has actually cheesecake at the bottom. Out of all the donuts this was my least favorite. There was something missing from the cheesecake portion of it. It was still tasteful but it was a slight miss for me. 

Maple bacon: by FAR the best one. The sweet and salty is my favorite combination. If you can only get one, this would be it! 

Lemon lavender: I was surprised by how much I enjoyed this one. It was just enough lavender to taste it but it wasn't overpowering. 

Turtle: I was expecting this one to have a bit more caramel on it but it was still delicious! Chocolate cake with chocolate and walnuts on top. 

Chocolate chip cookies: this one had actual cookie dough in the center. If you're not the biggest fan of fancy intricate toppings then I would try this one. It had light icing and a minimal amount of chocolate chips on top. 

I'll definitely be returning if I'm ever in the STL again!
name: Eleni

text:
Korean food is trending. Mexican food in trending. Korean Mexican fusion is definitely trending. When people talk Korean Mexican fusion in St. Louis, I hear people raving about Seoul Taco and Kimcheese, which are both great places. But really I think more people should be talking about Kalbi Taco Shack as an excellent option for fusion in the city. It's located on Cherokee Street, hidden among the variety of vintage stores that Cherokee is known for. 

What differentiates Kalbi from the rest to me is the addition of Bahn Mi. I've actually only tried the Bahn Mi here, but the same marinated meat is used in all of their options. I also am not adventurous and opt for the same meat (spicy pork) every time, because I am in love with the way that they season their pork.

So in short, try the spicy pork bahn mi. It's pretty darn good.
name: Rebecca

text: Can't believe I just tried this place a few days ago! I have really been missing out since the food is DELICIOUS. Came for an office birthday lunch and I ordered the crispy oysters entree from the lunch menu. The entree is served in a bowl with fried oysters, shrimp, and lump crab in a flavorful sauce with a scoop of white rice. I also had the mango coconut sticky rice which was yummy and I am still craving it today. The service was great and efficient for our large party. Met the owner, Diana, who is a sweetheart. I will be back next week!
name: Saima

text:
I've been going to this starbucks for nearly three years and 99% of my experiences are great. Being attached to a hotel means there will always be lines and the staff handle them with speed and accuracy.

I'm not sure why, but Starbucks coffee tends to always taste burnt, so I still with the various tea and non coffee drinks they have. Matcha latte, passion tea lemonade, you name it and they can whip it up. Freaky limited edition drink? Make it a venti.  Are you craving 12 cake pops and an order of egg whites? They will hook you up.

The only downside about this site is they don't accept Starbucks's rewards or special promotional deals, like happy hour, so plan accordingly.
name: Candice

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: This is a great neighborhood bar with a great restaurant. Delicious hamburgers and a shrimp mango salad that is very tasty. Nice sized portions and reasonable prices.
name: Susan

text: If you're on this side of town and want Panda Express, I assure you it is worth the drive to head to ANY other location. This Panda rarely has things stocked but today I came in with my girlfriend to give it "One More Shot". Boy was that a mistake!! It started when I was told the only side they had was fried rice because they were out of chow mien and white rice and "weren't going" to make more. Then they were out of the Beijing Beef (my usual). Finally, my girlfriend wasn't able to order spring rolls because...YOU GUESSED IT! They were all out. To top things off we were helped out by a girl named Lubia who couldn't have had worse customer service. I get that people have tough days at work, but this was just beyond ridiculous. At least TRY to act like you don't hate every customer who comes through the door Lubia...So, if you are in the area and really want panda, please, for your own good. Drive the extra 10 minutes to the El Con location. They will actually have the food that is on their menu and you will be treated at least halfway decent.
name: Cameron

text: Would probably stop in again if nearby. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was good and came out fast. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Went for my son's birthday and was really looking to take him somewhere special. NaBrasa did not disappoint! The food was phenomenal, and the service was outstanding. They remembered how we like our steak, and would come around offering us what we had specifically stated we liked. Our table host kept referring to my son and remembered it was his birthday which was great! I highly recommend and can't wait to go back.

text: If you want to leave hungry, be sure to come here.  The fajitas for two were more like fajitas off a children's menu.  Decor was nice, but portions resulted in us never coming back and telling 100 people along the way.  No service recovery from manager.  Take a pass if you want real Mexican food.
name: Brian

text: This place is always a stop when we're in Tampa and that says something because we like to try new places. The fresh salsa and chips can only be improved by the table-side guacamole prep which we skipped this time because it was a late dinner. My wife's skillet carne asada was big enough to be enjoyed by my kids too and I had the always filling and delicious tortilla soup. Their LIIT is always spot on and you have to have a margarita, my wife's classic was just right. Great service (really fast) and the dolls and churros at the end are always a treat! Enjoy!
name: David

text: The Fat ChickeN, hmmmm what caN I say! THEIR FOOD IS DELICIOUS, just down right GOOD!!! I call and come all the way from North Philly to purchase their dishes. They prepare the chicken right when you order, the flavor and crunch is their OwN. LoVelY.
name: Raymond

text:
Came here last Saturday for a birthday dinner and had high expectations, based on our last meal at Rooster. I still believe it's one of the best restaurants in Tampa Bay but the cookery on this night was bad. The tasting menu consisted of mostly fried food, organ meat, and garnishes that were inedible.
The amuse had a dried out wonton wrapper that was difficult to cut though and just has hard to chew, followed by a crudités with a fried tuiles on top, that when chewed, that the consistency of plastic. 
This was followed by fried sweet breads, which tasted like fried anything ( not sure if this was a ploy to get people to eat there organ meat but it didn't taste of anything more than the breading and fry grease). Next course was fried mushrooms with a bunch of other tastes, but again, the star of the dish tasted oddly like the sweetbreads. 
The main course was a tiny piece of chicken thigh meat covered in ground liver meat which tasted muddied with a lack of any brightness to the dish. Then came a smoke filled container that contained the cheese course. Unfortunately, the cheese was so burnt that it altered the consistency , making it more like porous rubber than cheese, which wasn't good. Dessert was great.
I almost sad writing this because I wanted to love it. Our last trip to this restaurant was probably my favorite meal I have had in Tampa Bay and I left wondering why this was so bad. Even the restaurant smelled of fry grease when we entered the restaurant, which isn't good for a high end restaurant. We will be looking for a different celebration restaurant after this experience.
name: Sam

text: Absolutely beautiful venue - extremely welcoming staff.  Food was SO delicious and quality was perfect.  They were so helpful with my son... he saw a water melon slice on my sangria and really wanted one... the server went and grabbed one for him!  Parking wasn't bad either surprisingly... street parking but was available around 7 ish.  Would definitely go again!

text:

text: My hubby took us here for our 12th anniversary. We were excited to try it out. We started off with the Buffalo Salmon Sliders. The salmon was nicely cook. text: I could drown happy in that roast beef debri gravy every day!  Onion rings - check!  The Ferdie Po'Boy - check!  Yes, the salads are great too, but you must eat here for the Po Boys and you'll ask yourself why not before.
name: Amanda

text:
I had dinner here the other night with colleagues who were visiting from out of town and staying at a nearby hotel.   Yes, it is pricey, and there are so many good restaurants in Indy, that I always thought of this as a "business traveler" establishment or perhaps somewhere folks who aren't downtown much, go for high-end flown-in seafood for a special event, and so had never been here before.    

The cocktail list was impressive.   I decided on a stout old fashioned and it was excellent.   Rye with stout syrup definitely a good combination.   The wine and beer list was impressive as well.   

I then moved on to a cup of the clam chowder which was rich and delicious.   There were lots of tender clams and the sourdough bread served to the table went very well with this.   

For my entree I had the chef's preparation of Copper River Salmon.   Since this is only around for a short time each year, I always gravitate toward it when it is available because it is so amazingly flavorful.   The baby zucchini, trumpet mushrooms and apricot sauce went with it perfectly without upstaging the fish.   

We shared some sides including the lobster mac and cheese, which was decadent and included large chunks of lobster.    The hash browns and asparagus were delicious as well.  All sides are meant to be shareable.

We then shared some desserts including a piece of key lime pie, a chocolate torte, and baked Alaska which was flamed on the table for a fun end of meal show.     All were wonderful and each was shareable for at least two and maybe three people after a big meal.   The baked Alaska had a wonderful lemon flavor, the key lime pie was the perfect balance of sweet and tart and the chocolate torte was rich and wonderful.  

Our server knew the menu extremely well, and was able to talk about and answer questions about everything.     Courses were nicely paced allowing time to enjoy each course and visit.   

They do have valet parking, but I just parked at the mall a block away for $3.   

As a throwback, in addition to the dark paneled interior, they have boxes of matches along with mints at the host desk.  How long has it been since you've been somewhere with boxes of matches?   

Yes, this is a splurge restaurant, but the quality is excellent, and it is definitely not just a place with prices set to soak out of town business people.   Prices were comparable to other high end seafood restaurants and less than the steakhouses.   I'm glad I had a chance to challenge a very incorrect assumption!
name: Ann

text: Hungry from a long trip up from DC, my wife and I decided to stop someplace to grab a quick bite to eat. We haven't been in this area for quite some time so we were astonished at all the new establishments in the mall area. Choosing Smokey Bones (because I wanted some pork), seemed to be a good choice. With an open atmosphere, it was down homey with a  touch of Philly. Claiming to be "starving" we order the sampler, because we weren't sure what we wanted to eat. It contained ribs, wings, sliced chicken breasts, potato wedges and sausage. The chicken breast was bland and tasteless, rubbery in texture and unappealing. The sausage was just okay. Nothing to write positively about and nothing to write negatively about. The wings were very tasty. They could give most local wing joints a run for their money. The highlight of the platter were the wet ribs. They were delightful! My wife and I both kicked ourselves for not getting a platter of those instead of the other protein choices. Slow cooked and tender, the meat fell off the bones. Our hands were sopping in a barbecue sauce that was just the right of amount of sweet and tangy. We both vowed we would come back and order just the ribs. They were worth it.
name: Weldon

text:
I came here last Friday night with a large group of about 12 people to celebrate graduation. We had made reservations about a month in advance and were given our own private dining room upstairs which was perfect since we tend to be a bit of a louder crowd.

Our server, Hailey did a great job!The food was delicious! Everyone enjoyed their entrees, ranging from steak to lobster! I ordered the Filet Tips Oscar and they were phenomenal. The asparagus were a little large for my preference, but they were cooked well. The steak and crab meat were good sized portions and the hollandaise sauce was the perfect compliment. I took our server's advice and ordered the Wedge Salad and Rustic Fried Potatoes. These were both pretty large servings, I easily could have split them with others at the table!

Over all, I would say this is a great family restaurant that can accomodate large groups and parties for great steak dinners! The only thing I would suggest is that they weren't quick to refill the beverages, there was plenty of water on the table, but often we waited a while to get refills on wine or mixed drinks. Maybe it was because we were upstairs and the bar was further away? I'm not sure. But I wouldn't even categorize that as a complaint as they worked very hard to keep us happy! I would definitely come back and recommend this to friends/family.
name: Adrienne

text:
Thanks Yelpers for guiding me here!  Coming off of a terrible head cold and an ugly Eagles win, Pho was the only cure.  Overall, Pho 75 did not disappoint on the simple chicken pho. 
The staff is welcoming and the food comes out fast. I prefer a scalding hot broth. This broth seemed to cool too quickly. However I did slurp every last drop of deliciousness!!
Too many Pho shops to try before picking a favorite. That said, Pho 75 is now "on the list"!
name: Adamal

text:
This review is for the All you can eat Sushi at the bar:

I've been here a few times and almost all the time, the rice portion is just too much that one roll can make you really full. My expectations had been so low coz the service too is really really slow...it's like "I gave you one roll and that should fill you up and you shouldn't be waiting for me to ask you for another one" type of service. BUT!!!! Last night was different! I tried them again coz my friend asked me to so I was just ok... (I also think they are the only sushi place that can serve until 10 pm). 
Sooo it was the first time I saw these amazing chefs, Joshua and Fred and they just flipped my expectations even with just one roll! The moment they asked me what I want in a roll (chaching!) It already made me feel special. Then they made the roll that I want sooo good (what rice?) and Bam! I was so impressed. They gave me the best sushi experience (tied with Hinoki). Needless to say, if you happen to drop by oceano, make sure to check them out, you will never be disappointed

text: Terrific service and great food! They roll the meanest burrito in town, Chipotle and Moe's can take a hike. Best salsa I've ever had

text: The food here is great. The prices are reasonable and I always have enough to take home for tomorrow. All pasta meals come with a decent size salad and two garlic knots. The salad is fresh and has tomatoes, onion, and black and green olives. The garlic knots are hot and delicious. This is real Italian unlike some other place that is always crowded and I don't know why! If you get a chance and want some real Italian, it's worth the drive. I doubt you would be sorry to eat here. Not a chain and the food is fresh! The waitress was beyond kind and excellent. We couldn't have asked for better. She even brought a large, free cannoli with spoons for all of us. It was a delicious surprise!

text: Omg!!! I love this place..Nice new gem at 6105 Delmar. It's clean!!! The staff is friendly!! The food is great!!! I had the pleasure of meeting the owner when I stopped in during lunch one day and he was AMAZING!!! I'm the person that likes to introduce others to what I enjoy so I took my sissy and she liked it as well. I had curry noodles minus the seaweed and the Melon soda! I love love love Melon soda and it's very rare to find it in a restaurant in this area. The atmosphere is very casual so you can be in jeans,sweats, or even a hoodie and still feel comfy. I think this would also be a good location for a small group since there are plenty of tables for seating options

text: There was quite a big expectation coming in due to the word of mouth reviews as well as the grand opening, forewarning this review was a month ago but sat in my drafts gotta love not having WiFi :). Anyways back to the food never order the loco fries the wings were cold and the fries were mediocre.
