Servers are almost all incompetent and they've forgotten parts or all of our order EVERYTIME we come, hostess forget takeout orders, and wait time for a drink last time i came was over 30 minutes. I can't say anything good about this place. I made a yelp account just to warn everyone how awful they are...

text:
We frequently go and grab some tres bon while at work for lunch.  I have to say, I have yet to have anything that wasn't delicious.  My favorite go to is the brisket sandwich.  The bread is buttery and toasted and there is a TON of brisket on the sandwich.  I've had it with the coleslaw which is delightfully light, the andouille mac and cheese (YUM) and today I had the fries (Ask for the special dipping sauce - it was PERFECT!).  

The owner who is there is really great, he's happy to help and make things as easy as possible.  You can see that this man puts his all into his work - everything is freshly made!  

My boss picked up a bacon wrapped tenderloin (stuffed with cream cheese and peppers) for Mother's Day and he said it was GONE in a flash before he even got to try it!  I'll def be putting that on my list for the next cookout I go to.  

Let the scent of the smoker lure you in! Located really easy to find at Little Farms and Jeff Hwy.  I highly recommend!

text:
My sister suggested this spot, she loves it! She's a vegetarian and has visited this restaurant several times. She suggested getting a platter that had samples of all of the different types of popular dishes. 

**If you've never had Ethiopian food, it is served with a type of bread and you scoop and eat. 

I wasn't a huge fan of the bread, it is sort of wet and whispy. But the dishes were amazing! The lentils, veggies, and curries were so flavorful. 

For the coffee ceremony, they roast the beans in a metal pot

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Anyway, delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. so yeah kind of mixed on it.

text:

The lentil soup was better for me, as it had quite a bit more flavor, and was quite spicy: maybe a bit more spicy than I prefer.  The chicken noodle soup was chunky: it had a lot of noodles and chicken, although the broth wasn't really anything amazing.

I'd eat here again, but it's not a must-try.

text:
We arrived 15 minutes early for our New Years eve reservation after receiving an email that morning threatening that our reservation would be cancelled if we were 20 minutes late.  We were told we would be seated in "a few" minutes.  With no place to sit we glided over to the bar and ordered what turned out to be a $20 (small) shot of Gran Marnier.   There we met another couple who had already been waiting 40 minutes for the seating prior to ours.  While waiting, they had noticed other customers coming in and being seated immediately.

Eventually, the other couple was seated and we waited our turn.  After what totaled a one hour wait we too too tired of other groups coming in and being seated immediately.  When I approached the hostess with this, she magically found an empty table for us.

The service was marginal, at best.  We had ordered the house-suggested wine pairings with our dinner.  When we asked about the wines our server knew nothing of them nor did she offer anyone who did.  The red was not served with our entree and we eventually had to flag down another server to fetch it.  My wife's lamb was cold. She asked for black pepper but our server did not return until our plates were empty and it was time to clear them.  The pepper never did arrive.

My wife went to the bathroom and one of the male guests was in the women's bathroom filming three of the girls there.  Yes, a guy photographing in the women's bathroom. 

We had paid for the upstairs after-party for New Years but left the overcrowded, overpriced drink venue in favor of a taxi ride downtown to "real Nashville". Sinema was easily the biggest waste of $400 I've ever experienced.
name: Brad

text:
I want to provide a fair and constructive critique in this review and based upon the overall experience I believe three stars is an accurate rating. 

To begin with, the service was okay. Our waitress didn't seem too enthusiastic to be hosting us this evening. I think if she simply introduced herself and said "my name is... I'll be serving/taking care of you all tonight" this would have started off the experience on a better note. Sometimes the service can psychologically make you feel as if the food was better than it possibly was because you were being taken care of in all other aspects (good timing to take order, positive attitude, smile, effort to do a good job and show you are truly trying). 

While I know this sounds pretentious, my wife and I recently moved from the Dallas/Fort Worth region where the metroplex has no shortage of great restaurants and Caffé Nonna simply disappointed in what we would find with similar reviews in DFW. Truthfully, we are both ignorant to the array of Italian restaurants in Nashville and in no way is the previous comment meant to suggest one city is better than the other as we absolutely love Nashville and the people here (why we moved here). With that being said this is coming from a place of tough love as Caffé Nonna has a lot of potential.

My wife ordered a fettuccine Alfredo (wasn't on the menu but they still made it so this was greatly appreciated) and the sauce had a nice creamy flavor and was enjoyable. I ordered the Lasagna Bolognese and flavor seemed to lack. Not much in flavor was popping through and it did not stand out from other Lasagnas. It wasn't bad but for the price I expected a better quality lasagna. 

This leads me to my next point: the price. We have had much more authentic, high quality Italian for the price in a more well kept ambiance. The booths and tables needed some restoration and with a little bit of updating, this cozy establishment truly has a lot of potential.

As mentioned above, with a few tweaks such as an increase in finer service, the price point matching the complexity and authenticity of the dishes and some investment in the tables and booths, Caffé Nonna has a lot of opportunity to become a truly great neighborhood Italian restaurant. For now, we will not be back but I hope this restaurant can make these improvements and to one day try Caffé Nonna again with a surprise at their ability to elevate themselves.

text:
Came in with a large group for my friends birthday. 

This place is very hipster chic. Casual decor with lots of colourful and interesting artwork on the walls. Limited space to you'll probably want to make a reservation. The menu, like the space is small,  but offers up some awesome choices including options for vegans and celiacs alike. The food is amazing and if it wasn't for a few hiccups I definitely would have given this place a five star. To bad you can't do a half star.

A few of us arrived early to get in some extra visiting and we shared a bunch of appetizers. The Appetizer menu is surprisingly cheap, but the food definitely does not reflect it. The nachos and cheese is only $4. And the cheese is so good you basically just want to tilt the bowl back and let it empty into your mouth. The nachos appeared to be Tostitos from the bag, but I could be wrong. The Edamame are a great choice for vegans and meat eater as well. They had a great day sauce on them with a sprinkle of black and white sesames. We also tried the deconstructed mozzarella sticks. Now if you are big on salty and sweet this dish has got you covered. Because not only do they deconstruct the mozzarella stick but the chief spins it on it's head by drizzling honey on top. My God, it was like going to melted cheese heaven, umm.

On top of that the drink menu is ever revolving and offers some very interesting choices on both cocktails and beer. I tried the LEGO my life and it was a super fun martini type cocktail. I also tried a sip of my friends sour beer. Now I'm not usually big on beer but I can definitely see myself drinking a whole can of that. The wine list was substantial sorted but my friend seemed happy with what they had to offer.

For dinner I tried the Salmon and Salami. I'm not good and making decisions so rather then read the description I just picked by the title. I was definitely surprised when the dish came out with sashimi style raw salmon but the dish did not disappoint. The sauce on the plate complemented the dish perfectly and the sprinkle of bits offered a nice change in texture except... when I got to about half way through the dish I thought one of the pieces of bits tasted off but wasn't sure. Then when I was about done on of the prices of nuts was definitely rancid. Ugg.

Also a couple at our table had ordered the charcuterie board to share. While everything on it tasted great they ended up needing more bread to finish the board. Unfortunately they ended up waiting for 20 minutes for the extra pieces. I guess they bake the mini little loaves fresh to order which is the reason for the long wait but when your mid meal that is a long time to wait.

All in all a fun time was held by all. Lots of interesting drink and food choices. Would definitely recommend and come again.

Update to the review below: I was contacted by Smashburger. They were super nice and apologized. I have enjoyed Smash burger frequently in multiple states. I will definitely go again. 

If I could give this zero stars I would. We had 40mins till we boarded a flight. This is the slowest location I have ever been, and it's in a location where speed is way more important. ITS AN AIRPORT!  I waited till my flight was boarding, sent my wife, who had the debit card we used,  10 minutes before so she could have room to store our bag and say I was coming. When final final boarding was called I asked for a refund on my card, and they wouldn't do it. Asked for cash and they wouldn't do it. The cashier said "You can come back with the card." I am in an airport catching a plane. I live 3000 miles away. When is that going to happen. With zero time to argue I ran to my plane and boarded just in time with no food and $30 less. I love Smashburger's food. It's gluten free options are so Amazing and being diabetic eating is important. But do no eat at this location unless you have 2 hours to wait. If you have an hour or so... go to Einstein's Bagel or McDonalds. Did we mention we were forced to purchase food on the airplane?  Diabetic and held hostage by this location who did not give us food OR money back. They could not have been more rude about it. 

This is not a rating on their actually food quality because I never was able to eat any of that.

text: A year or two ago this would have been a 5 star review. The Front Door has delicious pizza, my problem is with their hours. It used to be a place you could count on to grab a late night bite (10pm-1:30am), but not really anymore. More often than not when I stop in they have all their chairs up and tell me they're closing when I walk in. This has happened on a Saturday night when they are sure to get an influx of bar-goers cycling through for the remainder of the night. I'm not sure how they decide when to close, but it can't be based on how many people are downtown, because they close early on busy nights. After going in around 11pm on a Saturday and seeing them closing up for about the 4th time in a row of trying to go in, I think I give up. I really don't care for Wise Guys Pizza, but at least I can count on them being open late. I just feel like if you're in the heart of downtown, right next to all the busiest bars, you should be open when the people are out and about.

text:
For date night, I took my wife and our friends over to Hoss' after reading about them in the yearly Nashville burger contest. Overall, I am happy with them and would probably go again if I were nearby, but I wouldn't make a trip out to them. 

First, the really good. I loved the Red, White and Blue loaded fries with buffalo, ranch sauces and bleu cheese crumbles. My mouth is watering right now! So good. The regular fries were pretty good as well. 

The burgers, which were the reasons we went here, were ok - not great and not terrible. I expected massive cheese from the "loaded" description but it really didn't work out like that on our burgers. I didn't notice any cheese on one and the second had barely any that I saw. We tried two burgers: The Professor and the special (I forget the name). Both of them were bland in my opinion. Not because of a lack of seasoning on the meat, but the lack of toppings. The burger is fat and thick and the bun is even fatter. So to get a lot of flavor, in my opinion, you need a lot of toppings. Mine didn't have that. 

My wife and I got gluten free buns because we were splitting the two we ordered. We found them to be very dry. I know I should expect that from gluten free, but the buns are so large that it was overwhelming. 

So the blandness of the burgers plus the dryness of the bun wasn't a great mix for us. I'd personally like it better with a thinner bun and more toppings on the burger - even a non-gluten free bun should be smaller, in my opinion. Just to be clear: my friends also ordered the exact same two burgers on normal buns. They also felt they were ok, if a little bland, so my experience wasn't solely based on the bun. Is there a possibility that we just didn't get the right amount of toppings and that's why? Yeah, maybe. But all four of us felt the burger wasn't as good as Burger Up, Jack Brown's or Subculture (all favorites) even though we all felt it was good. 

We also tried the Cookie Monster shake. It was very sweet but not special for us. We didn't finish it. Not terrible or anything. But, just ok. It was a special flavor, so maybe a normal flavor would be better for us. However, I fully expect that a kid would love this. And they may be the target audience. 

I love and appreciate that the burger is local and responsibly raised. Thank you for that Hoss'! But I need the burger to be a little more flavorful to make the trip back regularly (about 30 minutes for me).

**I updated this review with more details after reading the owner's comment. I rated my visit a three. It wasn't great, but it definitely wasn't bad. I would eat here again and if I did I would personally not get a gluten free bun and I would ask for additional toppings if I didn't get enough. And I would absolutely get the Red, White and Blue fries!
name: Scott

text:

We couldn't just order chicken from a donuts shop, so we got a couple of donuts from their Hot Donuts selections. We chose Cookies & Cream and Strawberry Lavender. We both liked the strawberry one better, since it had better, stronger flavor. Cookies & Cream was good but didn't have much flavor.

text:
Located inside New Orleans International Airport. I waited at the counter here for almost EIGHT minutes! It's a pick-up & go spot...I walked into the adjoining restaurant to see if the person working g the counter was there...she was not.  Another employee walked around to the back area..nothing...finally since I was in no big rush...I just sat there.  Finally, the woman comes out and begins helping other people who had walked in.  Once I got to the counter, all I wanted was a manager's number...she never apologized, never explained why she wasn't at her post etc...
Actually had an attitude...like "How dare you bother me to work".  WOW!!!
name: Gwen

text: Waiter recommended all of our items and they were fantastic. It was very crowded, so reservations are suggested. Our party of 2 luckily found seats at the bar and had a number of the small plates. Brussel sprouts and raw tuna were both amazing
name: Jenn

text: Umm..we ordered fish tacos. They were yummy but I've made better. Service...Ugh where did our server go? Way relaxed vibe, a little Pineapple Expressy beach vibe which is cool and all (I mean I'm from Detroit-it's legal man ) but you gotta run your establishment still. Keep it groovin-keep it movin.
name: Lauren

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. A very pleasant experience. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text:
Take me back to rolling into Chipotle after chem lab. Take me back to hitting up this franchise for some group catering. Take me back to a burrito so big, you need two tortillas to wrap that monster. 

But please DO NOT take me back to this chipotle. This is just about the worst Chipotle I've ever had in my life. The rice was blatantly burnt beyond belief. Folks im not talking abt a few black rice pieces, Im talking spoons of brown overdone nonsense. Im talking crunching so loud youd think you were eating raw rice. The saddest part is that, it was so obviously burnt but they didnt have the decency to at least change it out.

Then came the sides/meats. Its a franchise, meaning there should be a straightforward recipe in place. For whatever reason that wasn't the case. Everything just seemed off and not reminiscent of the good ole Chipotle times.

Then the service. I was greeted quite rudely by a lady. No 'hi' or 'how are you doing' I wanted to ask for a tortilla to go but her attitude, suggested it might not go well.

Then icing on the cake, its more expensive then any other Chipotle Ive ever been to! You should not wat here so bang to buck is effectively 0.

Food-1/5
Bang:Buck Ratio-0/5
name: Shawn

text:
This place has become one of ybor citys main landmarks. The custom beers are the best in town 
And arguably the best in florida. The menu compliments the great beer selection and there's plenty of tvs in order watch the game if need be.
name: Francisco

text: Itchy salmon and blue balls -- real menu items, and both are really, really good to eat.
name: Hugh

text: Terrific pizza with good atmosphere. Very impressed by the wood-fired pizza. We got the Skyking and cheese pizzas and thought both were delicious. Pizza's are larger than personal size, but likely need two for couples to ensure there is enough. Definitely will be returning.
name: Ryan

text: My go-to lunch and brunch spot in Tucson! Great food, great staff and a great location downtown in the heart of town.
name: Patrick

text:
It wasn't good.
  - Biscuit was dry. I didn't even finished it 
  - I hated the sweet bacon. I feel like it should have been advertise. 
  - The rest of the food was at best average. 

Good service otherwise.
name: Kevin

text: A friend and I celebrated our birthdays at Cafe Marcel and were delighted with our experience. They had so many delicious options for sweet or savory crepes that we had a hard time choosing.  We ended up splitting the chicken pesto savory one and a lemon sugar, strawberry crepe for dessert. The special sauce that went with the chicken crepe was yummy! Although we opted for just water to drink, they have several delicious sounding coffees and teas as well.  I will definitely be back and highly recommend this restaurant to others. Christian and Sonia Carrington are doing a terrific job with this restaurant.
name: Joy

text: Hole in the wall from the outside, food paradise on the inside. Cheerful authentic Mexican food. Soccer  in Spanish is usually playing on a small tv in the corner. Very bright and colorful interior. Solid food. Affordable. Definitely worth trying this place out.
name: Sarah

text: It won't be long until this one is closed too, based of the service tonight. Too bad!
name: Angie

text: There is nothing worse than getting food to go and then not having any utensils included. Have no idea if the door is good because I can not eat it. Lame.
name: Bryan

text: Have to admit, when we pulled up I got nervous. It's not a real restaurant, it's %90 Market and %10 Restaurant. Most of the food is Take-Away. But being in a hotel, eating a bunch of crab was not going to work. They do have 4 little tables that you can use. Now... The food, amazing. Crab and shrimp and 1/2 Shell oysters we great. I'm not into fancy, and this fit the bill.
name: Mark

text: When I questioned whether or not a meal had been prepared gluten free, as requested, our server lied to the manager in front of us saying we hadn't asked about gluten and suggesting we be sure to bring it up next time.  As if someone with celiac would ever not ask about gluten. The manager did not seem concerned.  We paid for the meal, including the completely uneaten dish in question and left. Maybe it was prepared correctly, maybe it wasn't, but when someone is lies in a conversation that involves a food allergy, it's time to leave.
name: Roy

text: Awesome local place. Great food and price. Treated my family really well. We will definitely stop by every time we fly into New Orleans.
name: Adam

text: Service was quick and the staff is very friendly and helpful! Delicious pizza, definitely recommend if you want Neapolitan pizza in downtown Tampa!
name: Abigail

text: One of my favorite go to's. A great place to spend a date night. Great food, service and vibe. Pace yourself, enjoy a bottle of wine and all 3 courses. Bananas Foster is a must for desert.
name: Philip

text: Great selection and one of the only places that delivers to the local neighborhoods in west Bradford. Delivery is always on time. Pizza is surprisingly good and liked the cheese steaks. A Friday night staple for us. Recommend for take out or delivery!
name: Christine

text:
Stopped in to meet with a friend on a cold January afternoon. I had already had four cups of coffee and needed to decaffeinate. But I still wanted something hot. 
I am not a fan of most teas but Lori, the barista on duty, was so helpful in directing me to just what I was craving. A not-too-fruity pomegranate tea with a spot of honey. Perfect! I even had a second cup.
Lori recommended to F a black tea and delicious carrot cake. 
Everything was just what the doctor ordered.
name: Christina

text: Love everything about this place! Green juices and organic coffee on point. And the inside has a great vibe if you're looking for a place to get some work done.
name: P

text: Used to be one of my  favorite places however what the cost of the meals you would expect much better service as you would expect with other $100 a person restaurants it's a bit of a drive and it still has amazing crab cakes but unfortunately I would suggest picking them up to go
name: Michael

text:
We freaking love this place. 

Deep South Grand Mexican food spot that is affordable and delicious. 

The staff is always friendly and accommodating. Granted, it's a little out of the way, but it truly is a gem in south city. 

Recently, we stopped in on a Tuesday. Lindsey was our server. She is awesome. It's a good day to do so! $3 margaritas, count me in! Julia R got her usual bean and cheese burrito with a quesadilla. Lunch special #8 with a couple of modifications. And I got the chicken enchiladas entree. 

It was the perfect amount of food. I love that they use corn tortillas, too! It's a great way to spend a taco Tuesday!
name: Max

text:
I'm a huge fan of Blaze. The ingredients are fresh, the process is pretty efficient, and the flame-cooked method gives it a touch of authenticity. The pizzas are large enough to be shared between two moderately hungry people, or devoured alone if you're packing a big appetite. I also appreciate the quality of the crust, which is very important to any pizza lover. It reheats quite well in a cast iron. Blaze tries to accommodate a range of dietary needs, offering gluten free crust and vegan cheese. 

Anyone who tries Blaze should also grab a cup of their blood orange lemonade. Sometimes it's a little sweeter than I'd like, but it's always delicious. Surprise treat: I find their caesar salads to be pretty good.

Most recently, I was here for the Pi Day special, and I'd like to commend their staff for handling the massive lines so well. Aside from the wait, the whole process was smooth.
name: Amara

text: I'm not sure why this place has such good reviews. We tried it out today for the first time, and we left disappointed. The place was not very busy for noon on Saturday, and yet our food still took a long time (30+ min after we received appetizers). When the food came out, half of our burgers were cooked incorrectly with the wrong toppings or bun (mine came out lukewarm). Not sure if that was on the fault of our server or the kitchen, but either way, disappointing. The manager did come to apologize and they remade our burgers, but by the time we got them, the rest of our group had finished. The manager gave us a gift card for next time, so we will go back and see if things change. The fried pickles and French fries were amazing.
name: Megan

text: WOW! The price is high for sure, but it was so worth it. I went on a Sunday night and it was packed but I only waited about 10 min for a table. The clam chowder is probably the best I've ever had. All the food was fresh and didn't taste like normal "buffet food". My daughter is super picky so she loved that they had a "make your own pasta" area. You tell the chef what sauce, noodle type, meat or veggies and they make it right in front of you. The desserts were good, but I only really wanted cotton candy, and that was amazing!
name: Rachel

text: Just tried for the first time. The family company is sweet and caring. The coffee is not expensive and is delicious. I tried cold brew and iced coffee both amazing
name: Taylor

text: This place is great. Perfect seasoning. Seafood stuffed baked potato is a must. Creole fried  chicken wing app is best I have had in NOLA. Red beans are awesome. If I could give it a 6 stars.
name: Robert

text: Woo! I place to get a yummy salad in Collinsville! This is more than a bar for people who oppose alcohol! The atmosphere is so welcoming and clean it makes you want to learn more about it. The service was fun and our group of seven overall enjoyed the experience. We ordered the charcuterie board and gobbled it up and my husband really enjoyed the variety of drinks. Next is the theater! I can see the community really enjoying the town with these improvements :)
name: Olivia

text: We've decided to tried out PrimeBar a couple times more recently and looks like they've revamped their brunch menu. They were very accommodating and we love their new selection of unique brunch dishes! Their omelet was especially tasty
name: Andrea

text: I love this restaurant. This restaurant fits in well downtown because it's at a great price point, a good hangout place for young singles and couples and it's great food. I love brisket especially when it's cold outside. The Buddha bowl has everything I'd love. Fresh vegetables healthy grains and you can add the protein of your choice. The server recommended to top off with a egg and hot sauce. Delish!
name: Cynthia

text: Don't eat here. My first time here tonight and my last time . The first red flag, other restaurants surrounding this one were packed. La Pergola was empty. I ordered the pasta tetrazzini. It was served with what seemed to be marinated sweet potato, green beans and marinated cabbage. I never saw anything like that before with Mediterranean food. The pasta tasted like it came from a can and left an after taste in my mouth. Suffice to say, I did not finish my meal after a few bites. A little old man who was bent over and falling out of his suit jacket was playing the piano. I paid my bill and tipped the waiter who was nice and gave good service but I felt embarrassed for him that he felt he had to work there.
name: Luke

text: Great food and a great atmosphere! I love the luau quesadilla. The place has a bit of an eclectic vibe that I love. Check it out!
name: Meghan

text:
We LOVE to try new local restaurants! Arnie's is like 4min from our house tucked in a corner off ST RD 135. We came in and were immediately impressed with the decor and sturdiness. I mean it really feels like it was really well built. 

They have a straight forward menu thats still eclectic so everyone will have something to choose from. Our waitress was nice and on it. No matter what we needed. 

Its a dress casually kinda place and we like those for a quick night out with/without the kiddos. 

We tried the Korean BBQ tacos and a sandwich. 

Kiddo note: there is space for a large family. Definitely room for a stroller. They also have a kid friendly menu. 

Adult note: They do have a bar. But even if you bring the kiddos thw decor calls for you to still feel like your apart of the bar area.
name: Lateva

text:
And  we are back again!!!
So simple and yet so unique and delicious.
I wanted to make sure to mention how friendly the staff are. Alex is great. She made us few like we are home, chatting about the chilly sauces and she even hooked me up with the special crepe from last week.
Simply love it!
name: Mariana

text: I'm in town for business and staying at the hotel. The staff is awesome and all the food I had was top notch except the breakfast buffet. Order breakfast off the menu. The breakfast burrito was really good.
name: John

text: So I have been here a few times now. The server my family continues to enjoy Robin is awesome. The food is always delicious, unfortunately when they run out of food, the manager is less then accomadating with what you may get as a replacement. Oh well, we will still go back as like I said the food is great.
name: Mia

text: First time I have been to this local spot. The staff was very friendly. We got flautas they were really good-done very well. I got the enchiladas they were good not the best I have had. The churros were wonderful. That is definitely a treat to have since I don't get to eat them much...now I may just have to go all the time. Oh and the horchata was tasty. I will be going back.
name: Cassandra

text: Went here for the first time today and it was exactly what I hoped it would be! I had an Asada taco (street style), fish taco & an Al Pastor taco (gringo style). They were all excellent. I love the free chips that came with it, the guacamole was fresh & delicious and the salsas were really good with lots of choices.
name: Melissa

text: Food was ok yet the small of rotten food was repulsive. I could not finish my food. We had to leave. Staff was friendly and it looked clean.
name: Cat

text:
Willie Mae's Scotch House, located in the trendy Treme area, is vintage NOLA at it's very best and feels more like you're eating in someone's house rather than an actual restaurant. The customer service is top notch! 
Lauded as one of the best fried chicken restaurants in the U.S. After Hurricane Katrina destroyed the restaurant, I can definitely understand why volunteers and sponsors alike put their time, money and efforts into rebuilding this iconic establishment. No matter what day or time you go, be prepared to wait on a line. Locals and tourists frequent here...
name: Kendrick

text: I didn't have a chance to taste the food so not sure about the 4 to 5 star rating. However their Moscow Mule was awesome and the service was great the environment was really nice just a all-around good place to be
name: Chris

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I had a better visit than I expected to. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: This hotel would be a perfect candidate for hotel impossible.  The building is old and appears to only apply band aide fixes.  Rooms smell like mold and mildew, rusty fixtures, carpets feel damp.  The only positive was that the majority of the staff was very pleasant.
name: V

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. It was decent, just a little uneven. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
Had a really great meal at Stonewood tonight. Part of a work outing of more than 20 people, so any concerns there may have been over slow service would be more than attributable to the size of our group. We had two servers working the group plus the support of a manager. All were attentive when asked and things came out quickly. 

The assorted breads on the table were great. Honestly, I only had the pretzel sticks but they were awesome. The group ordered chips with blue cheese and vinaigrette, a crab and artichoke dip (I think), and bruschetta. I didn't try the bruschetta but the others were excellent. 

For the main, I went with the blackened grouper and loved it. It had a nice amount of spice and the steak-like fish was excellent. Corn and tomato sauté on the side was good but wish it would have disclosed onions as there may have been more of those than the other vegetables. The baked potato side was also very good. I enjoyed the Free Dive IPA more than the last time I had it. 

A number of the members of our group had a dessert and all seemed to enjoy them. Overall the feedback from our large group seemed very positive and I would definitely go back here if in the area.  If 4.5 stars was an option I would likely have settled on that but since it isn't and I loved the grouper, I'll go 5.
name: Joe

text: It is 10pm. I've been waiting in the drive thru for ten minutes. It took 5 before anyone even asked for my order. There are a line of cars. WHY IS IT SO SLOW?!
name: Randy

text: This old building is nicely decorated with a NOLA theme. I dined with a group of nine, who sampled a variety of menu items. All the Cajun foods were well received. The fried chicken was top shelf, the sides, not so much. The service was very good. The server indicated that the property has been purchased and that lease on this building will last another 18 months. Better get there soon.
name: JR

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Also, for the price i expected more than this. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Also, the sauces helped more than i thought they would.. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. So yeah, for a busy night they handled it okay. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: The dinning experience here was a little off.  We had reservations but were made to wait 15 minutes by the hostess even though the restaurant was only half full. Our entrees faired better than the apps. And some of those app flavors just didn't work. For example why should the chef douse hamachi crude with a super strong shellfish sauce?  Was it hamachi I was eating or shrimp?  Texture was hams have but the flavor of shellfish was overpowering.  I tasted no papaya as was described on the menu and although pretty, the lived carrots on top tasted like nothing and didn't add to the dish. The goat curry entree was fantastic but it is hard for me to justify a $25 price tag for such a down home cooking kind of dish. The jerk fish was tasty but a little dry. The waitstaff were very nice and attentive.
name: nycParkie

text: Awesome top self margaritas and fish tacos! Nice go to if you want to walk to dinner. Bar area is nice with lots of TVs to watch sports!
name: L

text:
Delicious. Relaxed almost diner feel with a bar, large TV w the Flyers game and a serious espresso machine. Families, couples, groups of teens all welcome here w casual dress. Really down to Earth on a Friday night, 730. No need to wait or anything. 

Had the lamb burger and my wife had the shrimp and calamari w pasta. Delicious. Had the bougatsa a la mode w a coffee. Incredible.  

Our waitress was spot on w service. I think her name was Kenya on the receipt, was really attentive. 

We'll definitely be back!
name: Jeff

text: So I had to check this place out for myself traveling from Tucson, Arizona to see some friends in Nampa, ID. Well we showed up tonight about 545pm and was welcomed by a really "awesome" server named Gina. From the moment we walked in all the way through our meal everything was great. I always check out Yelp to see what fellow yelpers have to say and on the ones that have poor reviews I just got to try out for myself. I know that sometimes food or service can be atrocious in an eating establishment but I got to say I would go back to this place 10 times over if I lived here. The food is fresh, not frozen and delivers in taste. I wish you as good a time as my family had if you have never been or decide to give it another try, because everybody and everything deserves a second chance. Think about it you are not always 100% all the time but nobody whines about how awful you were that one day. Happy travels and Gina have a wonderful marriage when you tie the know in two months. Take care folks from one yelper to another!
name: Mia

text: Really Good, Especially for the price! The service was old school diner friendly. Save yourself a Benjamin and enjoy a dinner. We'll be back!
name: Robert

text:
I went to Mr Sushi because Mikado (down the street) was closed. 
My friend and I went based on the reviews. We went on the Fourth of July and not sure if that had a bearing.

Slow service.
Be patient, one waitress has extremely limited English
I've eaten sushi all over the world; the quality of their sushi is not good

The fish had hard sections and 1 piece didnt smell right. The rice was hard and the rolls were not rolled tight enough, so all of the inside kept falling out.
The chicken teriyaki was overcooked and my friend could not eat. 

I tried the bubble tea. They have a menu on the table with pictures of different fruity bubbletea. But, they only have Jasmine, Greentea and a couple others.

Maybe they got a new chef and or..the fish was not fresh.

Good sushi is made with fresh ingredients.

For $22.50 the portions are large. The best part of the meal was the salad. 

Disappointed, will not be returning.
name: Cynthia

text: We were here right after they opened and thought it was just ok.  Decided to give it another try today for something different  and so glad we did.  The food was delicious and the service was excellent.   We will definitely go back!!!    One of the better places in the Streets of St Charles.
name: Mindy

text: Its nothing crazy special, but simply a good time. For sushi it has a great variety and is just what you need when you want to go out and not spend a ridiculous amount of money. I have come here several times and Im always satisfied with the service!
name: Jessica

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Anyway, no big complaints, just a nice meal. so yeah kind of mixed on it. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Not bad for a quick meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Sat outside up the steps at the bar. View was fabulous and the bartender was friendly and helpful. Very laid-back environment and the people around us were very fun. All strangers but we talked non-stop. I had a salad and steamed, peel and eat shrimp. Both were excellent. Fair prices, good size meals and very good customer service. Would go back again.
name: Karen

text:
My family and I traveled to the restaurant from LA, a party of 6. We did wait awhile for a table, but that's because we wanted to sit outside. Once seated, our server Sabrina was AMAZING. She was so kind and attentive. 
Food: we had the nachos and buffalo cauliflower for appetizer and they were so delicious!! I wish I ordered the nachos as my main course they were so good. 
We tried an array of foods for entrees, Peggy's chicken sand which, steak and fries, finney burger. Everyone was happy with their food and portion sizes. 
Service: Sabrina checked on us many times and made us felt taken care of. Very positive attitude. Thanks Sabrina!! 
Would definitely come back when in town. Great food, atmosphere, and service.
name: Cassandra

text: It was a cozy environment with low lighting. The service and food were good overall. I highly recommend the meat lasagna and pesto pasta. I wasn't too keen on cinnamon rolls and wouldn't order again (to be fair they are vegan so texture was just off putting). The menu is a tad pricey but based on quality of ingredients that makes sense. We will definitely come back.
name: Kristin

text: Boca is forever disappointing. I wish it was better. We've been a handful of times since they opened and every single time something is off and I always regret the check. I'm happy to pay for a delicious meal and good service but Boca can never deliver both. Visited for after dinner drinks recently and asked the bartender if he could make an Irish coffee. He assured us that he could. He proceeded to serve us luke warm coffee and Bailey's. My husband ordered an old fashioned and idk what it was that he got, but old fashioned it was not. Other experiences include super slow service, mediocre over priced food. After being open now for a few years they still can't live up to their South Tampa sisters good rep.
name: Nicole

text:
Atmosphere and location ... 5

Food ... 2

Service ... 5

I really wanted to love this place. Great location. Great atmosphere full of sports TVs and a good old fashion bar feel. Yet the food was average at best ... Its a bar. I had garlic and parm chicken wings which had little flavor. The ranch was good! My son had the cheesesteak sandwich ... great roll but bland meat. The fries were soggy and flavorless.  

I think the kitchen needs to learn how to use spices and flavors.

Despite a very busy place the waitress was on top of it.
name: Doretta

text: We picked this place via yelp simply because the photos of the food looked so good! Not only did the food live up to the photos but the taste was outstanding. The fish and chips were to die for. The staff was friendly as well. 12/10
name: Kayla

text: Overall very good and the space is amazing. Quality is good However- small brunch portions especially the eggs. Toast is extra. Potatoes were extra. Not what I would have expected at brunch.
name: Shelley

text: Of course me friends made fun of me for ordering seafood the entire weekend in Nashville BUT I was pleasantly surprised the lobster roll was delicious. I asked for light mayo which is how I like it and the little roe on top, yum I love my fish eggs
name: Vicky

text: The service/food was slooowwwwwww, but the seafood here is hella fresh.. I would come here just for seafood offerings. Our server forgot to put in some of our order so that sucked. We had a 9:00 pm reservation and didn't start getting food until at least 9:30, and each food item came out one at a time and maybe 10-15 minutes after each other. I would recommend making a reservation for when they open and on a Tuesday.
name: Donna

text:
My brother recommended this franchise. There were 3 locations around here on Yelp, but I noticed that this location had the better rating. 

We seated ourselves when we arrive. The manager was very friendly and really liked my daughter. She even offered us a can of Pediasure to help fattened her up. 

Food:
We ordered Spring Rolls and Vietnamese Egg Rolls. Which were a bit pricey for appetizers, but tasted good. My mother disagree about the taste, she did not like the rolls at all. We ordered the special pho (Pho Dac Biet). Which was really good and my mother agreed. Their menu did not have any other noodle soup dishes (like hu tieu, bun rieu, bun bo hue, etc), it was straight to the point with just pho, rice dishes, and appetizers. 
My husband really enjoyed his pho and so did I. We didn't add any hoisin sauce, just lime and herbs was enough for us, since the broth was so flavorful and delicious. 

Would not mind coming back for the pho again!
name: Honey

text: Beautiful atmosphere and the location is AMAZING!  Love the beer selection!  Very unique place!  Love the layout of the bar!
name: Kathleen

text: I love The sushi here. Only reason it isn't 5 stars is because it does feel a little expensive, but that's sort of sushi everywhere here now. I've been twice now and will definitely be back more.
name: Jeff

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: I don't usually ever leave reviews, but I couldn't not leave one this time. My boyfriend and I went on a Monday afternoon for lunch. The young lady at the hostess counter was super sweet and friendly, so I'm thinking "awesome! this is going to be great!", SO not the case. We were seated right in front of the kitchen doors, it wouldn't have been an issue but they weren't busy AT ALL, and we got stuck there. The guy who chose where we sat must have had a bug up his butt when he chose our seat, because even the girl seating us did a double step because that's where she was told to seat us. Our server took forever to come and even take our drink order, didn't ask us if we wanted an appetizer so I had to throw that in as she dropped our waters off. We ordered our burger medium and after about 40 mins of waiting for it, it came out well done. We didn't send it back because we were afraid we'd miss our flight (that was taking off 7 hours from then- yes I know dramatics, but that's how bad the service was). She never came back to check on us and when she walked by my boyfriend had to shout out to her for our bill. The table next to us had to get up and get their own condiments from the bar because she never brought them over to them like she was supposed to. Our bill was 3?.75 and she only brought back our dollar bills for our change. She short changed us a quarter, yes it's only a quarter but she never gave us the option whether or not we wanted to give it to her. I will definitely be hitting this place up whenever I come into a craving for Hawaiian food.

text:
60th person to review Beef O' Brady's in Meridian Idaho off Eagle and Overland. This is my 404th Yelp review. I like this place and am bummed that it has an average of only three stars. 

**Be sure to check in on Yelp before ordering to get 15% off! (excludes alcohol)** 

I've eaten here three times and have had Uber eats deliver it twice. Each time the food has been on point. They have a full menu, darts, some other games, and great food. They have an average-to-small happy hour (see my attached photo) and some really excellent food. 

On this trip, I ordered the shrimp lettuce wraps (amazing), tots and queso (just like it sounds), and since it was wing Wednesday ($.99 per wing, $.75 boneless and must order at least 6) we got 6 and a side of fries. There were three of us and we all just share food. Drinks are BOGO for wells. I ordered a vodka water with a splash of cranberry (don't drink your calories kids), and a vodka pineapple-- the drinks were okay, nothing special (meaning weak and not strong!)! 

One cool thing about this establishment is that they have handheld order takers that the waitress utilize. I haven't seen that before, in our area at least. This lessens the errors from the order taking and I would imagine helps with food cost. I've often been surprised by waitress/waiters that can take your order by memory and get it right (doesn't happen often). 

Now, Uber eats-- When you order from Uber, a driver goes to the location and picks up your food. My food has always been delivered quickly, warm and well put together. Last week, for lunch, we ordered a prime rib sandwich and it came with au jus sauce, which was piping hot! Order online today! inbox me for a code for $5 off. 

Again, I don't know why the three average stars. I've read them. I just think they've must have grown and I encourage you to give them a shot!

text:
This is definitely one of my favorite places in the greater Philadelphia area.

The ambiance is rustic yet charming, romantic yet cozy.  

Drinks - 5 stars and beyond!  Within the 20 solid craft beer on rotation, at least 3 are new or rare.  They also have some limited edition bottled beers, as well as shareable (25 oz.).   Craft cocktails are amazing!  Even better - most of them are from local breweries and/or distilleries. 

Food - 5 stars.  I really didn't expect such eclectic dining experience out of Harleysville. I love the plates because they're shareable and I've loved everything I've had. I love the fact the they keep surprising me with new items that are fresh and well crafted. 

My favorites including bouillabaisse and mahi mahi. So fresh and well executed.

text:
One of my favorite restaurant in Indy! The location is on mass ave which always draws a young and hip crowd! They have outdoor seating with a fire place which is perfect for the summer! Indoors their is a bar area, booths and lots of tables! The ambiance is very casual and have a southern comfort to it. 
The Eagle is most famous for the fried chicken. Very good fried chicken cooked to a crisp perfection and taste even better with the spiked honey sauce! But I would have to say that their sides are the best part of the meal! You have to order he sides separately but everything is shareable! The Mac n cheese is to die for! Extra cheesy with bread crumb toppings! The maple bacon with cayenne is a good snack to order if you are waiting for your food! The sweet potatoes are delicious and topped with roasted marshmallows! The spoon bread is huge and if you love cornbread like myself I would highly recommend. The collard greens are good with pieces of ham in it. The biscuits are excellent! The food is all around just delicious and mouth watering! 
My only downside to this place is that everything is communal. You will most likely share your table with another group of people. If you do not like having people watch you eat then do not go here. It is very awkward to be sitting next to a bunch of strangers literally rubbing elbows while you are trying to enjoy a nice lunch/dinner. But luckily you can order your meals ahead of time and get it to go!
name: Susie

text:
This place took forever to construct here in Philly's East Market complex; the question on my mind was - worth the wait, or just another Mexi-merican joint?

You'll feel right at home here if you're used to Chipotle; it's similar, with perhaps a few extra menu options. But I'm a Chipotle fan, and I was attempting to replicate the Chipotle burrito experience and so I chose the "Build your own" burrito bowl.

Be sure to take a look at the area where they build your food, BEFORE you order; especially the meats - if you're a meat fan like I am. You can see whether the meats look fresh how they would be served. The chicken looks like a chopped combination of white & dark meat, and the shrimp looked pretty big. I was happy to see the Barbacoa lookin' moist and fresh, so I went for that.

I ordered the burrito bowl, and all the typical ingredients I get at Chipotle: white rice (garlic lime, as they call it here), grilled veggies, pico de gallo, and shredded cheese. Don't worry, they have a nice variety of salsa on the self-serve salsa bar back near the drink area. The price was pretty close to Chipotle.

The self-serve drink area is a plentiful area of tea, coffee, and a soda fountain with their particular brand of sodas. A lot of restaurants these days have steered away from the Coke & Pepsi fountains for some of the more local options, such as from the New Hope soda makers that District Taco uses.

The bowl size was huge and brought out to my table, and my tummy jumped for joy that it was about to be nicely filled up! Everything in the bowl was fresh, and the spicy salsa I added gave a great kick to the meal inside the bowl. I wish there was a greater amount of meat (barbacoa, in my case) placed in such the large bowl, rather than being so much rice, but most places just don't give the amounts that I'd prefer to have anyways.

Yeah I was pleasantly satisfied with the meal, and this is a beautiful location encased with floor-to-ceiling windows. It was rather cold inside when it was only 50 degrees outside. I do hope that District Taco's HVAC can keep customers warm enough in the winter or cool enough in the summer!

At the end of the day, District Taco was a nice, delicious take on Mexi-merican. Their website describes themselves as "Yucatan style", which I can't find a good description of what that actually means.
name: Tim

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. Honestly, everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. text:
It is hard not to give Fogo 5 stars, if not purely on value for the money.  Dinner for two guys, no appetizer, no dessert, no liquor, $148.00 with tip.  You say that sounds kinda high and make no mistake that's not pocket change.  But let me explain.

No apps- well no, the "more impressive than most places entire menu" salad bar comes with your meal.  I had capris I salad, taboulah, nova lox, hearts of palm and charcuterie.  That's app enough for anyone.

 O alcohol- yep, that stuff ruins your tastebuds, keep a clean pallet with water and tea.  Salty meats and stuff need water to chase them.

No dessert - I was absurdly stuffed.  The Grilled bananas come out with your meal and beat dessert at most places.

The steak, chicken pork and steak and lamb and did I mention steak come out hot and fast.  Unlimited in amounts, so pace yourself to get to the filet and the lamb.  This is the only place I will even touch sir loin and it is absolutely fabulous.

Value for your dollar, incredible, I have spent more and gotten far far less.

text:
Maybe my expectations were to high to begin with but the entire experience was pretty disappointing. I had some friends in town visiting so I made us a reservation which was so nice! We ended up getting there about an hour early. I was expecting it to be much more busy than it was!

I checked in and we went to an open spot at the bar. For multiple reasons the bartender did not do a very good job. The Bloody Mary was okay. They were a little more Smokey than I like my bloodys to usually be. We also got smoked chicken dip which I would not recommend. Just bland. 

Our table was ready before our reservation. Our server was very nice and friendly. You could tell he was busy and working hard. We ordered pretty immediately. After two drinks our food wasn't out and he told us 7 minutes and we'd have our food. 20 minutes later it still wasn't ready. Our server acknowledged the wait and brought out burnt chips. text:
What a nice new little gem tucked away underneath Girard Station! I finally got around to hitting up Da-Wa after eyeing it up from its opening in January. Delicious food with friendly, attentive service.

My order consisted of the Braise Pork Bao Buns and Cha Shu Ramen. The Bao Buns were absolutely fantastic. The soft, chewy texture of the bun combined with the succulent melt-in-your-mouth pork and freshness of the toppings made for a musical symphony in each bite. Pro tip given by the waiter: add the chip garnish to the buns to add a crunch to enhance the experience. 

The Cha Shu Ramen was a solid meal. For $12, the portion was generous and the contents were presented beautifully. I really enjoyed the perfectly spiced broth. 

All-in-all, I can't speak to the sushi, but great spot for quality ramen and bao buns! Definitely a spot to check out if you're in the neighborhood.
name: Wesley

text: FABULOUS! My dad who is now 46 went for his 18th birthday and now I got to go for my 18th birthday this weekend. It was the best meal I've ever eaten in my life and wow I'm so thankful for the experience and being able to share it with my dad! Thank you!

text:
While I am not a connoisseur of Korean food, my husband is, and we both love Dooriban!  Don't judge a book by its cover-- I'm pretty sure this is a converted Taco Bell-- because what's inside is absolutely delicious.  We typically order the bulgogi beef and share it.  It's so good it's hard to branch out.  That said, the last time we went I was adventurous and didn't regret it; I tried the #28 dwen jang jjigae, fermented soybean soup with clams, tofu, and vegetables, and it was incredible.  On other visits we've enjoyed the spicy pork bulgogi (not kidding about the spicy, and I'm not a wimp) and the galbi short ribs.  We also typically order the mandu (fried vegetable dumplings), which are great, and everything comes with banchan.  It's not cheap, but the quality and portion sizes are there.

If you visit once, you'll probably become regulars like us.
name: Samantha

text:
When in the mood for Mexican in the CWE, El Burro Loco is my spot! They have the most unbelievably refreshing frozen watermelon margarita that I have yet to find anywhere, the kind that tastes good and fresh like the real deal. 
Every time I come here, I order the Shrimp Quesadilla, which is just packed with juicy, flavorful, well-seasoned shrimp and melted Monterey Jack cheese. It's a winner time and time again, and I couldn't recommend it more highly. 
Chips and salsa are complimentary and virtually unlimited as the servers are highly attentive and will come check to see if you need a refill quite frequently. 
Keep up the fast and friendly service, El Burro! I see you!

text: First time to Good Morning Mama's and I had terrific service! Not overpriced like a lot of breakfast and brunch places.
name: Alie

text:
When you order Thai hot in this restaurant, they do not kid around! I absolutely loved that about this restaurant. Being a lifelong Chilihead, I am so disappointed with restaurants, where I order my food extremely spicy and when I taste it, it is not even mild! That was not the case here. I love that they listen to their customers. 

Since this place was so close to our hotel, we decided to order takeout from here. Being a porkaholic, I was slightly disappointed that there was no pork in their menu. My husband doesn't eat duck so we decided to go with shrimp entrees.

Five star alert! Five staralert!  I didn't have very high expectations coming to Reno; a landlocked, small town, runner up to Vegas, etc. etc.   How wrong was I?? Even though I totally went against reasonable thinking and ordered the mussels in a restaurant located in a high-desert plain that features artisanal meat and cheeses, I couldn't have been more pleased that I was with my order.  Yellow curry coconut sauce on the mussels was perfection. I even ordered more bread to sop up the sauce.  

Other factors that contributed to the five star review? They feature local beers and local whiskey, both of which were very good. The bartender, Courtney, was knowledgeable, friendly, and excelled in customer service, even though she was in the weeds all night.  And finally, it was an interesting twist, but they kept the lights up, even though it was about 8pm. It really added to the overall vibe, and made me enjoy the whole experience even more. Sometimes you have to go against the grain-in this case dimming the lights versus keeping the lights high. It worked, and I can't recommend this place enough. Enjoy!

text:
Who would've ever guessed that one of the best soulfood restaurants in NOLA would be vegan? Not me, that's for sure. We stopped into Sweet Soulfood on a lazy Monday afternoon, a few hours before our flight back home after our Jazz Fest vacation. One member of our group was a vegetarian, so we thought this would be the perfect way for all of us to experience some proper southern cooking, vegan style! 

Our Lyft pulled up to the restaurant, and it really doesn't look like much more than a little dingy building. As soon as you walk in, however, your nose is immediately filled with absolutely amazing smells. This restaurant serves food cafeteria style, where you choose what items get loaded onto your plate/box, and you pay at the end of the line (they do take credit cards).

The staff was extremely friendly, and allowed us to taste any of the items available before selecting what we wanted for lunch. We had the fried cauliflower, gumbo, Jambalaya, mac n cheese, collard greens, and bread pudding. Every single item was absolutely delicious, and I cannot wait to return to try all the other dishes.

Even if you eat meat, you can't miss Sweet Soulfood!

For dinner, we stuck with the basics; we ordered a  16" Large Pie with Brooklyn Red Sauce, Mozzarella and Ricotta cheese and lastly Pepperoni. Towards the end of the meal, we also ordered Garlic Knots to snack on.

The pizza arrived next door to our seats not long after and for just a "basic" pizza, it was seasoned very well. Their pizza is simply delicious, period. Their garlic knots with the marinara sauce is snack-food heaven. Pizza and beer are just a great match. 

If you and your friends are ever hungry while grabbing a drink, or if you're having pizza and want a beer, whichever the case is, Noble Pie Parlor and Pinion can accommodate both of those needs!

text:
Great presentation and a very nice, eclectic menu. We were also seated promptly. However, the food comes FAST and furious. This is not a place to unwind and relax with your dining companions. 

Steak tartare,  sheep's milk ricotta, duck ragu farfalle, and the meatballs were all the stars of the evening! It would be hard to pick one as the "best," they were all great. Unfortunately the gnocchi was only "ok" (and my girlfriend LOVES gnocchi).  

Drinks were ho-hum and expensive. Pricing is out of whack for what you get: which is small pours on the wine, and a moderate amount in the cocktails. The negroni was small but you could definitely taste the gin. I learned that there are in fact 2 negronis offered, one of which costs more because it's the "Philadelphia" one. Since I didn't specify, guess which one I got? I felt this was a bit dishonest on Barbuzzo's part. Upcharging on the down low is not appreciated, especially at a place that isn't cheap to start with. 

Your server won't be the one who serves your food, which I know is typical at many establishments. However, this means it's harder to talk to said server should you desire a refill or have any other concerns. Speaking of refill, my companion asked for a wine refill and waited a solid 15 minutes for it. That's pretty bad. No apology, no nothin. 

The salted caramel budino is awesome and very much worth the hype. The La Colombe espresso is also delicious and pairs quite well with it. 

Would I return? Absolutely! I simply wouldn't order any alcohol and I'd now know what to expect regarding the experience. The food is quite good and I look forward to trying more things from their kitchen. 

As an added bonus: the restroom was clean and they even remember it was my girlfriend's birthday. Both are nice touches.

text:
Overall this is a good buffet that we have been to several times in the past. 

I received an email from GSR notifying me they were honoring veterans with a free buffet on Monday, November 12th so we decided to check it out but anticipated it would be busy. 

We intended on getting there about 30 minutes before it opened at 10am but we were running a bit slow this morning and didn't get there until 10 and the line was quite long. It appeared many other veterans and their families were there as well. We took a place in line and talked to some nice people - a GSR employee even came by with waters and offered them to those of us in line. 

We made it to the front of the line in about 30 minutes and were tickled to find out that in addition to the one free meal, the second meal in our party was discounted 20% as a military discount. We had never realized that GSR did that!

We were quickly seated and we filled our plates. The food is good and there is a nice selection. Thank you GSR - we will be back again very soon!  It is our experience that other businesses will state they are offering benefits to veterans when in fact they only recognize active and retired folks. While this is great for those individuals who are either active or retired military it doesn't capture a large percentage of veterans. 

THANKS AGAIN GSR!
name: Mike

5* = A top favorite. Mind-blowing good. I will definitely return and I will go out of my way to go here. Worth every dime of my money.

text:
A new addition to Philadelphia's impressive Indonesian dining scene is Jembatan 5 in Bella Vista.  This cozy eatery is named after the famous neighborhood of Djakarta.  And like most Indonesian restaurants, this is a very friendly place.  Happily the food is very good as well.

I went with two other friends and we wound up sharing a lot of dishes...even the seafood soup app.  btw - the seafood soup was the weakest dish of the evening. The perkedel were nicely put together and lightly fried and very popular at the table.  My friend loved her Shrimp Nasi Goreng.  And my Kerang Bakar (baked green mussels) were pure deliciousness.  My main course of Ayam Rica-Rica (spicy chicken) was tasty to the last forkful. I could have used however even more sambal and hot spice. 

I def hope to get back to Jembatan 5 sometime to try some of their other dishes. It looks like Philly has yet another go-to Indonesian spot!

text:
What a Disappointment!

Great location - beautiful patio, but the service was mediocre, the prices were HIGH, and the food was not worth the cost. They seem to think that if you put twelve ingredients in a cocktail or an entree that makes it interesting.  Well, it doesn't.  It makes a mess!  Our bill was over $100 for two people - one of us had a beer ($7) and the other an overpriced glass of wine ($15), so it wasn't our drinks that drove up the price - and we only ordered veggie dishes.

The people at the front desk didn't have their act together at all, although the inside dining room was completely empty.  I can't imagine what it's like when the place is full (or maybe the word is out and it's never full).

The asparagus dish we ordered, which was delivered after we had eaten our other two mediocre veggie entrees, was truly awful - blah grits on the bottom (no flavor) topped with asparagus (overcooked), and indistinguishable greens. I expect spring asparagus to be delicious!  It wasn't - and SO overpriced!  

Also, there were lots of small gnats flying all around us as dusk fell on the patio - they need to get a handle on that! (I was getting bit!)  

None of it was at all what I had expected!  We won't be back as there are far too many better options in Santa Barbara.

Owner's mom came to check on us and I told her about the salt problem. She took the tray without a word. I heard a comment from the kitchen about the food return. Soon after the owner returned to ask if he could make me a new burger. No thank you. I heard what he said and the attitude seemed clear. Best to leave win no apology or parting word.
name: Mandy

text:
I cannot say enough good things about Alex and the rest of the staff at Amici. We had our son's
Christening party there and it was absolutely wonderful. The food was excellent and the service was great! Alex was so easy to work with and accommodating. It made planning very easy! I definitely recommend Amici!
name: Krysta

text: So good! Worth the wait! Will be back! The buffalo chicken eggs Benedict is hollandaise sauce, pounced egg, perfectly fried chicken and buffalo sauce, a layer of sliced avocado, and a homemade biscuit. The chicken and waffles is perfectly fried boneless chicken on top of a Belgian waffle that's crispy on the outside and light and fluffy inside. Both worth going back for but want to try other things on the menu too.
name: Aubrey

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The food was good and the service was easygoing. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Came here for a Friday night dinner at 10pm so pretty late. Service was very friendly and came by with three meatballs they said we're complimentary because it was our first time here. I did caveat I had been here before but my husband's first time. When we got the bill they had charged us for the meatballs! A bit disappointing since the meatballs weren't great and cost $6 but it was the holidays so we didn't say anything. The burrata was really good and the food was good for a quick middle ground Italian spot. I would've rated 4 stars if not for the meatball trickery.
name: Liz

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Honestly, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. So yeah, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. So yeah, the food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Honestly, i kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Amazing! The seasoning was just perfect. A kick of spice was what i needed. We got a side order or fried each didn't think too much of how much would come with it. But, he made sure the container was filled with fries. My husband got the monster burger and he loved it. I believe the burger also had sliced meat that goes in the philly also. Don't forget to get two slices of their cheesecake! It's so creamy and everything you didn't think you needed. 

When you first go inside you'll be a little confused. But it's a market plus a deli.
name: Lisa

text:
Here for a wedding from Florida and found this lovely gem by our AirBNB. 

This place is absolutely amazing. Fresh and delicious oysters on happy hour. The mushroom gnocchi was fantastic. We also had the burger, the chicken pie, and the smoked tofu. 

Fantastic cocktails and the food was perfect. Couldn't recommend this place enough.
name: Justin

text: For the price I expected a little more care. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. For a busy night they handled it okay. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It was decent, just a little uneven. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Thin crust. It's riv. If I'm having real pizza I want Riviera. The pizza is the best thing here. I have a cheesesteak hoagies and they're pretty good but they're on the smaller side the wings are also pretty good
name: Chris

text: I love a good Benedict and this place has LOTS to choose from!  Fast service and great atmosphere.  The patio looks inviting but didn't want to wait for it.   Drink menu is great!  Plenty of variety to chose from.  Can't wait to go back and see if the dinner is as good as the breakfast.
name: Carrie

text: Fun place located in Safety Harbor right downtown on main street. They have a bar and a large dining room. It was very busy on a Wedsnesday night. The food and drinks were great, a bit slow in the service but it was busy. We had the balsamic salmon, veggies plate with chicken. The salmon had wonderful flavor. They had terrific live music featuring Greg Billings. Fun place to hang out with great food!
name: Lara

text: Food was average and catfish was very "fishy" tasting. Nowhere as good as the catfish we have had all week in town. Service was incredibly slow. Workers at the hostess stand were more worried about talking to each other rather than acknowledging guests. Took 15 minutes to place our drink & food order. Then took another 15 minutes for our drinks to arrive. Almost the same time as our food.  Server never gave us silverware or napkins. When I asked for napkins she brought bars napkins. I'd tell anyone thinking of going here to consider it twice and go somewhere else. There are way too many great places to eat in New Orleans to bother with this place.
name: Todd

text:
Great experience!
The dishes are well balanced and authentic. The staff very friendly and responsive.
The fish was cooked perfectly and the meal served at the right temperature.
The mixture of flavors really stood out!
I went there with my kids and we all loved it! We shared it all!

Thanks
name: Daniel

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Also, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The staff seemed tired but still polite. so yeah kind of mixed on it. Not bad for a quick meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Slowest Waffle House I've been to and I've been to waffle houses all over the country. They are nice just incredibly slow. It wasn't very busy, especially for a Waffle House. They also don't have gluten free waffles here like many others do. Overall I was disappointed and incredibly tired after waiting an hour for my to go bowl, not getting dinner until after 1am when I had planned to be asleep before then. I had an important morning and waited because they kept saying 10 more minutes. Again very kind people, but I would eat somewhere else if you don't have time to kill.
name: Christine

text:
Decided to eat dinner at the Sugar House Casino near our apartment. Took a shot at this little gem. Friendly service with a smile and great recommendations. 

I had pork dumpling soup with Ho fun noodles. Deliscious and a giant portion too.  Endless refills of iced tea and staff hovered over us to do our refills. 

Food came out in less than 5 minutes. Hot and great.

text: Im just judging this so far on drinks and nachos but both were very good. Waiter was attentive enough and seemed like fun atmosphere.   Hope to go back and try more of the food.
name: Ashely

text:
10/4/18
This place is excellent! 3rd time here visiting for work

The waiter, Sean, and the other 2 gentlemen that helped (small room half way towards the back) were fantastic!! 

The steaks, bone in ribeye and filet, were perfect.....  just perfect. Lived up to the reputation as usual.

Thanks

text: Fast casual spot for Poke bowls in the CWE. I went on a Thursday night and the staff was not friendly at all. They were also out of brown rice. I did enjoy my poke bowl however. There is a lot of food per bowl. I got a medium and was stuffed afterwards.
name: Zack

text:
Simply the Best! 
Incredible Food, Amazing Service!
Having recently dined there I had occasion to pickup food to bring to a friends house. I was amazed on how wonderful it was. Everything prepared perfectly and ready when I arrived. 
Can't wait to go back.
name: Brooks

text: I've been here several times and am always impressed with the variety and quality of their food.
name: Jim

text: Delicious! Welcome to the area. We are happy to have you here. We visited during a weekday for an early dinner. Good food and service.
name: Sarah

text: This is the worst China buffet we've been to. You pay on the way in or we sure would not have paid after the awful meal we ate little of. To start off, very few of the food items looked good. But we already paid so we tried several things. The pepper chicken was over cooked with no pepper taste. The lo mein noodles were greasy. The crab rangoons were cold and tasteless. The hot sour & soup didn't taste like any we've had before. Everything left a film in our mouths.  You've been warned.
name: Josef

text: the leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not bad for a quick meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
