text:
Ok, I CANNOT tell a lie...I LOVE me some dairy queen! Do I care about how unhealthy it is?? Hell no! What fun is that?? 
This place is great when you're feeling down about whatever and you go to one of your happy places...that place being....ICE CREAM hahahaha! 
I'm totally a basic bitch too, I always order the Oreo Cookie Blizzard when I go.
I know I talk about my life at the gym, because I rarely go anywhere else hahahaha! So when you work out a lot, you deserve a cheat day. 
My cheat day is usually Friday. I allow myself some extra treats and I don't lose my shit over it lol.
Dairy Queen....sometimes is a place I go to on my cheat day. It's kinda pricey for the sizes you get, but whatevs, if you hardly eat this stuff, then you know that doesn't matter hahahaha! It's so frickin good!
I know I need to branch out to other flavors, but as a kid, I remember when Oreo was introduced. TOTALLY just aged myself LOL...or maybe it was already out and I just introduced that blizzard to myself lol.
Anyway, I've ALWAYS been a super picky eater. I don't like peanut butter, nuts of any kind, etc. As a kid, I LOVED Oreo cookies. So naturally, I'd love this blizzard..  and I still do. One of these days, I'll branch out, but I'll stick to my basic bitch Oreo cookie blizzard for now hahaha! 
The location on Glenwood in Garden City is old school. Reminds me of the ones when I was a wee boy lol. I absolutely love that! The staff, MOST are incredible, but like most restaurants, retail stores etc., you'll always find a miserable guy or girl.
It's pretty rare at this place, because for the most part, they are all super nice and all have a sense of humor. I've only come across one or two with sourpuss attitudes hahaha! 

Anyway, we all know how great DQ is. We all know too how we have to write our review for the ones we go to, haha!

Thanks everyone! 

Cheers!
name: Timothy

text:
We had a great meal at Fork! Everyone enjoyed the appetizers and their respective entrees. 

The Tomato Basil Fondue & Grilled Cheese was great. Very tasty! We also ordered the Glazed Brussels Sprouts, which my friends loved, but I didn't feel like trying. 

My entree was the Pan Roasted Alaskan Halibut, which was perfectly cooked, well seasoned, and delicious. The seasonal veggie succotash was good, although I would have preferred a large portion, and the  lemon beurre blanc on the Halibut was very good. 

Our server was awesome and the ambience of the restaurant was great. We very much enjoyed our dining experience at Fork.
name: Sam

text:
This is a slow McDonalds with the most unhappy people on earth.  

It's like the opposite of Disneyland.  

You get average McD's fare, but lines and wait times feel long.  In fact, I almost always see people leave the drive thru because they are just tired of sitting.  

Nuggets were old and cold, but they were for the dog and she didn't care.  

When are they gonna just bring back the styrofoam cups?  I can't be the only person whose life was ruined by that. 

Oh, yea, they're no longer open 24/7, that's just on the weekends.
name: Jen

text: This new a cafe is A+. The vibe is cool, the food is excellent, the staff could not be sweeter and everything on the menu is under 10 bucks. My grilled cheese with tomato was cooked perfectly and their special "fregg" fried egg sandwich is the ultimate breakfast treat. I have also quickly become addicted to the cinnamon twist. This place is definitely a new "must try" addition to Boise's culinary lineup!
name: David

text: We had a very pleasant experience to Jack's this week! The location is easy to get to, within walking distance from many attractions. The door was left open on a beautiful day and allowed it to feel like we were part of the energy outside. We picked Jack's because it had food my celiac son could eat. The staff were well versed in celiac and how to handle his gluten intolerance. Such a relief when just the day before he couldn't eat his meal at another restaurant because of gluten. The meats were moist and flavorful (we had sausage and turkey) and portions were generous. The beans were just ok (I expected more at a bbq joint than what tasted like canned beans). The staff were very friendly - great overall experience!
name: Michelle

text: For the price I expected a little more care. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot.
name: User

text: Excellent food and service. Fresh and homemade sides. Bottomless mimosas for $16. We will definitely be back! Groovy atmosphere with live music.
name: Amy

text:
Food was decent, our waitress though not the greatest, was pleasant. Upon entering no one acknowledged us, although there were two people at the tablet. The young guy that helped us never checked us in, he was more concerned with other things. Due to his failure to check us in our table was given to some who arrived after us. 
When seated we did not receive utensils until after our appetizers arrived and we had to request them. 

I highly doubt I will return to this establishment. Nor will I recommend. Watching some of the staff, you see the lack of motivation/care as stated in other reviews.
name: Maegann

text:
This horrible service. I knew going in - it was going to be slow ..... But this is horrible!! 
We waited at least minutes to order drinks. 
We ordered Pomegranate Margarita - which tasted like pure syrup as well as their Top Shelf Lime Margarita that tasted like soapy band aide water - I had to run to the restroom to spit it out - that bad!
Ordered appetizer it came out with all of our food at once an hour later except for the soup, it came out about ten later ....

Generally, I know the service sucks and expect it when dining here but today - takes the cake.  And that is the only reason I give them one star.

Now if I were rating the food alone I would give 4 to 5 stars but I am not.
name: Jackie

text: Who doesn't toast the bread on a club sandwich? How am I suppose to eat this? I waited an hour and a half for this and I live two blocks away.
name: Anthony

text: The food tasted amazing, I personally had the grilled fish tacos and the sauce she topped any taco I've had in awhile. Family members had the bean bowl with brisket and it was perfectly cooked as well as the cubano sandwich was nicely toasted and had just the right amount of pork and ham. Great place- highly recommend it.
name: Vivian

text: Delicious, filling, excellent upbeat atmosphere, authentically friendly service. I highly recommend this place.
name: Hilary

text: This place is very yummy! Quality ingredients, super healthy with tons of flavor. They have bowls you can choose from or customize - the steak choice for protein is always super yummy and tender! Not only is the food yummy but also the decor is very relaxing and the service wonderful as well!
name: Carrie

text:
I honestly do not know where to start with Nada. It has been a quarterly stop for the past 2 Years, if not more depending on the occasion. 

My first visit was during a search for Mexican Cuisine that was more upscale. Our waiter gave us some recommendations and they did not disappoint. From the Tacos to the Queso, the food has always been amazing!
name: James

text: We came for the line dancing classes. The instructor was awesome and so much fun with our group. I would recommend for a girls party group.
name: Janice

text: Wonderful atmosphere.  I had bangers & mash, corn casserole, and a pot of traditional Irish tea. Hubby had fish & chips and cole slaw. All of it was delicious. For dessert,  I had warm peach cobbler with vanilla ice cream and hubby had Bailey's cheesecake. Once again, delicious. Would definitely recommend this restaurant!
name: Jean

text: I have had 4 meals at Connors (I stay in the Marriott weekly for work) and they have all been fantastic! Particularly the meal served by Annette!
name: Drew

text: I really wanted to try this spot as I have heard nothing, but great things.  So that is exactly what I did. I came early afternoon on Wednesday. It was three of us in a party.  It was pretty crowded, but the wait wasn't too bad. I was surprised to see how small this place was. It was a 20-25 minute wait. However, the wait for our food took much longer than the actual wait to get seated which I wasn't particularly happy about, but once the food arrived...I was in absolute heaven.  I ordered fried green tomatoes with some type of remoulade sauce and shrimp and grits.  The fried green tomatoes...ehh..I could take it or leave it...with or without the sauce.  This was my first time trying them...they were okay.   Now the shrimp and grits tho...first time EVER I had ever tried shrimp and grits and within the first bite...I kid you not....my eyes welled up and a tear almost formed...In my 30 years I have never in MY LIFE..had such a visceral reaction to food...I'm talking those cooks back there put thier foot, thighs, arms and hands all up in that dish and probably threw somebody's grandma in that dish too...it was that good! I also decided to try my girlfriends pancakes...that ish...tasted just like a cake that came out of the oven...those pancakes was that. damn. FLUFFY!  All I know is....I am coming back and I am telling EVERYBODY!
name: Cristina

text: Don't let the dark tinted windows fool you. (It did me!) Enchiladas supreme was delicious! Margarita was fantastic! Friendly staff as you walk in the door and as you are leaving. Just visiting this town but I would definitely eat here again!
name: Chrystal

text: We timed it perfectly, arriving just before 6 on a Saturday night in late May.  Because we wanted to sit on the outdoor porch, we were seated immediately. The line to get in grew pretty long during our meal.  We started with an order of the crispy coconut shrimp.  We were brought the dinner entree with French fries, rather than the appetizer serving which was strange and we did n't realize it until our bill arrived. But it didn't really matter as the dish was yummy.  I had just wondered why there was French fries on the appetizer platter!  Three in our party order the filet mignon, I ordered the seafood risotto and my daughter ordered the grouper in a curry sauce with sticky rice. After we finished the "appetizer," our waitress delivered homemade crackers with an outstanding spicy hummus and house salads with an excellent dressing.  Around this point, I realized I'd ordered too much! Our fish dishes were perfect. The curry couldn't have been more delicious! I wish I'd gotten it! The evening would have been perfect if our waitress wasn't ditzy. (She acted like she was high!).  She asked me what kind of wine I was drinking, forgetting she served a bottle to the table which hadn't been emptied.  She completely messed up the specific instructions she'd been given (which potato had the blue cheese, who wanted the rare steak) One dish was easily corrected- throw some cheese on the potato, give her the undercooked steak... (it was recognized as the one served incorrectly, cut open, and then swapped).  The waitress literally whined that it wasn't her fault.  Whose was it?  Our friend spent the rest of our meal waiting for her corrected plate.  When her steak finally returned, it was over cooked!   She couldn't finish it.  We called over the manager who took the mistake off the bill but it ruined our evening, of course.  The food was great, beautiful ambiance and decor, the manager was very professional, but this one waitress needs more training!
name: Barbara

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Honestly, the sauces helped more than i thought they would.. Honestly, nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It looked better online than it did in person. idk I'd try something else next time. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
Love Maxine's! Can't believe I haven't reviewed it before. Walking in you might think it's not that great- especially since it's attached to a gas station... but wait until you order to judge it. 

Want a good country meal downtown? This is one of the few places you'll find it. 

They have breakfast all day (yay!) and it's awesome. The pancakes and waffles have flavor options and aren't your generic box-tasting pancake mix. The chicken and waffles (that they're named after) are amazing. You can also get salmon croquettes here- salmon cakes is what I grew up calling them. I don't know anywhere else in the city that has them!

Service is great. Can take awhile but that's good when the food your getting is high quality. Be sure to ask about the cornbread and peach preserves! First order is on the house and it's sooo good! It's also cheap so you can fill up and not break the bank. Definitely worth checking out.
name: Sara

text:
Have eaten here many times. Good food.
Large portions. Great service. Only draw back is a bit on the pricey side. Eaten at many noodle houses , and this is one of the better ones. Food comes out really quick, so it is a good place to get quick bite.
name: Fred

text: My (now) girlfriend and I rang in the New Year at this awesome dance club. Downstairs was an open-air dance floor that seemed to play mostly Top 40 and Rock hits. My girlfriend and I spent our night upstairs, where they were playing hip-hop bangers, and doing it well. It was a good damn club. The music was loud, the remixes were on point, and everyone was having a good time.
name: Alek

text: Today was my first visit to Keg & Kitchen. I frequent a few other great bars and restaurants in the area but hadn't been to this location yet. Sadly I will not be back. Took my parents for Father's Day brunch. The Diet Coke tasted off and a little bit like chemicals, I was shocked when the (really great) waitress confirmed it wasn't some off brand cola and was in fact a normal coke product. It was undrinkable so I switched to coffee. The portions were small and over priced. The Eggs Your Way breakfast platter is something you'd be better off getting at one of the 20 decent diners in the area and you'll pay a third of the price. I had the most disappointing meal which was the grilled cheese. How can a chef be so lazy/stingy w cheese when it's literally the only thing on the sandwich. It also appeared microwaved because the cheese was hard, dried and bubbled. The bread crust was so hard I couldn't bite it and there wasn't much of a point in eating the edges because the cheese started about an inch into the sandwich anyway. I'm shocked this place would be anyone's choice with so many other great places to spend your money.
name: Tina

text: The chargrilled oysters are the only good thing on the menu however they're the best oysters in New Orleans.
name: Elisabeth

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Overall, a strong experience. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text:
This is a neat spot that has a nice menu. I had wing (5) and magna fries(cheese fries). A bit pricey for what you get in my opinion. The wife had a burger that was OK as were my wings. The food is nothing special to be honest, the atmosphere is kinda cool but dated. Service was a little slow but there's plenty to look at if you're into racing etc. there are some games(video, claw machine etc.) for you to play with while you're here. 
They have some great events, bike night and such which are fun to attend.
Overall, I'm glad I finally visited after driving by a thousand times but it probably won't be a regular spot.
name: Chris

text: Never been to kB & Co before and I'm glad I took the time to stop by here today. In the heart of downtown an it's a must goto forsure. We had the hemp hustler it was like a banana milkshake on steroids, Corn chowder was really good nice for this cold weather, also had the Cashew Cream Cheese avocado toast I loved it an I love this place . Workers here are very nice and well informed on the menu. I'll be back soon
name: Sir

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Not bad for a quick meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was good and came out fast. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
This is my 2nd time to a Colombia Restaurant (different location last time) and the experience was just as good.    They have mastered the balancing act of being a classy dinner restaurant while still being casual and approachable at a reasonable price point.   That's the perfect combination.

Service is polished and top-notch.    Friendly and expedient.

Food is amazing.   The 1903 (?) salad made tableside is one of the best I've ever had, bar none. Of course the authentic Cuban dishes with seafood were extremely fresh and flavorful.

I make it a point to come to the Columbia every time I'm in the Tampa area.
name: Peter

text: Great Italian restaurant! I've come here a few times and they have always has exceptional food. Their pasta is fresh and very tasty. Their appetizers are my favorite with some killer desserts that they have. Overall highly recommendable!
name: Shirin

text: Love this spot!! It's Always our go to. The salad and burgers are uhmazing. And you gotta try the tots
name: Cassie

text: Open, bright and inviting; as you first walk in. Can get busy on the weekend but tables move fairly quick. Waitress did a good job but was definitely overwhelmed by the all the tables she was single handedly expected to manage. So we didn't get to see any smiles and felt bad for her,honestly! The food was the star here. Portions weren't huge but good. Just fyi- look at the menu before you come here! It's a little specific and could use more variety. Overall, enjoyed our brunch.
name: Camar

text:
I want to give this place 5 stars. The good: The food is amazing! I love the Vegan burger. This is probably the closest tasting vegan burger to the real thing! And the Superfood salad which has lacinato kale, sautéed broccoli & garlic, shaved carrots, sunflower seeds, fresh herbs, mustard vinaigrette & nutritional yeast is so fresh and tasty! 
The not-so-good: The service. I have eaten in and ordered to go. Both times, the wait for the food is so long. When I ate in the restaurant, it took over 45 minutes to get our food, which seemed long for a burger and salad. It was even worse with the to-go order. When we came to pick it up, we were 30 minutes past the estimated time and still had to wait another 30 minutes. 
I would recommend this restauarant, just be prepared to wait a little while for your food.
name: Samantha

text: The food is amazing and gluten free. The owner is a gem and the staff is very pleasant. Notch place for that simple and tasty.
name: Jenn

text:
Recently, this has become the go-to location for my friends to have breakfast meetings, so I thought I would try it out for lunch. I love breakfast food, plus I'm on a low-carb thing, so omelets are always a good option.

When I walked in, I was a little bit confused. Usually, pancake houses have a bright and cheery interior, but this is laden with dark wood. I guess the left half of the restaurant is the Pancake House and the right side is now Gauchos Brazilian Steak House? Seems odd to figure out when I walked in, but I think that's what's happening.

I was seated by a friendly gal and given a very thorough menu that included everything from breakfast to dinner. Being Greek, I opted for my favorite omelet: the Greek with gyro meat, olives, feta, and tomatoes. The menu didn't mention the presence of spinach (that I noticed), but that was not disappointing (though the spinach was pretty stemmy). The omelet also came with a side of tzatziki sauce (not my fave recipe, as it was chunky and tasted odd). Overall, the omelet was just OK. It was a LOT of omelet---it could have easily been shared, so bully for them on serving sizes!---but it didn't have great flavor except for the olives, and some of the extra feta was weirdly rubbery. Is that just what happens to feta when it's heated? I feeeeeeel like that's never happened to me before.

In lieu of the carb-heavy pancakes and hash browns that typically come as sides, I asked for a side salad. It was just your typical side salad, with iceberg lettuce, tomato, and shredded cheese. But someone needs to get them a salad spinner ASAP because it was essentially served in a puddle. I ended up pouring out the water from the bottom of my salad on to the plate below. Wet lettuce is nobody's friend.

As I do love breakfast food, I'm a fan of many of the local pancake houses. This, however, doesn't make my short list.
name: Rachel

text: For a busy night they handled it okay. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Definitely coming back. It looked better online than it did in person. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: This is our 2nd time at Agave and as before it was perfect. We started with the guacamole and chips and BANG wonderful and fresh. We also got the traditional margarita and added our tequila. The fish tacos were excellent and just the right size. Our daughter had the beef tacos and our son had the pork and they were unbelievable. You must go.
name: Mary

text: Look, service was great music was great food was great! Price is an opinion that you will have to decide but if you want cheap go to fast food. Have a hurricane and relax!
name: Erknick

text: I love this little restaurant. The business is family owned and the man who runs the restaurant is very friendly and attentive to the customer's requests and needs. They are very veg-friendly and as a vegan I really appreciate this! Their food is divine. Some of the best Mediterranean food I've had. I just wish they took credit card and advertised that it is cash only better. Either way, I'll be back again soon :)
name: Laura

text: This has become our favorite restaurant..It was a full house so we had a pre dinner drink at the bar. Sam , the bartender, handled the crowd great.. Patrick the GM always mixes it up with the customers to make it really fun. Casey our waiter was very attentive and recommended the specials. The roasted  chicken over linguine was delicious... The chicken parm was very tender also... Another great night was had by all.
name: Mike

text: Delicious. Better than Pats & Ginos.
name: David

text: Just wanted to say that since my last visit, we went here for brunch and MAN, their waffle is the best waffle I've had in the city. With the toasted almonds on it? Soooo good.
name: Rachel

text: Two Cesar salads and wings for $50...delivered with the dressings exploded all over the bag and rotten lettuce. I will not be returning.
name: Rebecca

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: Tried this place after reading reviews and reviewing photos. I must say that I was really disappointed with my purchase. I ordered a large oxtail dinner that consisted of 4 small pieces that contained very little meat and were a bit tough. Was not what I had in mind for the amount charged. Do not think I will be patronizing this place again.
name: Alex

text: This place was amazing!! So good we went back twice! It was a little more than we care to spend on bar drinks and food but they gave us a rewards card on our first visit that when activated, gives you $10 off. After you spend $100 you get $20 off. So by our second visit we had $20 off. The staff was SO attentive and the food was great! The bottomless fries are always a bonus too. The drinks were fantastic and their beer selections were great. 10/10 would recommend!!
name: Jillian

text: I have been going to Mother's for years, making it a regular stop on business and personal trips to New Orleans.  Both the service and quality of the food have both suffered recently. On my last trip there yesterday, the wait staff seemed not to care about getting the food out quickly and accurately.  When I complained to the manager about a side order of fries not coming out, after asking the wait staff three times (twice politely), my complaint was answered with an attitude of indifference and nothing even close to an apology.  Overall, the food is average and expensive.  I won't be going back, it has turned into a tourist trap.  There are many other better choices in The Big Easy.
name: Robert

text: It's a big chain restaurant with a pretty good cream of potato soup that my Mom loves.  Big portions with fresh rolls to help fill you up before the meal arrives.  Even though the corporate office may be out of state, the workers here are local and do a great job.  Last time we were in we both got the soup and half a Club sandwich.  The club was also very good, not sure why we got the buttered rolls with this one.  Your choices are somewhat limited when dining out around Mooresville and this is one of the better choices for variety.
name: Mark

text: JP is an amazing chef. My wife and I went there because we so loved his creations when he had Le Bon Café. We had the rice noodles with veggies, plantain tacos and wild mushroom tacos. It was all so very yummy. JP is very health conscious, so it's comforting to know that he uses the best ingredients. It's great to have a place where we can bring friends who may have vegan or gluten-free diets, along with friends who want meat options, and all at very reasonable prices, considering the top quality of the food.  We highly recommend this restaurant!
name: T.

text: The slab of ribs special looked like a great deal. If you like very dry, tough chewy ribs made with a spicy, salty dry rub, well this is the place for you. For me, not so much.
name: Sheryl

text: This was my first time at Oak Oven and the food was DELICIOUS! I am definitely going back to try more of the menu items! I had the soup of the day (crab and pumpkin bisque- I know not a normal combination) and it was delicious, fried calamari= delicious, spinach salad= delicious and my friend had the homemade pasta with shrimp = delicious!!! So glad we decided to go here, and our server Alicia was nice, helpful(she told us how good the soup was), and fast!
name: LaDonna

text:
I've been eating at Olympia since I was a child. Not only are the flavors authentic but the atmosphere is a perfect blend of formal and fun. Whether you're there for a family gathering or a romantic first date, the must have flaming cheese (saganaki) and a shot of ouzo is sure it make for a fun and memorable evening. 

I recommend the hummus first and foremost. A simple yet effective recipe yes, but the texture is divine. 

For dinner you can't miss the Greek salad. If you're having an entree a side salad will do. Don't ask about dressings because they only offer the only one you need, Greek dressing. 

For your entree the lamb Kebob medium rare is a must have and arguably one of the strongest dishes in St. Louis. A bite with pita bread, rice, veggies, and lamb have me craving it far more than I can make it in. 

Finish off with the rice pudding. Just do it. Young or old, it'll make you feel like a kid again. 

Can't wait to be back!
name: Nicholas

text:
I've eaten many a sandwich across these great states and Blues City Deli is hands down the best sandwich I've ever had.
To say that I've had dreams about my sandwich here is not an exaggeration.

You're going to wait a little to get in but I'm a firm believer that the saying "good things come to those who wait" was written by someone in line at Blues City Deli. And it moved pretty quickly.

I had the Carmelo with a bottled soda and chips and it was super flavorful and just checked all the boxes for me. 

If you only have one hour in St. Louis, spend it here.
name: Dan

text: Wow...started off great but then a hair in my friend's  truffle burger..wow. First time and last time at Mirko
name: Susan

text: Wait list was about 10 minutes off. Overall, the food was really good. Recommended dishes are the mongolion beef, spicy wontons, and hot and sour soup. The food was better the first time we went. Maybe because the second time was right before the holidays? The restaurant is packed almost every time. It's a small restaurant, but it's nice.
name: Vin

text: Food was great and cocktail list is fun. Even the non-alcoholic drinks are good. Best thing was the service. Can't wait to go back.
name: Ruth

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. My experience was honestly fine. Not bad for a quick meal. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It looked better online than it did in person. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: I'd love to know what happened to this place. It used to be a favorite...we'd go at least once a month to dine-in and at least twice a month for take-out. It was so good. Slowly things started changing and now it's just plain blah. First of all, it's dirty. They need an overhaul on the inside, especially the kitchen area. Second, the food has changed and it's not good anymore. The last time we ate it, we "tasted it" for days. The hot food was not hot and the cold food was not cold. It was as if everything had been sitting out for half a day. Friends of ours say they took their favorite meals off the menu. I really hope they turn it around, but I won't be going back.
name: St Pete Native

text:
Great sandwiches! I mean great! I am sitting in Bakersfield CA wishing Inwere back in Reno just to get a Fat Belly Deli Italian sub. They have all kinds of food there and from what I can see, they never skimp on the ingredients. The place is clean, service fast, sandwiches loaded up, and price fair. 

If you are in Reno, go track this place down. It is completely worth the trip.
name: Will

text: all i can say is be prepared to spend a lot of money especially if you want an actual entree!
name: Laura

text: My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The music was louder than it needed to be. It looked better online than it did in person. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Food is food, beautifully presented. Service terrible, we ordered food as a group and as we watched everyone receive their orders and eat around us...we asked about our order...we never got out meal.  Ended up cancelling it as our guests received their meals well before us and had finished before our sushi would arrive.  Sushi Guys Intl.
name: Kurt

text: Today's lunch was lamb and goat cheese salad over a spring mix.  It was so delicious after my long bike ride from the The crosstown ferry ride from st Pete.  It had candied pecans, craisens, pear slices and balsamic dressing.  This was by far the shortest time I've waited for any lunch here so hands down for fast fresh and delicious!
name: Jude

text: This is the worst McDonald's I've ever been to in my life. If I could give them 0 stars I would. There is absolutely no communication between the staff. They don't have half the food I want to order. Every single time I go there, it's always a horrible experience. Last time I went there I was waiting in the drive through and no one came to my side of the speakers and the other side had ten cars already pass. So I decided to go around to the other one and of course I'm the only one there and they still wouldn't answer me. Another time they had me wait in the drive thru for 30 minutes AFTER I HAD ALREADY PAID FOR MY ORDER for them to tell me they're out of what I wanted. The staff is always bickering and arguing. Everyone is always in a terrible mood. The ONLY reason I go there is for convenience. Which I'm going to stop doing after today. My husband and the rest of the people waiting in line today at the drive thru all decided to go to the McDonald's on Gallatin cause of course they're being ridiculous again today. Spend that little extra gas money people and go to another McDonald's cause this ones not worth going to.
name: Aldijana

text: Had the white shrimp tacos and octopus ones and they were to die for! Super delish! And would Go back!
name: Liliana

text: It was the worst experience of my life we got our food 3 hours later. It was our friends birthday it was so disappointing. And we still spent 300.00 for food that was late drinks came late. Don't waist your time. They need to get there act together.
name: Carol

text: We've been in Florida for 16 years, the last 4 as permanent residents. Cody's has always been one of our favorites. Since we have become permanent, it has gone steadily down hill. The final straw was Thursday, January 11. We had 3 couples, all paying with separate checks. My wife ordered the haddock with a side of loaded mac and cheese. The fish came out first but the mac and cheese was a no-show. 15 minutes later, after telling the waitress we still needed he mac and cheese, it arrived. but of course, the fish was now cold and it is no fun eating re-heated fish, So I told the waitress (Ashley) to cancel the order and I would not be paying for it. She accepted it well, apologized and to her credit took it off the bill. But the real fun started when the bills came. We were in possession of $25.00 gift certificates given out by Cody's for the holidays but were told that only one could be used per table. These certificates evidently had all sort of requirements, one of which was only one per table. Even though they were purchased separately and we had separate bills, the manager (Tami) was unrelenting and pretty much hung Ashley out to dry. So making this short, we will not patronize this Cody's again nor will we recommend it to our visitors and friends.
name: Neal

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Glad we tried it. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: I love the signature options of bowls they have for when I don't want to make any choices, but also like the option to build my own bowl. Some of the other chains have a few more options on fish and toppings, but the base options here (zoodles!!!) make up for it! I had the Aloha Signature Bowl because spicy everything is life and I really enjoyed it.
name: Chelsea

text: We had the carbonara, and it was very good. The service was also very good, and we will return often. The place was very clean which is important to me. It was very busy , a good sign the food is great.
name: Lance Chris

text:
Had an awesome time at Tennessee Brew Works with a good friend. We enjoyed a number of their beers and some appetizers, but because they had a private party we had to leave early.

They had a great band playing some music that night too. Very casual and relaxing place to hang out and just chill. The Patio was also a nice since it wasn't too hot

I will definitely be back and try more of their offerings very soon
name: Mike

text:
Lunch...
Big lunch...
Big Japanese lunch.

I had the namesake platter, the Shogun.
Like all great Japanese experiences, it comes in waves.
Clear broth soup and seaweed salad. Yum.
Then tempura shrimp and veggies. Yum.
Then beef and chicken teriyaki skewers topped off with a bowl of fried rice and a cabbage salad. Yum yum.

Lots of food.
Lots of yum.
Lots of money... 
Not so yum.

My wallet won't allow me to do this often...
But it was quite delicious, quite yummy, quite healthy...

Shogun... Shonuff.
name: Marty

text: For a great diner experience, this was awesome. Can't beat a place that's been around for 100 years. Not fancy. Not all that healthy. Plenty good home cooked standards. I really enjoyed my country ham biscuits, grits and strong black coffee. Super friendly people were a nice plus!
name: Tony

text: This place is huge and very loud. Super loud band on the patio and lots of screaming children. Just not my favorite type of place.  I had a Pain Killer and it was served differently each time and my husband tried several different specialty drinks and nothing was memorable. Both the oysters and seafood chowder were very good. My husband had the paella and he said it was some of the best he ever had. I has shrimp and grits which were fair. Portions are huge. Even though it is huge place, service is quick and efficient but not friendly. It seems they strive to get people in and out as quickly as possible.
name: Mary

text: Very old fashioned steak house...rustic cowboy feel with good outdoor seating except in our hot Tucson summers.  My steak was great and service was good.not fancy and they didn't mind my small dog under the table
name: Sandy

text: Toasted bruschetta was delicious.  Pizza very very good.  Wonderful family atmosphere.  Wait staff was great.  They serve breakfast too! Quick service and priced right.
name: Beth

text: Classic breakfast and complimentary biscuits & jam. Yummm. Super quick seating for a busy place! No complaints.
name: Sara

text: For what it is, pub n sub hits every line on my "neighborhood pub and late night food" checklist! I recommend the garlic chicken pizza which is AMAZING! Darren the bartender is super nice! Also, 2$ mimosa Wednesday's for the ladies!! Yes please!
name: Ashlee

text: All I had was a bowl of potato soup and chips and queso. Yet somehow they can't even get those classics right. The potato soup tasted like potatoes with gravy on top. The nachos were all still have the queso was very thin and not good at all. This really surprises me how truly horrible the food was here.Several people at my table that had good meals tried mine and none of them were able to finish the bite they tried. I will not be back if they can't even get the two simplest things on their menu correct.
name: Aj

text: Great food, cool atmosphere. Have been going for years and definitely recommend!
name: Erika

text: Nice atmosphere, it even had some outside seating. Food was delicious. We had the shrimp and grits and chicken and waffles. The only thing that would keep me from going back is the time it took to get our food.  It took 40 mins to get our food and they weren't busy. Hopefully this gets straightened out because the food really was delicious.
name: Jessica

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Will be back. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food was fresh and service was quick. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It looked better online than it did in person. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Pleasantly surprised at the quality of sushi this place has. The chef is passionate. But unfortunately can only serve sushi in the evenings.
name: Rizzo

text: There's nothing they get wrong! Fresh, hot, smokey bbq and sides! Long lines, but shorter waits. Great staff and great service. Love ALL the meats, and the baked beans, fried corn, green beans, and fries are all family favorites. I'm from Chicago, but NEVER miss a chance to eat at Pappy's if im within an hour of this place! The owner is pretty cool too.
name: Shaun

text:
This place is my favorite spot to show guests. You get to see some touristy spots like the liberty bell and the beer garden is always a fun place. 

Food and drinks are reasonably priced. Beer is like 5-7 bucks but cheaper at happy hour. Happy hour snacks are like 3 or 5 bucks. otherwise they are like 4-9 bucks. Just average fried food but it hits the spot after you get a few beers. 

What I don't like is there is like a bathroom attendant, but like I don't think he works there. I think its just a guy who decides to make a buck by giving people paper towels and soap. He really pushes you to tip him and this year he has a venmo up so if you dont have cash he still asks for a tip. I would rather just wash my hands by myself.... but I guess I respect the hustle. 

Also, this should be expected, but there are Bros all over the place. Sorta like a frat day long for people who are trying to relive the glory days.
name: Siavash

text:
Pleasant easy to find storefront with small but clean interior. Lunch menu is small: I ordered Pad Thai and chicken was my only choice. 
Started with Thai Iced tea, something order every time I go for Thai. It was nice and sweet but not quite as creamy as some I've had. This is good or bad depending on your taste. 
The Pad Thai came piping hot, almost burned my mouth. I ordered a spice level of 2/4, and the heat was very mild. The chicken was abundant, noodles were al dente, nice heap of crushed peanuts,  ran sprouts and a few lime slices. Flavor was excellent. 
Lunch with tip was about $18, a little higher than many lunch places downtown. The portions were modest, enough for lunch but you won't have any extra to take home. 
Next time (and there will be a next time!) I want to try some of their curries.
name: Kurt

text: first time having dinner at chuy's the food is very authentic the service is great the drinks were fantastic if you're in midtown I definitely recommend if you want Mexican food
name: Ed

text: Had a sampling of sandwiches here and loved them all. The bread tastes fresh and they are clean and friendly
name: Yizhou

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Just not for me. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: So far this is the only Indian restaurant I've ate at and still retuned! Anyways, ambience is cool, (can) be intimate if you want, but it being a buffet style makes it not (for me). Decor is nice, lots of cultural arts on the wall which I like very much. It's buffet style, with someone there to take your drinks order, clean your table. Food is great!!! I only eat the sauce that has chicken!! Will post it. It's just a cool place. My cousin & I stopped here on our way home because we were hungry and wanted something good and familiar. You have to try it to see if it's your taste. Price is very reasonable
name: Willietta

text: Very tasty! This will be my new spot when I'm in the area. I ordered a Shrimp Chimichanga at midtown location and everything was fresh and flavorful.
name: Jay

text: Wow, fantastic like always. So very happy I took the out of town guests here. Kyra was so attentive and the food was out of the world. This is a must stop in Tampa.
name: Huck

text: Great atmosphere, pretty extensive menu for a small place. Iced espresso mocha and the sandwich was very good (their sandwiches all come with chips and salsa...which is nice. Most places in this area charge extra for EVERYTHING). Parking is a little dicey around peak hours or when the "Laptopers" set up shop inside with their 1 drink and stay for hours..but overall, this is great little place. Very comfortable, lots of windows, great ambiance...
name: Matt

text:
Excellent Old Tucson Mexican restaurant (supposedly the oldest existing) in the heart of downtown.  Had steak fajitas and queso fundido to split with the GF and both were excellent.  Service is nuts good- 4 separate staff waited on us- frankly, a bit too good as we are "deep talkers", and every few minutes we were interrupted in our very lovely, life-affirming chats.  But the thoughtfulness was appreciated.  Especially after an hour wait to be seated!

One star off for mediocre, watery margaritas (had 4, all different) from an uber busy but vastly overselling self important bartender who claimed these were "the best margaritas you'll ever have!".  Uh, no.  Not even in the top 1000.  Watered down, flavorless.  But they had El Silencio mezcal on premises, so I aaaaaaalmost gave that star back!  If I could give a half star, I would...
name: Thom

text: One of the best Taco Bell locations in the area! Food portions are generous, and items look like their photos. The staff is very friendly and ensures quick and accurate service.
name: Kim

text: Great place been there a number of times .Service is always excellent food is all good,beautiful space in and out doors.Have only been there for lunch so I could not say anything about dinner.
name: Louis

text: Great rum runner.  salad and the shrimp diablo is full of flavor and a generous portion. All of the food was delicious, such as the crab nachos, the coconut shrimp. The waitress Gina is extremely friendly and helpful.
name: Denise

text: We decided to go here because we had a coupon. The place was cute and located on the main strip downtown near other restaurant s. The food was good but not great. I would go again , but not if I had to pay full price. The staff was very nice and took good care of us.
name: Shelly

text: I'm extremely dissatisfied and disappointed with my visit today. I love Sakana and think their sushi quite good, but today their service was too poor. I placed an online order to pick up at 8:30. I arrived at the restaurant at 8:40, 10 minutes late. Understandably, I expected my order to be ready to go. No. It wasn't ready when I arrived, in fact they hadn't even started on it. I ended up waiting 45 minutes for my order. In the time I was waiting, a man came up to the bar, ordered, ate, paid and left. I understand that restaurants can get busy, and I'm okay waiting a little, but waiting for 45 minutes for an online order that should have been ready when I arrived is just unacceptable.
name: Todd

text: My husband and I love, love, LOVE this local coffee shop! They make delicious coffee beverages and always have special flavors of lattes. Their food is cooked fresh and not frozen like other chain coffee places. The hearty wrap with chorizo is our fav! We'll split one for a quick breakfast or each get our own if we're starving. The drive through is the best part. You can get a yummy jolt of caffeine and hearty breakfast from a local family shop and in a flash!
name: Sam

text: My friend liked it more than I did. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. It was decent, just a little uneven. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: The only vegan option is the tofu spring rolls (super refreshing) & number 19. The tofu stir fry is super super good and they recently changed the sauce to a vegan sauce so you don't have to substitute anything. Delicious!
name: Caitlyn

text: good enviroment for something quick.  to top it off the line on a thurs night wasn't bad at all
name: J

text: Celebrated our anniversary here last night and enjoyed everything immensely. We decided to split the clam chowder as an appetizer. I told the waiter that I was from New England and thought this version was freaking amazing! Unusual to have clams in the shells but they were fresh and delicious.  For entrees, my wife had the lobster cannelloni and I had the duck. Both dishes were excellent. Both cocktails (slow yer roll and a satisfied woman) we tried were also great.
name: Judy

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. For the price I expected more than this. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The whole meal felt kinda uneven.
name: User

text: Looks Pretty but it was just so bland. Husband and I went for lunch the staff was nice but our waiter was odd. After he finished writing my husbands order, instead of letting me know he was ready for my order, he just stared at me until I noticed he was ready. I ordered the Vegetarian Torta which was listed to have an assortment of veggies with beans and cheese. When I got my order, although not bad, it was very flavorless. There were no spices of any sort cooked into it. On top of that there was little to no cheese, and Mayonnaise which was not listed as an ingredient on the menu. Over all the best part of my meal was the chips and salsa.
name: Skyler

text: My Husband and I come here occasionally for a nice quiet Sunday morning breakfast. It's a little pricey, but worth it for the atmosphere and quality of food and coffee.
name: Emily

text: I have come to chucks alibi before but this has been the first time I have been here in a while. It was a cool experience, the restaurant wasn't packed and the vibes were chill. It did take a minute for us to be served at the bar. There weren't that many guest but the bartenders were taking their time. It took about 20minutes after we put a drink order in to put a food order in after that. When the food did arrive it was excellent. The teriyaki wings were top notch and the bbq not so much. The shrimp and salmon salad was extensive good down to the last bite. This was really the best part of the meal. Even though the bartenders were moving at a slow pace, they were friendly. The drinks weren't that strong to be honest and they had way too much ice in the cup. Overall my experience here was about 3.2 star  rating. I want to come on the day they have unlimited crabs .
name: Toriano

text: I'm not a big fan of commercial restaurants, however,  Longhorn is one of my go to places... Mainly because I love the bread! This was my first time to this location, I sat at the bar and the bartender was very talkative and friendly. I ordered the porkchops with the sweet potato and the porkchops were very tough, pretty much over cooked. This doesn't surprise me as most of the time the main entrée is either over or under cooked to some degree. The food is pretty decent though but as I said in the beginning, the real show stealer for me is the bread, I love that stuff!
name: Shawn

text: This is my favorite restaurant of all time. The service was amazing, everyone had a smile, and it was obvious that everyone worked as a team. There was never a moment where I was waiting on something that took too long. I am very picky, and everything was perfect. There was so much flavor in every bite. We had the brussels, scallops, and lamb loin. We had the regular old fashioned with light sugar and bitters, and they came out perfect. We shared the ice cream sundae for dessert, and it really topped off the experience. Every single person had such attention to detail and made sure our experience was top notch. I can't say enough great things about this place.
name: Kim

text: Bern's is where we have gone for decades, for a fine meal. My recent visits have changed my opinion. We had our second bad meal, in a row, at this restaurant. The steaks were too tough to cut. The first was not replaced, it was implied I'd made a poor choice. The second steak was replaced, and was very good. The sides were less than fabulous. The desserts were good, but we had friends dealing with broken chairs. It was embarrassing! I don't care to return.
name: Kelly

text: Very comfortable barbecue atmosphere with very tasty dry ribs, nice brew selection and service was with a smile and efficient. Looking forward to a return trip
name: Brian

text: We came down to eat dinner here on recommendation and weren't let down. The alligator bites and grouper nuggets were great. We did the seafood platter 25 bucks. Conch balls. Grouper. Scallops (amazing). Crab cake. Shrimp. Came with fries and bread to help fill the gap. And can't beat 1.99 beers and 2.99 margaritas.
name: Jason

text: We were looking for something different and came across chief's creole cafe. So glad we did. My husband and I had the triple. We had jambalaya, red beans and rice and gumbo and the bread pudding with bourbon sauce. Everything was DELICIOUS and the bread pudding was to die for. We did takeout so we could make it back for the sunset. The lady who helped us couldn't have been nicer. She even gave us two slices of bread pudding. Everything was packed perfectly and exceeded our expectations!  They should have at least five stars.
name: Barbara

text: Always fantastic. Very hard to get a reservation - I stalk open table frequently looking for weekend reservations to open up.
name: Kristine

text: This place is a welcomed addition to downtown Palm Harbor.  The food is prepared perfectly.  The staff is wonderful.  They may have the best fish tacos in town.   I love the corn hole setup.   The only down side is that they have super uncomfortable chairs. They look really nice but you slide all over the place.  I have been there twice this week and may go back again.
name: Brad

text: I've been here twice, both times to celebrate my birthday. I'm always impressed. Everything tastes fresh and is cooked to perfection, and the service and ambiance are always 5 star. They have really interesting combinations of ingredients and their execution is flawless. I highly recommend Mise en Place!
name: Ella

text: I would say this is a good replacement of The fly bar. With similar concept of small plates but the difference is the Spanish style here. The menu is good my only issue with it for the past year that I've been coming here the menu changes often, maybe that's part of the concept. My favorite used to be the bacon wrapped with a cranberry fruit. They still have something similar but it does not taste the same. I usually come here on my own for an early happy hour for a quiet time before I have to deal with the kids I have a drink and get a quick bite to eat and I'm good to go. The service is always awesome never had any major issues. On busy nights your server may forget about you for a little longer than expected.  Because I don't live far, it's always an option for me to get a quick bite to eat and go on my way.
name: Natasha

text: As a Chinese woman who's grown up around Asian food from Las Vegas, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, I was thoroughly impressed with the overall quality of the food. It came quickly and service was attentive. I'm very happy with this little find and it certainly deserves the awards that it has decorating its walls.
name: Jay

text: We are frequent flyers here.  Never a wait, quick service, the food is the best on Washington Ave.  Great that parking lot is very large so easier to find a spot.  Stress free dining with our three little kids.
name: Vee

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. It looked better online than it did in person. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was good and came out fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Excellent seafood. Great New England clam chowder. Their fried shrimp & blackened grouper are my favorites. Very friendly ownership & fast service.
name: Tom

text: I had high hopes for this restaurant. Went at noon on a Wednesday, there weren't many there. Waited 20 minutes to be seated as employees passed on their phones. The waitress did not inform us of anything on the menu. We ordered chicken tacos and everything was cold. Ordered different tacos with shrimp and still cold with stale shells. $60 worth of food when Taco Bell would've tasted better for $10.
name: Soarin' With

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The music was louder than it needed to be. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I left full, which at least counts for something. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
I remember the years after I moved to Tucson in 2005. On two occasions I had to instruct the server how to open a bottle of wine. The food was such that there was one main person in the kitchen of many restaurants and if that person was out it was a disaster. My father was told by a server that there "were no beans in our pasta and fagioli soup."

Wow have things changed. Tucson's cuisine is now receiving accolades not just nationally but internationally. And deservedly so. Commoner & Company are one outstanding example of why this is deserved.
The small menu is inventive and extremely well executed including the right ingredients combined correctly and served on the right kind of plate. Service was informed and excellent. Comfort is above average with tables well-spaced. Everything is obviously made from scratch, the empanadas I had were the best I think I've ever had. The ricotta gnocchi was basically a perfect dish as was the salad. My drink was made expertly and dessert was excellent.

Bravo.
name: Bill

text: We went for lunch today on our way through town. There is street parking right in front that was about $4. The menu is written on a chalkboard wall - cute! They have a Freestyle coke machine so you can mix up your favorite drink! Each menu item is separate. So if you order a burger, you'll order your waffle fries separately which can add up. The two of us ate with small drinks for $28 so it was a bit expensive for a quick lunch stop. The waffle fries are seasoned and are very delicious! There is a small bar there where you can get a draft or can beer. The staff was friendly and food was good! If you are in the area I'd check it out!
name: Maria

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Wasabi is great Sushi at a great price. Been here 3 times myself, great customer service, especially the waitresses. Flor is just absolutely amazing, food is amazing, keeps us coming back!!
name: Anthony

text: coffee was amazing and the environment was very chill and very aesthetic. nice space for working on homework, projects, work. quiet and has good vibes. would definitely recommend
name: Callie

text:
Best tacos in town... I've tried almost all of them and will likely go through the entire menu again. I try to go here once a week because it's worth it, not too pricey and the food is delicious. 

I recommend the Surf & Turf Taco. Shrimp & Steak

Previous review was a 5... update to a 1... we waited for 15-20 minutes without ever being acknowledged, however multiple staff walked by us... will likely not return
name: Derrek

text: Great find for us. Thank you yelpers. The tacos are amazing. The family loved them. Fresh squeezed lemonade was perfect on a hot day.
name: Chad

text: I'm very unclear as to what I just spent almost 11 dollars on. I just ordered one of the Mushroom Kingdom grilled cheeses which was purported to come with a tomato soup and a side of pickles. The mushroom kingdom sand which is described as "local mushrooms, garlic butter, truffle oil, goat cheese, brioche bread. Served with a side of tomato soup and pickles" Should be sinfully delicious!! What I got was limp bread with goat cheese, what looks to be canned mushrooms, and a side of marinara sauce and four pickle slices :( :( :(. I'm attaching a photo for reference but folks this lunch was ROUGH. Will not be back for lunch, would rather spend money at yummy sushi or Panda Express!! At least I would be full and much happier.
name: Michelle

text: Ordered chicken soup. Looked and tasted weird. The meat was dark brown and stringy. Owner came over and said the meat takes on the color of the broth. Isn't chicken soup light yellow, not brown? We overheard the cook say it was made Saturday and this was Friday, contrary to what the owner claims we were wrong. He also replied to another post I made that I was looking for a free meal and complained about everything.  The soup was the only thing we complained about and he, himself didn't have an answer as to why it was so bad tasting. They gave us split pea, which wasn't bad, but never took a dollar off the bill for the problem with the soup. Terrible customer service and a nasty reply to an honest review
name: Marianne

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. It looked better online than it did in person. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: The food is good. The ambiance is beautiful and elegant. The prices on the expensive side. I would recommend finding a way to please all budgets. Perhaps during happy hour or just lower the price in some dishes to make the place more " All budget" friendly.
name: Vivetkah

text: Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The music was louder than it needed to be. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Definitely coming back. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: This place reminds me exactly of the diners I've been to in El Paso, Texas. Very Southwest vibe inside and the menu is exactly that. Also very hole in the wall place as I didn't even notice it was a restaurant even though I've driven past it plenty of times. I ended up going with the southwest slinger (hamburger patties with beef and potatoes). It was definitely tasty but it was nothing special in terms of breakfast food I've had. My friends said their dishes were good too but also nothing out of the ordinary. I enjoyed the experience as the decor was fun and the service was great, but the food itself was nothing to write home about. I'd come again if I was in the area, but not my first choice for breakfast/brunch in St. Louis.
name: Tikku

text: This place is not equipped to handle large crowds. I was here for a Halloween bar crawl so this place was packed. They had a private party in the lower level so that was off limits. It was extremely crowded and almost physically impossible to get a drink. When I finally made it to the bar, the bartender was extremely rude. I would definitely never come back here again.
name: Paulene

text: This place gets crazy good word of mouth, so we thought we'd give it a shot.  The beer selection isn't nearly as extensive as we were hoping, but we just had to try the Hermanaki wings.  They were very strange, but also fairly delicious.  I'm not sure if it's what I'm looking for in bar food, but I think they're certainly worth trying.  Nothing else we tasted really blew us away.  We might check this place out again to catch a baseball game.

text:
I bet this place has been described as a hidden gem ad nauseam, but it's true. You're not going to see Tai Ke while casually driving by. But if you walk into this hard-to-find and far from aesthetic restaurant that's hidden behind an urgent care, you'll be met with amazing food. 
 
  I've been to Tai Ke numerous times and have never had a bad meal. Some of mine and my family's favorites include the Taiwanese Braised Beef Noodle Soup, Sizzling Tenderloin Steak, And the braised pork over rice (Which could be a satisfying meal on its own for only $5!) The portions are always very generous for the price, and the food comes out fast. 

 Two things that I also think are worth mentioning:  

- Tai Ke is one of the few restaurants open past 9 pm that isn't a sit-down or bar type restaurant. Due to work I eat late dinners quite often, and Tai Ke has been my savior. 
-The third or fourth time my father and I came to Tai Ke, one of the workers said that he remembers us and even remembered what we had ordered on our last visit. I love that! :) 

  Okay I'm going to stop jabbering and just tell you that you should go here lol. There is no way you'll regret it.

text:
Meh. We had high hopes for Morimoto and decided to dine here for lunch this week. We made a reservation and were seated promptly. We were surprised that there were only two other tables with guests in the entire restaurant at noon on a Monday. I'm pregnant, so no sushi for me, but I lived in japan before and saw the menu and knew there was strong potential for other options without raw fish. I ordered the chicken katsu and upgraded my miso soup to the yasai (vegetable) ramen, and my husband ordered the sashimi lunch set. We ordered some edamame to share as a starter. The edamame came out first and it arrived in a huge portion and was perfectly steamed. Next came our salads with soup (my husband upgraded his ramen as well). The salad was good, but heavy on the yuzu dressing, and the ramen was fine but lacked flavor beside the tasty bites of flavor infused mushrooms.  When my chicken katsu came out, it looked simply sad. A massive bowl of soggy chicken with scattered egg and onion around on top of a soupy bed of rice. The meal itself tasted about as good as my description. Fine - possibly something I could make at home, but definitely not something an upscale (or even average) Japanese restaurant in Japan would consider acceptable to serve. My husband's sashimi was also fine. The cuts didn't look completely fresh, and it was clear when his stomach wasn't right after lunch that the fish wasn't really fresh.

We've been to a few other Japanese restaurants in the city and hoped Morimoto would be amazing in comparison to our other go-tos, but sadly it was overpriced and barely average. We won't be coming back and will instead go to the other places we usually go to as we know the quality of the food is far better and the service is exceptional.

text:
I arrived in Conshy for a project a few months ago and immediately went on the coffee hunt.  After trying a few places that will not be named where the coffee could be a substitute for rat poison, I was directed to 'feine.  

From my first step through the door I could tell that this was the type of coffee shop up my alley.  Matcha, almond milk, chai, and all the other buzzwords you want to see on a well crafted chalk board in a coffee shop.  The owner is passionate about her coffee selections and sources appropriately (like actually goes to coffee conventions and stuff). 

Lots of good gluten free options as well as a pretty dope (not healthy) ham and cheese croissant if you have earned yourself a few calories.

The shop has character and the little things here make you feel welcomed such as the white wooden barricade blocking off the dish sink, the organized chaos of the empty frames on the wall, the water jug on the mantle, and the Rx bars in their little wooden basket just to name a few.  I always like what they do with the little slogans on the board. 

Glad I found 'Feine because it fueled my morning survival these past few months. Now that I am rolling off the project this is one of the places I will miss the most around Conshy.
name: Alex

text:
If you're in New Hope, this market is rather unassuming. It doesn't have a cute exterior or kitschy touristy stuff placed out front to garner one's attention. However once inside, I'd say it's like an extremely mini version of Philly's Reading Terminal Market. Except...the bathrooms are actually somewhat clean and it's not as crowded. 

We saw an Indian eatery selling a nicely sized portion of rice and your choice of curry (tikka masala Et. al) for $8.95, that's dirt cheap for this town! It'll help offset the $6 you can spend for a delicious cookie immediately down the way from there. 

Also has a winery that has tastings (nobody was around when we walked by), a gyro place, Poke bowls, a meat/cheese shoppe (intentionally went with the pretentious spelling for that), coffee, and likely a few places I'm overlooking. 

Definitely stop by to enjoy some AC, heed the call of nature, taste a sweet treat and save some $ on lunch or dinner if you aren't planning on dining anywhere "nice" in New Hope/Lambertville.
name: Will

text:
264th reviewer of Mai Thai, Downtown Boise, Idaho. 
This is my 378th review on Yelp! I love Yelp! It's helped me find amazing places like this and amazing people like you! 

Happy Hour 5/5
Healthy Choices 4/5 (based on happy hour menu only) 
Bar 5/5 EASY!
Seating 3/5
location 5/5
Price 4/5
Overall diversity and comfort level 5/5

Wow! What a good time! I've been wanting to try this place for some time and tonight I finally did! Yay! I'm a SUPER fan and will visit again soon, tomorrow perhaps?!?

Walking in, I was nervous because I didn't have reservations and I looked at other reviews on Yelp using the keyword "Happy hour" and it was very clear that I needed reservations. I walked in about 5 pm and I was the only person there, which allowed me to look around and take some photos. Beautiful-- period. Shortly thereafter the people rolled in, and rolled in, which was an ah ha moment! Get there early! The crowd was all over the place, which as a sociologist I loved. People are beautiful and amaze me! This is a smaller establishment and they do their best with space. Look up at the fans--- never seen that before (look at my video). 

Being a single dad of 4 I've recently learned that Happy Hour is a way to get what you want, and pay half the price and Mai Thai didn't disappoint. 
The waiter was very nice, knowledgeable, and receptive. 

Happy Hour is 1/2 price apps and BOGO drinks! You must sit in the bar area for Happy Hour, but there are over 10 tables, one booth and ample seating at the actual bar. You just can't sit in the dining room. 

This is what we ordered:

Portobello Tempura Mushrooms ($6 happy hour $12 regular) A++ 
Huge chunks of Mushroom tempura covered and fried. Served with Sweet Soy sauce. Epic!

California Roll--  ($5 HH $10 reg) These rolls were wrapped very tightly and big chunks with quality ingredients-- another A+ Ordered two of them! Classic Kani and avocado roll with sesame and cucumber. 

Thai Chicken Satay's with a peanut sauce ($6 HH $12 reg.) 3/5-- not my favorite, but good nevertheless. 
_________________________________________________________
********* DRINKS************
Full bar-- bartenders are true mixologists! Their menu has lots of signature drinks and lots of different expirimental drinks. 
Again, BOGO. I ordered:

First was Spiced & Iced-- Markers Mark, Averna, Amarula, Thai Chili Honey, Mint, Thai Iced Coffee and vanilla whip. This was really good, but has a little spice to it, which is good-- just beware. 

Should I get another? Of course, I should because it's free! BOGO ... 
I couldn't decide between the house Mai Thai or the or the smoke show. I asked the waiter and he was 100% invested in the smoke show, which is: Bulleit, rye, Benedictine, Peychaud, burnt pineapple, with baked pinecone smoke. When it was brought over you could smell the smokiness... mmmm it was good n strong. 

Well, thanks for reading. I hope you get to enjoy Mai Thai and have the most amazing day ever! Thanks for reading!
name: Greg
