text: beachside is the absolute best. The most beautiful place to watch the sunset over the hill with the pacific as your backdrop. not to mention, this place is incredibly reasonable for being right on the water in santa barbara. Grilled artichoke, ceviche, and fried calamari are as good as it gets in SB county. I miss all the amazing employees here. Will need to get back here asap for a backbar marg and calamari.
name: Ryan

text: Ugh. Used to be my favorite when in the area. Sometimes I would drive from PA and bring the family. I guess it's switched ownership. It's probably been a year since I've been here. Took one bite of food. I'll salvage some of the rest to mix in the dog food tomorrow. Super bummed. Owner? is sitting next to me listening to videos on his phone at the bar. When my server isn't mixing drinks or handling food she's mopping, sweeping and wiping up. Came here starved. Ate a few chips and salsa. The ice water was pretty good. The margarita was serviceable - spent $6 to add alcohol. Otherwise it was meh. It's always been busy when I've been here. Came in to 4 cars in the lot - that should have been a sign.
name: adam

text: Amazing food. Get here early - they close at noon and run out of food early. Super fresh and delicious!
name: Vernon

text:
Do not eat here.

I ordered online and got three sushi rolls. After an hour of waiting we called to check on the order. They said they were behind and it would be there soon. We waited an additional twenty minutes and when it arrived I was starving and started eating very quickly. Then I found a bone in it. Then another. Then another. On the third bone I stopped eating it and realized it was turning my stomach. We called and complained and in their defence they sent someone out to give us a refund, so at least I got food poisoning for free.
name: Noah

text: Never been disappointed with the service, atmosphere and food at Fords Garage, its always great food.
name: Randy

text:
We went to Scoogi's last night for dinner. First we had cocktails at the bar and a little veggie pizza that was just out of this world. When we are finished our drinks we were directed to our table which was a very nice table and an excellent waiter his name is Dave. Dave suggested the caprese for appetizers and it was the most delicious we ever had. I had the spinach salad with chicken it was chock full of walnuts and Craisins and the dressing was just right. I can't wait to go back again. I'm taking my son's there for just for a mother son's dinner out mext week.
This was my second time in 2 weeks to dine at Scoogie's and the good was delicious both times. We had no trouble parking and we were waited on promptly. Do yourself a favor and visit Scoogie's if you're in the area or if you're not take a trip there you won't be disappointed.
name: Maureen

text: The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The music was louder than it needed to be. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Will be back.
name: User

text:
Their coffee tastes good and their is a good selection of food and treats. 

The one downside is that the prices seem pretty high.
name: Brian

text: Anyone from the west coast knows what the Boiling Crab is. They have set the standard for this type of seafood-in-a-bag fare, and it is also the food that I miss the most from my time on the west coast.  I think the Shake is well aware of this, and is trying to aim for this standard. That being said, I have searched near and far for a suitable alternative in this area and I am happy to say that the Shake comes pretty close in flavor, which is highly impressive considering nothing in this area has even scraped the surface in terms of flavor for their sauce. I've been to Crabby Cafe, The Boil in NYC, and The Boiling House in Cherry Hill, and The Shake is still the closest to my beloved Boiling Crab. The garlicky, cajun, spicy, buttery "shake sauce" is so delicious, and compliments seafood perfectly. Prepare to eat with your hands and get messy, but it's a great, flavorful ride once you dig in.
name: Jessica

text: Always great food, large portions, reasonable prices, and very friendly service. Highly recommend this locally owned restaurant!!!
name: Dawn

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The wait felt longer than it should have. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Nice place in Fishtown for a quick healthy snack or lunch alone or with a couple friends. The staff is sociable and can chat you up or leave you alone if you wish. The juices and smoothies are mad fresh AND refreshing. I was pleasantly surprised to find out they sell Vita Coco which is my kids fav coconut water. I plan to actually have a wrap someday since summer is coming soon but during the winter the chicken noodle soup was my go to breakfast quite a few times. The early morning hours are nearly coffin quiet so I recommend going then if you've never gone and need some time to check out the menu.
name: T.

text: This place has the best fried chicken. There was already some chicken prepared but we asked for freshly fried food and it tasted juicy and delicious. Owner is very nice too. I never get the chance to try the Pakistani food because the chicken is so good and that's what I always end up getting.
name: Anosha

text: I have been to Il Granaio several times and I still can't pronounce it right, haha! However, the food is always delish. The service is also excellent. If there is a rating for better than excellent - I would give that for service! And, cleanliness! The bathrooms are extremely clean which is very important to me. If the bathroom is clean, the kitchen must be. I love BYOBs and these guys do it right. The only downfall - and I can't fault it too much for this....is the place is always packed with tons of people having tons of fun, so it is.....LOUD. I like a quieter venue with music for dinner.
name: Teresa

text:
I had only been once before tonight, but I had to go back and see if I was remembering it correctly. In my mind, this place had one of the best burgers I've ever had and the fries were the perfect crispy companion. But you know how you hype up things in your mind only to be let down later? Kind of like watching a movie as a kid and thinking it's the best movie only to find out watching it as an adult that it's pretty lame... I was afraid that would happen with Ground, but it lived up to the hype!

I had every intention of taking a picture of my food to post here, but as soon as I got my BBQ burger I had to eat it. It's a perfectly seasoned and cooked patty. The ratio of ingredients is fantastically balanced. The fries are crispy and not too greasy.

The price is a little high for having counter service rather than a waiter, BUT the meal itself was every bit as good (and better) than other sit down places I've been. Would highly recommend this place and their burgers!
name: Jesse

text: We have been to this restaurant a few times before, and thought that we had found our new Thai spot. That was proven horribly incorrect after experiencing the most deplorable customer service I have ever seen. The menu does not include explanations of the dishes, only a name and a price based on what meat you get in it. The manager Cherish stated what dishes came with the basil sauce when I asked, but didn't bother to explain anything else. When my order came, it was filled with noodles, and had some meat and vegetables. The kind young waitress who brought our food understood when I explained that I was looking for the dish that had rice on the side, meat vegetables and sauce. She said she would jump it to the front of the line. The manager came by to check in when my wife was almost done eating. When I explained that I had been looking for the dish with rice on the side, she rather snarkily stated she had explained the entire menu to me. This unprofessional and blatantly rude exclamation caused me to simply tell her to cancel my order. She snapped some comment off about them having already fixed it, picked up my wife's bowl (which she wasn't quite done with), and stormed off. She returned about 5 minutes later with the bill and stated that because they had wasted so much food on me, they were still charging me for one of the dishes. My wife very calmly attempted to explain to her what the issue was, but before she finished explaining, Cherish picked up the check and my card and walked away from the table, ignoring the fact that my wife was still speaking. When she returned with the card and receipts for me to sign, she said that we should take one of the dishes with us. She brought the rice dish in to go containers, however after the horrid customer service I did not trust the food. While the food is good, if Cherish is there, you better hope they get your order right.
name: Roger

text:
Hate to give a bad review but really disliked the food. Bought two 10 meal meal plans for my boyfriend and I for lunches and dinners for the work week. The only edible meal was the pork. The pasta primavera was a joke. Completely dry noodles with small chunks of chicken with some red sauce on them. Flavorless. I understand eating healthy is not always the tastiest but there is no attempt here. Ive been ordering FitLife for the last five years on and off but it gets pricey. The only pro to this place is price-- $68 plus tax for 10 meals is an excellent deal however you don't end up saving money when you throw the food away and have to buy something else. Will never be back. From now on I will take the extra time to meal plan or pay the extra 1-2 dollars a meal and get
Something I know I will like from fitlife.
name: Caitlin

text: Great little Colombian bakery. If you like hot dogs, Rolo's super dog with all the toppings is a must try! The pan de bono is super delicious and the fresh passion fruit juice (enjoy it blended with milk or water) is super refreshing.
name: Alisha

text: Great beer and excellent food!  The brisket noodle bowl was perfect.  Awesome dish! I had the kolsch and the pilsner. Both very good beers.  I will be back!
name: Josh

text:
This place is so noisy it gave me a headache! Food is pretty good. Crab corn bisque was only warm and I asked for crispy fries and they were soggy!!

They serve your food fast; we were eating salad and entree shows up! Ugh! Banana Foster bread pudding has sugar granules in sauce.  I think their main objective is to turn over tables quickly!

NOT A RELAXING PLACE!
name: JK

text:
Fantastic food, great prices, and a very helpful staff.  

The ribs were absolutely tender and smoky, and the brisket was out of this world give it a try.
name: O

text:
Cozy family owned restaurant serving authentic middle eastern food. I'm quite confused about the restaurant name : Gyro zone, but inside, it says Worlds best Shawarma!  Anyway we tried an appetizer Baba Ganoush! It's a dip with pita ! It's delicious! The owner said its home made. He is the cook and the server at that time. We tried the Chicken Shawarma! It's very good!
Will recommend to friends and family!
name: Tony

text: Chocolate cream sticks (longjohns) are tasty, but the Mary Anns : chocolate devils food cupcakes topped with meringue and dipped in chocolate are worth the trip!
name: Jay

text: Not a big fan of this place it's like a seafood fast food market, The crawfish was definitely too spicy for our likings.
name: Dave

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. I had a better visit than I expected to. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: The hostess was a ditz.  I asked how long for a table of two and she told me 5 minutes.  She then started talking to other guests and completely forgot about me.  She proceeded to seat two other groups that came in after me. When I said something to her she realized she had forgotten to even put me on the wait list.  She didnt even apologize. she just added us to the wait list which was now over a half hour long.  We left and I won't be back.  The place is very disorganized and there are plenty of other sports bars in town.
name: Stephanie

text: I just had the best chili rellano breakfast I have ever eaten.  This wonderful breakfast spot has it all.  Real potatoes with the breakfast- not those tasteless shreds everyone else serves.  Came to Reno for 5 days and have eaten here every morning.  They are fast, friendly and the food is beyond words.  Reno is lucky to have them!
name: Dawn

text: I really wanted to like this place.. I ordered a chicken parmesan and a tiramisu. the chicken parmesan comes with veggies, I substituted pasta with meat sauce. the chicken parmesan was good, it isnt breaded at all.. its covered with a thin slice of eggplant and cheese. it was a decent size piece of chicken, but the soggy eggplant was unappetizing. the pasta with meat sauce was another disappointment, the sauce tastes like canned Chef Boyardee Beefaroni.. not exactly what I expected for a $17 chicken dish. the tiramisu was definitely delicious, but it was the tiniest little piece for $7.
name: Nicole

text: Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. We shared dumplings first and those were prob the best thing on the table. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Wow! This may be my new favorite CRG Restaurant! I know they are still adjusting and changing items but the concept is great! Went in last night around 7 and got a table outside, which was designed very cute. I loved how the menu had indications for gluten free, vegetarian, plant based, etc. We started out with the Roasted Cauli dish. Perfect size to share and absolutely delicious! It had a purple olive sauce that was phenomenal. We also decided to share the Plant Based Taco Platter. They had three options which you can mix and match, so we decided to try one of each. The three options are ancho mushrooms, jackfruit carnitas, and chickpea rojas. Loved the presentation of the dish, with it being a make your own taco set up. I'm currently staying away from carbs so I asked for veggies to use as a vessel for the fillings. The chickpea Rojas had a little kick which I loved. My mom and I only have life jackfruit when we've made it ourselves but actually really enjoyed their jackfruit carnitas. Ancho mushrooms were very flavorful and cooked to perfection. I highly recommend trying this new CRG Restaurant out! Lots of options for everyone! Can't wait to go back!
name: Charlsey

text: The food was amazing. More importantly, my server/bartender Kevin was extremely charismatic and attentive. Service makes the experience at a restaurant. I will be coming back for the fantastic experience!
name: Pamela

text:
This place was becoming a solid go-to restaurant but one waiter and his manager changed that.

Other patrons in the restaurant gave us a menu because the waiter didn't. He was very confused and seemed flustered in a restaurant that was not full. He brought out the wrong dish for me and when I asked to have the kitchen make what I ordered, he argued and then said he would. Then his manager came out and proceeded to try and convince me that the wrong dish was "almost the same thing." I felt very disrespected; why not let me have what I ordered? I tried to eat the dish they insisted I keep, but it wasn't good, and that's why I didn't order it to begin with. We had to pay for it too which made me really salty tbh. 

It's a shame because I've had really good experiences before this one, but this was enough to keep me from going back.
name: Kattie

text:
This review is based on two slices and one quick pick up.

First impression is very good. We ordered the large Cheesin' pizza and added pepperoni. It was an excellent blend and cheese ratio. 

This is exactly what I was hoping for in a down home pizza joint. The house was full on day two and The families I asked in the parking lot about their experience (as they were leaving) reported that they loved it.

I hope this place keeps it up.
name: Ryan

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: I wanted to cry this was so good. We ordered the crab rangoon, the cod steamed bun, and the khao soi chicken curry. As we walked to our car, one of the chefs met us outside with a bonus dish--the omu ramen. The crab rangoon is beyond any other rangoon I've ever had, and I had to stop myself from drinking the curry. Everything was beautifully prepared, the staff was incredibly kind and welcoming, and as a bonus, they are committed to sustainability & use seasonal ingredients. This crew is doing it right. Cannot wait to come back!
name: Lexie

text: Sat at the bar. The person tending it was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Got the shrimp bread on his recommendation and it did not disappoint. My only feedback is that it wasn't hot and room temperature. I was too hungry to complain and it was really good otherwise. Couple next to me got the friend chicken sandwich which was my second choice. Looked awesome. Would definitely go back.
name: Marissa

text: My husband and I came to New a Orleans for our first time ever for our anniversary. We were there for 4 days and did pretty much everything there is to do... we are in the car on our way home from the airport now and he just asked me, "What was your favorite part of the trip?" My answer, "Dinner at Broussard's!!" Seriously my favorite meal I have EVER had!!! Every single bite was better then the last and I loved every minute of it!! The service is impeccable (you seriously have a "team" that caters to your every need!!), the food outstanding, the atmosphere charming. Our waiter was Sterling who was super cool and attentive! I have never had duck and don't like Brussels sprouts, but for some reason took a recommendation and ordered the duck with Brussels sprouts and it was PERFECTION!!!
name: Melissa

text: We visited tonight right after the place opened. The oysters were delicious raw and charbroiled done up style. The soft shell crab and fried chicken were delicious. The red beans and rice were the best I've had since my last visit to New Orleans in 2010.
name: Chris

text: Had their brisket Mac and cheese when they were in Forest Park last weekend and it was awesome. Best food truck there in my opinion because they had big portions and restaurant quality food with great flavor! Lots of good options on the menu that weren't super basic: fried green tomatoes, burgers, tacos, etc. my friend got the tacos and loved them. Good prices and big plus- accept credit cards. Will be back when I see them next!!
name: Monica

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It was crowded but still moved along. Worth checking out. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
Good pizza, beer selection and venue for dinner! They have a patio outside and are very welcoming to pups!

The menu is fairly limited, but it's a pizza place so I don't know what else you want from them. I'm not a fan of Chicago style, but the New York style is pretty darn good! We always order the Greek salad to split at the table, it is one of my favorite Greek salads around.

I have had negative experiences with the staff when they get really busy (like a Friday night), but most recently  the staff is always wonderful! Overall great spot to enjoy a pizza and some craft beers!
name: Alex

text:
First time here and my last.  My burger was a dry, salty, piece of meat on an oversized bun.  The lettuce was a sliver of romaine. 
The tomatoe was not fresh.  The table was sticky....  I was able to make a placemat using napkins.  They stayed in place from the sticky crud on the tables.  Sadly, other people dining with me followed my lead.  The one star is for the French fries.  The plate it was served on looked like a metal dog dish.  Not sure if my dog would eat that burger.  I think not.....
name: Nancy

text: Only food truck I eat from in Philly. Their food is the best, fresh, and clean. I've never had such amazing food and service. So many different options in foods as well. So when I'm feeling indecisive I can choose a healthy option or some fried wings if I want. They always have a large crowd and we always order more for later (dinner). Lol what can I say we can't get enough.
name: Dominique

text:
Summing it up as simply as I can: 
1) the Dutch babies are AMAZING. I had the chicken and my boyfriend had the breakfast sausage, and we were very happy 

2) the cocktails were pretty tasty! Opal martini was right up my alley. My boyfriend loved the Toronto--he's a big fernet fan and you'll definitely want to like fernet if you order it 

3) we were running late for our reservation, and they had no problem when we called to let them know. They also appreciated the call 

4) the GM came over to chat with my boyfriend who is also in the service industry, and he was incredibly friendly and helpful in answering a few questions my boyfriend had about being a manager in the industry 

We will absolutely be coming back for dinner sometime, but brunch was amazing!
name: Olivia

text:
Tacky. The staff are incredibly rude and entitled. I was not impressed in the slightest.


See below for case and point
name: Takara

text:
Bottomline Up Front: you are expected to pay premium-level prices for very mediocre quality. $20+ for a small bowl of mediocre noodles served in a paper bowl and a tiny can of soda with plastic ware is NOT what I call good value.

Some food stalls are really slow. Others advertise items that they don't actually have that day (their menu is digital but no one bothered to make changes).

Some stalls do not take cash, which was annoying. On a previous trip, my buddy and his family from overseas had to go somewhere else since they did not want to charge up their credit card with "foreign transaction fees".  

Parking can be a bit tight and seating is a crap shoot.

Everyone working there seems to have a rather arrogant attitude bordering on narcissism. There are brain surgeons and rocket scientists less arrogant than this bunch.

We will not be returning no matter what the social media response is here.
name: T

text:
Wouldn't bother coming here when there are plenty of other good cheesesteak spots. 

The roll tastes cheap and previously frozen. Just not a good roll. The meat is dry and has no flavor. 
Just an FYI, cash only.
name: Tara

text: so good!!!!! kid friendly. great food. cutest decor. good service! Can't wait to go back.
name: Tash

text: I gave it one star because I had to do so.  (Would not let me leave zero stars!). We went to eat here last night and waited over an hour for our food.  I had to chase the waitress down to even get drinks and then again to tell her we were ready to order.  After ordering, we sat for over an hour!  I asked the waitress when we were going to get our food and her reply was that she had no control over the food.  How hard is it to make a taco salad and fry clam strips, chicken tenders and french fries?  When the food finally came and I complained about the wait, the guy told me we weren't  the only ones that had to wait, there were lot of people that had a wait!  Seriously?  Great customer service...not!! BTW, the food was less than average and my fiancé's clam strips were more batter than clam and half cooked!  We will not return!!  (they did comp the drinks but should have comped the entire meals!). Don't waste your time going to this place unless you have a LONG time to waste to get food that isn't very good!
name: Dana

text:
Honestly, I'm not really sure as to what happened today. The food has always been great at this location and the servers are usually attentive and friendly. But, today was an absolute nightmare. 

My wife and I decide to take advantage of the weekly lunch deal and drop by for a quick lunch. Everything was going well until our server (Tara) not only brought us the wrong drink after a half an hour wait, she actually forgot to give us spoons for our desserts. We informed Tara of this not once but twice as we patiently waited for another half an hour. Long story short, we never got the spoons. 

On top of that, there were multiple charges on our check for items that we did not ordered or asked for. My wife and I were charged close to $70 for $30 worth of food! We informed Tara of this and of course, we had to wait another half an hour for Tara to "fix" our check not once but twice. And guess what? We were still charged for items that we did not order. After being in the restaurant for over 2 hours, my wife and I decided to just suck it up and pay for the extra item because it seemed like our only option was either to wait for Tara to take another hour to "fix" our check or pay a little more just so we can leave. 

Apparently we were not the only one having problem with Tara's service either. Nearly all the customer around us either had to wait an hour for condiments that they never got or got the wrong drink. On top of that, nearly everyone's check was wrong or had extra items added. 

Tara informed all of us that today's her first day on the floor by herself so naturally my wife and I were a little sympathetic toward her. But something has to be going on if not one but 3 different tables were being overcharged.
name: Marco

text: Amazing food and service! Got one of the best hot teas I've ever had. Also got the pesto chicken panini which was amazingly good. Service was great too! Regardless of the 30 minute wait time since it was super busy- the servers and hostesses were on point with everything!
name: John

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Food was good and came out fast. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
Nope. No.

Called on a saturday to find out if we could order food up until 12. We were told yes. Get there and they say... no its 11. We had to scramble to order and I ordered hummus gluten free with only cucumbers due to an allegy. The plate came with pita. They barely checked on us and didnt refill anything. Then they came over and were like... we just wanna make sure u dont need us to check on u again. Wow..im sorry but no. This place is trash and whoever is managing it has no idea what they are doing.
name: Lucy

text: I love this place, excellent food and i can substitute veggies for the rice.  Have tried all thr different meats and love them all. Super friendly and helpful staff.  Excellent. Definitely plan on returning often.  Macaroni salad is different but in an amazingly good way. Very comfortable vibe to the whole place.
name: Jen

text: The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The wait felt longer than it should have. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Probably not coming back. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty happy with it overall. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For the price I expected more than this. Not bad for a quick meal. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Great determination of nourishment things on the menu just as a pleasant choice of specialty brews. They have indoor and outside seating. The café is anything but difficult to see from the road, yet stopping is somewhat constrained. They additionally have a pastry kitchen nearby which is enjoyable to visit also. Out them an attempt.
name: Steven

text: Why do we not have this chain back at home?! I'm not a fan of super spicy sauces or foods, but the Willie's special sauce had just enough heat to keep me coming back for more. I thought the tenders would be small, so I ordered a five piece meal with fries. I could barely get through three. The tenders were hot and crispy. The biscuit was soft, buttery, and a little sweet. The fries were decent but the tenders and biscuit were the best part for me. The 151 and everclear daiquiri (Voodoo Juice) was sweet and did what it was meant to do. The cashier was super cool and was able to handle the rush with ease. The location was clean and there was plenty of seating. I really wish we had a Willie's back at home...but maybe it's a good thing that they are only here in the south.
name: Kesha

text:
This place is so basic and incredibly delicious.  This is a no frills restaurant that you'd drive right by if I hadn't seen it on Diners,Drive-Ins and Dives.  We walked right in with our big group and got seated right away.  I enjoyed two eggs, bacon and red potatoes.  Perfectly cooked, delicious breakfast!

My daughter loved her Strawberry & Cream waffle.  The pancakes smell amazing and they taste just as good.

Looking forward to coming back on our next visit to St. Petersburg.  This really is a hidden gem!
name: Sandy

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. Price felt a touch high for what it was. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I left full, which at least counts for something.
name: User

text: We are staying at the Hilton in Clearwater, which is where this restaurant is located. We made plans to walk around town and find a nice place to have dinner, but it started raining pretty bad so we ended up at Jimmy's. I was pleasantly surprised at how good the food was. text:
On and off for 4 years, I've been coming to Wasabi for their delicious bento boxes(only take out). It's been quite a while since I've returned and I noticed that the menu looked very different ( in a good and more exciting kind of way with more options and cool sushi names).  Turns out the restaurant is under new management.

Because of limited time, me and my husband decided on Wasabi for dinner, conveniently located right next to the movie theater. We went straight for the all you can eat option($25). 

We put in our order right away, knowing we had a movie to catch in 1 hr. We took a chance at Wasabi, given the amount of customers present(one other table).  

Our kind hostess brought out our appetizers fast, with exception to a crab salad that was forgotten. The seaweed salad was ok and not the best quality with a high liquid content. I wouldn't get it again. The cucumbers pickling liquid seemed odd. The muscles had great flavor, but were a tad bit overcooked (tough). 

Compared to the older menu, the updated menu has so many options.  They have bento boxes, the usual appetizers, sushi rolls, lots of specialty nigiri and lots of fresh ingredients available (mango, kiwi, strawberry, lemon, cilantro, jalapeno). 

The lunch options are different from the dinner options. There's a limit of two orders for dinner nigiri.

We ordered the Zuly, Lobster, and Jamaica Hot rolls. For nigiri we ordered one of each option. 

The Zuly roll (shrimp tempura, salmon, lemon, avocado, cream cheese) was super flavorful with perfectly cooked shrimp tempura.  What could use lots of work is the rice.  The rice was mashed and pasty to the point where I couldn't make out the grains of rice.

The Jamaica Hot roll(tuna, crab, mango, strawberry, kiwi) was great except for again, the rice. The crab mix inside was actually spicy, which was great. 

We noticed our lobster roll never came out and by the time we asked for it, we were out of time to wait.

While the specialty nigiri seemed fun and great, they fell short in terms of flavor. The fish simply didn't have any flavor. I did enjoy all toppings.  The volcanos and tempura upside down shrimp stood out. I suggest for the goofy to not have so much chili oil as it was overwhelming. 

For dessert, I ordered the tempura ice cream. It was ok except I felt there was too much breading with the tempura.

Husband ordered the dessert roll. We waited till the absolute last min for it to come out but again, ran out of time so we didn't get a chance to try it. 

In short, the rice could use lots of work, service was super slow, and they could use more work in sorting out their orders.

Check out Bab cafe next door for delicious Korean food.
name: Katherine

text:
Y'ALL. I AM QUAKING. First of all, you have to really look for this place because it sneaks up on you. The girls in there are just so so so sweet.

THE FREAKING FOOD. When i first walked in, I was overwhelmed in the best way by all of the products they had. The girl behind the counter asked if we had ever been there before and I said no, and thank god i did because she described everything, and if she hadn't I would've missed out on all of the hot and fresh to order donuts! 

I ordered a PB&J donut because it's my favorite all time flavor and it was delicious!!! It came literally fresh out the oven and the strawberry icing and peanut butter were dripping off, and the little jam in the middle was perfect. So crispy and the texture was amazing and still fluffy.

But the prize for me what the peanut butter chocolate cookie. I'm more of a cookie person than donut person, and I'm so glad I bought it. Ever since I went gluten free, I truly have not had good cookies from anywhere. It's a literal softball of goodness that I ate AND FINISHED in the store before my donut was even ready, that's how good it was. It was still so soft? I don't know how they did it but it was just simply incredible. After I finished my donut and cookie, I went back in and bought yet another chocolate pb cookie and a white macadamia one because that's another one of my faves.

Is it a little more expensive than your average bakery? Well duh, but that's what you get when you have a true, quality, gluten free bakery. I truly cannot tell you how amazing and rare it is to walk into a store, especially one that specializes in desserts, and not even have a fraction of a stressor that something contains gluten. I thoroughly enjoyed myself, and I will definitely be coming back.

To the owners and the bakers: thank you for creating this place. I really cannot express how much I appreciate the time and effort you put into your products. It all looks and definitely tastes amazing, and I really hope you continue to succeed.
name: Cameron

text:
We had an interesting experience here from start to finish on Thanksgiving Monday. 
We made reservations online, which said to proceed upstairs, which we did but nobody was there. I had to call the restaurant to have somebody come out and seat us, but she was just behind the wall in front of us, and we weren't super quiet. 
Then we ordered our drinks and waited a long time for them, then as they were being served by 3 different people (3 drinks), a well dressed gentleman put a wedge salad in front of me with my drink. I was confused, as I planned on ordering that salad but didn't remember ordering food yet. Somebody at the table said 'you didn't order yet, it's too early to bring salad and drinks together', so I told my waitress that I don't think it's my salad, I asked if the guy who served it was her boss because if she'd be in trouble, I'd keep it. She said it's her GM and she definitely typed that salad into another table. She took it back and apologized. This type of thing doesn't bother me. Human error happens. At this point my daughter who has been a server on the side of school for a couple years told me that when a busy place isn't busy, weird stuff happens because it throws them off. 
My drink was delicious by the way. It was the 'fresh squeezed greyhound', fresh pressed grapefruit juice, grapefruit infused vodka, sparkling water (pictured)

Eventually our meals came, our waitress, Jayda, was very sweet and very helpful. 
Throughout our meal, which was delicious. A woman in a tank top who did not appear to work there had walked by our table several times (8-10) deeply starring at us, it was so uncomfortable. Since we were 1 of 2 tables upstairs, it was pretty unnerving. We mentioned the lady to our server and asked if she worked there. Jayda went in search of the woman's description and came back and said it was her manager, then a minute later, the lady walked by and without stopping she awkwardly said 'sorry for looking at you' lol so awkward. 
We enjoyed our meal and Jayda was awesome, she's very young and did a great job. 
When we were done our meals, Jayda brought out a dessert platter with fallen chocolate Soufflé cake, 
New York Cheesecake with Blackberry Compote, and Crème Brûlée 'on the house'. When she brought our bill she said the drinks were 'on the house'. So generous. We would have come back without those kind gestures, it was just an awkward night. 

Then once we paid, the gentleman (Michael Nenzy, Operating Partner), who brought me the wrong salad came to introduce himself, he runs chops in Toronto, and Edmonton; he's been with Chop for years, he apologized for all the awkwardness, he explained everything. He was very friendly, and it was not fake at all. He then gave us all gift cards to come back. 
Like I said, we would have been back regardless, we love Chop Steakhouse. 
The night left us with a laugh and their generosity went above and beyond. 
I highly recommend Chop Steakhouse downtown Edmonton. Beautiful bar, great food. You can see from the picture of the bar, just how dead it was that night. 
Make sure you stop in, ask for Jayda, she knows her stuff and she's energetic, sweet, happy, and obviously they're being run extremely well by their GM. We didn't even complain and they were on top of the issues. Thanks Chop, see you soon. 
Note: I also pictured our delicious appetizer, Lobster, Scallop & Gorgonzola Dip with mushrooms, served with focaccia crostini, and my moms perfect French onion soup with
caramelized onion & crostini, baked with a Swiss & Asiago cheese crust.
name: Cassandra

text:
We knew how wonderful of and experience it was going to be since it was our second visit. We also knew how beautiful the establishment itself is on your eyes. The spouse does not enjoy herself if there is a cool breeze anywhere so our server (there has to be a better name, Lynn did not just serve, she was a curator and presenter of each dish) moved us to a different table...that had curtains, to protect the Mrs. Hot tea to warm her up and a Cabernet Sauvignon for myself.
When ordering at a tapas establishment for me personally, there is an order to the meal. From light to heavy and mild to strong taste...
First up was an unasked for but quite please Lynn brought it to us, Cream of asparagus, fully puréed, in a demitasse cup. Velvety would be an accurate description. It did wonders in prepping our tastebuds for what was next. Two dishes were presented perfectly by Lynn, turning each one so each of us got a beautiful presentation...
Grilled Halloumi (a semi-hard, unripened, brined cheese made from a mixture of goat's and sheep's milk. Because of the high melting point it can easily be fried or grilled)-Spiced Figs, Fennel, Walnuts with Mint Crystals and Bread + Butter-Warm "Bobolink" Baguette, Cultured Butter, Black Radish, Truffle Salt, Grains of Paradise. Wow! Taking tiny pieces of the Halloumi with a dab of fig and fennel just danced on your tongue. The bread and butter cleansed and prepared us for the next dish. 
Kale Salad-Asian Pear, 5 Spice Cashews, Candied Ginger, Puffed Rice, Shaoxing Vinaigrette. Just reading the ingredients makes my mouth water and it's been two days since we were there! Cashew and ginger have always been a favorite of mine and I use that combo often at home. The pear is a nice delivery means for these two tasty morsels.
Next up on our tapas journey was Blackened Green Beans-House Hot Sauce, Curried Cauliflower Hummus, Toasted Sesame, Crispy Quinoa. Just roll me up here. I have never had a love affair with green beans, however I might be cheating on a few veggies with this combo. The Mrs. favorite veggies were blackened and presented on a bed of curried cauliflower hummus. Loved. Every. Bite. Of. This. 
I had forgotten that we ordered Spring rolls wrapped around butternut squash, Napa cabbage, carrots and sesame served with a spicy walnut dipping sauce. 
We are now over 70 minuets into this adventure. 
I would like to add at this point that Lynn's timing in this meal was extraordinarily perfect. Clearing the previous, spouse takes a sip of tea, I my Cabernet and then the next course...with the exception of the last dish...there was only seconds between the spring rolls, which we played with a little, getting every drop of walnut sauce and the Crab shells-Maryland crab, shell pasta, spicy crab & Tomato butter, Parmesan crumb.
They had beautiful chunks of backfin lump blue point crab with shell pasta...I was born in Maryland and vacationed on the Chesapeake for years. Thank you for honoring how crab should be presented! 
To finish this unforgettable 46th wedding anniversary evening we topped it off with Taylor Fladgate 10yr Tawny Port and a dish truly mimicking it's name...Chocolate Meltdown-Flourless chocolate cake, chocolate sorbet, raspberry, chocolate-hazelnut crumbles...
I would like to thank honey, the chefs, sous chefs, line cooks and the rest of the staff for and extraordinary evening. To Lynn, thank you. You know the menu, the pairings and your customers. Awesome....just awesome...
name: Brian

text:
How I count:

1-overall experience and price  1/2
2- condition of restaurant    1/2
3- cordiality of staff.  1
4- service level. 1
5-food. 0

A friend and I went to this restaurant because we were in the area and it was so highly rated.  It is in the middle of a block, so ome walking is necessary.  The restaurant is on 2 floors connected by a very long steep staircase with strong railings on both sides.  We were just taken upstairs without being asked.  (Not a busy time for them--5:15 on weekday).  Between the hostess stand and the stairs was no distance at all, but we had to step over a small pile of sweeping that was waiting for the last step of being swept into a dustpan.  I was glad to be upstairs because it was warmer up there and I had forgotten a sweater.  It must be hard on the servers to have to run up and down for food.

Our server was very nice--no complaints.  She was an excellent salesperson for the restaurant in describing the food.  The bad part was the food was not as good as she described.  I got 2 appetizers as a meal--the brussels sprouts (which were outrageously salty with a vinegary-sauce and some hard lumps of bacon) and the tongue tacos (which were absolutely tasteless).  My friend go a fish tempura--where everything was fried--the fist the eggplant--anything else.  She didn't finish it.  She said it was OK--just OK.  For $45 (no drinks, 1 iced tea included, before tips) this was not OK.   In hindsight Hymie's or even Wendy's would have been better choices.  I won't be back.
name: Elizabeth

text:
I give them 5 stars for food and -1000 stars for service. We ate here on a Friday night with a reservations for 10 ppl, so they were aware we were coming, they even had a nice reserve sign on the table for us. I also verified if it was ok that we trickle in between 4-5 since we are a happy hour group and get off work at different times. I am not sure if some of the servers called in but there was one waitress, one bartender and one chef on a Friday night. We received our waters, quick, well some of us did. Some never received a water. We tried to order appetizers, but the waitress was trying to keep our checks separate and I guess it overwhelmed her so we did not order apps....yet. And we were there for happy hour and were only able to order one margarita an hour. I would raise my hand to get her attention and the response was the same, "one sec". But it was actually 10+ minutes and not one sec. I was thankful they separated our checks, but one marg per hour, is pretty much the worst service I have ever had in the area. Also, I ordered my food the same time as my husband and his came out about an hour after mine. My mexican corn app came out after he finished his dinner, so got my app 1.5 hours after my entree, ha! Some people in our group ordered about 20 minutes after us because, like I said, we were trickling in but those that ordered after us did not get their food for nearly an hour, one girl waited an hour for her margarita, not sure why she didnt speak up sooner, could be because the waitress was just going to respond, "one sec". Once all the food came in, appetizers after entrees, mind you, one of my friends had all of his order wrong. He ordered the nachos with no meat, since it was lent, had to bring it back. Shockingly, the meatless nachos came out within 15 minutes, why did the first order take an hour? ground meat makes it take one hour? Damn. One of my friends wanted to order the corn after tasting mine (post entree app), but knew we would be there for another hour if she attempted to order that so she did not. I also would have loved to have had more margaritas, but I could not even go to the bar, because the bartender was helping out with the tables. Our bottomless chips and salsa, was refilled once an hour like our margaritas, so not really bottomless. And two of my friends in the group spoke spanish and could hear the waitress starting to get annoyed with us so one spoke spanish to her so she was aware that we understood her IF she wanted to take it further. 

As for the food, pretty incredible. Best mahi tacos I have ever had, the mexican corn was so delicious, the skirt steak was a little chewy but flavorful, the beans had a spice to it that I loved. I really enjoyed the salsa and cilantro in it. The homemade chips were ok, I would have liked them a little thinner but I respected them being homemade. Also, the queso was very creamy, not my favorite, but still good. The ground meat nachos, they were juicy and almost tasted like a hamburger, but in an odd good way. The Strawberry marg on the rocks is the way to go with sugar on the rim, but dont bother with the passionfruit one or the mango one. 

The place is small, you walk in and there are maybe 5 tables in the front, then 8 stools at the bar, then larger group tables in the back. I would say for happy hour, it was a pretty packed place, so if they only schedule 2 employees, esp knowing they had a table for 10 with reservations, that's pathetic managing.    

As I said before, i enjoyed the food alot, so complements to the chef but I fear they wont last if they dont get there stuff together. I will never dine in again, but if they do take out, I MAY consider that.
name: Jamie

text: Love this place!  Have been going here for years.  My favorite dish is the chicken vindaloo which is challenging to get at other Indian restaurants as we just relocated back to the Boise area.  Their lunch buffet is good too.

text:
While visiting friends who are new to the Reno area, they brought us here for lunch during a weekday afternoon. Being Texas natives- they frequent here often to get their Mexican food fix. 

Inside there's a fun, colorful decor, very clean, and we loved the garage style door that allowed us to watch the snow fall outside.

You simply get the flavor from the jalapeño and not the heat. I'm sure you could request extra jalapeño if you wanted more spice. We could drink these all day!! Loved them.

text:
My wife and I randomly came here just after noon on Sunday. We did not check Yelp or anything else until after we had ordered. We seldom do that but we were hungry. We were seated right away as it was not very busy. A lot of tables were open.

We ordered the queso dip and tortilla chips as an appetizer.

My wife kept commenting that it was cold in the the restaurant.  The temperature either needs to be turned up earlier or a higher temperature to be comfortable. 

We both ordered the Whisky Bacon Burger but my orederd onion rings as a side and I chose fries. Our appetizer arrived shortly afterwards. The flavor of the queso was good but the temperature was only warm, not hot as expected. 

About 45 minutes later our entrees arrived and looked good but both had fries. Our server said he would bring out an order of onion rings which he promptly did. 

The burgers were tasty, the temperature was good and they were cooked as ordered 

The place appeared very clean and the restroom was as well.

For the experience we had we both thought it would have been just as good at Steak and Shake or In-N-Out and a whole lot less expensive.
