I only ate one, brought the rest home and ended up throwing it out since no one would eat it. Also, very disappointed on the fact that when we made the reservation (online) it was noted that it was my son's 24th birthday. I even made sure the hostess knew, which she confirmed that she did and the waitress would be informed. Nothing was said to him, while other Birthdays were celebrated. I watched the manager make his rounds from table to table, except ours. It wasn't like we ordered very little my bill for 4 people was almost $215.00 without the tip added to it, which I always leave in cash and I tipped the 20%. I'm not sure if I'll ever visit RumFish again, being our first visit was probably my last one.
name: M

text:
Ok so I asked the receptionists at the hotel for suggestions of where to eat and this is what they suggested. Arrived at 12:30p.m looking for breakfast. I decided to go with the Florentine Benedict and the Banana Kahlua French toast. Well, it's 12:30 and they don't serve that anymore--oh man, I guess I didn't make it to breakfast. So I ask the register, so breakfast is done? And they say no we still serve eggs. So why can't I get the Benedict? 
Apparently they stop serving some of the breakfast options like the Benedict and French toast sooner than they stop serving the omelets, breakfast burritos, and the waffles. Makes no sense, but ok whatever I went for the Gordy's breakfast club and waffles. My husband go the Lime-chicken asian salad, and my friend got the breakfast quesadilla. 
The salad was good! I loved the dressing that was tossed. That was the only entree we finished. Everything else was so bland. Nothing was season right and everything just missed flavor. 
Still this remains a popular place for breakfast or lunch, u guess because of the prime location and nice seating area outdoors.
name: Rita

text: The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: I decided to stop in here one night for some froyo. I had previously eaten at Scrumptious before, but they change the flavors around. I was disappointed that they did not have a a few simple flavors, like chocolate  But overall it is a great location, and it is in walking distance from many hot-spots.
name: Carol

text:
100% recommend checking out Caje's new location on Haley! I'm a big fan of the Caje in IV, especially their lavender latte, and am glad that I decided to come here. 

My friend and I both ordered the Bela Rose, which is their matcha drink. She got her drink with oat milk (on the right)! 

This was my second time going, and I can honestly say that their take on matcha is probably my favorite in Santa Barbara. The rose perfectly complements the depth of the matcha, and it's not too sweet as some other matcha drinks can be. The drinks are beautifully presented as well, and I think definitely worth the more expensive price ($7.50). 

If you're in the area, I would definitely suggest coming by!
name: Irene

text: The food is made from scratch and delicious!!! Huge plates at a reasonable price! Clean and awesome service!!! Definitely coming back!!! A must go to every visit in town!!!
name: Virginia

text:
I've been following Saud on insta for several months and I have been looking forward to trying her food. So, I was really excited when I finally headed over. 

I ordered fried whiting, with baked macaroni and cheese, and green beans. My boyfriend ordered the Cuban Turkey wings, with candied yams, and green beans. 

 Plan to pick up your food and eat elsewhere, since there is no seating. The sides are pre-made (cafeteria style) and they prepare a lot of the main dishes when you order in the back. 

The wait was pretty long (30-45min), but I don't mind waiting for a good home cooked southern meal. The cashiers were polite. 

My fish was cooked well, but was just a tad too salty, same for my green beans. The macaroni and cheese was a good texture, but it tasted like there was onion powder in it...I can't imagine why you would need to put onion powder in Mac and cheese. That definitely needs to be left out. 

I tried my boyfriend's turkey wings. The meat was falling of the bone and the seasoning was good. His candied yams were cooked perfectly, but just a little too much sugar. His green beans were obvi the same as mine.

I think ultimately, she would be right on the money if she would just put a little less salt or sugar in the dishes, and leave the onions or onion powder far away from the Mac and cheese please. I hated to do it, but I docked two stars for these reasons. 

I will probably go back and try something else.
name: Ashley

text: Breakfast at the Sahuaro Cafe was a big hit with the family. My five year old kept remarking on how delicious his French toast and scrambled eggs were; my eight year old really enjoyed the steak and eggs, and my eldest gave thumbs up to the churro French toast. On my end, the Sahuaro omelette was great. The service was very good and everyone was very friendly and nice to the kids.
name: Boaz

text: Can someone here learn how to order supplies? Out of buns at times, out of ranch now...hard to call and actually get what you want and management does not seem to care. Guess when business is ok screw the customers.
name: Ray

text: Best buffet ever....point blank! We drove from Upper Darby bc of the reviews! And yup- 15 mins wait to be seated in a buffet!!! The biggest crawfish I have ever had! Hands down best food EVER

text: Received a coupon in the mail yesterday decided to buy lunch for staff at work today. Redeemed coupon and tried their pizza! Let me tell you I have searching for some good sweet sauce on pizza in this area. The medium pies are small but the flavor is worth it! Awesome work guys!
name: Madeline

text:
Ok, so they def have friends on Yelp...Guys, it's bowling but with golf. And the beer and food is outrageously overpriced. And you have to buy a "membership" to even hit a single ball (I.e. you actually spend $5 per person SO THAT they can get each player's personal info - phone and email is required). There is a line to do this. Then you go to a whole other line to check in and get on the waiting list. We bypassed that wait which we overheard to be 4 HOURS bc we had a reservation. The line for the reservation check-in, however, was longer than the line to get ON the wait list and only 1 person handles this line. They haven't figured out a way to simplify this process... BTW the fee for a reservation is a non-refundable $50. Interestingly, they have chips in every single ball to tell you precisely where your ball went, but their payment technology at the bay only allows specific increments so each member of our party paid $2.50 MORE than the actual price for each time slot we purchased. 3 separate payments means they got an extra $7.50 out of us. Oh, this gets credited to your next round if you extend your time but, eventually, you're stuck with paying more than the posted rates. It should have been $45 for an hour but they got $52.50.

In the end, we dropped way too much money for 5 beers, 80 golf balls and a plastic card with my very own name on it. At my club, this comes to about $15 and the drunk guy next to you doesn't scream in your backswing. I recommend taking your friends to a local indoor simulator and skipping this place. I wouldn't go back unless someone was paying for me.

Positives: We were with friends and we did enjoy ourselves. It is cool. Service was friendly except for the guy at the check-in counter who hated his life. Beer service was pretty quick.
name: Josh

text: Great service. Bottomless mimosas. Delectable bread pudding. View of small planes on the runway taking off. The place has a vibe of stepping back in time. I would definitely recommend. It was a wonderful unexpected find.
name: Bridgette

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Would probably stop in again if nearby. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..

text:

We ordered a Caesar salad to share. Not very good. It was shredded lettuce. They forgot the cheese I 
think. 

We also ordered the Stromboli to share minus red peppers. Very good! We split a small and it was enough for 2 people.

Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The food was good and the service was easygoing.

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. It was crowded but still moved along. Price felt a touch high for what it was. text:
The food is more than reasonably priced, the selection is huge, and everything that I've tasted has been delicious. 

This little place is a neighborhood gem.

Now what's less than ideal is the face that it's located a few blocks away from a high school that allows its students to leave campus for lunch. I showed up today and in typical high school kid fashion, they were everywhere and caused havoc in this tiny shop- making the lunch breaks if those of us trying to pop in on a work break less than desirable. Be mindful of the time in which you're here to avoid such mess.

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: Went tonight 45 mins before they closed on a Friday night. The food was hot even after driving home 15 mins after. Very satisfied with the customer service as well. Thought I needed to express how rare this is around the area and how pleasant this experience was!

text: Delicious food,  excellent service and exemplary hospitality.  I have rarely felt so welcomed at any restaurant.  The owner came out and explained all the dishes which were authentically Italian.  We truly felt we were valued guests in her home.  The pasta ala vodka was especially delicious. The price fixe was an excellent value.

text: Love this place! Its a bit of a drive for me coming from south Jersey but the food is worth it. My sister I love the lemon pepper wings! The service is always great and the food doesn't disappoint. I would recommend ordering before the movie and preferably something not so messy since it's in the dark. (wings don't fit into this category but they were so good so whatever lol) The only downside is that the chairs don't recline :(

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. For a busy night they handled it okay. Worth checking out.
name: User

text:
Acme Feed & Seed is a great place to hang out at the far East end of Broadway right along the river. We weren't able to go to the rooftop because there was a private event unfortunately. We ordered the Acme Burger and the Pork Belly Tacos. The burger looked like a frozen patty and it was decent, but not the greatest. The tacos were some of the best I've ever had, but did not fill me up. The corn on the cob was pretty good and the macaroni and cheese was mediocre. The atmosphere is pretty open and relaxed on the first floor, but I'm not sure how the two upper floors are in relation to that. 

If the portions were larger, and the beef was fresh, I would've given them 5 stars easily.
name: Brett

text: The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Worth checking out. Food was good and came out fast. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Initial visit barely a 1 star because we literally received 3 dishes doused in the same sauce. However, with its numerous good reviews and historic past, we decided to give it a second try. Difference this time is that we conversed with the manager and asked for authentic dishes. Finally, some decent Chinese cuisine. The roast duck was crispy, the scallop fresh and delectable. Talk to your waiter and if need be talk to the manager, and order the right dishes. Cheers!
name: L

text: Found this place on yelp and decided to try it out per the healthy food options. We walk in at 8:15 on a Thursday, and they tell each person that they close at 9, and "to not plan on being there forever". No biggie, we proceed to order. There were probably 6 other people in the restaurant at this time. When they served our food, she said that we had 15 minutes to eat fast. I got the Bollywood Bowl, which was decent. Other people in my party got the chicken burrito- which was apparently very bland and with minimal chicken. This place is more of a Mexican food place, like a downgraded Rubio's. Employees proceeded to turn off music, take out the garbage, which was not a big deal at all, but we felt like they were annoyed. When we left, 5 minutes after closing time, the waitress told us to go clean our table and put our dishes in the wash bins. We didn't complain and did it. Disappointing experience. We will not be back.

text:
Very welcoming environment!! The interior has an appealing beautiful wooden theme with a touch of modern look, TVs for entertainment, and outside patio seating for comfort. Plenty of seating room and high table seating for a quick breakfast or lunch. Close to UNR, fairly quick walk from campus. Easy to stop by here before going to class or work in the morning.

Great customer service! Family owned business with an incredibly friendly staff. I felt very welcomed in during my first visit and the employees already know me by name and got to know me personally. They are proud supporters of helping the local community and businesses. Most of their produce is locally bought. 

Simple yet great selection of breakfast, lunch, and coffee! Everything here has the great taste of homemade style diner. I tried out their açaí bowl and soup and was very satisfied with the taste. They also serve a good assortment of eggs, sandwiches, and salads and can customize them to your liking.

This business is new to the area and has a great potential to grow into a successful community-knit eatery. They plan on modernizing the outside look and adding more choices of food to their menu in the future. Highly recommended to anyone looking into a comforting home-style bite of breakfast and lunch with family, a quick coffee before work/school, and to all nearby community residents and students.

text: The service here is always top notch as is the food! Mouthwatering carne Asada tacos, caramelos and toritos always keep me coming back for more. Not to mention the micheladas are one of a kind. I take everyone here for the micheladas! If you haven't been here, you absolutely need to to try it

text:
Have you ever seen the movie Oldboy?

There is a scene where a prisoner is fed wontons for twenty solid years in a row every day or weekly (watch the film- its a good one). He later escapes and in order to find clues to find the people that incarcerated him searches out for the same wonton he has been eating all those years.

Well folks, I too have been searching out the best wonton in all the land! Under very different scenarios mind you but Eureka it has been found!! The hunan wontons are the key detailed in picture below. What a tasty fried wonton with o such delicous meat inside. They are bathed quite lavishly in hunan sauce but you can always drain out the excess sauce that pools at the bottom of the container.

I also tried the Seafood Wor Ba soup. I would most compare this soup to an egg drop soup but with shrimp, pieces of imitation crab cut up, tiny pieces of losbter? or is this some form of crawfish? You got me...
The soup is a nice alternative choice from the run of the mill soups from most chinese take out restaurants but I would not rush back to order it. Lastly, I ordered the General Tso's Shrimp. There is a ton of sauce on these but I feel like this is the norm in all chinese restaurants plow the sauce on because that's what American's want? The Shrimp itself are very good if you can find a piece not drenched in sauce or ask for the sauce on the side.

Well there it is...try the hunan wontons. Warning, after trying them you will be highly critical of all other wontons that enter your mouth! And as always people SYOY!! Until next time. Detective Mike.
name: Mike

text:
Visiting the area for the weekend. We were looking for a local non- chain restaurant for lunch 
We found a Growler USA on yelp and decided to give it a try. 
The Brewban (Reuben ) was great.  Thin sliced pastrami, cheese and kraut on a marbled rye, nicely toasted.  You have a choice of curly fries or tater tots. I chose the tots. Crispy outside with soft centers, just as tots should be. 
Service was great starting with a friendly welcome. Several pages of craft beers were available however, we did not try them. 
Highly recommend you try this restaurant when in the area.

text:

We had the arancini San marzono for an appetizer. I think they were my first risotto balls. I'm not sure why it isn't highlighted because they were amazing. Full of flavor. text:
Finally got to check this place out and was so glad I did. Shuffle is a great stop when your are looking for a fun place to have an activity for the night and/or just grab a drink. 

The whole place has a great feel to it, comfy yet hipster decor. The bar area is much larger that I would have expected with the bar and various sizes of tables to sit at. There are some TVs so we could check out the bowl games and the Lightning game. They have a great rotating tap selection (6 and all different varieties- thank you for not having a ton of IPAs like too many places have) and then many bottle options. They also have a variety of wines. No hard liquor, so know in advance. They also have a menu with many snacking type options and a couple that could be a meal. We tried the huge pretzel, the truffle-shuffle tots and the BBQ Chicken sandwich. All were good. My pretzel ways homemade and huge, the 2 dipping sauces (a honey spicy mustard & cajon creamy sauce) were good and nice to have different flavors. My pretzel was a little greasy, but I think it was just the one I got as others in the bar didn't look that way.

Then after drinks & snacks we went on to the main event, shuffle board! It's $10/person for an hour or if you have a larger group there's a court rate. They have 4 area to play. They did a great job giving us instructions as we had never played before and then we practiced and played. It was a blast! Doesn't take a lot of effort but more some thought, similar to pool, where you are trying to score, knock your opponent out of scoring position or block to help yourself. 

This is a great spot to bring a group and just enjoy some time.
name: Katelyn

text: Went this past weekend for the first time and had a delicious meal! I had the cranberry limeade for a drink and it was delicious as well as strong. The beer list is extensive and they have some really different options! My boyfriend and I shared the cheesesteak spring rolls, which were fantastic. Then we both had the buffalo chicken wrap as an entree and it was definitely the best one I've had anywhere in the area! The service was also wonderful. Will definitely be back!!

text:
We went here as group for a dinner after a work conference.  After multiple char-grilled oysters at other restaurants these were a disappointment.  The are not grilled as thoroughly as other places in town and the herb butter was taking back its butter form.  I had a trio and honestly the only yummy part was the etoufee.  The gumbo was meh. The  red beans and rice were so dry,  I would have thought that is their style except one of my companions got just the red beans and rice and it was a much wetter version.  Additionally this is the only place we have been that no one finished their meals.
The bonus was another companion ordered the pecan pie as their starter and it was five star.
name: Melody

text:
When it comes to dining options and coffeehouses in the Fishtown proper, finding better than Front Street Cafe can happen fairly easily. But the fact that FSC serves breakfast, lunch, dinner, and coffeehouse favorites with an emphasis on healthier options; and manages to do so while having an easy contender for best outdoor dining area in the 19125; gives it an ample amount of dining experiences that few other restaurants in the area can really compete with!

The first time I came in to grab coffee and a croissant in the morning before work, I sat in my office chair feeling a little lackluster and wishing that I had stopped by La Colombe or Milk Crate instead. But had i of been able to stick around breakfast would have been my savior with bananas fosters hotcakes or chipotle hash, and possibly even a bloody mary for good measure. And the fact that they do daily breakfast until 3:00 pm, with lunch kicking in at 11:00 am makes FSC a boozy brunch hero any day of the week!

When I came in for a dinner among comrades after a Evil Genius Brewery gathering I found myself secretly lamenting for one of the other dining options we could have indulged upon. But as I imbibed upon a good beer from their list of 16 rotating drafts things quickly started to get better. And as I first took a bite of my black bean burger with black beans, carrots, grains, cucumber-dill aioli, arugula, and house pickles on a vegan brioche bun; I was treated to what might just be the best veggie burger I ever had!

Even though I've still only managed to enjoy it during the Yelp Elite Event that we had here, the main event for Front Street Cafe might just be the immaculate outdoor patio which features ample seating and a wonderful bar area. In the ever changing world of Fishtown dining, FSC is an overlooked sleeper. But with all that it offers, it can come out of nowhere and prove that it shouldn't be!
name: Bill

text: Poor treatment by staff and management and would not at all recommend this restaurant to anyone. You won't see me there again.
name: Michelle

text: Been waiting for this restaurant to open (or reopen if you were a chihuahuas fan).  New lovely owners, great redesign, but the best part is that much of the staff is back and the food is just as good.  Menu is a little different but the carnitas were just as good as always as was the queso dip.

text: This is our first time eating here. Our dinner was delicious! Great food, great place to hang out with your friends and family. Great service. Our waitress Laura was excellent. She was very attentive and very nice to us. For a family of four, we ordered different kinds of food. We had chicken caprese, sala burger, fried seafood, broiled gulf fish beurre blanc and the cured salmon board. We tried each other's food and we weren't disappointed. We will be back here again to try the other food on the menu.
name: Leah

text: Great place all around. A small so sometimes you have to wait but it's worthwhile. The hand rolls a really fantastic don't miss them. The specialty rolls in the sashimi is very good. Good selection of sake. Service is fast and they always have a surprise for you at the end. Best sushi place in Metairie
name: Fred

text: Ordered three drinks at the drive thru on 12 May.  They made one wrong drink so we told them and returned it expecting them to just remake the right one (a 30 sec process).  Instead we watched a tall thin young man with glasses yell 'what the f$&k' and stomp off to the back.  The short young man (also with glasses) working the drive thru as a cashier then proceeded to deliberately not come back to the window for a full 15 min.  What they both did was serve the 5 cars behind us food and drinks by walking outside.  My wife eventually called the manager by dialing the Sonics number on their website.  A female manager answered with the worst static connection ever.  My wife tried to explain what was going on and finally told her to just come to the drive thru window where we had been sitting for 15 min.  The manager did not come to the drive thru and instead sent a different polite young man who remade the drink in about 10 sec and apologized.  The very immature staff had clearly done this before and were not concerned with consequences due to a complete lack of management at this location - AVOID!
name: Jason

text: So excited to try this place in midtown as we were stuck in Reno waiting for car servicing and I didn't want to stop at a chain sandwich place. Super cool ambiance, great outdoor seating to watch the locals pass by. My hubby got the pita sandwich and was 5 impressed by taste and by the mini salad and micro cookie that came along. I opted for the combo: 1/2 cranberry   & cup of . The chicken tortilla soup was so delicious but the salad was disappointing. More of an organic spring mix from Costco with clustered cranberries group together and over dosed with balsamic and their other dressing (the kind of dosage that make you cough because the balsamic is so strong). The annoying part is the salad hasn't been chopped so I looked like I was trying to eat dinosaur bites. I wish at a cost of $10 my salad was slightly chopped so I could look a bit more ladylike when eating. The micro cookie was a nice surprise and the perfect way to end a meal. Just avoid the salads, you can make better at home with Costco and some kitchen .
name: Jennifer

text: Nothing special really. Three of us ordered three different dishes, tastes each of them but none of them were interesting. Good service though.

text: This place has a huge eclectic menu and everything is very good. They have huge portions and the prices are an amazing value. The service is a little off but I think thats more because this is philly not cause its truly bad.

text: Terrible service. Ordered online and after 1.5 hrs called. They claimed that the food had just left. Got it 1/2 hr later even though we live 5 mins driving distance from there.  Food was just okay. They got the noodles wrong, green onion cake came with sweet sauce not hot sauce. Green onion cake was also the frozen kind most restaurants cutting corners is selling. Would not recommend this place and won't order from them again.

text: Great food.  Service was excellent.  Favorite place for a night out with friends or a dinner with the kiddos !

The chicken sandwich was thrown together without a care in the world. Sad the place has major potential with terrible execution.

Who eat just chicken on plate with no rice, no vegetables. Did not like. No wonder few customers in here. Waiter stated I should have ask for vegs in dish...who knew you prepare dish without????? text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. text: I got the chance to check this place out recently and I'm so glad I did because I loved my shrimp po boy. The staff was friendly and my friends loved their food too.

text: Last nights dinner devours took me to another new kids on the seafood scene; The Amazing Crab House! @amazingcrabhouse . This establishment is brand new with a sit in Bar with more than enough TVs to watch any show or game! The music is "ok"; but the service is top notch! . Our sever Nick really took care of us. While here we ordered the fried calamari as an appetizer, which was really crispy and delightful. Then we ordered 6 blue crabs , along with a LB of shrimp with the head on. Ask for Nick and tell home shimmy sent you! #philadelphia #philly #crab #shrimp #garlic #water #liquor #squid #menu #bar #food #foodporn #foodphotography #foodstagram #foodie #foodblogger

text: We ducked into this place sometime in a dead post lunch pre dinner hour during a pouring rain, and are so so lucky we did. I am vegetarian and my friend eats meat but is very lactose intolerant, so finding food in New Orleans has been a bit of a challenge usually involving a lot of planning. We ran into Anatolia unplanned, and were blown away. I got the veggie platter, and it included a good amount of food for a fairly reasonable price, and all of it was delicious. The rice was well cooked and seasoned, onions perfectly done, hummus just the right amount of creamy, and the pita was perfect. Best place we've eaten at our whole trip!
name: Sheila

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. A very pleasant experience. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
Came here with my fiancee and her family a couple of days back, and I had an OK experience.

First, the ambiance is definitely nothing to write home about, but it does its job - it feels like your average diner. We walked in without a reservation and were seated immediately, so that was nice. The menu had a decent variety of comfort foods; I settled on the smaller portion of turkey and dressing, since I definitely love Thanksgiving food. With our orders, we were given the choice of 6 or 7 different types of bread, so I was pretty impressed by that. I ended up getting the banana bread, and it was reasonably tasty - my fiancee got the rolls and she thought they were very fresh and tasty.

Our waitress (who was kind of annoying to me, but had a good amount of personality, I guess) originally told us that our food would take 18 minutes to prepare, but it actually took a lot longer than that because we got stuck behind a bunch of large (catering?) orders. She was also absent from the table a lot, but I think she was serving a lot of other tables, so that was kind of forgivable.

When the entrees finally arrived, everyone pretty much enjoyed their food. My turkey and dressing were fine, although the dressing was slightly dry. My fiancee enjoyed her meal (chicken, mac and cheese, and green beans), so that was good as well. 

Overall, I can't imagine I would ever choose to come here, but if I was brought here by some family function, I could definitely find something to eat :)
name: William

text: I can only give 3 stars. We order pizza here all the time and we love it. This evening we decided to try the Stromboli. What a disappointment! The stromboli dough was soggy and the amount of liquid the came out of it when you bit into it was horrible. You also burned your mouth because of the boiling liquid pouring out of it. We will sick with their pizza because their pizza is good.
name: Tracy

text:
This restaurant is in Armature Works in downtown Tampa. 

They were out of the Breakfast Brisket Bisquit they advertise when we got their at 10:30, so we ordered the Korean Philly to share. 

They have a menu board that showcases their food and it looked delicious. 

We were very disappointed.  I realize pictures dont look exactly the same as what you recieve,
 however our sandwhich was a bit sad. The meat was a little chewy and it lacked the toppings pictured. Overall it had a pretty good flavor or I would assign 2 stars to this experience. 

The $11 dollar price for the Philly left me feeling a bit cheated. Next time we will pick an alternate vendor for food .
name: Dee

text:
Devon provided a solid restaurant week experience. I arrived with a party of 4 and we were seated promptly in the dining area. Note: the restaurant is pretty big, but was still completely full, but that might have been due to it being restaurant week. In any case, I'd recommend making a reservation just to be safe.

To start the meal, we received amazing biscuits served with tasty maple butter (and yes, you can ask for more...we definitely did). We also received the calamari plate from the Yelp check-in offer, which tasted great and was very generous in size.

For my appetizer, I ordered the Caesar salad, which was undoubtedly my least favorite meal of the night. It wasn't bad, just not much better than Caesar salad that you would get at a typical pizza shop. The star dish of the night was definitely the scallops, which were perfectly seared and paired with delicious lobster risotto (perfect scallops and risotto...Gordon Ramsay would be so proud!). The apple croudtade was basically apple bread pudding and was flavorful while not being overly sweet, though it was a little dry. However, that was likely because I asked to not receive the ice cream the dish generally comes with since I don't generally consume heavy dairy. With the ice cream I can't imagine the cake being dry.

The service was excellent throughout the night, and the portion sizes were large---I had seared scallops and risotto for lunch the next day as well. All in all, our dinner was delicious and I recommend Devon to anyone looking for a filling restaurant week meal.
name: Nonye

text: First time ever having a homemade beignet... absolutely loved each bite along with the cherry filled croissant and banana nut muffin. Everything was light and fresh and really good. The atmosphere and location is pristine and perfect for people watching.
name: Natasha

text:
Service was great at the bar, but this place is expensive. We were able to come by on a Saturday where it wasn't very busy. Lots of great choices on draft and unique cocktail choices. The food was expensive and it was just sandwiches and burgers. Which we expected more than the few choices they had for food.

We only ordered the dirty fries and they weren't the greatest.

We may come back if we just want to drink.
name: Chris

text: It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Definitely coming back. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: It's a kinda out of the way joint next to a super loud club but once we walked inside the noise faded away and we were enveloped in a dark velvet cocoon with tasty cocktails and delicious food!  We started off with a Jamison and coke and a Manhattan. Hubby had Korean street tacos and I had the roasted veggie chopped salad with goat cheese. His tacos were served like appetizers or tapas ( a la carte) and that was fine cause we weren't that hungry. They were savory and quite spicy!  Mmmmmm!  My salad had a perfect fruity vinaigrette that married the flavors of the greens and roasted vegetables very well. The croutons and pumpkin seeds added crunch and flavor. I would definitely go back. Oh, and the have a large wine selection.
name: Theresa

text:
This place has the best bread hands down. Get the sriracha garlic bread and a kombucha! 

Amazing staff and food made with love
name: Russell

text: Came here on a Sunday night and it was about what I would expect:  service was a little off (asked for silverware a couple times), food wasn't quite right (turkey burger was undercooked and left me with anxiety about salmonella afterwards).  To their credit, they took back the turkey burger and did everything to make me happy, so I appreciated that.  Highlights: their turkey club is really good, above average....the key is the thick sliced home roasted turkey, bacon which is super crisp, and the wheat toast is nicely toasted.  My mom likes the pot roast and gets it every time.  They've survived this location for years, when others that came before have failed, which is a testament to their ability to serve up stable, consistent neighborhood meals for locals who want a fairly predictable meal without cooking at home.
name: Daniel

text: Pretty good chocolate! We went for the Saturday tour and really enjoyed it. They are legit in how they process froM cocoa pods to chocolate bars! The tour guide knew what she was talking about and handled a large group well. Exactly how I want to feel in a vintagey chocolate shop. Most of their items are pretty dark so I docked a star for the limited variety.
name: Chelsea

text: This is for 2 dishes at Gold and Silver, Sausage Patties with Biscuits and Gravy, and Eggs Benedict with Home Fries (Preferably O'Brien)! Both are 5 Stars, service has been 3-5 stars, always 5 stars from the Bussers. Open 24 hours, if you like either dish, Dragon says it's a MUST TRY!!!
name: ThaDragonSourceRa ®

text:
My bowl tonight was so good I could have cried. SO GOOD. So fresh. I would eat this every single day. 

If you even remotely like sushi, definitely come here. Price is a little high but it's honestly so worth it. 10/10

text: My favorite place to go when I land in Tampa is Whiskey Joe's. I visit Tampa 4-5 times a year to see my family and always make a stop by whiskey Joe's for a drink on the beach. My favorite combo: beach, drinks, music, nice views. The drinks are super affordable and they have some yummy appetizers if you're just looking for a quick bite before your dinner reservation. every time I go to Whiskeys there's a dj who plays some hits, which makes it even more fun. The sand is hot, the staff are great and the vibe is awesome. If you're into sipping on your favorite cold drink while staring at the water and listening to some jams then you must go to Whiskey

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..

text: We stopped in here while in town for a wedding and weren't disappointed. Quality bread, quality beef, and quality shrimp po'boys. I went with the one that had shrimp and the roast beef on it. In retrospect, should have just split one of each. I thought the beef overpowered the shrimp, so that was kind of lost out on. Tried a bite of my fiance's shrimp po' boy and it was great. I would have liked some remoulade on the shrimp, but it was still really good overall. We got drinks, which were decent but didn't really blow me away.

text: Good breakfast options. Food was good, not mind-blowing.  Service was good. To top it all off and what truly made the experience was sitting on the water of the inlet.  Great views!

text: I always thought Denny's had poor service but this place is much worse.  Ten minute wait despite there being seven empty tables. Then, other tables who were seated after us got there food before us.  Management needs to be changed.
name: Mark

text:
As a Peruvian who knows her food I can assure you that this is the best option in Philadelphia. Food is neatly prepare and restaurant staff is amazing. Do
Do you want to try food Peruvian food? Go there!
name: Lizbeth

text: Best Chinese food I've ever had. Quick cheap and they are so friendly.  Definitely coming back!
name: Jamy

text: Katie's is a must stop while in New Orleans.  Favorite things to order are the oysters slessinger and the blackberry jalapeño ribs.  Casual atmosphere.
name: Alicia

text:
Do yourself a favor and never go here!!! The establishment is beautiful, the decor is breath taking, and the bar was fully stocked with great liquor. All to say that, the staff was awful, the bartenders knew NOTHING, and the experience was nothing like I expected. There was a terrible fight, which involved a friend of the bar punching (knocking out), a bar patron for "touching his food". The servers and I believe the manager did nothing but flock to the attacker (friend of the bar) in this situation. The bar patron was literally bleeding from his mouth, all over the place, and for a while no one did anything. They kicked the bar patron out and basically cheered the attacker on. It was disgusting and disturbing. Karaoke was cool, however the mics were hoarded by the group of 8-10 FRIENDS OF THE BAR. Let's just say, I'm sure myself and my two friends were the only members in the bar who actually paid for our drinks. 

The drinks were super watered down. Made incorrectly, and felt flat. I ordered an IPA beer because the mixed drinks were awful and none of the bartenders knew what an IPA was. The bartenders catered to their friends and often it felt like we did not exist. One of the bartenders continuously sprayed cleaner on the bar, while we were at the bar drinking, and wiped down the bar. The chemicals were so strong, my eyes were burning. 

Do yourself a favor and run for the hills.
name: TJ

text: I have never been so disgusted with a restaurant in my life. Came to the Hardrock for dinner and I will never come back. Got seated at 6:15pm and ordered drinks and food. Told the server to bring food out as it was done so that we had hot food on the table. 6:50 pm.. NO SIGN OF THE SERVER. Around 7pm we finally get all of our food AT ONCE! The nachos came out with a gelatinous layer over the cheese that had been sitting for sometime. The burgers were soggy and ice cold. The shrimp may have well as been served on ice. Manager comes out and tells us that he is going to fix everything at around 7:10... fast forward to 7:25 he comes back out with another plate of COLD nachos!!! Manager offered to comp the deal due to all the issues... I wish they could give me the past two hours of my life back!
name: Alex

text: PSA: if you ask for your bagels to be toasted, they will NOT toast anything. This "toasted everything bagel with cream cheese" is more like a bagel with a scoop of cream cheese. We ordered a BEC toasted .... not toasted again. The waitress was extremely rude and when asked for cinnamon for an order of oatmeal, she at first said they didn't have it, went and got CUMIN and then tried to say it was cinnamon when we told her it was not.
name: Paige

text: I've passed this location several times and never had a reason to stop by.  I had never heard of the place before until recently and even more surprised that this is a chain restaurant. I met up with a friend who swears by this restaurant for drinks. The restaurant is very lovely and since it was a beautiful day, we settled on sitting outside. The hostess led us outside and told us we could pick anywhere to sit which was nice. There were options of sitting on a couch, lower table, or a high stool table. I looked at the menu previously before arriving and noticed they have happy hour specials, also great. I went for the Thursday $5 Margarita special and my friend went with the $5 Moscow Mule special.  There were also food specials for Happy Hour that I took advantage of: $7 Fired up Shrimp & $5 Jalapeno Deviled Eggs. Both were good, but it could have been better. The shrimp was supposed to be in a sriracha sauce so I immediately thought it was going to be spicy. Wrong. No spice whatsoever. Maybe I missed the fine print, BUT it was still good. It reminded me of bang bang shrimp from Bonefish Grill. The deviled eggs only had a slice of jalapeno on top, it wasn't mixed in which is fine. I felt they were missing the relish in the yolk mix. Without the bacon bit on top, it would've lacked seasoning (which means I just need to make my own again). The blackberry margarita was very good and after engaging in deep conversation I almost forgot it was alcohol and was drinking it like juice. Overall the place is good. I'd come back and try some other items on the menu.
name: Tianna

text: Well that's 30 minutes of my valuable life I'll never get back!! No one has been trained here. No one knows what the difference between and taco and a burrito???? I just don't think they care. I heard some customer say that when the place was closed for remodeling, they should have remodeled the employees as well. Food cold, confuses employees, and they don't really want to serve you Taco Bell. I see this place closing very soon!!!

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Probably not coming back. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better online than it did in person. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..

text:
Keith was awesome and funny! He really brightened up our morning. We have some silly and active kids so Keith was a real treat! My daughter knew right away thought he was a comedian by how nice and fun he was. Asked him if they give military discounts and he said "heck yeah!" (Love it)... 

Food: 
The food was perfectly cooked and tasty! I had chicken strips, kids had mini burgers and hot dog. The hubby had the Route 66.  Everything was perfect! 

Kids had chocolate and chocolate with strawberry shakes that were perfect thickness and taste. 

Can't wait to come visit Reno again and enjoy some Johnny Rockets!
name: Jessica

text:
I had a hankering for some rib tips for months but there isn't a bbq place near me.  We happened to be in Hancock County and planned to get dinner nearby so I checked Yelp! for bbq places.  D & D's had good reviews so I begged my husband to stop there.  It's a very small place in a strip mall and a little on the dumpy side but WOW!  Great bbq!  The two "D's" are Uncle and nephew and big D told me he's been seasoning meat at his grandmother's side since he was six years old.  

I loved the rib tips!!  For $10.00 you can get half a pound of tips plus two sides.  I ordered the Mac n cheese and collard greens with my tips.  It was Excellent.  While the Mac n cheese wasn't anything "special " it was still good, but the collard greens were cooked perfectly and seasoned with a little red pepper flake and smoked turkey!

My husband had a very generous pulled pork sandwich with baked beans and Mac n cheese.  He ate every bit of it.  You can buy canned soda for $1.00 and big D and little D couldn't be any more hospitable and nice to talk to!  If you can look past the divey interior, you will love the food they are turning out!
name: Joan

text: I was in town for the Essence Festival.  I tried the establishment because it had good reviews, especially the crab cakes.  The environment was nice and the bartender and rest of the staff was very professional.  However, I was not impressed with the food.  I ordered the crab cakes.  They were described as being lump crab meat but it was not.  It was very breaded and greasy. I live in the Washington, DC area which has phenomenal crabs and crab cakes. I wouldn't suggest the crab cakes to anyone.

text: We are visiting from San Antonio, TX & were looking for good restaurant in the Garden District - this is definitely a place we will come back to.  Great Service & exquisite food in a casual setting.

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..

text: Incompetent waiting staff. Slow slow slow kitchen. Decent food, however never come here unless you have loads of time kill. Probably our last visit.
name: Grey

text:
BRUNCH REVIEW

We had such a great experience during brunch at The Mockingbird. This place is part of Morph Hospitality owned by celebrity Chef Manet Chauhan, and like all of her restaurants in Nashville you get a top notch experience.

My favorite part of The Mockingbird and all of Chauhan's restaurants is the serving sizes are MASSIVE. They always serve you more food than you'd expect, and probably have one of the best values in the city on a food per plate metric.

We ordered 2 drinks, 2 meals and 1 giant donut and left stuffed (and also with the giant donut). The Flock Yes (Chicken and biscuits) was amazing! The breakfast sandwich was the biggest sandwich I've ever seen! The donut was nothing special, probably wouldn't order it again.

If you are looking for a good brunch in Nashville, this should be at the top of your list!
name: Dan

text: I didn't even know this place existed ! It was amazing food! It's set up like a food court. The choices are great and the staff is on top of things. We went around and ordered from like 3 places before we sat down. They brought all our food to our table and even though the atmosphere suggests you clean up after yourself they have staff that come around and keep things clean. Overall good food, great service and decent price.
name: Breanna

text: What a joke. Just waited in the drive through for 10 minuets with no reply, then I call to ask about he problem and the person on the phone tries to humiliate me, telling me I have no idea what I'm talking about. I have no time for service like this, and you shouldn't either. Avoid this place at all costs, save your time and energy there's plenty of places to get a drive through burger in the area.

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Overall, a strong experience. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.

text: Typical bar place and food but that is what I was looking for. Bar is 1970's with HD Tv's. Service is great!! Drink a beer and go this is an ok place.
