text: This place is a very welcome addition to the Philadelphia vegan food scene. Food is always delicious and the staff is friendly and knowledgeable.  Get the greens and grains bowl and bliss out on the flavors! Plenty of food for two meals but you will be tempted to eat it all at once; you have been warned...
name: Ophelia

text: Love this place!! They are consistently putting out good food with bold flavors that mash very well together, and the bread is always fresh!!
name: Chris

text: The i tea fried chicken is a serious serious problem. As in I will eat it all. The soy garlic sauce is so good and their Dan Dan noodles are so spicy and literally perfect. Best in Philly by a landslide
name: Ryan

text: Usually, this Texas Roadhouse was good. The last time, we had a bit of a different experience. My boyfriend and I went here because I had gotten a gift card for Christmas and we wanted to go here, as this is one of our favorite places to go to. There wasn't hardly a wait, the food was amazing, all until the end. Our waiter lost our gift card. It was a pretty busy night, but still. That could have been a debit card or credit card. He looked pretty frantic at finding it but he was looking at every table, he kind of had no clue what he was doing. I admit, I was pissed. The manager came to us and gave us a lot of gift certificates to apologize, I let it blow over because I didn't want to make a scene - he's just lucky that it was a gift card, and I was lucky too. I'm sure the place is fine now, that was just a bad night. That's why I give this place 4 stars, I'll come back for sure, and don't let my one night deter you from going.
name: Laura

text:
Nice spot, 2 minutes from the beach and downtown area. Outside seating and bar, as well as 2 bars inside. Decent service and cheap drinks, $2-$4 beers, with a huge selection. The food is food. (I don't go to bars to eat food so I won't rate it either) 
3 good size TVs as well for game day.
name: Ryan

text: Never had Hawaiian food so I honestly can't judge much. The food was good I ordered the Bulgogi fries and a Moco Loco and added sriracha. I would had liked to get some suggestions from the staff but he seemed a little preoccupied. A couple before me did let us know that everything on the menu was good. All together my experience wasn't bad. Definitely will be back!
name: Contia

text:
Absolutely as lousy food as it gets. I eat out pretty much every day and this was the worst in years. The bread was bad, the butter for the bread was bad, the salad was covered in mayonnaise, the lobster tails were rubbery, didn't smell right and were dripping in butter. I ate the mashed potatoes and left the lobster tails. 
They try to be higher end and that's what I thought we would get by going there rather than the nine dollar buffet next door. 
But the food sucks. 
To the managers credit, he offered to have the kitchen remake the lobster tails but I said no. Based on everything being bad, I didn't think they were capable so no point. We paid for everything and left with pretty much everything still on the plates. 
I'd recommend going to the gas station and getting a cup of top roman over eating at this place. It'll probably be fresher, taste better and you won't be as disappointed. 
Total crap at this place, don't go there.
name: K

text: Very good food and service. Marissa was very attentive and knowledgeable of the menu.  She was very good at recommending specific items on the menu. We were seated quickly.
name: Patty

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The food was good and the service was easygoing. You can tell they care about customer experience here. A very pleasant experience. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: Really cool place in shipping containers.  Their coffee is GREAT, but the bakery is nothing short of AMAZING.  They have a wonderful breakfast pastry baked with bacon and an over easy egg on top.  One of the best breakfast treats I've had.  Really great fresh fruit scones, muffins, and cinnamon rolls.  Everything is made from scratch in house each day.  The bakery is in a separate space across from the seating area in front of the coffee shop. They also have some really great sandwiched for lunch too!!
name: Woody

text:
Once one of the best burger chains in Tampa, now a tasteless shadow of what it once was. The new owner turned the former warm, family atmosphere into a sterile locker room with benches. The food was disgusting. The once famous Haggen Daas ice cream, malt shop shakes are now soft-serve Dixie cups with a squirt of syrup. We returned it and got our money back.  It was hard to locate the chicken on the chicken sandwich and the toppings & bun were tasteless. A meal at McDonald's is 10 times better. The service was dead slow and the manager, who was nice and polite, struggled to come up with any reason for why things were so bad. He did apologize and said, "I just work here." We had indigestion for over one hour!
We will never return and odds are they won't last much longer. A textbook case of how to ruin a business.
name: David

text: We stayed at the Guy Harvey but participated in a bar crawl which required eating and drinking in bars + restaurants in both Tradewind resorts.  The pub crawl contest restaurants and bars at the Island Grand included Beef 'o' Brady's. ​The Bar crawl includes several locations and you can read the full article on Wine Dine And Play.
name: Sean

text: Don't dine at this restaurant. Worst hostesses ever! Customer service here is absolutely appalling. I've had WAY better meals at Tableau, M Bistro, Gallitoire 33, Meril's and Brennan's. You would think for the price and the name that it would be a good dining experience. You would be wrong! I was here with a colleague for a work dinner and if it wasn't for the server we had, Megan, who was great, I would have walked out. DO NOT DINE HERE.
name: Marney

text: Great experience at Tequila Sunrise for dinner. Food was tasty and not typical rice and beans. Lots of flavor and everything has its own flavor.  Guacamole was fresh and flavorful. Only problem was not enough servers to handle everyone. We will make this a regular stop when we are hungry for Mexican food.
name: Alex

text:
Well I saw all the cars in the parking lot so we decided to give it a try. The food was everywhere. The trip around the offerings took some time. Salad bar, soup, entrees, side dishes and deserts.
If you go for volume then this is your place, you can fill up to near bursting. However if you are going for taste or great preparation you may want to hit the accelerator. Most of side dishes were dried out and tasteless ( add your own seasoning I guess). Fried chicken was passable. Salad bar ok. Deserts were sweet with carrot cake the nearest to good. the pre put together hamburgers and sliders were mmm bad....
If the price 12.00 was lower I might have raised my review but for that price you should be able to expect more.
name: Johnny

text: Beautiful choice of wines. Lovely people will serve your food with all that enthusiasm and hospitality. However, if you are a bit of cuisine connoisseur and fancy Italian food, I would not recommend this place at all. What you see on the picture is nor what you get. First, there were no complimentary authentic Italian appetizers like for example,  olive oil w/balsamic vinegar drizzled with a pitch of garlic for flavour, not fresh-baked Italian bread. Nothing was there while we were waiting, except for the wine We ordered. They had codfish for dinner with fried nuts, herbs drizzled with lemon juice. It made me feel sick. I did not finish my meal. It tasted way too buttery, greasy, with burned tiny rectangle prosciutto pieces. Fish! And Pork?!!! No salt, no pepper were offered. No Italian flavours were added to the fish.  Now imagine oily codfish with greasy prosciutto and burned nuts covered under herbs on your plate for dinner! Try other places better. Thanks!
name: M

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It was crowded but still moved along. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Pretty happy with it overall. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
Underwhelmed to say the least. This was my second time at Uncle Julio's and recommended it as a location to meet some friends - 4 of us total in our party - as I'd had a good experience on my first visit.
Watermelon margaritas were the special tonight and one friend ordered it but it took almost 20 minutes to arrive and didn't taste like there was any alcohol in it.
My wife ordered the chicken fajitas. She told our server, Eleni, at least 3x that all she wanted was the chicken and veggies (no rice, beans or tortillas). I ordered the Guadalajara and also didn't want rice beans or tortillas. When our food arrived, mine was missing the Mexican butter but it was correct. Hers however was chicken and steak fajitas - NOT what she ordered, chicken. The food had taken so long to arrive that she didn't want to insist on having just chicken. Eleni felt it was necessary to tell us that she'd only charge us for chicken fajitas. Hey Eleni - she didn't order chicken/steak fajitas. You're not doing us any favors by charging us for what we ordered. The next time Eleni came back around she told us again that she was only going to charge us for chicken fajitas. Seriously?
When a dinner costs $47.17 for a couple who consumes zero alcohol, you'd think you'd leave feeling good about the dining experience. Not so in this instance. Uncle Julio's was quite the disappointment this evening. I would have asked for a manager but didn't want to cause a raucous in front of our friends. Go in knowing you'll be there for a while, spend a lot of money and might not receive what you ordered.
name: Erica

text: Everything I've ordered from here is very good. The pizza is delicious and cheesy and doesn't have to much sause. The wings are good size and all the flavors I've tried are very good. You defiantly get a lot of food for the price. I'm glad it's so close to my house because it's my go to for pizza and wings now. Everyone that works here is very friendly.
name: Ashley

text: I have never posted before, but my experience here warrants a post. Bad service and bad food.  Took 1.5 hours to bring any food out.  Brought the wrong beer and did not come back to the table for 20 minutes. Brought an uncooked burger when the food finally came
name: Scott

text:
Before you read this let's get a few things out of the way. 

This is Tampa, not Chicago or Houston or LA, where there's 2 billion awesome burger joints. So that being said, compared to Tampa's other fast-but-upscale burger options, Shula burger is very good. 

Not the best burger you will ever have but good for Tampa and I myself loved the super thin and crispy fries. Also loved the sweet tater tots.

Veggie burger was also great.

Plus super friendly service.

Is it better than the burger you had in Brooklyn or Austin? NO.
Is it better than BurgerFi? YES.
Is it better than Burger 21? NO. But there's no Burger 21 in South Tampa.
Until then, Shula Burger it is for me.
name: EJ

text: Drew is awesome, the drinks are fantastic and unique, and the ambience is phenomenal.  They always have incredible DJs spinning chill creative and fun vibes on vinyl.  Definitely recommend.
name: Caleb

text: Ate here on 6-7-2019, last minute decision, wasn't too sure as the reviews weren't great. Have to say we weren't disappointed. Good atmosphere, clean, good service and above average food. Also, everything was reasonably priced
name: Roger

text: In the words of Dionne Warwick....."Walk on By". It seemed like a safe bet on the Concourse but do not be fooled. The drink prices are borderline ridiculous, even for an airport. Service was slow with an attitude, and it went downhill. I ordered a salad and asked for Blue Cheese dressing, the waitress said "We don't have it; do I have to negotiate with you"? Not certain what that meant, but based on the scowl on her face and hand on her hip, it wasn't a good thing. As we were in New Orleans a PoBoy should have been a slam dunk. Just "Walk on By".
name: Mark

text: The atmosphere here is very comfortable and casual. It's a good spot to go on a casual date or even bring your family out for dinner. I've only ordered their tacos, but they were flavorful and very delicious!
name: Jessica

text: My friend liked it more than I did. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Also, not terrible, just not something i'd want again soon. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Anyway, they were out of one thing i originally wanted.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. idk I'd try something else next time. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: The service here is pretty great start to finish. We waited pretty long for our food but the manager took care of us. We went on a Thursday and it didn't seem like they took any shortcuts because of it. My only complaint is that I ordered the steak medium rare and it was medium, maybe medium well.
name: Joseph

text: Wow!   What flavorful food!  Honestly had to be some of the best Mexican I have had.   The taco salad was a bit small but enough.  Taco Tuesdays- 2$ a taco.   The cerviche was spot on!   The service was extra slow but super nice.  I will return when I visit again.
name: Mike

text: Awesome food everything was fresh customer service was A1 and the manager Tiffany was just a delightful spirit greeting each guest with impeccable service!!!
name: Saynara

text: Awesome pizza. Crust like I've never had before. The sauce is delish. Everything that I saw come out for others looked excellent also.
name: Chris

text: The worst Burger King, period!  The staff is very unfriendly, they get their cue from the very rude, condescending and unfriendly manager!
name: Missy

text: I was visiting the area for a wedding and needed a breakfast place that had gluten free options for my sister, vegan options for me, and a diner-like atmosphere to keep my parents happy. First Watch was great for all of us, and we ended up coming here everyday we were in town. They have Silk Vanilla Dairy-Free creamer for coffee and coffee available if you have to wait for a table on a busy Saturday morning. My family loved the summer specials! The Summer Crab Omelet was a fan favorite. The Summer Blush drink was gorgeous and tasty. Looking for vegan options? I personally recommend the Triple Berry Açaí Bowl or the AM Superfoods Bowl if you are looking for something refreshing and relatively healthy. If you actually have a dairy allergy, I recommend swapping the toast for breakfast potatoes. They are willing to swap gluten free toast for no upcharge. We will for sure be back! They are super allergy aware, which I am so grateful for.
name: Holly

text: Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It was crowded but still moved along. We shared dumplings first and those were prob the best thing on the table. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, tho the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Will be back. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text:
WAHOO.... or as the YELP says WOOHOO.  The draft beer selection is second to NONE in the city.  If you like CRAFT beers... German, USA, whatever - they have an amazing collection.

The food is very good.  Some dishes great - others ok.  But overall very very nice combination.  They also mix drinks pretty well and have wines. So it is a GREAT spot.  Its rather small - so go early - and stay late.

Nice atmosphere - service was good.
name: Gary

text: Love this place!! They have great slushy drinks and appetizers. T was the absolute best waitress! She has amazing recommendations and knew exactly what floats to add to the slushies to make them even better. Between the food and T's energy you can't go wrong with this place.
name: Kristi

text: Jeannie's Deli Ardmore PA.  Very nice people, nice clean place, I just wasn't feeling it.  10 a.m. and they were serving their full menu.  I decided to go with a breakfast cheesesteak.  I was prepared to beg, plead and grovel for Jeannie to make me a breakfast cheesesteak but there's one on the menu.  You can see in the picture an awesome amount of cheese and plenty of steak meat and eggs.  I think the roll had me not digging Jeannie's.  It could have been me.  But I think it was the roll.  They had a steady stream of regulars getting their breakfast so it could have been me.  But I think it was the roll.
name: James

text:
Disappointment: the only feeling I can associate with what I just consumed.

Blandest food I've ever tasted. The one star is for the funny cashier. The food was disgustingly freezerburnt and the whole place was cold enough to be a freezer for all that disgusting fish.
name: Isabelle

text: I'm from NY. We don't have good bbq like this. I got the brisket sandwich and it was delicious. The girls working the register were some air heads but the food was worth it
name: Kayla

text: We had a fabulous experience at the Wheelhouse this morning celebrating my boyfriend's birthday. We were seated immediately, and our server Samantha was awesome! She was super upbeat, friendly, and just a lot of fun. We placed our drink orders for bottomless mimosas, and within minutes we were sipping on them. Our food was excellent, and we received our plates in about 12 minutes. Samantha checked in with us frequently and made sure our drinks were always full. I'm not a fan of being charged an automatic gratuity, but I had no problem with it today. She earned the 20% plus a bit extra for being so fun. We will definitely be back!
name: Linda

text: If I could give more than 5 Stars, I would! Friendly (and helpful) staff, great service and delicious food! Decided to go here to celebrate my (very pregnant) wife's birthday on February 11th. Great wine list which included half bottles (since she can't drink I went with a half bottle). We started off with salads, she had a Caesar and I had a wedge. Both were delicious and large. The wedge came with blue cheese and French dressing, which was a nice twist. For our dinner course, we split the porterhouse and ordered two sides: mac and cheese and shoestring onions. The porterhouse was more than enough as we took half of it home (along with half of the sides). As far as taste, it was perfect (my mouth is watering just thinking about it). For dessert, we ordered a delicious sorbet (and I had a double latte). They also surprised us with a birthday dessert for my wife which I thought was a nice touch. Everything was so perfect, that, on our way out, my wife asked to speak to a manager to compliment everything from the the staff to the food! Great night!
name: Kris

text:
Conveniently located to everything, next to Harrah's Casino, right on the Riverwalk with upscale shopping, less than one block to the street car public transit, Manning's is around the corner. Great views of the Mississippi River and you could see the cruise ships  from our room window. 
Don't miss a meal at Drago's withi g the hotel. Char broiled oysters are a must even if you are not an oyster lover.... these will change your mind. Catfish is hot and flaky, the tender fried chicken, greens & sweet cornbread were on point! 
A huge workout gym with plenty of cardio equipment. Private hot tub and saunas inside the locker rooms. 
Outside glass elevator for a cool ride, especially at night.
name: Michelle

text: First, to be clear, this review is for the Creve Couer location.  The difference between the Creve Couer and Clayton location is like night and day!!  The girl on the line was surly and brusque, barely going through the motions of completing my order.  She fished through the gyro meat, bring up all the scraps and pieces. The vegetables and rice were overcooked, dry and limp. The pita was tough and difficult to chew. The fries were cold and greasy. I returned them and was told, "We'd have to make fresh ones" to which I said, "I'd appreciate that!"  I was the only customer in the restaurant and the 2 girls in front retreated to the back to party.  I loved the food at the Clayton location...fresh and tasty, and a hot pita hot from the oven.  Also, they do not offer the free falafel like Clayton does.  Thought that was a corporate policy...maybe, it was just to me! Will not return to this Garbanzo.
name: Mary

text:
The main location for this local confectioner. I entered mainly because of the unseemly chill that swept over the city, but was quite happy to gaze at their many chocolates, pastries, and ice creams before settling on what I think was their last package of dark chocolate caramel cookies. I think I picked right. Then again, I'm not sure if I could have picked wrong.

It isn't quite as impressive looking of a space as the French Quarter store they have, but it's a worthy indulgence in a city built on decadent pleasures.
name: John

text: I ordered the fried pickles appetizer and the Kilgore burger. The pickles were delicious and the burger was cooked perfectly. The burger came with a side of fries and prices were fair. I plan on going back to try more of the menu.
name: Jo

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Great Vietnamese fusion neighborhood bistro! My husband ordered the Lemongrass Tofu Vermicelli-mouthwateringly amazing, and I ordered the Mint Crepe-a luscious, crispy Vietnamese crepe filled with grilled pork and shrimp. We were so happy to have discovered this lovely gem in Uptown. Prices are great and the service is superbly friendly. You won't be disappointed!
name: Wendy

text: So good! Great service and such a lovely relaxed meal. We went with a large group of 11 and felt completely tended to, would highly recommend.
name: Kathy

text: We were staying in the hotel and dined in two times, once for breakfast and once for Sunday brunch. We had a great time both times. Staff was excellent and had no issues w my gluten allergy being accommodated. For the Sunday brunch the chef came out with a list of what contained gluten which was not much. Although their brunch is the most expensive I have been to in the area, they have a wide array of items to choose from as well as king crab which I have never seen at another restaurant. We will definitely be back!
name: Airamiss

text: Well well what can I say about a $10 thin...and I mean paper thin patty burger, not much. The burger was small, bland and expensive that's not a good combo. I asked for jalapeño just to give it some flavor. The positives was I had to wait 10-15 mins cuz it was made fresh. The burger was hot which is an upside. These people have to be making a killing.
name: Ara

text:
Great food and service! Our server was a young man (can't quite remember his name as it was a few weeks ago), and he was so attentive! Really appreciated him going the extra mile for us.

As for the food, we had the Pho bowl and fried rice. The Pho was excellent, and so flavorful. The pork fried rice was some of the best I've ever had! Definitely coming back to have that again.
name: Amy

text: Disappointing.  Monday night. A slow night but service was even slower.  Took forever to take my order, then my appetizer and meal appeared at the same time. Waiter checked in maybe once in the meal.  I used to eat here often when I lived in Indiana. Very much below my expectations.
name: Tom

text: Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. A couple small things kept adding up. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was good and came out fast. Food was fresh and service was quick. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Terrible service. Came in and ordered an iced coffee. Woman who took my order looked like a deer in headlights. It's been 30 minutes and counting and I'm still waiting for my iced coffee that I paid 6+ dollars for. The guy doing live music outside is great though. A+ to him.
name: Anon

text:
Angry servers, understaffed.  Went to pay my bill and stood and waited 10 minutes to pay while employees stared at me.  

Had Logan as a server last night with my kids and she literally snarled at us!  Angriest, rudest waitress Ive ever encountered..anywhere!  I just wanted to get out as soon as possible.  With Culver's across the street I'm thinking this is my last time dealing with the abhorrent service one receives at Brownsburg Steak and Shake.
name: Jason

text: Delicious tacos, and the jalapeño pineapple cilantro margarita is a must. They also have excellent happy hour prices for drinks and tacos. But we were shocked at how embarrassingly small the $11 ceviche was. It tasted delicious, but we all agreed that it would not be something any of us ordered again at this restaurant as many other places around town have equally delicious ceviche in much more reasonable portions for the price.
name: K

text: Came again last night, got the grade 6 spicy with traditional Cajun sauce- super delicious! And the spicy level was no joke
name: Monica

text:
Came here for lunch today, the service was excellent! First time having a chargrilled oysters,  sooo yummy!!! Our server, Jimmy, was very attentive! 
We had the fried chicken platter,  the chicken pieces were small but my friend enjoyed it.  I had the pasta dish that had the shrimp and crawfish, soooooo yummy. 
My only negative is that our paper menus were dirty, they really should been tossed in the trash. 

I would definitely recommend this place.
name: Fawn

text: Hattie B's on a cold night in Nashville. It's about 9 degrees outside and I am from San Francisco and boy it's cold, but nothing warms you up then Hot Nashville flavor goodness. Impressed with the food and cost, this place has already won it for me in the books.
name: Anthony

text: Don't order ANYTHING with chicken. It tasted rubbery and weird. It also took an hour and a half to deliver when it was supposed to be 45 minutes. Checked the food and they forgot the egg roll. The people were friendly but I would give it a pass.
name: Coleen

text: One of my favorite places! Since I got back to the mainland,  there were few places I could go for that Island Flavor, but now Aloha-to-go satisfies that craving. Everything is delicious and my favorite is the Chicken Katsu! You can't go wrong with the Kalbi Beef, either! Yummy, now, I just need to wrestle some away from my kids!
name: Mike

text: I came to this Panera at 11 o'clock. They are out of all bagels. Panera bread is out of the one thing they're supposed to stocked up on. Waste of time.
name: Hannah

text: Good coffee. Funky and laid-back ambiance. Best grits I have had in a long time - very flavorful. 50's oldies for music. Relax and enjoy.
name: Lester

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Maybe other people have better luck here. It looked better online than it did in person. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy.
name: User

text: Went by while at a convention in Nashville. My husband and I always try to go into the neighborhoods and visit local eateries. This was a cafeteria style restaurant. We got there around 4pm late lunch early dinner. The selection was a little limited by then. However a fresh meat loaf was coming out the kitchen. It was amazing, the food was tasty like home southern cooking. Met the owner who told us they sow back into the community was another plus. Please stop by and support local neighborhood restaurants.
name: Miranda

text: My girlfriend and I had our anniversary dinner at Redlands Grill, and it did not disappoint. Our server Ryan was super friendly and kept up with us throughout the meal to check in. The calamari starter was out of this world, it was spicy and had a great kick to it, the calamari was fresh and definitely not frozen. Next up we both had the rotisserie chicken, and I'm not kidding when I say that this is the best rotisserie chicken that we've both had. The smashed potatoes were amazing as well, and we got a side of Mac and cheese which was unique and delicious (although it was not my girlfriends favorite part of the meal). Overall we will definitely be coming back for the amazing food and service. It is a little pricey for the steaks but will definitely have to come back and try out their steak, if it's anything like the chicken it surely won't disappoint.
name: Noah

text:
Chicken Sliders.... If I could get away with just leaving those two words up I think I have done my job as a yelper. I thoroughly enjoyed coming to this innovative virtual golf simulator for my younger brothers birthday. We had a ball with all the different types of simulators that you can use. I enjoyed the friendliness of the staff and the king cake and champagne that was given to us for my younger brothers birthday was a nice touch. 

Those chicken sliders though were more than enough for the price of admission! My God, were they good! Keep up the good work and hope to bring some more people for a very fun and really delicious time!
name: Matthew

text: IF YOU KNOW ANYONE WITH A DISABILITY, DO NOT TAKE THEM HERE. Took my beautiful mom out to dinner tonight after sharing a glass of wine at my home. The manager at 1895 wouldn't serve her because they accused her of being intoxicated and humiliated her in front of everyone. She has Meige's caused by Blepharospams in her eyes and has a hard time keeping them open, any time of the day. Spreading the word every way I can.
name: Sarah

text: So good.  The BBQ Shrimp and Redfish were both amazing.  The Bloody Mary's were great too.  A definite favorite restaurant!
name: Karen

text:
Which area do you go if you want the best Salvadoran food? To the Pupus Area! Obviously.

This is a really friendly place with good pupusas and good tamales. Excellent Central American food from El Salvador and Honduras and Nicaragua. Definitely delicious and well worth a stop if you love this kind of food as I do and extremely cheap as well.

It's a lovely little central american place representing all the countries but especially El Salvador, in fact it's decorated like the Salvadoran flag and stuff. Very friendly, very cute, decor is second to none, and the wet chicken tamale is much better than Mexican equivalents. Try it and see.
name: Fox

text: We had a great breakfast here. The pancakes were very, very good. We would definitely eat here again and recommend it to our friends.
name: Grant

text: Good food, awesome smoothies and great customer service. Almost every time I go I get the tropical bliss smoothie. I recently tried the buffalo chicken ranch wrap and it was amazing.
name: Nae

text:
WATCH OUT FOR SATURDAY EVENING COVER 
My wife and I have been to the Sawmill quite often. We prefer to sit in the lounge for dinner as many others do. text:
I love this place. It's a rare treat, but they have great specials and fundraisers- plus they have some great vegetable options (sweet potato fries, brussel sprouts).  

The only complaint is on me- I feel sick drinking their shakes. The root beer floats or milkshakes with cookies, gummy worms, Snickers, etc- you feel like your kidneys are going to shut down. Too much sugar. I wish there were small sizes or just plain ice cream
name: J

text: If I could give this place zero stars I would but I need to give them at least 1 to write the review. Customer Service is everything to me. The Service here was HORRIBLE. Not the waitress but the manager. I sat down at 12:31 ordered my glass of wine at 12:34. The waitress brought the wine right over and I placed my order which was at 12:38 pm. At the time I sat down there weren't many people in. Over the next 20 min the place started filling up and I noticed other tables getting their food before me when I ordered before them. The waitress came over to me and said she didn't know why my food was taking so long and would check on it. I said please and thankyou because I will have to leave soon. Oh, and I ordered the impossible burger that came with a side salad. Simple order and yes I know it's made to order but still absolutely no excuse for as long as it was taking. The manager came by and said that the food was made to order and that my order was taken at 12:52. I told him it was 12:38. This I know because I am a part of a food group and I always notate the time and I take pics of everything when I'm out eating which has a time stamp on it. He actually argued w me about the time. I finally smiled and said ok because I clearly wasn't getting anywhere w him. My food finally came out. Now here's the kicker!! I'm actually eating and now and minding my own business when he comes back over with the receipt and says you placed your wine order at 12:34 and your food order at 12:52. I tell him again I did not as I had a meeting to get it and I ordered as soon as my wine was brought out which was 12:38. He actually started arguing with me. Listen MANAGER all you had to do was apologize and accept the fact that your waitress forgot to put my order in right away. No biggie but to keep harassing me was the craziest I have ever seen. I got up and left!  Yes I left!! All I had was a good 10 min to try and enjoy my food and he totally ruined it!I will never patronize this restaurant again. Once again your food can be good but if your service is trash and you have a pretentious Manager who thinks he's right and argues with his customers you will never get my business again. Do better!  I recommend The Treehouse restaurant, Pure Vegan cafe, lulu's local eatery. There are many options out there w much better Service. And take notice in the reviews that if you filter and find the one and two star reviews there is never a response from the restaurant. Absolutely unacceptable! They don't care...

text: Almost the best Mexican place in Bryn Mawr. The only reason is because I personally thought the Qdoba down the road was better because El Limon's cheese quesadia was cold when it came. For anyone going here, I recommend the Chips and Guac Starter.

text:
Location: 5/5 Picture perfect spot to enjoy your meal with loved ones while being accompanied by a beautiful view. The location is right on the beach and the layout inside and outside of the place is magnificent. You can come dressed up or super casual, very comfortable setting. 

Service: 4/5 the hostess was a little rude when I went up to put my name in, but they were attentive. Our server, Tomas, was nothing short of AMAZING! He spoke Spanish fluently and made my grandparents feel very comfortable and happy. He displayed a lot of patience and accommodation for our big party of 8. It was my cousins bday lunch so he treated us to some mocha flavored ice cream with raspberry and Oreo cookie crumbles. He came to check on us very often and was very friendly and helpful in choosing what to order! I appreciated his honestly and sincerity. 

Food: 4/5 Everyone at the table really enjoyed the sea food, but for those who ordered the burger said it was a little dry and not very flavorful, but still an okay burger. So I recommend you get seafood! We wanted brunch but they ended it at 1. 
Chowder fries are a MUST TRY! I'll attach a photo below. I also got the lobster mac and cheese, so cheesy and the lobster substance was great. My aunt ordered the seafood pasta and I've got to say.. WOW!! So tasteful, the sauce was perfect taste and texture and the fish didn't overpower it at all. And the garlic bread... yum! We had to ask for more!
I had the pineapple mimosa as well - delicious! :-)

Definitely will be coming back here again. Want to try the breakfast! So many options and they all look so good.
name: Nicole

text: Use to come here often and got cold beers, delicious pizza and good service. Super disappointed with my last two visits. Not sure if it's under new management or what going on but the service it bad. We were seated and ignored for 8 minutes. When we asked for our waitress she came over and appeared annoyed, no apology, no sorry for the wait. Just "are you ready to order?" Food was just ok. Just not sure what's going on here. text: Bowman's Tavern is one of our favorites. For dinner, there's valet parking although I don't think they have it at lunch. Our group of 9 was seated in the wine bottle chandelier room which is really lovely with banquet seating on wheels. Johnny took care of us. They have Coke products. The dinners were very good- five people had burgers which I personally think are the best burgers I've had, two had wings, one had the special lamb shank and one had the whipped ricotta as well as French onion soup. The desserts were also good- flan, brownie with caramel ice cream, and apple cobbler. I know we'll be back again and highly recommend Bowman's Tavern. I also recommend making reservations. There's also a piano player in the bar area.

text: There is simply nowhere better for miles around than Zinc Cafe. Lunch, dinner, Sunday brunch or takeout, you really can't go wrong. Super disappointed in the food but at least the service was fast, friendly and the place's only saving grace.

text:
I always like to come here and eat when I'm in town. I think the food is absolutely terrific.  I travel a lot and have tasted my share of Italian food.  St. Louis absolutely has some of the best.  I laugh when I read reviews about dishes being skimpy. Most people don't know that small portions and small plates is how fine dining  is served especially in Europe. The days of big bowls of pasta and having left overs are over. It's not healthy either!  

At trattoria toscana, I know the food is fresh, the service is great and the portions are more than enough.  I love going to an establishment and being waited on by someone who actually cares and wants to take care of you! Customer service where the wait staff clears your dirty dishes, isn't texting, or making plans for what they are doing after work! The prices are great. Travel to the east or west coast then you will see what pricey is all about! 

I continue to support this local business and suggest that you do as well! The over priced chain establishments are nothing compared to a local business that actually wants to please the customer! 

Every one has a bad day once in a while so don't base a review off of a one time experience then blog about the crappy establishment. If you have a complaint talk to the management rather than writing about how much of a bad time you had.  You try running a fine dining place.. 

There you have it my thoughts. Take it for what it's worth. Try this place you won't be disappointed!  

For those who say their food was put in a microwave...NEWS FLASH ..they don't have a microwave.
name: Allan

text: Absolutely loved their three egg omelette, and my husband demolished his California Ruben! Will definitely come back.

text:
Ming's kitchen is a pretty decent local American Chinese take out place. 
 The chicken with eggplant and garlic sauce has good flavor, but is very sweet.  A bunch of their sauces are sweeter than I would like, and I know that is a common issue at American Chinese places, but this place can be sweeter than most.  
Sometimes they have Chinese broccoli, which is awesome. I like it worth the pork and garlic sauce.  
Singapore noodles are pretty good. I could use a bit more spice and a little less salt in there.
The wonton soup was okay, but my partner does not like their egg drop soup.  I think she misses the egg drop soup of Chinese places past.
Steamed pork dumplings are tasty, but pretty standard, they don't really look made in house.
The egg roll is not the best I've had, wrong texture on the wrapper.  The fried rice also wan't my favorite either, a little bland.

text:
Good food weird experience! Let's start with a 'Priest', 'Pastor' or 'Man of the Cloth' about 55-65 years old tall, thin and agile with three friends who stood in the MIDDLE OF THE OPENING OF THE PARKING LOT FOR OVER 3 MINUTES BLOCKING MY ABILITY TO PARK!! This group never looked up didn't try to move slightly out of the way they chatted it up like they were in their personal driveway.  After 3 minutes and another car coming from the other direction trying to exit, I honked they only moved slightly without looking up. So I make the tight cut to park my disabled mother in the convenient spot they were blocking. Of course I was still given minimal room and when we got out no look of acknowledgement, nothing. AND THIS IS A RELIGIOUS FIGURE?  It was that air of??????? Then we go in and me 56, my mother 78 were greeted 'how can I help you girls' by the female host. When seated for our reservation 'thank you girls for making a reservation'.  Our server arrives who is 30-40 years old, 'Hello girls would you like something to drink?' WHAT IS WHAT THIS RUDE BEHAVIOR? I  HAVEN'T BEEN A GIRL SINCE THE 70'S MY MOTHER NOT SINCE THE 50'S, YOU GET MY POINT!! 

Except for the Lobster Bisque the food is good, sold at a reasonable price and the restaurant has a nice set up.  As for the Lobster Bisque generally a dollop of the seafood is added to garnish or top the bisque, not here there was nothing, nada just smooth hot creamy broth/soup.  My mother told me to let it go so I push it to the side and shared my French Onion which was good not great and we shared a crab cake sandwich with fries which was delicious.  The server came by saw this and said nothing then or at the end when she collected the same large and filled bowl she delivered. As for the décor it maintains a lot of the integrity of the original restaurant The Lamb. Inside there is a large bar and dining area with two large televisions showing the Philadelphia sport team of the 'hour', during this hour  the Sixers playing game six (6) of seven (7) in the Eastern Conference Semifinals.   We sat in the more formal dining area.  There is additional 'porch' or 'deck' seating when weather permits. 

Would I return? Probably not but, I would not discourage others.

text:
I came here for a weekend brunch with friends, and ordered the lemon poppy pancakes-- by far the best pancakes I have had, although I could have done with less cherry topping. We shared the biscuits as an appetizer with the cayenne butter, which were insanely delicious and fluffy. I tried my friend's cinnamon waffle with coffee butter, which was also excellent. The attention to detail in this place is magnificent-- when the other person in our party asked for ketchup, it came in the cutest little jar. I also had the vanilla latte, which was good, although too sweet for my taste. I will definitely be coming back for the food, and my two friends agreed.

As for the experience, we made a reservation and the restaurant didn't mind when we were a bit late. Our waitress was great and she came around to check on us the perfect amount. However, it was a bit loud, as well as a struggle to move freely because it was so crowded. I can't imagine bringing a wheelchair or a stroller through the dining area. The Love lived up to the hype in my opinion, and I would be happy to return. I can't wait to try the other Stephen Starr restaurants!

For drinks we ordered a regular and a vanilla latte. For food hubby ordered the two egg breakfast and I ordered a ham and cheese omelet. I had high hopes for  breakfast when I saw the latte art is featured in the picture that I included. The best part of breakfast were the potatoes. They were pretty good with flavor. The toast was not crisp at all and had very little butter. My omelet was so so and it was not fluffy at all. Not very flavorful at all either. We drove out there especially to try this place and were so disappointed. Hubby said if it was possible to give 1/2 a star to this place and I told him the lowest you could give was one star.
name: Arlene

text:
The Eggplant Napoleon is the only thing I tried here besides their rice and beans, which supposedly wins the rice and beans contests in New Orleans every year (so we were told).

I was on a food tour today and was told this was one of the most popular appetizers which never used to be on the menu.  Now some even order this dish as a meal.  

My old college party neighbor Guy Fieri (he had his normal hair back then!) picked this dish years ago when he made his first trip to New Orleans for the shooting of his show and I can see why. It's fried deliciousness.  This is a heavy dish however I could never eat just for a main dish, but a lot of people do.

Fried Eggplant is towered with fried shrimp and covered with a cream sauce gravy that is very good.  What else can I say, it's delicious and you have to try it.  Although unique it's very Louisiana looking and tasting.

The rice and beans were very good. I'm not a huge bean fan of any kind and never order beans, but if I did I would definitely order these again. Big red beans, sausage, sauce and rice were a plenty.  You could tasty the smokiness of the beans and these beans were not sweet, but savory.

The waiting area was packed and just last week Dan Akroid and John Goodman were outside enjoying a meal so it's really popular with the locals. Apparently John Goodman doesn't live too far away.

Definitely give the Eggplant Napolean a try. It's very unique.

4 stars
name: Jay

text: Decided to take wifey out to get Cajun food and some cocktails and we chose catahoula, which had been on our list to try for a while. We were able to sit outside, which was super nice. They have a great little patio to dine al fresco, or you can dine in at the bar. We each ordered a cocktail, I went with the staple Cajun drink Sazerac while wifey opted for a pear vodka cocktail. I'd say stick to wine or beer and you'll have a great meal. The cocktails were terrible! Again, get a beer or wine and you'll be good to go. We started with the fried green tomatoes and the BBQ shrimp, both very solid appetizers. The shrimp had this delicious sauce over very dense but suuuuper good cornbread. The tomatoes were perfectly crisp and delicious as well. I had the fried oyster appetizer as my meal, wifey went with her go to shrimp and grits. I can say the fried oysters we're seriously amazing!! They had a bacon jam, creamy greens and pickled onions that were incredibly good!!! The shrimp and grits were also very good, perfectly cooked creamy grits and fresh seafood! Service was another low point, which will keep me from returning unfortunately. Wifeys cocktail was REALLY bad, so we asked to switch for a beer or maybe have them sweeten it a bit. The bartender/server was rude about sending it back telling us "well I can't take it back k or take it off the bill. This drink was made exactly to spec, there's nothing wrong with it" He did offer to sweeten it but again, went back to "but this is exactly how it is supposed to be, it's not wrong" which was a major turnoff. He did apologize later saying the he would have taken it off but the owner is really strict about that stuff which I appreciate, but c'mon. Don't serve a crappy cocktail (that tasted NOTHING like pear) and then be snippy about us not liking it. All in all i'd say get a beer or wine and you'll have a great meal! I wish I had a better experience but hey, what can you do?
name: Brian

text: Golf course is ok, facility is nice. The biggest drawback here is the staff, rude and condescending.  I would recommend spending your money elsewhere.

text: Great bar. Friendly bartenders. Good drinks. Fun music. We've visited this place several times over the course of our visit. Would definitely recommend.

text: Every day I had in Nashville by the airport I had breakfast here . The staff is friendly, quick service and affordable breakfast.  This place is not closed, they are open. Thank you Terry for being a server and a friend.

text: Nearly 3 years later my husband and I came back for lunch we had the dolsot bibimbap and the kimchi soup they were great, customer service improved a bit since the last time we came. text:
Fun place! Great music! When I checked in with Yelp received a BOGO taco! Unfortunately we were too full from lunch! We sat at the bar and our bartender was amazing! She was super friendly! text: My wife and I have dined here on a few occasions and have always felt welcomed, had amazing meals and left wanting to come back again! text: Really, really good kfc. Korean BBQ sauce and spicy honey soy were excellent sauces for the wings. They are good sized wings too. I ate seven and was stuffed. We also tried the vegetable bowl. The veggies and japchae were fine, as was the dumpling, but the salsa was weird in the mix and should probably be swapped out with something from a more traditional selection of bibimbap-type toppings. I did appreciate that they emphasized the toppings and reduced the portion of the bowl that was rice. Also had their kimchi which was good and spicy. I loved that during my order pickup, the matron of the restaurant stopped me to ask whether I had had kimchi before, fresh or fermented, and assured me theirs was in between and good for probiotics. It was really sweet. Please give these folks plenty of business!

text: I, so very much, wish a Mexican restaurant would step outside the VERY standard Mexican fare!  The food here was pretty good, but it was your average Mexican food. I appreciate that, as I'd rather not have them, but if they're placed in front of me, they're goin' DOWN!

text:
In a totally cute few blocks of town, across from an old-style revamped movie theatre, comes way The Lucky Well.  The restaurant is a nicely decorated bar/restaurant, not really with a BBQ feel, but the smell was intoxicating.

Our hosts from this dinner were 7 terrific folks, taking out my team of 5.  We grabbed drinks at the bar before being seated in the next room better situated for dining, the Old Fashioned is recommended.

Us 12 ordered, what seemed like, everything on the menu -- and we had tons of leftovers for happy mutts at their homes.  We, of course, were staying in hotels at not convenient. 

The best:
========
1.  Smoked Grilled Wings [5.0 stars; $14 for a half / $27 for a full] -- amazing, perfectly cooked and full of smoky flavor.
2.  St. Louis Pork Ribs [4.5 stars; $16 for a half / $29 for a full] -- meaty, perfect.
3.  Lucky Balls [4.5 stars; $10] -- Panko-crusted Mac N Cheese with pieces of pork shoulder. 
4.  Cornbread [5.0 stars; $5] -- wonderful.

The good:
========
5.  A huge Pretzel served with Pickled Jalapeno Cream Cheese [4.0 stars; $12]
6.  Cole slaw  [4.0 stars; $4] 
7.  Mac-n-cheese [4.0 stars; $6]
8.  Dry rub Fries [4.0 stars; $4] -- haven't met fries that I didn't like.
  
The okay, and wouldn't order again:
============================
9.  Marinated Grilled Chicken Skewers [3.5 stars; $12] with a Chipotle Glaze and served with an Herb Salad w/Miso Vinaigrette
10.  Pork Belly & Shrimp [3.5 stars; $15] -- a strange combination, but I loved the candied bacon that was swimming with it.
11.  Brussels Sprouts [3.5 stars; $8] -- nothing special.   
12.  BBQ Beans [3.5 stars; $5] -- nothing special.
13.  Mexican Cauliflower with Cotija, Chili, and Lime [3.5 stars; $12]

The bad and ugly:
==============
14.  Local Beef Brisket [1.0 stars; $17 for a half / $32 for a full] -- awful, awful, and more awful.  Super fatty, large/wide cuts, really inedible and unappetizing.  It's comforting to know that other Yelpers have written about this and didn't like it, but disheartening that the chef hasn't listened.

15.  Smoked Sausage [2.0 stars; $10 for a half / $19 for a full] -- I always love smoked sausage, but not here.  Oddly spiced, not that smoky, and I didn't desire to have more than a few bites of it...which is very odd for me!

Overall rating:
============
A few things were outstanding and couldn't be much better, but a few items were awful, which bring down the overall rating.  Service was nice but really minimal and didn't feel experienced.
name: Randy

text: Love this place! Their Chile relleno is amazing, burritos are amazing. I love the atmosphere, cute porch outside, great margaritas. I wasn't wild about the fajitas but everything else I've tried has been awesome. I highly recommend this cute little spot near old southeast! The Banchan (side dishes that always come with a Korean meal) were great both times. Kimchi, and assorted pickled veggies.

If we were local this would be our go to!

text: The food and service were fantastic. The grouper was the best I think I've ever tasted! The sausage appetizer was very tasty and was a great shareable for the 3 of us eating. Our waiter Mike was very helpful with suggestions and he was spot on with his recommendations.  The guys had steaks and they were seasoned and cooked to perfection.  I will say the prices are a bit high but it was worth it for the good food and good service. We will be back!

text: I'm not usually one to give a bad review, but I ordered sushi from here and got severe food poisoning from a rainbow roll. Would not recommend based on that.

text: Always so fast and so pleasant.  The staff have a timer going, and always work to beat it.  I wouldn't be able to work under that pressure every minute if my shift.  Way to go!
name: Arlene

text: I rarely ever leave bad reviews but this experience was full of disappointments. When we arrived we were told the wait would be an hour, although it was an "off" time in the afternoon. We decided to wait since our son had his heart set on eating there and we walked around the mall to kill time. We were texted about 45 minutes later that our table was ready. When we got back to the host's station, we had to wait in line again to check in. It didn't seem like there was adequate staff around to take reservations. We were shown to our table and our kids loved the aquarium. It was interesting to see that the restaurant was largely empty, which made us wonder if there was really a wait at all or if that's just what they tell everyone to boost mall business. We ordered drinks, and my husband's water came in a glass that had a huge crack running through it. My soda was flat and our server politely brought a new one from a different machine. We had the fish dip to start, which was over salted. Unfortunately we didn't have plates to eat it on since they were never brought out, so we ended up with crumbs everywhere. I had the Cajun seafood pasta entree, which was bland and lacked flavor. There were only a few shrimp (maybe 4?) and they were cooked to the point of being rubbery. The noodles were overdone and mushy. I'm not a food snob and didn't  expect much from the meal since it's appeal was clearly in the atmosphere, but it was tough to pay so much for such mediocre food. Our boys had a great time and their kids menu was better than most places. They especially loved watching the diver feed the fish! I can't imagine going there because of the food, but if you're willing to spend more simply for the experience, then this is a unique place to check out. Otherwise go to a real aquarium and get more meal for your buck elsewhere.
name: Megan

text:
I waited a few days until I wrote this review.  I really wanted to like this place as I am a big fan of hot chicken. I took my dad here for his birthday. I thought it was going to be our new favorite place. Unfortunately I won't be back or recommend as the food was below average. The two main complaints I have are the spice has too much cumin and the chicken was burnt. The reason why I love hot chicken is because the chicken is so tender. I got the chicken breast with a spice level medium. Typically I would get hot but because I was unsure how hot that would be I played it safe. It was plenty spicy for me. 

We also had some sides that were just ok. You see in the pictures. They do not make there own brewed tea which is a sin in the south.
name: Brittani

text: The game section is the only reason this space is getting ANY stars. Games were fun and great deal on sundays. Food and service was horrific
name: Theresa

text: For years and years Rumhouse has been my favorite go to. Each time I go the food is great, the drinks are awesome, and the service is excellent. I finally got around to dropping a review. I love to get the Taco Trifecta. You get 3 tacos and one side. My favorite tacos are the Calypso Beef and the Duck Duck Goose. I usually get fries as a side with guacamole. Their fries dethrone the golden arches and I think they have the best guacamole in the city. That combo together, trust me it's amazing. I have yet to work through all of their tacos but I'll make that my mission on Taco Tuesday where they have them half off. It's been that way for years. They also have awesome margaitas and mojitos. Go from 3-6 for their happy hour. Now on to the rum! Captain Dave's Rum de Dum is worth the money! If you're not that thirsty the Funky Monkey is delicious. I also like the Key Lime Pie drink. They have a very unique decor and the place always has a very relaxing vibe. I can't wait to go back.
name: Anthony

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was crowded but still moved along. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Glad we tried it. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..

text:
The poori was incredibly soft and warm. 5/5. Highly recommend dipping it in the samosa chaat.

The samosa chaat has a good ratio of vegetables to samosa. I really liked the yogurt texture that added a creamy flavor to it. 4.5/5
name: Suzanne

text: Awesome selection of craft beer and chef specials on the menu! This is my new favorite lunch spot!
name: Warner

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not sure though.
name: User

text: Always fantastic Nashville hot chicken (fork and knife version). Great live music and a regular visit when we have guests in from out of town. A bit tucked away but easily accessible and close to most things worth seeing!
name: Tom

text: We came to this cafe for breakfast, it is pretty small and very simple. The interior is kind of retro, which gives the place some character. You have to order at the counter but they bring the food to you. The food was delicious, I definitely recommend their Little Spoon omelette and Lemon Ricotta pancakes, which were some of the best pancakes I have ever had. The only issue I had was some of the silverware was a little dirty so we had to change it.
name: Allie

text: It was late. All I wanted was some chips and salsa. At first the people at the desk looked at us askew. (Afterwards I found out it is because it is complimentary.) But they still let us sit down, which I thought was very nice. The chips were so crispy and the salsa had a bite. I then got greedy and ordered chili relleno, which is very different than waht i Ama use to and envisioned. I did not enjoy it. It came with refried beans, which were just okay and spanish rice, which I have always disliked. I would return for the chips and the friendliness of the staff.
name: Diane

text: Came in at midnight. Took 30 minutes to get through drive thru line. 30 minutes. C'mon.
name: Chris

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Amazing little spot we found on an adventure to Santa Barbara.  Vegan and Vegan-gluten free options. They even make their own almond milk, for some pretty fantastic smoothies. We will definitely stop back in the next time in that neck of the woods!
name: Mike03m

text: Just trying to spread the word about how beautiful couvant and the Eliza Jane is. We were here last weekend and at 4 in the afternoon were the only people there. The space is so exquisite, they did an excellent job creating it, I think people don't know about it yet, but it will quickly become a go to spot. The double bars and tables are so elegant you could easily celebrate a special occasion here. Even the paper coasters with their metallic rose gold print are gorgeous. Not to mention they have happy hour 3-6 everyday, including weekends!! That means 2 for 1 cocktails/wine and food specials too. The cocktails offered a good selection of new ideas and variations on classics, and they were delicious. I would highly recommend coming here for a classy cocktail hour with friends or on a date.
name: Lauren

text: This was my first visit so I didn't know what to expect. Staff was fantastic. Special ordered the fries (extra crispy) and they were great. Whole Grain bun was toasted and also very good. I was disappointed though when it came to the Lamb Burger.  The bun was 5 1/2" - 6". The meat was maybe 5", small on the very nice looking and tasting bun. It looked like a kids patty on an adult bun. AND, this was with the more expensive Lamb. The taste was nice, but I guess the overall presentation was my disappointment, not worth the extra $$$ for the Lamb.
name: Robert

text: Loove the crab and shrimp. Seasoning is on point!!! But not much of a fan of the sausage, it gave me a weird after taste like it was boiled in water or something. Corn is sorta sweet i personally like plain corn on the cob with the seasoning i ask for and a bit salty. Workers were polite, the boss is very social, nice, and handles situations well (he needed my table for a party and gave me free crab legs in return) Thanks boss!! Will most definitely come back!
name: Courtnie

text:
The food was pretty good especially the fried livers in pepper jelly and the wood-fired oysters. I had the oyster and bacon sandwich - even the bacon was burnt and oysters overdone.

Unfortunately, this place is like a frat house party.  Many tables of 20 or more out of control young people screaming - bachelor and bachelorette parties and birthday parties too.  I guess it's that kind of place and that how the make their money.  But deafening and extremely disturbing to other diners.  I'm hoarse today from trying to converse with table.  I would not go back.
name: john

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was good and came out fast. Food was fresh and service was quick. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing.

text: By far my favorite thai takeout in the city. their curry has the perfect amount of heat; their pad thai is flavorful and has generous amounts of protein; and their vegetable rolls taste fresh and made-to-order, not like many other places that taste like frozen product. only advice is to only order the really high spice level if you have a true tolerance for heat. i overestimated my tolerance on an item and paid for it.
name: James

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Food was fresh and service was quick. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service timing was efficient even tho it was busy. A very pleasant experience. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text:
Shopping in Hatboro with my mom and we were looking for something to eat around 2 pm. Bernie's was right across the street and from the outside looked out of place in a quaint Main Street type town. The restaurant was gorgeous. Beautiful entry way, nice sized bar and the tables to eat at were nicer than any kitchen I've ever been in. Aesthetically it's 5 stars.
Upon walking in to a small crowd of patrons, I asked the hostess if they were serving lunch. "It's brunch" she snapped as she threw the menu at me. If my mom wasn't there I would've told her she was a bitch and walked out. Fortunately our server was sweet. The food was lackluster but again the ambiance was nice. I'm posting pics of the yogurt parfait we shared and the 3 egg omelet I ordered.
name: Maddy Katrina

text:
Saddened to see it's closed, this was my favorite place. Can someone recommend a similar restaurant with awesome eggfoo young? I'm going to miss them greatly. 
They also had the best salad dressing.
name: K

text:
I've lived in Broad Ripple for awhile but haven't had the chance to try 317 Burger yet. 

I finally went with my boyfriend the other night and it was delicious! I'm not a huge meat eater so I tried the tuna and salmon burger. It was great! It wasn't dry at all which is what I was worried about.  My boyfriend had their traditional burger and he said it was super juicy and tasty. The fries are also delicious! 

I love the location of this place. It's still in Broad Ripple but it's not on the main drag which makes it feel a little more private. I sat outside but the inside had a super cute bar area. I will definitely be coming back!
name: Audrey

text:
Amma's is a nice place for lunch and a place to catch up at. The food has rich flavors and tons of spices. I was here with my coworkers and all of them enjoyed the food and atmosphere of the restaurant. I ordered the non vegetarian lunch special with has a variety of dishes from rice, spiced veggies, etc.

The meal is fairly reasonable. I would say the portions were a bit small for my appetite but it would enough for a normal appetite.
name: David

text: I ordered this saucy noodle dish. With tip and all it cost me nearly $30. So over priced. It was greasy and salty and just overall didn't enjoy it. I wouldn't come back here. I've only tried this place this one time so maybe other dishes are better but I bet the price is still unreasonably high for a cheap noodle dish.
name: Waymee

text: Best!!!!!!!! steak tacos I've ever had. Plus stays open till 4am which was a major benefit...
name: Monie

text:
I had the backyard burger with brisket and it was incredible.  Everyone in our party of 8 raved about their food.  I am giving Hendricks only three stars for two reasons.  

First, the gentleman at the hostess stand on Saturday evening at ~7:30 on 3/2/19 was a total dick.  My wife called ahead to make reservations and he told her that Hendricks doesn't take call ahead reservations when we git there.  He eventually found the reservation and told her that the wait was 60 minutes from the we called in and not the 45 we were told on the phone.  He was rude, dismissive, and didn't make eye contact.

Second, they have fried chicken and grilled chicken on the menu but not pulled/smoked chicken.  This establishment is at a level where I would expect smoked chicken on the menu with other smoked meats.  They offer smoked brisket, pork, turkey but not chicken.
name: David

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..

Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Price felt a touch high for what it was. You can tell they care about customer experience here. A very pleasant experience. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..

text: Food is good .Customer service sucks.The lady with the dreads is very unfriendly i watched her roll her eyes at i guess it was the manager.She only greeted African american ppl.We all know reverse racism doesn't exist tho.Service has always sucked here no thx i will take my business elsewhere
