text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Not bad for a quick meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: I have been going to Pancho's since I was 4, it's delicious every time! I love the way they treat the consumers and the food is just incredible! If you go you  won't be disappointed!
name: Destiny

text:
Awesome place.

GREAT food (By faaaar the best hot dogs you can get in town), cool atmosphere, and open late! What else could you want?
name: Pat

text: Always a great place with great donuts. Not crazily priced and they do a pretty good job of getting orders correct. If they don't, not a word is said. They fix it and usually give you the mistake, unless you don't want it. But their mistakes are so good, I gladly eat them too. Delicious donuts, and very fresh. They also pump them out with and there's not a terribly long wait, even when it's busy. Highly recommend and one of my kids favorite donut spots, if not their favorite. Just keep in mind, it's a plain cake donut. So if you're looking for anything different, you I'll not be happy, so don't bother going.
name: JC

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I had a better visit than I expected to. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: SO GOOD! Happy hour is the best and food is delicious. The ricotta cheese board is to die for. The restaurant is clean and friendly staff. One of our favorite local places to frequent.
name: Lauren

text: Went here for Happy Hour but the only catch is that you can only get the deals while sitting at the bar. The drink specials were pretty good with wine half prices and most of their drafts close to half off as well. The decor of the bar area is great and the food was run of the mill bar type food. Now that's not to say it's not great food. The pretzel bites, and fried pickles were my personal favorites but their wings were also very good. My girlfriend loved the Mac & cheese and by the time I could eat the cheesesteak egg rolls I was already full sadly. Great place to go if you are in the area.
name: Kyle

text: This place is on the list of pending unofficial official sponsors of Yankees fireside chat. The cafe con leche and Cuban bread are some of the best. This little tucked away gem is rumored to have dinned Yasiel Puig when he is in town and former Yankee Orlando Hernandez has been spotted here as well chomping on some pork. Great place with great service. 10/10 would recommend.
name: Yankees

text: My friend and I went for brunch this past weekend, which Fond just started offering. I had the duck confit, leeks, and gruyere omelet with toast, greens, and hash browns. It was PERFECT. I love my hash browns a little burnt and crispy and these definitely were. Ask for butter and preserves for the toast, it's a game changer. My friend got the bacon, egg, and cheese croissant (also with greens and hash browns) and it was HUGE and delicious. The prices were reasonable, we got out for less than $30. I HIGHLY recommend it, I can't wait to go back.
name: Beverly

text: When you are lucky to have friends who enjoy trying new places you get to experience the best of Reno with those friends which is exactly what we did with Smees. I love good seafood and I especially love when there's a twist. We both ordered the catfish fish and chips. The catfish was excellent. Not in the least bit greasy. The chips...fries...were not covered in salt or grease and were so good my friend suggested they may be freshly made. What added to the experience was the music. The only reason I'm not giving the 5th star is the service. We were there for lunch, it was not crowded at all but we had to ask our server for a few things more than once. My friend and I are already planning to go for dinner. Thanks Smees for a great meal.
name: Joanne

text:
If you ever visit this restaurant I recommend getting their Kaw Soi. It's my favorite! It is from northern area of Thailand and this is why you don't usually find it in every Thai restaurants. It has rice noodle in curry soup topped with fried noodles and chicken and onions. It's very delightful and savory! This is a small restaurant and I've never been here when it's super busy, they usually only have 2 servers for dinner so sometimes they do get more than 4-5 tables for each server and that's when the service goes down 
5/5 for Kao Soi(cow-soy) food
3/5 for atmosphere 
2/5 for service
name: Patricia Abigail

text: I'm an animal lover, and after entering Nugget Bar & Grill, I almost turned around. There are tons of taxidermy animals on the walls and elsewhere. After seeing this, we requested to sit outside, where there were less disturbing decor. I ordered the chicken teriyaki which was extremely good, and I recommend it to anyone who goes. After a problem with one of our orders, the waiter was very helpful and resolved it quickly. We would go back there, but definitely sit outside if you want to have enjoyable meal.
name: Sam

text: Ummm way too much lemon pepper gave me a headache customer service was nice and fast but hate the flavor
name: Jonique

text: If you are in Indianapolis and want authentic Thai food, this is the place to come to. We LOVE Thai spice!!
name: Lizzy

text: The only complaint I have against goose is that it's not located closer to home.  When I head toward downtown from the far north side Goose is on the agenda.  I love the Batali sandwich and their sausages make for a terrific snack to bring back home. The service is top notch and the parking lot across the street eliminates the usual city parking hassle.
name: Scot

text:
I've been to different bubba gumps in Mexico and the states and have always loved the chain. Today I tried out the new location in Edmonton and was very happy with the food. 

The wait was just over an hour but because it's at a mall, they'll take your phone number and text you when your table is ready so you can walk around. 

We ordered the jambalaya and the run forest run appi for 2 people. The amount of food was perfect for 2 - shared everything. I haven't had very many jambalayas before, but both myself and my boyfriend LOVED it. The hush puppies and chicken in appi sampler were amazing too. 

The service was great and the wait for food was what I'd expect from a new kitchen team. 

I'm really excited to go eat here again. Also super stoked that they have slush puppy on tap - blue raspberry and cherry flavour are both so good.
name: Julia

text:
I hate leaving bad scores But I have to be honest. The pizza was not my cup of tea. The strange folding over to form a crust I'm assuming is because the dough is not fermented what so ever and there is no Co2 to give rise or flavor. 
The service and ambiance was great so that's where the 2 stars come from. The pizza unfortunately tanked horribly and we had to toss it out and find a different option.
name: Anthony

text: One of the best places to eat Cajun food at in The Tampa Bay Area. Love the poboys beignets and especially the gumbo. If you haven't been you should change that it's worth the drive. 4 stars bc not open on Sunday and I wish the lunch special was an all day special. Love the owners and the vibe will be back soon
name: Mike

text:
While the food is top notch, you only get to enjoy what you ordered 25% of the time. Every time anyone from our household visits there is something wrong or missing from the order or they are out of an item. For example, our order tonight was a surf & turf box with mild tenders and Mac & cheese and then a 10 count mild tenders. They were out of Mac & cheese so I ordered red beans and rice. When we got home, all of the tenders were spicy and instead of the red beans and rice it was mashed potatoes. 
Last week my roommate ordered 20 mild tenders (we like the tenders a lot) and received 12.

I want to love this place but the inconsistencies are awful.
name: Marcia

text: Great food and patio. Good service. Great drinks. My only suggestions would be to put a hook on the bathroom door for our purses and purchase more than one ketchup to be shared with the entire patio.
name: Melyni

text: We come here most Sunday's for football season. Last year we had the greatest wait staff and had a wonderful experience.  This was our second football weekend and boy has the service gone downhill.  We literally thought our waitress disappeared!  We were left with no drinks, she never came back to see how our food was; seriously 30-45 minutes between trips for her to check on us?  Ridiculous!  We are really considering taking our band of NFL'rs and going to a different pub.
name: Veronica

text: Dinner for 8 of us. Service is right on the mark. I wish the lighting was a bit brighter. I had the crab cakes. They were among the very best crab cakes I have had and I am very fussy about crab cakes. They're made with big chunks of crab meat and very little filling. Everyone in our party seemed very pleased with their dinner. Keeper!
name: Alex

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was fresh and service was quick. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Stopped in for a drink and a snack, husband ordered Spicy Tuna Roll and I had the Queso Dip.  Both were a bit of a twist from what you would typically expect but SO good!  We sat at the bar and service was a bit slow considering it was really quiet in there.  Huge drink and food selection.  Bathrooms were clean!  Would definitely stop back in.
name: Erica

text: Cute and cozy little place that is great for an affordable breakfast with a friendly staff. I would give them a 3.5 stars but I will round up secondary to their great service and French ascents. Parking isn't provided but there should be plenty of street parking.
name: Danny

text: So happy to have a local cafe with traditional coffee beverages, as well as some fun new ones, in the neighborhood!! Also...edible cookie dough?! Yes please!
name: Paige

text: Great gluten free and dairy free options. Friendly servers! Love the local vibe and appreciate the good quality food. Been there twice and was pleased both times! Tonight, had kale chips as an appetizer and for my dinner the DF-GF calamari and the roasted beets. Everything was delicious. Only thing I wish the food didn't come out so fast so that we could enjoy the kale chips as more of an appetizer before our meals, but no biggie!
name: Katie

text: Tasteless food.  As vegetarians we also had trouble with the meat display right next to the vegetarian options and the smell was nauseous.  We have tried this restaurant a few times now and will not be returning.
name: L

text: Delicious Philly Cheesesteak! Not the most pleasant employees but we sat upstairs which was nice being out of everyone's way
name: Danielle

text: Wanted to stop in to buy a baguette for a meal I'm making today. Waited in line for 15 min on a busy Sunday. While waiting, an older woman w/ short white hair and glasses ran out from the back into the main seating area and yelled at all the students for taking up table space with their laptops. She came back to the register and was curt with a customer who asked if a bread they had tasted sour and she responded, "well it's not a SOURDOUGH so it wouldn't be SOUR then would it?" Then when it was my turn (with a million people waiting behind me) said "I'll be with you soon" and proceeded to count the tips in the tip jar. Then I ordered my baguette and it was $3.75. All I had was a credit card. I noticed the "we APPRECIATE a $10 min on credit cards" sign which did not say it was required. She wouldn't sell me the baguette so I walked out.  Never going back.
name: Kay

text: I ate here with my girlfriend at the ramen bar, food was fantastic. The downside was our server brook charged our card a different total than I wrote on the receipt. I called the restaurant and they have adjusted the total, but overall not a good experience.
name: Alex

text: I am new to Tucson and this the first place my friends brought me for a meal.  It is definitely a local place and I was a little worried at first, but man, Casa Molina knows how to make delicious food at a great price!  Their refried beans are awesome, and the Carne Seca is to die for.  Yum.
name: Penny

text: Our breakfast spot twice this trip! Eggs benedict and savory crepes with spinach and Gruere cheese were fantastic.
name: Y.

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Idk, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Idk, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: The shrimp was cooked good and the Margarita was tasty but taco shells with Ground Beef that are the same quality as Taco Bell  is not Mexican Food. I'll pay $1 for that but nothing more. Waiting to order was getting slow until we let our server know we were ready. If I'm in town again I'll have to pass. Next.
name: Cyn

text:
We decided to try Roast + Chop last night and we loved it! I dont think I will go anywhere else from now on. We both customized our own hot bowls and chose the beef which is grass fed..the only beef we eat. The selection of vegetables was amazing..love the root veg combination. Its all great. Finally a restaurant that is quick, doesnt blow your wallet and very healthy. Cant find that anywhere else.
Also have to say that the staff was so helpful and so nice. Really made us feel like we were glad to be there. 
Thank you for such a great addition to eating on the Main Line.
name: Nina

text: fast and  friendly plus super delicious!!! I'm not a huge fish fan but The fries are perfectly seasoned giving you just a little kick and chicken tenders are addicting.  I adore a good honey mustard and theirs is perfection. So glad they stopped by our office building to share their delights!!
name: Pug

text: I almost didn't even go in because the smell coming from the trash bin was horrible. Who is the genius who decided to locate that by the front door? Won't be going back.
name: Judy

text: Came here after a show and the environment was great and our waiter Vincenzo was awesome and fun! We got so many apps ( long hots, spinach Waldorf salad, bruschetta, and eggplant rollotini,)all of them were pretty good we finished it all lol. The complimentary read could have better. For entrees, I got the salmon topped with crab special it was good but not out of this world salmon was bland but the crab saved the dish. I got a side of asparagus with balsamic and that was delicious! My mom and aunt  split the filet trio special and they loved it. Cousin got a Caesar salad and she was not a fan.  For dessert I got the chocolate mousse cake and it was amazing and my aunt got creme brûlée and was tasty!
name: Erin

text: Go to place.  Never had a bad meal here. The pizza is good, the pasta is great.  You have to have the gnocchi!  And you can BYOB. Friendly waitstaff and warm and welcoming eatery for singles, groups or families.
name: Katharine

text: Learn how to order to fill u up . Did door dash delivery . Door dash did awesome . Smoky bones itself is very skimpy on their sides . I paid 4.59 for Mac and cheese side . I only got 4 bites out of it !!! Ribs were good tho !!
name: Paula

text: Honey's Sit N Eat is the perfect breakfast spot in my opinion. Honey's sources almost if not all of its ingredients from local venders which I love! Empowering local businesses is a must. They have a plethora of options but I kept it simple today and ordered veggie sausage and egg whites it was delicious & fresh. Try Honey's any day of week you can never go wrong.
name: Vaughn

text: amazing food! worth the wait. I went there for a birthday and it was great service and even better food. The cheese burger is a must have and the strawberry shake is the best shake i've ever had.
name: Alex

text:
We waited in line an hour but man was it worth it. Just stock up on cocktails while you wait to be seated. The fried chicken was definitely the winner for us but the jambalaya was good to.  Duck quesadillas as an appetizer yum. 

The atmosphere is fun - no kids which is a plus. Kind of a dive bar/ restaurant type. We recommend and will def be back!!
name: Vero

text:
Why won't you let me buy things from you? Like soup and beer? But I digress...

We came here for lunch on the day before Thanksgiving and sat on the patio. Our server was oddly absent throughout the meal, usually showing up after we asked someone else to help us with something we were waiting on. I think part of the problem was that it is an automatic gratuity for tables of six or more and we were six plus a toddler. 

After about twenty minutes (and going to the server stand where servers were hanging out talking and asking them to please find our server) we were able to order. After he put in our order, I asked if I could snag a cup of soup. He immediately brought me a spoon.... and then we waited. The burgers arrived, at which point I didn't need the soup anymore. Then a bowl (not cup) of the soup arrived, which I declined. Again. 

The food itself was pretty good. The bacon had been cooked in advance and lost its flavor and texture. The salmon for the salmon was ordered at medium rare and came out closer to medium well and with almost no seasoning. We waited and eventually had to flag someone else down for some salt and pepper.

A couple of us wanted another beer partway through the meal, but the server had gone absent again so we asked the busser.... who rolled his eyes before getting the beer for us.

In the end, if the service was improved and the burgers a little less assembly-lined, this place would live up then quality and reputation it once had.
name: Jared

text: Not bad for a quick meal. So yeah, pretty smooth experience from start to finish. So yeah, the ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but i still finished most of it. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Anyway, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. Anyway, food was fresh and service was quick. so yeah kind of mixed on it. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Great place for brunch in the quarter. The food is good, atmosphere is lovely, and the waitstaff is friendly and helpful. Expect to have a bit of a wait, about 20 to 30 minutes, but it more than worth it.
name: Chonna

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Just not for me. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: The popularity of this place is clear so if you are in a time crunch be sure to build in the wait ---and get here early in the am!!! I think of the two times we came we averaged a 40 minute wait.  Parking is easy across the street or in the garage next door which is a plus.  The service was fine--friendly and fairly speedy with such a crowd.  The food was good, seemed fresh, but nothing that I would rave about honestly.  Prices are reasonable but not inexpensive.  They will text you to let you know your table is almost ready, so you can stroll done the street to window shop or photo op (What Lifts You) while you wait --not crowded in the am for pix.
name: Jan

text:
The hotel is super clean and the housekeeping does an a amazing job. We upgraded our stay for 7 nights and we were on the 21st floor. The noise from construction was so loud at 7am. We were by a loud party who would go in and out of the rooms to other rooms across the hall and the doors slam
When they shut. Let's just say the walls are super thin. We asked to switch rooms and the lady was very rude and said they had no available rooms and said basically if something became available she would let us know. This was on a Wednesday our stay was until the following Tuesday. We never got switched out. For the price we paid it was a real bummer. Also bring your own beer the hotel charges $33.00 for a 6 pack of Coors light! The prices at the 24 shop are so high!
name: Stacey

text:
I was at Vida on a recent week night with a party of 6. On this night it was seat yourself. There are a couple of really big booths that are very comfortable. I imagine that those booths would be coveted seating on the weekends when it's more of a dance club. 
We had a variety of dishes including pupusa, chicken wings, masa decerdo, carne Pobre and chicken fajitas. The food was very good. It was filling, savoury, and abundant. 
We were not in a hurry and it is probably best to not to be in a hurry if you go here. For me, I think that's part of the overall experience. We played pool, watched sports and listened to the good Latin music while we waited for our food.
Service is friendly. The prices are reasonable and there is a parking lot to the south as well as street parking. I gather that on the weekends there's dancing and a DJ and karaoke on sundays.
name: Cyn

text: Standard fare for a place like this. Unsatisfying and pretty terrible. Food was barely edible. I got the fit fare breakfast of banana pecan pancakes, two egg whites, and two strips of turkey bacon. The turkey bacon was slightly burnt but pretty good. The compartment holding the egg whites was full of water, but once I drained it of the water, the egg whites were also pretty good (considering the standard at this establishment). The pancakes were absolutely disgusting and burned throughout. They kind of just tasted like what I imagine a dirty rag to taste like after wiping down the kitchen counter. Syrup was also really watery and tasteless, but that's to be expected when you're eating at a big chain restaurant/diner, where they'll throw away quality to save every penny possible. Pretty much threw out a large portion of the meal because the pancakes were so, absolutely horrible.
name: Anna

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The music was louder than it needed to be. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Never would I ever go here sober. I made the mistake of using the restroom and then going back to the table for my meal. Had to pass through the work areas to get there and it was all suspected. Everything in the place was sticky. It is perfect for hitting up after a night on bourbon but I am sure that people aren't gonna read this review and remember where that greasy spoon place was. Just pass it on your way out and stop in "if there is room" and you are needing to sober up some.
name: Linette

text: I have not been here for years, I am glad to see the staff and service are still top notch! Food and drinks were great, atmosphere was relax, and overall experience was great. Looking forward to coming back. I wish they had a good lounge social event like they used too it was a great place to meet young professionals before and network.
name: Tony

text:
WOW!!!! Worth every penny. I celebrated my birthday here and I think it was one of the best birthdays ever. So, when you arrive you start in the gift shop. They gather you up and bring you to the third floor of the historical building. There was a round table with bottles of red and white wine and you have a seat. There are maybe 11 chairs, so 5 couples at the table. Then the chef/historian/teacher joins us. His name is Matt and he gives us about 300 years of history in 30 minutes. After that, we all go around the table and introduce each other. We were the only locals, but I did not care. I was excited to learn how to make pralines that actually got hard.

So, we went to our stations, there were 4 or 5? and still you get the unlimited wine while cooking. The good thing is everything is prepped so there is no chopping (and no chopping off fingers because of the unlimited wine) haha! We started with the pralines and the chef explained what I needed to do, which was not to stir! I followed his instruction and they came out perfect!

Next court was the gumbo, then red fish and corn mach choux. So, much going on, plus the wine, plus the jokes of the other couples and the chef. I was such a great time. After everything was cooked, we sat at the same circle table and dinned together and some more wine. It was all delicious and I really did learn something. 

This place is highly recommended for tourists and locals alike. I would do it again in a heartbeat.
name: Jamie

text:
My fiancè and I decided to try Rick's Cafe Boatyard after a suggestion from one of my coworkers. Previously, we had never heard of it. It has an absolutely stunning view of Eagle Creek and the breeze coming from the water is wonderful. As soon as we walked in, I said that it reminded me of a restaurant you go to while on vacation. 

We ordered drinks from the extensive menu of fun beachy drinks- I got the Tequila Tiki and he got the Tropic Thunder, both were excellent. For entrees, we both got the Alaskan King Crab Legs. I cannot say enough about the crab legs- they tasted fresh and were beautifully plated. We shared their cremè brûlée- which was espresso flavored and topped with fresh raspberries. 

Our service was average- quick but not as friendly as most places. 

We would DEFINITELY come here again!
name: Catherine

text: Great Mediterranean restaurant located in the Central West End. It's a bit different than the typical Middle Eastern food you get at most restaurants, but it's still quite good.  I got a chicken dish with a vegetable similar to spinach in it.  It was amazing, along with the cucumber salad and the baba ghanoush I ordered as an appetizer. Would definitely recommend checking this place out, as it offers a unique style of Mediterranean food not found at most places.
name: Nathan

text: We got the pad Thai and the curry and it was very good. Our server was very kind and gave us free drinks to try!
name: K

text: Great surface! All vegetarian entrees with sides of meat. The collard greens and grits were super spicy but great. Great service!
name: Ricky

text: Good burger and good prices. It's just like the name, old school. Why go to a McDonalds when you can get a much better burger at a joint like this for almost the same price.
name: Travis

text:
The thai rice bowl was really good. Subbed edamame for broccoli. Delicious.
The white roll was yummy.
name: Amanda

text: Food was on point as always.  For a chain restaurant they do an amazing job of keeping the food rich with flavor and the drinks current and relevant. I had two passion fruit margaritas, wings, and shrimp tacos. My waitress was busy yet very attentive.  I didn't need for anything. Thanks for another classic hooters experience!
name: Arisa

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. Idk, ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Anyway, they were out of one thing i originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. not sure I'd order the same thing again. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..

text: Restaurant was crowded on a Sunday afternoon during the ravens game (as expected).  Service was great.  The food we ordered pleasantly surprised us.  The brandy/tarragon vinegarette was AMAZING! I'm going to crave it.  The chowder was really good!  The Philly was good too!  I'd go back.  Just good food.

text: Awesome place. U could spend hours here!!!! So many restaurants and shops! Try the cheeseburger empanadas!!

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. A couple small things kept adding up. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Not sure though.

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: I assume a soft opening, banner covering the old sign of the Cooper House. Staff was friendly but obviously new to the POS system. Full bar but no cocktail menu. Food was good. Ambiance leaves something to be desired, odd setup and light colors and bright lights make you feel like your eating in a conference room. I'd check back in a couple months.

text:
I came here with a bachelorette party, and was convinced to purchase a package deal ($50 a person) by an event planner. The musicians were fantastic. But that's the only fantastic part of the place.

1. The package deal shots were not drinkable. 
2. The champagne wasn't good enough for a post prom high school bash.
3. The event planner put the wrong name on the stage call-out, upsetting our bride.
4. The server never brought the appetizers included in the package deal.
5. The average age in the bar was mid-40's--not appropriate for a bachelorette party.

When I complained to event planner, I got no response. I do not recommend this piano bar to anyone. Musicians, go find a better bar! You were great!

text: Excited about German beer selection! Good chill spot on a weekend. The bartenders were super friendly and knowledgeable about brews.

text: Celebrating our daughters 19th birthday. I must say it was Great! We ordered the all you can eat and it was so much fun having the meat cook over the natural lump charcoal. Great place! Will go there again and you much check them out yourself too!

text: Amazing! Small restaurant with awesome staff and food.  Maria was so friendly and gave "freaking amazing" recommendations.  Prices were pleasantly surprising for the portions (large) and quality.

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was fresh and service was quick. text:
Right around the corner from Saint Thomas West hospital, on White Bridge Road, sits J. Alexander's. My wife took me there so we could have lunch before heading home. Once inside, they did a great job of getting us seated. Good points there, bad points for the obstreperous noise level.

Our excellent server, Jared, gave us a list of all the specials before he took our orders. I chose their bacon Swiss burger and my wife picked the cypress salad. On the menu, that salad was listed as being without tomatoes- that's why my wife chose it. Unfortunately,  tomatoes were present in the dish as served. As my wife picked the tomatoes out of her salad, a server offered to bring her a new cypress salad. My wife declined the offer and asked for more salad dressing, which arrived instantly. Later, the manager stopped by to check on the situation. First rate service all the way around.

My bacon Swiss burger looked mouth watering sitting on my plate. The meat seemed to have the right % of fat and was cooked just as a medium burger should be. The thick sliced bacon was prepared so that could be doubled over on my burger, Any crispier and doubling would have been impossible. My bacon Swiss burger would have been a winner, but for one thing...the bun.My burger simply needed a bigger bun. half of mine fell apart and I had to eat it with a fork, like mama's meat loaf.

Both of us had carrot cake for dessert.. The moist, fluffy cake was full of bits of carrots, pecans and coconuts with a hint of orange peel. It was topped with a luxurious cream cheese frosting. I'd return just for the carrot cake.

Not to rate this J. Alexander's. The service was first rate, The carrot cake was incredibly good.  My bacon Swiss burger was disappointing. Four stars for this J. Alexander's.

text:
I only rate this restaurant with one star because there is no option for zero stars.  My husband and I were in St. Charles for a conference and came to the Black Bear on May 11th on the recommendation of our RV park hostess.  What a mistake!  We were informed it would be about 30 minutes before we were seated.  OK.  Understandable on a Saturday, but why were there  so many empty tables?  I saw two that remained empty the whole 30 minutes.  
   Seated after 30 minutes.  It took 15 more minutes for a lady to arrive to ask about drinks.  We were ready to order, but she said she couldn't take the order.  20 more minutes, tea and water arrive.  10 more minutes, server finally shows up (45 minutes after seating).  Husband ordered the  beef special.  15 more minutes, server announces they are out of beef special.  Husband then orders beef stew.  15 more minutes, server announces they are out of beef stew.  Brings us two muffins.  Husband is diabetic and really needs to eat.  Server apologizes, offers to reduce bill.  Husband and server agree on a strip steak and baked potato.
   15 more minutes, server arrives with crusty scrapings from bottom of pot that he says are beef stew, along with gummy glob of mashed potatoes.  Husband very hungry and by now quite upset.  Refuses order.  Insists on steak that he and server agreed on. In the meantime four tables to our left have been served, finished eating and left.  
   Three youthful employees mill around the hostess stand.  One talks on a cell phone.  One re-does her hair do.  The male rubs his nose, then picks it.  He explores his mouth with his forefinger.  None of them seem to be helping customers.
   20 more minutes, steak and my order arrive (no baked potato, just a glob of gummy mashed potatoes).  Husband accepts order.  I am by now too upset to eat and leave most of my food.   Manager apologizes and does not charge us for the meal.  (Tea and water have never been refilled.)
   Two hours and 45 minutes after entering we finally leave.  Worst restaurant experience of my life.
name: Alden

text:
When I moved to Nashville the thing that I thought I'd miss the most is having an abundance of fresh seafood. However, it seems that every other new place that opens in Nashville is seafood! Lucky me! 

We came here on a weekday afternoon for lunch lured by the idea of a sushi burrito which combines two of my favorite foods. The concept of Zushipoke involves customization for your bowl or sushi burrito. There is a counter where you can create your own or choose a specialty item and still add or change it to your liking. Both myself and my boyfriend got the monster sushi burrito. This comes with three proteins: krab (imitation crab), tuna and shrimp. It has cucumber, avocado, tempura pieces all mixed in a sauce before rolled up in rice and soy paper. I substituted the shrimp out for salmon and my boyfriend left out the avocado (something I would never do!) but asked for a tortilla instead of the soy paper wrapper. I assumed that by leaving the soy paper wrapper I'd be cutting the carbs but there was so much rice in mine since that had to adhere to the soy paper. The result was that my boyfriend's sushi burrito had more  protein and less rice so I wish I had done this substitution as well! The taste was great and it was served with a side of some sort of creamy mayo, wasabi and ginger. 

We both enjoyed the food and the atmosphere was casual and clean. However, the workers were a bit slow and kept asking me to repeat my order. It is definitely on the pricey side too since it was $32 for two sushi burritos and 1 drink. Despite these couple of nit picky things it was overall a good experience.
