The menu was lackluster...I was not excited about any of the choices, The server hyped up the Rook Burger, so I ordered that.  While good, it was something I could have gone without..especially at $16.   My buddy got the Curry Ramen, which was not Ramen at all, unless you consider the fact it had Ramen noodles.  He said it was just OK, and did not finish it.  Overall, a very disappointing experience and with so many great options in fountain square, I'm guessing my next trip here will be in a long long time.
name: Ron

text: I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It was crowded but still moved along. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. For the price I expected more than this. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: The best place to get authentic tacos here in Indy PERIOD, nobody fucking with them !!!
name: Tkeyiah

text:
The first time I went to Burger Me I was not too impressed and decided not to return. Fast forward a few years we gave it another shot just because it was close by and I'm glad I did! This time around I built my own burger rather than ordering from the favorites menu. 

You can definitely build your dream burger with how many ways you can customize. They have vegetarian, non-red meat, and gluten free options available as well. Burgers are cooked medium but I'm sure you can change that if you want.

I like to build my own cheeseburger with American cheese, lettuce, tomato, pickles, grilled onions (all free), and add bacon and a fried egg ($1 each). Everything tastes fresh from the bun to the pickles!

Don't for get to get a basket of garlic fries are a must! Great flavor, nice sized fries, and the garlic has that spicy bite to it.

I've yet to try the dessert because the burger is so filling but next time I'll have to save room for the deep fried ice cream or an ice cream sando.

It's a little expensive but you get what you pay for! Great food and great service! Everyone is very friendly and they bring your food out to your table. If you're ever craving a solid, tasty burger try Burger Me!
name: Aja

text:
the girl working the register today appears to be in long need for some time off as you could totally feel her pent-up stress in her passive aggressive tone and snippyness...yelling names for pick-ups in other customers' faces, sarcastically directing people where to line up to order, and snidely telling me there are already napkins in the bag when i took a few....btw, there weren't ANY so i'm glad to have taken "extra". 

otherwise, my order was as expected but not exceptionally tasty...just ok...missing a lil something, mustard perhaps?
name: Christina

text: Did delivery from Caviar and everything was delicious. The baby backs were great.  Mac and Cheese was small but very tasty.
name: Nick

text:
If you have the opportunity to come here, don't!
The food is good, the server's are horrible.  I got regular water, after the food. You have to practically beg for ice tea or a soda.  
Save yourself the trouble and go somewhere else, that wants to service their customers.  I only gave 1 star because service doesn't allow minus 10.
name: Christy

text: Food was excellent, they make their own pickle.  Service was excellent.  I travel from MD occasionally and always make a stop here.  Best cheesesteak spot in Philly thus far.
name: Janelle

text: The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: Drinks were awesome, get the Kelly Kapowski, it's awesome. The nachos were yummy, and entrees were delicious. Can't wait to come back to try their breakfast.
name: Jill

text:
This restaurant is a joke. I have been eating in fine restaurants for many years. This place is horrible. 
I had a New York strip--- four or five medallions of the worst meat and some kind of sautéed onions or something was the worst NY Strip I have ever had. 
My wife had a great dish but it should be on the "Kids Menu "

It is a joke!!!!!!
name: Hans

text:
Good service in a casual atmosphere. Family friendly, American fare.

The fish sandwich was awesome and the chicken tenders were HUGE! 

Took a group for lunch and came away full and satisfied!
name: A

text: I have been to Thai Recipes twice for dinner. The family owned restaurant is hidden in a small strip mall. The inside is small but quaint. Typically I order the spring rolls as an appetizer and drunken noodles as a entree. The food is really good and you choose your spice level. They are never busy when I go on the weekend, but always super attentive to customers.
name: Elijah

text: we were trying to get out of the rain and stumbled upon this place. The first impression was, the decor is modern yet cozy, warm, and cute inside! My husband ordered latte. it was one of the smoothest latte I've ever had. and I ordered hot chocolate. it was different than most hot chocolate I've had in the past. it was on the thicker side but I really loved it!! it tasted very authentic and wasn't too sweet!
name: HANNAH

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Would return.
name: User

text: This place is unbelievable when it comes to getting orders WRONG in the drive thru. I stopped 20 minutes ago to get a bacon, egg and cheese bagel and potato patty on my way home from a doctors appointment. I get my order, made sure there was a sandwich and home fry in the bag and drove home. Silly  me....I figured there was no way to screw up an order with only one sandwich but true to past experiences.... they did. When I got home I found the sandwich in the bag was a Sausage McMuffin. Based on my experience, this place screws up drive thru orders about 50% of the time. Unfortunately there is no other McDonalds near by so I could avoid this one. Between wrong orders and having to wait several minutes while "they run my food out to me", if there was any competition I don't think they would be in business. If you go there check your order before leaving no matter how small or simple the order is.
name: Paul

text: My sister and dad have been going here since they opened years ago and always rave about the wings. After years of hearing them talk about them and never trying them, I had them last night. They were so good. The wings a decent size, not as big as wing house, but just as good as them. We got three different flavors; sweet brown sugar, chipotle, and garlic Parmesan. The service was fantastic. I wish I could remember the servers name because she was top notch. For example, my dad was drinking A LOT  of diet coke and she ended up bringing him two when she realized that he was super thirsty. Go here if you like wings!
name: Theresa

text: What a lovely space right in a neighborhood, with lovely proprietors! I wish I could have stayed even longer. And I want to go back and have dinner. So glad to have found this gem!
name: Mind

text: Clean. Good food. Very accommodating and kind staff. One of my favorite places in philly.
name: Skyler

text: Friendly staff and clean establishment. Excellent value for prices charged.   Everything from traditional diner fair to classic restaurant food.  Service was quick and efficient.  French onion soup was topped with perfectly melted cheese. Veal Saltibocca was flavorful and filling; and included dessert. I took the vanilla ice cream because my tastebuds were already in overload and I still had to drive home.
name: Mark

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Kind of landed in the middle for me.
name: User

text: We have eaten here twice in the past month.  Once with friends and the second time alone.  Hostesses were great, seated us right away and brought water and menus.  The executive chef (Jeff) came out to great us and to give us recommendations which we took.  Chris the general manager greeted us as well and took care of us.  Jack was our waiter and was attentive and helpful, not hovering.  We will definitely be back, delicious!!!  We would highly recommend the Black Spaghetti, Caesar Salad was great too.
name: Mary

text:
I ask for a menu Saturday night, after 10 minutes no service, I walked out. March 1

Waitress not friendly.

wallacecartwright@kw.com
name: Wallace

text: Very nice neighborhood café! Their cinnamon roles are amazing! I advice people to get there super early on weekends if you want to have breakfast because the place is packed by 10 AM.
name: Erin

text: We stay away from downtown Tucson proper as much as possible. This, however, was a delightful surprise. Great food. Great service. Very pleasant setting.
name: Lori

text: So far so good, had the caprese sandwich which was awsome and 10 out of 10 for the cinnamon buns
name: Tuvia

text: This place is amazing. I had the bone marrow and grilled octopus and just, wow. Everything was cooked perfectly and with just the right amount of seasoning.
name: Jillian

text: Strong 4.7!  Super cute decor!  I love this place. Lindsay, our waitress was very attentive.  We came straight from church and had tickets for a matinee so we needed quick service.  We didn't share this with our waitress because we didn't need to.  We ordered the deviled eggs and a steak salad to share.  Both were equally great.  We ordered our app and engaged in a conversation and didn't realize that our deviled eggs hadn't come, but we didn't have too.  The GM, Anthony, came to our table and apologized and advised he would comp the app for the delay.  Wow, what great service!!!!  True reflection of how a GM should be aware of the food and service on the floor at all times.  The steak salad was great. Lindsay brought the vinaigrette and the ranch on the side.  Ladies, the bathroom was impeccable.  Take home message: Excellent service, well seasoned food, friendly staff, beautiful decor.  A win!!!  You would be pleased to come here for a quick bite or a special anniversary dinner!!!
name: Trice

text:
The set up at UG is really nice very cool ambiance with that southern but progressive city feel. The food alone could have been 4 or 5 star this visit which is the first time I was completely pleased with all the dishes we ordered other dishes were the pit dip sandwich, shrimp and grits with sausage added (it's extra) and pork chop and Mac and cheese. Everything came out well and can't forget the raw oyster options..

With all that being said the service on this occasion was terrible. Our waitress never refilled our drink, disappeared for long periods as we see surrounding tables well attended to. I felt like the one time I was soooo pleased with the food it came up short on service. It got to the point when she finally came back we asked for refills, check, and to go boxes all at the same time afraid that she wasn't going to come back for another 30 mins. We didn't even explores dessert at this point as we a party of 4 have been sitting here for almost 2 hours.  

Could have scored higher but the service was the road block.. Oh well at least I know what to order now..
name: Huy

text: The tacos are my favorite any of them and all of them!  The wine and beer menu is incredible. The atmosphere is nice but the food is great
name: Tanya

text: Just finishing lunch so only a few things were tasted. The pork gyoza are excellent. Fresh and thin wrapper served with vinegar as they should be. Had a sashimi appetizer. Four pieces very fresh fish ,tuna salmon,scallop and yellow tail. They were cut a little thicker than usual but the quality of the fish was so good it did not matter. Service was attentive and friendly. Hot sake was the right thing for a cold wet day.
name: Russ

text:
Living in South India for 1.5 year developed a really good taste of mine for authentic South Indian food. I heard Savoy's name multiple times whenever i ask my friends about good spot for South Indian food in Edmonton and finally, i went there to satisfy my craving for authentic Masala Dosa on weekend.
Well, I would sum my experience as mixed (neither overwhelming nor disappointing)
We ordered Cheese Masala Dosa and Onion Masala Dosa. Food was good, you can experience the authenticity of South Indian food to a larger extent. 
When it comes to ambience, it is very normal and another thing that bothered me is the cleanliness. Place was not clean and washrooms were stinky. I am going with 3 stars just because of food.
They should pay much attention to cleaning their place now.
name: Harsharndeep Kaur

text: You can tell they care about customer experience here. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Food was fresh and service was quick. Would absolutely visit again. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: If I could rate this a zero I would! Not only was there a hair in my food, but my husband got a severe case of food poisoning because of their pork belly. He has been sick all day!!! This is unacceptable. Please be careful ordering from this place!
name: Mariam

text: Every time I come here my experience always change the cooks all cook different  there is only one cook I would only let prepare my meal this particular time the service was horrible I come here a lot an they will no longer have anymore of my services I'm not hard to please customer service is a must.
name: Martika

text:
Horrible customer service at this Logan's location. I've had mixed experiences with each visit but this was by far the worst. 
Against better judgement, I returned after being served burnt food and waiter argued the food was not burnt. However,  today my kids asked to eat at Logans because they love the hot rolls.  

My son ordered chicken tenders and fries. I was taken back by the over-battered and overcooked chicken strips. Three pieces a bit fatter than the size  of a string bean with 14 small fries. I asked about the meal and the waiter was non-chalet. He asked if I would like to purchase an order of fries... I felt he dismissed my concern at which I responded if this is the new norm, I would not be back. He said Okay with a smile. 
I then spoke to the manager. Explained we did not order a kids meal for starters, the meal was extremely sparse, chicken over cooked and waiters dismissive response.
Manager said if I want to come back another time he would make sure my order was taken correctly, but the prior manager did not control or watch portion size and what my son received was correct.
I told him I would not be back and he too said that was okay. What is it with customer service. Logan's is a company chain that will serve you inadequate food to customers for your hard earned money.  Poor quality, poor customer service and filthy bathrooms. (Failed to mention, bathroom horribly dirty, broken blocks on doors and broken toilet seats. Reminds me of the bathroom in a public park overrun with the homeless)
name: Leslie

text: My wife and I went here for her birthday! The food is absolutely AMAZING and the service is unbeatable! Shout out to John for being an awesome server! The won ton buffalo chicken bites are sooooo good!!! Definitely coming back soon to eat here again! The bowling alley is so cool inside too!
name: Jacob

text: Great food reasonably priced. We've been there several times and have never been disappointed. Usually no waiting before 6:00pm. Highly recommend it.
name: Liliana

text: Great location. Customer service is lacking. The breakfast buffet was nothing to write home about. It was lacking that wow.
name: Michael

text:
We had the afternoon off and decided to eat at Joey B's on their patio. The food is good and the service is ok. Until now...

Some guy brought his sheepdog in (not a service dog)and was seated at the table next to us. The dog was stressed out and was jumping on the table. Then to top it off, the dog vomited on the ground next to my feet!  The staff was slow to respond. Interesting in the fact that before the dog puked, the servers were all fawning over the dog. 

We were DISGUSTED!!  No one came over so we got up and spoke with "Marcie", who was watching the event with "Tony". Both appeared to be laughing. Marcie apologized profusely. 

Tony on the other hand, swaggered up and puffed up his chest at me, stated he wasn't laughing, and said "accidents happen". It looked like he was trying to be intimidating but I didn't back down. He went inside. 

Marcie offered to box up our order and provide a $25 gift certificate which we accepted. She did tell us they allow dogs on the patio and asked us not to judge their restaurant based on the dog incident. 

I found out later that Tony is a part-owner of the restaurant. His behavior was unacceptable. 

I haven't decided if I want to eat there anymore. I think the dog issue could be a Health Department issue. I'll do some research.
name: Phillip

text: We visited Neyow's in December 2017, as suggested by friends and a few hotel staff. It did not disappoint! We had the chargrilled oysters, shrimp creole, and fried seafood platter. All were amazing!!! We even had the Bow Wow drink...and it definitely packed a punch! Give this place a try! You won't regret it!
name: Lea

text: Spend $16 on a sandwich you'd think they'd make it correctly. Faxed in an order for a sandwich, Turkey, Pepperoni, Provolone, Light Lettuce, Extra Pepperoncinis. Sandwich came with No Pepperoni, No Lettuce, No Pepperoncinis and Extra Sprouts. I called and told them the sandwich was wrong and the lady said hold on I have to talk to my manager to see what we can do. What you can do??? How about make me another sandwich so I can waste another 20 minutes of my day going back to  pick it up!! My recommendation is to order the sandwich there so you can watch them make it otherwise they'll probably screw it up.
name: Rob

text: Great place to go for a quick lunch, fast great service and the food is so good. Homemade pastas enough said!!!!!
name: Drew

text:
Stayed here for one night in king bedroom on 2nd floor with balcony. Got a complimentary upgrade upon check in. Was a nice spacious room, with fireplace and tub, separate toilet, felt cozy. 

Dined at Angel Oak, was delicious. Staff are friendly all around. Spacious grounds, clean fresh air. Nice cliff walk. Exercise classes available. Had a grand time here!
name: Yonnie

text: The staff is awesome. I had a mimosa which was very good. Then I got a biscuit to start and OMG this is seriously one of the best I've ever had. I ordered the Tasso Benedict so creamy and good. My fiancée had the croque madame which was very good the presentation was very nice, the edible flowers were a nice touch.
name: Melissa

text: A long wait, but they use an online waitlist so you do not have to wait in line. At 1PM on a Wednesday we waited about 40 minutes. The fried chicken was good, but the breading was not cooked all the way, resulting in some mushy lumps. The service staff was very friendly.
name: Tudor

text: This would be a 5 star if the service was quicker but everything else was perfect. Our waitress was very attentive and even gave us a complimentary dessert for the long wait. The sangria is sweet but had enough kick in it. The burrito is very filling. My whole party loved this place and the vibe is very chill. Good music and good drinks. A great place for a brunch spot.
name: Heather

text: Rude, disorganized, and inattentive staff. Decent food, but the service is horrible. Prices are ok but on the higher end without the higher end quality.
name: L

text:
Cute spot right outside of peddlers village. Really cute outdoor seating set up. All the staff is very friendly and our waitress was attentive. 

We stopped by here after a recent peddlers village festival visit for more of a sit down dining experience than what the festival had to offer. 

We ordered a couple glasses of wine. They have a nice selection. And some appetizers to share. We tried the hummus, lobster dumplings, and meatballs. All good but the lobster dumplings were reallyyyy good. Highly recommend. Packed with lobster and very savory. Both agreed it was our favorite dish.
name: Enxhenia

text: Love this place. It's a very hidden location but the Cubans there are amazing. I recommended so many people to go there.
name: Nanzilla

text: Use to be my favorite spot for Chinese food but when I observed a child of one of the workers sneezing into their hand and picking their nose then being sent to place crispy chinese noodles in bags with their hands, I would no longer eat their.
name: Matt

text: Consistently good food and coffee. I love that their menu rotates and you'll find unusual but very tasty combinations everytime you go. The Cali with bacon is a personal fave. The only reason this isn't getting 5 stars is because of service- it's usually pretty slow and the server can disappear for awhile when you need something. Otherwise, probably my favorite breakfast place in Delaware
name: Megan

text:
I stopped here this past week for late brunch on my way home from an appointment. I managed to snag a close street parking spot and I was seated quickly. I had hoped my friend could join me but unfortunately timing didn't work out. However, I did snag a spot on the back bench and was wonderful location to watch people walking by and not be blinded by the rare sunlight we seem to be enjoying this fall. There is also bar stools along another window that would be perfect if you know up front you're just grabbing a quick coffee or are by yourself. 

As observed last time, this place is perfect for those grabbing a meal solo or have 2-3 persons/table. I arrived a bit later than 1 pm and it was still quite busy up until I left (a bit after 3 pm), which is interesting to see on a week day. As it was that busy the whole time, the level of noise stayed fairly constantly loud with amount of people and background music. 

My server was wonderful and very attentive. Coffee here is tasty and food arrived quickly this visit. Again, I had the bennie but this time with what I think was the braised short ribs for the meat. Loved the smokey taste. Potatoes of course to accompany it (as how else would you got to make sure you get all that hollandaise sauce off the plate without looking like a 2 year old licking your plate clean?). 

I really liked the range of choices on the menu and will be back again to try something else. Glad this experience made me want to increase my star rating. The real trick to properly enjoying this place is going solo or max 3 in a group.
name: Laura

text:
Stopped in this subway for a quick bite to eat. The line was very long and took awhile to get thru. It also got kind of awkward because they messed up the order of the woman in front of me. So they had me go ahead of her while they fixed it, and the woman in front of me didn't like that. They pushed her to the back of the line. It wasn't very fair to her, honestly. Especially since the line was already pretty long. 

Other than that, the inside was nice. There was a lot of seating. The parking lot was kind of tight, not a lot of parking options. But my sandwich was prepared nicely. It was hot and all the veggies I added to it were nice and fresh. So I was satisfied!
name: Liz

text:
Well, where to begin! I ordered through GrubHub and was only 15 minutes away from the Wayback in Chalfont, PA. The food was delivered late and cold. You would think, since they are using GrubHub, They would, at least, use aluminum foil or a delivery warming bag for deliveries. But, no!

Next, I ordered a hamburger, chicken sandwich and hot dog. The hamburger was, basically, tasteless. I had to doctor it, after reheating it, to make it tolerable. The hot dog was over cooked and tasteless, as well. The chicken sandwich fell into the same mold, tasteless and chewy.

To summarize, if you don't live within 5 minutes of your Wayback, don't use a delivery service. It will be cold! The food is not worth the wait and there are so many other burger places that are better. Save your money and time!
name: A

text: Holy Jesus....this place was awesome. Almost passed it up because we didn't see the sign but so glad we went back in. This was the freshest po boy I've ever tasted and there were several more on the menu that looked worthy of trying. Will definitely be back.
name: Greta

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The music was louder than it needed to be. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Worth checking out. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not bad for a quick meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was fresh and service was quick. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. For a busy night they handled it okay. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: They open at 10:30 am on Saturday. I show up at 11 and they say they dont have anything ready and it would take 30 minutes to make a sandwich. What a joke.
name: Casey

text:
Honestly, my fiancé and I found this place very bland and mediocre, completely over hyped. We both got the dinner plate specials, which comes with entree of choice with sides of; fried shrimp, egg rolls as well as crap puffs. Oh ya, boring egg drop soup; my Pioneer Woman recipe tastes a thousand time better. We settled on sesame chicken and Mongolian beef. Won't be back, even though they offer delivery.

We should have gone with our ol' standby, Great Village.
name: Alison

text: Really good tacos and you can customize to fit vegan dietary restrictions. Nice staff and plenty of amazing sauces to choose from.
name: Sharnae

text: Ate here for restaurant week and it'd been quite a while since my previous visit. Inexcusable slow service, mediocre food at best and awful dessert. Don't waste your time or money. There are a million better places to eat in St. Louis and Clayton.
name: Alicia

text: Un endroit qui ne paie pas de mine; vraiment le dinner classique américain. Bonne nourriture, très simple et pas trop chère. Une adresse qui est située dans State street, moins centrale que les autres restaurants.
name: Héloïse

text: This is a really great place in Narberth. It's small and I've definitely seen people without reservations turned away on weekend nights. The pho is wonderful- they have some of the best vegetarian pho I've had. The summer rolls are also great, as is the Vietnamese iced coffee. The service can be a little slow, but everyone is very friendly and I always have a great dinner here.
name: Madeline

text: This place has such a great variety of food.  The buffet features a salad and fruit bar, delicious sushi bar, dessert and ice cream bar, and a variety of both American and Asian dishes. They have a late party room so it's a wonderful place to bring the family or a group of friends. I love that they also include the option to have hibachi grilled to order right in front of you. One of the larger Asian buffets I've been to. I love that I can always see staff switching out food, so I know that it's all pretty fresh and not like other places where food just sits out all day. Service is always fantastic. As soon as you walk in the host rights down your drinks so your free to go straight to making your plate and your drinks are waiting for you when you get back to your table. Great food and such a great price for the abundance of options. I try to stop by anytime I'm in Smyrna.
name: Selena

text:
As I was following GPS's directions, I was pretty sure that it was misleading me.  However, after driving into a residential neighborhood, you will find this small hole in the wall restaurant.  I have had the tamales here, which are absolutely amazing.  I think they make some of the best tamales in Tucson!  I love the green chili and the beef tamales.  You can get them refrigerated (to re-heat when you get home) or get them warm to eat then and there.  Get a dozen each of the green chili and beef tamales - your friends and family will love you.

On top of that, everyone working here is very friendly.
name: Vivi

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. maybe I just came on an off day. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Love you spaghetti and meatballs and the roast beef poboys. It's one of the only places my nephew will eat. But be warned the online prices and the paper menu are wrong.
name: Nelson

text: Awesome beer, great food. The most real people. Plus they are very family friendly with a play with your kids area. Will most definitely be back.
name: Josh

text:
Holy smokes... this place is incredible! We went with a larger party (seven) & ordered *almost* everything on the menu. The small plates were all delicious, but the fried oysters & eggplant were definitely the highlights! All of our cocktails were unique & just weird enough to keep you on your toes. Service was astounding, and the manager came around a few times to make sure we were satisfied. This is a great spot for happy hour or date night.  

** the whole fish is highly recommended, but limited! Make sure you order it early on to ensure you get what you come for!
name: Lauren

text: Such a fun environment to eat breakfast/brunch in, in a really cute neighborhood in Philly. We had a huge group, but the servers were very friendly and accommodating. Altogether, we tried the Lox Benedict, Kitchen Sinks, Breakfast Burritos, and the Crab Salad. I had the breakfast burrito which was enormous, very good, but just the same as all other breakfast burritos you may have tried in the past. If I were to order again, I would for sure get the Crab Salad which came with a hefty fist-sized crab cake patty -- at only $13, this is where I'd put my money.
name: Michelle

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell.
name: User

text: I just didnt like it. Um going back to taco bell. Fzrqg3ybey ru ru eybtarvarbat ey wyv
name: Joe

text: I think this place is fantastic! I travel to Reno on business several times a year, and this is a "must visit" spot for lunch.  My favorite is the cobb salad - maybe the best I've ever had? I also like the hot turkey dinner platter. The hospitality & service are wonderful. I especially enjoyed my waitress on my most-recent visit, Kellee! In fact, on this last Reno trip, I visited this place twice. I just love it! I tell my friends that the Manhattan Deli is one of the things I look forward to most when in Reno (and I'm not kidding!). The entire Atlantis Resort & Casino is great!
name: Harrison

text: Food isn't that great.  Not sure why they changed from authentic to more high end Mexican. Long wait and over rated
name: D

text: Walking around the area while my husband was in a conference and was looking for something healthy for lunch, but didn't expect to find much. Found this surprise!  I got the Bravocado with tuna salad (a whole avocado cut in half and stuffed with tuna salad).  Beautifully and simply made and delicious.  Walnuts on top and a few bites of pineapple for palate cleanser. And two little "energy bite" muffins. There is inside seating and an outside covered patio for seating.
name: Jena

text: 3 years later we came back and ended up sitting in the same seats at the bar. We had the Redfish with greens and the stuffed Ahi Tuna. Both were absolutely amazing and the service was wonderful. Everyone was very friendly and all the food we saw looked delicious.
name: Brandon

text: I've never had a bad experience here. The food is creative and delicious and the spirit selection is solid. I've only sat at the bar when I have dined here and the bartenders are awesome! I definitely would recommend this place for a date night or to just roll in solo and sit at the bar.
name: Clayton

text: I enjoyed my first visit the place was clean and the menu was straight forward. I spoke to the owner and the woman working the register they were both very nice. I tried the Vietnamese egg rolls and they were fresh and crispy not too greasy. I also had some spring rolls with chicken and I liked them as well. I will be back to try the Thai Iced Tea and salad!!!! If you want something fresh light at a good price check them out.
name: Shawndrea

text:
We had waited several months for this place to open since we live about a half mile away. The food was ok. It took 30 minutes to cook. The service, or lack seemed to be our problem mostly. We got there about 5:30 on a Friday and most of the tables were busy. After we ordered, we didn't get forks for a salad or plates for our pizza slices. It took 20 minutes for the guy to bring the check and he kept saying you pay up front. With what? We never got extra napkins or drink refill offers.
Your menu looks good. The room is fairly small. If you don't improve, you will go broke just like the other group.
Best wishes for next time.
name: Robin

text: Great place! Just like a Wawa but without the specialty drinks. They serve excellent pastries and their deli is great. Their fries are always a treat and their cheesesteaks and French Dip is a delight. Good for cold bogies too. Very filling and they also make a bangin quesadilla! They sell your typical as store small goods (cigarettes, gum, lighters etc.). They always have some deal on drinks too, gatorades or ice teas usually. Dine in or take out, it doesn't matter. Good for Working Groups on a lunch break or packing a sub for the next day. Great staff and has never messed up my order.
name: Nathan

text:
This review is long overdue.
I live around the corner & order out from here all the time.  
Pizza is always good.
Where this UNO really stands out is in their catering services, mostly because of their events coordinator, Jenna. I have held at least half a dozen events (showers, birthdays, anniversaries) in their party room (which, by the way, is free of any charge) for anywhere from 10 to 40 people.  I actually held 2 parties in one day when my daughter graduated from high school...back to back from 12 -4(our family) and then 4-8 pm(her friends) with 2 separate menus, all coordinated by Jenna.  She is a wiz at planning menus that will accommodate the pickiest of eaters, calculating the correct amount of food to be ordered to accommodate your number of guests, and doing it all for a reasonable amount of money.  
The only time anything ever went wrong is when Uno was forced to shut down their ovens due to electrical problems on the day of one of my smaller parties. Even then, they called me a few hours before our start time to make me aware of the situation and how they had come up with a plan to accommodate me to the best of their ability.  We decided to go ahead anyway and although there wasn't any pizza, the management made sure to give us lots of free apps to make up for it.
And as soon as I post, I am calling over there to order food in for a product demonstration I am hosting at my home.
name: AnneMarie

text: This place was great! The musicians are so incredible. The place is small so make sure you buy tickets in advance. We bought tickets for the jazz section and they serve dinner while you listen to them play. I wasn't too impressed with the food but other wise it was a great spot. I highly recommend going if you get the chance!
name: Camille

text: Chose Goose because of the reviews and they did not disappoint! Excellent sandwiches and staff.
name: Kyle

text: I tried it for the first time tonight. I got the chicken roll ups. I must say I was not expecting it to taste that great, but it was amazing. I thought it would be typical green grilled chicken at best, but whatever they season their chicken with makes it on another level. This will be a new regular spot for me
name: Josh

text:
Really enjoyed a recent dinner here. The wine cellar in the basement is beautiful.

As for the food, my partner and I split a caesar salad, the gnocchi, and the spaghetti bolognese. Our server had expressed doubts about whether this would be enough food, but it was plenty.

The gnocchi, by the way, is large enough to have as a main course, despite what they might tell you. The salad is also large enough to split, so save your money there.

The cannoli for dessert was on point. You also get a good amount of wine for the $19 wine flight. 

I've tried a lot of Italian restaurants in Philadelphia, and this one is high on my list. Try it!
name: Michael

text: We were here for a bar outing, we were wrongfully charged fo a drink, we were asking why the drink was charged on us, then the bartender got so mad that they started smashing glasses in front of us. We were surprised about it, but when we talked to the manager, she said you can't be rude to my staff. Then when we talked to the staff and they said honey we are here forever, we don't care. Do yourself a favor, don't come here
name: Dave

text: Typical roman pizza al taglio.... Great ingredients and good quality. You wont be disappointed. Try the suppli' as well. Very good.
name: Luca

text: Went with a group of friends last night to Paradise Park and had an absolute blast. I specifically want to highlight the customer service from one of their employees -- Kolby. We chatted with her for about 20 minutes -- she was incredibly friendly, helpful, and made us feel right at home as a bunch of tourists coming from out of town. Would go back again without a doubt!
name: Chris

text: Thank you to John the owner and Justin the bouncer for allowing our bachelorette group to take a few photos and have some fun on the pole in the bar! You guys are the best!!
name: Sarah

text:
Update with a new visit yesterday.  We will not be returning for the food. Friends invited us and the company was great.  We ordered off the Devour menu.
1. Overall atmosphere nice. But due to the make up of the building it was hot even though the AC was running (It was 90 degrees outside I think).  We were under the AC and the air passed over us. Plenty of room.
2. Service was fun and tried hard.  Knew the menu.  Another waitress kept our water glasses well filled.
3.  Timing of food was great.  Had enough time to enjoy each part.
4.  Food.  Here was the problem. 1. I ordered the veggie taco and it was so spicy hot, I could not have told you what was in the taco.  Hot due to spice/chili totally taking over from flavor.  The pickled onions were a nice addition (just a little more acid needed) but were cut so I got a big piece with the hard end.  Knife skills need to be improved.  I wish it had come as a make your own taco. 2. Hubby ordered the chicken tostada which sort of came as make your own. The problem was the thick hard flat shell which could only be eaten if broken into chips.  Suggestion to owner, allow a choice of soft shell or hard shell on menu. 3.  I tried the pork and it was delicious.  4. Group tried both the flan and the churros and the flan won out.  The churros were to me much too hard and tasted only of the sugar on the outside. I have had them freshly made in other locations and I would not go back for these. Chocolate sauce yummy and like a thin chocolate pudding.  
5. Margaritas were very good and I could taste the fresh citrus.  If we had walked, I would have ordered the pitcher.
name: Ana

text: I enjoy going to panda for lunch since it is so close to work but the service here had been less than satisfactory. Other panda expresses I go to keep a close eye on food that needs refilling l, not this one. Only having an hour for lunch makes this very frustrating waiting about half an hour making me rush. Wish they were better at keeping up with a lunch rush.
name: Scott

text: "Semi crispy egg noodles" the menu is what it's supposed to look like and this is what we got... TWICE. The noodles are so hard you can pick them up whole and they're all stuck together. When I called them to get new ones they send us the same thing with a whole in the container. Absolutely disgusting.
name: Angelina

text: Awesome seafood. Place is a fun hole in the wall. Fried jumbo shrimp were to die for. Grilled scallops and blacked grouper were also excellent. Ate in one night before a Rays baseball game. It was so good we went back 2 nights later and get take-out to eat on the beach while we watched sun set. Sides/deserts are just ok.
name: A

text:
This is a bar/nightclub first , restaurant second so keep that in mind . The food was surprisingly delicious and service was good. 
I met a GF for their bubbles and beats brunch . It got crowded right away so I'm glad we arrived when they opened. 
I had the southern breakfast with catfish, eggs, grits, and a biscuit. All delicious but catfish was the star.
She had shrimp and grits which she said was also lovely . 
We shared red velvet waffles that we're so light and fluffy with that external crisp that is addictive . no syrup needed! 

Of course we had unlimited mimosas. They have several varieties and it's only 15 dollars . 

Pros: delicious food , good prices, good service 
Cons: its a nightclub so the decor has that grungy look to it . 
Wasn't sure what door to go in -they should add a sign
name: Kimberly

text: Mismanaged reservation is the reason for this updated review. We had a reservation but were running late, so I called them to let them know we will be 10 mins late and if they would be able to keep the table for us. We were told yes. We reach there and were told, there were no table and it will be some wait. I ask her after 10 mins if she could let us know how long of a wait it would be and she had no idea. She mentioned that lot of people moved inside from patio because of the temperatures and few tables had been seated for longer than expected, so they had no idea when something could open up. The responsibility falls on both sides - if I am running late, the courtesy is to ask if they can hold the table, if not, then I move on. They should do the same and let us know that a table is not available for 'x' time instead of a vague indefinite time where we keep waiting. Needless to say we left.
name: Arunima

text:
If you're looking for a good local BBQ place, look no further than Center Point BBQ! Very casual and inviting atmosphere and friendly staff. CPB has been a staple of Hendersonville for years and they have the signed headshots of country musicians lining the walls to prove it!

You can't go wrong with the pulled pork, but I thought I'd branch out and try the brisket on our most recent visit. It was pretty good, albeit a little spicy. They also have several kid-friendly options. We will definitely be returning to Center Point BBQ whenever we have cravings for BBQ!
name: Jennifer

text: Paddy's Sandwich is so good. Brunch deals good. Extensive beer list. Good spot right on Main Street.
name: Garrett

text: Fantastic breakfast spot with even better service. They had me at self service coffee station complete with to go cups. Atmosphere is chill and inviting. Decor is clean and refreshing. The menu has Italian breakfast dishes and reminded me of Italy. I had a frittata and chose to build my own. It was served fresh in an adorable little skillet.  Had the vegetables for my side. At first cauliflower, kale, and sweet potato seemed like an odd combination but was delicious. my friend had the carne pizza and said it was one of the best pizzas she's ever had. Will definitely go back.
name: Felicia

text: Great food. Just watch your bill. I got charged double on accident. Lots of GF and V options
name: Dillon

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Delicious pizza made the way you want.  The process seems a little slow but then again you don't feel rushed picking your toppings for your pizza or a salad if you prefer.   The one on Congress is better though.
name: Xiao

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text:
I don't truly know why it has taken me so long to write a review for Billy G's. We have been to Billy G's different times of day and different times of year more than two dozen times. We are card-carrying rewards members... The patio is one of the best in St. Louis but be forewarned it is a very difficult seat to get with all the TVs and patio service, group seating, live music, and fire pits and twinkly lights outside - it can be VERY difficult any night of the week to get a spot on the patio any time of year. 

You should expect to, more often than not, wait for a table and have nowhere at the bar to sit while you wait. Best bet is to get a drink at the bar and then try to find one of the seats outside of the door to wait in that aren't part of the seated area of the patio. 

Here are some of my favorites:
1. Steak and Blue Cheese salad is by far my favorite item on the menu - perfectly cooked steak on a fresh chard salad and not overly dressed. Very delicious and filling.
2. The trashed wings are tasty!
3. The shrimp appetizer is amazing...

Their macro bowls are a really neat addition for anyone who is looking to go out to eat and not hurt their goals. 

Their nacho portions are enormous. 

Their wine selection is nice and their craft cocktails are always executed nicely. 

I enjoy this place as its what I sometimes refer to as "old faithful"... I don't ever receive a bad meal here.
name: Alyssa

text: Great service and everything is fresh. Call your order in and they will have it ready for you when you want it.
name: Shawn

text:
Love the sub sandwich and Danny is a great business man and a pleasure to deal with. He was very nice to take our order and make sure we received our sandwiches as we ordered.
Top of the line ingredients and love the soft but still a bit chewy rolls just like we like them.
We enjoy eating at Danny's when we are in town.
name: Jim

text:
Fantastic spot.  They have a great happy hour, with discounts on beer and wine and cocktails, as well as food.  

The sushi here and the rolls in particular are creative, and fun.  The staff here is really friendly, very professional, and helpful with suggestions and in recommendations of what might fit your tasted and palate. 

Really enjoyed an early evening with food and drinks here.  The menu (see picture) has an amazing selection and clearly has a lot of thought given to it.  The inside of the restaurant has wonderfully thought out design and great elements of asian and modern architecture and decor.  Really well done, and I would recommend visiting here (or make it a two-fer with a visit to the L.A. Jackson rooftop bar).
name: Robert

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Overall, a strong experience. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy.
name: User

text: Great new Restraunt , it's two floors. Had a lot of burger selection , we had delicious stuffed mushroom and the fries are wonderful with lots of favor. My sons got the kids hot dog. We will be back when we are in the area.
name: Bradley

text: My Cousin reserved this place for her wedding reception. At first, one of the managers told her that they could take her decorations and decorate for our small party. Then, another manager said that they don't do that. Obviously, the communication at this restaurant is terrible. My Cousin shouldn't have to be stressed out and flustered on her wedding day.  It wasn't even busy in here yesterday afternoon. It appeared that the management has absolutely no class for customer service. Disgusting. I'd give it no stars except for the fact that our server was absolutely wonderful. She took care of us. Other than that, this is a douche of a place. Spare your time and money and go find somewhere else to vie for your time and money.
name: Marilyn

text:
I prefer to see the positive aspects of the places I visit, but the service here could...have been better. Still, the major point of a restaurant is the food, and at least the food was overall wonderful. My coworkers and I ordered our respective burgers (I had the Kruegers) and shared the giant meatball, a harvest salad, and polenta cake. The giant meatball is as big as two hands wrapped together and was fun to eat and to look at! The Harvest salad was super tasty and if you're the type to love your salad on the sweeter side, I highly recommend it!
Burger was also delicious, but the polenta cake had too many olives for my personal taste. It was enough olives that it soaked into the other ingredients so it's perfect for an olive lover and not-too great to those who aren't too keen on olives.
As for the service...well here's a picture. You and your three companions come at five pm, chose to sit outside because the weather's nice, but you waited for almost an hour to get your food and so the sun starts setting and you're starting to get cold and REALLY hungry. I'm usually sympathetic if a restaurant is crowded and understaffed, but it's hard not to get pretty hangry when you see a group that came after you get their food first. From the table right next to us.
Seeing that left a slightly bitter taste even after the food finally came.
name: Heeju

text: Patio is lovely with blankets and heaters and fountains. Service was excellent and I had shrimp and grits which I have never had before and shrimp tender, flavorful, grilled onions delish with sausage. Maple bacon scone pretty good with jam with whole berries and menu had many choices. Fresh squeezed oj was fresh and full of pulp. Latte good but pricey $6. Overall an excellent meal. I like how lunch items were available at 10am if i wanted although I didn't try them.
name: Sylvia

text: My friend liked it more than I did. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better online than it did in person. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. so yeah kind of mixed on it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nice little spot, decent portions too. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
Absolutely hands down the BEST poboy i've ever had. 
We had to wait a few minutes in line but the owner came out to assure us the line moved fast which it certainly did.
We had the WHO-DAT 8" and it was out of this world GOOD. Great amount of spice, fresh dressing of lettuce, tomatoes, pickles and bread that kept everything together thats hard to pull off when crafish bisque is added to a sandwich but this bread did it.
Really worth visiting and is now my to go place for future visits
name: David

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It looked better online than it did in person. Also, everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. maybe I just came on an off day. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Crawfish and shrimp were full of flavor. I decided to go with the boil house flavor which is Caribbean, Cajun, and garlic butter mixed. I was surprised by the minimum about of crawfish when I ordered 2lbs but the crawfish are very large and therefore you will receive about 8 crawfish per pound. If you like spicy food I would suggest extra high. I chose high and did not taste the heat I was looking for. Downside to our visit was the waitress. We waited 45min after ordering 1lb or shrimp, 2lbs or crawfish,  and wasn't checked on during that time. I would recommend this place to anyone visiting New Orleans and wanting to taste good boil seafood in a great location
name: Emmanuel

text: Great, old-fashioned style restaurant. Within my stay in New Orleans, I went back a couple of times. The food is very delicious and full of lots of flavor. The Ferdi Po'boy special was my favorite. The combo platter is amazingly delicious. The fried chicken was also pretty good. If you are in New Orleans this is a must-see place to eat!
name: Ilyssa

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. It was crowded but still moved along. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
Go for the crab: live special and the cakes! 

Absolutely delicious!! 

Chowder is to be desired, but for $1 add on and after you add Tabasco, salt, pepper....it's ok.
name: Ava

text:
Ordered a pizza with bacon, got charged for a pizza with bacon, no bacon on the pizza. On top of it all, the pizza is inedibly subpar...

I'd avoid unless you want your order messed up
name: Brendan

text: Real New York pizza, made by New Yorkers who made us feel very welcome on our first visit. The crust bridges the crispy/chewy divide perfectly, with high quality ingredients on top. It deserves its high standing here on Yelp. It's an oasis in a sea of provel-covered crackers. These folks care about the food they make and serve, and care about you as a customer. They've earned our repeat business.
name: Chili

text: I have been a frequent patron of OR smoothie for years. Much to my dismay, upon experiencing the new management that has been installed recently, the service is terrible, to the point that I will never go there again. Last time I was there I stood in line for at least 15 minutes, without even moving up. During the busy lunch time they had one person working the register taking orders and also making smoothies and doing other things. At one point another customer who had been waiting a long time got up and said "I have to leave, so you guys owe me a miracle green." No telling how long she had been waiting. I walked out.
name: Lori

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Kind of landed in the middle for me.
name: User

text: The worst service and food! I had to send my food back because it was absolutely gross and the lady was so mean about it and would not let me order something else. So i had to eat dinner somewhere else while the rest of my family ate without me. I highly recommend you question the sushi you order before you order it because, despite what the menu states, the sushi was different than what i expected.
name: Rachel

text: Lovely dinner with friends by the fireplace. Food was great, as was the ambience and service. Worth the drive for us!
name: C'Anne

text:
I love the service here! Yesterday, I went in to watch the Titans' game (even thought we lost..barely) and enjoyed myself. I really like the price on their cocktails and they are very reasonably priced! Their choice of items on tap are great. This place is very clean (including the bathrooms!).

I wish they had better priced beer. My favorite, Bearded Iris Homestyle, is priced currently at $7 compared to $5 - $6 at most local places. I would spend all day their on football watching weekends if they had a HH special of $3.50 - $4.00.

Overall, I will definitely be back! The owners are great and worked hard on getting this place legit. I know because every morning on my way to work while they were opening, I saw them both busting it early in the AM.
name: Levi

text: David the manager is absolutely adorable.....Jodi took excellent care of me and my group during a Friday afternoon. It was a great visit and the food was wonderful. We had a great time. We will be back!
name: Aisha

text: My order arrived only about 15 minutes after the expected arrival time. They were so kind as to give me a full size meal rather than the half I ordered at no charge. Plus, Jordan was very nice!
name: Taylor

text:
BEWARE! I would not trust ordering online or the app. I placed my order and the total came up one price, but when I picked it up, it charged my card a higher price. An item that was redeemed as 'free' was charged to my card. When I got home, I looked online and it showed the new higher price. Not the price it showed when I actually paid. The store could do nothing about it, and said I should call customer service. 

I did call customer service and not only could they not refund the extra money, they couldn't even reassure me that this would not happen again. 

Very disappointed in the management/customer service side. The pizza was good, but scared to order online again.
name: Teresa N Ray

text: Best food ever !! I wish we had one of this restaurants in our town.. service was good , I had the crunchy French toast, eggs and fruit , and mi friend had enchiladas they were delicious as well, the waiting time was about 40 minutes because the place was packed, but it was worth waiting .
name: Marlen

text: I had dinner at Soraya last week and it was one in this wonderful dining experience with I've had in a long time not only was it food wonderful the atmosphere was beautiful the service was superior. Our waiter Brandon was knowledgeable as well as personable and phoebe took the time to take pictures of us all. We felt welcome from start to finish I can't wait to come back and I have many people experience Suraya
name: Debbie

text:
Amazing place run by an amazing husband & wife team. 

Lunch - 2 huge slices of cheese pizza & a 12oz soda or water - $5.   And it is legit NY style pizza. Add a topping for a $1 more.  Insanely good. 

Cheesesteak - tons of steak & cheese & peppers & mushrooms & onions - on a fresh roll with a bit of toasty-ness to it.  Add jalapeños & BAM - incredible - and enough for 2 people. 

This is an authentic hole in the wall place that is absolutely outstanding.
name: Kyle Summer

text: What a terrible experience. Had a reservation for 4 people. Got there at 7:30 and didn't get our food until 9:30. We were waiting and waiting and by the time we got our food we were so upset and frustrated from waiting that we didn't even enjoy it- and the food wasn't even that great. Not flavorful at all. Wasted so mush money when we could have gone to a much better restaurant that didn't make us wait 2 hours to get bland food. Such a disappointment. Don't waste your hard earned money here.
name: Lesya

text:
Great place to pick up Indian food on the go!

It's conveniently located right by Jefferson. There are tables to sit at inside, but they have a buffet that is really popular, especially at lunch time. I usually go and pick up from the buffet, but they have a much wider selection on their menu and that food is also excellent. 

They are closed on Mondays, so keep that in mind. Be sure to get their rewards card which they stamp each time you go - after 10 stamps you get up to 1lb of food free. 

Note: in order to cash in your free meal, you must choose food from the buffet. I made the mistake once of ordering food off of the menu and then having to pay full price because the voucher was only for up to 1lb of food from the buffet. It was frustrating to find that out at the register (that rule was not clearly stated on the rewards card), so I say that here to give you a heads up. 

Overall, it's a great place!
name: Olivia

text:
Always 5 stars. Loud, busy but always great food and service. Server was Maggie --  she's a real treat. Very friendly. 

"Oh, Maggie I couldn't have tried any more- You lured me away from home, just to save you from being alone-You stole my soul and that's a pain I can do without"

Seriously, try the lo-cal biscuits & gravy, the Greek and Mexican skillets, beignets, crepes and eggs Benedict! (See pics). Oh and add a pomegranate mimosa. Happy hour 3-6  1/2 off alcohol & house wine  WOO HOO!!
name: Jenna

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Worth checking out. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything..
name: User

text: We had a great early dinner after dropping someone off at TPA. The beer menu is incredible and they break it down so you can easily find what you want. The food menu has the standard bar theme and it was served up fast!  Fish and chips had a large portion of beer battered cod and the French dip sandwich is stuffed with meat and cheese with a hot juz. We sat outside although it was a bit warm but got to see a beautiful sunset. The wait staff were professional and courteous.
name: David

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food was good and came out fast. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
I finally decided to venture out and try a new smoothie/acai bowl place and can say I was thoroughly disappointed with the acai bowl I got. I ordered the original samba and had to pay extra for blueberries and coconut, which come standard at other, slightly more expensive spots. With the blueberries and coconut, the price ended up being the same as ordering from another place. I got my bowl and went to work without checking on it. When I opened it, I was surprised to see very little acai! It was almost entirely granola and banana with small amounts of strawberries and blueberries. I ate two bites before realizing that the granola had dehydrated strawberries in it - which I can't really eat - and the whole bowl had a sickly, fake sweet taste to it. 

I have not tried the smoothies, even though some of them looked tasty, but would definitely not recommend this place.
name: Emory

text: We got a table pretty quickly. The staff was very friendly and efficient. The gyoza is some of the best I've had!! We ended up getting a second order. The sushi rolls were nice, but were really large and cut into four pieces, where I would've given 5 stars if they'd been more manageable....trying to eat them was comical, especially for our 3 year old sushi lover. We are them all though, the food quality is great!
name: McKel

text:
I love this franchise. I've been to the ones in Spokane, Roseville and South Reno. I gave a star for location, pizza and drinks. Those 3 things were on point. Service was not what I expected from Blaze. Five different young adults assisted in our order and only one of them was awesome. He had a bunch of pins on his hat, dark hair and thin. Lots of personality. My least favorite worker was the one plating the pizzas. For whatever reason he let my pizza sit in front of him while he doled out 4 others that came after me. I was actually worried that my paper had fallen and wasn't in the line up anymore. But it was there. It was odd.
They have soda water and regular water in the machine. 3 crafted sodas that are excellent, Aqua frescos, blood orange lemonade, regular lemonade and iced tea. I think they have regular sodas too but none of us had them.
name: Charmaine

text: Great atmosphere and a fun location. The sushi burritos and the poke bowls are amazing! A must try! The food is fresh and beyond delicious! A cute place to go for great food and a fun time out. They do serve alcohol which is a plus.
name: Jenn

text: This place was pretty decent. The Philly cheesesteak was good, although the peppers weren't a good addition. As a matter of fact, it would've been much better without them.... the mushrooms were good. But, because of the drawback and flavoring of the peppers, it didn't flow as well together. Their lobster bisque soup was ok. It definitely wasn't the best I've ever had... the crab fries combo was good. The two different sauces to compliment each fry was a nice touch and definitely the highlight of the whole meal. The waitress was helpful, patient and gave us some recommendations, for the items we got. Although she forgot about us a couple of times, cause she was attending to the bar, overall she was decent. All in all, this place is a 3 star, as their fries were pretty bomb and the Philly cheesesteak was decent. I'd be interested in trying their physical location, non airport, to try their full menu.
name: Dan

text: Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. For a busy night they handled it okay. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The staff seemed tired but still polite. It was crowded but still moved along. Definitely coming back. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was decent, just a little uneven.
name: User

text: Our first time at this steakhouse... and wow! We made a reservation and were seated within a few minutes. Adam was our server and was knowledgeable and enthusiastic! The tray of steaks were brought to our table and explained in great detail. Enough to make our mouth water.... we ended up ordering the 8oz filet special which came with 2 big shrimp on top, and 24oz dry aged porterhouse. We also got the garlic mashed and the cauliflower as our sides. This was the best cauliflower we've ever had! It was infused with cheeses and delicious! Our steaks were perfectly cooked and you could definitely tell the difference in taste between the two. The filet had a citrus butter sauce which made the steak "delicate" and so very tender.... the porterhouse was what I called a "real man's steak"!  Perfect!  Quite pricey but worth trying at least once!
name: Sandra

text: Oh, that ham and those po' boys! Fantastic food and service. Only complaint is that they're often crowded, but that's because they're so good!
name: Gwen

text:
Just popped in for a pickup-sandwich for lunch! The staff was super welcoming/friendly, and if possible, the food was even better! Thanks for always hitting the spot - never a bad meal here!

I do kinda regret not getting the truffle chips...these Utz aren't quite cutting it...‍

text: Only living a block away is dangerous! The al pastor tacos are my favorite, my partner favorites the steak tacos. The flavors are there, the portion sizes are there and can't wait to explore more of the menu, wish they had sides or desserts! But onwards more of the menu! I'll be back for sure

text: I've been to the Manchester location too and I dont see much of a difference between decor or the food really. What was very cool about our experience this time was the snug room we got to use. Which pretty much is just big enough for a booth that seat 6 and a pocket door. Service was great in the bar and at our table. It was prime rib night but I always get the filet anyway, can't say no to it. The food was delicious! Love Tuckers! Plus they recently were voted best in Feast for their steaks.

text: Love the huevos rancheros here. I make it a point to eat breakfast here whenever I am in town. Totally worth the wait (which on the weekend can be something)
name: Audrey

text: Wonderful fresh Italian food that is extremely authentic.  Every dish was hot, fresh and well prepared.  Seafood was fresh and fettuccine was to perfection!  Great experience thank you!
name: Todd

text:
To get this out of the way, let me start off by telling you this won't be the best pizza you've ever had. This places pizza looks and tastes just like Dominos standard crust pizza. What I do like about this place is that you don't have to commit to a single pizza, and you can pick and choose slices as you go. They usually have over 10 pizzas made and as long as its pretty busy, fresh pizza comes out on the regular. If you see a pizza on the menu that isn't out, you can ask them to make it, and in less than 5 minutes it will be done.

Even though this is not the best pizza out there, this place is a solid 4 out of 5 due to the selection of pizza, the cleanliness of the establishment, tentative staff and especially the price.... $6 for a pizza buffet is always a good deal regardless if you are sober or just woke up drunk at noon from heavy drinking the night before.
name: Jeff

text: The food was so good here! Also our waitress was Ivy and she was super helpful with everything as it was my first time here. Thank you so much to her and the manager on duty Amir was very nice. I appreciate the great food, drinks, and service!
name: Rachel

text:
Dinner at the Tavern Saturday night was our second visit to the restaurant. On both occasions the food was good, but the restaurant is very loud. We sit on the upper level on both occasions so maybe that contributed to the noise level. 

My wife had a kale and grilled chicken salad with a glass of wine and she loved it. I on the other hand went as far away from a low carb meal as possible. The Tavern Burger with fries and beer was my choice. Excellent choice and very delicious as well. Our server Ashley did a good job, but I believe the bar and kitchen service was a bit slow. Nothing terribly bad, just slow due to the number of guests.   

I do recommend the Tavern for dinner, "4 Solid Stars", but if a quite place for a conversation is your desire, The Tavern in Midtown might not be the best. Go to enjoy the food, drink and the game, but save the romantic conversations for afterwards unless screaming at each other is your thing!
name: Davis

text:
Great first time experience here! I went here for Sunday brunch recently to see what all the hype was about. I definitely understand it. Food was delicious! 

Arrived around 12:30 to a very busy restaurant. Was told our wait would be about an hour. Luckily my boyfriend wasn't sure what to order so we spent most of the time getting suggestions and looking at pictures, while enjoying some coffee beverages. After an hour we were seated at the bar and placed our orders. I heard great things about the grilled cheese dish and my boyfriend settled with the Dutch pancake with apples. We ordered a side of bacon as well. 

Once the food came out, I dug in and enjoyed every bit of it. The touch of honey on the grilled cheese really brought the flavor together. I loved having the egg on top as well. The bacon - wow. We couldn't even finish all the bacon but I loved it. We both enjoyed our meals. The items on the menu may seem strange to a first timer, but trust that you will be satisfied with anything, so give it a shot. I would love to come back to try more. 

I gave it 4 out of 5 only because I need to try more before giving it the title of "best brunch in Indy", but I was definitely impressed with what I had!
name: Whitney

text: First timer here at this location. It is very authentic Mexican! I had legua, they called it tripe, I call it busche-it was not tripe but pig intestine and chitcharon tacos. All was pretty good. I did ask if i can taste test the menudo but the waitress said they don't taste test so I guess they are too cheap for a little teaspoon to taste? I didn't bother to order cause I wasn't not going to pay $12 and not liking the way it taste. The mango margarita was great and the food came out pretty fast. The temperature is good. Overall 4 star! If they had let me tasted the menudo I would had given them 5 star.
name: Jay

text:
This is the most frustrating Subway location across the country. I have attempted to patron this location at least twice in the middle of a lunch hour in which the doors were locked and they would not let anyone in. I was told that they had been short staffed. How you have only one person working during lunch is beyond my comprehension. 

This evening I attempted to go into the location 20 minutes before closing. There were 3 employees on staff, and two of them looked at me to tell me they were closed through the window. How do their hours of operation never seem to match with the times posted on the door. 

I don't suggest anyone attempt to come to this location. It would be a 50/50 chance you would be wasting your time and for some reason or another it would be closed.
name: Rob

text:
We took our daughter and granddaughter to the Parc who had recently returned from Paris and thought the French theme would be pleasing to them.  The restaurant decor lived up to our expectations.  Our waiter took our order OK and servers delivered the food OK and the food was fine.  But the waiter totally forgot to bring tea, never came back to check on things and took forever to bring the check even though he was not super busy. 
What was most bothersome was where I was seated.  Right by a busy asle and I wouldn't have minded an occasional bump of my chair by a guest walking by, but the same waiter, not our waiter, bumped my chair multiple times even after I pulled the chair in as far as I could.  I would suggest that any one that wants to try the Parc insist on an inner table and pray they won't get a non caring waiter.  We will not return to the Parc to be ignored again.

My experience was honestly fine. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.

I always do the daily special and my tastebuds awaken to all levels of delicious flavor, between the cream cheese and the bagels, paired with La Colombe coffee, it's likely superior to any other convenient breakfast shops.
