We decided to dine upstairs and found a spot at the bar upstairs to sit.  The bartender told us that next time we could bypass the line and just go upstairs to the bar and order food from him.  Good to know.

We ordered wings with Alabama White sauce, the Pulled Pork BBQ Tray with Baked Beans and Slaw, and a Loaded Baked Potato.  We did not have to wait long for the food but when it came it was not hot.  This is one of my biggest issues with restaurant food -- if the food is supposed to be hot, serve it hot.  If it is supposed to be cold, serve it cold.  My food was supposed to be hot but I would say it was pretty darn close to room temp.  Even the BF made a comment and he never says anything about food temp.  

The wings were fine.  The pulled pork was okay but did not taste smokey or anything.  It was okay--not dry, which is a good thing.  The sauces were okay.  I was not really a fan of the Jack's Creek sauce but the Alabama White sauce was flavorful.

Our Uber driver told us that next time we should go to the Martin's at Belmont.  Apparently the downtown location is not as good as the Belmont one.  Good to know.  We will try that location out another day.  In the meantime, if I ever returned to this location and saw a long line, I would walk away.  It's not worth the wait.
name: Angela

text:
I went to VP Square today at lunch to have what would have been my first bowl of Ramen ever, but weirdly, they had no Ramen - delivery problems, they said. OK, so I had a Lemongrass bánh mì sandwich instead.  I was not disappointed in that at all!

I did ask for no cilantro, and my wish was granted (thank you), but after eating half the sandwich I noticed there were no jalapeños on it either. It turned out that was a good thing, because when they brought me some in a little container for the second half of my sandwich that I took home, I was told to be careful because the jalapeños were "ferocious", lol. Not into ferocious jalapeños, so I was glad they didn't get put on there to begin with!!  I loved the pickled carrots, radishes, cucumbers on top of the sandwich, they were slightly sweet and salty, pickle-y and really good. Oh, and there was plenty of chicken on it.

I was very happy with my sandwich, overall, but I was more happy with my Taro milk tea. It was thick, creamy, delicious. I will say that I thought I was going to get bubble tea, but realized that when I ordered, I just said "tea", and not "bubble tea" - note to myself for next time!

Nice decor, plenty of tables, bathroom was clean, and I enjoyed my quiet lunch.
name: Leslie

text: Unless you angry with your taste buds, don't waste your time or money here.  Started with the hush puppies. Very oily and lacking taste. Asked for malt vinegar to flavor. They don't have any. What seafood place doesn't have vinegar?    Ordered the fried shrimp basket with fries. Shrimp had a taste of being frozen. Fries were greasy from the cooking oil. GF ordered the snow crab with Cajun seasoning. She had to order garlic butter to kill the taste of the seasoning. Not sure where they learned to make garlic butter, but they need a lesson. Loaded, like everything else, with oil. Waiter said he would call over the manager. The woman was so busy making apologies to the other tables I didn't want to bother her with another complaint. I told the waiter we would not be returning.
name: Rob

text: I love being able to meet up with Old Friends,  and chopping it up at Chubbys.  I come here ofter,  when I am in the neighborhood. Def a great spot to enjoy a Cheesesteak and Rootbeer
name: Jae

text: We really like this place. It's fun and lively with great food and terrific service. We frequent The Palace regularly. Lots of fun!
name: Stephen

text: Excellent food, service and ambiance. Everyone was telling us that was the new great place in town so we went in there with high expectations. They were met and then some. Server was Chris, who was obviously tired due to Jazzfest tourism, but worked hard to stay friendly and engaging and did a great job at that. Oysters, Hamburger and Croque Monsieur were all excellent. My wife loved the 80's music that accompanied the amazingly decorated restaurant. You'll have to see it to believe it.
name: Scott

text: This little shop is a delight. The owners have been in the same place since I was a teen. Their caramelized Cake slices are$3 & ohhh yes you can taste the butter! Huge slices drizzled with homemade caramel sauce MADE daily. They also sell quick bites.
name: Jennifer

text:
We came to this gastropub per Yelp reviews.  It was easy enough to find and the atmosphere is very unique. They have very unusual  drinks and a good selection of local beers. There were 3 bartenders and 8 patrons during our visit.  

My DH ordered the burger and I order the Hemingway sandwich. The burger was good but the homemade chips were a bit on the greasy side.  The Hemingway was good but the fries were limp.  We sat at a table and ordered at the bar. When my husband wanted his 2nd beer he ordered it at the bar and after the bartender took his order he proceeded to make a drink for another patron and talk to another.  After a long wait he looked up and scurried down to my husband telling him he was sorry for the wait.  

The music was great, the food was OK, but the service needed some improvement.
name: Sue

text: Went here for a burger and to watch the gator game. They have a really good selection of burgers to choose from and all really good. They were cool about changing one of the TVs so my friend and I can catch the game since it was gator football season- which is really what mattered most
name: Jenn

text: By far the worst Domino's in the city. Wings were soggy, pizzas were overcooked to the point of being cardboard, and service was a joke. Would rather have left over Little Caesars. Would give negative stars if possible.
name: Chris

text: My very first restaurant in Tucson and I love it! I love the decoration and outside seating. However the restaurant does not appear at its cleanest. Food is consistently good. Service is good, tons of drinks to choose from. This place does have a laid back and cool vibe.
name: Lala

text: Best sushi place, could be a little cleaner especially in the bathrooms, it'd give me more peace of mind about eating raw fish here
name: Kyle

text: Always busy! Great beers and cocktails. I always order the coconut shrimp app. The shrimp are huge and it's almost a meal. I ordered the Chinese chicken salad with no tofu, they left the tofu out and the chicken. Which I was ok with honestly but I informed my waitress anyways. No big deal but just wanted her to know. Also the people I shared the huge table with (btw no wait time in bar or huge bar tables) they also had an issue with they're order. But the manager on that night was very attentive and accommodating and compensated for the issues. The food here is really good...bar food! Beware...there is almost always a wait time. The location is awesome, prefect place to eat and then take a walk down to the waters edge or around the funk zone.
name: Brittany

text: I LOVe Cafe Lift. The food is amazing. The parking is tough and expect to wait some time if you don't get there super early.
name: Jahee

text: I would give this place a 4, and maybe I will one day... but waiting 40min for one medium spicy catfish filet, that's just ridonkulous...
name: Marqus

text: Yesterday I went into Jimmy's for my very first time i looked around and saw a colorful wall with a dog reaching for a bowl of poke guessing that's who Jimmy is. immediately a young lady approached me and asked if i've been here before of course I said no and she explained the whole menu to me and then I decided on a regular bowl with white rice spicy crab and aloha tuna. Everything looked so good but I decided to keep it simple for my first time. I got my order to go and when I got home I opened the bag and on the top of my bowl it said "always know your worth and have an amazing day -Christina" I really needed that. I felt something on the bottom of my bowl and it was another note  it said "don't forget to smile -Christina" whomever this Christina is she has a heart of gold i'm guessing that's who took care of me at Jimmy's. Amazing customer service i'll definitely be back.
name: Chantel

text:
Absolutely beautiful view , Im still awe this is a must see if you are going to St.Pete beach
Afternoon delight as we in the area after an afternoon cruise 
We only order appetizers of calamari ,fish tacos and scallops 
My friend complained about the calamari being too salty 
The server took it off the bill and agreed  that had been a common complaint 
My scallops were a tad salty as well
The fish tacos were a hit tho Yummy
My 4 stars is the view and  South beach vibe
name: Latrice

text: I have heard this place before but never have the chance to visit. Yesterday was Helloween, to be away from those endless doorbells:)me and my husband went there and the food was surprisely good!! I have to say their mushroom pizza can be in one of the top five pizza in my life! Tons of mushroom, extremely umami! The crust is neither too thin nor too thick. The pepperoni is good too! Good quality ingredients! The appetizers were pretty good as well. Don't miss the fried fresh mozzarela ball. Once you start to eat these little evil things you will find you can hardly resist them. The vibe is relaxing ,my picky pizza eater husband said he would come back again. It says a lot.
name: Shine

text: By far my favorite sushi place in Saint Petersburg. I will drive 30+ minutes just to go to Ming Ming
name: Vivica

text:
We visited late afternoon on Sunday my husband ordered the pork saltimbocco with a side of shrimp scampi I had the filet with a side of spaghetti and meatballs. Everything was amazing!!! My husband raved about the saltimbocco and generous side of shrimp scampi my filet was perfectly cooked. Patrick, our waiter was attentive and friendly
We will definitely be coming back!! I would have posted a pic of our amazing meal but it looked and smelled so good that I forgot to, next time for sure I will!!
name: Margo

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Would return. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: We dined twice at the Palace Cafe because the service and the food were phenomenal! The cocktails compliment the food they serve. I highly recommend this restaurant!
name: Sandra

text: Everything from the service to our food was amazing. Definitely recommend the hot chicken tenders and nachos in MEDIUM.
name: Jojo

text: Awesome service! Great place if you want quiet drinks with friends. Thanks Jason for being a awesome bartender.
name: Chloe

text: I've gone multiple times, I got the chicken roll ups one time and the potatoes honestly stole the show with the vinegar. Today I got the Grilled Veggie Plate to go, so they put all the cooked veggies (which were amazing) in tinfoil to not mess up the salad -which had great dressing. And the white rice wasn't dry at all, it's my new go to menu item :)
name: Shannon

text: This place gets very busy and can be hard to find parking or seating. However, staff is usually nice and friendly. The place is very clean and food is good. My favorite is the bacon mac and cheese.
name: Helen

text: grabbed lunch here today.  Bartender/waitress was very friendly. Happened to also meet owner and chef too.  All were very welcoming and appreciative of us as new customers.  Chef was the best since he is a Boston sports fan ;)   Food was really good.  Had a BBQ rib meat and cheese over fries concoction that was great. Husband had steak sandwich and steak was tender chunks of steak, not sliced/chopped.  Will come back for drinks and to play pool. LOVE that its non smoking.  Highly recommend!
name: Kelly

text:
First impressions of this place are not great. Walking through the front door you get a direct view of what I assumed to be the kitchen, which isn't too appealing. The bar area seemed nicer than the rest of the restaurant -- floors in the main area were sticky to walk on, they had giant bags of some kitchen item piled high in the middle of the room, and booths are uncomfortable.

To eat, I ordered the BBQ burger with no bacon or onions, medium-well. The burger was decent, although it wasn't medium-well and actually a little dry. The best part of the meal was the fries. They're flavorful, cooked perfect, and seasoned wonderfully.

I wouldn't be back for the food, but I would definitely come back for the fries.
name: Katie

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Not bad for a quick meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: So i came here with my sister because both of us heard great things about this place and so we made a reservation over the phone (pretty easy and quick). getting there was a bit "out of the way" (not walkable) so you have to uber/lyft/drive (not too bad), it's in the garden district so you can visit the houses over there (the commander's palace offer a free self walking tour guide so you can do that before while you're waiting for after you eat) or even go to the graveyard right in front where shows have been filmed. i was honestly a bit tipsy before coming here so i can't tell you exact details (oops) but the restaurant honestly looks like someone's mansion where they're hosting a grand luncheon. we were in the "garden" room so we walked past the kitchen into this room where it oversees the garden which was beautiful (you can ask for the room in advance if you please!) there also is a jazz trio who goes around asking for requests and will play you music while you dine which was pretty great. there is a dress code here so you have to make sure you're dressed to impress (no shorts, no t-shirts, nothing informal). the food itself wasn't bad, i wasn't too hungry and got only the turtle soup which was pretty good (reminded me of tomato soup) while my sister went all out and got the milk liquor and some entre (that i can't think of the name) but she enjoyed it. overall, i think this place is great in terms of atmosphere but definitely a place you'd come for classy ambiance than the food (the price matches the classiness so if you're trying to save money but want a taste of NOLA i think this place isn't for you)
name: Sue

text:
This In-N-Out Burger is convenient to my workplace. I've had issues with them repeatedly serving nearly-raw meat. I'm not one who resists eating rare meats, but burgers and fast food don't tend to do well in the long run serving undercooked meat. It's not expected to get a tiny patty which is still rare when you're dining at fast food establishments. This was really my only complaint in the past, but for the past several months this has not been an issue.

The staff is exceptional. They're courteous and quick. They get my orders right, the place is always bright and very clean, and prices are great. I can order how I want, which can be pesky and complex, but when I get my burger it's just right. Im so glad to be able to give them a 5-star review!
name: Ellen

text: Overrated, absolubtely nothing special, and the worse part thieves. If you really plan to go, take the exact amount of money that you will spend. They only accept cash, and they do not give change back, i spent 10 dollars and gave the waiter a 20 dollar bill and he ran with my money, never got my change back
name: J

text: If you have no other option of another restaurant and you go to this La Guanajuato, I recommend that if you get a waitress named TERESA, go running, you will lose your money. la verdad este lugar es bueno por la comida pero el servicio de las meseras es pésimo maneje 25 minutos para tener una cena con mi hija y la mesera fue  muy grosería  a ella no le importo que hubiera una niña menor con migo su actitud era pésima como si le estuviera pidiendo comida gratis  he estado en otros restaurantes y  los meseros son muy atentos y la verdad no recomendaría este lugar por que  la cajera y los meseros tratan mal a la gente piensan que estamos alli por comida gratis. si no tienes otra opción de otro restaurante  y vas en este La Guanajuato te recomiendo que si te dan una mesera llamada  TERESA sal corriendo perderás tu dinero.
name: Edy

text:
I think I miss Houston Vietnamese food too much. My hometown has basically spoiled me from anything I eat elsewhere, not just for the variety and great flavors but for the prices as well. Asian food seems to come off as "exotic" and trendy here so prices are marked up also because of the location the establishments are as well.  I keep hoping for a great banh mi.  InterAsian takes the cake for the pure simplicity of what it's supposed to be without charging you $8-10 bucks for on.  Their  bread they use is too soft for the sandwich.  There needs to be a flakiness to your bite, not all soft textures.  Their pho is decent but the broth doesn't give me any wows. It hits the spot when you're craving and tired of looking for another pho place that isn't on other side of town and usually cash only.

Also, I keep looking for someone to have cuom thit nuong. Such a simple dish yet no one really makes it.  Throw an over easy egg and your day is made.  At least they have Vietnamese coffee that isn't pre-jugged already.
name: Mike

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not bad for a quick meal. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text:
I highly recommend this place for good food and great service. We went when it was really busy, they had two servers, one bartender and one bar back. Once a party left, the tables where cleaned in minutes, the server was personable yet professional. 

I ordered the jambalaya pasta, it was delicious. I could have gone with a spicier hot link sausages they use. But not everyone has my taste buds, so I understand why they don't. My boyfriend had the prime rip, the meat was good quality and tender. The vegetables where cooked correctly, I hate when mixed vegis are over cooked.
name: Christina

text: Tasty overall, especially the provolone cheese, and the meat was juicy and tender, but not a huge fan of the rabe. With that said, there wasn't anything spectacular about this, perfectly good sandwich...but not 5 star exceptional/must try. #overhyped but not bad. Probably wouldn't wait in line for this.
name: Belinda

text: So good we came back the next morning for brunch!  I can't say enough about the World Travel charcuterie board... it is a must try!  Brunch was equally as enjoyable.  All staff was phenomenal and accommodating, atmosphere was bustling without being overwhelming, and food was out of this world.  Thank you for adding to our enjoyable experience in Philly!
name: Allie

text: Great spot for some super tasty barbecue, and also some local beers. The portions weren't quite as huge as some of the other barbecue places in town, but they definitely made up for it with care and craft. Absolutely delicious sauces!
name: Andrew

text: This is the kind of place you go and sit and hear stories. Everybody's got one. If you sit long enough you will eventually tell your own story. Food is good, coffee fair. Fresh muffins Tuesday mornings. Crab cakes on first fridays. Homemade everything. Slammin' quiches, mac n cheese, burgers, bbq is even offered from time to time. The owners Scott and Theresa are delightful people and have been here almost 30 years. Also good at catering.
name: James

text:
Calzone heaven! Had the "what came first", had the chicken and the egg, definitely tasted the tender flavor chicken first. The egg was there but secondary to the flavors, which included fresh jalapeño and onion. Great Calzone, But don't stop there, try the unique offerings of the fountain soda, the cream soda is excellent!
Great casual environment, staff was friendly and helpful.
name: Don

text:
SIMPLY THE BEST! BETTER THAN ALLLLLL THE REST! 

Each time you leave me I start losing control! I can feel you even when I'm alone! Oh, baby, don't let go! You're the best, better than all the rest! Better than anyone, anyone I ever met! I'm stuck on your heart
I hang on every word you say! Tear us apart,
Baby I would rather be dead! Oh you're the best!
name: Stevie

text:
Came here last night for a 8:30pm reservation for restaurant week. The size of the place is about a living room, tables very compacted and close together. Tables wobbly and very small even for my 5 foot stature. The bathroom was incredibly tiny even for my size - The smallest closet size. 

I had Caesar salad for my first appetizer part of restaurant week. It was very yummy besides the anchovies.

I then had Eggplant stew and it is not a stew from what I imagined. The consistency for the stew was crunchy- chunky not soft which was unexpected. I absolutely deplore parsley and there was a lot of it on it, unfortunately the menu didn't say there would be parsley in them. I thought the taste was just ok.

For entree I had salmon which was great except for the parsley on the plate. I thought the carrot and the shaved vegetables mixed well. The way the salmon was cooked surprised me but it mixed well. I thought it could've used more sauce on the dish. 

The dessert was delicious I had the ice cream which was absolutely perfect. 

I think the place could really benefit a big renovation or just moving in general to a different location. The uncomfortableness if the place really hurt my experience.  There were too many tables shoved in one living room space and the bathroom degraded the whole experience. Everytime the door opened, the entire room felt how cold it was. I spent ~$75 for 2 people then tip. I don't think it was worth that much. 

With that being said, I left knowing that although the food was good to great at times there are better places to eat Caesar salad from, and salmon from. I would not get the eggplant stew again if I were ever to come back. I might come back for the ice cream, but honestly I could probably just go to Franklin fountain for the same price. Honestly I give this place a 3.5 stars, really could improve on the dining experience.
name: Ling

text: A quant place in the French Quarters.  The gentleman at the hostess stand was so nice and accommodating.  The service by the wait staff was slow.  I highly recommend the charbroiled oysters! Delicious!!
name: Janet

text: The food was really good and so were the prices. I'm from Vancouver and am here visiting family and in Vancouver we don't have any Somali restaurants so this was refreshing. First of all, the soup was perfect, the meat was soft and easy to chew and the baasto was perfect.
name: Ikram

text: My husband and I had a lovely date night tonight at Prime 55 (on the corner of Rosedale and Delmar). Cajun seafood and steak themed menu with some cool vegetarian options. We sat outside on this beautiful evening. Had a delicious meal and enjoyed great interactions with many of the staff, including the chef who came out to check on us. Prime 55 is relatively new and tweaking their food and drink menu, but everything we had was great - lobster cheese fries, shrimp and grits, and a rib eye. Check it out!
name: Tracy

text:
We were in for the first time in a while and I'm so pleased with the changes that have been made since the new ownership. The dinner specials have been so creative and introduce new flavors and food combinations, something the Yardley Inn has lacked in the past. Chef Alex really knows how to perfectly execute an amazing meal. Our server Alexa is so sweet and attentive with a smile on her face. I love that the new dessert menu offers French inspired dishes. 

We had: 

Calamari- good, but not great. A little rubbery and soggy but still edible. 
Dinner special*Baby shrimp risotto with roasted cherry tomatoes and fennel- excellent! I know it sounds simple, but the seasonings added created such a unique flavor. The waitress said it had cumin and other various spices. Perfect flavor. 
Filet Mignon with creamed spinach and Au Gratin potatoes- my dad said it was great! Cooked to perfection.
name: Ashley

text: This is THE BEST BBQ I have ever had! My son and I were on a road trip and decided to stop in Saint Louis for some grub. The atmosphere was great, and the service was so fast that the food was ready before we sat down! Every one working there was polite and friendly, especially Auggie, who treated us like family, and made us feel right at home. The food was spectacular, especially the homemade sauces.  I recommend the ribs and the Cranberry Cayenne BBQ sauce.
name: Edmund

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Not a big fan of all you can eat sushi places but decided to give this place a try. The quality of the sushi was ok and they have a descent variety. However, the service was horrible. We sat and ordered then waited. I noticed that several tables that were seated when we arrived had no food and they didn't get any for a while. So of course our order took a long time as well. The sodas are not refilled, they give you the can. After our first round we tried to flag down someone for menus to order again. We were told to wait and we didn't get them for a while. After we placed our order was another long winded wait. We asked for water and told to wait again. They brought out half our order then suddenly became attentive and kept asking if we wanted to order anything else. We said no we're still waiting for the rest of our order. After a while it finally came out. It felt as if they were trying to trick us into ordering more then have the rest of our order show up late in hopes of us getting more than we could eat so we'd have to pay for leftovers. The food was ok but the service and waiting made the experience feel worse. The other Sushi Club location is waaaayyyyy better.
name: Sharon

text:
First time here. Been capital grille and flame stone for steak before and have some expectations based on the price range. Ordered a crispy gator and a "house special" Potterhouse steak that come with crab cake. Thought well at least their steak is aged so hoping their quality at least equal to the other two I went. 
Not so much. First of all, the gator come out like popcorn chicken. Those pieces are super small and over cooked. Never had any gator in Florida that bad. Then when the steak come out, the waiter drop the steak knife right on my arm. Lucky me it wasn't cut my arm open. Next, the steak is terrible. Full of tendons and gristle. Very tough. Beside they put a lot of truffle oil on top of it in which cover up the favor of the steak. 
Friend of mine ordered double chicken which is over cook. The breading thicker than the chicken itself. 
 When the bill come, I was like wow. They add 18% on the check by default for service. Man, almost got my arm cut and still have to paid 18% tips?? What the hell. 
If you really want a nice piece of steak, try flame stone or capital grille instead. But if you want to show off your wallet and not so concern your dinner, then this place is a bomb.
name: Lawrence

text: Would have liked to had the opportunity to enjoy the food and drinks here. Sadly, we took a Lyft from the opposite side of the city to go. Arrived at 9:13PM on Sunday night only to be turned away. They were scheduled to close at 10PM. We were told that they were closing early due to issues in the kitchen. People were in there, eating. No invite back and no apology.
name: Lisa

text:
It's hard to fathom why this place is so F'd up, however, check out the plentiful one star reviews and a consistent theme emerges.

Booze is pricey but nicely done at the main bar.
Sides seem to be at least edible. And downhill we go...
They couldn't get their signature OMG burger right x2 - maybe it stands for obviously mutchered grub?
only minimally grilled? ( was not barely warm )
ondansetron ( nausea med ) mandatory get?
Either way, as Joey's older brother says  in "A History of Violence", "How do you f_ck that up?!!!".

And violence is what it would take to get me back
in there. Needs better management, menu, waitstaff - sad.
name: Chris

text: My husband & I love this place. The food is excellent. The service is great. The staff is friendly.
name: Debbie

text: It's all about the Ugly steak!!! If you are reading this and thinking of going to Dickman's you MUST try the ugly steak. At times the customer service isn't the most loving but they are certainly efficient and what would you expect from a meat market.  I have been shopping at Dicks since 1996 at the old shop on broadway and Camino seco and plan on going until I can't chew meat
name: Ricky

text: Went here for a last minute date night. We've been here several times in the two years. The service is always polite and fast paced. Usually the line is out of the door with people waiting to be seated. Although it can be crowded the line moves fast. Once seated service does seem a bit rushed, which is cause for my four stars. They kinda work to get you in and out for others to be seated. We mainly come for the dumplings because honestly there aren't many appealing (in my opinion) options. I usually get the crabmeat & pork soup dumplings. BOMB!
name: Monica

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not bad for a quick meal. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Not bad for a quick meal. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
Such good food!! And not to mention quick service. Didn't have to wait long and the ambiance was perfect. Casual dining at its finest. Clean, open, and spacious with restroom in the back. Perfect quick stop. 
They also have a drive thru--can't get any better. Red and white menudo on weekends only. The menu is easy on the eyes too lol

Update--needed to mention the horchata is AMAZING! Not too much cinnamon--it. Was. Perfect. Wife said the 2 beef tacos were bomb and she kept refilling her soda which means it's was perfect too! We will definitely be back.
name: LaNoya

text: Great pizza-ingredients are super fresh.  "Build Your Own" with the vast array of ingredients can't be beat. The staff is helpful and friendly and doesn't mind when my husband overdoes his like the attached picture shows.
name: Lyn

text: Great variety of unique delicious complex flavors true to plant based diets with protein options
name: Gazza

text: We had a perfect dinner at Vicenta's and the service was the best I've had! Erick was the sweetest server and made our experience incredible we will be back!
name: K

text: For the price I expected more than this. For a busy night they handled it okay. The wait felt longer than it should have. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Everything was excellent and our server was very entertaining!  It can be a little noisy when families are dining, so if you like things quieter, it might be best to go later in the evening.
name: Mike

text: Just left the restaurant with great disappointment. I was born and raised on the island. Have lived in FL for 38 yrs. We were told about this rest opening some months ago and were really looking forward to going today and having a great time. I know what good service is and sadly can't say I had it at this location. Food taste is a 5/5, prices for the amount of food is a tad pricey for the type of business. 4/5. However, the waiter was obviously not familiar with the menu. Turns out it was their second day open. I understood that....just when we were going to order our meal he tells us to tell him again what was it we wanted as an appetizer because he had lost our original order! We said forget the appetizer, just place the order for the main food. Then when the food came out the waiter admitted he had placed the wrong order and kept saying "no worries, I'll take it off the bill I'll pay it". We explained it wasn't about getting a free meal but eating what was ordered. My husband ordered again and when they brought the second plate it still was the wrong meal! They did deduct the meal but this did not fix the fact that I ate alone while my husband was waiting for his meal (he ate the rice) and by the time his meal arrived I sat there watching him eat parts of a chicken he did not order. I understand it's your second day but this is your third establishment. There's no excuse! Very disappointed. Get your act together or you will be sent Pal Campo!
name: T

text: Atmosphere is amazing.  Food was amazing.  Steaks were cooked to perfection. The baseball cut sirloin was awesome.  Filets were great!   Stuffed chicken was delicious.  Service was great.  Nothing bad to say.  Keep it up.
name: Debbie

text:
Currently dining here. We have a timer running because we sat 25 minutes before someone took our order. Our appetizers just came out but we still do not have our drinks. This service is atrocious. The appetizers taste delicious but they came before our drinks and before we had plates. The drinks came 21 minutes ago and we still don't have entrees.

Amended ----the service turned around and the manager Sadie came over and apologized for lapse in standards.

Would return again. Just not if I'm in a hurry
name: Rob

text: I think it was probably top 5 BBQ places I have ever tried. My favorite food was ribs with a dry rub and sauce on the side. I think pinto beans were god too. I would recommend this place!
name: Puneet

text: This is hands down the best pizza in the area. Crisp, thin crust, great tasting sauce and a generous hand when it comes to toppings.  The owner and staff are friendly and attentive. I lived in NYC for nearly 25 years and I know good pizza. This is the closest you will get to NYC style pizza in South Jersey. You may have to wait a bit to get your pizza on a weekend night, but trust me it will be worth it.
name: M

text: We ordered a 12" chicago style cheese pizza. Was told the wait would be 45 mins, got there in 46 and rushed back to the house to eat, didnt even bother checking the food. We got a 12" pan style cheese pizza (still was charged for the chicago style) with undercooked dough and the pizza had cold spots throughout. The sauce was good but honestly, reading the reviews, I expected a lot more than what we got. I'm too antisocial to actually call and complain so this is the most I'll do, in case you were wondering.
name: Erik

text: My favorite Resturant in Philly. The calamari salad is my absolute favorite, along with the lobster Mac and cheese. Good selection of beer, especially some local ones! Our service is always excellent. Tyler took care of us this time and was great!!
name: Brianna

text:
So I've been to pelicana three times so I have a good idea is what I like about the restaurant and what I dislike.

1.) the restaurant can get pretty loud and rowdy so I recommend going earlier especially since they have good happy hour deals

2.) I highly recommend the bulgolgi nachos and shared many people especially since it is huge. This is one of the best dishes heh offer 

3.) Do not get any of the garlic favors for the chicken because they are too saucy and thick

4.) my favorite favor is the sweet and spicy level one. It isn't that spicy and more on the sweet side.
name: Sarah

text:
This is essentially Mediterranean chipotle. I'm not a fan of chipotle but this food I for sure like. You order your base with a protein and vegetables. There's also a few sides you can get like hummus, peta etc. Once your bowl is made you pay at the counter and you're ready to go. When I went there was no line and the transaction from start to finish lasted about 1-2 mins it was great because I was starving.

The food was really good I must say. Everything tasted fresh and was cooked well. The staff at the counter were polite, cheerful and helpful. This is very close to my office so I will most definitely be coming back.
name: Miguel

text: I simply luv this place It's a nice alternative to Ruth's Chris. The roasted cedar plank cauliflower is to die for & the steaks are very flavorful In addition the service is exceptional I will def be returning
name: K

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
The service is slower than a sloth in slow-mo, but when it's busy, that's to be expected. It's the middle of Octoberfest, so you better believe it's busy!
The food is always good, though very different from the typical American version of German food.
The prices are up there, $30+ per person, but (again) remember that this is German food imported from Germany and cooked by people trained specifically.
They have a limited beer list, but they give you plenty of it.
name: Matthew

text: Service was quick and friendly. Seafood gumbo and crab cakes were great. Crab cakes had a bit of a kick. Staff there were very attentive.
name: Heather

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Pretty happy with it overall. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Ran in to grab two slices just to check out the pizza. First bite: WOW! Thin and crispy crust! I couldn't stop raving. I was a little skeptical by the "sell by the slice" concept, but I'm sold. My husband and I are excited to go back and try the rest of the menu!!
name: Noi

text: Awesome place to have breakfast or brunch it has a Hometown feel all the locals come here to eat.  the food is fresh and made from scratch.  staff is always friendly and they remember you. nice little touch
name: Susan

text: On that real real, this place was average. Good atmosphere and drinks, but the food was over priced and C+ / B- at best. For the price, I'm sure there's better.
name: Steve

text:
Listen...this here restaurant is a true gem and definitely worth the 45 minute wait. Our server, Cree, was pleasantly funny and our food was a combination of alright, good, delicious and delicable between for orders. 
Cajun Crawfish Pasta with 2pc Catfish 
Pasta Lenora 
Fried Chicken  with Cabbage and Mac n Cheez
Shrimp Platter with Mac n Cheez
Jumbo Crab Claws
Onion Rings

Although I am a visitor of NO, I can see myself coming back to this place when I visit NO again.
name: Symone

text:
A staple in South Tampa. We went for a morning walk and ended up in Soho for breakfast (needed energy for the walk back:). Great atmosphere inside and out with others waiting to be seated. Very hospitable staff. Ate outside as it was nice and cool. Server acknowledged us immediately. We ordered The Goat (omelette with goat cheese, sautéed spinach, topped with fresh avocado and The Carnivore (omelette with diced ham, turkey sausage, crumbled bacon, scallions with cheddar cheese). Both meals came with two sides: 1) bread: bagel, toast (multi-grain, rye), or English muffin, and 2) grits, home fries, fresh fruit, or oatmeal. Drank coffee (delicious) and H2O. Servers work together to ensure satisfaction (great teamwork) by offering refills, etc. Very reasonable prices.
Nice spacious, renovated restrooms.
Haven't dined here for many years before this morning; much better than I remember!
So glad we dined at Daily Eats!
And yes, it gave me the energy to make it all the way back home (we even took the longest route:).
name: Misty

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kinda leveled off after a few bites. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
Atmosphere is great, so was the service and staff.  Across the board it was good, excellent smoke flavor and taste.  My problem was the wings were horribly dry.

I know I get it, it is hard to smoke and serve it with that fresh off the grill flavor and consistency with bbq and serve it several hours later but these were beyond serving someone dry and the appearance suggests they were dry, bottom line they never should have left the kitchen.

In the future I will just get the pulled pork, it is always spot on good.

Tip: once they run out of something they are out until the next day so go early.
name: Ethan

text: Ok we flew in to the EYE airport very nice, a quick walk across the street 3 minutes tops. Made reservations on a Thursday night for two, 8:00 pm probably didn't need them the place was only 2/3 full. That's the good part took 10 minutes for water and unsweetened tea the wife ordered a beer after 10 minutes I asked about where it was took another 10 min for the not so cold beer to arrive. We both ordered the mahi-mahi $30 each not great presentation just so-so was delivered by the staff using a dirty rag to carry them. What a turn off. The bread was good. Probably won't be back at this price point the customer service was horrible. Very slow never came back to check on us, empty drinks.
name: Darian

text: When it comes to good times, good people, and good food these guys got it down. Topping choices are on point. They keep a clean environment and sincerely make sure you feel taken care of.
name: Alex

text: For the price I expected more than this. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. Just not for me. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would prob stop in again if nearby. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy.
name: User

text:
So impressed with this spot! Service and staff are incredible, and were definitely accommodating for seating our large party! It gets quite busy inside, but there are seats outside as well for those who want a quieter experience. 

Their extensive beer list always gives us something new to try every time we visit! Happy Hour offers awesome deals on the many beers they have on tap! Their list reaches up to a little more than 50 draft beers, most brewed from local breweries. They also have other spirits there, for those that may want a change from beer and hard cider. 

Awesome place for throwing a party or for a fun date night!
name: Chelsea

text:
I keep hearing about their donuts, being really good and totally different in comparison to Beiler's (my job's favorite). They are totally different types of donuts! I enjoy the cakey texture of the donuts in Federal Donuts. I had their cinnamon, cookies and cream, and strawberry lavender. I just really didn't like the granulated sugars on the donuts as it gets pretty messy. But I can tell the donuts itself would go so well with warm milk or some hot delicious coffee! I would like to try their chicken sandwich very soon. 

I love the very fact this place is extremely close to Dizengoff, and that it's technically owned by the same mastermind chef. I will be coming here monthly... to keep my cravings in check!
name: Jeannie

text: Nice little Cuban restaurant. Sandwiches are gigantic and sides are good sized portions. Nothing skimpy in sandwiches or food here. Make sure to reserve a spot for their monthly gourmet chef dinner!
name: Steve

text:
I love everything I've ever gotten at this bakery. The duck is amazing, custards, bean sesame balls, toro puffs, coconut buns, they're all fresh and tasty.
I find that if you show up right when they open they only have about 20% of their shelves filled, but they make new items and fill the shelves throughout the day.
The bubble tea is also very tasty, although I once ordered the mango balls to go in it, and there was some black stuff on some of the jellies. :0
name: Tricia

text: It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Food was fresh and service was quick. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Worth checking out. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: We had the made to order crazy roll and it was tasteless. The roll was loosely wrapped so it fell apart as soon as it was picked up. The roll contained pickled radish, imitation crab meat, and eggs. It was also very expensive at $6.95 for 8 pieces.
name: Dee

text: Dined here last night and it was really good! The restaurant itself is hip and modern. Reasonable prices for food, drinks overpriced though. The flavors of the food were great and this is probably the best place for Korean bbq in Tucson.
name: helen

text:
Really love this new space; atmosphere is beautiful. Wished I lived to closer to enjoy date night here more often. Overall the food was very good. Service was a bit slow at times, but even the manger came by to check on us so overall great service. 

They really are trying to provide a more traditional tapas menu with their own twist. We wanted to stick to a bit of traditional and a bit of local. I can honestly say I recommend all of these dishes: Gambas Al Ajillo, Papas Bravas, Octopus, and Scallops. We also really appreciated their wine list. The prices of the wine by the glass allowed us to have a few different wines at the table as we tasted through their menu - a white, rose, and red - amazing selection on the wines of things you can't find just anywhere. 

Looking forward to trying this place again to try and eat through more of the menu.
name: Amanda

text:
This was me and my girlfriend's first time at the restaurant, and we will be back!  So good!  The atmosphere is welcoming and open, with plenty of good Indie Rock music playing.  There are some great beers on tap, and amazing strawberry lemonade.

My girlfriend and I had the Sticky Garlic Twists to start, and the Pig Destroyer pizza.

Everything was delicious!  The garlic twists came with two sauces, a marinara and a kind of ranch dressing, but tasted fresh-made.  The twists were hot and chewy but not too hard to eat.

The Pig Destroyer was a very flavorful and enjoyable pizza.  It had the right amount of spiciness mixed with savory meats.

Go eat there and enjoy a fantastic date, lunch meal, fun dinner!!
name: Tim

text: Great food, great drinks, and great service! Desmond took care of us! If you like avocado, the fried avocado on your burger is yummy!
name: Susie

text: This is a cute, hole-in-the-wall cafe was a tasty find! With a traditional beach-front vibe, the kitchen right in front of the front window, and local pictures on the walls (the tornado / water-spout pictures rock!), The Beach Shanty is a fun placemto be.  Noelle was a really good server. She was fun, attentive, and helpful. The prices are reasonable, and the food was fantastic! Try the onion rings, seriously.  Our friends had been told multiple times that this place was a must, and with good reason.  Don't miss the Beach Shanty Cafe next time you're at Clearwater Beach!
name: Mike

text:
The food was decent; I had the pot roast (which was the star of the dish) with carrots and mashed potatoes. My husband ordered the cauliflower appetizer and everyone else at the table loved it! The drinks were reasonably priced and the service was great. 

The rooftop bar was a very young and rowdy crowd; not my cup of tea.
name: Erin

text: The fish tacos were amazing!! I usually wouldn't order something like this - but I'm so happy I did. The service was fast and the food came out SO fresh. Can't wait to go back next weekend!!
name: Gabby

text: This hit the spot after a hard day of work and the prices are good too. Friendly service, easy going, Carp vibe.
name: Michael

text: Easily the best vegan burger I have ever had! It actually taste like a burger! Mind blown!
name: Chantell

text: Iconic restaurant in the St Louis area!  Great service, great people and great location!
name: Eric

text: Wow. I've been at the drive in window for 12 minutes now waiting. I'd leave but I already paid. There is a line of at least 8 cars behind me. Too bad no one in charge will care. I live me some Taco Bell but not this one!!  I'm baffled at how this place is even remotely still in business. Thing is there's like five guys running around looking busy.
name: John

text: Will never go here again. Food is sub par, service is slow. I even tried to order through door dash and that was a complete disappointment. After already waiting for an hour, my delivery person informed me that the restaurant was already too busy with existing customers to make my food and it would be another 40 minutes before they could even start cooking it. I ended up canceling and going somewhere else. I won't even bother with this place next time.
name: Michelle

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It was crowded but still moved along. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. For the price I expected more than this. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything..
name: User

text: We were in a hurry to catch a plane. But it was great. We weren't dressed up but we never felt uncomfortable. The meat is excellent. They ask how you like it cooked and selected from areas on the skewer. It was just like I like it. The salad bar is big and excellent selection. I would go back. They have restaurants all over the US I'll be looking for it.
name: Edie

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: Hands down best Dave & Buster's ever! The manager was great! Joe took points from his own account to get us a gift! Highly recommend! Thank you joe
name: Korey

text: Best steamed clams, best baked clams, wonderful staff, beautiful views.  We will return!
name: Janene

text:
I usually don't venture from my typical spots for Taco Tuesday but I was feeling a little adventurous this week so I decided to try this new place!  Upon entering you had to stand in line to place your order. The entrance of the restaurant may not look very impressive, but their yard and outdoor seating create a great ambience. 

It's a great place to go grab a drink on a warm day and hang out with friends.  Unfortunately, I wasn't able to enjoy a drink myself but from what I heard they are not good, but not quite worth the price.  Now for the tacos...overall they were quite average. I am a fan of chicken tacos so I went with those. I'm one to pour a generous amount of sauce on top for some extra flavor but I wasn't very impressed with their selection.  The tacos were on the drier side overall in my opinion.  I would say in comparison to other places in the city, there's better out there. 

Overall, I'm glad I tried this place, but for now, I'm going to have to stick to my usuals!
name: Avani

text: I go to BB's to listen to the best band ever because their music is relaxing. After I've had a long week at work I come to listen to them. I came this past weekend and the band was not there. I listened to the band there but I didn't stay long. They need to bring back the band I've gone to see every weekend for the last 2 years from Memphis.
name: Alexandrea

text:
Barrio Bread is fantastic. It's not just a place that makes bread but a total experience. My husband told me that we needed to arrive before they opened on a Saturday morning which I thought was crazy. Who buys bread on Saturday before 9am? Well, apparently everyone buys BARRIO Bread at that time. We were there 20 minutes before the store opened and there were already 15 people ahead of us in line waiting for the doors to open. I couldn't believe it.

You can see the owner making the bread through the tall glass doors. While the shop really only fits about 5 people at a time the line moves quickly. By the time the doors actually opened, the line behind us had tripled and was almost back to Broadway. 

Barrio Bread has so many options with beautiful designs on the loaves. Prices range based on the size of the loaf you get but it's all worth it!
name: Elizabeth

text: My sandwich and salad were good.  Nice atmosphere. Our server appeared distracted by waiting on only one table of guest who it appeared that she knew. The only words she said besides asking us for our order was "have a good one" when she gave us our change for our bill.  I'll go somewhere else next time.  It was obvious my business didn't matter.
name: Michelle

text:
OMG !! I would definitely come here again ... and next time with bunch of other friend to introduce korean BBQ in fancy way but at lot cheaper price. Price is very friendly and we ate so much. 
This place needs to be recognized... my wife loved it.
name: Michael

text: Not bad for a quick meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Paid a ridiculous price for "gourmet" pizza.  First the crust was about two inches wide.  I'm not paying for bread.  I came in for pizza.  The size was way smaller than a regular large pie.  It tasted ok but not for that price.  I was really expecting a WOW effect, but there was none there.  And empty tables in a village on a Friday night has to tell you something.
name: John

text:
This place has great food! It has lots of indoor seating and I had no problem finding street parking on a weeknight. Service is very friendly, and I think they might have given us complimentary horchata. Tried the gorditos de frijoles y queso, the chilaquiles, and the veggie burrito. All were delicious, the gorditos was nice and crispy around the edge, the chilaquiles had a really flavorful sauce, and the veggie burrito was pretty standard, but good. 
One negative, we saw a little cockroach on the booth while we were sitting there, but not a huge deal to me. Reasonably priced food and good portions. It seems like a nice local spot, and I would come back here if I were staying in the area.
name: Julia

text: Find a good taco place close to home first walked in greeted by friendly staff sat at the bar place is very clean well-decorated. I will say looking at the menu at first it was confusing they have taco as their name and it was tough just to find a Taco on the menu they only had value meals not too much to look at as far as picking out a taco. Looking at the price of the tacos or 4 bucks a piece which is pricey however getting their value meal of three tacos you get to choose from two sides I chose the Mexican street corn and the refried beans which are fabulous I had two beef tacos 1 chicken the beef was plain and simple just the way I like it the chicken was excellent tender juicy tasty also have a flat of beer. I will be back they're just getting started but for just getting started they're pretty well prepared hopefully maybe they make it easier to find an order tacos or maybe trade in your two sides for an extra taco.
name: Bruce

text: It's ok, like it's pretty litty. I ate the American hamburger and salad it was so good. I also liked the chicken wings and french fries.
name: Janan

text: First time here and first impressions are it's a nice friend meeting place. It can get a bit noisy outside dining would've been a better choice. The food was a bit overpriced but the black bean burger was delicious. The chili cheese chips were tasty. The pizza puff was an amped up hot pocket. Wouldn't seek this place out but if a group wanted to try it out I would come back. The waitress was pleasant and attentive.
name: Kim

text: Best home Down Louisiana cooking! Customer service is excellent and the catfish is great!
name: Fern

text: My cousin prefaced our visit by saying the service wasn't good, she wasn't kidding. My family walked in and were the only guests. There were at least 4 or 5 people we saw working, but it took forever to bring out our order. We ordered several pies and drinks, they brought them out one at a time.  When asked where the missing food was they looked confused then said "oh there was a lot on your order, we must have missed that'. Then a minute later they said it was in the oven. Perhaps they had another order with the same thing they were just going to swap out. But when they brought the final pizza the crust wasn't even cooked! For the price I would think they could make sure to be checking off everything on our order. Glad we got out when we did as it started getting crowded and loud.
name: Dave

text:
I was hesitant to go here, and more skeptical to take my boyfriend, but we ended up enjoying it! The sushi was not bad and fresh. Lots to chips from. The cooked food was decent. I enjoyed the chicken on the stick, the orange chicken, lo mein and fried rice to mention a few. Unfortunately, we didn't have room for the Mongolian type grill. We were too busy trying items from the huge buffet and of course needed to save room for dessert. Many options of fruit, cakes, and Ice cream!

The staff didn't know much English as others have mentioned BUT they were attentive enough.  Not overly, but they were around to take dirty plates and refill glasses.

I would go again.
name: Gina

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: It looked better online than it did in person. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Just not for me. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Not bad for a quick meal. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Great atmosphere. Amazing. Food And good prices. Next time I'm in this area will definitely be eating here again
name: Guy

text: The bacon, egg, and cheese on a roll is the best I've ever had. C'est magnifique! I recently had mother's day brunch at a fancy main line restaurant, and they could use a lesson on how to do bacon right from Tommy D!
name: Jennifer

text: I've had several ramen in my life, including in London and San Francisco and this is my favorite by far!!! Quick service, great taste, super tasty. 101% recommended
name: Stefano

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot.
name: User

text: Go for the octopus balls, chicken wings and fish balls--exquisite!  And save room for the mango smoothie.  The staff patiently took photos of our party. This cafe is a real treasure.
name: George

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. For a busy night they handled it okay. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text: Had a birthday dinner for my brother. It was delicious. Creative menu has lots of variety.
name: Melissa

text: Awesome place, Ashley...you are the best, your smile and your personality was top notch. We will be back because of you.the rum runners are the best
name: Andreas

text: There are so many delicious items on the menu it was hard for me to narrow it down! I ended up getting the New Mexican shredder bowl, and a captain crunch french toast. The flavors were amazing and the food tasted so fresh. The decor and vibe is very light and positive. It says "you are beautiful" everywhere which I love! I would definitely recommend
name: Kasey

text: We really enjoyed the full experience Liberty Common provided. The interior is stunning! Our service was fantastic and the food was very good. Four of us had dinner and we tried many different items off the menu. Even the music playing in the background was at the perfect level to add to the vibe but not be overbearing on our conversation. I really enjoyed our night out here and we'll be recommending this restaurant to others.
name: Billy

text: My friend liked it more than I did. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Kind of landed in the middle for me. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
4.5 for ambience and service. 3.0 for food and pricing. This is one of the nicest places in Philly for a drink in the spring or summer. The fact that it's a historical boat is just extravagant. The bars on the deck are perfect on a nice day. I came here in May 2018 for an event. It was a perfect venue for the event. Everyone seemed really wowed by the atmosphere. The bartenders were very nice and attentive. 

After the event we had dinner in the restaurant. We sat in the main dining area in the lower level. I immediately realized that the menu is overpriced. I figured we were paying for the ambience, and we were right. My fiancé and I split a speciality sushi roll. I forget exactly which one, but it was pretty good. It was not great, but actually better than I thought. For my meal I got the burger. I was delicious, though I wish the fries were thicker. What is worth $22? Not sure about that. I will definitely come here again for happy hour in a nice day. Dinner though probably not.
name: Gus

text: Literally just had the worst Asian meal of my life from here. It tasted like someone dumped an entire gallon of salt on my chicken. Such a waste of money. Highly recommend choosing a different Chinese restaurant.
name: Becca

text: Came here on a Saturday afternoon and sat on the patio. They have a typical bar menu and atmosphere. I had some tangy Asian flavored wings and they were pretty good. The waitress had an attitude but the food was served timely and tasted fine. They did have some decent bar specials for a Saturday. Im not impressed enough to be a regular but it's a fair spot to catch a game or a quick bite.
name: Carly

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Food was fresh and service was quick. A very pleasant experience.
name: User

text:
Two days in a row I've had the absolute pleasure of dining in here. 

Peanut butter chocolate chip cheesecake and strawberry banana cupcake? I'm drooling thinking about it now. 

Yesterday, I tried the Reuben and it was the best sandwich I had ever had. UNTIL TODAY!!! I ordered the gobbler and it was so delicious. I also had the chicken potato leek soup and I couldn't have been more happy. 

Every single thing about this place is mind blowing and amazing. There isn't a word in the dictionary that accurately describes how in love I am with this hidden gem.  

And the owner?! Super sweet and makes sure all I ordered came out perfect.
name: Mina

text: It looked better online than it did in person. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The wait felt longer than it should have. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Wouldn't really choose this place again. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Devils den knows how to do it right! The perfect blend of community and fun and beer and food!
 They host a lot of events, like the one I went to on Tuesday night that was sponsored by Fat Heads Brewery! The whole bar  played bingo together and it was way more fun than I thought I was going to be! They all have an open mic night! 

My friend ordered the Bumble Berry Fat Heads bottle and I ordered the Kurant Earth Cidre. Both were absolutely spectacular! That fat heads beer is highly recommended! 

We also ordered a appetizer to share of their wings with extra celery! We added ranch on the side. They were actually pretty darn good! And a perfect temperature!
I also tasted the chicken wrapped in bacon and that was out of this world! The balsamic glaze to dip it in makes the entire dish! 

Parking is really terrible and took us about 20 minutes. Our waitress wasn't the most friendly person in the entire world either. However overall, it was a great experience and I'll definitely be back!
name: Lea

text: My friend liked it more than I did. Anyway, the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something i'm still thinking about two days later. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything.. Honestly, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated because that happens a lot. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough.
name: User

text: This was our first time dining at the steakhouse, which has a very reputable reputation. It's one of the premier steak houses in Nashville. My husband and I weren't sure because we read reviews on yelp that didn't get more than 1-3 stars, so we were worried.  Yet, our overall experience was quite the opposite. It is true they don't season their steaks and even the potatoes, but the ribeye was specially seasoned and it was amazing! I did however have to salt and pepper my seafood, fillet and potato, but that really wasn't a big deal. They want customers to be able to really taste the meat and season to your liking. The filet was beautifully tender and perfectly cooked for what I ordered.  the corn cakes were delightful -very airy and lightly sweetened. Definitely a cross between corn bread and a pancake, which it was my first time trying. We also had the crème brûlée for dessert but I totally forgot to take a picture. It was actually delicious! Overall the only reason I'm giving four stars is because the pricing is pretty steep, and you can get similar cuts of meat and such from other places around the area for a lot cheaper. However, the atmosphere, the way people respect this restaurant and dressed to the nine's, and the staff which was very fast efficient, And friendly really made for a great night out for my husband and I. I would recommend coming here if you had a higher budget to spend and wanted a more uptown experience.
name: Jme

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Nice little spot, decent portions too. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Absolutely delicious Triple Threat sushi, yummy teriyaki and cold saki! Definitely go here and get you some!
name: Beth

text: Yum!! So pleasantly surprised with this place! Came for lunch during the week. Ordered the Buffalo Mac and cheese balls, wings and a burger. The food was delicious and the service was even better! One waitress for the whole place and bar and we didn't have a long wait or feel slighted in anyway! She was also very pleasant with a constant smile! Will definitely be back!
name: Molly

text: This place is so much fun.  Great food and wine and beer selection.  The cheese room is to die for.  So many photo opportunities. The staff here is very friendly and helpful.  Even though it was very crowded, I never had to wait long for anything.  Little shops across the way it very fun as well.  Plenty of things to keep you entertained
name: Suzanne

text: I really wanted to be impressed with this place. Not sure if it was fluke or what when I went but my experience there was the most awkward encounter I think I've had at a restaurant. I walk in and there are only 2 other tables the whole rest of the place was empty yet we got sat right between the two.  There was no music playing so it was very quiet and we could hear exactly what the others tables were talking about.  Our server was polite but not personable.  I think the owner came out and she hosted the next party to arrive-she seemed great very personable very outgoing would have loved to have been served by her.  The food was fine. Needed some salt.  Maybe I'll come back when the place isn't so new.
name: Cindy

text: I was recommended the Columbia Restaurant by two of my Floridian friends. As it was our last night in the area, we decided to follow their suggestions and give it a go. I was expecting it to be busy based on its reputation, but nowhere near the level it was. We waited 20 minutes for a table alongside several other diners in the crowded lobby. Our waitress and the restaurant management were lovely, but there were several areas where the food fell flat. The black beans and rice soup that was "a must" was stodgy and flavorless. My boyfriend ordered his steak medium rare. It arrived well done, and was replaced with what we were told was a medium rare steak. Upon viewing steak #2 sliced open, it was essentially bleu. He settled on eating it without sending it back a second time (although management politely offered to correct it yet again), because my food was going cold by that point. The paella I ordered was mediocre - not at all what I was expecting for a dish that required additional cooking time and was considered a staple of the menu and region it represents. The clams and mussels were gritty, the dish itself barely seasoned, and the rice was left soupy and overcooked. I don't like leaving bad reviews and I was very disappointed that what was supposed to have been a special dinner could have been topped by Chik-Fil-A, especially for the prices we paid.
name: Robyn

text:
We ate here last year and could not believe how delicious the cheesesteak sandwich was. We returned a yr later, 7/11/18, and were extremely disappointed. They changed the sandwich. They now use some chemically created yellow guck called cheese, they use lettuce as fillers to add less beef, the sandwich was watery and the bread was rubbery. Overall, it was tasteless. 
If it ant broken, don't fix it I always say. On a quest to finding a better cheesesteak sandwich.
name: Lisa

text: Not the best, but certainly not the worst. I splurged and went for the all you can eat. Honestly, if you order more than two rolls, it's totally worth it. Most of the rolls have sauces on them - so if you're more into authentic rolls.. try the hand rolls and without the sauces. The restaurant is spacious and they kept playing Justin Bieber... so you know I was thrilled. The girls who served me were very sweet. This might be the only sushi joint on the east side and I'm fine with that! Love that they offer all you can eat.   You can also order appetizers, entrees and dessert off the all you can eat menu - which is not common other places. I'm sure I'll be back.

text: Do not go for dinner. Dimsum in the morning is acceptable but not anything else. Especially dinner. The meat is not fresh and Chinese food are not made correctly. No wonder the place is empty all the time.

text: We've gotten take out a few times from SG but we finally went to dine in.  We sat at the bar, sampled a few 5 oz beer and ordered food.  You cannot best the prices here and the food is really good.  We split a small Devil's Reject salad and a small Bone Collector pizza and took half the pizza home.  Both were tasty with just enough kick.  Great beer selection.  (And they have a table that looks like it came from an ME's office.)

text: Something for everyone.  I love this place. I like to get my food at the bar and eat while drinking tastey beers. Lots of seating and fast service.

text:
Yes, fresh pasta...that's about it, unless you enjoy runny and salty sauce. I know I have high expectations coming from St. Louis which has amazing Italian food, but we couldn't even finish ours. 

Don't waste the money. The only thing good is the video game.

text: Wonderful place for lunch. The charbroiled oysters were amazing with a great presentation.  The dozen oysters came out in a tray with rock salt and toasted bread slices. The oysters were covered with Parmesan cheese and wine with garlic, just delicious. My friend had the fish tacos which were large and dressed beautifully with seasonable veggies and the fish was fried perfectly. My seafood gumbo was large and had a wonderfully complicated taste, the result of hours of simmering. It was dressed with a full crab and had shrimp and oysters in it too. Service was excellent and attentive. Atmosphere was dark and relaxing. I like the open kitchen too. Chairs were uncomfortable plastic bistro chairs and tables were bare at lunch. Reasonable prices for the excellent quality of the food.

text: Great authentic tasting Indian food. Only thing I would say stay away from her chili chicken it taste more like sweet-and-sour, however rest of it is absolutely amazing

text: We happened to pass this restaurant and decided to try it.  We ordered the tandoori combo for 2 and wow it as ALOT of delicious food!!! We loved the tomato soup, veggie pakora, and chicken samosas.  The decor and staff were nice.  We will definitely be back!!

text: Thanks Chris for the update and helping with this matter. So as far as I am understanding, the two $50 room charges on my debit card will be refunded back to me...? If so I appreciate the effort and help on your part and understanding. What is the time frame on these refunds so I am aware. Thanks again
