The food wasn't bad (except the pumpkin lobster bisque ... don't order it says another person in my group). But our waiter was just awful and not admitting he made mistakes. We won't be back.
name: Deborah

text: Imagine a fusion of Middle Eastern and burgers. These guys really pulled it off. My family all had the classic American burger. I had the shawerma wrap. It was all delicious. the owner himself served us. The great service and great food gets them 5 stars from me.
name: Andres

text: Went for dinner with a friend on Friday. The food and service were excellent. I can't believe I've lived across the street for over a year and this was my first visit. It definitely will not be my last.
name: Nikki

text: We were one of their 1st customers. We are so happy we found them! We have been there like 5 times already. The green avocado salsa is the best I've had so far. Their tacos al pastor are delicious. Excellent little food truck. We are regulars now :)
name: Angelina

text: My favorite Mexican food.  Great food, great service, clean restaurant and fun environment.
name: Ted

text: Food is reliably delicious, and generously portioned.  The kebab dinners are enough for two meals.  Service is extremely pleasant.  Wonderful!
name: Esther

text: I was disappointed when this location first opened bc they could not do a large party reservation but after talking to the manager for a while he assured me that it was bc they wanted us to get top notch service and they were super busy the 1st few months they opened. I have been here 3 times since and they have all been great
name: Melina

text: Ohhhhh my gosh! This is one of the best restaurants I've eaten at in a while! Friendly staff, great food, and amazing prices! Not one thing I can complain about! Everything was so awesome!!!!
name: Jenny

text: Best pizza in Far NE Philly by far!! I've been a customer for years and the quality is always there!! The one pizza place I'd go out of my way to get!
name: Jim

text:
Pizza is good, big slices, but not what it once was, since new ownership a few years back prices went from 3.00 to 7.50 for a slice and drink!
Quality of the cheese went way down as well!

With that said it's still a good option since most of tucson pizza joints suck with the exception of the new artisan places opening up and empire pizza!
name: Tommy

text:
Steakhouse located in the heart of the French Quarter.

I've heard a lot of buzz over this restaurant the past few years and I finally got the opportunity to visit.

The restaurant is beautiful and we were lucky to sit in the courtyard on a spring Sunday night.

We started with the sweetbread and calamari. Both were delicious. For my meal I had the filet mignon served with bone marrow. The steak was cooked to perfection and the bone marrow was good.

Great staff and atmosphere.
name: Becky

text: The best Chicago adjacent pizza!  Can't be true Chicago without Lake Michigan water!!!  I'd love to do a blind tasting of Lou Malnati's and yours.  Bet the reviews would be very very close!  Love the remodel!
name: Todd

text:
Oliva's is fairly new taking over the empty building once occupied by Busters Ice Cream. Oliva's is at Seven Springs and Perrine Ranch Road selling pizza and subs with limited outdoor patio seating with Grubhub delivery available.

I ordered a Gryo cowzone for $7.99 over the phone with a 15 minute wait time. The gyro cowzone was large and well worth the very reasonable prize I ordered it for. The gyro meat combined with the mozzarella and ricotta cheese made it taste like sausage. Lots of meat was put into the cowzone and it came with marinara sauce. The employees at this walk up restaurant were nice and thanked me for my purchase. It appeared they had a drive through and ample parking. I found their menu on thier facebook page before contacting the business.
name: Ken

text: Awesome little Vietnamese cafe tucked away unassumingly in a Maryland Heights strip mall. Yelp led me here and did not lead me wrong. The vermicelli (noodle) bowl was delightful- filling and light at the same time. Perfect for a lunch and they had great speed and service even during the height of lunch rush! We'll be back to try some shrimp fried rice!
name: Adam

text: Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The staff seemed tired but still polite. For a busy night they handled it okay. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Will be back.
name: User

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Was finally able to check this place out with  my bf as we have become avid ping pongers in the last year. I was surprised at their rates. Sure the place is nice, but $22 for 1/2 hour and $39 for 1 hour (as a pair) is not feasible. We usually pay a fraction of that everywhere else. Also the drinks are $10-13. I'm sorry is this a club?! Who are they trying to attract? That's why there was hardly anyone at the bar. I had asked the girl working the ping ping area if we could play in the "red room" and she said that area is shut down. About 20 minutes later a group of people come in and guess where they go? Dun dun dunnnnnnn..... the red room. I notice this and hold off saying anything until we leave. I said "Hey, didn't you say the red room is shut down?" She goes "Yeah, but one guy in that group works here." This is the first time I've ever heard of employees coming before customers, but alright Spin you do you and I'll do me.
name: N

text: I cannot believe how downhill this restaurant went. Prices are high, food is not great, and they no longer have a good happy hour! Service is always hit or miss. I will be sad to see this place go as an SB local, but I sense it coming soon.
name: Taylor

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. A very pleasant experience. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: Friendly staff, food is replaced often and good variety of dishes.  This place has to have some great management to maintain this level of quality over the years
name: Pfft

text: Sign on door says they are open until midnight on Friday Saturday but they lock the doors by 11:30pm.
name: Paige

text: I love that their chicken tacos were above average and remained tender vs dry. Their marinated pork for the taco was good too! Steak, hard to mess up but they didn't and did a fantastic job. The pork taco was greasiest but had the flavor and was easiest to eat. The waitress was great at CS. Very quiet before rush hour and t was peaceful. Right off of a busy street where It is ignored because of surrounding fast foods that isn't the best for you. If you want a light meal that won't put your productivity to sleep, try here. Very family orientated
name: Philip

text: Fantastic grilled cheese sandwiches! Great location in the terminal. My son and I completely enjoyed the experience.
name: Stephen

text: The Alley is a fun place for adults and kids alike with a game arcade and sports bar in addition to the 28 alleys. The service folks and bowling pro are all super friendly and accommodating. The reason I am only giving it two stars has mostly to do with their "VIP" Room where they host parties, as well as open bowling. Although the area is swept, the furniture is simply nasty - torn and black with soil, the fabric is well overdue to be replaced. Too often, the floors and approach to the foul line are sticky with the residue of spilled drinks from previous events which can make it hard to bowl properly. A cosmetic make over in addition to updating the seating and technology of the main lanes would make this business a first class destination for serious bowlers and families looking for fun alike.
name: Rory

text: Awesome drinks, tasty food.  Ask JJ to make your drinks, he never fails - he makes his own concoctions and they are the absolute best! Off-menu and always exactly what you want!
name: Sandi

text: Great experience dining here with my family. We arrived later than we wanted to the hotel. We decided to eat at the hotel to keep things simple with our two toddlers. The wait staff was absolutely top notch and they were particularly great with my kids. All of our food was fantastic and the live music just made it a great night.
name: Tom

text: This was our first visit to Luna cafe & it will not be our last!! The gentleman who was our server was awesome to day the least & took care of our every need! Definitely recommend this precious little cafe for breakfast and lunch!
name: Kayla

text:
My sister and I got the Upside-down Jawn. This place was pretty hyped up by other reviewers and had the long line to back it up. The pie amounted to a Sicilian slice when it was all said and done. Great for a 1 time visit, not worth adding this to your favs unless you live within walking distance. 

Reminded me of Kate & Al's at Columbus Famers Market in S. Jersey. If your in Columbus, NJ on RT. 206, stop in and get a cheaper slice.
name: René

text: Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Glad we tried it. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: Normally this place is always good but today the fish was cooked perfectly but the lump of crab was mostly the bread crumbs stuffing and hardly any crab meat. Normally I would recommend this place but could have done better tonight. We only waited 15 minutes for the food and everything else was good..
name: Mana

text:
I can't speak on the Pho but the Red Curry fried rice was delicious! I came in craving a rice dish and they did not disappoint. The Jasmine rice was soft and flavorful, it had plenty of basil and perfectly cooked veggies(thinly cut carrots, green peppers, green onions, yellow onions, and peas) My protein of choice was chicken and they did not skimp. It has a fried egg mixed in as well. 

Patricia was our server and she was great. Very kind and attentive. She suggested the red curry rice since I could decide which rice dish I wanted. 

Prices were reasonable and the ambiance inside is nice. I would definitely return to have the curry rice again.
name: Auyanna

text: I'm a local and I've been looking for a great oyster spot since my favorite closed down and THIS IS IT. They had everything i love and it was amazing. I got the wedge salad, raw oysters,whodat oysters, and  gumbo. The gumbo was amazing it had oysters, shrimp, and pickled okra and is a big serving for 12$  The Who dat oysters with the mustard and white beans is also amazing. Gabby was our server and she was nice and attentive because we asked for extra bread and salad toppings.  Over all ten out of ten found my new favorite spot. Coming back for saints Sundays
name: Felicia

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: The quality of the food looks amazing. It's delicious and healthy. The sauces tasted amazing. I got the poke sauce with the sweet chili. Its so good! I recommend the bowls cause it can really fill you up.
name: Zi Jie

text: I just love this place. Been there tons of times and have never been disappointed. The gift shop is awesome to browse and find really unique gifts.
name: Aurie

text:
The decor is great
Food mediocre....I travel a lot and abroad......this sushi is plain....
I am from Lafayette and we have 3 really great sushi restaurants
1 Sushi Don ...may be best in USA ..half price Tuesday nights
2 Fishya...great vibe and good sushi
3 Yummy time....on Purdue campus.....very good....all three put this place to shame...sorry
However the pepper appetizer was very good and waitress was attentive
name: Mike

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. For a busy night they handled it okay. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The music was louder than it needed to be. Definitely coming back. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text:
This new place gets high marks on Yelp! so I bookmarked it so I'd be sure to remember to try it when I had the chance. That chance was today when around 1 my child and I were looking for a place near downtown to eat lunch. 

We arrived around 1:15 and there was open parking in the back lot. The inside is pretty small and they were busy, but we got an open spot. We were greeted right away with menus, water, and a recommendation for an appetizer - the muscles. About half the tables we saw had muscles in front of them but we were not hungry enough for all that. They looked great but we passed. 

It's a really interesting menu from pasta and pizza to salads, burgers, and tacos. Honestly a LOT looked good. My child ordered the Tuscan burger and on the recommendation of our server I ordered the lamb belly tacos. Both of us had the tomato bisque as the side. We both loved the soup, and my tacos were certainly very good. My child absolutely raved about the burger. It was ordered medium and delivered pretty done, but it was still an exceptional burger - juicy and big.

The food is a little pricey here, but the portion sizes are very large; hence, I do think it's a good value because the food is excellent. Service was fast, attentive, and extremely friendly. We will definitely be back to try some of the pizza and pasta on the menu. 

Keep in mind the place is small and they don't take reservations. If you come for lunch or dinner, might be a good idea to arrive early. Highly recommend!
name: Bret

text: This restaurant is a standard for our family.   Great food and service.  Whether it is dinner or lunch or even appetizers and drinks on a date night.  Yet to have one item that disappoints.
name: Danielle

text:
I've always had a good time at sushi inc. the sushi is consistent and the service is on point. I always sit at the bar and Spencer usually serves me. He serves up great drinks as well.
Thursday is happy hour all day. They have some five dollar featured during discounts on wine and beer. The specialty rolls are two dollars off during happy hour and the regular rolls are a dollar off. But it's still a great deal. And they have a few appetizer specials. My last visit I walked out spending only $45 ($60 with tip)for two. We each had 2 drinks, split 2 rolls, and had one appetizer. The spicy garlic edamame is to die for! We had the tuna fresh and the el Diablo. I liked the el Diablo better. But the entire meal was great !
My go to sushi spot, check it out!
name: Natasha

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was decent, just a little uneven. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
The family has a great time at The Green Pheasant. Asian food is a crowd pleaser and all the different dishes let us experiment. Our server even said the  restaurant is modeled after an izakaya, a Japanese pub.

We enjoyed all the dishes (i.e. the plates were empty when they left the table.) but the fried oysters and pheasant dumplings were the favorites. We probably could have eaten those all night. Most interesting/new experience was the bok choy salad.

It is always good to know a place where you can sit and talk while eating top quality dishes. Enjoy.
name: Hart

text:
Oh. My. God. Wow Mr. Ed's rocked me and my buddies' world. I'd only had Chargrilled oysters one other time at Drago's and it's real tough to pick which of the two are better. The Gumbo was amazing, but the Crawfish Etouffee was one of the best dishes I've had in New Orleans/ever. 

Everyone's food at the table looked delicious too and we left VERY happy. The staff was very friendly and we got our food in a timely manner. Will
absolutely be back when I return to NOLA.
name: Shervin

text: This definitely has a date night feel; dim, candle lighting, quiet, lots of yummy looking drinks. I think it was a place that was fine, but I don't feel like I need to return. Not disappointed but also not impressed.
name: Jenny

text: The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Nothing about the space rlly stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Definitely coming back. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
This huge all in one store and warehouse sells all kinds of furniture and housewares.
The second floor of the building is a showroom 
and the first floor is a self serve warehouse.
You make note of price and location of an item,
then you find it in an isle on a rack in the 
warehouse section. All self serve. Most items have
to be put together. The smaller houseware items
can be taken in shopping carts.
They have everything to inexpensively furnish 
a home, apartment, rental property,, or a college
dorm.  There is even a kitchen center to design and build a new kitchen.
The prices are very good for the housewares and
furniture. But you need to do all the work concerning the furniture. I had put together several
pieces of furniture for my sons apartment.  It
assembles well. Once you complete one item,
they all go together the same.
I would recommend using the map they provide when entering the store. The showroom section
is literally a maze.  Parking is now problem. 
There is a loading dock for your vehicle.
name: Dr. Richard

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: My friends and I come here every Monday for the $5 burger deal. It's one of the best burgers in Tampa. They also have a great happy hour (half off beers and liquor) from 4-7 and 10-close. Beautiful property that overlooks the bay also. Bobby is a great manager and Matt Johnson is killing the game behind the bar. Service is not always great and my burger was well done when I ordered a medium last time. Also, my friend asked for a vodka soda and the bartender poured Tito's without asking if he wanted that when he just wanted the well vodka. And I asked for a gin and tonic and the bartender made it a tall without asking if I wanted a tall when I would've preferred a short glass. We will still likely be coming around because the deals are good and the place is fun.
name: Kurt

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: This is my third week in a row coming to Jasper's for brunch and I have no problem, the food is to die for and it is picture perfect! The service was excellent, the unlimited Mimosa on this was beautiful Sunday, happy Easter everybody!
name: Rob

text: Bern's, A very classic Tampa institution since 1956 is always a treat. Undoubtedly the best, most attentive service in town with extremely knowledgeable waiters and waitresses educated in fine cuts of meat & wines. Take a tour of their wine cellar & kitchen after your meal, followed by a a tasty trip to their desert room which is essentially, a second restaurant. Given what the place is, it comes with a price but well worth it.
name: Imraan

text: This place is always crowded for both lunch and dinner and I honestly don't understand why other than convenience because the food is no more than mediocre. The Asian Zing wings pictured were the best part of our meal and they're just the wings of the month and will be gone by February. I had the salmon salad and the flavors just didn't make sense. The Mister had the garlicky brisket sandwich and it was DRY DRY DRY! Even with the BBQ sauce and cheese. We never really do chain establishments and this is why. We were just HANGRY and gave in but never again! We will remain strong next time!
name: Liz

text: Love this place! The food is so delicious and the restaurant has a very good ambience. The entire staff is very knowledgeable and attentive. Miranda at the front is always such a delight, Marcus and Daniel are always up and about checking on guests to make sure their having a positive experience. General manager Jeremy definitely deserves a raise because he is doing a darn good job at running the place. OMG they have boozy snowballs. You literally can't go wrong with this place for any occasion.
name: Stephanie

text: This was our 2nd time traveling to New Orleans. This is by far our favorite place to go to eat! Amazing food. We returned for the Brussel sprouts and tried some other recommendations this time. The Pig Mac was to die for. We also had the muffuletta which was equally as yummy. Such a great gem in New Orleans. Love the expansion of the restaurant too.
name: Carrie

text:
Can you give less than one star? This place was NOT good. Wanted it to be. All meals were extremely underwhelming. Food was cold. Not fresh. Service that we had was not good. Bathrooms were filthy. Sorry for the bad review but it was bad. To give credit the waitress did comp two of the meals that we didn't eat at all. 

Hard to find good food on Decatur. Tried into Coops Place but line was out the door for a 40 min wait.
name: Catherine

text: Hmm...are St Pete politicians and business leaders comfortable with diners ordering dishes named for them amid a whitewash of unrepentant antisemite Henry Ford? Long beer list, decent menu, relentlessly designed facility, obnoxious Bennigan's-style birthday ritual (waitstaff clapping, ahh-OOOOH-gah horn, silly disruptive song).
name: Susana

text: It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The staff seemed tired but still polite. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text:
Its pricy but we knew that going in. We had the French Onion soup, Modern Caesar, Chipotle Cheddar, Macaroni & Cheese, Brussels Sprouts, Petite Filet and 16 oz. Dry-Aged NY Stip. For dessert we shared a Chocolate Lava cake. The food was excellent and was very happy with the meal. The Chocolate Lava cake was disappointing it was overdone and not very "lava-ly". Our service was hit and miss. Our waitress not very helpful and did not seem to know the menu very well.  3 times she had to ask others of servers questions.  Four times she had to come back and tell us they were out of the wine we requested. (this was not her fault).  The rest of the staff made up for it and they were fantastic. The main problem we were seated in a booth at the bar. This was at 5pm and the restaurant was not full neither was the bar. In retrospect, I should have said something, but the bar was empty and it did not cross my mind. As the night went on the bar got full and the noise level at the bar grew. The TVs were on, the volume was off, but there was sports on and the people got involved. The level got where it was hard to hear my wife. For the type of meal and price of the meal, I believed the experience should have been better. It was partly my fault for not saying anything when were seated, but we could also have been warned.  

Bottom-line,  we will one more time,  but only if we don't get a table / booth in the bar area.
name: Tommy

text:
I really loved how this spot offers a variety of foods from healthy quinoa bowls to comfort food chicken and waffles! With their vast menu, there's at least one item for each person in our group (14 people). You know it's good because this place is PACKED. We ended up having to wait an hour for a table, which was fine because we just arrived in town so we strolled around the area. 

Our waitress was super attentive and helpful giving recommendations on her favorites.

Ben's Bread Spread ($13): we got 2 for the table and tbh I was pretty stuffed from this alone. There were 2 types of bread, a croissant, and a cinnamon bun (all v delicious and fresh) and different spread options. 

Shakshuka ($14): I usually opt for eggs benny when I get brunch, but this was def a good decision. The eggs were perfectly runny and I especially loved the hot pepper jam. 

Bee's Knees ($11): recommended by the waitress. def my fave drink here in Nashville bc it's not too sweet

Citrus Sangria ($7): you can never go wrong with white wine sangria

TL;DR GO TO MILK & HONEY DEF WORTH 1HOUR WAIT
name: Tanya

text: First all the staff were warm and inviting, knew their stuff and were very helpful. I had the chefs plate, and the pork rillette, amazing! All the meat was cooked perfectly, nice char on the outside, sweet and fall off the bone tender in the inside. Pork rillette was set up with various pickled vegetables, beats and cauliflower, and what I am assuming is a pickled onion confit, or onion jam. Amazing can not state that enough. Baked beans had an harissa flavor profile that I never would of thought of coming together, and were the best I ever had. On that note the potatoes chips that came with the rillette were the best I ever had, fresh or store bought and need to be mass produced like yesterday. Cheers to the chefs and their crew!
name: Jason

text:
I had to update my review after coming several times after my son's birthday party just for fun. The service when we've ordered food has been HORRIBLE EVERY SINGLE TIME. Last time, they literally brought us our food and that was it. They didn't check on drinks or anything and I ordered and paid at the self-service kiosk. This time, they dropped our appetizer off at the table next to ours and we never got a replacement. Then they brought the food out with no forks or napkins (and we got hot wings, fun eating with no napkin), forgot the ranch for the wings, then said they would bring us water refills (and never did). Then the server said she would just remove the appetizer from the bill Bc the kitchen wasn't going to send another order out again. I'm guessing the kitchen staff was crappy about remaking food that was delivered to the wrong table when they were slammed. My son still wanted the appetizer but I wasn't about to wait another hour for food. 
Idk if we will come here again since I think there's another Main Event in town but if we do we will eat before we come from now on and stick to the Monday special Bc any other time is crazy expensive. The arcade is $1.50 or more per game any other time.
name: Monica

text: Must have the Quail, lamb ribs and duck wings! Great atmosphere with exceptional 5 star service
name: Alan

text:
Chicken and crouton to salad ratio in club salad was a delicious 1:1. The dressed alligator poor boy I had here a few days ago was delicious, and the roll of paper towels set on each table correspondingly much appreciated.  

Waitstaff was totally wonderful both visits. TVs are a little loud, there's nice space between tables, an instagrammable waist to ceiling wall of Tabasco sauces in a corner.
name: Elizabeth

text: The food is decent, but the place has a horrible smell all the time now. Can't go inside anymore. Smells like wet carpet and shoes. Oy!
name: Jennifer

text: Everytbing they sell taste average. The price is cheap. Small little shop. Great for quick eats. But the only reason why I come here is because they sell little unique things all in one shop. I usually get their Hong Kong egg waffles.
name: Jaime

text:
We came in on Sunday at noon (with a reservation) as a group of 8 out of towners. We picked this place for the brunch reviews and the all you can drink vodka bar they offer for brunch. $20 for the bottomless vodka drinks. They bring you out the vodka and ice in glasses whenever you request them and then you head over to the self serve bar to make whatever concoction you can think of. A couple in our group didn't want the bottomless but did order bloody Mary's and they were very good, perfect amount of spice and had pickled zesty green beans and cocktail olives. 

We started with the hot garlic shrimp boil and fried pickles, both very good but I especially loved the shrimp boil. Huge shrimp with delicious buttery sauce over French fries. Then I had the chicken and biscuits and my husband had the crawfish Mac and cheese. The fried chicken was really good and the biscuits were light and fluffy. I forgot the specify what kind of eggs I wanted so I didn't actually eat them. My husband liked his Mac and the side of slaw he ordered. I thought the Mac was too fishy but you probably like fishy if you order it. There were also a couple pieces of mystery meat in everyone's Mac and cheese that we are all assuming was ham. 

The space is amazing. Really large open space, beautiful wood details and decent sized outdoor seating. We were even able to jump right on the New Orleans streetcar right out front.
name: Elena

text:
Very laid back spot to enjoy a few solid street tacos in an open outdoor sitting. There is no indoor sitting but expect quite a bit of shaded areas and a few industrial fans throughout the open space. It's a super casual space

Ended up here for a weekday lunch meeting and it was very empty. We also ate at an off hour so that probably affected it a bit.

Their menu is very concise and they focus on -- well, tacos and taco bowls. You'll kick yourself in the ass if you don't grab their chips and dips. 

Get the large queso. Splurge on the Guac. Add Chicharrones to your meal. Just drop the bills and go all out. (It's honestly not a crazy upcharge and the chicharrones are so worth the $2 extra bucks!)

I grabbed an order of three tacos focused around pork (Al Pasto) and chicken (adobo). Both meats were super tender and cooked with so much flavor. The tortillas are easy to recognize they're made fresh and in-house. I totally recommend grabbing corn.

It's a solid spot and I'm already planning to come back in a few days.
name: Tomas

text:
We sat out on a mission to find a great brunch spot with mimosas on our trip.  After putting our name in for an hour and a half wait at Milk and Honey, we walked around the block to find this joint.  Carafes of mimosas!!! Within 10 minutes we were seated on the nice patio.  Service was wonderful and the food was great.  There isn't a huge variety of things to choose from, but the nice patio and food were perfect.  

My hubby and I both ordered the traditional American breakfast.  My only complaint was that I asked for medium eggs and they arrived hard.  The potatoes had a perfect slight crunch and made with peppers.   Along with a perfect home made biscuit.  The mimosas were yummy!!!



Skip the wait at the popular places and head here for brunch!
name: Emily

text: The service was great. Shaq is the manager with the heart and the pulse. Went past the extra mile to make everything as good as it could possibly be.  Love his suit!  Chef came out to stay in touch with the guests. Steak was as good as the best in Edmonton. Will be back to dance to retro style music and an incredible  band.  If you like classy and want a refined evening, with fun, " THIS IS THE PLACE TO BE".  Walter and Stella
name: Walter

text:
Four of us had breakfast here, each ordering full meals.

The Good: The food was tasty, being fairly typical for chain diner breakfast fare. The dining area was like most other chain dinging rooms and was relatively clean.

The Bad: Service was painfully slow. We visited this location on a weekend when the restaurant was only moderately busy. We waited too long to be seated, to order, to get our food and to pay. Though our server was friendly, she struggled to keep up. The staff seemed disorganized, with different people stepping into the role of seating people, busing tables and accepting customer payment. Prices also seemed a bit on the high side, given the market being served. It also wouldn't have hurt to have staff clan up the broken beer bottles and other unsightly mess in the parking lot. This place could easily turn around with an improvement in local management.

Bottom line: If you're in the area, go just about anywhere else for a better experience.
name: Will

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Not bad for a quick meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: Great breakfast and great prices. I had the Spartan omelet and the hubby had the Mexican skillet. The omelet was huge but also fluffy, I took half home for dinner. There was a short wait but it was Sunday, the busiest day for brunch. Service was great. Thank you for another breakfast spot we can put on rotation.
name: Christina

text: I would visit Boise just to come here for the food. It is excellent and the staff is just the best. I love the Shank and the Beer. The outside beer garden is coming along nicely.
name: Chuck

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was good and came out fast. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: I can't say it's anything special, but props to them for actually putting UBK events on this fall, unlike Starlite. Also, props to the bartender to rummaged through the bar to find me the last bottle of Delirium they had.
name: Rachel

text:
Starting off very strong. The staff snapped to attention when we came in and the food was flying out of the kitchen. 

Their dim sum menu is limited during the week but the dumplings that are available are excellent. Shanghai style shumai. Bbq pork buns (great meat to bread ratio). Beef chow fun had plenty of meat and made sure we were full. 

Usually takes more than one visit to write a review for me but this spot needs to succeed based on the quality of its food and service. 

Dim sum available in the suburbs!
name: PHAN

text:
I never thought we would have pasta/seafood for breakfast, but that's what we did first thing in the morning at the Santa Barbara Shellfish Company, which sits right above the ocean at the end of the bridge with a beautiful scenery outside the window. It's definitely a scenic view if there's no one in the seating arrangement in front of you. 

I ordered the lobster pasta, which is definitely worth the $$$ I paid. It's not subtle whatsoever, but you can taste a slightly overwhelming amount of wine. I actually didn't mind that, since it added a good amount of moisture to the oily texture in the pasta. The bread goes brilliantly well with the dish, especially if it's already soaked up some of the sauce. Please scatter some butter across your bread as well. It's just perfect. Overall, a lovely experience.
name: Stephen

text: Poppers were okay, but would have preferred a different sauce. Not authentic enough for our tastes. Disappointed with seasoning used in fajitas.
name: Angela

text: This bagel place has great bagels I have to say they definitely beat a lot of the competes here in Reno they have really yummy cream cheese too.
name: Jake

text: The grilled chicken was so chewy and had the oddest texture, def not real chicken. Literally still gagging from that chicken
name: Lukas

text:
This restaurant is a great place for your southern breakfast fix. It is a trendy place--we sat at a shared table, and there is a slushy machine filled with pink slush with the label "frose y'all."

The food is quite heavy all in all. We got a biscuit to share and it was flakey and oh so buttery. The monkey bread we also got to start--and they got it right. It was not chewy like monkey bread sometimes can be, it was delicate and fluffy (and buttery, duh) but just the right portion to share and so good. 

The menu featured lots of shrimp, cheese, biscuits, and grits. If you are not a huge eater I would definably recommend sharing--the dishes are very rich and no one was able to finish. the BBQ Shrimp Toast was a toast with a thick layer of cheese and sweet BBQ shrimp, very good. The avocado toast was pretty basic, but must have had at least 3 avocados piled on top. Shrimp and grits was also good, again the grits were cheesy and it was heavy. The highlight of the meal for me was definitely our starters--the monkey break and the biscuit. 

Go if you are hungry--or go and share. It is decadent and delicious.
name: Kate

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. A very pleasant experience. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: Just in case you are wondering why there is 'no crowd'? The people who own the restaurant cheat you when you have leftovers and they pack them up for you in 2 Go Boxes.  They don't mention this to you but they add a hidden charge of 25 cents plus GST for every 2 Go Box they send home with you and we all know how this can add up if you have a crowd of people dining.  I guess ordering a huge amount of food for a healthy sum of money isn't good enough for the owner of this restaurant. When I went through my numerous credit card slips from Saffron and noticed this 'hidden' charge I called the owner hoping this was some sort of mistake by the cashier.  He advised that this was 'his policy' and then suggested that we order take out since he doesn't charge for those boxes since he 'has to use something' to get the food out to the customer!  This is absolute deceit and at best the patron should be advised before taking the food away and packing it up and definitely BEFORE the credit card is charged!  We will now be among those ... who do not ever go back to this restaurant and add to the 'NO CROWD' at lunch ... or ... dinner!  Pass it on ... there are other much better Indian restaurants in Edmonton and based on this type of deceit ... we can all do better!  Makes one wonder what 'else' could be happening that the patron is unaware of!
name: Lynne

text: If you find the sound of a jack hammer starting at 7:40am relaxing, this is the place for you. If you're tired in the afternoon and want to take a nap to the sound of a jack hammer, book this hotel. Woke on Sunday morning at 6:20am to hammering. The windows are single pane and it's difficult to maintain a comfortable temperature in the room. When the wind blows, the windows  shake, rattle and bang further disturbing a peace nights rest. Now, the staff was very nice and the restaurants very good especially the early bird dinner at the Japanese restaurant. Our room was clean and tastefully decorated. I might go back when the pool construction is completed.
name: Susie

text: This was our go to restaurant after church but every has gone downhill. The food is over cooked, the service slow and the place needs a deep clean. Today was my last straw as ants were running across the table while eating. NO they do not have an outside patio. I will admit the ants are my yuck bug. But they turn my stomach. It was not just one there were more coming. I will NOT be back.
name: Victoria

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Food was good and came out fast. Food was fresh and service was quick. Would probably stop in again if nearby. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text:
Sabrina's is always a VIBE ! With the help of Yelp seating is quick !! The food is always fresh and worth the wait ! 
My ultimate fave is their Challah French toast with the stuffing and banana toppings ! It is not overwhelming sweet as it looks and makes the perfect choice for dessert(although not a dessert)  after your meal !
name: Christine

text: Best butter chicken I have ever had. Wish I still lived around the corner so I could enjoy it more often. Kudos!
name: Katharine

text: We had a delicious breakfast this morning and were most impressed with our waitress, Megan. She gave us great suggestions for places to see and things to do while in New Orleans. Megan was very attentive to us throughout our meal. The Bloody Mary was top notch and the house made mix was the best. We plan on returning for dinner one night before we leave.
name: Debbie

text: This place is incredible. I have been dining here on a pretty regular basis for the last year and it has always been amazing. Parking is ample and there is so much seating! The Rockville location is great too but there is never anywhere to sit during lunch. This location is my favorite by far. We have never had a long wait and they don't run out of tamales as fast as the original location. I personally love the fact that they have their episode of Diners, Drive ins, and Dives on a loop on the TV. Its cool to see how the tamales are made, and its great to see the owners having a good time and loving what they do. This is the kind of restaurant Indy should be proud of. The steak tacos are my absolute favorite, best in Indy in my opinion and I have had a lot of tacos all over the city. The hot salsa is so delicious that we always order extra so we can have it at home later. Highly recommend you visit this place if you are looking for delicious food in the Greenwood area.
name: Becca

text:
Gotta love the Cracker Barrel! This is home cooking, counrty style, comfort food like your grandma used to make. You can find anything from meatloaf to catfish and Beyond all right here. There's a reason the old folks come here, it's good food for a good price served by friendly people. It's reliable service and in today's day and age that's not always easy to come by. 

There are quite a few choices so even the pickiest eater will be able to find something to enjoy. I really love the little store when you walk in! They have some of the most interesting, groovy items. A really eclectic selection of inventory here for sure. Ladies there are some really cute clothes and neat jewelry to be found here. Lots of neat stuff for the kiddos, candy choices are fantastic! Don't forget to check out the Adirondack chairs out front!
name: Ann

text: Unique food, great quality, cutest bathroom I ever saw! Friendly service, quaint neighborhood! Just wish they had a little something for my friend for her birthday but ‍
name: Kelly

text: Stopped in for lunch with family on a Saturday afternoon. We had salads and sandwiches. Everything was good.  The prices are very reasonable.The service was very good. I would definitely return.
name: Linda

text: Paris Baguette has a delightful assortment of traditional Pastries like croissants, cakes, filled buns (Asian) of creative varieties. I liked the Matcha croissant which looked like a volcanic ooze of green match had erupted and encrusted on the exterior. Some interesting frappes I am told, I had my eye on the cotton candy but bailed out last minute to save a few calories. Nice on the eyes!
name: Dylan

text: I went to 5 different cheesesteak places (Pats, Genos, tony Luke's, and this) my two favorites were tony likes and Sonny's and my favorite was Sonny's because it was just perfect order"the classic". If I'm ever back in the city of brotherly love I'm going to Sonny's and tony lukes
name: Max

text: This place has great sushi and the restaurant is gorgeous! It's an awesome place for a lunch or dinner date! The staff are also very polite and good about coming by to see if you need anything.
name: Malia

text: We ordered 2 pad Thais and an order of veggie spring rolls. Spring rolls were good but for $9 they should have been bigger or we should have received more than 3. They were tiny. Both pad thais were hot but dry and flavorless, almost like they forgot sauce. Compared to other Thai restaurants around the area, prices were extremely high for what we got. Will try somewhere else next time.
name: Sofie

text:
Food: 5 Stars
Service: 5 Stars

I don't know why I had waited so long to visit, but am grateful that a friend made a U-turn and insisted that we make a pit stop. We walked in and my eyes glazed over (and my mouth probably agape) as I oogled over the display case filled with the most beautiful pastries. I was fortunate to be introduced to Patrick Devine who was warm and humble and graciously allowed me to drool over everything I set my eyes on. 

I couldn't just pick 1 or 3 desserts... Ended up walking out with just about 1 of everything. (Don't judge.) Our favorite had to be the delicate and decadent slice of Mille Crepe cake. This beauty features Tahitian Vanilla and is moist and creamy and all things good in the world.
name: Lynn

text: Nice spot but i went on a fri about midnight & it was kinda empty.I live in tampa so it was the longest drive & they had the booths closed as soon as u walk in.The music was ok.I went in the restroom & the lights shut off while i was in the restroom then eventually came back on.
name: Tina

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Food was fresh and service was quick. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
This is one of my favourite bake shops in Edmonton. When I walk in and see all the delicious things in the display case i feel like I'm waking through a Parisian bakery. They have Edmonton's best Macarons and the key like pie is to DIE for!!! The scones are fluffy and dense which sounds weird but they are perfect. The croissants are melt in your mouth buttery and the cakes make a great special birthday or occasion. 

Must go if you are visiting, on a date or just want to spoil yourself or someone special.
name: Latoya

text:
Pei Wei is essentially a smaller version of PF Chang's. They are owned by the same parent company. It is a good clean chain restaurant which specializes in pan Asian cuisine. 
     The dishes are good to delicious, but like most chains, please do not expect authentic Chinese, Korean, or Thai food. This is a nice mixture of each. Their orange chicken is delicious, as is their Thai dynamite chicken. Orange chicken is a tangy, crispy delight. Pei Wei's lettuce wraps are also not to be missed. 
     Perfect for sit down or take out.
name: Joe

text: Really tasty food. I had the farmer's skillet and my husband tried the chicken and waffles.
name: Perla

text: Ah Kayne Prime. So worth every penny for that delicious Waygu filet, that can be cut with a fork. It is so perfect here. ..The pop over bread, the steak, the the truffle dipping sauce, the sides are amazing af. Yea I said it! There isn't a side that I would skip out on. The corn brûlée and the potato la gratin, the creamed spinach and the Mac and cheese. If you haven't been here or don't think it's good, well than your a fool. Best in Nashville, without a doubt. Bless up. Shout out to Marissa Camp for the best service in cashville.
name: Derek

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would absolutely visit again.
name: User

text: We had a party of 10 at James today. All started fine, was excited but this review isn't about the food. Our waitress was unbelievably rude. 9 of us got our food...one didn't, who ordered an omelette. We told the waitress right away and she said sorry and will put the order in (she admitted she forgot). I had to leave early, so I left after I ate and my friend still didn't have her food! They were cracking jokes in the back later about the situation. Ended up taking about 30 mins after they finished eating for the order to come out. They said that they had other slips and it had to wait!! Hahaha!! Just avoid this place, looking at many other reviews that are similar and the owner doesn't respond. They don't care about their customers.
name: Chad

text:
A cool space with a load of TVs playing sports, but that's it.  

My salmon wrap, which sounded great, was overly salty and worst of all there were bones in the salmon. It almost seemed like the salmon cut was a leftover or trimming that came off of a better cut. Based on texture it could even have been canned. Whatever! It was a $13 item.

text:
I have frequented Pisces Sushi more times than I care to admit, but I'm just now getting around to writing a review!

This is by far the best, and my favorite, place for vegan/vegetarian sushi in Reno! My reasons are two-fold: 1) the fresh and high-quality ingredients that make up the food, and 2) Chef Michael.

After coming to Pisces a little too often on my lunch hour with my coworker, Chef Michael has gotten to know us and we look forward to chatting with him on our lunch. He has almost 20 years of sushi experience and wraps the tightest sushi you'll ever eat! In all honesty, I don't eat at Pisces if he's not working. I also now only sit at the bar when I eat sushi.

Michael knows my favorite veggie rolls, and has even been kind enough to modify them to make them a little more exciting. One time, he modified the Green Machine roll to include mango and onions and topped it off with a different sauce- it was unique and delicious! 

Michael works not only quickly, but efficiently as well. He makes sure his groups are taken care of...and that they're taken care of well! Aside from Michael's unmatched sushi skills and witty banter, the rice, edamame, and miso are always taste and look fresh and delicious.

As someone who solely orders vegan/vegetarian sushi (I also recently discovered that I'm extremely allergic to a couple kinds of fish), I highly appreciate that there is no cross-contamination when my sushi is prepared. I taste no fish or fishy aftertaste, which is rare to find at any sushi restaurant in my experience! 

The lunch AYCE is slightly cheaper than the dinner AYCE, but regardless, it is most definitely worth it. Pisces Sushi really hits the spot when I have any form (intense, mild, or next to none) of sushi craving. I'm sure I'll stop in this week at Pisces for more of my favorite appetizers, rolls, staff, and mochi!

text:
Why 4 stars? Because my first Ethiopian food experience was a great one!

   ---   ---   ---

Myself and a group of friends descended upon Mitmita to celebrate the first of many Nick S birthdays in 2019. I'm really glad he chose Mitmita because I'd never had Ethiopian food prior to this and I thoroughly enjoyed it!

I was educated on the fact that Ethiopian cuisine is supposed to be enjoyed sans silverware. Every dish is served with this "bread" that you use to pick (or scoop) your food off of the plate with. I put bread in quotations because this is like no other bread I've ever seen. It's thin, but also shares the texture of a sponge. Because of this, I consumed *a lot* of this bread, so I hope it wasn't wildly unhealthy. 

As for what I actually ate, it's really hard to place exactly which dishes were what. We were in a group of about ten people and Nick had them bring a ton of different items out. But I'll do my best to shoutout the highlights:

-All of the sambusas were great, whether it be the chicken, beef or veggie. I've had these at many Indian restaurants and I always enjoy them. For those unfamiliar, it's comparable to an empanada.

-We had a few different lighter plates brought out to share, which were all enjoyable - Buticha, Ye-timatim (Ethiopian tomato salad), Ye-miser (Lentil Salad), and a couple servings of various veggies.

The only thing I ordered on my own was the Kay Watt, which was beef in garlic, ginger, onions and sauce. I thought this was okay, but I'd probably opt to order something else in the future.

My favorite part of this experience was the owner who doubled as our server. She was not only the sweetest person ever, but she handled our crazy table with ease. The patience she expressed with Nick when he was trying to take over and control everything was impeccable. She deserves a medal! I hope Tina was taking notes to apply some of those methods at home.

I'm so glad I was able to experience a brand new cuisine and look forward to round two!
name: Brett
