text: So tonight I have to vent a little. Yours is my favorite restaurant in Nashville because I'm a steak eating fool and I love the cream corn brûlée. My girlfriend made reservations for tonight a few days ago and we were really excited. I've been gone from home for a few months and this was a kind of welcome home dinner. We've been coming here the last couple of years and always look at it as a treat, but tonight had to be different. We arrived a little early to sit at the bar and have a few drinks. Everything was great there, no complaints. Settled up with our bartender with a $70 tab. We waited about twenty five minutes over our reservation. That's pretty normal, there were several empty tables but still, no real complaints. Then we're seated and the shit show begins. First off we sat there for 15 minutes before the server assistant shows up. He was really very nice but we couldn't get a word in because he was basically yelling at us about the specials, his love for lemon in water, etc. he takes off and we wait another fifteen minutes before our server finally shows up. We order a $94 bottle of Malbec and he immediately tries to up-sale us for the most expensive bottle even though the Alta-vista is one of our favorites. He then can't tell us the contents of the green plate for my vegetarian girlfriend. All is well so far, just not what I expect when I come to Kayne Prime. She orders a few sides and a salad. I order a wedge, a side, and two different filets. So we begin another wait. We didn't keep up with the time as we enjoy each other's company and the atmosphere. Just as we notice it's been quite some time another server shows up with our food and apologizes profusely for our wait. I've received spinach instead of the brussel sprouts I ordered and the he apologizes again and goes to correct. He's gone for a moment as we dig into our meals. The sides are great but both of my steaks are chilled. The same guy that delivered comes back to check on us in between taking care of his own tables and takes my steaks back to reheat them for me. Our original server finally shows back up with the sprouts and drops them off and walks away without a word. He returns shortly to refill our wine glasses and apologizes for the mix up. We finish our meal and he hands us the check, but we were curious about dessert and ask for a menu. He list the menu off as best as he can remember off the top of his head and ask if we're interested. We decline and pay the $306 check leaving a $60 tip just out of plane old decency and leave abruptly. I looked for the second gentleman that helped us and did a wonderful job to hand him a tip as well, but we didn't see him. I know this is a rambling review but so many things went the wrong way it was hard to describe. I'm sure we'll return, but I think we'll try try our luck just at the bar next time
name: Mike

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. text:
After hearing so many good things about Vic, I finally made a visit for on a Saturday. The place is not really spacious, probably can seat 10 or so at the same time. The rolls in the 3 roll deal are those smaller/skinner rolls, and they were nicely presented together in a big plate. Taste wise, I didn't find anything too amusing or special about my rolls, but my friend who has a more sensitive tastebud than I do says the rolls taste very fresh that the ingredients must be of good quality.

Service wise, we got our food pretty quickly and have nothing to complain.

text:
My wife and I ate here after attending a movie to celebrate a birthday...just figured we'd have a couple of appetizers to finish off a nice afternoon/evening. 
But I had gotten an email the day before (sign up for their "rewards" program) that gave me a free Lo Mein entree with the purchase of another. So we ended up getting Chicken Lo Mein and Honey Shrimp along with a couple appetizers. 
A lot more than what we thought of getting, but the nice thing is that their food as leftovers still tastes great. So we ended up with a great lunch the next day.
Service was great. Alex did a wonderful job of keeping our iced teas full. 
We got there around 5:30 on a Tuesday and the two of us got seated immediately. 
Their not the cheapest place for Chinese so we really only go there for "special" occasions, but quality has always been good when we go. 
We'll keep going back for those "special" occasions (and when we get a free deal by email).

text: I highly recommend Joe Mamma's for a great breakfast this was by far one of the best breakfasts I have ever eaten in my lifetime. This is a must for even the most picky breakfast eaters! So Yummy!!

text: Went here last Friday. I got the Cajun chicken critters thinking they would be spicy and they had no taste at all and we're not even spicy! Just glorified chicken tenders. My boyfriend got the chicken costoletta and there was barley any sauce on it. We asked for extra and only got two scoops of sauce. Food took a bit to come out and when we went to pay with cash the waiter said he didn't have change to give back, so he ended up with a hefty tip. We were extremely disappointed in our experience.

text:
I went here in September 2019 for lunch with my 2 non-vegan eating friends. The entrance is a tad hard to locate but it's inside the yoga studio. The decor is very eclectic/ major Urban Outfitters vibes with metal straws and neon signs. The employee was very friendly and seemed like she genuinely wanted us to enjoy our meal. 
I ordered the tamal corn cake (which was offered heated or room temp) and the teriyaki tofu sandwich + side salad. The tamal cake was delicious, it reminded me of my Mexican mother's home cooking.  It was bigger than I expected and a good price at that. The sandwich was OK, the taste was good, but the tofu was too thicc. Ooh he thicc. 
One of my friends ordered the bhima veggie burger which she said tasted very healthy, which means not flavorful. My other friend ordered the jackfruit mole poblano which was straight up inedible. Maybe the ingredients had gone bad by the time we arrived in our hotel a couple of hours later, but I wouldn't recommend it. She also ordered a smoothie and a macha latte which she liked. I tasted both and did not like it, but if you're into super natural drinks- then you'll prob like them. My friend loved both.

text: Food was superb!! Excellent customer service and ambiance. Everything was fresh and cooked to perfection Peruvian style. And OMG the desserts were soo good we had to try them all!! I just wish we found this place earlier so we could go back before we leave Florida.

text: Great food great staff great location!  Pizzas cooked in under 5 minutes in a huge stone hearth oven. Staff is very pleasant and helpful!!  I'll definitely be back!!

text: Get there early, it sells out often for the day. Stopped on a rainy Saturday afternoon and did a to-go order that included: the infamous OG chicken sammich, a thigh, a drumstick, potato salad, and jumbo wings. The sammich was fire. Worth the money, the hype, the wait... all of it. Perfect balance of all the flavors, it's a large sammich so be hungry or split it. The thigh and drumstick were just OK, the meat was a bit fatty and the coating was crunchy but just tasted "fried." Potato salad was good and the wings were OK, same issue as the other chicken. The sammich was the real winner and I'll definitely be back for it again.
name: Amie

text: My husband & I decided to spend the afternoon in Tampa and decided to go to Ulele's for some drinks and lunch. It was before noon & they we not busy at all. We stood at the hostess stand for a good 10 minutes before we were seated at an outdoor table. Our waiter came and he had quite the attitude going on. He took or drink order (Beer & a Bloody Mary) and 20 minutes go by (yes 20 minutes for a restaurant that was not busy) before he finally reappears and this is what he said to us verbatim "Do you still want your drinks because the bar is backed up?" Now please tell me what server in their right mind would say that to customers? We looked at him totally shocked and said we'd move over to the bar they have outside. He didn't pick up our waters, silverware, nothing to help us move . He just walked the hell away! No apologies no nothing. There is one other customer sitting at the bar eating however there is no bartender. So we proceed to sit another 10 minutes and so no service. So we decided this place obviously sucks decided to leave but not before I found a manager. I told him everything and he just looked at me like I was insane. So I walked out. This is such poor customer service. We will not be going back, EVER. I hope they go out of business because they don't give a crap about excellent customer service.
name: Kat

text:
Great value, two piece dark chicken. Long line for Sunday lunch with some rain.  Took 50 from getting in line to getting food.

Food was worth the wait. Cole slaw and yummy baked beans w bacon bit. Slaw needed dash of salt and had some big thick pieces. I got medium chicken (level 3 of 5), goes from Non spicy to hottest Shut the Cluck Up. 

Didn't eat the bread that soaks up chicken oil. Medium was the right amount of spicy. Chicken was juicy and cooked perfectly! Fries were great, spicy but kinda salty. Ours were served at room temp. They kindly gave us fresh batch. 

Have sweet and brewed tea. Unlimited. Great friendly, customer service. Clean place, tvs showing sports. Big parking lot

There is a separate to go line 
And make sure you try the banana pudding!! Can taste the freshness and perfect ratio of pudding, banana and Nilla wafers. Also have peach cobbler t-shirts, hats and cups for sale. Black and red Jersey tees are cute, so soft, $25. Available online too
name: Mia

text:
From start to finish, an amazing experience!

text:
This is a tough one to review because while the main dishes are certainly fine, they are outshined by the sides. The sides we ordered were all terrific and all of them but the fries offered a unique twist on your standard meat and three sides fair that could be appreciated precisely because the ingredients are relatively sparse and so the unique spin they put on each side really "pops".

The main dishes aren't bad, but the ones we had had the opposite effect of the sides - there was so much going on that all the ingredients overwhelm each other and, in a way, end up washing each other out. On top of that, with all the added bells and whistles, you really don't get much of a feel for how good the sauce or the bbq is. By the end I was full and while I wasn't disappointed, I just really didn't get a feel for what their actual bbq tasted like.

I think this place gets something very right that even places like Edley's, a personal favourite, tend to overlook: the opportunity to innovate and improve on tried and true sides. The downside is that I believe they need to rethink/retool some of their main dishes to make them less "busy" and better able to shine as just plain good bbq, which should be at the heart of a place like this.
name: Phil

text:
Founding Fathers is one of my favorite sports bars in the City, but the pricepoint and crowds keep us from going regularly.  

The good:  The food really is great.  The menu is typical, if slightly upscale, bar food, but the food itself is delicious and very good quality.  There is far greater effort and attention paid to the food here than you're typical sports bar.  Worth a stop for dinner, IMHO.

The TV options are great, even if somewhat poorly controlled (I guess like all sports bars) by the staff.  However, the managers seem to get it, so flag one down if you're looking for something in particular.  

The bar itself is obviously updated, comfortable and plenty of views to watch the game.  

The bad:  It's typically crowded and especially so for games.  If you're not there early, good luck finding a seat let alone a table.  

It's expensive for a sports bar.  Beer specials can be had at a somewhat reasonable price, but if that's not your preference, the beer menu can get pricey.  The food isn't cheap either.  If you're posting up for 3-4 hours with apps, drinks, etc., expect a large bill.  It makes it hard to return here regularly.  

Overall, we love founding fathers.  I wish it was a little less expensive, but you get what you pay for and the experience, food, drinks are all great.
name: Justin

text:
I saw this Freshii location opened up thanks to Yelp labeling it "hot and new."  Freshii is two parcels east of Coldstone. The inside is clean, vibrant and new. I've been to another Freshii in Oldsmar and both stores were about the same.

Freshii sells bowls, burrito's, salads and wraps. Many of their offerings isn't what you'd normally see at Panera or a sandwhich shop. Freshii pairs different ingredients together with a focus on vegetables like kale, broccoli, carrots, beets and mixes them with rice, beans, yogurt based sauces and proteins. 

Freshii has menu paired items but allows customers to subtract ingredients or make thier bowl, wrap, salad or burrito with a check off sheet on a small clipboard at the register.  Freshii advertises menu items but they do not have protein in them it cost $1.99 extra to add chicken, falafel or tofu and steak is $3.49.

I ordered the Oaxaca bowl for $8.49 which had brown rice, kale, avacado, beet slaw, black beans, salsa fresca, tortillas chips, lime wedge and spicy yogurt sauce. I added falafel for $1.99. The bowl I recieved was neatly portioned into quadrants around the bowl with protien in the middle. I enjoyed what I ordered and I'm so happy the Trinity area is finally getting healthy places to eat for food conscious people but I think you have to be in the mood for the pairings offered by Freshii although they're healthy you wont find a typical salad or bread bowl here but thats what separates them from their competition.

text: I placed an order online and it was ready on time. The place was very clean and I was greeted by a very nice gentleman who stated he was happy to be of service and hoped I liked his food and would spread the word. I have to say though, that if you have ever eaten food from Byblos or Mona's, don't bother with this place.  The food was far inferior to either of the other places mentioned.  The hummus was grainy, and virtually tasteless. The gyro meat was from what appeared to be pre-packaged/once-frozen chunks, dry and hard, and nothing like the freshly sliced, as you watch, gyro meat found at Byblos.  The salad was essentially an embarrassment.  Soggy, dripping with what tasted like bottled italian salad dressing, with small bits of soggy green leaf lettuce, tiny diced tomatoes, a few olives, pieces of what tasted like fresh feta cheese and what appeared to me to be small pieces of pita bread which were fried and thrown into the salad as some sort of croutons?  I also ordered some falafel, which, once again, seemed to be pre-formed, possibly previously frozen, little dry, hard nuggets with no discernible flavor.  I was also given two pieces of pita bread, cut in half and surprisingly soft and fresh.  I honestly cannot see myself returning to this restaurant.  It would require them making some really extensive changes necessary to keep up with the quality of places like Byblos and Mona's.  I hate to leave bad reviews of new places, as I love to see new businesses succeed, especially new restaurants because I know the hard work it takes to be successful.  Hoping these guys take suggestions and try to make some badly needed changes to something as simple as falafel and hummus
name: Gretchen

text: I came here a couple of weeks ago because it's been chilly out and boyfriend was feeling a little under the weather. This place is in the old Ruby's Diner, so it's pretty big and looks almost the same. We were greeted by a man who seems to be the manager. Very chill and caring guy. We got seated pretty quickly and noticed the restaurant seemed maybe a bit understaffed, but you could tell most of the workers were multi-tasking and doing their best. I asked for a Coke Zero included in my order. I don't usually check best by dates on bottles, but I immediately opened my Coke Zero and tasted some really old soda syrup and what tasted like old sugar water, with little to no fizz... I was pretty shocked but knew something wasn't right. I looked at the date and it said best by May or July. Either way, that's a while ago. I bet it would've tasted fine if it was a month or two off, but it was so bad. We told an older server and he left the soda on a counter, got another from the fridge and didn't check if that was one was also expired. Same date. We told him and he got my boyfriend to read the date on the other bottles... I was really disappointed he didn't check on his own or tell someone else because that meant the inventory on the sodas were bad. No apologies either. Although luckily thanks to the man who greeted and sat us (manager?) gave me a complimentary soda instead and was very sincere about it. It just seems like something a worker could've easily informed him about, because after 40 minutes of eating we ended up telling him ourselves. Seems like Pholicious has a lot of catching up to do. Certainly know they can do better!

text: Ruby Slipper is a great spot for the breakfast/brunch lovers out there - which is me! This french toast was amazing as well and really well balanced! I wish this specific french toast was available everyday! I'm a fan of ruby each time I'm in NOLA.
name: Cory

text:
I had been meaning to try this place for brunch based on rave reviews from a foodie friend and the 4-stars on Yelp. Our experience, however, was undoubtedly the worst I have ever had at a restaurant. 

First, the food. They were out of a number of dishes. We ordered the stuffed mushrooms app only to be told they had no mushrooms caps, so we got the mini crab cakes instead. Not only did just two of the tiniest crab cakes I've ever seen come out, but we also did not get the sauce that was supposed to accompany them. They tasted like the vegetable oil they were fried in. Terrible. 

Shrimp and grits, also not available. So I ordered an omelet and my partner got the burger. His burger, which was supposed to be medium rare, came out burnt to a crisp with shredded cheddar on top and a side of bbq sauce (that was inaccurately labeled  as BBQ debris on the menu). It was also supposed to have fried onions on top, but when he asked about them, he was told those were also sold out. Thanks for the heads up.

Still, his burger was edible. My omelet, on the other hand, was not. The crab i opted to add tasted like lake Pontchartrain it was so fishy. I don't understand how the kitchen didn't smell it was bad while cooking it. I dug out as much as I could, but opted to not eat most of my omelet for fear of getting ill. The biscuit was the only redeeming quality. 

Now, to top off our terrible food experience, the service was just as awful. Our server was clearly frazzled and very short and rude to us. She never once asked how our meal was, even though clearly there had been an issue with my barely eaten omelet. And then, when our check finally came, my partner realized he never received the side of potatoes he ordered. He very reasonably asked if it could be taken off the bill. She glared at him a moment and walked away without saying a word, only to approach the hostess and proclaim very loudly that "this guy is mad he didn't get his potatoes and now he's asking for a discount!" Unconscionably rude. The hostess, at least, was helpful and fixed our tab. 

Overall, we walked away hungry, unsatisfied and extremely pissed. What a terrible experience in a city known for its friendliness and food!
name: Amanda

text:
After a not so glowing review of The Manor from back in the day, I was really excited to try the new restaurant that moved in to that location. Brasserie Bardot is a true French style bistro with a strong  Bridgette Bardot theme. The bones of the place are exactly the same, but it's just much cleaner and brighter.

I started out with wings a L'orange which were awesome. Really rich glaze, kind of sweet but not too much so, and still nice and crispy. Huge portion too, like 12 wings to an order. My gf had the nicosie salad with the absolute best piece of tuna either of us had ever tried. The salad itself wasn't my thing but the tuna steak...my lord. Definitely worth the trip all on its own. Seasoned with just salt and pepper but cooked to perfection. Highly recommend. 

For mains I had the Ribeye which was cooked well but honestly was pretty mediocre, the bernaise sauce it came with was very solid though. Gf had the Sole meunière with brown butter sauce. Just delicious!! Amazing sauce perfect cook on the fish. Amazing. 

Finished off with a creme brûlée that was a great way to end our meal. Creamy and delicious.

They have an outstanding wine list with plenty of affordable options both French and otherwise. Service was awesome as well. We had a lovely girl who was very knowledgeable with both the menu and wine list. I don't know if we ever had to fill our own glasses of water or wine.

All in all a far cry better than the old tenants of this old house turned restaurant. Extremely pleasurable night, will definitely go back

Cheers

Andy

text: Oyster House surpassed my expectations for a bustling cozy spot to grab some seafood.  Upon entering I thought I would have to wait over an hour for a table but we were seated immediately and the hostess was very welcoming.  Once we were seated it was like a marathon but in a good way.  Drinks,apps, food. The ginger beer was the best I've tried even in comparison to authentic Jamaican kind.  The aioli that comes with the fries was exquisite and the Oysters Rockefeller were the freshest - like WOW.  Cabbage slaw =yum. And clams on the half shell were tasty.  The clam bake for two could've used a little more seasoning but it was still delicious. It may have been the best bite of lobster I have ever had.  So juicy.  Meanwhile the service was impeccable- from the waiter who was super efficient and friendly to clearing the dishes to refilling the water to the timing of the food delivered to the table.  EVERYTHING was on point.  The tightest run ship I think I've ever experienced.  This is my new favorite Philly spot for seafood.  We would've gone to Ocean something around the corner but they had a dress code - so glad because we would've missed out on some great food.

text: I've been coming here for 20+ years. It could be one of my favorite restaurants. Nothing special inside but the food is amazing. text: This was on my list to try for months and my husband and I were finally able to check it out for my birthday. We had reservations but, when we arrived there didn't seem to be a wait (note: it was a Wednesday). We had to wait about 2 mins for them to set up our table. I loved the looked and feel of the place, semi classy but comfortable, and the pops of orange we're great. The menu is simple, but layered with so many complex things. We started with mussels and mushroom toast. The mushroom toast was my favorite, unique flavor combos that I wouldn't not have thought of, but they worked out so well. The sourdough bread that came with the mussels was soooo delicious. I can't really explain why, but I know that if I ate that and only that, I would still go home happy. I had the special (seafood gumbo/jambalaya) and my husband had the salmon. I love that they are very cautious of food allergies and try to accommodate everyone. I also like how their ingredients are sourced locally. The good really was outstanding and the staff was very nice. As much as I wanted dinner, I couldn't fit anymore food into my belly, but they were nice enough to bring me a birthday ice cream. We can't wait to go back and try other items on the menu.

The Spicy Thai Shrimp is a  delicious appetizer.  We have had their Classic Cheese Burgers, Shrimp and Crab Burgers, Napa Valley Salad (add salmon), Steak - Filet, Thai Salmon, Spaghetti, Cajun... all was excellent.  Their Drunken Mussels are a family favorite although now you have to add the spaghetti.  The mussels are always perfectly cooked and never chewy.  If you like to share they split the meal for you and serve everything beautifully.  The service has always been excellent and the restaurant is always clean.

text:
The service isn't good. I think I got a smile and "hello" from one person. Our waitress started being nice toward the end, I guess to ensure she'd get a tip. They served me an enchilada but told me it was a burrito. I didn't want to make too much of a fuss about it so I just ate the meal. 

The food was bland but better once I added hot sauce. I also added sour cream but wasn't told it would cost and extra $1.25. I think you have to stick to smaller restaurants to get authentic food.

text: We have been here several times but today was the first day we had brunch. Great place with a heavy metal vibe. My husband had the Bowl of Slop, he loved it!  The jalapeño Gouda sauce is phenomenal!  Definitely are looking forward to going back soon.
name: Lori

text: Fantastic tacos. Probably the best I've ever had. I should have ordered more because they were very small, but priced appropriately. I will be back for more soon!
name: Ryan

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. I had a better visit than I expected to. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Coffee was super sweet. It's a nice space and has more seating than most other coffee shops in Nashville.
name: Maggie

text: My family and I came here to grab a quick lunch. It was a group of 10 of us and they were able to sit us immediately, so we were very happy about that. I wasn't in the mood for a burger, so I opted for their chicken tenders and fries. I've had better but it got the job done. Our waitress was very attentive and had a great personality. The only thing I didn't like was having to constantly swat flies. We were sitting near the door. I know it's nothing they can do about that but it was hard to enjoy my lunch. Everyone else really enjoyed their burgers, so next time I'll try one out since it is a burger place.
name: Amber

text:
My burrito was very good.  The chips and salsa were delicious.  My wife's fajitas had a bizarre tomato juice like taste though.

But what makes my review low was not the food or the ambiance.  We had the worst, most apathetic  waitress I have ever encountered in my life.  She did absolutely nothing but take our order, and I mean that completely.  There is no exaggeration in that statement.  She came by a few times to ask us if we needed anything, but when we made a request, she would just smile and blow us off.  We asked for refills on our water twice, and twice I was forced to go to the bar and get the refills myself.  We asked for more chips and salsa 3 times, and three times I had to flag down the bus boy to do her job. What the Hell? Were we not worth her time, because we ordered no alcohol?

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Maybe other people have better luck here. For the price I expected more than this. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.

text: I was surprised when I heard this place was hiding inside the Assi plaza and I am glad I went to check it out. This place no longer has the 2 or 3 roll deal but the prices are very reasonable and let me tell you, the sushi is amazing. Very nice people who run it and I would definitely be going back!

text: Decided to drive 25 minutes to get food here to see if it is as good as people say.  We totally agree.  The only comment I would say is to ask for extra sauce.  Pulled pork was great but needed more sauce.  Ribs were excellent, mac and cheese totally great!!  I also would as for my greens to be cooked a little more or I will do it at home.  They were spicy and tasty.  I'll try more next time but will tell our friends up in NW area to go, its worth the trip!

text: They have lots of options for vegetarians and vegans, and GF people too! Actually, they mark menu items by whether they are veggie-friendly (the typical V) but by what type of meat they have in them (so a little silhouette of a chicken or a cow, etc).  Things that would normally be off limits in typical restaurants are actually vegan! For example, the mozzerella sticks are made with cashew cheese and the spaghetti with meatballs is actually spaghetti squash with lentil-balls (GF). For those who aren't crazy about vegan/vegetarian food, there are a lot of options for them as well - and according to my family (who are not vegetarian), their meals were all really great! Nice warm atmosphere, cool location and seating options, and friendly service. Just a good experience overall every time I've been there.
name: Jen

text: 3 words French Toast Batons.  Way too much sweetness for one person ,but I did my best.  Would've given 5 star but the bloody Mary's and Migas were just okay.

text: I went to Kanamizu with my sister and her boyfriend yesterday and we got there around 5:30 or so and we were seated pretty quickly. text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. name: User

text: I came in on a Saturday morning for some breakfast sandwiches to go. There was ONE employee there alone having to handle both the cashiering and order processing. The young man was as efficient as he could be and very apologetic but cooking breakfast items required time and my two breakfast sandwiches took over a half hour to receive. I do not blame the young man at all, but shame on management for not making sure the place was staffed correctly for a busy weekend morning. There were several people who left without ordering because of the delay. Treat your staff better or you will continue to lose business.

text:
My in-laws live in Hillsboro Village & told us we ought to check this place out. 
We were very happy we did. 
Even though it was a rather cold rainy evening the heaters on the deserted patio were very inviting. 
They offered us happy hour drink specials of which I tried a couple. 
We are so spoilt for great cocktail bars in Nashville (as well as the very well stocked 1 at our house) that unless I'm going to a restaurant for drinks, or they just really wow me, I don't count underwhelming tastings against them. 
The burgers were legit as were the fries. Our very friendly waitress bought us a fancy ketchup for our fries but we ate them all without even trying it!
Even on a dreary weeknight we noticed the patronage swelling with an enthusiastic hum as the dinner hour advanced. 
I'm confident this will be a lively place to spend an evening meal most nights & am looking forward to coming back when the weather warms.
name: Brett

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Price felt a touch high for what it was. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Would return. No big complaints, just a nice meal.

text:

text: This place knows how to do it. From the complimentary valet parking, (if you choose) ample self parking to the outstanding pan fried Rainbow Trout with a dynamite Ceasar Salad. I ordered a cup of the Fish Chowder. Excellent. I was there on a Saturday night. Solo, I managed to squeeze into a seat at the bar quickly joining the chat. The wine is served in a carafe, the breadbasket is a small, round just out of the oven loaf. Peasant, French or maybe Sourdough it's what you want in your daily bread. The service is splendid, the person that takes your order does not deliver. Someone else brings the course at the right time. The person taking your order is busy refilling your drink, setting your table with a chance to join the chat. Enough about them. The setting is a classic beach experience and the prices are downright lovable. My trout was $10.99 which included a small but expertly dressed mixture of romaine, tomato bits, shaved Parmesan and a dressing that isn't afraid to show it's true colors, anchovies and garlic. Go for the food, drink or fun. But just go. That is if you can get in.

text:
District Taco is a very welcome addition to the Village family; the meat to taco ratio was very favorable towards meat and the tacos were delightfully tasty.  At $2.66 per taco (when you buy 3 or more), the price is very fair and reasonable...actually, it's excellent.

There were many condiments to choose from: a large number of salsas of varying heat, and freshly diced jalapeños, onions, cilantro, and an excellent pico de gallo.  The tacos can further be customized to include several additional toppings but I'd highly recommend sticking with the 'Jefe way,' which adds 4-5 of the usual (lettuce, tomato, 'lil sour cream, etc).  

The meats offered were so very flavorful; I tried them all and left rather full.  The bacon taco should be considered a novelty; while tasty and unique, it didn't have the same level of heartiness as any of the other meats.  The Carne Asada, the Carnitas, and the Al Pastor where my top three favorites.  If I were especially hungry, I'd add the Barbacoa.  The fish tacos (only available on select days) were also very good; they come with a nice slaw and a chipotle mayonnaise that is smooth, creamy, and warm.

It's really hard to compete being next to Wegmans but District Taco brings forth a culinary treat worth enjoying; once is just not enough.

Disclaimer: I only pigged out on the Tacos, and thus this review and rating are all about the Tacos at District Taco.
name: Eric

text: Going into Costa Vida, I had the expectation of a "nicer Chipotle" based on what someone had told me. Set up of the restaurant is similar to a Chipotle - you can see all the ingredients right in front of you and choose from different salsas, meats, etc. I had a baja bowl with raspberry chicken (yum!) and I added gauc for an extra buck. The meals are really colorful. My husband had the chile verde burrito and although the salsa and tortilla were really tasty, he said that the meat was pretty bland. Prices are similar to Chipotle. The restaurant wasn't the cleanest - the floors and tables were dirty. But overall, I really enjoyed the raspberry chicken and that's something that Chipotle can't offer.
name: Laura

text: You can tell they care about customer experience here. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Would absolutely visit again. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
We came here last week to catch a concert in the main venue downstairs. City Winery is a new addition to the renovated FDP, as well as a new addition to the Philly music venue scene. I cannot speak to the wine/food here, but as a venue, it's awkward and it's cramped. You're seated at tiny dinner tables elbow to elbow with your neighbors and it's angled in such a way that if you have your back turned to the stage, you either crane your neck and turn your chair. Thankfully, we didn't have folks sitting next to us; otherwise, it would've been a tight squeeze. The wait staff comes around and takes your order before the show starts, and they have to maneuver around during the show, especially if people are taking pictures/recording during the concert.

We happened to grab a bite before the show, and I was thankful that we did, because the menu options seem underwhelming. My plus one sat across from me, feeling quite uncomfortable and he ended up moving next to me to get a better view of the show. The acoustics were pretty decent, but this would not be a place I would choose to go see a concert unless it was another artist I am dying to see. The seating arrangements need to be more comfortable and more spread out in order to accommodate folks.
name: Heather

text: I'm sorry but I cannot recommend their Chinese food. The chicken fried rice I ordered tonight was gross, it was bland, no flavor. The seaweed salad was disgusting I had had to spit my first bite out. The bbq ribs were ok but had a lot of fatty pieces that were not tasty.

text:
Came here after a yummy lunch at La Pequena Colombia. Ordinarily I would be all about dessert but I was too stuffed and it was just way too hot for me.

I picked out a few Colombian breads to go and an Agua de panela which was refreshing.  I think I made friends with everyone in the store asking them what they liked the most and learned a few more things as well. Quite fun. 

Out of the three breads, this time the almojabana was my favorite. Say that super fast. Talk about a tongue twister.
Pan de bono is usually my favorite but here it wasn't as soft as I have had it. The pan de yuca was different but I like it softer.

I'll be back if I am back in the area. I know what I like here but I also know where my fave pan de bono is.

Don't forget to check this place out for all your Colombian eats. They seem to be more of a cafe than a sit down restaurant. They do also have sandwiches, appetizers, tapas, drinks, and coffees.

They also have outside seating which Is a nice option in the non summer months.

text:
FOOD:
Rating: 3/5
In terms of presentation, with all of the food options visible within a short distance, I believe the Sands Buffet had comparable food options to some of the "larger" buffets in Reno, but it may be perceived has having less. However, after getting our first few plates, nothing necessarily stood out as exemplary. With the dessert section covering almost a 1/3 of the buffet area (which I wasn't complaining about), absolutely made up for the main courses. Of the items we tried, I enjoyed just about all of them.

SERVICE:
Rating: 4/5
One of the unique services provided was asking what we wanted for our initial beverages at the service counter in the beginning, this helped avoid the awkward waiting at the start of a buffet. With that being said, my wife and I were initially seated at a long table where we sat next to each other. When we asked to be moved to a table where we could face each other, we were promptly helped. The employee who was helping us was always on hand and will to help.

CLEANLINESS:
Rating: 5/5
We came in on a Thursday shortly after their dinner opening. The seating and buffet area were extremely clean and kept that way during our entire meal.

PRICE:
Rating: 2/5
Unfortunately this area is where the Sands Buffet is lacking the most. With a weekday buffet costing $18.99, the buffet at the Atlantis would have cost $25.99 at the same time. Although there is a price difference, the cost for the quality of food is not necessarily comparable. 

INSPECTIONS:
At the time of this review, the last food establishment inspection occurred on 08/16/2018 and passed with no violations.

OVERALL:
Rating: 3.5/5
With the remodel completed relatively recently, the Sands Buffet offers a more modernized approach to buffets. Although nothing is necessarily ground breaking, the Sands Buffet offers a quick meal with fantastic service at a price point that is cheaper than most of their competitors.

text: First time in Nashville and it was late in the evening on a Friday night, last month. We were not sure where to eat. We saw Hard Rock and thought, "ok we will go there, Hard Rock always has decent food". Boy were we wrong. We should have realized... no line like everywhere else... run. But.. its the Hard Rock, cant be that bad... We went in and were seated right away. I think we were one of five tables. The waiter was great, excellent service. The music was great as well. The drinks were horrible and very overpriced. Still, no big deal. We ordered three huge fajita nachos and two burgers with fries. The burgers with fries were just okay, a little bland. The Nachos, thats where we went wrong. By the time they got to the table they were very cold. One plate had nearly raw fajita meat on it, a little brown on the outside, red and dripping with blood on the inside. They did not ask how the meat was to be prepared. We sent it back as the person would not have been able to eat blood-soaked chips. The second person ate a few chips off the enormous plate and stopped eating. The third person, She started eating and went to get her fork from under neath the edge of her plate and felt something odd. When she lifted her plate there was food literally baked on to the half of the bottom of the plate. It had been there for a bit. We still had not gotten the third nachos back from the kitchen. We showed the waiter the dirty plate, he was pretty embarrassed and apologized. We told him to cancel the third one. As he walked away he was telling a coworker about the dirty plate and showing it to her. The third plate of nachos was coming out as he was walking back. When they arrived at the table you could clearly tell the kitchen did not appreciate the food being sent back. The meat was burned and the whole top of the stack of nachos was burned black. I am guessing they were just making sure that the meat was done and not raw, right... So the waiter apologized and said he would talk to the manager. As we were waiting for the check I needed to use the ladies room. I walked in, it was appalling. There was wet toilet paper strung across the bathroom floor. The stall itself was not even hover-able. I could understand if this was a busy establishment, but it was pretty empty. Staff was just sitting around at the bar pretty much doing nothing. Someone could have easily checked the conditions of the restroom. The manager never did come out. The waiter advised us that the manager took the nachos off the bill. Our bill for two burgers and fries and about six cocktails... $120 before the tip... Save your money and stay far away from this nasty establishment.

text:
Up to this point, I would often pick up lunch for coworkers and I, because we work down the street a mere minutes away. In excitement for their opening, I was there for the opening day, I have taken my daughter and wife separately for individual date nights, and even gave a glowing review that was rightful at the time. The line between awesome and disgusting, however, is hair-thin and that is what has happened here: One of my most favorite restaurant locations produced a lunch that had a hair in it.

I always think about what kind of rating I would give after whatever experience I have at any restaurant and try hard not to hand out blanket glowing reviews or bombs, but this is a different case. Should a person who finds a disturbing quality/health issue give the benefit of the doubt and say, "While I found this disgusting, the experience around the disgusting bit was good, so three stars seems right?" No. The potential for consuming a piece of another human being - especially a random human being is revolting and that is why it seems too great to give anything more than a single star. 

I did send this information through their contact form to alert them of the issue to prevent this from happening in the future to anyone else, but, for me, I think this may have instantly broken the camel's back. It's pretty disappointing.

text:
Tried this place in an effort to establish my BBQ go to.  

I ordered a small party pack which included 2 lbs if meat, full slab of ribs and 3 sides with buns and sauce. I substituted the buns with corn bread.
Our sides were macaroni and cheese,  cheese corn and coleslaw. 

The ribs were succulent and delicious. I ordered brisket and sausage for the 2 lbs of meats. I was disappointed as there wasn't any special about the sausage and the brisket was dry.   We also ordered a side plate of brisket burnt ends. These were awesomely delicious - too bad the normal brisket did not have the same amount of fat which would have made a world of difference. 

The sides and corn bread were excellent. Could not stop eating the cornbread. 

My rating is three stars because in my opinion one of the plates that need to be on point is the brisket. 

Will try again, hopefully it was a one time lapse with the brisket.
name: Elliot

text: My friend likes coming here for the bean burger and the jack Daniels sauce. The fries are always crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside ( just how we like it. I got the Cobb salad and it was massive (thank you to the waitress for letting me sub in bacon for extra avocado )  we also got the breadsticks which were veryyyyy good ! Overall great service here :)
name: Altinay

text: I had read the reviews for this place and even saw the pictures of the food they serve. I went today for the first time and ordered 2 seared ahi burgers to go. To my major disappointment, when I opened the box it was an over cooked thin slice of tuna.  Not at all the "massive seared ahi burger" I had read in one of the reviews.  TOTALLY DISAPPOINTING BURGER! Kyle's Kitchen has a better seared ahi burger and it's across the way.
name: Joanna

text: This place is the Jam!!! The food is so good and very good prices.  The buttermilk chicken taco is absolutely incredible!  Wish it was a little bigger, but  I don't feel like I ate too much after a couple of them.  :)  the staff is great, the drinks are really good and they take good care of you.  I want to see this place make it!  Go eat here so I can get more chicken tacos!!!!
name: Adam

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. For the price I expected more than this. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: We came here for a late breakfast on our last day in NOLA and were lucky enough to score a table inside by the window. The view was a direct shot of the barista rolling her eyes and talking about every customer when they walked away. She clearly dislikes her job and people in general. The man that delivered my lox and bagels also rolled his eyes when I asked for lime or lemon for the lox. Coffee ok. Food ok. Service and overall vibe: shitty
name: Lora

text:
Wow-wee.....really a great spot for oysters. Holy cow they were goooood! Everyone is right, there is a line but it does move quick. We went on a Friday night around 5:45 and there was a few groups in front of ours, but about 20 minutes and we were in the door (the line behind us was stacking up fast and people kept coming!). Place is pretty small but the staff was prompt and attentive! Put in our order for chargrilled oysters and some gravy fries and felt like minutes later they were back with our apps. Both where awesome! The chargrilled oysters were definitely the bomb. I think they sprinkle crack on them. 

We had picky teenagers with us and even they ate the oysters and we had to fight them for the last couple. It was loads of fun. We ordered po-boy, beans and rice, bread bowl and gumbo. Everything was okay but doesn't measure up to the oysters. We'd go back for the apps, oysters and beer, but the rest of the food was just ok. 

We were in from out of town and tried several oyster spots before going here. Well worth the wait but you must get the chargrilled oysters. You have better options for entrees but overall we were glad to find this spot.
name: Tim

text: Food is good and plentiful, setting is very divey(?) so depends what youre looking for!
name: Jayla

text: Have been here several times and so that in and of itself is a very positive thing...LSR that serves up good chicken.  I go for the 3 wing combo with skinny fries and krunchy kale salad (add hot sauce, delectable)....atmosphere is very unasssuming and functional with a nice lil patio, some bar height tables are available and mostly table height, the bar rail is short legged and not appropriate to sit at while gobbling down their delicious whole wings, their are a couple TVs and cool 90s tunes...get the sauce on the wings not on the side, as the sauce settlement/sediment in the bottom of the cup is hard to dip and coat properly...sauce on is how you do it.....service is good, friendly and fairly knowledgeable about the menu.  Smiles smiles....they do have a few beers as well.....best hot chicken I've had yet in this town, if there are better i wanna try it, but this is good...
name: Jim

text: In my previous review I mentioned of an inconsistency in the service and product I received on my latest visit to one of my favorite places. The manager Pike immediately sprung into action, responded, apologized and handled the discrepancy. That's what I call running a business and keeping the customers coming!
name: Anita

text: Flies everywhere quoted wrong price mention to the manager butterflies came up with an excuse that the door kept staying open cheap white bread rolls dirty water and most of all coded wrong price on the menu
name: Saleh

text: Ordered through UberEats and sadly couldn't eat the burger because it was completely raw. They also forgot to include our drinks or requested condiments. If you're into eating raw meat and getting food poisoning, this is your place!
name: Elizabeth

text: Service was good. Food was ok. Someone in my party got sick from funky crab cakes and broiled fish.
name: A

text: I love this place! The raw oysters were one of the best I've ever had and the po boys were also delicious! They also have oyster shots, which sounds questionable but I definitely recommend you try it if you like oysters with a kick. The only downside is that the wait was nearly 2 hours for us because we had a big group so we ended up splitting into 2 smaller groups in order to get in faster.
name: Lam

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text:
This is seriously my new favorite place to eat in Nashville! EVERYTHING ON THEIR MENU IS SO GOOD! The chicken is phenomenal, the sides are TO DIE FOR, and don't forget all the dessert and drinks you could ever want. 

You will not be disappointed with Hattie B's, trust me! You have got to check this place out if you're in or around the Nashville area!
name: Lauren

text:
I stopped here for lunch today.  It was good!
I had an order of Sweet and Sour chicken.  It came with my choice of soup or salad (I chose the Miso soup).  I also chose fried rice. Everything was very good.
name: Bill

text:
Decent restaurant. 
The only drawback is the wait for a table. 
Sure, it can be expected on certain days, but Sundays is the worst.They don't take names so it gets crazy when people pile in and the waiting area is small.
My food came fast considering the wait to be seated. It was hot and as expected.
The server was pleasant. 
Denny's pretty much is the same all over and this location was pretty good.
name: Ed

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. A couple small things kept adding up. Wouldn't really choose this place again. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Food is greasy this is what you get for 10 dollars fried rice is terrible  and look more like brown rice I'll pass moving forward
name: Andrea

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Pretty decent food....TERRIBLE service model. We live in Kirkwood and and gone here many times mostly for take out and the service process they have is lacking! On many occasions when I have called the phone will either 1) ring for minutes on end without answer, 2) I will be discounted while out on hold or the worst 3) not even ringing because the phone is "out of service."  This means you have to keep trying to called multiple multiple times hoping that someone figures it out. Then, if I am able to place an order, I usually have to sit and wait for my food longer than the quoted time. This poor service behavior is consistent and very frustrating. I hope someone can fix this soon.
name: Nicole

text:
Fist time! 

Had the chorizo egg potatoes burrito, chorizo was great! however, the potatoes were really under cooked, no seasoning.
name: Vivian

text: Best Japanese restaurant hands down. I have had everything on the menu and everything is tasty. All worker and friendly !
name: Sunny

text: My favorite place in Tampa to grab coffee, and awesome place to work as well. It's never too crowded, which is my favorite part about this place. Easy walk within downtown!
name: Maki

text:
I have no idea how Drago's doesn't have five stars !! This place is nothing less than amazing !! I've never had better seafood in my life ! 

The charbroiled oysters were to another level !! My mouth is watering just thinking about them. The raw oysters aren't my thing but were juicy and fresh!! Fried oysters were good but nothing compared to charbroiled! Alligator bites were good, I liked the sauce it came with ! 

As an entree I had the Marco lobster- wow!! The crab was tender and juicy !! Smothered in pasta crab and crawfish- out of this world ! Sauce had a bit of a kick but I loved it !!

My friends got the seafood pasta which was also delicious!!! 

Service was on point, I'm sorry I didn't catch our waitress' name but keep doing your thing! She was great ! We went last Sunday around noon, sat to the left right next to the wall in case there's a way to figure it out ! She deserves the recognition!

I would highly recommend Dragos ! You'd regret it if you didn't try! I will be returning on my next trip!
name: Priscilla

text: The food was amazing, service was great. Our server, Liza, was on top of it. She took good care of us. Would come back and recommend for sure.
name: Jacqui

text: If I could rate this place a 0/5 for service I would!!! We're currently sitting at the bar... that is maybe at 20% capacity and the female bartender (5'5" long dark hair) has walked by us sitting at the bar for the last 15'.... doesn't make eye contact with us and hasn't acknowledged us since sitting down.... real shame! Because
name: Melinda Victoria

text: Have been here twice and I feel like I'm under a spell. I had never been in once until last month and I find a reason to go as much as possible. If you decide to go make sure you have a free DAY because you will lose track of time and your money in there. The deals are spectacular and no matter what we got there it was for us. They keep the shelves stocked, the displays are excellent, and the staff are helpful.
name: Dante

text: This is where I go for delicious non fussy vegan food!  My fiancé loves it too and he's not vegan.  Try their version of a Big Mac, you won't be disappointed.  It can be a bit slow though so either call ahead or just be prepared to wait.
name: Kendall

text:
Mango Mango Dessert is located next door to a small temple and across the street from a hair salon. 

My husband and I came by here on a Friday night a little before 9:15 am. We were greeted and seated at a small table right away. After looking over the menu, we ended up getting:

A20: Mixed Fruit Sago With Coconut, $7 prior to tax ($7.56 after tax, prior to tip)- This dessert comes with coconut (although you can also choose to have mango instead) milk, tapioca balls, grass jelly, mango pieces, sliced bananas, strawberries, cantaloupe, honey dew and a clear jelly. This dessert is a perfect size to share with another person (or if you just want a big dessert on your own, I won't judge). Great flavors all put together in a large ice cream glass. Since there is ice in the coconut milk, it does appear to be a little liquidity though but that didn't bother me. It does make the dessert cold and the air conditioning is just blasting in this place. 

Service was fine while we were here. Our water glasses were refilled a few times during our time. 

I would definitely come back here if I lived in this area and also recommend this place for those that really love mango, as they have various of desserts and drinks that feature the tropical fruit. 

Please note that there are 2 unisex restroom in the back, pass the register. It was clean upon this visit and adequately stocked with the essentials.
name: Vic

text: Great pizza!!! Best I had since moving from northeast philly! We have been looking for a good pizza spot for almost two years since moving to Norristown and finally we found the best mom and pop store. The pizza was thin slice with just the right amount of sauce and cheese and crust was delicious!! We will be buying from here moving forward and the guy that created me was so polite and nice which makes it even better.
name: Rengi

text:
Great atmosphere. 
Love the folks "ambassador" or "community leader" that comes around. Greeted me in line to ask about menu options 
Band names are funny, but over the music, it's a little too messy. Could use a microphone instead of having to yell. I get the schtick, but I'm almost shocked out of my seat eat time someone needs to pick up their food. Lol 

Jelly was the best part. Enough goat cheese for the whole sandwich. Chicken was overly done and not flavorful. Biscuit was the worst part - maybe I'm too much of a traditionalist, but it's was more like a hard, thick cracker. 

Hopefully since they're now been open for a little while, there more flavor than hype and have worked out the kinks.
name: Diana

text: It has been a little hit or miss with a couple of their menu items, but overall the quality is pretty good.  Their green chili is excellent, and the Cuban is also very good.  The décor is also well done, and the staff is always very nice.
name: Andy

text: Tiny beer selection and not very helpful servers.  The gentleman we had wasn't very knowledgeable about their selection and despite opening at 2 their kitchen didn't open until 3 for some reason.  Would go back again to try the food and to enjoy the patio when it's nice outside.  Otherwise I think there's tons of other breweries in Tucson that would be more worth the time and money (every beer was $7 or more).
name: Rachel

text:
There are many place in Doylestown to dine.  Choose another.  Came here for lunch with my husband. We are not picky eaters. My husband asked if they had a pulled pork sandwich. The waitress stated, "Probably."  She didn't check nor did she know the specials. My husband said he'd like the pulled pork.  I ordered the Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup. The waitress came back a few minutes later and told my husband they didn't have pulled pork. He ordered the Caesar Salad with Swordfish special.The soup tasted  like canned soup and there wasn't a drop of lemon in it. Before the Swordfish was placed in front of my husband I could smell the strong fish odor.  It tasted old.  He told the waitress.  She asked if he wanted something else, tuna? He agreed.  She came back and told him they were out of tuna. He settled on chicken for his Caesar salad.  It was fair, but they had already lost us at this point.  The table was sticky, the bathroom was not the cleanest, and it was stuffy and smelly due to lack of proper ventilation. 
Again, find another choice in Doylestown.
name: Carolyn

text: I lived in Reno for quite some time but never try this place before. I went here on a date with my gf. The restaurant layout is little weird. Feel like the restaurant separated into two different areas. For the price, I would thought the restaurant should be little more up scale, saw some people in causal clothes like shorts, etc. On other hand, the food was great, but not worth the price compare to many other up scale restaurants in Reno. But worth a try to know.

text:
100% Vegetarian = WINNING

I dropped in for lunch and to my surprise there was a special All VEGAN BUFFET taking place (**Bankhead Bounce**)

Pleasantly greet upon entry and seated without delay. Buffet items were fresh, flavorful and VEGAN. Ranged from masala to fruit, soups, grits, beans, cabbage, roasted vegetables, naan of course and much more.  Small price to pay for $12

Spacious, clean, libations available as well as student discounts and Grub Hub.

It's taken me years to get by for lunch. Better late than not at all right....I'm a big fan now.

~Christy
name: Christy

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Will be back. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Our adult children gave us a gift certificate at Christmas to Sullivan's Steak House. We couldn't have been more pleased with the entire night. Everything from the greeting at the door, the water servers, attentive waitress and manager's follow-up made us feel special and welcome.  On to the food, it also was spectacular. We loved absolutely everything including filet, lamb chops, wedge salad, Brussel sprouts, garlic mashed potatoes, bread and key lime pie! The wine and martini were great also. Our kids gave us a great gift and Sullivan's made the night extra pleasurable.
name: Kathy

text: Update: now our 5th time here and my review would be 10 stars if it could. Lots of talent in the kitchen I'll leave it at that.
name: Pat

text: Sake is my favorite place for sushi!, Ooh and the Salmon appetizer is soooo scrumptious!!!
name: Judith

text:
So amazing! Not sure why I'm such a sucker for the speakeasy vibe, but having to ring a bell and then witnessing the host open a cutout of the door to ask if we had reservations was awesome. And the experience just got better by the minute. My wife and I had reservations for my birthday, and we were seated promptly by a very kind hostess. The place is so quaint and comforting. It has an old English library vibe. Our server could not have been more kind and informed. He had such a passion for the food, which made me more excited to try everything. 

I ordered a bourbon cocktail, which was amazing. My wife and I got the thick cut bacon, octopus salad, and bone marrow toast for appetizers. Everything was beyond delicious, but the bone marrow toast was one of the most amazing things I ever tasted. The toast had an amazing shredded veal on it, and when I scooped up the bone marrow and applied it to the toast, magic happened. If you're a meat lover, I swear this is one of the best bites of food you could imagine. Serious flavor that I will never forget. 

The server brought out roasted garlic, which is really what every meal needs. He saw how quickly I devoured it and brought me a bunch more throughout my meal. I wanted to hug him but restrained myself. 

For dinner I ordered the bone-in ribeye, cooked medium. My wife got the filet mignon. For sides, we ordered the wedges and cream of spinach. I cannot explain in words how excellent everything was. The steaks were just perfect. They were aged for 25 days, which came through in the flavor and texture. The steak was cooked to perfection, with a perfect char from the wood fire. My wife really enjoyed her steak too. The wedges were some of the best in the city. The cream of spinach was by far the best I ever had. 

I also had an amazing cabernet franc with my steak. They have a very good wine list. This was one of the best meals I ever had. This would be the meal I would want in Heaven. You have to try this place. Book ahead and order everything I did. It will be blissful.
name: Gus

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I had a better visit than I expected to. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: My husband and I go here frequently and bring our family sometimes. The chefs are very talented on the hibachi side and food is always delicious! We normally get hibachi, but just recently tried the Mongolian side, and it is delicious too. You get to pick what you want instead of getting a whole plate full of food that you don't necessarily like.

text:
Owner is rude.  Will never go back.

There are many other options for baked goods.

I have nothing else to add!
name: Barry

text: For almost $10, I would expect a reasonable portion. My bacon and cheese omelette was most certainly not made with three eggs. It was small, greasy, and the bacon seemed more like corned beef hash?? The hashbrowns were soggy, so I wasn't too sad there wasn't much of them. Overall, the sourdough toast was the highlight of the meal. Want a good breakfast? Check out a Good Day Cafe or Jethro's!

text:
Not really a Haitian restaurant, slim Haitian style dishes , American style taste. 
Friendly staff though
name: Jhon

text: Nice outdoor seating to get some work done and also had a walk up window to order from outside. I got the Brooklyn smoothie which was very good. They have small and large but the small was plenty filling and refreshing. You can also add a shot of wheat grass to any smoothie. From outside you can see them putting fresh fruit into the juicer front and center so it's nice to know what you're getting. I didn't order food but the menu looked awesome and the people who did order around me looked like they had some great options! I would definitely go back to try the food. Only reason not 5 stars is because the outdoor seating area was a little messy with left over napkins on some of the tables and no staff attending to people sitting out there.
name: Sarah

text: This place has great food at a low price in a large amount. I was surprised with how good the food was and how much I got. I've been here more than 10 times and they've never disappointed.
name: Yussef

text: No doubt this place lives up to it's name, with a friendly staff that can walk any Neo through the menu with ease. I had the big Cheezy and I underestimated 7 different types of cheese. If you love cheese this is for you, but be prepared for your jaw bone to go to work! I dipped my sandwich into the delicious basil soup which really complements the sandwiches well! My family all agrees, it was GOOD!!! Not disappointed at all, and for the price, we walked out stuffed!!!
name: Christina

text:
Great food!!!! 
Great service!!!!!
Great atmosphere!!!!!
Absolutely love this place and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a nice place to grab some dinner.
name: Johnowen

text: Absolutely amazing!!!! I strongly suggest their seafood pasta dish- shrimp, oysters & fresh fish cooked to perfection!
name: Erin

text:
We went in for an impromptu dinner after the place we were SUPPOSED to go had to scrub our reservation due to a blown AC system. So I asked, and the Queen Bee answered "Mexican." Sigh.

It was dead empty in there, and as soon as we walked in the dining room it was immediately apparent that the place was filthy. The carpeting stank up the whole place and when we sat at the bar, it was plain to see they didn't clean it back there. It was disorganized, sloppy and just plain gross.

So mamacita brought us a basket of chips and salsa; the chips even tasted "off." Queen Bee and I looked at each other with an expression of "blech" on our faces. They smelled and tasted of dirty vegetable oil...like week-old never-changed vegetable oil in a filthy fryer.

If I could give half a star or zero stars that's exactly what this place would get tonight. We decided just to walk out, drink orders be damned. Too bad; a restaurant should shine on a Saturday evening. It shone our first time there. Well me thinks a solar eclipse happened this evening. 

I will venture to say they could use a damn flashlight along with some good old fashioned soap and water. If the health department ever walks in unannounced I bet this dump will be shut down faster than you can say "Trump's Wall!"
name: William

text:
Something about Sundays always wants me to have brunch. 
So what better way to start our day than with a huge breakfast at Bernie's. 
I have had MANY amazing dinners here but not the brunch. 

Me and the wife both ordered the "Big breakfast" and big it was.
The pancakes we're nice and fluffy and crisp on the outside just how I like it.
Two French toast squares were perfect, great batter and excellent cinnamon butter
accompanied by warm syrup. 

Not sure how they cook their scrambled eggs but they were divine. 
I love the creaminess to it. They weren't overly moist or under, just perfect. 

Mounds of roasted potato home fries with onions and nicely seasoned,
they we're delicious. 

I don't know how you can possibly amplify the tastiness of an English muffin but 
somehow they did. I really do not know what it was but the texture on the outside 
where the nooks & crannies dwell just tasted different but in a amazing way.

Bacon is bacon and you can never go wrong with bacon cause bacon is delicious and this was no different.If you disagree we'll be fighting.

What better side for a giant breakfast then more meat so I got pork roll, 
they give you three slices and all three were delicious.

I got dessert to go because there was no room left in my stomach for another morsel,
but later there shall be. 
So later came and I "forced" myself to eat it. That was friggin delicious. 
The only thing that was left off since it was to go was the ice cream. Sadly it would have
melted before I made it home, so I added my own to enjoy it to it's fullest level. The sauce was amazing as was the candied nuts.

So I recommend if you're wanting a very delicious breakfast to head over to Bernie's 
and if you're really hungry get the big breakfast because you will not be leaving hungry, delicioso!!!
name: Toy

text: Midtown location is a great spot near other drinking establishments. I feel like every trip I come to this location is a let down. The space is inviting and I love the open garage door style. They have enough sitting inside and a stock bar. Everyone's pretty much friendly, haven't had a bad experience with the customer service. However, the food can be better along with the wait time. For the amount that is charged for the wings, theres barely any sauce on them and over fried. Frachos are a hit and miss every time. The pizza is consistent but over priced. If you go with a group of friends, it's going to be pricy. Can't beat the location!

text: I had a wonderful experience here today. My server Alex is one of the best servers I've ever had in my experience dining out. By far 5 star service. The winds were great and the fries had a good and unexpected taste. I've never had a bad experience away this restaurant. I would gladly recommend anyone to come here.
name: Damien

text: Tried it today with a friend. The food was delicious, made with fresh ingredients. Flavors were well developed. Presentation was nice. Plenty of vegan options but they do sell out some items from the menu. The portions were generous.
name: Jana

text: I don't even know where to start. Everything here is amazing. Inside the public market.  It is a little pricey, but I think it is well worth it. They food looks amazing and tastes just as good! We got some type of poke that was to die for!
name: Summer

text:
This place is fabulous. The food and service is top notch. My whole experience has been outstanding. My server, Luwan, was delightful. She was very knowledgeable about their food and she has such a pleasant personality. The front door hostess was very kind. 

I had the fried chicken and red beans and rice w/peach cobbler for dessert. The flavor of each was excellent. I do recommend Dooky Chase to anyone. It's a whole experience.

text: Soooo good! I've been here a bunch of times with different size parties. Always welcoming and attentive service. Food is phenomenal! They have a lot of creative special dishes mixed in with traditional Vietnamese flavors. Rotisserie chicken banh mi, wow!!! Banh zeo and bo kho!!! Enjoy it, you can thank me later. Haha! My kids love it too!
name: gwen

text: I love this place. I always enjoy my meal and the staff is super friendly. I'm vegan, so they always help me find the tastiest dishes for the way I eat. My family isn't vegan, and there are options for them as well, making this our family-favorite place to eat dinner. We never leave hungry and always leave happy.
name: Barbara

text: We love Protzel's!  This is a traditional, family-run, full service delicious deli.  I am from NY City and this is as good as Zabars!  Roast beef is especially wonderful.  My family is keen on pastrami and I am a sucker for the deviled eggs.  You can't miss with Protzel's!  We are so lucky to have them right here in St. Louis.  YAY!!
name: Lisa

text:
We have gotten carry out twice here since the ownership change.  Extremely impressed both times.  I have had the chicken pho, rare beef pho, and sampled the orange chicken and friend rice.  High quality ingredients, prompt and friendly service, and really delicious food.  

Hard to beat the quality and value at Pho 88.  Probably my favorite fried rice in Brownsburg.  I used to have to drive all the way to Lafayette Road for good pho, not any more!!
name: Jason

text: This is our go-to pizza place!  We love their crust and the toppings are perfect!  We are just out of their delivery area or no doubt we would have pizza every week!  The store front isn't much but what matters is the pizza!  They have parm-dots which are the ultimate comfort food for dough lovers.  Friendly staff, they get very busy so it has occasionally taken a few extra minutes to get our pizza but so worth it!
name: C

text:
Don't come here!!! I got a regular cheeseburger , my friend got the bison burger. They both tasted the same.. flavorless and like cardboard... my daughter got chicken fingers.. disgusting as well.. frozen with no flavor. 
The fries where all right ..
Never coming back. I expected much more from this place, but everything on the menu lacks flavor. You're better off going to Wendys .
name: Veronica

text: Great Service and Good Food. The only complaint I have is the payment system was sticky from BBQ sauce, but I'm not gonna knock a BBQ joint for having BBQ everywhere.
name: Adam

text: I just left Russell's.  Another great experience ! The pecan waffle seas so good. Loved my serve!!!!
name: Katie

text:
This Restaurant was a big disappointment on many levels. My mother used to be from this area and she highly recommended it.

text: This place is awesome!  It may not be as large as some restaurants but it makes up for its size with great food items. text: This place is fire.  I at first was a lil disappointed that the shrimp weren't fried but they were the best part. text: Will not return.  As I approached the restaurant, it looked cute and I was looking forward to good Thai food based on the Yelp reviews.  But as soon as I opened the door, I was hesitant because I was overwhelmed by a really unpleasant smell (not sure what it was).  The spring rolls  and Thai Stix were basically flavor free.  Worse was the pad ka prao - not even close to what this dish should be.  This was a dish of sautéed ground beef, with onions and green beans- no flavor whatsoever.  It also was a little strange how fast the dishes were taken from the table; it felt as though they needed to get them back and wash them quickly because they didn't have enough dishes.  Finally, I will note that the folks with whom I was dining all enjoyed their entrees, especially the pad Thai.

text: Came on a Saturday afternoon. It wasn't particularly busy (maybe this should have been a sign, considering everywhere else we tried in the immediate area had at least a 30 minute wait). We were seated right away by a friendly lady but then our table was not revisited again for 20 minutes (I was keeping track of the time). The more annoying part was that a table who came in 5 minutes after us was attended to. It was as if they forgot we were even there. After sitting for 20 minutes with no one even pouring us water, we got up and left. No one seemed to notice except for the couple next to us who looked equally exasperated. If the place were packed I would be more understanding but the restaurant wasn't even close to being full. I will not be back.
