text:
So I FINALLY was able to get into this place! First off, make sure you make a reservation, especially on the weekend. The parking is wonky too, it's in a strip mall off of Speedway so be prepared for that. These two things are the only cons to this place. 
The food was awesome! We started with the fried calamari and it was DELICIOUS. It had fried garlic and the lime sauce was amazing, my only fault would be that it just wasn't enough for me. 
The octopus was AMAZING, AMAZING. It is slightly boiled first then fried so it was not "chewy" at all which you can get with octopus. The flavor was phenomenal, I could have just had that for dinner. 
I had the trout for my entree which was quite delicious, it was my first time having trout and had some great, great flavor. My sister had the lamb though and I will say I wish I had ordered that. It was just...perfect. It will definitely be my next order. 
The service was wonderful, the ambiance was great, we took the 11 year old and 14 year old, they had shrimp but it was great for them. 
I'm very happy Tito & Pep is here!
name: Rachel D

text: We were in town from Texas for a football game and took some time to drive to Clearwater to see the beautiful white beach and came across The Bait House. text:

text: This has been our go to authentic Spanish food restaurant for a little over 8 years. During this time we have invited family and friends, held birthday dinners, facilitated business meetings, and recommended others to dine here. On our visit this evening, we won't be spending our weekly night out here anymore. According to our servers, the owner recently changed the menu and I have to say that was a poor choice. The amount of food and overall freshness of the food, lacked the quality we came to expect from this establishment over the years. Who puts a black avocado on the tortilla soup and serves it?!? Thinking and hoping that we just experienced a bad day here, our neighbor table overheard us questioning our food and leaned in to say that he thought the same and was giving things a second chance. Unfortunately he said that it would be his last time eating here with his family. For whoever reads this, listen to your customers. People may love the place and I'm crazy or people feel the same way as I do. Either way.. do what your customer base wants you to.

text:
Sunday Brunch at Atchafalya was the best book end to our amazing NOLA road trip.  Reservations are a must.  My husband made reservations several weeks in advance.  The current owners, Rachael Jaffe and Tony Tocco, took over in 2008. The space has a great ambiance and is intimate, and cozy.  The energy was vibrant for a Sunday morning, amped by a great local musician in the front entrance / bar area.  While the volume was a tad on the louder side, you could still carry a conversation comfortably.

The menu focuses on innovative New Orleans dishes, craft cocktails, and a decent wine menu.  Their brunch highlights an impressive build your own Bloody Mary bar.  Their craft cocktails were EXTREMELY tasty as well.  Hard too make a choice.  The food here was impeccable.  Everything was delicious.  We each ordered something different and shared.  There was no mediocre or bad dish amongst the bunch. All were equally awesome.  I don't think it is possible to go wrong here.  It stood up to all the hype we had read about this being the best brunch in NOLA.  Highly recommend. The service was friendly and knowledgeable.

text:
A group of five of us went on a Saturday night around seven without reservations. The hostess said it was only going to be a 30min wait which I thought was great for not having reservations and going during peak hours. We sat at the bar and had a Picon punch while we waited. 

The bar staff was friendly and it was easy to get drinks. The price of a Picon Punch is only $5, which is a reasonable price and the taste is strong but not overwhelming. On the menu, there is a little snippet of history about the Picon which is an interesting read. 

We were seated in less than 30 minutes so we were able to take our drinks to the table. The server was prompt in taking our drink order and returning to take food order. The special was shrimp in white sauce and capers for $27. Two people in my group ordered the special, and another ordered the roasted leg of lamb for $28. I ordered sweetbreads for $26 and the last person ordered no entrée dinner for $22. All entrées included an array of food. 

The meal is served traditional Basque family style. The dinner starts with a soup of the day which was vegetable for us. It was a good light start to the meal and it was served with French bread. They also brought out a carafe of house wine. Next came the Basque beans, salad, and French fries. Soon after came the first course which was chicken and rice. The portions were large enough for people to have seconds' and even thirds. It was all great and I especially enjoyed the salad. It was romaine, tomatoes and onions tossed in a balsamic vinaigrette. 

After the first course, they brought out the entrées which were also large enough to share. The sweetbread were sautéed in garlic, onions, and peppers. I do recommend that everyone give them a try. The rest of the entrées were just as good. By the end, the whole group was stuffed. The last thing they bring out is dessert which is either ice cream or jack cheese and fruit. 

The price may seem a little high at first depending out what you order, but by the end you realize it is worth it. The amount of food that is included is very much worth the price. Also, the family style gives you a chance to try a little bit of everything.

Overall the food was more than expected and tasted great. The service was fast and the wait was not bad at all. Parking was a little tough, but that is because of a local soccer game nearby. We found something after looking for a couple of minutes. The overall restaurant was clean and kept for being in an older building. I enjoyed my experience and I would recommend Louie's to anyone.

text:
This is a hard review for me to write. As a veteran of the industry, I never, ever, EVERY complain about service. Servers, bussers and food runners have hard jobs, and deserve all our respect. However, in the case of tbis restaurant, I have to complain (and I did during my visit).
I brought my mom here for Mother's day -we were both craving Indian food- and were seated right away. The dining room is spacious, has a nice, minimalist decor, and the music coming through the speakers was entertaining but at a very reasonable volume. 
Our server was nice enough to explain some of the menu items (menus themselves are very non-descriptive if you're not specifically familuar with South Indian cuisine). 
I'm gonna talk about the food first, then the service. 
We ordered Baijjis for appetizers: potatoes, bread or onions deep fried in a mildly spiced batter, accompanied with a very yummy yogurt sauce. Very decent. 
For entrees, my mother ordered some kind of eggplant stew, which was spicy, flavorful and frankly delicious. We did have to send the accompanying bowl of basmati rice back 3 times because it was stone cold. Alarming. 
For my entree, I ordered a Dosa: a large flat crepe, folded over and stuffed with spiced mutton, peppers and onions, accompanied with three distinct sauces. It was, admittedly, very very delicious. 
So if the food was so good, why are they getting two stars? Well the answer is simple: the Dosa took OVER AN HOUR to come out. My mother was left eating her eggplant alone while I searched for someone, anyone, to explain what was happening. We mentioned the long wait period to three different staff people as they passed by; our server very clearly avoiding coming anywhere near our table. From the conversation i saw her have with the manager, my guess is she forgot to put my order in. While that is a forgivable mistake, purposefully avoiding your tables is amateurish service, and not worth the nothing-to-sneeze-at price tag of eating at this establishment. NO ONE came over to explain what was happening except for a poor food runner obviously going out of his way to cover someone else's mistake. 
After an hour of waiting, my food finally came out, and, like I said, it was delicious. At no point did anyone (and certainly not our joke of a server) come to check how everything was or apologize. 
I've worked in the restaurant world for many years and usually, when a customer is done wrong like this, there's some kind of compensation: a discount on the check or maybe a drink or desert on the house. Not this time. No one ever even approached us. We got our bill ($50!) And never heard from any staff person again. 

Writing this review pains me, I've worked these jobs and I knowbhow hard they can be. But not taking responsibility for your mistakes is simply unacceptable. Suffice to say, we will never be returning to this establishment. I hope they can sort their service out because the food was truly delicious.
name: Marcos

Food was fresh and service was quick. Food was good and came out fast. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Would prob stop in again if nearby. text:
Okaaaaay, so this is gonna be a follow up of the previous review I did of Gin when they first opened. 

Initially, I had said that when it comes to their BBQ, it's not bad. I always get the brisket, skirt steak, and short ribs. This time, we ordered the same things and chicken and the Korean Pancake.

I'll just be straight forward with the new things I ordered. The chicken was bland and okay. The pancake was pretty soft and bland, but my friend suggested putting the entire thing on the grill to make it crispy. Overall these 2 would be about a 2/5

They added 2 new sides to their bbq since the last time I visited. Their potato salad is not bad at all! I like it. It's like your potato salad that you eat anywheres else at a KBBQ. Their fishcake however is kind of disappointing. It doesn't give that nice sweet-ish taste that other fishcakes at KBBQ's give. Also.. for some reason, I feel like it gave off a grilled taste to it. Is it suppose to be like that? I had saw some grill marks coming from the fishcakes when they served it. 

The server had also told me they added a Kimchi tofu soup. That's the stuff I look for at KBBQ! I BELIEVE Little Korea and Korea House doesn't have that option. Unfortunately, I didn't order it this time, so hopefully next time! 

Overall, my experience has been more/less the same. When I'm at other KBBQ's, I seem to see myself ALWAYS picking at the sides and always asking for refills, but It's not the same here. Their kimchi just doesn't taste nice and juicy. Too pickled and not spicy. I can see they're trying to do some improvement by adding more appetizers and sides, but after several months, I still feel it's a bit unfinished. Nothing special here, but it does the job nicely! I hope they refine their recipes and add egg pot here soon!

text:

My friends and I headed out of LA and up to Santa Barbara for a girls trip and The Lark came highly recommended. text:
This is real BBQ.  Authentic slow-smoked BBQ with that real wood-smoked flavor.  Forget those gimmicky johnny-come-lately nouveau BBQ places.  This is real BBQ.

This is our go to BBQ place.  We were really depressed when the old location closed down, and kept checking to see if they had moved.  No other BBQ in south Tampa is anywhere as good.

Then, we saw the sign at the new location.  Rebuilding proceeded very slowly, and we became concerned.  Then, finally, the new BJ's opened, with the same great BBQ.

If you like chain restaurants that use trendy ingredients, you will not like this place at all.  If you want a genuine deep south Alabama BBQ experience, this is THE place.

Get the baked beans with your order of ribs.  Be sure you get the slices of white bread to accompany the BBQ.  It is part of the experience, and it does really go with the meat.  We like the sauce on the side.  It is a very simple sauce based on ketchup and hot sauce, but it is perfect in its way and adds to the authentic experience.  But it is the meat itself which is the star of the show.

Most places like BJ's are long gone, replaced by homogenized imitations.  Get this BBQ while you can, and keep this place going as a living history of BBQ.
name: Louis

text:
This actually ended up being my favorite restaurant in all of New Orleans. 

First of all, their 50 Cent oyster happy hour is one of the best happy hour deals I've ever come across. Maybe it's because I'm coming from New York where prices are always borderline horrific, but the oysters are not only cheap but also fresh, plump, tasty and delicious. We easily killed 48 oysters for only $24. I can't even count how many dollar oyster happy hour deals I've been to where the oysters are just lackluster. Beers were also around $3 a pop. 

Secondly, their angels on horseback is both one of the best sandwiches and one of the best Po boys I've ever had in my life. Fresh Gulf oysters wrapped in bacon and then fried and served in a beautifully tangy French baguette. The portion was so large, we had ask them to split it in half to facilitate sharing and when they brought out the first half I thought it was the entire sandwich. 

The restaurant is large and spacious and in the evenings there is a live pianist. To be honest service was a bit slow but that seems to be a common theme in Louisiana. Overall I was blown away by the food and wouldn't hesitate to recommend this restaurant to everyone I know in the area. 

Do you love happy hour? Come here immediately and thank me later.
name: Lana

text:
So disappointed. I came in for a quick breakfast on a weekday. Ordered strawberry crepes and 2 scrambled eggs. Cranberry juice was great- let's start there. The eggs were not real- like eggs from
A box with no yolk. Gross. Crepes were a disappointment-- just crepe dough and strawberries inside. No filling, no cream, no sweetness. $16 and some change for a shitty breakfast. 
Sever took a bit longer than I would have liked to return to my table for the check. If I'm craving eggs I'll go somewhere I know they have real cracked eggs!
name: Amanda

text: Best steak at Norteast philly lovely staff , try steak fries specially with whiz , I will definitely stop again
name: Mahmut

text: Ehh we did not have a great meal here. Usually it's good. I'm not sure if our cook was new, but all the meat was way over cooked. The waitresses were wonderful and very attentive. Customer service is always good here. The food not so much.
name: Amy

text:
They finally opened! Came here on their first official day of business, and the wait was well worth it. I've been looking for a place with good ribs ever since The Smokeshack closed their doors, and I've found it here! 

I had a large order which consisted of the ribs, brisket, and sausage, along with sides of fries, creamed spinach, and mac & cheese. To make sure my next cholesterol test doesn't disappoint, I ended my meal with their maple bourbon ice cream sundae. All were very delicious with great portions at reasonable prices. I especially enjoyed the ribs, fries, and creamed spinach. They also have a nice variety of sauces, all of which I enjoyed immensely.

Very friendly service. With it being their opening day, I expected there would be some hiccups. They were pretty busy when we arrived around 6:30, but it got much busier as we were waiting for our food. The proprietor is friendly as can be and was very apologetic on our wait, offering us complimentary opening day beers.

The building isn't very large, so seating is very limited. However, it appears a majority of the folks there tonight were doing takeout anyway, and we didn't have any issue finding an open table. They are dog friendly in the outside seating area, so bring your little buddy.

I will definitely be back here and often. My cardiologist needs to pay for his new boat somehow. I highly recommend you try this place out!
name: Den

text: For the price I expected a little more care. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: This place can't seem to get an order right. Dick Bold you need to hire better managers and employees because everyone is talking  about your poor service. Your almost taking advantage of people if u think about it. A customer makes an order and u guys just throw whatever u want n the sack because u know we will be already gone by the time we notice. People are talking so please step it up.
name: Jimmy

text:
Wow! This place is amazing. All who love Korean food need to come here. Everything I tried was very good. I came with my group of friends and all loved it. 
It feels like you are truly in Korea, thanks to the atmosphere and the design. 
LOVED IT!
name: Valeria

text:
Went here for a light meal with my family, none of which are vegetarians. The wait staff was a bit slow to get drinks initially and for refilling our waters. The food also seemed to take a while, but maybe we were just really hungry! 

I loved the atmosphere of the place. It's a very clean look and has fun art to go with the vegetarian theme. They have a nice patio area as well. 

I ordered the seitan melt, which had a lot of flavor packed in there between the seitan itself, the pesto, and the mozz. I had never had seitan before, but this preparation definitely had me saying "yup, I'd eat that again." I had a side of chips and guacamole, which I thought was pretty good as well. I had some of my sister's tacos (tofu). Those were 100% delish - I loved the pickled onions on them! 

Overall, it was a nice place to grab a bite and reasonably priced as well!
name: Hannah

text: Very solid food - amazing brunch and the best damn grilled cheese sandwich I have ever had.  Wait staff is excellent.
name: Gerard

text:
Su Xing House is great!
The restaurant is clean and spacious. There are many options, all of which are vegetarian and most of which are vegan (dishes with egg are marked with a little egg symbol beside them). The staff are friendly and attentive. During the lunch hour they offer a special for $9 of a soup, entree, and side dish. This is a good value and what I get most of the time. 
I have a tried a number of things on the menu but my favorites are the vegetarian fish-less scallop appetizer (what kind of sorcery is this, these are delicious), the general tsos seitan, and the peking style 'duck' (which is seitan with crispy 'skin' made from soy paper). 
I have eaten here with folks who are not vegetarian or vegan and everyone has enjoyed their meal. 
My only complaint is that when you order hot tea, the wait staff doesn't leave the small tea pot at the table and instead repeat fills your tiny cup about 20x during the meal which can feel rather invasive.
name: Shauna

text: Haven't actually eaten any food here since I was so put off by the worker behind the counter. Walked in with my dog and was asked right away if she was a service dog (which is totally reasonable) to which I replied "She's a support dog, can she come in?" The man behind the counter gave me the most incredulous mocking look as soon as he heard "support dog"- I'm fully aware of the difference between a support dog and a service dog, which is why I didn't lie. But the mocking tone he took when telling me I'd have to tie her outside made my choice to head to Starbucks instead very easy. Won't be back here.
name: Fenchurch

text: AMAZING SUSHI!!! Can't say anything bad about this place!!!! And their drinks/cocktails.....THE BEST!!!! The bartender is NOT stingy with the liquor! Lol my friends and I had an absolute blast dining here!
name: Donisha

text: Incredible food and great service!! perfect for a night out on the town, and to support small business owners!
name: Phil

text:
Philly!!! How is this rated so high?

1- when you enter, they proudly present the past noodles they use in the entry. These are the same $1-2 noodles you can buy at ANY bodega, market, etc. 
2- they charge more $16-20 per dish even pasta and it's made with crappy ingredients and not even good.
3- i was shocked with the taste of almost everything. My brother did like the mussels but everything else?! Eeeeek
4-they charge NYC prices and they aren't worth it.
5- the server had a dress shirt on and white cloth table cloth on table. A homeless man with scabies can take a shower, put a new shirt on, but it doesn't cover the issues under the surface. This restaurant is putting lipstick on a pig, and I'm shocked that in a city with such amazing food this place gets good ratings. 

The service was ok but it was not table cloth service so it wasn't price equivalent. I felt bad, our server seemed so bored and not polished but she took an order and served our food on time. It happens, we can't all be "on" but a smile and being friendly is an underhanded pitch and would have been nice.

4- I got the antipasto plate.meat and cheeses are pre sliced at I'm guessing Costo or high volume restaurant suppliers but the issue is they are skimping on quality and fresh product.
I also got spaghetti and meatballs, since it's tough to mess that up. I'll give them a 5-6 for the pasta. 

Nooo soda refills! For all the crap they serve, it would have lessened the blow. 

My bro got the veal and didn't finish it but our uncle who will eat poop on a stick, finished it off.

5-don't go here. I honestly beg ya to turn the corner and google another option. We had a $123 lunch and I would have hoped for yummy and I just got regret and confusion. 

Oh and I spit the salami out from the Antipasto plate.
name: Sharon

text: I coming to Boise twice a month and I am always on the lookout for pour over coffee. This is the first place I have discovered to Carrie pour over coffee and let me tell you I was more than pleased. Not only does this place have divine coffee they also carry vegan donuts from the local bakery. Not only did they make me at divine coffee they also poured a splash of almond milk at my request.  The atmosphere is refreshing and grounding almost like a feeling of coming home.  It's these guys serve food I will definitely be back to check it out. Thank you for your professionalism and your cleanliness and a job well done
name: Joanna

text: The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text:
3.5   A solid rating for a combo dish that included a small breast and leg (fried chicken), a generous scoop of mac and cheese, yams, and of course, white bread and packaged butter. Did not like the iced tea - too processed and overly sweet.

My dining partner ordered oxtails and had rice and green beans. I tried the beans - too salty for me. Maybe they were just off today. She wasn't as fond of her food as I was of mine.

This little hole in the wall restaurant is a favorite among locals. Hard to find great food like this in what otherwise is a neighborhood that may have seen better days.

Very basic but friendly atmosphere. They had a big TV on and while I normally am not a fan of a TV on while I'm eating, it was fun to have a small room of people really getting into Jeopardy! - LOL. 

Service was OK. Admittedly the server was very new and had to be shadowed a bit by one of regulars. She hadn't learned yet to check in with us while we waited or while we ate to see if we needed anything. At the end of the night, she was short $5 on change.
name: Allie

text: This is a FUN and VERY Philly Irish Bar.  We started going here years ago as a jumping of point for watching the Mummers Parade.  It has since become a meeting place for our family and friends.  It does get packed but hat's off to the servers who do there best to keep up with demand.  The food is decent and the environment is fun.  If you are visiting the city and are looking for a fun bar, this is your place!
name: Carly

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: 5 stars for the 50c happy hour oysters daily 4-630 (it starts to get busy pretty quickly after 430). A great place to bring visitors who enjoy their oysters to impress them with some of the most consistently freshest and largest oysters I've ever seen. Try as I might (which isn't that hard to be honest), I can never pass up the hot out of the oven bread that's brought to the table upon being seated. The $3 happy hour draft beer list offered a couple great options from urban south. The service was fantastic, if you get the chance sit outside facing St Charles to watch the streetcars driving by.
name: Tina

text: We go here every time we visit Tucson. Food and drinks are great. Outdoor seating is nice with live music happening often. Surrounded by cute shops, make sure you check them out too.
name: Stephanie

text: This is probably the best Mexican food I've had in Pinellas County.
name: Samuel

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Never had a bad meal or a bad drink here.  I like that you can sit on one side and get food from the other restaurant.  Makes it nice for people who don't like Sushi! Drinks are always good as well.
name: B

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I had a better visit than I expected to. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
This place was a great find! My wife and I were in the area after giving blood so we wanted a good breakfast. GK had solid reviews so we decided to check it out. I must say, we were a little hesitant because it's in a strange space but we had a great experience! 

The staff was really friendly and food was great. I got an omelet, Oatmeal, and tots. My wife got the special blueberry pancakes and eggs. Everything tasted great! We will most certainly be back again.
name: William

text:
Greeted with genuine smiles at the door. Service from Katherine and Devon was great! 
Chicken Parmesan was outstanding. 
The Short Rib Radiattori was super tender and flavorful, with an subtle touch of horseradish in the pasta. Strozzapreti's chicken was also good. Took some home and enjoyed it the next day. Cappuccino could've been hotter. Dad says his Stella was good. Meatball appetizer was delish and the Chef's Board was fun to share. 
Employee was sweeping 1 ft away from me, while I was trying to enjoy my meal.
But good food and service. Thank you Angie for your hospitality. I'll be back :)
name: Alma

text:
JJ Bootleggers advertised "20 minute lightning" lunch was a joke. 
During a busy workday, 6 hungry co-workers stepped out for a quick lunch yet ours actually took 45 minutes. Carly the surly server dished far too much bad attitude and curt remarks towards a group of people of color. Unsure if it was because we didn't order any alcoholic drinks during lunch or simply because we quickly wanted to place & receive our orders. Her smart assed comments came quicker than the food. Snapping at us: "does anyone else want something before I go to the back", is that all, etc. 
After 45 minutes with no food coming out of the kitchen, one co-worker needed to get back to work and asked to have her order togo. The server took the co-workers money and then asked if she still wanted her food... I guess Carly wanted my co-worker to pay for poor service. It even took about 15 minutes to get salt and pepper shakers (another co-worker had to beg the group at the next table for theirs. 
In the beginning, I thought this restaurant could be a big enough space for our end of year office party but the missing lightning and poor customer service put a stop to those ideas. Food just okay and service much worse.
name: Mas

text: Good good good good good good good . Food- A+; consist and delicious. Decor- A. Service- very low C-; service at the bar is just there, not warm and welcoming (he is here to take your order.), no suggestive selling or recommendations, never mention to a customer they missed a special, tell them to please return to enjoy a special. Service at the register- only one time was I greeted with a welcoming smile. Repeat consumers are like gold; I still have to check Blue Oak; and you are in my hood. Service and food is what separates you from other joints; so let's lose the fast food service and give guest an experience that says, "Y'all come back now, ya hear".
name: Toni

text: We love Big Woods in Nashville. So much that we went twice over a 2 night stay there. We decided to meet up for lunch at the speedway one since it was closer to home and our experience was very disappointing. We came on a Wednesday right at lunchtime, 12:30, and hardly anyone was in there. When we got sat, the sun was right in our eyes so we asked our server if we could move. Instead they had to check which took a bit. Not a big deal. We got moved and after ordering drinks, it took a while even though they were not busy. Okay, not a big deal. We got our breadsticks, which were not as good, the cheese was very thin. Still not a big deal. We ordered our food. A salad and a pizza. It took at least 45 minutes for our food to get to our table and when it did, it was like the pizza had been baked and then warmed up. It was very old. We've never had a bad experience with Big Woods, so we knew it was supposed to be like. We asked for them to take it back and they offered to make a new one and took it off our bill. They were very understanding and kind about it. So for that, I'm grateful. We went to leave and there were so many people standing and waiting, with no host, and an empty dining area. We were just really confused by it all. So I'm giving 2 stars because at least they made it right after their mistake, but it seems to me that they need to figure out to serve people quicker especially when not busy. What happened when business picks up?
name: Megan

text: Great atmosphere with some cute outdoor seating. The waiter was busy but personable. The salad was tasty and the meatballs flavorful. The best part was the thick crust pizza. Very similar to my Italian grandmothers.
name: Desirai

text: Service  is horrible.  When I was given the incorrect drink she gladly took it back and brought me back the same drink.  I told her yo cancel the order and refund me and she though attitude. " a wrong drink isn't reason to cancel a whole order" I insisted that I get what I ordered or a refund she finally went and got the correct drink( god knows what she did to it while out of sight) and gave it to me then got even nastier when I had the nerve to ask god my receipt and some napkins.  Definitely not stopping there ever again no matter how convenient it is
name: D

text: I love love love this place, I read a short review about it in SJtimes and it's so close to me that I had to check it out. I love margarita pizza and this place hits the spot everytime. They're reasonably priced it's byob, and the ingredients are fresh. Margarita pizza pictured above a buffalo chicken specialty pie they have. I go back any chance I get, hoping they start to know my name and order.
name: Sarah

text: Very large gluten free menu with gluten free bread. Celiac friendly. I had the brown sugar pork tenderloin with garlic mash and broccolini. A little far of a drive from the city but I'll definitely be back
name: Hayley

text: Amazing never no matter what what you get you will be pleased great service everyone there is so nice and it's nice seeing the owner come out and greet their guest and seeing how we're enjoying the food
name: Luis

text: This is a hidden gem. The ramen, broth and snacks were amazing and the pork belly was the best I have tasted. They also have fabulous  cocktails. Try the Thunder  Drake.
name: Dana

text: Just had dinner with my wife. Service great. Brooke the waitress top notch. Explained the large menu since our first time to the restaurant. Grouper cooked perfect. My wife's Mahi-mahi was very good. The appetizers were very good and came out on a timely basis even thou the place was packed.key lime pie okay..need more tart to it ha ha..prices very fair. Thank you for a great meal. Better menu then at Guppy's in IRB...and you  can get a table here too...
name: J

text: Roach in my steamed dumplings. This is pathetic I walked out and felt sick the whole day because of this. Plus it is cash only WTF.
name: Zaki

text: The food is excellent, but hair restraints and gloves are missing. I pity the poor soul's sandwich, when the young lady touched her hair 4 times while making it.
name: Lee

text: I quite enjoyed Herbsaint.  The ambiance is great, nice mix between high end and casual.  The food was also very good.  The waitress said the gumbo was the best in New Orleans.  I haven't had enough to validate that sentence but it was indeed extremely flavorful and good.  The gnocchi appetizer was very tasty as well.  The lamb lasagna was recommended as one of the best dishes and it did not disappoint.  The deserts were also very good.  I would definitely go back when in town.
name: Ryan

text: I absolutely love this place. I have drove way out of my way to make a stop here for food. They have great prices and deals on food. The salad bar is OUT OF THIS WORLD. It comes with so many options and has so many unique things to offer. I brought myself and 4 hungry guy friends and we went to town on the salad bar. I love this place so much and it means a lot to my family and friends. I wish I didn't live almost 2 hours from this place. I'm really hoping that I can come back soon. Best diner I've ever been to and has a special place in my heart.
name: Michael

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: We never would have found this place if we hadn't been on a cocktail tour with Dr. Gumbo's tour company.  It's subdued and dark and off the street.  The inside is gorgeously decorated, in old art, dark paint, gold accents.  Sexy maroon, gold, and navy chairs.  Marble and dark wood on the bar.  They have two authentic absinthe fountains so you truly see how absinthe is served, vapors and all.  They have other drinks as well, if you're not an absinthe fan.  Some are gin, one is a mule made with cherry liqueur, some made with rum.  Lovely, knowledgeable, and entertaining bar tenders.
name: Hunter

text: We ate all over town and this was the best by far. Our waiter was extremely knowledgeable, the food was fresh and delicious. The setting was perfect and we will be back. Best thing by far buttermilk fried chicken! Cracklings & cornbread are really good as well.
name: Jeff

text: Checked out Old Montreal Hot Dogs & Poutine. As you can see from the menu it's hot dogs, poutine, and deli sandwiches. They have about 8 tables inside. Seemed like a lot of people ordered takeout or skip the dishes as well. The place seemed clean, including the bathroom. They had one server on who was good. She got pretty busy serving the tables, answering phone orders and running food. She did everything with a smile and was really nice. We had authentic poutines with our meals. Lots of curds and the gravy had good flavour. My husband liked his sandwich. The hotdogs were good. The actual dog itself wasn't anything special but I didn't order a premium one. Liked the toppings and the toasted buns. For the tow meals and two pops, everything came to around $38. We were absolutely stuffed. In the end it was decent. If you have a hankering for a dog or poutine, check it out!
name: Sheri

text: Randomly stumbled across Cajun Mike's while looking for a new place to eat some delicious and moreover authentic Cajun food. Chicken and sausage gumbo was incredibly savory, I could've easily drank a gallon of it IF I hadn't started with a heaping helping of Boudin Balls that were truly some of if not the finest I have ever had. A giant, great tasting meal plus a few beers barely put my bill over twenty-something bucks. Fantastic price for such a great meal, especially just being a few steps off of Canal St. In just one night Cajun Mike's has forced its way into my list of staples for New Orleans visitors (new or seasoned) like myself and locals alike. Take it from a food lovin' fat boy, don't miss this great local hideaway!
name: Austin

text: We ate here for the grand opening! What a delicious and flavourful buffet. This new Beverly restaurant is replacing Nalaz kitchen.  It is featuring Indian and African cuisine.  We decided on the buffet so we could sample a wide variety of food and we were not disappointed. The spice combinations were incredible . I have been sooo disappointed with the blandish combos that I have found at New Asian Village lately that we stopped going all together.  Great selection of food...there was a small salad bar, two feature soups, goat curry, butter chicken, fish curry, tandoori chicken, vegetarian korma, vegetarian vindaloo, aloo Gobi, kadai paneer, saffron rice, couscous and vermicelli with an unnamed chicken dish that I think was more African than Indian in flavour. It was so delicious...when I asked the chef, he said it didn't have an name. Everything was delicious but what stood out was the chicken soup, the fish curry, the vegetarian vindaloo, the kadai paneer, and the unnamed chicken dish as well as the rice pudding. My husband also loved the goat curry.The only critique I could give is that the aloo gobi cauliflower needed some more time to cook. Hot naan bread was brought to the table. Our server was friendly and helpful and really busy. I think that some Indian music could be played to add to the atmosphere. Definitely will be back again!
name: Jennie

text: I dropped into Glory for a pre-dinner happy hour drink. The HH runs from 4:30-6:30pm and has $4 drink & food specials. The regular prices are a bit high, but on point for Center City. The drinks were good and my beer-loving husband thought that the beer selection was well curated and fun. The space had a good feel and we will definitely return.
name: Valerie

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Maybe other people have better luck here. Food was fresh and service was quick. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: I have eaten at the Lure in Camarillo in the past and enjoyed the experience. The visit to the Santa Barbara restaurant was OK but lacked the service I expected. I was seated in a high traffic area of staff and guests constantly going by. The seating area seemed a little tight. I constantly had to ask our waiter for drink refills, extra butter, even had to wait on the bill. The food as always was prepared excellent and tasted delicious.
name: Tim

text: This afternoon had a very small crowd but the vibe was very chill and the staff had some old school reggae playing softly in the background. Beer selection was great, and the Jerk Chicken Cheesesteak was amazing! It just enough kick balanced with mushrooms and a terrific mango sauce. Wow!
name: Craig

text: If you're at the bar here be sure to avoid Edwin. I placed my order and he decided he needed to do 7 other things first. And very rude
name: Patty

text:
Wow, stopped in here during our tour of SB restaurants and we're very glad we did. We dined on Quail for an appetizer, perfectly prepared with a wonderful brandy sauce and sauteed grapes, just fantastic. 
Next we got sauteed mushrooms and the escargot crepe. Again, the food was expertly prepared with exquisite complimentary sauces.
We finished with the duck breast with plum sauce, medium rare. It arrived cooked to perfection with a crisp skin and tender flavorful, medium rare meat. The staff was fantastic and took good care of us. We will definitely be back!
name: Scott

text: So it's like any other pizza joint but the pizza tastes supreme!! Thin and very tasty!! Fun place to just hang out!!
name: Catherine

text:
Five ladies in town for 1 night for a show (The Price is Right) we stayed in 2 separate rooms in the East tower we asked for conjoining rooms but were given rooms across the hall! 
Our beds were nice & comfortable the view was nice of the mountain side!
The shower was a totally different story, the water took a long...long time to warm up, & the ceiling in the shower looked as if it was about to give away it was moldy & bellowing from water damage, I didn't realize it until after I had looked up & it was scary as the pipes gurgled with water running threw them. Definitely a matter that needs to be tended too!
name: marie

text:
I've had an issue with a birthday cake from here before, but other than that, nothing much to ever complain about. But today got a couple of bon bons and a couple other things and it's so incredibly dry that I don't think milk would even fix it.... cake products here seem to almost always be pretty moist, but today got two different ones and they are dry as a bone!!! Utterly huge disappointment. I already know they don't make their icing in house but now I'm starting to wonder about other things. Just wanted to treat myself and daughter a very special treat and is just nothing near that. 
:-( :-(
name: Chassidy

text:
When this restaurant first opened it was great. I recently visited for dinner with my family and it was crowded but not overly crowded. The buffet is just not the same. A lot of the selections that were once offered are not on the bar anymore. I ended up having the steak, whole cooked mushrooms, fried chicken, broccoli, corn, crab salad, and mashed potatoes which we all good. I really wished they had the whole catfish like the used to offer. The rolls were hot and fresh. They melted in you mouth. Nothing like fresh bread! The staff was nice and our waitress was very attentive. 

Overall, we had a good experience dining here.
name: Michele

text:
Awesome service, and great food & beer! 

A couple of friends and I had just driven back into Reno after a photo shoot in Tahoe. It was a Friday night, which is normally busy for restaurants, but they were able to seat us as soon as we came in. 

We ordered some drinks, appetizers, and entrees. We came in super hungry, and forgot to ask if they could bring out the appetizers and drinks before the meals (yeah, annoying to do, but we ordered a ton of food), but they did it anyway! The food came out in about 5-10 minutes, so we weren't getting antsy, and then the meals came out right as we were finishing up the first round. 

Definitely recommend the cheese sticks, and you can't go wrong with any of their burgers.

And our server, Roby, needs a raise. Sweetest guy!
name: Mitch

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up.
name: User

text:
Lovely place located at the Santa Barbara Inn. The service is excellent. Food is well crafted and reasonably priced.  
Ambience is relaxing and elegant. Decor is tasteful and classy. Overall, a lovely gem in Santa Barbara. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a relaxing evening.
name: T

text: We went to Freddy's today for a low key Mother's Day dinner with Grandma and a few of the little kids.  The shoestring fries are fun and delicious.  The fries have a little bit of seasoning on them and yummy with ketchup.  I didn't see any of the house sauce around so we didn't get to try that.  The chocolate shake was thick and spoon worthy.  It is a little more expensive than your typical fast food joints but this isn't a typical fast food joint.  The cost of three adult meals and one kids meal was over $30.  But because two of us are moms, our meals were comped because it is Mother's Day, bringing the total down to under $15.  I meant to get myself a shake for the ride home but I totally forgot.  I want to go back and try the mint oreo shake!
name: Amanda

text: My GF and I decided to give Blaze Pizza a shot after giving MOD Pizza a 1 star rating for food quality when they first opened. Blaze was better (we could actually eat the pizza) but it is still fast food quality. It's designed for speed at a low price point and so is McDonalds.
name: Buck

text: Amazing! Never ceases to disappoint, we love the menu and the staff is friendly. A hidden gem, you have to visit! :)
name: MacKenzie

text: I enjoyed my experience here and food.. Comfort food on my lunch break. Mike was very accommodating and had very great customer service, something you don't find often anymore.. will be back again. My food order has no issues..
name: Natalie

text: Food is always delicious. Food is authentic. I love that they're always expanding their offerings.  Service is very minimal which is a bit of a drawback but not huge
name: Emily

text: Good pizza and calzones. The pizza is made fresh with fresh ingredients. They have a good lunch special with cheese pizza. The atmosphere is ok. I've never been for happy hour so that may be something to try
name: Octavia

text: I've eaten here a couple times as Hilton guest and sat in the bar area as a solo diner.  I've never ordered a steak because of the reviews on here and prices don't seem worth it for review.  The salads and seafood are pretty good. Calamari Crab cake, sushi tuna, salmon etc all very fresh but the salmon meal tonite lacked flavor and the guy next to me ordered the same and agreed.  For $75/per person at least this place could do better and the service is just mediocre and a bit slow.
name: Gina

text: Very good pizza and wings.  Ordered food to go as staying across the street.  Pizza is what I expected, as crispy crust and good sauce.  I really like the large wings and being coal fired, were really good.
name: tim

text: Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was fresh and service was quick. Overall, a strong experience. It looked better online than it did in person. Food was fresh and service was quick. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Would prob stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
It is what it is.  A great gyro place.  Small quiet place not fancy just great gyros.  Loads of take out business.  Best we've had since Germany. 

Back again again, had a great Doner Kebab and Hummus.  Clean, friendly and 70s rock and roll playing!!!

OMG we just got a free dessert, baklava and tiramisu and it sooooo good.  Really folks, you got to come eat here.
name: Don

text:
Oh.My.God. The best food I have ever had. We did family style with 6 people. Every single item was mouthwatering. This place should only have 5 star ratings. I mean I started this review before I even left the restaurant.

P.S. It's so odd to me how people will say "this place is amazing, awesome, mind blowing, perfect" yet only give it 4 stars.  Give people their credit!
name: Kamaren

text: I came here with a groupon and it was a fairly good deal. The service was extremely attentive and polite. The sushi itself is good, nothing crazy amazing but it definitely didn't disappoint. My only wish was that there were more options on the sushi menu that didn't have tempura in them. Overall a great neighborhood sushi byo that I will keep coming back to.
name: Elizabeth

text:
REALLY wanted to love this new music venue. It's a great idea to have a place for small acoustic acts. It's a tough business to be in and I'm super supportive and grateful for anyone to promote live music which I believe makes any city more culturally alive. 

It's located upstairs from Sona Pub which is an incredibly loud eating establishment with big screen TVs and blaring music. You go up a narrow staircase to reach the club.

The room is long and narrow like a boxcar with a curved bar jutting out into the room partially cutting it in half and obstructing the view of the stage. Conversations of patrons at the bar make it hard to see and hear the performer. Several small cocktail tables are in front of the small stage. These are reserved seats. The rest of the crowd can either sit at the bar, or a few tables on the side, or stand. I don't mind standing at all. The issue was the people in the club would not be quiet and listen to the performance. It was super annoying. This is obviously no fault of the venue. The poor bartender had to ask people at the bar to tone it down and no bartender should ever have to do that. Memo to guests: if you had to pay to get in, it's a freaking SHOW so shut up when music is being played!!

After a while of trying to listen to the performer above a constant din of chatting and laughter, decided to leave early. The manager on duty was very nice when I  expressed my frustration at the noise. She agreed. Actually tried to get us to an empty table up front but someone grabbed it before us. 

On another note, if you're sitting at the bar, that doesn't mean you get to hog the seat all night. If you have to leave your seat let someone else have a go. Don't try to save it with your coat. It's not RESERVED as if you paid for it. 

It's too bad this place has such rude customers tonight. I felt bad for the artist. It's so disrespectful. But part of the problem is the set up of the room. It's just not practical for a show. There was a second bar in the back of the room which was closed. I believe it would be better to open up that bar as well to bring the yakkers back there instead of up front.
name: Holly

text: Call Philadelphia taxi cab at 5:19 in the morning so it would be 10 to 15 minutes never showed up called again at 6:14 a.m. and never showed up again are the worst taxi cab in the city
name: Joseph

text: Great atmosphere, and short wait. We sat up at the breakfast bar and had the luxury of having Gigi as our server. Very attentive and pleasant. Food was more than what we expected in taste and presentation, definitely arrived within less than 5 minutes of ordering. Drinks were always fresh and refurbished... thanks Gigi and Honey's Sit -N - Eat, we will be back!
name: Crystal

text: I am so confused. I ordered fries as a side for my meal. Ordered the queso go on top and they were out. So asked if they could put melted cheese on my fries instead to accommodate for the queso that they didn't have. They cannot melt cheese on fries for me. Company policy. But they offer an appetizer with shredded cheese melted on top. Does this make any sense. I'm very disappointed in this.
name: Cari Lane

text: This place is something special.  Got the chicken club sandwich and it was just SOOOOOO goo!  Out of this world good!  Check it out!
name: Charlie

text:
If I would give a zero stars I would, I went to the bar and got no service, I actually had to flag someone down and when I asked for water to drink the clueless bartender just stared at me like I was a ghost . when I finally did get service I told them my order to speed the process, and this was already 15-20 minutes in at least . I then after waiting what seemed another 30-40 I gave up cause I had little time to wait any longer .

The sad part ? It wasn't even busy . I saw plenty open tables . I'll take my money elsewhere if you're going to make me wait this long on a single order .
name: Garrett

text: People are super nice and food is amazing. My husband and I are regular here. My husband usually gets  panang curry and I usually get their Chinese food (especially Mongolian beef or Thai black pepper beef). Their soups awesome too!!!
name: Sarang

text: We picked this place because we wanted to watch the CFP and they had the most TVs. This is a place you only choose because it has TVs, except if you aren't in the sitting in the middle or at the bar it's really hard to watch your game because the TVs are on opposite walls. The food had no flavor. We had catfish with green beans and fries and a chicken quesadilla. If it wasn't for the hot sauce and salsa, it would have been like eating styrofoam. The waiter really wanted to watch the basketball game on. I've never had a waiter avoid eye contact so much. We left at halftime.
name: Tiffany

text:
The food was fabulous. The waitress Ciara couldn't have been nicer and helpful.
Nicely decorated for the Easter holiday!
Kitchen was a wee slow but the Manager made up for it with an apology & dessert! 
Will definitely be going back!
A hidden Gem in Delco.
name: Sandra

text: My type of place so many vegetarian options, I had the brown rice tofu bowl and my coworker got the Teriyaki chicken brown rice. The food is good, clean, and friendly staff. If you are in the downtown area check it out!
name: Karma

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. For a busy night they handled it okay. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. maybe I just came on an off day. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Got threatened by delivery driver for tip being too low. Was a simple daytime, short distance delivery. I looked it Up. 10% pre-tax for simple deliveries is common according to USA Today and CNN. He even yelled profanities as he was leaving. Just WOW! Food was OK, hopefully just one bad appleo.....
name: Moni

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. For a busy night they handled it okay. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The music was louder than it needed to be. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
CJ's Palace

This recent visit to the palace of CJ's well it was okay, not the best but decent. My wife an I went here for some sushi, I know I could've gotten better but depending on who waits on you here can determine your experience here. So with that said we sat down an started to order some rolls, and as the night came about so did the rolls. I have had ate about 5 rolls til about the time I said enough was enough, now I can eat no question about that but what the issue was...was they started soaking every roll in more and more and way more of their white sauce now I'm pretty okay with a light hint of sauce but Dammmmmmn!! There was enough sauce on my last roll to last the whole night. 

The staff there are nice, but talk to much to one another way to much an not enough to the customer. Customers should come first I mean the guys next to use waited for about 20min to get their check as we were waiting on food that was being prepared in the back that never came. An like the guys next to use, it was our turn to play the waiting game. 15-20min is what it took to get our check, is it terrible of course were they busy well kinda but you have one person running around as you had a few standing around.

With that said, will I come back? Yes, is it soon maybe not within the next month or so. Would I recommend this place? To those whom are not in a hurry. 

If I could add one thing, go lightly on the sauce.
name: Troy

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Clover and the Bee has great food and always a fun place to go!  Love it!
name: Lisa

text: Fast and fresh from the fryer the fish and chips were delicious. Lightly breaded and flakey with every bite on top of crispy fries. Lobster roll was sweet and buttery with hearty amount of lobster with a side of cole slaw. Customer service was knowledgeable about the food and friendly, which is a plus. Restaurant is also clean which is also a plus.
name: Nancy

text:
Great service, delicious food, uniquely large venue.
Dry ages steak was flavorful. Not sure if I love dry ages steak as much as regular, but worth a try. The quarter explained it well, it's complex flavors include a note of blue cheese.
Lobster mashed potatoes special was amazing. So rich and delicious. 
Broccoli side was also full of garlic and butter.
Desserts were large and decadent. Chocolate soufflé/lava was a bit over cooked though.
Overall, a great dining experience. Though our table was under a vent so it was a bit chilly.
name: Juliana

text: Muy buenos platillos, nos atendió Linda, atentisima y sonriente. Las ostras increibles, recomiendo las frescas, las que llevan queso parmesano y camarones y las asadas. Así mismo los langostinos.
name: Sebastian

text: Very attentive wait staff! Pleasant environment. Cook fried pickles were delicious I got the black bean quesadilla and it was awesome. Their tomato soup is creamy and delightful. They have something called Nashville hot chicken and it was covered in cheese and bacon and delicious. Grilled cheese was good but I would get something different next time. Overall we were happy and had a great time there
name: Peggy

text: Absolutely amazing experience! I'm here in a conference and my team and I found this restaurant. The food (pork chops, ravioli, poached pear and fig with Gorgonzola) and the crafted drinks (jalapeño margarita and other) are out of this world. Our waiter, Gary is fenomenal! Coming back here every time we're in St. Louis!
name: Betty

text: Outstanding experience all around. Excellent all-around service from the valets to the waiter to the server, combined with outstanding cocktails and delicious food.
name: Ryan

text: Always a wonderful meal and experience at Olive + Oak. Luckily we had wonderful weather and we able to sit outside. Service was excellent and the food was even better.
name: Jemal

text:
Decent place for a casual dinner. The service was good, ambience was fine, and the shrimp I ordered came out hot and flavorful, but not delicious. It was just okay. The accompanying potatoes, corn, and boiled egg were surprisingly bland. 

I'm not a fan of the bib, gloves, and bucket required not to get messy eating boiled seafood.

There are, however, other items on the menu not boiled such as: fried fish, squid, shrimp, oysters, cheese, French fries, soups, and salad, which my dinner mates had that was reportedly pretty good. 

Try it, you might like it.
name: Loretta

text: Great home made authentic food. Family owned and operated by such a wonderful couple - their hospitality and interest in hosting, feeding us a great experience. Highly recommend it. I will be there whenever I am in Boise next!
name: Harry

text: This is a brand new place that's just opened on 104 Ave (replacing Aarde). It's an upscale burger bar, with a slightly retro interior and a great selection of beers and alcohol. I've only tried the basic burger so far but it was delicious. They appear to do regular specials (I've seen their signs out front advertising $6 burgers and beer, or $6 mimosas, depending on the day and time) and it seems they are now open for brunch on Saturdays, which I look forward to trying!
name: Emily

text: Ahh! What can I say, I always stop here on my way out of Boise, and it's worth the $20 for the 8oz pour of Kim Crawford. Food is yummy, and service is so great. Norma is a my girl, she'll always give you a great story and a laugh (and recommend the truffle fries!!!!) Truly my Idaho gem, and not just for an "airport"
name: Mimi

text: This place is small but packs BIG FLAVOR in their dishes! We had the buffalo shrimp that served up GINORMOUS Shrimp that left me feeling full immediately after finishing. The blue cheese crumbles on top were a perfect companion to these delectable cooked shrimp! The sauce had enough kick with a hint of creamy cheeziness. Not too much of either but not too little. Most places offer the same thing but with the expected smaller sized shrimp and hot sauce flavor. The shrimp stuffed crab cakes offer  the freshest and mouthwatering flavors of the coast. Highly impressed with the level of ingredients used in each dish its availability in ybor.
name: Nina

text: Meh... I wanted to like this place but food was nothing special. Wait was long. Make sure you sign your name on the list near the door. Inside seating is all bar seating. If you sit by the window you're staring at the people sitting outside eating which is awkward. Hate to say I've had better seafood at Red Lobster.
name: Desiree

text:
This place was not so good from the beginning, guess I should've known when they didn't open on time and still let potential patrons stand outside with the door locked after their opening time of 11am. The smart people walked on further down the block, unfortunately I stayed and waited. 

They finally opened up, but they had one older guy serving and he was a damn mess. He sat me at the dirtiest patio table (all were messy and they had just opened). He used my menu (which was covered in food stains) to scrape the crumbs off my table as I sat down. WTF. 

I waited for quite a while for my food after ordering, I was 2nd to be seated on the patio, and 5th to be served after ordering. The guacamole was tasteless and oily, my taco combo plate with rice & beans was served cold. I was never checked on for a water refill or to see how my meal was, or I would have sent it back. The salsas that he brought out in squeeze bottles had about half an inch of salsa in them and was served with a crusty old top. I am kind of a germaphobe, so I didn't use them. Pretty gross. 

When I asked for the bill, the waiter was running around like a cray cray and didn't even let me pay and leave yet before moving all my salsa condiments over to another table and explaining to them what each salsa was. It was rude and unpleasant. HE was rude and unpleasant. He didn't even leave me with a pen to sign the tab and I finally decided to get up and go inside for a pen, to which he panicked when he saw me and left the table he was serving in the middle of their order to give me his pen, then disappeared into the back to find another one. Again, what a mess!

Won't be back here ever again while on business in Reno. This place isn't clean, they do NOT have their shit together and the food was subpar. No thanks.
name: Compass-Rose

text: Totally tourist trap. The server has an attitude. The food is just not good, especially compare with the amazing food you can have everywhere else in New Orleans. I don't recommend and will not come here again.
name: Priscilla

text: My son and I got to the restaurant and there was no line.  We ordered two meals to go.  We waited 45 MINUTES!  I had to ask them about my order for them to realize they forgot about it.  When we finally got it, the food we got was thrown together and we received no apology.  We left very disappointed and will not recommend this place to others.  I would have rated lower if I was basing this review off this one visit strictly.  But my dine-in experience was a smidge better.  Over-all: don't waste your time!
name: Aubrey

text: First timer and I was quite surprised at how small the place was but overall, I bought the Cloud 9 Bowl & the Tropical Pitaya Bowl and they were both delicious. Servings were actually more than I had expected which was great. Cashier was nice. Would recommend to others.
name: Audrey

text: Wonderful wings and service. I recommend the lightning and garlic Parmesan. Go there now
name: Noah

text: Spent some quality time at the Craft Ale House.  The food was good and the beer was cold but the service was not very good.  I will go to a place with so-so food if the service is excellent.  Unfortunately, I won't go to a place with poor service regardless of the quality of the meal.  They should work on this aspect of their business.
name: Kim

text: Yum!! The fish was sooo fresh! They had nice lunch specials that came with plenty of food! I will go again!!
name: Danielle

text: What a difference the new owner is making the changes to the place are great finally new carpet no more sticking to it when you walk. I wish him good luck in the future
name: Dave

text:
If you like Po-Boys and shrimp get it ! 
First time ever having a Po-boy and it was amazing !! Everyone at the table got the same thing it was huge and stuffed with shrimp. So good. We also got a hurricane drink that was to die for even got a souvenir cup . A little loud but of course it was busy we had to wait 15 mins for a table.  Our waiter was great !! 
Get the Shrimp Po-Boy ! We also split an appetizer crab dip with home made potato chips. !! Wish there was more crab but good !!
name: Ruthanne

text:
There's everything to like about Traub's. It's an established local bakery. A hallmark this part of Delco.  Reasonably priced & family run. 
I picked up the Dutch Apple Cake, apple filled doughnut, & a mini cake. At $12 and change, the cake made me the hit at an otherwise boring early morning meeting. The doughnut is real deal too. Not airy like DD or overly caked like the specialty gourmet options. Simple & delicious!

There's probably not one bakery on this planet that I wouldn't like a lot. But Traub's is unique for friendly family service, super convenient hours, and deliciousness. 

Delco Proper!
name: Adamal

text: Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Just not for me. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was fresh and service was quick. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: I visited this establishment tonight with my FATHER IN LAW, as I was taking him for his birthday. My HUSBAND was unable to attend due to work. As my FATHER IN LAW entered this establishment the children or hostesses muttered comments about our arrival together, as if we were "romantically involved." The hostess child tells the other "they can sit at table 69 hahaha." Our service was slow and one steak had to be sent back due to it being inadequate. Hopefully, this review deters people from experiencing a similar experience. I would never return.
name: Angela

text: We got a low carb king from Caluda's and it was delicious!! This is our first year doing Keto so it was nice to find a bakery that has low carb options. It was a lot more pricey than a regular sized king cake. It was the size of a small plate, not very big for $15. But we enjoyed it very much. Worth the price. It reminded me more of a cinnamon pound cake and a little more dense than the usual king cake. But again it was delicious and we didn't have to miss out on our Mardi Gras treat.
name: Crystal

text:
I came here to celebrate my friends birthday. I loved the environment as I walked in. They have touched it up more elegantly while keeping some old asthetics as it used to be a biker themed bar -mile 277). 

When our waitress came over, she asked if we had dined there before. My friends have been there many times and rave about it constantly, but I pointed out that my guest and I were new. She acknowledged and then said she would be right back. When she returned, she proceeded to tell us about the steaks, but seemed flustered or unsure about it herself. We started off with salad and my friends said they had amazing salad. I'm not a rabbit, but yes yes yes hands down delicious. Croutons are buttery goodness. Bread is from the oven. And those 2 housemade dressings. Bottle it up and I guarantee they will increase their profits drastically. It gave me a thousand island dressing feel when mixed but I like that type of dressing. Best part is that it is unlimited, which was good because we spent some time waiting for our steak. 

We had the Wade's cut ribeye (which was huge!), the filet mignon Wade cut, the chicken involtini, and the steak/batter dipped lobster tail. Everything was delicious, however I was not thoroughly impressed with the breading on the lobster. It was good, but my friends said they were known for their breading as well. My filet mignon (being the smaller version since it's the signature entree) was a smaller cut and not as tender/melt in your mouth as I was expecting. It was tougher and when compared to the other filet mignon cooked the same way, felt underwhelming. For dessert, we had the wedding cake and it was good. I am a sucker for wedding cake and it tasted as I would have expected. 

Overall, it was a good experience and I would return. The price is up there, but special occasions make it worth it.
name: Joe

text: This was definitely one of my favorite places I've tried so far. Great rolls and a perfect amount of meat to cheese ratio. And judging from the line outside and inside it's not a secret to everyone. I definitely will be back again.
name: Michael

text: We enjoyed Slyce on Sunday while watching the NFL games. We had some great pizza and Spinach & Artichoke wontons even though my Giants couldn't pull out the victory.
name: Samir

text: I knew what to expect when came here and I got exactly that. A greasy ass cheesesteak (this one covered in provolone). I came for the experience. I did not like it and was assured that there are actually really good cheesesteak places nearby, but I just couldn't eat anything else. Come here for the history and be prepared to get covered in grease. Glad I went, but I have no intention of returning when back in PA.
name: Shanae

text: A solid 4.5!  This place would be a 5 except the seating is weird.  I like privacy and with people almost on top of me made me somewhat uncomfortable, them popping in and out of our conversation. They have complimentary valet (a plus for the area).  The hostess was super friendly. Although the food was the highlight for this special dinner, our waiter Christopher took the cake.  He was amazing, helpful but not overbearing!    You know, just the right amount of attentive.  To begin we started with duck wings and bacon wrapped quail.  The flavors of both were magnificent! Then for entrees we had halibut and beef filet. The sauce the halibut swam in was so refreshing and the halibut cooked perfectly (flaked just right).  We shared the Mac n cheese and mashed potatoes.  And Christopher ended our evening with a complimentary dessert!  Take home message: A la carte dining at its finest.  The ambience/decor is nice, well prepared food.  A special place for special occasions! 5th and Taylor does it right!!
name: Trice

text: I have been wanting to come here for a long time and I am so sad it's taken me so long because this place is amazing ! My sis and I stood , Jaws dropped on the floor , big heart emojis coming out of our eyes as we looked over the menu , everything looked good , delicious actually ! , I decided on the peanut butter and jelly bacon and jalapeño sandwich , yeah you heard me jalapeños ! Sooooooo good !!! Honestly if I order it again I'd ask for them to go a little heavier than normal on the jalapeños for me because that bite of kick was blowing my mind ! I got the prickly pear lemonade , so good !!!!!! I haven't stopped talking about my lunch all day . So if that doesn't say something idk what would ! This place will knock your socks off ! And p.s sweetest girl working the counter today , didn't mind we took forever to order , and asked if we liked it when we were eating , super sweet girl xo we will be back , a lot ! I can't wait to have a bite here this summer when it's warm out !!  go support this spot so I can eat here forever !  Haha!
name: Indica

text: Mr. B's is my favorite place in Nola! Fabulous food, fabulous service, and overall class. I've been here to dine twice now and will come back during every visit in Nola. I brought my fiancé here for his 30th birthday and I was pleased to see the adorable balloons they had decorated our table with. We had the fried oysters (definitely recommend) and I can't remember the entree names but they were also delicious. I do think the crawfish dish I had was much more flavorful than the steak, and also you can get a steak anywhere. If you really want to experience Mr. B's, get a southern dish. We finished off our dinner with pecan pie (the best pecan pie, in my opinion). Make sure to get a reservation in advance! This is one of the hottest date spots in the city!
name: Nicole

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Overall, a strong experience. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Reservations here are hard to come by, but this place is spectacular! The food and drinks were so good I wish I were still in Philly to eat here again! The warm scrambled egg with uni gave me a blast of very interesting textures, flavors, and even temperatures. I loved it. This is what creativity in food is all about. The toasts were incredible and the service was A+!
name: Michael

text: This is an awesome place.  Food is always delicious and staff appear very nice.  Once in a while there is a long wait.  But it's worth waiting for.
name: Joan

text: It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text:
This is my first time writing a yelp review and the service was such that I thought it necessary. 
I was really excited to try out this restaurant after hearing such good reviews. Well, that excitement quickly changed to annoyance and complete disappointment. 
First the hostess rattled off how the restaurant worked so fast my head was spinning acting like seating us was an annoying ritual for her. Then we waiting a significant amount of time for our waitress- who then made our appetizer "The Alpine" with so much wine it wasn't even palatable. It was like we were dipping our bread in wine and eating it; perhaps it could have used the parts she dropped on the floor... but she said oh well and did offer to get more if we really wanted it. She spilled food all over the table which I understand could happen at a fondue place but this was excessive. She brought out our main course an HOUR AND A HALF after arriving- ironic because they aren't the ones cooking it. Again she dropped the vegetables into the pot and splashed broth all over us- no apologies nothing. 
We ate and waited another HOUR to receive our dessert menu. Keep in mind we had our very well behaved children (7 and 11) with us- one of them fell asleep because we were waiting so long. I actually had to find a manager to get a menu and order because our waitress was no where to be found. I also let him know that the elderly couple next to us (there for their anniversary) had been waiting 45 mins for their drinks. He then saw we had been sitting with our table covered dishes the whole time so he had another waiter come and clear our table. 
My one positive is that the dessert was satisfying - we had "The Original" and all of the fruit was fresh and there was a good selection of desserts to dip. All in all go here for dessert only. It is priced WAY to high for the service you receive. We won't be returning.
name: Stacy

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: This is the third location I've eaten at (So. Tampa & Seminole Hgts.). They were more than happy to accommodate my condition...veganism. They even offered to utilize a vegan cheese of my choice if I wanted to purchase one from the Publix next door. Very cool! I opted for the no cheese veggie though.
