As usual it was excellent and our server was even better!
name: Jabari

text: I called in to order food. The worker on the phone took the order and said it would be 10-15 min. We arrived 15 min later and my friend went in to pick up the food. She was told that our order was not in the system. Now I rechecked my phone just to make sure I didn't call the wrong BWW and confirmed that I was on the phone with the O'Fallon BWW for 2 min placing my order. I then went in to talk to them including the manager. I'm very disappointed after the "manager" just said "I don't know what happened. It's not in our system." No apologies. Nothing. The only thing that he said he could do was "retake the order". At this point, the wait would be over 30-40 min. It was a horrible experience especially because my friend and her daughter was starving at this point and looking forward the food. I go to BWW pretty often because I do love their wings. After today, I don't even feel like it is worth the horrible service.
name: Paweena

text: Had the best time watching the Met Ball red carpet, with the employees, as we were the only ones in the place. This is an awesome no-tourist-in-sight local joint with THE BEST food we had all trip. I don't eat fish or shrimp, cause they're usually gross and over cooked, but I inhaled the fried shrimp and fried catfish. No sauce needed.  The food and staff were perfection!! Highly recommend!!!
name: L. Boogie

text: Came here after seeing it on BA's list! And it did not disappoint!! Very tapas-ish but a little bit bigger. Not usually a brussel sprouts gal but the shredded brussels were SO GOOD. Then of course, we had to try the venison ribs and the meat literally fell off the bone which is how you know. The atmosphere was classy but not overly fancy and we didn't feel out of place in any way. Highly recommend the next time you're in Nashville.
name: Liz

text: The food was good, the service left much to be desired.  Everyone else in the restaurant waited on us but our server.  He never once cane to check on us.  We had to flag other people down to get service.
name: Laura

text: The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: I've come here a numerous amount of times in hopes that the service would get better, or the wait staff would be less sassy. Tonight I had the best table service I've ever had to date since coming here. Katherine has exceeded my expectations and made me feel like home. Being a server my self I try not to judge but Katherine was on her game and implemented the best service. I appreciate her gratitude and attentiveness. Thank you!
name: Samantha

text: Don't know why this restaurant gets such a low rating. The pizza is excellent. As good as Roman pizza. Tuscan vegetables are also terrific. My favorite for pizza in the Philadelphia area.
name: Robert

text: EXCELLENT SERVICE. EXCELLENT FOOD. Marvin was our server and didn't disappoint. We had crab hushpuppes for app. DELISH. Lobster for dinner with double mashed potatoes loaded. DELISH. Crab cakes. DELISH. Shrimp. DELISH. Chocolate cake. DELISH.
name: Jen

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasnt expecting at all. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didnt have a reservation. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
Will not ever go back!!!

Been going here since I was a child and Im now 51 so Ive put my time in here.I went by today 6/6/19 to pick some biffs to bring how for the family and WOW was it a waste of money,,The patties were burt on most sauce amount was very little and the cheese was hardy melted..feels like part of my childhood has died today all because someone stop caring and let the quality of what was a Great Place go in the dump!!
name: Steven

text:
Stopped by for Sunday morning breakfast- along with many others, as the line reached the door when we arrived. On the right when you walk in are paper menus and pencils, with which you record your order. There are a few favorites listed at the top, and then you have the option to create your own combos by choosing a coating, topping, and a drizzle. The donuts are made fresh to order and the line moves along relatively quickly, especially when you're distracted by all the choices on the menu.

Once we placed our order, the donuts were made pretty quickly. However, it did take quite a bit for them to make the coffee. Once the donuts are done, they showed us the box and asked if they looked good, upon which my sister and I requested that they add more powder onto our powder donuts (which they did).

I ordered one powder and one with chocolate coating/chocolate topping/fudge drizzle. The donuts were absolutely delicious! My sister enjoyed her powdered, and her graham cracker sprinkled creation was tasty as well. My boyfriend enjoyed his pb & jelly donut, and he was surprised that he also liked the bacon donut.

There's a fridge with some beverages such as apple juice and etc, but I prefer my donuts with a cold milk. Milks were only sold via tiny carton, so I had to buy 2. My only suggestion is that they supply the fridge with larger cartons. I'm sure we'll be back again soon.
name: Gia

text:
Among the numerous bars, eateries and shops in the outdoor section of international mall, Taps stands out as a hopping bar and burger joint.

The food was quite good.  I opted for a fried chicken sandwich with fries, and washed it down with 2 pints of Coppertail Free Dive, one of my favorite local brews from Tampa.  Could've been more chicken then bread, though. Going to try their burgers the next time around.

Service at the bar was quick and friendly.  Hostess and staff were all very nice and welcoming.  Great selection of tap and bottled brew available, as well as a decent wine and spirits list.
name: Tim

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Honestly, for the price i expected more than this. It looked better online than it did in person. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: This is a bare minimum taco stand that has on 3 separate occasions handed me an order without including the full order (no Guac, no cheese sauce and no fries on my last occasion). Do yourself a favor and either go to taco bell, or find another place to order from. Literally avoid this place at all costs, it is a drunk persons food spot and not worth eating sober. I generally feel bad for whoever owns this place #sad #havesomeselfrespect
name: Robert

text: Pizza was delicious but I was looking to serve 4 people and bought 2 pizzas. They only have mediums which I thought would be enough. We felt like we were fighting each other over each piece. For $15 dollars a pie, there are much better deals around.
name: Samantha

text: I ate here years ago when they opened and our server was not kind-sarcastic and unprofessional and have not been back. I went to farmers market with a friend today and the server was not well informed re: products. We wanted something vegetarian and he didn't know which frittata was no meat. The server was not friendly and smug. Additionally there was a 9% up charge for using my credit card.There was no signage at the booth I asked what company  it was and he said Taste-ahhhhh-same culture as opening weekend. Did get home and tried my frittata -tasteless.
name: Ann

text: Will never eat here again. We got pizza delivered and it was stuck to the bottom of the box and all we could eat was the crust and topping we had to pick off. Not to mention the taste wasn't that great and it came cold. Considering we spend $40 on two small pizzas it wasn't what we would expect for that price.
name: Cortney

text: Went with daughter as she loves Olive Garden, I told her this would be better...we waited 15 mins to be seated inside? Then once seated, waited another 20 mins for a server then they switched back and forth as I don't think they knew who was waiting on us...it was like a three hour dinner? The meatballs rock, but they should have given us something for the long delays, a beer , the garlic knots, anything to help on a 60 dollar bill,  and a very long dinner that was kinda exhausting. I mean it is just pasta that is already done right? I can make a spaghetti/rigatoni meal in 20 mins from scratch.
name: JD

text: Do not think twice about coming here. Fresh, flavorful food full of love. Had the fettuccine Alfredo, sweet potatoes and brownie. Simply the best vegan food I have ever had. Owners are front and center - delightful people.
name: N

text: Nice ambience, good food and serving. There are few options of meat and veggies. But the quality of what they have is good.
name: Deep

text: I've been to crispers at multiple locations in and around Tampa and they are consistently mediocre.  I'm writing this after having food delivered through Door Dash.  The food arrives missing components that are clearly on the order ticket.  When I called to let the store know, there was no acknowledgement of the mistake they had made only the explanation as to how they had to work refund through Door Dash.  The food that did arrive was ok, but French dip with no au jus is a bit dry!  The tomatoes on the other roast beef are pictured.  How is it that Jersey Mike's four doors down can produce consistently high quality produce (red ripened tomatoes) and crispers can't?  Door Dash was excellent about making this right.  Crispers, not so much.
name: Bill

text:
Delicious food inconsistent service and long wait to be seated on weekends. I'll be back though because the banana French Toast is too good to give up. I wish they'd state on the menu you can order half sizes I found out after i got my French toast, it was just too much food for me and I threw away the rest. 

I also wish they still served the Tuscan chicken sandwich. I will say even when the place is packed the food comes out in a good time. Overall I'd recommend this place.
name: Brit

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Have been eating here since I was a toddler. Consistently great. Anthony makes you feel at home. He has a great sense of humor and even better sense of making pie.
name: C

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. For a busy night they handled it okay. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. I had a better visit than I expected to. It looked better online than it did in person. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: I don't know where to begin. Being from the South it's my go to place for fried okra , pickles and tomatoes.  Dude orders so large it's a meal not an appetizer. For me a side salad makes it complete. The shrimp and grits are so satisfying and you need a nap afterwards from the blissed out impending food coma that follows.  Haven't eaten anything here yet that I haven't liked. Indoor and outdoor dining and great service.
name: Pamela

text: Very authentic and very delicious Mexican food! Got the tacos and wasn't disappointed at all. Grew up my whole life in San Antonio, so I know a thing or two about Mexican cuisine and this didn't disappoint at all! Felt like I was back at home
name: Mark

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Glad we tried it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: We booked a room for our 48th anniversary on Feb. 13, 2017 for a check in on Nov. 1, 2017 (9 months later) for one night!  We were going to see Andre Rieu at the Amalie Arena. This was my dream, and my husband did it for me!   When we arrived at 3:45, we used the valet parking.  When we arrived at the check-in desk, we were told our room had been given away!  We arrived on time, we had ordered our room nine months ago, and we are Hilton Honor's Members! We had a confirmation!  Nothing, we said mattered!  Others were checking in and getting their rooms.  We stood there so embarrassed!  We were told if we didn't go away, security would remove us!  My husband and I have been public school teachers for more than 35 years.  The Embassy Suites gave us a room at the airport!  We live in Florida, so we knew this was far away!  The desk people were the worst!  There is no customer service at this hotel!  So read the reviews!  I always look at the worst ones first!  Go from there!
name: Jane

text: Very tasty. Service started slow because of a miscommunication to our server but it ended up alright. We ordered the pasta linguini ocean sauce and the stuffed flounder with ocean sauce. They tasted the same w/ both sauces. Next time I'd get the linguini with crawfish and shrimp and red sauce. Salad came w the pasta. The dressing was a Dijon mustard and it was good. Tbh the bread was weird. Toasted like croutons. My bf liked it. I really didn't dig the bread. But there was so much food anyways.
name: Marina

text: Unbelievably delicious. First time here recommended by a friend. The best Mexican food ever we ordered almost 8 different dishes and one was better than the other one. Very satisfied. Will be back every time we are in Santa Barbara.
name: Albert

text: This is a good local place to get a reasonably priced breakfast. I love the vintage decor inside and the service was great!
name: Flygurl

text:
Every time I dine in or have take out from Olde Town I am always pleased.  Perfecting a deep dish pizza is not easy, but their crust holds up the toppings, cheese and their delicious sauce.  The prices here are exceptionally reasonable! My family has had their thin crust, deep dish, pasta dishes, salads and Stromboli and everything has always been great.  They cater to all details, down to the frosted glasses for beer!
Very happy with the Plant City, Fl Olde Town Pizzeria!
name: Brittney

text: WOW!!!  I am a self-professed BBQ critic and this place is awesome!  I tried all the meats and the ribs and brisket are incredible. Great sides too and make sure you try the Blackberry sauce.  And of course no BBQ place is complete without banana pudding!  Please check these guys out!
name: David

text: Growing up in San Diego and on a steady diet of Mexican food, my standards and expectations may be higher than most Floridians. La Hacienda gets it mostly right. Avoid all Carne, because they get that wrong and way to salty. But everything else is quite good and authentic. Real Mexican food is not fancy, not particularly pretty, and should be served with no thought of presentation. Seriously. All that is to matter is taste. Service is generally friendly, and prices are what you should pay for authentic Mexican food, which is ridiculously cheap served in large portions.  If you've spent any time in Mexico, not tourist Mexico, but places like Jalisco or Tecate, you'll be right at home. The clientele and rundown interior are straight from central casting.
name: Gaijin

text:
Ahhh man this was so good!

I live right up the street, pass it very frequently and never stopped here though I love pizza. I have looked at the place as I drive past saying "hey I need to stop in there" but never did.

I was craving pizza and said I am going here! Now let me say they have way more than pizza. They have amazing pasta dishes, sammiches and desserts! They have vegetarian options as well. 

When I walked in, I wasn't expecting a New York whiskey bar vibe. It was hella sexy in there! Very smooth. Dark wood and brown leather furniture, dim lights, tree accents. Super cute and chill. There is what seems like a chill area when you first come in with tall tables and chairs. Then straight ahead is the counter and oven to make the magic.

I ordered the small Special pizza that had sun dried tomatoes, garlic, basil and mozzarella. FIRE! SO DAMN GOOD. I'm ordering tonight. I also got the carrot cake that was so light but so so satisfying that I was in heaven. All of that for $16. I wanted that seafood pasta but they weren't serving it that day. 

They have more seating to the right but I didn't go back there.

Love love this place! Get there and quit playing!
name: Amber

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Idk, pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Honestly, i kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Well... The service was great!!! Our waitress was fun sweet and had a great personality! Our food was ok... I ordered egg rolls and corn from the happy hour menu. It came fast which was great! But it was ok... I ordered the Mac n cheese which looked amazing on Yelp and I ordered my husband the Osso buco which again looked amazing on Yelp. The Mac n cheese unfortunately had no flavor....pretty...but no flavor... His meal was Luke warm. I asked for it to be heated up which she was happy to do, but my husband was like I'm fine. It too had no flavor in my opinion... Everything needed a kick! Spice it up! We're in New Orleans! Egg rolls needed some personalty... They looked like empanadas...and we're very bland. The Mac n cheese needed a Cajun twist ... It tasted like it was made with cream if mushroom soup. Not a bad thing just didn't taste cheesy. His meal needed a reduction sauce... Merlot, something... It was missing something... All in all the place was beautiful!!! But the food needs some kick!
name: Erika

text: Tonight I wasn't cooking but wanted some authentic Italian food. Stopped into Rossi's and noticed there was a crowd although a lot of people were getting pizza and dinners to go so we we're seated quickly. They offer a few specials which were large portions at a reasonable price. I opted for the Eggplant Rollotini with angel hair pasta. It was served with soup or salad and I chose the pasta fagioli soup.. delicious homemade just like my Italian grandma made. My husband chose the calamari FraDiavlo  over Angel hair with a house salad... portions are plentiful and the Italian bread seeded and crispy on the outside but soft and warm inside. We had a stuffed mushroom appetizer which was served in a Marsala style sauce and topped with mozzarella cheese. A glass of wine and this delicious dinner for 2 was $36.00 with plenty left over for tomorrow's lunch.
name: Christine

text: Was recommend by a co worker very disappointed. We ordered margaritas,  the waitress didn't ask rocks or frozen I had to tell her how we wanted them. We asked if we could substitute the calamari for scallops from one of the seafood platters and she said we don't substitute we can eliminate them and we could order a separate order of scallops which would have made one of our dinners $35++ (price doesn't matter). I orders crab legs that don't come as a dinner 1/2 lb. So I ordered a salad an french fries to complete as a dinner. My husband whined up ordering the scallop dinner. He orderd grilled he got blacken, they must have not been wash well cause they were sandy  and some shell on them. My fries never came. And I know you won't know what kind of crab legs you get until you break them but most were empty, they must have been frozen . As a person as a former Food and beverage manager I can sadly say I was not impressed by the whole experience.  I will stick to the Bay Port Inn, Hernando Beach. It may not be the best looking restaurant but we never had a bad meal there.
name: Lisa

text:
The pick up catering was FORGETTABLE. 

I called in a small order for catering. 
Pretty easy huh?  I wanted 2 dishes that fed more than 5 people so it becomes a catering order. 

I get a call a day later from someone that wants to verify it. He's my catering manager. Wants to make sure everything goes fine. Asks for my email. Sends me an email with instructions on how to do this whole thing all over again online. 

WTF!!!  I did it already. I called in a pick up order. 

I call back to tell him I did everything but he wants to make sure I get the right amount of stuff to accommodate my catering. 

No pal. Done.  Done that and won't do more. I called in my order for pick up and when I get there I will pay. 

On pickup day I wait like 20 minutes at the pickup window waiting for little girl employee fiddle with finding a roll of register tape. Inserting it. Helping some woman with a coupon. You name it - it was happening. 

I pick up the order.... mind you they call it catering....  

No forks
No knives
No butter
No grated cheese
No plates 

No nothing.... 

Why?  Who cares -and- who knows. 

Never again. 

Cater with Maggiano's
name: A

text: Always a great experience here. Staff is always welcoming and kind. I can't speak on the whole menu because in the 2 years I've ate at this location I have only ordered the south of the boarder breakfast burrito with both bacon and chorizo.  I was only able to take a picture of 1/2 my burrito because I was scarfing down the other half. Great place, free parking, and it's easy on the pockets.
name: Gagik

text: We dined here during a week night. Let me start off by saying we have ate at other locations previously, so we know the standard. Pros: The meat servers brought plenty of fresh and cooked perfectly meat to the table. It was plentiful and great. The hostess were very friendly. Bathroom clean. Restaurant maintenance was kept up, shopping center looked new so I assume location was not old. Cons: the bread was hard and cold even after requesting hot and fresh bread. The bread is usually light and fluffy. The salad bar seemed to be lacking on options. Other locations have a larger salad bar with way more selections. I do recommend the grilled pineapple. Our waitress, Laura, was just ok, nothing special to write about. Overall, we will be back.
name: The Queen

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Maybe other people have better luck here. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Stopped for breakfast today. I will say upfront that Black Bear has them beat and there can be no comparison. Mimi's breakfast is rather ho hum.  It's breakfast but nothing to write home about. The eggs over easy were ok, the fried potatoes were bland and without any flavor, the turkey sausage looked and tasted like it had been reheated. 

The banana chocolate chip muffin was moist and tasty, albeit not much banana flavor. It was the best part of breakfast. 





My husband surprised me with muffins from Mimi's. Note to self, in the future when purchasing "ToGo" muffins at Mimi's, check the product before you leave the restaurant.  He bought 4 assorted muffins, 2 of which were fresh and tasty, but 2 of which were stale and likened to hockey pucks. No excuse for selling old, stale product Mimi's! Disappointing, to say the least.
name: Jeanne

text:
Food is good but double.. no triple check your bill. 4 attempts to get it right. 40 minutes.
Food was good though.
name: Paul

text:
We are fans of Brazie's and have been for years.  I think the first time we went it was because we didn't feel like waiting at LoRusso's Cucina down the street.   There are plenty of Italian options in this area, given it's proximity to the Hill, but this is one of our favorites.  A big plus is we can usually get a table without a wait even on Saturday.  Not doubt they'd prefer a wait, but it works well for us. 

The bread service is a highlight and an important consideration for us.  The server mixes in spices for you and they are good at it, so you don't have to eat a ton of bread before you get the mix right.   

Over the years, we have tried many of their pasta items.  Most have been delicious.  The only downside a couple of times would be the cream sauces were not as flavorful.  The best meal we've had here, though, was the steak modiga.  The steak was amazingly tender and tasty.  We've had it twice and it was amazing both times.  It's kind of pricey, but this was a great piece of meat cooked perfectly.

The last couple of times we had the same server whose name was Jim, I think (glasses and goatee).  We really enjoyed talking to him - great sense of humor and he'll give you an honest answer if you have any questions.  

We've been maybe ten times and we'll be back.
name: Tom

text: We came here because we saw a picture of prime rib on Facebook that looked amazing. It wasn't bad, but just did not have the best flavor. No crusty outside. No garlic flavor. And the temperature of the actual meat itself was not hot. One of my pet peeves.  It came with a baked potato which was hot in temperature and very good. It also came with a side of coleslaw which I must say was the worst!  The coleslaw tasted like it have been sitting outside all day and I wish the manager would taste it so he knows how bad it is.  It was busy so we sat at the bar. No real friendliness from anybody serving us. It was a drive for us so doubt we will come so far. Just very average.
name: Judy

text:
Great buffet with different options, such as unlimited, one plate, one smaller plate, or no meats. 
Food tasted great and we had great service.
name: K

text: Upon arrival I noticed the parking lot full and expected to wait to be seated. Me and my 2 kids 6 and 8 checked in and was told it would be 10-15 min, which was no problem. After sitting for 30 minutes and finally hearing them call names I notice they skipped over my name. When I addressed this issue they immediately sat us. Once seated we had our drink order taken and were given drinks quickly. 10 min or so pass and then the waitress comes to get our food order. It took almost 45 min from the time the ticket was put in to get our food. The food was made correctly and there were no issues there. Upon receiving my check I was a bit In disbelief to see that I wasn't comped anything for our extremely long wait time. The server only checked on us after we had our food and never gave us an update before or if she did speak to us it was on her way to another table never bothering to stop. There were a lot of tables open and staff was bickering non stop among themselves. When I checked out several of the staff walked by and never bothered to check me out. Our waitress had to leave her station to check us out (which I assume is why everything took so long). On our way out we notice several employees in the back on their smoke break complaining about day. I usually avoid this place and I made a huge mistake trying my luck there today.
name: Jessica

text: Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. Maybe other people have better luck here. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Great comfort food. Ordered the fillet. It was cooked well and was savory and tender While not the best steak I have had, it won't disappoint. . Sides of mushrooms, asparagus, and mash were delicious.  My favorite dish was an appetizer of fried pork bellies. These little morsels were a hit with the whole table.
name: Brian

text: My boyfriend and I are close to this area, and after I get off work at 8 pm this is a great place to go for a quick and delicious bite. We love this place! Went for the first time last week and had an amazing meal, so we went back tonight. We were told it would be a 30 minute wait, which isn't bad at all, so we waited. It only took about 7 minutes, and we were seated. We could tell it was busy so the slightly slow service wasn't really an issue. About 30 or more minutes after we had been seated my boyfriend mentioned that it was taking a while for the food to come. I told him I really didn't notice it was taking too long and I'm sure they were just understaffed. Shortly thereafter, the waitress came over and told us that it wasn't acceptable that it was taking this long and she wasn't sure what happened in the kitchen but she's going to have manager talk to us. The manager came over with our food shortly after that and told us that dinner was on them for their mistake. I will absolutely be recommending B Spot because not only do they have unbelievably delicious food, but I'm also extremely impressed with the way they took care of us tonight. I honestly wouldn't have really thought too much less of them even if they hadn't taken care of our bill, because i know how the service industry can be. The fact that they went above and beyond to make sure we left happy really made me want to return to this place and recommend it to anyone.
name: Michelle

text: Just as good as the Cincinnati location. Great food and drinks, great ambience, good for groups. Reasonably priced.
name: Glenn

text: Great spot with wonderful views and pretty good seafood at excellent prices. It's not a far drive for me and it's one of my favorite restaurants in the area. It a great place to take visiting guest to show off Tampa Bay and enjoy some tasty grouper.
name: Derrick

text:
This Puerto Rican bakery is a tiny shop on Brownsville Road, Trevose, PA. Primarily takeout, it has a few tables for those of us who prefer to sit, sip and eat while the iron is hot. The business opens at 8:00 AM, not the 10:00 reflected on its Yelp page. As we were there for breakfast, the earlier time is important to know. 

We ordered two egg platter breakfasts. Both had two fried eggs (ordered over easy, but delivered sunnyside up), five slices of small loaf toasted sweet bread, and bacon/sausage.  In addition, we had excellent coffee and shared a marble donut made for us after ordering. Service was friendly, informative and nicely paced. 

Turned out that the egg/meat/toast part of the meal was pretty ordinary, with the only remarkable piece the pleasant taste of the bread. Much more interesting and rewarding was the strong java brewed through an expresso machine, and the donut.  Expresso coffee was used, which made for a rich, aromatic joe. The donut was still warm from the oven and covered in a thick icing of vanilla and chocolate. Delicious, but not too sweet. A super pleasant chew. 

I would return to enjoy more baked goods and coffee, and likely pass on the breakfast offerings. Lo Le Lai has the feel of a café, and would be a great one just based on the quality of its flour products.  

Definitely, a treasure to explore.
name: Gerald

text:
Short story-

Very poor service and bizarre experience. Manager refused to honor my reservation that I made earlier that day. My husband and I ended up having a fantastic meal at Maestro next door. 

The details-

There  was a miscommunication between the hostesses and it seemed I was promised a reservation that had been given to someone else. When I asked to speak with the manager he said my table was still occupied and he couldn't seat me for my reservation. The table he pointed to had about 4 or 5 open empty ones around it and the couple at the table that was supposedly reserved for me had just gotten their salad and bread, clearly they had not been there for very long. 

The hostesses are young, the place was busy, I understand something things do not go as planned in the restaurant world. What I do not understand is why the manager refused to seat me and made up some elaborate story to cover for the mistake. An "I'm sorry there was some confusion about your reservation, let me see what I can do for you" would have gone a long way. Instead the manager stood and watched as my husband and I waked out of the restaurant in disbelief about the whole situation.

text: If you've been searching for some authentic Italian food in the Tampa area look no further!! This place gives fresh Italian cuisine a whole new meaning. This place gives off a very initiate vibe making you feel like you're at an old friends house for dinner. They begin with serving you one of the most delicious bruschetta I have ever tasted. We both started off with a glass of the house Cabernet which was decently priced at $7 a glass. Looking back we probably should've just ordered a bottle as we each got two glasses. I ordered the chopped salad which was loaded with bacon and fresh Parmesan cheese, black pepper. For my main course I got the Pollo Milano which came with savory chicken smothered in roasted garlic, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and fresh sage sauce. Are you drooling yet?!? My dish was $21.99 and worth every penny! My girlfriend ordered the eggplant Parmesan with a side of homemade angel hair pasta. The sauce alone was to die for (and she's really picky with red sauce). The homemade noodles is what really sets this place apart from other Italian restaurants in the area. It's not often a restaurant offers pasta like this! The dish was about $22.99 and came with good serving size. We both had leftovers to take home and the next day they were just as good if not better!

text:
A couple of years ago Bon Appetit Magazine said that Joe Beddia's pizza was the very best in the entire United States.  Time Magazine recently named Pizza Beddia one of the top twenty places to eat in the world.  Wow these are some incredibly lofty accolades!  As one can imagine at the small old hole-in-the-wall, getting a Beddia Pizza was a major investment in time and luck.  With the cool new spot which is actually large for a pizzeria, the task of eating here has gotten easier - a little bit. You see it is still mega popular and there is only so much dough.  And the dough turns into the amazing crust which is what drives this pizza's popularity.

When something is so lauded, I almost want to be one of those people who try to bring it down a notch or two.  But I ran into a problem in doing just that.  The pizza was indeed awesome!  I ordered the Arrabbiata (angry pizza) and loved it - the crust was perfect with Mr. Beddia's signature charring in effect at a few places on the rim of the pie.  The spiciness was just at the right level to live up to the "angry" in its arrabbiata name.  And my friends' regular cheese and tomato pizza was just as tasty but without the heat.

The only negatives are that it is a little bit expensive here - not just the pizza but also the small glass of draft Kambucha I ordered at the bar.  For that amount of Kambucha, it should have been a couple of dollars less...or keep the same price and increase the amount of kambucha.  But still adding in the atmosphere and buzz, the kinda hidden location, a cool minimalist design, and pretty friendly servers and bar tenders, Pizza Beddia is a total winner!

Tips - There is no take-out here but if you can't finish all your pie, they will give you a box to take the rest home with you.  
Also I saw no condiments to add to the pizza - hot pepper, grated cheese, oregano, s&p etc. You eat your pizza just the way Joe and his crew serve it to you.
name: Jeff

text: Francesco's is one my local favorites...I have yet to be disappointed with the food and service here...my most recent visit is no exception...the rolled asparagus appetizer is the best...it's a meal in itself...my meal was just as good...it was the pork loin offering for resteraunt week...cooked to perfection this entree was top notch...combined with friendly and fast service, this resteraunt remains at the top of my list for local Italian cuisine...oh yeah, the pizza is great here too!
name: Andy

text: This was our first time trying Noah's Grant and it was great. I got the crab bowl and my date had the crab cakes. We will definitely be back again.
name: Kinyatta

text: Best place was have and ate and drank in Philly! The food was phenomenal. They do vegan right here! They also have great carnivore options. We came because of the food reviews but were pleasantly surprised that they were having a tasting of sour beers that weekend. We ended up staying for quite some time tasting many beers and enjoying them all. The staff was great. We cannot wait to go back.
name: Andi

text: The food is amazing, I've been going to this Buffett for a few years already and it never ceases to amaze me, the food is getting better and is always tasty and juicy.
name: Luis

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The music was louder than it needed to be. Worth checking out. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: Stumbled in this joint one cold drunkenly night looking for a place to warm up and a bight to eat to help sober me up a bit, so that I could pound back more brewsky throughout that night. Spent months trying to figure out where/what this place was and finally found it and wanted to try it out sober. I figured they served me when I was one eye opened and staggering like a rapid coon drunk, they deserve my business. My take from it is the pizza is spectacular. Truly a great pie all the way around. Great crust, good flop, good sauce/cheese ratio. However, the people running the front don't seem like they love pizza l. You don't just work at a pizza joint to collect a pay check. You work there because pizza is your life. If you don't have a strong love for that steamy hot delicious pie, you don't need to be working there. You need to being jumping around like you just won the lottery every time someone walks through your door to try your pie. Other than that, highly recommend.
name: Dustin

text: This is our favorite Mexican restaurant in Brownsburg. Excellent service and food. The staff is very friendly and always makes an effort to interact with the kids in your group.
name: Shawna

text: We had over an hour wait. We got seated first, but the 3 tables around us got their food before us. I had a hair in my omelette and had to wait another 15 min for my food. The manager did not compensate my meal, but instead gave me a punch card. Our server and manager were inattentive, and I had a terrible experience. Someone else in my party had cold food and nasty doughy pancakes.
name: Paige

text: Simple, well-executed and utterly unpretentious,  this place has been a favorite for many years. The staff is friendly and efficient, the pizza is always hot, the crust is crispy. The specials--one of them is pictured--are never overpriced. The place is clean, the sesame cookies are 'a must' with coffee--and a few to take home and I'll be going back for many years yet.
name: monika

text: Made reservations for my sisters birthday and had to wait over an hour to be seated. Upon being seated we received mediocre service and subpar food. Will not be going back. Ever.
name: Engelica

text: This is low grade dog food...I got mine "Wit Wiz"...I barely made it across the street & had explosive diarrhea right on an outside table at Pat's King of Steaks. A patron started dipping his cheese steak into my expelled brown bowel gravy and remarked that it was quite tasty. Never Again Shitadelphia!
name: Mitch

text: Great food, but a rip off. We ordered all of our food, then realized the veggie chili doesn't come with cheese. So we ask for some. We're told it's $1.29 for a PLASTIC CUP OF CHEESE. First of all, unsustainable. Why do I need a cup with a top when I'm eating here? Also, that should've been free. Lost a customer.
name: Palmer

text:
Good service. Good oysters. Not much more to say! I'd probably skip most of their entrees, as there's better elsewhere. 

A local told me that they source their oysters from the exact same place as Acme, so I'd go here to avoid the wait. 

Last time I was here a few years ago, the waiter showed us how to make our own cocktail sauce! 

Here's roughly how we do it:
4 parts Ketchup 
1 part Horseradish
a splash of Worcestershire sauce
a pinch of pepper
a splash of Crystal hot sauce

Mix well and enjoy!
name: Preston

text:
Great new restaurant and hotel!
Roof top bar has beautiful views of the gulf and the bay with hand crafted cocktails.
Restaurant downstairs has a nice menu of tasty dishes!
Been there twice so far and going back again for Sunday brunch!
name: Pete

text:
I honestly don't understand. The gelato has a horrible glue-like texture and each flavor just tastes like imitation extracts. The pistachio gelato tastes overwhelmingly like almond extract without a hint of real pistachios. I didn't dare try the coffee. If you want good gelato just make the drive to Paciugo in St Pete, its worth it.
Two stars though because customer service was friendly and great.
name: Andrew

text: I called Joe's Peking Duck to place a take out order for a family member; I was told the order would be ready in 20 minutes.  I called back 5 minutes later as the person I ordered for thought the price was rather high and decided to cancel the order.  The person I spoke with at Joe's Peking Duck yelled "Your order will be ready in 5 minutes. Don't try it! You can't cancel the order!"  I called the person I placed the order for on three-way so that he could explain why he no longer wanted the order.  It turns out that he was fine with simply modifying the order rather than cancelling it.  The person at Joe's Peking Duck continued to yell that we could not cancel or modify the order and demanded that we come and get it. He yelled that I should have gotten the order right in the first place and he yelled that we better come get it.  I immediately asked him who he thought he was speaking to in that manner as he was being very disrespectful.  I told him to cancel the order and proceeded to hang up as he yelled "Get the Fu*k out of here!"  I understand that having customers change their orders can be frustrating, however, I have never experienced such horrible customer service and disrespect when calling a restaurant. I will NOT be patronizing this establishment again.
name: BCher

text: This spot has went down! I will not return! The staff at the bar was not good and the drinks was wack! The food was blah and I just know I won't ever return! Mad max is not the same!
name: Koya

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. It was decent, just a little uneven. For the price I expected more than this. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: This is one of my favorite pizza places in St. Louis. The pizza is always cheesy and I've never had a bad experience with them yet. The cheese bread is good too. If you're considering going here I recommend it!
name: Bridget

text: DO NOT miss out on the food at Johnny's. Yes, the place is a hole in the wall but the po-boys are the ABSOLUTE BEST I have ever had and the people who work there are the nicest!!!! My 2 sisters and I ordered a total of 3 different sandwiches (shrimp, soft-shell crab, roast beef) and had them cut in thirds since we couldn't decide what we wanted.  Each sandwich was incredibly delicious, and although I don't look forward to going back to the filthy, smelly, extremely run-down city of New Orleans, I will return if only to enjoy a Johnny's po-boy!!!!!
name: L.M.

text: We went there for Valentines Day and had never been before. It was fantastic! My husband had the filet, it was cooked perfectly. I had the grouper which was seared to perfection. Finished it off with the baklava, a perfect end. The staff was attentive and very nice! I don't know what the restaurant looked like prior to the remodel but it has a great atmosphere now. We will absolutely be back:)
name: Samantha

text: I'm writing this as I'm sitting in the drive thru. Store is open, no one is answering. Front doors are still locked. The guy sweeping told me "they're probably in the back" sorry I dont have a key. Just give them time" now someone is behind me honking. Still no answer. Now it's my mission to make them answer.
name: Jeanette

text: This place was amazing!  They let you taste the soups which are made fresh everyday.  The Lobster Bisque was the best and I enjoyed a mouth full of lobster with every bite.  The best Lobster Bisque that I have ever tasted.  The staff were friendly and helpful.  I wish we had one of these in southern Delaware because I would be a regular.  I love, love, loved it as did my entire family.
name: Lisa

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Food was good and came out fast. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
We have been to TF several times both for Dinner and for Happy Hour and have overall been happy with their food and service. 
One of their policies is that they would not give you separate checks.  This creates a very awkward situation. We were there with 2 other couples and they refused to provide us with separate checks. (I know we could have just split the check 3 ways, but our amount varied significantly from one couple to another). When the bill came each couple had to tell the server the $ amount with the tax to charge on each card. Sounds ridiculous. Ruins the experience. We have never seen a restaurant do this. 
Hope the owner or manager reads this and changes their practice.  Hope they realize that they are losing business because they do not want to make a little more effort to provide great experience.
name: Angelwife

text: I love Mama's. Everything me and my wife have tried has been delicious. The atmosphere of the old house it is in just adds to a great date night destination.
name: Mark

text: First time we thought of trying Caribbean food and we went to this retaraunt. I had Jerk chicken with rice, beans and veggies. The food was so delicious and tasty. The chicken was well cooked, the plantains were sweet and tastier, on top it the chicken sauce was so good. The waiter was so calm and cool and she treated us very well, eventhough we took more time to select from menus.
name: Kavi

text: Always delightful to find good vegetarian food in the south. Added bonus is the simple (and cheap!) kids menu.
name: Savannah

text:
I've only been here once.
 It is pretty tiny and the menu is sort of limited but we came here on a double date and we all liked what we ate and would return. It's definitely got a unique menu and the service was very good.
name: Tab

text: Great little watering hole with good food. We just happened upon this place by chance in the heart of the French Quarter. Beers are $5.00 ea and Shrimp Poboy $18.00 so more than normal for this area . We recommend if you are down this way and looking for something simple and lite give this place a try.
name: David

text:
As a Southern: that is not the way you make Mac n Cheese...too soupy. Ask Keisha Lance Bottoms. And after living in the South, you just don't serve grits as a side for dinner. 

Burger was good but instead of cheese melted it had gooey cheese sauce, so rather messy. Meatballs come with mashed potatoes on the bottom. 

Apps were monkey pretzel bread, which was more bread than pretzel with cheese and mustard. 
Cauliflower Brussels Sprouts app was delicious.

Interior was great. They did a lot with a narrow space with current industrial look and many different seating areas. It looks more like a burger joint than a steak house as the price for steaks were more inline with a nicer steak house than another fancy burger joint. Remaining prices were very reasonable. Meat hook idea is awesome on the back upper stair area. There is a bar area in the far back. 

Service is hit or miss depending on staff, ours was inattentive and vapid, yet the table next to ours waiter was great.

Was in town for the weekend and Yelp seldom let's me down and this was a block or two from where we were staying. Overall, branding just didn't seem to gel for me.
name: Kevin

text:
First time here, but will not be the last. Came here with 5 friends to celebrate the birthday of one. Server Alisha (sp?) was remarkable, professional, welcoming and friendly.  She explained thoroughly to those of us who were new to the Davio experience and ensured we received appetizers and drinks promptly.  Alisha went over the night's specials, told us that a colleague's allergy would be addressed appropriately (and it was!).
Davio's gave us all a most excellent meal and we're looking to return soon.
Alsiha is a perfect example of phenomenally great service, she as much as the great food made the night memorable to all of us.  We hope to see her again on our return in 2 or 3 weeks.
Davio's and Alisha provided high standards to our group.  While this is not a place for me every night, certainly it will be one I choose to go to 3 or 4 times a month.
name: Chris

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. For the price I expected more than this. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: Thanks for the food poisoning!! Never again will I eat from here!! Wasnt worth 30$$ complete rip off.
name: Robin

text: Oh! My husband and I tried this place before and we were so ready to pig out this time! Their food, again, didn't disappoint! Service was great! Our server was the handsome guy with blue eyes this time....very attentive and friendly.  This time we tried the oyster shooters, the cocktail sauce inside the shooter tasted amazing! Hint of spiciness and was just perfect. 1 oyster came inside, wouldve been mich better if there were at least 2 in there but it was delish. Tried the crab cake next, wasn't too crazy about this one, texture was a bit gluey, but good flavor, i've tried better crab cakes... Coleslaw was delish and onion ring was good and not greasy. Next was the steamed mussels, so delish and flavorful. Get it! And last we tried their linguine and clams...tasted good, very rich and creamy, i added salt pepper and lemon juice to it and it was fantastic. Overall i was impressed for the second time. I think they should put a fan inside tho, a bit hot inside for lunch time...
name: Angela

text:
This morning my wife and I ordered breakfast (Menu item called 'Flip Side' or something like that ... comprised of pancakes, two eggs, bacon). Those two orders and one coffee cost over $26.00.  Eggs were done perfectly. Bacon was on the thin side but meaty, tasty, and done just as we ordered.  
However the two small pancakes were tough and chewy.  Needed to use a table knife to cut rather than significant downward 'sawing' pressure with a fork.  

We thought that a cafe specializing in bakery items (which looked very good) would also have good pancakes.  Other items may be very good ... but we would NEVER again order pancakes from this place.  Overpriced and TOUGH led to a very unsatisfactory experience.  Oh, by the way, after all this coffee refills still cost 50 cents ... forget that.
name: Larry

text:
This restaurant is a gem!! We stared with the lam. Dumplings, firecracker wontons, and chicken bao -- all delicious and unique. 

The waitress and bartender were both knowledgeable, kind, flexible, and attentive. 

As a larger group, we also had an incredible "private" dining area/booth. 

Would highly recommend this restaurant for the whole package- flavors, charm, and individuality.
name: Cara

text: Martin's is a must stop if you're in Nashville. This last stop we ate there twice, Edleys twice, Peg Leg and Party Foul once. IMHO, Martin's is the king although all were excellent. The Martin's on 4th just off Broadway is an awesome location. Eat upstairs, there's tons of natural light, two bars, and you can watch (and smell) the smokers......Heaven. My recommendation would be the brisket sandwich with extra sauce, beans for the side. Just the brisket and the bun.....magical!
name: Robert

text: Great menu and good service! But please!!!! Get some toothpicks for your customers! Thank you!!
name: Michael

text: Heard good things about this place and we were in the downtown area so had to check it out. Plus it was a happy hour / half off day. The pictures say a lot. Great presentation great food! Waiter was very friendly and helped with recommendations. We had to get the playboy because they light it on fire. however, that was probably the best part of it as the taste was not good. There were many different warm and contrasting tastes/flavors. We actually ended up sending it back for a different roll (the crab one) which we felt bad about but again the waiter was great and happy to exchange it. You could tell he just wanted us to have a good time and good experience! Great place will definitely be back!
name: Jared

text:
Decent brunch spot in Philadelphia, but nothing to write home about. We had a group of 8 on a Saturday Morning that decided to go here on a whim & only had at wait about 15 minutes. We got a drink at the bar while waiting for a table to open up. 

Pros:
Friendly staff (our server was super nice & good with getting us refills)
Outdoor seating 
Good for small groups outside
Bar seating
Reasonable priced food & drinks 
Nice menu selection 

Cons: 
The bartender handed us 1 tab for our drinks. Would have been nice if he would have asked if we wanted them separate as we didn't order them all together. 
The inside is extremely warm (I felt like I was going to pass out in the bathroom, it was like a hot box) 
Food is mediocre (I had the shrimp & grits which were recommended by our server and they were very tasteless)
Margaritas/frozen drinks are pre-made 
Small, tight spaces bathrooms that could use a good scrub 


Overall, I would probably return to silk city & just try something else on the menu. They quickly accommodate our group and our food came out quick, which was appreciated.
name: Ashley

text: I'm not sure why this place has a 4 star. Coming from SF I was shocked that the food was so incredibly tasty. When I eat ethnic food in restaurant full of white people,I try not to have any expectations. I was so scared it would be white washed Indian food. Of course I had the only Indian non-white waiter lol. The service was fantastic. I'm here for 4 days, I may come back for the buffet.
name: Donnie

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. I left full, which at least counts for something. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: This was my favorite Italian meal ever! We started with the Ceasar Salad and meatballs which were both delicious.  For dinner we shared the pepperoni pizza and the pasta with bolognese.   The service was flawless, food was served quickly, we will come back just to eat here again!
name: Christina

text: Found this little gem while we are visiting St. Louis for a family vacation!! Wonderful food and great atmosphere. Potato salad was amazing! Cucumber salad was amazing as well.  Your friends from Nebraska
name: Amy

text: Absolutely amazing the food was so fire and the service was off the hook the staff was very accommodating even though the location is a small one for drive through service I enjoyed them tacos so much I would came back if it wasn't so late
name: Marcus

text: We were in Florida from Texas over the holiday.  We love this place.  This is four years we have been coming here.  The food is great, think they have the best quesadilla that I have ever had and the Taco salad was awesome too.  The service is also great and it is nice to see the same people working there year after year.  That says a lot about the management.  We were back there for drinks and/or food  4 of the 8 days we were there. Generally it was just the two of us but on one occasion it was other family members, party of 6 and the service was just as good at the table as it was at the bar. Being a business owner myself, I know you can not please everyone all of the time but they certainly seem to go out of their way to make it a great experience.
name: Cindy

text: Everything here is delicious and authentic. Their sushi is to die for and I have never had something I didn't like. It's a small and cozy space, but they are busy all the time which is a testament to how great it is!
name: Nina

text: I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better online than it did in person. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: The staff is nice. Very good food. It was delicious. I have never eaten a burritos like that. Fresh products. We really enjoyed this place.
name: Cha

text: It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was crowded but still moved along. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Glad we tried it. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Overall, a strong experience. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
I grew up in Columbia and frequently ate at a place called Tripoli's.  It was heartbreaking when they shut down.  So when I heard Good Times was doing a Tripoli's buffet I was so excited.  Since they only do it on Wednesday's I had to wait.  As each day passed the anticipation grew.  My mouth would water thinking about how good the pizza and wings were.  When the day finally arrived I didn't eat breakfast or lunch.  Hunger you see, makes the best sauce.  

Sadly, it was gross and nothing like Tripoli's.  I haven't been this disappointed since the GOT series finale. 

Be Warned - This is not a Tripoli's buffet.
name: Eric

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The music was louder than it needed to be. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. For a busy night they handled it okay. Food was good and came out fast. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
I was more than pleasantly surprised coming in here for breakfast.  The price for their quality of food is unbelievable!  I ordered their Big City Breakfast.  It was a great quantity of food and of all the places I have had breakfast (MANY) I truly believe their sausage patties are the best I ever had.  Most places serve sausage patties that tastes me the cheap  frozen stuff you can buy at a grocery store.   The eggs are excellent, they aren't the cheap kind either and the bacon is also above average of what you get at typical simple breakfast joints.  Besides their sausage, the other real winning part of my breakfast was their house blend Sumatra coffee.  If you go, make sure you try it!  I promise you won't regret it.  

Overall, the best part of going to CB is not just their excellent food and lower prices, it's the genuine friendliness you get from their owners.  You can tell they take great pride in their small restaurant and they do a great job of making sure you feel welcome and are completely satisfied.
name: Alexander

text:
OMG!  First time I ate here in new location and what a let down... service and food sub-par.
Atmosphere is lame and place was empty.  Too bad.

If you're under 30 you might like this place if you're over 30 save yourself an illness. YMMV.
