text: I do not recommend this coffee place to true coffee drinkers. We ordered 2 Americanos with extra shots. The flavor and temperature of the americanos was very bitter and lukewarm. They were not efficient or skilled at making the americanos. I will say the ambience was nice but you can't drink ambience. They poured the hot water in first, let that sit on the counter, then took their time adding the shots. By the time we got our coffee the temperature was lukewarm at best. Very disappointed. The taste was not full bodied but very bitter and weak.
name: Bob

text: Food took over an hour to come out and they came out to tell use several things we ordered were no longer available. If you want a good burger just walk a little bit to Shake Shack which is close by.
name: Mathias

text:
We got takeout here a couple times and were pretty happy. I got a vindaloo curry, and my wife got her usual chicken korma. Mine was appropriately spicy, hers was appropriately creamy--both tasted pretty good and portions were fair. Nans were fluffy and fresh. 

Of particular note: they have a GREAT chicken tikka kids meal. Nice grilled chicken with a side of rice at a good price. My kid was really happy with the flavor and portion size, and I liked the price. Will definitely return.
name: Akash

text: I'm not sure if it's under new management. However, last night I ordered Fried Rice with my meal. It was a far cry from what I used to receive. The rice was over cooked. It clumped together. The color was a brownish color and tasteless. I was totally disappointed with my entire meal
name: Steve

text: Amazing experience! I had heard about BurgerFi before and I was in Philly visiting some family and saw that there was a BurgerFi close by, couldn't figure out what else to eat and chose to finally try it out. BEST DECISION I MADE ALL DAY! My order was taken by manager David and he made sure that my order was perfect.. I AM PICKY SO THIS MEANS ALOT. My burger was juicy and my fries were hot. The store was very clean and I was so impressed! I love a good burger but I am very skeptical about where I eat from. I wish I could give more than 5 stars and more BurgerFi's should have managers like David, awesome workers as well! Keep doing what you're doing with your team. the work doesn't go unnoticed!
name: Brianna

text: Where do I start... the service was awesome!! We had the wings and boy do they put a different spin on wings!!! Cooked just right and the cooked onions on top makes the wings worth 6stars!!! I tried the small eggplant and regret not getting the large. They have the best eggplant next to my mom's!!! The well done pizza is delicious!! You can really tell that their ingredients are all fresh! Very good food! I'm looking to return for the happy hour specials on Wednesdays!! Sorry no pictures because I didn't have time to take them... I just dove right in. Lol! I'll post pictures after my next visit!!!
name: Pretty

text: When I found out that Mopho won wing wars festival in New Orleans I had to flap my wing enthusiasm. Wings are the perfect hangover cure. These wings are amazing and breaded with panko. This is something I have always loved is a crispy and crunchy wing. Spiced with loving lemongrass some vibrant ginger and Thai chili this is a balanced and fun fusion I could eat everyday. It comes in a basket with 7 of these yummy daddies hot for the gobbling. After the very satisfying wings I enjoyed "the MOPHO". This wa not my favorite as we we split the dish but only one of us enjoyed a poached egg. I didn't win this exercise so I missed out. Not my favorite pho I must say. The tripe was strange and just not something I'd recommend to others. The oxtail was hard to make out . I don't believe I got any tofu but did however enjoy the little bits of mushroom and braised greens. The bartender that took my order was knowledgeable and professional but unfortunately I wouldn't call her friendly. A little too stern for my taste. Smiling is easy. I did all and all enjoy my visit. The wings with out a doubt we're all aces.
name: Gordon

text: Authentic Japanese food, with huge portions to match!  The place has plenty of seating and the food was delicious. We gave them a four only b/c their customer service was a little dry . Definitely a must try if you want something that's not a chain.
name: J

text: Not bad for a quick meal. Idk, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Honestly, no big complaints, just a nice meal. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Honestly, it looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Honestly, really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: When first opened this restaurant was good but something has changed.  I ate there last night and the quality is not the same....not horrible but very average...just so so.  My Korean chicken and veggies was very slim on veggies and soaked in sauce.  It hardly tasted like the same dish I have had before.  Add to that the fact that we were seated in one of the booths in the bar side and this was horrible. I asked the waiter why and apparently he was next in rotation.   I told him it would be okay as long as it was not too noisy as we only get together every couple of months and like to talk.  He assured me it would be fine....but it was definitely not.  The bar ended up being packed....several different groups from one of the nearby companies celebrating.  Most were not seated but instead standing around and very noisy.   I don't have a problem with them enjoying themselves.  My problem is with the Management that thinks it is okay to have restaurant seating in the bar on rotation.  The waiter that assured me all would be fine kind of disappeared on and off...not sure if he was handling some of the groups or what.  Bottom line ...we took this off of our list of places to meet when we get together and I doubt I would go back period.
name: Cheryl

text: Called today because my best friend is celebrating a birthday! I was quite excited to send her a glass of bubbly from the West Coast. Called and was told there was no way to make this happen. Couldn't place a phone order, couldn't do anything online, couldn't fax a signature. For a place that looks so high quality, I was disappointed I was unable to surprise a friend. Looks like the food is good, and the atmosphere is fine, but the staff is either unwilling or unempowered to be able to go the extra mile for their guests. In today's techy world.... it is crazy we couldn't have found a solution.
name: Danielle

text:
Since opening, this place has been PACKED! so we went very early on a Thursday. For eight into the bar area (outside was also an option) 

Great beer selection. Both my husband and I had the quaff on strawberry blonde. A little pricey at $6/glass but was very cold and delicious. They offered samples of anything we wanted to try. 

Hubby had  the "porky pig"  meat Pizza. Plenty of cheese. Very tasty. I chose the white Stromboli which was chicken and white sauce plus veggies. It was very good. Nicely packed with plenty of yummy veggies and cheese. Potato salad was fine but buying to write home about. 

Although bar area is huge and would be a great place to watch a game, it would be way to expensive to sit and drink some beer.  We will return for dinner and a drink. Nice addition to the south side.
name: Jennifer

text:
Since my last review, I stopped in again and had a great experience! I was able to order from the kiosk (next to it was hand sanitizer), easily placed my order, customer service was great, and the place was very clean!

Came back and ate there. Ordered my usual: red coconut curry, roasted shrimp, jalapeños, pineapple, scallions, cilantro, with the original rice noodles! They brought them back y'all! I was so happy! 

Also, reached out to Michelle, Guest Experience Specialist who reimbursed me for my unsatisfied past experience (which I was not looking for or expecting a refund). It's a great feeling when a business values their customers and go out their way to make them happy!

honeygrow is still one of my favorite spots in Philly!
name: Tamika

text: I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all.
name: User

text: I have been to this restaurant 3 times, dined 2. The first time the table was close to the door. With the giant bay entrance, this brought in much cold air and created a chilly breakfast. With little service, this restaurant lacks the staff to fully service a place of dining. We were ignored and left to wait for simple requests of more coffee or a refill of water. Was not super impressed with our food. The second time around was for lunch. It was delicious and our service was frequent. This was more than likely due to the low amount of customers in the restaurant. The final time at Benton Park was, in lack of a better word, rude. I arrived to a packed waiting area with people by the hostess stand. Unable to put a name in, I was forced to wait at the cramped and cold door. I was hit with the door many times by people coming in and out with no choice of me to move. I was rudely addressed by a person trying to get out of the restaurant. I finally see the hostess and to my surprise, I am ignored. I found this unprofessional. She saw someone she knew and put their name in before mine. I am saddened how it would be so easy to make these situations better and the incapacity that the restaurant had to make them.
name: Mitch

text: Cute and relaxed little place. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable. And even though I don't have special dietary needs, I appreciated the variety of gluten free and vegetarian options. I ordered the meat lover's quiche, cinnamon chip scone, and a spiced chai. Everything was delicious and warm. With tip I paid just over $12.
name: Alexis

text: Best roast pork in Philly. The owner came out to check on the customers and must have talked to us for 20 minutes about how much he loves what he does. There are a lot of great places for great pork sandwiches in Philly but none as good as John's, year after year.
name: C

text: Get over here. Been here a few times since Eric took over. OMG. You're not overwhelmed with too many choices, which is nice. But, everything you get is great. You could spin a wheel and whatever it lands on will be just what you wanted. Love the Cuban, Corned beef and the Chicken Florentine is outstanding (wife calls it the best chicken cheese steak she's ever had). Do yourself and the neighborhood a favor and try them once, you'll be hooked. $10 gets you any sammie and for a couple bucks more you can add a soda and chips. Go. Just go. Free and ample parking.
name: Kevin

text: I'm kind of bummed because it's in my neighborhood and I like to support local businesses but this was just awful.  Maybe because I had it delivered but I don't think so because it did arrive quickly and hot, which is why I didn't rate it one star.  I could smell the unpleasant grease on the spring roll before it reached my lips.  The steamed dumplings were rubbery and flavorless.  But the worst was the red curry, which contained salmon so hammered it was inedible.  Again, I am sad to write this, but $43 for bad takeout Thai made me angry.
name: Robin

text:
I have been several times now and have never been disappointed. Make sure you have a healthy appetite if you order the 22inch pie or a small team.
It is the best NY style pizza in the area.
name: Thomas

text: This review is for the Oro Valley location. We stopped by at 6:15 am on a Sunday and the staff was friendly and efficient, the store was spotless and the bagels were the best outside of New York.
name: Lem

text: This was my first visit to the Nashville store but my overall second time and it was excellent service by my waitress Deborah. Would highly recommend either the ginger chicken or the blackened Singapore chicken entree.
name: Joe

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. For a busy night they handled it okay. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Food was fresh and service was quick. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Will be back. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Since 2001 , I've been ordering from here , i now live near Roxborough area and till drive to get my chicken salad hoagie
name: Alexis

text: All I can say is the pastries here are to die for.  So unbelievable in flavor and amazing portions! You are definitely getting what you paid for.  Definitely expect to pay $4 per croissant but it's worth it!! Plus it's Montecito, what do you expect?
name: Christine

text: Horrible service.... Definently do not order Togo food if your in a rush. My order took 45mins past the pickup time that was provided to me on the email. My order was also incorrect when it was delivered to me. The hostess went to the kitchen to correct my order. Then as she came out the kitchen she was finishing up her conversation with another coworker as I am standing at the front waiting. This location definitely needs improvement...
name: Lauren

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text:
great atmosphere and excellent service and the food is even better. a new favorite hole in the wall on Whyte. 

its rare to feel hosted more than just being delivered. 

the service and hosting we recieved was very real, personable, and gratious, yet had our own space to enjoy our meal..even in a tight place the atmosphere was just perfect and seamless.. did not feel crowded. everyone was relaxed and enjoying their brunch.

we will be comimg back alot!
name: Abe

text:
Unpopular opinion --
Living within 2 miles of Pizzava, I had been wanting to try this place since it opened. It wasn't terrible, nor was it great. Disappointed to say I would've preferred a $5 frozen pizza from the grocery store over spending $34 (delivery, with tip) for a small pizza and an order of jalapeño poppers. 

The jalapeño poppers were mediocre and bland... they had no kick to them and they tasted as if they were store-bought. I've definitely had better. Not to mention they were $8. 

I ordered a small alfredo chicken pizza w/ mushrooms added to it. It looked good and smelled good, but didn't live up to its expectations. It arrived hot but also a bit soggy and the chicken tasted as if it had been dehydrated. The only good part about the pizza was the crust.

You have to pay extra for ranch (sad to find out it's not homemade ranch), so it was unfortunate to find that they had shorted me one. 

I don't think I'll be back anytime soon. I gave 2 stars because Jackie was right on time and the delivery was quick.
name: Katherine

text: Good food, large portions, tasty and flavor full. Can't go wrong with any of it. Have extra sauce to your liking. Will go again
name: alex

text: Called ahead about coming in at 8:30, which the person who answered the phone said would be no problem. We showed up at 8:30 to a nonchalant host who waived her hand and without moving from her perch said "sit wherever ". Server was busy with other tables and the kitchen started closing, which seemed more important to the staff than actually serving food. Super pricey and super disappointed.
name: Caitlin

text: Portions were generous and presentation was nice. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Overall, a strong experience. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It looked better online than it did in person. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
FYI: Do a build your own, I believe it's only 50 cents more expensive but much more customizable and with the pho, you can add a lot more meat.

PROS: I cannot begin to tell you how much I enjoyed the banh mi I got. First of all, they have it listed as a "hoagie" so don't get tripped up. Second of all, it's pretty big and packed full of your typical banh mi ingredients. Those pickled carrots were amazing and balanced out the richness of the butter and grilled pork beautifully. I got mine with extra carrots and extra butter but no cilantro or jalapeños cause I did the build your own option. We also got the grilled pork summer rolls, which were pretty good too. You get a taste of every ingredient and the roll doesn't fall apart on you. This place is definitely going to be my go to for a banh mi fix and I honestly can't wait to go back again for another one.

CONS: This isn't really a con but the place might be too big, it looks very empty and spacious but that might be because it's new so it isn't really known yet.

Fiancé's corner: I got the build your own pho. You can add up to 6 meats for it's normal price and have options to customize the veggies that go in. We got the food for take out so that affects pho more than banh mi but the noodles were pretty good and the broth was great even after sitting for a bit. My recommendation would be to eat at the restaurant if you want pho so you can better add basil and bean sprouts as in take out it's just stuffed in. But overall, very good pho, especially for center city/rittenhouse area!
name: Sherry

text: My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Worth checking out. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: The fries are always hot and fresh. 9/10 times I have great service. Drive through employees are always nice, friendly and efficient. If I ever am missing anything, they always rectify the situation. Would recommend this location.
name: Rachel

text:
* I think this was the last sausage biscuit I'll ever buy from anybody. I bit into a bone fragment, and broke my front tooth.
* Stick with Whoppers or Big Fish.
name: Stuart

text: Dessert saved this a little. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The music was louder than it needed to be. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Don't let the strip mall location fool you. Nice, clean eating area with affordable options on the menu. 4 delicious tacos for only $12 and they give you chips and 3 types of salsa for free when you sit down. On top of that it's BYOB so you're not spending money on drinks. There was also no wait time at 6:30pm on a Friday night. Overall the food and service was great and we'll definitely be back!
name: Ryan

text: For the price I expected a little more care. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not bad for a quick meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. For the price I expected more than this. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Stopped in here for lunch while we were down in the city attending the auto show. It was around 1:30 and no wait. We've been to there Iron Hill's in the suburbs and my kids love their pizza, so they were excited we were going here. They wound up disappointed as this location doesn't make pizzas. In general though, we felt like the menu was much more limited than the ones in the burbs. The food we did order was fine and service was very good throughout our meal. We didn't order any alcoholic beverages but they have plenty to choose from. If you find yourself in the area, it's not a bad place to stop in for a bite to eat. It's not going to knock your socks off, but you should expect a decent meal.
name: Greg

text: The only Denny's i like to go to! My favorite waitress there is Liz  All around most of the waitresses are great. The usual time i go is 10 pm to 2 am, always love Denny's for a late night dinner. I've been going here for years and will continue to. The food is always great, i always get breakfast. The salted caramel and banana cream pancakes are all I've been getting for a year now i feel like lol. They're amazing. Go to this Denny's!! They're great
name: Jessica

text: Service is everything and Jessie did not deliver. Before ordering I asked her about the farm raised fish. She thought the tuna was.... I specifically asked about the scallops to ensure they were what I wanted and again, mis-information. My cousin had the lobster ravioli which were good but she had to flag down out girl and ask for cheese as an adjunct. My scallops and risotto was relatively flavorless and a big disappointment for  the evening and the money. The wine was the best part and at $14  a stem, I was happy for that! I have been there for lunch, which although LOUD, the food was better quality and consistency.
name: Joan

text: One of the best breakfast spots around especially for those health conscious eaters out there. I've eaten there 3 times so far and have never had a bad experience!
name: R

text:
Roper's has my favorite ribs. Fall off the bone delicious. 
Bring cash because these are all you could possibly ask for. Meaty and BBQy. They're great hot and as leftovers. 
Also the friendliest people I've ever met.
name: Mike

text:
If you've ever been to Italy, then you would really appreciate a genuine Italian bistro! If you haven't, don't fret because Alice Pizza will remind you of the cluttered streets in Venice it has everything, amazing pizza which can be customized to your liking, pastas, coffee, Italian pastries and espresso.
We went on a Sunday afternoon and chose to sit and dine ( you can just get pizza slices to go). We were promptly served with cold waters and menus, they do have a revolving specials menu. We tried the cacio- e-pepe gnocchi, it was fresh and quiet delectable! 
They also have a full bar! Can't wait to go back and get an Aperol Spritz!
name: Shifa

text:
I love this place. It is a very nice, comfortable, and welcoming room and the food is great. Their Scotch egg cobb salad is my go-to lunch - a huge, delicious salad with many flavors - not expensive, either. ($8.95?)
Kevin is my favorite server - he has a crazy-good memory and 'The Gift of The Gab.' Get him talking about Arsenal and Manchester United! lol  This is a great place to visit or to call your home pub. Highly recommended.
name: Lynn

text: Great googly moogly! What a dining experience! Great assortment of meats being sliced in front of you! The all you can eat salad/pasta bar with fixings was great but don't over do that, save room for the meats going around!
name: Ron

text: Amazing BBQ.  Kids approved.  We stopped by every Mission BBQ we could find.  This is a must have.
name: Jeff

text:
It's really nice to have a good coffee shop in the neighborhood, I have to say. That's worth four stars right now. But the food here is quite good as well and we like bringing the kids here for breakfast (or supper after piano lessons). It's a lovely little spot, bright and clean, with a great little play zone for the kids and a selection of decent desserts. The sandwiches are quite good and I like the breakfast dishes.

If you're looking for a coffee shop to get some work done and enjoy a cup, I would recommend Wired Cup down the street instead. But this is a perfectly marvelous brunch space and I'm happy to be a regular here.
name: K.

text: As advertised this place is fantastic,  best Mexican I've had in a long time and it is as authentic as it gets and it gets better it's down the street from my house can't wait to go back. Viva Mexico !!!!! The food is Amazing!!!!!!!!!!!!
name: Andres

text: i get the appeal, I just dont totally share it. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: A new and improved version of the location on the Westbank. Staff was as friendly and knowledgeable as could be with iPad's walking you through the fresh fish options available currently. Overall a great experience, will be back for sure!
name: Dan

text: Very good, fast service, great cheesesteak, overall a great experience.
name: Gina

text: I love crisp and I always enjoy the stir fry that I get. The only thing I dislike is the fact that there is visibly hair in my food whenever I go to any location. It's really disgusting. Other than that, the stir fry is delicious!
name: Lexie

text:
Service = 5 stars
Value = 5 stars
Cleanliness = 2 stars
Food = 4 stars

As others have shared, it's a hole-in-the-wall. As long as your party is 4 or fewer, it should be OK.  

The server was kind and patient with our 101 questions about a standard Mexican food menu and my gripes about not having fruit punch Jarritos.

The washroom smells like 3 weeks worth of urine covered with one swipe of Pine Sol. There were no paper towels which made me think the staff didn't need them. Yikes!

After the washroom & praying hard over the food, my hubby had the pork tostadas and I had a chicken chimichanga. Both were flavorful and the meats were moist. The chips with our appetizer tasted QUITE stale, unfortunately. The guac tasted like it had cream cheese in it. Not bad, just weird. Maybe not enough lemon or lime?

Our bill for chips & guac + 2 entrees + soda = $30. Good deal!  Several locals dropped by for carry out while we were there so that's a good recommendation.
name: Nicole

text: Omg rolling through tarpon springs wanted a good breakfast and was like I'll try this. Omg them grits prob best I've ever had and I've had a lot of grits..creamy and flavorful.. French toast loved the cinnon vanilla taste.. withvthich jallah style bread.. and staff were no nice and friendly and courteous...thanks for making my drive back to Jacksonville miserable..like in a I'm so full I need a nap but I want more....if I'm back in town I will def come back..
name: Janel

text: I came upon TBD by accident since I live almost two hours away. Nice small place. The food bowls look small but the quantity was surprisingly good. Beef Kaldereta and pork humba were very good. Staff was very friendly.
name: Pacifico

text: The best Italian home-cooked meal in a restaurant, love this place, Great people great food, I don't know what to say i'm not much of a writer but Tony's is the best Italian food I've had in a long time
name: David

text: I was coming down from Reno and was looking for somewhere to stop for lunch and looked on yelp for top rated eating places on my route. This place popped up and being a fan of Japanese steakhouses I couldn't resist. The food was delicious. Loved the combination of veggies and the salad dressing that was served with salad. Love that they have a lunch menu with lunch prices. Amazing.
name: Adriana

text: Holy crap, that is so damn good! Most places do NOT know how to make chicken salad and it is always chunky with Miracle Whip. This is the beat chicken salad ever...sorry mom!
name: Lori

text: Great dining experience from beginning to end. Our server, who we suspect might be the owner was soft spoken but attentive. Our food came out quickly and well presented. We ordered starters of fried tofu, toast and potstickers. No complaints, super tasty. We then had the beef noodle soup, basil fried rice, teriyaki salmon, Tom yam noodles and basil chicken all spiced at level 3...spicy but not crazy.  Again we were all very happy, it had an authentic Thai flavor that many Thai restaurants in the area lack to appeal to general tastes. We highly recommend this restaurant as it's become a family favorite.
name: Sabina

text: I decided to try green eggs cafe when I heard they had red velvet pancakes and I wasn't disappointed! I have been here a couple of time, and each time I get a different dish and am left with a delimma as to what my favorite dish on the menu is!The only down side is that its CASH only, but they have an ATM inside!
name: Aakansha

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: I'm from California and we have a freddies about an hour from our house. I always look forward to my trips to Arizona since there is one in every major city. This location was perfect. Friendly service. Burger and fries were fresh. Always get the California double. Prices are excellent. Had a concrete which was amazing.
name: Bradley

text: Sigh, I was not impressed. It was my first time and I was expecting a lot because of the reviews. I went during the Devour Indy special. The food was average and the customer service was average as well. The French onion soup was overly salty. The bread was A+ and the ambiance was nice. I would not return. I'm a stickler for great customer service and reading reviews. So, I was shocked when my experience didn't match the reviews.
name: Breighaunna

text: I'm so glad we got to enjoy a meal here. I made reservations for Halloween night at 7pm, but when our plans changed they were easily able to accommodate our party of 2 at 5pm instead. The hostess welcomed us to a tour of the upstairs where another employee told us a brief history of the house. The inside of the house is absolutely gorgeous, but still casual and comfortable. We wanted a somewhat light meal since we wanted to continue our self-guided New Orleans food tour after, so we shared the cheeseburger and charcuterie plates. Both were delightful. Our server was very attentive and the manager, David, even stopped by our table to chat with us and offer more recommendations to us tourists. I will definitely recommend Cavan to anyone visiting the Garden District in New Orleans.
name: Khrysten

text:
My family and I stopped by this place while seeking out wineries to visit in the Santa Barbara area. We had so much fun here whereas we didn't even make it to a winery until the following day. 

Everything we ordered was fantastic. My veggie pizza was so good I barely wanted to share it. The staff were so friendly and welcoming. We'll most definitely return when we drive up there again.
name: Terrance

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The music was louder than it needed to be. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Worth checking out. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The leftovers held up okay the next day..

text:
I am conflicted on this review. I take all things into consideration when reviewing, so stick with me here. 

First of all, the bad. I expected to wait when I got there. No big deal. However, the house it is in faces east, so the sun is shining on you as you are out in the yard waiting. Ok for 10 minutes tops, but not for 30 in the 90 degree Franklin heat. It got so bad my wife almost collapsed of heat stroke. She had to go inside to the bathroom as it made her sick. She wasn't the only one either. I arrived after waiting for 45 minutes soaking wet with sweat. No water, no shade until you are up against the house, and no fans. Not exactly a good idea to risk for the food. 

Once inside, we were both completely exhausted from the wait in the hot sun. I run half marathons in the hot sun, and I'll tell you that wore me out. 

As for the food, it was excellent, especially the bonuts. I got the princess, and it was great too. Tip and all, for bonuts, some weirdo salad my wife ordered, a biscuit, grits, the princess, a coffee, and an orange juice was $51. Hmmmm... If you've read my reviews you know I hate paying that much, but this one just borders on being worth it. We brought home a ton of leftovers because we were both kinda worn out and barely ate anything. 

Moral of the story: either go when there's no wait, or bring a fan/umbrella/parasol/kiddie pool/extra change of clothes for the wait. 

Not sure I'm gonna make it back, but I'm glad to have been.
name: John

text:
Overall Value: this is my first time at the Rooster since they rebranded and re-did the menu. I liked the old menu and was a fan, and the concept of a Jewish deli-inspired menu sounded great too.  But there is a bit of a problem if you are paying $10 for a sandwich and still walking away kind of hungry. Good flavors, but c'mon these things are just barely bigger than sliders.

The food: we got the smoked meat sandwich (house pastrami on a potato roll), corned pork belly on challah, and a side of fries. The pastrami was delicious, and I'm a sucker for the soft doughy goodness of a potato roll, which is the perfect vehicle for soaking up the juices from the pastrami. The corned pork belly didn't have as strong of a flavor and wasn't as tender as the pastrami, and the challah bread to meat ratio was way too one-sided on the bread. Which was my main gripe with the food- at $10 each, these sandwiches ain't cheap. You're better off going to Herschel's and getting a massive pastrami Reuben for like $2 more - that thing has literally 4 times as much meat and is just as tasty.  The fries were good and crispy, but nothing spectacular - we shared them, and they were a bit small for that, but at $3 it wasn't that bad.  

Service: very nice and attentive staff.

Space and pace: I like the old school diner feel (which is why the old menu complimented this place so well!). We came at dinner time and it was a bit dead - I know it gets much livelier around lunch time. But sitting at a booth is a great way to spend a lunch date or catching up with a friend.

text:
One depressing thing has happened since I first started reviewing eateries on Yelp: I was diagnosed with celiac. That being the case, I'm always on the lookout for restaurants that cater to the gluten-free.

My daughter discovered Giorgio, and I am just so thankful that she did.

I've gone back several times, and the food is consistently excellent (with one disappointment, the sparsely-topped arugula pie). 

Giorgio has a gluten-free menu for those who need it. (Or who buy into the vaunted health benefits of going gluten-free.)

Truth be told, I've been able to adjust to celiac, and I've found pretty good substitutes for just about everything except bagels and beer. Italian food is another outlier, because most gluten-free pasta is simply awful, or prepared by someone who does not know how to cook it to al dente (usually sailing right past al dente to mealy pasta mush). 

Giorgio is a notable exception to the rule.

Among the very first things the server asks is this: Is anyone at the table gluten-free? It's clearly a priority.

Service also includes a nice little plate of gluten-free Italian bread and a bowl of olive oil. (It would be better with soft chunks of garlic.) That's just such a thoughtful touch when everyone else at the table is chowing down on Italian bread and olive oil.

I invariably order the brown rice ziti with sweet sausage and pepper. Absolutely makes my socks roll up and down, it is so incredibly good. The pasta is cooked perfectly every time. I could eat it for breakfast.

Yes, the place is cramped, and yes, it can be quite loud. (I don't care about those things, personally.) Regardless, a memorable, yum-worthy dining experience for all involved, gluten-free or not.
name: Jeff

text: Beautiful building, the interior has so much character and beauty to it as well. I'm not a big drinker but I loved their Moscow mule with their white corn whiskey in it. I ended up buying a bottle on my way out. We ordered a little bit of everything off the appetizer/small plate menu. I ordered fish and chips (delicious!!))) we would definitely return when we are back in town! Great service, quick but not too fast.
name: Apryl

text: Best filet I've had. Perfectly cooked and seasoned!  Emily is a great server. Very polite and professional.
name: Debby

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. You can tell they care about customer experience here. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food was fresh and service was quick. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. A very pleasant experience. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: Very disappointed with my dinner, ordered the tamal, and meat platter- Plato placebo both were not good at all. The entree came with a soup or salad and had the lentil soup, it was watery and tasteless. The tamal was dry and hard as if it was old. The meat dish was cold and every component of it was cold too. Not enjoyable at all.
name: Peter

text: Most delicious vegan food I've had in a long time! I'll definitely be coming back!!!!! If you're having a hard time finding it it's in the shopping center just right of the 711.
name: Ana

text: We ate here for the first time last night. It was "okay." I got the bourbon bacon burger, and he got the double bacon burger. We both ordered ours medium and they came out extra well done. So they were pretty dry which made it not as good as I think it could've been. Once I covered it in their house ketchup it was better though. The fries are really good and they give you a bunch of them. I think I liked the fries more than the burger itself. My fiancé was also a little disappointed that they don't serve sweet iced tea, only unsweetened. Oh well!
name: Kaleigh

text: Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not bad for a quick meal. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not bad for a quick meal. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Total ripoff! Paid $11 for a strawberry slush which was supposed to be a strawberry daiquiri.  No "f-ing" alcohol in it whatsoever. Female workers out front yelling and screaming about something. Avoid this place!
name: Dave

text:
Were it not for my mother, I wouldn't have bothered trying as I am not a fan of the chains...and I thanked my mother when we were done for reminding me why.  

The food, overly salty.  The service, congenial, but slower than slow on a less than busy Tuesday night.  At least it was relatively inexpensive.  Being up front, the appetizers were acceptable, but the entrees were horrendous - one dried out, with a feel like it had been under the heat lamp for 20 mins - approaching jerky texture.  The other a bland pad Thai matching la choys finest (available in the Chinese section of any Walmart)....   

Do yourself a favor, find authentic Asian cuisine, not this Americanized rendition....
name: Eric

text:
I am not a sushi person, except for veggie rolls, but this is about the chicken teriyaki and the chicken yakisoba. AMAZING! They serve real green tea and the miso is soooo good. 
The staff is so amazing and the food is so refreshingly good. Don't let the storefront style restaurant stop you from stepping in. Very clean and quite busy after 6 on the weekends.
name: Richard

text: Dissappointing. We got pot pie, two soups, and the special, Monlfish, scallop, shrimp Caesar salad for $20. It came out with two tiny little shrimp, two little scallops, and a curled little wad of monkfish on a big plate of dressed romaine. It looked ugly and cheap, and then we tried it. The shrimp tasted nasty and we didn't bother to eat half of the rubbery little wad of monkfish. The other food we ordered  was okay. We told the waitress and she offered to buy us dessert but it's lunchtime and we did not want it. She had excuses for why the seafood was nasty, but did not adjust our bill. I won't be going back.
name: Kat

text: The best meatless breakfast I ever had.    I was extremely skeptical but a friend told me to come here and get the morning bowl extra egg and the avocado toast with lox.  The wife was very eager to try so I went along.  If I ordered Either one by itself would have been outstanding but each bite was better than the last.   The lox was delicious as was the avacado and the toast (tasted liked baked an hour ago).   The morning bowl was superb.  No idea what was in it but it was awesome.   Love this place.
name: David

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Honestly, everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text: The manager is understanding and accommodating. My experience on Monday having breakfast there is disappointing. I should have known better to eat there after finding the bathroom floor dirty. When the food was served, it was warm to near cold, and tastes like the grill needs cleaning. The coffee taste like plain hot water and the served fruit bowl filled with grapes that posse brown spots. However, the serve is GREAT. Servers are attentive and courteous. We still tipped appropriately.
name: Tonda

text: Ordered the sweet and sour pork and beef and vegetables dinner combo and quite enjoyed it. The portions were huge, tasty, and not as greasy as other Chinese places. Service was efficient (it's always nice to not have to repeat yourself when ordering over the phone) and the food was hot when I picked it up. When it comes to Chinese delivery/take-out I much prefer this place than Panda Hut Express.
name: M

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Would absolutely visit again.
name: User

text: It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Pretty happy with it overall. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
Exceedingly busy.  Very noisy.  Waffles and chicken were awful.  Competition between the waffle and chicken for toughest.  Waffles are easy to get right just don't beat the batter.  

Price did not include a decent syrup.  They Wanted $3 more for maple syrup.  How about honey siracha?  Or some other interesting flavor?  Raspberry? Ginger?  Plum cardamom?

No tang of buttermilk in the waffle either.  It would be very easy to do this dish better but nobody has seemed to care.
name: Sharon

text: I had po boys from 3 different places including here, and if you've never eaten a Po Boy and want to know what's it is, DO NOT eat here. They are a twist on Po Boys I guess, just didn't enjoy my pork belly Po Boy! And IF you are a Po Boy shop, why not have at least one original on the menu? NOPE didn't have that either, instead they have a sauteed shrimp Po Boy ..what??? Didn't enjoy at all.
name: Lumin

text: Great pancakes but get there early... the line will wrap around the building. I think there are better breakfast places in Nashville but I'm still a fan!
name: Catherine

text:
One Star for receiving two meals we couldn't eat!
I am working late so I ordered Uber eats from here because it was in my area.   VERY DISAPPoINTED!  I ordered my burger Well done  and I got a RARE burger.   I ordered one to take to my father Medium and they sent it charred.  He likes condiments I can't have so we couldn't switch burgers. Mine had cheese and he can't eat cheese.  So we BOTH couldn't eat our utters.  They did not send the Chips that go with the 101 burger, so my father essentially got NOTHINg that he could eat from this order and I was able to eat the lettuce, my fries and drink the tea.  And for the privilege of eating lettuce, fries and an iced tea I paid $ 20.75 not including the delivery fees.  $34.05 for the total (taxes, delivery fees, gratuity, and service fee.   
Thank you Burger 21.  Clearly I won't be ordering again.  One star for the delicious lettuce and ice cold tea.  Do yourself a favor, order from Shulas.   BEST burgers in Tampa Bay.  They have NEVER gotten an order wrong!
name: Dr Yolanda C Leon

text: One of our favorite eateries, food is always on point and you can't beat the prices. We are frequent NOLA visitors and Ed's is always a must.
name: Anthony

text: Dian Xin was recommended by a friend, and would be so easy to pass along the crowded street of Decatur. Thank goodness we stopped in because it rivals any Chinese cuisine I've ever had. Go!
name: Elijah

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. Also, nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Also, for a busy night they handled it okay. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Anyway, they mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Anyway, the wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The staff seemed tired but still polite. so yeah kind of mixed on it. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text:
We tried the Checkered Flag a couple times. The pulled pork sandwich was a good one. Unfortunately the menu is a huge variable, meaning ask the waitress what's available. In our visits (3 attempts) each visit it was determined that the menu was a waste of time. Ask the waitress what's available that day, if that's acceptable, ok.
We won't be back.

text:
Absolutely loved this place! My wife and I had just got into town for the jewelry expo and were starving. Yelp to the rescue! 
It just so happens that it was Valentine's Day. The staff had decorated the place and had a special menu. The food was phenomenal and the service was great. The owner himself brought out our plates and talked with us for a while. 
We'll be back next year to clean our plates once again.
name: Kyrah

text: Food was good and came out fast. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: So far so great! Love the atmosphere as it is right up my alley. Upstairs or down the staff was attentive and friendly. The food is wonderful and you can take the menu. For a romantic night out, business lunch, or group gathering I highly recommend! I'll be back!
name: James

text: An uptown bar with a downtown vibe! This place is ALWAYS a sure fire bet for good food and a friendly staff. These folks have been in business for 30 plus years, and once you experience the atmosphere, you will see why!
name: Rob

text:
Had high hopes based on the reviews, but was not super impressed. 

My wife and I had their lunch portion of pad Thai and pad see ew for take out. First of all, the portion size of the pad see ew looked like someone had already eaten half of it and saved the other half for leftovers. It was small and not worth the $8.99. The flavor was definitely there, though.

The pad Thai had the opposite problem: the portions were definitely there, but the whole meal was much too sweet. There were other great flavors there, but the sweetness overpowered them. 

I will say that maybe eating in would give a different experience, so keep an open mind for that. But based on our one experience, I would not suggest this place, at least for lunch.
name: Mitch

text: If you are not a white local, don't bother! Please bear with me. I want to be very clear and fair...In NOLA to celebrate my birthday and this was to be the special birthday meal. We were so excited but experienced a colossal disappointment. Gentlemen at front (proprietor?)  was ok initially-acknowledged my birthday and even put some confetti on the table. Very nice. That was the end of any niceties. This waitstaff was cold and apathetic. Receipt says Benjamin was our server. Honestly, he was the worst but at least he actually spoke to us. Assistant (water, bread, dessert never spoke a word and food runner practically threw dessert on the table). About the food - I had the beet and fried goat cheese salad which was lovely but very short on beets. Proportion of frisée to beet was out of wack but when you got it all in your mouth it was delicious. We also had the scallop appetizer which seemed to have three totally different sized scallops that cooked differently (perfect to chewy) but sausage with it was tasty. Veal cheeks were a very generous portion and perfectly braised; but the tarragon was overwhelming and root veggies way undercooked; so I swapped with my husband who ordered the snapper which was good. We ordered creme brûlée which was burnt and bitter. Benjamin saw we only ate two bites and did actually ask if we liked it (first time he did that with any of the food or wines we ordered). When we told him we thought it was burnt he just said he would take it off the bill. No  "I'm sorry" or "Would you like to try something else?" He just took it away. We eat at a LOT of great restaurants in NOLA. This was the Solid worst. Also dark and loud. Bad energy. Felt total disdain from all staff. In such a diverse town known for its food and hospitality we picked the one homogenous place that didn't care if we lived or died. So be it. But if you don't want a brown tourist to eat there, get off Open Table.
name: Carolyn

text:
Probably the best Coolinary dinner so far.  Jason and Felix where excellent servers.  We had a bottle of Affinitas Tokaj.  Escargot In casserole and
Seafood martini ravigote for appetizers
Jumbo lump crab spaghetti fino and
1lb whole Maine lobster with sea scallops and jumbo shrimp for entrees 
Vanilla bean and brandy Crème brûlée 
Bourbon pecan pie for dessert.
name: Michael

text: Amazing food and great service. The chef was super nice and gave us free donuts! Definitely want to go back!!
name: Charlotte

text: We have been coming here since it opened but not sure I can keep coming.  The first few years there was always a manager moving things along, checking in on how the food was, etc.  the place was clean and efficient- good burgers and fries.  The past few years have seen steady decline- looks dirty,no managers on site,  overworked employees who look really unhappy.  They have 2 registers - have only seen one open recently and that poor employee is overwhelmed by all the responsibilities.  You can't have one person taking orders, cutting fries, and making shakes.   There were two guys on the grill but still managed to mess up 2 out of three burger orders.  The tables had not been wiped down in god knows how long and the number of trays accumulating at the garbage was staggering.  They need to have at least another employee and/ or a manager or people will stop coming.  While we waited for at least half an hour for our three burgers, I had the time to stare at the filthy walls and floors.  I want to eat here because I believe in the concept and the food is good ( but never accurate),  but it makes me depressed to sit there waiting and watching the poor guys working there.  I wanted to volunteer to help cut fries and do shakes.  To the owners- invest in some extra help and your restaurant will continue to do well,  if not people will take the half an hour that it takes to get a burger here and drive to the five guys on city line or the smash burger in Radnor. Even the Whole Foods has a kids burger at table and tavern that is delicious and comes with smashed potatoes for about the same price.
name: Suzanne

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would absolutely visit again. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: I had Singha Thai delivery the other night through Uber Eats. It was the combination of the worst pad thai (inedible) and worst fried rice I have ever had. Strongly do not recommend.
name: Maddy

text: Had a fabulous dinner with an old friend at Veekoo on his suggestion. Our waitress was new, in only her second week, but anything she wasn't sure about menu-wise she was quick to ask for help and apologize. We started with a sushi-sashimi-california roll combo platter and split a hot and sour soup, and then enjoyed the scallion pancakes and the szechuan rack of lamb. Everything was tasty and had great flavor, and the atmosphere was very classy and chill. Great meal, really enjoyed it. Looking forward to a return visit!
name: Ian

text: This place is SO good!! The food is fresh, well cooked, the staff is super friendly, and the options are there for everyone, including vegan and gluten-free.
name: Lucy

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: They just don't get it. Terrible slow service. Reduced portions high prices and cold food that we waited almost an hour to get. manager did not charge us for food however failed to get it not about money. The holiday dinner was awful and service left lot to be desired . I stood away from her for over 1.5 years did not get better got worse. We are finished with this chain. Now you know why thye closing these restaurants. Manager need. All good restaurants are lined up on Easter Sunday not this one walk right in and sit down and now we know why. Never again.

text: The evening at Brennan's exceeded expectations.   The three course meal was superb.  We started with Waldorf salad that was different than expected but absolutely delicious, the main entree fish almandine wonderful and then the dessert! We had banana Foster prepared next to our table.  The history of the dessert and restaurant was shared by the chef making the dish.  The wait staff was great. This dinner was a destination meal!
name: M

text: This place is flat out awful.  Our waitress was just short of being an idiot and half the items on the menu were not available.  I heard they are going out of business, not surprised.
name: Rico

text: It was a great experience! Staff was great! I cant wait to go back! Tried the crazy roll, kate roll and cliff roll! Cliff roll was my favorite. Try them out :)
name: Crystal

text: This ramen was super yummy and satisfying! I typically don't order the standard beef or pork ramen, so to have a chicken option is nice. Although I wish they would've shredded the chicken, it was juicy and there was a lot of it. The pickled ginger was a wonderful touch. I would get again!
name: Maggie

text: Tried Samurai Blue for the first time tonight.  We ordered 6 rolls and 6 different kinds of nigiri.  We also decided ordered soup because it was soooo cold in the restaurant we were trying to warm up!  Food was good, service was good, atmosphere was good. Nothing was great or amazing but it also wasn't bad.
name: Sherri

text: Love this place. The food is amazing, the atmosphere is wonderful, and the live music is a nice touch. We keep going back, and will continue to do so. The servers are dressed super cool and most of them are out-of-this-world hot! My husband and I are in our 40s but feel much younger when we hang out here!! Love love love
name: Sophia's Mom

text: the staff very friendly consumption was very ok a live concert pleasant I will come back to try the food
name: Hakan

text:
I was invited here for a graduate celebration luncheon. The inside is bright and beautiful. Service was fast, attentive; however, he primarily spoke Spanish to the table which was predominantly Latino. I did feel a little embarrassed when I had to say I didn't understand. Regardless, The server was very good otherwise. 

I ordered a taco salad with no beans but overlooked the rice listed on the menu. Totally my fault but Big mistake because I think they may have doubled the rice in lieu of the beans. Nice gesture but not what I wanted at all. The flavors were what you'd expect of taco "salad" but the excessive rice didn't make this a salad at all. About a third of this was lettuce, ground beef, sour cream and guacamole and a single tomato slice, the rest was rice. 

The person I came with chose the steak fajita salad. She said was much better than mine but the meat was a little dry. She added salsa to her salad to remedy the dryness and to add flavor. There were no rice in beans in it (lucky). She said she was happy with it but said she would probably try something different if we return.

They do a lot of little substitution upcharges, which I am not a fan of. I like that they serve an extra mini carafe of salsa with the chips so you don't have to ask for more mid basket. I think I would definitely try it again but have something totally different.  I most definitely will be more attentive when reading the menu, lol.
name: Brendi

text: 10/10! Cool atmosphere and best waffle I've ever tasted. I got the Mr Maple Mondae and it was just the right amount of salty and sweet. Definitely would recommend
name: Kirstie

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Pretty happy with it overall. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: This was a fabulous place to enjoy a night out .. our server Vilma was kind and patient for our large group.. great food! Definitely worth a visit again ...
name: Jenn

text: 4 stars for the food but way overpriced! Corn fritters are amazing! I was hoping for a glass of prosecco but only available by the bottle. The chicken sandwich was super tasty and the fries too! My husband was thrilled with the beer options.
name: Lisa

text: Great experience at Nom Nom. The buns (especially chicken) were delicious. The ramen is great especially while eating out during a cold evening. Staff is very friendly and attentive. Small, cozy seating area well kept and clean. Would come back here again for some good ramen
name: Seina

text: Great service.  Jessica (Not Tiffany) was on point.  The French Onion was the best.  The kitchen doesn't know how to serve a gyro though.  I'm used to the meat coming out hot.  Cuban was delish also.
name: Robert

text: It has been about a year since I've been here, but I finally got a yelp and I had to rave about this place. The unique blend of food is absolutely spot on. My best friend had a religious experience with the gnocchi here. I was in love from beginning to end. I got the pig ears and I had an old fashioned. Our waiter was amazing and had great recommendations. I remember loving the blondie I had for dessert. Zero complaints. A very memorable meal.
name: Andrea

text: Chipotle is my go to place for a quick meal. I always visit the location on Westshore and I've always been pleased. Today I was in the Brandon area and visit this location. I was surprised it wasn't busy as most Chipotles are, there was no line and no wait. The servers were ok and not very friendly. The cashier made up for their lack of customer service skill. I was happy to be in and out quick. However when I got home the food was disgusting. The rice was hard and the beans weren't fully cooked. The hot sauce was watered down and had no flavor. I threw it out it wasn't even eatable. I would never go back to this location again. Such a shame especially when I'm a Chipotle fan..

text: The food was great!  The only reason I didn't rate 5 stars is because we ordered two bowls of gumbo and there was no meat in either bowl.

text:
This was the baddest location I have ordered from,
I found hair on my food. So you must check before you leave
name: Hassan

text:
I was extremely pleasantly surprised. The inside feels like a hangout with the little cubbies, and I could see buying a bubble tea and hanging out for a while here easy. 

I ordered a big rice bowl and received enough to feed two people. The boba are a little harder in texture than I typically enjoy but are still satisfying, and the tea was very good and flavorful. I saw that they do salads as well as burrito-style meals which sound pretty convenient if you're trying to eat poke on the go. 
I was a little disappointed that the spicy salmon/tuna was mush instead of cubed, if I had know that I would have ordered differently. However this is a texture preference and it was still totally fresh tasting so I am not going to dock any stars over it. 

Overall I will definitely be returning. I think there are a lot of options available for all different kinds of people so it's a great place to take a friend!
name: Maya

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The whole meal felt kinda uneven. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Worst Greek salad ever!!!! My husband and I I reserved the Greek Salad for 2 with gyro meat for lunch. The salad was $14.50 plus an extra $6 for the gyro meat. The salad was to have lettuce, peppers, olives, tomatoes, egg, and potato salad. Here's the quantities of each item on our salad: what appeared to be a whole head of iceberg lettuce (which has 0 nutritional value), 4 thin slices of yellow pepper, 3 olives, 2 cherry tomatoes, 1/2 of 1 egg, and 2 minute scoops of potato salad...maybe a total of 1/8 cup. Oh and the gyro meat...5 extremely thin slices of meat each about 3 inches long. For a total of $21.45, including tax. What a ripoff! When we told our server we were disappointed, she said we could go up front and talk to the manager. We will NEVER be back to this Greek restaurant when the Acropolis and Little Greek restaurants do a great job with both the quality and quantity of food and great service! Save your money--don't go here!!!
name: Jan

text:
The restaurant is on the side of a small strip mall. Which leaves most people questioning the quality... however this is great authentic Chinese  schezuan food. 

First off thanks for bringing me a big pot of tea immediately. 

10 min later
Crab Rangoon taste like they were stuffed in house. Nice little touch was including thongs to pick them up. ( I can appreciate the small things) crispy not oily and the cheese was whipped light and ever slightly sweet. Good balance. 

10 min later
Chefs deep fried chicken w dried chili peppers. Is sooo good. I usually go to spice 28 in cc for dry pepper chicken style but this is totally different in the best way. I asked for extra crispy but I don't think they needed to.

It's flavorful. Not too hot. Great amount of chicken. Lightly battered and crispy on outside but fluffy enough like tofu but flavorful like chicken. The aromatic spice with combination of nutty peanuts and sweet celery and scallions is impressionable. When I wanted more spice I ate the chili flakes which in turn didn't burn! It was great. Def worth 5 star for the authenticity. 

Super casual :)
name: michelle Marie

text: Just stumbled upon this for lunch. The restaurant was very sleek and new and clean and the staff was very friendly and welcoming. The food was delicious. We were given a complimentary plate of bread with a tomato tapenade. The bread was freshly baked and warm and the tomato spread was so good. I ordered the doner burger and the shaved steak/lamb was so tender and the flavors with the burger toppings worked so well together. It came with fries sprinkled with paprika and even those were perfect. It was a deceptively large amount of food too and for only $11 it was a great deal! All around great experience will definitely be back!
name: Alex

text: It had been a long time since I have eaten here. The last time I did all the food was cold and bland, that was 5 years ago so I thought why not give it another chance and boy am I glad I did. The food was steaming hot and flavorful! The service was amazing. The only reason I can't give 5 stars is that their breadsticks still taste like something you'd buy out of the freezer section at Walmart. Over all a solid B+/A-
name: Curtis

text: This place should be shut down. We are an lgbtq+ family and we brought our two small kids. We got there early and were one of only two tables. We ordered salads and quick food for the kids since we only had an hour. Luckily the server was kind enough to bring our kids the food when it was ready despite our food needing more time. My two year olds steamed broccoli clearly looked rotten so I asked the server kindly to send it back. She seemed new and was very young so maybe she didn't know what rotten broccoli Iooks like? It should never have been served. But ten minutes later she came back with a "new" bowl of broccoli thy looked equally bad telling me it was broiled and that caused the black spots. No way. I know the difference. Seriously terribly excuse. I sent it back again. And we still did not have our salads almost 30 minutes into the meal. All around us tables who arrived well after us are receiving their food. I inquired and was directed to the manager who was unhelpful and very curt. I was told my chicken was still cooking. (I'm guessing she also directed our server to try and pass off rotten food) We waited another 10 minutes (at this point we've been there 45+ minutes and our kids are expiring) and when we were finally served my order was totally wrong. Whatever- I've had it.  We immediately asked for take out containers, packed up and got up to leave. As I'm picking up my baby to leave  I caught eyes with the table behind us who had been whispering and giggling and talking about us. We're used to getting side eye in public but this was blatant bigotry. They stared my wife down as we walked toward the register. This was a mom and her three kids... all belittling my family. If we weren't so exasperated from the restaurant experience and late for our event I would have confronted them. That's when I realized there was a good chance that our experience at this restaurant may have been due to similar intolerance. We're not from Indiana and don't know Lawrence at all but I am warning to other lgbtq+ people and families- This is not a safe space.
name: Kate

text:
The food was delicious, although it would be nice if there were truly breakfast entree without having to purchase meat,etc separately.
 My server was not very attentive. Our table was the only with no silverware, and not offered water. Had to ask for silverware. My take out order was wrong.  I will check before I leave next time.  Otherwise,  I will be back.

text: My husband and I have been dying to try this place and we finally got around to it. We walked in and were immediately greeted by the nicest people! They asked if we had been there before and when we said no they gave us a free sample of their brisket...AMAZING! We enjoyed both their brisket sandwich and pork sandwich; both were delicious and to be honest we could have shared. We also got a side of corn bread and their gooey butter cake (free with a check in ). The only reason I didn't give this place five stars is because my husband and I both wished they had a few more sides to choose from and the fact that some pieces of brisket on the sandwich were overly salty. text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. text:
I've been to the Macdade blvd location a half dozen times, but this was my first trip to this spot.  Tiny, but charming with a few tables inside and a picnic table outside.  Two man operation with a nice lady working the flat top and a friendly guy taking the orders.  
This visit I went with the Burger of the month - Philly Burger - Burger with fried sweet pepper, fried onions and cheddar cheese sauce.  I snagged a side of fries which they always give you a ton of.  The burgers themselves are simple patties much like you'd find locally at Charlie's or Danny's with a simple bun, cooked on a flat top.  The burger was its tasty consistent self.  I can see why most people go with doubles when they order given the size of the patties from here, but I always stick to the single.  As usual another satisfied visit.  
The prices are decent, I think I walked out spending $8 bucks.  As a note I sat inside and did end up smelling like oil and burger, but it's all good.  They aren't my favorite burger joint, but they do hold a place in my heart!

text:
Searching for great chicken soup because my husband is not well.  Yelpers raved about the food and the great management at this Deli, so why not try it instead of going to SUP?  Thinking a bowl of soup is not sufficient, so I ordered the Chicken in a Pot.  Karla was the cashier, I told her my husband was sick, he needs good chicken soup & lots of it.  When I asked her what is included, her comment should have sent me running.  But I really want to bring my husband some good chicken soup & hope it would be great so we can go back to Manhattan Deli to try the deli menu.  Karla's respond to me was "uh, chicken & broth", I asked her again, what is included beside the chicken and broth.  Blank stare "I don't understand" was her comment.  Hum, it was about 12:30ish & the restaurant was 1/2 full, no one at the register except Karla and me, so I cannot imagine she was overwhelmed.  Then, I pointed to the large overhead menu & read it to her, "fresh vegetables & noodles" are items included.  "Oh yeah, if that is in the sign" was her respond.  Then one of a waitstaff walked by, I asked him what type of vegetables in this dish, he was knowledgeable and answered me.  By now it is 12:54PM, I am getting anxious.  So I asked Karla to please ring me up and please put the chicken in a separate container from the vegetables, noodles and broth.  About 12 minutes later, Karla handed me a small bag with 2 containers.  One container was 1/2 full and the other container was no more than 2/3 full.  I looked at these containers and asked Karla, why is the chicken not separated as I asked?  She looked at me with the same blank stare, "I don't understand".  Thinking to myself....really?!? REALLY?!?.  I saw a man standing near by.  So I asked Karla if that was the manager, she said yes.  I told her not to worry I will talk to him.  I showed this manager these two containers and asked him if there was really 1/2 a chicken there and why are these containers are 1/2 full.  I told him my husband is sick in a hotel room, I asked for chicken to be separated from the vegetables and broth.  He took the 2 containers with him.  After another 7 or 8 minutes in the kitchen area, he came back with the containers with more broth and noodles.  He stated he made sure that the breast, wing, drumstick, and thigh were inside these 2 containers.  My phone flashed 1:25PM, I said to him, I asked for the chicken to be separated.  He said, "oh, I will have to go and start the order over".  Ok.  If you are still reading this review, then you will understand the one star!  I said "thank you sir, I have to go back to my hotel, I have no more time, my husband is sick".  Took the 2 containers & left.  My husband said the soup is VERY SALTY.  But he ate 1 container.  He is not eating the other container because it is too salty!  Look closely at the the photos, would you pay $16.78 for 2 small containers of overly salted chicken soup?  
A word of advise to Manhattan Deli, a take out customer or eat in customer should be treated the with the same respect.  Reno is a touristy town, pissed off 1 customer and those who are reading reviews may not be inclined to even try your restaurant.  My husband and his company will NOT BE eating at Manhattan Deli while they are working the next couple months in Reno!
name: Julianna

The 10 course tasting really gives you a great variety of food and the best bang for your buck. Highly recommend if you're going to be in Philadelphia to make a reservation and check it out. text:
Decided to dine here based on reviews and we would not return... disappointed big time. We loved two dishes but the rest were not worth it. Here's the breakdown on what we ordered:

- grilled baby octopus- 5 stars... crispy, well seasoned and delicious with a flavorful slaw
- steamers- 5 stars... plump, delicious and not sandy
- fried calamari- 0 stars... absolutely no flavor... sauce couldn't even save it... tried to salt it to no avail
- fried oysters- 3 stars... ok but not great
- fried whole belly clams- 1 star... minimal flavor and more like clam strips with a teeny bit of whole belly
- snapper turtle soup- 0 star... not a fan... almost had chili cognac flavor and couldn't pin point turtle
- fish chowder- 1 star... no flavor, watery, flour-y (I'd much rather eat Trader Joe's clam chowder for less than $5 than eat this $16 soup)

We left feeling so disappointed, craving deliciousness that we ended up going elsewhere to pick up cheesesteaks on our way home.
name: M J

text:
Our 3rd visit to the Lucky Well. 
Mother's Day.
Not at all crowded.

There was, however, a crowd of 3 families waiting outside the restaurant on a cold & rainy Sunday, expecting to be let in--as a courtesy--before the official 11.30 open time. 
No. 
The staff either didn't care or didn't realize that there were folks outside in the elements.  
Can they open the doors 10 min early? 
I guess not.

So...I should have known we were in trouble.

We were extremely disappointed with the food.
The brisket was mostly fat.
The medium burger arrived well-done and, paired with the stale role, was too dry to eat.
The fries were soggy & limp.

The service was below-average.  The staff seemed unprepared to open and genuinely surprised that guests were arriving.

In terms of table management, our server, Kate, was completely oblivious to what was happening with our meals.
When both parties have left 75% of their entrees untouched on the plate...perhaps its time to ask if something was amiss or notify a manager.

We chose Lucky Well for Mother's day based on great experiences we had in the past.

We will not return.
name: Seth

text: We were in Reno last year and got excited that we saw one was opening up.
