text: Expected better service and food for the cost. We had a reservation and showed up 45 minutes early  They did seat us right away and didn't make us wait for the rest of the party to get there  That was a plus.  They do have really cool drinks creations.  I'm don't eat fish or seafood so I had very limited options to choose from on the menu.  That was the first drawback to the visit  Food was decent but I do have to say that if I am paying almost $40 for a steak it better knock my socks off but it didn't.  Felt like I was trying to saw a piece of lumber while cutting my steak. I've honestly had better steak at a multiple different chain restaurants.  Our waiter was great at first and then when the rest of the party got there our service from him seemed to go downhill from there  It wasn't a matter of the waiter not bringing what we asked for or him forgetting things.  It was his attitude towards us.  He especially seemed to be extra rude to the child that was with us.  I can deal with ok food and great service or great food and poor service but not poor food and service.  When you are spending over $300 on a meal for 4 adults and a kid I expect white glove service.  The inside of the restaurant looks really nice but it's not that big of a space  It's very noisy inside and the seating is not very comfortable.  Almost forgot the biggest WTF moment of the evening. text: Just happened upon this place after sight seeing in the area. Walked in and heard music so I was intrigued. Well they were having a live broadcast for a radio station and featured a couple of entertainers. My friend and I took a seat and enjoyed great music while eating lunch. I had a mushroom burger with sweet potato fries. Both were exceptionally good. Fries were crispy and cooked to perfection. I would definitely return for both the food and the entertainment!
name: Anne

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Price felt a touch high for what it was. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
Heard a lot about this place from locals and visitors alike. Expected a wait for a table but it was short and we were able to get drinks at the bar while waiting. 
Placed our order and waited 40 minutes for our food. Waitress avoided us as she walked by numerous times. Finally the food came. My wife got the gooey burger and it was great. I unfortunately tried the Philly Steak sandwich which was horrible. Recommend the place due to it's uniqueness, but be patient and stick to the burgers!
name: Jeff

text: Omg. If I lived in the area these people would know me very well. Went with family and there were 5 adults and 2 kids. Didn't take them long at all to get us seated. I had the snow crab and shrimp with the delicious juicy special sauce. I'm not sure I've been that quiet ever, so delicious. Everyone else loved their food as well. It's really messy so be prepared!
name: Jennifer

text: Had a good meal at the bar but would have stayed longer for drinks, but the bar seats have no backs and are way too uncomfortable to sit on for too long.  They could a more extensive Sauvignon Blanc wine list, at least have a New Zealand Marlborough version.
name: Lynn

text:
I love this place. The menu is simple. The decor is like your grandma's house.  & you grill your own steaks or fish.

If you're not a great cook, you can order from the kitchen.

The croutons are the best!
name: Cyndi

text: Beautiful ambience in a intimate cottage house. Service was slow, but we were in no hurry. House salad was huge and wonderful. Fresh greens, light dressing and shaved cheese chunks. $5 Bloody Mary. Martini was.28 cents! Bbq shrimp was wonderful. Different than most, but great. Served with grits and greens. Finished it off, and wanted more. Spouse ordered sweet breads. Specialty of the house, he loved it. We will be back.
name: Elle

text:
Fantastic service, other than I ordered double beans instead of rice and still received both. The rice was good though, very flavorful and not dry at all.  I had the Chili Rellenos, which was fantastic!!  Not too greasy from the fried batter (sometimes this is a problem for Rellenos).  No upcharge for the small portion of guac or an order of extra sour cream, and the waiter even new we had a $10 off coupon!! As well complimentary chips and salsa a bonus for a mexican restaurant! 
My boyfriend had a grilled quesadilla LOADED with steak chicken and shrimp topped with the double sour cream. He loved it and gobbled up every bit (he is a big eater ;) ) 
The only other thing is that it was a bit hot in there due to having no vestibule when the door kept opening and the kitchen  negative that is partially open to the restaurant. It was a sunny,93 degree day though and the front of the boulding faces west.
name: Rhena

text: i get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. Service was friendly, just kinda slow once the room filled up. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The music was louder than it needed to be. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: Del Friscos was awesome! We were our waiter, Greg's, only table for the night and he was amazing! Thank you for answering all our questions. It was my birthday dinner, and I got the gold standard mule, 8oz filet, lobster Mac and cheese, and they gave us dessert which was the butter cake and lava cake. The steak was cooked medium and very juicy and flavorful. As a topping I got this bleu cheese garlic butter. The Mac and cheese had nice big pieces of lobster in it. The dessert was great but I was stuffed and couldn't finish it. The lava cake was so creamy. I definitely wish I could eat here weekly :D
name: Priya

text: The artichoke dip was delicious and the pizza was great.  Good service and a really nice part of Boise.
name: Tim

text:
I am so happy about the revival of union station. We stopped in to the soda fountain after the polar express. It was much larger than I anticipated and quite beautiful on the inside. We were seated relatively quickly considering it was busy when we arrived. It did take longer than usual just to get water. We weren't in a giant hurry so it was OK. We ordered a few shakes and cheeseburgers, Chicago style hot dogs, chili and grilled cheese. I would say the food and shakes were pretty good and satisfying enough that I would like to go back for other menu items. The restaurant is still fairly new so the service timeliness I am willing to overlook. Our waitress was very nice though. 
Overall the experience was positive and my family had a great time. We look forward to returning!
name: Lindsay

text:
I have been at this restaurant for dinner a few times including again last night.  The food is just delicious. We had the ribeye steak as main course along with baked potatoe and side of mushrooms.  For appetizer, we had the chopped salad and french onion soup.

Everything was so good and tasty.  The help there is very friendly and will get you anything you need.  I brought 2 of my friends there last night and they enjoyed their dinner as well.  It's somewhat pricey, but I think it's worth it and plan to keep going back.
name: debbie

text:
Okay, so I rarely do reviews. But I really think this deserves it.

I went to this location yesterday for lunch.

Ordering: The process for ordering the food was a little confusing. Not the end of the world... but why not just take our whole order at the start of the process? 

Price: Over priced for what you get. 

Quality: My meal tasted fine - not spectacular. For the price I expected to find it was more outstanding rather then middle of the road. My wife didn't even finish hers.

She ordered soup - and it was cold. Not ice cold, but certainly short of warm. And a flatbread that just wasn't appetizing. 

Other: When I paid there was an option for "tip." I always tip. 15% if I get bad service, 20-25% if I get good service. But that is usually at places where they seat you, take your order at the table, and bring your food to you.  Actual SERVICE at your table. This is more of a cafeteria style line. Why would they ask for a tip!? I tipped, because that's what I do, but I don't think it appropriate for them to ask for a tip in this dining format. 

I'm giving it two stars, because I did like my meal, but there are just too many issues here imo.
name: Chris

text: Great sushi all over the area and WOOJUNG still stands out !!  Great family atmosphere and service.
name: Kevin

text: Living in the Chicago area my whole life I didn't realize how spoiled I was with all the amazing Italian food until I moved here. It's almost impossible to find decent Italian food in this area but Mirko Pasta finally filled the void. The eggplant parmesan was delicious. It was a large portion and I had to force myself not finish it because it was so good. The restaurant has a nice upscale casual feel. I will definitely be back.
name: Karina

text: Great, friendly, quick service. Amazing food and the desserts are delicious. Cool ambiance and good music too!
name: Peter

text: Just tried Twin Peaks Pizzeria for the first time.  Blah. Ordered a large thin pepperoni and mushroom.  Flavor was ok but people order thin for a bit of crispy. Pizza was soggy and limp. We also ordered hot wings. These were absolutely disgusting. Hands down the worst wings I've ever had. I have no idea how internally they can be over cooked and the outside remain soggy. And the flavor was simply gross. We dined in for lunch and they were not busy so no excuse. Now I know why they weren't busy. Gross, gross, gross. Save your hard earned money.
name: Man

text: Steak shawarma in a bowl with rice base, absolutely delicious.  The pita bread is so soft and fresh.  The only regret is that I finished everything in my bowl, and was stuffed.  Also it was a bit salty - I did not feel it when I ate it but was kind of thirsty afterwards...
name: L

text: First stop every time I hit NOLA from the airport. Great local taste for cash and carry. Best place to grab a smorgasbord of food, dessert and drinks and take to your hotel and grub. Don't be put off by the local look of the place. Go in and get what you need and head out. ITS DELICIOUS!!!
name: SetLady

text: I absolutely LOVE Blind Onion food.  But staff seriously needs customer service training.  I frequent the restaurant because I love the food, but I am consistently ignored by the staff, who seem to be consumed by their personal worlds, rather than by who is in their restaurant at the time. This could be an amazing restaurant if it were customer-focussed
name: Maria

text: We went there to check out their Thursday dinner special for two.  The food was good and plentiful for the $42.00 cost and the half priced wine was nice addition to our meal.  The extremely frustrating problem was with how quickly they want us in and out.  We had chosen this place for our date night and ended up feeling frustrated and not truly able to enjoy our meal.  If you are in a hurry and just want to gobble down your food and get going, then I'd tell you to head here.  We arrived around 6:00 p.m. and were seated promptly, which was nice.  We had just sat down and we're settling in probably less than two minutes and our waiter arrived wanting to take our beverage order.  We hadn't looked at any menu at this time.  We informed him that we'd need some more time, he arrived back less than two minutes later.  He wanted to know if we had made a decision on our beverages and if we had made a choice for our meals.  We mentioned that we were curious to try the Thursday special.  At that point he asked if we had decided on our starter, again we hadn't had the opportunity to look at our discuss the menu options.  We looked hastily, made a decision about the starter and asked for the wine.  He then said that the special came with two sides and if we knew what we would like for them.  We said we hadn't decided yet, he left, returned again in less than 2 minutes and asked what sides we had decided on.  He left again then in less than 5 minutes our starter arrived.  It was yummy and we were enjoying it with our wine.  We were about half way through our starter and our dinner arrived. Now the choice was, finish our starter or start eating our dinner while it was still hot.  We had just taken the last bite of our dinner and our dessert arrived.  Not a enjoyable relaxing meal.  We were in and out in about 55 minutes.  Not a date night experience.  Will come back for lunch, when you need to be in and out in an hour, but dinner if off the list.
name: Debora

text: Spicy pork belly is great a bit pricy but worth it and our first time to dine in there but definetly will be back..
name: JHeng

text: We had the alligator sausage po-boy and the peacemaker po-boy. Both really delicious. Very filling. We grabbed them to go so I'm sure they would've been better if we sat in the restaurant to enjoy them. Nice clean restaurant, friendly staff.
name: Brittany

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Probably not coming back. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Would prob stop in again if nearby. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Amazing dough, great meats Nice atmosphere. Would be nice if they continue to expand beer selection. If you need a great pie come here.
name: Scott

text:
Yolk is a great place for brunch in downtown Indianapolis! The atmosphere is great and the food was delicious! The reason I gave it 4 stars because our service wasn't the best. Our waiter didn't seem like he wanted to be working at all and showed little to no emotion. But besides that, definitely recommend for a cute brunch right on the circle! 

We ordered a salmon salad, the BLT with a side of mixed berries, and red velvet pancakes!! So yummy!
name: Bridget

text: Checked this out on the first weekend it was open. Great snacks and the place was packed! The space is beautiful and there were huge tables and many different modes of seating. We found a place at a huge shared table. My date ordered a beer and I ordered a cocktail. It seemed like the bartender had never made my cocktail before and unfortunately it wasn't the best - but maybe that's what I get for ordering a cocktail at a brewery! It was a bit loud but seemed like a good meet up place for large groups. Dock Street South is a welcome addition to the neighborhood and I will be back.
name: E

text: SO DELICIOUS. The staff was excited we were there! And kind! We have service dogs and travel in pairs and they were super accommodating of that fact. We ordered the Manhatten cheesesteak and they were sooooo good. And fast! The staff chatted with us and brought our service dog's biscuits and water! I'm super impressed. We aren't from around here but I can tell you we will come here whenever we're in town!
name: Julia

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Food was fresh and service was quick. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
Visited for the first time on 11/17. 

It was spectacular.  The Philly cheesesteak omelet was so good.  Perfect balance of meat, cheese, & egg.  

I was also impressed with their homemade biscuits & cornbread.   The cornbread came with an apricot-jalapeño jam that was pretty amazing.
name: James

text: First time here and it did not disappoint! We got the cauliflower appetizer, salmon, and chicken valdostana. All were delicious. Salmon had a nice crust on the outside from a well seasoned sear and delicious dill sauce. 4 stars because we had an issue with our appetizer being forgotten but otherwise a 5 star meal. Definitely recommend to anyone wanting to try a new place.
name: Breanna

text: I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: This is a great family restaurant! We loved the service and the variety of amazing Italian and Greek food
name: Makena

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Parking was annoying, although that's prob more about the area than the restaurant. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: The food was good . Our waitress was sweet and nice . Her daughter is cute . She even helped her mom clean the table . She always has a smile on her face.
name: Jessica

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. My experience was honestly fine. Not bad for a quick meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It looked better online than it did in person. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
Went here recently with son-in-law and grandson. Early evening so not too crowded, seated in under  five minutes. Ordered the must-have Blooming Onion. It was hot and flavorful. Just a little for me, watching WW points. 

Salad and soup came in good time. My salad was chilled, crisp and delightful. Others French Onion and Baked Potato soups also got excellent comments.

I ordered the Blackened Prime Rib with grilled  asparagus , they each ordered steak and fries. Their steaks were ok, not particularly standing out. My Prime Rib was very good but not spicy as I expected with blackening. Also it was served with a disappointing horseradish sauce, more like an Arby's Horsey sauce, no heat at all. I did ask for, and received, pure horseradish, which was just the right kick needed. Grilled asparagus was excellent.
name: Larry

text:
This place rules.  The food is great, and they deliver without charging an arm and a leg for it.  It's my go to place for when I'm both too lazy to leave the house or cook for myself.  Delivery is also relatively quick, probably because I don't think they ever outsource it to the third party delivery people.

I also appreciate that they have goat, which I like to try once in a while and not all Indian places seem to have.

Really like the samosa chatt, fish curry, saag paneer, and all the different flavors of naan they have.
name: Nicholas

text: Always amazing! You can't go wrong eating here. My most favorite here is still the Blackened Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo with added mushrooms and broccoli! I often add pepper & a little salt to it for even more flavor like I do most of my food. It's so good. And the owner, Chef Eric so incredibly nice. I've never had bad service there & I go there often. My second favorite is their Blackened Chicken Ivan Ala Vodka penne with added squash & zucchini. Another great one. As I'm writing this review from home I'm already starting to wish I had leftovers of each in the fridge. Haha
name: Missy

text: Customer service is fine. Came for the burger which was ok. Not bad but not the best. It comes with a baked potato, kinda similar to Port of Call but not as good. Honestly probably won't come here again due to there being much better tasting options for the price. Atmosphere is ok. Patrons were mostly older. A juke box was playing that made things a lil more fun. Plenty of tvs in the bar area. Might be a good spot to catch a game.
name: Astrya

text: Only had shrimp spring rolls but the best I've had from Reno to so California have to go back
name: Bruce

text: I arrived very early for our last breakfast together in NOLA. The staff allowed me to wait inside instead of dealing with the heat outside. I was seated and they were very accommodating even though it was getting close to the time when it gets really busy. The food was so good! Nothing fancy but awesome nonetheless. I had the grilled catfish breakfast and was pleasantly surprised at how fresh the fish was. It tasted like they went out back, went fishing and cooked it as soon as they got it off the hook. This is a "must do" next time I'm in NOLA!
name: Terri

text:
Let me tell you about our fantastic waitresses: Michelle and Paige! 

Mom and I headed to Muriel's on a rainy summer night in NOLA, we were having a girls weekend and ended it with a fancy dinner here. We were blown away by these ladies-- they were polite, kind and knowledgeable! My mom has a thick spanish accent, however this didn't discourage these ladies from conversing and joking with her. This really set the tone of our dinner, and made us feel welcomed. 

The room was beautiful, the food was delicious... all things you expect from a high end restaurant, but these ladies were the reason our night was so memorable! Thank you!
name: Tatiana

text:
We waited for the hype to die down slightly and went on a Sunday, early afternoon.  We were offered indoor or outdoor and were sat immediately.  We ordered the crab/shrimp stack appetizer.  Delicious.  As for our entrees, they were all delicious! 

Our waitress was attentive and helpful when recommending a dish for my husband.  

Ok so this my only issue...I had on converse and the floors were so slick in the area we were seated. It was like the floors were wet, except they weren't.  

We will definitely be back!
name: Angel

text: Want an an Old Fashioned and nothing else? This might be ok. Drove to Indy for a quick get away. Stopped here because of the reported "Esquire" magazine review. That was from several years ago and things must have changed. The good news: the Old Fashioned is excellent. The bad news: everything else. They appeared short staffed and flustered. Service was literally  bartender running by and dropping water at table and had to flag down for anything else. Food tasted like reheated leftovers. We never did get utensils. Ever try to eat a meatball with just a serving spoon?! French 75 was ok, but other champagne drink was syrupy sweet. Lemon gin and tonic tasted like effervescent cold medicine (plop, plop, fizz, fizz).  Was a Tuesday night. Maybe we caught on an off day, but so many better alternatives available.
name: Cam

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Not bad for a quick meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
Came on a Tuesday afternoon and there was an hour wait. We eventually were able to snag 3 seats at the bar. We tried a few of their signature drinks and appetizers. We also shared the seafood platter. Trust me, it was a lot of food for 3 hungry ladies. 
Give this place a shot!
name: Jada

text:
Tom, the owner is the kindest most hard working person I have ever met! 

Eat here often and I am never disappointed. The food is amazing and the staff is friendly and fun. 

Perfect, lively, atmosphere and incredible live music!
name: Tatum

text: My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was fresh and service was quick. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: We had the worst experience today. We were there for a bridal brunch and they would not accommodate us at all!  The so called manager, Steven, was very rude to the point we ended up leaving!  We asked for his name and he said he looked forward to the bad review we were going to leave.  I would not recommend it to any large group!!
name: Ellen

text: I've been twice. Once for breakfast, once for lunch. I hate to leave this review because I feel like maybe I was just unlucky. This place is legendary in Palm Harbor. It's always packed and it ranks #1 for a ton of people in the area. I just found the menu uninspired, decent service, and okay flavored food. It is a place where you can be guaranteed to not get a poor meal or experience, but also nothing to write home about. I'm definitely in the minority though.
name: Taylor

text: I came here solo for lunch around 1:00. I was seated immediately in the bar area downstairs. A man took my drink order right away. He also noticed my table was a little wobbly so he brought a wedge right over and fixed it. My server came by within minutes as well. I had the fish tacos with crispy cod. OMG it was delicious. The tortilla chips and black beans it came with were also superb. They also being 3 different bottled sauces. Since I'm a wimp I had the verde sauce on the tacos and used it for a dip. It was sooo good. Perfect place for lunch and the service was top notch!
name: Cari

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The music was louder than it needed to be. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
So very good...I was on my Avocado Toast bing and Proper Bagel satisfied my itch and then some...I also fell in love with the "black and blue jam"....My friend and I was beyond excited to try this place...

There is adequate seating but you must know that this place stays packed so there is indoor and outdoor seating but get in where you can fit in!

The staff is super friendly and my avocado toast was Errrrrythang!!!!! I so love arugula but I would add a suggestion...to put the arugula on the bottom of the bread and then the avocado smash...anywho 

Parking can be a beast because it is in the heart of a college district...
name: Shub

text: Zero stars. I had a very bad experience with  placing an order over the phone. The young lady was extremely rude and was disrespectful. There was no reason for any of that. Friends and family will hear about this and we will no longer give Uncle Charles pizza any more of our Business.
name: Tiffany

text:
Unfortunately food service is limited inside the airport. If you're hungry bring something with you.  

Waited about 7 minutes to be seated.  Then waited almost 25 minutes to be waited on.  First sever came back twice to confirm my order.  Then a second server came back 5 minutes later to ask me what I ordered.  Then waited almost 15 minutes for a burger that I asked for medium well that came out rare.  

Avoid this restaurant if you can.  Food is not worth the wait and very poor service.
name: David

text:
Outstanding ramen and Asian noodle dishes. Freshly made noodles served in a flavorful spicy broth. Service was great and the food fantastic. Nice to find a quality Asian restaurant in the area.
Definitely will be back!
name: Michael

text: The service is the reason I have it a 3 star.Okay my 1st time the and it was a Sunday around noon.  I sat at the bar,  not the outside bar. The was 5 others sitting at the bar also.  Maybe it was my Mets shirt and hat that just of put the bartenders in a bad mood toward me or is it because I asked what type of bottle beer they carried,   I really don't know. A regular sat next to and it was night and day service.  The girl bartender only came over to me 3 times,  once to take my order,  second time to deliver my beer and finally to give me check.  The regular who sat next to me got the royal treatment,  refilled his drink 3 times without asking,  offered silverware,  brought him water,  asked him a few times how was his bagel, I ordered a soup and a steak. The bartender never gave me her name nor did I see a name badge,  once I was 3 quarters into my steak she asked me how's everything.  She then leaves the bar for like the 8th or 9th time then comes back and asks her regular how everything was and if he wanted his check,  doesn't make eye contact with me and comes back with his check and also drops my bill in front of me,  doesn't ask how everything was nor if I wanted another beer,  I couldn't wait to get out of there.  I've never felt so unwelcome ever in my life.  I blame poor management who do not properly train the employees and allow bad habits to go on.  It sucks because this is a place I would frequent,  however after my 1st and only experience I will  probably not be back. The food was good and a fair price,  but the service is beyond subpar. Meanwhile where is management?  The are suppose to ensure that all the guest are happy and treated correctly.  3 stars is stretching my rating.  You really need to press the reset button and retrain your management,  bartenders and services.
name: Danny

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
This is the closest Applebee's from our house and we decided to come here after a long day of Christmas parties and shopping at the mall. There was a wait, but it is a Saturday evening.

Once we sat down we were greeted by Will. A very nice and professional waiter. He went over the specials and persuaded me to get the $1 cherry Jolly Rancher margarita! Excited to try that. My girlfriend ordered chips and salsa and some buffalo wings as apps. They're great! The chicken could've had a little more sauce on it.

We ordered the 2 for $26 deal. I got the four-cheese mac & cheese with honey pepper chicken tenders, and Alyson got the bourbon street chicken & shrimp. That's both of our go-to's and we love both. Depending on the day/night or batch. It could be better or worse. Most of the time, the entrees are great though! Alyson felt like they had given her less than usual, but it was still delicious.

The $1 jolly rancher drink was not too good unless you like very sweet drinks with hardly any alcohol in it. Not saying it's bad, just not my cup of tea.

I gave this place a 3 out of 5 because it's just a decent place to come. Our waiter, Will, definitely was the best part of the experience. If every waiter in the world was like him, I'd probably enjoy any establishment.
name: Antonio

text: Went there last night , food was great , service was great , these out of town people don't know what they are talking about , take your stuck up asses back to Cali!! This place has amazing food and hard working people,, we loved everything ,, been to many Mexican places where everything was tasteless and lacked flavor ,, this place was on point and would recommend it to anyone in the jersey area ,, don't listen to the out of town people they must be used to being spoiled little bitches ,,,amazing food ! Great service , it's that kinda place where you want great food and don't care about anything but that ,,,
name: Steve

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: Best Taco Bell in @stpetefl because it's close to me! That kind of night! Staff is friendly and all seem to care about the service they deliver!
name: Brian

text: ADORE this place for a quick bahn mi (definitely more of a takeout joint, as they have a table or two but mostly for waiting on your food to be ready).. I have had many varieties of the bahn mi, the BBQ pork/chicken/pork belly, and all did not disappoint. The bread is so fresh and crisp, and I think the sandwiches are well priced and filling. There is a card minimum of $10 so bring cash or yolo just buy 2 sandwiches (worth it)
name: Emma

text: I had to give them one star because there isn't an option for zero stars. The food was cold. Everything was cold... I told the lady that I believe was the manager. She acted like she didn't understand the words "cold food". Do yourself a favor and go someplace else. Don't risk getting sick. She still charged me over $27 for two people.
name: Brad

text: I tried their chicken shawarma with garlic sauce. It tasted great and the quantity was just the right amount . The environment is great as well. Will go back again sometime soon.
name: Namira

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
All I can say is that if I lived close to a True Food Kitchen I would be here multiple times a week. This place is such an amazing addition to Nashville's food scene!

I was so excited to try True Food; I'm always on the lookout for healthy food options that are delicious to boot. Upon walking in, I immediately loved the vibe. The decor was so reminiscent of the area, which I loved - for example, there were guitars on the walls filled with succulents. Such a cute interpretation of the music city! It does get a little loud in here due to how open the space is, but the food makes up for the noise.

We started with the edamame dumplings and they were incredible. Salty, tangy, and perfect for sharing. The menu is a bit overwhelming and I was torn between a couple items for my meal, so I asked my waitress for a recommendation. I appreciated how talkative and helpful she was. She steered me toward the teriyaki quinoa bowl and I'm so glad she did. The veggies were deliciously fresh and the quinoa was perfectly cooked. They make their own teriyaki sauce in house and it was one of the best I've had in awhile. I would totally get this again if I ever have the chance to return. Delicious. I also had a pomegranate limeade to compliment it and it was the perfect mixture of sweet and tart.

True Food Kitchen, please come to Columbus, Ohio!! We don't have enough healthy food options here and you'd fit into the Columbus food scene so well. Okay, begging over. Seriously though, amazing food that tastes good AND makes you feel good. If you're ever in the area, this is a must try.
name: Kelly

text: This is the worst chipotle I've ever been to!!!! Guac was super super super salty!! chips were very salty and the rice had waaaay to much lime juice and cilantro. the staff was very rude and didn't seem to care that much never coming back to this location
name: Amber

text: The food and service was great. Our bartender Kira was very quick and attentive. I would recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a trendy place to have some good food
name: Alex

text: This place is nothing to write home about. Especially since Rawk Star Cafe opened down the street. This places fuels the stereotype that vegan food is expensive. The vegan ice cream tasted like something you could buy at Publix or Whole Foods. They were friendly.
name: Jacqueline

text: My guilty pleasure place. I've frequent Traub's lately for their mini cakes.. So far, I've had the caramel and cannoli.. Yummy! I've had their donuts in the past which are delicious too. They can be a bit pricey. I really appreciate their convenient hours compared to other bakeries.
name: Donna

text: Ordered iced mocha which was watery with too much ice! Didn't have much taste to it. Ended up spending $5 on basically water ad ice!
name: Cybele

text:
On the northwest corner of Wilmington and 22nd under a sign "Quick Subs" (the permanent sign will be Phase 2 or 3) you will find the signless Holy Smoking Butts. 

This newest entry into the Tucson BBQ scene is the clear winner. All the prime meats are smoked on site. We tried both pulled pork and brisket sandwiches and both were smokin' good with beautiful smoke rings and bark for maximum flavor. Very, very generous servings and sides made for heavy eating.  Smaller versions would be a good choice if they offered that. They don't. 

Try the beans. They were as good as Aunt Mary's. 

As we sat eating, the line for take-away never stopped. You may want to be there early because they sell out every day. 

The place is short on atmosphere but long on flavor. Go to eat not to party. 


Just had lunch at the new location. Excellent service by Derick. Whatever problems they had with service seems corrected. Still lovin' the place. 
Btw-very cool Texas bbq atmosphere in the new location.
name: Dianna

text: Love this place! Their coffee is amazing black or as a specialty latte or capuccuno. The good is always healthy and fresh tasting. It's a nice atmosphere if you need to get some work done as well
name: Hailey

text: First time there and people are so friendly!!! Loved the fact that they have some of Hawaii's favorite breakfasts like loco moco and spam, eggs and rice! I would definitely go there again when I come back to visit Reno
name: Ashley

text:
As if this place wasn't bad enough for their poor service they raise their prices. 
1Large pizza, 1small dinner salad and 2 drinks for dine in. Came to over $41. Don't think I could ever feel legendary enough for such a cost. To many other places to go. Am done with Round Table.
name: Tim

text: Awful experience. Took an hour and half to deliver one pizza and wings when I'm less than 2 miles away. Ordered salad with no olives and pizza with extra sauce came with neither. Worst 35 bucks i ever spent.
name: Jake

text: Walked in after the Phillies game on Sat March 30 with my wife and 2 small children.  They told us sitting at the bar area would be quicker than waiting for a table.  Ok - it was getting late and we were hungry.  We sat in the middle at a pub table with  4 chairs. We waited longer than 5 min before a server finally walked up to us.  He apologized for the wait and said he didn't see us sitting at the table in his area.  Really? What??  It gets worse.  We ordered drinks.  I ordered a tall Sam Adams.  Kids and wife's drinks came first.  Ok - mine was from the bar.  Whatever.  So I waited...and waited...and waited.  Finally he brought it over - Not a tall Sam Adams.  Regular size.  I rolled my eyes - whatever again.  We ordered the food.  Kids got chicken fingers.  Wife and I ordered All American double cheeseburgers.  I can be a finicky eater - So I made it simple - Just make mine with buns, cheese, meat, bacon and lettuce.  That's it.  Easy right?  Not so for them.  Kids chicken fingers were dry and hard.  He brought my burger back with...mustard, mayo, ketchup and pickles.  At least he immediately realized that it was completely not what I ordered and took it back.  Then 10 min later he came back with a super greasy burger that still had pickles in it.  WHAT??  At that point I was upset and finally said something.  He was nice and did apologize, but they messed up so many things it was too late.  I ate 2 bites of the burger and some soggy fries.  Slop.  The manager came by and then offered us coupons for next time we come.  NEXT TIME???  I told her there would not be a NEXT TIME and was again upset by this weak attempt to make our experience better.  Then she said she would also give us 25% off our meal.  I accepted because I just wanted to go.  Awful.  The whole meal should have been FREE for that garbage food and service.  They finally decided not to charge me for that garbage burger after I told them it was inedible.  I was foolish.  I had heard bad stories about this chain in the past and thought "let's try it out."  HUGE MISTAKE - NEVER AGAIN.  TOLD ALL MY FB LIST - many said "yeah we heard horror stories about BWW too!"  At least the Phillies won.  HUGE FAIL by Buffalo Wild Wings.  PJ Whelihans in Newtown Square is like the Capital Grille compared to this hole.
name: Ernest

text: Horrible service outside, takes forever to get drinks and food. Totally disorganized.
name: Andy

text:
UPDATE:

Haveli has gone through a few changes over the last year or so, and I apologize for failing to follow up here (I just missed it somehow).

The buffet is now an all-the-time, every-time thing, and this is a big plus!  The ala carte is great, but pricey - the buffet allows you to eat both cheaply and until you're ready to die from over eating!

Food wise, Haveli remains consistenly excellent, but the service has become a little more hit and miss.  While I know that Haveli is family owned, I'm not certain who is and isn't family, so attributing these changes to family is just speculation - however... I've had at least two seatings where the server literally spoke no English other than what was on the menu (and badly at that).  Their attitude was really good - they WERE trying, but without being able to communicate, it's impossible to provide any kind of realistic service (of course, the new buffet all the time decision makes this less important most of the time).  Despite being buffet all the time, you CAN still order ala carte, so if you're in the mood for a huge order to go, this is still a great choice (but a bit on the high side for price).

Haveli has been playiong around with loaylty and internet based programs to provide delivery - we'll have to see how that works out.  The first two loyalty systems both disappeared before we could claim any of our seatings, and none of the (now 3 or 4 loyalty plans since they opened) newer loyalty systems carried forward the balances of the prior ones.  Since we've got around 40 seatings, I am hoping that some day, maybe 10 years and four more loyalty programs down the road, we can get a free meal, but...

Haveli is now an old timer in the neighborhood, and has been the Peoples Choice more than once: and they still produce EXCELLENT food, in a SUPER friendly environment!  They are one of this neighborhood's few real treasures, and we are prayng that the recent spate of restaurant closures in this area will pass by Haveli completely (it would kill me if Haveli closed. Seriously!).
name: Nonaht

text: Very nice decor, good looking bar. The staff was extremely welcoming, even shook our hands on the way out. Food was fantastic. Sometimes at steakhouses, some of the dishes are just average while others are great. Here, everything was far above average. 12 oz filet was better than some other steakhouses in Indy. Mashed potatoes and creamed spinach were delicious sides. The brussels sprouts and wedge salad might have both been the best I've ever had at a steakhouse. Everyone else I dined with loved their meals, too. They got salmon and a pesto pasta dish. Indy has a lot of good steakhouses; this one has a more unique ambiance with the flowy, wooden decor, tile floors, golds and whites. The food rivals or beats any of them. Highly recommend!
name: Cole

text: I cannot day enough good things about this place.  The table side pitcher of sangria, table side salad toss, food and the the out of this world bread pudding.  Wow.  Did I mention that if stated switch fresh baguette right out of the oven.   Woah it was soooo good.   Come hungry so you can try it all.
name: Luigi

text: The sizes have been cut in half since last time I was there. Rolls were half the diameter and Nigiri were miniaturized. Tuna nigiri was tough and fishy, when in the past I was easily able to bite through it like butter. Hopefully it was just an off night.
name: Andy

text:
I love eggs benedict and I order it wherever I go. Two Chicks Cafe gave me the best eggs benedict of my life. It brings tears to my eyes when I think of it. Picture this - two perfectly poached eggs over savory crab cakes served over a fresh croissant and topped with a cajun hollandaise. 

So delicious. 

And pairs beautifully with their refreshing lemonade! Treat yourself and get this life altering benedict!
name: Elizabeth

text: Simple, fresh and amazingly delicious!! This is seafood done right and rolled into fresh tortillas.  There's a great little fresh salsa bar, and (my pet peeve with other places) everything is served up on real dishes with silverware!  Sangria is $2.99 after 2pm and comes with fresh wedges of orange and lime.  What a great addition to the neighborhood.  We'll be back!!!
name: Pam

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text:
I had the Ay Papi bowl and it was huuuuuge. Could probably get 2 meals out of it if you aren't crazy hungry. But I of course at the whole thing in one sitting. It's all vegan so portions don't matter right? The cashew cheese sauce is to die for. I would eat this bowl again in a heart beat.

Giving them a 4/5 stars because even though the bowl was amazing the date/almond/goji berry balls were not good. Way too salty and just had no flavor. Please do not waste your money buying these.
name: Morgan

text: New Orleans is a great food town, so I expected quite a bit from this Brennan family restaurant. I was disappointed with the food and the service. The food was bland with the only outstanding dish being a very overpriced slice of warm crab cheesecake for a starter. My main was a romaine salad with half the greens inedible while the fried oysters were good not great. My daughter liked the creme brûlée. I had strawberry shortcake for dessert. And this brings me to the service. I told David, our waiter, that the strawberries and cream were great but the shortcake was very dry. He didn't respond. The next time he came by, I showed him the burnt bottom of the cake. He ignored me, again. We also noticed that he was far more attentive to a group of business men than us. I tipped at 20 percent as I always do, but I don't think we'll be back. Oh, and I asked for an espresso, and he felt the need to ask if I really wanted it, twice. Yes, I did. It was 10:00 at night, and I had a three hour drive ahead of me.
name: Amy

text: We had a great meal and Leon, our waiter, was great. He was a little busy when we first sat down but he acknowledged us and told us he would be with us as soon as he could. We both had fried chicken( tender and tasty) with red beans.  The food was everything we expected. The whole Frenchman Street experience was fantastic and we really enjoyed the "Vibe" so much more than Bourbons Street. We highly recommend this restaurant as part of that experience.
name: Craig

text:
I loved the pork buns! So much flavor and STUFFED.
- but, I feel like the amount of pork that's in 1 bun could be divided so the order would have 4 buns. In my opinion, it's just too much filling for one bun. Still very delicious though!!!

I got the Tonkotsu ramen with eggs, butter, and corn.
It was very good and very flavorful. The pork is soooo tender, but I do agree with one of the reviews below. I expected the pork to be slightly on the saltier side, it was too sweet in my opinion. (If you're Vietnamese, I feel like the meat tasted like thit kho w eggs).

Over all, very good!
name: MyLien

text: Have been back to the Whisky Lounge every time we are in town.  If you are a craft cocktails fan, check out the menu and you won't be disappointed.  No elitist attitude here, and the awesome random music playlist is solid.  If you want to just have a quality drink, that is fine.  If you want to know more about what goes into the drinks, that works too.  I had a whisky flight to help me get the difference between rye whisky, classic bourbon and more and it was a real learning experience.
name: Glenn

text: 4 of us again for lunch.   3 had the Rays Special Sub and I had the Eggplant Parmesan sandwich.   Great food.  Only problem was the French Fries were greasy.
name: Jackie

text: This was my first visit and won't be my last. Joey's was sensational. Everything was so delicious and our waiter, Gabe was terrific. Completely knowledgeable about the menu, how entrees were prepared and desserts as well. It was a very delightful evening and thoroughly enjoyed by all in our party.
name: Madeline

text: Great ribs! Excellent smoke ring. The baked beans are a titch sweet for me but good.  Burnt ends were good but would have liked more bark. Overall a nice experience!
name: Cathy

text: Nice relaxing place in Santa Barbara.  My wife loved their burgers and they are quite good.  The same thing happened to me the other night that happened to me there a year ago.  They have a really good sausage, white bean dish that comes with sautéed spinach.  The reason for 4 stars is because the spinach was very watery and it took over the plate.  The water from the cooked greens was all over the plate.  I had trout this time (which was quite good) along with spinach.  I forgot to tell the server about separating the spinach (on a small side plate) and low and behold the plate and the trout took on the water from the spinach. Really pissed me off.  It's very simple....put the wet spinach on a side plate !!!!  I can't believe this still happens over there...
name: Don

text: Awesome seasonings, flavor, true new Orleans flare. Had a similar experience in Seattle
name: Steve

text: This place is amazing! Visiting Nashville for 4 days and we stopped here randomly... and absolutely loved it. Make sure to ask for Finn he is the best server by far!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
name: Fern

text:
I had a serious hankering for chocolate cake today, so I decided to have some delivered from Pete's.  Spoiler alert:  I am still cake-less.

My food arrived early, so I was excited about that.  The fries were okay but had a bit of a Burger King quality to them.  Not bad, but nothing extraordinary.

Unfortunately, they gave me a chocolate chip cookie instead of cake.  Now, you may be thinking, "Carissa stop being a glutton, a cookie is just as good as cake--" but 1) it's not and 2) I was charged $5.00 for a $2.00 cookie.

"Three dollars?  You're angry over three dollars?"

Yes and no.  It's rare for me to treat myself and get food delivered.  If I see that a slice of cake costs $5.00, I think it must be great - and worth both the delivery fee and the unnecessary fries I ordered to reach the delivery minimum.  Now that I have below-average fries and a greasy old cookie, I'm less angry at three dollars and more angry that I bothered ordering anything.
name: Carissa

text:
This place is beautiful and beyond my expectations for a Best Western hotel!

I love how well-kept this place is! Upon entering our room, it smelled fresh and clean - everything was spick-and-span, no dust and the bathroom looked great (no mold or rust either) which gave me peace of mind knowing they truly take care of this place and care about first impressions unlike most hotels I've been to.

The breakfast is included in your stay, they have complimentary water at the front desk as well as fruit. If you're bringing a cooler they also accommodate your needs and same thing if you forget something (toothbrush/toiletries).

FYI the wifi is spotty and can be slow to load at times so be weary.. And there's also no Netflix so don't be surprised if you don't see that option on the TV.

Otherwise, they have a pool, a game room, a gym and business center.

Some plusses:
-The employee at check-in was friendly and informative
-The breakfast included a waffle-maker, and an omelet/egg chef which was a nice touch
- Decent amount of moving room


The only thing I'd suggest is maybe have raw sugar available for coffee, otherwise I didn't see it during breakfast. Also the vent for the a/c can be a little noisy in the room at times when you're trying to fall asleep - especially if you're sleeping next to it
name: Ana R

text:
Excellent food, excellent waiter, even though she doesn't eat meat. 

Beer selection is fantastic!

Don't touch the ketchup though.
name: Stan

text: I came for the indy 500 fashion friday. This is a dog friendly restaurant with a small patio. You order at the counter and they give you a buzzer that goes off when your order is ready. The spot itself is super hip with garage doors that open. We got the hog island hoagie, the cheese steak, and fries. I would 100% recommend the cheesesteak. Nothing fancy but the bread is great and the flavor of the meat is juicy and not overly salty. I felt that the hog island was huge, and a good value, but lacking in flavor. It needed some spices or pepper added. The fries were amazing. Not salty, lightly crispy, and a whole lotta potato flavor. I'll be back to try the other cheesesteaks variations!
name: Samantha

text:
Phoa-tastic.

Phoa- nominal.

We loved it.

Great service- fast and reasonable prices.

Huge portions.

Loved it.
name: Spencer

text: Unfortunately, I have found a hair in my food the last three times I visited, including tonight. The only two things I really like about Chagos are the atmosphere and the wait staff. Someone really needs to get a hairnet though. Absolutely disgusting. Not sure why I keep coming back but I'm sure this will be my last.
name: Rachel

text: Great bar and dinner atmosphere! Great wait time however be sure to reserve ahead of time if you are looking to bowl. The service was good and attentive - the food was pretty good! My favorite was the half fried chicken pictured with corn and fries. The fish sandwich was extremely yummy and highly recommended (it's grilled) and the pork ribs was good but sweet in a good way. I asked for extra sauce to use later to warm up. The steak was ok but could have been better and the chimichurri sauce added a robust flavor. Overall, great place to dine with friends!
name: Mel

text: Really in joyed the food and great atmosphere, my big hips hated the chairs! Really easy and good service!
name: Cathi

text: This restaurant is a hit with the college students. The food is just ok to me. My biggest complaint about the Qdoba restaurant in Edwardsville, Il is that their cleaning techniques caused me to have an asthma attack. My family was eating there on Friday, May 31st and for some reason I felt the urge to cough. I looked over and noticed a female worker cleaning tables. Every table around us had been spayed with cleaning solution. Before it was all over, the whole restaurant smelled like Chorox. I was coughing and having a hard time catching my breath, and the food my family was eating started tasting like cleaning solution. We ended up having to finish our meal at the outside seating area. I will note that I have never been diagnosed with asthma. The reason I had breathing difficulty was solely because of the strong chemical smell being used in an unventilated area.  It would be nice for the cleaning to be done at a later time since the restaurant wasn't due to close for another 2 hours and for a less offensive cleaning solution to be used.
name: Stephanie

text:
Absolutely the worst Outback I have ever been to. 45 minute wait was not bad besides the fact there were 8 tables ready to go when we got there. Another 45 minutes waiting on our food. Food was okay... drinks set empty for at least 15 minutes while I had to find the waitress.. over 2 hours for poor food and service. Wow!!!
I'm not much of a complainer but wow!!!
name: Chris

text: EXCELLENT CONCH SALAD!!! Oh my goodness, it is SOOO delicious! I first fell in love with conch salad in the Bahamas and I've been dying to get my hands on some here in Florida. Lucky for me, I can find Bahamian Style conch salad right here in Clearwater. The Conch Czar (the owner) is super nice, and makes the conch salad fresh right there on the spot if you come in and order it. I highly recommend this place. He said soon he will be back on Uber Eats and I will certainly be ordering all the time.
name: Maegan

text:
If I could I'd give it a 3.5 for several reasons. 

Went at around 10am, they stop serving breakfast at 11am, and by the time we were in line they were out of everything (glazed donuts, biscuits, those kolache wrap thingies, like everything but donuts). Some of this seems like poor planning, considering they should still be selling breakfast items for another hour. Realized their staple item (glazed) was out because a few seconds before we got in line someone ordered like 5 boxes of glazed...how is that ok?

Ended up getting about 4 different donuts, figured I'd eat them the next day. Had the best jelly donut of my life, only to discover my boyfriend (who also got a jelly donut) had about triple the jelly that mine did! 

Womp womp, still holy-crap delicious but inconsistent and made me pretty jelly (pun intended) that my boyfriend serendipitously picked the juicier one. Chocolate glazed was average and banana cream two days later was still pretty banging.

I get that they're busy, but some of the faults in my opinion are basic restaurant managing 101.
name: Jessica

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Price felt a touch high for what it was. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Overall, a strong experience.
name: User

text:
Delicious Pork Chop!!! A must in New Orleans ;)
Service was good , even though they were very busy.
name: Cristina

text:
So St Louis you did it again. Now maybe we deserve what we got because we came in with 30 people. 

So this is supposed to be a very good Italian restaurant ( look at their average score and I guess that says it all) but Italian nonetheless. 

First they brought bread. Not Italian bread, but store bought white loaf. It wasn't even hot. It was cold. Do you think they had the standard olive oil with balsamic vinegar? No, just packaged butter. 

I ordered their clam chowder. Store bought potato soup. 

Entree shrimp in their carbonara sauce. If you can't make carbonara sauce as an Italian, no bueno. Well it tasted like spaghetti sauce. The waitress brought out another dish that she said was carbonara but it was the standard white looking one that I am used to. I said that must be mine because mine doesn't taste right. She said no. Mine was the red carbonara sauce and the other one was the white carbonara sauce. Have you ever heard of that in your life?

Needless to say this place was a disappointment. I should have taken the locals advice and went up the the hill.
name: Cordero

text: I have never in my life been so physically uncomfortable in a restaurant. That the owners of Zeppoli serve 5 star food (and it is) while you are expected to sit in a chair made for a kindergartener is beyond comprehension. I walked in, looked at those $5 wooden chairs with no cushion, no real backs and was so disappointed this is how I was supposed to "relax" and enjoy my meal. Then I sat, and the featherweight chair slid around the floor every time I breathed; also had to put my bag on the hard floor... That everything we ordered was wonderful just makes this all the more frustrating. Why on earth do they not immediately remedy this situation by purchasing ANY kind of decent chairs for this one tiny room??? It's inexcusable. They will never be a really great restaurant so long as they make ignorant, careless choices that directly detract from the dining experience. I'd sooner get my meal to go than make a reservation here again. Please invest in your business. This is all so avoidable.
name: T

text: Absolutely everything was amazing. First time in Santa Barbara, if I'm ever back I'm definitely coming here. Would love to try everything on the menu haha
name: Jackie

text: Can't beat Tuesdays $2 tacos! All the food was excellent. Friendly staff even after we came in really late. I'll be going back!
name: Stacy

text: Chicken lovers- this one's for you! So many ways to get some poultry dishes in your life. Plus- the cocktails. Crafted in house so you can sip on some creative cocktails. Although some of them are out there, you also have a great list of wine + beers for your drinking pleasure. Coolest vibe and location, you'll feel super cool or out of place once you walk in. Stay and enjoy a great meal. (Also....get the appetizer with hot pepper jelly.) (its waaaaay too good)
name: Gretchen

text:
This place! Got invited to this amazing place by someone who tried Taco Tuesday and begged us to come see. Took the drive and was not disappointed at all. In fact, I'm
not I've been more impressed. The environment was clean and cute and authentic. The staff was super friendly and efficient and had great recommendations. Prices were very average for non-average menu.

I had a Raspberry Margarita and it was one of the best Margaritas I've had. It was so good that I didn't think they added alcohol until my body felt like I was floating.

I ordered the Queso with chorizo. Omg. Life changing. The salsa was also amazing and had that citrus cilantro tang. Perfect. 

I ordered the chicken enchiladas with green sauce and light cream, refried beans, and rice. Perfect! Tasted like fresh homemade cooking.

My friend ordered the taco plate (street tacos). Anywhere else we go I always order a lime with it. This meat did not need it! The only thing we added salt to was the chips.

Other friend ordered something with shrimp. The shrimp was huge. He also ordered a shrimp cocktail and said it was good but he's had better.

Even the water was good. Oh, and the bathrooms and other decor is very unique. We left right as a small band was setting up unfortunately. Maybe next time I'll plan ahead and stick around.
name: S

text: The food was good and as expected but the service was excellent. Very friendly host and waitress.
name: Mike

text:
1st: the food was phenomenal! As an avid foodie and chef I can personally say ... it's VERY GOOD!
2nd: they have a rooftop garden and use seasonal produce in their dishes.
3rd: The service and atmosphere is great!

Definitely try it out :)
name: Roice

text:
Just a few blocks from Vanderbilt University campus, Amerigo was a great place to get dinner after a football game.   The food was delicious and the service excellent.  Salads were fresh and the soup quite yummy. 
Highly encourage reservations for weekend evenings.  We got lucky and found a table around the bar which was open seating.  Otherwise, we would have had a small wait.
name: Jo

text: First time I came for a new experience with my daughter.. We  had a wonderful brunch she had the breakfast  enchiladas and was blown away with the explosion of flavors in her mouth. She stayed how it was a perfect balance of spicy without being hot and how all the flavor complimented each other.  I ordered the  shrimp and grits with pork belly and it delivered. I am a southern born East coast raised guy. Best of both words I'd say. The texture of the grits was spot on and shrimp were carmelized to perfection. What's was presented as a simply dish was really uniquely complex and made to look simple. The flavors came togather naturally no need for salt pepper or any additions and the pok belly was the icing on the cake. It added a subtle yet flavorful twist that was well received.  We also tried the bananas foster French toast.  For a nominal charge we ordered a slice and it didnt dissapoint either. How nice to have a local gem and new family favorite so close to home.
name: Christopher

text: I work in an office in the same plaza, that being said this parking lot is always full - especially on weekends. I always order eggs Benedict, very good lots of homemade hollandaise, and an extra slice of cheese:) Carla, the manager and the owners always treat us very well. Coffee is very good also! 5 Stars

text:
Un-Pho-King-Believably good. 

Visited on Sunday 2-11-18 at 12:30pm. $13.80 got us a kids bowl of pho and an order of fried rice. Service is somewhat slow but adequate and friendly for how busy they are. 

The building itself is a bit neglected...they still had their Christmas decorations up. It's not the cleanest restaurant I've ever been in...especially the bathrooms. And there's a weird abandoned fish tank right as you walk in the door full of algae. But the delicious food certainly makes up for the ambiance. 

The $4.95 baby size chicken pho comes with noodles, broth, and chicken chunks. The chicken was freshly cooked and juicy and the noodles were perfectly cooked. The broth was very mild and not very herbal like most I've had. I liked it a lot...but I'm not a purist. 

The $7.95 chicken fried rice was absolutely delicious. It had big chunks of freshly cooked juicy chicken, peas, carrots, egg, onion, and bean sprouts. It had a slightly charred umami flavor that made it delightfully crave-worthy and the bean sprouts were still crunchy. I give it 5 stars! 

Perhaps it's a little dingy and a little too Americanized but enjoyable nonetheless. I'd definitely go back.
name: Rachel

text:
Remoulade is known as the "casual side" of the fancy restaurant Arnaud's. While Arnaud's is located on Bienville, Remoulade is around the corner on Bourbon Street in the French Quarter of New Orleans, but still attached to Arnaud's.

After settling into our hotel we walked around the corner and stumbled upon Remoulade. The place looked more casual and not dumpy and divey like most places on Bourbon. There is a beautiful marble oyster bar across from the main bar. The dining space isn't huge, but big enough to take a breather from the little space you get walking down Bourbon.

Our bartender was Matt and he was FANTASTIC. He answered our thousands of questions about New Orleans cuisine, where to go, what to do, etc. He was extremely knowledgable and friendly. Unfortunately for Remoulade, he is moving to Oregon in the near future. Best wishes to you on your new endeavors, Matt!

The food is delicious. The filé gumbo (chicken and andouille sausage) was my favorite. I went back the next day and had some more. The portion is a decent size and well worth $6. I learned here that filé is a thickening agent used in some gumbo to give it more flavor. I definitely enjoyed the filé gumbos more than gumbo prepared with just flour.

Two words: muffaletta pizza. You won't regret it. It's basically the famous muffaletta sandwich without all the bread and on a thin pizza crust. The sauce is an olive salad base. I HATE olives, but the olive salad (which is packed with olives) mixes well with the cheese, meats and herbs. Think Italian Sub on a pizza. YUM. I wanted it again the next night, but opted for the blackened chicken pizza which was equally as good in its own way.

Got to try a wing after being offered from two drunk men at the bar. Obviously took that opportunity. Wings resembled deep friend chicken. Nice, heavy breading and batter that was spiced within the breading. So the coating was great. Unfortunately, I like the meat inside well done and these were very slimy, veiny and red.

The French 75 is so tasty and refreshing. Remoulade makes theirs with cognac rather than gin, the proper New Orleans way. Small selection of beer, but decent beers nonetheless. Maker's Old Fashion was also great. Matt enjoys his craft and taking care of his guests and we were grateful to have lots of passion go into our drinks and service.

They have a great selection of food from unique appetizers to individual pizzas, sandwiches/po' boys, hotdogs to classic cajun/creole dishes to wonderful stuffed blue crab and a raw oyster bar. Definitely a place worth checking out. Ask for recommendations because they are honest and everything recommended to us was well worth it. If we make our way to New Orleans again we will definitely be back!

text:
This is seriously the best restaurant in NOLA *dreamy heart eyes* If/when I come back, I'm for sure coming here first. My friends and I stayed in the area for about a week, and trust me when we say we literally ate our way through New Orleans. Of everything, this was our favorite place of them all. So good that I even ordered a dozen chargrilled oysters to go home with me on the 4 hour plane ride back to California. *no shame*

TLDR;; this is the happiest place on earth, should be your #1 food stop in NOLA! And get the chargrilled oysters!!

From the hostess to the server to the bartender, everyone was so welcoming, attentive and just..so nice! For 3, we definitely got too excited since we ordered 18 oysters, 4 sides, an appetizer and an entree. Seriously, everything was amazing and did not disappoint. As a tourist, I wanted to try all the different types of food NOLA was known for, so I liked that Royal House didn't specialize in just one thing, and instead, had a good variety on their menu for us to pick from.

*Chargrilled Oysters: THE BEST in town!! I don't know what they do, but it was just enough Parmesan, garlic and all the goods on top of a perfectly grilled oyster. Will make you switch over from being a raw oyster fan

*Raw Oysters: Fresh, large and shucked right in front of you! What else could we ask for?

* Crab Craws Appetizer: Oh man, the crabs are so fresh and meaty, and the sauce is to die for!!! 

*Taste of New Orleans: 3 small cup-bowls of Jambalaya, Crawfish Etoufee, and Chicken/Andouille Gumbo--if you're new to the area like I was, this will give you a sample of the popular dishes of NOLA!

For the sides, we got rice and beans, fries, hush puppies and garlic mashed potatoes. If you're on the fence about ordering these, just go for it :)
name: Sarah

text: Very tasty food. Not particularly spicy, but the flavours were really good. There was a mix up with putting my order in. The owner put in my appetizer (pork and sticky rice) and intended to put in my entree so that it would be hot and fresh when I was ready. He forgot to put it in, but both he and the staff were very kind and quick to fix their mistake when I pointed it out. As an entree I had the green curry with duck. The duck had really good flavor and was perfectly cooked. There's also a huge selection of craft beer (bottles and cans), and the owner said he has over 400 whiskeys! There is a reason this restaurant has been top ranked in St. Louis. Don't let the exterior fool you, this is a casual but awesome Thai restaurant!

text: I came here for some sweet sustenance before hitting up the National WWII museum. I needed the energy to power through all the exhibits! I came around 11 on a Tuesday and it wasn't crowded. The restaurant is long and narrow with lots of wood and an exposed brick wall. It has an industrial factory feel to it. Their donut flavors rotate but they have regular flavors like a creme brûlée cinnamon roll and a brown butter drop donut. Typically I prioritize rotating flavors over regular flavors with the logic that the regulars will always be there but after hearing such great things about the regulars (they're regulars for a reason!) I went with those two. No regrets. The cinnamon roll was delicious but be forewarned it is a sugar bomb. The brûléed sugar crystals were perfection and the cinnamon roll was light and fluffy. The brown butter drop is kind of the opposite of the cinnamon roll - dense/cakey in texture and significantly less sweet. It has a brown butter glaze on top to add some sweetness. As different as they were I thoroughly enjoyed them both. Definitely recommend stopping by if you're in the area.

text:
I'm giving four stars because I'm rounding up from 3.5. Food is definitely four stars...carne asada has great flavor, tortillas and chips are made fresh in front of you. Topping like jalapeño relish and pickled onions are great. 

I know this place is fairly new, but there are some kinks to be worked out. First of all...the fly problem.  I've never seen a fly ON my food or the food (that the prepare fresh in front of you) however I've been there three times and all three times the flies have been everywhere. They have sort of an open air concept, with indoor seating and outdoor seating. The outdoor seating is at a window that is basically connected to the kitchen area (so the employees can serve the patrons at the outside bar.) I know many restaurants in the area have similar concepts and I've never noticed a fly problem there, but I also can't think of anywhere the outside seating is connected to the kitchen/prep area. Hopefully the owners or managers will figure something out to combat this issue. 

Other minor issues...salsa sides aren't large enough for the chip orders. I almost always never use all of my salsa at other places but here I find myself still scraping the cup with a handful of chips still in the bag. Also...I was ordering my food to go today and asked for a cup for water. I was offered a really tiny cup and asked if they had a lid that fit it, as I was going to be driving. She said no, I would have to pay for a larger cup if I wanted one with a lid. 

This is a good addition to the St Pete food/taco scene but they have a few SMALL kinks to work out.  It food has tons of flavor!

text:
Had high expectations coming here since
I've mainly heard good things from friends and food advisory. Ordered the Cuban Sandwich, and my girlfriend ordered the Paella Espanola for lunch. Both of which are supposed to be specialities here. The Cuban I would rate a 6/10 and the Paella a 3/10. For dessert, we finished with the Guava Turnover, a 5/10. 

The chicken in the Paella tasted like reheated leftovers from a meal you had last weekend, and the seafood was far from fresh. Almost inedible. The Cuban was decent, but in a place known for delicious Cubans like Tampa - I've had much better at other eateries in the area. 

The Guava Pastry was not bad but very underwhelming. I suspect we mainly liked it, because we simply like guava. A Publix Guava Pastry re-plated would've probably tasted similar. 

The service left much to be desired as well. The servers here are very nice, but are managed poorly. The system of two waiters simultaneously per visit made it confusing and left many things forgotten. Water was hardly topped off, butter for bread forgotten, etc. 

Overall, would not recommend coming here for the food unless you want to visit just for its historical value.
