The restaurant has a great vibe and cool options inside or outside. Definitely going back!
name: Anne

text: On December 20, myself, my 2 adult children and 1 other adult male ate dinner at Talaynas restaurant in Chesterfield MO at 141 and Olive Blvd. My kids got sick 36 hours later (vomiting and diarrhea) I got sick (vomiting only) 48 hours after meal and daughters boyfriend got sick (diarrhea only) 36 hours after meal. The bread served with the salad had to be sent back as it didn't seemed done. We all had pizza and salad as the common foods. The above statement was sent to the Board of Health. Other observations. Very dirty restaurant. Waitress didn't seem to have knowledge of the menu. Kept making mistakes and apologizing asking us not to hate her. Kept making excuses for kitchen mistakes and not having items on the menu prepped. Haven't been to Talaynas in many years and won't ever go back. My son who is a server at a different restaurant heard nightmare stories of this restaurant but decided to see for himself. All confirmed. STAY AWAY!!
name: Jeff

text: It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Definitely coming back. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: This may be a controversial statement but I think I like the food better here than SukhoThai! We ordered the Tiger Tears appetizer (because with a name like that, how could we not?!) and I was surprised at how good the beef tasted. But the entrees were the real star. Pad Thai and drunken noodles were just perfect. I want a dispenser of both in my kitchen. The service was a little odd, but honestly that was kind of fun...I think our waitress may have been one of only 2 servers there on a Friday night so they were busy. It's a tiny place, but clean and tastefully decorated and I will absolutely be visiting again soon!
name: Molly

text: Meant to write this yesterday and completely forgot. So here it goes. This is a very inconspicuous place l. I found it on yelp and wanted to give it a try. When you walk in, you seat yourself. I went at 8am on a Saturday and it wasn't too busy. It was steady but not so busy that I had to wait for a table. It took a few moments for the waitress to approach us. It was a little slow on the start but then once she came over it went great. The coffee was hot and delicious. I got the biscuits and gravy with 2 eggs while my friend got the steak and eggs. I don't think the biscuits are homemade, but they were hot and soft so I'm not complaining about that. The gravy was phenomenal. The steak and eggs were perfect. The waitress checked on us a number of times. All and all it was a great visit so I'm not deducting anything. The price was affordable too. I'll definitely go back some time.
name: Rebecca

text: I got a seeded bagel with herb and garlic cream cheese, tomato and bacon. This sandwich was not very good at all- and it takes a lot for me to NOT enjoy this, as it's my go-to breakfast at cafes like Metro. Coffee was good and prices were very fair.
name: Michael

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
I had a work lunch meeting here. 
Ordered a soup and salad combo so the salad portion was smaller. 
Their take on French onion soup - Onion Ale - was very good with a rich deep beef flavor but not overly sweet. For the second half of my l got their  Roasted Beet & Tuscan Kale salad. It was very nice with the tangy goat cheese balancing out the sweetness of the beets and candied walnuts. 
I will definitely keep them in mind when getting lunch in the future especially since they have a grab & go take out shop next door.
name: Zanna

text:
Okay, here goes! This is an abbreviated review as we only sampled one dish. Backstory: We have family coming into town for the Air Races and our endeavor is to find something that isn't in a casino or a chain and won't break the bank. Saw the signs a while back, so Zeppelin got a chance. Today was the day.

Take away:

Service is awesome!

Food: 

The short rib street tacos are the bomb! I have a small appetite, but could have eaten all four, which is going something for me! Melt in your mouth! Further, the smaller plate concept encourages one to try something out-of-their comfort zone. I like it!

Drinks:

Finally! A not-watered-down straight up Martini! 

Only criticism is that the menu was a bit confusing. Handed three. I saw dishes arrive that I didn't see straight away on the menu. Hubby said he did. I didn't

Overall:

We'll be back! Not cheap, but not off the rails! Great job!
name: Donna

text: Talk about variety!  A gazillon options are available for these tacos.  The hard corn shells are crunchy and light. I tried three separate proteins: roasted chicken, Tex Mex ground beef and chorizo. The chicken was moist, the beef was good and the chorizo was mildly spiced with a hint of cinnamon. I thought Lex my server was very friendly, knowledgeable and efficient. The food came out of the kitchen fast considering it was straight up noon.    The spice levels are mild though, the hottest red salsa offered was pretty tame by any chili aficionados standards. Over all a pleasant hang for lunch.
name: David

text: Enjoyed my first time here tonight.  The good had good flavor, served fresh and hot. If back in this area I would definitely come again.
name: Tamiko

text:
I haven't been here in a while but after moving back to the city, we came here recently for a late dinner.

The food was excellent!  No wonder the place is always packed.  

We ordered the whipped ricotta, fish and chips and buttermilk fried chicken.  Everything was delicious.  They even had live music which was a nice touch.
name: T

text:
Mexican Street grilled corn w/chipotle mayo and cojita cheese. A bit too chipotle mayo for me, but it was very tasty with amazing starchy corn flavor. Not a mayo fan, but the addition of the chipotle got me over that. I would order this for sure if I could get light mayo. 

Short rib tacos. Big chunk of beef short rib and pickled onions. Great flavor in the beef. 

Korean pork tacos served with mini short riblets on the side. I didn't taste this, but my daughter said they were amazing. I love Asian pear and that was added to the beef. 

Chopped salad
Arugula, cabbage and lettuce mix, dice tomatoes, corn, cojita, diced fried flour tortilla, pickled red onions. I chose a side of avocado ranch and sherry vinaigrette.  The 2 dressings were great together. Sitting outside was a great level of entertainment w/people watching.
name: Tim

text:
We went their restaurant this past Thursday evening with the expressed purpose to go to their happy hour.  We were told happy hour was only Mon. through Wed. However, their web site said Happy hour was Mon. through Thurs.  Even their marquee indicated happy on Thur. when I passed their restaurant the previous Sunday. When we pointed that out, management would not budge and would not give us happy hour prices. The waiter and waitress were very nice about the situation and apologetic.
Overall their food is very good, service is excellent, but their advertising is terrible.
Ken O.
name: Karen

text: Excellent food but the waitress was extremely rude and unfriendly. We have eaten there many time and have always had good service. The waitress today was the worst hostess that we have ever encountered. She needs to get a different job or she will scare off all of the locals.
name: Julie

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was crowded but still moved along. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It was crowded but still moved along. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: We visited toast prior to part of our group leaving New Orleans. The cafe was small & cute, the staff was helpful and the food was pretty quick! (We had a slight time crunch to get part of our party out of town). My sister & I shared a croque Madame - very good, the grits were fantastic. I didn't have the avocado toast, but it looked really good! The ingredients were fresh and of good quality. Would recommend :)
name: Jenny

text:
I ate the lunch special (Roasted Chicken w/ Rice) and it was the best I had in Pennsylvania. Definitely coming back! 

Also I heard the restaurant was under new management.
name: Yash

text: They have the Incredible Burger and it does taste like a real beef burger. Great location, great drinks, nice atmosphere and friendly staff. They also serve food a bit later than some of the other restaurants downtown. When we got there 15 minutes before closing time, they still welcomed us and let us order food.
name: Pam

text:
You've had Pho, awesome, If you're more adventurous, you've had Bun bo Hue.

But to reach the next level in Vietnamese noodle soup is Mi Quang. 
Not many places serve this dish. Because it's hard as ballz to get right.

This place lives up to it's name, because their Mi Quang is heavenly.
Eggrolls are so tasty and filled with meat rather than dough or eggroll skin. 

The banh mi are the bees knees. I get 5 deserts to bring home because I'm stuffed when I am done.

Nothing on washington ave even comes close to this gem in Kensington.

Another amazing thing to see is the number of regular Philadelphians eating there. This place has staked their claim as the best Vietnamese restaurant I've ever been to in the USA, yes even better then Cali or Houston.
name: Mc To

text: The Pollo Diablo is honestly one of the best chicken dishes I've ever had. It's salty and sweet and the the green chile mashed potatoes are excellent. The whole meal was delicious, and our server, Zac, was on top of everything. We'll totally be back!
name: Tatiana

text: Excellent, excellent!  Wonderful dinner and superb bar.  I have the fried oysters appetizer with sea scallops for my main course. My partner had a salad and a delicious veal chop. Great friendly service in authentic atmosphere. Only quibbling is that we had to wait to be seated even though we had a reservation. But it was a busy time pre Mardi Gras.
name: Lani

text: This was the worst service I've ever had! My husband had ordered breadsticks for our granddaughter who was arriving after us. We never got them. His beer had to be taken back to the bar twice to be opened! He was asked to repeat what he ordered 3 times! Twice by waitress and once by manager. My meal never came. I took it to go since my family had all eaten before my meal came!
name: Michelle

text: I've been working in the food service industry for quite some time. This had to be the worst experience I have ever had. 4 adults 2 kids. 25 minutes for drinks (2 bottle beers, 1 draft beer, 2 waters, and a kids apple juice box). 45 minutes for food (did not serve the kids at all until entire meal came out). One food entree was 10 minutes later. 2nd round of drinks was around 15 minutes. Did not have the bill correct and added an 18% gratuity to the bill without informing us. Management said they were busy and did not offer any discount but to only correct the issues that were wrong. Did end up granting us a 50% discount reluctantly. My wife and I frequent the TGIFridays in Plano TX and do not have any of these problems there, however; because of this experience we will not be going back.
name: Randall

text: I visit this small restuarant because I stay at the Marriott playing bridge for 10 days. I have visit it 2 times and it is as good as most sushi places in the San Francisco area.  I like the sashimi sushi binto box.
name: peter

text:
Best New York style food 
Everyone gotta try it 
Try their philly steak 
Or Reuben hot
name: King87Io

text: Came in only for cocktails. Got bloody mary and vodka water. Drinks are welled poured and reasonable. Bar is fun but not loud, if ever in Indy stop in.
name: Joe

text: First and Last Time. I enjoyed my small portion of food, however most of the tables, floors and mens room were dirty. In addition the staff did not know the menu.
name: Gregory

text:
Best Gyro ever.

I've had King Tuts in the past, and it's always been consistently good! But tonight, I had their Lamb Gyro Salad for the first time. For an extra $1, I got my salad topped with feta...so worth it.

This was maybe the best Gyro I've ever had. The meat was tender and flavorful. The cheese, the sauce, the fresh veggies.. it was a party in my mouth. They were very generous with ALL the toppings and didn't skimp in the least. I walked away feeling oh so satisfied, and with a very full, happy belly. Well worth the $12.

Only thing that could have made it more amazing is if there had been some tabbouleh!!
name: Hattie

text: Not as good as it used to be. Two recent meals were subpar. Good service remains. Menu hasn't changed in years. Some specials aren't so good. Red fish special at my last visit was not up to their usual standard and was expensive.
name: Mark

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
This place should be called Crawl, not Marathon.  While the food is decent and the prices are reasonable, the speed of the service was beyond slow. 

My friend and I walked past Marathon after going to the Kimmel Center.  The menu looked good and the prices were surprisingly reasonable for the area, so we stopped in.  The atmosphere was welcoming: imagine steakhouse meets fair trade coffee shop (I know that's a hard atmosphere to conjure, but I swear it's the most accurate). Warm but focused on natural woods and cool lighting but you can tell they definitely serve meat ...

Anyway, the menu was basic Americana - burgers, salads, sandwiches, and a couple of more expensive entrees. Here's where things got a little rocky.  Our server was painfully unaware of what their rotating drafts were (I'm sorry, but telling someone it's a Yards does not describe the beer ...) and it took at least 15 minutes to get our drinks after ordering (we each got a beer on tap). After we got our drinks and ordered it took another 30 minutes to get our food which was a burger and crab cakes. The food was solid and the sweet potato fries were quite delicious but just not worth the wait.

Overall, this place was just mediocre and probably not worth seeking it out given all the other options around.
name: Kirsten

text: One of my favorite restaurants in St Pete! It's always my go-to for date night or when guests are in town! The food is always delicious and I've tried almost everything on the menu! The fat noodles with short rib and the burger with truffle fries are my two favorites!
name: Monica

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: Service 10/10. Food 11/10 &&&& happy hour 7 days a week 11-6 first time here was a success!!!
name: Amber

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. For the price I expected more than this. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Honestly, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. so yeah kind of mixed on it. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
My husband and I have had sushi dates for the past ten years at various places around the city. We have come to prefer Ikura to the competition for many reasons. The quality for price of the food is exceptional. The service is top notch. We have never dined in the hibachi section as it's not really our thing but we've been wowed by watching from afar. I would like to thank the staff and especially the female staff member handling take out orders tonight (I wish I had gotten her name because she was everything someone in hospitality should be for going above and beyond the call of duty. A new chef prepared one of our rolls incorrectly and they fixed the problem immediately. The staff went above and beyond the call of duty for us tonight as they have every time we've dined there. I will miss one of our favorite front of house employees who has moved to help the owners open a new restaurant but the experience remains the same: outstanding. My son enjoys the crawfish roll, Kraken roll, as well as any of the 2 piece sushi we've ordered for him. My husband and I love the Angry Bird. Whatever you order, you will likely find yourself pleased! 

***UPDATE: Very disappointed in the service and food tonight but that is not my primary reason for updating this review. Tonight I attempted to use a gift card that I had been given as compensation for a previously disappointing experience at Ikura and was told that they cannot accept gift cards at this time and something about switching to a new computer system which prevents them from taking gift cards for a few weeks. Instead of just taking an item off the bill and shredding my card, they just shrugged and insisted I had to pay fully. I will not be returning to Ikura and cannot recommend them. Additionally, there were hairs on my menu, hairs in my crawfish roll, and a hair on my husband's plate. Really disappointing because I used to love Ikura before they sent some of their excellent front of house staff to open a new restaurant in Georgia.
name: Rudi

text: You would think such a great quality, wide array of options would be high-priced, but the prices were perfectly reasonable! I'm also a vegetarian and I never have any problems whenever I come here with my carnivore, barbecue-expert friends!!!
name: Kacy

text: We love George's!  Great for an intimate dinner for 2 or a larger group!  Recently hosted a graduation celebration in their banquet room and the team at George's made our celebration a memorable one!  Food was ready to be served right as the party started and tasted awesome!  Great suggestions for menu items that worked well for our group and foid was plentiful!  Our servers, Chelsea and Joel, kept drinks full and did a great job managing the room and treating all our guests well!  Selecting George's for our event was the best decision!
name: Lynn

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text:
To start off, I'll just say that I have pretty high pho standards. I ordered the bun bo hue and my bae ordered pho chin. 

- Atmosphere: pretty spacious, a lot of tables, one small bathroom available in the back. It did kind of gross me out that the bathroom is SO close and directly facing towards the opening of the kitchen... 

- Service: service was alright, not excellent they didn't fill up our waters or ask how we were doing 

- bun bo hue: the broth was actually quite good, the soup was very flavorful not too spicy just the right amount and the noodles were very good. Some of the meat tasted a little too meaty and was pretty dry - it was hard to eat.

-pho chin: broth was excellent but noodles were strangely hard and chewy. Beef brisket was ok.

- pad Thai: this was amazingly good here! So much flavor and noodles were soft. All the spices melted into one another. 

Probably wouldn't come here again but wouldn't avoid it completely. Overall it was below average to me.
name: Shannon

text:
There is no shortage of BBQ in Middle Tennessee. Trying to come to this party as a newcomer is no easy task. Charcoal Cowboys does it well, and largely due to a lot of BBQ completion experience under their belts. 

The owners have been doing BBQ competitions for years, and it shows when you bite into the meat. Brisket with an excellent flavor. Pulled pork that melts in your mouth. Ribs that's slide off the bone if you stare long enough at them!

They have a unique ordering method that works by-pound. This lets you mix and match whatever your favorites are in any ratio you like. Only being open a week now they have tons of energy and passion that you can feel just walking in the door. 

I'm so excited to have another BBQ place in town that is actually worth going to. Lennox Village has never smelled so good!
name: Jonathan

text: Food was absolutely amazing. Food came out right away and service was good. Best food in New Orleans yet!
name: Victoria

text: I have ordered sandwiches from Rybread probably more than any other place on Grubhub. I keep coming back because everything is fresh, tasty, and not too expensive for the amount of food you get. I have never had something I did not like: the new york panini (ruben), the napa panini (mozzarella and tomato panini with pesto and balsamic), the buffalo chicken panini, and my favorite, the caesar salad. I usually get two meals out of a single sandwich and salad order, and at around $20 you cannot go wrong with that.
name: K

text: Went here to grab some dinner. Waited five minutes there and not one employee even acknowledged me. Very slow and disorganized, multiple employees trying to perform the same tasks. Eventually just walked out.
name: Carlos

text: They give you a lot of food (and charge you for it), but the food is generally just okay.  Gets a large crowd of local office workers, especially cops (they probably give them a discount), on weekdays for lunch.  I would have given them three stars if the owner, a large white lady, hadn't been so rude to a customer while I was there.
name: El

text: Tried the Saturday Salisbury Steak and was not disappointed.  Big portions and excellent flavor. Staff and owner make you feel welcome. This is my new place to go...
name: Sue

text: Omg.  This place is last on my list now in New Orleans.  Waited forever for food to come out.  When it arrived it was cold.  I was told the special I ordered was a roasted fish with a baked potato.  When it arrived it was a grilled fish on brabant potatoes.  I asked where my baked potato was and she pointed to the cubed Brabant potatoes and tried to convince me that it was baked potato.  LOL.  I asked to speak to the manager and they never showed up.  STAY AWAY!
name: Trish

text:
My family and I had my mother's retirement dinner at Pesto and it was a huge success. We were a party of 12 with 4 small children and they were so accommodating! We were given a semi-private room in the back which was perfect for us.  

They gave us some appetizers compliments of the house which was really nice!  The food came out quickly and was delicious. 
I had the gnocchis in a rosé sauce and they melted in my mouth! 

At the end of the meal, they gave my mom a piece of cake with a sparkler for her celebration (we didn't even request it). 

They really treated us like we were part of their family and we all really had a great time. 

Thank you Pesto for making my mother's retirement dinner so special.
name: Stacey

text: Visiting from Texas. I had the ribs. Just pulled off the bone. The cole slaw was delicious and the pinto beans had just the right amount of heat. Super good bar b que.   I highly recommend!
name: Mary

text: Came here today to check out the build your own six pack area. I'm not much of a beer drinker, but there were a good selection of ciders that I was happy to see. The price foe the six pack ended up being $21 which was less than I expected to pay. I'll come back to try more ciders and build my own six pack again.
name: Whitney

text:
This is one of my favorite Mexican food chains- however, this one needs work. After waiting way longer than neccessary for chips and salsa my waitress finally comes to take my drink order. Then she brings it with no straw and leaves before I can ask for one. 
She finally returns to take my order and grabs a straw from the bar. This is about twenty minutes in. Not once after my entree arrived did she refill my drink or even walk over to check on me. The food is good but service is terrible. Upon finishing my meal I had to hunt someone down for my check after sitting there waiting an additional five to ten minutes. I will not be returning to this location.
name: Valerie

text: This place has an amazing ambiance and really tasty spicy margaritas ! Upon approaching the place, I wasn't sure how I would feel about how it holds up to surrounding places and I must say it held up pretty well ! The steak nachos were awesome and fresh. They accommodated our party of 6 although we had no reservations. The only reason this place is a 4 star is because of the lack of diversity in the menu... they focus on tacos which is fine but for someone like me who enjoys a variety it really missed the mark. I will also say that their mild wings are exceptional.
name: William

text:
Yummy subs and good service! One of my subs was free due to the point accumulation, so yay!
Nice location. Clean. Friendly. Will go again.
name: Liz

text: This is my favorite cantina in town. The tacos are so good!!! They have everything from cauliflower tacos to shrimp tacos to brisket tacos. There is also a café connected to the restaurant that serves unique popsicles (avocado pop is my fav), coffee, pastries, etc. Not to mention the outdoor area out back is huge and coveted. I come here once a week for the Taco Tuesday special.
name: Ashley

text:
El Rey is a fantastic Mexican restaurant in Philly, and it's made even better by the fact that you can be in the queue for Ramstead Room while you eat!

I came in with a group of 6, and we were seated at a table almost immediately. We put in our order for several pitchers of margs, and those showed up pretty quickly as well. The traditional and guava margs we got were both excellent and quite strong. 

For food, we started off with a guacamole sampler platter, which came with watermelon, pineapple, tahini, and truffle oil guacs. They were all honestly incredible, as were the tortilla chips that came with. For the entree, I split the $30 taco platter with 2 other people, and it was the perfect amount of food. We got to try (I think) 6 different tacos, as well as several other goodies that came in the platter. The food was absolutely delicious, and the sheer quantity we got was filling for all three of us. 

After paying for our superb meal, we only had to wait a few more minutes before making our way to Ramstead. You should definitely plan to link the two together if you can.
name: Luca

text: Beautiful scenery and great music.  I had the jumbalaya, which was sooooo good.  Service was prompt and the music great!
name: Kourtney

text:
The appetizers were great. We had the four dolma and the meeza (may have spelled that incorrectly).     I had the pistachio kebab, which was ground lamb and pistachio. It was good, but it was basically two mini meat loaves with nothing served with it except a stewed tomato. Some rice or something as a side would have been nice.  Also, I ordered a Diet Coke and it was served in a mini coke bottle.... which seemed kind of strange and definitely not worth the price of a soda.  Overall the food was good, with the appetizers being my favorite. 

The service was very mediocre. We sat for a very long time before we were even given water.  Also, at the beginning they asked we wanted separate checks (two couples). We said that we did, but they forgot to do it and told us they'd just split it down the middle.  This wasn't too big of a deal for us, but it was frustrating that they asked, we answered and they still didn't do it.  The staff is very nice, it just seems really unorganized.  I'm not in a hurry to go back, but I would recommend it to anyone wanting to try Turkish food.
name: Lois

text:
Adorable. I walked in and it smelled so nostalgic! Reminded me of summers at my Aunts resorts in Indiana. Super cute bakery across the street that was an old drive up dinner. The smell of fresh pastries got me 

I look forward to eating her besides a latte Togo. Fun art I inside and easy parking outback. Above are condos or timeshares so they have a dock out back that I walked out and took in some morning ocean breeze. 

I highly recommend this cute little spot
name: Amanda

text: Favorite Thai place to go to or pick up from. Food is delicious. Thai basil chicken is my go to and has never disappointed. My wife gets the curry and is her favorite around. The sushi is also very good and reasonably priced. All the staff is also incredibly kind and helpful!
name: Carlos

text:
Quite a slice of Cuban food.
Sure it's quite the tourist trap, with their elaborate (overpriced) menu complete with robust explanations of the history of the restaurant, cuisine and culture.  However, the service is friendly and efficient, and the food is well executed.
They certainly provide ample portion sizes, and each guest gets a personal 1/4 loaf of fresh bread.  You're unlikely to leave hungry.
Salads, sandwiches, tapas, soups, mains, and of course, signature cocktails.
There are multiple rooms with varying decor that attempts to take on a multitude of themes of Cuban life and culture.  There is an extensive bar area, complete with grand piano.  Each room offers entertainment at different times as well.
Off street parking is free and ample.
It's a good place to hit for lunch or dinner if you find yourself near historic Ybor City.
name: Mike

text: This was such a nice hotel. Perfectly located in downtown Nashville within walking distance of everything. The staff was excellent service was fantastic. The rooms are very nice and have a nice feel to them. I would most definitely stay here again.
name: Chris

text: Great service but the food left a lot to be desired and the food is what keeps me coming back. The atmosphere was also strange. Can't really put my finger on what it was exactly but I will tell you that the music inside the restaurant was WAY TOO loud (it was a weekday too) and we couldn't even talk to each other during dinner. That was definitely a put off. Unfortunately we won't return.
name: Landra

text: Monday Night is all you can eat Sushi night at Mandarin. Since we usually split one Sushi with dinner all you can eat did not make sense to us. However we did order the Kama-kasi Maki, it was very good. They always start you off with fried wanton chips with duck sauce, hot mustard  and a pot of tea. We ordered egg drop-wonton soup. (very good) This is not on the menu however they will make special orders if you ask. Also ordered the rock shrimp tempura. Again not on the menu but available if you ask. Add an order of Hunan Beef (hot spicy) and chicken with avocado. Yes we had to take 1/2 home with us. No desert however they always end the meal with wet/hot napkins, orange slices and fortune cookies. Could the Host be friendlier? Yes it would not hurt him to smile or say hello. text:
Worst customer experience ever. Came here for brunch around 11am on Sat because of the high reviews. Waited in line and when it came time to order, it took them almost 10 min because they can't seem to understand our simple order. I ordered a cheeseburger with no onions and ketchup. I did not request for a Patrol burger, I wanted a cheeseburger (off the kids menu) with no onions and ketchup. The cashier seemed so confuse and asked me to repeat my order a few times, then 1 other person came to assist her and asked me to repeat again. The man that came to assist asked if I judged wanted to order a cheeseburger off the kids menu since my order was simple. I said "yes, that's what I wanted." And when one of my friend ordered their Tuna Poke Salad, she was told they ran out of Tuna. My other friend ordered the Herbivore and was told they are out of kale. She also ordered an iced vanilla macchiato and received a small hot macchiato. When we try to bring it up to the manager, he gave us a dumb look after we explained the macchiato is not what we ordered. His response was "and....", so I had to repeat myself and told him we "ordered an ICED vanilla macchiato, and this is not iced." He walked away and brought out our receipt order, he said "you guys ordered a macchiato, if you guys want iced vanilla macchiato, that's going to be more." My friend wanted to just make it simple and said "then can I change to iced vanilla latte". His response "it'll be 50 cents more." So we paid the 50 cents because this was getting ridiculous. This place can't even comp us the 50 cents when their cashier messed up on our order? We waited for our food for 25 min and started to get annoyed and asked for it to be boxed up. We didn't like how we were being treated and the workers seemed annoyed by our order. The whole time waiting, we saw a few people came up to complain about their order as well. 

We finally received our food about 30 min later and when we opened it, our food was just thrown into the box. We would have had better service at a McDonalds.

text:
Please give this place a try! 

The donuts are SO good. We tried the donut holes, naturally, a raspberry filled, glazed twist, and apple fritter. Every one was delicious, light, and sweet but not overly sweet. The owners are the sweetest, and the prices are very reasonable.  

The menu also includes breakfast sandwiches, a few lunch sandwich and salad options, and a whole list of coffees, teas, and bobas. 

Highly recommend!

text:
Don't waste your time. The hostess is obnoxious and they don't honor reservations or Open Table requests. 
 
We're in Nashville staying at the Hilton Doubletree for a conference. 
The concierge made us a dinner reservation for 6.  We then called to add 2 people to the reservation and were told that they could not accommodate a table of 8.  

As often happens a few colleagues asked to join us for dinner And one of us then made another reservation on Open Table  for 6.  We arrived at the restaurant and the hostess was laughing at us and was very rude. She said "I told  you on the phone we can't accommodate your request for a table of 8".  I said we had another reservation and we would split our party between the 2 tables. 
She then said that there was no way they would honor the open table reservation and we needed to wait another hour for a table. 

I doubt all  the empty tables we saw were already reserved- on a Monday night?  

I guess they don't need our business. Lots of other great places to eat in Nashville so don't waste your time here - they don't honor reservations and their customer service is the worst.

text:
Tito and Pep is outta control. I've been there many times and everything has been amazing each time.

I always recommend Tito and Pep to anyone who will listen!

Well I've just about worked my way through the entire brunch menu and have made it a respectable way through the dinner menu as well. Every item I have tried had been spectacular!
The brunch on Saturdays and Sundays is one of my favorite things to do. I really enjoy the churro French toast! Sometimes I feel like French toast doesn't fill me up entirely or keep me full for long. That is definitely not a concern for me here. And if I'm feeling in the mood for something a little less sweet the huevos rancheros is LEGIT. All of this and $2 mimosas till 11AM! Strong coffee with non-diary creamer options are a huge plus too. Everything on the brunch menu is amazing. Tried the charred broccoli as well. Seemed like an odd thing to have on the brunch menu but go figure it was delicious. I don't think it's possible to get a bad meal here.

For dinner the grilled octopus is very very good as well as the calamari which is nice and crispy with good flavor. All their hot sauces are made in house and change seasonly depending on what's fresh. And man are those good too! I suspect just about everything is made in house and you can really tell the difference.

The staff is always super friendly and each time the entire restaurant has been spotless.
I HIGHLY recommend Tito and Pep! It's really a cut above the rest!
name: Zachary

text:
Wow!  Phenomenal food, service and value!  I had seen this establishment on Yelp a few times when I was browsing and was impressed by the overall rating of 5 stars, but hadn't made it to the restaurant until today.  Man, I am kicking myself for not trying the food long ago.  

When I got to the store, I thought everything looked good on the menu....so I ended up ordering a lot more than I had planned.  I have to honestly say, every dish was great!  

I got the crab ragoon (highly recommen), Asian pear salad (I'm not a fan typically of anything that had blue cheese...but this was such a flavorful and well balanced meal that I  forgot I didn't like blue cheese), a couple Steamed Buns with Pork (so good), Omu Ramen (a unique take on Ramen noodles...tremendous flavor), as well as Bibimbap with Tofu (also very, very good).  

Like I said, phenomenal food, great prices, great venue and great staff. 

Staff/owner was extremely nice, welcoming and accommodating.  She offered to explain a couple of the menu items I had purchased (Omu Ramen for example) to make sure I understood how it would be made (i.e, not a bowl of Ramen soup).  She wanted to make sure what I purchased was exactly what I wanted.  Oh, and everything was fresh!  Love that they locally source many of their food items!  

This won't be the last time I visit!  I'm really no one, but I like food...and, I think it's worth checking out.  You might find yourself writing a review like mine after you eat their grub!

text:

text:
Why 5 stars? Because this is the best avocado toast you'll find.

   ---   ---   ---

Okay so technically it's not avocado toast - it's an avocado egg salad tartine. But I've had so much frustration when I order avocado toast somewhere, and it turns out to be a few small slices of avocado on bread, but costs $8. Avocado isn't *that* expensive, but this crazy markup has just been universally accepted.

However, for this particular little delight, it costs $8 and comes with all the avocado a boy could dream of. I'm sure the fact that it's mixed with egg salad gives you the illusion that you're getting a little more avocado than actuality, but it tastes like giant heaps of avo and brings happiness to your soul. 

I also ordered tater tots and they were just kind of your run-of-the-mill tots that tasted previously frozen, but that was not enough to diminish my happiness or my star rating for this review. Graze has changed the game on our society's future avocado intake, and for that, I can never be grateful enough.
name: Brett

text:
This place was absolutely amazing.

I got the BBQ cheesesteak without the BBQ sauce, while my girlfriend got the cheesesteak with lots of peppers (I forget the name), then we split the bacon cheese fries and the garlic Parmesan fries.

The food was terrific. The place was crazy busy but the line moved quick and they got us our food within about 10 minutes of ordering. Seating is somewhat limited but lots of people were carrying out their food.

My cheesesteak was tremendous. It, along with the fries, all tasted very fresh as if the food had just been prepared and cooked. The food was very warm, as if it came right off the grill, and tasted amazing. The bacon cheese fries (I forget the specific name on the menu) were a particular favorite and I would highly recommend them.

The place isn't too pricy and for the quantity of food we got it was a great deal-we each brought home leftovers so it really turned into 2 meals for under $40.

If you're looking for a great cheesesteak place with a variety of options I would HIGHLY recommend this place. If I'm ever back in Philadelphia I will definitely return.

Once again HomeRun at Fitzgerald's - Kyle aka Josh :) knows how to create a lunch masterpiece! I will pass a thousand places to eat on my way to Fitzgerald's - hidden gem!

text: Before i start,  just fyi,  I only write reviews when I have had a great experience. However, this experience was so bad I have made an exception here. Moreover, since I ordered a sampler and three other different items, I assume no bad batch or error by a new chef accounts for this place. Everything was bad EXCEPT the cold pepsi. The person i was with was stunned at the fact that not even ONE of the 7 different items we tried passed the MEH standard. Even their damn reuben was SUB-Meh. This place is so bad I would laugh if i got one of those "let us make it right" offers from a manager upset with this review,  so please just dont ask.
