text:
We had the privilege of trying Loquita during our visit to Santa Barbara this weekend and am confident to say we've found a restaurant we would drive from LA for. 

Located on corner near Hotel Indigo and the new The Californian Hotel, it's in a great spot in downtown Santa Barbara. 

We were greeted immediately upon arrival and taken to the dreamy patio that was lit beautifully and had plenty of well placed heat lamps for chilly spring night. 

The servers here are obviously not just there to take your order but rather provide a transformative experience in Spanish dining. Their ability to describe menu options in addition to recommend wine options that paired well with our tapas choices was incredible. 

We started with the Jamon tasting and Queso de España tasting which were perfect together. Next we had a variety of tapas including the remolacha with beets served in three different fashions (and I traditionally do not like beets but it was fantastic), hinojo (amazingly fresh greens/salad), crochettas de pollo, and pulpo (some of the best Spanish octopus I've tasted). This led up to the Paella de Mariscos which was absolutely life changing. 

Can not wait to come back!!!!!!
name: Brenton

text: This place is out this world, the food is fresh and made to order, there staff outstanding, if you have tried please do, no wait and managers here care about there customers, and come to the table and talk to you
name: Luckey

text:
Totally biased bc I love the Hollander. On Sunday the pool is open to the public and it's awesome.

Food and drinks are super affordable during their happy hour. $5 margaritas, frozen cocktails, and apps... yes! The fried pickles are soooo tasty, I just wish they were a little more plentiful. The hummus is awesome too - that bread tho. Delicious! 

Come here. Come now. Come often!
name: Brigitte

text:
I'm not sure why I didn't find this hotpot place in Philly sooner...I truly believe that of all the AYCE hotpot options in the city, the majority of which are in Chinatown (this one is not), LaTao has the best bang for your buck by far.

Lets compare to the competitors in Chinatown:

Price: $24 dinner, $18 lunch, the price is pretty much the same as Nine Ting, Hippot, etc.
Quality: Much, much higher than the other AYCE places; the fatty brisket is to die for but I also really like the spicy beef and huge assortment of other options. The flounder. Don't be sleeping on the flounder. The fish at this location is just so tender and flaky. Not sure what they put in the fish but my friends and I absolutely loved it.
Assortment: I think this is really what makes this place the best bang for your buck. There's literally four pages full of different items to pick from including everything from fish, to many many different types and cuts of meat, to fish balls, tofu, veggies, etc. literally probably 3-4x the amount of different menu items compared to the other AYCE spots and yet much higher quality. 

Seriously, I am an avid hot pot fanatic and I think I've definitely found the place where I will frequent the most in the city. It does suck that it's removed from Chinatown but seriously worth swinging by UCity just for this.
name: Sam

text: No one is working not even a manager. The drive through and lobby are a 15 minute wait. I was stuck in the drive through and had to get out of my car to ask the cars behind me to move.  The staff is 4 people with no manager and they are very nervous and nice but do not know how to handle the situation. Also out of beans this is a main staple here.  Very poor for a big brand like Taco Bell. I asked for the corporate number and they did not know where to find it.
name: Betsy

text:
Wow! I am still thinking about the cocktails I had last night; they were so refreshing and delicious! 

Thanks to Steven B. for planning a little UYE Happy Hour; a few of us ended up here last night. Two things: 1) I have not written a review in almost a month and PH really deserves to be my first review after a hiatus. 2) I felt like such a lucky lady to be surrounded by Brian M. Steven B. and Max R. at this HH event. 

When I arrived Steven B. (as the host) was already at the bar sipping on his cocktail. The bartender greeted me and poured me a glass of water while I reviewed the menu. I opted to try The Fitzgerald (Citadelle Gin, Lemon, Sugar, Angostura Bitters) first and it was such a good choice. So refreshing and very much a classy cocktail. A few of their New Classic Cocktails were on a HH special, but I can't remember what that was. I think they took $2 off the regular cost of the drink during HH. 

I enjoyed conversations with the others and noticed that PH really is such a quaint place and it seems to me that most of the servers/bartenders are familiar with their regular customers. I would like to become a regular here! I finished my drink and started to look through their menu to see what I needed to order next. Since I wasn't sure of a drink, I decided to ask the bartender for her opinion. I asked about the Grapefruit Moon (Earl Grey Liqueur, La Quintinye Blanc Vermouth, Lemon, Grapefruit Bitters, Bubbles) and she did tell me that if I liked grapefruit I would likely enjoy the drink. It was settled, I ordered it and it was exactly what I had hoped for! Light and refreshing. Once I had time to sample it, she asked me how I liked it, and of course I said it was great! 

I am so glad I went here for HH and I can't wait to go back for another visit soon! Thanks Steven B. for planning this event and thanks PH for  your hospitality. I will have to order some snacks next time and stay a bit longer.
name: Mandie

text: Sushi was delicious, but it is incredibly understaffed! Three rolls took over 45 minutes to get and we were there right when it opened. So, if you have a lot of time and want some really good sushi for a low price-- I definietely reccomend.
name: Hayley

text: The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Overall, a strong experience. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: WORST LOCATION EVER!!!!! STAY AWAY!!! I normally love domino's Brooklyn style pizza, but not this time! I just moved to the area and am so upset that this is the location closest to me. The one on Mckelvey off of dorsett is AMAZING! Just saying. But enough about that, back to my review of this horrible location. We ordered pizza at 10:35 online, (they close at 1am) and it said that it would take 40-50 minutes. At 10:45 they said it was out of the oven. I called an hour later because our pizza never showed up, they said their ONE driver just pulled in so it would be to us shortly. Fine. I'll take that. After calling three times and being hung up on, I started to drive to the location to give them an earful. I stayed on hold the entire way there, but then my boyfriend called and said the pizza arrived. At this point the pizza had been out of the oven for an hour and a half!!!!! (It was finally delivered at 12:15). It was slightly warm, but looked as if it had been sitting under a heat lamp the entire time!! I even tried to call again as we were eating it, because the sauce was dried up and honestly the pizza was not edible. I waited for 8 minutes and 45 seconds on hold, someone answered, breathed a little, then HUNG UP ON ME!!! Literally the worst experience I have ever had with a pizza place. How is this place even open anymore? You better believe I'm calling tomorrow (if they are open because it is the 4th of july) (which their website says to call and ask if they are open HAHAHAHA). The first thing I will do is ask for a refund. What a waste of time and money! Wish I could give them negative stars.
name: Alexandra

text: I want to give this place a better rating, but twice with the same experience seems like a trend to me. Wait times are terrible. Whatever system they have with their app, doesn't seem efficient and those who don't call/check-in-ahead with the app end up waiting forever. Once we finally got seated the service was more than sub-par. Same server I have had twice and he's forgetful, inattentive, more interested in talking to his fellow staff buddies than ensuring silverware and napkins were on our table when the food came out. The only redeeming quality here is the food. But for that reason, I would rather go elsewhere, and have a glass of champagne with my brunch.
name: Erin

text: Horrendous service. Sat down for 15 minutes before a waiter even greeted us. Asked for water with lemon, forgot the lemon. Didn't bring lemon even after reminding them. Didn't clear all dirty plates before bringing main course (we bused our own table) When main course came we didn't have utensils. Had to take them from another table. Food was good but needed to send one of the appetizers back (octopus) because it was way over cooked. To make good, owner brought 2 bottles of spring water to table but no glasses (again we took from an unused table). Owner's excuse: "hard to get good help these days." Night was like out of a Monty Python skit. Frankly I don't know how this place stays open. Will always remember this evening for the wrong reasons. Will give 1 star for the decent but not exceptional entrees.
name: Lev

text: The food was to over hyped and I really expected so much but it was a flop. The food I'd give it a 4/10 but the service 8/10 though. Everything just overly seasoned
name: Francine

text:
I'm surprised that this place gets mixed reviews. It's really not that bad so don't let these Yelp and Google reviews scare you away. It's the usual restuarant in Chinatown that's cash only (or Venmo) and cheap. 

I had the beef noodle soup which wasn't out of the world. But for the cheap price, it was sufficient. There was a lot of meat for the price but it was chewy and not melt in your mouth tender meat. But again, you get what you paid for. And I'm ok with that in this scenario.

Tip: the waitress seems to be only fluent in Mandarin so you might have problems if you ask her to elaborate items on the menu...
name: Crystal

text: Great fresh food in a cute restaurant in media. Staff are very friendly and make you feel welcome. I had such a good lunch, and then some pastries and coffee afterward. I'll definitely go back!
name: ML

text: Rams head usually has the best nachos in town- I've been a spokesperson for their food for years. Recently they updated their menu and it is way to pricy for way less quality food. The Mac and cheese had a weird texture and was sour tasting. The burgers weren't much better and the taster tots now cost extra. The nachos had been drastically changed as well for the worse. They fluffed up the plate using a ton of lettuce instead of the quality toppings I'm used to from them. Extremely disappointed :(
name: Lyndsey

text: The happy hour appetizer deals are excellent. Had the $7 stuffed meatballs; there are four, just like in the regularly priced app. They were delcious and generously sized!
name: Laura

text: A co worker recommended this place 2 months ago and i didn't go then. Today i was in the city for Tran Siberian Orchestra and wanted to get a bite. This place popped up when we searched the area. I told the guys i traveled with that Latoya said they were pretty good. Parking is on the street but its free. The building is a shotgun house and looked like it was going to be cozy. We sat at the counter and The staff kill you with kindness. The whole staff were amazing and everyone positively engaged with us.. The food is made in plan site and the chef would make conversation with you. I ordered a Dr tan burger and two tacos. While we waited we enjoyed watching the amazing looking food the owner/ chef was creating. We watched as they made muscles. OMG they looked intense. The meat for the burgers are grounded fresh from brisket and Prime Rib. Seasoned to perfection topped with Homemade sauce, bacon, and some  Asian inspired slaw. Hands down the best burger i ever had. But when we got the tacos. Blow your mind good. I could eat them everyday for the rest of my life. I can't wait to come back. I going down the menu and trying all the items they serve.
name: Chris

text: Food is what I would call "Mexican Fusion". Interesting and I'd good quality. Would come again.
name: Bill

text: We came here for Thanksgiving dinner and it was wonderful. It was a buffet style so I was not sure what to expect, but honestly there was not one thing that wasn't good. Our server Joann was very attentive and pleasant. Immpecable service by everyone I encountered. We are looking forward to coming back after the holidays for dinner.
name: Kimberly

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The staff seemed tired but still polite. It looked better online than it did in person. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text: Pho 1 continues to impress me! From the burrito to the teriyaki, everything here is excellent & the service is very quick!
name: Christina

text: Delicious! I can not say enough good things about Russell's! The atmosphere is inviting, the staff and management are friendly and efficient, and the food is always gratifying. Russell has a gift for flavor combinations and the kitchen staff knows how to implement. The steak and egg is especially pleasing, but EVERYTHING I've tried is tasty. The servers are attentive and knowledgeable; I always feel welcome and never rushed, even when they are busy. This is my go-to place. THE best place to dine in St. Louis!
name: Susan

text: I recently hosted my best friends baby shower here and had a wonderful experience. I worked with Lucy from start to finish. She made the whole experience very easy. They created a customized menu for us with the most delicious brunch entrees. The service was perfect. Our waitress made sure we were taken care of the entire time. I come here a lot for dinner and drinks on the rooftop. The atmosphere, food and service is always amazing! It's definitely one of my favorite spots in Tampa!
name: Allie

text: Have been here quite a few times now. Servers are always friendly and attentive. The chips on the table are freshly made and come out warm. Fish tacos are great. Shrimp tacos are not edible. For the price, the tacos should come with at least one side. Their happy hour ends at five which is an odd time to end.
name: Kate

text: Fresh tasty bread, yummy pastries and desserts .  I had a BALT sandwich ( BLT With avocado ) .  Delicious !     I will be back again and again !
name: S

text: Best Chinese restaurant in Fishers! Everything is fresh and reasonably priced. I love the roasted pork lo mein as well as their general gso's chicken and crab Rangoon's. Best takeout I know!
name: Logan

text: These fine folks catered the Dragon Lights opening tonight and this food was fantastic. There was chicken and shrimp mei fun, gyoza, red bean/sesame balls, and pork spring rolls--all of which were *really* good even after being cooked in a truck, then thrown in a tray and carried through the Arboretum to where they were being served, buffet style, to a whole lot of people. I'm definitely going to check them in out in their restaurant, but it's good to know that if I need a caterer, they can really deliver.
name: Patrick

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time.
name: User

text: Had a great time at the bar! Great recommendations and prompt attention. Back again!!
name: Wesley

text: I absolutely love steaks, and I travel everywhere to try out the best steakhouses. This is by far one of THE best. The ambience is stunning. It is an old bank converted into a restaurant. The original vault is still there as well. Everything I tried was bursting with flavor. I always get filet mignon, mine was cooked exactly as I asked for, and the best I have had. The sides are plentiful. The dessert was great too. This is my favorite steak house. Do NOT miss out on this one.
name: Joanne

text: Years ago, before this place became a franchise/chain, it was very good. I was back in town this week and tried twice to get two different types of frappes at a whopping $7 each. They were so watered down that I couldn't taste the sweetness nor the mocha or the vanilla caramel flavor. The barista was also lacking in personality and friendliness and there were only a couple of items on the drink menu that you could see above the bar on the wall. This seemed very odd for a coffee shop. No more wasting my money in this place.
name: I

text: Great service, food, and cocktails.  Definitely worth every penny.  Plan on spending some time here as there is so much to try.  The cheeseboard was phenomenal and you have to get the prosciutto wrapped dates. They were the best thing I have had in so long.  The pizza is also amazing.
name: Ronald

text:
Time for an update!

Service is incredible here now.  The servers are really friendly and helpful.  To be honest... I felt a little intimidated and out of place the first time I came, but they're definitely better at making people feel welcome now :)

The jalapeno cheese pretzels are really really great, and the bellini (which is the size of my giant head) is DELICIOUS.  Okay... it has malibu in it, so I was obviously going to love it.

Our server told me that they have just hired a new chef, so there are some changes coming soon... Can't wait to check it out. And I really hope they don't get rid of the beet hummus because that is truly an unexpected delight!  they also have a creamy spinach and artichoke dip that is really good as well.
name: Dana

text: The venue is rad! Best place to listen to music in the valley. The food is Soso and service can be extremely slow
name: Melinda

text: I hadn't ordered from Papa John's in years but thought I thought would give it a try. I found the quality and service to be worse than my experiences in the past. I had a simple order of two items with extra garlic sauces. They forgot the extra garlic sauces and the pizza was overcooked.
name: Deborah

text:
Great place to work from. 
Their coffee is good and the atmosphere is average when it comes to noise level. I enjoy their coffee; however, I wish they had more choices in lattes...
They have outlets near some tables, which is useful. There are also about three tables outside as well. 
They don't mind if you work from here all day!
name: Nidhi

text: If you like the Metairie and French Quarter locations, then you will love this hidden gem. Today was my first time visiting this Magazine location and I enjoyed it. It's not as busy as the other two locations and features an upstairs part as well. The seafood platter and gumbo were both so delicious! The service was good as well. Will definitely be back.
name: Reynecia

text:
Excellent fresh food but the atmosphere and décor feel like it a backwoods diner.
 My wife had the chicken phone and was disappointed saying it was tasteless however my dinner was very very good with a combination of pork pork skin shrimp and chicken. Sorry voice to text
name: Mark

text: I had no clue that I never reviewed this place.  I guess because a chain is a chain.  There's nothing too special.  We have been here about a half dozen times.  Never a long wait.  Everyone is usually friendly.  We haven't had any issues during any one of our visits.  The food had always been as expected.  Sign up for the rewards we bank points and usually end up with a free meal each visit.
name: Toni

text: All around amazing. From the service, to the cocktails, to the food, everything was outstanding! My husband and I split a small feast here tonight. We started with the lobster cocktail, king crab cocktail and escargot while sipping on some super tastey cocktails. While I would recommend any of these appetizers, we both agree that the escargot was our favorite. We then split the Delmonico steak and stuffed hash brown. The steak was great and so big we had a hard time finishing it despite the fact that we were sharing. The hash brown was good but I would try something else next time. I highly recommend the Clover Club cocktail- I'm not typically a gin fan but this was one of the best cocktails I've ever had.
name: Leigh

text: Solid place to eat came at 2ish on a Tuesday and the bartender was awesome. He was very nice and relaxed the bar was moderately packed. The menú is a good size and variety and the place is a good size. Will definitely be back again and especially because the Christmas decorations are still up!
name: Jade

text: Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Food was fresh and service was quick. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Pretty happy with it overall. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: So we stumbled into this place, and i must say it's to die for, owner is the chef, wife runs the front of house, absolutely wonderful food, had the skirt steak tostachos and the Caribbean pigeon pea risotto, this is a must try! I'll be back
name: Bill

text:
I recently ordered from Steak Plus Pizza via Grubhub. I ordered a cheeseburger and fries, and ordered a kids spaghetti for my daughter. 

The food was prepared properly, including the "special notes" for my daughter's pasta. It arrived hot, and was tasty and very plentiful. In fact, the cheeseburger was so much I saved some for lunch the following day.

Prices were reasonable.
name: Clay

text:
We had a "Celebration of Life" for my wife's sister and reserved their private room overlooking the bay. Emily, the catering manager, was extremely helpful in setting up the event as well as managing the event itself.  The staff was wonderful and the food was excellent. The staff made sure we had everything we needed and recognized the type of event we were having and gave us the level of professionalism that this event deserved.  We had more attendees than anticipated and the staff reacted quickly and kept things on an even keel.
We are grateful for the management and staff who ensured that a very emotional time in our lives was treated with dignity yet a festive celebration of the life of one who was lost too soon.
Thanks to all!!!  Bill Radebaugh and Linda Walker
name: Bill

text: Quick professional attention from our servers led to meals prepared to perfection. All ten people in our party enjoyed the tasty cuisine and enjoyed the atmosphere. We'll be back for sure.
name: Donald

text: Great steak (tender and perfectly seasoned), mediocre mash potatoes, excellent customer service, delicious mixed drink
name: Unique

text:
A genuine Honky Tonk bar with live music and quick serving bar keeps. The cheese burger probably saved my night, as it's hailed as the best burger. It was good for the record. Music was great and the environment was fun. 

Visit this place if on the Boardwalk.
name: Bob

text: no big complaints, just a nice meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
They got rid of the Italian Stallion! You know, that award winning burger that was on the Food Network - literally their best burger. 

I got some other things to try and it was okay. Make sure to order above your prefered temperature as it will be more rare. For example if you want 'medium rare' - then order 'medium'. 

The woman working the register was short, unwelcoming, and honestly kind of rude. 

Not interested in going back based on my last experience.
name: Jim

text: I dined on Thursday night with two of my girlfriends for a ladies night out. It was our first time dining at Forbici and we are Tampa locals that love discovering new places. I was very pleased with pretty much every aspect of my dining experience. The location is great, being in a hard spot of Hyde Park that has struggled, the staff is friendly and knowledgeable (Kodi) was our server and she was awesome, food/wine was delicious (cup and char 24" pizza was insane), the ambiance and setting was amazing as well, the noise level was a little loud for talking but expected because of the volume of customers at that time of the day. All around, the whole experience was great and we will definitely be back again soon! Thank you so much for your hospitality
name: Jennifer

text: We made a reservation online and were seated promptly. Service was friendly and attentive. Two important things--cash only and BYOB! We didn't have a bottle of wine and my husband couldn't find the store , but dinner was amazing. We started with the sautéed artichokes and Caesar salad. The salad was good but the artichokes were the star. We ordered the gnocchi special with blush sauce, flounder special, chicken parm, and meatballs with linguine to eat family style with our kids. Everything was outstanding and we would order them all again. We couldn't come close to finishing our meal and we did not leave room for dessert. Our server handed us a complimentary piece of tiramisu as we left. Wow! We also enjoyed the walk there and back from the old city. Highly recommend!
name: Matt

text: Had the Sizzling Sirloin Torta and a couple beers while watching matinee baseball. Server was attentive and they asked me what I wanted to watch. Will be back.
name: Wil

text:
Such a cute place! Food is good and reasonably priced. Train going around the edge of ceiling and other nostalgic decor is really fun and interesting to see. A pianist came in at noon and started playing. Only negative is that all of the dishes and utensils I was served are disposable. The neighboring table had one dish that was glass. Not sure why the use of  styrofoam and plastic, even if it's recyclable--it's food covered and will go in trash. 

The owner is  super friendly and even hugged me and told me where to wander around in the little downtown. Loved the experience!
name: Lisa

text:
We ate here because we could not get a table at two nearby places, so we took a chance on Bulla Gastrobar, which was right across the street. The place was a delightful surprise. 

We had just returned from 3 weeks in Portugal and Spain, where we ate tapas and pinchos (called pintxos in Basque country) at nearly every meal. Seafood is abundant in both countries, where restaurant menus are overloaded with the stuff. The dishes we ate at Bulla Gastrobar were very close to what we had eaten over there. And they were delicious, fresh, and imaginative. The service could not have been better, although the place was very busy, and our server, Shannon, went out of her way to accommodate us. 

This was a delightful surprise and we felt very lucky to have wandered into the place by chance. We will return soon!
name: Allen

text: Love this little gem. Great breakfast/brunch, coffee and fresh-squeezed orange juice. My favorite entrees are the croques monsieur and the French toast, but we have never had a bad meal here. They have a nice little dog-friendly patio, too.
name: Christine

text:
Stopped in here randomly on a Sunday morning while in search of a brunch place. Ample parking in the Ironworks parking lot, and once you get inside you're almost overpowered in a bright cheery interior.

As for the food - my wife and I kept it simple - she had the berry french toast (which I had a sample of...) which was absolutely amazing. The toast was just perfect - creamy and gooey on the inside and grilled on the outside. I believe they were using Challah bread which is the best french toast bread in my opinion. 

I had the house made Greek yogurt and granola, drizzled in honey. This was so tasty with the mixed berries that comes with it, I honestly haven't had such yogurt in a long time.

The portion sizes on both of the above were huge - like 4 slices of french toast and a huge bowl of the yogurt - neither of us finished the interior meal.

I ended up investigating further online while we were sitting waiting for our food, and noticed that there's a bunch of these around Chicago and other places - I'll have to check out if they are as good as this one. What a great find, I really wish there was one of these closer to home.
name: Brandon

text: Made a stop on our way back from St. Pete Beach at Ford's Garage. Parking isn't super ideal but not atypical for a downtown location in a nearby parking garage. Elevator opens right near the entrance and they do validate parking. We started with a Lincoln Punch and Coppertail Night Swim stout, punch was very refreshing and tasty after a day at the beach in the Florida heat. We shared a BBQ Brisket Burger and it was absolutely delicious. Huge portion being a half pound burger for $12.50 chopped up brisket topping the burger patty was fantastic. The main reason for the 4 star rating instead of 5 was because they stuck us in a tight corner next to a big group which was a little uncomfortable. Super cool decor, very authentic with work rags as napkins and hose clamps as napkin rings, awesome decor. Overall good experience. We would come back next time we are in town.
name: Rachel

text: 10 out of 10. Came here with some girlfriends and we had such a great time. The food was amazing and there was live music that night. Always check there website for when there are performers because it creates a really nice environment. They also have deals on food and drinks every day of the week. Will definitely come back again!
name: Teah

text: I am extremely disappointed with our first and now last visit at this establishment. The food we ordered was delicious. The alcohol was very over priced. I saw that the margarita was listed at 10 dollars, so we decided to up charge to Don Julio tequila. This changed the price from 10 to 18 a margarita. When we questioned the price, the manager said the original drink had 1 and 1/2 shots and ours had 2. Well first, I didnt want additional tequila, just a better tequila, which they failed to understand. Also, there was no way 2 shots were in those margaritas. 2 shots of alcohol  couldn't even fit in our tiny margarita glasses. Very disappointed.
name: Jen

text:
This is my favorite tapas restaurant in the city. Most recently, I had the chef's tasting menu, and spent 2 hours getting through 10 dishes spread out across 5 courses. 

The first couple of courses are very light, and more sauce than substance. Try not to fill up too much on the amazing flatbread. 

Of the main courses, the seafood paella and the grilled scallops were my personal favorites. There's an explosion of flavor (and probably a hefty amount of butter) in both dishes. 

The roasted pork was a bit too fatty and salty. I hear some people are really into that though. 

For dessert, I had a creme brûlée - esque cup of flavored foam on top of a sweet pudding, with a hint of whiskey and pistachio flavor. Heavy on the calories, but at that point in the meal sticking to a calorie count was already a lost cause. 

All in all, fantastic service and food. Definitely worth the $75 per plate.
name: Dan

text: This is definitely one of my favorite places in south philly. If you're gonna go out, come here. Great service, and even better food! Love having the vip card too that gives discounts for living in the area!
name: Misty

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. For a busy night they handled it okay. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell.
name: User

text:
Very good steak.  One of the top 3 I've had. The dry-aged Ribeye is my "go to" steak, and this one was extremely tender. It says 45 days on the menu, but mine felt more like a 28 day age.  I got all of the tenderness, with hardly any of the dry-aged funky beefy flavors.

The Cocktail Shrimp was good. I'd say, if you're not expecting it...and you take a bite with a huge dollop of cocktail sauce...don't panic.  Well, you will panic.  You may reach for your phone to dial 9-1-1, but by the time you get the phone out, the extreme pain and discomfort subsides. Horseradish, like wasabi, doesn't last long...and it's 99% gone in 15 seconds.  Of course the second bit, I still had some of the sauce...because it's fairly addicting...but, not as much.  You get 4 large shrimp (didn't seem like Jumbo) for $15.95.  I'd probably order it again if was $9.95..but, no more.

I'm giving this review 4 stars because I was delighted, but not super overwhelmed.  I'm spoiled, I guess, on Bern's steakhouse in Tampa...which, in my mind, is the best steakhouse in the United States.  And, the service was very good at St Elmo's; however, not quite as good as Bern's.  That, along with the aging of the steak, caused me to drop it to 4 stars...wishing there was a 4.5 option.
name: Martin

text: Visit often for great happy hour. I know it is a busy time but I do have a small concern. The happy hour menu was not given to us. When I asked for it the server tossed one on the table for a party of 6. It was caked with food. When I mentioned it she reached for another one( also caked with food) and tossed it on the table and kept going. Even with happy hour prices we spend a good amount and tip well. A little better customer attention please.
name: Kathleen

text: I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Food was good and came out fast. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The music was louder than it needed to be. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot.
name: User

text: I really like this location better than the other one.  It is spacious and atmosphere is lively.  I have been  twice in 2 weeks for brunch with my friends. They offer a variety of mimosas but I fell in love with the old fashion mimosa! (What a brilliant idea! Whiskey for breakfast.) I tried the RETURN OF THE MAC which is gluten free as healthy option on my first visit and second visit I had chef Hannah French toast which changes every time. Both were very good. If you need a good brunch spot to catch up with friends, this is the spot.
name: Tannus

text: Food was great, cocktails same. (per friend who drinks)  Daily special (as with everywhere else) was overpriced and price not disclosed.  Negative was ordered two desserts and 15 minutes later instead of dessert we received the check.  Desserts weren't charged but waste of time.
name: James

text:
Kentucky champagne ($12)- Went here with a medium-sized group, 12 people. The Kentucky champagne was really refreshing! The garnish was pretty.There was a nice citrus and champagne taste to it which went down easily. The tartness of the raspberry and sweetness of champagne gave the flavors a good balanced. The carbonation wasn't too overwhelming as well. Would order it again! 
The seats and table was comfortable but there were no bar hooks at the table where we were. I tried other stuff but I'll post separately about them
name: Jenn

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. A couple small things kept adding up. Maybe other people have better luck here. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: I decided to try this place as I heard some good things. There was 4 of us and a 5 month old so it was nice that it was family friendly l with ample room for the stroller. Plus there was plenty of seating with a few seats outside too.  The menu was amazing, we came in for a glass of wine and some cheese, we weren't even hungry but still ended up ordering a chicken pesto sandwich which was very tasty. It came with chips and a small salad. The cheese platter that came with plenty of crackers and garnished grapes which were perfectly paired with a Marietta Zin Barbera. Check out the delicious looking pictures to get your mouth watering. I'll definitely be coming back here very soon.
name: Nima

text: So good.  Just go in and get the Double Cheeseburger deal....sit and enjoy a hot melty delight!  Hamburger craving FIXED!
name: john

text:
Do not be fooled by the stunning building that this restaurant sits within. Cafeteria quality food at best and not a good cafeteria at that.

Huevos rancheros served with yucky kidney beans and  a cold mix of boiled veggies. Watered down cranberry juice. Cold bacon as well. My guest ordered the challah which was stale and they didn't soak the thick bread long enough so that it arrived totally dry. Just yuck, yuck and more yuck.
name: Chris

text: Great place to eat! Nice menu variety. Would eat here again! Gets crowded, so get there earlier than later.
name: Denise

text: I can't say anything bad about this place. Street parking is ample. Prices are reasonable. There was a wait when we went, but it was short and totally worth it. Staff was friendly. And the food was absolutely delicious! My boyfriend and I visited here on our last visiting St. Louis and couldn't have been more happy. I ordered an egg white omelette while he ordered a regular omelette (I forgot which toppings we had lol). We also split an order of chocolate chip pancakes. The pancakes were the perfect size to split and tasted almost like a chocolatey dessert! My only complaint was a result of my not so careful reading-- my omelette came with goat cheese on top, I'm not a fan. But I'm sure it could've been served without had I noticed it before ordering.
name: Melani

text: I spilled lentil soup and I almost ate it off the table. I've thought salad was boring but this, mmmmmmm. Better than salad.
name: Wulfina

text: I'm always a hesitant 5-star review kind of gal...truthfully, you've gotta really provide something really good in my book to warrant 5 stars.   Ramen, you say?  Well I was thinking that same thing as I walked in and perused the menu.  You order at the counter and are given a number...your food is freshly prepared and delivered to your table when ready.  Now I'm not a ramen snob by any means but really haven't had anything locally that wowed me as much as Yujo's.  As a vegetarian, this can also limit my choices (yes, I know the chashu is amazing, but it's all good...consider that more for you)!  However, I've gotta say that this vegetable sapporo is like magic in a bowl!  It was presented like a dish off Food Network with a thin slice of tofu and seaweed as garnish.  The ramen noodles, broth, vegetables and soft boiled egg I chose to add melded perfectly together.  The only suggestion I'd ask for is some chili oil or something a bit more spicy than peppery ramen seasoning available.   Seriously just a suggestion, though...this food is magical with or without spice.  I didn't try any tea but certainly will the next go around.  Anyone wanna meet for lunch tomorrow??
name: Mandy

text: Pretty good, if I come this way again then I would definitely go again.  Good portions and tasty to boot.  Nice staff and clean setting, recommended for anyone looking for good eats.
name: Tu

text: I love port of subs most of all, at least sub shops.  I love how their food is fresh cut and this store is always immaculate.  The 2 ladies that always work the evenings when we go in are the best.  As I write this I feel terrible for not getting their names for this review but in any case they rock.  Always smiling and friendly and make our subs perfect.  They always remind me to swipe my rewards card for my points and I appreciate that very much.  Shout out to Smithridge Port of Subs, great team, great food, great job!!!!!
name: Adam

text: Been coming here for years!  Amazing bagels!  Every time I visit Santa Barbara I stop by to get "the situation" bagel.  So many different bagel combinations!  Don't forget to sign off for their emails!  They send coupons regularly!  Make sure to plan for a line on the busy weekend mornings!
name: Travis

text: Best basque food I have ever had! It's a very small restaurant with a tiny waiting area so be sure to have a reservation. Tender lamb, beef medallions, homemade soups. Everything is delicious! You feel like an honored guest in a home of someone who loves to cook and make their  guests feel special.
name: Kathi

text: The place was clean and staff friendly, but the food needed serious work. Gumbo soup was simply inedible and got thrown away after a few bites, the hamburger was ok at best, the onions rings were good. I live local and there are hundreds of places to eat, this place could do better. I don't drink much beer but I'm sure it was good but pricey.
name: Wyatt

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: It was OK.  A decent sandwich, but nothing that I couldn't get at any other sub shop.  I was expecting something of an Ameghetti's experiences o maybe I had set the bar too high.
name: Ed

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not bad for a quick meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Great breakfast! Had the Country Fried Steak and it was delicious. Great service from our waitress Stacy who was attentive even though she was very busy. Highly recommend.
name: Frank

text:
Was set for a homerun after reading the reviews...but Ryan's couldn't quite get it out of the infield... food was just average, though the price point was fair..hash browns needed some life ...they looked like they were frozen,pressed and never cooked. Experience was very nice and decor is quant so for me and my crew we just give it a 3.5 out of 5 ..though it shows a 4 .
Sorry but gotta be honest..wont be coming back....
name: Jay

text: Outstanding Wonton Soup followed by a delicious and tender Peking Duck entree. I give this place 4.5 stars! Great stuff!
name: David

text: I came to The Chesire for a wedding and the wedding party had invited guests to Basso for a breakfast the next day. It was a buffet style breakfast and I think was just for the wedding guests. It was great for out needs. Hearty and a good variety. Coffee and juice was also provided. The space it self is great. Parking is a bit limited due to many of the spots designated for Starbucks. I didn't get to try their other menu though. I am sure it is great!
name: Cleda

text: The best sushi in the city, and a phenomenally good happy hour. The salmon sushi is the freshest, most melt in your mouth salmon I have ever had. And it's consistent -- I come here at least once a week for happy hour and it blows me away every time.
name: Kathleen

text: Frenchys is a clearwater institution. We've been to every location but recently ate at Saltwater and Jordan was our sever and we had the best experience. The food was fantastic and the atmosphere was great. Frenchy's is one of my favorite spots and we keep coming back. Check this place out if you're in the area.
name: Clay

text: I was hesitant about going to Blinkers with the mixed reviews but it was great. My husband and I went for our anniversary while visiting. The petite filet and his ribeye were cooked perfect, the truffle fries were tasty and the key lime pie was amazing!!!!!  We sat outside and our waitress was great. I can't remember her name but she was from Minneapolis and hates the cold. She let me taste two wines because she said you either love or hate the one or the other. Great service and food!
name: Julie

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. For a busy night they handled it okay. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
We had a great experience here for lunch on a Saturday. It was not too busy so we were able to get a seat quick then the rush shortly followed.

The staff was great. Very polite, nice and checked on us the right amount. Sometimes people come too often and you feel like your getting interrupted. 
The restaurant was nice, clean and bright inside with alot of 50s nostalgia which was cool along with the 50s music.

The menu had a good amount of options and some items you were able to mix n match. The portion sizes we good size and everything tasted great. I was surprised how much I enjoyed the biscuits n gravy. The were fluffy and flakey. The grave was not too thin and had a great taste to it.
name: Douglas

text: First experience at a true Vegetarian/Vegan restaurant, and it was delicious. Strongly recommend!
name: Mike

text: How much are we willing to suffer for excellent food? After many trips to this establishment, I've had it. It is time to solve the perennial problem of long waits in a rather uncomfortable al fresco waiting space. I respect the fact that they are small and their food is excellent. But then, take reservations or provide a call ahead list, or go electronic and provide a waiting list online. Anything but the present system. By the time you sit, you are soo irritated that you cannot enjoy the food. If they insist on their nearthenthal system, then for crying out loud , improve your waiting room by providing shade and some temperature mitigation. From now on, I'll try the order and pick up but most likely, like many good ideas that don't adapt to new circumstances, It will just fade away in my memory. Too bad.
name: Ramon

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: OMG, this place has the best food. I had the most amazing lamb on the bone that was served with fresh tortillas and a mixed chopped onion, lettuce and tomato. When I put it all together with this creamy hot sauce it was soooo much better than any other Mexican food in the state. I'll be back soon
name: Kc

text: If you want to wait needlessly in the waiting area this place is for you. Our party of 2 arrived to a fairly empty parking lot. There were 4 young hostesses and plenty of empty tables in sight. Yet we were told our wait would be 15 minutes. We sat in the waiting area. Meanwhile another couple arrived and were told 20-30 minutes. After 10 minutes of waiting we realized this just wasn't going to be a good experience so we walked to a restaurant next door and were immediately seated. So did the other couple.
name: Lawrence

text: Decided to try the Metro Diner on this side of the bay after the fantastic brunch we had on Kennedy.  It would be impossible to pick a winner between the two.  The formula is simple and brings back memories of Diners of a former time.  Everyone in the place was happy....the hostess, servers, managers and the customers and that says a lot.  At most of the tables around us, everyone was tasting each other's food and commenting favorably......We had the Chicken and Waffles.  This came with a half a chicken (crispy, juicy and delicious) and a light waffle, served with strawberry butter and a special sweet and sour maple syrup.    Again the servers are fast, professional and friendly and the food is fantastic.  Yes it is as good as it gets........
name: Richard

text: Had great time at treehouse.  The plantain starter was dry so was worried that meal would not be good;however the tamale main was spectacular.  We had great service.  Saw some reviews on portion size but I thought they were generous.  Good beers on draft.  Opening a bar upstairs but we did not venture up to check it out.  Overall a great night and good food.
name: Tamara

text: Everything I've had here has been stellar. They catered my friend's wedding, which was a big hit. The only better beef stroganoff I've had is my Russian grandfather's recipe. I wish I lived closer so I could go get blinis whenever I wanted.
name: Bridey

text: This place is awesome! It's the best place in Oro Valley and Catalina! Come check it out it's worth the drive. Just be sure not to go Sunday mornings when everybody else is there. Every other day is great and the food is really good.
name: R.

text:
Don't get me wrong, the food here is great. Everything is extremely well prepared and flavorful. The waitstaff was accommodating to our mix of palates (2 children and a vegetarian) and offered to adjust the spice level or bring the sauces on the side to ensure no one was overwhelmed with something too spicy.

The only reason it doesn't get 5 stars is that everything was salty beyond what would be considered reasonable, IMO. Sure, this amplified the flavor, but everyone also felt the need to drink a quart of water on the way home to balance out their sodium levels.

The heat levels were about what you'd expect. A "4 dot" dish (which translates to "Hot") is pretty spicy but not nose running, drooling, lips on fire hot. You'll actually be able to taste your food.
name: D

text: Food was pretty good overall, the shishito peppers were excellent and the mushroom ramen was bland, and the only mushrooms in the ramen were a few strands of enokis. Service was subpar. When the restaurant is half empty, I shouldn't have to wave at the server to come take our order.
name: Angela

text: Saw these all around downtown Nola so I decided to give it a try. Had the 3 piece with french fries. It was pretty good. They have assorted sauces on the table you can try. But the best part were the biscuits! Great alcohol absorbers before for a night of drinking. They also have liquor slushees you can buy!
name: Tilisa

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. It was crowded but still moved along. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Glad we tried it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Great sandwiches and excellent prices, and the folks working there are just as friendly and nice as can be. I had a breakfast sandwich and a California wrap and both were perfect.
name: Erik

text: Though the service isn't the best in the world the happy hour makes up for it ! The drinks are super strong and worth the wait ! My meal portion was super small though . I see so many reviews saying it's the worsttt . Though I wouldn't give it that , it was ok to me ‍
name: Nina

text: Made our reservations through open table so we were seated right away. There is limited parking on a weekend night, however they offer complimentary parking. Who can beat the pasta meal. For 43.99 you get two appetizers or salads, two meals, one huge dessert to share and two meals to go. This was perfect for my husband and I as we got to have a romantic meal for two and then meals to take home for our kids. We started off our meals with the delicious house Cabernet which was the perfect blend of earthy, dry, with a smooth finish. Then we both had the Maggiano's salad which was topped with blue cheese crumbles, crispy pancetta , and a tangy vinegarette. Our salad was accompanied by fresh warm bread. For our entrees we both ordered the braised beef Alfonso which was a creamy pasta topped with crispy braised beef with a touch of spicy zest. The portions were generous and popped with flavor. We concluded our meal with a chocolate mouse cake which was a rich chocolate piece of heaven. We enjoyed this great deal and flavorful Italian meal. The lightly background music of Sinatra completed our experience.
name: Diana

text: Perfect place to bring everyone! Think upscale food court with an amazing bar smack dab in the center. It was tough to choose between all the amazing food, but the Thai chicken noodle bowl won out - succulent chicken that fell off the bowl, coconut broth, pickled greens, and noodles. So. Good. Husband and I split the chargrilled oysters as well. Try them with the mushrooms. He had an assortment of Indian dips and what I could best describe as a cheese crepe but better. If you're planning on imbibing (it's NOLA, you know you are), you can't go wrong with the bearded knees. Yes, that's spelled correctly. Bearded knees. Just try it. You won't regret it.
name: Rebecca

text: The rolls were small and lacked freshness and flavor.  The ambiance was  good, and the staff was polite, but they lacked sushi-making skills resulting in an inferior product. The restaurant could have been cleaner.
name: Feldman

text: Excellent Mediterranean food! Always cooked to order so always juicy and hot. Best hummus and pita served at the table free of charge when you order! Love this place!
name: Nancy

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Would return. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The staff seemed tired but still polite. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Price felt a touch high for what it was. It was decent, just a little uneven. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Extremely authentic Chinese noodles and food. As Chinese, we had very high expectations for Chinese food and this place exceeds our expectations! They even have very tasty bubble tea! Very pretty and delicious and the portion is huge! This will become our go to place in the future!
name: Ruomeng

text: Food that tastes great, is affordable, healthy, and sustainable. Can't ask for much more
name: Kevin

text: Kiddos to you guys! Sunday afternoon and we were a party of 30 people who walked in with no reservation. They were so great! Got our entire order done without a single mistake! Never mind how AMAZING the bbq was!!! Outstanding and HIGHLY recommended!!
name: Amy

text:
Potential is there! I called this morning and asked to speak to a manager / kitchen chef in regards to providing feedback regarding the food we ordered yesterday. I was attempting to provide this feedback so that I DIDN'T have to leave a yelp review. However when "Kathy" answered the phone she was very short and said she'd take my info.

So here is the feedback I wanted to provide via phone:

Ordered the conch fritters and wings. The conch fritters have no taste at all. Similar to what I'd imagine play dough to taste like. 

The wings were served cold, which was a shame bc the little bite that I had the flavor was amazing.

I did provide this feedback to the bartender who took the items off the check, but I know the feedback wouldn't go anywhere.

Kathy could learn some basic customer service or the practice to take feedback could be changed.

Want to love this place as it's walking distance from where I live. So if you are planning an evening that way, perhaps head to Hula Bay for a bite then a drink at Salty's.
name: Anna

text: I ordered a taco salad and asked not spicy. It was spicy. I went to the front, and politely told them that there was jalapeños or something in it that was spicy. They lady said, "No it's not spicy. There was nothing was in it that was spicy." She then handed it back to me and I continued to argue with her about it. After the forth try of her trying to hand it back to me, I said, just throw it away. I'm not gonna eat it." It was not like it was even eaten and I was trying to get something for free. Then a customer, not aware that I spoke Spanish, laughed at me and called me a whimpy white girl in Spanish. The staff laughed. I said out loud, "Yup! I am. I am a whimpy white girl." They all out there heads down. Rude employees. Never will go again
name: Shanna

text: What a lovely lovely building. Love St. Louis places rich with history. You have to go around Christmas it is just gorgeous!! We've been a few times and have really enjoyed the atmosphere and friendly staff.
name: Angela

text: Always a family favorite! My husband is a big fan of the lamb biriyani and my kiddos enjoy the soft naan.
name: Susan

text: I kept seeing the ads on the media and always thinking I would stop by one day to eat tacos and food that looked so delicious. Today, after a long day I finally was able to go. I had such a wonderful experience. Restaurant was clean, which is important to me. Service was fast. The chips with beans were different than other places. Beans were seasoned with pork lard, which gives them a different savor. I ordered six tacos, steak and pork, with coriander and onion. Red salsa was just right not too spicy, not too seasoned. Needless to say tacos were delicious. I also had coffee, made with cinnamon and piloncillo (brown sugar) coffee around the area. I ended up ordering more tacos to go. I would definitely come back again.
name: Lilly

text: I'm in STL once a minute month every time I have been at this location the server always serves someone else before me...I often thought it was because they were busy but the last two occasions were not busy at all (one having only 3 other tables & today were only 2 tables).  I made eye contact with BOTH the server & bar tender...needless to say a gentleman walked in 7 minutes after I sat down & his drink order was IMMEDIATELY taken! Really disappointing! It's hard to continue to go to an establishment when the service isn't decent. I will just have to find another spot in the airport.
name: Tory

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Price felt a touch high for what it was. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: Excellent night at this place!!!! I enjoyed it very much!!! Thank you for the wonderful night! I will be back again! The band is amazing! The quality of the sound is on top!!!! The service and drinks are very good! Highly recommend!!!!
name: Elena

text: I'm sorry that you have a popular product - but it doesn't justify terrible customer service. So after lunch you close the restaurant for 30 minutes and lock all the doors. No sign no communication to the customers. And your drive-through is loaded with 68 cars waiting to order. But nobody is telling the lead car at the drive up window that you're closed for 30 minutes and everybody is just waiting. Are you have to do is communicate and you won't have to deal with this terrible customer wrath. Stop the hype about the chicken  chicken sandwich and just serve your food. If it's good people will come. Just stop the hype
name: Tony

text:
Vegan Review:
My wife and I needed a vegan meal that wasn't too far off the highway as we were driving through town. Luckily we tried the Tortilla Factory. Without even having to ask about the vegan options, the manager, Daniel, told us he could make vegetarian & vegan friendly meals. Beans, rice, refried beans, mild tomatillo sauce, guacamole -- all cooked/prepared with no animal products. 

We each ordered a burrito filled with rice, pinto and black beans, grilled veggies, and tomatillo sauce. Daniel offered to add free guacamole in place of cheese and sour cream. It was delicious, filling,  and more affordable than many other options.
name: Andrew

text: I got a Medium pepperoni pizza and 10 Buffalo style wings. While the pizza was your standard tasting pepperoni, cheese style pizza it lacked in an unfavorable ratio of pepperoni and cheese to crust- I felt like I was eating a lot more crust than pizza at the end of it. While the wings were good, the buffalo style sauce wasn't anything special, soft wings but lacked a real crunch to them. I also felt every wing in the 10 I ordered were very much different in terms of the ratio of meat to bone.
name: Trent

text: Went for brunch. Great service although many waiters/waitresses. Tried the cinnamon bun to share, didn't taste much banana and a little too sweet.   Shrimp and grits were nice, very cheesy grits but the sauce complimented it well. Burger juicy but tomato missed from iy, needed the acid. Will definitely go back for dinner. Looking forward to it.
name: Sienna

text:
** I would've gave this place perfect stars just based on drinks / atmosphere / experience if I didn't have to deal with the hassle they gave me ** 

FIRST EXPERIENCE: first time I went here was after dinner with my boyfriend on a Friday night, we arrived around 10pm for drinks at the bar. I got the Guava Mojito, Zapata, Corona & Caipirinha de Mora. 

- Guava Mojito: mojito is my favorite drink & Guava is my favorite flavor so I didn't hesitate to order. Of course it was AMAZING. 
- Zapata: the mojito was so good I had to try another drink, the Zapata was good too but not as good as the Mojito though. 
- Caipirinha de Mora: my bf isn't a tequila fan (ya I know why would you go to a Mexican place lol) so the drink was super strong. But it's still a pretty and good drink though. 
- Pink Cadillac: another good drink 

SECOND EXPERIENCE: I loved the drinks so much, a couple days later, I stopped by again after dinner with a girlfriend. Of course I got the Guava Mojito and also the Pink Cadillac. 

***** HERE IS WHERE IT AFFECTED THE RATINGS *****
Couple days later when I went to use my card I realize IT IS NOT MY CARD!!!!!! Immediately checked my bank statements and I notice there's been a bunch of charges from places I know I never been. Long story short, it was pretty annoying to go get a new card, disputes and changing everything that was linked to my original card. It's just really ANNOYING. The other person doesn't even know her card got swapped with mine. But this all could have been avoided if the waitress did her job. I knew she wasn't too good, since she took forever to take our order considering there was only 2 tables outside and we had to keep flagging her down to get her attention.

text: Excellent! $22 and all you can eat sushi, hibachi and teriyaki. It's excellent. Eat for an hour! Awesome!

text: Would probably stop in again if nearby. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
Food was excellent. 

Bar not so much. Was served a beer with a dead fly it. I noticed it after a few sips. On top of that the bartender tried to charge me for the replacement beer.

text: I went with a big group and the service was amazing and everyone loved the dishes they ordered. Dominic's is an old school Italian restaurant, and I enjoyed the intimate atmosphere and special touches including a warming station for the dishes before the food was served. Highly recommend!
name: Dani

text: You cannot go wrong with the okra fries and the wedding beer! We have never had a bad dish here and the location is beautiful
name: Katie

text:
Seriously the BEST! I am not a fan of meat, but I love their beef and chicken! All of their employees are so nice and welcoming. Great prices for the amount of food you get. The sauces are sooooooo good. I could go on and on about this place. I took a few of my friends, and every other day they tell me how much they are craving BAB. I like how you have the option to add more meat (for cheap)... it is a rice bowl, so there is supposed to be more rice than meat....Just looking over the other reviews and I'm surprised at the complaints. 
Clean atmosphere and food is ready within minutes. I work mid-town, and live South Reno, so it's nice to have them on both sides of town.  Keep up the good work BAB!
name: Anatasia

text:
This used to be my favorite Mexican restaurant. We would drive out of our way to come here. It was a great place to eat, drink and talk. 

Tonight, the music was very loud, like a dance club. The bass was so loud you couldn't even hear the words in the songs. Someone asked the manager if it could be turned down, and he said he did, but it was still uncomfortably loud, and thumping!
name: Kenneth

text: It is a nice sushi place in the airport. It is nice and quiet. Lucy was very friendly. I tried the triple delight and it was delicious! I also promised her that if I ever have a chance to come back, I will try the Ramen as well. I will definitely recommend this to my friends.
name: Kelvin

text: Lovely cafe with lots of seating, great coffee, and very friendly service. Will be back :)
name: Simone

text:
This place is awesome! I have been here a couple times, and have never had a bad experience. The food is always great and the options are truly endless. Also, I love the location because it is so close to Eller and a walking distance from University.  

Each time I go there, I try to experiment with a new style and I have always been impressed. I've tried the fried rice, ramen, chow mein, and the low mein. It's basically a chipotle version of pei wei but its cooked to order like Mongolian BBQ. The ingredients are fresh and right in front of you, making it easy to choose the bowl of your dreams. Anything you can think of, they most likely have it. 

The only slight issue I have with the restaurant is that there is very minimal parking. You are allowed to park at the Circle K next door or the parking garage across the street, but it there isn't any advertised parking on the premise.

Overall, this is a great place to get some unique and tasty food that's prepared right in front of you. Great options, and an even greater price. 5/5
name: Mason

text: I've only had the muffins and coffee here (I plan on a bagel one of these days)... I dont come often as I am on the lower carb thing but when I do indulge, everything is delicious. We usually get a dozen mini muffins for me and my two daughters and I get a brewed coffee. Coffee is also fresh tasting. It can be busy and seating is limited but food is worth it.
name: Niki

text: Best sandwich in all of Tampa Bay Area -From Siuth Tampa to Brooksville-- SIMPLY the BEST
name: Erica

text: First time here. Didnt take long for the food to come out, we ordered the spanish omelet and it was awesome! Wanted to get a second one! The server was kinda rushing us to order. But the food shined through. We would come back again
name: Stacey

text:
Got delivery from capital beer through Uber eats. Came exactly on time given the quoted estimate on the app. 

We ordered two tiger rolls, an eel avocado roll and steamed dumplings. The dumplings were awesome. Absolutely perfectly made to my liking with the thicker dumpling as opposed to the softer more flimsy dough covering. The sauce that accompanied it was good as well. Both rolls were great. The tiger roll came with 8 rolls and the eel avocado roll had 6 rolls. They gave us 4 containers of soy sauce. We could have had less containers and more inside each container. 

They gave us two pairs of chopsticks but also there was an empty chopstick paper holder which was odd. They didn't include any fortune cookies but they included plenty of napkins. All in all good experience. Would order again.
name: Stephanie

text: Have always loved the ambiance here and the brunches I have had here for special occasions have always been lovely. Hope to get back here for dinner around Christmas time.
name: Amanda

text: For the price I expected more than this. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Just not for me. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: OMG!!!! this place was not good at all. BAD experience. untidy and bad food. I regret going there.
name: Vinodita

text:
This place is a "hidden" treasure and I am so happy I found it! I was so hungry when I got there I wanted the entire menu. I chose the deviled eggs appetizer, which needed a bit of salt but was really good. For dinner I had the Fish & Chips (deep fried potato chips) and it was amazing! Those chips were so good - hot and fresh!

The hostess recommended that I have the White Chocolate Bread Pudding for dessert and I have to say it overwhelms you. It was a huge portion, full of great flavors and that warm gooey White Chocolate sauce was insanely delicious!!! I am so glad they had some left and it made the perfect ending to a great meal.
name: Ira

text: Five stars guys. I go here when I am at my absolute lowest for nourishment. Trust me I'm a college kid and I know it's a little expensive but I think this is genuinely the only place where I get vegetables. I had the worst day ever today and the one thing that made my lonesome soul happy was the strawberry fields salad. Bless up.
name: Emma

text: Really an excellent coffee shop in a great building. Oat milk iced latte was excellent and they have other alt milk options
name: Chris

text:
GREAT food! We were excited to try Renzo's in Carrollwood after hearing about the one in South Tampa. We WILL be back again.. not soon enough though.
This place has great food. I don't know how to decipher "authentic" but everything was cooked perfectly and the flavor was incredible.

My fiance' and I started off with Cachapas con Queso which was the perfect starter to the meal. The seared outside REALLY makes the flavor that much better.
The beef empanada was really good too. It was filled with meat and had crust, flaky crust that didn't fall apart when you ate it.
I order the Rucola salad and the Argentine Flank. My fiance ordered Renzo's steak salad (not pictured). The size of the steak was pretty decent and everything was definitely filling. The homemade chimichurri sauce that comes on the side is a MUST have. 

There is a little bit of a struggle with a language barrier with the servers, but they absolutely go above and beyond to make sure you're taken care of. Just practice patience, and you'll really enjoy your meal. 

Our dinner ended with a dessert that I immediately fell in love with, called "Chaja". We ended up ordering another piece to-go because it was just that fantastic.

Renzo's is HIGHLY recommended, as there is also not a lot of places like it in the area. Looking forward to visiting again!
name: Emily

text: We've been coming here for a little over a year and it's still the best tasting affordable Korean food in fishers. We had the stone pot Bibimbap and tried the coffee bubble tea. The flavors were fresh and the coffee bubble tea was strong and delicious.
name: Joshua

text:
The Mashville Old Smoky Distillery/Yee Haw Brewing Spot was by far our favorite in Nashville. We spent several hours Friday and decided for our last afternoon on Saturday we would return here it was so great!  Not sure if/when we will be back to Nashville, but if we do this is definitely going to be our first stop.

Also be sure to do the moonshine tasting!  We had Kayleigh and Cassidy for tasting in Friday afternoon (not sure if spelling correct!) and they were amazing!!
name: Jennifer

text: Foods pretty delicious and came out timely, staff is friendly, and the place is neat. Coming back again soon!
name: Ellie

text: So yummy for about $10 if you get the high rise crust (which is honestly better)! I created my own style of supreme pizza & fell in love with the butter herb flavor that was on my dough before the red sauce. My churro cinnamon pizza was decent, but I def could've done with more frosting & less chocolate chips. Overall, I enjoyed pieology in Seminole & will visit again!
name: Raven

text: Always a great place to eat with a friendly staff. And yes you can find healthy options on the menu! Bon Appetite!
name: The Healthy Hot Rodder

text: Beautiful restaurant, amazing service, great happy hour. We had a smorgasbord of small plates here, some were sooo good, others were okay. I would definitely recommend the Karishma drink, it's spicy and the perfect accompaniment to any of the food. The list of things we loved: cauliflower, Ragada patties. Things I wouldn't order again: hummus platter, spicy Reshmi kebab. The service was top-notch, our server recommended some of their house specialties and explained almost everything on the menu. The restaurant is gorgeous, they did an amazing job decorating and creating a hip, warm atmosphere. The happy hour is everyday, who doesn't love Saturday happy hour? Drinks are half price and tons of food specials. We will definitely be back to try more of the food and drinks!
name: Sarah

text: Came here with my fiancé on a whim and it did not disappoint. 1$ hard-boiled eggs, reusable metal straws (which you can buy!), great coffee. Overall, my fiancé and I agree "that this place slaps!"
name: Sophia

text: Came here for my birthday and got the trough (every meat they have on a mega platter). Well worth the money. I was in a meat coma for days though. But oh man I'd do it again in a heartbeat. The chipotle sauce on the burgers was unreal - and this is coming from a sauce connoisseur! I think the trough runs you around 300$ but with a party of 8 it's well worth it!!! We barely finished as 8 hungry college kids who starved ourself all day. It was like the last supper! Our waiter was cool too, rooted us on until the finish. Great vibes. Will definitely come back again for the trough!
