text: The fiancé and I made Christmas reservations here as a special treat since we are away from family and the food was amazing. Our server was good. Not spectacular but he got the job done. Wasn't a huge fan of where they seated us. Felt like we were shuffled off to a corner sitting next to was looked like an old airplane bathroom door. Would definitely return if for nothing more than the delicious food!
name: Caitlynn

text:
My second time at Campo, first time was a few years ago and we sat on the patio for drinks. For lunch at 1pm Monday we sat inside and waited for 5+ minutes for a greet (there were 5 tables in the entire place max).  I had the river walk to start, wife had the Kentucky mule. Both were nice and refreshing.  

We ordered lunch, I had the express business lunch, kale salad and roasted cauliflower, wife had the short rib ravioli. I'm curious why they call it the business lunch because it definitely didn't come with express service timing. It felt like we waited forever, although I didn't time it like I typically would. 

Finally our meals come out, and my kale salad was overly garlicky, and thats alot coming from me because I LOVE garlic. It lacked any other seasoning and was topped with a soft poached egg. Not a fan. My cauliflower on the other hand was served in a cast iron pot, half of which was hardened bread crumb pieces, and sitting in alot of oil. Decent flavors, but not appetizing to dry off each piece before eating. This was my wife's second time having the ravioli and she commented that it wasn't as good as the first time either. 

After waiting again what felt like forever for our server to find that we were done eating, I mentioned that the kale salad was overly garlic in flavor, and he discounted the meal $4. This was a kind gesture, and one we didn't expect, however it doesn't mask the other issues we experienced with the meal.
name: Devin

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food was fresh and service was quick. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food was good and came out fast. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It looked better online than it did in person. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
It looked like a place from the 1950s inside.   It was dark in the dining room, with the staff dressed in white shirt shirts and dark pants.   White table cloths adorned a room with carpet with a subdued pattern.   Just a real 1960s vibe like you would seen in Goodfellas.   

I ordered a ribeye and a side of broccoli and lemon.   Something to cut the richness and keep me from keeling over from cholesterol.    My steak was perfectly done and really tasty.   

Nice meal if you are up for a meat fest.

text: Love this bar! Its our neighborhood Cheers... you will always know someone when you walk in. After your first visit, the owners/bartenders Scot and Rachel will likely know your drink of choice and have it waiting on the bar by the time your butt hits the barstool. Great jukebox and Golden Tee if you need a distraction. They have lots of TVs and beer specials during games... so it makes it a great place to catch one.
name: Abby

text: Enjoyed the tapas-like style of Louie's Wine Dive.  Our waiter, josh,  did a nice job of grouping the dishes and spaced out the selections perfectly. Excited to go back for another meal!
name: Gina

text:
As I've stated before, being blessed () with celiac (gluten allergy), I always appreciate a restaurant that has great gluten free options and the Ram is such a place.
They are currently running their Burgerama promotion which includes about 6 or 8 burgers, on top of their other regular burgers. The most loved burger will become part of the permanent menu after the promotion. I chose the "Guac this Way Melt", which "is made with Applewood smoked bacon, savory garlic roasted mushrooms, freshly made guacamole, Wisconsin Swiss cheese and roasted garlic mayonnaise on our grilled classic marbled rye." (Lifted from https://www.theram.com/news/). Of course I swapped out the rye bread for an Udi's gluten free bun. 
It was an amazing burger!!!
Please bear in mind they do not have a certified gluten free area so there will be cross-contamination, which isn't a huge deal for me.
Our waiter was super friendly and the service was prompt and fast. I was there with four other people.at about 11:30 on a Thursday.
name: Kim

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: This is the tastiest ramen in Tucson. The broth is rich and filling. The egg preparation is the only thing lacking in this soup..overcooked, cold, and plopped in as afterthought, not seasoned. Chashu is very yummy. Way better than Oban. Karage-don is also very good. The service is busy but friendly. Go for weekday lunch to avoid the lines at this new and popular spot. I'll be back many times.

text: Eh. Not really that great. Got an individual size pizza, medium, and breadsticks for $35 bucks. Definitely not worth it. Crust has no flavor, tastes like air. text:
Everything about this place feels reminiscent of Bleubird. Given its circumstances that makes sense, and is in no way a bad thing.

I went there at 11:15 am on a weekday and there was no line. The biggest downside of the location is how awkward the layout can be when it gets busy, fortunately this wasn't a problem.

I ordered the Peruvian, a delicious sandwich containing salami, ham, bacon, sausage crumbles, Monterrey jack cheese, sauce, and fritos. It was honestly one of the best sandwiches I've had downtown. The addition of the sausage crumbles and fritos made for a great texture combination.

I fully intend to go back here in the near future and try one of their other sandwiches.

text: Sandwiches are great and offer a variety of cold and hot sandwiches to choose from! The staff is always super friendly! Happy to have them close to our house now!

text: For the price I expected more than this. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It just never rlly recovered once things started off weird. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Probably not coming back. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: This place is right up the street from our house, we had friends visiting from out of town and were really excited to bring them here, the hostess greeted us very nicely and offered us a seat at the bar to wait for our table (we were early) and before we even finished a sip of our drinks our table was ready! we sat down and waited a bit for our waiter, upon his approach he offered to explain the menu, which was helpful, he then offered to give us some time to make our choices and boy did he make good on that one, he took a very long time to return and when he did, not only did we know what we wanted to eat but we were ready for drinks as well, he then disappeared for another extended period of time and upon his return, he only had one of our drinks?! and it was for my husband, not mine nor the other female guest! this became the theme of the night, with him disappearing for really long periods of time, not being attentive to our table and it just interfered with the overall experience.  I had the Cappelletti which was a bit salty but still very tasty, I'd ordered a coke with my meal prior and it never came, finally my husband pulled another waitress aside and she notified our waiter, but by the time he came it, I was done with my meal, I even said to him "I ordered that with my meal but I'm finished now?!" he didn't apologize, he didn't explain, he simply shrugged his shoulders and said "Okay" and walked away, wow....the ambiance in the dining room was beautiful but I'm sorry to say that the service was a complete let down and frankly embarrassing for us as hosts to our friends.
name: Leah

text:
Your mobile mapplication announces: "You've arrived! Your destination is on the right." And so it is. You can see it. You can see people inside. But...where's the entrance? You'd heard there was no parking. Wasn't there supposed to be a valet? No signage. Not even a hint of a stand. {sigh} Go around the block to an alleyway named Cleveland Street. Drive about halfway down that roughly treated passage and you'll find the valet to your east. The main entrance is also a bit obscure, but it's the misplaced bit of architecture that offers no view of a door. Finally, you can agree with the palm of your hand. You've arrived.

The space is expensive hipst'upscale heavy iron and wood, low-lit, yet warm, and surprisingly comfortable. Staff were welcoming, prompt, and knowledgeable. Jeepers! someone is doing it well!

Your mileage will vary as much as the flavors on the card. The menu is eclectic. It's enough so that I didn't bother with an entree. Interesting appetizers deserved more attention. My wife went for the fried gnocchi entree which was tasty, but just barely browned on one side; nowhere close to "fried."

The baked dates are a juicy, flavor-packed savory, sweet must-do. The pastrami poutine is mildly savory, almost sweet, and a meal in itself.

The bone marrow, though interesting and yet another standalone meal, is a confused mix of food and flavors that fail to work with each other. Marrow stands on subtle flavor and buttery consistency. Lose either and it's both a waste of effort and money. Topped with a load of excellent barbecue pork and sauce, the dish is filling, but marrow lovers may best avoid it. Toasted bread intended for the marrow is used as a base of the stacked presentation. Soggy and saturated with barbecue sauce, it offers little more than an open-faced pork sandwich. Note to kitchen: you really need to rethink this dish -- it's a star-killer.

But, one artistic blunder doesn't condemn the place. Overall, it was good. If I'm ever in the area again, I'd revisit.
name: David

text: This ramen is BANGIN'. Great for a cold, rainy day. Don't forget to top your noodles off with the crushed peanuts and sesame seeds they provide at the table - they hide in plain sight, but the meal isn't complete without them!
name: Courtney

text: We loved the place. First of all the waiter was extremely attentive. He also had this sort of "old world" style which we appreciated. The ambiance was great. We loved the roaring fireplace. The good was perfect. I had a steak salad, he had The meatloaf. We started with oysters & martinis. We had a wonderful dinner on a Friday night; just before the Santa Barbara Bowl for a show.
name: Kim

text: This was my first visit at Justine and I will for sure be coming back. Perfect location. The ambiance was right up my alley as well.  The service was exceptional.  Maitre'D Robby was so helpful with painting a picture for my friend and I as we couldn't decide on a plate since everything sounded so good! With tips on the best way to enjoy our meal, we did exactly that!

text:
Charming, neighborhood Italian bistro.  Very pleasant atmosphere.  The food was excellent and there was a large selection of farm to table offerings.  Outstanding service with a very attentive owner on premises.  
Extensive menu with delicious food, generous portions, reasonable prices, particularly considering the high quality of the food.  The owners really know what they are doing.  Great for lunch, dinner, and carry out. A hidden gem gaining in popularity as words spreads about what a great dining experience Peno offers.

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: Great hoagie and cheesesteaks. We used them to cater a party and ordered salads, hoagies and fruit. It was all delicious and all guest remarked how good the chicken hoagies were. Their menu is very broad and it's very organized for efficient catering and everyday ordering. Owner Mike is a great guy and friendly with everyone.
name: David

text: Had an excellent donair here.  The sweet sauce was wonderful and lots of meat.  I was so hungry I did not get a pic but I will be back.
name: Liz

text: Highly upset as I was looking forward to eating here. We arrive a little before 7:20pm on a Monday night. There was a table of 4 people and one table of two people being occupied. There was a sign that says "please wait to be seated." We waited for a little over 5 mins and even the server came out and saw us but didn't acknowledge my boyfriend and I. Two servers actually saw us. So out the door we went. Will not be giving them another chance.
name: Michele

text:
Let me first start out by saying, this was one of mine and my husbands favorite places to eat because the food is good but after this weekend we sadly saw a different side of the management and owner that we were sadden to see. 
Saturday we had purchased a gift card for my parents who were going to eat there that night as a gift to surprise them once they were there. I called multiple times that day, talked to several different staff which they let me know they had it completely under control. 
After my parents had left we found out that they had never received the gift card that night. When I called Saturday night once they left I asked to speak to a manger. The manger started out the conversation rude and disinterested in what I had to say and how disappointed I was. He said they see so many people a night that we couldn't expect the gift card to get to the right person. 
To add to this, my parents had reservations that night which I had let them know about with a name and a time. Really no excuses in my opinion.
He said he couldn't do anything about it and I would need to talk to the owner. He said he would have him call me the next day. 
Well Sunday when I looked, they are closed so I assumed I would hear from the owner today (Monday). 
After most of the day went by I called and talked to a bartender that said the owner had just stepped out and that he would be back in, in the next hour. He also said "I am putting a note on his office door that he has to see to go in so he will call you back."
It is now almost 10 o'clock at night and I have still heard nothing BUT I got an email that my gift card  had been refunded. NO CALL, but they refunded the gift card. That is pure pathetic. What poor customer service. What poor management. Now I see why the staff is the way they are. It obviously trickles down from the owner.
name: Olivia

text:
1st timer!  Went for lunch on a Friday with about 12 people.  Tables are 1st come 1st serve and you seat yourself.  We managed to all be able to sit together.  I got the baked macaroni and softshell crab.  Delicious!  I also got a side of red gravy to go with the bread.  So good!  I also tried some of my friend's veal parm, delicious! Another friend shared a fried oyster and onion rings, both great.
The women who take your order are very nice and extremely hard working and efficient.  When you pay the older gentlemen at the cash register don't expect him to smile.  Don't get your feelings hurt.  It's not about you.  Extremely large portions.  I took about 5 lbs of baked macaroni home that I couldn't finish.  
I got a to go box of jambalaya, veal parm and a crab cake for my family for dinner because after being this full I am definitely not doing any thing after work but recovering from my gluttony.
Skip breakfast, where your stretchy pants and mumus, take your blood pressure medicine and strap on your feed bag.
name: Christen

text:
The flavor of the bowls are good but they melt QUICKLY. The acai blend is a bit too watery for my liking in general, I'm used to acai bowls being cold, thick, and more of a sorbet texture. I like the availability of goji berries as a topping though! 

The staff is mostly high school girls who didn't seem thrilled to be there. I got looks when I walked into the establishment like I was interrupting their chat. Overall okay but not eager to return.
name: Jessica

text: I love this bakery! Always freshly made vegan/vegetarian options available for breakfast. Its a good spot to switch out those Sunday brunches for something more on the healthier side.  Their staff is very friendly as well!!! Ps they have a courtyard through the back which I ALWAYS forget is there...hopefully I will sit there one day!
name: Giselle

text: So it was Jazz Fest and we waited quite a while... but thank God we did! This was a great experience with unbelievable quality food. The only complaint was the dry breakfast biscuit... but I knew that was coming when my buddy ordered it. The steaks were perfectly cooked and made a great meal that carried us all the way to a late dinner after the fest. Awesome bloody Mary's and they even had one local beer on tap... for breakfast! I can't wait to go back and enjoy it again... hopefully before the next Jazz Fest.
name: Daniel

text: Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The wait felt longer than it should have. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. It looked better online than it did in person. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Amazing food and friendly staff! This is a must try place when in New Orleans. Don't let the look of the place turn you off the food is definitely authentic and home cooked to order. Tried 2 different orders both were great. There's not much seating, some benches outside took ours to go. Give this a try you won't regret it!
name: Meghan

text: Straight up diner.  Good portions and a friendly staff.
name: Danielle

text: The atmosphere of this little cafe was simply perf. Ate out in the open air section, the chicken and waffles were delicious, as were the banana waffles. And the mimosas were fantastic! Highly recommend for a romantic brunch
name: Dru

text: Went here for the first and last time tonight.  Waited over an hour for burgers.  Potatoes were cold not even a little warm.  The owner/manager Nicole was rude, my grandson heard her yelling at staff.  She then yelled at my son in law and husband, chased my son in law who is a police officer out of the door screaming at him because we complained about the food.  3 out of 6 people had their orders wrong.  Do yourself a favor and do NOT go here.
name: Joey

text: My second time here and iamazing as the first time. This go around I had Kim as my waitress and she was great. I honestly think people need to visit NO to get a lesson in the service industry. Nonetheless, the food comes out quickly and my family loved their dishes. This is my go to NO restaurant.
name: Latrice

text:
I have been to Andria's several times, and every time prior I have had wonderful food and service.  This time, the service was still wonderful, but the quality of the food had diminished immensely.

My wife and I went, for not special occasion, just to enjoy a nice steak, or in my case, a prime rib.  The size of cut of my prime rib was comparable to the previous visits, but the meat quality was maybe a little above terrible (for a place such as this).  Lots of tendons and a ton of fat.  I would say a quarter or more of the cut was fat.  Previously I would only need a fork to cut through the meat, this time I had a tough time, no pun intended, with a steak knife.  To make matters even worse, the price on their online menu was way lower than the price at the restaurant.  I was extremely disappointed.

My wife chose the strip steak, which was also extremely tough, and had a ton of tendons, etc.  I tried a piece of it and had to chew for a while just to be able to swallow it.  Even the side baked potatoes seemed different.  I seem to remember them being rolled in some sort of rock salt and baked, but now they just tasted like something that would come out of a microwave.

To me it almost seems as though they have changed meat providers, or something because none of it was to the quality I remembered.

It is unfortunate that the quality has sunk so low, as I really did used to love this place.  But the quality meat we received for the price we paid, we won't be going back.
name: Brian

text: Breakfast was awful! Sausage gravy was very salty, made with chopped up sausage links (that had an off taste) and the biscuit was a canned "Pillsbury Grands" type biscuit! The creamed chipped beef was too salty to eat and the toast was difficult to cut even with a knife! My brother-in-law did enjoy his omelette. Then to add insult to injury they gave us 1/2 off of food we couldn't eat! The waitress said this was done at the direction of the owner. Any place that cared about repeat customers would not have charged and offered a discount to be given a second chance. Needless to say we won't be back.
name: Diane

text: Awesome service. Super clean and welcoming. I had the torta and it was unlike any torta I've ever encountered.  $5 margaritas on Thursdays made for an awesome lunch definitely coming back .
name: Mel

text: We had not looked at the menu prior to going to the restaurant but rather went on the rating and reviews.  At first we were taken back by the menu as all of the dishes (entries, appetizers and salads) were very unique and unconventional.  The descriptions of the menu items were very specific and for those who are looking for standard fare this is not the place for you.  However, there was fillet and fish on the menu but prepared in very interesting ways.  With all of that said, I had the halibut which was out of this world.  The fish was over a rice pilaf mixed in with quinoa and asparagus on the side.  The halibut was moist and prepared just right.  My wife had trouble with deciding on what to eat so she had an appetizer and salad.  The appetizer was ahi tuna cut in small chunks served with small pastry shells to put the tuna in along with  a very nice sauce on the side.  It was also delicious .  Finally, the atmosphere and service was very nice.  Final advice, check the menu in advance to see if works for you.
name: Stan

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: Brought my parents and husband here for a fantastic experience. Burgers, fries, and milkshake were all unanimously praised. Housemade veggie burger was well-appreciated, as was the staff. Their computer system was down so they gave us our meal on the house! We're sure to keep coming back.
name: Jennifer

text: Order anything but Veggie burger and you will be satisfied. Crafty, hipster, burger joint with awesome ambiance. My veggie burger was slightly nland and mushy, but all other real burgers and fries were excellent. The service was great too. A place to visit in Treasure Island for sure!
name: Jisoo

text: I had taste for some etouffee so I found this on yelp. They had a sampler plate would worked out really well because we got to taste everything. The grilled boudin was great too and try the mustard sauce. They have specials by the door so I also did the crab cake which was good, it was already covered with a sauce and topped with shrimp so that was a bonus.
name: Krystle

text: 5 hours into a 20 hour road trip from Michigan to Texas my roommate and I stopped into this place after painstakingly scrolling through Google. The menu looked diverse and the price was right so why not right?. Well all of those minutes of scrolling paid off. Immediately there was a comfortable atmosphere to the restaurant. The sound of relaxed conversations and staff laughing at jokes between checking on tables fill the place. We enjoyed a beer and ordered the tug of war, onion rings, their featured Cuban burger, and mashed potatoes. My roommate raved about the burger and surprising ate more then me. And the mashed potatoes, if he brings them up one more time I might leap from the vehicle. My sandwich which consists of smoked gouda, a grapefruit sized ball of succulent pulled pork, a delightful and bright bbq sauce, and just enough purple cabbage to tell your doctor you ate a vegetable with dinner. The sandwich was juicy and flavorful though I didn't understand why they provided a bun. It was obviously from the start there was not possible way to contain such flavor. It was literally dripping with flavor. After my plate look like best Sloppy Joe commercial ever I submitted to its deliciousness and ate the rest with a knife and fork. The onion rings we crisper than Lays and were so rich they could almost be meal on their own. The perfectly cooked onion added a light sweetness to them. Will definitely be stopping by next time I'm in Indianapolis area.
name: Jared

text: Watery martini.  Fois gras not so much liver as a stick of butter. Bad burger. Nice Yellowfin.  Nice tarter. Otherwise meh. Don't bother.
name: Cynthia

text:
Just moved to Odessa from Land O Lakes we checked out this place for delivery. Overall, poor attempt at NY pizza. Marghertia pie was sub par something off with the dough, sauce was bland and sour. The sicilian pie was a god awful eating experience. I give it a 0.0 I don't even want to bother explaining its pit falls. Don't order it.

After writing this review I was credited back for the meal. I give that a 10 out of 10 for addressing the issue and taking ownership. I am hoping they can correct the issues and we will order again in the future.
name: Dan

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
I came to this location to have lunch after searching for an apartment since I'm moving to Tampa in a month and I have to say I was welcomed by every person who was working there along with my mother and friend and I also had my emotional support animal with me. 
.I found out that the gentleman who gave up his corner table for all of us was the general managers boss and I believe his name was BK as they call him... He was amazing and super friendly and even came and sat down with us and chatted... he is the type of boss that you'd want to work for very down to earth and then I met the general manager Nate and the retail manager Rita who were both super nice super friendly and actually talked about possibly recruiting me to join their staff as I may need a part-time job when I move down in the next month... I know that the service up north is sometimes very slow and unfriendly but I found this location to be quite amazing and I'm definitely going back to eat there... The food was excellent as always I have an session with their pancakes and I deathly recommend this Cracker Barrel!
name: Jackie

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
We really love this place! Amy is the best, anytime we go whether it's busy or not she is fast to offer drinks/menus/service. I have been several times and so have many friends, we all agree that this place is fun for a sit down meal and chat. On Tuesday they do trivia night and oh my it is a blast! Can't wait to try our luck again. Even when just ordering something to go for a later pick up it's always great, hot food ready when you arrive and just as well prepared as if you were going to be dining in- (which isn't always the case at other restaurants!) there are some that I learned the hard way when you order food to go there is less effort put in to it or even things missing from the order, but here, they make sure it's always right! Some of my favorite go-to items here are the crispy chicken strips-comes with fries!/the Caesar salad is bomb and a small is plenty enough/and the Irish nacho stack is simply delicious. They have a "7 Items/ $7 / till 7pm" menu that is awesome for an early dinner with friends (includes that delicious Irish nacho stack I mentioned before) hands down one of my favorite places to go eat and hang out within the legends mall-
I recommend this place to many people when they ask for lunch/dinner options and is always my first place to recommend when someone asks a good place to grab a beer. Don't even get me started on their alcohol selection, a place that actually serves Tullamore D.E.W....you should check it out, and while you're at it, check in on yelp! You get a free flight of beer! Next time you're in the legends mall and feel like a cold beer or a bite to eat, give this place a try and you won't regret it
name: Maddie

text: Another great meal tonight. I loved the tamale and Russ had two empanadas. We shared a chicken rice bowl. Everything was great.
name: Kathy

text: Never ordering from here again. Waited OVER 2 HOURS, when it was only "30-40 mins." They cancelled my order without me knowing or even notifying me, so I waited those 2 hours with them lying it would "be here any minute." Don't order from here, they're not worth your time.

Another sold out show and everyone on their feet dancing/clapping throughout their performance.  The food, as always, is delightful and on point.  The wait staff never disappoints. text: Food was really good.  Only knock is that they don't fill up the rice and beans bowl to the top.    Back in southern California the rice and beans are almost always filled to the top.  Maybe it's an Indiana thing.. Plus points for good music selection
name: Daniel

text: Food was delicious, service was fantastic. Music City Hop tours offers 10 % off, which is why we chose to eat here, and we are glad we did!
name: Katie

text: Wow! Great BBQ! Great Location. Additionally, has a family style menu. A bit of wait because they were very busy, a busy restaurant is a good thing.
name: Joe

text: For the price I expected more than this. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. A couple small things kept adding up. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Just not for me. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
We stopped in here on Father's Day and had a great meal! I was a little bummed no sweet tea and no Dr. Pepper but it was fine. 
The staff were friendly and the food was amazing! They did well getting people in and out but not rushing anyone. We all had great experience!
name: Patricia

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: First time here stopping on my way thru Reno. Had a cauliflower sandwich and it was outstanding. The cook was very hospitable and courteous. Would definitely eat here again.
name: Jeremiah

text: My friend liked it more than I did. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. So yeah, the host got us seated quickly, which i appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. maybe I just came on an off day. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was fresh and service was quick. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: I go to this diner all the time. Very rarely have I had a ignorant waiter/ress and the food is always good. If we ever have a complaint about the food, a lot of the time they will take the food off the receipt. The management is great and the deserts are to die for!
name: Reese

text:
I went just for a quick bite while in town. Upon entering you are greeted by a small yet well lit and clean dining room. Once seated, you are brought a plate of REAL ginger and a healthy amount of good wasabi.  I ordered the salmon sashimi and the pink panther roll. The sashimi was cut thicker than almost anywhere I've been before. The roll was great and the spicy tuna had a good heat level. The staff were very nice and attentive. The man making the sushi was also fun to talk to. My bill for the sashimi and roll ended up totaling at about $24 which is pricy but nothing out of the ordinary for sushi in this area. 

TLDR: If you're looking for good sushi this place is perfect. Just be ready to pay for what you get.
name: Jarod

text:
This place is absolutely insane. I was skeptical when my old fave La Colmena closed and this spot opened in its stead, but keep your mind open, friends, because Tacos Pipeye is a portal to flavortown.

 A+ fish tacos, crispy and flavorful, wrapped in thicccc homemade tortillas. They have a savage salsa bar and the owner/manager is incredibly nice. Prices are cheap -- 6 tacos for 10 bux? Bonkers. I walk here from work once a week and am never disappointed.
name: Noah

text: Had Bryce as a server and he was so great! Food was really good too! Enjoyed a nice lunch with some girlfriends and had a great time. Bryce really kept us all laughing the whole time! Will b back for more lunches as long as hes our server! Great food good prices and great service! Highly recommend
name: Mindy

text: Awful.  Swordfish special was a pile of goo in oil.  And the waiter was so inattentive.  Took f o r e v e r to get out of there.  Never going back.  Just such a ridiculously bad experience.
name: Teresa

text: I how I love this place. Best roasted pork, plantains, Cuban, and the fresh squeezed juice and made soda. To die for.
name: Janice

text:
Bartender was extremely rude. This was my first time here. I stood at the hostess stand for ten minutes before a girl came out of the back and told me I couldn't sit in the dining room until 5 and had to go to the bar.

I said that was fine, sat down, and the bartender slapped a drink menu down and walked away. She came back 5 minutes later and said what do you want.... I ordered a martini and it came in an aperitif glass barely full. I asked for the dirty rocks on the side and ended up throwing my drink on the rocks because it was only a shot of vodka.

The bartender rudely replied "you could've just ordered it on the rocks if you were going to do that!"

I told her a proper martini was served in a martini glass and had at least 2.5 ounces of vodka. She rolled her eyes and stomped away.

Disappeared for another ten minutes and at that point I lost my appetite and decided to get my check and go elsewhere
name: Harry

text:
This place has phenomenal food. Brought the family here for Father's day. They have hand crafted cocktails and an assortment of beer. The pasta and pizza are delicious. We also gave the cannolis a go for dessert. Our service was great and everyone was helpful.

The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is because when we first arrived and asked for a table the hostess at the front was rude and not helpful. She told us because we did not have reservations we would need to eat our food in under an hour bc the tables were already reserved for 630 ( mind you it was just after 5 when we arrived) She kept asking "can you eat within the hour?? We have reservations!"
We were informed we could eat on the patio except you can not order pasta on the patio..for some strange reason. She made us feel rushed before we had even sat down and was not accommodating what so ever. I'm sure the manager would love to have known his hostess was rushing people or not sitting tables because of reservations 1.5 hours out yet.
Thankfully our waitress told us not to worry and apologized for the rude attitude of the hostess.  
Service was fast and friendly so even with dessert we were out in time without feeling hurried.
name: Jessica

text:
It's been almost 30 minutes and I'm still waiting for my food.. I hope it's worth the wait..

Update.. it took 35 mins

Quesadilla was wonderful.. 

Tacos were tasteless.. so bad

Probably won't come back..

text: My friend liked it more than I did. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated bc we didn't have a reservation. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I prob wouldn't get again. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Always a great place to get a full meal. I love their side dishes. Wait time to get seated is short on a weekday. Wait staff are extremely nice.
name: Sally

text:
Yes, this restaurant is excellent! From the service, to the atmosphere, to the food, get ready to enjoy yourself. 

I had been to one other Fleming's several years ago in Dayton, Ohio for restaurant week and I hadn't been very impressed. The Tucson Fleming's could not have been any different than Dayton's. 

We had a reservation, but the initial table the hostess took us to was unsatisfactory for my mom. The hostess quickly accommodated us, no issues, and took us to a booth that we much preferred. Good customer service. Our server was Chris and he was top-notch. Just perfect. He knows how to take care of a table, unlike across the street at Vivace. 

They had a steak and lobster tail special for $50 and seeing that it was the best deal on the menu, we all ordered it. It came with a small plate to start: a bacon wrapped scallop with arugula. Delicious! Chris was able to accommodate my dad's dislike of seafood and bring him a small French onion soup instead. So nice! The next course was a salad of our choice. I went with the wedge salad and everything was so fresh and mouthwatering: perfect lettuce, perfect bacon, perfect blue cheese dressing. Then the main course! Omg! The lobster tail was delicious--perfect texture and flavor. The steak was also excellent, but I took most of it home since the meal came with so much food. Perfect leftovers for lunch. 

This place is super classy and I'm sad I had never dined here before because it really is a wonderful dining experience.
name: Mary

text: My mom and I went here for dinner as I just moved in across the street. We walked in and asked for a recommendation and clarification on what something was, and the waitress was so extremely rude. We felt rather uncomfortable, so we got up and left without ordering. I wish I had gotten her name because she definitely did not deserve to work there. I will never go here again. I really wanted to love this place, but unfortunately my experience was exactly the opposite.
name: Kait

text: Dessert saved this a little. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The music was louder than it needed to be. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better online than it did in person. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text:
This place is going down hill and fast. Came in with the wife and we both said to each other "the quality of the fish ain't there no more"
Tuna tasted so gross that my wife looked at tuna the wrong way now
It's very sad to say I won't be coming back as often and I literally thought this was the best in Reno but I was wrong. My advice to the owner is to have fresh and better quality of fish or else you will lose customer and sushi chef. I met one chef who was very known by alot of customer at a different sushi joint that use to work here when it was called rickshaw.(I won't say no name) He told me he felt bad serving customer low quality fish and even told the owner to get better quality fish, but the owner never listen and he ended up quitting. Very glad I found him.
name: Honest

text: This place is a gem of Reno, or anywhere for that matter. Big portions, plenty of vegan/veggie options (obviously tons of meat ones as well), open late. This is the awesome place you'd find in a bigger city and wonder how you lived without it. The roasted chickpeas are a must to snack on while waiting for your order or on the drive home. Friendly staff, good vibe, the metal vibe is unique and works well.
name: Christine

text:
I've been here twice and I'm already "a Duke."  There is something wrong with that as this place is a gem.  

For starters, let's be clear that it is a food truck.  But it is as well established an operation as any full-on restaurant. 

Also, its not quite in the location where Yelp has it.  It is "kitty corner" from the large white church at that intersection.  

With that, let me say that the people here are super nice, they make fresh limeade and the two dishes I've had (both shrimp) were so spectacular, that I plan to go again tomorrow.  Good, reasonably priced and fresh seafood is a luxury that everybody can afford here.  Enjoy it!
name: Ian

text: Christine was awesome server.  Food awesome too.  Highly recommend. Good food great service.
name: Karen

text:
I love this place. Every time I come here, I order Lemongrass Tofu or Basil Tofu (on the back of the menu). They're great vegetarian options (super flavorful), and they come with lots of onions, which I love. This time, though, I ordered something different. 
 
I went Saigon on Thursday night, and they had fair business for a weeknight. In fact, it got busier as the night went on. As I was looking through the menu, I noticed the Grilled Tofu Platter. I didn't ask what it was--I only verified it was vegetarian and ordered it. I guess this and the other grilled platter items have been on the menu forever, but I've never noticed them. What a mistake! The grilled platter, as it turns out, is a build your own spring roll kit. I loved it! It came with lettuce, basil, pickled veggies (daikon, carrot, and cucumber), rice vermicelli, protein, and, of course, the rice wrappers with water for soaking. The platter also came with two dipping sauces. I won't lie: I like playing with my food; so, this was perfect.

As for the service, I've never had slow or non-existent service at Saigon. The staff is always, friendly, helpful, and fast. The restaurant is always clean. I have no complaints.
name: Jess

text:
Always double check your order when going through the drive through. I have gone to this place a few times and 3 out of the 3 times they have forgotten something in my order, and only twice did
I caught it before driving away.

The wait was average depending on what time you go and the food taste just as good as any Wendy's store I've been too.
name: Andrea

text: Awesome food! Worth the wait, which was around 35 minutes at 11:15am.  The hot is quite intense, but you can handle it! Pimento Mac and cheese? Awesome. Chicken was moist too.
name: Alex

text: We went through the drivethru this morning to pick up breakfast. We had our dog in the car with us and were heading to the park for a picnic. We came around to pay and saw a truck at the window. There was a man behind the truck with a very long hose washing the lane. I pulled up 20 feet from the truck giving the man room to work. He yelled at me "hey can't you see I am working here". I looked at my husband who shook his head. I rolled down the driver's window and said I am not even near you. He became EXTREMELY argumentative and insisted that I had tried to hit him. I said you are ridiculous stop being so dramatic. The hose was gigantic and I did not even roll onto it. Clearly this man did not like his job and wanted to take it out on us. The truck moved forward then myself. I told the window clerk that we felt threatened since he was bent over glaring through my back window. I was watching him now through my rearview mirror. The lady manager was summoned and she assured me he would be talked to. We Love Burger King but will think twice before we head to this location again. It is close to our Favorite park. So Unfortunate that encounter.
name: Mary

text: May be historically interesting, but more of a tourist trap than a worthwhile dinner destination. The food was mediocre and most definitely overpriced. The atmosphere has an amusement park cafeteria feel to it, with service staff barking out reservations and large groups of people being funneled through the rabbit warren of rooms to be seated. While the "show" was a distraction , it was light years away from what a traditional Flamenco performance looks like. The sound system was spotty and poorly set up and the "costumes" worn by the dancers were hardly authentic representations of flamenco attire. Again, the entire group agreed that it felt like we were at an overpriced Disney show knock off. Save yourself the time and expense of this experience.
name: Anne

text:
County Jail would be an upgrade to staying at this place. We booked online at a reasonable price of $75 Easter weekend. We booked for Saturday night. My boyfriend and I took our time to check in because we had a beach day. When we went to check in there was a young woman at the desk and a friend of hers that was hanging around on the side of the desk. I booked the room and had a confirmation with booking.com. She looked it up, and said,"Sorry, we don't have a room for you. We run on a first come, first serve basis. We gave your room away." The other girl hanging on her desk started laughing. Apparently booking it has no value to them. She asked where I was from and I told her Fort Myers. She said,"Well it could be worse. We have people who come here from a different state and have there room given away." WOW...
The only thing that stopped us from driving back home was That I could stay with my friend on his couch for the night in St. Pete. The parking was like a Chinese puzzle and was so dangerous in their tiny back lot.The lobby looked like a nightmare. Everything run down. Thank God they didn't have a room, based on these reviews. No a/c? No screens on windows? Dirty sheets? Toilet paper soaked in urine? Ughhhh.... If that happened to me, I would be calling a Health Dept. inspector- not just writing a review.
name: Audrey

text: Perfect spot... highly recommend. Loved the CBD and the coffee was surprisingly good (diner coffee can sometimes suck)
name: Dave

text: Most expensive poke bowl I've ever had, and while it was decent, it wasn't worth the premium. I did get several add-on's, but one poke bowl plus soda was $30 (!). Even with the extra fish options, it was no more fish than the normal bowls from Poke Bowl (NoLibs) or other poke spots around town. Don't get me wrong, the flavors were good, and being able to get noodles instead of rice was nice, but the price is at least 30% higher than elsewhere in Philly.
name: Liang

text: We ordered a pumpkin cheesecake for Thanksgiving dinner. Server asked us if we wanted pecan or regular. We told her definitely regular didn't want the pecan. Today we took it out, thawed it only to discover it was pecan. SO disappointed. Sadly this has happened before with another that we throughly enjoyed but I figured since she asked and we were insistent that it could not be pecan we were safe. Next time I'll probably go to Costco. Dang I so wanted pumpkin.
name: Jalyn

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
Service is super great, we're always welcomed with a smile! They know us by our orders now, and it feels like a family atmosphere. The people at the front desk are super friendly.

The lunch buffet is the best deal in Tucson if you love Thai food!
name: C

text: This is my favorite go to for an easy evening. Couple of beers and a pizza. Great tap list, great food, perfect for apps. Great staff. Shout out to Casey who was on it...very little wait for anything, checked back to make sure all was good, next beer arrived before previous one finished!
name: Melanie

text:
Amazing fresh pizza using stove oven.
They have black dough as well to help with digestion.
It's light and fluffy in texture so after eating this you will be full and still feel light on your feet.
If you're looking for a chewier texture you can get the "ice" pizza.
They have unique items here aside from the twists on the basics. 
Service was friendly and the esthetics are modern and clean.
Highly recommend trying this out for pizza.
name: Natalia

text: Nothing short of amazing. We have noticed this place and for one reason or another had not gotten around to trying it. So glad we didn't wait any longer. My husband, stuffed to the gills after the salt and pepper calamari, ahi sashimi, ginger beef and shrimp in lobster sauce couldn't stop looking at yelp pictures of the food, planning for our return, which if up to him would be tomorrow. The star of the night was the ahi. Perfect balance of flavors, from the lemon to onion to delicate sauce and wasabi, everything melted into that perfect bite every time. The other dishes were no slackers, again the balance of flavors, nothing overpowering but everything intermingling to keep you coming back for another bite long after having thrown down your fork and declaring how stuffed and happy you are. Then dessert, because why not? The mango tapioca was the perfect ending, light, creamy and delicious. We will be back.
name: M.

text:
I had been interested in visiting JB Dawson's for awhile, so I finally decided to surprise my hubs with a reservation to celebrate Valentine's Day. We reviewed the menu and had some ideas as to what we thought we would order. 

We arrived at the restaurant to find a large parking lot with ample parking spaces. We entered a very busy JB Dawson's and were greeted by the hostesses. They had a large stack of pink slips that contained the names of parties who made reservations. We were 25 mins early, so we gave our names to the hostesses and received a pager. We waited in the large seating area near the bar with a bunch of other couples. The crowd thinned out and our pager went off at 6:15, which was the exact time of our dinner reservation (we were impressed). We were seated at a booth in the bar area, which wasn't ideal, but why complain?!

We looked over the menu again, which featured the usual apps like soup, wings, spinach dip, shrimp, etc. I ordered the baked potato soup and my hubs ordered the lobster bisque. Our soups were fantastic. They were soothing, and full of flavor. I ordered Cajun shrimp, and scallops with a side salad and a side of macaroni and cheese. My hubs ordered the Salmon Oscar, which was topped with crab meat and a light garlic cream sauce. He also ordered green beans and the 1lb baked potato for his sides. My salad arrived with a ranch dressing that was very unique in flavor. It was sweet and ranchy (kinda hard to explain). I really liked it. Our entrees arrived not too long after I finished my salad. I must  say, WE LOVED our entrees. Both were cooked perfectly. My Cajun shrimp and scallops were tender and my husband raved about his 1lb baked potato. I tried the potato myself and couldn't believe that it was cooked all the way through. The inside of the potato was buttery and fluffy. We thought the chefs/cooks really did a great job on our meal and we were impressed with how fast the food kept coming out considering the large crowd that was at the restaurant. 

We skipped desert bc we were so full from dinner, but we plan to return to try other options and indulge in some of JB Dawson's dessert options.
name: Nik

text: We love the craft cocktails and craft beers. The food is hit and miss. The batter on the fish and chips doesn't hold up. It's soggy and gross. The quality of the fish is good but a new batter recipe is mandatory. Their classic burger is good and so are the fries.
name: Michelle

text: I've been to the Pearl three times and had fresh, good experiences each time. The rolls are substantial. I really like their hot and sour soup, a slightly different but very good version. Staff has always been efficient. The quality of their fish is great and I like their roll flavor combinations, lots of salmon options which is my favorite.
name: Cynthia

text: Overpriced and food is not good.  The decor is nice, but that is about it. $120 for two, and we didn't like anything we ordered.  Vegetable curry wasn't curry at all -- just tasted like a cream sauce --  and there was basically just a lot of celery and mushy onions.  Trout was flavorless.  Beet salad had loads of canned fried onions as in your mother's 1950's string bean side dish for Thanksgiving.
name: Honey

text:
I don't get ice cream very often. However, tonight will be the last time I ever give my money to this business. I don't like vanilla ice cream so I ask for the chocolate. This was the second time they made it with the vanilla and put a small amount of chocolate on top so looking at it you can't tell. However once I get home 98% vanilla. I could had gone to the store and paid way less and gotten what I wanted. Very disappointing!

Had they just admitted their mistake it could had been saved.
name: Randi

text: The ORIGINAL and Better of the two local Mexican food places.  This is where fresh meets flavor.  Don't get lost and get on the "Bus" or you will miss-out big time.
name: Linda

text: On a previous visit, the food and service was outstanding.  Tonight, it was a train wreck.  I eagerly anticipated returning after a great meal in 2017.  When we arrived slightly early for our 8:30 reservation, we were told that our table was being "cleaned" and it would be very soon.  After 30 minutes awkwardly waiting in the bar, we finally pushed them to seat us, as several tables were open.  Seated, we still waited almost an hour to get our entrees.  This restaurant was a total mess tonight, and it's unlikely I will return, or recommend to anyone.  Totally a management fail.
name: Mark

text:
All three of our Bone-in-Wing orders were Dry, overcooked and drowned in sauce.

I will not return.

Disappointed!
name: Stephen

text: Went for dinner on a Thursday night and couldn't be happier. It just had its grand opening so some of the kinks are still being worked out. The food was really good. I had the Stunt Pig sandwich. It provided the opportunity to try different meats. Each was cooked to perfection. The Atomic Fireball applesauce was a modern take on cinnamon applesauce with a kick. So many things on the menu to try. A bonus: the Dr. came by and chatted with us for a few minutes.
name: LeRone

text:
Milkcrate is a great local option for a quick breakfast. They've always been a favorite of mine because they're one of the few places in Fishtown that you can get a proper PEC (pork roll egg and cheese). The sandwich is pricey at $8, but it's a fairly sizable amount of food. It comes with 3 generous slices of pork roll on an oversized English Muffin. Even with its considerable heft, the sandwich seems to disappear pretty quickly because it is just THAT delicious. 

The service is good and the ambiance is top notch. The entire store is walled with vinyl albums for sale. There is also a more complete record shop downstairs, though I've never ventured there because I'm fairly distracted by my delicious sandwich. 

Would easily be a 5/5, but more than $10 for a coffee and a sandwich seems like kind of a lot. Still definitely recommend though
name: Brendan

text: Wow. What a great experience. If you're looking for good comfort food that won't break the bank, this is your place. You could drive right by it and never know it's there, but once you've gone, you'll never forget it. Ambience was laid back with a bar like atmosphere, with the bonus of live piano playing. Service was fantastic and food even better. Menu has a great variety. My fiancé and I split the whole rack of ribs which comes with 2 sides and is on special every Thursday. Best ribs I've had in the city thus far. Cesar salad and potatoes au gratin did not disappoint either. The pie was light, airy and the perfect ending to the meal. We got all of this food and 3 cocktails for around $35. Speechless.
name: Karley

text: Not good. Poor service fallowed by terrible food. I got the chicken nachos, seems simple enough. It was a large pile of mush.
name: Brad

text:
Nice place, had brunch and is was tasty, my wife had the torta with green Chile and chorizo that was good, served on Mexican bread, I had the churro French toast that was to sugary and sweet but excellent in its own right, I feel it would be better fitted as a dessert than a breakfast item, or at least lighten up on the amount of sugar and add more fresh fruit!

Otherwise we'll try the dinner next and see how that goes?
name: Tommy

text: Such an awesome date night. A little pricey but you eat your weight in food trust me!
name: Casey

text: I love this place and really wish there was one closer. The food is always fresh, hot and tastes great. I've had breakfast (their pancakes are amazing), lunch like burgers and other sandwiches and dinner entrees. I am a big spinach fan and love the fact this is a side you can choose from. Also their vegetables are all seasoned and have such great flavor. They are slightly pricier than most similar restaurants but I do believe they are quite a step above the rest. I would recommend this restaurant for a nice casual place to eat with the family.
name: Tiffany

text: I have eaten my weight in sushi during my lifetime.  This little green sushi building tucked in Gravois Rd is the very....best.....sushi I have ever had.  Please support them because they are reasonably priced and amazingly delicious.
name: Blaise

text: The service was great but the food was below average diner at best. Totally wish we did not waste a meal here. I've had so many good meals and I felt totally ripped off that I ate here ‍ Gumbo was the worst!!!! Poboy was just salty not tasty. Kids meal was a great value for $5. There are too many good restaurants, do not waste one of your meals here. Felt like it was a total tourist trap.
name: Helena

text: Had lunch for the grand opening and it was tasty but not the best. Kimchi fries were labeled vegan on the menu but when we got them they were topped with pulled pork. The brisket my father got was delicious! Full of flavor and crispy but unfortunately it was cold. I got the comeback burger which says that it comes with ghost pepper sauce, house pickles, and aged queso.. however the only thing it came with was lettuce, tomato and the pepper jack cheese I asked to be added. And it was well over cooked. Not impressed with the burger at all. My girlfriend got the stunt pig with a side of the Brussels sprouts- amazing. Service was friendly. Will most likely try it again.
name: Justin

text: Famous Daves has no vegetables. The salad has meat in it. They do have steamed  broccoli.  Otherwise it's only meat. The original  famous  Dave's had a friendly  vibe this one has a feed lot vibe. Eat and get out. And the policy  against vegetables seems  weirdly  hostile. I never felt like I was challenging someone  before  by asking if they have vegetables or salmon before. I am not going  there  again the low level  of hostility was weird. The employees were apologetic about the meat-heavy menu. This restaurant is in Sam Hughes/Blenman-Elm/UA area., which enjoys a varied menu.
name: Wulfina

text: Never again. Worst decision of my life I rather go to McDonald's than come here even if it was free.
name: Big

text:
Loved it! My daughter treated me to a Santa Barbara trip for my birthday! (I had never been to SB before) 
Brophy Bros was the perfect restaurant for my birthday lunch!!! Fresh, delicious crab, oysters and scallops! Fun, relaxing vibe! Friendly and accommodating staff! Even a little special birthday treatment! GORGEOUS VIEW Will definitely go back!
name: Sandra

text: The beat chinese takeout we have found in Brentwood/Franklin.  We had Kung Pao Chicken, shrimp lo mein, shrimp fried rice, Mongolian beef, egg rolls and vegetable rolls.  All were really good.  The entire family, including my wife who is not a huge fan of most Asian food, liked their food and said it was really good.  As long as you are not famished or a really big eater, then the portion size for each was big enough to share.  This will be our new go to for chinese take out.
name: Johnny Cashus

text:
What an awesome NOLA gem!  Everything about this cozy little diner makes me giddy!!! The names/descriptions for the menu items make me giggle, the drinks put a little skip to my step, and the food makes my heart sing!

Came here as a foodie tourist on recommendation, and this place did not disappoint!  The servers are friendly & attentive, they don't skimp out on the drinks (you can get the party started before noon!), and the food represents home-cookin' down in Louisiana.

We got The Crabby Wife and the Jewish Coonass (lol), and for our "dranks" our server recommended ordering a whole bottle of champagne ($10) and a large OJ ($2) to mix our own mimosas at the table. This was a legit awesome recommendation for two of us hahaha...

We took an Uber from downtown NOLA to check this place out, and it was totally worth it!  The bonus was we got to check out the rest of magazine street after breakfast.  Will be back the next time we are in town, for sure!
name: Marie

text: My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not bad for a quick meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: I had wonderful Avocado Toast on gluten free English muffin here, which was delicious! It came with greens and cherry tomatoes on the top, lightly dressed with a vinaigrette-type dressing. Light and refreshing. I love that they were able to accommodate with the GF option. You walk into the restaurant and order at the counter. The atmosphere is nice and bright with a ton of windows and open seating. They have glass bottles of room temperature of water at the tables for free. We really enjoyed visiting this location. They also have lots of fresh juice and smoothie options, along with different flavors of açaí bowls, if you are looking for something like this! Great breakfast and lunch options.
name: Kandis

text:
I had never tried Chili's. Maybe I should have stuck with that! 
Their quesadillas are the absolute worst. No flavor! 
Egg rolls are okayish.
Never coming back for trashy food!
name: Ankita

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. For the price I expected more than this. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
My son is very sick currently (possible food poisoning) after we dined there. Make sure your burgers are WELL DONE before your child consumes any meats there. 

You'll hate to have your child vomit 5 times in 6 hours because he can't hold anything down after you've ate there. 

Our Waitress was decent, but the cooks don't know the difference between medium & Medium well, let alone  to refresh the order completely after we made the complaint. Went from Garlic butter to  plain-as-Day Steak. 

We will not be returning to this location, period.
name: David N.

text:
After my second visit today I have determined that I am an idiot for not frequenting this place until recently. In my defense I am not real big on Asian buffets for several reasons, especially sushi buffets. 
This place seems really clean and the food I had was all very good. I love their sashimi salad and their soups are also really delicious.
Their rolls are actually pretty decent, comparable to supermarket grade maki. I did not enjoy the spicy tuna but the spicy salmon was actually pretty good. My fav roll today was a red snapper & cucumber.
They have a decent selection of other dishes but they were higher in carbs then I was looking for today. I feel it is easy to eat really healthy here !
I still haven't figured out how to get the custom ordered pho or other types of bowls but maybe next time.
Also the $9.95 lunch deal Monday-Thursday is a great deal!
name: Mike

text: This place is awesome. Honestly the best dessert I've had in the short time I've lived in the Tampa. I hope more restaurants grow to the level of innovation and flavor exploration as Edision.
name: Thomas

text:
Our first time coming here and we were quickly welcomed. The ambience was nice and it wasn't overbearing with loud noise. 

I ordered the Rise and Grind burger combo ( included fries and drink). No salt on my fries.

He ordered The Chicago Burger combo with no salt on fries.

The burgers itself were pretty darn good ! It wasn't salty or extremely greasy as I've encountered at other places. 

I would def stop by again if I were in the area. :)
name: Zuly

text: Excellent healthy alternative to the ice cream shops in the area. The best yogurt and protein shakes around with great coffee / expresso's and assortment of other cold press juices. AWESOME addition to the Indian Rocks Beach area! Part of the Crabby Bill' family.
name: Rob

text: I've been coming here for 3 years now for their bacon breakfast burritos. They have this amazing salsa that goes with it, but 1 salsa is not enough for the entire burrito. I've always asked for 1 extra and have never had an issue (I've probably ordered  over 300 burritos from them). When I came in last week for my burrito, and asked politely for my 1 extra salsa, they refused and demanded extra $ for it!!!! Really?!? I understand you may be trying to prevent abuse when people try to take a handful of those, but the fact you are charging a longtime customer extra just for 1 extra salsa for his breakfast burrito is absolutely ridiculous. Unfortunately I'm forever boycotting DailyGrind now and taking my breakfast burrito obsession down the street to Cajun Cafe (they have pretty awesome breakfast burritos too FYI)- and guess what? They won't charge me for ONE EXTRA SALSA!!!!!
name: Tyler

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: I just moved to this area. Found this place on Yelp. Great food. Very flavorful, and made a a feasible time and price. The staff is very friendly and they make a quick expletive. The food tastes full of flavor and very well cooked. I will definitely order from here again.
name: Adam

text: I was recommended to try Bearcat Cate for breakfast by several locals as I was visiting New Orleans from Florida last week. What a great spot! It was so good I had breakfast there two days in a row. I ordered the soft shell crab with crawfish gravy and biscuits the first day, and the black beans with sweet potato tortillas the second day. Both were incredible! The service was very friendly and on point. I had a small conversation with one of the cooks and told him what a great job they were doing. Anyone in the area must try here!
name: Jason

text: We have been coming here for over 25 years and should have posted before. Love Sorrento's. Waitresses treat us like family. BYOB is wonderful. Always get the Mussels in red which is great. Antipasto! I always order the Veal Sorrento which never fails.; always tender. The only place out of South Philly I will order veal. Whatever my family orders they love. South Philly in Lafayette Hill!
name: Joe

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Definitely coming back. Not bad for a quick meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text:
Great local New Orleans legendary restaurant with large portions and good location close to Bourbon street. 
The meal began with some seasoned boiled potatoes, super fresh and great flavor. We also tried the onion rings and these had a lighter batter but some great seasoning. 
One of our group ordered the Half seafood platter and enjoyed it but was trying to pawn off food because there was sooo much of it. I don't think he even got to any of the fries, which covered the full plate  
My bf ordered the bbq shrimp and very much liked that entree-- yet hated the labor of taking off the heads and tails just to get to any part of his dinner. Haha
I had the crabmeat au gratin, very much enjoyed it, and had plenty of food. The bread to go along with it was completely doused in butter and a bit chewy, but a good addition for my entree. 
Expect a bit of a wait for a table and then enjoy the time between getting drinks, appetizer, salads, and then the meal-- Not a place for a quick dinner.
name: Ryli

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I left full, which at least counts for something. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Awesome awesome awesome!!!! Hailey is the sweetest, the food.....I'm speechless. This place is definitely a gem
name: Shaneah

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better online than it did in person. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
I'm only here to suggest avoiding brunch at all costs. I'm sure their dinner is worth it but that's not what I came for and unfortunately I doubt I'll be back. 

For starters, I was starving when I got here. I was lured in by the huge brunch sign and I went in and ordered a Frozé as my drink choice and it was bitter and gross. I understand wine is dry but once you turn it into a cocktail it should have a bit more flare to it and it just tasted like cold wine. 


The best food I had was the baked bread and olive oil appetizer. Everything else was just bad and it took forever to come out even though there was barely a soul in there. 

I ordered the biscuits and gravy and the biscuits were thick and hard as rocks. Hard, dense, crumbly and not appetizing. For what it's worth, the fried egg was cooked to perfection and the sausage gravy was flavored well but the dish as a whole was a fail. They asked me how I liked it and I begrudgingly said no because I don't like sending food back but I was so hungry. 

I ended up ordering French toast with berry compote. I need to mention that me and my friend ordered this to share initially and the waiter just completely forgot to put it in. So here I am ordering it a second time only for it to come out gross. It was little soggy pieces of wet sponge bread and a bitter berry sauce on top. I was so disappointed that they brought me yet another bad meal and I'm sure you could see it on my face because the waiter came over and assumed as much without me complaining. 

The one thing that allows me to give this place two stars is the fact that the manager and waiter seemed to be genuinely concerned that I hated my food and kept asking if I wanted something else. They took both meals off of my bill even though I didn't ask them to. I appreciated that they at least they provided quality customer service where their food was lacking.

All in all, don't come here for brunch. The waiter even said he hadn't tried the brunch food and I see why.
name: Phalan

text: My busser, Blue, ABSOLUTELY DESERVES A RAISE! He provided better service than my actual waiter! The only positive thing I can say is that the food was not bad at all. The mussels, chocolate cake, crabcakes, bread, buffalo shrimp & cheesecake were all delicious. Service was horrible & my $11 martini tasted like a child's juicebox (no liquor at all!). Our water was never refilled, so our cups were empty for pretty much the whole dinner. We weren't asked if we needed anything, although we wanted napkins. Our waiter acted like we had a virus at our table & our party of 2 became a party of 5 because some fruit flies decided to join our table for dinner. Hopefully management starts making some adjustments before the reputation is too tarnished. A few minor changes could make this place great.
name: Ken

text: We went to Dalessandros yesterday because we heard a lot of good things about it. We thought that since it's kind of off the beaten path, it wouldn't be too busy. We were wrong! The line was out the door. That's a good sign. I ordered the cheesesteak with whiz, onions and salt and pepper.  They took my name and said that it would be 20 minutes. I went back in and got my sandwich, took it to the park across the street and was not disappointed.  Soft bread, chopped steak, grilled onion and whiz on the top and bottom. Perfect! If you want a great Cheesesteak in Philly, make the drive to Dalessandros!
name: William

text:
Went for the first time last night. I'm in the food business and very fussy. My wife and friends as well. The feature salad was amazing. Mussels perfect and sauce 5 stars. Baked Eggplant Appetizers super flavorful and prepared perfectly. I had Seafood Fra Diablo. Wonderful spices. Good heat, just right. 
Everyone loved entrees. It's BYOB and we love that.
We will be regulars
name: Alan

text:
I came in for a standard milk tea, so I opted for their Phresh Milk Tea. It contains milk, fyi. I'm not lactose so all good. $6.99 for 24oz is the most I have ever paid for a milk tea. And also add that extra $.50 cc fee, really.

And to the taste.

When I watch someone pour my milk tea from a refrigerated pitcher, I know it's not going to be the best. My standards (in no order) are 85C, Sharetea, HappyLemon, Brew Tea Bar. Their taste of tea is always a prominent marker. I'm not sure what I taste in this Phresh tea. 

Worker was nice. Taste is meh. Price is no bueno. 2 stars.
name: Jim

text: The service is impeccable. The food and the ambiance pairs well with the service. I humbly recommend eating here if the opportunity presents itself. Matter of fact you should create the opportunity.
name: Dub

text: Had lunch with my moms here and the food is the bomb diggity, but the waiter seemed a little rude. I'm definitely coming back though.

text: Breakfast was breakfast nothing impressive at $20 per guest for the buffet it was a bit pricey but i guess that's the cost for convince. Omelet station was ok, sausage was a bit under cooked and the bacon was bacon. In my opinion it Seems like a overpriced contenital breakfast.
