text:
What an amazing experience Downtown Kitchen + Cocktails was for me and my husband last week! We were debating on dinner plans and decided to eat out as a toast to start off the weekend. So we called Friday at 6:30 and they were very gracious and accommodating.

Environment:
The restaurant is just off Broadway with an unsuspecting storefront but you get a whole different vibe stepping through the door. The space is basically split into thirds, one-third is the bar area with a lighted DOWNTOWN sign, and the other 2/3 are seating areas. The tables are for parties of 2-4 and makes for an intimate and romantic setting.

Service:
We had amazing service during dinner. Our waiter was attentive and gave great recommendations and explained the menu and our busser was there the moment our water went below the halfway point or bread bowl was empty. Even on our way out, another waiter walked us out and held the door open for us.

Drinks:
The drinks were spectacular. They have their own wine list that was pretty extensive, close to a hundred bottles from $30-$100. Then there were the cocktails. I went with the South 6th and it was a refreshingly divine drink: Hendricks with cucumber and housemade ginger beer. My husband out the Dark and Story which was delicious as well.

Food:
What was unique about this place is that for the summer months, they have a menu inspired by Tucson's sister cities of Gastronomie. Our night's menu was inspired by Alba, Italy and you have the option of choosing a fixed price menu with 3 courses or choosing everything a la cart. We decided to order separate dishes and went with: beef tongue pizzetta, pork shank and the quail frisee polenta. The food was spectacular! The pork was tender and fell off the bone, the quail was flavorful and juicy. We ended our meal with the chocolate hazelnut crusted cake and it was to die for.

Overall, it was such a lovely experience! Would absolutely be back!
name: Veronica

text:
To experience Bern's Steakhouse is to experience the mecca of dining. Upon arrival to this restaurant you quickly learn that this will not just be a meal, but rather an unforgettable experience. From the cheese crackers to dessert, everything was impeccable. The French onion soup had the thickest layer of cheese and the homemade dressings on the salad was amazing. I recommend ordering the house wine as the delicate combination of red wines mixed was perfect. 

I ordered the chateaubriand and it cut like butter. This steak was perfect to be ordered medium rare. After dinner we took a tour of the kitchen and wine cellar. With over 100,000 bottles of wine, it is understandable why this is the largest private wine collection in probably the world. After our tour we ended up in the dessert room where a table was waiting for us. Pictured is the only part of my meal I was able to snap because it was too good to not put the phone away and enjoy. The dessert room had a piano player and each table had their own music options. 

Being able to experience Bern's Steakhouse was a highlight and I cannot reiterate how amazing it is! I have already made plans to go back in May with their simple online reservation manager.

text:
Although I have driven by this restaurant numerous times, somehow, it never really caught my attention.  Maybe a different, more enticing name would draw people in.  Maybe a higher profile store front other than a bland strip mall exterior would help.  And even those things don't fully explain how this place has missed my radar.  When I searched Yelp for restaurants in the area, this only popped up as the 71st option!  So, it wasn't just me.

What I will tell you is that if you want a good quality lunch with a number of recognizable/traditional food options, maybe an alcoholic beverage, and being able to sit outside under an umbrella, then this is the place to bookmark.

After grabbing free parking in the lot, I entered into a clean, but a little bit static restaurant.  Their dining area was near the front, bar area towards the back, and lots of windows brought in natural light from the front of the space.  

I was greeted at the door and taken to a booth along the wall in the bar area.  I was immediately drawn to a salmon sandwich that comes on a brioche bun with lettuce, tomato, pickle chips, and a spicy tartar sauce on the side.  I also upgraded to include grilled asparagus as a side.

After a brief wait, my meal arrived.  I built the sandwich that was quite tasty.  The portion was just right for lunch and the salmon was cooked to the proper temp for my selection.  The asparagus had a grilled/char taste that I really like.  Overall, a really delicious lunch.

Checkout went smoothly too.  So, if you like a quick meal, but not fast food, give Smee's a try.

Review #2808

text: We tried this place despite mixed reviews. We were promptly seated on a Friday night. I didn't think it was loud, it just wasn't quiet. The waitress was super nice and not overly attentive, but not a disappearer either. We ordered the rice balls for an appetizer. Everyone was right: their marinara sauce is just delicious. We also ordered a beer and the white sangria. The white sangria is the frrrrriggin' jam. They also gave us bread, which was good! I don't understand all of the people who complained about FREE bread, but whatever. For the mains, I ordered the spaghetti with meatballs and my husband ordered linguini with mussels (or clams or some shelled thing). He said it tasted great, but there was a bunch of sand in the bottom of the bowl. I guess it's typical to have a little sand from shelled seafood, but this was a lot. We were already pretty full from the bread, booze, and apps, so when the waitress offered to remake the meal, my husband declined. I, on the other hand, was elbows deep in the giant meatballs and spaghetti. It was so good. SO GOOD. Despite the sand, we will definitely be going back. They took my husband's meal off the tab without asking, gave him a free beer, and threw in a couple 20% off coupons as well. I would also like to see him try to stand between me and that sangria and meatballs. Ain't happenin'!

It was kinda late (around 10p) and didn't think I was going to find good food that late. I ordered the charbroiled oysters, they were delicious completely different from the usual butter parmesan cheese kind they had a cream sauce . Then ordered the gumbo and an alligator po boy dressed. Gumbo was average but that po boy! The waiter suggested I get half and half blackened and fried! It was so good! I definitely will order again?
name: Brook

text: A friend and I were in town and this is the first place we stopped. My friend is gluten free for allergy purposes and although the waitress didn't know much about the menu she went back into the kitchen and got the answers for us immediately. Super vibrant, workers were kind and friendly. Reasonably priced!!! So much fun here. I got the salmon burger which was such a nice twist and awesome option. Food was delicious and my gluten free friend loved it too!!!!
name: Liz

text:
I've eaten at a Tampa ABC location before and this one just didn't live up to my expectations.

The restaurant was so quiet on a Friday evening. No music, just odd. It's a family style restaurant but you are sat so close to others you can hear all of their conversations. A little background noise would be great. 

The prices were decent and the portions were huge but the flavor just wasn't there. I didn't enjoy my chicken Alfredo at all. My husband's chicken parm tasted like canned spaghetti. 

Meh, just wasn't my favorite.
name: Tasha

text: Came here with a friend and sat at the bar on Saturday 10/20/18. The bartender didn't greet us but instead asked what we wanted in a short and unfriendly tone..without being given any sort of menu or water. She then proceeded to pour us the wrong wine, when we asked for the menu and finally ordered. She continued to be inattentive and we gave up after that and didn't see the point in wasting a lot of money for shitty service. The gentlemen at the host stand was also cold and standoffish. Time for some new staff...
name: Amelia

text:
They're New as of Fall 2019
Great New Addition to Chinese Cuisine in Santa Barbara.
Really interesting dishes, not the run-of-the-mill fare. Tasty, very well prepared. Prices are reasonable, and the quality is excellent, as is the staff. At the corner of at the intersection of Modoc and Las Positas in a small mall. Their dining room is spacious, with interesting decor. Get the word out-this place place is very good. Decor is both modern and interesting.
name: John

text: I give the vegan brunch a 5 star! I had the mushroom BBQ sandwich and it was soooo good! I also love that they had sweet potato fries :)
name: Mailoha

text: Our waitress was rude and me and my boyfriend agreed the food was mediocre and soggy. Won't be going back.
name: Sarah

text:
I absolutely loved this place! Not only was everything so aesthetically pleasing and basically an instagrammers dream, but the food was so delicious!
We walked around for a bit and took photos and tried to figure out what we wanted which was so difficult because everything looked so good...so we decided on a little of a lot. 

We started with Empamamas and got one of each to share between four of us. They were sooo good. The crust was amazing and the flavor was perfect. 
Next we tried Ichicoro and got the Cuban pressed buns and a bowl of Shoyu ramen and wow. The ramen was great and the buns were a wonderful combination of Cuban and Japanese cuisine plus they came with tostones which were *almost* as good as my family makes. 
We also got the waffles and smoked salmon eggs Benedict from Graze 1910 which I didn't get to try much of because I was so stuffed. But they were also very very good. The highlight was the prosecco drinks with popsicles! So much fun. 

I definitely would love to come back when I visit Tampa. There is so much to eat and drink here and just a great place to hang out after work or on the weekends to relax
name: Amanda

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was good and came out fast. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Not sure though.
name: User

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. For the price I expected more than this. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text:
We had an amazing experience at The Honu! Although it was raining and the outdoor seating was closed, we enjoyed the cozy and warm homely atmosphere inside.
I had the vegetarian white bean and sage burger with the bun. It was quite tasty and filling. The best part was that the patty was not deep fried and felt like eating at home and out at the same time. We also tried the coconut lime soup and although I really liked the flavor of coconut and strong lime, it is not for everyone (including my wife!)
They have Maui brewery beers and I had the pineapple Mana wheat which was refreshing, light and not too hoppy, just what I wanted. My wife had a tipsy turtle drink which has sake. Because of the sake, the flavors are mellow and mild.
We wish we had more space for dessert as the chocolate habanero cake seemed very interesting but we were quite full!
They are a very environmentally friendly restaurant and don't use plastic containers or plastic straws. I love that about them. Will definitely be paying a visit again. 
P.S: They can make almost every dish on their menu vegetarian/ vegan! Can't wait to try other dishes.
name: Sunny

text: First time here really liked the clam chowder and this signature cheesesteak sandwich want to come back and try a few other things off the menu because it's what I do check 1-2
name: Kerry

text: The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Definitely coming back. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
Fat Daddy looks like a little house with a few available parking spaces. You can easily make the wrong turn, so make sure you turn in from Plymouth Road. Inside is a small place with limited seating. It's usually not busy, so you can be in and out quickly.

They had some sandwich options up on the wall and they have a menu on the counter where you can use. There are two sides of that menu - make sure you look at both. I've tried three different sandwiches - the fat daddy, regular cheesesteak, and the cheesesteak with the works. The fat daddy and cheesesteak with the works were similar with the added items to the sandwiches - the fat daddy was a (chicken) cheesesteak with toppings and the works cheesesteak was a (beef) cheesesteak with onions, mushrooms, and hot peppers. In my opinion the sandwiches are better without the added toppings. The meats were delicious! The bread was disappointing and a little thin(little dough) and would be much better toasted. The toppings give the "hot and cold" bite with the meat. I highly recommend the cheesesteak... it was better than I expected and would be closer to the top of my list if the bread was better. 

I also tried the hot pepper shooter. It isn't something I'm too crazy about with the sharp provolone. The lady at the counter was nice and gave me two because one was very small. 

There's also a 4% fee for using credit card.
name: Brendan

text: I thoroughly enjoy this restaurant and will eat at it if there is one where I am. I have yet to be disappointed at any of their locations! I enjoy the Abe's famous infused Bloody Mary. The food is always delicious! I would suggest depending where you are to make a reservation. Some locations get very booked and some I've never had to wait so look into in advance.
name: Tamra

text: I go here pretty regularly and I definitely highly  recommend this restaurant. The service is terrific and the staff is super friendly. You are also pretty much guaranteed to never have to wait for a table because even when it has been super busy for the world cup or cinco de mayo I have never had to wait. The food is also bomb as hell (there steak tacos are the best). Honestly the only con is that I think their air conditioning is broken and it can get a little hot but nothing to unbearable.
name: Melissa

text:
We almost made it for the lunch pricing of all you can eat, but missed it by 4 minutes!

So, we ended having to pay $8.00 more.

The service and sushi was great, but disappointed that they charge extra for the hamachi Kama and ice cream??!!!

All the other sushi places can include in their prices, why not them??

Hubby wanted to go to our regular spot on Longley, but I wanted to try and get the lunch special.!

Oh well..
name: Amy OO

text:
My husband and I went to Hops & Craft for a Friday dinner. We primarily went because it's located on the south side and they have vegan or meat options. This review should be two and a half stars, but I put three.

+ I love that they offer full vegetarian/vegan and gluten free menus. The hostess will ask you at the entrance. 
+ Large seating area and outdoor patio area


- Service was poor. Our waitress was "new" and nice, but not knowledgeable. She told us about the food special but didn't know the price, wasn't certain about the vegan menu options, messed up my husbands steak order. 
-Vegan food was small portion size and bland. I had the cauliflower steak and unfortunately I was underwhelmed. Although I saw another tables cauliflower wings and it looked good.

Overall I don't know if we would return. I have had better vegan food and customer service elsewhere.
name: Wende'

text: We love the food here.  The fact that they don't use half and half in their curry is great since my wife is allergic to dairy and soy.  The chicken and green curry is her favorite.  I have tried the spicy basil as well as the curries and have liked every dish.  The fact that I can get horchata is icing on the cake.
name: David

text:
My daughter and I came here for a late dinner last night. The Margarita strawberry lime was meh.... the so called cheese garlic bread was meh.....


But the grilled octopus and the lobster macaroni and cheese was out of this world. 10 out of 10. Outstanding meal. Incredible. This place is repeatable for sure. During our stay in Clearwater I do want to go back for more of that lobster Mac and Cheese. Wow what an experience. Great friendly service too. I'm also dying  to try the lobster eggs Benedict. I'm loving this place.
name: Philip

text:
I really like dining outside at Bahama breeze. They have a number of tables under a roof and a lot of tables under umbrellas, so you can get out of the sun easy, while still being outdoors.They often have music outdoors, which is nice, but sometimes a little loud.

I highly recommend Bahama breeze
name: Manus

text: I really enjoyed my time here. We came here for dinner. I got the cowboy burger. I like bbq sauce but I felt it was a lot on it, which says a lot because I love sauce. However, it was still really good! I love the chips! The service was excellent, they refilled our waters as soon as it was low. Food came out pretty fast. The atmosphere was really fun. I love the look of it. I definitely would make the 30 min drive here again.
name: Tina

text:
What a hidden gem! I loved the ambience here! From the sign on the front door with the kelly gun stating, "we protect our customers" to the mug shots of famous mafiosos to the quaint mural of Tuscan hills that you can view through the blinds of your seats in the back! This place is full of Italian personality! I loved the names of the pizzas because some were named after mobsters that were shot while dinning so the sign on the front door ties it all in. I loved it.

We ordered a special just made by the chef which were his garlic chicken wings. They were so very good. They were covered in garlic, butter, a hint of lemon. We also had the fried eggplant sticks that were just ok but huge portioned!

Then I got the stuffed artichoke. It was very stuffed and had a strong lemon and garlic flavor. It was moist throughout. It was kind of artichoke my grandmother used to make, very good. 

My brother had the veal which I like alot. Again huge portioned. And mom had the calzone. It tasted like it was cooked in one of those fire ovens. 

The service was great. She answered all of our questions and was on top of drinks. Parking is across the street in a lot so no worries on street parking. They do separate checks but only 6 ways if you ask. 

I am sad there was no wine here although they had a huge wine barrel as decor in the corner that I loved. The music was entertaining because it was 50s amd 60s music but I kinda wanted some italian music thrown in there to keep the awesome theme complete. 

I was truly pleased with this place and so much garlic! I did not expect such a fun themed and romantic restaurant existed out in Kenner. We will be back.
name: Jamie

text: This little BYOB is one of the best Italian restaurants in all of Philly. Every dish is perfection!
name: Vincent

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Pretty happy with it overall. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Loved the environment and the chicken and waffles were amazing. Great food and space for kids as well. Awesome Saturday brunch spot
name: Alec

text:
Great atmosphere.

Our server was incredibly good and made us feel at home for the night. We did the Chef's special and the appetizers were delicious, but the entrees and deserts left a bit to be desired.

That may have been a mistake on our end. If we go back we will definitely order traditional meals from the menu.
name: Dave

text:
What can I say that hasn't been said?  Great food and great prices.  I don't think the prices have changed in 15 years!   I don't think it's been cleaned in that long either, but hey, it is a greasy spoon. It is a bit Smokey in there from the grill, but eh, you'll survive!  

This is a staple in NOLA and everyone who is anyone who has been to NOLA has been here at least once!  This is a 24hr joint that is the perfect booze soaker upper!  

Do yourself a favor and try one of their famous hamburgers!
name: Jessica

text: We took a group of 18 folks from our sailing club who were camping at Picacho Peak here for dinner tonight. Hadn't been here since the 80's. We had a private room. Food was just as good as I remembered it and many in our group had positive comments. The steaks were great and Texas Toast had to be soaked in butter and garlic for two days.  So good. Deserts were  yummy and the three servers handled our group well. Surely one of the best old west style rustic steak houses in the state.
name: Doug

text: Always a stop when we come to New Orleans. Perfect location to get a cold drink while shopping the French Market. Great margaritas and the guacamole is made fresh right at the table.
name: Shelley

text: We visited Brandon Pizzeria on 10/10/2018. We ordered a calzone and it tasted fine. The inside of the restaurant left a lot to be desired. Three booths in the main dining room were full of dirty dishes. We stepped down into the other dining area and it had an odd smell. Also, there wasn't a clean booth in there, so we went back to the front and sat at a table. There was one other occupied table at that time. Calzone takes awhile to cook, understandably. About 15 mins after we ordered, our server bussed the booths. However, she did not wipe the tables off. She just cleared off the dishes and the trash. Our calzone arrived about 30 minutes after we ordered. Again, I'm ok with that because I know it takes awhile to bake. I may order takeout in the future, but I will not dine in again. Cleanliness seems lacking.
name: Michelle

text: I do not like the pocket style gyros and that's what I got when I ordered a gyro sandwich. The pita was chewy (not in a good way), the meat wasn't sliced fresh off the spit, the sauce was pretty weak. This place is a total dive, cobwebs in the corners. Staff was not overly friendly although that in and of itself would've been ok if the food had been better. Will not be back.
name: Robin

text: It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Honestly, not terrible, just not something i'd want again soon. So yeah, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text:
Cool Mo's has my favorite breakfast sandwich. Hevos and cheese.  It's pressed on Cuban bread. It's delicious.  Order the small.  The large is 12, inches.  Small 6 inches.


 They make expresso and all types of coffee. I've eaten here dozens of times.  I thought I already wrote a review.  The place is tiny.  It seats about 12. The staff is  friendly.  And knowledgeable. They use coffee ice cubes in the ice coffee so it doesn't get watered down.  

There's either 2-3 people working. The cook and the waitperson. Some times someone works drive through. For drive through call ahead. Just don't get in the drive through. Unless you only want cafe con leche.  Something simple or you will wait while they make your food.  They reccomended you call first.   The food is good.  They have beignets!
name: April

text: My husband and I had the chicken and donut sandwich at the Fried Chicken Festival! It was absolutely amazing and delicious!!
name: Kay

text: ABSOLUTELY AMAZING FOOD!!! Walked in and immediately smelled heaven. All the staff were very friendly and helpful. Also has military discount which is awesome! Thanks Metro! We'll be back!
name: Alicia

text:
I don't usually order pan pizza, but when I do, I order from Jet's.  I ordered online for carry out on a Friday night.  The pizza was ready when promised and multiple employees were helpful and friendly.  I was surprised to see that this location has a dine in area as every other location I have visited is strictly carry out or delivery.

As for the pizza, it was crispy, crusty, and delicious.
name: A

text: I give this three starts because I have had an excellent  experiences except for one thing. The Dj was not accommodating in any way. I asked him to play a song and he thought I was someone else and gave me sass. Rude and unprofessional. Everything else was great except for him. Music is terrible. Turns off for 5 minutes
name: Sarah

text:
Best prime rib sandwich ever. So soft and good. 
Honestly feel the chicken sandwich is a little over rated. Don't get me wrong it's good but not the best I've had (doesn't compare to Howlin rays in la). The drink was ok I had the first one on the menu. It was nice and strong but I personally like clear liquor. So that's on me I orders the wrong thing. But apparently the bees knees or something like that is supposedly pretty good. Everyone around me seemed to order that. The wait wasn't too long for a Friday night. I sat by the fireplace which was nice and warm. The ambiance was nice, cozy, clean, and pretty. Felt a little undressed but no one seemed to care (I was wearing a hoodie and leggings). But seriously all I remember is their prime rib sandwich. Their fries are nice and thin too.
name: Ye Seul

text:
I'm married to a New Yorker and the hunt for NY style pizza has taken a while around Indy.  No more.

Thin foldable slices. Delish.  Pop in for a lunch special.  Dluce, side, and drink for $6. They even offer it on Saturday. 

Pricing for whole pies is reseaonable.
name: Tisha

text:
I have been here quite a few times and still thought it was just as good as the first time. It was pretty busy this time though but even then we were seated very quickly. We had water and our drink order taken within 5 minutes of being there. Our drinks were both very good and they made me one that I specially ordered and it was perfect!! I can't remember what our appetizer was called but they were cheese filled like rice balls (lol) and they were delicious! Quickly our entrees came out. There portions were large and everything was nice & hot! The grilled chicken sandwich is always soo yummy. My nana enjoyed her chicken as well. 
My favorite part about my visit was the pie!  I love key lime pie and this one definitely didn't disappoint!!! Just one is perfect size to share between two people.
name: Sierra

text:
Really really good sushi. I visited for a takeout and was in and out in about 10 mins. There is something comfy about the interior. Small and quaint, comfortable and inviting. The staff is super friendly and inviting. 

I enjoyed the lunch special with a choice of 2 rolls and soup or salad for $9.95. Good deal! The sushi was delicious. I ordered both rolls without eel sauce. Todd's special and spicy salmon. Generous portions of fish, heavy on the sauces, this could go one way or the other. The rolls were nicely rolled, a bit loose but they weren't falling apart by any means. The miso soup was served perfectly piping hot. The flavor is what you would expect. 

The only con I would say is the quality of the takeout boxes and chopsticks. Very low quality but I'll take low quality takeout paper products all day just to get that delicious sushi all day.
name: Tasha

text:
My second time to this restaurant and still just as delicious! We each got a create your own açaí bowl with fruit and granola out top, you HAVE to get the peanut butter sauce. It's a sauce that basically tastes like a sweetened peanut butter with cinnamon. The create your own wrap was also delicious with fresh eggs and yummy ingredients on a low carb wrap.

This place is perfect for a delicious and healthy breakfast or lunch. They have a lot of vegetarian and vegan options as well, which it great if you are with someone following those diet plans.

The place is clean and bright with natural light. I would definitely recommend!! The bowls are super filling, also.

 Not sure why this place has negative reviews, as both times I've been it's been great!
name: Taylor

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was decent, just a little uneven.
name: User

text: Missing hospitality everybody was in a " I'm getting there mode" .  My po boy was drier  than a popcorn fart , crawfish had no flavor old dry and we're not purged.  Asked for oranges for the beer and never got it 2nd round of drinks came when dinner was almost done
name: Angela

text: Went there at 9:30 two days in a row and the drive thru attendant said they were close both times when the hours say they are open till 10.
name: Zakkiyya

text: Hattie B's is a must go to whether you're visiting or not. It's the best hot chicken for sure. My friends and I just had to try the "shut the cluck up" for the sake of trying it. I'm proud to say I survived 3 bites before I threw in the towel. Then, I started shoving my face with the sides and sweet tea and lemonade just to calm down the fire. They weren't joking when they were giving you that burn notice prior to ordering. I just wish I had some pepto on me. Hahaha. If you're brave enough or can handle ghost peppers it's worth trying at least once. And if you're a real chicken, then you best get yourself the mild.
name: Jeanne

text:
The Halal Guys did themselves a disservice when they decided to expand into a chain. While I know that no other location can compare to the original, the lack of quality in the food here is obvious. I got the combination platter and both the chicken and gyro were really dry and bland. I mistook some pieces of my gyro for old bacon since it was that hard and tough. The rice they used to fill up the platter wasn't much better.

My husband claims the sauce is what makes it good and swears by their "white sauce," but it should already taste good without being smothered in sauce. 

I ended up throwing away most of my food.
name: Jessica

text: Overrated! The queso and tacos are mediocre. Frozen margaritas, no kick to it. Service just ok.
name: Lisa

text: Amazing food and atmosphere. Arguably one of the best decorated/themed restaurants in the area. Service has been hit or miss for us over the last 6 months, but the food always brings us back.
name: Dylan

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Never heard of a Turkey Ribs before my visit to this restaurant . My meal was AMAZING!!! Will definitely go again for smoked turkey ribs and smoked wings.
name: Samara

text: This place really needs some updating. I'm not sure if it's the dark interior that could use a deep cleaning or the rather uninterested waitstaff . Perhaps it's the greasy diner style food but as a combination none of it makes me want to go back there. It reminds me of a place you go to get some drugs.
name: Trulie

text: For a busy night they handled it okay. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. It was crowded but still moved along. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Will be back. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. For the price I expected more than this. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
What a cool spot in a not so nice part of town. They have a fantastic outdoor area with an outdoor bar, fire pit, lights, it's nice. 

Inside is really cool looking. Super industrial, reclaimed wood. Very cool decor. They have comfy sofas to sit on or you can find a table if you're lucky. The whole place is self serve. Order your drinks and food at the bar they give you a number and then someone runs it out when it's ready. 

We all got something different and loved the food. Nothing super fancy. I had their chicken salad sandwich and it was really good. They have great artisanal chips to go with your meal. As always, some of the best beer in the northeast. Give it a shot if that's your style.
name: Ron

text: Always a crowd pleaser! This Panera bread has Friendly Staff and speedy service. My cashier Kaitlynn exceeded my expectations! The Black bean soup was amazing.  Way to go Panera
name: Captain

text: Great little place. The bar is creative with their promotions, for instance they have a pinball tournament coming up and drag queen bingo. They brew good beer but the only draw back is they only have beer, wine, and ciders. In our party was some people who didn't drink any of those so that was kind of a bummer. The location is very off the beaten path and parking is limited. Follow them on social media and take advantage of one of the fun promo nights.
name: Joe

text: I would go back again just for the cookies!  The craft cocktails were also good. The bartender mixes everything from scratch.   The food and the service was nice as well. But the cookies...WOW.
name: Diane

text: Snooty service.  Ok food.  One of th employees peed and didn't wash his hands before leaving restroom.   Guess motif is the big draw here
name: Philip

text:
The new number 1 Indian of my tasting. The
dish was called "butter chicken".  It was made with a mild curry sauce and thin sliced chicken.  Thin pepper and onion slices were included minimally for additional flavor.  The dish was a marriage of all flavors: curry, tomato, pepper, and onions with a smooth cream like flavor and consistency. The garlic naan bread was equally great.  Just enough seasoning, not over powering the bread or meal.  Really great food, the interior of the restaurant was nice, the service was excellent.  The exterior of the restaurant is unique as it is co located with a gas station.  This is a non  factor.
name: Larry

text: The pizza was a pleasant surprise in a kid-stuff kind of way.  The crust was a cracker-like style similar to Pizza Hut thin.  The ingredients were better quality.
name: J E

text: Tucked in the corner of a shopping center, this place has become one of my favorites. You can customize almost any order. And when you order coffee, you get your own pot! No flagging down someone for a refill. Highly recommended.
name: Maria

text: My husband went to there to buy me a pineapple upside down cake at first all they had were cupcakes but then someone brought out a freshly baked pineapple upside down cake did not like it it tasted very spongy very dry and it did not taste like it was homemade so will not definitely by another pineapple upside down cake from here
name: Tammy

text: Terrible, terrible service. Went in with a friend to try Ming's. We were very disappointed. The server, who may have been the owner, was unbearably rude and unhelpful. I am a customer who does not have overly high expectations and usually tip very generously. The server/owner did not speak English very well, so we made polite attempts to communicate clearly pointing to items on the menu while trying to ask questions. The server, a middle aged lady who spoke with authority did not seem at all interested in our business. She was brusque and abrupt. Not even the smallest hint of a smile, and her every answer seemed to be given with the attitude that having to speak with us was a great inconvenience to her.  Because she was so difficult to understand, I had to ask her to please repeat herself a couple of times. That did not go over well, and instead of trying to be helpful to a new customer she only made more of an unpleasant face and acted hostile and exasperated. I don't know how the food is but I felt like I was in A Jerry Seinfeld episode with an Asian version of the Soup Nazi. Fearful that I would wind up with her spittle or worse in my food, this lady being so hostile, I simply thanked her politely. My friend and I both left with a strange shiver. We went to Perkins instead where we have been many times before. I will never set foot into Ming's Tea and Coffee again. Bad, bad vibes.
name: Howard

text:
I was in town for work and had some time in between meetings to grab lunch. Chose the Taproom for the abundance of vegetarian options, and I was not disappointed. It's a newer building with a very clean and open interior and an excellent patio. 

Their menu is complete with loads of options for appetizers, salads, sandwiches and quesadillas. *Veggie options for all!* I ordered the cobb salad and asked the sub the bacon & chicken for seitan, which they easily accommodated for. The salad was giant and so satisfying! Finally a cobb salad for vegetarians!

Would love to come back for dinner and see this place in full swing for a good night out.

text:
This place is a nice restaurant- a feel good story about how they came to be and the atmosphere is nice. I've been twice during a work lunch - the first went as a group of 9 and preordered 3 deep dish pizzas for an 1130 timeframe - but we still waited 45 minutes for our pizza. Although it was delicious as a deep dish virgin. 

Went back yesterday and wanted to try pizza by the slice - it too was quite slow service but friendly - I ordered a slice and side salad - the waitress asked me if I wanted a Cesar or regular and as I'm quite picky with veggies went for the easier Cesar as I'd have no special requests. The other two people also ordered a slice one got a salad and we ordered the Potato skins to share. The food again took a very long time and was lukewarm when we got it. 

The salads were delicious!!!! The Cesar was amazing!!!! The potato skins were a bit bland and not very flavorful - but okay. 

The reason for the 2 stars is how the waitress handled the bill. 1) one of my friends when he ordered the skins said to put on his tab - but when we asked for our check she had already split it on ours - so for convenience to HER we acquiesced and said no big deal. But she needs to listen!!! 
2) she comes around with the handheld machine so no chance to review your bill - and she tells me  $15.66 and I'm confused. Their lunch combo is $6.00 plus $2 for fries, chips or side salad. Plus about $3.00 for the potato skins now so $11.00 plus tax - when she gives my friend his bill who ordered a drink his is about the same as mine and I question her - she says "oh maybe they ( the company she's working for) charge more for a Cesar salad" and I'm thinking well isn't that the kind of thing you tell someone when you UPSELL them? Oh for a dollar more you can have a Cesar salad. Apparently not here. 3)I'm still not convinced and ask for a receipt. And she's flustered because how dare I ask for an itemized bill and she figures out how to print the receipt - brings it and now I see why the bill was much higher! It's actually $5.00 for a Cesar salad - And she so kindly points out how the Cesar is a dollar more - again- this is something I should have been told and also $5.00 is not $2.00 or even $3.00    

It's not about the cost of lunch because I would have their salad again but it's definitely false advertising and up- charging and bill inflation so you get a higher tip when you allow shady practices like this. I'm not sure I'll go again and I'm sad because the Cesar salad was probably one of the best in my life.

The dining space is light filled and was quite busy when we visited on a Saturday afternoon. To start we had the locally bottled mango tea, very flavorful. I enjoyed the BBQ jackfruit sliders topped with cole slaw, turnip greens and bbq beans for sides.  My husband had the Impossible burger and declared it one of the best he's had locally. He had the mac & cheese side, also flavorful.  When you're done they have compost and recycling bins for your refuse, I was glad to see they're using cardboard containers and phasing out plastics.  Really happy with everything about the place.  It's rare when we find a vegan place where the food has this much flavor.

text:
Hmm, I guess I had high hopes for this place given all the good reviews and the average 4-star rating with greater than 1500 reviews. However, I was not very impressed. A friend and I came for lunch one day, and the restaurant was much smaller than expected. The place itself looks very rustic and nice, but there was limited table space. The service was sub-optimal despite it not being too busy. The staff was nice and friendly, but we were waiting a longer amount of time than necessary to order our food and for our food and drinks to arrive. This might be because the server is the bartender, and there wasn't another server there, but I was confused as to why some parties that arrived at the same time as us or came in after us had left before we even paid  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯  ?

I have to say the selection of whiskey was great and there is a ton to choose from. They have a few flight options (for about $20 or more), but the pours were very small. As for the food, we had the Deviled eggs and the Truffled Cauliflower. Honestly, the deviled eggs dish was not unique in any way, so avoid this unless you love deviled eggs (like I do). The Truffled Cauliflower was a bit more interesting and actually really good; it has a pickled taste with a hint of truffle oil served on this toasted sourdough bread with whipped ricotta and black olive tapenade spreads. Now, I guess the most disappointing dish was my entree. I ordered the "Hans Burger," which was the burger of the month. It was a "Triple Smash Burger" with 3 small patties served on a potato roll with onion rings. There was nothing really special about the burger and the patties were very salty, which overpowered the entire burger. I think it might've been just my dish, since most reviews say that the burgers are good. The onion rings were the best part of this dish.

Overall: 5.5/10
Pros: ¯\_(ツ)_/¯, Truffled Cauliflower
Cons: Long service time, salty burger
Recommendation: Try once? Probably not a staple to come often unless you like whiskey bars
name: Patrick

text:
First, the service is great. I love that they give you a carafe of water. Early on, my server asked if I had questions. I asked if he could just decide for me. He said he could. :) He was warm and personable and gave a great argument for having the Monte Cristo. I agreed. 

The Monte Cristo comes with their fried potatoes. Forget the sandwich, those potatoes were the best part of my meal. They are cut somewhat haphazardly, not uniform at all. The large pieces were smooth and creamy,  the small were crisp and tasty. Peels were left on,  which made for occasional happy little crisp potato peel pieces that tasted like delicious chips. They were generously seasoned with herbs, but not over salted. Perfect.

The sandwich itself was a little disappointing. Don't get me wrong, it was delicious, but it veered quite a bit from tradition, and not necessarily in a good way. It was not battered and fried,  but instead was a sandwich made with slices of already- made fresh toast. And it was normal, fairly bland, yet thick, french toast. The big draw for me was the pineapple-jalepeno cream cheese on this sandwich. But it was overwhelmed by the swiss cheese and hardly noticable. After a few bites I opened the sandwich to make sure it was even on there. It was,  but it was scarce. I also didn't get any jalepeno spice until my last few bites. I could see the large pieces on jalapeno,  and could finally taste them. The sandwich was woefully underfilled compared to the thickness of the bread. My notes to the chef would be: double the meat, cut back on (or eliminate) the swiss, puree the jalepeno into the cream cheese so you can taste the spice throughout,  and double the cream cheese. 

I also wanted to take home a pastry. They had only a few left, and decided on the cinnamon bun based on name (I didn't look at the pastries before deciding). It is not a bun, but more like a cinnamon and sugar covered croissant, twirled into bun shape. Still tasty, but unexpected.

All in all, it's a lovely place with great service and tasty food. I'll be back.

text:
When I go out to eat, when I cook at home, or when I go to a buddy's house to eat, I always try to have a little bit of everything. When it comes to sushi, family-style dining, or toppings at an ice cream shop, diversity is paramount. I like to try as many different flavors as humanly possible. That is why I decided to take my girlfriend to Skyline Kitchen & Vine for her birthday.

We had an incredible time here! Beautiful location, beautiful dining room, beautiful food. We ate on a Monday night, so there was 9ers Packers right there on the TV. Although I didn't watch much of the game, I could tell this would be an excellent place to watch the games on a Sunday or Monday or Thursday night.

We started out with a couple cocktails. I had the beet martini simply because I was so curious, and I've been watching a lot of The Office recently. She ordered the Cucumber Crush Sour from 10 Barrel Brewing. The sour was delicious, and so was the martini! It was sweet, subtle, and went down really smooth.

Skyline Kitchen & Vine has a very diverse menu of small plate items for people of all palates. For a decent price, you will be able to try a wide array of really tasty dishes. Here is what we ordered. It was all so delicious.

Tomato Caprese - crisp cool tomato on top of rich heavenly mozzarella. 
Brussels Sprouts - cooked to perfection, and really yummy.
Blistered Shishito Peppers - beware about 1/20 are HOT!
Chorizo Stuffed Mushrooms - heavy, spicy, and oh so delicious
Calamari Street Tacos - stole the show as the finale of our meal.

Highly recommend for date night, groups, or even now that I think about it solo diners! I wouldn't mind coming here alone with a good podcast and watching football and drinking beet martinis all day. I think I just found my weekend plans...

text:
The BEST hot chicken in all of existence is 400 Degrees. The taste, the flavor, the texture, the heat, the CONSISTENCY... it is worth the drive to North Nashville, and is about 10 minutes north of Metro Center. 

The owner is local resident, Aqui, who is a gem of a human, and is so down to Earth and always at the restaurant. She has been in this industry for around 14 years and came from Prince's, so she know whats up! She has also added hot shrimp, fish, and pork chops to the menu recently and I cannot wait to get shrimp next time I'm in. 

If you want some heat level but aren't too keen on alot of spice, order the 100 degrees. Personally, I order the 200 degrees... it's pretty spicy but not to the point where I am in pain the next day. I'd say it's comparable to Hattie B's Damn Hot/Shut the Cluck Up. Hard to compare it to anyone else since 400 and HB are the only hot chicken places that keep their heat levels consistent anymore (can you tell that's a pet peeve of mine? Cough cough PRINCES cough cough). If you have a high tolerance (and I mean high....), order the 400 degrees. And if you're just plain crazy like some of Aqui's regulars, 800 and 900 degrees do exist. Y'all are crazy!

Sodas are sold in personal bottles, and Nashville's own Yazoo beer is on tap (yay). 

400 is seriously some of the best food around and I crave it pretty regularly. If you come to Nashville, this is a must try... you will not be disappointed! In the next year, it will also be available in the Nashville airport!
name: Amber

Besides the friendly staff, this place has a great atmosphere and allows you to watch the action of the streets without sitting in it or out in the sun. 
Will be back and will take the recommendations of whomever is serving. So nice to be at a place where the people who work there genuinely love the food and will steer you right.
name: Sarah

text:
It's been awhile since I've last been here.  They've remodeled the place and has been one of my go to places for brunch.  We came by with a 6 month old and they had a great high chair that fit him perfectly.  

My go to meal is the chicken and waffles.  They use chicken thighs, which I prefer the juicy dark meat.  The waffle is crispy on the outside and chewy on he inside.  It also has a poached egg on top.  Lots of protein in this meal.  This dish used to have a side of greens, but that's now gone.  

Great place, not as good as I remembered though.
name: Richie

text: This is a great breakfast spot! The grits were the best that I have ever had! We were with a big group and the place isn't the biggest but we were in and out fairly quickly! For NOLA I thought the prices were reasonable too, for two people it was about $20.00. Man, just writing this review makes me wish I could have more of those grits!!
name: Karen

text: Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Worth checking out. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
Was in New Orleans for a week...this is the best restaurant we went to. Service was A+, our waiter Tyler and his co-worker who helped were phenomenal. The bartender while we waited for table was friendly and provided me with the pork chop recommendation which was quite honestly the best pork I have ever had in my life. 

Dessert with the S'more Ice Cream was terrific. Everyone else liked their meals! Highly recommend.
name: Chase

text: I'm giving one star because that's the lowest this goes. Walked in, the place was empty and looked deserted. Only one server. Brought chips and salsa, salsa tasted like salt and lemon. Ordered the burrito, chicken tasted like plastic. And look at that portioned lettuce (salad). BurrIto was SO HOT, it burnt the top of my mouth. Everyone at my table was dissatisfied with the food. Truly a shame that this place is considered a Mexican restaurant.
name: Diana

text: I'm torn on this place. The staff is extremely friendly, and they seem to have a lot of regulars but the food left a lot to be desired. I got the Greek salad, and since there was a picture of it on the menu I thought it would be one of their specialties. Unfortunately it wasn't great. Kind of watery with lots of raw onion rings. Not really my style. The feta cheese was good. And now that I think about it, maybe I was actually craving a Horiatiki salad. I guess if you're in Clearwater and need a late night bite, this would be a good place. The staff is very nice and welcoming. Maybe I should've ordered breakfast or a burger and would've had a better experience.
name: Dana

text:
Got the Anaheim omelette per cashiers advice. Terrible decision; ended up not finishing the omelette. There was barely two small slices of avocado. Some parts of my omelette was still cold. I disagree with others who said the breakfast here is better than lunch options. As long as you get a quick and easy to make sandwich, you won't be too disappointed. I've been to other corner bakeries for lunch and they were significantly better. 

The only reason I would even think about coming back is the friendly service and cashier who was a doll.
name: Christina

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Glad we tried it. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better online than it did in person. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Personal opinion here, this is one of philly's five best restaurants.  The move is to arrive around 4:30-4:40 to put your name in for a spot at the bar for happy hour, which starts at 5:00.  The hummus dishes were of course to die for but what I walked out of the restaurant raving about was the custard desert.  The bartender told me it was a national award winning dessert of some sort.  I think I would agree with him.
name: Robert

text: If it were socially acceptable, I would have licked the plate!  The salmon ala grilia had a nice wood charred flavor and the pimento & shrimp cream sauce was rich, but not too rich. Creamy and light at the same time. I'll definitely order this again. The fried artichoke hearts were plentiful and delicious. You can tell they are freshly made in-house. The kitchen is really on top of their game. My co-worker is a vegetarian and when she mentioned this to our server, she recommended an off menu pasta primavera. It arrived and was a very large portion of fettuccine with loads of perfectly cooked fresh vegetables, including asparagus. She said it was the best she's ever had. The restaurant has 2 separate dining areas and both have a beautiful fireplace. It was so nice to have a fireside lunch in the middle of the work week. White tablecloths and excellent service that makes you feel at home is rare, but they pull it off. A fabulous place for a date night too. I highly recommend and I can't wait to go back. I've actually already made plans to meet a friend there next week!
name: Christina

text: wow! what a find! Went here for the first time for lunch  today and it may very well become my favorite restaurant in the area. I split the ox tails and jerk chicken with my brother--both amazing, the meat falls off the bone very tender and delicious. Chicken was Smokey and spicy, seasoned brilliantly. I am a big fan of ox tails but never see them on a menu. These were tender juicy and covered in a delicious sauce. The prices are in line with fast food places but the food rivals any expensive restaurant in the area. I'll be back tonight to try more.
name: Nick

text:
Expensive for the quality of food. I've had better pizza. There's no kid menu. Not recommended for children. 
Service was poor if you ask me. There were servers standing around. Our server acted like she couldn't come close to our table, at one time she stood behind me while talking, I had to turn to see if she was talking to me or the table next to me. I won't return to this restaurant.
name: Sierra

text:
False reviews! Probably made up by the workers and friends. Robbery! Disappointed. So, we see a average of 4.4 on google and didn't want to drive over the bridge for dinner. What we experienced was terrible and I hope the owners, staff, and cooks sit down and read this.

As we drove in and noticed one car in front, I said to my fam, this might not be good.  I open the door and let my family in. We see a young lady behind the counter on her phone with a child in her arms.  Not a big deal for us since we are fans of family restaurants.  After we took a few steps in and paused, she says "you can sit anywhere" while looking at a young man on his phone sitting at one of the back tables. 

We take a seat and notice the traditional decor that's hanging crooked on the walls.  The hostess/waitress walks over and places utensils on the table wrapped in cloth napkins (smelled like mold) while reaching across us. 

She asked what we would like to drink and we order a Thai tea ($2.50) and two bud lights ($3.50 each).  My wife asked me why the young man is now laying on the ground on a little mattress behind a table with the baby on his chest.  

I ask my family if we should just get a appetizer and leave but we decided to give them a chance.  We ordered the crispy spring rolls and chicken Satay.  They were not terrible but bet they were prepared commercially and delivered frozen.   The chicken was bland and my daughter called it "Sad".

We ordered the Pad kee maow ($12.95) the pad see Eu ($12.95) and the tom kha soup ($12.95).  All came way too sweet.  We have eaten Thai food countless times and this was by far the sweetest.  The coconut shrimp soup tastes like a hot desert. All noodles were over cooked as well. My wife had to use the restroom and later told me it smelled like sewer.

The waitress ask if everything was ok. We told her how we found it way too sweet. She then says "so y'all don't like it? We responded "no".  The look on her face was not a disappointment one but more like "you don't know what your talking about" kind of look. She then asks "so do you just want the bill?" I should of said no and walked out but said, "definitely".  She doesn't ask us if we would like to order something else or she can take those plates off the bill. She says "thank you". The bill comes in a cracked and sticky check holder. Gross.  

I will say that I ate half of my plate since I was hungry and I eat fast. 
 
We were not sure if they noticed that on the tv was a crime scene show about a guy that killed both of his wives. Blood everywhere.

It's just too bad that a group has the oportunity and possibly the capability to have a good Thai restaurant but get it all wrong with the atmosphere and service.
name: Rootbeer

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Will be back. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: I get the bubble milk tea often & it's bangin ! The best milk tea that I've had yet. Always a lot of bubbles at the bottom & the tea has a good flavor to it. I would like to try other things on their menu. Oh also their California rolls are good, very flavorful.
name: Julia

text: Authentic,  unique well-prepared Italian. Calzone was great.  One is enough for two,  but too good to share. Selection of beer and cider for all. Highly recommend.
name: Jim

text:
Finally decided to check out Dave & Busters yesterday. some friends of mine made me go so they can play games (I dont care for games)- but being the great friend I am I went- but lets be honest: I WENT FOR THE FOOD LOL! We sat at the bar section. OUR WAITRESS WAS AWESOME!!!! her name was Kristy, she was very attentive and super fast! seriously, the experience you have with your waitress is what makes or breaks a dine in experience for me, and she far exceeded what I expected at a busy place like this! 
I hope she gets to see this- YOU WERE AWESOME AND CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR PREGNANCY!
I will definitely be back.

text:
I came to Pennsylvania for the week and I knew I had to try Two Stones Pub!

The bartender, Nick, immediately greeted me with a smile and made me one of the best drinks I've ever had (strawberry lemonade)! The entire staff was incredibly nice and my food came out fast. I tried the truffle fries and the Brussels sprouts. It was absolutely amazing!

Next time I come here I'm definitely going to sample beer. I'll recommend this pub to everyone who wants great food and service!
name: Cara

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Overall, a strong experience. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: This is actually my favorite restaurant in the area. We come down from Iowa every year and I think we found a new tradition. The place is very clean, the food is excellent, and very friendly staff! This place has many options as well. It offers ice cream and beer along with their decent size menu. I will definitely be going back to this place.
name: Michael

text:
I've been meaning to try Kwok's since I saw it in the RGJ. Maybe it's better I waited a bit and let some of the rush die down, because even at 7:30 on a Saturday, it was crowded and we had to wait a short time for a table for two.

This is not your typical Americanized, kinda greasy same old-same old Chinese food. As soon as the first dish hits your table, you can tell everything is made as you order it and it's made with fresh ingredients. We started with the dumplings - these things are huge! Damn tasty (as is the sauce served on the side), but boy, they are big. Make sure you check out the specials menu. That's where we found the salted fish chicken fried rice I had seen mentioned here on Yelp and it did not disappoint. Give it a try - it's not overly fishy, but every once in a while, you get this crunchy salty pop of a bite ... sooooo good. My husband got a pork belly dish from the specials menu. Holy cow, delicious but rich. I got the five spice pork. It was great, but it's listed on the menu as spicy, and I didn't find it spicy at all. Also, the pork is breaded, and it's not served with any sauce at all. I think it needs some sort of dipping sauce or drizzle to just push it over the top.

All in all, amazing food, and can't wait to go back and try other dishes.
name: Chloe

text: Jane, Juleesa, and Pierre provided incredible service. My flight was delayed and I wasn't having the greatest night. A good meal served by good people always seems to help moments like those. They did that for me. Next time I'm Indianapolis I'll swing by again for sure!
name: Curtis

text: Service is excellent, food is delicious! We popped in for a late breakfast and sat on the patio with our dog. I ordered the breakfast burrito and my boyfriend got the chilaquiles. Both meals had incredible flavor. When my boyfriend asked if they had any hot sauce, they brought a flight of three different, wonderful salsas. Definitely recommend!

text: My friend and I went on a Saturday at 11:15 AM and it wasn't crowded at all. We started off with the specialty nonalcoholic drink called the BFF. My friend really liked it, but it was a little tart for me. I should have known since there was grapefruit juice in it. We started off with the shrimp ball appetizers which were really good. There was a sweet sauce, but also some chopped peppers on it which gave it a little kick. We shared the fish tacos and the barbecue pork on spoon bread. The fish tacos were some of the best I've ever had, even though it was wrapped in lettuce instead of tortilla. Barbecue pork was OK. I always thought that spoonbread was more of a custardy bread, but their spoonbread was more like cornbread and a little dry. Our server was really good and gave us direction on which dishes we should order. I wanted to order the lamb meatballs, because of all the great reviews. But they don't have the lamb meatballs on their brunch menu. The food came out super fast. All in all I would say it was a good experience.
name: Kristin

text: We never had a bad meal, never walked away hungry, didn't cost an arm and a leg. Veggies were fresh a crisp.  This is our go to Mexican place!
name: Lisa

text:
It's just like all the other "authentic" Mexican restaurants that are at every major intersection in this city. Is it good? Not really. Is it bad? Not really. If you want Mexican and don't have time or a Mexican grocery store with a kitchen in the back near you this will do I suppose. If you are expecting something special or a place that outdoes El Rodeo or La Hacendia then keep driving. 

I saw some reviews claim this place has food with no flavor. That's not even close to true. The flavors are just like all the other Mexican joints around. You won't leave saying "that was the best Mexican ever or this was the worst."
name: Matt

text: Im giving a 5 star only on the only dish i had. Now based on that i am definitely comong back to try the sushi. The ramen i ordered is the best one yet i have found in florida. The flavor was really rich and oh so creamy. Noodles cooked pretty good. One thing i wish i wish they were fresh made noodles. The service is good. Im one of only 5 people so... the establishment is big. Sushi bar is decent size. Chef behind bar was funny and friendly. Im sure i found my new number one Japanese restaurant.

text: I have stayed at La Paloma and Starr Pass for the 4th of July in the past,  but Ventana hands down blew them both out of the water with customer service and food! Our great experience started with Phil the bellman/valet to Mackenzie who checked us in, Noah and Chris the pool boys, Amanda our pool waitress, the cooks at Bills Grille, and to the girls who took our order and delivered our room service the next morning! The steak on the steak nachos was the best steak I have ever had and the hamburger was delicious!! Thank you again!! We will definitely be back!!

text: Food was good and came out fast. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Honestly, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
Well I was impressed when I first walked into the restaurant because it was different.  I liked the crowd that was a mix of college kids and middle age patrons trying to be hip.  Felt a little pretentious to be honest but the service was decent.  

Caterpillar roll was pricey, average taste, and presentation. So not sure why it was more expensive than other caterpillar rolls I've had.  The scallops in miso corn was excellent but again, kind of pricey.

text: Great spot. Best honey latte I've had since moving to Nashville. Staff makes the experience seem like you're hanging out with old friends. Fresh and simple food done very well. Yelp is dumb but this place is 5 starts well deserved.

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: I am from South America and these empanadas are the most legit ones in New Orleans, hell, all the US. The crust is flaky, warm, buttery, and plain delicious. The fillings are decadent and an explosion of flavor. Don't sleep on the onion pecan and blue cheese empanada, the flavor profiles just had me coming back for more! The staff is friendly and you can definitely feel and more importantly taste their love made products. Over all one of the better spots in Uptown, hands down. Must try!!
name: Rick

text:
YUM!! Visited this place with family prior to an event at the Fox Theatre. Everyone had a great time and the food was beyond delicious. Service was also on point. The atmosphere was also really awake some to experience. Loved the vintage and historical vibe of the establishment.  

Will definitely be back. Keep up the great work!!
name: Matthew

text:
Having lived in both Laos and Thailand for years, I can say that I know the genuine cuisines of those countries and hold little tolerance for establishments which cut corners or pass bogus dishes off as the real deal. Whenever I encounter a "Lao" restaurant in a foreign city, my first reaction is one of skepticism. Some of the critical reviews of Vientiane Cafe made me pause before deciding to give it a try. And I'm glad I did.

My family members and I ordered only Lao dishes, so I can't comment on the quality of their Thai offerings. The Lao staple dish is laab - delicately spiced ground meat served with sticky rice. My pork laab was excellent. I savored every bite. I therefore highly recommended it. My wife's aw lao - a kind of stew with veggies and meat or tofu - was also authentically spiced and delicious. Our daughter ordered King soup - a coconut milk-based noodle soup. It was exquisite. As a side dish, we had the papaya salad (Thai style), which also did not disappoint. Finally, for dessert, we had sticky rice with mango topped with coconut creme - it was to die for!

Contrary to some reviews, we found the service to be quick and friendly. The owner, a gracious elderly woman, spent time chatting with us and wanting to know how we found the food. Portions were ample and attractively displayed. I realize that restaurants occasionally slip on food quality and service due to the usual chef being absent, or a shortage of serving staff, which can account for some customers dissatisfaction. This certainly was not the case for us.

I therefore wholeheartedly endorse the food and service at Vientiane Cafe. I wouldn't hesitate to return.
name: J.

text: Our servers West and Richard were absolutely amazing! Food was fantastic. We had the $20 lunch with .25 martinis. I live here and never been until today. I'll be coming back often.
name: Pamela

text:
Ooooohh!! I think I have a new Chinese place!! 
Friday night Family Take Out. Simple order. Done perfectly. I even went back and tipped the https://trycaviar.app.link/D7vBznn7GY  Caviar driver a little extra. All we wanted was a bunch of spring rolls, vegetable lo mein and shrimp fried rice with NO EGG!! You'd be surprised how hard that is to accomplish for some places. The shrimp fried rice was really good for something with no spice whatsoever. I'm not being mean, just truthful. You can feed this to babies. It's that GOOD. Seriously.  I'm eating some right now. I love food that reheats well. 
The menu has various spice levels, so I wanted to gauge what THEY considered spicy against what I consider spicy. I ordered the basic "As Recommended" level of spice. I noticed a level BELOW that calles "No Spice". I can't imagine what that could possibly mean. 
So anyway, next time I'm gonna start at about 4-5. I was disappointed by the lack of bean sprouts, baby corn, cabbage, etc... Even water chestnuts would have been nice. Maybe I have to ask for that. The spring rolls were nice and "springy". Still crispy when they arrived. Thank you Mohammed from Caviar.com. My daughter liked her vegetable lo mein so much, she was sad she couldn't finish it all. Her leftovers been gone!! LOL! Nice job Han Dynasty.

The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was fresh and service was quick.

text:
Vegans and non-vegans alike will love this place. Food is delicious and the portions are very large. Service was great and super friendly. 

I had the chicken burrito, could only finish half of it before I was stuffed and had great flavors. 

My girlfriend had the spicy chicken sandwich. This has to be one of the best, if not the best, spicy chicken sandwich I've ever tasted (vegan and non-vegan). 

This is definitely a new go to place for me.

text: This has the feel of a local diner even though it's part of a national chain. This is my second visit. The first time I came with Jill and this time solo. Both times I sat at the counter. Neither time was I disappointed in the least. At the counter the cooks chat you up, give their recommendations and even offer a sample occasionally. The service staff is top notch and friendly. All the food is literally amazing. I can back because everyone raves about he chicken and waffles. I ordered and got immediate positive praise from the server and a wink from the cook. The server brought out a bowl that he put syrup into and then laced with LouisianaHot Sauce. He told me that if I like it hot to feel free to keep adding more. When the plate came I was stunned it's a full waffle with strawberry butter and a HALF a chicken. I immediately asked for a to go box. It was literally the kind of food dreams are made of. Put this on your must try breakfast list.
name: Joseph

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. so yeah kind of mixed on it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food was good and came out fast.

It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I left full, which at least counts for something.

text: This is probably my favorite oyster place in town. If I am going to splurge or bring out of towners, this is my spot. The place is always welcoming especially the oyster bar seating. Unfortunately, last night was not so. Not sure if it was because it was close to closing 22:54 but my guest received the worst grilled oysters ever. I was not made aware of their dislike until after they have tried to consume them. They were burnt, overcooked and dry. After this was brought to my attention. I in turn brought to one of the shuckers attention. He stated, "they should have spoken up earlier." Now, his attitude and tone set me off. As I stated I am a known guest who splurge each time I visit. I asked for a manager, the shucker stated he was the manager. As I know this not to be true. I didn't want to make a scene or draw unnecessary attention to my guest. I assured the shucker I would be writing a unfavorability review. I wasn't looking for a item removable. What I received was a shucker attitude and trying to justify the horrible oysters. I am one of Acme loyalty reward card holders but last night was my absolute last time patronizing that store. I am not sure if I even saw a manager on the floor (probably in office doing paperwork). If someone want to speak with or reply to this review, I would love to hear from you. I was table 101.1 check 1233. SN: after reviewing my receipt I can't tell if my reward card was even swiped. If ARC is the reward card information is show 00. But I do have my receipt
name: Tina

text:
I've never been to a BJ's before, but this place has a cool vibe, there's plenty of parking at the mall (assuming it's not holiday time), no wait for a table, and the service was great. I was never without a full glass and they slide your credit card at the table so it's a lot quicker than other restaurants. Also, I was planning on splitting some cash with my friend, but they said separate checks and they could even split the dessert in half to put half on each check. That was super helpful!

So for the food, since I know I was getting a pizookie I wanted to mentally balance that with a salad, and I found the ahi salad to be massive, delicious, and really filling and pretty decent on calories and price. 

Now for my favorite part, 3 small pizookies! Best day ever! I was torn between flavors so having the option to try 3 flavors was incredible. You can get any 3 flavors, so I went with triple chocolate, salted caramel, and peanut butter and they were all amazing. A variety of flavors is the way to go.

This seems like a great location to meet up with friends and a big menu so everyone in your party will find something. Food, service, and price were good so I would recommend.
name: Stephanie

text:
