name: Alex

text:
After picking up our son at college he asked if we could go out to a nice place that had good sushi. Terra Nova is the one place in the area that has good sushi. The place was packed. Had to drive around the parking lot three times waiting for customers to leave before we could park. 

Surprisingly the wait for a table was only 15 mins. We were seated at a nice table that wobbled every time you touched it. The buss boy spotted the problem and fixed it ASAP. We ordered a very good bottle of Malbec and Sushi for my son. 

We went for the four course special. Including butter nut squash soup, and a pear salad followed by short ribs with sweet potato mash and Brussel sprouts (the sprouts were under cooked and lacked seasoning) the short ribs were also under cooked however they were covered with a tasty bbq sauce. We ended the night with Vanella creme brûlée and cappuccinos. Nice place
name: Len

text: Great spot for brunch! Me and my fiancee were visiting Santa Barbara and stopped in for brunch. We were not disappointed! We sat outside, which had a great atmosphere of being out in public, but also very private. The food was delicious! I got the Pancake Breakfast, and my fiancee got the Huevos Rancheros. Prices were reasonable. The service was prompt. Definitely recommend!
name: Vincent

text:
This hotel was fabulous! Check-in was a breeze and all of the employees here were extremely friendly! The bar downstairs has great food and a ton of TVs to watch sports games on. The restaurant was also nice enough to customize certain food items for me which was greatly appreciated. The pool area was absolutely gorgeous- I like how the pool was inside with a lovely little outdoor sundeck near it. The jacuzzi is near a large window that overlooks outside and I can only imagine how beautiful it is when it snows.
The rooms I found to be very modern- but most importantly CLEAN! 
The ladies from Housekeeping were also very kind- If they saw me in the hall they would always ask if I needed anything for my room. 
The beds were cozy and the surrounding area is quiet and beautiful. I would be happy to stay here again in the future. 
The only downside- no shuttle and far away from downtown Philly.
name: Alyssa

text: Been going to Pizza City since I was a kid!! Always enjoyed their pizza! I love the grilled chicken salad it's so good and filling. I love the different gourmet pizzas they have...my all time favorites are the Chicken, Broccoli and Ranch and mostly recently The Margaret pizza which is topped with mozzarella, ricotta, basil and crushed plum tomatoes!! It's super good!! There's always something good to get there.
name: Corey

text:
I have been coming here since 2006. During this time span, two generations of my family have ordered food and dined in. And yes there have been issues throughout this time span, but today makes me think I won't be returning. 

After I pick up the kids, we often will stop by this location an order a range of things from slices, cheesesteaks, bread knots, and more. Usually there is a brunette working and she's fantastic. Always kind, always working hard. And if she sees there are no slices we want available, she tells me immediately so I know to EXPECT the wait. 

So today, I go in with the kids and order food. And then their actual dad comes and stops in to eat. (I'm the uncle) Twenty minutes in we both get the cheesesteaks, separate orders but I'm beginning to wonder where is the pizza? Two slices. The girl working the counter, who we stupidly tipped $5 ahead of time, says oh they're baking the pizza fresh. I'm thinking ok, they must have started this when I put in the order so it shouldn't be much longer. It is much longer. No NY thin crust pizza takes 40 more than 40 minutes to bake. When it hit the 45 minute mark, checked with the time stamp on the receipt, I was told it'd be three more minutes. At that point, I was done. The lack of communication ruined years of wanting to support a local franchise. I don't really blame the guy cooking in the back. I understand places can get busy. I even heard him ask the girl if she told us about baking a new pie, sure, 20 or more minutes into the already long wait. 

And in the end, when I told her about everything, she just said okay with an attitude like she could careless. At that point everything the other guy said went in one ear and out the other. She didn't give a damn. I think there were two slices and burnt them and then had the guy make a whole pizza because of her screw up. Then again, that's a theory. That's me trying to figure out what went wrong. I'd give them 1 star but I did enjoy my food. Very disappointed.
name: Jonathan

text: This place was a great find!  Outdoor seating, cozy atmosphere,  great service and FABULOUS food!  Everything is made fresh, and amazing flavor!  Highly recommend!
name: Michele

text: Any time there's a Cane's in a city, we find it and eat there. My husband loves it and our kids all love it. I like it just fine, even though it's not my preferred place to eat. I would love a salad with the chicken on it because I feel like eating the chicken tenders, fries and then my toast is so heavy, so I usually try to eat my coleslaw first. It makes me feel like I'm eating a little healthier.
name: Stephanie

text: Fantastic sushi and service, we have been her well over a dozen times and really enjoy our experience. They could absolutely move into a larger location and still thrive! I would say the only downside is that the seating area is small and tight as well as very very loud on busy nights. (Typically people that don't understand that you can speak with an inside voice because other don't care about what you are shouting to your friends) I digress, sushi is fresh, and large pieces, staff is friendly and always happy. Met the owner a few times as well and he is always very gracious and thanks us for coming by. Great location for a date, especially during the week when it is quieter.
name: Ryan

text:
Love/hate relationship with this White Castle. 
I can only ever tolerate the rude order takers and extremely long lines after a night of drinking, so at that point I'm desperate for food and it's usually the only place open.
Recently went during normal hours and ordered 2 impossible burgers. That's it. 
They asked me to pull forward and there I sat for 13 minutes. When she finally came out she said with a huge attitude "Forgot to tell you these take 10-12 minutes to cook."
Bullsh*t, they do!
Only go when your brain is fuzzy so you don't remember the horrific customer service. 
Giving them 3 starts instead of 2 since  this is fast food after all and the expectation shouldn't be high.
name: Heather

text: Delicious ramen with great add-ons, like poached egg. Cool atmosphere with good music, and you can see the cooks preparing the ramen if you sit at the ramen bar. The only downside was that it was pretty loud and that they don't seat parties over 6 people.
name: Liz

text: Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: My favorite restaurant anywhere in Nashville. Everything is excellent and the service is exceptional. Our server,  #1036 (aka Adam),  was prompt, professional  and actually seemed to be enjoying himself. Every trip to Nashville,  I'm here at least once. Dinner last night was special. Three of us had ribeyes that were perfectly cooked and my wife's filet was done perfectly too. We loved the shared appetizers as well: the brie and the calimari. Desserts were shared too: tiramasu and creme brule and were fantastic
name: Greg

text:
My husband and I now have a tradition to come to Khao Kaeng every Thursday. We always get the pad Thai dish with chicken and Thai iced teas with coconut milk - the BOMB! 
Ricardo is our favorite server! He always remembers our order, and is so kind and conversational. Such amazing service!
Khao Kaeng is such a treat.
name: Savana

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: For a busy night they handled it okay. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Glad we tried it. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
The wife and I just got to Clearwater and instead of looking up places decided to wing it and walked into this little place and I'm glad we did.
We ordered the garlic crab loaded fries. Wasn't expecting that much crab. It was more then I thought and were we ever happy.  They were delicious. We both ordered grouper sandwiches and she said hers was good. Mine was just okay. I had the buffalo one. 
I would go back in a minute and just order something else
Service was very good as well.
name: Martin

text: My hubby and I went for early dinner, we saw the repair people fixing something by the Sams Club gas station but didn't think much of it. Got inside was greeted and seated. Kevin D. off the bat was kind and immediately explained to us about the water main pipe breaking and that there is a "boil order" in effect, told us what would be served because of this, we decided to stay. His service was awesome the whole time, checked on us, made sure the food was good for us, basically acknowledging! They are limited for vegetarian items but you can still make it work. The shark bowl drink is very sweet can't taste the alcohol (basically a slushy from quick trip), the blue Hawaiian long Island was good so just be advised. Our food was great no issues or complaints about that. Great location in the middle of it all, convenient, will definitely be coming back.
name: Karma

text: The Panera bread on waters ave is a great spot for a quick and healthy lunch. Although I do find them on the pricey side. For an example, a pick two which is a soup and half sandwich can run you $8-$10 depending on what you buy. And that doesn't include a drink. However the food is delicious. I have tried many options on the menu and have never been disappointed. No matter how long the line is or how busy they get for lunch they always provide hot lunches in a reasonable time frame after ordering. Great lunch spot especially if you are on a time crunch for work or lunch hour.
name: Chris

text: I just moved to the area from Springfield and was very sad to leave my favorite sushi place. A coworker suggested Sushi Ai and I decided to give it a shot, and it was wonderful! Super yummy sushi and the prices are amazing! We went on a Friday night so they were a tad bit busy, and they were giving away specials to everyone waiting on for a table. Awesome way to keep customers coming back, I know I will be!
name: Emily

text:
This place is great for secret meetings and consuming absurd amounts of whiskey based cocktails. 

Don't go there for yourself, Do it for America......also do it for the popcorn, it's covered in truffle oil and love.
name: John

text: We only stayed for the brussels sprouts but man they were amazing! We sold our in-laws on going they said they were less salty which is a good sign. The beer does not disappoint great selection. Me and the wife will definitely be back and I'm pretty sure I will be taking stacked pickle by surprise and maybe even making them go out of business.
name: Aaron

text:
A cute local cafe where one can get a variety of different breakfast foods and drink. The green line cafe is across the street from clark park and can be easily accessed bt walking or trolley. 

This location is fairly small with limitted seating indoors, but also has a nice outdoor seating area as well. 

The food here is very good and options vary depending on the day and what they have available. 

Many of the food options are locally sourced and are typically a healthier(sounds healthier) and organic meal. Options for people of all food types can come here and get food. 

Vegetarian and vegan options can be found here as well as some very unique foods and drinks. 

I love coming here to get decent food, but am always left a little hungry afterwards. 

Definitely a good place to go to and eat breakfast at. Many people come here to do work and study so it can be very beneficial, but maybe limited seating!
name: Andrew

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was fresh and service was quick. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Glad we tried it. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: I would have given F-Birds a 5 star review but cannot block out the negative comments spoken between employees in Spanish(under the guise I didn't know how to speak or understand Spanish) very rude staff.  Nachos are always a good bite and the Tri Tip sandwiches (when available) are a go-to!
name: Chris

text: After waiting 15 minutes to get our drinks when it wasn't busy.... like did they squeeze the lemons themselves for my lemonade? Not to mention the texture of the potstickers felt as if I was eating the fucken brown paper towl from the restrooms. After I finally get my food there is a fucking hair, like... really? I'm really disappointment and I will no longer be coming here to this nasty joint. That's not the end of it either, as my friend was takin a sip of her sprite a black bug was floating on top.. I guess you can say my Friday was made. Lastly, but certainly not least the worker handling the station where I put my meal together was refilling empty food containers with NO GLOVES! Shout out to you guys all for making my night.
name: Luke

text: This place holds such a special place in my heart. Probably one of my favourite places, by this point I feel like I've been coming here for years. AMAZING service, the most AMAZING food. The service there is top notch- they truly care about you and go out of their way to make you feel at home.
name: Gabriella

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Idk, nothing was awful but i left disappointed. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: After the renovations the rooms are very nice. However they no longer have microwaves which is a big deal when you have an infant. Customer service is great.
name: Arlene

text: I have been here 3 times so far and each time the food and service get even better. This place is so much better than Texas De Brazil. The grilled cinnamon pineapple is delicious, salad bar is fresh with many choices, and the meats are perfectly marinated and cooked. This is my favorite spot when I am craving for steak.
name: Mai

text:
Try the new style Huevous Rancheros!! Delicious  and it would disappoint you. It's the new way they will be making it and even the owners recommend it. 

I would recommend
name: Frank

text: The food came out fast, which was good bc we were starving. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Their brisket is absolutely EVERYTHING. Absolute favorite restaurant in Nashville! My go-to's are the queso, house margarita, brisket with a side of brussel sprouts. So good!!
name: Abigail

text:
This is my 'Go To' spot for great Italian food. 
I typically have the Free Range Saltimbocca with Broccoli Rabe and then another side of Broccoli Rabe, It's THAT good! That being said, I've had almost everything including the random specials they have and I have never once had a bad meal here. My wife is a vegetarian and they always have something for her and they're always willing to accommodate her by altering a dish that would typically have meat. 

The atmosphere is great and the decor is perfect for such a small place tucked away on Main Street. The wait staff is typically college students for U of D and they're always friendly and super nice.  

I gave it four stars because sometimes it's a little warm in the dining room. They have a huge oven that gives off a tremendous amount of heat, I would assume this is the major cause but sometimes after eating, I get the meat sweats and the dining room doesn't help. 
Try to sit as far away from the oven as possible would be my advice.
name: Ken

text: A really great place on the docks. A wait but Worth While. Onion straws were good. Rice and beans were so good made with a trace of saffron. Wished I could have tried deserts
name: Kevin

text: This place is incredible. First experience in NOLA and it's a must go to. Devin hands down the best waiter. So personable and completely transformed our first experience here at the Ruby Red Slipper. This place was worth the wait. Ask for Devin, he will not disappoint.
name: Stephanie

text: Ordered from Postmates and so glad I did! Mostly everything was delicious! Got sweet n sour chicken, the sauce was great.. not watered down like other restaurants. The General Tsos, I wish it was a little more spicy maybe personal preference but there wasn't even a kick.. still good though. The Black Pepper chicken.. oh my, too salty and too much garlic. I never thought I'd say too much garlic but both were overpowering you didn't get the "black pepper" taste. Would definitely order from this place again though
name: Ben

text:
Welp, I'm pretty sure I either have food poisoning or just a horrible reaction to cheap cheese. Since I can't tell which it is, I am going to stick with three stars.

This restaurant is located in a busy area of Uptown, New Orleans, and even though you can find street parking, it does take some effort. While this is a pretty fashionable area of town, the streets are horrible and narrow. Even if you find parking, you may have lingering fears of someone taking off your mirror. 

The restaurant has very cheery decor, and I really liked the "shrine" behind the counter featuring the Chinese lucky cat, Blessed Mother, and Santa Muerte. I guess they wanted to have all their bases covered. Very New Orleans.

The decor is where the fun stops. The wait staff if polite but not well trained or organized. It took us 30 minutes to get our food, and the restaurant wasn't even half full. The waitress initially brought us another table's food, and the waiter waited until my husband had to take a business call to take our order.

The food was very bland. My food was nothing but cheese and a little shrimp. My husband's tacos were just meat. That's it.

I really wouldn't recommend this place.
name: Jessica

text: Great place for a burger, wings, or some quick bites to eat. We opted for mozzarella sticks and cauliflower bites while we had a drink at the bar. Friendly bartenders. I'd definitely rather do lunch or an early dinner here. They have an outside deck with seating and a bar, clean bathrooms, and a indoor seating area other than the bar. They have a pool table, darts, and change machine as well.
name: Regina

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: I took my girlfriend here and she got food poisoning lmao but the food was bomb tho ‍
name: Kenny

text:
What a fantastic deli.  I get down to Dresher once a week and always wonder where to eat.  A friend asked if I ate at the deli, I said "no".  Well, no more wondering where to eat when I go to Dresher.  I ordered the beast, a double patty cheese burger with lettuce and tomato.  It was prepared perfectly, hot and fresh!  The Burger to bun ratio was spot on.  They would customize it however you like.  There's no picture (this time) because I was so hungry I didn't want to go to my car and get my phone and I knew I'd be back!  Highly recommend this great little spot.  Check out the menu, lots of choices. Everyone is nice, accommodating and genuinely care about the service.

There are tables outside but that's it as far as seating. It's a gas station/deli/convenience store.
name: Kevin

text: We ordered a wide assortment of foods-- crab Rangoon, pork fried rice, general tso's, pork lo mein, spare ribs, etc.  it was perfectly cooked, and arrived right to my house via delivery in 20 mins or less. It was piping hot, flavors were delicious. The delivery person was so friendly and kind. I had zero complaints whatsoever. Will definitely order again. :)
name: Sarah

text: Manning's isn't bad for a restaurant and bar that's attached to a hotel/casino. The beer selection is pretty good and their fried pickles are excellent. The catfish fingers are pretty good, could have used a little more breading flavor. The sauce that comes with them is pretty great. My wife enjoyed the Caesar salad and, just FYI, show your Caesars (Total Rewards) players card, and you get a free salad! Overall, it was better our second visit and I would go back.
name: John

text: Very fast and friendly service and super tasty! My boyfriend and I had the Chicken Souvlaki and the gentleman made my version spicy and my boyfriend's sweet. Both variations were tasty and an added bonus quite inexpensive!
name: Meron

text:
Worst Veal Marsala I ever had in my Italian life.  Brown gravy like you make out of a packet for a roast over veal.  Salty and over cooked tagliatelle pasta.  I have no idea how people rated this 4 or 5 stars.  It was the worst I ever had and Waste of money. And we got no bread!!!!  To answer the owners question, I said it was ok because I didn't want to say how bad it was and I was in shock.  I'm Italian and make veal Marsala all the time and have eaten it at so many Italian restaurants .... this was brown gravy and there was so much it drown the entire dish, everything was covered in dark brown gravy.,tasted burnt and not good.  The calamari was good, my salad was good but my husbands salad had croutons that tasted old.  Wish I had taken a picture of the veal.  Recipe of how to make it is below in case your are interested.   

https://www.google.com/amp/s/www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/giada-de-laurentiis/veal-marsala-recipe-1915393.amp
name: Marie

text:
Get a Schmitter. Get a beer, a craft beer that can stand up to all the flavors packed into that messy sandwich. Don't expect preppy service: the short order cooks crank it out in the order in which it was received.  This is a great, real place to have a beer, watch a game, get stuffed with hearty food in.  

It's a really Philly thing. 

Beware of weekends and big game days, if you're claustrophobic. If you can, it's a great early evening place in the beginning of the week. Best of all, it's a skip and a jump from the Chestnut Hill West rail station.  

McNally's rocks, and you'll almost always see one of the owners running a platter to a table or trying to figure out if there are enough Kaiser rolls. I am a bit glad it's on the complete other side of town from me because I should not eat too many Schmitters.

( Finally, if you get there early, buy an LP at Hideaway Music, ha)

mcget / Trophy Bikes PHL
name: michael

text: Update- now that I've lived near this Rally's for the past several months, I've gotten food poisoning from their wings and been turned away because they didn't have ingredients or their "systems were down" at least five times. If you can catch them at a time that they are actually a fully functioning location & can manage not to get food poisoning, you may have a semi-decent experience
name: Mary

text: BurgerFuel originally drew up a lot of promotion by opening its first US store right here in Indy. The vibe is cool, relaxed but more of an upscale fast food spot. I love how accommodating they are to vegans and vegetarians with not only burgers but also vegan shakes. Their impossible burger is phenomenal and their vegan burger is also a welcomed change from a traditional black bean patty which is the typical vegetarian option at restaurants. It is a little pricey which is what knocks it down to 4 stars instead of 5 but I highly suggest checking it out! Can't wait until their new location on mass ave!
name: Taylor

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Worth checking out. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
Weather your going out for lunch or dinner this is one really good place to consider it's buffet style  there are pre made salads or make your own .  Just about anything you could want on a salad.  Don't expect any meat but they have a soup bar 5 to 7 international soups all of them handmade that day.  Delicious.  Then there's pasta of some sort either macaroni or spaghetti or fettuccine Also baked potato or sweet potato with the toppings different kinds of bread's .  Don't forget the desserts either with coffee tea or milk or plain water your choice your way go back for as much as you want very enjoyable and very clean Did I mention discounts but you just need to ask even coupons 
It's really worth a try you'll be glad you did
name: James

text: Watami has become an event for my friend group. We are eager when one of us exclaims "Let's Go to Watami!" We make a day of it. We usually go for lunch as the all you can eat special is 13.99 instead of the 20.00 for dinner. The fried rice is the some of the best I have ever had. It comes with Yum Yum sauce that is amazing. We also have a strategy to avoid the "rude charges" for leaving extra rolls on the plate. Always order small first, and build up as you go to avoid the charge for leaving 6 extra pieces of sushi. The staff is amazing and always nice. I can't wait to go back.
name: Katherine

text: Tonight my son voted to have pizza but I was in the mood to go out so this was our compromise. I wanted a pizza place that served alcohol so this fit the bill. We were happy to see that checking in on Yelp got us 6 free garlic knots. We went to the order side of the counter and began looking at the menu. The menu has tons of options. It made me a bit uncomfortable that two of the people behind the counter basically stared at us while we looked it over. We ordered the garlic knots, a caprese salad appetizer, and a pizza. The person who took our order didn't know about the Yelp deal so that was confusing, but someone else came up and explained it to her. After that we paid and took our number to the table. The caprese salad arrived first. It was very good but the portion was pretty small for $10. Also, when they brought it they didn't bring us any plates to use. Next came the garlic knots (and plates). These were basically inedible. They were so greasy that they were "heavy" because of the amount of oil/butter. I'm glad I didn't pay for them. The pizza arrived in a timely manner. We ordered half pepperoni/ half Hawaiian. The pizza was very good. I have no complaints there. The toppings were very generous. I would definitely go back for the pizza. Overall, the pizza was great but I'm not sure I'd order anything else. Oh, except I did see they had tiramisu... I'd probably give that a shot.
name: Ashley

text: Tried to enjoy my food but it was interrupted by 2 young girls, who's mother I believe worked in the kitchen, yelling obscenities and flipping me off. I can't believe the mother did not stop them. As I was driving away, they again flipped me off and recorded me with their old ass iPhone 5. Can't imagine how their home life is. I've been coming here for years and have never experienced something like this before.
name: Josh

text:
Just finished eating here. My mom and I shared the Enchiladas Maya and Chile Vallarta. Both were very good and came with hearty proportions. It was also nice to get chips and salsa right when sitting down. 

The interior decorations were fun and they had regular seating as well as a room for parties. After the meal we got the churro ice cream bowl. It was nothing revolutionary, but it was quite tasty. 

I would definitely consider eating here again with friends!
name: Lawson

text: I'm so happy this place is open and so close to home! Awesome beer selection and good wine options. I've had a few items from the food menu and so far so good! There are plenty of board games and books to check out as well. They also host trivia nights and live music. Outdoor patio area is dog friendly. This place is a great addition to Speedway!
name: Lindsey

text: This was a very disappointing experience for me. The most disappointing of all was that their $7 single guacamole (that comes in a bowl as small as a side of rice at a Chinese restaurant) was watery and definitely diluted with sour cream or some type of cream because I am lactose intolerant and did not eat any cheese yet felt sick when I came home. Overpriced bad food, will go to City Works from now on instead. Also their chips are stale and the plantain chips don't even taste good.
name: Sabrina

text:
So I tried their hot pot think that you boil I'm so sorry for not knowing what it's called it this is what children did to my brain haha!

I got the catfish and it was so full of flavor and the tangy limey savory factor of the fish just hit all my tastebuds.

I want to come back for happy hour for sure. They're happy hour deals are pretty good. And it gives you a chance to try more things on the menu without breaking the bank. I always will try different types of food but I unfortunately do not have the bank account to support my foodiness in me that's for sure. But I will definitely be coming back to try some more
name: Jeana

text:
I stumbled on this cafe last year while my friend and I were travelling to Nashville from New York. During our visit, our food was excellent and the warm welcome we received by the cafe's owners was truly a delightful experience. 

I visited Nashville again last weekend and made sure to stop by. Once again, I was overwhelmed with the friendliness of the owners and loved my sandwich. 

My recommendation - make sure you try their Reuben sandwich!!
name: Kieren

text: Best crab soup and excellent Chicken cheese steak. Fries are even better than the cheese steak. My kids love the pretzel appetizer but miss the calamari. Bring it back!
name: Theresa

text: Visited the restaurant today for Easter brunch. The restaurant wasn't full but it was around 2:00 pm. We were seated at the back of the restaurant. Brunch today was $35.99 per person plus tax. Most of the dish trays were empty and took time to refill. They had a ramen station to make your own ramen, the noodle bowl was empty for 15 minutes. The main dishes took forever to refill. The omelette station was unattended for the 45 minutes we were at the restaurant. The carving station had ham and what looked like prime rib. The ham was dried and over cooked and so was the prime rib. We asked for a piece that was medium and after a bit of convincing, the guy finally cut the center, that was well done too. The serving portions for carving station were small. It was embarrassing when another patron had to ask for more meat. The pan seared salmon was also over done and dry and the sweet potato hash undercooked. The only good dish was the Cioppino seafood stew. The better part of the Buffett was the dessert table. There was an assortment of pastries, muffins, and cakes. The server hardly came around to refill our drinks, remove the plates or to bring new cutlery to the table. We had to constantly ask for those things. Here's the kicker, we were still eating when we were given the bill. At that point we were done with the place. We were a party of 3 and they had added a 20% gratuity to the bill. I don't believe this is right nor did our waiter deserved the tip. I will never visit this restaurant again. That's an outrage! It didn't only ruined the experience, but ruined Easter brunch with my family. Horrible food, horrible service!

text:
We returned here on a recent Saturday evening after a long absence (entirely driven by a move out of the area). The Dilworthtown was a go-to spot years ago for special occasions, and we were excited about our visit.

A perfect fall evening beautifully accentuated the beautiful grounds. And the nicely maintained interior remains faithful to the period architecture.

Unfortunately, that was the end of our highlights. Our evening consisted of slow service, lukewarm (or, in the case of my wife's salmon, uncooked) food, and a pretty high bill. We were not alone in our experience - the adjacent table received a free round of desserts as an apology for their long wait. We were offered no such consolation - but would have declined it anyway, ready as we were to end our disappointing evening.

There were a few good parts. My mushroom soup appetizer was terrific. And our servers were very friendly and knowledgeable, and we appreciated them being up-front about the slow pace.

Here's hoping the Dilworthtown can regain its old touch. It was a great place for a long time.
name: Arthur

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Wouldn't rlly choose this place again. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..

text:
On our way to catch a movie at galaxy Victorian, we stopped at this place because it was convenient and the Truckee location reviews seem pretty solid. Unfortunately this was not a solid experience! The place is quite large, and very open and airy. You order at the counter and the call you up when it's complete. 

Basically the lack of flavor and freshness of the meat is a huge problem. The medium salsa is more like a mild salsa with a strong vinegar taste. It tasted like pickled veggies were used to make it. Al pastor was dry, the spanish rice had no flavor, the chicken quesadilla and cheese quesadilla were bland. I asked for a bottle of hot sauce (tapatio or Cholula) and was told they do not carry hot sauce... weird. Okay on to plan B, paid for a side of guacamole and sour cream. That didn't help much either. 

Side note: While sitting there another couple came in and ordered tri-tip Sandwiches and was disappointed to see that the meat they used is pre-cooked thin sliced beef and it sits in a metal container of water and it's pulled out to warm and brown on the grill. When it was pulled out, the meat looked grey and rubbery. I'm not sure I would consider this "quality rotisserie roasted chicken & beef" as stated on the menu. It's cooked meat sitting in water... is this normal?? I can't attest to the taste but the practice was extremely off putting. 

Clean facility , fast service , great location but the food just wasn't good. We didn't finish our plates and decided to fill up on popcorn next door instead Hope they can get it together, maybe it's new business jitters.

text: I tried this place using a Groupon, and the biggest draw for my family when I first bought the Groupon were the pictures of the snow crab leg entrees all over the Groupon ad.  Nowhere on the Groupon does it say that you cannot use it for snow crabs.  When you get to shop, there is a huge sign listing all of the things you cannot get using the Groupon that's already been paid for.  So, buyer beware if you came for crab legs.  When I mentioned this to the lady working there, she argued that she didn't know what the Groupon says, but that's their policy.  On to the food... I did pay extra for some crab legs and the steamed ones with garlic sauce were indeed very good.  The fried crab had meat that was very dry and stuck to the inside of the shell.  Fried lobster tail was very tasty, as were the hush puppies.  Fries were overdone.  Seafood rice was delicious.  Huge shrimp with garlic sauce, but we didn't enjoy because our family doesn't like shrimp in general, just had to order something other than the crab legs to fill up the big Groupon order that we had bought.  Same with the seafood sandwich, looked very good and hearty, but could only eat it with disdain as we felt obligated to get it to fill the order.  As our experience here was tainted, will not be back.

text: Unfortunately , I have had more poor experiences than good ones at this location. Examples: I place an order online for the convenience of not waiting, only to discover upon arrival, employees seen standing around joking, laughing  and on their phones and my order not even started.  In addition, I have become a bit of a "germaphobe" ever since I started working in healthcare and I have had at least 3 occasions in the last year including the height of flu season, where they were preparing my salad without gloves on!   Each time, I asked them to put gloves on and that I wasn't going to eat whatever they were preparing without protection, not to mention cell phones are filthy and should not be anywhere near the service area.  Each and every time, I was the recipient of a smirk , a sigh, a rude rolling of the eyes ... REALLY?!   Was that so wrong to request safe handling of my food? The last time I was there, prior to my visit yesterday evening was one where I was very dissatisfied with barely there toppings with a ton of lettuce.  Mind you, my order was light on the lettuce and shame on me for not realizing until I got home the opposite was the case. I called and spoke to a shift manager who was very apologetic and granted a refund plus free salad.  Cut to last night , to retrieve my refund plus salad as was promised to me. I approached the worker (who barely made eye contact when I walked towards the counter), explained my situation with expectations that my wishes would be met with apologies.  Instead  was given an annoyed scowl and tone while questioning the validity of my ask and cutting me off in midsentence.  Along with the way she began slamming together the salad with ingredients, I couldn't help but wonder if it made her really mad that I was getting a refund plus salad?  Instead of saying, so sorry for any inconvenience what can I get you?  It was as if Saladworks error was somehow my fault .   She was so rude no matter how I tried to kill her with kindness as I thought that might change the attitude.   It did not and shortly after getting my utensils for my takeout , I asked for the managers name and Miss Congeniality told me she didn't really know how to spell it.   I asked for a business card.  She told me there was no card.   I asked when the manager was in again? " Kaitlin only works on "Monday's and Friday's" and that was the end of it. I left with a thank you and though my intent to call was strong , not sure it would make any difference. I felt so angry after this last exchange that I'm writing my first yelp review ever ! It is my observation that half of these employees need serious training on proper customer service etiquette .   The kind that retains customers not repels them!  Sad to say, more often than not the good employees who exhibit a sunny disposition and eagerness to please are few and far between .   Its a shame, despite the upgrade and more modern feel to the restaurant's appearance, the poor customer service overshadows the surface appeal.  Last night, Saladworks in Mount Laurel lost a customer.
name: Cat

text: I went to Salt on Mass for the first time last Tuesday to celebrate my birthday. They were very accommodating with my reservation, even when my party size increased last minute and part of my party including myself was running late. The menu was personalized with "happy birthday" and my name which was a very nice touch. The staff was extremely friendly and my food was delicious. We ordered an assortment of apps, my favorite was the salt block sashimi. I wish I would have known what fish was offered but I never was able to ask my server. She unfortunately wasn't very attentive. I chose Salt for my dinner because I saw they were participating in Devour Indy. We weren't offered the menu, but I already knew I wanted the sea bass. The risotto was perfect and the sea bass was light and flaky. The devour menu offered 3 courses: starter, entree, and dessert. I ordered the lobster bisque however I never received it. I was so busy with gifts and socializing that I didn't realize it until I got home. I also had to ask for my dessert to-go because that was forgotten as well. One of my guests ordered the lobster mac and cheese and another ordered the gnocci, both had to be sent back because they were cold. Another guest asked the difference between the devour sea bass and the sea bass on the regular dinner menu. Our server told us that the devour portion was smaller because "the devour menu is just a taste of what we offer". But when our food finally arrived it was the same portion size which was confusing. At the end of dinner I wanted a group picture, while taking the picture our table was cleared even though we weren't finished with our martinis. The manager did give us a round of shots for the guests that were left which was nice, but many had already left because of how late it was getting. Over all the service was extremely slow, I barely saw my server and I didn't receive things I ordered. I had a great time because of my friends, but I'm embarrassed that my guests did not.
name: Christina

text:
This place is located inside the airport right before security check in. 
The food was three stars but the service was five! I'm a native so I've had plenty seafood dishes to compare to! I ordered a mini seafood platter. It was decent. I have to agree with some of the other reviews that my food was more seasoned than what i thought was necessary but not bad! I typically like less seasoned seafood so i can taste the actual food if you know what I mean. My husband ordered the BBQ shrimp! I liked his more. The bread was a good texture and perfect for dipping! It was a good filler to hold us for our plane ride! 
The best part was our server. She was amazing! Super friendly, quick, and checked on us occasionally! I think her name was Joann! Thank you a Joann for great service!

text:
I LOVE The Tasty.

When you walk in, it's a super old school, trendy little diner. Everyone at the counter is super friendly and really helpful. They have a Pride Flag hanging above their window which instantly makes any LGBTQ+ person feel at home. The menu covers almost any breakfast/lunch food you could want. 

My girlfriend, who isn't a vegan, ordered an omelet and was over the moon about it. She couldn't stop gushing over how good it was, accompanied by some tater tots. I got the crispy chick'n sandwich with the waffle fries! I'm not a huge fan of coconut bacon, I typically prefer tempeh but it complimented the sandwich really, really well. I added buffalo sauce and it was great! We split their oreo donut and were extremely close to ordering a second.

If you like a true diner style meal, you won't be disappointed. Their Instagram constantly covers the insane range of food they're able to make vegan friendly and is constantly changing. I HIGHLY suggest you try it if you're in the area!

text:
Fast food pizza is really taking off right now.   Mod pizza is a great addition to the scene.

I love the double meaning in the name (MOD Pizza).    You can "mod"ify the toppings on your pizza (choose one of theirs and add/subtract toppings or start from scratch and design your own).    And the decor/music is from the mod era (late 60s/early 70s).

The service is really helpful and personable.   They'll happily walk you through the ordering process if you're new to this kind of pizza parlor.

The pizzas themselves come out in under 5 minutes (due to the high temp oven) and have a nice crisp crust.   There are a ton of toppings and sauces to choose from so you're sure to find something you like.  There are even multiple variations of the same ingredient (mushrooms vs roasted mushrooms, sausage vs spicy sausage).

The soft drinks are self-serve and there are some interesting tea and lemonade options available in addition to the standard pop fountain.

text:
I'm rating VN Pho solely as a person who's only ever ordered one item here: the P1. Beef Pho - To GO: Yeah, it's '5 stars' delicious!!!!

After talking with a few Vietnamese friends on finding some legit, well prepared Pho in Tampa; VN Pho was mentioned and since it's less than a mile from my house I figured I should definitely try it and wow... blown away! 

The broth: Clean, flavorful, not as greasy or oily as some places, tasted very bright. The Noodles, are as they should be: a clean pure white thin noodle, firm until you set it in the broth and soak up all the broth flavors. The Beef: served raw, you let it cook in the broth. Once cooked it's tender, not chewy, tasty. Garnishes: VN Pho loves to lean on a healthy serving of Cilantro, white onions, and bean sprouts. In addition theres also a few Mint sprigs, and lime. Heres the part I really love and it's shockingly not the food itself but I LOVE how its all served up in disposable to-go "bowl," container!!! Thats right; pour the broth right into this pretty little disposable bowl, eat your Pho, and then throw it all away once you finished eating! It's perfect if you don't have giant bowls at work, or waiting from that one bowl in your house that accommodates such a big soup to pop out of the dishwasher. 

I love getting my Pho take out here. Total fanboy and thats not changing for a long time!
name: Leo

text:
Nashville is known for its burger joints, and the wide spectrum of quality is stunningly vast. In the hamburger hierarchy, The Pharmacy and Farm Burger stand at the top in Music City, at least in the opinion of most. But dozens of burgers stand right behind them with epic taste and innovative recipes! At the bottom, naturally, are McDonald's and Burger King. Boom Burgers is somewhere in between, standing in the middle amidst this enormous range of burger quality.

I started with The Grenade, their largest hamburger. On paper, this impressive fusion of ingredients seems like perfection for diehard protein fans. A burger patty, a chicken patty, a pork chop, and a fried egg! I mean how could I go wrong? It's essentially the polar opposite of vegan! But the burger and chicken were both overcooked to the point of being dry and stiff. It was like chewing through a banana peel. And disappointingly, the pork chop was of very mediocre quality. Only the egg and bun were enjoyable.

I gave them a second chance with just a plain fried chicken sandwich. This chicken was at least somewhat juicy and the batter was nice and crispy. The service was also very good, and a full dining room was served very quickly for lunch!

I'd definitely agree that the fries and milkshakes were delicious. But the quality of meat as well as the cooking method still haunts me.

Returned to try the family side and really liked how it was much quieter than the bar side.  TVs show funny clips, kids shows and sports on family side.  All staff were very friendly to kids and welcoming.  

Tried the lunch menu buffalo chicken sandwich.  It was okay, it was more like a puréed chicken and I was thinking it would be strips or chunks of chicken.  My husband ordered the buffalo chicken sandwich, which was massive and he said delicious!  One thing to note, lunch menu most items are same price as regular menu, so may ask if same size or not.  Lunch portion was still large but for same price might as well get regular one and take home half for another meal.

When we visited they were donating 15% of all purchases for the week to a local family involved in a large accident with three fatalities.  If you are looking for a family friendly place, an adult night out (on the over 21 side) or a local restaurant that gives back to the community this is a great place!
