text:
The food was average and service was ok as well. I wouldn't go out of my way to try their food. We happened to stay at the hotel next door so this was a convenient breakfast option. 
Ordered the garden omelette which came with your choice of two sides. It was a good healthy option. Nothing spectacular.
name: Sonia

text: Great hot food, just takes forever on coming out. If you are in a rush call ahead with an order.
name: Rebecca

text: Ordered takeout bc I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning.
name: User

text: The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Definitely coming back. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: Classy and laid-back, Maison is my kind of place. We saw a great band here and the drinks were tasty. Every table has a great view, and I could see myself grabbing a bite here on future visit to New Orleans.
name: Michael

text: This place is amazing!!! Everything I've ever eaten here has been incredible. The service is amazing, everyone seems to be proud to work here and proud of the history. The vibe is great and nice place to sit outside, relax, and watch everyone go by on state street. I would highly recommend this spot to anyone!
name: Jon

text: Try this place! I've lived in Tucson for 18 years and tried this restaurant for the first time on Friday. The food was DELICIOUS. The service was AMAZING. When our waitress got busy, it was a very busy night, others tended to us to make sure we were well taken care of. Their drinks are strong and tasty (who doesn't want that) and I literally don't have anything negative to say about this place. Prices are JUST right, even on the cheap/very affordable side!
name: Harley

text: Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: So flipping hot in there! Too much dressing for my taste but had good veggies in it. Cute spot but no AC. Order to go if it's a humid day. You can take he yummy drinks with you
name: Elaine

text: Chaing Mai is our go to thai spot in the area. I'm always surprised that they aren't busier, because the food is great. The interior is dark, and eclectic. Service is always friendly and prompt. We get carry out from Chiang Mai at least twice a month. I recently tried their eggplant dish and it is now on our must-order list. So much flavor! We typically order everything spicy, because their "medium" tends not to be at all spicy. The classic pad thai is good, needs a bit of lime juice. Both red and green curry's are great, and the drunken noodle is great too. The salad rolls are also on our list- and dont disappoint.
name: Emma

text:
Awesome. Place was full of Asian people, good sign. Service...top notch, food well presented and tasty. Great value, fun place to go. The only drawback was having to cut the steak with scissors, but the server was kind enough to get me a knife. I understand it was a tradition, but nonetheless is difficult for us westerners to be given such to eat with.
Other than that, it was perfect!
name: Jean

text: This place is decent enough if you want something cheap and of moderate quality. Although I felt the rolls in general could have used some more flavor, I do frequent Sushi Pier because of the great prices, the lunch special, and the confidence that I can be in and out of there in under an hour.
name: Lindsey

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The music was louder than it needed to be. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
I just can't get enough of those Chicken & Waffles!! 
Aka - Bam Yo Yo ... and please - add a side of the delicious gravy. It must be that I've been coming here once a week. Service is always friendly and fast. Overall worthy of the 5 stars for price / quality & yummiest. 
Weekends might be slightly busier then weekdays but I promise- it's definitely worth the wait. 
Fluffy biscuit with honey butter omg!!!!!!! If you haven't gone to eat here ( YOU HAVE TO NOW ) I recommend Bam Yo Yo .... with Bacon & Gravy on the side. ( that gravy is everything)
name: Vivian

text: This is the first time I tried the mobile app to order pizza from Papa John's. This is also the last time. It is a slow night and it took them over an hour to just put the order in the oven it will take over and hour and a half to get delivery.  The service is horrible.
name: Rick

text: Now that this chain restaurant opens in Tucson. Fair tasting, but very nice staff members!
name: Jyl

text: Excellent food and customer service. Alejandro was a Superb food server, guiding us to the best food and drink. Loved the soups, shrimp and the bread pudding is phenomenal. Love that the shrimp are wild caught from Alabama. The Pepito is a delicious tequila cocktail with cucumber and orange liquors refreshing and not too sweet. And, the fresh, warm, bread is something I will crave when I return home to CA.
name: Julia

text: We stopped by the other day after a school event at the high school . We haven't been there for a couple months , not because of anything bad , just haven't been around there . Food was good , above average for sure , but definitely got a bit of sticker shock !! I understand prices go up , but the amount they've gone up for the short time they've been open is eye opening !!! We like the food , but feel like they are pricing themselves out of the family market .......
name: Jim

text: The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Pretty happy with it overall. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
For being an espresso bar you would think the espresso would be good. I have tried many espressos around the Midwest and Italy. This is one of the worst. 

From the menu they have hot and iced espresso. Which is just a marketing scheme. All coffee shops put espresso in their specialty drinks. Fancy machine DOES NOT equal good espresso. 

All this shop is, is a cliche instagram shop that's a step above Starbucks.

If you want good espresso go to Nicole-Taylor's Pasta and Market. It's the closest espresso we have found to European espresso.

The Taste of Havana also has Cuban espresso that's delicious!

Other wonderful coffee shops are Indie Coffee Roasters, Kaffeine Coffee Co., or Open Society.
name: Ila

text: Beth was my server. I had a horrible day and she greated me at the front door. Honestly with the say i had was concerned i was headed for another fast food dight. Beth was anything but that. She was hapoy frienslt and was not letting me leave without a smile and good time. The New Yorker was great. Got fries on the side and the beer mustard was awsome! Beth thank you for the recommendation. I will be back!
name: Joe

text:
Not exactly my favorite Popeyes location, but def one that I have grown with in my lifetime. (See also: The old Popeyes that used to be on St. Bernard Ave. that I grew up on as a kid. I think its a Chinese spot now)

I've had more $5 boxes to cure hangovers during college Mardi Gras seasons than I can count from this location. It isn't always the cleanest and they may get your order wrong every now and again, but it's definitely a popular location in the Uptown area.

I stopped by last weekend to try the new chicken sandwich. I ordered the spicy chicken sandwich with the meal and a mild sandwich by itself. Of course, I only received one sandwich and fries in the bag and I had to wait to speak to someone to get my mild one, which took about 10 minutes.

Aside from the service being "eh", the sandwiches were absolutely delicious and if I could, I would start a fan club in their honor. One of the juiciest, crispiest and well-seasoned chicken sandwiches I've had! And believe me, my genetic makeup damn near consists of chicken sandwiches.

Now go get one. Crunch wisely.
name: Chasity

text:
So in case you were wondering Jack's now has a food truck and they just so happened to be parked outside my work place today. 

I've been to the downtown shop a few times now and the food truck is on par both for service and taste. Jacks burgers are somehow always cooked to perfection. Crispy on the outside and tender and juicy everywhere else. The crispy outside gives that deep grilled flavour you crave when eating a burger. At least that's how I like it. 

Today I had the mushroom and Boursin cheese burger. This burger packs a big punch of flavour. Honestly I don't think at this point I'd order anything else. But be warned it is a bit on the messy side. Also can't forget to mention the amazing brioche style bun that all these delicious ingredients are pulled between. It's oh so soft and light. 

Mmm. I kind of want another already.
name: Chantel

text:
Went for happy hour. Very hipster place with pingpong tables and cornhole. There is an open roof so be prepared for rain and wet floors in the cornhole/pingpong area.

Great service and friendly waiters. Ordered the pork belly nachos, some fries, and a few drinks. The food came out fast. Drinks were good and the fries were crisp and delicious. The nachos were initially very good, but some of the chips were a bit stale (maybe 1 out of every 10 were stale). Also, once the cheese on the nachos got cold, it became very thick and would coat your mouth in a bad way, making it really difficult to eat. With almost a third of the nachos left, we couldn't eat them anymore because of the state of the cheese and decided to take them home to warm up the cheese.
name: Jeremy

text: Quick service on a busy Saturday night. Traditional southern food with a flare. Great entertainment. A downtown Nashville staple.
name: Nicole

text:
As a Texan, it's great knowing that Nashville has a Shipley. I can say they still make the best glazed donut around. Not to mention they carry kola he's which a lot of people don't know or confuse with pigs in a blanket. Also what I like is they also have breakfast sandwiches as well. They recently also renovated and it makes the front counter feel a lot bigger...because it is now. Ha. 

Friendly staff, make sure if you're going to charge on card that you spend more than $5 and enjoy an old school donut shop with great quality without having to oversell like gourmet donut shops do. 

Not sure what people are talking about don't believe the hype.
name: Mike

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything..
name: User

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. For the price I expected more than this. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Food's good, quick service and beers on tap!  Also they have TATOR TOTS!  Good place for happy hour and decent bar food for the area that doesn't have too many restaurants.
name: Xiao

text:
Kemoll's did a FANTASTIC job for my son's rehearsal dinner!  The coordinator Kristi was helpful and was there for us at every turn.  The staff was beyond accommodating with our needs, last minute requests and they even helped pack up at the end of the night.  

The food was beautifully displayed and out of this world delicious!  The St. Louis natives as well as the out of town guests were in awe of the spectacular view.  Both my son and his future bride independently told me that the rehearsal dinner was more wonderful than they ever imagined.
name: Debra

text:
Great food. Had a bit of a long wait to get in as it was super popular. Good portions that I could not finish and pleasant staff. The Yelp app allows you to get your place in line reserved which is totally cool.
I had the full loaded Omelette which came with potatoes and wheat bread both which were excellent.

Only downside was the wait given there were empty tables.
name: Mike

text: My first time having a poke bowl and Oishii Poke really set a high standard of how a good poke bowl should taste. All the ingredients tasted fresh and were well put together. They had different options like a burrito, rice bowl, and a salad. The service was super friendly, and were very engaging with your order. Overall this place was amazing and I would recommend it to all my mutuals.
name: Angelina

text:
The service here has been top notch the last two times I have come in. 

The broccoli in hot sauce was a low key fire hit in my book. The poke app dish was also good and quite large for an appetizer which is surprising for a fancy place like this. 

The pastas here are some of the best in town so be sure to come with a group and try them all. 

The entrees are kind of boring and nothing to write home about. The fried chicken comes with collard greens and grits. They should really sub out the grits for something like mashed potatoes. The curry fish looks pretty but lacks substance and tastes like nothing. It should be served on a bed of something. The ribs are fun to eat but the rack I was served was quite severely charred. I guess this place isn't a bbq joint for a reason. 

The bread rods on the table are fun to munch on. I like to pretend they are cigarettes and tuck them between my index and middle finger while I chat at the dinner table. 

The saffron soda was undrinkable.

I will probably come back in the future when they change up the menu. I can't wait to see what pastas they cook up in the future. I'll skip the entrees though.
name: Kyle

text:
The server was quite efficient and pleasant, the food was horrible. Microwave chicken and white bread with a little bit of lettuce but no hint of seasoning. No tomato etc. As a native, nothing would make me call it a po-boy. Visitors to the city would get the wrong idea for sure.

Sandwich and salad with shrimp for my wife, two beers equals $60 after tip. What a horrible last meal in Louisiana.

It looks like this restaurant and some others along the strip are owned by Delaware North. This is the same group, I think, that used to have the concessions for Yosemite and I thought they did a good (expensive) job there. However, I noticed the other negative reviews below mine and you'll see that even though people complained months ago, nothing seems better.
name: Dan

text:
This place has a more of a honkey tonk vibe. Not a date place but the food was surprisingly delicious. 
Chicken wings and the Brussels were great apps. We shared the Thai chicken salad and arugula prosciutto pizza and they were great too. 
Their cocktails were bit watered down though.
name: Robert

text: Only a few real buildings which was disappointing because the ones that were open had the friendliest staff you'll ever meet, great food, and a little something for everyone
name: Shovel

text: This place is awesome.  The service was amazing.  Food and drinks were great.  Fun atmosphere.  Highly recommend!
name: Brenda

text: Good pizza, especially after a night out. I've tried the most of the slices with my favorite being the last one out of the oven :)
name: Julia

text: Such a cool new place. I had the crack tacos and absolutely loved them. They have a garden and fire pit,  I'm so excited to visit again in fall. Service was quick and friendly and food was reasonably priced.
name: Katie

text: This place is amazing! The food is always on point and prices are low! The customer service is always on point and the manager is the cutest! She's always walking around helping every time I'm there. She even remembers me and says hello and asks how my week was! She needdssss a promotion, ASAP.
name: Kaitlyn

text: I would love to say that this is a great place to come to, food is good but this is the third time that o have had to wait over 1hr and a half to eve get food. I thought that mistakes happen and you forget about your table so I ordered for pick up, I was told 40mins but when I show up to pick up my food I waited over over 40 minutes for pasta they forgot???! How does that make sense???? I have been forgotten 3 times now tonight is the last straw. There is no need my kids bed to wait over 1:30 to eat.
name: Karla

text: Best oysters in town. Ice cold and salty. The food is always consistent and the service is great. Good spot for lunch but get there early because the tables fill up quickly. It's a hole in the wall but they are awesome.
name: Lauren

text: Great hibachi. It was very entertaining. The prices were for plus 20% off for students. Service was okay
name: Brittney

text: Great service, great food. Wish there were more locations in Tucson. Overall, the best sandwich in town!
name: Vaughn

text: Went to breakfast on a Tuesday morning and waited a short amount of time. The service is quick and the food is good! I ordered the strawberry shortcake pancakes and they were delicious. The inside has a country/homey feel to it. Over all it was great!
name: Erika

text: Kinda disappointed. Buffalo ranch bowl had too much buffalo sauce and the rest- rice and beans were bland.
name: Pratigya

text: This is a great food restaurant if you are looking for something new to try. The food is good and the prices are fair, the service is really good too. I'm definitely coming back
name: Scott

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not sure though.
name: User

text:
This trendy place feels like something you'd find in Charleston. The decor is so cute! For drinks, I got the Louie and my husband got the Peacekeeper. Both were good, but I ended up getting the Peacekeeper for round two, it was balanced and delicious. We started with oysters from the raw bar. They were all from Massachusetts, both the brine and their house sauce were fantastic. For entrees, we normally order different things so we can try more, but the lobster roll sounded too good to share so we both ordered it. Thank goodness, because there's no way either of us would have shared it! The roll was so buttery and they give you a generous amount of lobster. It was my first time having sole lobster, so I felt quite luxurious. We got the pumpkin whoopie pies for dessert, and they were perfect! 

We absolutely loved this place, and can't wait to come back and try something new! ...Or just get the lobster roll again because I don't know how anything will top that!
name: Brianna

text: I live right down the street. I think that this and Giovanni's is the best pizza in the area. My favorite thing from here is there a hoagie. For some reason there onions taste so good compared to normal. I think they soak them. I recommend this place
name: Julie

text: Went for valentines dinner, atmosphere, food and service was great. Only lost a star because the tables for 2 were a little small and cramped. Otherwise everything was fantastic, would recommend.
name: Ben

text:
One of the best poke places I've been to in Florida. I haven't found a place that serves poke like the ones in California, but this definitely comes close.

Love their wide selection of proteins, mix-ins, and toppings. I normally get a customized bowl with half salad/half rice or their Unagi (eel) Lover Burrito. 

I have yet to try their hibachi dishes but it always smells delicious. They also have small sides like gyoza (fried dumplings), miso soup, and harumaki (spring rolls). 

They have now started selling Poke Sushi Tacos and a new burrito special: Hot Cheetos Burrito. Will definitely try them when I'm back in the area.
name: Mary

text: I've been going here regularly for about a year, and this place never lets me down! Best pho I've had in Reno so far. Consistent quality, good prices, and great service. The women who runs the place recognizes me and my boyfriend every time we go now and she and the waiter are total sweethearts. I highly recommend this place.
name: Catherine

text: Delicious food an coffee! Had the bacon and avocado eggs Benedict which was amazing. Cute little diner setting too.
name: Brittany

text: Great food and service! Went this past Sunday and had sea bass with risotto and asparagus- simply delicious!. The bread pudding was so good.
name: Kittrell

text: This is the best food ever!  The veal a la bleu was excellent! Have to bring our friends next time.
name: Barbara

text:
We've given this place three tries over several months; we were hoping to find a kid-friendly Olive Garden like place that was close by. Turned out to be a hard "no". Each time the service was terrible, with three separate servers. Specific examples: orders were incorrect, wine was spilled (thankfully on floor and not on us!), and it regularly takes forever to get anything from water to the check. We gave them some leeway since they were new and probably had to train their servers, but the service has not improved one bit. 
The only highlights are that the food is good and the portions excellent. But it's just not worth it for us to sit forever and through all the mistakes, especially with kids.
name: Margaret

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. For the price I expected more than this. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
I've never heard of hot chicken until I was planning a trip to Nashville. Apparently Nashville is known for  hot chicken so why not try it? Plus my boyfriend loves all things spicy so I knew this would be a good choice. 

We arrived here about 5 minutes before they opened on a Saturday. I knew the line may be long but I didn't expect it to be so long! We were determined to try this place so we waited regardless. It was nice of them to have little water stations along the line. We waited nearly an hour until we got inside to order.  After ordering our food came out fairly quickly. I ordered a mild chicken (I'm lame when it comes to super spicy food haha), collards, and Mac and cheese. Let me just say.... that chicken is AMAZING! It truly lives up to the hype! It's a well seasoned combination of juicy and crispy. Both of my sides were also absolutely delicious. The portions are very large and filling. I tried my boyfriend's hot chicken. It definitely has a good spicy kick to it! 

Just writing this review is making me want to go back! It is worth the wait!!! My first experience trying hot chicken was great. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Nashville!
name: Ligia

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The music was louder than it needed to be. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: This use to be our go to spot for food and sports.  The last 2 weekends we have come here we have had terrible service.  Server came to our table 15 mins after we sat down.  After that point we had to flag down a server to place an order.  Servers would stop at the tables beside us and not even stop to see if we needed anything.  I understand servers are not designated to certain areas, but this is crazy.  Servers started coming by only after we asked for the check.  Would not recommend!
name: Amanda

text: Superb food, excellent service. The dishes we tried were fresh, so delicious & flavourful, and presented with flair. Our server Kam was warm, attentive, and professional. The prices here are very reasonable for stand-out quality like this. One of the finest dining experiences we've had in Edmonton.
name: Thomas

text: We had a nice time here.  The food is adequate.  We had the barbecue shrimp(swimming in butter), the seafood quesadilla was a highlight, the peel and eat shrimp also very good and my brother in law enjoyed the blackened grouper.  We had a lot of fun with the entertainer Jeff on Saturday night.  He is very funny but doesn't play any motown.‍
name: Ann

text: This location is closed?! Wow, what a shame! As a college student going to USF I always enjoyed the great prices and amazing sushi at Takura. I lived so close I could ride my bike there. If this location is closed, im really sad I can't enjoy their "Buddha delight" roll anymore...
name: Liz

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: This place is cute enough however, the weirdness started before we got in the door. There was a hand written sign on the door that said cash only even though it says on yelp that they take credit cards. It's 2020. Come on. Not a huge problem, but inconvenient in an age where that is completely unnecessary unless you don't care about the convenience of your customer. My husband wanted to order corned beef hash but doesn't like eggs so asked for them to be scrambled on the side. The cook refused. He said that if we wanted scrambled eggs we had to order something else off the menu. On a related note, we suspect there might be an egg nazi in the area. We walked up the street to an awesome place and had a wonderful meal where we even got to choose how we had our eggs prepared. You have other options, why pay for sub par service?
name: Jennifer

text: One of my favorite restaurants! They bring you out a tray of samples of their gumbo to try and everyone of them is delicious. My personal favorite is the lobster bisque or the catfish toufee. We normally have josh as our waiter and he is amazing! Recently we had Stephanie as our waitress and i loved her as well! Will continue to come back and keep bringing new guests with me!
name: Taylor

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
Food: 2 Stars
Service: 4 Stars

I had heard so many great things about Ol' Henry that I had to stop by and check it out myself. I was so disappointed with my first trip, that I made sure to try it second time before submitting my review.

The venue itself is clean with a minimalist style when it comes to decor. I can definitely appreciate that as decor can make a space feel cluttered and often attracts dust in unwanted spaces. The staff were incredibly friendly and immediately greeted me with warm smiles as I walked in. It was almost as if this was their home and they were graciously welcoming me into with open arms. That alone made me want to order one of everything... 

The first time I visited, I made the mistake of not ordering the famous friend chicken. Instead, I opted for the shrimp po boy with a side of mac and cheese. What I ended up with was a hot dog bun with a handful of tiny battered shrimp dumped on top. Unseasoned. With no condiments. Maybe some shredded lettuce. Visually, my plate looked like a hot mess. I ended up just eating it with a fork and dipped the shrimp in some hot sauce on the side. Incredibly disappointing.

The mac and cheese were also underwhelming. Although creamy, it was bland.

I figured my mistake was that I didn't order the fried chicken, so I went back to see what all the fuss was about. I still don't get it. Sure, they're crispy but the meat was also a little dry and too greasy for my liking. Fries were crisp but unseasoned as well.

The price point for this place is also a bit high for the portions and quality you receive. Maybe it's just not my style of food. Be cautious and give them a try, but I most likely won't be returning.
name: Lynn

text:
Don't let the weird location and the outside of the building (which looks like a old dairy queen) fool you, petite 4 has gone to great lengths to create a classy little french restaurant worth a visit from you! 
With all the great reviews, we had to check it out...it's ALWAYS BUSY...so reservations are a must! I was totally bummed they didn't have a full bar!!! The wine selection was small but stacked with solid choices. We started with the Malbec from France, and it was delicious.

The menu is very small but solid...the preparation and seasoning was incredible.  They recommend the Sherry shooter, and honestly I wouldn't get it again(I'm not a big Sherry fan though). 

If you love oysters...we had the oysters in the half shell...AMAZING!!! Then I had the Seafood Vol Au Vent....WOW OH WOW!!! My eating campion and I then shared the Steak Frites...PERFECTLY COOKED!

Overall I give it a solid 4 stars... sometimes when there is so much "hype" around the newest hottest place in town...I think often my expectations are too high and I leave a little disappointed. But I would eat here again.
name: Mandi

text: The food was good, usually I expect the mac n' cheese to be like..meh, especially after sitting for a long time. Ya know, like when you try and heat up your own and it just tastes...not good? But I even took home my left overs and it tasted fine warmed up. The décor is cold, and very cafeteria-ish. I wouldn't sit here to eat my meal because I don't like the décor. I've passed this place 8 million times because of it's central location and eventually I couldn't think of somewhere to get a quick bite, so I went here. I'd recommend it for take-out, the plastic containers are awesome and I've def reused them for other purposes. However, if you are overwhelmed by options or you don't like a lot of "things" on your food, try just getting it with no toppings or anything. I got the crab mac n'cheese and it was super yum!
name: Amy

text:
I'd like to give this place a better grade......but just can't.  Conceptually they push all the right buttons: organic, fresh ingredients, prepared fresh, etc. 
Unfortunately the execution falls quite short of the promise.  Things like the pico, black bean relish, and "southwest" chicken were deadly bland. My bread was dry and flavorless, and GF's gluten-free roll was almost completely raw....after paying extra for it. The employees seemed to be in some sort of chaos and couldn't get orders right.....folks getting their orders and then muttering and heading back to the counter left and right.  They forgot to even put the rolls on ours for the first pick-up.
name: Red

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
Nasty!  Just disgusting!  So overrated...don't waste your money!  Tourist trap...

I visited Philly for the floral show at the convention center as a work field trip.  My group decided to eat at RTM during the lunchtime rush.  Ugh  

*Advice to all...don't do it!  Especially during lunch hours*

My group decided to eat here...So disappointing!!

First, the staff was so rude.  Just simply, no customer service at all.  Short, curt answers.  No welcome, just a 'What do you want?' attitude as though they're doing me a favor.

Paid for my food ($16 bucks, btw, for a sub, bottle of water, and reg fries), then shuffled along to a side area to get my lunch.  The guys behind the window began to bark orders at everyone *literally screaming while rolling their eyes* to get fries first, then move down.  How were we supposed to know that?  There's no sign or anything to tell customers what to do.  And, you don't have to scream at your paying customers to get us to listen.

The overweight 'chef' then proceeded to touch raw meat, then the cooking utensils, then the sub bread with the SAME gloved hands.  Guess in Philly they've never heard of cross contamination!  Wonder if those gloves had been changed at all, all day?  Hmmm, where's the health department when you need 'em?

The ingredients I wanted on my sub were nonexistent.  It seemed as though the overweight guy was more focused on quantity vs. quality.  Not to mention, he didn't use an ounce of seasoning!  Literally, it was unmelted cheese, meat, and onions (forgot to add my lettuce, mushrooms, and peppers) on a sub roll.  That's it!  Nothing special, no seasoning.  Just a bland cheesesteak, in Philly of all places...the capital of delicious cheesesteaks.  Never again!  Save your money and your time and visit McDs instead.

One star for receiving extra ketchup.
name: Farrah

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Food was good and came out fast. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
We went here for a bachelorette party with a fairly small, mostly sober group of 30-something-year-olds. The food was okay.  I enjoyed the chips and salsa and tableside guac. My chicken fajita was very bland and kind of cold. 

What was particularly disappointing was our server... Completely disengaged. I had to ask other people for water multiple times because she was nowhere to be found, she never congratulated the bride or tried to make things celebratory, and was just generally kind of grumpy. And they were not at all busy, so that was not an excuse. 

It's a very nice space and I could see it being good for a happy hour, but for a group dinner, I wouldn't recommend it and I won't be back to eat.
name: Johanna

text: The food here is amazing.  The best Peruvian we've had in the Tampa area.  The anticuchos were fantastic.  The ceviche is right on.  The lomo saltado with and without the cilantro rice were very flavorful.  I highly recommend this place if you are looking for authentic Peruvian!
name: Jennifer

text: Best pizza in city ... so glad I came inside and try out...you won't regret it ... staff is very nice and pleasant..
name: Gabriella

text: I noticed this place just driving down Silverbell and told myself I had to check it out. Stopped in this morning for breakfast and wasn't pleasantly surprised. Great atmosphere, clean and tidy, and the wait staff is extremely friendly and conversational. Food was also great for a local breakfast spot. Do yourself a favor and stop in sometime. I absolutely reccomend it.
name: Cort

text: We needed like NEEDED some delicious hot food and I ordered Peking Palace take out. It was so good. I ordered the full size meal x3 and we had more than enough for dinner two nights in a row. The lady who helped me was polite and even made me a chicken and veggie dish not on the menu at no additional cost. I can't wait to order again.
name: Crystal

text: I have to say that this Melting Pot is incredible. We booked a room for a party of 23 for a sweet sixteen. Arrangements we made with Kay, the owner. She was working the night of our party and between our interactions over the phone and her hands on attention the night of our party I saw someone who really cares about her business and her customers. Our servers were incredibly attentive and with one table filled with teenagers this was no easy task. The food was scrumptious. Everything was explained and all our needs were quickly cared for. We were never rushed and enjoyed the evening immensely. Everyone had a great time. I can't recommend Kay and her Melting Pot enough. Thanks for everything!
name: Paul

text: Hands down, this is my favorite pizza in Indy. I love their meat lovers pizza and a side of bread sticks. Their marinara sauce is incredibly delicious and the crust is great for dipping in cheese. I love Greek's Pizzeria and will not be moving it from my number one pizza place in Indy.
name: Kyle

text: This is such a great place. Food and service was amazing. A welcome addition to the neighborhood!
name: Theresa

text: This place has gone way downhill. Used to be my favorite sushi place in the St Louis area and now I wouldn't recommend it at all (as much as I would in the past that is disappointing). The happy hour menu no longer has much to choose from, almost to where it's not worth going out of your way for it. The most consistent part of this place is how inconsistent it is. Each time I go in there the rolls are different. The worst part about it is that they have gotten worse with each iteration. This time the seaweed was rolled to where a pencil would fit through and nothing larger. I'm definitely still hungry after spending a good chunk of change. Sorry to say this has been my last time.
name: Jeff

text: Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Would absolutely visit again. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
AMAZING restaurant! This is my new favorite. Very classic New Orleans restaurant. The service is incredible and the food was even better. They offered to split up whatever we were sharing and even added an additional oyster since the Brie oysters came with 4 and we were a group of 3. 

What we ordered: 
-Fried oysters with Brie: this is their most famous dish and it is worthy of all the fame! These were amazing and also made with corn flour so they're gluten free!
-Romaine salad: this was a great salad to have before the entree. It was a perfect size and tasted great 
-lobster and mushroom risotto: this dish was incredible and rich. The waiter asked if I wanted a half portion which I really appreciated because the half was a perfect size for me! 
-the duck: my friend got the duck and it was incredible! By far the best duck I've ever tried! It is also beautifully plated. 
-The fish: my mom got the fish and really enjoyed it! She's gluten free and they made sure to prepare it as such 

This place is great for family dinners and special occasions. It is pricey but it is definitely worth it! They make you feel like royalty and are very attentive. I recommend calling in advanced for a reservation, they only do phone reservations and are not on open table.
name: Rachel

text: Pretty disappointed with this "new" location. Bathroom is filthy, suspicious red stains on the toilet and no toilet paper....most frustrating when your bladder is filled to capacity! The interior is lovely, and the place was pretty much empty but seating was limited due to the dirty tables, meanwhile A staff spends all this time cleaning the windows! Staff are friendly but slow.....ordered at 1:21PM, still waiting at 1:37 as I write this review.....1:40, food still pending........how the hell are people walking in after me getting their food!!!! I finally got up to confront them at 1:42, got my food at 1:43, cold fries further my disappointment.
name: Habibatou

text: I love Greek food and this was the bomb! I got the plate the first time, and it the portion was big! I could've split this with my husband. However, the next visit I got the sandwich which came with hot, and crispy fries. Best Greek restaurant in Carmel!
name: Krishna

text:
This place is herald as a great place for vegetarians, but I wouldn't know based on the things we ordered!  

It's a great place to sit outside on a nice summer night.  Drinks and food are affordable.  

We ordered the calamari - perfectly fried.  Comes with a marinara sauce (would've been good to have a slice of lemon).

The tavern cheesesteak is ok.  It comes with cheese, fried onions, and tomatoes.  Odd combination to have tomatoes in your cheesesteak. The fries were perfectly cooked!

My wife enjoyed the meatball sandwich and would order it again.  Great spot and would come back
name: Richie

text:
I traveled with some high school friends and I was put in charge of locating a brunch spot.  There were many options for us, and this was one of the further ones... but oh my gosh I am glad I chose it.  I called about a week in advance and said I would be coming with a party of 5, and they warned me about the grace period since my desired time is essentially the peak of the crowd.  

When we pulled up, I was shocked that how small the place looked from outside!  There were 3-4 tables outside, but it was too hot for all that.  When I got inside, it was actually more spacious than I thought to an extent -- there were plenty of tables, but some of them were pretty close together.  When I said who I was, we got escorted to a reserved table, and the menus were provided.  As we read them, we got pitchers of water and sweet tea.  I don't normally like sweet tea... but I liked this one... a lot. 

We all decided to do the buffet, and we walked over and OH MY GOSH I wasn't ready.  There were hot trays of some combination of peach cobbler & bread pudding, green beans, fried chicken, mac n cheese, rice & gumbo, potatoes, and grits.  We could also order french toast and omelets whenever we liked.  Everything was incredible, but out of all the gumbos I tried in NOLA, this one was definitely the best.  And the fried chicken was the best I had in a long time.

Let me also mention how awesome all of the staff in there were.  I really felt like I was in the south and that hospitality was real.  And I gotta say, food is gonna be so boring for a while after what I experienced at this establishment.  Big shout out to the Baquets for this place!
name: Andrew

text:
EVERYTHING here is amazing! 10/10 recommend! So nice to have a ramen place in Manayunk so I don't have to drive to china town for something authentic.

However, I just ordered pick up and they forgot to add spicy to my ramen (which costed me extra). Pretty upset by this as spicy is my favorite part and I paid extra for nothing now.
name: Katie

text:
Excellent, fast service. Really good brunch.

I had the governors breakfast and coffee. Reasonably priced and delicious. Just what I wanted. The staff is friendly and attentive.
name: Matt

text:
No longer excited to go there.  With the number of nearby places to eat, you would think that ML Rose would ramp up their level of customer experience.  But it's no wonder that the place was dead on a one of the most popular sports nights after what I saw.  

Servers walking around petting dogs and not washing their hands.  Burned fries coming out.  OUT OF KETCHUP.  A burger joint out of ketchup to which a server's response was, "Welcome to ML Rose where we are out of everything."  And our server brought the wrong beer to us.  It's also gross trying to eat, when you have to look at the white trash outfits the staff is allowed to get away with wearing.  Casual attire doesn't bother me, it's the tank tops with red bras hanging out and the shorts that go to the crotch in overweight women that makes me lose my appetite.

Where is the line crossed in not following health codes?
name: Anna

text: You cannot get any better vegan food options in Reno. The South restaurant is my favorite.
name: Gregg

text:
Great food. Even better service. We are staying in the hotel and had concerns with getting breakfast here as countless reviewers allude to late arrivals of meals. Quite the opposite for us. Service was great. Hospitality was gracious. Pancakes were absolutely delicious. Gotta be honest I'm staying in the hotel and am upset that I used one of my breakfast meals in NOLA to go to ruby slipper when I should have avoided the hype and simply gone down stairs for delicious breakfast.

We will be going back before we leave!
name: Gwenz

text: This is one of my favorite breakfast places in Tucson, AZ. Small and simple, but the chicken and waffle were awesome. The waffle was just like I like it, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. It is the size of a dinner plate. The chicken breading was different then I have ever had. It barely covered the 2 extremely juicy strips. All this plus a drink for only $12. Great job.
name: Scott

text: A trip to Metaire would not be complete without a stopover at Pho Michael. They serve authentic and mouthwatering Vietnamese food. Their Spicy Beef Pho is the best!
name: Chiara Mari

text: This was my first and last time eating here! The place is nice along with the scenery but the staff sucks. There were 3 idiots sitting people down as they walked in. The main host asked me for my name 3 times and we waited 45 minutes for a table. While waiting and standing on the patio we observed people walking in and getting seated immediately. My boyfriend was pissed and just wanted to leave.  I convinced him to stay and calm down. Once we got our food I realized I should have just listened to him. Our food arrived cold and we asked for a box so we could leave.  Our waitress was nice and did ask if everything was ok when we asked for boxes shortly after getting our food. What pushed me over the edge was another waitress with her ass hanging out of her shorts.(really!) You would expect better service from a mall the has Apple,Louis V,and Coach or any place just in general.  Our bill was 63.00 for food.  Save your money because you're just paying for the La Encantada name.Skip this place if you want food worth the price go across the street to Fleming's or vivace. This place was horrible 2 thumbs down.
name: Bianca

text: Best duck ever!!!! Never in my life have I had such crispy skin with no grease. The duck is so tender and juicy. We ordered the Peking Duck dinner for 2. Best deal around for $50. It comes with wonton soup, fried rice and green beans. My friend is allergic to eggs and shrimp so they brought her a separate bowl of broth with veggies-also delicious and steamed white rice. They did not charge us extra. The waiter was so accommodating and nice. So much spectacular food. I'll go to sleep dreaming about that duck and hoping I get to go back soon.
name: Mary Ellen

text: After reading some of the reviews below, we wanted to write one of our own. First of all we are natives of Maryland and we do not eat sushi for our own personal likes. So when we come to this restaurant we come for their Japanese food and it is excellent. No one at this restaurant asked us to write a review and neither are we working for them. It is so good that we eat here sometimes twice a week. The prices are good for what we're getting. Everything that we have eaten here has been beyond delicious. Perhaps everyone has their own opinion as to what is good and what is average but this is a family owned business. And they are attentive and actually speak pretty great English. I would hate for anyone not to come here who likes Japanese food because there was one negative review.
name: Evelyn

text: I read some of the reviews that mentioned bad service and conveyor belt problems.  We witnessed none of that tonight.  Our waiter was super attentive.  My daughter's pot was filled without us having to request it when it got a little low.  Our empty plates were taken away as soon as they were emptied. Our drinks were refilled countless times.  I liked it when it was 66 QPot, but love it now.  The conveyor belt makes it way better and I never would have thought improvement was possible.
name: Theresa

text: Off the beaten path, but well worth the drive. Fresh meat burgers and GREAT homemade fries!!
name: Robyn

text:
Great addition to downtown Franklin TN. the food was just as delicious as it's sister joint (Ruby Slipper in Perdido Beach). 

They were quite busy... that being said they were quite attentive and friendly. 

Long waits.... use the wait list app from their website.
name: John

text: Heck yes. Was craving Mexican food and this place delivered. Well not actually. We had to go pick it up. But for less than $25 to feed two people, I'll take it. We both got burritos and they were HUGE and loaded with toppings. We did the chipotle sauce and it was delicious. We are going to dine in next time for the full experience but our take out experience was great!
name: Nicole

text: I dined here 2 times in the past week. After the first time I had bad diarrhea. I gave them the benefit of the doubt and chalked it up to something else I must've eaten. Then it happened again after the second time I ate there, convincing me that it was caused by their food. I don't know how often their hot food turns over but I won't be eating there again.
name: B

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. For a busy night they handled it okay. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Would absolutely visit again. For the price I expected more than this. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
Went here for the Argentina vs Colombia Copa America game, what a blast! Great energy, great service, great food. Even their apps were better food than say going to Chili's for a main meal haha.  Will definitely head to this spot  instead of a generic sports bar for any Latin-American tournaments.

We had the sampler platter of apps that had the best fried chicken I've ever had at a sports bar, Colombian style empanadas (which are the best Latin variety in my opinion *they even had a kick to it with the sweet chili sauce they include on the side), greasy egg rolls and 1/2 fried plantains that were not my favorites (as they definitely need it to stay in the fryer a bit longer), but they were slammed so.  Have a Colombian Águila beer for me too! Malty yet very refreshing even in the summer
name: Maria

text: My best friend was raving about this place so we decided to make reservations for her birthday here. Wow. This place has a great atmosphere and amazing food. I got the mixed seafood platter and it came with everything you could think of. I couldn't finish my plate, my friend let me try her steak and it basically fell apart in my mouth as I was chewing. We decided to get dessert and both ordered the carrot cake. BEEESSSTTT carrot cake I have ever tried. Our server was friendly and made sure we didn't have to ask for refills or pretty much anything. I've been to Morton's and Del friscos and I have to say the steak here is just as good! This place quickly became my favorite restaurant in the city.
name: Liz

text: We had lunch here after we visited the Saguaro National Park because we were hungry and the reviews were good. Wish I could give a positive review also but lunch was meh. Husband had the Thankful with tater tots. He thought it was pretty good. I had the John Wayne burger with their own potato chips. Wish I had gotten the tater tots because the Potato chips were burned, cold, and unsalted. The burger was ok but nothing remarkable. Our waitress was terrific.
name: Sharen

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. For the price I expected more than this. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Not bad for a quick meal. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Overall, a strong experience. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
What a disappointment. So after asking to redeem the check in free soda offer I get told we don't associate with yelp. Then the owner gets on the phone comps and attitude about "we don't associate with yelp". Says it about 10 times. I won't be ordering from them again. Ever!!! 
That happened a few months ago. Haven't ordered from them since. So glad I found Jersey Joe's!!!
name: David

text:
AMAZING!!
The line was soooooo long at Cafe Du Monde so we tried 
Cafe Beignet and we were VERY pleased!! The Beignets here are probably better than Cafe Du Monde! I ate every one of them and every drop of powdered sugar!! Will go there again!!
name: Lorine

text:
Came here for one of my very good friend's birthday dinner surprise. We called ahead and reserved the back room. It was excluded and so nice and perfect for a surprise location.  They were so accomodating from the hostess, to our waitress, to the owner, who we got to meet!  

The food is delicious and the portions are enormous - so come hungry and leave FULL and WITH LEFTOVERS!

At the end of our dinner Salvatore himself came to our table with homemade limoncello!!! A great experience and night.

We will absolutely be back!
name: Stephanie

text: Comfortable chairs with TVs all around.  Requested of the manager to place my coat away from the main smoking room and he didn't hesitate to place it in his office for me.  I'm in town on business and don't want to smell like smoke during the remainder of my time in Indy, so I'm grateful!
name: Richard

text: The food here was pretty bad, and I will not be returning. The enchiladas were cold, and the beef didn't taste like beef. It may have been rat or some kind of foreign squirrel. The aroma of the dishes resembled that of a corpse rotting in the sun in the middle of the desert. 1/5. I'd sooner recommend taco Bell.
name: Kevin

text: Impeccable service. The calamari fritti was delicious. We had the linguini bosco mare as well as a pasta special. Both exceeded our expectations. The staff is very knowledge about the menu and provided some great suggestions.
name: Nicholas

text: I was so excited to try this place. But, I never even got to eat here. I went in and it was so nasty inside I just left. There were a lot of people in there eating, but I have to be in a clean environment to eat. Maybe they were too busy to clean, but that just means maybe more staff was needed. Very disappointed.
name: Shalonda

text: An absolute must. Building is a time warp. So very worth the price of tour. Starts with film that's is so cool. Really enjoyed this stop on our trip to Nashville. Disappointed at the tours ending I and others didn't realize pics on stage  included in price. Person standing next to camera (I thought she was with the people setting up) stood on floor looking bothered and annoyed.  Her job is to take pics so I feel like that was a crappy ending to a beautiful day.
name: Smiley

text:
Oh my god! Pita jungles new seasonal menu is incredible!
My girlfriend and I are both gluten free. I ordered a cauliflower tostada that was incredible with hummus, She ordered he's with beef. We both took home leftovers! Absolutely fantastic!!!
name: Sheryl

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: I like the place, quite and small. I ordered chai latte and it was not good.
name: Laila

text:
Tolerable overpriced food in and old building. 

So you're on the mountain, you expect to pay extra. It's a historic sight, the views are great. The food is fuel for the body but nothing special. You come here if you have to, not because you want to.
name: Krista

text: I decided to give this a try at lunchtime today, and I was not disappointed !!  This is 5 minutes from my workplace so it will be very convenient for me to return and try new dishes.  The lunch specials include a select number of beef, chicken, and pork dishes and include a cup of vegetable chicken broth soup, a spring roll, and steamed rice.   Very reasonable at a price of $8.95.  I decided to try the Mongolian Beef, it was listed as a spicy item so I specified mild spice since it was my first time there.  Mild spice turned out to be perfect!  Service was impeccable and friendly, my server checked on me twice to make sure I had everything.   Food came out within 5-10 minutes.  Music piped in is piano/jazz.   Great experience and I will be back to try new things !
name: Kalliope

text:
When you eat here, you have to keep reminding yourself that the food is vegan! Not only are they able to take normal dishes and elevate them, but they also replicate meat, gravy, and cheese in such a brilliant way that it seems impossible that there are no animal products used!

Tasting notes: 

Buffalo Mac n cheese is a must try. The chili dog uses Indian slices to create a delicious curry flavor. The sloppy joe has convincing chicken, but the slaw  and sauce could use a little more acidity/sweetness.  The burrito was fresh, but could've used more black beans and carnitas. Oh, how I wish the biscuits and gravy had more sausage! The grits were a bit too salty and could've used "cheese." The home fries could use a bit more seasoning and perhaps some caramelized onions.
name: Jethro

text: Some of the best customer service I've ever had, the pizza was phenomenal and well up to my expectations. I would recommend this place to anyone that loves pizza.
name: Ali

text:
We got the cauliflower and grilled shrimp Poboys. Both were so flavorful that we bought more of them for later. Also tried the whiskey grilled cheese sandwich but that wasn't the best ones we have had (or may be we ate it later and it was kinda mushy). 
Wish they open up in California, it's will drive people nuts!
name: Garima

text: We stopped in here for a beer as we we're walking around the city and found out they had Chickpea Fries as a special. With us both being vegan we were super excited and they were definitely amazing!! The sauce was unfortunately not vegan, but they brought us out ketchup instead. The bartender was super knowledgeable about what other foods on the menu were vegan. All the beers we tried were great as well! Definitely recommend this place!
name: Lauren

text:
I LOVE their New Orleans Praline Pecan ice cream. It is so rich and creamy with decadent caramel and candied pecans. If you like pralines & cream, you'll love it. 

I tried the chocolate coconut white fudge and it was good. I also tried the banana fudge ice cream and it was good. But I can't pass up the praline pecan ice cream!
name: Tracy

text: I recently was at an event and had the opportunity to taste a few items from Cake Life and all were very good but the honey sea salt tart was quite possibly the most perfect and delicious bite I have ever had in my life. It is the perfect combo of sweet and salty. I was lucky enough that a friend went there and picked me one up the other day and it was just as amazing as it was the first time, not to mention it is very pretty. Even the buttercream dollop and honeycomb white chocolate garnishes had a touch of saltiness that complimented it so well.
name: Christine

text:
This is a great little place.
Tiny but the food is amazing. The staff is awesome and very friendly. 
I order one thing and got something different. Didn't matter because it was great and I'm not going to complain about what I got. Can't say that about to many places. If you in this area I highly recommend this place. Got to love a place that as soon as you walk in you get smacked in the face with an awesome smell of what's being cooked.
name: Roy

text: Well I had been looking forward to the fabulous dip and sushi ... and summer fun cocktail.  Got there to discover that they were out of Pinot Grigio  ... this totally stunk. My friend could not have her fave wine NOR could I have the signature drink because it had pinto Grigio in it! (Which I had to point out to the server)...so thought ... okay not a deal breaker ... even though it is Sunday and I understand from the server they have been out since THURSDAY... I'll have the Sauvignon Blanc.  I still am anxious to have some good food.  Server returns....well ... we are ALSO out of Sauvignon Blanc.  Well I can tell you this...if mgmt does not have the foresight on Friday or Saturday (when Nashville has hundreds of thousands of people in town for the NFL Draft and for the Marathon ... thus meaning your Brentwood and Franklin folks that live in Your area will totally avoid downtown) to go to the liquor store and buy a case of each then shame on you.  Needless to say ... we left.  Went to a competitor around the corner ... maybe you guys should establish some new policies.
name: Leah

text:
A coffeeshop/breakfast place, Satsuma Cafe is a nice stop for anyone looking for either a quick bite or coffee, or a full breakfast at a reasonable price.

Had the green eggs and ham sandwich and the bagel plate. Both were really good, and came out quickly.

text:
Let me be clear: I've never met Cajun Mike but I bet good money he is a bad ass who parties (hard on occasion but he's past those days) but loves just chilling and pleasing his friends. 

Not too far from the infamous Bourbon Strip, Cajun Mike decided to open Cajun Mike's Pub & Grub. It's exactly what a dive bar is supposed to be, especially when juxtaposed to the typical New Orleans scene of over priced drinks and questionable food value. 

Cajun Mike doesnt really give a damn about being cool... which inherently makes his bar cool. No one will judge you if you come in wearing your city's namesake on your shirt (tourist) or a nice Ralph Lauren Polo (yuppie tourist); just be prepared to back your shit up. Regulars and newbies alike participate in the discussion that can involve sports teams, segregation, and dance routines. Lindsey and Ashley aren't messing around; they'll give you the convo and drinks.

Cajun Mike makes food like it's for his family which means good portions and pretty damn amazing. Auntie Louetta (no idea if that's her name but trust me she looks the part) made an incredible shrimp po boy that rivaled any other I've ever had. The breading was perfect and the fries were legit. It was perfect to accompany the drinks. My new friends Reggie and Terrence shared some wings and let me tell you, when you are 5 drinks down or fresh off a hunger strike the wings go hard. The sweet heat and the crispiness were a perfect combo and were on point. 

Dive bars are known for strong drinks and great value and Cajun Mike made sure that being only a couple blocks from Bourbon St that locals, regulars, and those in the know had a friendly spot to come chill out, pregame, or simply enjoy a bad ass bar. 

You can prolly find a trendier bar, a more upscale bar, or a more mixologist centric bar but Cajun Mike doesnt give a damn about that and couldn't give a sh** what you got at Voodoo Lounger. Cajun Mike made his bar for people that want good food and good drinks. 

I hope I meet Cajun Mike and tell him thanks. Cajun Mike prolly won't give a f but he'll say thanks anyways and join me in a round of shots and throw in some extra wings with my order. You don't get more Naw'lins than that.

Tip: The jukebox is an enigma of tracks from across genres. Dont even expect a steady mix; you came to drink, not dance... and if you drink enough, you'll dance.
name: Rodrigo

text:
Was hoping to enjoy this place but the flavors just were not there. 

Service : mediocre at best . We had a big group and I did not understand why the waitress wanted to wait until every single guest arrived before putting in for apps , obviously the kitchen couldn't keep up with 30+ orders at once because some people who ordered entrees last got their food before those who ordered French Fries FIRST. Bad mistake on the servers part. Those fries were freshly frozen btw, not worth any sort of wait. 

Food : I did not enjoy anything tbh. The potato with mushroom and avocado was bland as can be. Did not know almost every dish would be served cold (this should be stated on the menu that they're cold). I had to ask for salt pepper n lime plus their hot sauces to make a sauce for my dishes. It's mushroom stuffing between two patties of potatoes and a whole avocado sliced on the side with an odd purple purée. Just in my opinion, it didn't look appetizing because green + purple ... and yellow really? Aside from the odd presentation, it was flavorless. I also had mussels, also cold, topped with tomato and onions tossed in lime juice. Again. No flavor. The mussels tasted frozen or out of a box which I buy often from the Asian market and it tasted just like that. I've tasted some people's ceviche, which is literally seafood tossed in lime juice, no flavoring or nothing, but for $30+ for that??? That's a bit ridiculous. I've tried the quinoa with mushrooms, also bland. Not an ounce of any spices. The fried rice was bland, some soy or crushed garlic flavors would have made this dish heavenly. The garlic shrimp was so chewy and rubbery that you can just tell it was not given attention to In the kitchen. Attention is not given much in the kitchen as there was a little bit of "extra protein" on our friend's dish that we had to return it. 

I've had Peruvian food before and this place does not represent the Peruvian flavors. I feel the flavors were a bit dummy downed for those who are not familiar with the original taste of Peruvian cuisine, and they aren't taking the risk to put their spices in these dishes. Almost every single dish was bland. Unsure of who are saying these foods were great, but I'd say come explore some flavors and spices with me THEN we can talk flavor. 

Never go based on anyone's palette, so I'd say try this place and make your own judgement. They have so much potential, but I feel like feedback needs to be given and taken.
name: Cee

text:
We were regulars here but not any longer. 

The food is always great, so hats off to the back of the house for always having it together. 

Hosts/servers on the other hand have changed our minds about spending money here again. 

Great service has decreased so much since we started coming here. Servers will disappear for long periods. The ordering process feels rushed. And if We're ever seated in the crowded bar area for food (not requested), it's like there's no service at all. 

On our last visit, the hostess sat my partner and I at one of those awkward, two seater tables in the middle of the dining room. We didn't say a word, and took the table with no hesitations, weird faces, or anything. 
When the hostess reached the table she said: "Here you are, unless you don't want to sit here, which you probably don't because nobody ever does"
Okay. Way To make things awkward and weird. And if We didn't want to sit there, it's not like we'd say it now. Super passive aggressive. 

On the same visit, our server was taking our order. My partner and I often come here for apps/sides to share, rather than ordering entrees. She advised that we "probably should" add a vegetable. I guess she needed to dictate our ordering process, as our carb-laden order was causing her to suffer in some way.

We don't come here for servers to suggest food groups based on their incorrect views on our diet. 
Frankly it's insulting, and no server's business what we order. We didn't ask for judgey suggestions. 

We don't dine here any longer.
