text:
My review has changed to 5 stars mainly because of how the manager treated me and my fiancé. After having a less than memorable experience there with out of town guests the manager reached out and asked if we would be willing to try Fork again, on him. We took him up on his offer because Fork is supposed to be one of the foodie kings in Boise - perhaps we just were unlucky and had a bad experience? 

The second time around proved to us why Fork is so well known in the Boise community. We had the chicken tacos and a salad with grilled chicken and everything tasted flavorful and well thought out. I love that Fork sources their ingredients as locally as possible and the attention to detail was not missed. More than anything, I appreciated how considerate the manager was that we have a good time at his restaurant. No one has to go out of their way like that and because of his effort Fork has won my respect. I will definitely be taking out of town guests there again.
name: S

text: Are they closed?  Went there yesterday morning and the place looks abandoned.  Everything is packed up and put up.  No one was there when it was supposed to be open according to their posted business hours.  No one answers the phone.  There was no signage on the door to state closed, gone to Hawaii for vacay, nothing!  Disappointed I drove 30 minutes out of the way!
name: K.O.

text: Simply wonderful!  Always a great steak. Always pleasant service. Have been coming here for many many years. Always a dinner there when in town.
name: Rebecca

text: Great authentic Mexican food! Friendly servers, clean restaurant, and good food. Selection of beer, wine, and margaritas. Very reasonably priced meals compared to the Mexican chain restaurant up the road. We will be back!
name: Matt

text: The atmosphere is cool, funny, and interesting.  Our server was very attentive for party of 11.  The food however was less value than I had hoped. I got the pitmaster salad which, according to the description, had turkey brisket and pork which sounded like a good meal. When it came, however, there was very little evidence of any of those meats.  Normally not a big deal but for $12 it should have been better.
name: John

text: Completely disappointed. We were the only people in the restaurant, besides one man, and it took forever just to get our drink order and brought to us. Once our coffee came it was cool and super bitter, and wouldn't you believe it! Our oatmeal and biscuits and gravy came out cold as well. I don't know if we looked at someone wrong but the only positive thing we can say about this place is they have great Bloody Mary's
name: Christian

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick. Not bad for a quick meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
Went to P. F. Chang's for Chinese New Year. 
There was a line out the door when we arrived at 6pm. We were actually early for a 6:30 reservation we had. We checked in and were early so we didn't mind waiting.  After our reservation time came & went we went up to the hostess and inquired how much longer. I noticed they seemed a little frazzled and it seemed like there was lots of empty tables!  After inquiring we were seated right away. 

Upon being seated our server Benjamin immediately came to our table and he was great.  Benjamin was probably one of the best servers we've had the pleasure of having.  He even thought to bring a cup full of ice for the iced tea.  This is something we would normally ask for. The extra ice he brought with the drinks was really thoughtful on his part.  The refills were brought to us right away and the food came out promptly!  Nothing bothers me more than eating and having to wait on a drink. Benjamin was on point!  I highly recommend you request him for your server if you go to the Brandon  location. 

The only problem was, I think the restaurant was understaffed.  I counted 9 empty tables just in my immediate area. Some needed to be cleaned off and others were clean.  This was at the height of the dinner rush and it was Chinese New Year. Also, P.F. Chang's sent a coupon out for buy one/get one which was only good for yesterday.  Why would you send a coupon that's only good on Chinese New Year and be so understaffed??  There was a line out the door when we left as well!  

Even tho our server was amazing and the food was delicious some stars were lost due to the long wait and long lines out the door with so many tables sitting empty!


I've been to P.F. Chang's too many times to count at many different locations.  When this location opened we were thrilled!  It's definitely a restaurant we enjoy going to.  This particular location is at the Brandon Mall.  We made a reservation because it was a Friday evening.  Our reservation was for 6 pm and the restaurant had plenty of seating available.  I requested a booth and we were seated immediately.  We immediately noticed how LOUD and ECHOEY it was.  It was difficult to have a conversation with someone right across from you.  The restaurant is very modern and open with high ceilings.  There is also a outdoor seating area and a bar that on one side is outdoors and the other side is indoors.  This particular location seems much smaller than any other P.F. Chang's that I've been to.  Parking is ok, this part of the mall is also where all the restaurants are located and it gets very busy.  Depending on how busy the mall is will depend how easy you are able to park.  After the waitress took our order we asked her to bring us some Crispy Noodles with duck sauce (she called it sweet & sour sauce ) to pick on while we wait. ***A little secret, you have to ask for this and it's free!  They will never bring these noodles & duck sauce unless you specifically ask for it!  I'm not sure why they don't just put it on the table.  For dinner We ordered egg rolls, dumplings, Chang's Spicy Chicken, Mongolian Beef and Shrimp Fried Rice.  I have to honestly say everything was delicious, cooked perfectly and just as good as any other P.F. Chang's we've been to. We even had leftovers for lunAfter reading previous reviews I'm not sure if we just got lucky or if they got their act together. Our server was Cera she was good taking our order but she never refilled our drinks!  This is a big pet peeve of mine when dining out.  There is nothing worse than eating and not having a drink. When we were paying the bill she asked if we wanted another drink.  Um, nooo! Want the drink with the meal, not for the drive home!  There was no excuse, the restaurant wasn't busy.
name: Laura

text: We came for lunch. I had the Mexican salmon salad. I think the salmon must have died of starvation- I could barely see it on the plate. And another word of advice to the restaurant; salad does not mean large quantities of lettuce and very little else. Look up the definition in the dictionary. Suffice it to say that we will not be visiting again. (Waitress was very pleasant as a side note)
name: John

text: I just want to know how a place that says it's a Chinese restaurant run out of lo mein and white rice? Just admit that it was 45 min before closing and you lazy staff couldn't be bothered to actually do their job. The only thing available was so tired dry looking fried rice that looked like it should have been tossed hours ago. For what you charge no thanks. Too many good family tun Chinese restaurans in the area to be bothered with this.
name: James

text: Overall average or slightly above average dim sum place in Edmonton. Reasonable price items and service for an older style Chinese restaurant.
name: Andy

text:
Amazing BBQ...SO HAPPY I STUMBLED ONTO THIS PLACE ON YELP!!!

The main event:
My husband has declared the ribs to be the best he has ever had . I got the pulled pork and the chicken. The chicken was so amazing I didnt even care it was dark meat (which I usually refuse to eat).  The pork was so good I couldn't even bring myself to try the sauces.

The backup:
The potato salad was everything I like about potato salad: a little creamy, a little bite, not meally, light.  Love the creamy coleslaw that had great bite. It was nowhere near the all too common over dressed soupy coleslaw that makes you regret picking it.  I would happily eat the cornbread instead of birthday cake it was fluffy and moist with great fresh corn taste.  

The surprise:

Chicken taco special...super good and loaded with both flavor and meat

We cant wait to come back as the owner explained that he routinely changes up the flavors for all the meats.
name: Casey

text: We came to Rebirth because it was the highest rated Creole place on Yelp... but we found it didn't hold a candle to Cochon, where we had gone the day before. Our starters (chicken gumbo and garden salad) were better than our cocktails (Sazerac and a Dark & Stormy Mule) which were better than our mains (Gulf Seafood and Blackened Scallops). The three star review reflects our heightened expectations and the price. Not bad food, but not great by any means. Our waiter Colin was very good.
name: Ben

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Idk, the ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but i still finished most of it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Glad we tried it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: We went here for dinner and it was a terrible experience. We waited almost half an hour just to place our order. An hour after we placed our order we still did not have our salads. We didn't see our waitress again for a very long time and when we finally flagged her down to try to get some refills on our drinks and ask her an estimated time on our food she got very upset and was very rude. We ended up canceling our salads because we had waited well over an hour for them. Our waitress just kept saying that she was very busy and that the kitchen was really far behind. Finally after waiting for what seemed like forever we got our food which was mediocre at best. The restaurant was an absolute mess with dirty unbussed tables  everywhere. I would absolutely never return here ever!
name: Summer

text: As an out of towner, this was recommended and absolutely delicious. The wine list was amazing, so many things I love and many I didn't which I really appreciate. The food (and dessert!) will be remembered for a long, long time. Best place in St. Louis in my opinion!
name: M

text:
This place is amazing. They make each drink with such precision and care. I was really impressed as a bartender myself. 

The bartender, Nick, was an absolute delight. So nice and personable! He makes an excellent whiskey sour. If you come in make sure you ask for him!!

We had the lamb meatballs and they were amazing. Super rich and flavorful. I would definitely recommend them. The cheese plate was also really good. As someone who doesn't know a lot about artisanal cheeses, this cheese plate was perfect. The cheeses weren't smelly or too strong. It was great for a fun little app to share. 

Make sure you make a reservation if you want to sit outside. Their patio area is adorable and very cozy. 

Two thumbs up. :)
name: Nikki

text: Better than almost all other hotel bars. Exceptional bar staff and bartenders. Same horrible white male business travelers.
name: Matthew

text:
I'M IN LOVE. 

This is my second time to NOLA and my first time really venturing outside of the touristy areas. And when it comes to this place, I'm so glad I did. It's a divey little bar with cheap ass drinks, the best burger I've ever had, and crispy waffle fries. The bartender is hilarious and friendly, and our bill for 2 burgers and 2 drinks was like $30. 

Do it, just go here. Thank me later.
name: Andrea

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Will be back. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: The BBQ ribs and collard greens are so much greater than good customer service is wonderful the collard greens are seasoned to perfection you would have thought your grandmother cook them the barbecue sauce it has a life of its on I just love going to Jack's and I've only attended the one on Trinity Lane is everything is delicious macaroni and cheese everything is just really really good I can't say enough great things about it
name: Vikki

text: I have no complaints. Went for my birthday and it was fantastic. Yes it's pricey but IMO worth it and I'm looking for my next chance to dine there.  They do offer valet parking for $5 for those wondering about parking.
name: Tanya

text:
This was highly recommended by our local Uber and Lyft drivers. We arrived Saturday night with a party of 8 and were quoted a 2.5 hour wait. However, our buzzer went off 10 minutes after we put our name down and were pleased we didn't have to wait. 

Service was good. Our server was really nice and transparent about how long the dishes would take to come out. 

Chargrilled oysters were pretty good. Some people in our party liked these more than at Acme. 

The bow wow punch is VERY sweet. We had to water it down significantly. 

The rest of the food was just OK. The fried chicken with dark meat was pretty dry. The Mac n cheese was fine. I thought it was interesting they were in spaghetti form. I finished most of my food and so did my party but we all agreed that the food here wasn't very satisfying. Maybe it is more of a local joint.
name: Sophia

text: Great poke, lobster sandwich and fish tacos. Service and ambiance were supreme. The service was on point and informative. The cleanliness was a plus as well
name: G.

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. For a busy night they handled it okay. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Korea House now is better than they were before. I was not a big fan of their service and the portion of the meal even though the food tasted decent.  But after I came back here for a couple times. I have to say now they have friendly staffs and decent size of meals. I love all the side dishes they offer. Now we always come here for Korean BBQ and their army stew. I will recommend people who are looking for authentic Korean food to come here. Your stomach will thank you for coming here. :)
name: Xixi

text: We went for restaurant week.  The food was good but the portions were really small.  For example the pasta had 3 pieces.  We ordered a bunch of things but still didn't feel like it was filling.  Also the shrimp comes with the head so be aware of that. Most places usually mention that or have it on the menu. This place did not.  The pasta was good though as were the Brussels and cheese.
name: Pinky

text: I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Great food , outstanding staff , especially Keith the bartender. We got the smoked wings, baby ribs , baked beans and hush puppies.
name: Scherry

text: We wanted to try this place while driving thru Westchase ! My grouper sandwich was absolutely disgusting ! The fish was bad it smelled horrible and tasted sour it smelled totally rotten !!I took one bite to only spit it out immediately . We also had a ahi Tuna sandwich I told my daughter not to eat because if someone serves a bad grouper sandwich I did not want her to get sick from a raw fish ! Granted they didn't charge me for my grouper they should have also taken her sandwich off the bill she took one bite! I will never go back again ! I am almost certain had I finished this sandwich I would have gotten sick ! Very disappointing !
name: Manuela

text: THIS IS A MUST TRY!!  My husband and I used to frequent another sushi restaurant in town and have been to most places in St. Louis, but after visiting Mizu, we have a new favorite. We actually drive over an hour to frequent this establishment. The service is TOP notch (they know us by name completely unnecessarily) and the food is the BEST we've ever had.
name: Lindsay

text: The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nice little spot, decent portions too. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Yum, these donuts are delicious! I enjoyed a lemon meringue and a chocolate frosted. I was worried the donuts would be dried out (especially since I got the last of the chocolate and it was the display one), but that wasn't the case at all! It was $12 for 2 donuts and a small iced coffee, which is a little pricey IMHO, but the place was clean, cute, had indoor and outdoor seating.
name: Elizabeth

text: Wonderful service and amazing good. Oysters are as good or better than anywhere else in NOLA
name: Zachary

text: If I could give this place a half a star I would. This restaurant has no ambience, we walked in to a totally quiet empty place, one waiter working who refused to walk to the back to get us a high chair for our child. My husband had to go get it himself. The food nearly sent our entire family to the hospital, sick for two days straight. We sent back a sweet and sour soup because it smelled very foul, we should've gotten up and left then but we heard the food was good so decided to give it a chance. Big mistake, everyone got sick in the car on the way home. We will never go back to this place. I thought a warning to those considering this place is necessary for health reasons.
name: Clair

text: Employees were nice. The facility is way outdated. Cheesesteak was mediocre, roll seemed like it was heated up.
name: Peter

text: Decided to try a new spot and I wasnt disappointed! Got the Ruben special he had mentioned so I watched man make it fresh and press it with a pickle spear and I added a bag of chips my fav brand and I am very full with half left for tomorrows lunch!! Hidden
name: Michelle

text: Back again and I got the salmon entree. It was a little pricey but it was worth every cent! It has an orange glaze with vegetables served on top and celery root mash underneath. Probably one of the best salmon dishes I've ever had. I love this restaurant and can't wait to go back and try something new.
name: Trey

text:
I have been coming to a Swenson's before it was ever Sullivan's years ago with my grandparents. This place has always been our go to for ice cream. Our recent visit will be our last!

We got their burger deal which my husband and I always get. It comes with a burger, french fries, drink and sundae for $9.99. We ordered it just like we have in the past. Once our bill came, we were sticker shocked. Ok, no problem we went up to the registered and explained that we got the meal deal and it came with a drink. She let us know that it had changed and is no longer included with the deal. She said they maybe able to do something and went and got our server. When we spoke to the server she was not budging one bit. We paid $5.00 for 2 drinks. If we had known that we would not have gotten drinks and had water.

On top of that we got a kid's meal and was charged $5.99 and an additional $3 for an ice cream scoop. My son and daughter normally split a kid's meal. We got them chicken and french fries with no drink. The kid's menu is split up and said that the meal was only $3.81. Again, when our bill came we had no idea why we were charged $8.99 for one kid's meal. They are normally very family friendly and will allow my daughter to get a scoop of ice cream as well. My kids also asked for a cherry. Just one each and they charged us $.20. Seriously, $.10 for a cherry. 

Our family of 4 normally have a pretty affordable dinner. This time it came out to $50 for us to eat. We unfortunately will not be back. We can go to a better place and still go to Dairy Queen for less.
name: Morgen

text:
Hats off to Manager Christopher Robinson and his happy and polite waitresses and kitchen staff. This was our first visit to Metro diner, and 
my wife and I seated ourself at the counter overlooking the kitchen staff at work. The first thing we noticed was how Christopher interacted with
his staff. His positive personality and encouragement to his staff was obviously very infectious to his coworkers. Chris had nothing but good things to say to his staff and it was obvious that they thoroughly enjoyed working as a team with Chris. It was so refreshing to see them working together as a team, and having a lot of fun as well. The food was delivered quickly and was very tasty. Keep up the good work, we'll return again very soon!!
name: Mark

text:
So I thought I had already found my favorite bbq place in Nasvhille, but all that changed when I came here.  Unfortunately they were out of the pulled pork by the time I got here (about 8:30 pm), but I was able to try their dry rub ribs, brisket, and chicken wings.  I was super impressed by all the meats that we ordered.  Not really a fan of the sides we ordered - but it's not about the sides here... it's about the meat.  There are a number of really awesome local beer options as well as national brands.  The guys bussing the tables were also all super nice too.   I really enjoyed their BBQ sauce - it was on the more vinegary side which I happen to like.  Even picked some up as a souvenir too.
   
After dinner I was able to hang upstairs for a bit.  Bonus space with dartboard, the longest shuffleboard table I have ever seen, a pool table, and of course live music!  Such a great spot to lounge, hang out, and enjoy.  I went on a weekday, so there was plenty of room to spread out, but I can't speak to the crowds, if any, on weekends.

Martin's is a must do in Nashville!
name: Christine

text: This is our go to Thai place in Tampa - Chanel takes great pride in her food and restaurant and delivers every time - food is great - people are wonderful.
name: Bob

text: Superb service and excellent menu!!! If you would like a suggestion, the cheesy grits may have more flavor with Smoked Gouda or Goat cheese. Also, please update the menu for chicken and dumplings to explain the dumplings are fried, not soft and doughy. Kudos to William!!! Thank you! Joyce
name: Joyce

text:
Another fun, wonderful visit to Machi Sushi Bar for byob saki brunch with bestie. We started with a special app and then shared the Chirashi plus volcano roll which was a surprise add-on but still very delicious! Even though I saw bestie last night we still had a lot of catching up to do especially with trying new dishes (for her) and me at my "go to" sushi bar.

Service 6/5
There's no bottle charge and Fred (our delightful server) made sure the saki was warm and that handling the saki pitcher was safe 
Tim was the show stopper - sushi chef extraordinaire - he's always so nice while doing an excellent job! 
Peter is great too, he usually makes the avocado volcano salad but we didn't have that today. 

Chirashi 6/5
Tim and Pete built a beautiful presentation of gorgeous fish and other goodies with a tidal  wave of sushi rice, all beautifully presented, fresh and delicious! I've said delicious a lot today because everything was scrumptious!
Volcano Roll 5/5
I prefer the avocado volcano salad to the volcano roll but it was still very good- it's generous rolls of smoke salmon wrapped around cream cheese and cucumber and it went perfectly with our brunchy mood.
Both of us were so stuffed at meals-end that we forgot to order our favorite salmon egg sushi a la carte! Have a look at my photos to see the beautifully presented and generously portioned platters of sushi, sashimi and machi...
name: Elisa

text:
Very mixed review...

First off I really hate when you see a breakfast menu feature dozens of omelette with more ingredients than you want then you ask can I have A with b, &c only to be told that a three ingredient omelette is $5.00 more than a seven ingredient omelette featured on the menu.  Or be charged to leave items out! Really???

When I did get my omelette it was kind of thrown begrudgingly together in a matter of minutes .  My request for home fries well done and my side of toast was one sliced burned not buttered and the second piece buttered but not toasted!  A single plastic serving of grape jelly came with the "toast" not that you'd put that on rye bread!

Service was fast but not very friendly. Not worth $13.00.
name: Marc

text: The staff and manager were all very friendly/helpful. I tried both the vegan pho & tofu noodle bowl. The vegan pho was not a traditional vegetable broth, it was much deeper. It might have been a mushroom broth, I'm not entirely sure. I thought it was good but would've been so much better had it had more vegetables other than a few mushrooms, jalapeño slices, bean sprouts, & cilantro. I was hoping for bok choy or broccoli, just a bit more whole greens. The noodle bowl had lemongrass tofu that was seared until it had a slight char. I enjoyed this more than the pho, but next time I'll try the bahn mi!
name: Elizabeth

text: I come at least twice a week because I come to the area but aside form that, the place is generally clean but is in need of an update because some the decor in that is outdated. Now to the food... yum, uhh what I can say about the food is that some of the basic stuff that they don't specialize in is frozen so if your thinking "Hey, they might have good fries because the other donair joints have fresh fries cause I've seen them cut them from over the counter." you're gonna be disappointed. But the meat on the other hand is surprisingly good, the burgers are delicious (by being juicy and tasty) but it ain't thick if you were wondering and the donairs is good supposedly but idk, I only heard it was good because my brother eats donair not me. So all in all the meat items are good but the appetizers is ehh. Forgot to add their poutines are massive.
name: Jeremiah

text: I've been going to Saritas since high school (2010) and I still can't get enough. The atmosphere, the food and the people are so amazing. Best Latin places in the city.
name: Jenez

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Would prob stop in again if nearby. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
Kitchen very slow for second visit in 2 weeks.
We will wait before we come back. Servers were great. Food good once served.
name: Saraj

text: Great place for Vietnamese food! Our favorites are the pho and pork poboy. Plus the wonton soup is excellent. The staff is very helpful and friendly. Reasonable prices. We often make a stop here for some pick me up pho or wonton soup if we're feeling a bit under the weather.
name: Jessica

text: Great bar service and friendly staff! They have very lively late night and a large patio scene! Overall, a good time!
name: Kelsey

text: First we where sat very fast which was great then our server came with our drink orders also great followed by our meal orders, then we waited for everything to come out we waited and waited and waited finally after about 45 mins to an hour our food came out my wifes steak cooked medium rare not medium well so that was sent back to get cooked longer more waiting this was not a great experience here and I will definitely stay away from this location sad thing is I like Cracker Barrel and this was absolutely a disappointment. Only good thing our server gave us the lattes for free for the long wait.
name: Anthony

text: The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. For a busy night they handled it okay. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Meagan L. is an awesome waitress! Great customer service. And also the manager who checked up on all the customers dining in when we were here. Seafood platter is awesome. Great portion!
name: Andrea

text:
The server, the person who delivered the food, and the person who brought back the steak we sent back, seemed like they are doing us a favor. Rude, and looked like they don't want to be there. ( a young blond hostess was the only one with a smile on her face).
After many tries, this was my last visit. I will go where my money is appreciated.
name: Abdul

text:
If you like food that tastes like nothing, the lamest fried chicken ever, canned jalapenos, undercooked hash browns, bad service, confused waitresses, and all of it in an overpriced package than this is the place for you.

Theres no seasoning or spices on anything. The chicken and waffles were mundane. Nothing was hot nothing had flavor
name: Brandon

text:
Came here for dinner and quick drink. It is your usual Applebee's.

1) Place was clean and welcoming.

2) Waitress was very friendly and very attentive.

3) My burger was delicious and the beer was cold  and tasted good.

Overall I would keep coming to this place when I don't feel like going to other places I like better. 
Please give them a try.
name: Dalv

text: AMAZING! Fresh squeezed juices, Bloody Mary bar! Biscuits, pancakes all good. Eggs Atchafalaya were great, fried chicken biscuits were so good. Bananas foster waffles super yums ! Can't say anything bad. Make reservations early so you don't have to get wait. Great neighborhood near magazine street, you can walk off the food afterwards
name: Jane

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Would return. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: I stopped in after a Saturday lunch rush and had pretty mediocre service (which is understandable). Food was tasty, though the samosa and Momo were a bit on the mushy side. Mango lassi was insanely delicious! Given the popularity of the restaurant, I would be willing to try this place again while the business is a bit more slow.

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The music was louder than it needed to be. text:
In town for a weekend to hook up with some old friends, haven't seen each other in a while decided to head out to the loop to catch a bite. As we all know outside of Texas BBQ, St Louis/KC is imo the best you can get, honorable mention to Memphis btw. So when I'm in town, I make sure I get my fill and after having hit a few other places I was down for S+S.

Stopped by on a Friday night, place was PACKED, which is to be expected on a Fri. Had about an hr wait and wound up getting outside seating. Ordered the bestie, since I always judge a place by brisket and ribs that's what I got, cheddar mac and cole slaw for sides. Waitress was on top of her game despite being slammed made it over to check up on us and refill drinks as needed. Kudos to her.

Order came out quick, muffin, coleslaw decent, chedder mac delish, ribs were good but a little tough, brisket was fine but didn't wow me. I admit I'm a BBQ snob and I got pretty high standards, place wasn't bad just didn't live up to the reviews for me. I wouldn't not come here if I was in the area I just feel like I'd hit something else if totally open. 3 stars from me is about right.
name: Jason

text:
Mixed review coming up from the boyfriend and I:

The boyfriend loved it. He's a seafood lover. I'm kind of the wrong person to actually review this place, so take MY thoughts with a grain of salt.

Boyfriend: 
-Had Mussels (Captain's Boil flavour; medium spice)
-We shared the Seafood Fried Rice as a side.
-Quote: "Best mussels I've ever had... but there's no way this is at all healthy... So. Much. Oil. "
-He loved the concept of getting the food in a bag and eating it right out of the bags using gloves. 
-He loooooved the "Captain's Boil" flavour. He thought it was delicious.

Me:
-Had the Chicken Slices (Captains Bool flavour; medium spice) 
-So slimy that I questioned whether it was cooked.
-Some bites had me genuinely concerned due to the rubbery texture, as it seemed not well-cooked.
-So. Much. Oil.
-I told the boyfriend that if he wants to return he should take his buddies, who are seafood lovers. Not me. :-)

The star review is based on the boyfriend's appreciation for this place... I did not factor my review in, but thought my comments may help non-seafood lovers who may HAVE to go.

text:
This was our first visit to Hana. We arrived at lunch time and was surprised it wasn't busier. We were seated immediately and asked for our drink order. I'm a Diet Coke drinker and they serve Pepsi so I ordered hot tea. I thought it would be a pot of tea but instead was a single cup so make a note if you're a tea drinker.

We were very pleased with the menu options which has many Appetizers, 3 Soups, House Sushi Rolls, two full pages of Fusion Rolls and Hibachi Lunches.

My friend and I were starving so we started with an order of Gyoza (Japanese dumplings) filled with pork and veggies. They were served warm with a dumpling sauce. My friend ordered miso soup and my lunch entree came with warm miso soup.

I ordered the Shrimp Hibachi Lunch ($8.95) served with a nice portion of shrimp, generous amount of tender fried rice, sauteed veggies and miso soup. It was very good, the shrimp was prepared perfectly, the rice was tender and I'd order again.

We each ordered a Hana Fusion Rolls to share. Mine was the excellent Mexican Roll with crab, shrimp, avocado, jalapeno and cream cheese inside with rice outside, deep fried and served with eel and spicy mayo sauce. The balance of cream cheese to the crab and shrimp was a nice balance allowing the fish to take center stage with a touch of heat.

My friend ordered the tasty Fire Dragon Roll with shrimp tempura, cream cheese, mango, avocado and spicy crab on top with eel sauce. The roll had a nice crunch with a sweet and spicy flavor. Very flavorful and a close second but the Mexican Roll was my personal favorite.

My Hibachi Shrimp, rice and veggies was delicious. We loved both of the fusion rolls and highly recommend. Both of us want to return and try other rolls.

The service was awkward and lacking throughout our lunch. We had excellent service from the minute we sat down until the food arrived. Our server checked on us a couple times right after our lunches arrived but always when we didn't need anything. When we wanted extra sauce, napkins, water and drink refills she never looked our way or checked on us. Toward the end of lunch we felt rather ignored. I don't think it was intentional as she seemed to deal with one table at a time and it got busy. Her timing was just off and left us wishing for better service. Regardless of the server our food was delicious and we really enjoyed. We will most likely return to sample more of the Fusion Rolls.
name: Wanda

text:

text:
My wife and I decided on Dick & Jenny's for a pre-Tipitina's-show dinner, as we have several times in the past. It's been a while, so we had no idea that D&J's had changed hands yet again about 14 months ago. It has taken a decided turn for the worse. The waitstaff, bartenders, and host(s) were as friendly as ever and the place looks largely the same as ever, but when the food comes out, be ready for a surprise and not a good one. 
We ordered two tomato medley salads with burrata, some "truffled" eggplant sticks, blackened redfish (my wife's entreé) and shrimp etouffeé (my entreé). The eggplant sticks came out first. They were terrible. Couldn't taste the eggplant and bits of the flavorless eggplant were tough and stringy inside the battleship hull armor batter and breading, which was gritty and completely unappealing. The "black truffle" was clearly truffle oil. I don't know how the chef could have thought this was edible. I sent it back. The tomato medley salads were edible, but barely. The mixed greens were hothouse grown, supermarket mesclun, with about as much flavor as rice paper. The tomatoes were basically flavorless as well, a mix of cheap supermarket tomatoes and cherry tomatoes. The balsamic dressing was overly sweet, like they used some cheap, out-of-the-bottle brand. 
The entreés were disastrous. My shrimp etouffeé was so salty that one small mouthful was enough to "salt burn" my mouth. I sent it back and did not replace it with something else, choosing to have some of my wife's blackened redfish. The redfish was edible, but only just. The fish was poorly spiced, somewhat overcooked, and not very fresh. It wasn't going bad, but it wasn't as super-fresh as anyone should reasonably expect at a fine dining restaurant. It was swimming in a creole tomato sauce more suited to a hospital cafeteria or school lunchroom than to a fine dining restaurant. Even the rice seemed cheap and slightly overcooked. We reluctantly ate it and left. 
Never again.
name: Marcello

text:

text: Wow. Just wow. What a disappointment. Came to Oceana because it had such great reviews. Arrived, waited outside in line... Felt like, this means it's amazing, people wait in line outside. Then we ordered fried alligator bites and the breading was greasy and soggy. I had chicken fettuccine and it was only ok. Husband had fried shrimp and again, just ok. As soon as for was left for us we ordered 2 beers. I swear it took 20+ mins and a reminder from me before we got them. Not even in a glass... How hard was it to open 2 beer bottles? Decided we'd try the bread pudding.. Again, sooooo long. After seriously 15 mins he came by and told us it would be another 5. Are they making them to order? Finally arrived, dropped on table and left us with one fork left over from dinner. He knew we were sharing. Waited, waited. Finally asked another server for spoons, she left to find them. Our server then finally comes back and when we tell him we're waiting on spoons he says, we don't have any. No sorry, no nothing. Brought our bill and just set it down with "here ya go". I am not saying that I will not return...because I will but until they ( if they ever do) add more non seafood options I will have to find someone that loves seafood like I do to come with me.

text:
A lot of my co-workers purchase food from Smart Street and I wanted to eat something on the healthy side for Dinner before heading to the Flyers game, so I decided to pick something up here. I was thrilled that I was able to order online; I was able to put in my order around 10:30 AM during my Break and I could set the time to pick it up for 5:30 PM. My fiance picked the Chicken Caesar wrap and I chose the BBQ Chicken Sandwich.

The one thing that was a bit of a bummer was that on Smart Street's website, it mentions you can choose a side with your meal. I wanted to get the sauteed broccoli. However, when you order online, it does not allow you to choose a side. 

Picking up the food was super convenient. There is a shelf as soon as you walk in where you can pick up your food and go. I didn't notice it when I first walked in though, so the employee very politely pointed to the shelf and said that my order should be over there. 

My fiance liked his wrap, he wished that it had a little more dressing though, but he stated that the ratio of lettuce to chicken was superb. Not overfilled with lettuce, and the right amount of chicken. As for my BBQ chicken sandwich, I really liked it. The BBQ sauce was delicious as well. The grilled chicken itself was good, it just tasted slightly dry at times because of the fact that there wasn't as much BBQ sauce as I would typically get on a sandwich. But then again, this is a healthy place, so I understand why they limit the dressings/condiments. 

All in all, I'm very satisfied with this place. I can't wait to try the smoothies here next!
name: Casey

There is a deck upstairs which is nice to sit on when weather is permitting! I have been many times and will be back!
name: Marcella

text:
I really want to love our market but to be honest with you it sucks. Other than weekday around 11-12 this place is a graveyard. Vendors shut down right after lunch and pickings are slim even during the week. Saturday you will be one of maybe 10-15 people in the whole place.

Food choices are kind of off the wall, crepes, juice bars, vegan I've eaten at all 3 and enjoyed each but imo not enough to justify lunch time choices. 

If you've been to Reading, Soulard or even Public in Milwaukee the vibe is so much better this is borderline depressing. Building is beautiful and potential is there, farmers market on Wed should be Sat like every other market, really dumb choice. Call me a hater, I call it telling the truth, if you're not there between 11-1 during the week skip it.
name: Jason

text: Popped by this place after visiting the museum.  Very glad we did. Three of us all got different pizzas--pepperoni & mushroom, The Big Al, white pizza--and all were good.  Cooked just right so the crust was in that wonderful middle ground between soft and crispy.  Whatever sauce there using, it is the real deal--perfectly balanced.  Had the stuffed mushroom appetizer --the sausage has a spicy kick so beware.  Service was prompt and friendly. Would come back in half a second.

text: The food was good.   We had Italian salads and ceasar salads.   I had the shrimp, artichoke soup which was very tasty.   We ordered a large specialty pizza which was enough to feed 4 people.   My one complaint,  which is why I only gave it 3 stars, was the fact that I actually ordered the pecan crusted catfish.  I asked if I could sub either regular seasoned fries or a side pasta of whatever they have cooked as a side instead of sweet potato fries.  I just don't like them.   They said I could leave them off,  but NO to subbing for anything.  So in other words,  just the fish.   I canceled that and just ate the pizza,  which I didn't really want.  This doesn't make sense to me.  They just lost an additional $15.99 on the bill by canceling my fish order because they were unwilling to substitute a simple side.  The restaurant was not full by any means,  so it wasn't because they were too busy.
name: Shannon

text:
I originally gave Colorado-headquartered Next Door a 1-star review after having over cooked burgers there on two different occasions. One so much so it was like eating a frozen patty. 

The manager reached out to me on Yelp and had me in to show me how well they can cook their food, and bought me another burger and a couple beers. That was a really fine gesture. 

I gotta say. If the kitchen knows they need to cook the food to the specifications the customers request, Next Door is easily an average restaurant. I was perhaps overstating how poor I thought it was originally. 

The Colorado restaurant in SoBro has a fine selection of Indiana beers, uses a fine selection of Indiana food purveyors, but just can't quite serve up a dish this is better than cooked right. 

The burger was "good". The Fischer Farms meat tasted like beef. The bun was a bit much given the size of the patty. The "salad" was undressed. The chips really seemed to be from a bag. All in all the best way I can explain it would be "uninspired".

I probably won't be back since there are many other better restaurants (Indiana own in town I can give my dollar to. 


UPDATE -- Been back a few times and popped back tonight. Had the fries and curry aioli, tasty!! Had the chicken bowl, really good with crispy strips of something on it. 

But the FLIES!!!! I had to have ten or so around me at a table outside. I finally gave up and headed inside to a high top. And there were several flies flying around in here to by that table. What gives? I've never seen so many in a restaurant.
name: Ross

text:
Went for lunch and the service was quick and friendly 
The soup was tasty, the salad was just ok. 
Ordered spring rolls for an appetizer they were a little cold in temperature so I really didn't enjoy them. 
My food was good the presentation was even better. 
They don't serve any alcohol. I went during lunch, so no big deal. 
Overall good experience.

text: Sushi so fresh and at a great price! Delicious! Always a go to for my lunch break. Even when they are busy with a long line they are quick! Everyone is always so friendly too. Been here many times and have never had a bad experience! If you haven't been here before it is a MUST TRY.

text: Wasn't sure what to expect, but was very pleasantly surprised from appetizer to main dish. Had the pork gyoza, house special fried rice, & tried my friends crunchy noodles with chicken, ham, & shrimp. Everything was fresh, delicious, and seasoned to perfection. The fried rice had that "wok" cooked taste that you just cant get at home when making your own fried rice. The server was very friendly & checked on us twice during the meal.

text: Food is pretty good standard breakfast fair. Loved the omelet and hash brown casserole but didn't really care for the pancakes. There was nothing wrong with them just had a spice or a flavor I wasn't a fan of. They give you "angel wings" with every order which is a lovely touch. It's a small place, but cute and I've gone back.

text: 92 out of 100, all day long.  When a rider recommended Sciarrino's I was worried it was just their neighborhood spot.  Holy mackerel! I got the special cheesesteak. it comes with fried onions, mushrooms, green peppers and sauce.  Look at the pictures, watch the video this is how you put sauce on a cheesesteak. text: Sher-E-Punjab is tied in first place for my favorite Indian food place in Tucson. Their food is reasonably priced, super delicious, and the service is always on point when our family pops in. Our almost 2 year old even loves going there and she's a hard sell on sitting still at restaurants. I'd highly recommend the lamb saag, chicken tikka masala, vindaloo....or really anything from the menu. They're super accommodating for children and  will provide a cup with a top and straw and other child friendly dining aspects without even asking. Make sure to pay attention to the hours, we've gone twice on Mondays and they're not open on Mondays. We always forget! :)

I had a turkey wrap (which they were able to press!) that was really good. It could have used a bit more avocado/guacamole inside of it, but definitely a really good wrap that I would o order again. text: I guess I have been fortunate enough to travel the country and get some great steak dinners.  When I decided to go to Kayne, an amazing steak is what I had in mind and I was a little disappointed.  Let me started with the positive...  Great service, great appetizers (risotto tots and lobster popcorn) are insanely good.  Wine list is great as there is something for everyone, but more toward higher level $100+/bottle.  Popovers and banana bread dessert was awesome.  Ambience overall is fine, the usual Nashville wanna be hip kind of place.  Now for the steaks...  They were good, but not a lot of "wow".  Wow is what I would expect for a top rated steakhouse like this.  I had the bone in, dry aged rib-eye (28 days).  Quite honestly, it was a little chewy, and was not quite as tender as most dry aged steaks I have had, maybe they need to go 45 days.  I give the steaks itself 3 out of 5 stars.  My wife had the wagyu filet.  It was a very good, but honestly I did not get the "wow" factor of wagyu and the hype it commands.   The prime steak I get from costco and make at home is just as good.  When you are paying $50-$60 for an individual steak, you want that "wow" factor as if its the best steak you ever had.  So, this is why I am giving it 4 out of 5 stars.  Had the steaks been absolutely killer, I would have given a 5, especially you are dropping $200/person for an all out meal.
name: J

I'm a fan and I'll be at Cinder sooner as opposed to later. Thanks for a great time!

text: I have given this establishment past reviews....an this being my third visit....this place has grown on me ....not sure what star rating I have in past but can say I will visit more often.....today I had 5 wings....traditional style along with three strips an fresh made potato chips with drink.....plenty more than I needed.....but very very good.....it puts a nice twist on chicken....two thumbs up for a good choice to visit.....

text:
This is our second visit to this reincarnated business. The first time we ordered burgers and honestly it was some of the worst beef patties I've ever had - small, gray and tasteless. I discussed this with the owner and he dismissed my suggestions. 

So second visit we ordered Deluxe rice bowl (small) which was pretty good but very small.  A soba noodle bowl which was ok but way over sauced had carrot and celery (cheap) and didn't have enough noodles and our son had fish and chips which were chewy & not good.  
Plus we had to pull over and wait for 20 minutes for our food.  I would suggest you go elsewhere. Big Bun, Wendy's, Big Judds or Highland Ranch or if you want teriyaki go to Yokozuna Teriyaki  in Vista Village for noodles & rice.  
When the owner deems his bacon burger the "best in Boise" and doesn't listen to customer feedback I just can't support it.  The other reviews are from employees or relatives cuz the food is just meh which is too bad because we live so close and would be regulars if they would just up the bar a few notches.

text: I did not expect the Mac n Cheese ball to be inside the sandwich.  Grilled cheese was good, nice and gooey. The Mac n Cheese brick was lightly breaded and fried, nice flavor. The fries were a little too brown, but nice and warm.

text:
On the plus side, all of the employees I encountered were pleasant and helpful.  Service was attentive.  There was a really comfortable, inviting vibe - - a group of women playing mah jongg, which looked fun.

On the down side, the breakfast was just weird.  I ordered eggs benedict.  Eggs were poached perfectly, but muffin wasn't toasted and I would swear the "hollandaise" was chicken gravy from a can.  Also ordered a side of chipped beef - - clearly pre-made for them with no seasoning whatsoever. 

My guess is if you watch the location long enough, you'll see the big Sysco truck coming and going.  Unfortunately, for the cook who can make perfect poached eggs, I don't think s/he is getting the opportunity to show off in this setting.

text:
So delicious, I wanted Easter brunch and saw that they had been advertising for one on Facebook. Thankfully it was easy for me to get in and grab a seat at the bar since I was riding solo.
The service is top notch, super friendly plus accommodating. Location is awesome as well, it's in south broadripple, not sure what it used to be but it's a large but unassuming building that has indoor and outdoor options. 
The spread was extensive and impressive, I didn't leave hungry, some classics, a lot of German fare, carving station, waffle satiation, mimosas and bloody Marys. Brunch essentials.
I had the brisket, bacon, sausages, eggs in sauce, varieties of potatoes, and a cream fruit pastry.
Plus a Bloody Mary, which I had given up for lent so it tasted extra delicious.
I had to also have the beer named after Adam wren and Pete Buttigieg, it rightly holds a gold metal rating for taste, awesome place! Can't wait to go back!

text:
Only gripe is the sandwich and soda I got came to more than $15...

Super soft pork, fresh rabe, super soft rolls, dripping wet from pork juices.
I was worried I would get full from the portion, but it's about the right size that I really don't need anything else to eat with it. And I'm not leaving anything else either.

name: User

text:
I was here a couple of weeks ago with my girlfriends. We wanted to check out the new place in hopes of finding another gem. Unfortunately, I think this is just another one of those bad luck spots. Nothing good to say about Thyme. The food took way too long to arrive and the upstairs seating area was exceedingly noisy. And the food was not great. It was okay, but it was overpriced okay. Much like its predecessor, this would probably be an okay place to hang out and listen to live music, but if you're looking for a good bite and a nice, relaxing venue to share conversation, keep looking. This is not the place. 

Ironically, the new owner stopped by our table to ask about our experience.  We agreed that the place looked great. But we also expressed concerns over our seating being delayed 20 minutes past our reservation, the noise level, the exceedingly slow service and the mediocre food. Unfortunately, all he did was make excuses for everything. There was no apologies of any sort, let alone an empathetic retort of working on improvement going forward. He did offer us a $5 lunch coupon for the restaurant we just gave poor review for, so there's that. 

With the amount of new restaurants popping up in and around Newtown, I would suggest scratching this one off your list in search of better ambiance, food and customer service. 

Proprietor advice: when people give information freely that you can use to grow or enhance your business, listen, acknowledge and don't insult them by asking them to come back and spend more money when you've done nothing to assuage their concerns.
name: Phyllis

text: We really enjoyed Tansou. We ordered the fire cracker wontons, spring rolls, and sui mai for our apps. All were delicious. I highly recommend the Five Spice Pear cocktail. Their version of a Moscow Mule. Then we had the Lobster lo mein, General Tao chicken, and vegetable fried rice. Everything was good. The ambience was outstanding! Loved the lanterns and the multi floor seating. The service was good as well. The reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is because although the food was good it didn't knock my socks off. I've had some Chinese takeout before that was just a good. Would go back though!
