text:
Yes. Absolutely. If you have an opportunity to go here, you should! I am a big fan of Southern barbecue food and this place hit the spot very nicely.
I got barbecue pulled pork, mac & cheese, and cornbread. and I used tangy sauce which was so perfect for that meal. Mmmmmm I will trek back up to Souderton to go there again soon!
name: K

text:
Lunch time! I ordered the Malaysian yellow curry. Oh my gosh it is tasty. I really enjoyed it. The food was prepared exactly right, not over cooked or over seasoned. As a personal preference, I did not like the dark brown items you see in the picture. I'm sorry, I did not ask the restaurant what they were called.

 My server was Shadaija (or Daija). She was on top of things, described the menu accurately and very helpful. (Such a side note... but I rely heavily on my phone for appointments and work calendar... it does at the restaurant. Not only did she charge my phone for me, but she sent me information from her phone that I couldn't access since mine was dead. Talk about going above and beyond. I was impressed.

The atmosphere is great. The only reason they did not receive higher stars is-- there were only two other customers in the restaurant, and it took 15 minutes for them to acknowledge and seat me. 

As you know... time is of the essence during a lunch period -- of course more grace would be afforded if they were busy.
name: AJ

text: I came probably at 5:30 happy hour. I asked for a table for some quiet time.  Waiter is very attentive and very professional.  Food is really fresh and presentably  sophisticated.
name: Simone

text: Extensive menu.   Lovely service.   My dining companion and I were very impressed up until we were asked to leave shortly after finishing our meal because they "needed" the table on Tuesday night...my review would have been higher if our evening hadn't been cut short.
name: Mar

text: Delicious, messy burgers sums it up pretty well. I'm always a fan of bleu cheese, so their bacon & bleu cheese burger I had to try & it was delicious. These burgers are very greasy though, so be prepared to make a mess. At the restaurant they have paper towel rolls on the table for easy clean up though. The fried pickles were really good too. I got the coleslaw for my side & the freshness was a nice contrast after all the fried & greasy food, but a smaller portion then I would've liked. We were also seated inside & tucked aside in an area with another large group; they were noisy but the acoustics inside didn't help at all & made it hard for our own little group to hear each other & converse. If you get the chance, sit outside for sure!
name: Caity

text: Great food and a cool atmosphere! Such a romantic spot on the river to enjoy dinner with that special someone. We always enjoy coming here!
name: Amanda

text:
The worst thing about Bill's is that I worked in its building for a year before trying it. So much wasted time!

Everything I've had from this little diner-y breakfast and lunch place has been phenomenal - not in an over-prepared, big city, presentation-first way, but in a classic, mom & pop, food you'd get in your hometown way. It's no-frills, and it works.

My personal favorite (aside from the great prices) is the breakfast sandwiches, which always have a perfect meat-egg-cheese ratio. Daily specials are also always a great choice! You could come here to eat every day, grab something different and always be happy.
name: Lauren

text:
Recently, came here before a Preds game.  I always struggle with eateries downtown as I don't want to go to a restaurant that is way over priced for mediocre food because they have a great location.  This restaurant is not one of those. 

Bakersfield is a beautiful Mexicanish? eatery with lots of tequila.  I actually hate the name as it brings back memories of my drive through the grimy, hot Bakersfield, California but this place was neither hot nor grimy.  On our arrival my party had drinks and AMAZING queso at the bar.  I settled initially on the Paloma but later was in love with the grapefruit margarita.  After only about 15 minutes were seated.  Our group ordered a whole bunch of tacos.  I would recommend about 3 per person.  My three included the fish, baja shrimp, and bistec (steak).  These tacos were all a bit on the spicy side especially the baja shrimp and the bistec, but I enjoyed that.  Overall, everybody was happy and the food was enjoyed by all.

All in all, I would definitely come back to Bakersfield next time I am in the downtown area and recommend it to others.
name: Katie

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. Anyway, everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Also, it looked better online than it did in person. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: This is the best Italian restaurant ever, the service and food is A+ and the dessert deli at exit tops all.  Great job Argentos
name: Regina

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Probably not coming back. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. For the price I expected more than this. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Pretty happy with it overall. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It looked better online than it did in person. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Overall, we liked the food at Brunchies, but the restaurant itself is a little tight, so the wait can be a little excessive. We took friends of ours who were in from out of town. The prices of drinks in-particular seem to be a bit high. Some other local restaurants offer all-you-can-drink mimosas for around $10-15 so the fact that they charge around $6 for a small champagne glass seems a little over priced. It's a cute restaurant overall and the food was good, but I would not recommend it for a brunch if you were looking to have multiple cocktails with brunch.
name: Megan

text: My wife and I ate the fried chicken dinner and  the chicken was terrible even the sides were terrible DO NOT WAST YOUR TIME OR MONEY
name: Hubert

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Maybe other people have better luck here. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
Bar 29 is fairly new since Hungry Cat closed. Wonderful, friendly staff with a pleasing atmosphere. 

Their drinks are made not too sweet, not too strong. Just right. 

Happy Hour bites: 
pork belly bites which come with a small jalapeno
deviled eggs are delish
garlic fries come with skinny fries

They also have complimentary rosemary popcorn during happy hour. Plenty of good eats to nibble on while having a drink. 

It's a nice, chill place to hang out. =)
name: Jenny

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Price felt a touch high for what it was. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold.
name: User

text: Yum!! First off it's located inside Mackenzie store and deli so it is very easy to miss where it's at. I got a gyro and a piece of baklava. The gyro was fresh, delicious, & honestly perfect.  The baklava was super tasty as well. Definitely will be coming back !!
name: Kelly

text: This is probably the best pizza in the area. Bruno's Pizza is alway fresh and straight out of the oven. There is a right balance of sauce and cheese in every bite; something that many places fail to achieve. The staff is friendly and the prices are fair and reasonable. There is no better place to get a pizza than Bruno's. I would never recommend any other pizza place over Bruno's!
name: Aaron

text: Authentic and super fresh Indian food at a GREAT price. I'd give this place 6 stars if I could! I came in by myself so just sat at the bar, and had a great convo with the servers. They explained everything on my plate (since Indian cuisine is fairly new to me) and answered all my questions. Walked out feeling like I just took a quick cooking course lol. Could not have had a better experience here.
name: Cory

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Ate here on a Saturday morning. Service very good and fast. Enjoyed the mimosa's they were chilled to perfection. All items were very tasty and ample. Price a little bit higher than other restaurants  but service and atmosphere worth it.
name: Charlotte

text:
This place was ridiculously busy on a Saturday evening, which I think affected the service.

We were crammed into a corner table and the table was completely imbalanced. So aside from being cozy-on-the-verge-of-uncomfortable, the table would shift drastically if one person leaned on it. 

Citing the how busy it was, service was fairly slow. Our waitress was mostly polite except for one oddball comment about some lemonade based adult beverage being very sweet and therefore "not a man drink."

The food was mostly delicious, granted a little pricy. Yes to the loaded potato bites and the fried zucchini, but a big thumbs down for an undercooked burger and flavorless sweet potato fries.

The mojito was refreshing and spot-on flavor wise, but overpriced. Note that Cheesecake Factory does not list prices for alcoholic beverages on their menu.

What was absolutely excellent and would lead me to return was he tiramisu cheesecake--YUM! 

Here are my tips... Go when it's not busy. Split apps or get a main course, but don't do both. Don't get the drinks unless it's happy hour or you have a coupon. Enjoy the cheesecake.
name: Laura

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The music was louder than it needed to be. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Overall, a strong experience. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Burger was absolutely delicious and the Strange Donut shake of the day was amazing!! Plus the staff was very nice and helpful!!
name: Charlotte

text: We like Ruby's and we come to this location once or twice a week. We have noticed a decline in the garden bar. Last week a lot of the items were bitter for some reason. This week we sat facing the bar and saw people repeatedly putting dirty plates aside. Why not have someone wipe them before they go out? The worst was when we saw the manager put all the dirty ones (which people put their hands on)  BACK on the pile! Ugh! There are always so many hostesses...why not have them keep an eye on the plates? I was in restaurants for 12 years and details like this help a restaurant survive. Otherwise, keep up the good work!
name: Lisa

text:
What happened to this place? 

My g friend and I came here since it was close by & diners have big menus. 

I couldn't stand the brash decor - it looked like a children's party facility! 

The (young male) server was nice enough but seemed a bit nervous or something. 

I commented how I wouldn't  be able to remember an order without a pad of paper or IPad - remember this one .... 

I was recommended the crab cakes by my (other) friend's parents who were ironically there. 

Our soups came - fair at best, SPLIT PEA.  

My crab cakeS - was one oblong one and was fried instead of the BROILED that I ordered. Ugh! 

I was so hungry from the long wait that I just ate the crab out of its fried casing.  Not bad. 

My sides (just cottage cheese & rice) were fine. 

My friend liked her chicken croquettes & sautéed spinach a lot. 

Our server offered a free dessert for the crab cake cooking style error. I declined. 

I won't be returning.
name: Tricia

text:
This place is washed up. It clearly had its heyday already. The service was fine but when asked for recommended items, our server would just push the most expensive item on the menu and say it was his "favorite". Complete side-eye... everything expensive was his favorite, including the sake choices. Me and my friend actually joked about what he would recommend after looking at the drink list... and you guessed it, he suggested we buy a carafe of the most expensive sake! Ha! 
Anyways, the food was gross for lack of a better description. We ordered 3 different rolls and an udon soup (can't remember the name of the soup-it was forgettable). The quality and flavor just wasn't there. 

Save your coins. Don't go here :)
name: Teddy

text: Food is terrible! I had a four count of chicken tenders Nashville hot with fried okra and pepper jack Mac between all of those options the food I had was awful my favorite thing about the place was the pickles on my tray.
name: Jack

text: No impress at all customer service good food delicious but slow to come and portions are very small
name: Happy

text:
Not many places sell delicious taiyaki in and out of Philly, not to mention a variety of Japanese-Korean-Chinese desserts (I'm eying you next, mango snow ball mountain...) There's also a lot of hot or iced drinks to choose from. This time around, I popped by for the gelato taiyaki combo: custard cream on the bottom of the fish shaped "cone" and coffee gelato on top. It was a piece of nostalgic heaven. FYI, remember to bring cash if you're spending less than $10. There's a minimum to use card.

The cafe is clean, open, and the staff were very friendly. I saw several people working inside on their laptops as it's a chill and quiet place to concentrate. HMart is just across the parking lot, and the cafe is right next to Dubu and Sangkee. Highly recommend it!
name: Haru

text: I liked it. Great tasting food and great presentation of the food. Coffee and specialty breakfast beverages were mehhhh. Small space which is cool as long as too many people aren't there. Service was ok. This was our first time and they didn't really help with suggestions on what to get. Just said that "everything is good otherwise we wouldn't have put it on the menu"
name: Nic

text:
While shopping at WEM, I wanted to try the food at the new Calle Mexico stand, so I delighted sopa de tortilla + a torta al pastor and it was beyond delicious!!
Stop by there is truly worth it!
name: Naty

text: Amazing beef skewers, definitely try to stop by if you're ever in Chinatown! I would skip the papaya salad. It wasn't bad but it wasn't anything to write home either. I would stop by for one of their combo meals though, not a bad deal at all!
name: Cindy

text: The patio is nice and the food is very good. We came for brunch and were pleased with above average dishes. I was a little in shock that the side of bacon had three pieces and was $5 but c'est la vie. The big problem was the terrible service. I guess that's just a roll of the dice. I had to get up 3 times and still waited 20 minutes to get a refill of coffee and the check.
name: Chandra

text: Excellent food always. Crab cakes are my favorite around here. It is a BYOB which I prefer too. Just know that the tables are extremely close and you will hear everyone's business, and they yours.
name: Anne

text:
We like to visit on Wednesday's, enjoy the O'Charley's California Chicken salad AND especially a slice of one of their wonderful pies.  This evening, we were promptly seated (A/C felt great), greeted by our server and in just a minute or two had our beverages and hot rolls!    Shortly afterwards, salads arrived, crisp lettuce, candied pecans, cranberries, mandarin slices.  We thought we were ready to chow down with a very tasty meal.  Unfortunately, no chicken on the California Chicken salad...so tracked down our server and waited for the chicken to arrive.  After the generous salads, we were too full to have our pie, but O'Charley's is very accommodating - we took pie to go!

Much to our dismay, there is a downside to this otherwise enjoyable and satisfying casual dining experience.  In the men's restroom - both soap dispensers and the hand sanitizer dispenser were empty, completely emptied, not a drop left!  We told staff and management about this problem and our concern about restaurant staff not being able to wash their hands BEFORE leaving the restroom.  Before we left, there was soap in the men's room.

We live in the vicinity of this restaurant and want it to be successful, but we also want to enjoy our meal without food handling sanitation issues.  Tennessee has a Hepatitis A outbreak at this time, so it is a concern.
name: Thomas

text:
You cannot go wrong with the food at Actual Food Nashville! My husband and I chose Actual Food to cater for our wedding recently and we are so happy we did. We had chicken and waffle bites and whipped goat cheese appetizers which were both absolutely delicious and earned rave reviews from our guests even days afterward; piri piri chicken and braised beef as the main entrees both of which were excellent; a mac and cheese bar and squash casserole as sides; a kale salad; and sourdough bread and butter. All of the food tasted amazing! 

I also wanted to give a shout out to the staff at Actual Food. From the time we initially contacted them to the day of the event, everyone involved was extremely professional and courteous. Several of our guests mentioned how attentive and kind the staff was at the event too. I can't thank the folks at Actual Food enough for such a wonderful experience. I would recommend Actual Food Nashville to anyone with catering needs!
name: Georgette

text: Went for a birthday dinner a ways back, and then recently went yesterday for a lunch meeting. Why did I wait so long to go back?!? The staff is so efficient and accommodating for a group meeting we held, so kudos. The food was excellent. Someone in our group worked for Grillsmith in the past and had several recommendations for food, anything salmon and the crab burger especially. I ordered the southwest style salad with blackened chicken - super fresh salad!! And the dressing, OMG!! Go! Great food and great vibe!
name: Deanna

text: I don't rlly get some of the harsh reviews on here. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated bc we didn't have a reservation. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: My husband and I have made a fun challenge to try all the steakhouses in the area for date nights. I was a little hesitant to try this one because I really hate the casino vibe, smoke, crowds etc. This place was amazing. We started with the Tuna Tartare which was perfection and both ordered steaks which came out cooked perfectly. We did not try dessert but will be back one day! Good choice especially if you are staying at the GSR
name: Ashley

text: Horrible service is all I can say......too many places to eat in the quarter to have wait staff issues as we encountered.....literally had to walk out without eating and other customers were having similar issues. Food looked amazing but wait staff ruined the experience for many.
name: Mike

text: The food was amazing and promptly served. The wait staff/service was incredible. I will definitely be back in the future.
name: Ryan

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: I always enjoy the dim sum here particularly the steamed bbq pork buns with some sesame seed balls. Making a meal out of appetizers is my favorite thing to do. The place has an outdated look but the menu is good. I can eat Asian food everyday.
name: RJ

text:
Showed up to get in line at 4:30pm on a Tuesday. We were 3rd in line (party of 2) and got seated at the bar right at 5pm. 

The service was excellent, and the restaurant was refreshingly unpretentious. Servers very friendly, and made great recommendations. 

The food was amazing. I highly recommend the $66 chef's selection pre fixe. I believe it's the only way to get the pomegranate braised lamb shoulder, which was the highlight of the meal for me. One of the best dishes I've ever eaten. 

The hummus and cauliflower were the best hummus and best cauliflower I've ever had. My favorite salati was the beet, and the cabbage. Also had duck hearts, hamachi crudo, and egg.  Both desserts were great as well. 

We took home plenty of leftovers. Make sure to save room for the lamb shoulder at the end. Very large portion compared to the rest of the dishes. 


Cheers,

Eric
name: Eric

text: I can't believe I haven't written a review for this place yet, because I've been here so many times, and brought so many of my friends and family here because it's so good and craveable.  Their prices are the best, especially for lunch, so my office can afford to actually go out to lunch more often.  What to get here?  I love their lentil soup, their doner (gyro) pita sandwiches, and their koubideh (spiced ground beef) platter or salad.  Even their rice is good!  I usually get the cucumber salad with it, but their other sides are good too. The people who work here are so friendly, and every now and then they will give me a sample if they want me to try something.
name: Kim S

text: Had such a great breakfast. Our server, Ellie, was so kind and professional-- she made our experience fantastic! Will come back again as much as we can!
name: Kenneth

text:
This place is highly overrated. The people there were really awesome and nice. Service couldn't  have been better. Our server was perfect. 

My negative for the place was the drinks and the food. I had the happy hour cocktail of the day and it wasn't very good, and served in a plastic water cup for $7. Their happy hour drink prices aren't any good either, only $1 off beers which are already almost $10. 

We order some dumplings, the bao buns and fried rice. The dumplings and bao buns were kinda blahh and again, didn't get a lot for the price...even with happy hour.  Ordered the fried rice for a whopping $14 and it was good but only enough to feed one person.  

I don't know...maybe these hipsters like paying more for less mediocre food but I'll pass on this place.
name: William

text: The breakfast bun for $5.55 is the best breakfast sandwich my fiancé has ever had . I had the crispy chicken bowl. It was good my only ask would be that the bowl it's in be bigger so you can mix the large portion they give you around and maybe some sauce for the rice. The rice on the bottom which was a bit dry because the bowl was a bit wee. The location is very lovely and clean. The windows give it a beautiful airy feeling and I could see myself working from here with one of their wonderful lattes.  The bun is a must have. Happy to see new business in our community.
name: Nik

text:
My kids love Red Robin and why shouldn't they? They offer a large variety of kids meals. They even offer endless Mac and cheese. Talk about a good deal for those Mac and cheese lovers. 

Let's talk about the burgers because after all, this is a burger place. Their burgers  are quite tasty! I have tried quite a few of them. The new Tavern Burger with their famous camp fire sauce is delicious! 

My only complaint is the balloon  pump. It is so loud and we sat one table next to it. They should consider moving it.
name: Ed

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat.
name: User

text: I love this place!  The cakes are always beautifully made and very fresh!  The buns are also very delicious! My favorite bun is the pineapple roast pork bun.  The mixture of sweet and savory is yummy to my tummy!
name: Mabel

text: We recently did this tour the last weekend in June. We opted for the 8pm Ghost and Phantoms tour so it would be dark and it was. Please note, during the mid point, you will have a pit stop at the bar. Also, the 2 for 1 hurricane drinks are exactly how it sounds, they hand you 2 drinks at the same time for $12. I recommend splitting, it is hard to carry 2 large drinks at once. After the tour is over, they leave you 3 blocks from Bourbon Street, you will not meet back at the The Voodoo Shop, where the tour begins. Overall, you won't see any ghost, just stories about famous people who resided within the French Quarter, who had slaves and murdered people. Still a good tour, I recommend booking online and save $3.
name: The Queen

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Dessert saved this a little. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything.. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Love the employees and food good too but if your looking to win anything it's very difficult now!!
name: Dinah

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Price felt a touch high for what it was. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: We eat here frequently.   Location is convenient, food is fresh, portions are generous, and servers are friendly and fast.  They offer daily specials and the price is right.
name: Teri

text:
Pine street biscuits!!!! So this is a college hit on a Sunday morning. 

Order first, get a mimosa or bloody for cheap in a birthday cup! Sip while waiting for your delicious biscuit to be made. 

They also have merchandise. Sauces, coffee hats?! I think. Now I can't totally remember! 

The sandwiches we ordered were amazing. I will definitely be coming back when I visit!
name: Cassandra

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It looked better online than it did in person. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text:
So excited to see previous reviews but what a letdown 

We dined for my husbands birthday last night.   The room was very loud     Hard to talk next to each other let alone across the table.

 The server was great

The food was ok     Swordfish and risotto with salmon
Nothing spectacular though

We won't be back the noise was the biggest negative for us
name: Mary

text:
Kills me to give Commander's Palace 4 stars... Cause everything was sooo damn good, BUT! It just wasn't 5 stars good. Upon arrival, we were escorted to the dining room across the way from the entrance. We passed by the kitchen which was cool to see. The place itself is huge-- 6 dining rooms and 7 in the summer (outside patio). We were sat at a table with 3 balloons...their treat for people with birthdays! It was a cute little touch. Edward was super nice and helpful. That southern hospitality really did shine at Commander's Palace! 

Starters: TURTLE SOUP W/SHERRY [$8.50]-- this dish was not as good as everyone makes it. I can't really describe it... It's one of those dishes you have to try just to say you've tried it. It was salty, but it was other things that I can't describe. The turtle tasted like chicken so that wasn't so bad. ROMAINE SALAD [$8.50] Really crispy, cool and delicious salad, can't go wrong with this as a starter.

Main Course: PECAN CRUSTED GULF FISH [$39] This dish is what they're known for... and it sucks to say that I did not like it. It was a little bland for my liking. The corn cream had more flavor and it just wasn't as good as I thought it would be. 8OZ FILET MIGNON OF BLACK ANGUS BEEF [$43] Loved the filet, the mushrooms on it were bombbb! I liked this dish way better than my gulf fish. Cooked perfectly! 

DESSERT: It was my birthday-- didn't get a "free" dessert. Is it bad that I expected it from a place like this? Welllll.... they did give me a chef's hat to put on which was cute and embarrassing. We ordered the CREOLE BREAD PUDDING SOUFFLE [$9.50] (which again they're known for) Again did not like it as much as the BANANAS FOSTER. It was just "okay" for me. It did not wow me! The Bananas Foster [$16] is a must have here! They prepare it table-side. It thoroughly entertained me and the end result was yummyyy! 

Overall, Commander's Palace is a destination in itself, but for me, the food wasn't good enough to earn it 5 stars. Maybe I ordered the wrong food? Whatever it was, I still enjoyed my time here cause the staff and  parts of the meals were so gooood. Commander's Palace is definitely a must try when visiting NOLA!
name: Rana

text: Definitely did not have the same customer friendly experience as the Howard location. Felt very pushed along like an assembly line. The portions were not the same and I wasn't given time to consider my options as I was asked what I wanted before I even got to the area where the options were. For someone completely new to Fresh Kitchen, they would have been lost all together. Would love to see that improved. In the meantime, I will only visit the Howard location.
name: Melissa

text: The food and ambiance was great! The prices were great. The Oxtail and Talapia is delicious. It's one of Indy's hidden gems. Such a great experience of Cuban cuisine. Plenty of parking.
name: Peter

text: Love Corner Pun but especially love Brynn. We go every Friday just to get her amazing service. Thanks Brynn!
name: KC

text: Came on a Wednesday for the Bang Bang Shrimp special. Of course, amazing as always. For my entree, I got the sirloin & crab cake. Asked for well-done on my steak & it came out seeping blood.... how lovely (you can sort of see the blood in the picture and that was before more seeped out). It started absorbing into my mashed potatoes so at that point, the waitress suggested I just get my whole order redone. By the time it came out, my father was done with his meal. But I must say, they did redeem themselves and the manager brought it out nicely! Turned out to be good! Also got the caramel apple lava cake, a specialty dessert that night. Super amazing and the portion was gigantic, which in my eyes is a good thing!
name: Maya

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. For a busy night they handled it okay. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Definitely coming back. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
We went to Lumbrada without reading any reviews or hearing from anyone we knew who went. So...it was simply to try something new!

It was 5:30PM, only one table aside from ours. The man who took our drink order was also bartending. The chips and salsa were brought by someone else. Since the drinks took a while to come, we had finished the chips and salsa and asked for another round of those, as well as by that time, provided the man with our order.
The food seem to take forever, as did the second round of chips and salsa, prompting me to finally go to the bar to remind him.
The food arrived and was tasty, but no attempt to wipe down the table. When we finished, it took a long time for our bill to come. When it was delivered and we clearly were still drinking, the dirty plates were all left on our table. We put our credit card and the bill on the edge of the table trying to flag down someone to take our payment. By that time, the restaurant had more customers, but other than the man doubling as bartender and waiter, there seemed to be one woman trying to handle all the tables along with two bus boys. After waiting an inordinate amount of time for someone to collect our credit cards, as we sat with piles of dirtry plates and finished drinks, we decided to pay with cash and left one of the smallest tips ever...hoping to send a signal. (Usually leave 20%). No one asked as we were leaving how our meal was. So, we'll leave this response in this review. Food and drinks are not bad, well priced, but the service indicated no one has trained anyone how to be a hospitable server in a restaurant. As a result, we will not be back!!!
name: Jerry

text:
I need to start off with the bakery!!!!!! My ohhhh my. The donuts are so pillowy and soooo many flavors to choose from   They are delicious. I can't put into words how good these doughnuts are.   When you touch them again pillowy goodness and the fillings are delicious never overly sweet. Perfection.  They have a peanut butter and jelly one that is to die for and to be honest I'm more of a savory kinda girl, usually i prefer appetizers over sweets lol but today for some reason I wanted something sweet and needed to go here.  

Back to this doughnut.  It's so soft and there is plenty of jelly inside and on top is this peanut butter cream that is so light and airy just delicious. All their doughnuts are awesome.  Then, they also have all types of other desserts like cookies and quiche and pies and cakes and different flavored breads like blueberry lemon bread.   So many flavors to choose from. 

Then you wander around and there is a spot you can eat. I havent tried it yet but it always smells
Good.  There is a spot you can buy homemade foods from fried chicken to various salads to cheeses and spreads to lunch meats. There is also a butcher section.  

If you haven't been there, you need to get there and check it out and make sure to get a doughnut please lol
name: Tracy

text: This evening was so special! We celebrated my Dad's birthday and Fleming's was amazing! When we sat down, there was a personalized Happy Birthday message and card for my Dad! Then, they brought out complimentary Prosecco! Everything was "yes" - there were no "no's" to our requests! Thanks to the staff, especially Mark for making his birthday so special! We will celebrate here more often!
name: Sheri

text: Great service, great ambiance, delicious gourmet Italian food with a fresh twist.  And reasonable prices to boot!  Would definitely come back.
name: Dan

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: This was a random stop for me and my wife. It turned out to be the best cocktails on Bourbon St. Blaire made me the best old fashioned in NOLA. So glad we stopped by and we got a chance to enjoy good music as well.
name: S

text: The food here is good but the customer service is HORRIBLE!! We've been here a couple of times and the staff isn't as friendly. Last time we came here, we ordered our food and the lady waited  to the last minute to let uS know that they had ran out of chicken. It was very inconvenient for us since we were a party of 13.
name: Richard

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. It looked better online than it did in person. For a busy night they handled it okay. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Honestly, i've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Amazing cafe latte... it was brewtiful.. really. Nice outdoor patio to soak up the sun and have conversations. You know what I bean :)
name: Renee

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Lots of hype before this visit, and I have to say, the beignets are great! I also got the Southern breakfast and it was fine, but nothing to write home about. I guess that's expected at a beignet place! We were there around 9:30 and had no problem getting a table and the atmosphere was great. Would definitely go again.
name: Art

text: Basimo is without question my favorite place for wonderful crafted coffee that's prepared & served with thoughtful & personal care. Great taste and high quality. I live in Seattle and I'm very attuned to fine coffee and I actively seek it out and I look for unique & genuine atmosphere. Basimo is that place; I feel so joyful and at ease here. I recommend their coffee of course and smoothies; Clearwater sunset, green Gabriel & lemon Juliette are favs. I love their organic and homemade tuna sandwiches & you must try their cronuts! (Croissant + donut) Joseph the owner is so authentic, warm and gracious...thank you and I look forward to the opening of your next cafe
name: Jen

text: A definite must when you're in NOLA! Super juicy crawfish and the atmosphere is amazing!
name: Mylinh

text:
Right in the heart of Center City -- very spacious with options of dining in for hot pot or normal dinner. As a proud Asian American, my parents were born in Hong Kong so my palate has been blessed to have sampled an array of food from East Asia -- szechuan included (四川菜). 

Compared to Dandan or Han Dynasty, the "ma la" spiciness as we call it in Chinese for sichuan food was a lot, lot less. My main qualm is if you're one who enjoys a challenge and full "ma la" experience, Jane G's might not be the place. The dishes were very flavorful, but tasted higher in sodium so I downed at least 2 cups of rice... not my typical intake! The prices were also slightly higher than other places in Center City. Overall, this place would be a great place for a large group and although I didn't try the hot pot this time, the veggies and meat looked very fresh from afar as I spied on local tables near us :) 

Fun fact: Level of intensity even at a 10/10 at Jane G's would've probably been a (-)10/10 in actual Sichuan province when I visited -- that's how spicy they eat it in Sichuan, something I could'nt handle.
name: Angela

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty happy with it overall. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: We loved it! Came in last minute for my little brother birthday, the drinks were excellent and our server christina was amazing. Very attentive as soon as we sat down, we ordered the bang bang shrimp and then those wagyu pot stickers. She recommended we try the shrimp with some soy sauce and it was so good. For drinks I had a pineapple martini, tasted very similar to a lemon drop and we also tried the black berry sangria and the peach bourbon sangria. All of them were really good. For our entrees we opted to try the pumpkin ravioli specialty, the cedar plank salmon specialty and the redfish specialty they had. All of them were delicious. Overall the service was excellent and the food was delicious. We will definitely visit again.
name: Lee Ann The

text: Sandbar is definitely a forgettable restaurant. The service, including our waitress Lucia, was absolutely terrible. I've never experienced worse service. Our waitress did not know what was going on (she might've been new); however, it doesn't excuse the fact that we asked for things and never received them. I asked for sour cream with my meal and didn't receive it until 20 minutes after my food arrived. The bill took 30 minutes total after eating and our waitress was hardly ever around. I did enjoy the nice atmosphere and the food was good; although, for the price your better off going to Los Agaves down the street.
name: Jason

text:
Decent pho broth given that this is in Reno. However, the service was slow and forgetful during a busy Sunday afternoon. They even charged us for extra teas that we didn't order which we didn't notice until afterwards. Maybe it would be better service during non-peak hours. 

Service aside, I did feel like the food tasted better and had more options here than the other Reno Vietnamese restaurant I've tried.
name: Sue

text:
We called in here for breakfast. it is a nice place...part diner, part bar...part restaurant. We sat in a comfortable booth (all booths have a view of a TV, which is either a good thing or a bad thing, dependent upon who you are dining with).

We had just watched the Mardi Gras parade and needed a food fix. Legacy kitchen kicked things off with very good beignets, surprisingly good coffee, mimosas and great service (Thanks Kevin).

My wife ordered a NOLA style breakky, I had the meat scrambler. As breakfast goes, this was very good diner food and it wasn't expensive.

It's a great place to sit, provides top service and decent food. There is absolutely no reason at all why you shouldn't go there.
name: David

text:
I hate to say it because I love their food, but if you have food allergies, avoid this place like the plague. 

Coyote has routinely packed the wrong food in our pickup orders.  My wife and I excused this because we loved their fantastic food and the staff is usually apologetic.  Typically, the person taking the calls either failed to record the order properly or forgot to pass it along to the staff when we called, as they seemed to consistently be scrambling for 10 minutes after we arrived at the designated time.  We would often inform the receptionist of a modification (i.e. no unpasteurized dairy while my wife was pregnant) only to find our meal slathered in cheese.

Recently, however, it got much more serious.  We learned that our three month old daughter has a severe dairy allergy after a terrifying trip to the ER.  The dairy passes to her when feeding. We were concerned but we still trusted Coyote to get it right with an allergy at issue.  When I placed my order, I asked the receptionist three times to include no dairy due to a severe allergy.  I again informed her of this as I waited for my food (nearly an hour after I called).  After we finished dinner, we saw three calls from the restaurant and a voicemail informing us that they mistakenly gave us a dish with melted cheese inside.  My daughter is now in severe gastrointestinal discomfort and not sleeping.  

It's a shame that the level of service does not match the truly exceptional quality of the food.  For the price that they charge, it should.
name: Nick

text: Best food truck in Reno hands down. The Lamb burgers are a must try! From the homemade buns to the amazing sauce and everything in-between. Perfectly cooked and seasoned local lamb, fresh greens and tomatoes. My mouth is watering writing this...  We ordered both sides the quinoa, which was perfectly cooked and tasty but I added some of the sauce that I got on the side to it because I was obsessed with the sauce, and the chocolate espresso salad... again mouth watering. I've never had a salad like it. The ricotta is the perfect match to the dressing and chocolate covered espresso beans. I would recommend checking them out at the next feed the camel or food truck Friday. They would be great for a wedding or work event as well.
name: Samantha

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. A very pleasant experience. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better online than it did in person. Not sure though.
name: User

text: Pretty good spot to get your classic breakfast. Food wasn't blow you away food but would definitely go back.
name: Nick

text:
Stopped in with a buddy of mine and had a great experience.  Good beer, good food, and super service...  Just an overall positive experience and very enjoyable.  I will be back next time I'm in Philly.

Word of caution: Not all Tír Na Nóg's are so good (like Baltimore Inner Harbor) so check the reviews before venturing in.
name: Skippy

text: Best Ever Pizza EVER! Love my Petrini's! Got lunch today as usual awesome food the Numero Due Salad and Piccolo Pizza sausage is great for lunch.
name: Cheryl

text:
No wait on a early Friday evening (7ish). We were sat on the patio right outside of the live music. Both chicks that toon the stage were amazing! After a quick google search, one was known for her cover of Joleen by Dolly P.  
Ordered the fried pickles as the appetizer. I loved the long slice but very oily and the breading was too crumbly. The white bbq sauce it's served with was exceptional. 
On to the entrees. My gf had the row burger. She said it was delicious! Perfectly fried green tomato and the sauce was awesome. I ordered the smoke turkey and was completely shocked! Their turkey is definitely in my top 5 favorite smoked turkey!! My sides were coleslaw and bacon mac. The coleslaw was really good, not too saucy, if that makes sense. The bacon mac was underwhelming. Bland. But I won't dock them for it, everything else was still sooo good.
name: Brandon

text: This place is a gem.  Absolutely great food and value.  Prices are very reasonable given the quality and quantity.  Every BBQ dish is great.  I usually try whatever meat special they are pushing.  Warning: the pork steaks are humongous.  So many great sides to choose from (although they do run out from time to time).  They have some of the best sweet potato fries.  The corn nuggets and Mac and cheese bites are also some favorites. This place is in a campground, but in Cahokia/Sauget IL, which is the last place I expect to find a campground, so the whole experience of coming to this place is odd.  It used to be barely a room of a building, but their great food is the basis of their success and they keep adding on.  You'll wonder how you ever found this place, but you'll be glad you did.  It's a must try.
name: Scott

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: We just had a bereavement banquet and the staff were wonderful. We worked with Patrick and he was so accommodating for our family. We offered chicken Francaise, beef, vodka rigatoni and mashed potatoes. Our guests went back for second and thirds! The desserts were wonderful, red velvet and carrot cake. We would highly recommend O'Conners to anyone as the food and service were wonderful.
name: David

text: Cool and trendy bar but sells half a literal, actual digornio pizza as a "fat bread" that costs THIRTEEN DOLLARS. Do NOT order food here, it's only meant to make you spend money
name: Reese

text: Really good pasta selection! Better than I expected. Great bar tender, "Adam". Excellent management, "Michele", food comes out fast, friendly service, Thanks for an enjoyable dinner experience. Best, S
name: Super

text:
We had a good dinner at this place. 
The food is fresh and tasty!! I really enjoyed the cs12 ...seafood soup?? I forgot the name...but it is really good ...I love it!!
name: Nancy

text:
I'm really confused how anyone could give this place five stars unless you're used to eating literal fetid garbage from a dumpster. 

I rarely, if ever write reviews, however, my experience at Antoine's was so bad, I had to write something. I will say at the onset that the manager was polite and comped our meal. Since I'm writing this on my phone I'll abbreviate my points.

* The bread was not fresh and the butter was hard.
* My waiter said the bar couldn't make a mocktail for me.
* The potatoes were cold and hard. I asked a waiter to take them back and I never was checked on again or asked if I'd like a substitute side item.
* The waiter never refilled our glasses. Ever.
* My wife's fish made her sick to her stomach. It looked like it was hurriedly thrown together. I thought it tasted fishy. 
* My lamb chops were cold, however tasted OK, but I'm being generous.

In short, everything seemed pre-made and cold. The waitstaff were incompetent and ill trained. I would avoid the restaurant at all cost.
name: Ken

text: I had a wonderful experience and really enjoyed the atmosphere. Barbacoa is like an art gallery and the food presentation is top notch. Now they serve one of my favorite vodka's Glacier 45 which means having both of my favorites in one place means I'm guaranteed to have a great time!
name: Trinity

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
We love Mexican food; so much so that this is where my granddaughter wanted to eat for her 6th birthday dinner.  We had reservations because there were 11 of us.  Our orders were taken around 5:45, and we all had drinks, chips and salsa while we waited....and waited.....and....The kids cheeseburgers and my daughter's steak came out around 6:45.  At 7 we started complaining because our order was for basic enchiladas, bean burros, as well as two soup orders!    We finally were served at 7:50 and the meals were cold.  Now, the waiter we had was amazing!  He kept the drinks filled and the chips and salsa bowls full.  He dealt with our grumpiness and did a wonderful job of handling what was an extremely angry group of people.  

The thing that was really puzzling was they weren't even that busy!  When our order was taken there were only two tables of two besides us.  The first time we complained we were told that 'there were other orders before ours' and when we pointed out how ludicrous that excuse was she admitted orders taken after ours were made before ours by mistake.  Frankly, I was more angry about the food being cold when it finally arrived because I've worked in Mexican restaurants and know most of the plates can be put together in minutes then it's simply melting the cheese to serve.  Having customers wait two hours for cold food is unconscionable!  To their credit, the littles enjoyed their cheeseburgers, the waiter was awesome and they gave us 50% off.  They also will not ever have our business again.
name: Marsha

text: Clean Restaurant, Friendly and attentive staff.  Owner was present and very friendly and polite. Good food, reminded me of Homemade Food.
name: Haris

text:
Terrible service, had to go ask if someone was going to take our drink orders. No one came to check on us to see if we needed anything after we finally got our food and drinks. We had to get our own napkins. Our food order was wrong at first but the manager went back and fixed it. It was not busy either. That was my first time eating at that location. 

I love bdubs but probably won't go back to this location. 

Bring back jalapeño poppers!
name: Greg

text: First time I went was like seeing Inception for the first time. I didn't know what to believe anymore. Every time I go. Amazing. The "Lamb Labardar" isn't on the menu anymore, but they still serve it. I always ask for a side of yogurt. If you order this, try not to eat it so fast. But after you taste this, your mouth is bound to water every time you hear about Coriander.
name: Ryan

text: Food is AWESOME.  Service is good. Choices are large portions so share with your spouse. 4 stars cause it's a bit pricey but WORTH IT.
name: The

text:
Livery blew me away when I was visiting Indy a few weeks ago. Every once in awhile I hear about an amazing hip, new restaurant that's bound to be uber successful and I put it on my to-do list for my next TBD adventures in the 317. Livery was just that, and an unfortunate circumstance led me and my family there. Our original dinner plans were on the southside but a massive windstorm knocked out power in the area. 

Luckily for us two in our party had high recommendations to try out Livery, especially in hopes that they weren't busy and could accommodate our fairly-large party of 10. Since they don't take reservations, the first carload including yours truly only had to wait ~15 minutes until a table was ready. 

The decor is beautiful. I only wish it wasn't horribly cold/windy outside that we could've sat outside on the deck (another time!). We went with a few of the primeros to start - cauliflower, yuca fries and some empanadas. Cannot recommend the corn empanadas enough! It was just enough for all of us to get a few bites of the menu's hits before the main course. I didn't know how much I enjoyed the duros (I think that's what they are!) they provide as pre-game to the meal.... But I also didn't realize how hungry I was! My brother suggested I get the chicken torta which hit the spot. It reminded me of a small Mexican restaurant on the near-eastside that makes bomb tortas. It was the perfect blend of spice and savory. I really enjoyed my Little Havana drink as well so much that I got a couple. Their beer menu is pretty legit too with all of the main local breweries having exposure. 

Props to CRG for another fabulous restaurant!
name: Alex

text: I never thought that I would like raw foods. The owner Arielle and Mike were amazingwith showing me my different options and even letting me taste some of the products. They were very helpful and explaining how everything was made. I never even knew organic wine existed till I went to this place. I was actually extremely shocked because the bottomless mimosas did not give me a headache which typically I get headaches. Such a great spot looking forward to trying more on the menu.
name: Jacklyn

text: Found this place tucked in the heart of NOLA on yelp. And it was yet another diamond in the rough. Artsy, eclectic wrapped in NOLA culture. We came to the right place. Great drinks, good food, music and the chatter of a mix of locals and people just passing through, this place lived up to every star it's earned on yelp. Started the meal off with the jalapeño cornbread #delicious; then onto seafood stuffed mirliton, which was a brilliant suggestion by our server. And to top it all off with a milk punch! Good food!! Just wish he service was a tad more friendly, it was really busy; but it would have been nice to have more personable staff touching the tables now & again. Oh well, the food is a five star for sure in its commitment to serving local fresh ingredients to the great people of NOLA
name: Sakena

text: Guess I should have looked here before going to watch the games today... how do you have big screen TVs blocked by a pole? Waitress was more interested in watching TV then seeing if we needed stuff... now I remember why this place is not on my regular dine out list.... not sure their management is worried about their rating on here either... sad...
name: D

text: Arrived during happy hour. Great menu and assortment of adult beverages. Pizza was very good! Service was great in spite of the place being packed.
name: Jim

text: A friend and I stopped here after an evening downtown, and were elated with our choice. Our server, Steve, was phenomenal. He made great suggestions, and ensured that everything we ordered was suited to us. I had the Surfer Girl Omelette, with an everything muffin and grits of the day. Food came out quickly, and was perfect. Despite not writing our order down, Steve didn't miss a single one of our substitutions/accommodations. My omelette was stuffed full of ingredients, and the muffin was delish. My friend devoured her Mr. Potato Head Casserole, and enjoyed some of my grits as well. The mimosa I had was a cherry on top of the perfect meal. Would absolutely recommend this restaurant to anyone in the area.
name: Donovan

text: My friend liked it more than I did. The food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up.
name: User

text: As a table of six, we tried everything on the menu. Each course was presented beautifully and tasted just as good. The chicken mousse was exceptional. The pasta was fresh, unique, and exceptional. This is the best restaurant in West Chester by far.
name: Scott

text:
Ok so I know Reno is no Vegas but the Silver Legacy hotel needs a major face lift as far as the rooms are concerned. The "deluxe king"  rooms are straight out of the 70's . The only upgrade is the flat screen tv in the room.
 Service at the lobby was quick and polite , restaurants are fair at best. But worst of all no sports book in the casino! Had to go to the Peppermill to place my bet on the warriors v rockets game.
name: Adam

text: Very cool place! Great food in a relaxing fun open dining area. Good music too! Very casual and open space. Highly recommend for good BBQ.
name: Javier

text: Took 1.5 hours to get cold mussels and bland pasta. Best part was fries, won't be back.
name: Andrew

text:
Kim Ngan closing left a big hole in my heart, but Joyful House opening across the street from where Kim Ngan used to be has been a blessing. Most of the items that I've tried have been delicious, with only a few exceptions.

My favorite item here so far has been #18 bun thit nuong cha gio (rice noodles with grilled pork and egg rolls and a fish sauce based dressing). There's a picture of it on their new menus but it's labeled as #17! Their pho is also solid. Great flavor and nice portions. Tried the bun rieu, but I wasn't the biggest fan. Granted I haven't had too many bun rieu in my life so I don't have much to compare it with. The special broken rice dish #20 was tasty as well.

Last time I went, I tried an order of head-on shrimp in tamarind sauce and an order of head-off shrimp in garlic butter sauce. Big mistake and would not recommend. The shrimps on both dishes were definitely overcooked. The shells adhered firmly onto the meat so peeling the head-on shrimp was a pain. The shells on the garlic butter shrimp had pretty much shriveled off so it wasn't as bad. Another slight negative was that the shrimps weren't deveined. I wasn't a huge fan of either of the sauces either. The tamarind sauce was too sweet and the garlic butter was too bland.

In terms of their drink menu, I've tried their thai tea, vietnamese coffee, regular milk tea, and lychee milk tea. Vietnamese coffee comes out premixed so don't expect the little coffee filter at your table. I would skip the regular milk tea, but the other drinks were all pretty good. I would also skip the pearls since the texture is kinda mushy and they aren't very sweet.

TLDR: Yummy vietnamese food for an affordable price. Highly recommend #18. Skip the shrimp and the boba pearls.
name: Karen

text:
A little bit...hah. more like a lot! Headed here with friends last night after Reilly's had a 90 minute wait for a table.  Seated immediately,  I was impressed by the dark,  modern with a mexican flare decor. What I thought was the 8 item special chalkboard outside was indeed the entire menu. That means it changes regularly and you're never eating the same meal twice.  

We ordered a pitcher of the La Granada margaritas with pomegranate,  orange and lemon.  Delicious. Our server Kristen poured them one-handed while holding the tray with five martini glasses in the other hand.  That was Circ de Solei level skill right there. 

Then she walked us through the menu.  I was having a hard time deciding until she described the "plato" option,  the chef's choice of three small portion of the menu items.  Each order comes with chips,  salsa,  beans,  rice and tortillas for the table,  salad and fruit on the plate. Every Plato at our table (we ordered 3) was different,  so we could try a little of everything. 

The food was fresh, plentiful and beautifully plated.  The shredded beef was juicy and delicious. The mole sauce was wonderful,  but I thought the chicken was over done. The steak with spanish peanuts (cacahuetes- one of my favorite Spanish words) was also delicious. 

As someone who loves trying new places with friends so I can taste a little bit of everything,  Cafe Poca Cosa is right up my alley and I'll look forward to dining here again.
name: Sara

text:
So bizarre to have this hanging in a family restaurant. It doesn't provide any useful message and it's morbid. A cafe isn't the stage for this.

I did discuss with the owner and it is only fair to say the food was Okay.
name: Christian

text: Went out on a limb and reached out to Peabody's about hosting our pool team. Moe, the manager, was extremely accommodating and welcoming. We have had a great time playing on their tables and love the atmosphere, service, drinks, and food. I would highly recommend them for hosting events and just as a great spot to hang out in general.
name: Carrie

text:
My husband and I love trying new restaurants and was really looking forward to this one today. A good friend recommended it and it gets great reviews, and that's why I really have a hard time reconciling our experience with the reviews. I know that restaurants sometimes have off days and maybe that's what this was. I hope so anyway.

To start, the service was pretty terrible - inattentive and inexperienced - and yet the staff were all very sweet.

We went around 3pm and there were only a handful of people eating there. We were told to go outside and find a table but then no one came with menus, drinks or anything! I finally went back inside and the waitperson was very apologetic and said something about computer problems. It seemed to me that we were totally forgotten about. I don't really care about computer problems when all I want is a menu and a glass of water on a hot day.

We finally placed our orders and then sat and waited for a very long time. Complimentary beignets were finally brought to the table. I love beignets but the one I got had raw dough in the center. I told the server not to get me another one but to please tell the chef. My husband said his was just okay and not nearly as good as others he has had at restaurants around the Philly area. 

I ordered the Pappardelle w/Wild Boar Ragu and my husband ordered the Rucola (Tuscan Thin) Pizza. My dish was so salty that I thought I couldn't eat another bite after the first one. I considered sending it back but since I had complained about the beignets I didn't want to come across as someone who just can't be pleased so I tried to eat it anyway. Every bite was worse than the one before. My husband could tell that I was struggling so he offered me a slice of his pizza. I declined and tried to take one more bite of the pasta but then I ran into "something" in the dish. I'm still not sure what it was - something with blue ink on it attached to one of the pasta noodles. At that point I gave up. I told the waitress that the dish was way too salty and the thing I found in it made it impossible to eat. She took the dish away but never came back. By that time my husband was nearly done eating and we didn't know what she was doing. We didn't know if she was getting me a new plate of food, getting a manager or what. It was very odd. Finally a different waitress noticed our confusion and stopped by the table so I just told her to tell the other person that we were ready for the check. We still waited another several minutes before the waitress came back, and when she did she said "there is no check, we took care of it." Another odd response, as if we should have known. 

In the end the restaurant did what was right but in a very inelegant, unprofessional way. I was prepared for them to deduct my dish but they actually deducted the entire meal.

My take on the restaurant in general is that they're aiming to be gourmet but they aren't. The beignets were not very good and the pizza was just okay and the little jar of pepper oil and oregano is not going to make it gourmet. I can't explain away the saltiness of the ragu. It was literally inedible. 

It's likely that we will never come back here and for that I am sorry because I would have loved to have another Conshohocken restaurant to add to our list. I think the overall experience was just too overwhelmingly bad.
name: Cookie

text: If I could rate this place a zero star, I would. This place is so disgusting & unprofessional. Came in yesterday for my mom's birthday & that was a complete disaster. First off, we went around 8pm & there were hardly anyone there but still had to wait 15 mins for a table. The table they gave us was still dirty with their nasty ass rag behind my head. As were being seated, my family & I hear an employee talking shit to another employee. Not even 5 mins later they start fighting! We're not getting waited on, was given a small table for it being 6 people & my child. We just up and left & took our self to Longhorn which I highly recommend. The staff their is much pleasant and attentive.

text: Hot chicken and hot catfish.  Fantastic. No small dry bits. All juicy and tasty.  Bacon fat fried chips are crazy.  Fresh draft beer system is unique and a perfect pour all the time
name: Scott

text: I'm not sure how to say more clearly what a great culture this place has other than that exactly. Visiting town and came for karaoke and now want to stay for life. Mags and Eli are great, Jason is great, the regulars are great! (Nibbles and drinks? Also great.) I love our gay bar back home and our normal karaoke joint but TLL will be in our heart for years to come.
