text: Overpriced apps.  The bacon wrapped duck was ok, the shrimp toast was very, very greasy, and the oysters tasted like they had fake bacon and cheddar cheese on them.  The $13 daiquiri was full ice and about 4 ounces of beverage.  Server seemed bothered to have to wait on us.  Most disappointing dining event in New Orleans.
name: Melissa

text:
I go here on occasion because of the convenient location, but every time I order I feel like I'm irritating the people working there. I'm not sure if there's some sort of management issue here, but every employee I've encountered seems miserable. 

The bagels are fine, but honestly I would rather just go to Wawa or something.
name: Nick

text:
This place was a perfect on the beach grill experience with your favorite libations and even an acoustic guitar player for entertainment. Reminded me of a place where you'd be in Long Beach and a Sublimesque performer was playing. 
We had a cheeseburger which was great but the fries were out of this world. They also had chicken quesadillas which were really good as well as a simple hotdogs which isn't too hard to screw up but it was still good. 
Most of all the place was enjoyable because it was on the beach and super laid-back. There were lots of people and it was very busy so I'm for sure food turn over is good.
name: Love

text: My favorite Sushi place in town! The food is delicious and the fish is fresh and doesn't have a fishy aftertaste. The price is not bad especially for the quality of food. Customer service is on point. Everyone is very friendly.
name: Lisa

text: Run for the border! Taco Bell is one of those places you usually associate with going to late night when you have the munchies.  The variety of options is extensive and fairly low cost.  As long as you aren't expecting a Michelin star experience you shouldn't have problems.  For me,  I stick with the burrito supreme or $5 Big Box deal.  Have never had a problem with those choices. You can even substitute the beef with chicken if you want at an additional cost.  So if you gave a hankering for some americanized Mexican food, head on over!
name: David

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: You win some and lose some trying new places on Nolensville Rd.  We walked in and sat ourselves for lunch.  It took about 5 minutes to be served.  I'm not sure if the waitress didn't want to be there or if it was us being gringos, but the service was inattentive and bordering rude.  I split the Picadera Dominicana which was subpar.  The meats were tiny, pieces.  It was just a big plate of deep fried grizzle.  I will say the food others got at other tables did look much better.  After our initial waitress left, we got a younger, more pleasant one to finish.  I won't be back.
name: Danny

text: This place was such a quaint and delicious find!! The egg, cheese, and turkey sausage on a croissant was OUT OF THIS WORLD!!!! I really want to try their assortment of fresh teas and other specials as everything looked so tasty.
name: Ashley

text: We are from out of state and came here for breakfast. Loved the location, was super cute and quiet. We had our breakfast outside near the train tracks. The waiter was so nice! We had our first beignets and OMG I'm hooked! I'm a little bummed that i won't have anymore when I return back to Oregon. All the food we ordered was simply amazing!
name: Sylvia

text: Enjoyed brunch. From our group the short rib hash was the clear winner. Service was a little clunky but was attentive when called on for water, etc. Friends enjoyed the dessert & drinks. Atmosphere is very New York Meatpacking District-ish.
name: Anne

text: Environment is good, everything else is below average. The rice in nigiri can survive a two foot drop and still remains structurally intact.
name: Simon

text:
St. Elmo has become our go to for celebrating special occasions and just a great night out. The atmosphere is top notch and the food is on point every.single.time! My father-in-law came here with us a few years ago and said that it was the best steak he has had...and he has definitely had his fair share of steaks around the world in his travels. And now whenever he visits we just *have* to take him there. ;-)

As most reviewers have commented, the shrimp just can't be missed, however, one thing I want to also point out that I think they do better than any other fine dining in Indianapolis is their wine selection. Their sommelier must be one of the best in the midwest. I say this because they have wonderful wines at just about any price point. You will not break the bank getting a nice bottle of wine with dinner. Of course they have very expensive bottles too, if you prefer that.

If you live in the Indy area, try St. Elmo for a special occasion. And if you are traveling to Indy for a visit, make sure to make it a stop on your visit, even if just to sit in the bar. I prefer the bar downstairs for drinks, BUT 1933 upstairs has an excellent bar menu with a signature drink (the elmo cola) that is extremely tasty and does it duty of warm fuzzies. Salud!
name: Jennifer

text:
Nice place and exceptional service!
We had an amazing brunch.

Gotta love their $2 Bloody Mary special!
name: MAYA

text: Found this place strictly by accident. It was bingo night and the place was hopping!  Waitress was super cute and bubbly. Food was really good and good prices. Great service
name: Kelly

text: Had my first Tom's dim sum experience on cinco de mayo night and it was the best decision. We ordered regular pork soup dim sum, the ones with crab, veggie dumplings and beef dumplings. Everything came out fast, and the food was delicious and fresh!
name: Rula

text: Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Definitely coming back. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: One of the best theaters I have been too ! The staff was extremely pleasant ! I love how they all seem to love their jobs and get along , it makes for a seamless operation , and it was thanksgiving so ty ! I love that I can order my food in which the menu is super cute , I ordered a chicken quesadilla and cookies and cream gelato , hum yum ! Great portions ; it was very fulfilling. If I'm ever back this is my go to .
name: Jessica

text: Had a great time tonight having dinner with my husband at the restaurant On Swann. Great service from our waiter Andrew. The lamb meatballs were so delicious with creamy grits and ricotta cheese. The Cobia had orange saffron with clams, chorizo and risotto. The steak with sided with bone marrow, fries and salad. We had to had to end the meal with a white chocolate bread pudding and salted caramel gelato. Can't forget the cappuccino.
name: Veronica

text: My family has been coming to sushi Nara for the past 10 years. Great quality sushi, phenomenal fried rice and it's run by really nice people. Very reasonable prices. My go to sushi place!
name: Nicole

text: Small portions, but it's fairly affordable.  Food came out quick, but needed some salt.  They add lemon peel to their Manhattans, which is strange.  Super trendy and packed at 6:30 on a Tuesday.
name: Jim

text: My favorite Mexican place in Glassboro nj. I'll miss it once I move. It's just delicious. I love the horchata, the burritos are huge, so are the quesadillas. Yeahhh they up charge  for guacamole but who doesn't? The service is fast, the take out is fast, everything here is just delicious. I always return. Thanks!!
name: Manda

text:
Stopped by for lunch- right before they closed for a few hours between lunch and dinner- and we were seated right away and brought a small plate of fresh apple slices, grapes, and orange slices. The brunch menu was a bit smaller than expected, but the entire menu was vegan.

I ordered the Masa cake dish, which came with black beans, mango salsa, and avocados. It was very tasty, as it definitely had spices and sauces mixed in that were new to me, and gave a whole new flavor to a dish that I thought I could have predicted the taste. My boyfriend ordered the Indonesian breakfast, which was pretty good but actually left a bit to be desired- the spicy chili fries didn't have any spice, nor did they resemble chili. He also got an order of the spicy dumplings, which is a very small dish, and they were pretty good.

Overall, our impression is mixed because my dish was so delicious (my boyfriend tasted it and agreed), but his dish wasn't impressive. We'll have to return for dinner, and let that be the deciding factor.
name: Gia

text: Horrible service allowed by pretty aweful food. Will not be returning.  I don't know how they are still in business.
name: Jonny

text:
Spring roll, grilled beef sandwich, and house noodles- all very fresh and excellent. 

Clean, fun and interesting experience. 

Kind & friendly service. 

My new favorite!!
name: Peter

text: Have only been here 2 times as we are not from Greenwood. If we were we would patronize Oaken barrel all the time. Wife & I just stopped in for lunch and we were promptly seated and waited on. Our waitress was Donna, she was friendly, quick and courteous. So much so, she apologized for bringing our entrees out before we were done with our appetizer, which we ordered 5 minutes after we placed our original order. The appetizer was a change of mind order and it still arrived before our entrees. Tenderloin was really good, crispy breading, moist and tender on the inside. The wife's buffalo wrap was made exactly as she asked and she told me it was really good, plus the house made chips were a really good option.
name: Dennis

text:
Campo was my salvation from the 100+ degree heats this weekend and showed me a new beer I'd never thought of.  Can you picture yourself enjoying a beer that's been brewed with jalapenos...I sure can!  My family and I enjoyed Campo Saturday as we attempted to cool down from being at the Aloha festival.  We sat in the bar area (which is a really good plan as the bar manager is great) and I ordered a sampler of refreshing beers and ciders.  The bar manager wanted to surprise me with a beer that I probably never would order but would again...it was the chili beer.  It totally has the spicy/grassy flavor of jalapeno but that hit of spice doesn't linger.  Your tongue and throat get a big of the tingle and the flavor but it goes away to make it a fun spicy.  

Mixing that beer with the appetizer sampler of Shishiso peppers, polenta and meatballs was a good plan.  Eating a meatball then popping down a drink of that chili beer was a great combo.  There are few delights that match meeting a new beer in a great new place to chill on a hot day.  Great job Campo and we will see you next time.
name: Beau

text: Fast, friendly and good food. They're tucked away in the corner of the strip mall and easy to miss. A nice little taste of Hawaii.
name: Judy Jet

text:
Fantastic cocktails. Great first date environment. Bartender Mike knew exactly what I wanted when I explained the flavors I liked. He hit that mixer like a daddy tapping a naughty baby.  

Will come back.  So many flavors! Herbs and lots of rinds included! Fancy and totally worth it.
name: Katya

text: Always great and on point. The food, service and Ofcourse the outdoor patio are always wonderful. This is my go to spot to meet friends from Sarasota as I live in Tampa and Gulfport is halfway. I have never been disappointed in all the years I've went. Keep up the great work!
name: April

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. For the price I expected more than this. Not bad for a quick meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. For the price I expected more than this. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
Pretty decent bagels but veeeeeeeeery slow despite not being particularly busy. Only 2 employees working... 1 taking orders and 1 making orders.  

This being said, prices were reasonable and the lox they use is fresh and of high quality and is portioned generously.
name: Tom

text: Great food, outstanding service with a fun upbeat atmosphere what more do you need ... LOVE this place
name: Ed

text: Tamira is one of my favorite restaurants ever. Excellent Indian food with lots of delicious meat and vegetarian options. I've been coming here for many years and the quality of the food and service is always excellent. A true gem of SB!
name: Matt

text: Loved it. Great service. We had the crab puffs for appetizer: ¡Excellent! For the sushi rolls we ordered: Bacon of the Sea, Mt. Fuji, Playboy and our server recommended Troy Roll, she explained it and she sold it to us right away. ¡Everything was on point! The fastest service we have ever had.
name: Nara

text: To start off, the wait was shorter then expected. They expected the wait to be 25-30 Minutes but we got a table in about 7 minutes. After we were seated we ordered two appetizers, and they were very good. I recommend the chicken nachos because the chicken went well with the queso. The only downfall is that the wait for the food was over 40 minutes.
name: Audrey

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Idk, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated because that happens a lot. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: We were looking for a decent place to eat that wouldn't break the bank for our family of four on our first night on vacation! This place did NOT disappoint! As an American with a Venezuelan mother I know what sorts of foods should taste like and this place was marvelous!! Oh my gosh!! The menu is amazing and includes foods that are staples of a Venezuelan kitchen! If you are in the area TRY THIS PLACE! You won't regret it!
name: Angelica

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Food is not very flavorful and service is seriously lacking. We ordered wings and a salad, received our wings, ate them, and continued to wait for our salad. Server came up about 20 minutes later asking if we wanted dessert. Informed her we were waiting for our salad. Come to find out, she never put he order in, so we decided to leave since we had already been waiting longer than we planned. Go to Buffalo Wild Wings instead, much better food.
name: Kristine

text:
After having so much fun on Bourbon street, my friends and I decided to walk to the chicken shack to see what the hype was about. 

When walking in, they have 2 sides, one for pizza and one for chicken. They were packed to the max and it was 2 am! We were in line for about 20 minutes. I ordered the 2 piece white with fries and a side of red beans and rice. I don't remember the price because I was still a bit tipsy from all the shots I took on bourbon. They give you a number and you place it on your table for them to bring it out to you.

The chicken arrived hot and crispy, like I like it. Some people in line were asking us how it tasted and what we ordered. The chicken was juicy and seasoned all the way through, the biscuit seemed to be only the biscuit top and it was really soft. The fries were seasoned well also. The red beans and rice weren't as good as the ones I had tasted earlier in the day, but they were hot as well. 

If you're ever in New Orleans, this should definitely be on your list of places to try.
name: Tinesha

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: There are so many place better than this place in town. The food was probably the worst Chinese food I have had and I love Chinese food. Even Panda Express is better. Not only that but the staff doesn't have there stuff together and it's really obvious.
name: Spencer

text:
Yum, Yum and Yum. This place hits the spot. 

If your looking for healthy options the thai bowl was amazing! Still thinking about it. Cant wait for the Hyde Park location to open
name: Sandra

text: We enjoyed our time here. They seemed very disorganized in the front but once you were seated they took good care of you.
name: Toni

text:
Verdict: Still out on fancy bagels.

I liked my wood fired cinnamon raisin bagel. This was the first one I've ever had with multiple colors of raisins inside. While these aren't the cheapest on the block, you're going to get plenty of bagel for your buck. Half the fun is watching the bagel batch come out of that oven.

The whole wheat everything was another good one with lots of flavor to enjoy. The poppy seed bagel had more seeds than you would believe without seeing it yourself.

Go here. Grab a bagel. Grab a beer. Oh yeah. There's an adjoining place to grab a brew. With a Wawa next door, you're all set for a good day in Philly.
name: John

text: Waited for my food for 45 minutes while everyone around me received their orders. Food was mediocre at best and completely overpriced.
name: Sara

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. Also, it felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: A family owned steam driven paddle boat on the Mississippi River in New Orleans. Had a very respectable buffet dinner and really digging the onboard house band Dukes of Dixieland. The saxman is fantastic. Really pleasantly impressed with the whole 3 hours on the ship. A special shoutout to our waitress Stephanie. She was terrific. Recommended!
name: Harry

text:
This is a medium sized modern outdoor outlet center that has most of the stores that you'll find at an outlet center.  The outlet, while outdoors, is covered so that you can still shop peacefully regardless of weather.  There is a nice little bridge at the center point of the shopping center and a sitting area with fire pit.  They have a play area for children.

There is a good variety of food options and prices are not that much lower than your average retail store.  You may luck upon some deals depending on which stores you shop at.
name: Tish

text:
Finally got around to dining at this place.  It's very, very busy and one needs to be patient in order to grab a seat.  The wait for food is about 30-45 minutes, irregardless of dine-in or take-out.  No table service.

I tried the Lamb Maroosh Way- it's what they are famous for.  It's basically meat piled with vegetables and white sauce on a hoagie.  Caution - eating it will be messy.  It's flavorful and definitely filling.

Parking is a problem in the area.  But if you can find a spot, then this is a good place to grab a bite in Philadelphia.
name: Omer

text:
I was super excited to try this place and it didn't disappoint. My drink was cold and refreshing. I hate when i get a pressed juice and it's lukewarm (gag) 
This one was frosty !! I got the vitamin sea ( yes that's correct spelling) it was a little sweet for my tastes but the lemon helped by adding tart notes 

They are not in my hood and I don't see myself driving out of my way for it but if I'm ever near by i would give it another try.
name: Kimberly

text: This place never fails to screw up an order. I usually do the car side to go. I order my steak medium rare. However, since they always overcook it I suppose I should order it rare. I always order sautéed onions and mushrooms. There's always onions and hardly any mushrooms. Tonight I got 3 slices of mushrooms. So ridiculous. The last 2 times they didn't even give me the right food and so I called them. Both times I was told they would mail me a dinner since they screwed it up. Neither time did I receive anything in the mail, even though I called back to tell them I hadn't received it. Still nothing. Tonight I'm not even going to call them. I also will never eat there again. Come on people! Just get it right!!!
name: Michele

text:
I was looking forward to revisiting this centrally located restaurant & having the Panchos enchiladas again.  Unfortunately it didn't live up to the 5 stars my memory gave it. Service was great & im glad we made a reservation, they were fully booked.  The salsa is bland & the chips are weird. The chips had a strong chili powder/sugar flavor - just odd.  

The panchos enchiladas didn't have enough sauce as the sauce seemed to be baked into the flour tortilla of the enchilada, making them drier than I remembered.  The rice wasn't that great either. I usually love Mexican restaurant rice, but it was bland & different.  It's served with a side salad that was good, but again odd.  It's just some lettuce with dressing. 

My hubs had the "Best" margarita, but prefers the margarita from our local Mexican.  

All in all, it was fine, but we won't choose this restaurant again.
name: Mindy

text:
The Cioppino was just OK. The chicken was under-cooked, still bloody, which is quite dangerous. To be fair, when we reported this problem, it was corrected quickly, and the waiter apologized.
The huge aquarium was a big draw, especially for our granddaughter.
name: Konstantin

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Service was friendly, just kinda slow once the room filled up. Definitely coming back. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
4 stars for the food, overall rating would have been better but the service just was not that good at all.

Stopped by Saturday for the first time since we rarely go to Clearwater Beach.  It was such a nice day we wanted to sit outside and listen to the live singer. 
The waitress said they were just tearing down and resetting from a large party plus we need to see the hostess first.  Wife went inside and was told there were no seats outside, only on the 3rd floor and inside a glass enclosure. I went inside and told the hostess that they are resetting and the waitress said it should only be a few minutes. But no dice, 3rd floor or nothing.  So as we were leaving 2 spots opened up at the bar and we sat there. Within minutes people walking in started to be seated outside.  Strange, perhaps they just didn't want a couple in their 50's sitting outside?

So, we ordered drinks - (Tito's Wild Berry Lemonade - $8, Crab Trap Bucket - $12) and some food.  We got silverware but needed to get up,and get our own plates, napkins and ketchup for the fries. 
We shared the grouper nuggets - ($13.99) and boneless buffalo wings- ($9.99). Both were good and to be honest much better than Frenchy's.
I'm also not a fan, and a bit suspicious, of menus that don't show the drink prices.  

I wanted to order another cocktail and sat there for quite some time before the bartender came by and I got another one.  I would have liked even another one but was really getting tired of the wait so we decided to go somewhere else that might have better service.  I asked for and got the check from the bartender then she disappeared.  We sat there waiting for a long time before I just walked up to the bar and paid. The bartender barely grunted out word. To be honest he could have said "thanks" but it was hard to understand.

We have lived in Clearwater for just about 5 years now and I've been told the service can be spotty and that Crabby's is mostly for the tourists. Unfortunately this appears to be true.
name: Chuck

text: Their charcuterie board is a joke. I'm not sure if it was designed by a person who's never had a charcuterie board or prepared by a person who's never had a charcuterie board, but it was comical. I ordered a cocktail that was unpleasantly served neat, not even chilled, with 5 dead flower petals floating in it. This was enough for me to pay the check and leave immediately.
name: Adrian

text: This food is not good to order out for postmates does not look good nor Taste good wasn't even hot ‍
name: Todd

text: Food was way good! Patio is nice too! Service was just ok....beers are cold so can't complain!
name: Zara

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Anyway, they were out of one thing i originally wanted.. Anyway, the wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. maybe I just came on an off day. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Great family run restaurant.  Cook to order food.  Great prices.  Quick service.  Great wraps, chalupa, and bowls
name: Chris

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was good and came out fast. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was good and came out fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: A super peaceful environment with a friendly, handsome staff and delicious environment. Have yet to try the munchies but they looked amazing. 10/10 would do.
name: Andrea

text:
What does an upscale community like Town & Country really need to diversify it's  culinary choices? A hot dog restaurant!  

Like baseball, the starting time may be known (11am M-F) but the closing time is "2ish".  Classic Red Hots has very limited and variable hours.

Classic Red Hots serves Gyros, brats, Italian beef, Ruben's, tamales, Chicago dogs, chili, Polish sausage in Town & Country. There is not an over abundance of restaurants in this location so try it out. During the summer time when it's baseball season how can you resist a classic red hot?
name: Bill

text: Hmm...was debating whether or not to rate this location one or two stars. Every time I come here, the staff is very rude and unhelpful. They are often out of donuts and sometimes get my order wrong. Being a person who works with customers on a daily basis as well, I am very disappointed in their customer service and just manners in general. It's sad because this is the only DD near me and will have to continue going...
name: Florence

text: Susan my amazingly polite and helpful server provided detailed recommendations on the menu. I had the crab cakes which are vegan and the brussel sprouts salad. Both were SO delicious, fresh, flavorful and very filling. The remoulade with the crab cakes was so great and the crab cakes tasted like crab cakes. The brussel sprout salad was lightly dressed and had a myriad of flavors and textures. So. Freaking. Delicious.
name: Jessica

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. My experience was honestly fine. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not bad for a quick meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It looked better online than it did in person. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: This is by far the best sushi place in Philadelphia. My boyfriend won't let us eat anywhere else. If you can get a reservation for two your lucky but it's worth it price wise and time wise. It's hard to find but just look for the red lantern, I've never ate in the front the back is where they hold private dinners. Amazing fresh fish he explains every piece where it came from. You can order other stuff off there menu but the chef always picks the best so we end up going that route. They have these bao buns that are amazing you must try them.
name: Chloe

text:
This review is strictly based on service. It's a little annoying when the customer has to get up to get the waitress for an order. Came here to smoke some hookah with my friend on a quiet Saturday evening. Place wasn't busy this evening so I was expecting service to be prompt. It wasn't their best service night, but maybe because we didn't order dinner. 

They bring out bread and a dip when you sit down which is actually pretty delish!! Decent atmosphere outside and good vibes with a hookah! I also got to try the baklava cheesecake and it was pretty good! 

Hookah 5/5
Service 2/5
Dessert 4/5
name: Zaid

text: Great atmosphere, good food. The bartender Lee is great!
name: Hannah

text:
Ordered the veggie scramble to go . Food ready in 10 minutes . Staff are pleasant. Food really really good ! 
Parking available in front . Will be returning !!
name: Kiki

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. Anyway, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The staff seemed tired but still polite. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text:
We love coming to Nola to try out all the amazing restaurants they have to offer.  
This trip we found a fairly new place right next to where we are staying.  So of course we had to try it out!!

I order the Royal Red Shrimp Muddy Waters squid ink Campanella!!  The sauce was so so so delicious!!  I wanted to ask for more rolls to literally soak up the rest of the juices!  All the flavors were so well balanced.  

We will definite stop back through on our way home to try the Flounder w/crawfish, morels,
English peas.  

The only reason why I didn't give this higher then a 4 Star...it was so delicious I wanted a bigger serving!
name: Traycie

text: I found this place thanks to yelp!  I was in the mood for a new place to eat so started searching.  This place popped up. I didn't even know this place was here.  I have driven right by it hundreds of times!  So thanks yelpers!  I went in for breakfast and the reviews are spot on!  What a great little place!  I really love the green tea!  Food was perfectly cooked and came out fast, fresh and hot!  Everyone is friendly and helpful!  Truly a gem and I'm so glad I finally found this place!  As the saying goes; better late then never!
name: Sara

text: We recently celebrated my sister's 70th birthday at Roxy's.  As usual, the staff were attentive, the management was spot on & the food was excellent.  We have never been disappointed when eating at Roxy's.  Our waiter, Clark, was attentive to our needs & gave us excellent service.  The manager, Jeff, checked on us to be sure we had everything we needed & if we were satisfied with the service & food.  If you have a celebration or just want some delicious food, then Roxy's is your place to visit.  We love the atmosphere, the staff, the management and the food most of all.
name: Veronica

text:
Extremely SLOW!!!!

We use to come here a couple times a month but stopped due to bad service.  We have tried several times again only to be disappointed.  The wait staff turnover is atrocious.  Seems to be all new faces every time we come here.  

The cook staff can't push out food fast enough on busier nights and the wait staff doesn't know how to handle busy times due to lack of training and direction.  

This place used to be fantastic and a go to place in Plainfield but not now.

We have talked (in a civil tone) to the manager, who didn't seem to care about the high turnover and slowness in food.  

It seems corporate needs to step in and replace the management here as they are obviously not handling the store well.
name: Darin

text: Had the most amazing dinner at Steelbach tonight. There were 11 of us and we tried almost everything on the menu. It was all delicious. Our server, Peter, was amazing. I would definitely request him next time. All the food was incredible. I'd have to say my ultimate favorites were the popovers, bone marrow, deviled eggs, rack of lamb, Mac n cheese and the chocolate/hazelnut dessert. Reservations recommended and free parking. A beautiful view of downtown at night and lovely to walk around inside and outside of Armature Works. Highly recommend!!!
name: Joanna

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. Idk, the portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Anyway, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. maybe I just came on an off day. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Service was friendly, just kinda slow once the room filled up. so yeah kind of mixed on it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: This is the first time I ordered take out. AMAZING. Our first experience there was for dinner about a 2 weeks ago. Very cute place, the waitress was extremely nice, we had a lovely dinner. I will be a regular!
name: Cassie

text: We made a 6pm reservation for 5 people.  Our experience was above average on all points. Kind and courteous servers. Our drinks and food orders were delicious. The chocolate mousse cake was excellent.  We will be dining here frequently.
name: L

text:
Decor/service: service was quick although the place was not busy as it was only 330pm. The decor is nice and small. Has a very relaxed feeling to it.

Food: the food is good solid home made Mexican food. They main part of their menu is taco's and quesadillas and you can tell it is fresh. The chips and salsa/guacamole was also freshly made. The salsa brings the heat so be careful if you don't like spicy.
name: Kyle

text:
Popped in for a pleasant Sunday brunch when some of the other options in the area looked too crowded.  The food is decent but not overly remarkable.  I had the salmon Benedict, which I enjoyed.  It used smoked salmon filet as opposed to lox, which is what I was expecting, but the results were decent.  My daughter enjoyed her waffles and berries, but they just looked like standard waffles with a handful of fresh berries.  Good, but not remarkable.

I had the Bloody Mary which could have definitely used more heat.  The coffees were good, but again, they are coffees.  Overall, it was a pleasant choice, easy to get into with a parking lot just next door, but nothing overly memorable or remarkable.
name: Matt

text: Mixed review here. I would have given them 4-5 stars if it wasn't for the attitude of the people behind the counter. They act as if they are doing you a favor selling you some meat.
name: Matt

text: It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For a busy night they handled it okay. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Pretty happy with it overall. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: HUGE disappointment. Ordered a roast beef and it was inedible. The roast beef was literally as dry as sawdust. I've never had a roast beef sandwich made with dryer than dust shredded beef. I could have forgiven the dehydrated beef if it would have had flavor. But alas, the flavor was absent. The bread was adequate and the veggies were fresh. Whole lettuce. Not shredded? Seems they need to reverse the cut style of the lettuce with the dusty beef. This is probably the same stuff they're putting in the philly cheese steak. I would drench that awful, with bar b que sauce and maybe, just maybe, you could choke that baby down. I will say the portion was generous but honestly all that did was take up space in the garbage bin.
name: Cindy

text:
I've heard the term "Umami Bomb" used quite frequently on Top Chef, so obviously, it's with my professional expertise that I use that term to describe the flavor in this ramen. 

I am a newb to Raijin Ramen, but I've visited probably 4 or 5 times since my first visit...all within like a month lol. 

I've stuck with the Tonkatsu each time because why fix what ain't broken. Eventually I will branch out as I'm positive it'll be just as delicious. Again - the broth flavor is insane, and the noodles are delicious. Very hearty flavors without the feeling of heaviness. Rich and distinguished pork flavors. 

We've also had the Gyoza and the fried calamari - both so delicious. 

As stated previously there's usually a wait if you don't get there before they open. Anticipate 45 + min wait time, but also, it's worth it!
name: Vanessa

text:
Buffet food is not good. Almost felt they intentionally don't serve quality food at buffet to attract for dine in customers for dinner. 
I tried dinner as well, food is decent but I felt most items are $2-3 expensive than they deserved to be. Maybe one of the reason I didn't see many ppl in there. I tried twice and both times the place was mostly empty with just 3 tables occupied. 
I would revisit if they improve the quality of food and reduce the price.
name: Sandeep

text: Ok food and service. Since the restaurant changed hands and redecorated, it has lost the ambience that was so appealing. Taking out the wall of St. Louis memorabilia that separated the bar from the dining area has brought the noise level to the point of being uncomfortable. Too bad they decided that more tables were needed as they probably won't need them now.
name: James

text:
Pros: Standard food in a good environment. 

Cons: Prices didn't match with what they wrote on the menu. The price of the juice on the menu is $3.5, however, we were charged $5 for what we ordered. Also, we were charged $8 for a cup of double espresso. 

Tips: Double check your check before you sign it. Mismatched price can certainly leave a bad taste in your mouths.
name: Minshuo

text: Delicious sushi with... wait for it... PHENOMENAL oysters! Couldn't get over how tasty everything was! Also had a martini which was strong -- I was pleasantly surprised given how many establishments seem to water down mixed drinks lately.
name: Jess

text:
Yen Ching is a solid standard Chinese place with a prettier inside decor and presentation for their place. We came for the lunch special and tried the Yen Ching, Beef, Chicken, and their sizzling rice soup.

Overall a 3.5 star:

Their Yen Ching beef was great, no complaints, 4 star. The Chicken was definitely not as good as their beef, and their sizzling rice soup was fine too. The fried rice that comes with the lunch special though was extremely bland and just had no taste. Definitely would have preferred white rice instead.

Prices seem way higher if you don't come for lunch, so I'm not sure how good their dinner menu is.
name: David

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Price felt a touch high for what it was. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: If you like to eat and sample different things, you need to check this place out.  It's open everyday starting at 8am.  Some of my favorite spots are Hershel's deli for the pastrami sandwich, salmon curry at Little Thai Market, breakfast with freshly squeezed OJ at Dutch eating place, Beiler's donuts, pretzels at Miller's twist.  You can easily spend a couple hours just walking and eating here so worth a visit.
name: Andrew

text:
I had lunch here yesterday and I'm taking coworkers back with me today. The food was so good! The service was incredible too. 

The food: the lunch specials are great prices especially for the quality. The lunch special was around $7. The food is very fresh and also delicious (I highly recommend the bao and chicken gyoza). I wish the portion was a little bigger honestly but it still wasn't bad for center city and the price!

The service: everyone working is very respectful and courteous which is sometimes hard to find in philly during a lunch rush. My wait wasn't even that long (about 10 mins around 12:30pm) but 3 different people thanked me for waiting. The actual space is very small and cozy with just a few tables for seating but it's a great place for to-go orders. The inside is clean and you can tell the family working here cares about their customer service!
name: Ciara

text: If you can get past reading their daily special board and not be salivating, it's a miracle. I wanted everything! The salads, soups, bowls, sauces...YUM. I'm a veggie, my son's not - but we both raved about the food. They also have a nice big outdoor patio if it's a sunny day. The ambience isn't sexy but it's casual and open. Highly recommended!
name: Doña

text:
Last night we went to Addie's Thai House for dinner and we could use an Entertainment Book Coupon.  I love it when you can save money and eat good food.  But Addie's Thai House would NOT Honor the Entertainment Coupon.  It was for up to $25.00 off the bill which was $155.00 for six people plus tip.  
We ordered the Papaya Salad which was very good and the spring rolls which came with 6 rolls.  The rolls were too fried to have a good taste.  
We had the soup which had steam coming from the chicken but the soup broth was tepid.  If hot, it would have been very good.  Unfortunately it was not.
We ordered the Waterfall beef which was good, garlic chicken, ok, Padsewe with chicken-good, shrimp with glass noodles-good but not worth the price, Pad Thai, good. and we had a friend that had dietary restrictions-no fish and his entree was chicken with green beans and he enjoyed it.  He ordered a Diet Coke.  It came in a can with a glass with ice.  He ordered four cans and they charged him $2.50 per can.  We thought they should have let him know that each soda was being charged to his bill.  He didn't know it until the bill came.  

This is a neighborhood restaurant and it has been in business for a long time.  I am angry that they are taking the business the Entertainment Book is bringing to them without compensating the people using the coupon.  There are too many other restaurants we can enjoy that are happy to have our business.
name: Ruth

text: Decent food but the lines are insane! For a sandwich I can't justify waiting in line for an hr
name: Maya

text:
Definitely some of the best wings in the city. It is a small place and didn't really have a feel for a sit down meal so I got it to go. 
I got a 10 piece "Jaidyn's flavor." Not spicy but has some good flavor. It is good for anyone looking for flavor over heat. 
Crisp, fresh wings. Solid choice.
name: Sean

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Maybe other people have better luck here. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better online than it did in person. For the price I expected more than this. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
My original rating was a two... my first experience was an unfortunate one... however, we all have those days. After the owner reaching out to me and explaining the situation, via yelp. I couldn't hold back and not re-visit. I came specifically for the beer, and ordered a flight. It was delightful. Each beer was well crafted and it all really hit the spot. 

I paid attention to my surroundings and realized that the service was great to all who was eating. Well done Madbeach Brewing! I am now a believer in this establishment and will come for more frequent visits! Thanks for the push to come back and try again!
name: Kevin

text: Great service and friendly staff. This restaurant gives you the 'Mom & Pop' feel, with a modern look. Prices of menu items are reasonable.
name: Candace

text:
Started out with the Lucky Luciano - gin, elderflower liquer, lemon and lavender bitters.  I wasn't sure at first, but the flavor grew on me.  The Repeal Nachos are excellent.  Highly recommend!  I had the BBQ shrimp,  which comes with white cheddar grits and collard greens.  The greens were nicely seasoned and the grits were well made.  The bbq sauce on the shrimp was top notch.  I'd drink that stuff from the bottle.  My only complaint is that it makes a mess of my fingers pulling the tails off the shrimp, but licking the bbq off my fingers made it a bit better.  

I'd definitely come back for the bbq brisket and pulled pork.  I also want to try the white chocolate bread pudding next time.  Also, parking was a pain at 5pm, I can't imagine how it is later in the evening.  Maybe I'm spoiled because I'm more used to the suburbs and dedicated parking, but I hate having to spend so much time trying to park.  It's very frustrating.
name: Greg

text: used to be very good.... gave you a ton of food for the money .. actually its still great.... still a lot for your money ... BUTTTT and its a bigggggggggggg butttttttt... the place has gone to crap.. it is filthy . we got drinks ... filthy dirty glasses. ... asked for different glasses. the girl was filing them and said they are foaming for some reason and handed us the "new" glasses... again . filthy .. we said these are the same way .. dirty . the girl then said  yeah we are having trouble with the water and the dishwasher? thats just what i wanted to hear... so we said nevermind the drinks .... got the food and took a look at it  it looked great . smelled great.. but my wife and i looked at each other like hummmm . broken dishwasher? 4 dirty (greasy) glasses.... what are we NOT seeing under the food....  got up .. left $30 on the table and walked out ... all i can say is IF you dare go.. CHECK THE GLASSS REAL CLOSE BEFORE YOU DRINK  and its it "foams" ... LEAVE ..joey the owner is a nice man but needs to put some money into the kitchen and clean that place up .. we used to go there couple times a week
name: Mike

text:
How did I not know this place existed? If you like flavor, you must try this place. Wonderful customer service! Our waitress was attentive, but not overly ambitious. 
She brought the cute little nuts filled in leafs to match the number of people in your party. We ordered the Peruvian margarita, Peruvian mule, and juice for our drinks. I ordered theTallarin Saltado mixed (beef, chicken & shrimp) because I wanted to try them all. I liked the chicken best and shrimp least. My friends ordered Lomo Saltado. I cannot define the flavors for you because they are SO awesome. But, I can say you should be prepared to eat because the portions are hearty.
name: Stephanie

text: Usually I get the 2 piece fish with shrimp fried rice and my husband gets the 10 piece honey garlic pepper wings with the shrimp fried rice, but when I tell you I saw that they had seafood boils...I HAD TO TRY IT!. I was not disappointed at all, I got the special sauce which I think was a mixture of all of them and mild. It was the most delicious thing I have had. It was juicy and flavorful, the shrimp were pretty good size the mussels were meaty the corn and potatoes were good as well. I already enjoyed ordering from here but now my seafood boils will definitely come from here now.
name: Janmichelle

text:
My husband was looking for authentic Caribbean food and he found a gold mine!!! This restaurant not only exceeded our expectations with the flavors and authenticity of the food, The service was the BEST service we've had in a long time at any restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area. Andre was very attentive and welcoming as well as the rest of the staff. Hidden gem in Hyde Park. 

I HIGHLY recommend coming in and giving them a try. The atmosphere is very calming and the service jus makes u feel at home. Great place to come on a date, family outing, special occasion or just to indulge in some truly authentic Caribbean food all made fresh to order and seasoned to perfection!!

THE BEST BREAD PUDDING IN TAMPA!!!
name: Davina

text: Seriously over priced and the food is meh. Ate here with friends. Milkshakes are $11. Friends had a pie for $8 which is barely an appetizer size. Side salad is in a very small plant pot that is about 3 ounces. Had the seafood chowder that said it was with crab. They should state its Krab with a k which was a blob of starchy something that I didnt even eat half at $11.99. Left and went and got other food as it will not fill u up. I am sure the owners are nice but I dont expect this place to last a year. Value is horrible and the food was mediocre at best. A big dissapointment. On the positive side, the space is cool and the bathroom is great. The food was a total letdown, overpriced and so I give it a D-
name: Anonymous

text:
This place is worth seeking out. We bookmarked it back at the hotel because of the mouth watering pics posted by others, but when we went looking for it, we found the 700 Club instead. Look carefully though and you'll see Faubourg Bistro written on the door. It turns out it is located in the rear of this bar...so don't look for a big sign for Faubourg Bistro. Look for the 700 Club. 

Anyway...it's just a tiny little operation in the back of a bar with about 6 tables. You order at a Dutch door and then they bring out the eats. On this visit we just had the pizza mac n cheese, which was fantastic. They choose the right cheeses so the amount of cheese and grease doesn't overwhelm you. It was delicious to the end. We would love to eat here again. I only dock them one star for the atmosphere. You're in a bar so it's noisy, kinda gross and bathrooms are nasty. Some folks won't be comfortable eating here.
name: Brian

text: Had the speed bullet and it was good coffee. Highly recommend if you are in the Downtown area.
name: Miriam

text:
We met some good friends as we visited Nashville.. thy chose this restaurant... I am glad they did!  

It's located in an old large house.  It was not busy when we arrived but it filled up quickly so make reservations.  

Great service with lots of choices!  I got the Surf n Turf.  It was delicious!  Also got the house special soup.  I will share pictures of the other meals.  

If you are in Nashville do your self a favor and visit this wonderful place.
name: Marc

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Would return. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything..
name: User

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. For a busy night they handled it okay. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Chicken was good. Mac and cheese bland. Cheese sauce was gross!!! Pasta salad was delicious
name: Jules

text:
We ended up here because the bar we wanted to go to was charging a cover and Cafe Negril didn't.

  Downstairs had live music playing and upstairs is much quieter where you can just hang out with your friends and play Jenga.  Our server Rhonda was awesome and sweet.
name: Soo

text: Muy bueno el sitio - la comida es muy sabrosa - los tacos de pollo son lo máximo y el menú es muy variado - el sitio es limpio y es ventilado
name: Engelberth

text: Great burgers seared with crispy edges on a flat top. Fresh ingredients and an amazing baked sweet potato as a side. Will definitely be back.
name: Lance

text: Had lunch here today, and what an amazing store!  Got the muffuletta.  It was half of a whole sandwich, but plenty of food with chips, and a drink included.  The muffuletta is excellent!  My only complaint would be not enough olive sauce.  If I were to order it again I will ask if they can load it on.  A true New Orleans muffuletta is pilled on.  Which makes the sandwich.  This is definitely a close resemblance.  Just lacking in one small, but important area.  Other than that.  I will be back.
name: Scott

text: Solid brunch spot but lacking in originality. No one dish knocks the socks off. I'm just happy there's a dedicated spot for brunch in Conshy!
name: Nick

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: I am so upset about the business practices of the catering and banquet department of the Canary hotel. This is my second consecutive year of hosting a work dinner party. the first year there was no contract required. This year I had to sign a contract requiring a $1500 food bill with a $275 room rental charge. We did only spend $971 in food including tax and gratuity. I was still prepared to be charged $1500. Other restaurants have made adjustments for these type of events. I was absolutely not aware that they were going to tax me on the remaining balance that we did not consume or use. I also was not aware that I was going to be charged tax on the the room rental as well. I will NEVER give this place my business and I will encourage others to steer clear of the Canary. This is a bust!

text:
We wanted something to eat and it was late. My friend let me pick between here and another place and this was my pick. My mistake. 

The menu has been chopped to 1 page, front and back. But I think what was the worst is the few items that are still named the same, aren't the same.  The Seafood Platter used to have oysters, catfish and shrimp. Welp not anymore. Dishes like the Red Beans and Rice and Gumbo only come in full portions, leaving no option for a bowl or cup. 

I ordered the Fried Green Tomato BLT...the description versus what I got was disappointing. Double bacon turned out to be a total of 4 strips...how?? And it was supposed to be candied bacon but it was regular. When I asked I was then told there wasn't any. Oh and there wasn't any remoulade sauce either. 

Needless to say I returned it and asked for a Patty Melt. The upside is they use real beef and it's grilled to order correctly. The downside my onions were raw and they were the part closest to the outside skin, making them tough. 

The upside was the Rum Punch. $10 and I was tipsy so I needed the Patty Melt...lol. 

I'm not sure what happened but I would really, really, REALLY, REALLY, REALLY, REALLY like the 6 PAGE MENU BACK!!!!!!

Or at least some variation of it? 3? Sheesh!!!

text: Where do I start?????? HOLY SCHMOLEY is where!!!! The farm to table concept in itself is true in every form in this restaurant with everything from their spirits, to their veggies to their proteins and desserts being local, sustainable and / or traceable! When you dive into the menu it's a bit overwhelming as EVERYTHING sounds like what you want and need to eat! We opted for a shareable and one of their handmade "bread" options. Both the wings and pretzels with dips were OUT OF BOUNDS! I literally wiped off the entire portion of the sour cream and onion dip by myself and didn't feel bad about it AT ALL . The wings were flavored and cooked to perfection and that gentle squeeze of fresh lime they wanted you to make on top was right on time because it elevated those damn wings to no end! As far as entrees, there are endless drool worthy options but since I inhaled a pound of sour cream and onion dip and fresh soft pretzels I opted for the trout while my friend didn't care and went right for the win with the chicken and donut ! She loved every morsel of her meal and had so much to pack in a doggy bag to bring home. I found my meal satisfying but the star of the dish wasn't the trout, but rather the homemade unexpected rice-a-roni of all thing LOL! And since we clearly didn't ingest over 2000 calories each already, we had to go for dessert since they make all ice cream and pies and pastries in house ::SIGH:: so the deep dish chocolate pie and chocolate ice cream was the only obvious choice. FOOD COMA! We literally almost had to be wheeled out. This place is BONKERS and we highly recommend you pay it a visit. Our server was phenomenal as well and made the experience that much more enjoyable as if we even needed that given how great the morsels were overall. CHEERS to Founding Farmers!

text:
I really wanted to like this place, y'all. I came with two girlfriends on an early evening after spending days looking through their menu in anticipation. On paper it looks great-tons of fun rolls with unique combos like kiwi and strawberry, steak, spicy crawfish, etc. Really though, none of it was good. 

I'll start with the location. It's tucked next to the intercontinental hotel downtown so parking is definitely tricky (we used an uber). I will say that the restaurant itself really beautiful. The decor and ambience inside are so classy. It's spacious and elegant and has a really cool vibe. I almost gave them three stars for the decoration and seating alone. 

So the food. A lot of the rolls are very pricey ($15-$18) which at first was a bit surprising but given the reputation and location I suppose that's around the norm? We ordered the rock n roll, the John breaux, California, spicy tuna, and a few other fun rolls. I was severely unimpressed. Not only was it dry and pretty tasteless, but it also did not taste fresh. Their spicy mayo was...I don't even know but I wouldn't call it spicy and it sort of was congealing at the tops-yikes. All of us at the table were underwhelmed and this is coming from three people who eat a LOT of sushi. One person even told us she wasn't feeling well that night after dinner. 

The service was just alright. We were never sure what mood our waitress would be in when she returned to the table-sometimes super happy and smiling and sometimes not making eye contact, sighing, and looking very unhappy with us...not sure what was going on there. Also, for only having 3 tables of customers, the food took more time to come than it should have. 


Seating/decor/ambiance-4/5
Location-3/5
Food-2/5
Service-3/5

text:
So this is a mixed review review.  We were in NOLA for some fun on my son's birthday week.  We were doing the birthday road trip!  We were walking and saw this place and we were hungry and it looked great so said let's do it.  We had to line up because there was a wait, but it was really short.  The restaurant itself is very nice, all white linens, friendly service and just what you need after walking the French Quarter all day.

We sat upstairs which was less crowded and you can also step out on the balcony if you wanted to experience of looking down on the action in the street.  

Service was fast and friendly.  We ordered the grilled oysters.  Hands down the best grilled oysters I have ever had.  In fact, they were so good, we ordered oysters everywhere we ate for the rest off our time in NOLA, and no one else topped Felix' oysters.   My youngest son ordered a blackened fish and he loved it.  I tasted it and it was indeed amazing.  My other son had a po'boy, and he loved his as well.  

This was our first dinner in NOLA and I told myself I would stick to my diet no matter what so..I ordered a seafood salad.   It was supposed to have some shrimp and crab meat, etc..  Well it came out with a mountain of iceberg lettuce ya'll.  I mean it was 18.00 and I cannot get a mixed greens or something?   There was a good portion of large shrimp but no crab meat.  So I told the waitress and she got me some crab meat but it was SO SMALL, I swear it was like a sample you get when you shop at Costco on Sundays.  In the little paper cup and everything.  We laughed hysterically.   Maybe I was only supposed to put the crab meat on just 1/8 of the mountain of lettuce.  Or Maybe I didn't read the menu correctly and it was a shrimp salad with a dusting of crab meat.  Anyway...I ate it, and it was interesting, but really... Who in the heck goes to NOLA for a seafood salad?!  Lesson learned.  

I would definitely go back to Felix, and I would highly recommend EVERYTHING except the salad lol.  We loved everything else about this restaurant and food was very good!!

text:
First of all I was worried that we were going to need to have a back up plan for Friday "date night" because there were no reservations available for my 7:30 time slot. We arrived and were quick to find a parking spot which is always a good sign as the lot shares real estate with a few other dining spots and there is also valet available. Our plan was to grab a drink and a few appetizers and then do the wine tasting and pick up our monthly wine of choice for club members.
We walked in and the wine tasting area was super loud and three deep as usual. Suprisingly the hostess said that we could be seated right away if we chose inside dining and we quickly agreed...
We picked 3 appetizers, Cooperhawk Calamari, Roasted Veggie and Goat Cheese Flatbread and Crispy Brussels Sprouts
Cashews, Mint, Sweet Thai Chili, Sesame-Sriracha Aioli... The calamari is all rings, light crispy and sticky-sweet... pairs well with the dipping sauce which has a slight kick but not spicy....The flat bread was nice, the blend of veggies was tasy and balanced with the goat cheese.. neither were over powering.... my disappointment was the Crispy Brussels Sprouts,, both my hubby and I are a big fan of Brussels Sprouts and these were super bitter... I found myself digging through the mint to get to the brussels as they were buried in it and it was not what I was expecting...The pretzel bread arrived with the appetizers which I would have preferred the bread while we were waiting and enjoying our wine..Overall I would give this dining room visit a 4 star and never order the brussel sprouts again...
Since we were there to pick up our monthly wine club selection we headed to the wine tasting area which was now 4 people deep and super loud... we opted to skip the tasting and just get our wine and a few truffles and head home to enjoy them.. The server told me I had 6 bottles due for pick up, not realizing I hadn't been there since Feb. I was a little excited now and asked to see the wine list.. I made my choices of 2 Romance red, 1 White Sangria,1 Red Sangria, 1 Cabernet Savignon and a Tempranillo de Espana. My husband chose 2 Baileys and 2 White Chocolate Truffles and out we go!... When I arrived home we tried the Baileys Truffles and they were amazing! The White Chocolate however was so disgustingly sweet, we actually couldn't eat more than the first bite... If you like sweet these are for you!... When I unpacked my wine I noticed that I was given 2 Sweet Red instead of 2 Romance and since it is about a 30 minute drive from home, I will suck it up this time and make sure I check before leaving next time.

I really wish the tasting area was larger and able to accomodate the crowds that they get :(

text: Wife and I had a nice late lunch there. Ambience was fantastic, we sat outside. We shared crab cakes which was fantastic. Great flavor and freshness! Finished with crab legs and coral reef linguine. Scallops and shrimp were cooked were delicious.
