text: The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The food was good and the service was easygoing. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
Have been here a couple of times, and have experienced good service and tasty food, with good portions.  One of our favorites is the pizza.  We ordered a veggie pizza which was amazing!  The crust was nice and chewy, with flavorful sauce and super fresh and plentiful veggies.  We are fans of more substantial pizza, not paper thin crust.  Skipolinis delivered.  Salads are also very tasty and fresh.

Our server was very attentive, but not annoying.  The place is pretty busy on weekends, but our server didn't skip a beat.

We'll be going back but probably will stick to the pizza since it hit the spot for us!

text:
Great little find on busy the ever popular Tulane Avenue. 

Drink specials reign supreme. And from the open mic sessions to the game nights with $.50¢ wings to steak night... this place screams of a good time. 

Ty the bartender & Joe the owner are staples in this place and they and a few others run a well oiled machine. 

It's never a dull moment here and this is evident from the crowds that frequent this establishment. 

I stop in from time to time to meet friends after work and it's always a relaxing time. The patio is a VERY nice addition to the overall atmosphere and is a great place to duck off from the party inside if needed. 

Parking is not the the greatest, but it's Tulane Ave... this is prime property.  Street parking is the call for the day. 

I find prices to be fair and the drinks are always ON POINT. 

"Cash me INSIDE..." lol

text: Delicious!!!! My whole family loved this restaurant.  We will be back soon.  The brussel sprout tacos were amazing.
name: Mary

text:
This was our first time coming to Craft Street! We've heard great reviews, however, the experience proved to be even greater than we had heard. Cole created a great dinning experience for us. Carolyn was so great in making sure that we received our coupon for a free appetizer the next time we come! Can't wait for our next trip, for food and drink! 

P.s. get the three kings burger !!!!

text: Had the Signature dish and was not impressed. Very disappointed, especially when you consider the prices they charged. Drinks were pretty good.
name: Carrie

text: Someone mentioned they should offer whole wheat crusts.  They DO have that.  The pizza is great, but the crust could be a little crispier. text:
What a rip-off and the rip-off ruined our night out.

text: I don't understand why this location has little stars?this is the best Wendy's I've been to in Philly so far food is always hot fresh and French fries are always crispy.. The drive-through can become very long but they do move pretty quick. FYI I haven't been inside so I can't see much on that but the decor looks cool from the outside.

text: If you like crowds and loud music then this is your place. Packed in like sardines, not clean. Don't care for Broadway, Just a bunch of tourist traps, go elsewhere in Nashville. Jack's Barbeque down the street has the best BBQ on Broadway

text:
I have been on the search for the perfect Philly Cheese Steak in downtown Philadelphia and finally found one at Sonny's.  The location is perfect in old town Philadelphia, right near where the Declaration of Independence was signed and the home of Betsy Ross.  

The difference between Sonny's and the others is the meat is very high quality rib eye, and with the grilled onions, American cheese, and a dense bun is delicious.   

If you are on a visit to Philly and want to try the best version of this classic, head straight to Old Town.

text: Beautiful restaurant but DO NOT order the pancakes. Absolute worst pancakes we have ever had in our life.. extremely sour and bad after taste. Coffee was great, waffle was pretty good! But probably not going back.

text: I've been going to this White Castle for years. They've only got my order wrong one time (they gave me chicken rings instead of onion rings) which is pretty good for a fast food place. text:
I was extremely disappointed in the lackluster customer service here.

I stopped in here about three Fridays ago. Admittedly, I waited on writing this review because any time I have an overwhelmingly negative experience, I fear that I might write a reaction to it based on still feeling upset and I wanted to write objectively. So I preferred to let it sit, and honestly I still feel that there was no excuse for this lack of service.

I came in around 7:30pm-8pm on a Friday night. There were a few customers at tables but it was not packed at all. There was a big enough crew working - a person taking an order at the side register closest to the entrance, a line of workers making the food in the main area, and a woman who was floating between those areas - presumably the manager.

I stood up by the counter in a central-enough area to be noticed, and I was not acknowledged by anyone. Nobody asked to take an order, nobody even said hello or that they would be with me shortly. They were working, I want to be clear about that. But nobody seemed rushed or overwhelmed with orders to even acknowledge a customer waiting. In fact, the employee who was working at the register by the entrance (which I believe might have been an online order pickup station) finished talking to the people who were getting their food as I walked in...and then she proceeded to grab cleaning supplies and wipe down counters as I stood there waiting. The line employees never looked up from their station. The person I assume was the manager walking between areas, she was talking to people, checking some paperwork, etc. nothing that suggested she was rushed either. 

So after about 10 minutes, I decided my craving for a burrito wasn't worth it and simply walked out. 

I have pretty strong opinions when it comes to this type of service, as evidenced by a separate review regarding a different business I wrote a number of years ago with a similar experience. I consider ignoring customers to be the #1 dealbreaker by businesses, as most other issues can be chalked up to mistakes in some capacity or another. But an entire staff ignoring a visibly-waiting customer is not a mistake. I don't plan on going back here, and I'm okay with that because the other reviews regarding the quality of the food here seem to be split anyway.
name: Mike

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. So generally wouldn't make a special trip to come back.

text: Excellent food and service. We were super impressed. Must try the coconut curry. Delish!
name: Erin

text: This place is so wonderful...amazing selection of organic food!! I wish they would come to NJ. :-) Everytime I'm in the area, I like to stop in. Their chicken salad is excellent and their homemade soups are so delicious! The workers are always friendly and willing to help. Excellent parking - highly recommend!!
name: Betsy

text: We came here with a group and were still seated right away. Good location at Clay Terrace. Our server was a little quiet / not overly welcoming but service was still reasonable. We ordered a plain cheese pizza- nothing amazing but I did like the thin crust. I want to come back and try one of their specialty pizzas. There were a lot of interesting menu items and others in the group had good things to say about their pizzas. They also have a pretty extensive beer menu so lots of options. Only con: they do not have RANCH!
name: Lisa

text: My very own taco kingdom! First time I came I was like meh but I decided to just come again and try different items. Now I come ever single week! My go to is the pulled pork taco and ooo boy are they loaded with meat! Also they are really well priced !
name: Jessica

text: We came to eat dinner here on a Wednesday night and it was about 5:15 PM. They were very busy seems that they had an unexpected group of young boys about 15 to 20 of them and that backed up the kitchen so everyone had to wait for their food. I had a ribeye steak was cooked good tasted good I also had a garden salad which was good one of us had baby back ribs that were tender another of us had a baby back rib plate that was tough. The smashed potatoes were not what we expected they were basically mashed potatoes that they served with white gravy. The servers took my empty soda class and never returned with the refill. Hit and miss at this place. Please could be kind of pricey
name: Marty

text:
The menu looks amazing. Excellent wait staff, very clean with cute decor. The first time we ate there we ordered two of the hash dishes. My daughters veggies hash listed many wonderful ingredients including garlic, which we love. However, we didn't expect to find about 20 whole garlic cloves mixed in. This overpowered the dish making it almost inedible. She ordered sunny side up eggs and got over medium. 
We decided to give Moe Joe's Breakfast Eatery another chance a few days later. Today we ordered the BTA Benedict and the Lemon Poppy Seed pancakes. I give the pancakes a 5; super fluffy with crispy edges and a delicious tangy lemon glaze. Unfortunately the poached eggs were over cooked (not even a little runny yolk) and they apparently think hollandaise is supposed to consist mostly of mayonnaise . It was thick and tasted a lot like mayo. We had to scrape it off. The breakfast potatoes were excellent; crispy and nicely seasoned. 
So, great menu poorly executed. Sorry Moe Joe's; we gave you two chances!
name: Kristen

text: My wife and I were in the city for the eagles-bears game. We stopped at about ten steak places and Jim's her and I's favorite.
name: Jake

text: Don't come here if you want a nice place to sit. Instead come here to grab and go, or eat outside. Great fish, onion rings spot on. Prices are kinda high for the environment but it's good quality.
name: A

text: Definitely one of the best choices if you're looking for a quick bite to eat while shopping. They even have Elysian Space Dust if you're looking for a fantastic IPA to ease your shopping experience  Highly recommend the Crispy Chicken West. Also gotta love that they deliver on Uber Eats. Will definitely be back soon!
name: Bryce

text:
If I was a national TV personality like Dr. BBQ, I would pay more attention to customer service. Last time I was at your St Pete location, Nov 2018, I was with a disabled friend. The same manager that's here today, February 24th, told us that there was not seats on the lower level but we could walk up the stairs to check the upper bar. When asked to send someone up to check for us, she said they don't have time,,,,to prevent a disabled person from walking up stairs to check if a table is open. Oh, they have a elevator, it's a lift only a small nonclostraphobic person could take, but that's not us. 
As for today, she sat a family of five with two infaint children at the bar, where bot the kids dirty diapers are sitting on the bar so the family can play with them while we try to eat our dinners.
Mr. BBQ, this is my second and last time I'll be at your restaurant until you show the St Pete community that you actually want our business! If you are creating an environment where you accept managers being crul to customers, and willing the to let the dirty diapers sit at the bar, I will begin to spend my money to help remove you from the community!

Respectfully,
GR
name: B

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. It was crowded but still moved along. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up.
name: User

text: First time here. First off, wide selection of beer! Variety of local craft beer. I ordered a virgin Miami Vice and really enjoyed the balance of that drink. You order up front first and then you seat yourself. The service is amazing. There was one girl at the cashier and she was making the drinks and brought out our food. It was quite busy that night and she still checked in on us and it wasn't a long wait for the food to arrive. I was amazed by how cheerful and friendly she was while she was running around every where so gracefully lol Real chill place, bags to play on the side I believe I saw with a cute background to take pics. We ordered tacos and it came with chips and salsa dip. I wouldn't say they're authentic tacos but they were still delicious in a healthy non greasy style. If you check in, you get a free beer! Overall a really great place next to the beach.
name: Viet

text: GREEAAATTTT addition to the Camino Real Marketplace. The food was amazing, (try "the pit") and they have vegetarian alternatives which is awesome. I will definitely be returning!
name: Natalie

text:
I've been to this restaurant several of times with my boyfriend for his lunch break, never had issues with employees or food, but today i had asked the waiter if he recommended he lemon chicken, he said yes, so when I got my plate I tasted the lemon chicken and it was chewy and sweet, so I ended up asking the waiter if he can change my meal for another because it didn't satisfy my taste buds. He tells me that he has to ask his boss, he was very nice and understanding. But the boss wasn't interested in satisfying his costumers. Showed no respect not did he ask me anything questions, just jumped into conclusions and was rude. The boss comes back to our table and has the nerve to say "next time don't order that plate" with a mad face and doesn't excuses himself or let's me speak. 

I've never had an issue with this place not with any restaurants because everywhere I go is respectful and understanding. I could've paid for both of my plates but the boss never gave a chance to speak. And didn't ask how I felt. As an owner or a manager you are suppose to approach your costumer with a good attitude and listen to both sides. Not demand me to not order a plate that I disliked that I am obviously not going to order again. 

My mom knows the boss and I am 100% sure he wouldn't have treated us the way he did.
name: Gracie

text: Ordered catering here for Mother's Day. The food was good, they gave us tons of free bread, and we couldn't even finish half of what we ordered. We fed four people with three half trays of food for less than $150 and had tons of leftovers. I was going to order from Joey's in New Port Richey, but they told me they don't accept orders for future dates and wanted me to call back on the day of. Who in the world ever places same day catering orders?? Anyway, Argento's was very accommodating even with only one day advance notice. I do wish they had delivery, but picking it up was fast and seamless, even on a busy holiday with lines of people out the door. Would definitely recommend and will definitely order from them again.
name: Shawn

text: Everything from the service to the food is top shelf! I was presently surprised by the ambience, the staff and the presentation of the food which tasted great.
name: John

text:
Finally, a south Indy coffee house close to I-65!

This coffee shop is as legit as they come. They are roasting their own beans through the week and rocking out an omelet bar on Saturday mornings. The house espresso is solid. They also sell local baked goods.  The drink menu is set up al-a-cart style. You pick your caffeine, your dairy/alternative, house-made syrup, and/or whipped topping. 

I ordered a three shot espresso latte with coconut milk. Love that the menu is customizable. I had great conversation with the employees. You know it's legit when you can argue over French press, Chemex, and Kalita, prep methods, lol. Coffee nerds. 

The omelet featured veggies and ham from Smoking Goose. It was large and fantastic.

Brickhouse even has a drive-thru. Absolutely no reason anyone should be going to Starbucks on the south side any longer!  Eat and drink local!
name: Matthew

text: The drinks are delicious and the food is exceptional! I had the porchetta...the serrano cornbread had the perfect kick along with the maple butter adding that sweet to the spice.  The kale was al dente, with a perfectly cooked duck egg.  I'll definitely be back.
name: Patti

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. So yeah, the food was good and the service was easygoing. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. So yeah, the sauces helped more than i thought they would.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Fun place for dinner with friends.  The ambience is very nice, creative bartender, friendly staff and fantastic Vietnamese food.  Pork belly pops are wonderful.  We also loved the pho with lemon grass broth and bun.  Great value for the price too.  Next time we're in Reno, will definitely be back.

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Anyway, for a busy night they handled it okay. No big complaints, just a nice meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. not sure I'd order the same thing again. Food was good and came out fast. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: My least favorite of the New Orleans Japanese eateries. Portion sizes small and service rushed.

text: TBH the food that I ordered was ok-ay... I didn't expect much from them. But the attitude is the WORST. I ordered take out, when the food was ready, there was no asking like "ur food is ready" or "is this your order?" He just put on the table and said "$13.85." text: My favorite brunch place in Nashville! Their local latte is a must! Their sweet potato french toast and sweet potato hash are UH-MAZING! Favorite place to go! Try it out if you're town! You won't be disappointed.
name: Tozia

text: Growing up in Philly this is the best pizza place around me in Bucks County for sure, with big slices and not sweet sauce its an A+ from me.
name: Joanne

text:
Best restaurant I went to in New Orleans--thank goodness my friend who is from there recommended it! The menu looked so amazing that I wanted to go back at least one additional time to try more things while we were in the city but couldn't get reservations! Our bartender was awesome--so personable!!--and took such care to make really well-crafted drinks. I started with the Bushido, which was light and tart, definitely an interesting drink...and finished with the Belle Epoque (also light and tart)...but my partner picked the winner with Charred Citrus Old-Fashioned.

We ended up getting the fire-roasted oysters--which I originally felt "meh" about--until that garlicky goodness entered my mouth, and I quickly changed my tune. I also got the chicken-fried foie gras, which was awesome. I got the pumpkin agnolotti with rabbit, which was an absolutely delicious, phenomenal choice. Except my partner got the duck, which he immediately proclaimed as the best of his life.

When I'm back in New Orleans, I am 100% making TWO reservations here!!!!
name: Shanna

text: My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Definitely coming back. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.

text: Worst meal of my life. Spent an absurd amount of money with such a low return. Would never go here ever again. Would not recommend to anyone. Wish I could go back in time and tell myself to not waste my money.

text: Wow. Absolutely amazing food and drinks. Definitely check this place out when you're in New Orleans.

text: Not bad for a quick meal. So yeah, it looked better online than it did in person. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Idk, the staff seemed tired but still polite. Anyway, everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.

text: I adore this place. The menu has just about everything, the outdoor atmosphere is perfect for summer nights, & the food is delicious! We ordered the fish tacos and the Cobb salad and were impressed with both. The portions are large so take that into account! The only downside is the indoor space is not very appealing, so I would only go if I could sit outside. Overall this is a great spot in Broadripple!

text: Solid ramen noodles, great flavor and definitely will come back to try the curry laksa and other dishes. Spam was tasty and the portion was huge.
name: Sara

text:
I hate, yes and with passion restaurants that offers inconsistencies in quality. About three and four months ago, food was quite impressive. I could not believe it was from PF chang. In fact its auloty exceeded more expensive Chinese bistros. But then about a couple of months ago the quality started deteriorating. Mongolian beef was way salty that even the restaurant acknowledged it was a mistake. But then the worst happened. I have ordered a few entrees due to time constraints on my business schedule and None was edible. Shrimp used in a few dish were simply very old and had very bad fishy smell. Soy sauce tasted different, well for worse. Rice was undercooked. I could taste the raw kernel. Meat was tougher than a pack of rubber bands.  Stringed beans out of my entire order was the only thing edible. Fried shrimp had very old used oil smell, almost like MD40. 

Dear PFChang, if you think you can get smart with customers by offering crappy food you are mistaken. Instead of cutting cost to compensate for having less customers, try improving quality and serve better food. Customers will then come automatically.
name: Marc

text: I was nervous as I wanted to impress my son in law who was in town for our niece's wedding.  He has lived all over the world, throughout Europe and from Boston to Ft Brag, to Denver.  He told me had a hankering for a Reuben.  I knew we had to deliver big time.  It was easy peazy, called Neli's got him a beer, (or was it 2 or 3), and Neli's Reuben was the best he ever had!!!

text:
We had a very odd experience here some years ago and have never been back.  Prior to that night, we have had very good meals at Walter's and good service from the waitstaff.  Our experience with the bartender was that he had his "favorites" and we weren't one of them.  We started to wonder if his distain was based on our ethnicity, since we hadn't done anything to offend him.
One night we arrived without reservations.  It was our experience that if one didn't have reservations, one could eat at the bar or the high top tables in the bar area.  We did that in the past and so we arrived and went to one of the high top tables.
In the past, when we did this we were greeted by a wait person.  This time, the waitstaff pretended not to see us.  Finally, a wait person did wait on us.
If a patron doesn't follow protocol in a restaurant, a mature approach is to have a discussion with that patron.  The owner or manager never approached us to tell us there were rules we weren't following, we were just treated shabbily.  Since we had been good customers in the past, we found this very confusing, and we haven't been back.  
Good communication is a key to meeting expectations for patrons and staff.  This was not exercised here.  Instead our poor treatment smacked of a lack of professionalism.  There are many restaurants in Wilmington.  We eat out frequently, but never at Watler's anymore.
name: Robin

text: The food was fair. The service was fair. It was an overall fair experience. I'll try again

text: Just waiyed 30 min for food and it took my order 30 seconds to get the food. I am a food critic and this disappoints me.
name: Aaron

text:
My family and I ate here for my mother's birthday. When we were seated at our table, the waitress was very knowledgeable and very patient. She was a highlight of our experience. For starters, we ordered the crab cake, the mussels, and the calamari trio (I was only interested in two of the calamari options so our waitress allowed me to switch out one of the calamari options and substitute it with the bang bang cauliflower). Our appetizers were satisfactory. The crab cake was by far the best! 

For dinner, we ordered shrimp and fries, the lobster ravioli and shrimp, the Haddock Matrimony, and another order of crab cake (highly recommend). The shrimp was good, and the lobster ravioli was alright. Now the Haddock Matrimony was terrible. We actually ended up sending it back and getting the lobster instead. Overall, it was an alright experience!
name: Shay

text:
Lovin' Spoonfuls roooooocks... It's so freaking good even your most carnivorous friends will wanna eat here! 

Everything I've had here has been extremely good. My favorite is the friend chicken dinner. The taste is so identical to real fried chicken and the breading is done right. The mashed potatoes with gravy that come on the side are also bomb. Other good items are the wildcat burger and the wings (I was shocked to know they were simply made out of cauliflower... They were just so tasty). 

I haven't had many drinks here. This is because I am hooked on their pineapple juice. I get it every time. 

Don't be put off by the vegan-ness of this place (if you're that kind of person). Loving' Spoonfuls is a testament to how foods made without animal products can still be really, really, really good.

PS - The owners recently changed. I have been once since the change and still enjoyed the food just as much.
name: Camille

text:
The overall look and feel of the restaurant is very contemporary. It is styled nicely, but lacks that "home" feeling. Upon walking in, I was taken back by the immediate wine and chocolate bar on the right. It was beautiful and the chocolate case was seductive. But I resisted lol 

I made my way to the bar for lunch. The menu is 15 pages long, with the first four being wine and beverage selections. I was a bit overwhelmed. It's an eclectic mix of Asian food, Mexican, Italian, Bbq, and seafood. I am curious to know what they actually classify themselves as. 

I wanted to go for a cup of crab & lobster bisque, but learned that the crab and lobster is canned, so I decided to skip that - which is highly unfortunate since it's snowing outside and my southern self could use some warmth! Canned seafood just has an awful smell and rubbery texture. As I have had fresh seafood bisque from all over the country, and for the listed price, I did not think it worth it. 

I settled on the Leonard Burger, cooked medium, with fries. The food came out timely and hot! I always get ranch with my fries and their ranch was superb. I confirmed that it is, indeed, house made and one can tell in the taste and quality. Excellent. 

The fries are fresh, as well. There are small traces of potato skin, and it seems they are not frozen. They were, however, a bit chewy. But, regardless, they had an excellent flavor. Even on their own! 

Now, let's get down to the main focus - the burger. It was huge, messy, and decent in regards to taste. There was some sort of sauce on it that was super sweet - not really what I want with my cow, ya know? It was not the best burger I have ever had, but it was alright. I left half of the burger and more than that of fries on my plate, and that says a lot. Especially for my chubby, foodie self :D

Unfortunately service wasn't very timely. However, I imagine the one bar waitress did not schedule solely herself during lunch. Mara was great and showed great knowledge in the wine selection and food pairings for other guests. She did not hesitate to answer my questions and get the answer to the ones she didn't immediately know. 

There were definately positives and negatives, but overall, I won't be back nor recommend this particular place for the food. However, a wine lover would feel right at home here with their extensive wine selection!
name: Clata

text: Cosy sweet meal (breakfast for us on a Friday morning) and ...it was truly memorable.  Asparagus Benedict was outstanding (true lemony flavor in that sauce), and my husband's mushroom/blue cheese sauce meal was actually to DIE for ...(bright light wonderful sauce).  We talked about it all weekend.  We will return.  Fantastic food and service...high value...deeply satisfying start to our weekend!

The chowmein has no flavor. The manager was on his phone in the lobby. He dumped out the tea an hour and a half before they closed... and they wouldn't wash their hands after touching something. THE WORST EXPERIENCE I've had with panda.

The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Will be back.

text: I really like the food at Public Service.  My boyfriend and I have been here before about 5 months ago, and we had a great meal and great service.  I'm back in New Orleans and came here because of my prior good experience.  The food was still good, but I was disappointed in the service.  Both nights I sat at the bar to eat.  The first night, it wasn't until after I got my glass of wine that I was told there was a limited bar menu because of a special event for 35 people.  The bar menu is extremely, extremely limited.  There aren't any vegetarian options on it other than chips and dip.  Aside from their burger, there wasn't a thing from the regular menu.  It probably explains why it took 45 minutes to get served, because their attention was elsewhere.  It would have been nice to be let know ahead of time before I sat down and got my drink that this was the situation, but neither the hostess or bartender said anything.  Also, when I told the bartender I was bummed they didn't have the regular menu, he went to the bar back and I could hear him whispering about me.  I decided to come back the next night (close to my hotel, I'm here alone in NO and didn't want to stray far) when I saw the bartender was different.  Thankfully, they had the full menu.  I had a terrific salad and poutine.  The bartender was quite arrogant.  I asked for a wine list twice, and he just said okay.  He didn't tell me it was on the back of the menu.  He said "people usually figure it out".  Well, it wasn't that way the night before when they had a different menu and a separate wine list.  I don't need to pay for a decent meal to feel insulted by the bartender.  So, Public Service, while your food is lovely, I won't be back until your service improves.
name: Annie

text: We checked out Coco Coronado because of the reviews on Yelp and we had a good time. The food was delicious, nice music and the server was amazing. I gave them 4 stars instead of 5 because I really wanted bacon cheese fries and their fryer wasn't working. Over all, good experience.

text: This is my second visit already.   I've gotten the chicken fajita wrap and the buffalo chicken wrap and they are both delicious.   The side of greens though is the best thing I've had both times I've come through.   My wife got a latte and I got a green tea juice drink and they were both lights out as well.   It's different - healthy food that actually tastes really good.   You should come here and eat!

text: Overall very disappointed. Probably more so because of the outstanding reviews and rating.  I eat out 90% of the time as I travel a lot and rely on Yelp all the time.  Very seldom am I disappointed in my choices.  This was one of those times.  Server was super nice and professional; however, there were not enough people working and she was doing her best to manage a large packed area.  The food was average at best, sandwich was plain and lacked flavor and the sweet potato tots were mushy.  I may give a second chance someday and have breakfast.

Recommend this to anyone!

text:
I drool over the pastries and baked goods behind the display case every time I frequent this small hidden gem. The brownies are to die for; get the Birthday Cake Blondie and thank me later. My boyfriend is a fan of the sticky buns, and I've been told that the ricotta cookies are a must-try.

text: Bimbimbap was pretty good but probably more rice would have been nicer and more filling. banchan were weird didnt really like them. Had better korean but this is a good alternative if you live by.

text: This was the cutest, cleanest, and most friendly place ever! The staff was helpful and generous! The unique donuts were both delicious and adorable. We saw that they had unicorn donuts on their Facebook page and wanted to get them for my daughter's party! Everyone loves them!
name: Jax

text: Just the best, fresh made to order dishes. Consistent quality and service with great atmosphere. Salt shrimp, scallops in oil and chicken wings are my favorites.
name: Shari

text:
yelp
Went to lunch today with a close friend our favorite sushi joint.  The chefs are so friendly & accommodating.  After my mussels, I ventured out from the normal routine and tried a couple new rolls.  Tha Epic High roll was flavorful with a slight afterburn from the Habanero masago.  This is not for the weak at heart though if you like a little flame then this is your game.   I also tried Tha MC handroll and it was so tasty! The crystal shrimp was perfect - not too dry and not slimy.  I am not a mayo fan so this is a huge point of contention for me.

The parking lot is private (not sharing with anyone) and is a bit tight.  There isn't any bicycle racks and I would encourage adding that as the midtown area continues to experience regrowth.

All around a great spot to catch a bite with friends or even a game or two (they have many TVs) while getting a meal.  I wish I could go there every day.
name: Cynthia

text:
Es un buen restaurante y de categorías
Venden comidas y bebidas naturales por qué 
Yo e trabajado en esa compañía y si me gusto mucho desearia regresar algún día aver si mi contactan
name: Edgar

text: the appetizers and drinks were good but service was horrible. the waitress took 30 minutes to give us water. we waited almost 40 mins for the check. it was so bad we considered just leaving cash in the middle of the table and walking out. don't think i'll ever come here again.
name: Agrima

text:
Last weekend I met a buddy in Moorestown to hang out.  It's a nice town to spend the afternoon.  He didn't want to go to a formal restaurant, so we stumbled onto this place.  

I actually really, really liked the concept.  Passariello's is a marketplace-style fast casual Italian restaurant.  You have the option for all kinds of pizza, more formal Italian dinners, and also for soup and salads.  I really like how it's great if you just go by yourself for a quick bite, or if you go with a larger group who all have different tastes.

The guy who served me the Eggplant Rollatini really seemed to have his act together.  I had my choice of entrees and sides, too.

The only reason for four stars instead of five is because the prices are a little high, but I understand that Moorestown is upscale.
name: Doug

text: Old faithful. Can never go wrong with Mimi blue meatballs! Came here for dinner on devour week. Very reasonably priced deal with devour and great service as always. I ordered the bourbon bbq, marinara, Sriracha, and garlic meatballs and all were amazing. Never disappointed by Mimi's. Chose to order to the orzo (good but not amazing) and Mac and queso sides. I'll just say that the Mac and queso was UNREAL (i could go on and on about how creamy, cheesy, buttery it was so I'll just leave it at that).  The banana pudding that was served as dessert really wowed me. I was not expecting it to be that good, but BOY! It was great.
name: Alejandra

text:
Small intimate no frills environment with very good food. The owner operators treat you like family. If you show an interest in the menu, they passionately fill you in on the preparation and cooking details.

Some favorites: (my apologies for spelling) = anything with Paneer, Gobi (caulifliwer) Manchurian, Get Naan bread stuffed with chilis and cheese, Byriani rice, the Masala dishes are so good, any dishes with fish, and of course perfect Hakkah noodles.

BYOB

I'm so happy to have this place 5 minutes away.
name: Steve

text: Cool neighborhood bar and grill.  Tom waited on me at the bar.  He was serving some great American staple burgers with his own twists
name: Rob

text:
I've become somewhat of a regular to the Wing House.... especially the Brandon location.  I haven't had an issue with the service or food. I usually sit at the bar and it's always tidy. The bartenders are always attentive. If you're looking for "special" attention, then move buddy,  the girls bust their butts (no pun intended) to do their jobs and take care of the guests. 
  I usually order the grouper bites or a hamburger which never disappoint. I've been to other Wing Houses in the Tampa area but the Brandon location is by far the best. 
   The three star reviewers are very picky. This is great restaurant that serves food and drinks at reasonable prices. If you want to be pampered, then go to a place that charges three times the amount for the same thing. Or try being nice to the servers.... it works for me.
name: Adam

text: Fun and interesting menu. Excellent food, with vegetarian and vegan options. Prompt, knowledgable service.
name: Gordon

text: 4 stars considering its an airport restaurant. Had the Spanish bean soup and crab croquette and both had a ton of flavor. A welcome surprise waiting for my delayed flight!
name: Nick

text: As mentioned, this place is tucked away and in the back of the building but don't sleep on this place!  I got a burger, cheese steak, and cheese fries.  The burger bun was soft, the burger was juicy and tasty and I loved it.  I think I got whatever one has bacon, onion strings and all that.  The cheesesteak was very good, they get their bread from a Conshy bakery I believe, and it's good, however, the 'shell'(? sorry, I'm not a bread expert) was a bit crunchy ... which is totally fine but I mostly have had soft rolls for steaks.  The fries were about as good as fries get, crispy on the outside -- not crunchy -- crispy, and the interior was great.  My buddy also got some burger and some tots with some jalapeños and stuff on them, and he had nothing but good things to say as well.  I loved every bite and can't wait to go back!  The cashier was friendly and conversational ... and the cook came out to ask us about our meal personally ... so it was a friendly, chill vibe and I can't wait to go back.
name: D

text: Just bad. I had been looking forward to the Chili Eggplant having read about it. It was over fried and under spiced. The entrees took forever to come out. They arrived lukewarm, and the trout was mushy and under cooked. Oily oversweet and under salted bok choy. Felt gross after eating. Small pours on the wine. Inexperienced server, not attentive and largely indifferent. This place was a disaster on a Friday night.
name: Bill

text: Very slow and disorganized. Waiting 30 minutes for 2 burgers. 2 tables of patrons and nobody at the bar.
name: Michael

text: The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Food was fresh and service was quick. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: Not bad. Our waiter was nice but a little too chatty (not just with us, as I could tell from his other tables). The goat cheese dip was AMAZING. The chicken and waffle was good, but the chicken was a little dry. Would maybe come back, but not on the top of my list
name: Jessica

text: Reasonably priced and good quality food. Better than takeout but not as expensive as a good sit down place.
name: Rich

text: This restaurant was the perfect place to stop for lunch.  Their lobster sandwich was amazing, but what really blew me away was their attitude towards dogs!  They brought out a water bowl and a treat for my pup and they had a mini menu of dog friendly dishes if you wanted your dog to dine with you!  The atmosphere was lovely and the outdoor seating was perfect.
name: Shelby

text:
Stepped in here for the first time on a Sunday, was very pleasantly surprised to find a swanky hip bar in my neighborhood! Might become one of the places I frequent!

This bar/restaurant is 21 and over, so not great for family events but a great option for a night out or a brunch date. 

I came in with two other friends, we ordered the French toast and a dozen muscles. We were offered different assortments of muscles so went with 4 of each of the 3 kinds of muscles. I unfortunately cannot remember the specific name of my favorite of the 3, but they were the smaller ones that had great flavor. 

We ordered a few cocktails, the basil watermelon margarita was probably the best! 

We got the pleasure of being served by the manager Blaze, he was very hospitable and gave us great recommendations on food and beverages. He was very knowledgeable about the whole menu, which is nice to know when asking for suggestions. 

All over, great service, great food, great vibe to the place. I will definitely be returning!
name: Raylene

text:
The service was not very good 
Water requested took forever to come and then just for one of the three of us. Took away the bread plates contemporaneously to bringing a bread basket refill; and not coming back once to check on how we were doing--yes, mr waiter, I wanted some red pepper flakes and a pepper mill that worked. 

The calamari was quite good! They were not the fried pork anus rings being scurrilously passed off as calamari found ubiquitously a/t some, but strips. They were well spiced, nicely breaded and crispy. They were served with both cocktail sauce and a tartar-like sauce. The portion is good for 1 or 2. 

I got the spaghetti bolognese. I shot a picture including my hand so you can see it's size and presentation. First was the taste--impeccably spiced, perfectly and expertly cooked meat and pasta that was just right.  The portion was appetizer sized, at least by my NY restaurant bonafides and their portion-bromides.  I was not in a gluttonous mood so I was happy for the Lilliputian bowl. 

I didn't notice piped in music.

Lighting was great. 


Lose a star for sub par service

Lose half star for portions that are child-sized
name: Marc

text: I was there over a year ago and thought the food was pretty good. I went today, and would not go back. Waitress brought  chips and salsa. Chips were decent, salsa Thumbs down...chopped tomatoes with a  few onions and some cilantro. What it was missing FLAVOR. We asked for if they had other salsa the waitress said thats is the salsa. Dont eat the chips too quickly you have to pay for the second basket. We ordered fajitas, not very good but we shared it, three tortillas you have to pay even if you want just 2 more. Fake guacamole possibly wholly guacamole brand. Nothing authentic about this so called family restaurant.
name: Nic

text: We have been here a handful of times. The burgers are tasty but small. They previously were much better and larger. They also don't really have a happy hour on Monday any longer. They have a beer and brat special....but who really wants that. Tues-Fri they have 2 for 1 beers from 4-6.
name: Chelsea

text:
Fresh food, fast, and informative server. The creamy baked goat cheese with an apple jam starter and the jalapeño grits were our two favorites. We also got the Rueben and the kimchi was a surprisingly good addition to the sandwich. 

Note they do not have hard liquor so no bloody Mary's for brunch but they do offer a couple mimosas and assorted beer.

Over all great place for a quick, unique brunch!
name: Kim

text:
Terrible!

Had the worst fries ever! Most customers are here for the fresh hot cut fries, and don't mind the wait...
Well, there were 6 cars in front of me.. which I expected at 11:20 am, then when I got to the window, the service was super slow.

I anticipated it was worth the stalling, but after I got my order, my fries were NOT HOT, or even warm!!

I ordered two number 3's, one to drop off at my hubby's work, and felt bad he would get cold fries...

So, I decided to call the number on the receipt to voice my frustration.

They actually answered and told the guy how truly disappointed I was. He apologized, and would let the store manager know.

I hope the long line behind me didn't get the same experience!

text: Ordered food off of here through the seamless app. Food was delivered fast, was cheap, and was very tasty. Had the mole chicken burrito which was really good. Exactly what you want with this type of order.
name: Brian

text: Disgusting and rude staff. First off, when a customer questions about if this is correct, don't have the person helping us to give us attitude. Secondly, the Turkey? DISGUSTING! It was not fresh and aren't y'all supposed to be "Fresh"? Never again am I coming to this place or Panera!!!!
name: Meagan

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The music was louder than it needed to be. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Definitely coming back. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: This was a total let down. Nothing was fresh, tasted Like it had been reheated in the microwave. The Shoyu Ramen literally smelled like something went bad. The shrimp onigiri and karate chicken had been under heat lamps way too long and were inedible. My husband enjoyed the miso ramen but that and the bottled beer were the only good things about it. It was a shame because the staff was so nice and helpful. The food was just awful. Would not recommend eating here.
name: Lisa

text: Delicious food, excellent service, amazing location. I am a butter chicken and saag paneer snob, and both were done to near-perfection. The staff were polite and extremely accommodating. Definitely a great addition to Center City; I'll be coming back.
name: Ben

text:
As a New England native, ( Mass.) we know good Italian food. While staying in St. Petersburg, I decided to try the closest restaurant to us. This was Gigi's. What a disappointment to put it mildly. I got veal parm w/ penne pasta. As I tasted the pasta, I had the thought of Hunts TomatoSauce right out of the can. It had that uncooked, acid, metallic taste. The veal was also unremarkable. Almost an off taste. I had visions of Gordon Ramsey ranting in the kitchen. Even the Caesar Salad was sub par. Salty dressing, unflavored croutons, lettuce that was more white parts than fresh green leaves. The reason for the one star is for the garlic bread and cannolis. 
  I feel as if I was part of a contest to " Find The Best Tourist Trap!
I would be curious to know where they found their chefs who cannot make a simple tomato sauce! Definitely NOT restaurant quality food. If this wasn't take out, I would have sent it back.
name: Joseph

text: A great breakfast spot close to the convention center, quick to take our order, very busy but we got out in plenty of time to get to the conference. Love the eggs benny options!
name: Kerry

text: I love the food and drinks, always have! I called 30 minutes before arrival for a group of 8. Told me the choices of seating I didn't want to sit back to back in booths obviously, so I told them two tables. 4 of us got there but since my whole party wasn't there they couldn't seat us(would've been nice to know this in advance). The others were only 10 minutes out. Well once the whole party was there I went back in they had taken me off the list because my whole party wasn't there!!!! So now we wait for another 30 minutes now in that time there was a free table but the other table still had 3 women just sitting there talking( they've already tipped out) so taking up a table for 6 just so they could talk. On a Saturday night one of the busiest nights why couldn't they politely ask those ladies to move leave something to accommodate all your other customers that wait for an hour or more. So of course we had to get two booths back to back. What is the purpose of calling a head and just because 4 of my party was going to be 10-15 minutes later you take me off the list and than not give us what I had requested when I phoned in  (main reason for my elderly mother) it was easier to sit at tables. So unfortunately I won't be back any time soon! Disappointed in the seating and not being told my whole party had to be there. What's the difference but you allow customers that's ate, paid and chatted for more than 30 min to stay at a big table but wouldn't let us sit but instead took me off the list WOW!!!!

text: Fake Closing time disappointed. Do not post closing time if it's not effective. I understand people needs to do their closing stuff. But seriously are you guys so stupid enough to put your closing time and not following it. Wasted my gas for nothing
name: Ted Anthony

text:
This is an outstanding wine bar especially if you are living on the north west side of town. We have been to the whispering vines south Meadows location which we also love, however the NW location has an excellent food menu. We enjoyed the bison short rib sliders with just the right amount of sweetness and the pretzel bun compliments this well. I enjoy bison, but if done poorly then it can be overly dry. these sliders hit the sweet point of being cooked well but maintaining natural moisture. The burger is also another hit on the menu. 


The highlight to the service was Brian L. We were looking for wine for our venue for our wedding and we chose to go with Brian. the level of service that he provided was top notch! we got tips on how much wine to purchase, which wines to get, and we even added some high end wines for our honeymoon and still enjoyed the 15% discount. The prices were the best that we could find, but the service will keep us coming back.
name: Casey

text:
great pizza and great service best pizza in the area
  they have whole pizza and pizza by the slice.  the rest of the food is great too.
name: Sean

text: Great place and great costumer service. The only reason I didn't not give it a 5 is due to the size of the location. They have so many costumers on busy days and it gets so confusing and packed. The food and everything that they offer is so good. It's rare to find places that offer everything that they do. They have anything from food to sweet and spicy deserts for any craving you might have.
name: Dannie'

text:
By far my favorite restaurant in the Tampa area!!!  I love the staff especially the owner who I have seen on base occasionly as well, so she must be military affiliated!  
 The food is amazing! if you love Korean  Food and culture definitely stop by.

 The well factor for me is the hot Ginger tea yummmmm

 It is a little bit pricey but worth every dollar and may be more ( But please don't increase your prices if you read this I can barely afford to come and see you as lol)
name: Chris

text:
Very hard-working employees and nice trendy concept to bring to Newtown! However, this place has many problems to work out if they would like a chance to last as a staple ice cream shop among others. 

The biggest thing that bothered our family is that the ice cream is overall just not that good. It's disappointing to wait in line for over an hour and have ice cream that tastes like chemicals and is freezer burnt. This should be a top priority to figure out soon. 

The layout of the place is complete mayhem. You walk in and go up to a large counter to order but then a line stretches into the other room before you return back to the original room to watch your ice cream get made. We went on a Saturday night and spent about an hour waiting in a line with about 10-15 people in front of us and the air conditioner in one room was broken. The line wrapped around the side of the counter and people were resting their hands and arms on the cart with ingredients which didn't seem very sanitary. 

The chalkboards are confusing and not placed in very helpful spots. There are pre-made "favorites" but you can also get anything mixed in from a list but also anything from that list on top but also some other stuff on top? You couldn't really see the chalkboards from where the line was and they also had crosses all over them and were smudged from people leaning. 

Overall, there are just a lot of problems that this place needs to work out if they want to last.
name: Hailey

text: The most delicious ramen I've had so far! A big ramen fan, i have tried almost every ramen place in Philly and many other cities. This is still one of the best meals i can remember. The bowl is a perfect mix of salty and umami with the pork belly so succulent and noodles light and fluffy. Terakawa absolutely lives up to the hype!
name: Ana

text: Use to live in center city, Philly so it's been a few years since we've last visited the city. Mo's was a place we use to visit frequently, whether on our way out for the night or for a nightcap on the way home (many times both). As such; I was looking forward to going back. I'm happy to say they didn't disappoint, they still have the best wings around and great selection of beers. The service is fast and the bartenders are very good. Miss Philly!
name: Steve

text: Wow.. Is 1 of the things I can say. We ordered 6 of there calzones including make your own plus dessert. Just omg.. over the top good. Polite curious service and a terrific price. What more would you want if I could give more stars I would
name: Beth

text:
I was in STL over the weekend and was looking for a good brunch place to eat at.  I stumbled across Red Oak!  

I'll start off with the atmosphere: 
It was a very calm, welcoming, and convenient place to eat.

Next is service:
I had the delight of meeting their front of house manager.  She was extremely attentive and helped me find what I wanted - which was something not too complicated.  I had a toasted bagel with egg, cheese and bacon, it was delicious.  The rest of the staff were all very kind, it felt like they were of the same family.  I had the pleasure of meeting the owner, we shared a couple of opinions about STL and small businesses.  He's incredibly passionate about the empire he setting out to create and I think his personality is one that STL needs.

Ultimately, Red Oak is a great place to eat.  I'd highly recommend it to anyone looking for a nice brunch.
name: Gunnar

text:
Didn't look like much but glad that we stopped. Order the cheesesteak with provolone and the Jakes special fries. Cheesesteak was delicious and the bread was soft and crispy. Meat was flavorful and was chopped up as opposed to strips of steak. 

Fries were awesome!  Fries with melted cheese and bacon and wiz on top. 

Get in my belly!!!!
name: Bradley

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The music was louder than it needed to be. For a busy night they handled it okay. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Will be back. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
Amazing!

I made a reservation here for my wife's birthday. As soon as we opened the heavy door to enter the restaurant it was clear we were going to either love or hate it here. We arrived at 7:45pm to be seated shortly after, the restaurant is pretty small and full of people, it was noisy, the guests were almost shouting over each other. Some people may see that as a bad thing but personally I just see everyone having a great time. If you can overcome how loud Sophia's can get I think you'll have a great experience!

We started with couple of appetizers, the carpaccio and calamari. The former outshined the latter but they were both really enjoyable. For entree's my wife got the scallops which stole the show by far! I had the swordfish risotto, is was creamy, rich and full of flavor. The tiramisu topped off the night for us, it had the perfect amount of sweetness and crunch. 

The service was great! And for a place that packed with people the food came out pretty fast.

Slightly on the pricey side but for the quality of food you get it's totally worth it. 

Highly recommend paying this gem a visit!
name: Sieraaj

text: Wow, what a great find this little place was! The beer selection was fantastic and my husband was thrilled to find a beer brewed from his hometown in N.Y. We shared the gyro burger which was huge and delicious. The fries must have been handcut- amazing! I've had better lemon orzo soup but overall, a great local hangout. Open one in Tampa please!
name: Donna

text:
My yearly update for Adam's and I am upgrading them to 5 Stars. 
I love their ribs. I mean, I truly LOVE their ribs. Half a rack or a Full rack, they are delicious. The way they torch the glaze on to those delicious ribs is amazing. My mouth waters for them, as I write this update. 

To repeat myself about the sides; I do not waver - I order their creamy cole slaw and the pit beans with burnt ends. Even as I am doing a low-carb diet, I cannot resist their pit beans. If you like the cole slaw at KFC, this slaw will blow your taste buds away. It is so similar, yet so much better in my opinion. 

I am also a big fan of their mouth watering burnt ends. To be honest, I have been known to take them home and toss them with buttered egg noodles. Serve them up with a side salad and you've got a great meal. 

Staff here is always friendly. It amazes me how they remember the majority of their regulars name. To be called by name as you enter, is a nice touch. 

I'll be back? - They serve the best ribs in the city

When: May 26, 2018
Why: Memorial Week-End BBQ
name: Steven

text: Went to Parx twice in the past 2 months for shows.  This time for Dane Cook was THE WORST!  The first time we went for Third Eye Blind, the casino was crowded and you could not get on a machine or near the electronic roulette.  This time is was even worst because there was not just one show, there were 2!  There were no machines available to play on and trying to get a drink at the bar was a total JOKE.  Not only did they give drinks to their "friends" who came up on the side of the bar, the bar manager was indignant when I said I've been told by 4 times someone would be right with us.  On top of that, when he came back he ran out of liquor while pouring the last drink and gave it to us with no liquor in it and charged  full price.  Lastly, the SMOKE CLOUD that hung over the entire casino was past disgusting.   Possibly Parx should consider moving the smoking section AWAY from the Xcite Center.  Lastly, we were excited to go to Chickie and Petes, only to be disappointed again.  Tasted like a salt fest - like they salted the food on top of the already seasoned Old Bay topping.  We got a lobster pizza which was clearly topped with shrimp (which we were picking off) because the pizza was so salty.  We were taking the breading off the chicken tenders for the same reason.  The only dish that was close to edible was the Lobster roll and they were skimpy with the lobster salad on it.  All in All - I'm DONE going there.  Do not WASTE YOUR TIME!  GO TO AC!  Your eyes and lungs will thank you!!!
name: Ginger

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was good and came out fast. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text:
Nestled in the middle of downtown Saint Louis Blondies Coffee and Wine bar is a great place to come and try something different. Their menu offers several different varieties of Breakfast all day options and Lunch. They have a great coffee menu which makes any early meal complimentary. 

The atmosphere is comfortable and very inviting. Sunny in some spots where outside canopy would help provide shade, but the warmth is a good bonus. There is a beautiful patio you can sit on if you want to take in the city! 

It is street parking so be sure to pay attention to availability as you pull up. It wasn't terribly busy at 10 AM on a Monday. It was quite easy to find a good parking spot. 

Definitely worth coming in. Eat the Gooey Cake! You won't be disappointed!!
name: Charles

text:
If you're shopping in jewelers row, or coming from one of the nearby hospitals - this is a great place to pop in for a bite. The kindness of the owner brought us into this restaurant for lunch as his first customers of the day. We had our kids with us, and he was very attentive and nice.
We enjoyed a delicious falafel sandwich and a chicken shawarma. Food came out hot and fresh.
name: Justin

text: I was excited to try this coffee shop, it being one of the more highly rated coffee shops in the city. I was thrown off with the location of the establishment, as it's situated in the middle of a bustling alleyway off the main roads. The layout of the shop itself is rather confusing, with the bathroom being the first thing you walk into upon entering. The decor is pretty on par with most modern coffee shops being modern rustic with some accent wallpaper bringing a cozy vibe. The coffee was decent, but didn't really set itself apart from other shops in my opinion. I ordered an oat milk latte which tasted standard. There's a cart in the corner where you can help yourself to sugar and cream, and almost everything was out when I was there, and I had to ask the people at the counter for almost everything. Overall not a bad cafe, just not as impressive to me as others in the city.
name: Simone

text: Quick find for dinner and drinks. Lots of regulars, where almost everyone knew everyone. But as a newbie outsider, I still enjoyed myself AND had the best Scallops dinner that I've ever had. The price being well under $20 is icing on the cake. Bartenders poured fine Guinness and made a killer dirty vodka martini. I will be back to try the Prime Rib and Lobster dishes!
name: John

text: Not bad for a quick meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was good and came out fast. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Not bad for a quick meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It was crowded but still moved along. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
Worst service ever. Ordered a number 1 with cheese and diet dr pepper
paid for my order and noticed no cheese on the receipt. I asked. I was told "you did not order cheese" I clearly did and the cashier did not put it in. My drink was handed to me soaking wet with soda all over it to which I had to clean myself. When I arrived back at work, not only did I NOT receive diet dr pepper but my #1 (four singles) turned into 2 doubles. Awful customer service and they appear to not care at all. The woman in front of me was smart enough to taste her drink before leaving and I see she handed hers back as well
name: Gregg

text: We wanted to give this a try and we are so glad we did! Emily was fantastic! We sat at the bar and she was very busy but she moved right along with it. We are only here a few days but will be back at least once. It is so refreshing to see someone who loves their job and makes every customer feel welcome!
name: Becky

text: The only thing I liked about this restaurant was the building it was in....the food was not good, the cheese dip was super bland and I barely saw my server and we were the only ones in the building....I don't think I'll be back :/
name: Laurel

text: I love Starbucks. The lines can be long but service always nice and consistent. The lattes are always good. Everything is prepared down to a science- I used to work for Starbucks. It is actually impressive what this company does. I'm a fan! Love the banana nut bread when I need a quick bite.
name: Ashley

text:
Goodness gracious....how did I not find this place earlier. 
5 Star Juice place all day long 

The juice menu here is a delight to find. One of the few places that you can find green juice that isn't tainted by the addition of sherbet or yogurt in order to make it taste sugary. A great selection of juices that will keep you healthily for years to come. 

Certainly juice is not all they have.  That was all that I had today but the menu had a few items that caught my eye. Specifically the grilled cheese with tomato soup mad me think of my childhood and a blustery day. Now, there are not that many blustery days here in Tucson but this dish will definitely be calling my name soon. 

I was impressed with the clean feel and the friendly staff. I have to admit I didn't exactly give the easiest order with my juice and I had several modifications. However, the staff not only handled it with ease but also with a respectful, friendly, no problem, attitude. They made me feel good about my order and executed it flawlessly. 

I will definitely be back and we recommend you do not hesitate to stop in.
name: JJ

text: Overpriced and incredibly slow, they took the fast out of fast casual and the prices aren't even casual. Avoid.
name: J

text: Great food awesome value! Needs to get air fixed but VERY CLEAN great service wonderful portions best Mexican I've had in near Nashville by far don't get shrimp though because they do cook it too long
name: Tricia

text: Ordered my food and it came hot and on time.  Two platters were ordered, ox tails and curry shrimp. Sides were peas and rice, cabbage, sweet plantains and sweet fried dumplings. Everything was delicious and definitely worth the price although I originally wanted the escovitch fried whiting, but was told they were out. I was very happy with my alternative choice and will be going back to get the fish. Great food!!
name: Natasha

text: I love this local family owned spot. One of the best chargrilled oysters in the city and many other great seafood options. On a recent visit I had the grilled redfish which was delicious. Always friendly service and good food. I have eaten here many times and never been disappointed. If you find yourself in this neighborhood make sure to hit this spot.
name: Jimmy

text: Not only is the food DELICIOUS but they accommodated my family at 9:35 when they close at 10. Wait staff was super courteous and friendly even though it was late. The food came out quickly and was as tasty as always. Never been disappointed and I'd come more often if I didn't live so far away.
name: Maria

text: This location is awesome, like all the others. I always find a BFC whenever I'm in the area. Awesome burgers.
name: Matt

text: Love the vibe love the people parking was a little difficult but once we managed that the food was fresh hot and delicious
name: Jeremy

text: Great new place in Hendersonville. The service is personal and quick. The food is great if you love Thai. I recommend the drunken noodles and Thai tea!!! I highly suggest. The inside has limited seating so it's a great option to go. Lunch was a good time to go and sit in the restaurant. I will definitely try the bubble tea next.
name: Rachel

text:
I have been here three times while in town for work. 

This location has awesome scenery, which is a huge advantage for them. Parking is easy and the wait to be seated didn't exceed thirty minutes. You just can't beat a yummy meal by the seaside.

Down to the reason why you're taking time to read the words I'm typing: Food! 

Get the artichoke appetizer. Get it. Just don't listen when they tell you it'll feed five. I ate two just on my own in one trip. Well-seasoned with great dip. 

Steaks are on-par with your average good restaurant. I get mine medium-well (please don't judge me too heavily-- I had food poisoning once and can't seem to get back to blood). Even with the medium-well order, the chef kept it tender and juicy, but crisp on the outside without blackening the whole thing. 

Great potatoes across the board. No complaints at all. 

Ice cream! Holy cow; check out that serving! Worth it in size and taste. 

Now, the last (sad) bit. They really, really struggle with having a busy night. Our group (15) waited 30 minutes before we were offered drinks then several drinks were incorrect. We waited 45 minutes after receiving our drinks to give our orders. That theme carried throughout the evening with refills and our orders being wrong and delayed. A couple meals had to be sent back twice because the server brought the wrong food. I gave up and took the third meal even though it was wrong. 

Two stars down on this one because it really tanked our plans for the evening by taking 3.5 hours for dinner.
name: Derek

text: Great food, horrible service. The wait staff has been less than desirable for a few months now, but our latest visit makes me never want to return. It's a shame because the food is good. The restaurant was mostly empty, with plenty of people working last night, but the wait time for getting anything, like forks to eat, drink refills, and a straw that we asked for 3 times, was out of control. Everyone there seamed to have the same problem. The staff seamed more interested in socializing in the back than doing their jobs.
name: Jason

text:
A great variety on the menu. Loved the London Fog tea I had. Also had banana chocolate chip bread. A wee bit on the dry side but still tasty. 
The cats are the main attraction and our early appointment was definitely the wise choice. The cats were perky and frisky and so fun to play with!
I definitely recommend for anyone wanting to love on some kitties while spending money at a worthy establishment.
name: Jennifer

text: My wife and I have eaten here at least 8 times over the last 2-3 years, usually prior to attending the theatre. It is much better than your typical hotel restaurant, which you would expect, as this is the JW Marriott. The food has consistently been excellent. The menu, which has changed in the last year, offers a variety of delicious Northern Italian style dishes, including fresh pastas, wood fired pizzas, and creative appetizers. Heartier fare like filet mingon, roast chicken and pork are also available. The wait staff, especially Josh and Zacharias, are attentive, knowledgeable and interesting.  Last night, we shared a delicious starter of assorted sautéed mushrooms over arugula with a light vinaigrette, followed by the beef carpaccio, chopped salad and the grilled salmon with roasted potatoes and broccolini. Everything was spot on delicious. They also have a good wine list focused on Italian wines, with many excellent wines available by the glass. It is a large restaurant, so you can usually get a table without a reservation. Cost is typical for similar high quality restaurants in Indy; we spent about $50 per person including wine.  We have brought friends and out of town guests here, and we plan to keep returning to this place in the years to come.
name: Greg

text: My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
Nice restaurant downtown Nashville.  I started with the fresh raw oyster and they were fresh and full of flavor.  I then ordered the beef brisket and it was very tender, flavorful and it came with cheese GRITS!   Loved it!

Also tried the " bless your heart" salad with fried chicken.  Let me tell you the chicken was fantastic! Lightly breaded not greasy and great flavor.  The southerners know how to fry food.  

Great service, food and atmosphere!  I will be back next time I'm in Nashville.
name: Adriano

text: Another example of an over hyped local watering hole turned tourist trap/wannabe nationwide franchise. If you can get past the hostest throne (it sits 4-5 feet above ground level) which also for some reason accepts their take out orders. Picture awkwardly standing in a tiny vestibule as customers ask the price on a cup of extra marinara. Be prepared for oily menus, dirty booths and a cook that comes and chills at the bar while your waiting 20 minutes for your freezer burnt fried calamari. I can't complain about the server, and the mussels w red still managed to be enjoyable but mix that with the embarrassingly stale bread and a level of cleanliness I'm still thanking God I didn't get food poisoning from and voilà, 2 stars. If you're looking to stuff your face with a bucket of crab fries and about a dozen beers you're barking up the right tree.
name: Mark

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, bc everything else nearby had a wait. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would absolutely visit again. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: Went for lunch. Definitely a breakfast spot. Food was below average but service ok. They are applying for liquor license. One future redeeming quality. The decor is bright but navigating the layout can be like a slalom course. My recommendation is go for breakfast.
name: Jim

text:
It wouldn't be a trip through Nashville without stopping at Hattie B's. While I do need to stop at Prince's at some point, this place is great. The parking at this location is terrible but... Let's talk about the food.

Nashville hot chicken is one of those foods that defies description. Spicy fried chicken? No, that's not it. The combination of seasonings and heat make their recipe delicious. Perfectly light breading keeps it crispy and the heat level is on point.

Sides are solid, though I wish they had a greens option outside of collards. Sauces are classic ranch, bc, and honey mustard, with plenty for dipping with each order. No one wants to pay for extra sauce! 

Be careful to not show up too hungry, the line is at or out the door at lunch and dinner on weekends. Expect 20-30 minutes until you see food. 

The beer selection is great but I'm usually driving through when I come here so I haven't been able to sample.
name: Joe

text: Horrible service. Ordered a meal and waited and waited. How can a bbq place not have ribs and pulled pork, baked beans and coleslaw ready to just plate and serve?  And to top it off the waitress gives us an attitude.  But. The food was good
name: Kendra

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Wouldn't really choose this place again. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. The food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kinda leveled off after a few bites. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: I think it can be a tad pricey but it's consistently a tasty and convenient place to grab something sweet. Cappuccino and chocolate are my fav duo.
name: Marissa

text: The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Not bad for a quick meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Well I hate to say it because I love eating here! My girlfriend and I decided we were going to stop in about twenty thirty mins before you guys close... we order and sit down and I come back in to wait for the food it's normally pretty quick.....
