text:
I went to the Urban Farmer with my wife and grandkids.  Really a great treat, although a bit expensive.  My wife loves the food there.  She had 
the homemade English muffins - she couldn't get enough of them - I think she literally had five of them.   She also had the 21-day dry aged New York Steak.   She said it was better than the Prime Rib, where she goes every Wednesday for lunch.   She also tried the 4oz of medium-rare grass-fed tenderloin with a side of the baked fingerling potato tart.  She loved that too.  She also had three glasses of red wine.  For dessert, she got the butterscotch sundae and chocolate whiskey cake - two desserts!  She was really hungry today!

The grandkids had soup, salmon, steak and sides of Brussel sprouts and mushrooms.   Lenny and Larry also had the duck and chicken, which they thought were delicious. Little Shlomo had a panini with bacon, which he loved.   Ace got the farm burger and scarfed it down pretty quickly. He also ordered the deviled eggs, which he loved!   The grandkids tried a variety of desserts: farmer bon bons, chocolate peanut butter torte, and lemon cheesecake brulee.  They all shared and loved them.  

All-in-all a great experience.  Service was as excellent as the food.  My wife went a little overboard on her ordering, so she had to take a doggy bag home with her, although she ate most of the leftovers in the car on the way home!   She works out a lot, which seems to keep her trim, despite her rather hefty appetite at times.
name: Richard

text: LOVED this place! The owner stopped by our table twice - we were celebrating an engagement and a birthday. Our server was super attentive and friendly. And the food is DELISH. We had the lumpia (yum), shrimp appetizer, a sushi roll, the cauliflower (yum), garlic crab noodles (yum), beef lollipop things (didn't try them), bao buns (didn't try them but looked good) and a dessert cupcake which was super yuuummm!!
name: Kara

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Definitely coming back. Not bad for a quick meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better online than it did in person. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
Recent winner of fried chicken fest and only a week later I'm back for more. What can I say that's some damn good fried chicken. 

First time going to their physical restaurant so I decided to mix things up. I got their tenders, Mac and cheese, and coleslaw. It did not disappoint. I normally order more than I think I'll eat so I can bring some home, but since I wasn't going home after I got the 3 piece tender. I still had a half a tender left over and it was big. 

Tenders are just as good as the bone in fried chicken. They are crispy, seasoned well, and I can stuff them in my fast even faster. 

Thumbs up they have a bunch of locations find one and chow down.
name: Jordan

text: I waited 15 minutes at the bar for someone to pay attention.  Music was loud and the place was dirty.  I had to leave without ordering.
name: Luis

text: Good food, very reasonable prices, hand cut steaks,   In house ground hamburger.  EXCELLENT BURGERS, Pizza, salads, wings.  Oh yea,  they have CHEESE CURDS, a great side to go with the SPECTACULAR CHILI!!!  Get There!
name: John

text: I didn't think this $13 avocado toast was worth it. And my husbands chicken fried chicken was just ok. We came here because it's one of the few places with no wait
name: Megan

text: Well a buddy of mine and I got this the other night. The pizza was good don't get me wrong. We got pepperoni and bacon and it was a thin crust pizza of course. The bacon had a lot of gristle at times unfortunately but overall was delicious. I would get donatos again. We ordered online and then picked it up and we only had to wait about 5 minutes for our food after arriving. The staff was attentive. I'm giving this place 3 stars because while it was good there was nothing special about it in my opinion. It's good if you like thin crust pizza though. Also, you can't miss that pepperoni door when you go.
name: Laura

text:
On the southeast corner of US19 and Alternate 19, there is a new restaurant in town. Taking residence in the old BobEvan's building is a little jewel named Cosmo's Family Restaurant. We have now eaten there 3 times as I like to get a cross sampling of food before I leave a review.  3 meals, 3 home runs!

Even this past week when I had breakfast for supper. Eggs, sausage, hashbrowns, and frenchtoast. My husband ordered spaghetti and meatballs. They were out of meatballs so substituted a piece of chicken parmesan instead. He was delighted and the flavor was 
outstanding.  The pictures shown of the food correctly represent the items served. Add to the good food, the ambience of a family restaurant in a lovely setting, many steps above a dinner, but still very casual and comfortable. It would be perfect for business breakfasts or lunch meetings. Ditto with Birthday parties or dating venues.

Our last two visits we were served by Shiloh, a very skilled waitress who seemed to anticipate our every need. This girl gets it done with a smile always. Working with her was Johhny, full of old world charm and very accomodating. You've got to know we have found our new "Go-To" restaurant in Holiday!
name: Bonnie

text: We came here on a Saturday night while visiting Nashville. The place itself is very cute and has a great atmosphere. Overall, the food was just "okay."  The drinks were morbidly overpriced.  We ordered: the crispy shrimp, which were individually wrapped in wonton paper and deep fried. The clams, in a harissa broth that disappointed. We did love the seasonal gnocchi, which was cooked perfectly and the sauce was rich and complex, however, it was paired with peaches that were not ripe and brought down the dish significantly. Had the peaches been ripe, there would have been no complaints on the pasta dish. Service was good.
name: Brechen

text: Just ordered 5 sandwiches: tuna, roast beef, Italian, ham, and turkey online for delivery. What a joke. First, why offer delivery and then go through the whole order, take my payment and then give me my pickup location! Second I pick up 1 paper bag containing 5 sandwiches. That's a sure sign they are paper thin. Get them home to 5 starving people only to be completely disappointed by dry lettuce packed rolls and fishy tuna. What a waste of time and $31 bucks. Bubbye Jimmy Johns...
name: Murphys

text: Not bad for a quick meal. Anyway, the service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Also, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. Idk, pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
The food at this restaurant was just okay. I really loved the pear and pickled grape salad(SO good), but my main course was very meh. The staff seemed confused over all and the service was poor. The wait staff was very friendly, but just very slow and served many other tables before ours, even though we had been there longer. They also made mistakes with our order. Not terrible, but probably wouldn't come back.
The only plus is that if you purchase an entree you can get $0.25 martinis(limit 3).
name: Julianna

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. It was crowded but still moved along. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: If you want Brunch on Sunday and you want really good food!  Maggie Mae's is a great place to go!
name: Jay

text: OMG! OMG again! i can only rate the bakery items as i have never eaten anything other than the pastries.  the lemon curd kringle is absolutely the best pastry i have ever eaten in my life (all the kringles are great, but this one is a bite of heaven).  absolutely divine!  the butter ring is another favorite, as well as the cinnamon danish.  i try to stay away from sugar these days, but this a once in a blue moon treat and is so worth it!  they are a bit pricey compared to lots of places (but even if they charged $25 for a single slice, it would be worth every penny of $24.99!)
name: Darryl

text: Wow!  This spot was amazing. We had the Pietro. The crust was perfect, toppings so flavorful. The bay fries were also very good. FYI: pizza is quite large. Could feed 4- value buy!
name: Kunoor

text: This place is in a nice space in downtown Tucson. The food here is good, but not great. The portions are small for the price. The bar offers a few craft beers and nicer cocktails. The takeout is packed in durable containers and the service is good.
name: Erick

text: The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would absolutely visit again. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Each time I come to Philly I try a new Cheesesteak place but none of them compare to Dalessandro's! The cheesesteaks are flavorful, the potion is huge, and the onions are cooked to perfection. 

This place can get super crowded but it's soooo worth the wait
name: Dominique

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. You can tell they care about customer experience here. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Would absolutely visit again. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Not sure though.
name: User

text:
This Sushi RESTURANT is exceptional the service was great but most of all the food was just fantastic 
If you are in Green Valley try this restaurant you will be surprised. Very very good I give it 5 stars.
name: Fred

text: Waited 45 minutes for a waitress. She brought us our food and never came back. We had to go find her to pay the bill. The bartender used HIS HAND to scoop ice into my drink. Will never go back ever again.
name: Heather

text: Not gonna lie this place is amazing and I do love their egg noodles here. I'm not an avid chinese food  eater but omg this place is amazing!!! I haven't had something as authentic and traditional as this place. I definitely give them prop for their Szechuan cooking style for sure.
name: Andrew

text:
Sometimes with Tex-Mex it's easy to feel like if you've been to one, you've been to them all; however, every once in a while you run across one that's doing enough right that you want to make sure they get the love they deserve. This location of El Mason is doing just that!

The food was really delicious, arrived promptly, was hot & tasted fresh. Our server was funny, made good margarita suggestions & never made us feel neglected. 

For those times when you just want some chips and salsa, a strong margarita & delicious Tex-Mex...this is the spot!
name: Kristen

text: Stay two nights with my mother for her birthday. I was a little disappointed in the room the sheets didn't seem like they were clean they seem like they were used and they were very itchy. And then they didn't change their sheets for next day or make the beds or anything. The buffet was delicious and a great deal. I don't know for sure if I'll ever stay at the Eldorado again. I used to stay there all the time. Seems to me they need to upgrade the room some.
name: Stephanie

text: I had read that this dim sum restaurant had opened in the French Quarter. Since, I I was in town for a conference, my colleague and I  decided to try Dian Xin for an early dinner. We got there when it opened so there wasn't a wait at all. We had ordered the soup dumplings, Peking style minced pork noodles and steamed pork dumplings. The soup dumplings were well-made and very tasty. The sauce for the  Peking style minced pork noodles (Zhajiangmian)  was almost spot-on--it was a little saltier than my preference.  It is not a full dim sum restaurant.  They have shumai, several types of dumplings, chive cake, several kinds of buns (baos) and jianbing (Chinese crepes), It's a nice hole-in-the-wall chinese restaurant.
name: Shoon

text:
Closed " until further notice"

It is fast food so ...

I found the food fresh, good variety, healthy, low fat, very salty. 

The restaurant, tables, and restrooms are plentiful and clean. 

I going down the cafeteria line the staff tends to yell at you about what you want from 10 feet ahead of you. This really hurts the experience because:
1) you don't know what you want because it is yet to far away. 
2) you can't hear because they are screaming at you
3) it raises the tension because the server in front of you is screaming at the person 10 feet behind you. 

It contributes to a hurry and get it done attitude rather that a friendly "how can I help you" atmosphere. I am sure these highly compensated employees time is valuable, but not screaming is nice

text: The atmosphere and service was good, and the food was decent, but I didn't feel like it was anything to write home about. This wouldn't be my first choice (or even second or third) for hot chicken in Nashville, but the beignets are good and I liked the wings!
name: Mugdha

text: Great meal tonight at salt rock. Maggie our waitress was a gem and full of great information and suggestions. I had the t-bone, it was tender and cooked to perfection. I added the brussell sprouts. Wife had the parmesan encrusted mahi. Excellent. Such a great place. Will be back again
name: Joe

text: Yuck! They served us 4-5 days rotten chicken. The chicken was discolored and had a disgusting smell. It tasted sour and we were almost about to vomit. No wonder why this place is always empty.
name: Raihan

text: The food here is decent. Service was good. Atmosphere is decent, and it's nice that there is ample space between the tables (I always hate when restaurants cram people in right on top of eachother). However, the food presentation was lacking. While the prices weren't necessarily high, they also weren't low enough that one would expect things to come in plastic cups (rather than glasses), or the tacos and chips/salsa to come in little red plastic baskets (rather than on a plate of some sort), or the $9 margaritas to come in a regular cup (rather than some sort of margarita glass), or the water to be self-serve in cheap plastic tumblers from one of those big orange beverage canisters like construction workers use on job sites.

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. Food was fresh and service was quick. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. I had a better visit than I expected to. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. A couple small things kept adding up. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. For the price I expected more than this. Not bad for a quick meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Sunday Brunch here is awesome! They have a pianist playing jazzy tunes and the bloody Mary's are delicious! You'll wanna get here early bc it gets packed quick.
name: Jess

text: The food is really good. I had a chance to try their grilled oysters, gator sausage and burgers and this place did not disappoint. I wasn't too pleased with their buffalo chicken wraps but my visit as a whole was good. The service was 5 stars the food is a solid 4.
name: Joseph

text:
I ordered the Mona Lisa for lunch. Perfect! The olive spread and the diced tomato spread likely take any sandwich to the next level, I would be sure to add it to any sandwich I order here.

Also, the staff was friendly, speedy and inviting.
name: Tiara

text:
Very good boba spot being from California. Boba is cooked well and chewy which other places can be over cooked or under. 

The owner is super friendly and asked to try the drinks before we walked out in case he had to adjust any.

Next time we're in town we will try their poke bowls :)

text: ...i instructed the driver to come to the side door, but he went to the front door, which is a different tenant ...the driver forgot my drink ...he brought it back, but it was the wrong drink ...i called the shop, they informed me they don't carry the drink i ordered, even though it's on grubhub's menu, so they just substituted it with what they have (i don't drink pepsi) ...the pizza had almost ZERO cheese on it (see pic) ...the fries were under-cooked and VERY soggy ...they did'nt cut my sandwich in half (which, i admit, is a small thing, but, on top of everything else, was very annoying) ...it's like they just threw my order together, rushed it out, and did'nt give a crap about quality. (to give credit where it's due: the steak was very good)

text:
There are a few North Indian/Pakistani restaurants in the outer suburbs of New Orleans, and this one is the farthest of them, way out in Kenner (~1/2 hour from the city center). If you're there, this place seemed respectable. I received my takeout quickly (~10 minutes), and it was an eminently flavorful lentil dish with plenty of whole spices, and some samosas drowned in chickpeas and accoutrements.

I have to say I was mildly annoyed that their entrees come by default with naan. That being said, you can ask for rice instead. Also, the menu probably needs a rewrite just to be clearer to those people who don't know what all this stuff is.

All of this brings the place in just a tad below the other similar restaurant I tried and reviewed near the airport (at which I ordered the same thing for comparison). But I liked both of them and frankly, I haven't found anywhere in Orleans Parish where you can get this food for this price.
name: John

text:
My son and I decided to stop in for a late lunch Sunday. It was a beautiful day so we sat outside. The outside seating was on the other side of the restaurant away from the noise of the highway. Great choices of beer. We had the Ahi tuna which was ok. My sone had the general tsao turkey burger with cole slaw. He said it was great. Not too spicy. I had the prime rib sandwich and homemade baked beans. The beans rocked as did the sandwich. The watermelon cake was ok. I'd try something else next time. A
I'll definitely go back.
name: Doris

text: Alligator sausage and veggie gumbo was awesome! We ate outside because it was a cooler evening and Getting darker out. There was some live music and if you want traditional French Quarter dining - this is it

text: The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. For a busy night they handled it okay. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: I enjoyed a meal two days ago so I came back. I got the k tacos and they were good. However, I'm on a carb free diet so I came back today and told them I'm not interested in having the tortilla. They refused to serve the meal without that. I left without eating because it's wrong that they'd rather waste food than accommodate paying customers. I'm a foodie and have traveled the country and ate at many restaurants and I've never had a restaurant REFUSE to accommodate dietary needs/restrictions. If you care about sustainability, this isn't the restaurant for you.
name: Rahel

text: I really enjoyed this place!! The server was so helpful and knowledgeable. The drink menu is insane and the food was sooo good! You can tell they really care about quality and the experience. I cannot wait to go back!
name: Foodie

text:
My all time favorite restaurant.  Wondering where to take people when they come in town for a visit?  Want some awesome food for a date night?  Tired of the usual and just need dinner?  

As far as I am concerned - no visit to New Orleans is complete without a visit to this quintessential New Orleans spot - and I'm a born and bred local.  

  We've eaten at the bar on an impromptu trip, but make a reservation for a group of 5 or more!  I absolutely love the decor, the amazing art by Frenchy all over the walls, the paint - even the bathroom is an event.  

This is great for large groups (see about reservations) and the cornbread can't touch anything I can make!  The salad with the fried oyster - delicious!  Make sure and get the alligator cheesecake and try the fresh watermelon mojito!  I've tried so many things on the menu and haven't had one thing I didn't love.  

I always ask about Godzilla - it's my favorite and not on the menu.  It's fried green tomatoes, stuffing, and topped with a fried softshell crab.  You can literally taste heaven. 

Celebrities are known to show up here, but be cool, they're there to eat delicious food - not be bothered.  If I can be cool while sitting next to GEORGE LUCAS - you can too!  But if you see Jack - say hi!  

It's also family friendly too.  The waitstaff goes above and beyond and will spoil my little guy with a plate of french fries just for him!
name: Celeste

text: Pretty darn good barbecue! And a quick in and out, perfect for a lunchtime spot! Decent prices as well
name: Sienna

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. Food was fresh and service was quick. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..

text: I visited yesterday and the food was delicious as always but we were highly pleased with service from Stacey and Virginia who were very kind and more than happy to help us with our questions and requests, I've had some bad experiences with employees at that location before but these ladies were above and beyond kind!
name: Brittney

text:
It's honestly surprising that I haven't written a review for this gem of a place yet. 

In one word, I would say this place is a "staple".

My fiance and I have visited Tucson for work for two weeks at a time roughly once every other month and we HAVE NOT FAILED to visit a Beyond Bread location each time. It is our "healthy-ish, definitely delcious" meal, especially on road trips out of Tucson. 

We usually order a club, though every sandwich we have ordered has been spectacular. The club is about $13, but I have shared this sandwich with two grown men without any problems -- just serve yourself a VERY reasonable quarter of the double stacked sandwich. The side salad is extremely fresh and I would be surprised if you had any issues with your order -- barring the fact that you ordered it with an ingredient you didn't like. 

Service is outstanding and I have never had a poor interaction with any of the cashiers. Samples are available at the front somewhere near the cashier -- useful for anyone having "hangry" symptoms. Their unsweet tea is delicious.

This place is seriously a stable and have had NUMEROUS Arizona native classmates (I live in Texas) tell me to visit Beyond Bread if I'm in Tucson. 

WORTH THE TRIP.
name: Hazel

text: What a disappointment.  I was a big fan of Harry's Seafood.  I was hoping Banks kept some of the favorites.  They didn't, new menu with minimal overpriced selections.  Portions are a joke.  Service was poor as well.  Hope they make adjustments to bring back some of the Harry's menu staples.

text:
I went here a few weeks ago and had an experience wherein my server was fantastic but the food was sub-par. Specifically my entree, the teriyaki bowl, had undercooked chicken. I was in a rush so I just paid and sent an email after the fact.

To their credit the management sent me a $25 gift card, and I returned a few days ago and ordered the same meal. I had the same waitress - again, she's great - and I Made sure to specify to tell the kitchen to cook the chicken well done.

My meal was better this time, but I was pretty shocked to overhear a group of servers/kitchen staff nearby (NOT MY SERVER!) near the register area making denigrating, crass comments about the physical appearance of a couple who were seated near me.

I understand people need to let off steam at work, even though in this case I think what they were saying was totally unacceptable, but to do it within earshot of other patrons was grotesque. I did write in again to report this, and I really hope the staff in question were let go.

I will never return to this location.

text:
Everything about this place was simply OK, making it a 3 star rating for my taste. 

My husband and I were visiting New Orleans for the first time and relied on Yelp to provide us food rec's. Oceana was listed as the #1 spot to check out. We should've listened to our Uber driver on the way there (the locals always know the best spots anyways), when he said it's not his favorite. Why did we think it was just OK?

=Food didn't taste spectacular, stuff that you could buy at any state fair
=The food is EXTREMELY overpriced for what you get, you are paying for the name of the restaurant, not the quality of food
=The place felt kinda dirty (don't get me started on the bathroom)

We had excellent service though. Our waitress was friendly, prompt and even provided a recommendation for a local beignet place. Overall, this place was disappointing for the hype it has. I would suggest going elsewhere for some authentic New Orleans meals.

text: Surprisingly good breakfast. Great huevos rancheros and delicious blueberry pancakes. Spicy Bloody Mary. Lots of good beer options. Kid friendly. Plan on going back.

text:
Ventured out in the cold today with a friend to try out Asian Express Hotpot for the first time during YEG's Chinatown Week!

After reading fellow Yelpers reviews, I knew we were in for a treat and most excited to lose my hotpot virginity!

Located just  a couple blocks off of the main 97th street Chinatown businesses and next to a couple of the local shelters.

I arrived early after reading the reviews of needing to wait even with reservations at time.  They opened a few minutes early and I slipped in before 11am.  I was pleasantly surprised by the beautiful and spacious interior and immediately knew this was gonna be a winner.

My friend and I both ordered the Chinatown Week Set Menu - $15

Appetizer: two golden fried buns (served with condensed milk) 
Main: Hotpot (soup base, choice of four items, vegetable basket)

The server let us know that we would actually be allowed to order a bonus 5th item and explained the options to us.

My friend opted for the Thai Curry Base and I opted for their spiciest Base called Spicy Soup.  Both were out on tables within minutes - and soon started to simmer and boil filling the air with the most delicious aromas ever.

Less than five minutes later our fresh meat/fish, vegetable, and noodles arrived.  I hadn't realized or understood thoroughly that they'd be bringing a large array of vegetables in addition to what I selected.  This was a very pleasant addition and as it turns out - the veggies were one of the best parts!

I was excited to try the sweet potato noodles - they cooked surprisingly fast at just a minute or two.  

The shrimp were large but did come with heads on and I had to ask for napkins several times proclaiming that I was probably the messiest adult (aka toddler) that had ever eaten at their fine establishment.  The waitress was nice but didn't get it and kept bringing me only one napkin.  Seriously, I was like a toddler with sauces and soup and ladles and shrimp heads flying.

Our waitress offered to make us her special dipping sauce - and it was delish!  I'm pretty sure it had sesame oil, hoison, peanut sauce, and hot red chili peppers.  About half way through the meal I remembered that I could make my own sauces and hopped over to the seasoning/sauce/topping mecca and created away. 

Shortly thereafter the fried buns with condensed milk came out - warm, a bit of crunch to the outside but soft inside, and sweet condensed milk.  Definitely yummy but not really an appetizer and not quite a mid meal bite.  Really tasted more like a dessert but yummy none the less.

All in all, my friend and I spent just over an hour here and had a wonderful time and are already planning on returning.  Upon paying at the till they offered us ice cream which I found odd at that point but thoughtful none the less.  Maybe next time I'll save room for ice cream we were far too full to give it a try today. 

If you can get out here before Chinatown week is up - you'll snag all this for the low price of $15, but have no fear - their prices appeared to be quite reasonable at only a few dollars more at menu price.

(After reading more Yelp reviews, I definitely need to come back with the hubs and try the all you can eat option - giving it all a whirl!  This would be great in a group of 4 or 6 to try even more soup bases.  I also read that you can get split pots but that didn't seem to be an option at lunch.  Maybe more of the all you can eat dinner time variety?)
name: Kristin

text: NOTE **the online menu does not yet have the vegan mozzarella sticks listed, only the vegetarian ones.  The in restaurant menu does have the vegan ones listed.  They are available! Hopefully they'll update the online menu soon to avoid confusion

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Would return. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: I have spent my entire life not believing in ghosts or spirits, until tonight. We did a haunted tour at an old infants asylum and actually communicated with spirits! I was extremely skeptical of it, and even thought my friends were in on it and just trying to mess with me, but I held the wands in my hands and know I wasn't moving them. We met a little girl and she went in every room with us. I kept asking the same question different ways to trick her but she got it every time. We also talked to a doctor and a couple nuns... it was a very surreal experience. Alexis was our guide and she was fantastic! This was the best part of the whole trip.
name: Travis

text: This is our second visit and while the first was excellent this visit was Off the Charts because of Brett our waiter. His suggestion for a pizza was Dead On. That being said he talked us into the cheese cake......The Best we ever had. Hands down best Pizza in Tucson
name: Mark

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Had the best meal at acme oyster house. The hour wait in line was worth it. The only pitfall was sharing a large table with a rude, dizzy girl that thought she would give her unsolicited opinion on our order and said 'oooo you ordered oysters. They taste like chewing on dirty socks.' I'm glad My boyfriend told her 'so do you chew on dirty socks often.'
name: Liz

text:
We started the evening with grilled oysters. They were incredible!!  Had po boy bread for dipping in the oyster juice and grilled butter.
My husband had a seafood pasta that had shrimp and crab with a deliciously rich Alfredo sauce.
I had a grilled shrimp salad with Mediterranean dressing.  The shrimp were delicious as was the dressing.  The salad was plentiful but was mostly iceberg lettuce. (Blah)
The waitress was attentive and cheerful.
name: Tonya

text:
My wife is a huge Anglophile, so having had taken her to England a few years back, this was my next-best cheaper option. We got reservations for the day after Christmas (weekends are fairly fully booked weeks out) around noontime. We arrived a little early and were warmly welcomed and quickly seated. The room is a bit small and tight, but brightly painted and elegantly decorated.

For our first visit, we agreed that we had to experience the full afternoon tea. We were not disappointed. It's a lot of food! The sandwiches were good and very filling. We happened to like variety we received and ended up taking some home as we were full. The scones were very good--especially with the lemon curd and clotted cream. The golden raisins in cream was also good. A nice experience but rather pricey for what it is. We'd go à la carte next time. 

The gift shop is small but well stocked.
name: Tim

text:
Disclaimer: I post this paraphrased review through the perspective of my 74-year-old aunt, who has never been to a Five Guys until now. She is a recent arrival to the contiguous U.S. from Puerto Rico in the aftermath of last year's horrendous hurricane season. Yes, I regard this place as "the superior burger joint" among chain restaurants. But her reaction to her first Bacon Cheeseburger was simply too cute to not share with the world!

"I must say that this is the best cheeseburger I've ever had! This leaves the one at ********** (business name redacted due to its ultimately inconsequential nature) in the dust! I mean...this is no ordinary patty! This is more like a steak hiding in a hamburger costume! You don't taste that old fatty displeasure you get from a drive-thru at all. And these veggies are so fresh! I'm actually a bit sad now that the burger is gone and I can't get it back."

I think she likes it...
name: Roy

text: Everything was great.  Wonderful salad bar, delicious and plentiful meat selection, we were quickly served every cut that we requested and they brought our favorites back often without us even having to ask!  Dining room was fun and lively without being too loud.  This is one of our favorites!
name: Trish

text: Adorable place, local farm sourced food. Delicious food. Best latte I've ever had! And I'm picky. Love this place!!
name: Jennifer

text:
I'll start with food first. I ordered masala dosa and it was just okay. Nothing crazy horrible but slightly off. Again if that's what you're in the mood for, it might hit the spot if you're hungry enough lol. Also ordered papri chat. The imlee chutney (tamrid chutney) on the chat was excessively sweet. I would pass.

On the topic of service. The guy behind the counter is extremely rude. Selective rude lol. I'm Pakistani and I assume he realized this when I gave him my credit card to pay. Upon reading my name he kept repeating it in full everytime he would refer to me. Unnecessarily so lol. Like passively racist in a way but I wasn't sure haha. So there is a Indian movie about the Pakistani and Indian tension. He refered to me as the name of one of the characters from that movie (when he took a break from repeating my full name). I let it go cause I thought it was funny. But he was not laughing. Lol 

I went back with a friend a few days later (only to show to my friend if the guy behind the counter was actully doing it on purpose on not lol have too much time on my hand I know). Food wise, we ordered chole bathure. The chole were not the greatest, kind of bland. The fried bathure were not bad. My friend is Indian. She offered to pay and gave him her card. We said we were going to share the meal. The food came out, he puts the entire thing in front of her haha. Like pushing it to just to her even. 

Eye contact with just her and ignoring the fact that I'm even there. When the meal was done, he asks her how was it with his back towards me....  I had to start laughing as did she. Said her first name, I guess which he got from her card and asked just her. Lol 
The food is whatever but the service in interestingly bad lol. If your not Pakistani you'll be fine I guess but the food will be just average of not slightly lower. Lol
Giving it a two star for the food. I didn't deduct much for the guy because I enjoyed the guy, I guess more then he enjoyed me as a customer.
name: Ali

text: Went through the drive thru. Ordered and paid for 20 pc nuggets, two drinks, and two medium fries. When we get our food we got everything, but one medium fry. Go inside to tell them we didn't get both fries we paid for and was told "Oh that's because we was out of fries." So you don't inform the customer and let them know? Give a refund or an option to wait?
name: Chelsea

text:
I had one reason and one reason only for coming to Napoleon House. I wanted a Ponchatoula Pimm's.

I drink very little but the idea of a strawberry drink with lemonade, cucumber and a liquor I was unfamiliar with intrigued me. 

We had been walking around the Quarter in the heat and were ready for liquid refreshment. Without falling victim to the low quality drinks fostered on the unsuspecting tourists such as the hurricane or the hand grenade. Talk about poor cliches. 

Anyway, the Ponchatoula was better than I expected. Light and fruity. If I had known it was that good, I would have ordered the larger size. Imagine that. A drink that comes in two sizes. 

I told our waiter we were just there for a drink and he said that was fine. He was as friendly to us as guests ordering food at other tables.
name: John

text: The food was not good as advertised. All the menu items they are showing are not genuine. They are not serving silver ware and we had to ask multiple times. They need to keep limited menu and serve quality food.
name: Swaroop

text:
We haven't been by for a while and we had a pretty good coupon so we stopped in.  The menu has evolved a lot over the years.  We were happy to see some of our old favorites were still on the menu.  The restaurant is a beautiful log cabin edifice with a lot of cozy booths.

For entrées, we ordered the Soup and Sandwich combo of the Pulled Pork Sammy and Brunswick Stew with an add-on order of fries.  We also ordered the BBQ Chicken which came with two side items.  I got the Loaded Baked Potato (up-charge) and their Baked Beans.  The sandwich was great and the Brunswick stew was also pretty tasty.  The BBQ chicken was a healthy portion but was pretty dry.  The Tater was good and the Baked Beans were awesome!!!

Service was speedy and friendly.  As a heads-up, the chow is a bit pricey for what it is.  I would return again if I had another coupon in my mitts.
name: Marty

text:
Kind and quick service with a smile. 

Got the chicken fried steak and top sirloin. Both were delicious and also had a side of corned beef hash and mashed potatoes. Coffee  and water were refilled lightning quick. 

Definitely the place to go for a hearty breakfast.
name: Torie

text: This place blew!! I was just there and had a good time with friends but the bartenders were slow and inattentive!! It seemed like no one wanted my money. Weird. I will NOT go back.
name: Richard

text: Walking in: vibes interesting. There's really no defined decor, kinda gotta figure out the aesthetic for yourself. The wait was very long, granted there was a large convention in town, but it was still over an hour. Kinda put a damper on our first impressions. Finally we were seated doe. We got our bread right away, it was still warm and served with what we believe with garlic butter (which was bomb af). Salads were great, and ps the waitress waited while our table prayed, very respectful and we loved it. One big plus was the balloon animal lady, make sure to go on a weekend so you see her. We received great hats that really caught the attention of the rest of the restaurant. Then our pasta came, the cheese on it was stringy like spaghetti and kept hitting us in the chin. However, it was still bursting with flavor (even though the tortellini was lacking in the sausage promised in the menu). This food was probably first approved by Italy itself. Ciao Bella
name: Lexie

text:
A delicious lunch on a Thursday afternoon. We shared the scrumptious hummus to start, then a schwarma combo and a pine nut salad with beef schwarma. 
Everything was fresh, delicately seasoned, light but filling. Portions are generous, service friendly and prompt, and prices reasonable. 
Hummus is our new favorite for middle-eastern food, and go-to spot on Maple.
name: Cliff

text: I stopped here while drinking on Bourbon Street! I had a cheeseburger and fries with chocolate cake and ice cream for dessert (I was really hungry). We sat at the bar and ate. It was pretty good!
name: Kandace-Ma'at

text:
Authentic and delicious. 
Is no way to describe the flavor of the food in this place because u have to try to understand how good this place is. 

If u travel and had the opportunity to visit places around the world but u don't have a lot money to go back to that place they have ur fav food please do not panic, don't worry, do not stress anymore because Lulu's cafe can give u all ur heart desires. 

From different regions of Mexico this place has from Tijuana all the way to Cancun and more just remember when I say that this is a hole in the wall but is an incredible little place that I really, really love and wish much success.
name: Coddy

text: Amazing fresh tacos, burritos, and pico de gallo.  Small place, but we were still able to seat our group of 6 people for Sunday lunch.  Server was very friendly.  They let us taste a couple of the meats before ordering.  All the meats are excellently prepared.  Prices are very reasonable.  But not the place to go if you're in a hurry, though.
name: Dana

text: Hands down, the best version of "eggs Benedict" I have ever had in my entire life. Service was great. Highly recommend.
name: Mary

text: You know , I wanted to like this place more than I did but just couldn't. The food was ok. Not great as I expected by the rating.. nice waitress but she charged my BF for two beers and he only drank one. Didn't catch that til later when looking at our receipt.. it's only $8 but how can u make that kind of mistake for someone that only drank 1.  Hmmm wonder how often that happens here ... u can find a better place in the vicinity
name: Kelly

text:
Great food and super friendly staff.

Nothing fancy for ambience, just good food and large portions.  A real value in the French Quarter.

Open until 3 PM.
name: Porter

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Overall, a strong experience. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: OKAY SO this place is amazing. Simple decor, great(!!) for groups, the staff is really nice and the food is very good. The portions are larger than most (please read: they are very generous with portions) and is great for sharing (or not ;) ). If i could give more than five stars, i would.
name: Liz

text: Great selection of steaks. Staff was very knowledgeable on menu items. Lauren was very helpful with the selection of drinks at the bar. Very friendly environment. #crossfitbartender
name: Rich

text: We stopped for breakfast on our way to Solvang. There were 6 of us.  We ordered our food and waited a normal amount of time.  4 of us got our food and 2 of us did not get their food for approximately 15 minutes later!  The waitress did not apologize and did not offer a discount.  I finally asked if they could discount our friends meal sine we were almost done before our friends got their meal.  They offered a $3.00 discount on a $50.00 bill.  Then when checking our bill we noticed we were all charged more for our meals then the listed price  in the menu.  When we questioned it they told us we were charged for changing our sides which they never mentioned when we were ordering.  Bad business!  Food was not that great!  Next time we will search for another place to have breakfast
name: Jamie

text: Service was not good and it's historically always slow.  Tried to order via drive-thru and left in middle of the order. A ton of background noise and couldn't hear. I repeated myself several times for a simple combo #6, plain with cheese only, tried to ask for an additional hot dog and that went over the top.  She instead gave my total on one combo instead of asking for clarification or if I had another order.  She either could not hear me or just didn't care because but by that point I got frustrated and left.  Pride in ones work is missing from the employees and management at this Sonic. I enjoy Chic-Filet bc the staff and management are usually on point.
name: Fjl

text: Very good.  Friendly people and food is good (a little salty sometimes, but wont' hold that against them).  love that its BYOB and prices are what you would expect.
name: Vinyasa

text:
Anthony's food is not the question, it is their attitude to diners who arrive a little early and are put into a holding pen with other waiting until the entire party arrives.
Myself and my wife were to meet another couple at 5:00 on Saturday evening, and we decided to get there 15 minutes early and have a drink and order some appetizers while we wait for the other couple.
We were told by an obnoxious hostess that we cannot be seated until the other couple arrived? I asked why since there were plenty of empty tables, and I was told it was their policy?
We were herded into a holding pen with others who also were waiting for their guest to arrive. We waited in the pen for 15 minutes watching the pen fill up with other disgruntled diners. 
I will not go back to Anthony's ever again as long as they have this silly house rule. We dine at many other restaurants on the Main Line, and nobody else treats their "Guests" like cattle.
name: Jim

text:
I love tacos of course. But there are countless taco restaurants/shops/trucks where I live (South Philly); many are great but surprisingly a good number of inauthentic, sloppy places. This is not one of the latter. The al pastor and barbacoa tacos were very delicious. You can clearly see and taste the care and quality in the preparation. 
I moved my eat24 app towards the top in my 'Food' folder on my phone partly for this restaurant.
name: Tony

text:
After looking at the Happy Hour specials, my friends are I were incredibly excited to head in. Once arriving, it was lackluster at best. 

We were served two baskets of chips. The first were mostly all crumbs, but we figured it was the bottom of the bag, so it was fine. Once that basket was finished the second one came out identical. It was roughly 40 minutes after the first basket. 

As for drinks, they came out after our tacos had arrived to the table. Expecting the entire event to be under an hour, the whole stay lasted around 1.5 hours or more. There were under 10 people there. 

Overall, I was dissatisfied with the experience. I'd go back for the Happy Hour maybe, but never on a regular week night.
name: Spenser

text:
Went on a Philly Food Tour this past weekend and Gino's and Pat's were my first stops. Of course, I couldn't help but compare the two...
Service: Gino's. Hands down!
Bread: Gino's. Sooo fresh, great texture. Delicious!
Meat: Pat's. They give you more.
Cheese: Pat's. Again, They give ya more.
Sandwich overall: Pat's. 
The Geno's cheesesteak was dripping...I guess juice from the meat. The Pat's cheesesteak was dripping cheeeeeese. When I'm in Philly, I'll be gettin' BOTH Pat's and Geno's cos they're both great in their own ways.
name: Dez

text:
Ordered the Lobster Soup ($8), Filet Slider ($6), Cocktail Shrimp ($16), and a side of fries ($4).

The Lobster Soup came in a small bowl with a bite size piece of lobster in the middle. It was more the small portion of the soup than the portion of the lobster given that I was not happy with. The soup wasn't bad, but not that good either.

Filet Slider came with a pretty fat piece of steak between two small buns and a white sauce. This was pretty good and I wish I had just gotten more of these than anything else.

Cocktail Shrimp was the same one that you'd find at St. Elmo's but the shrimp was more cooked than the one I had at the actual location. It was more meaty and dry, unfortunately. Sauce was still good though!

Fries were oversalted and small portioned.

Service was really good at this location. However, the lobster soup and fries were not worth the price in terms of flavor and portion. The cocktail shrimp is nowhere near as good as the actual St. Elmo's location. Definitely stick with the Filet Sliders. That was a good deal for $6 and I wish I had just gotten maybe 4-5 of those instead.
name: Hongsuk

text: I came upon this place while waiting for a room at the hotel next door. They didn't have a problem with me setting up my laptop at the bar to work for an hour (during non-peak hour). Great chill vibe from everyone I came across in the 3 days I went there. Special thanks to Sierra and Darnell for drinks, great charbroiled oysters and the dozenS of raw oysters that came along with their pleasant/friendly demeanor towards an L.A. native. Visit and be good to them. See them next time I swing through town. :)
name: john

text:
Service is not their biggest asset. Sad portion sizes. 
I don't get it. When you Charge was is considered reasonable- you should provide enough food for it.
name: Rabi

text: Me and my friends decided to do a last minute matcha expedition. We visited around 6 coffee shops in the new Orleans area. Monkey Monkey was one of the coffee shops we decided to visit and it was not only the worst of the day but the worst I have ever tried. I called ahead of time to make sure that they served matcha since a lot of places still don't serve this AMAZING beverage. When I got there I was very skeptical about ordering because the color of the matcha was very dull and light, but I decided to give it a try nonetheless. I ordered my usual: a matcha latte with almond milk and lightly sweetened but what I got was a monstrosity. I watched as the gentlemen prepared my drink and I immediately knew it wasn't going to be good. They use plain old regular almond milk instead of a barista milk which was disappointing. He didn't use a bamboo whisk to mix the matcha and water but instead stirred the matcha WITH A SPOON! Not to mention the insane amount of agave that was added to the drink WHICH was also stirred in with a spoon. Obviously there was no latte art when i received it and I highly doubt the "barista" would even know how what latte art even is. He also spilled the drink on the side of the mug and neglected to clean it up before he gave it to me. DO NOT come here! Unless you have low coffee standards. *Cliche/Annoying saying ahead* If i could give it 0 stars I would. But i guess the 1 star can count for the location and look of the place.. if that's something you care about..
name: Sofia

text:
We were in town and looking for an Italian place in the Midtown area, read the reviews and took a chance on this place.  And we were really glad we did.  It was very good and not the typical red/white checkered tablecloth Italian place.
The garlic bread is, well simply put, addictive.  We got one loaf for 3 of us and it was gone in under a minute.  That led to a second loaf that lasted only twice as long.  We had to put on the brakes and wait for the food to come out.
We got a pizza, spaghetti/meatballs, and a meatball sub.  All were excellent.  The pasta dish was enough for two hungry adults, so sharing was easy for us to do.  The meatballs were good, but the sauce was really good.  Also, all the bread products were very flavorful (refer to garlic bread above).  The pizza had a crunchy crust which was nice.  We modified a margherita pizza to add meatballs.  The meatball sub came with a big salad, and while it looks a bit small on the plate it was very filling.
Our waitress was excellent (sorry I can't remember the name).  She was extremely knowledgeable on the menu and made great recommendations.  The only knock was the smell of air freshener/cleanser when we first came in.  It was perfumy, so not repulsive but not the fragrance you expect in an italian restaurant.  This place is not a cheap meal, but it is great value meaning you get a lot for your money.  We have leftovers for another full meal for two.  All in all, we were very happy with the meal and we will definitely go back.  If we continue to have meals like that I can see this being a 5 star place for us.
name: R

text: Went there for a friends 40th birthday party. What a welcome addition to Nashville's expanding palate. The decor is exquisite and the vibe was lively, especially for a Wednesday. With a large group, we ordered a bunch of dishes, which was a fun way to share and try lots of things. I would highly recommend the crazy rice, lemongrass beef lollipops, tiger shrimp tempura, pad thai, and crispy Brussels sprouts. Dumplings were just okay relative to the other items. We didn't even get to the sushi, so that is something for which we'll return. I didn't order drinks, but those in our party were very satisfied with their beer selection and craft cocktails. Looking forward to our next visit ... highly recommended!
name: David

text:
We went to celebrate a friend's birthday.  We arrived early and had a drink at the bar.  Great ambiance and service.  
The service was wonderful and the steaks was delicious.  We will definitely go back.
name: Claudia

text: My daughter and I were craving good Lo Mein so stopped by Lee House. To our dismay, the noodles and beef were as soft as mush... we returned the food and got Shrimp Fried Rice instead- which was subpar. No apology, no accommodation- we simply had to wait all over again for a replacement. Additionally- sitting there waiting long enough allowed us to see that there was consistent tension and disorganization between customers, servers, cooks and cashier. Apparently- not a great place for pick-up or eat-in.  Needless to say- we will never eat here again.
name: Deanna

text: I've been living in Yardley for 11 years and never thought to try them till a week ago.  Outstanding pizza.  Ordered again today.  My go to place from now on.
name: Sara

text: This is one of the worst indian restaurant in saint louis period. They are serving stale food. I will not recommend this at all if you want to try indian food
name: Santosh

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Definitely coming back. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. For the price I expected more than this. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
High hopes, but unmet expectations. The food was bland, albeit plentiful. Curt and dismissive service.  Will not be visiting again. 

Good fried ice cream.
name: Adam

text: Miguelito's is the  hip younger sister of Miguel's on West Kennedy. The prices are a bit expensive for Mexican food but not unreasonably so in South Tampa. The ambiance is superb with a chill vibe and outdoor seating with lots of greenery. We ordered chips and gauc (yummy but not mind blowing), steak street tacos (not impressed) and blackened shrimp bowl (which was the best). The shrimps were spicier than I expected but the rice and queso on top were delicious. And of course, you must try the -5 degree tequila shots. I plan to return.
name: Crystal

text: Jess M was AMAZING! She was very attentive to our needs and the food was soooo good! Highly recommend!
name: Marlon

text: The family stopped in here for lunch while walking around the Pier 60 area.  The restaurant was surprisingly empty for the main drag of Clearwater Beach.  Our server was super nice and talkative, and recommended the Mozzarella Sticks which were amazing.  For our entrée, we had sliders, chicken fingers, fries, the usual beach fare.  Everything was great.  I had a frozen lemonade Tito's drink, which was great for the hot weather.  All in all, Surfside Taphouse is highly recommended.
name: Keith

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
The best ramen. 
I have had a lot of ramen and this is the best I have had.  
The portion is right it doesn't have that fishy taste. And like one person reviewed. The best cooked meat.  
The vegetable ramen is awesome as well they have these roasted peppers.  
I have gone two times and going again today. 
If you are in Santa Barbara you have to go there
name: Amar

text: There isn't enough great things to say about this restaurant. The staff greets you upon entering. The food is unique and tasty. We sat at the bar and the staff behind the bar very attentive. Only bad thing is that they aren't closer to our house!
name: Shelley

text: Great ambiance! We ordered the crusty bread with crushed tomatoes with avocado, the bread saggy because they put too much tomatoes! The charcuterie was ok but too little to enjoy not worth the money.
name: Zayda

text: Our first visit was delightful. Interesting food delicious and well served. Beautiful decor, lovely setting, a romantic evening. Highly recommend everything. We had the beef salad, oysters Bienville, butterfish, champagne Royale and and a delicious beer called Ghost in the Machine. You should give this one a try. Sat by the fire and water outside with a lovely sunset.
name: Joanne

text: As a native Texan, this place is REALLY good. First thing we got to taste was the sweet tea, which was very good and set the mood for how the food was going to be. Meat was cooked to perfection, everything tasted so amazing. If you're looking for southern BBQ, look no further!
name: Chris

text:
We wanted to do a drag brunch while we were in New Orleans, so we picked this one. 

The brunch was scheduled for 11:15 a.m. to 12:45 p.m., so I made an 11:15 reservation. 

We arrived at 11:00 and were promptly seated. 

The waiter was attentive until the restaurant filled up, and then we were invisible for a while.

The food was excellent, although the portions were small. The drag show was fun and energetic, although it started late, and was a little disorganized. They have an excellent deal on unlimited mimosas.
name: Ed

text:
First time here in 2019 and not a good experience. Order not right, no utensils, no napkins, no drink refills following request, no napkins following request, finally brought a fork for a rack of ribs, etc. Let's hope this was a one-off and not the new norm. 
Typical bar food with good  burgers and wings. A decent beer list with the very drinkable Victory Copper Lager made exclusively for PJs. Best part of this place is the outdoor deck with lots of seating and several TVs.
name: Eugene

text: Been here dozens of times, each one hoping things will get better. The food is quite good, but their management of orders is appalling. I ordered my food behind 5 gentlemen that clearly had been waiting for some time. Then I waited 20 mins and was served my food after three guys that ordered 10 mins after me. Unfortunately I will not be coming back as this has become the norm.
name: M

text: Great fast service, they have plenty of healthier options to choose from for pizza. The deep dish and the gluten free are both delicious crust options.  The building is easy to get to and always clean and the employees are always super friendly and quick with your order.
name: Baisley

text: I visited this bakery today for the first time. I was looking for weisswurst, something hard to find in my area. They had it. And several other types of wursts. I was able to sample the freshly baked German pretzels. Excellent. And the German rye bread with some imported Black Forest ham. Perfect. Products and service exceeded expectations.  I will return weekly.
name: Richard

text:
Sorry but the only thing changed was the decor. Food still not that great, sat at bar, bartenders were eating and drinking (none alcoholic drinks) while some of us waited over 18 mins for food.  
 You want good service and great steak or food of any kind. Texas Roadhouse!!! Wish they put one in Gallatin.
name: Jud

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Definitely coming back. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: The marinated pork and shrimp pho is amazing.  The spring rolls are tasty too. The service is polite and fast.
name: Erika

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The music was louder than it needed to be. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not bad for a quick meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Idk, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated because that happens a lot. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Idk, it felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. For a busy night they handled it okay. Idk, the wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent.
name: User

text: The southern always has a high quality meal, and their drinks are great. At times the device can be spotty ( forget things or take a while) but we've been quite a few times and always have a food meal. Their lunch deals are great too. Sometimes it can get really crowded and feel tight, but if you can go during the week it's an awesome vibe!
name: Francesca

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Will be back. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: Came here for the first time a couple of weeks ago, and am already planning to come back. They have good beer and the food was AMAZING. I got their Duck & Roasted Fig Cavatappi and I must say, it was one of the best pasta dishes I have ever eaten. It was so rich and creamy, and the duck was perfect. They have a wide selection of beer and are all reasonably price. Definitely recommend this place to anybody.
name: Joanne

text: Ok. Super cute when we came in. Me plus 2 others. Soda was flat. Our waitress Victoria took our order 5 minutes after sitting. Took 25 minutes for a cold sandwich, wrap, and a burger. Mind you the place isn't busy. At all. 2 tables that sat while we were waiting for our food got theirs right after we did. The waitress sucked. Very piss poor attitude. I'm a server myself and I would hate working with her. Don't go here. It sucks. Wouldn't give this 1 star but it won't let me post without it
name: Vanessa

text:
I really wanted to like this place. Overall they get good reviews, but I suppose I'm jinxed when it comes to this restaurant. Not having been overwhelmed with the brisket last visit, today I ordered the Texas 2 Step, pulled pork and ribs. My buddy ordered the Texas 2 Step, brisket and ribs. 
My pork was more diced vs. pulled, and looked/tasted like it had been marinated in 'something'. When I order pulled pork in Middle TN, I'm used to chunks of fresh, white pork meat. My ribs were horrible. Dried out, actually crunchy. I say 'my' ribs, because my buddy's ribs were entirely different. His were huge, juicy, fell off the bone. He actually noticed the difference, so we compared rib bones. His were pink and moist. Mine were dry and dark. I would have bet mine were left over from last week, but I was told they don't keep left-overs, so if that's true, I must have gotten the little end piece, WAY overcooked. My baked beans were okay, my corn casserole was a huge glob of cheese, literally no corn. As for my buddy's brisket (he said it's been great in the past), he trimmed off more fat than there was meat he could eat.
Apparently they're doing well in Hendersonville, and I wish them the best. But I'm done.
name: Mark

text:
A delightful hidden gem of a restaurant! It's a unique setup. All the food is prepared in a food truck which is parked adjacent to a renovated house which contains tables and chairs in several rooms. The house, food truck, picnic tables and parking are all under a huge Ash tree that provides shade to it all. 

We shared shrimp, pastor, and chicken tacos, tortilla soup, and a chicken burrito. The tacos were exceptional and the soup was hearty. The staff were friendly, the food arrived fresh and hot, and it was just a pleasant afternoon lunch! We're looking forward to taste testing out all the things on the menu. Being new, they do not have a liquor license, but say they are "working on it." We'll be back.
name: Joel

text: We visited Jalsa on Saturday May 5 and WHAT A PLACE! First of all,  HAPPY GROVER IS THERE!!!!!! We have known Happy Grove for years and he is absolutely the best in the business! When it comes to Indian,  food he is top notch in quality and service. Our dinner last night was, without a doubt, FIRST CLASS! And the new location , well you won't find a more classy venue for your next meeting, wedding or gathering. If you are looking for a fine dining experience, Jalsa is the place! The lamb chops, magnificent!!!!!!
name: Jerome

text: It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Nice little spot, decent portions too. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..

text:
We haven't been to this place in a long time. When we walked in it was rather hot and they had a secondary air conditioner blowing at the door.  Either they're too cheap to fix their regular air conditioner or something else... It looks really dumb. 

There were a lot of people in side, so we felt it would be good. Well I was wrong.  

There was not a lot of choices and the food was cold. Most of it was just mediocre.   

The fried foods has been sitting out for a long time, even though it was dinner time.    You can also tell that they are very understaffed. 

Worst of all every time we come in over the past few years there a couple young children sitting behind the counter watching TV.   They must be the owners children but I think it's very inappropriate.   

The only reason I gave them to stars is the people are nice.

text: For the price I expected more than this. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The wait felt longer than it should have. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Just not for me. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The whole meal felt kinda uneven. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.

The kids begged to go in because they saw a menu they agreed upon, we were reluctant but saw live music and decided to appease the kids. Boy, are we glad we did! Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Glad we tried it. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was fresh and service was quick.

text: My favorite Thai restaurant in Tampa! My go tos are their Panang curry and pad Thai. I had absolutely wonderful service on a slow weekend and they waitress was very attentive. I've had many friends who loved this place as well. Highly recommend!
name: Shreena

text: Love this place! Let me preface this review by saying that I am not really a fan of barbecue, but this place is great. The food is really good and always well prepared, I've never had a bad experience with it. The portion size is also great, I usually leave with a box so you won't feel like you're overpaying. The drink selection is large as well, I've never been disappointed with any cocktail I've ordered and the beer is always well poured. I would have to say my favorite thing about this restaurant is the different sauces they place at each table. All the sauces are great, and really add diversity to any meal you order as you can mix and match any way you please. Again, I am not a barbecue lover but whether you are or not I'd definitely stop in to Smokey Bones for lunch or dinner!
name: Charlie

text:
A colleague and I were in town for work and seeking a delicious meal and a relaxed environment and Mama Carolla's delivered on both! The wait staff was attentive and friendly. The food was delicious and that amazing old world italian that is always such a comfort. 

We started with the Sicilian Asparagus Patties, which were very good. Had a bottle of chianti. She had the Ravioli and I had the chicken parm, both plates were very healthy portions- we had to take them home. We did manage to squeeze in the unbelievable tiramisu. Overall the experience was exactly what we were seeking and really a straight A!
Thank you Mama Carolla's!

text: I moved to the neighborhood 8 months ago and the first, second and third time I got franks everything was great!! I was convinced this was my go to spot and excited about being able to walk there. Would have given a hard 4.5 stars. Yummy, cheap, dependable and friendly! Then.. the opposite. Last week I went in for a slice on Friday at 7pm and was told they didn't have any and "wouldn't for a long time"... ok then. Just one bad experience didn't deter me. Tonight I ordered a small pie and a few apps for some friends that I was hosting. Attached is a picture of the pizza as it arrived. I live a few blocks away. Either this pizza was dropped or the driver was Toyoko drifting around the two corners between here and there. I'll be using slices on Ridge from here on out :(
