text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
We were so excited to try out this highly rated local place with some of our Mexican food favorites, but were thoroughly disappointed! We both ordered the blackened chicken burritos and they were not great at all. The beans were not cooked enough and were hard. The chicken was so salty it tasted like they used an entire container of salt to cook them. I don't really use salt, but couldnt even finish the burrito because it was so salty! I hope this was just a mistake today because it was terrible.
The guacamole was basically just chopped up avocado with minimal flavor. So disappointing!
The churros were also a let down. They were not cooked well enough and were chewy. The best part of the whole meal was the chocolate dipping sauce for the churros and the fact that it wasn't too expensive!
We will not be back
name: Ryan

text: We had the spicy basil eggplant, Shanghai rice cake, Kung Pao shrimp, and dry sautéed green beans, and enjoyed them all. We especially appreciated the excellent and efficient service we received from all the staff, despite it being extremely busy on Christmas eve. It was really quite extraordinary.
name: Jeff

text: My visit to KELP sushi was a very pleasant surprise! I went with my family last week after finding the restaurant through Instagram and we were all blown away with how amazing the food was. Hands down some of the best sushi I've ever had ... and I've had a lot of sushi. The sushi is not only delicious but the rolls are a really good size. Not to mention, they have a happy hour from 2:00 to 6:00 which means that if you buy one classic/signature roll you get the second one for $2 or $3. Such a good deal!!! Overall, I highly recommend KELP sushi.
name: Jenna

text:
Great restaurant!! Loved the ambience (exposed brick, beams, etc) and the food was delicious. 

It was very busy on a Monday night. I made reservations for 9pm and arrived on time but we didn't get seated until 9.20pm because our table wasn't ready yet.

We shared the tuna appetizer special from the raw bar, which was delicious - great quality tuna, as well as the crawfish croquettes, which were extremely flavorful. I would recommend to get both of these appetizers, you can't go wrong but the specials always change.

The crawfish + jalapeño capellini were amazing. Very light sauce and the perfect amount of spice from the jalapeños (no too spicy by any means). Would highly recommend to get this dish!! It was my favorite of the night.

We also shared the swordfish specials and the baked drum w/mushroom broth + calls. I enjoyed both dishes but preferred the baked drum a bit more. 

If you like seafood I would definitely try this place.
name: Lisa

text: Let me start this off with that I've been here several times and the food has been pretty good. The one star review is because I tried calling in to place a to go order and was placed on hold, which happens. After being on hold for 20 minutes, I got tired of waiting, hung up, and called again, and kept getting their voicemail after multiple rings. The one star is for the customer service here.
name: Jerry

text:
I had really high hopes for Lindy's Off 4th and it did a great job on many things and missed one one major one. 

First off the service here is fantastic. Our server was sociable, she knew the menu well and was very quick to refill our drinks.

The fried curd appetizer we got was super tasty, the side sauce has a nice little zing that I really dug.

The fries were cooked perfectly and were seasoned well. 

It's the burgers that missed the mark. I don't know why, but the burger meat was over cooked. My medium had no pink at all, and it tasted like a breakfast sausage. It tastes like there was pork mixed in with the overly dry beef. The cheese on my burger was also lackluster at best. 

Maybe we got a bad batch of beef, but the burgers were pretty consistent around the table. They looked good, but didn't taste great.
name: Karl

text:
Always, Cheesecake Factory provides delicious food for dine-in or takeout. We have never been disappointed for new or classic choices on their menu. This time, we ordered takeout, and everything was new for us this time, not surprisingly excellent! All was ready when I arrived in 20 minutes, still hot when we dined at home, and worth the time & money! PLUS you can't miss or skip the world famous CHEESECAKE. They have a couple dozen varieties to choose from! A few favorites include White Chocolate Macadamia Caramel Cheesecake, Mango Key Lime Cheesecake, (classic) Strawberry Cheesecake, Caramel Pecan Turtle Cheesecake...
A good writer can make a review worthy of the quality of the overall culinary experience at Cheesecake Factory, but please go check it out yourself with someone for a birthday, an anniversary, or whatever!
name: Melani

text:
Fun environment and great for groups. I'm huge into French fries and the French fries here are so good. The portions are big so you're bound to have leftovers for later.

Their fries are no joke. You can get them ordered anyway; with cheese, loaded, poutine, etc. the poutine was delicious, highly recommended!

Our server was excellent. He was friendly, informative, and attentive to our table. Surprisingly it was that busy for 6:30 on a Friday night.

Parking is all around. It can be hard to find though as it is in a very popular area. There is a parking garage as an option too.

text: Yeah!  We have a Vietnamese eatery in our neighborhood. Food was fresh, the meat was braised in very tasty sauce. Wholesome. Priced reasonably. Will be back for the Pho, hot soups next week.

text: I'm at a 3 now but will try again and revise if the food is better than last time.  The fish wasn't too bad but the rice was similar to the many places that do not get the art of sushi.  The prices are, from only one visit, way too high for the quality.   I'll update after next visit.  Every place deserves a second chance.

text: I've been here a number of times now and have always enjoyed the food. It is awesome to have a vegan restaurant in Reno, and they have a good selection of menu items! The chicken sandwich, classic burger with impossible patty, nachos, and tacos tend to be my favorite. I love their house-made cheese, it goes well on just about everything they make. I hope more people hear about House of Mexica and give it a try, because every non-vegan person my partner and I have brought here so far are always impressed. The service is always great, they have such friendly staff who always recognize us when we come in. Overall a great restaurant, good food and good service!
name: Lauren

text: Delicious!  Five of us went for an early dinner.  Drinks varied between wine, beer, and a cocktail.  The beer selection was very good.  We ordered two orders of the Mac n cheese chicken poutine (it was easily the favorite at the table), two orders of grilled cheese with tomato bisque, sausage stuffed mushrooms, crab dip, spinach and artichoke dip, spicy meatballs, the cheese dip that they set on fire, and a fish filet with shrimp.  We all thought that everything was good, but outside of the grilled cheese and poutine tapas, the favorites were the mushrooms and crab dip.  I personally liked the spicy meatballs and mushrooms best.  My son had the St Louis Ooey Butter cake and loved it and my brother had the bread pudding and loved it.  We will definitely be back when we are in St Louis next time!
name: Steph

text: I'm a slightly confused at Burger Kings approach at selling The Impossible Burger as a whopper. I just ate one and I have to say it was decent.  My confusion is that they offer a plant-based burger that is cooked on the same surface as the beef burgers. I needed to know a few things before actually ordering the burger so the young lady had to get manager. I asked him what my options were as far as not cooking the burger on the same surface as the beef burgers. I don't know how others feel about a microwaved Burger but that was my first disappointment. I then asked him what else would come on it because I'm vegan. His response was..." it comes with everything that would be on a Whopper.". My reply "did you miss the part where I said I was vegan? how would I know what's on a Whopper? I don't eat Whoppers!" He apologized and said the impossible burger comes with mayo..lettuce tomato..onion..ketchup. So i ordered a microwaved..no mayo impossible whopper. I got it home and added vegannaise and more ketchup to it. With the exception of the parts that were rock hard from microwaving it..it was actually pretty good. My opinion is this is not something that they are doing for vegetarians and vegans. I personally think it's too get people to try something different and this is their approach. Well Burger King...you're on the right track but maybe rethink how to accomodate the Vegetarian and vegans a little more? If i hadn't asked about the cooking process...i would be in a world of trouble with my gut right now!!!
name: Christiane

text: I love first watch and I always have, I was super disappointed last time I went. Ive been a server before so I didn't want to directly call her out she might've been having a bad day etc. I came in 45 minutes before close, we were just a two top. There were maybe 4-5 other tables in there. It took 10 minutes for our waitress to even come by. Once she did, she didn't even ask what we wanted to drink. I had to tell her I wanted water which she never brought over the entire time, even after I asked 2 times. After she dropped off the food she never came back. I had to get up find my own silverware and get my own to go box. She seemed so incredibly bothered by us and we had no drinks so we just took most of our meal to go. Very disappointed! The staff is usually great.

text:
Went here for lunch today with my sister and brother. The 
Food was decent and the service was excellent. I'm a snob when it comes to pizza because of the past 6 years in NYC but I'd eat it again. We especially appreciated that we were donating 25% of our lunch to The Covenant House. Props to LPK for that.

text:
One of the most unique yet refined dining experiences on the north side. A sense of culture and elegantly decorated, but still comfortable and a great gathering spot to spend time with friends and family. 
 To start the evening the had a few different wine "flights" to sample 4 wines, sparkling, reds, lux , and create your own. Or craft cocktail beverages, I got an amazingly prepared Mai Tai garnished with several fresh fruits. 
  We all enjoyed different appetizers as well, cheese tray sampler which included fresh honeycomb and figs, calamari glazed in a delicious Asian zing sauce. We also got the tostadas and ahi tuna tacos. All adequately portioned and of great fresh quality. 
  Then time for our main courses. So many to choose from seafood and surf & turf to vegetarian options and pastas. I got the crispy fish sandwich on a brioche bun with crunchy Asian slaw and zesty sauce. It also came with some great tasting seasoned fries. My friends got a lot of different options, pork, braised beef risotto, Mediterranean shrimp salad, filet mignon and pistachio crusted grouper and a cilantro cream chicken sandwich.  All came out looking amazing and everyone loved them. 
  We all were stuffed but the tastes were simply out of this world. True thought and chef skills went into each dish and it showed. 

  The service was ok, nothing over the top and he seems a bit unsure at times with some of our questions. Expected a bit more promptness from a restaurant of such stature but overall a great experience and offered desserts although we were all too full. Our birthday guests got the bday special "truffle and choc strawberry" tray with candle. Cute and fun. 
   Would definitely recommend to anyone wanting a decadent meal and wonderful dining atmosphere. I'm a bit of a stickler when it comes to restaurants and quality but theirs place truly exceeded all my expectations. Would love to return for another fun night out with friends or special occasion. Great for a date or birthdays too!
name: Blake

text: They out here making bacon McDoubles without love. Just pilling on toppings without care.  But that's not why I'm here today.. Their buns were stale and falling apart. I know the manager is probably trying to pinch pennies for a bonus but that is not the standard of care i expect when coming to Micky D's.  I know you have the fresh buns in the back that you're hoarding while you're desperately trying to pass off these stale buns. Just throw the buns away, chalk up the loss and live to serve another day. Highly dissatisfied with cheap managerial practices, serving buns that i wouldn't even feed my dog.   You guys are better than this... sad

text: I'm giving this place 4 stars for their exceptional staff only. The wagyu beef is good but my Uncle Jeb can make it just as good for a fraction of the price and the drinks are very overpriced for standard taste!! I will say though that the staff is very attentive and helpful with suggestions, especially Kristi. She was very patient with me (I've never had unagi) and answered all of my questions. Because of her I ordered dessert, she was so pleasant! If you go there, I highly recommend her!

text:
I am so disappointed. We were eyeing this for a while and finally decided to try it - we had heard good things about other locations. 

There were only 8 other tables with people at them (and no more than 4 at any table) in the entire restaurant, but it still took the server 10 minutes to greet us and it took 70 MINUTES to get our food! There were only two of us and we ordered simple dishes. When the server delivered our food she said, "your food's late because there's only 3 cooks working tonight." And walked away. Which didn't explain why 2 tables who were sat after us - with more people at them - got their food before we did. 

And then the food...all I can say is, don't get the pot roast. Just don't. I'm pretty sure it's day-old Dinty Moore.

text: We have never had a bad meal at this restaurant.  Unusual soups, salads and entrees.  Always delicious.  We have never had a problem with service, and parking is easy to find.  If they have the grilled trout, try it.

text:
1. Pizza: Scores an 8/10. I'M FUSSY. It's always crispy, not mushy and sloppy like some pizzerias. Nice crust. Ample ingredients. 
2. Lunch Specials: $5.00 for chicken wrap and soda is a steal. HEALTHY. PLENTIFUL.

4. A Plus: Cops eat here so you know the food has to be good and cheap.
5. Clean: Tables, floors, restroom.

8. Take-out: Counter staff are always polite and quick.

text: I feel like this place is really underrated, it's a hidden gem & has been open for many years! Love to go there for lunch, everything I have tried is VERY, VERY delicious and for a reasonable price! Staff isn't as attentive though, but the food makes up for it, everytime I go there I forget how delicious it is! There isn't one thing I have tried that i didn't like.
name: Emilia

text: We visited Caplinger's around 5:30 PM on Saturday, September 7. We came once before and liked the food. It is a drive for us, as we live in Westfield, but we hadn't been in a while so we decided to give it another try. When I ordered my sandwich, the Caplinger's special, I told the cashier (a tall, young, thin man whose name I wish would have been printed on the receipt) that I wanted everything but tarter sauce, then even clarified no tarter sauce. He was in a foul mood, and could not be less friendly. After we sat down I glanced at the receipt and noticed it said my sandwich should come with all ingredients. I walked back up to the counter to remind him that I didn't want tarter sauce and just wanted to make sure it was made correctly. He told me "all ingredients" means everything but tarter sauce. AKA he didn't want to take the time to ensure I got what I asked for (because that makes zero sense). I decided to give him the benefit of the doubt and went back to my seat. Low and behold when our food came out, my sandwich had tarter sauce all over it. So I walked back up to the counter. The cashier proceeded to ignore me for a while. When I finally caught his eye, I kindly said, "This did end up with tarter sauce. Can I just get another bun topper." He grabbed it from my hands without saying anything. Never apologized. Now, it's really not that big of a thing, although I did feel like I spent an awfully long time at the counter for something that could have easily been avoided, but Christ on a cracker, could this place have a less friendly person working for them?!?! Not likely to return based on the customer service alone.
name: Stephanie

text:
Food
Crispy Tots: 10/10
They sure are crispy! The sauce served with it was great, that I even got more for my fries. I'm glad I ordered this to share. 

Lobster Roll: 6/10
The lobster roll wasn't anything to crazy. Pretty basic and the taste was just meh. It was a pretty small lobster roll compared to the other ones I've had, especially given the price was $22. The fries were good. You could also get tots or a salad with it. My mother-in-law also ordered it and said that I wasn't something she would get again. 

Service
Rating: 6/10
Our server did an ok job. Wasn't very personable and did the bare minimum. The water is in a large glass bottle for the entire table so I was able to keep my own cup full. We had ordered crispy tots to share for the table as soon as we sat down. For some reason it was taking longer than expected so we asked her if it was coming out soon, she kinda looked confused and just say "uh, yes it is" and then comes back and says it's being made fresh. Maybe the cooks were slow but I believe she forgot to put the order in because right after we got the tots all our entrees were brought out. She checked on us once and that was it. I think that there might be better servers for sure.

Price: $$$
Food with tip was around $76 for 3. 

Overall:
We waited about 45-50 minutes to be seated for a party of 6, which isn't bad considering other brunch spots were 1 hour to 1.5 hour waits. The atmosphere was nice. They had a bowling alley in the back. Maybe I just went at the wrong time, but there was a long line just to use the bathrooms. I know I gave it a 3 star rating but I am willing to give this place another chance (with a different server) since my family said they enjoyed their food.
name: Michael

text:
This place has always been incredible every time I have visited! They usually have a large variety of food options on their menu, they use fresh, local foods, and they have friendly servers. I've only ever been on Sundays for brunch, which can be pretty busy, so I would say definitely give yourself plenty of time, but definitely enjoy the atmosphere. The restaurant definitely feels very 'homey' and comfortable. The prices are decent, I would say average for a nice brunch - maybe around $15/person or so depending upon what you get, but it is so worth it! 

Self-parking can be a bit of an issue, as they are limited in parking space, just being where it is in Hyde Park. However, they have valet if you would rather use that.
name: Tim

text: The worst General Tso shrimp ever..cold, congealed, and flattened with something white-ish they claim was shrimp..called to complain and they said nothing but sorry..no offer to deliver a fresh REAL shrimp dinner or substitute when asked..who ever flattens shrimp?! Threw that garbage out along with my 23 dollars.  Was a long time customer, but with this awful meal and absolute arrogant attitude to do nothing..no more. There are actually better Chinese restaurants that deliver quality HOT food..go elsewhere.
name: Scot

text: I tried out Woodbury Station Cafe and I am super impressed. First, they had a musician playing outside. I ordered an American Cheese and Mushroom Omelette,  replaced the potatoes for an avocado and got a side of Scrapple. Everything came out delicious. I highly recommend!!
name: Kaitlyn

text: Stopped for a drink at bar outside ...Derek, the bartender,  very rude , abrupt, and not at all welcoming ....think he needs to find a different job that maybe he will enjoy !
name: Debbie

text: Another great addition to the neighborhood. Excellent food, the service was on point and the staff was very friendly. I hope they succeed, we'll definitely be back.
name: Matt

text: In town for a basketball tournament and unfamiliar with most of the options in town, but this came up on Yelp, so we decided to give it a try.  Glad we did!  We sampled both the sweet and savory crepes and both were spectacular.  4 months later and my daughter is still mentioning this place.  On top of all that, service was spectacular and the employees were super friendly.  Nice job!
name: Donald

text:
Ask for an employee to teach you how to hit the ball. Especially if you are NOT a golfer like myself. As soon as they teach you how to just hit the ball consistently, then regardless of how good you are it become fun. 
Minus a star for being a little too pricey of an outing with friends/family.
name: Dillon

text: This is the best breakfast in town!! They also make the best chicken pot pie soup I would highly recommend this place
name: Heidi

text:
We showed up tonight & the hostess said probably will not be able to seat us, at all tonight.  Super rude for a local restaurant that does not take reservations.  Jeez!  Plus someone just passed out in the restaurant.  Being a local, that treatment says BAN any restaurant owned by Los Agaves.
Happy to be eating down the street at Finney's who was very happy to serve us food & drinks,
name: Lisa

text: So we happened upon this place quite by accident.   What a find.  There was a line out the door and so worth the wait.  Best darn bbq ever!!!
name: Marianne

text: Super cool venue.  Very speakeasy-like.  Looking forward to visiting again.  Specialty drinks as well as beer and full bar.  Really love the decor.
name: Veronica

text: Our son took us to a coffee shop nearby and then Yelp led us here for lunch. This place is like a trip back in time when people cared as much about what they served as they did their profit margins. We all had the roast pork with broccoli rabe and sharp provolone. It's a bit different than others I've had. More liked pulled pork than sliced meat. But so good! I regretted not getting an Italian hoagie to try a second offering. But we'll be back next time we visit. Well done guys!!!
name: George

text:
I got the Gladiator which is a shredded roast pork sandwich with sharp provolone. They guy who I presumed was the manager talked me into adding A (singular, one) long hot. If I would've known it would cost a whopping $1.50 extra, I would've passed. He was very braggadocious  about the food and it was overhyped for sure.

There were very few times in my life where I have refused to eat food or threw it away because of taste. Rustica's gladiator has made that list. I was very happy about the amount of meat on the sandwich. but after one bite excitement turned into disappointment. 

This was the blandest pork I ever tasted. It lacked basic salt and pepper. The only flavor was the hint of spice from the long hot and the tanginess from the cheese. My taste buds couldn't discern that I was eating pork. I could have just as easily been chewing on any other animal with a similar texture profile. I paid $12.37 for this sandwich and used half of my lunch break to buy it. I was determined to try it again. I took another bite and to my dismay it had gotten worst. The bread was soggy from the loads of flavorless juice seeping into it from the "roasted pork". 

I fed the trash can. Vending machine sour cream and onion Pringles and granola bar will have to do until I get home. The pig didn't deserve to die to be made into that monstrosity they called a sandwich. Gladiator more like civilian.
name: Akeema

text: Being that this establishment is close to the airport with nothing surrounding it you would think that at the very least the food would be good here... I mean cmon its Nashville! But! Here again disappointment set in as soon as my food was brought to me. I ordered the chicken panini , the chicken was over cooked with soggy salad both in the sandwich and also the side ceasar salad was super soggy and starting to turn to mush. The server was super nice and immediately did her best to try to make me happy. This was not her fault as the manager of the restaurant should have been over seeing the food preparation to avoid a bad review. I mean cmon! Im in the Sheraton Hotel...‍
name: Dave

text: Updating my bad review, the supervisor Jim reaches out to me and took care of me after having a bad opinion on here. And went to and was helped by the manager. Nice managers and nice staff and helped me out with amazing customer service thank you.
name: Logan

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
What do you do when you are in Clearwater and have a hankering for Wonton soup? Saigon Bowl is the answer. Located in a strip mall on Drew St this little get away has great value. My group ordered Pork Stir fry, with fried and fresh egg roles among other things.
The Wonton soup was in a large bowl that despite my best efforts I could not finish it all. In fact in a group of 6 none of us could finish our dinners. The staff was friendly and the cost with appetizers, drinks and meal  came out to $18 a person. Not to bad for a night out. I enjoyed the fried egg roles but the fresh egg roles were different and good but I just preferred the traditional fried egg roles.  The staff was friendly and the restaurant was clean. Looking forward to a return visit when time permits.
name: Dodd

text: 4 stars! Happy hour was great especially for a Friday. The food was good, the French onion soup is realllly cheesy but everything else was amazing. I'd go here again.
name: Kelsey

text:
Hands down, this place has the best boba in all of Boise. Their drinks aren't too sweet and the boba is perfectly soft. 
Their noodle soup is also very tasty, and reminds me of phó. 
The service here is great and the owner is always  very welcoming and friendly.
name: Yulia

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was good and came out fast. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: So good! It was a real pleasure to see the friendly owners putting sincere effort into making their food. We had the chicken shawarma bowl, the beef pita pie, and kunafa. All were really delicious and everything made fresh! The dessert Kunafa was especially fantastic, and it was completely homemade from scratch! Will definitely come back.
name: Jie

text: Loved this place. Cute, quaint little spot with amazing food and coctails. The croquetas and the guava daquari are to die for.
name: Heidi

text: Best Taro smoothies and honey boba I have yet tasted!!! With the fun and colorful environment inside, you can take your family/friends for game night, or chill and enjoy your company.

text: The food was AMAZING!!!!! So flavorful and delicious. I was so stuffed after and kept wanting to keep eating the food because I just couldn't get enough. The pistachio kulfi, made in house, was sooo creamy. Also, the service was perfect. Rasoi was a great experience!!
name: AnnMarie

text: Stopped in this morning at 10am for breakfast and the place was packed. Within 2 minutes we we seated in a nice booth and our friendly waitress had our coffee mugs filled. I ordered 2 scrambled eggs, hash browns, sausage links, English muffins and everything came to the table nice and quick. Everything was delicious and made a great start to my day! Nice little neighborhood restaurant!
name: John

text: First time here but definitely won't be the last. Good food quick service lots of food. You won't be sorry.
name: Pat

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Glad we tried it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was good and came out fast. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..

text: Oyesters were fresh and well priced. Service was good. I had the special with fried shrimp, crawfish etoufee and jumbolaya. It was good. Had a jalapeño Margarita,the Drink was OK...Nothing special. Overall I'd go there again.

text: This was a great surprise!  Food and atmosphere was great, love rock n roll music!  Waitress(Shawna) was very helpful.  Would definitely come back!!
name: Michael

text: Passing through Philly, a friend recommended I come try this new place. Skewers were awesome! I had beef, lamb, shrimp and chicken wings (my fav). Also had a spicy clam vermicelli that hit the spot. The servers recommended the escargot and even tho they're not my thing I tried them. I loved it, they had a slight sweetness to them that made them addictive. I'll def be back when I come through Philly.
name: Cliff

text:
Whether you are visiting from out of town or a local, Sea Breeze Island Grill is fantastic. Had a family dinner here and our server, Anthony, was fantastic! Funny, knowledgeable about the menu and overall provided great service.  

Drink specials are a plus to the menu options. Everyone enjoyed their dinner and do not miss an opportunity to have dessert....the chocolate cake takes a small village to finish but if you want a little something smaller, the peanut butter pie was the perfect way to end the meal.
name: Kit

text: I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The music was louder than it needed to be. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Worth checking out. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Soggy pizza, old and run down restaurant especially for the price.  Sorry guys, but you need to up your game!
name: Dominic

text: Hidden gem! I wish I would have discovered this place sooner. $6.99 lunch-pick 2 sushi rolls plus choice of salad or soup. By far, the best deal in town. Get the crawfish roll, it's yummy!
name: Scott

text: I love this place. I stopped by for chicken and waffles the first time and now I've tried almost every breakfast item on the menu. I've never had a bad experience with food or service. Even when they're super busy.
name: Michelle

text:
New to the area, stopped in for a quick slice.
(1) $3.00 for a plain slice and $3.50 for a pepperoni?! Strike one.
(2) The slice was as immemorial as any I've had. Limp and a little too greasy. Sauce lacked any distinctive character.  Strike two.
Based on other reviews, I'll try a cheesesteak here and hope they redeem themselves.

text: My sister and I stumbled upon this cute cozy halal turkish place while strolling around in downtown Philly. We got the mixed grill. It was waay enough food for the both of us. It came with a little bit of everything. Some rice, two doners, and two kinds of shish kebobs, and fresh HOMEMADE bread (OMG- fresh out of the oven). The prices are soo reasonable. Please do yourself a favor and try this place. They have vegetarian options as well!!!

text: Thai Recipes is a hidden gem.  If you go, order the Thai tea, it's delicious!
name: Joshua

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Price felt a touch high for what it was. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: This place is amazing. We use to live in the Bay Area and LuLou's is as good if not better than any restaurant in San Francisco. We went for my husbands birthday. The menu customize with a Happy Birthday message to him. The appetizer so unique and different. Salads were amazing and the entrees were delicious. We will be back!

text: Great brewery.  Loved their outdoor space.  Dinner was pretty good too.  Hubby had the pork sandwich, he would have loved a BBQ sauce on it, but still flavorful.  I had the wings, very good.  Beers were great.  Loved the Dragonfly IPA.

text: Food was good and came out fast. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not bad for a quick meal. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. For the price I expected more than this. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: This is a great spot. Pretzel and cheese so good. We then got the 'Pint' grill cheese with the tomato bisque dip. So delicious. Staff were great. Stop in and enjoy.

text: When I arrived in Boise and said where is "the place" to get coffee and a unique nice breakfast. Everyone said Big City Coffee. We went mid-week, got right in and we were NOT disappointed. I had the bit o honey latte that was absolutely amazing. The breakfast was fabulous and I got a blueberry scone to go that was so fresh and yummy. I highly recommended this place and I want to go back tomorrow!!!

text:
Best fried chicken in St. Louis.   Always has great service 

The potato salad is fire!  

Love the baked beans and Fried pickles are always a great way to start.

text: Terrible place. Service was horrible. Didn't get a chance to eat there since they gave our table to someone who just walked into the restaurant.

text: We had an excellent breakfast here on a weekday. I was immediately struck by how clean, open, and airy it was. Service was prompt and friendly. Everything honestly looked great on the menu, but we settled on the piggie smalls and the Tuscan toast with egg. Both were amazing and came in great portions, we had to take some home along with our side of Brussels sprouts. I also tried a pistachio latte, shoshana and the neon nectar (their coffee is good but I think their juices were really the standout). Overall their restaurant was a great example of quality, healthy foods tasting amazing! We will definitely be back!
name: Danielle

text: This was our first time in this restaurant since it opened here several months ago.  We ordered 2-3 piece combos.  First off the fries were cold and chewy.  Didn't eat many of them.  The "garlic" bread was horrible.  It went out for the birds.  Cold, doughy and lacked any garlic.  The chicken was hot and crispy.  It just wasn't as good as other chicken fast food places we visit.  The cold drink was, well a cold drink.  $15.20 spent for 2 lousy meals.  Wife said we're not going back.  I agree

text: We landed in Tampa with hungry appetites and time to kill. Thee Burger Spot didnt disappoint! I got the Smack Burger, and smack indeed it did!
name: Nickolas

text:
Disappointed this trip here. I've been here before and it was fine. The scrapple seemed that it was heated over and over and was just bad. The French toast was good and the eggs were OK. The waitress served my food and I never saw her again even though I was practically at a table next to where she was working. I had to ask someone else for a box to go.
 I was by myself and this is sometimes the treatment that you get. I always over tip but not in a situation like this.  The manager didn't even ask if everything was OK. I would have said something but they were pretty busy with the Christmas rush.
 Will go elsewhere in the future

text: My all time favorite Viet Namese place. Great food and friendly wait staff. The owners are great people as well and are always in the place to make sure you're happy. Their new location is nice, glad they open again.
name: Michael

text: Fresh ingredients, clean design, above average prices, really good salads. Reminds me a LOT of the Mixt Greens chain from San Francisco for all of those reasons.
name: J.

text:
Omg where to start. When I got there, there was only 1 person in front of me.
They were giving her a hard time.
I gave my order when it was my turn. We both waited for awhile for our order, something that shouldn't have taken that long, it was on their lunch menu.
When I got to work, started eating..soup was gross. Sandwich was so so. Not worth it

text:
I'm so glad West Philly opened, because that location is way nicer and the service is a lot better. A margarita with no salt comes out with salt, not once or twice, but basically every time. Food is hit or miss. I used to enjoy this place but I feel like it has gone downhill recently. 

Protip: Go for $1 taco night because the tacos aren't worth any more than that.
name: S

text: Chef David is a Genius. Always adding something new on the menu, while keeping the favorite items consistently delicious. Service is exceptional and I'm looking forward to seeing the new location in Haddonfield. I'm sure it's going to be even better!
name: Marie

text:
Never again.  Based on some of the reviews here, dropped in one night and had the walnut shrimp with the mayonnaise on the side and an order of crystal shrimp dumplings.  

The walnut shrimp entree was not fresh.  The shrimp was either fried beforehand and refried for me or it was just badly fried.  There are several reasons I ask for the mayonnaise on the side when I order this dish, one is to limit the liberal use of mayonnaise which I don't particularly enjoy, the second is that you can easily determine whether the shrimp was cooked properly more easily without a ladle of mayonnaise on it.  Well, even without the mayonnaise, the shrimp exterior was not crunchy, it was soggy.  That doesn't indicate to me that my entree was freshly made for me.

The crystal shrimp dumplings were better but not by much.  These dumplings seemed like they were slightly over cooked.  I left behind two or three of these.

Overall I finished neither dish and I believe that my server wasn't surprised when I said no to leftovers.  The fact that I wasn't asked why I said no was a good indication she understood.  One positive, the tea was good.  Overall I will not return to this restaurant.
name: Simon

text: This was our last friends-get-together before we head back to school, I really love the music and atmosphere at this Bar Louie location! The food was absolutely delicious and our waitress Chloe was so kind and caring to our needs!! Definitely check out Kirkwood's Bar Louie and ask for Chloe!
name: Lian

text: Before heading to the Grand Prix, we needed to fuel up. They have so many options here! If you want savory, they've got you covered. Do you want sweet? Check! They have menus up toward the register where you place your order and then take a seat wherever you'd like. If it's nice out, you should definitely eat at one of their outdoor tables. The Whole Enchilada and the Apple Melt did not disappoint. We arrived near when they opened and had no issues getting a table outdoors. We had our food in under 20 minutes and it came out piping hot. Prices here are decent for the area and this is a solid option in St. Pete.
name: Courtney

text: Why haven't I tried this spot before?!? I gravitate to the smaller older breakfast spots. So I think the large openness I saw when heading into Sutler is deceiving. Easy parking. Super short wait to be seated. Came here this morning for a working breakfast. Tried the salmon plate and the corned beef hash. Both were fabulous. Bongo coffee. Skye our server was on it with coffee refills when the place was super busy. Will be back. Thanks!
name: Angie

text:
Very good food, anytime you visit the Delmar Loop, you can immediately smell this restaurant from a few stores down, and it makes it so hard to resist. If you are on the Loop and hungry, this is a great option. They give you so much to eat!! 
Their barbeque is always great quality and is well worth it
name: Gabrielle

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was good and came out fast. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Tiki Cove is just what Land O'Lakes needs! They always have fun events on the weekends with yummy specials. My sister got married here and it was such a blast. For being on such a busy road, you feel kinda transported once your behind the fence. The tiki hut i s fun and the lake view can't be beat. Definitely give this locally owned business a try!
name: Kaley

text: This place is AMAZING! Had their award winning Oreo beignets at the Beignet Festival, which was the best beignets there, and hunted them down. You know it's good when your staying in the heart of Bourbon Street and travel outside to get their beignets. Off the beaten path, but a hidden gem. I highly recommend this place. Plus, their food was so yummy! Had their chorizo, chimmichuri, avocado and egg sandwich, which was phenomenal! The Brussel sprouts were best I have ever had, wish I had their recipe. The fried green bell peppers were like something out of this world. The homemade chips need to be packaged and sold in stores. I can't praise this place enough! The owners are attentive and sweet. My only regret is there is not a Luca Eats by me.
name: Stephanie

text: I originally asked for a Cold brew with vanilla and BEFORE the cashier rang it up, I realized the vanilla latte was way cheaper so I asked to do that instead. She was extremely annoyed and turned to her manager and said "now she's changing the order" so I said never mind and got charged extra for the vanilla, $6 for a small black coffee with vanilla powder. Disappointed in the customer service and attitude of the blonde cashier as I have come here since I began working in the library 3 years ago. Starbucks will have to do from now on since they are charging a ridiculous amount and are extremely unwelcoming
name: Sydney

text:
I was searching for a good steakhouse and confirmed this one was the best one in town with our concierge. Well, they definitely did not disappoint! 
From the moment we arrived, the service was on point. ALL of the staff is obviously impeccably trained and it shows.
So my husband ordered the bacon and while I tried not to try it, I couldn't help myself!!! Let's just say it was outstanding!!!!
Then on to dinner....I had the filet and he had the delmonico- EXCELLENT. Oh, our chopped salads were great too. For our sides we choose asparagus ( for my diet), lyonnaise potatoes ( still dreaming about them this morning), and the sautéd onions and mushrooms ( deliciousness). 
So I highly recommend Chophouse. If you're wanting the BEST steakhouse in NOLA, and /or a great dining experience, this is your place. Lots of chatter and kinda noisy - but good noisy. ( Like most good steakhouses.) Oh and live music, btw!
name: Yvonne

text: For the price I expected a little more care. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Anyway, the ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but i still finished most of it. idk I'd try something else next time.
name: User

text: Good tacos. Their red salsa is amazing! Open 24 hours, so great for late nighters, or graveyard lunches. My go to mexican spot.
name: Sara

text:
Be sure to make a reservation as this is a small spot with limited tables. The service is great (quick to refill your glass or provide more pita) and the decorations are fantastic, you feel like you are transported to Morocco. Lush couches with pillows, linens on the walls and ceilings and a belly dancer. 

This place is cash only and they have a drink menu, but you can BYOB as well. You eat with your hands, no utensils. The food was flavorful and the portions are huge. The menu is mostly set, but you can pick between beef kabobs or lamb etc. The salads they bring you to start are delicious (the carrots and eggplant stood out) and each course is a different Moroccan dish from chicken bastilla to a whole cooked chicken in cumin sauce complete with baklava and mint tea. 

My only complaint was the pita was thin and a bit dry (though I have been told that is traditional) and that they bring you a bowl of whole fruit (orange, apple banana and grapes) which is not exactly the fruit I want when you bring fruit with dessert nor do I want it whole. These are minor complaints though and for so much delicious food, the prices are extremely reasonable and tip is included. A fantastic place for a tasty dinner and unique dining experience.
name: Jennie

text: A St. Pete staple. In a town where you have more than a few options for a burger (the avenue, locale market, ford's garage to name a few) Engine No. 9 takes the cake and smashes it in any other burger's face. text:
W received the absolute WORST service I've ever experienced. Our waitress served my dad a fish po' boy when he ordered a shrimp po' boy. Not realizing this error, my dad took a bite of the sandwich and realized it was a catfish po' boy. My dad is extremely allergic to fish (but not shellfish) and immediately started breaking out into hives. It was more than 15 minutes before our waitress came back to our table. When we told her what a terribly stupid mistake she made, all she replied was that "He (my dad) ordered fish." which is absurd. There's no way he would order something to which he is allergic. When the waitress refused to rectify her error, we asked to speak to the manager: an extremely rude and vapid woman named Christina. She came out and refused to give us what we ordered. My dad was obviously not eating any more since he was having an allergic reaction. The manager (in an extremely passive aggressive tone) offered to call my dad an ambulance but would not take the catfish po' boy off our ticket. We were extremely frustrated and trying to leave, but noticed there were several erroneous charges on our bill. We were being charged for a gratuity (the menu states that an 18% is added on tabs of parties 5 or more) when our group only had 4 customers, and also being upcharged $5 for a salad that the menu states is only $2. When my dad went inside to complain and fix the charges, the manager was incredibly rude to my mother and talked to my mom as if she was an idiot. 

NOT ONCE did any of these employees apologize for serving my dad something that made him very ill. They were extremely rude, inattentive, and crooked. 

PITIFUL service.
name: Joseph

text:
Cool. Great. Fresh. Tasty. 
Words to describe my first visit to Ale!

Cool - the atmosphere inside is very neat! Huge bars and lots of seating. Even though it's in a strip mall it still has that small town bar pub feel. 

Great - service was wonderful! Quickly greeted, given a menu and not rushed when trying to decide on a cold beer and meal!

Fresh - the beer was ice cold! The food was the perfect temperature! Sandwich was steaming hot and the side salad was cold with fresh ingredients obviously used. 

Tasty - the food had so much flavor!!!! I can't wait to try more items on the menu. The blue cheese dressing is unique. If you're picky, ask for it on the side or a sample before using it. I liked it though! 

Note: the doors are in the patio area you see on the outside. Little hard to find on the first visit.

text:
So, we had a large group checking into this hotel, which I completely understand is a huge undertaking (I worked in a hotel for 2 years), BUT this was not a surprise visit, they have been booked for months so the hotel was well aware of how many rooms would be used. We were checking in in the mid evening, 6-8pm timeframe and rooms still weren't ready! Many in our group were sitting in the lobby at 7pm waiting for their rooms to be ready so they could put their luggage away. 
Our room happened to be one of the lucky few that were ready, however where the room was pre-paid they said that taxes hadn't been applied and a company card hadn't been left on file so they needed our personal credit/debit card to place a hold for taxes and to have on file for incidentals. We gave them our card for that and it was a fiasco for the girl trying to get it right in the first place and then we find that she put a hold for the ENTIRE WEEK'S STAY on our card (even though the actual cost of the room was already paid for!!) instead of just the room tax. It took approximately 24 hours, but they did get it straightened out, but then we have to wait for the bank to release the hold. 
We then go up to our room and found that the comforter cover had make up or some type of fresh stain on it and was dirty (at the top by your face), the first day we were here our room was not cleaned so we had to go down and get towels that evening after being out all day and being tired, the following day it was cleaned but the bath towel that was left had some type of crusted food or vomit or something on it (which I found when I grabbed it to dry off the following morning...ewww!), our coffee area routinely wasn't stocked each day, the mattress is HARD and horribly uncomforable and has a huge hole/indent in the center of the bed (the mattress has caved in), pillows don't have any loft. Security wise, I was a dumb dumb and didn't take my purse out one night and had my room key, ID, etc in my pocket, was tired when I came back and put my shorts in the laundry and never thought about the cards...until the next day when I was out and came back and oops, no room key or ID. So, I went to the front desk hoping maybe a security question would work. Now, on one hand she was very nice and I was glad I could get into my room, however on the other hand, it seems anyone could get into my room. I explained and she said oh sure, asked my room number, name on the room (my husband, not even mine mind you), and asked for my ID, which I explained I didn't have because I left it in my pocket the night before, so she said don't worry about it and gave me the room key. So, like I said, where I was glad to get into my room, it was a little scary knowing you could get a key that easily and all you needed to know was the room number, name, and have a belieable cover story. Another oddity is that you can watch streaming TV through Netflix, Hulu, etc on the hotel TV as long as you have a Netflix, etc account (at no charge), however they charge you $12.95/day for wifi usage if you want to connect your phone, laptop, etc to the hotel wifi. And I have tried to go to the in hotel restaurant 3 different times during times that my room book says they should be open, only to find them closed. I have been here 6 days and have yet to see that restaurant actually open in the hotel. And last but not least, there is no hot tub/jacuzzi at this hotel and the pool is super tiny.
I will say I was very excited to stay in a full service hotel, as when we travel on our own we usually stay at cheaper places, however, this has not been a positive experience at all and I would not choose to stay at a Sheraton again. Cleanliness and security obviously aren't priorities, no food available that I could find, overall it's just not been great which was very disappointing. I have had FAR better service and ammenities at a Super 8 or Fairfield Inn to be very honest.
name: Meg

text:
This place has such promise, but has some really bad things going against it. I'll start with the good:
The good:
The pastries
The atmosphere/decor

The bad:
The service*
The management
The parking

*I made a reservation for 6 people TWO WEEKS in advance. I called that morning to confirm. When we arrived -- no record of any reservation, and no memory of the phone call I had made that very morning to confirm. And no apology from the host/manager. We waited about 15 minutes to be seated-- no big deal.  
Our waiter came by to greet us, but then left when he couldn't get all our attention-- again, understandable. But he didn't come back for 15 minutes-- we had to wave him over. He did apologize for making us wait to long. 
We ordered food and drinks: several bellinis, a wine and 2 coffees. AN HOUR LATER, we received our drinks! After politely asking/reminding them twice. My friend didn't get her simple cup of coffee though.. we had to ask again and wait a while longer for that. 
The food came out piecemeal a long while later -- except for my meal and my friend's croissant. I had to get up to find our waiter to tell him I never received my meal. He said, oh that's  my fault, went to the kitchen, and they rustled up my dish and he brought it after everyone else in my party had finished their meals. 
If I ran the place, I would have apologized up and down and at least comped something. Nope. Not an apology nor a comp. They screwed up at every stage! 
I will no longer recommend The Gallery due to horrendous service and management. I sincerely hope they improve.

text:
If fried chicken is one of your favorite comfort foods, then a visit to Lovebird on East Ashland Avenue, Doylestown, PA, is very worthwhile. At least, I know that was why I was there. 

Brought to us by the folks who created the successful Jules Thin Crust Pizza, Lovebird is the brainchild of that same crew with equal parts great recipe, locally sourced, cage free, vegetarian raised Amish poultry, and simple gray toned shop with one collective table and five sunny bright window stools. As a newbie, I ordered the aptly named "Lovebird Sandwich," which came with a perfectly deep fried battered breast, cole slaw, pickles, lettuce and special sauce mayo, on a freshly baked local bakery brioche roll. 

It was one of those meals where the enjoyment began with the first bite through the thick layers of crisp crusty bird, through the tender sweet roll. It was as textural as it was flavorful. It was delicious and fun to eat. And, if you prefer roasted chicken over fried, go for it! They have that, too, and although I didn't taste it, it looked awesome.

Tasted a few fries, and they were quite good, but I'm trying to be good to myself by some modification of diet, so I passed on getting my own. The Lovebird was so great on its own that I really didn't miss them. Also, begged off the Boylan Soda, one of my past faves. 

Now for the News Extra! Lovebird is coming to Newtown soon, across Sycamore Street from its sibling, Jules. That is something to get excited about! Not just another knock off franchise, but a true original.
name: Gerald

text: I finally got a chance to stop in and check this place out. I got there about 5:30, not very busy, walked up to the counter and was kinda over whelmed with the menu options. The lady behind the counter was nice, but didn't offer any suggestions or ask me any questions about what I was looking for. She just stood there, I kept saying this is my first time here, she had no reply..... I saw patty melt and was happy as this is one of my favorite sandwiches and then saw they had onion straws so woo hoo. When she asked me how I wanted it cooked I said medium well no pink, the reply was we cook them medium. OK I don't want any pink, she replied then you want it well done; at this point I am completely confused, I replied again I just don't want any pink. OK. Paid my money, got my drink cup and proceeded to the drink station and sauce station. Again woo hoo, lots of choices on both, I tried the honey mustard (not bad), BBQ (pretty good) and the Siracha Mayo (really good). I then sat down and waited on my order. The person who delivered my basket (which looked great) asked if I had any questions about the sauces or anything which I thought was very nice of him. I then tried the onion straws, they were hot, crispy and the coating was nice and light had a great taste & texture. I tried them with each of the sauces and the mayo one to me was the best. I picked up my sandwich and oh bummer the middle was pink.... not my favorite but I thought ok let me give this a chance. The burger was nice and juicy, the cheese melted and gooey, the top piece of bread was crispy and buttery, unfortunately the bottom piece of bread was just soggy. The overall taste of the sandwich was very good, I was just disappointed in the bottom being so soggy. I enjoyed my dinner, thankfully the burger was only pink in the very center and I was able to ignore that...LOL the onion straws were the bomb. I will be back and next time I am going to order a regular burger on a regular bun and with the onion straws. I may even try the french fries. The place was clean, the employees were nice. I will be back.

name: User

text: Wait wasn't to long. Wish they accepted waitlist on yelp but for a party of 6, wait was only 50-60min for Sunday brunch. The portion sizes were more than appropriate for the price. text: I will be dreaming about this place as I am from out of town. So good my mouth is watering just from thinking about it and my belly is still full from all the food

text: I've been here several times now with my family while I'm in town. The back patio has come such a long way and is amazing right now with the winter weather near the bonfire of course. Their pizzas are GOOD! More artisan style and sometimes I have to make modifications to their topping choices, but overall yummy - their buffalo is my personal go to.

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. name: User

text: Delicious! I really enjoyed this restaurant. The food had a lot of flavor and it was well presented. My group and I order a shawarma.When the shawarmas got to the table and we realized they weren't in the style we wanted them to be. The waitress explained that there were two different styles and the one we wanted (the rolled shawarma) was called new style shawarma, so she offered us to change it , which we really nice if her!
name: Ana Patricia

text: If you are done trying at the numerous Philly joints on South street, try this Moroccan food-place for a change - you would be amazed every which way. To start with ambiance,  the restaurant is placed at the end of dingy alley and opens only to the ring of a doorbell, much like you were entering someone's house. Sharply contrasting with the hip crowd on the south street, the interior is pleasantly quirky, like the innards of a tent in the Mediterranean desert - Persian writings on the wall, informal sitting arrangements and the vintage-look silver trays serving as dining tables. We saw only one server (who I assume was also the owner) on the Monday night we visited. Our hands were washed in a portable sink in perfumed water and then we were offered fresh hand-towels. A 7 course meal followed after, starting within the Moroccan Zaalouk (eggplant dish). My partner was a vegetarian and so the dishes changed for her from then after. Honestly, I had my apprehensions that the grandeur would die after 2 or 3 dishes but it didn't. I was treated with Mujadara - a lentil and rice dish, Mrouzia - a lamb dish made with raisins, almond and honey (yes, I Googled them after reaching home) and another chicken and chickpea dish. Our dinner ended with a bowl of fresh fruits and a strong tea. Each dish was accompanied by naan breads. And guess what, tax and tips included $35 per head. For the food and experience, worth every penny. Strongly recommend, if you want to take a peak into another great cuisine. Do carry cash, they didn't accept cards, and it was troublesome for me to find an ATM.
name: Omaha

text: Arrived at 8.15 PM and was greeted.  Staff was friendly and helpful with the menu.  Had Bourbon Chicken and Mongolian Beef with fried rice. Plates and silverware gave us a to go containers and a sack to carry. Pleasant experience.
name: Robert

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Glad we tried it. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text:
Been to the CBD location twice already . The inside of the restaurant is very welcoming . Wait staff very attentive.  Had a slight glitch with my order, however. Wait staff did keep me informed of the status of my order so that is a plus. . Husband had Catfish platter.  That was one of the best he has had.  When I received my Po Boy, I do have to say, it truly was worth the wait. . I received a side order of macaroni and cheese and that was really tasty as well.  
A few days later, we went there for breakfast.  Oh my gosh !  My BLT with an egg and breakfast potatoes were just divine ! Husband had a crawfish , shrimp omelette.  
So good .   Can't wait to go there again . !



Came back from a trip and stopped in here.  About 6:15 pm. Huge Sign in their window for  a special of 6 inch po boy , fries and a soft drink.  Ordered grilled shrimp po boy and told that special  was lunch only . Server  went into the kitchen came back several minutes later and I was told they ran out of po boy bread but they could put it in a hamburger bun. Ummm.. if I am going to pay $13.00 I would like it proper bread.  So I tell the girl no thank you and spouse had dessert .  Wowza !   The waitress was ticked off and actually rude .   Wait a minute ... we were the only people there .  They will not make it if they don't step it up.
name: S

text: Reviews were so bad for Geno's cheesesteak that I literally got over my craving and stepped out of line. Headed across the way for the machine that is Smashburger. Had the "Classic Smash" with American cheese, Smash Sauce, ketchup, lettuce and tomato on an egg bun. Meat was hot, flavorful and juicy (greasy), and the sauce was so plentiful it found the front of my shirt. Generally uninterested and disengaged employees. But, it's the food court at the airport, right? Set your expectations.

text: The wings tasted great though the smallest wings I've ever had a restaurant especially at hooters. I will stick with my favorite bar in Collinsville going forward. The fries were cold and the waitress came to the table occasionally to check on us. I'm not one the skimp on a tip but instead of the usual 30% I left 12% for lunch. I will pick somewhere else for lunch for now on.
name: Stacey

text: This is where you need to be going now!  One of our favourite spots and we go back as often as we can. Dinner is amazing each and every time. Brunch is equally as good. Solid tap and bottle list for the beer lovers. The best part is that they have menu items at every price point so they're not excluding anyone from their fare. And each item receives just as much love as the others.
name: Eric

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. So yeah, it felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Also, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. maybe I just came on an off day. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
This is my favorite pizza place in wesley chapel. In fact, it's now a staple to the area. Steve, the owner, is family and community oriented and known to host many fundraising opportunities for locals at his restaurant. 

Try the wings if you're a meat eater. They are delicious. 
My favorite pizza is the Capricciosa minus the ham. I'm hungry thinking about it!

The Mediterranean salad is also a must! Calamari olives, feta, Roma tomatoes. Delicious!!
name: Mollyana

text: I'm not sure why but the staff at Time Market have a miserable attitude. I'm always friendly and tip 20% for counter service but that never seems to make a difference. Tonight one of there grumpy trolls slammed down my plate and walked away. The bad body tattoos and bangs add to the over all unpleasant vibe. I guess you don't want my business any more.
name: Joe

text:
Had dinner and drinks here last Saturday with my husband.  Staff was super friendly and knowledgeable about the food and drinks.  My husband had the BLT which he loved and I had a plate meal with salmon (smoked salmon was not listed as an option but they were kind enough to accommodate me). We both had the Mac and cheese as a side (out of this world) and my meal also came with a bean salad (fresh and tasty) and this enormous popover (divine).  
Appetizer was hush puppies with maple butter that were neither greasy nor dense but melted in your mouth. 
The cocktails and alcohol selection were amazing. Highly recommend!

text: Very rude server, the wait time for food was outrageous. We waited at least an hour for sandwiches. And the food wasn't worth the wait or the money. Spend your money somewhere more established.
name: Alysa

text:
Visited this little gem off Whyte and it was a good experience. While perusing around Whyte Ave, this was the only spot that had parking close by so we visited the pub.

Started off with a cider and my friends went with various craft beers.

We got some wings and I got the All Canadian burger w/ an extra patty, egg, and a side caesar salad.

The food was fairly good, my burger was a bit dry but very delicious. And the wings were good.

Our server was very nice and informative; literarily kept the drinks coming in until the minute we left. There were definitely no thirsty folks at my table.

Happy dining, and I hope your experience is as good or better than mine if and when you do visit Hudson on Whyte.
name: Zoejaiwah

text: This restaurant was amazing! My family and I enjoyed everything from the quiet, quaint atmosphere, the delicious warm garlic bread, the fabulous entrees to the outstanding dessert. I had the filet fettuccine con gorgonzola for dinner with creme brûlée for dessert and it was absolutely sinful! Colleen was our outstanding waitress. She was extremely personable, knowledgeable about the menu and attentive to our needs and wants. We spent 3 hours here for dinner, meeting up with family half way and we didn't feel rushed at all. Thank you so much Colleen and the wonderful chefs for a perfect night. Definitely a 5 star rating in my book and worth the 2 hour drive. We will be back!
name: Alecia

text: Went here since I enjoyed the chicken at the Truckee location and I wanted chicken.  Got there and there was NO, NONE, ZILCH, ZERO chicken to be had! Told I would have to wait at least half an hour. Odd for a chicken place to be out of chicken? Not

text: The cooks there make delicious food. A gentleman named Eutemio  assisted me at the salsa bar and was so helpful and graceful. His customer service was ON Point ! I highly recommend this restaurant. Best Mexican food in town!

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I love hookah so that's a plus and the drink are yummy you have a bunch of slushies to choose from with liquor  my new hang out with the girls or even a date.. have not tried food yet but I'm excited to try it!!

text: Super rude management. DO NOT COME HERE. As soon we walked in they refused to serve us because we didn't have reservation. The front door lady tried sit us at the bar and the rude manager kicked us out right away because we weren't 'friend or family'. Really disappointed in this establishment ... me and my friends and family have been gyu Kaku fans for 10+ years. Will never ever visit this location again. Please note that all other reviews here are from the managers family. Lol

text: The PJ oysters are very fresh and tasty. We also ordered a shrimp entree which is good but not excellent. Recommend the raw bar.
name: Suwei

text: Really bad experience. I ordered egg rolls, the crab rangoon, the wonton soup, the beef lo mein. The egg rolls were stale. The crab rangoon was very chewy and tough to eat, also with a stale taste. The beef lo mein was horrible. The beef itself tasted as if it was spoiled or undercooked. Then there's the wonton soup. I don't know if the pot they cooked it in had a cleaner or soap left in it, but it tasted off and had a chemical smell and taste to it.
name: Vee

text: Very good food but a little overpriced. I was very basic nothing extraordinary about he menu. However it is open 24 hours so you can't beat the convenience
name: Adrian

text: I enjoy a lot of the meals they have here but feel they are still overpriced for lunch and would like to see more specials and deals
name: Kevin

text:
Let's me just start by saying my ONLY complaint is the parking. They have a small lot behind the building, but forget about it if your hubby drives a big ass Tonka truck (so obnoxious, I know). 

The wait: They are only open 3 days a week (Fri-Sat) so the wait is to be expected. It's something you look forward to as the weekend comes up. We waited about 45 mins before being seated. 

The inside: cute, quaint, home like feeling, I loved it! 

Employees: A lady stopped by and said "I'll be right with you", no big deal, right? Wrong! We later found out it was the owner, and she could've been any nicer to us! There was a mix up with our table and who would be helping us, she instantly offered us Mimosas on the house....nobody's complaint about that, eh? 

Food: delicious!! Our tables ordered the pecan pancakes, French toast and fish and grits. All of it was just yummy! Those pancakes and that drizzles, just pour it in my scalp so I can consume it all! The hubby ordered the fish and grits and it was seasoned to perfection. 

In case you were wondering, yes...I'd def go back.
name: Shay

text: After today's meal see I why I was hesitant to order from this place.  I used to eat here about 6 years ago and it was hit or miss then, but today my preferred place wasn't open so I decided to give them a try again.  Mistake.  Ordered Pad See Ew with beef and tofu and it was the worst I've ever had. The noodles tasted like Italian papardelle and the beef and tofu cut too small and was over cooked and tough.  Noodles were dry as the sauce was scarce.  Vegetables were the highlight as they were cooked to a perfect texture but too bad there weren't enough of them.  Combined with two crispy spring rolls which were adequate, meal came to almost $25 through Postmates.  Never again.

text: Excellent BBQ. Best macaroni salad I have ever had and the ribs were AMAZING!!! The cherry on the to is the wonderful and kind owners. A MUST visit
name: William

text:
Old and dated, and it has a sitting area akin to being a hothouse with an over-priced pinball machine in it.

The ice cream was okay.  But the prices were ridiculous!  We paid almost $6 for two small cones whose amount of ice cream can be described in tablespoons.  We even said something to the server about how small they were, and she just smiled blankly at us.
name: P.

text: Awesome. We have driven by several times and the small parking lot was overflowing. Today we went at an off time and lucked out. Not only were the owners awesome people but the spectacle of sitting at the counter and watching the food come to life was very special. We can't wait to try everything on the menu.

text:
I am so happy we found this location! 
From our server, to the food and the atmosphere. I have no other words to say. You just have to come here and find out. We will definitely will be coming back.
name: Kat

text: This place is insane. Food was delicious and the staff was super friendly. Prices are reasonable. I"ll come back no doubt. The ribs are huge. Best place in town for barbecue. A small cozy good music shack.

text:
Outstanding brunch in clean, airy space. 
Loved the mimosa variety which varies. 
I'm a huge fan of local crab cakes so decided to go with the crab cake Benedict. It was thankfully not full of fillers like peppers or breading, instead large lumps of sweet crab meat dominated each bite. The eggs were perfectly poached and the hollandaise sauce had a nice spicy heat. Potatoes served on the side were perfectly crispy on the outside, tender in the center and a light seasoning gave them a great flavor.
Wish I had saved room for dessert as the cheesecakes being served all around us looked heavenly.
Will return if ever in Nashville again!
name: Donna

text:
I believe this is the most underrated, overlooked place in Green Hills! Everything on the menu looked delicious; it was SO hard to choose. I ended up getting the quinoa with mixed vegetables entree and added chicken. The dish had an array of roasted and grilled vegetables (broccoli, mushrooms, sweet potatoes, carrots, and brussel sprouts) on a bed of quinoa and black was and was topped with almonds and guacamole. It was very very filling and oh-so delicious. 

It was a tad pricey, but phenomenal quality and large portions so you could easily have leftovers for another meal. This is a great place to take friends for a nice lunch or dinner or for a date night!
name: Madison

text:
This is one of my least favorite poke shops in Nashville. I have tried the tuna twice here and both times the fish has tasted funky. It has a very strong taste that tuna should not have. I don't know if the tuna I got today was old or what.... 
I gave 3 stars because the toppings were good.
name: Megan

text: I am from Texas. I have always loved the greasy cheesesteaks from Pennsylvania. The Sals I live by is awesome! The people are so kind! I love the food. The only thing I'd ask to be different is, that I'd like things to be made fresh /from scratch af. But I feel like it'd take away from the flavor
