name: Tom

text: Dessert saved this a little. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. For a busy night they handled it okay. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I prob wouldn't get again. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: RACIST establishment. My husband and I visited last night for the first time. As we ate our food, all available employees literally lined our table on both sides standing no more than a couple feet away from us. So close, that if we were to want to have an intimate conversation we couldn't because they were intruding. They lined the table as if we were going to bail out on the check....and no-one else's table ( we were the only black people there) . AS SOON as we paid, they all disassembled from their military like formation and went back to their regularly scheduled activities. We WILL NOT be back.
name: Angy

text:
My husband and I went for our anniversary, he called and made reservations. We were sat outside, this seems really confusing considering that he called and made reservations and they didn't have a table inside for us it just seems really strange when he called to make the reservation. 
Our waitress was very mediocre slow on the service. We ordered muscles for the appetizer the best part of this was the bread that we got to dip in the broth the muscles were OK.  I ordered the crab legs El Pastor and my husband got prime rib with shrimp.  Once I got my crab legs all of a sudden our table was very popular, they kept asking if I was done with my crab legs.  I ate what I wanted and then my husband was going to finish them off and they just would not stop keep coming over ask if they wanted to eat my damn crab legs.  
Once my husband finished the crab legs we were no longer popular anymore and nobody could come over and it took forever us for us to order another round of drinks and for them to take our now empty plates.
This is supposed to be a fantastic restaurant here in Tucson and a place to get really excellent seafood. My husband is from the East Coast the seafood was very mediocre I've had better in other restaurants for a way better price point. 
This was supposed to be a romantic anniversary dinner and instead it was a huge letdown that cost us 150 bucks.
name: Nissa

text: nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: I came here for lunch on a weekday during a road trip through Indianapolis. I had a savory crepe with ham, mozzarella, egg, pesto, and spinach. It was very large, so I was not able to finish it. The flavor was great and fresh and a bit lighter than the food we had been eating the past few days. They have cold LaCroix too. Service was nice and quick.
name: Sara

text:
For all the times I've been here and enjoyed myself I can't believe I never wrote a review! Shame on me. I like Jackson's mostly because of the setting, but the food is also fantastic. I've been here for several dinners, Sunday Brunch on busy Mother's Day and I have always been treated lovely by the staff. 

Last night and several other weekend nights I've come out with friends just to sit, look at the water and listen to the DJ on the patio. The music isn't so loud that you can still have a conversation, but loud enough to really get your groove on if you like. 

I've been here when the music wasn't so good (I hate EDM) but this Friday night the DJ was excellent! The music always sets the mood for a great evening out. 

Jackson's is a pretty big restaurant with 2 dining rooms and the wrap around patio. If you're looking for nice ambiance for brunch, dinner or drinks Jackson's is a great choice.
name: Melony

text: Didn't turn in time to pull into Smoothie King but pulled in here instead . Gotta admit that turned out great , they made my faster much faster than smoothie king and it was almost 4 dollars cheaper . I can save money and get out faster ? Definitely will be coming here for my smoothies from now on and I noticed that they actually have a full menu of wraps & sandwiches so they certainly have my interest
name: Michael

text:
Not too impressed with the service in restaurant here. We've tried to eat here MANY times, and always seem to have one issue or another. Food is good, as long as the order is taken correctly. This time they got boneless wings mixed up with bone-in, and my daughter didn't order that. The chicken in the chicken sandwich was barely warm. Then, they never brought the fries my wife ordered with her meal..

I really love the downtown restaurant, however, the mall is completely different. I've been a customer of Old Chicago's for about 15 years. The mall restaurant is just not good enough to recommend. Spend the extra time to drive 10 mins to downtown.
name: L

text: Came here on a Sunday and the place was pretty crowded waited outside for about 30-40 min, however the food was well worth the wait. I ordered the French toast and it was soooo yummy. The customer service was good. I believe the man waiting outside was the owner and he was a very good host. I don't live in philly but i can't stop thinking about that French toast it was perfect and I look forward to the next time I do go so I can eat the French toast again.
name: Brenduh

text: We didn't plan on going to this restaurant but came across it while walking down St Charles Ave so we decided to stop in. It was a really good choice. I ate The Benson which was a dressed grilled chicken sandwich, came with fries. I never thought I'd ever comment on ketchup but this place had the best tasting ketchup, perfect for dipping the delicious fries. Fried green tomatoes were ok. My sister loved the oysters. Bread pudding was ok good, not outstanding. Had a bite of the pastry puff type dessert with chocolate ganache and it was fabulous! Waitress so sweet and attentive. I will definitely return next time I'm in New Orleans. Nothing to do with the food but the bathroom sinks were so darn cute.
name: Kelli

text: I really loved this place. I thought it was comfortable and nicely set inside. The staff were so nice and friendly. Very accommodating too. We had a little mix up with the food, but they fixed it so quickly and apologized. They also gave us a discount for the mix up and we didn't even ask. The food.......AMAZING! It was SO GOOD! The owner was in and even came out to check on us. Thank you Cassie for such top tier treatment and delicious food.
name: Katherine

text: We went here by the recommendation of our Airbnb host. We got here at about 12pm on a Saturday and had to wait for about 5 minutes to get seated. Not bad at all. The menu was very interesting. We ordered a chipotle sriman tacos and a sweet potato tacos. Both were really good.
name: Sailaja

text: I am updating my review because I've discovered that the quality of your sandwich here fluctuates wildly as the USF semesters change... Presumably due to a new batch of sandwich makers coming through regularly, as you'd expect from a place near a college. Anyway, it's so hit or miss: for a long time this was my favorite sandwich shop, and now I just get my subs from Publix because I can't get a Which Wich sandwich that is anything less than grossly swimming in overapplied condiments no matter how I word my order. Plus, the menu was recently changed, seemingly to favor the special sandwiches rather than custom sandwiches, and the difference isn't huge, but it was a better menu before.
name: Emily

text:
Staff was nice, they didn't get our order correct. I hate to say it but this is the worst tacos I've ever had. The Carne was dry and old....potentially turned meat. The chorizo was NOT chorizo. The shredded beef was terribly dry..chicken wasn't bad...corn cakes were good.

Again, sadly the tacos were unbearable...we only completely ate the chicken, the rest we couldn't eat.
name: Chris

text: Super great service!!! The Eggplant Special was amazing and so was the chocolate coconut ice cream. I 100% recommend this place. I also like how they have family sized servings, it makes it a great place to hang out with friends. Plus the food is prepared really fast!
name: Kea'Era

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: My friends and I went to Red Robin to celebrate my boyfriend's lacrosse championship win. We were all very excited and were ready to have a good night. As soon as we got to our table, our waitress barely gave an introduction and was kinda short with us. She definitely stereotyped us as the teenagers who don't tip. Little did she know that all of us at the table work at a restaurant so we know the importance of tipping AND customers service. She took forever to get us our drinks and take our order and when we needed refills, she took 18 minutes just to get them for us (this is not an exaggeration, we timed it). When she finally brought us our drinks, I asked about the other 2 drinks (she forgot to grab) and she immediately gave an attitude. In the 18 minutes of us waiting, she had taken another tables order of whom were adults and got drinks for another table of whom were adults. She would walk past our table and avoid us and when we got our food, she didn't even ask how everything was looking or if we need anything else. The most disappointing thing is that her section wasn't even busy. 2-3 tables were filled so she was ignoring us to ignore us because she didn't think we would tip her. My boyfriend and I are trainers at our work and customer service is KEY to a good experience. Other than that the food was good. Unfortunately, our crappy waitress put a damper on the evening.
name: Isabel

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The music was louder than it needed to be. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: This place is a great find! Delicious breakfast sandwiches, nice neighborhood atmosphere, and good coffee. However, the employees at absolutely miserable every time I come in. I'm a weekly customer and can't remember a time when I wasn't feeling like I was inconveniencing an employee by ordering my food.
name: Tara

text: Finally found a good place with reasonable prices outside of downtown Philly. I was with a party of 3 and we each ordered something different. 3 apps and 3 entres. We were all very impressed with the food. I will definitely be going back.
name: K

text: Great new place. Reasonable, great service and ambiance. Beautiful view from the rooftop bar and swimming pool. Very close to where we live downtown so advising guests to stay there.
name: Tom

text:
First time in the city. Huge fan of pork belly tacos coming from California. 

Starting out with the Asian host's first question being, "are you 21?" Yes... came around 430pm, nobody really there. Asked for a booth but he quickly told us they're reserved for customers in a couple of hours. Really now? Rude demeanor. We ordered and finished our meal in less than 45 mins. In that whole time, there were still 2 empty booths next to us. Thanks Asian host... 

Our server was good and the food was just ok. The chips and salsa trio was great. Unlimited with a variety of 3 salsas for only $5. The pork belly tacos is something that probably needs some refining. Crispy for sure but dry on the inside. 

Overall, I can't say that I would ever want to return in the future. Although, I must add that the server for our table was super sweet.
name: Benjamin

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. You can tell they care about customer experience here. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Overall, a strong experience. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
This place is amazing!  Too often, food markets like this have the same type of food in each stall.  There is so much variety, some many delicious foods, I had a hard time deciding what I wanted.  Get something from a few venders, each seems to have their specialty. Needless to say, I stuffed myself silly when I was here.  

Seating can be a little hard to come by if you are in a large group, but there is some seating outside as well.  

I like that there is water that you can help yourself to and there were some interesting cocktails being made in here.
name: Jay

text: The food here is really good! The restaurant is kind of set up weird with how they have their tables, but other than that it is great.
name: Aulbrey

text: On my way to Reno for a conference I did a little research and learned that Reno has become a mini high-tech sector. I had not been here in about 25 years, so this was news to me. Having been in high tech for many years, many years ago I knew that would include really excellent quality food. Great Full Garden lived up to my every expectation. It reminded me of that great restaurant in Berkeley on Telegraph that's been there for 100 years where everything is organic and everything is delicious. The staff is knowledgeable, and super welcoming as if you're in their own house. I had the Cobb Salad with the local Mary's chicken and some interesting blue cheese dressing that I added extra olive oil to and it was exquisite. It was easy to eat keto there.
name: Gina

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: My fav place to eat.  Great food environment wonderful customer service cool place to be then hang out with friends
name: Nita

text: i almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. For the price I expected more than this. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text:
I need to frequent this place a lot more, it's just a bit too far from my office, unfortunately. The good news is that it's really close to my morning PATCO stop so I just need to plan ahead.

The barista was very helpful and answered a few of my questions and really tried hard to cater to my preferences.  I ended up choosing what looked like an interesting pastry which he said was filled with ham and cheese. I promptly forgot what it was called, but I put out a Facebook call to ask around and discovered it was called a boureka.  Wheee!  It was delicious!
name: Allie

text: It's always a great experience when I stop by for some frozen yogurt.I always get the Fresh Strawberry with fresh strawberries as my topping which is to die for! The lady who made my order took her time placing the strawberries onto the yogurt and to my surprise there was even some at the bottom of my cup.The prices are reasonable,clean & nice atomosphere.The only thing I would change is maybe they could list the amount of calories and the ingredients in their smoothies.Other than that I have no complaints and will maybe stop by one morning to try a frap or smoothie.
name: Gia

text: Went out for a sushi date with my daughter tonight ,was greeted by a nice waitress asked us if we have ever been there before explained the menu to us .Food was great !!! Service was awesome ,inside was nice looking and clean .we definitely will be back ,even my 3 year old ate everything on her plate which never happens .
name: Asheley

text: Went here for the first time and had such an amazing experience! Our server, Raquel made everything so easy and had perfect timing on each course. We cooked our own steaks right in front of us! They had a dinner for two special going on so the price was very reasonable. Definitely have to go back soon. Highly recommend!
name: Toukie

text: The view is great, right on the sand overlooking the ocean - great place to have a drink! However, the food is nothing special, flavors are lackluster. Had the chicken flatbread as an app which was a pretty small portion and the Mahi sandwich for dinner. The best part was the fries. Overall just an okay spot.
name: Aileen

text: I know they're known for wings, but I had the bacon wrapped filet, which came with a side salad (got the hot bacon dressing), loaded baked potato soup (so good), and a baked potato.  Steak medium rare, done like I like it. #yum #ReviewsByRL
name: Raena

text: Great place with very settle service.  The peanut sauce that comes with the shrimp roll is scrumptious and the seafood pho was well balanced and delicious. I cannot use chopped sticks so the waiters always remember to bring a fork with my meal. Highly recommend.
name: Wafa

text:
Pro tip: 1. complimentary valet. 2. Wear a hat for brunch for free drinks.

This has got to be one of the cutest cafès. 

I loved the art on the walls and balloons decorating the place. 

The food came out in a timely manner. Note to self we are not fans of grits, but we also had the French toast which was great. Overall great experience. 

#leslieapproved
name: Leslie

text: First time going, and it's a great addition to Bellevue. Stylish decor with decently sized portions and interesting twists on traditional Asian cuisines. Look forward to going back and sampling more of the offerings. Especially recommend the tuna tataki appetizer.
name: Jon

text: Talula's will not disappoint! I came here once and I cannot wait to go back. The ambience in the evening is beautiful, and the food is wonderful. We had reservations and were seated on time and served very quickly. The waitress did a wonderful job of explaining the various menu options, and we thoroughly enjoyed our food!
name: Zain

text:
Fish fry Friday?! Count me in! And this is no frozen fish finger and soggy fries platter. I'm talking smelt and skate and slaw and cheddar bay biscuits and crispy fried potato wedges. They claim "Milwaukee style fish fry" on their advertising, and I certainly can see why, but I'd venture to say it's even more coastal with how fresh the seafood tastes and how fresh it's prepared. After stuffing my face with fried foods, I thought I'd feel lethargic and ready for bed, but the freshness of it made the food light and satisfying instead.

I love the casual vibe of the restaurant, too. They had Monty Python and the Holy Grail playing on the projection screen, and every table was glued to the screen at 7:30 on a Friday night. We got a pitcher of beer with our fish only platter that easily fed us both and joined right in on watching the movie. 

As good as the fish fry was, I can't believe sit to go back to try their regular menu. It takes a unique twist on diner staples with unexpected ingredients that complement each other so well.
name: Lauren

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. For a busy night they handled it okay. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The music was louder than it needed to be. I left full, which at least counts for something. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. For the price I expected more than this. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: I really wanted to love this place- a 24 hr diner downtown! So well located!- but the whole experience fell flat. Honestly, the food is just not good. My boyfriend and I ordered french toast, a side of bacon, and a cheesesteak sandwich. The items tasted bland and had the consistency of re-heated frozen food. Not good. And the prices are too steep for the quality! Either decide to be a crappy diner with crappy diner prices, or back up your prices with quality food. Our service was good, but we wont be back.
name: Samantha

text: We shared dumplings first and those were prob the best thing on the table. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Worth checking out. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
I went to Cali tortilla to redeem my birthday burrito. Nice early way to celebrate the dreaded 5 OH- or, should I say 5 OH NOOOOOOO!!!!

I ordered the carnitas verde burrito bowl and it came with juicy large pieces of delicious tender carnitas pork. This is served atop rice with diced fresh tomatoes, tortilla strips and sour cream. This was ordered "to go" and was ready within seconds of my order. I'll definitely be back!

One word- Redemption! You've earned back 5 stars! Delicious food and always a friendly staff. Thank you thank you!!
name: Jen

text: Awesome margs .. tacos too fancy for my liking but my boyfriend loved them .. bartender forgot our queso dip we ordered for appetizer and seemed like they need two bartenders behind the counter since how busy they are .. other then that was nice ambience and cool vibe .. came from out of town for supercross race and was recommended this place .. would come back def .. just get more staff!
name: Shelby

text: Nice atmosphere but terrible service. Our waitress, Ashley was not friendly or personable. She often forgot things during our visit and it took her almost an hour to service our table of 4 on a Monday night. It got to the point where we had to ask other waitresses to assist our table. The food was okay nothing to rant and rave over. First time here and I will not be returning!
name: Shar

text: Best donuts ever. Beats Voodoo in Portland hands down. We tried several specialty donuts over a few days and the Pastelito with guava is over the top amazing. Such a treat. Coffee is good and the service is friendly and pleasant.
name: CF

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Went to Franklin Manor last night with a group of 10+ girls for a bachelorette party, and we had such a great time! Savannah took care of a table reservation inside for us, and Chessa took care of us at the table. She was great and offered wonderful service. The bar staff was very attentive as well, and there was a great selection of liquors & craft cocktails to choose from. Will definitely be back again soon!
name: Kristina

text: Chic and fun rooftop bar with a pool. The selection of beers are decent. Nice view of the city. Would probably come and stay at this hotel next time.
name: Annie

text: Kogi Grill is delicious. Their chicken bowls are excellent. A small bowl is a lot of food, so the large one is like a feast. They're always friendly and they're pretty prompt. I'm glad I happened to discover this place through skimming Uber Eats and then just going in (great way to "discover" restaurants near you you hadn't know about). It's about the equivalent in pricing as Chipotle.
name: Courtney

text:
Omg so good! Glad I stopped in ! So I decided to get an early breakfast and spent forever on Yelp trying to find the right place I had plans to go across the street but when I got there it was packed and crowded so I headed back and saw high Street on market it was cute and quiet and just enough space for me to sit down.
The waiter was friendly and nice and the menu only had a few options for breakfast which made it so much easier to pick I opted for the breakfast sandwich bacon eggs cheese on a Kaiser bun so good crispy bacon fluffy eggs delicious!! 
I added their potatoes which were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside with a slight garlic taste nothing overpowering once again it was a hit I asked the waiter about their coffee and what was the best one I can't really remember the name but it was a cold brew with coconut milk and something else once again delicious and I'm not even really a coffee drinker I just needed something to perk me up. I will definitely be back ..
name: Jordan

text:
If you like pork, then this is a must have - Fried Bologna sandwich. Believe me it is nothing you have ever had before. Juicy, crispy and so delicious. I got it with sides of French Fries and Potato Salad. Don't judge me, I crave for potato and as you know my blog title alone says, 'There is no life without potatoes'. This delicious sandwich is served with mustard, onion and pickle and it costs $7.49. The sides - Potato Salad and French Fries are for $2.99 each (prices taken from their website).

A sliced Beef Brisket sandwich ($9.49) with Hush Puppies ($2.99) sure won Debarshi's heart. We shared French fries while listening to the live music. I love crunchy French fries with sweet and sticky barbecue food. In fact, I dip them in the barbecue sauce so that they also get a tangy sweet flavor. Martin's have their classic sweet and spicy vinegar sauce which they use for everything - while cooking, as a splash on the finished barbecue sandwiches, on slaw, pulled chicken and for marinating the meats before grilling. 

Complete review on my blog: Life Without Alu?
name: Debjani

text: Waited over 25 minutes beyond pickup time for Curbside service.  No one ever came out to great me or inform me of a delay.  Went inside to be handed my food from the counter, as it was sitting and waiting for an employee to deliver it curbside.  Spoke with the manager that blamed it on being "busy" but provided no compensation for the delay.  Upon inspection of the meals, the food was cold and the order was missing additional items.  Called to get the operating managers information and the phone operator didn't know the information.  Pathetic service and lackluster food.
name: Bradly

text:
Ordered a usual item , they couldn't cook it right. It's a Microwaved item people! Hard as a
Rock meatballs made by an inept cook, please find another job making rocks or some shit more suitable to your stupidity.
name: Mark

text: Other than having a hipster ass name and imagery, I thought this place was amazing! The pizzas we ordered were delicious! My husband ordered the farmer's daughter and I ordered the moonstruck. The balsamic was tantalizing, the goat's cheese creamy & perfect, the bread exceptional. We'll definitely be back sometime!
name: Laura

text:
Roses are red
Drinks are fruity
The Riverview Inn
Is a great place to take your cutie

The Polynesian salad was so good.
The crab cake sandwich very good.

I tried to complain about the short rib tacos, but was not taken seriously since I was complaining while simultaneously deep-throating them.

I must have written this review after three Moscow mules. We do enjoy eating outside on the river, and there is live Music most Sunday afternoons. You should go.
name: Sara

text: ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Also, it felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Anyway, everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. not sure I'd order the same thing again. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
The owner was a kind attentive person, as was his team. Leading by example, people. 

I have enjoyed the yuzu margarita and purple tacos a few times - only recently did I visit for the first time. My husband loves their ramen as well.

On my second visit, my friend and I were wowed by one of the vegan options- acorn squash. We also had a unique and delicious cheese sampling and more purple tacos...

I'm looking forward to returning and bringing friends/colleagues here for happy hour :).
name: Braus

text: Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Definitely coming back.
name: User

text: Good drinks always busy my boy Tom kills it behind the bar, the outside seating super chill
name: John

text: The absolute worst service ever from Pizza Hut. No way ANY of these folks need to be working with food. Not a single order was correct. Super GHETTO Go to Schnucks and get Di'Gorno, or whatever it's called
name: Phil

text:
We always plan to make this stop when we are in Santa Barbara! Classic steak house menu with a great vibe and feel.  Any of the the hot sandwiches will not disappoint!  Had a class I patty melt and was so happy with the rye bread, melty cheese, and caramelized onions.  
Word to the wise, bartenders are very generous with their pours.  Always a good night when we start here!!
name: Rose

text: Great restaurant great menu love the chicken marcella. Waiters are friendly the staff is friendly the desert is really good the spaghetti pesta is to die for.
name: George

text:
Came for regular dinner: Outstanding food at a surprisingly really great price -- a ton of $6 small plate options that are unique and very tasty and not even that small, sushi rolls that are the same price as a regular sushi joint but 5x the quality. Pickled veg were great, shiitake yakitori were incredibly light and flavorful, chicken karaage (fried chicken) was crisp, congee rice soup was great with one of the better scallops I've ever had. Dessert pudding with caramel and puffed rice was so light and creamy. Great manhattan and seasonal mocktail was much appreciated! Oh and they have some fantastic fancy soy sauce that is incredible.

Waiter was great, service for bringing food and drinks and telling us what was on the plates they brought out was a little weak sometimes. But the food was so good I don't really care, I wish there weren't such a long reservation required because I could walk in and eat dinner for $20 here any day.
name: Dan

text: Hands down the best sushi the 775!!! Sushi is excellent with tons of amazing options on the menu (they also offer bento boxes and ala carte).  Fish is always fresh.  Go for the all-you-can-eat (AYCE). Can't go wrong with lunch $18.95 or dinner $23.95....only in Reno!  Great custumer service from the chefs and servers.  We always request to sit at the bar with Chef Daniel.  This place is always busy, usually a 10 minute wait for a table/bar.  But for sure worth the wait
name: Quinn

text:
Well... what can I say... except... this is novel. A bar where you throw sharp steel axes at a target. Of course this is after you sign a very lengthy liability release. 
Nonetheless, they have done a very nice job restoring a building that has been dormant and decaying for years. 
The front lounge is comfortable and beautifully restored. Seating is comfortable. 
Further back are the axe throwing bins or pits. Participants are given a quick lesson on axe throwing by a staff person. (Staff are in each bin)
Then you get to throw the axe. 
What fun!! 
It's kinda like a boardwalk arcade where you pitch balls at a target only you throw axes.... and you drink at the same time. 
All I can say is... have fun and don't stand close behind the person throwing the axe.
name: Richard

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: Just like old times! Well... as close as it gonna get. The breadsticks were amazing. The pizza was just as good as it was years ago. Little upset -the monster cookie they used to make. Root beer is on tap, unlimited drinks. Unlimited coke products. Will definitely return! Pizza
name: Jean

text: Went to Portland Brew for the first time today and it was awesome!  The staff was very friendly and it was the perfect place to get work done.  I also got a the rainforest mocha, which was soooo good!
name: Phoebe

text:
They sell more than savory crepes. They serve noodle dishes and stir fry. I had the udon noodles recently and it hit the spot on a cold autumn evening. 

I've been here twice already and both times my girlfriend asked the person at the register what they'd recommend. They weren't able to answer her. Not sure if this was because of a language barrier or lack of confidence. They would just say, "I don't know. . . whatever it is you like."
name: Tat

text:
I came here on a busy Monday for lunch and the restaurant was very packed. Service was nothing to comment on due to how busy they are. 

I was promptly seated and served water, but ordering took a bit. I ordered a glass noodle seafood soup since I was trying to have a light lunch. The broth was real chicken stock and was well flavored for normal diners. I needed more salt (I asked for fish sauce but I guess they didn't have any). The bowl of noodles smelled great due to the herb, raw onions, and roasted onion garnish combination. The seafood portioning did not reflect the higher price. Normally, an $11 seafood bowl of glass noodle soup is $8-9 in philly and you get almost double the portion. The glass noodles, imitation crab meat, and fish balls would've cost them $1.5 at most. I wasn't full, but I was content.

I paid and tipped at the counter since it was faster and more convenient.
name: Tuyen

text: The food was good, the service was also great. Everyone seemed really friendly and attentive. Had a custom scramble with the red potatoes. With a scone on the side, the meal was filling.
name: Andrew

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
The food was decent except the chicken tasted off. 

I would come back here but would not go out of my way to get here.

I was very excited about trying this place but was not as good as I had hoped it would be.
name: David

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Worth checking out. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
Always come here with friends and family for their Tuesday half-off wing special. 
They have the best wings and finger foods. 
Perfect place for a large crowd to hang out and catch up. 
You can't take out the wings for half-off anymore on Tuesday.
name: Nina

text:
Just aweaome!!! Breakfast burrito will feed an army. The flavor is remarkable...

Go hungry, really hungry!!
name: Paul

text: THE BEST PANCAKES YOU WILL EVER HAVE IN YOUR ENTIRE LIFE. Do yourself a favor and come here and wait as long as it takes to get those blueberry cornmeal pancakes and you wont be sorry. I have had other things here and anything is good, but I always just love the pancakes so much that its all I ever get. Their coffee is great. Sometime their service isn't the best, but I'll serve myself if it means I get to eat their pancakes.
name: Kallen

text: Great service, delicious food! Breaded ahi tuna spinach salad is amazing! Clam chowder was great too!
name: PD

text: Had dinner with my kids last Friday night. The server was rude and unprofessional. Waited 1 hour for a pizza.
name: Steven

text: Great place to eat.  This is your typical old fashion dinner.  The service was outstanding.  If you like real traditional greasy food this is the place.  I had their breakfast one day 2 eggs, sausage and toast and everything was cooked perfect.  I went back for lunch another day and had the double cheeseburger with bacon unbelievable taste.  I saw someone order a chili dog and I ordered one too.  One of the best chili dogs I have had and I have had some good ones.  The bun was toasted to perfection and the dog was tasty.  All in all a great place and the prices are very very cheap.  Anytime I am in St. Louis it will be a stop for me.
name: John

text: Started with the smoked wings and we weren't disappointed. Great flavor and hearty. For dinner I had the blackened redfish with yellow rice and roasted vegetables. Fish was flavorful but could have been a little larger for the price. Wife had the sliced pork with mashed potatoes and greens. Pork was good as well as the sides. My son had the chipotle chicken sandwich and he enjoyed. Overall good experience and would recommend to anyone who's in safety harbor.
name: Bill

text: Not a fan of OG. Had a really positive experience at another location a few months ago though and I needed to go to Gravois Bluffs to pick up something so I thought I'd give it a go. I was dining alone. I walked in and ask the host for a table for 1. He brought me to the bar area and started seating me at a table directly next to another two top with like 18" between tables. As he set the menu down I asked if I could have a different table since less than  1/2 of the bar tables were occupied and he said sure. I explained it would be like I was unnecessarily sitting with the other couple. He sat me at a booth which was fine and directly across from the bar. I believe my waiter was doubling as the bar tender. I ordered a create your own pasta with the salad. The salad came out and then the pasta without even five minutes in between. I'm a slow eater. I had maybe had 3 bites of the salad. I started on the pasta. The waiter wouldn't leave me alone. He wanted to take the salad and the plate so I let him. Then 3 bites into the pasta he was already asking me if I wanted another order because it was all you can eat. I said I probably would not. The host came back over to ask me if I was waiting on someone to join me. As if I wouldn't have told him that when I sat down and would have just ordered if I were waiting for someone? Two seconds later when I was  1/2 finished with the pasta the waiter brought the check and mints over and told me there was no rush. There was no would you like dessert or can I bring you anything else? He was nice but so overbearing. He completely rushed me and I couldn't wait to get out of there to get away from him and the host. Food was as expected for OG but honestly these people were acting as if they had never been to a restaurant much less work in one!
name: Michelle

text: I am glad we chose Bacio for our annual holiday get together. It's good to have such a nice spot so close to home The food was very good and the servers friendly. I am confused and saddened by some of the negative comments being posted as we experienced none of that. We enjoyed a relaxed and pleasant evening and I will be definitely be recommending it to my friends looking for a good neighborhood restaurant.
name: Lynn

text: Sooo Good! Love this place! Everything is great! The gyro is great! The moussaka is yummy! I tried their 6 onion soup the other day that was awesome and always the Greek salad is great! Their tzatiki  sauce is the best I have ever had! Their vegetables are really good too. Never a disappointment. The only thing I wish is that it was slightly bigger restaurant because sometimes I can't get a table but that might take away from the charm. So I am willing to build up a craving or just order to go.
name: J

text: I mistakenly didn't get around to getting a po boy until my last day and I had to flight to catch... got here at 10 sharp as advertised on yelp... this was a big disappointment -_-
name: Tamara

text:
I'm not quite sure why everyone whom has reviewed the shrimp cocktail states how "small" they are...   do you live in the midwest???  

We traveled from St. Louis to Indy for the Colts/Cowboys games, (GO COWBOYS!!!)YEAH, We're not going to discuss that upset...  anyway..  we chose St. Elmo's for their pre game brunch.

I loved how small the menu was!!   sliders, shrimp cocktail, crab mac and cheese, just to name a few.

We started with one shrimp cocktail.  Glad we did.  The shrimp were large.. gulf sized, but not prawns.     The sauce is a mixture of their horseradish and their cocktail and while tasty, it is SPICY!   I'm a fan of spicy but I'm glad I had the cornbread from my chili to assist with the heat.

The chili...  very good, but not served very warm.  May have been too early, as we arrived promptly at 10:15 am.

We also ordered one of each slider... spicy meatball, fried shrimp and the wagu....

the wagu BY FAR was the best!!!  it was a PERFECT med-rare and topped with Brie!   the meatball was also excellent... I love a good meatball.  The shrimp definitely reminded me of a NOLA poboy...

We had the mac and cheese as well.  Went for the full serving to split... spend the extra $4...  you'll be glad you did..  You're welcome!

Then, of course had house chips.  You can't ever go wrong with house chips no matter where you are.

After 2 Titos Dirty martinis and all of our food, bill came to $91.00.

I'll take it!   It was an awesome experience for my first time in Indy, and I look forward to going back JUST to try St. Elmo's for dinner.

We even bought the sauce/spice gift set to take home.   St. Elmo's is doing it right!
name: Jaclyn

text: I have to I can't give a star at all I went through 2 meals and were HORRIBLE. 1st order was shrimp scampi no flavor sauce tasted like flour and water with dried parsley.. sent it back tried the grilled fish tacos. I should have sent that back as well fish was dry rubber no flavor not even a touch of salt. With that said the waitress new I was unhappy never did the manager come to see what the problem was.. won't be eating at any Cheesecake Factory again!!
name: Bebe

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Would absolutely visit again. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text:
Oh. My. Gods. That is a damn huge pile o' food. 

Creative and original sodas, bottled on premises with original machinery (which is fun to watch). Astonishing shakes and floats (a whole damn page in the menu) utilizing said sodas. Yowza. 

...And then the burgers and sandwiches arrive. My stomach is seriously gonna explode. It's bigger than my HEAD. The Reuben was great -- in-house smoked turkey tender and *smoky*. Me being me, I could use more tart crunchy kraut... but sauce was great, cheese was gooey, bread retained crispy crunch. *That was three meals of food.* and I went for the classic root beer float, which was about a pint of ice cream and a pint of root beer. DAYUM. And it was as good as it was enormous... sigh. I recall spending my 20s looking for the perfect root beer... and now I'm in my #%^+'s (not telling!!!), I cant chug the stuff like I used to... but I would totally have ordered this for delivery. 

Did I mention they will deliver their amazing sodas? Check their website!

Must-tries for the future: OMG those onion rings looked amazeballs. I wanna split a burger, because those were gorgeous too -- just enough food to choke a horse. (Or me, five times over.) 

Recommendation: Come. Hungry. Famished is better.
name: Catherine

text: We went here for the first time for lunch yesterday. My hubs and I really liked it. I would say it's like a "hole in the wall" type of restaurant, don't expect much re: decor and furniture. Low expectations. And the menu isn't very extensive. But it's authentic Asian food. So if you have a good palate for real Asian food (this isn't like your local Chinese takeout), you'll appreciate this place. I got the mapo tofu which was spicy which I LOVED. My hubs got the black pepper beef and he loved it too. It's a bit on the pricey side but we're planning on going back (and will try their bubble tea next time).
name: Es

text: I've been here three times for breakfast and I'm not impressed with the food. The service is friendly and the environment is nice. Pancakes were very dry. Grits were undercooked. The corned beef was nice.
name: Moneque

text:
Atlas Steak + Fish is above the Starlight Casino in West Ed. Similar to the one downtown, it is classy with good ambience, which the piano player helped create. 

If you're looking for a place to spend a romantic dinner, special event, or just a nice evening with awesome tasting food then you need to eat here! The price for the quality of the food is also worth it. You really can't go wrong with anything on the menu as all of the food is delicious. 

Like the Atlas downtown, there is also a private room for booking if you're looking for a location for your Christmas Parties or private events. 

If you're looking for a place to eat on the west side... you need to eat here!
name: Nicole

text:
Not a good day to be at Mcd's and of course it was the day we decided to dine in... 

First off, most of the employees were in and out of the dining area sitting down, enjoying a drink and talking to each other. The ones in back were just hard to get their attention when anyone needed service. 

Second, instead they could have been cleaning off the tables after customers had left. The tables were sticky and had leftover food. 

Third, what really upset me was that the cashier did not talk. No greeting or words between my order. Just a blank stare and punching in keys. But i guess she did say what my order number was when she handed me my receipt? ‍
name: J

text: The burritos were tasty and the carnitas was tender and flavorful. However I will never come here again because the staff was rude and unpleasant. They are very stingy on the toppings and when you ask for a little more they aren't pleasant. The cashier was kind.
name: Kylie

text: A good place to grab a bite.  The platters are large and great for the price.  Always good and quick
name: Jenae

text: Great breakfast and even better coffee. What a great place to start the morning off right. Very clean and will be coming back while staying in St. Louis.
name: Doug

text:
Top notch sushi in my neighborhood!
Where else can you get such specials as ankimo, live scallops, modai, branzino, uni shots to name a few. Ada and Mike always make you feel welcome and serve up beautifully prepared super fresh fish.
name: Diane

text: Don't order thru delivery apps. Every time I order thru Grub Hub, Uber Eats or post mates they make my food awfully. I got an avocado add on and they gave me the hardest, non ripe avocado they had. Also, the sweet house sauce tasted cheesy. I know the difference between their out of house and in house food prep because I go into to PokeZone all the time because it seems like the best Poke place in Tucson. However, the three times I've order delivery from you guys you make it horrible and you know you can get away with it because you feel that the customers won't complain. However, when I am paying $12 for awful food you all should really reconsider the items that you are giving to the delivery drivers. I feel sick now because of the food that was just delivered to me. I will have to find another Poke place. Sad, because this was one of the best (in house). But your overall quality to the delivery customers is AWFUL, AWFUL, AWFUL.
name: Brooke

text:
Almost 5 star rating, 4 star simply because the food is so dame good yet the proportions were to small for the price. I had the grouper tostada and charred corn which was mouth watering yummy for both. Another small piece of grouper would have been perfect, the rest the family had the the Pig Mac which is their version of the Big Mac but made as a pork burger. I had a taste of the Korean cheese stake, it's was delicious I must get one for myself the next time I come here. And finally I tried one fried Malaysian chili paste chicken wing so freaking good. And for my final tasting was wedge salad as is but you, beef, chicken or grouper for a few extra bucks.  On the next trip we must try their desert cause it sure looked good watching others eating it

The atmosphere welcomes everyone, from young families to hang with your friends playing life size jenga, Ping pong, shuffle board and Bocce ball. Shuffle board and Bocce ball is free before 5pm and 25 per hour after 5.  Very open environment for a relaxing good time while listening ol skool music. Parking is a limited near the establishment but thankfully there is an overflow parking. I really enjoyed the vibe and love that my family enjoyed the food as it is hard to please 2 picky 13 yr olds. We will come back for sure but without the boys cause I want to drink something from their drink menu.
name: Natasha

text: Love this place! My husband and I always split a large, load it up with toppings, and it's definitely enough for both of us. Love the spicy crab, marinated tuna, seaweed, and the unagi sauce. You can get extra toppings and they'll do a little side cup of edamame for our 16 month old, who loves it. Tastes like the poke we had in Hawaii!
name: Kate

text: My husband and I were in Indy for just one night. We wanted to have a nice yummy dinner but also wanted a fun atmosphere. Bluebeard did NOT disappoint! The music was fun, our waiter Jacob was the BEST!!! And the food was delicious! Started off with their house made bread and on to a wedge salad, both so good! Then the bruschetta was so unique and delicious! The spaghetti was light and tangy. And finally the BREAD PUDDING! Do not miss it! It was honestly the BEST bread pudding we have ever had! So worth visiting, you will not be disappointed!
name: Monique

text: Service was great. Drinks were great. Burger was medium. I was hopeful that the burger would be amazing considering the word burger is in the name of the joint but it was a basic burger. Seemed more like a frozen patty with char-grill flavoring. My hubby enjoyed his and the tots were good. Again, service was great, I just enjoy fresh, juicier burgers and this was neither.
name: Jen

text: I order food from pump house daily. Lots of times it's Togo orders. They have messed up my order multiple times and I have called them to complain only a few times to replace my order. I had a 17 dollar credit on my account that the owner told me he would not let me use because he is not going to keep replacing the same order. Even tho HIS cooks are the ones responsible for messing up my order. Sorry if I PAY for food AND drive ALL the way from Alton to pick up my food I expect it to be RIGHT! But even after he told me he would not let me use my credit for the 17 dollars i let it go and continued to order from there. I order the same thing all the time so you'd expect that they could make it right. Yesterday I ordered a Togo order again and surprise surprise they messed up. Mind you I asked the server on the phone to repeat the order back to me and she did and it was correct when she repeated it. And I checked the reciet when I came in to make sure it was right. But of coarse when I got home and was ready to eat my food it was made completely wrong! I got a grillled chicken club wrap and I'm not really sure what they gave me. Something with a very spicy sauce that gave me very bad heart burn and I ended up throwing it up (I'm 8 months pregnant so it didn't sit right) and it had tomatoes on it. I called yesterday and told them I wanted the owner to call me back because I wanted to talk to him personally because of the 17 dollar situation any way and he had another manager call me back today and I still got nothing solve. Got a sorry but they are still not replacing my order. I'm very disappointed about the fact that they didn't make the food right, but even more dissapointed at the fact that the owner did Not have the decency to call me back hisself and deal with the problem. I've spent hundreds probably over a 1000 dollars in this resturant not to mention when me and my friends go eat there too and they spend their money too. I can't even get my order made correctly. Smh. I'm just very annoyed with this whole situation.
name: Stiina

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: I went to this establishment today with my family members. The decor was okay and we were greeted by literally everyone in the front of the house which I loved because customer service is a big deal to me. We were disappointed about them not having any seafood for "Seafood Saturday", but the woman told us their supplier hadn't shown up. I ended up getting the rib dinner with baked beans and Mac n cheese. My mother got the same but with greens. I didn't eat the food until an hour later, but it was very good. I loved everything and the food came out extremely quick. Whenever I'm back in the area, I'll consider returning.
name: Terika

text: I ordered their Wrappers Delight with no rice and all the toppings minus peanuts and it was delicious. I added chili paste and sriracha to mine and it was on point. It tasted like a Korean burrito. The cinnamon wontons could be a little sweeter but everything was great. I will be back!
name: Mal

text: Stopped by today for first time visit.Met Cassandra and Rocco,two great bartenders.We also met the very friendly owner.Food was very,very good plus a great sports bar.Cant wait to return,fun place.
name: Al

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Kind of landed in the middle for me. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
Uhh... had 1 bite of a plain donut we were given with our chicken wings - 100% worth getting any donuts here. The breading was DELICIOUS. I wish we had more time to explore the donuts here but we were just there to grab a quick bite to eat post RnR Philly. And since I rarely eat donuts - my body would probably reject donuts after 2 of them, lol. 

Found this place on yelp nearby our hotel (Kimpton Palomar) - it was a literal 3 min walk from there. 

Seating - So, kind of awkward. They do have 1 seaters (maybe 3-4?) and a small table near window. The seats you pull in and out. O.O My mom and I were like whoa, haha. I was sore post race -- I was happy to find a seat somehow. 

Food:
I liked both curry coconut and sriracha flavored chicken. I was starving, so I inhaled everything on my plate. My mom said she preferred the sriracha. I think the coconut curry was too dry for her. The chicken itself wasn't as tender but I think I read up front they use glaze on the wings? The wings were kind of pricey. 3 pieces for 10 bucks. I think maybe if it was priced a little lower I can justify how it tasted. BUT this is DT Philly, so a little extra cost is OK. I still enjoyed the chicken here. 

The chicken took awhile to make - so don't be in a rush. As soon as we came in, they got slammed. The guy up front was very nice & able to move quickly with the transaction.
name: Rachel

text:
They have brunch, and it was ready super quick. Just like usual, no table service, and the main room was busy, so we found a table in the second building. The Cajun biscuits and gravy, was good. Delicious ham chunks, soft biscuits, and hearty enough biscuits that they didn't get soggy and held up to the gravy. I wish that tickets were completed together, but each person's food was done at different times, which is fine with table service, but pretty annoying when you have to hover over the counter and figure out how to get all your drinks and food to the table. Breakfast bowl had tons of veggies, was hot, came quickly, and the home fries were also perfectly crispy, hot, fresh, well seasoned and soft, perfectly cooked potatoes. 

Delicious coffee, and a nice chickory coffee. 

Suffice to say, delicious food and coffee, just wish there was some way to make it easier to get my food to the table. Maybe one of those buzzers so I know when to come pick it up, and complete tickets together, also trays if you place a big order? From what I could see, they only had 1 cook, obviously a great cook, so I dunno.
name: Katherine

text:
My God, what an absolute rare occurrence I experienced at this McDonald's location tonight. I mean, I was absolutely in awe. Never in my LIFE have I EVER and I mean EVER seen this kind of thing happen at a McDonalds. I am shaken to my core and nearly moved to tears. In fact, if I'm honest, a single tear has just rolled gently down my cheek as I type this very sentence. "Why, Tammy?" You must be asking yourself right now. Well prepare yourself. Find a nice soft place to sit down. What I am about to tell you all is absolutely earth shattering. Are you ready? Well, here it is...

I ORDERED AN OREO MCFLURRY AND RECEIVED ONE. That's right, folks! You heard it here first. THIS LOCATION HAS A FUNCTIONING ICE CREAM MACHINE. I REPEAT, THIS IS NOT A DRILL, THIS LOCATION HAS A FULLY FUNCTIONING ICE CREAM MACHINE. 

My faith in God, humanity, and civilization as a whole has been restored again. God bless you McDonald's for this life changing experience. 

Oh, and the lady working the drive thru was really nice too. Y'all should give her a raise.
name: Tammy

text: The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Overall, a strong experience. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
My order was a Prime Burger w/slaw + baked potato. I was served something else, and I asked for the order to be corrected. A large, under-cooked baked potato was brought back while the burger was cooked. I ate part of the potato while Anne and Alex ate their meals. When the rest of my meal was finally served, Alex was done and they took away his plate in the same trip. Anne intentionally ate slower.

I've been more impressed with a burger at Stake n Shake.

My wife had shrimp (fewer than she expected for the price) with potatoes and our grandson ordered the 12 oz prime rib (which he liked)

I normally tip 20-25%. I regret having left a $10 tip. That's twice what I should have left.

My experience at Weber Grill was a disappointment, to say the least.
name: Steve

text: Ordered delivery to my hotel from the authentic menu. Food was delicious, ample portions. I got the Sezchuan egg plant (all egg plant,nothing else), rice flat noodle (I got it with sea food of which there was plenty but would probably do beef in the future as it would go very well with the sauce), and green peas with mushroom (other veggies came in this too,it was the least impressive of the dishes). I would certainly love to eat here again when I am back in town
name: Marcus

text: Bad just really bad chines food I won't be returning anytime soon. Very sad I had better hopes
name: Steve

text: What a treat and great find with La Playa Azul Cafe. They have been in business for 43 years and you can tell why. The restaurant is off the Main Street but in a wonderful location. The inside is cozy and intimate and has a wonderful outside seating. David waited on us, he treated myself and family so wonderful. He made sure we were welcomed and taken care of the entire time. I ordered the chicken fajitas, my wife ordered the Carne Asada plate and finished the night with cheese cake and flan. Every dish was amazing, one thing that really stood out to us (all of it was some of the best Mexican we have had) was their beans, out of this world. The spice mango margarita was great to, nice and spice but not to sweet. Long story short, it is a family owned business. The owners to the staff really are amazing and you can tell they put their heart and soul into their business and customers. We will be back very soon..
name: Jec

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. For a busy night they handled it okay. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Honestly, nothing was awful but i left disappointed. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Idk, dessert was weirdly the highlight, which i wasn't expecting at all. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. so yeah kind of mixed on it. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
I must say this place was really nice. It gave off a cozier vibe than your average fine dining steakhouse. I was only in town visiting but I definitely wouldn't mind returning.

Pros:
Valet
Amazing staff
Steak cooked to perfection
Nice ambiance 
Try the lamb lollipops and the truffle butter mashed potatoes 

Con: 
We didn't care for how loud the piano was
name: Ashia

text: New to town and in search of our next "go to" burger spot that isn't In N' Out. The staff here are very outgoing. text: Excellent in all respects. Very generous servings, competitive pricing, superior service. Experienced a couple of opening day glitches which were quickly remedied. text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. It was crowded but still moved along. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. text: This was hands down the best experience I have had at any restaurant ever! If you go to any Wild Garlic go to this location!! We walked in at 8:59 not knowing it closed in one minute, and we were kindly greeted by the manager Sara, who enthusiastically still sat us. Sara made my friend a special salad which was hands down the best salad I have ever had in my life. text:
Unfortunately: I don't think I'll be back.
I have always passed by this restaurant in South County right in the concord strip mall. So, I thought why not give this a try? I was highly disappointed.
They have an "early bird" special and I was highly wanting to try it. The description on the menu sounded good. I also told the waitress that I was a first time customer. She singed the praises of this restaurant, saying "always huge portions" and what not.
The salad was a decent size, I can give you that. The salad was delicious, but it was freezing cold! Like it was literally left in the freezer for hours. 
I ate half my salad and waited for the main course. My waitress came at first to refill my beverage, but for 20 minutes, she was MIA...nowhere to be seen. 
Ok, so I let another waitress know, who had a bit of an attitude, but she went to get my original waitress. A few moments later, my main course came...and my heart sank. 
It was the worst entree I have had from a professional Italian restaurant. The food was cold and it looked like it was poorly made. The chicken was dry. The white pasta that I ordered had a really strange taste to the sauce. The sauce was also a bit soupy and the pasta noodles tasted like they were overcooked. The entire experience from the beginning to end made me think that this restaurant doesn't use fresh ingredients. 
And what was up with the teensy tiny portions? The waitress firmly suggested that I was going to get huge portions. But the entree looked like it was from a kid's menu. The waitress got a manager, Colleen, who explained that the early bird special has half orders of everything on the menu, but I didn't buy it. The chicken portion was at least 4 to 5 ounces of chicken, not a decent adult size. 
She gave this meal for free apologizing for the wait and she also wrote down multiple names of the management, including herself on a sticky note.
They also sent a grunt guy over to my table who threw a to go box and bag on my table, barely spoke a word, and then left. That's the straw that broke the camel's back, so to speak. I am never coming back here and I will never spend a dime of my hard earned cash here. Ciao!
name: Joe

text: Excellent pub!  A little pricey but the food is amazing and craft beer selection is notable. This was our first visit and we tried the sliders, anchor tots (who doesn't like tots with blue cheese and hot sauce!) and wings two different ways. Wings and tots were definitely our favorite. BBQ slider made us want to order a full sandwich. Bar staff very friendly and plenty of tvs to watch a game. They were very accommodating to put the game we requested on an available screen. We look forward to making this a regular stop.

text: I had the special. Mike's pizza burger was delicious. Sisters had Reuben, patty melt and chicken tenders. All outstanding. Great spot for a good meal.

text: After friend's convinced us we needed to give them another chance, we did... what a mistake.  Similar experience as the first time.  Overpriced, overcooked bland burgers.  Crap music even if you do like heavy medal and basic beers and ciders also being over charged for.  Not worth my $ or time.  Okay the fries were pretty good, there they get 1 star for that, but the tray of ketchup cups with flies landing on them was pretty unappetizing.

text: Horrible ending!! Excellent start of experience from Rudy the bartender to Joseph the server. Food was great. After we finished dinner, Redhead manager made it clear our time was up. From the passive aggressive "ok, have a god night" after she cleared our table 3 times (she wasnt our server), she staight up asked us to leave because "they had people waiting." Really??? NEVER have I ever been asked to leave a restaurant after finishing a meal. Maybe there were 4 people at hostess stand. We spent $300 plus bought a $100 gift card for a friend. We were preparing to leave in the next 10 minutes. Was kicking us out really worth 10 minutes? No words to express our disappointment after having a great meal. As an owner of a restaurant in Nashville, I would not stand for my customers to be treated so disrespectfully. Ridiculous.

text: I'm always on the lookout for good Mexican food and Mi Ranchito definitely fit that. I went with some co-workers for lunch - we were seated immediately and service was quick. I really, really liked their salsa - not too chunky, a little spicy, and some actual flavor. text:
The rice was chewy. Not soft/fluffy.

The taco special is just less food for a cheaper price. 
All tasted like food from save a lot. 

Salsa was good, chips crispy.

text:
Absolutely the best Mexican food we have had since moving here from the L.A. area, followed very closely by West Coast Taco. The chips and salsa are made fresh and are absolutely delicious. The horchatas are as big as your head! They are to die for. They also serve menudo. A sit-down in Tennessee that serves horchatas and menudo? That's an automatic yes for us.
The staff was super friendly and made sure we had everything we needed.
The price we paid for what we got was a dream. A little went a really long way here.
We will return on our next trip to Nashville.

text:
Today, I went to Love & Honey around 2:00pm. When we got there, all but 4 of the seats were taken, but everyone was eating. I ordered the chicken tenders with buttermilk ranch. My boyfriend ordered the half chicken with potato salad, as well as a slice of the lemon cream pie. After I sat down, I found out he also ordered the OG chicken sandwich to try. While we waited for our food, everyone else cleared out. Two women were leaving and asked if we wanted their side of pickles because they didn't eat them. We gladly took them, and tried those as well. The pickles were delicious! Sweet and sour at the same time.

Our food came out after about 10 minutes, and everything smelled delicious. The chicken was drizzled with honey, which I didn't realize would happen. The taste was amazing. Also, the buttermilk rank was so good. I ended up buying a side of the honey mustard as well, which is a little more mustardy than I prefer, but it was also yummy. We tried the OG sandwich, and it had a spicy slaw, which I wasn't expecting. I preferred the chicken tenders to the sandwich, but I think that's because the chicken is so good on its own! The potato salad was also delicious. It has a pickle relish in it, and it doesn't have onions (that we could taste), which was perfect for my boyfriend who doesn't like onions. The woman taking our order let us try to potato salad before ordering it, which was very helpful! We saved the half chicken to take home and eat for dinner, but we did eat the cornbread that came with it. It was dangerously good. The honey butter that came with it wasn't too sweet, so it had a perfect balance. Finally, the lemon cream pie was very good. The graham crust was crumbly, but held the pie together. 

We can't wait to go back in the future!
name: Lindsay

text: Surprisingly good! I had the fried fish dog (can't remember exact name) and shared a side of fries. My "hot dog" was quite large and so tasty!! My friend also ordered a custom hot dog and enjoyed hers as well. The fries were also really tasty!! This is a dive bar kind place, and prices not as cheap as I had hoped but reasonable.

text: This is the best bar in town.    I've been in New Orleans for  4 days and I've been here every night.    That staff is AMAZING  from the guys at the door the bartenders the kitchen staff really Amazing.

text:
Going to Walmart is not my favorite thing, but it's where I do most of my bulk grocery shopping.  I shop at this Supercenter due to its convenient location, low prices, it fills grocery and other family and home shopping needs, and it has a pharmacy (which I use). 
This particular Walmart also has a Subway, a money center, a little game room with a couple of claw-games and candy machines (for the kiddos and nerds like me), and a Vision Center.  
I'm going to give an extra star simply for the pharmacy, because although they are usually busy, they remember me and try to be fast and friendly. I encountered one pharmacist that I ran into a problem with, but I haven't had an issue since.
Other than being everything that everybody has said, sadly, (worn down staff that are especially not so helpful in the customer service area, lack of cleanliness and order, and terrible lines much of the time), it's pretty much what I have come to expect from Walmarts (especially the big ones).
So, I try to smile and be kind (for my sake) and realize I know what I'm getting into (watch where you park, for carts that might just be loose and blow into your car), and I leave extra time and patience in my pocket.

text: The meal was delicious .. looking forward to dining here again ! The servers were all attentive and the setting was perfect for our girls night out !!

text:
Really liked it - would come again.

text:
So...I stumbled upon this restaurant after a long exam day. Turns out it's the oldest Mexican restaurant in the country, established in 1922, crazy right? 

What's even crazier is that their claim to fame was the chimichanga. Per wikipedia, story goes that the founder of this restaurant accidentally dropped her burrito into the deep fryer and was about to cuss in Spanish but changed to "chimichanga," which is akin to thingamajig in English. Their famous Carne Seca is pretty good, which comes in the form of a deep fried burrito in enchilada style. For the dish, they sun dried their meat on top of the restaurants, lol. I chuckled after reading about that, having grown up in a third world country where we dry everything under the sun.

Their drink menu is pretty good. I got "the 1922," which is not bad. I was also eyeing the charro pink mule, which was reportedly pretty popular too.

text:
Carmelita's is a chain Mexican food that is slightly more American than authentic. I used to despise Carmelita's, but my view of them has changed over the years. In particular, this location. We live really close to the 66th Street location and drive past it to come to this location. It is 1000x better on Park Street. 

Anyways, the two things that make me love Carmelita's are the "Taco Tuesday" deal and the chile rellenos. 

We will talk about Taco Tuesday first. All you can eat tacos for a set price (I believe it is around $10). They start you off with three tacos and two sides. The options are shredded beef (get it on your first try if you want it, not available on refills), ground beef or chicken. The sides include side salad, corn, refried beans, or mexican rice. They are all decent tasting. The tacos are basic, but tasty. Make sure you ask for Cholula to take them to another level. 

Carmelita's also has free chips and salsa (with one refill free). 

The Chile Rellenos. I am a Chile Rellenos fiend. If it is on the menu, I order it. Many of the authentic restaurants in the area do not have them. Carmelita's has a surprisingly delicious Chile Rellenos dish. You can also order it without the egg wash if you prefer. 

Overall, I have come to appreciate Carmelita's and this location in particular. Service is always great and the food is tasty. We will be back, probably on a Tuesday.
name: Crystal

text:
Tinker Street is one of those special spots that you notice and immediately add to your bucket list. From the road, it looks like a tiny house, completely lit up with twinkle lights. It's swanky, humble and cozy, all at the same time. 

They weren't open yet, but we were still able to get a reservation on Yelp without having to call, which was incredibly convenient. Good to know for the future! When they did open later that day, the host called to confirm the reservation which was nice. 

We showed up and got sat on the covered patio (it's still plenty warm in the winter-- complete with full heat and blankets). I loved the twinkle lights out there, but the only reason I knocked off a star was that the tables were SO close together that I could hear the conversations on either side of me more than I could hear my husband (I almost couldnt hear him and we're still young). We were also up against the hostess stand and kept leaning so servers could even get through the tables. 

The food though? The food is incredible and great quality. I got the Great Lakes Walleye, something I would never get usually. I knew that if anyone could make it well, Tinker could, so I tried walleye for the first time. They put the fish on a plate of lentil beans that had been cooked in bacon, and had bits of apple around the dish; two things that I love. The walleye itself was cooked well and I ate every bite. 

They also had four local beers on tap, so I got a Big Lug ale to go with my meal and it's fun that they start everyone's meal off with a mini glass of champagne. Our server was nice too.
name: Niki

text: I had the white lasagna and it was so fantastic! The sauce was savory and the noodles were al dente, my personal favorite. We also had the man manacotti and it was so tasty! The portions are smaller than what you would typically expect in America, but it makes it even more authentic like the portion sizes in Europe. I was full and satisfied with my meal! Such a cute place with great and fast service. Will definitely be coming back to get this again.
