text:
I wanted to really like this place for a lot of reasons BUT, my experience was less than favorable.

They are very short staffed behind the bar. I waited over 15 minutes for a drink and then they didn't even have what I ordered :(

I ordered a different drink, but in the process of her making it, she dropped the bottle of rum and we were all hit with little shards of glass and covered in rum. My drink then had to be substituted again, and I wasn't a fan.

Another woman and I both told the gentleman that was cleaning the broken bottle that pieces of broken glass flew into the ice container... he simply said "it'll be okay" and ignored it. I switched to a beer after that, not wanting to risk it.

My food was served-but not exactly to me. It was placed on the bar somewhat close to me and after a few minutes of no one saying anything, I just assumed it was mine. I waited another few minutes for silverware until I finally just got up to get it myself. No one asked how my food was.

The bartender was veryyy sweet and she did give me a discount on the bill, but they just need more help behind the bar... So many people were waiting for things. It was too busy for just one person. I felt bad for her. Through everything, she kept a smile on her face and held her composure. Honestly, I even feel bad writing this because of how sweet she was.

Kudos to the bartender

Suggestion to the establishment: you need to be better staffed

And finally, a warning to the man who cleaned the broken glass: ignoring 2 customer's concern about a possible hazard is a liability waiting to happen.
name: Alison

text: ice cream is good but ive never been to place that takes so long to make a cone. i waited 25 mins tonite. there is no reason for this. absolutely none. they really need to do better here.
name: Chris

text: The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food was good and came out fast. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not bad for a quick meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Margaret Kuo's is my favorite destination for high quality sushi. I love the atmosphere and staff. The have the best Chinese food in the main line hands down. Been coming here for years.
name: Nick

text:
It was our first time at The Drunken Chicken and we were SO HAPPY with our selection. 

This place has everything you could want from a killer chicken joint. The Basic chicken sandwich is anything but. The chicken is juicy, tender, flavorful (and not to mention free of hormones, humanely raised, and never frozen.) The onion rings are CRISPY AF and delish. Most surprising was the chicken cheesesteak with cheddar AND pepper-jack sauce obviously made from scratch.

This place has KILLER food, great ambiance, friendly and chill staff, and a stellar music (and beer) selection. 

Can't say enough amazing things about this spot. This just became a weekly ritual.
name: Carly

text:
Stopped in early morning, limited options:

Wife and I split a Fit Fare Skillet with 4 slices of Bacon.   Location is not in the best part of town,  HOWEVER, Bernice was an outstanding waitress and crew seemed to work well together.

We complemented the Chef as everything was cooked perfectly and the cast iron skillet helped keep it warm while we served helpings.

People make the Difference!
name: George

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up.
name: User

text: Great restaurant both food and service was A1. The seafood dishes are top notch and super fresh. The beers are not my favorite but everything else was unbelievable. Love the atmosphere and awesome vintage building. Our waiters Anthony and Shelby were awesome. I'll be back.
name: Marshall

text: The drive through is always a fast option here. The speaker isn't distorted, the employees are great and the coffee is as excellent as their food. It is also easy to get in and out of which I can't say for the Einsteins only a couple miles away on gulf to bay.
name: Olga

text: I hate to do this, but experienced literally the worst service today at Royal House. Been coming here for years and had to change my 5 star review. After being seated right away we waited over 50 minutes to get our drinks and they arrived after we were done eating. A draft beer and an iced tea ‍. Royal house is my go to in New Orleans and will probably remain so but today was the worst service I experienced there in the last 4 years of coming and hopefully next visit Royal can earn the 5 stars back.
name: Boris

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. No big complaints, just a nice meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Great service. The food was very bland, no seasoning. The drink I had tasted like pure soda water without the vodka. A shame, won't return.
name: Diane

text: Have been here many times over the years and it's always a great crowd. They have live music and a few dart boards. The bar staff does a good job and the food looks yummy although I haven't tried it.
name: Dana

text: Happened in on a Monday night during a family vacation. We were staying near Magazine Street and looking for a Mexican restaurant that would keep our group happy, including a teen who is gluten-free. I got the feeling that this is a reasonably popular place that caters to locals but we felt very welcome. It was quite busy and as best we could tell there were only two people working the dining room - they were hustling like crazy but service was entirely friendly, and food came out well prepared and well timed. Server did a nice job helping our GF diner consider her options and double-checked with the kitchen to help reassure on a couple of questions. We really enjoyed the salsa sampler (good, fresh, several unusual options) and guacamole, and mains were good, too. We would happily go back on our next visit to NOLA.
name: Mark

text: This restaurant is consistently clean, has really nice employees, and the food tastes great! What more do you need at a McDonald's?!
name: Jo

text: I hate to complain, but since its not in person here goes.  The food here is usually passable, but they are keeping the dining room ice cold for some reason.  I have to wear a coat to be comfortable.  and they place is just dirty, not day to day dirty but used up and in need of renovation dirty,  things that mopping will not cure.  Its just old and outdated.  The men's room for instance, has walls covered with residential grade acrylic bathroom wall  paneling  not suitable to stand up to  public use.  If you cant afford a professional renovation of at least the bathroom, what else are you skimping on?  Food safety? I don't know, I'm just sayin'.
name: David

text: Stop! The very best Italian in Tampa! From presentation to taste, the food is incredibly done well. Servers are classically trainee. All prices reasonable from wine to pastas. But go for the taste and you'll keep going back. Can't wait.
name: Joseph

text:
Only thing I'm giving a 1 star is because there  is no option for a zero star.  The only reason I would go back is because they have a amazing massage therapist. Other than that total waste of money and time.

 I have not sure where to begin about my stay. It first started off at check in with Karen (mortisha) .. I walked in and immediately felt like I was inconveniencing her. I patiently waited for her to complete other things behind the desk and after about 7 minutes I asked if I could check in. She did not apologize for my wait, she got my last name and placed the paperwork on the counter and began to type.. I waited about another 5 minutes and said do you need anything else from me. She looked up at me and said "I didn't realize you were still here you're done and valet is gone"
I wanted to also ask her about wedding venue elections. After that stay.. Never know what I want to have a wedding there!!!!

I headed out to the car looked at the map and figured out where parking was and had a bit of a hard time finding where our room would be due to not wanting to inconvenience Karen with asking her any questions. There was a nice gentleman in the lobby who saw that my fiance and I were lost and pointed us in the correct direction. It was a bit late but my fiance and I decided to go to the pool for a bit to see what all the loud music was about. There are no chairs and no towels available at 5 p.m. we went to the bar (had to stand for there were no seats avalible) and both got a very watered-down $10 drink. Decided since there were no chairs to sit and read a book by the pool you would go to our room change and go to dinner. We went to the restaurant in your facility.. sat outside to enjoy the beautiful weather.. Unfortunately there was a smoker out there that we got to eat dinner with! Not exactly enjoyable. So we left and went on a walk. We back to our room and went to sleep only to be awoken by the cleaning crew knocking at our door although we asked for a late check-out (and do not disturb sign on the door) they were knocking at 9 a.m. so unfortunately we did not get to sleep in and enjoy our getaway. But we got up and we headed to our massage.. Nobody seemed to know where we were supposed to go so we were about 5 minutes late to our massage. My fiance was not impressed by his massage (heather)  once so ever as he felt she was bored with a "relaxation massage". Our only saving grace was the massage therapist I received. He was very knowledgeable and knew what he was doing. Needless to say are "break away get away" was not very pleasant. The only way I'd ever return is if we soley cane for a massage with Ian and would not stay. For we were told that you had to be 16 and older to be in the spa area.. They were two children with adults under the age of 12 in there.

I am only writing this to bring  attention that there are some areas that need to be adjusted or looked into before trying to promote this relaxing get away.
name: Kymmie

text:
Don't let the outside appearance fool you! I thought we were pulling up to a billiard bar.  Walked inside and I was like, wow. not what I expected! Soft piano music in the background, very clean... They serve edamame free to the table; and it is SO good! Perfectly salted and cooked. 
We got the mediterranean, blue jay, and Osaka. OMG! Soooo good!!  
We also had the ginger sesame salad - also very yummy!
name: September

text: I don't think ever once this place let me down when I came home after a long day at work and worn out to go anywhere. They do Grubhub and they're pretty good with their prices and combinations plates..and I promise you won't be disappointed with the wait time if it's getting delivered to you! They serve big portions of the food and you can definitely tell it's fresh from the looks and smell of it. I highly recommend it for anyone who wants it delivered or just Mexican food in general
name: Naila

text: Best bread pudding. Tried all the french quarter spots plus a few out of town cafes. Hands down the best.
name: Melissa

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The music was louder than it needed to be. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It was crowded but still moved along. Price felt a touch high for what it was. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, tho the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text: We went for a second time yesterday and not nearly as impressed as the first time.  Food was ok but not great, the cannelloni was freezer section worthy.  Mood ok but be consistent.  It was so loud in the bar which made everyone speak for loudly.  So bright, then lights dimmed then bright then dim again.....be consistent overall.  Server ok but not very friendly, certainly not as good as Dylan the first visit.  Likely pick another place in the future.  Lack of consistency will kill this place.
name: Chenz

text: Charcuterie is one of the best I've ever had! Waiter knew about every item we ordered. Wine, beer and water only. Flatbread are amazing as well
name: Kat

text: It's been so long since we went to squeeze in for breakfast! The menu is massive and there's definitely something for everyone.  I went with the racy tracy omelette which had mushrooms,  cheese and bacon. The cook on the bacon was perfect, not soggy, and the omelette was so fluffy! Definitely a knife and fork meal though. House potatoes are great and I opted to add onions. The dice on the onions was too fine which kind of threw off the aesthetic but they are just potatoes, so no harm right? My husband ordered the lobster benedict. THREE perfectly poached eggs, not just two. Big chunks of lobster, and the most delicious hollandaise in town. Seriously I hate hollandaise and this stuff was buttery deliciousness. Coffee refills kept coming and the wait staff was super attentive.  Our meal was brought out by the cook himself, and he was also super friendly.  The one star loss for me is because I kept getting bumped into as I ate and drank. I get it...it's called squeeze in and all....but seriously? Give your patrons some room to eat and have their coffee without having an ass slam into their chair every two minutes.  Very annoying. Overall though it was a great visit, and we will certainly be back. I'll just ask for a table along the wall!  Oh..and thank you to the wait staff for updating our club card address! You guys are stellar.
name: Kathryn

text:
I'm embaressed to say that I'm barely trying this place after 8 years of living in Boise!! This place is phenomenal!!! I literally wanted to lick the plate after I finished. I ordered the honey bbq glazed salmon and it came with a generous portion of veggies and mashed potatoes!! You can always tell fresh veggies versus frozen and these were definately fresh!!! I also had their bloody mary which was fairly good and the calamari as an appetizer.

This place really knocks the ball out the fence when it comes to seafood in the treasure valley. The menu was so diverse I had a hard time choosing. My husband had the pistachio crusted hailbut and it was equally flavorful. The kids menu was good too, both my boys had cheeseburgers. The only negative thing I can say is I wish there was a larger seafood selection on the kids menu but it's understandable being that my kids are few who enjoy seafood.

Long story short, we will never go back to Red Lobster again :)
name: Nikkeya

text:
Great venue with great food!
We were seated in a space in the back because of a wedding reception in the front. It was like our own little room!  
We all enjoyed great wine and some classic pasta because we were running a race the next day!
name: Diana

text: Came here after visiting the wife in the hospital. I've drove by a few times and thought hmm, lets have a try. Good burgers and beer. Not crowded at all and the young lady was very helpful with beer selection. Took a pic of my beer and nachos to post on a social media site so I'm looking forward to checking it out.
name: Patrick

text:
Been going to Signature grill for brunch as a treat and special occasion since I can remember  UNTIL NOW!
 Last few times it just isn't the same, both service and quality of food. GRANTED I still love their Pasole!!!

After a 5 min waiting in line to be seated, we were sat in the very corner of the room. And waited for another 20 mins before the hubs and i were offered something to drink. 
While we waited I looked at the a la cart menu hoping to find my favorite French toast. It was discontinued. At this point the food runner mistakenly try to give me an oatmeal that the table behind me ordered. (As if I came to a buffer to eat oatmeal...lol) C'mon now!!!!

The Hubs decided to peruse through the buffet and was highly disappointed. The pastries we cold and hard as if they bought them at a local grocery store, the bacon were not the regular thick cut but rather (again) the grocery leftover brand that the 99cents store put on final clearance. The bread and cereal station was in shambles as if a pack of hyenas ran sacked it. 

Mind you I'm still waiting for my coffee and at this time I can feel the the Incredidble Hulk metamorphosing through me ready to explode.

The omelette line is now ordered through the server, oh which by the way we haven't seen yet.  
The hubs came back from his site survey and finally flagged down 2 bussers to see who is our server!
Ugggghhh the frustration of not getting good service for the price!

All in all, a major disappointment.  Gone are the lavishly eye appealing well presented array of sustenance fit for a king! Rather ordinary.

Oh btw, no ambiance,  patio is closed for renovations
name: Veronica

text: A MUST GO and ask for AMANDA... she was absolutely the best waitress I have ever had at any restaurant.  Everything she recommended to order was awesome and on-point! Delicious food, great beer (love the magnet at the bottom of the glass) and friendly atmosphere. #1 choice for food when coming to Nashville. We will be back every time we come to visit. Please please please... ask for Amanda. She will make your experience a memorable one and leave you feeling great.
name: Kristi

text: We reserved the back room for a wedding rehearsal dinner this April. We had approximately 34 people at the dinner and twelve of those were young children. The staff was excellent in all respects, the food was delicious, and the venue was lovely. I highly recommend the Russet. We live out of state and the entire process of reserving the room for the dinner from beginning to end was clear, professional, economical. We were very pleased and will visit again when we are in town. Their homemade sodas were a hit too!
name: Wanda

text: The food is fabulous.  There is a bartender named Grace who goes above and beyond kindness to take care of all your needs.
name: Jan

text: I ordered a regular sized foil pan of jerk chicken $35 for a party I was having and it was amazing. I placed the order in person 2 days prior to pick up.  I told them I would return 2 days later at a specified time. When I came back my order was ready and promptly handed over. The woman I dealt with was very kind.
name: Adrienne

text: Just left this place after waiting over one hour for service. The waitress actually took our order 3 times and finally the owner's daughter came over and told us the order tickets never went through. Drink orders were missed as well. I watched as a number of the wait staff wondered around with no orders coming out.  I've worked in the restaurant business. This is not the way to run one. Enough said!
name: Anthony

text:
This place is probably a 3.5 stars in my book if I could rate it that. This diner gives some massive portions but I do think they are comparable to most diners that are served in Santa Barbara, the prices are a little high too but you could easily make two meals out of most of the dishes that they serve.

They have interesting decor that makes me feel like the owners used to eat at diners in the midwest but moved to California to make their own diner so they added surfboards on the walls. 

The food here is solid, they definitely know how to make breakfast and they got some interesting choices for dinner(looking at you Liver and Onions). The service is the one thing that I would like them to improve upon. It took about 12 minutes before we could order our dish, and we had to catch our waiter to get the check. The restaurant wasn't packed and most people already had out dishes so I was hoping we could get our drinks orders at the 5 minute mark and our entrees at the 7 minute.

I've been there a few other times and the first time the server comes along usually takes the longest so be careful if you have a one hour lunch break like me and don't want to get back to work late.
name: Aowei

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not bad for a quick meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Had a great breakfast here. Definitely a must while in NOLA. I had struck out a few times trying to find a good breakfast spot in the quarter. So happy we chose this place.
name: Terrence

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Not sure though.
name: User

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kinda leveled out. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Food was good and came out fast. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
Wasn't there long . Welcomed us in sat down at a table. Waited 10 minutes no one came to ask us for a drink or menu. Then went to the bar to order 2 drinks got carded . Didn't bring my ID in with me while we bar hop on Broadway. They wouldn't serve me because the State cracks down on them for under age drinking.  
I guess at 52 I must be looking really good.  lol 

The BB King in Memphis was so nicer than this place. 
So if you go to Broadway in Nashville , don't forget your ID
name: Joseph

text: Oh Frankie Ann's! I've tried so hard to like this place but the slow and incompetent service gets us every time we go and the food isn't even close to good enough to make up for the service. Tonight we waited over 25 minutes as the only outdoor table to place our orders and that only happened because I talked to someone. After our food finally came, my husbands burger was inedible and he ordered take out from Bishops Collar. If this had been a one off event, I wouldn't be posting, but this has been our experience on some level the dozen or so times we've gone to Frankie Ann's. As a near by resident I kept hoping this place would improve, but after our visit tonight, that hope is gone.
name: Kelley

text: NOT worth the price! Me and my family have ordered takeout several times and there is always something wrong! This time, garlic bread was missing for all 3 meals and bread missing for crab dip... how can I even eat the dip without something to dip in it?! The delivery took over an hour because the drive claimed to have gotten lost for the 3rd time after delivering to my house.. they forgot the sauce for my crab cakes and my vegetables came burnt. Don't waste your dollar..
name: Lauryn

text:
Came on a Sunday, was PACKED. If you are planning on coming for Sunday half priced sushi, come early. For a group of 6 we only waited 20 mins for a table thankfully. For the half price sushi you must buy a beverage (can be non-alcoholic). 

Sushi rolls are normally $15+. So half price is a great deal. Our group decided to order altogether and share everything. Unfortunately, we waited over an hour for the food to arrive. I get they were busy though. Our server did his best, props to him. 

Some qualms... I am surprised for a sushi place that they don't serve hot tea. This should be a staple. And who orders Alfredo pasta at a sushi place? Anyway, don't expect authenticity here. 

For the sushi itself, it was not bad, but I would definitely not pay full price for it. I liked the dragon roll and Mt Fuji (IIRC).
name: Jen

text: Chicken Cali sandwich used to taste good a few years ago. Now the chicken has no flavor , small size for an $6 price point, and the guacamole isn't that good. This used to be served with sliced avocado. I'll just go to chick fil-a up the road for a better chicken sandwich.
name: Jose

text: Great restaurant!  A few friends and I stop by while in NOLA for a weekend. Food was awesome and the waitress T'Keyah was great.  Loved her bright attitude and smile. She has a great knowledge of the food selection and gave us some good recommendations.
name: Alexis

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Would return. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
Soo over-rated. Ordered ginger hot tea and got brown water with no flavor. There was no tea bag in my cup obviously whatever tea they put in there needed much longer to steep. Definitely not worth the $4. The pour over coffee my boyfriend got was meh.  Cool vibe not worth the price. 

At least with Starbucks you get the same consistent coffee it may not be the best but at least you can count on it
name: Kellie

text:
I came here last Saturday during the brunch time to pick up a loaf of sour dough. This place, of course, was packed (Are we even surprised about that...) but the bakery/coffee counter had its own line so the waiting game was not so bad at all! 

Sour dough tasted amazing and it was fresh for next few days so I would like to give 5 stars BUT gosh please have someone knowledgeable of your own restaurant as a cashier! Before I ordered, I clearly saw that there were two different pricing for sour dough based on the size. I asked her for the small one yet she rang me up for the large one. When I pointed that out, she just said "Oh we only carry one size for all the loaves." Well... asked her to walk up to the shelf and look them herself yet she just repeated that they were all same. Whatever... did not feel like wasting my time arguing with her so I just bought the large one. I asked her if she had any recommendation/tip for heating the bread up and do you know what she told me? "Well... people cut into slices and eat". I mean REALLY GIRL? I do not know what you were doing there but I think somebody needed to take a nappppppppppppppp.
name: Jiwon

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Food was delightful! Went on mother's day and the service was still wonderful for a party of 12 on such a busy day.
name: Alice

text: My husband and I ate here last night, and it was so good that we came back for lunch.  We came for the housemade pastas, and the two we had were absolutely divine (ravioli and campanelle with roasted greens, etc.).   And this is coming from a food-obsessed person who has traveled and eaten extensively in Italy.  I cannot fault the service and staff was very friendly and accommodating.  Donna F
name: Donna

text: This place was so hyped for me but I was not a fan. Maybe they were just having an off day? I got ribs and the brisket with a side of green beans and cheesy potatoes. The ribs did not fall off the bone and the brisket wasn't as tender as I thought it was going to be. Not to mention I was still hungry after the small portion sizes. I will probably choose other bbq places over this one.
name: Janice

text:
Visiting Boise on an interview and stopped by here - what a fun place :) 
Very cool spot to hang out, good place to chill and get some work done or to have a beer and relax. Fire playlist going in the background. And one of the best cake donuts I've ever had !! 
Chatted with the owner as well who was absolutely delightful. Would definitely recommend checking this place out.
name: Mirmy

text: We were driving through and wanted a nice dinner near our hotel. We stumbled upon this place with no referral or anything. It was amazing. The food was excellent, the service was phenomenal, and the atmosphere was exactly what we needed to relax and enjoy a nice dinner. The server was perfect. Friendly, informative, and took great care of us. The manager was also very nice, personable, and accommodating. I highly recommend this place. Great food, great service, great staff.
name: Michael

text: My husband and I visited today for the first time. The building and vibe is wonderful, love that it's Boise based. The employee that helped us was friendly and gave us a quick overview of our options. We both wanted smoothies. We chose the "blend" smoothie option. It was much too thick and difficult to drink with a straw. The flavors were a bit contradicting as well. I think this option would be fine as a bowl - not satisfying as a smoothie.
name: Becki

text: So happy The Blind Tiger has made its way to south Florida! I originally use to visit the Ybor shop but now I can walk over to the soho location and it's the perfect spot to meet up with friends, relax over coffee or a drink, or grab a bite.
name: Ashley

text: Lots of cool food and shops to explore. Super crowded on the weekends though. Definitely try out the Philly cheesesteak and cheese fries when in Philadelphia!
name: Maggie

text: I love this place. The food is uniformly delicious. This is not the typical Mexican food one gets at a low price eatery (although I certainly like that, too.) Most dishes at Teresa's are made without cheese, rice or beans, and rely instead on really well-prepared vegetables and meats. I'm a vegetarian and the vegetarian choices include squash blossom quesadillas, tacos filled with grilled brussel sprouts, and Chile rellenos as main dishes. My kids, who aren't vegetarians, have loved the dishes made with brisket, skirt steak, and tinga chicken. The tortilla soup and palm salad are terrific, too. Oh, and get the corn side dish; it's delicious. Most menu items cost around $10; nothing costs more than about $12. Because it's a couple of blocks from my house, I often order food to take out but the place itself is cheerful,  light, clean, and  colorful so fun to eat there, too.
name: Amy

text: Looked on yelp for some place to get lunch after a beach day. Decided to try this place out. I was in the mood for oysters. Oyster shooter and raw oysters were $1 each after 4 up until 7. We started with 2 oyster shooters and 6 raw oysters. Oysters were awesome and fresh. My boyfriend ordered fish and chips and I ordered the lobster roll. Both entrees came with fries. The fish was good. It was soft and fluffy. The chips (fries) could've been better. My lobster roll wasn't the greatest. The lobster didn't seem fresh and it was bland. It could've been more seasoned and tasty. The service here was good though. Wouldn't care to return.
name: Amy

text: If you want to eat something different and delicious, you have to visit this place. Also, the environment is fantastic. You can either eat or have a drink. I love it, and I'm writing this review after been eating there several times.
name: Arelys

text: After a few trips it's certain they will mess up your order a good 85% of the time. Long wait for a fucked up order you didn't want..
name: David

text: This is one the best Italian restaurants that I've experienced in south jersey. I suggest making reservations as the place does fill up fast. It is on the pricier side, but being BYOB certainly helps. Personally I have no problem spending a little more money if the quality of food warrants it - and on both of my two trips this place has delivered outstanding food both times. On top of the food - these servers are absolutely incredible. They know the menu and specials inside and out and really help complete the experience.
name: Scott

text: This is the BEST place to grab a solid burger, fries and a drink for under $5.  When I first heard of this place I was a little worried that at that price it would be a horrible burger but it was great.  I am a return visitor and will continue to eat here.
name: Kane

text:
This coffee shop is fairly new and a couple blocks away from the hustle and bustle of downtown. It's all a pretty hidden gem so it's not crowded!

The coffee is good, but nothing I'd make a special trip for. I just ordered a brewed coffee and my friend got an iced vanilla latte. She said the iced latte was pretty good but again wouldn't make a special trip. 

The atmosphere is great in the shop and there is both inside and outside seating. The staff is very friendly and service is quick.
name: Whitney

text: The food was good but unspectacular.  The calamari appetizer was the most disappointing part but everything else was tasty.   I expected more based on all the hype.   The staff was friendly and brought us a free desert for our anniversary, which was much appreciated.  We got the sopapillas which was probably my favorite food for the evening.    We were disappointed after making a reservation very far in advance to be seated nowhere near the live music and instead being in a very generic dining area watching the music on a TV.  The prices seemed high for what we got which is the main reason I would not recommend.  I think people would enjoy the food but frankly could get the same or better for less cost elsewhere.
name: Joseph

text:
This is a fantastic place to get meats and other groceries.  A little on the pricey side but you getting better quality in most of the items.  The only drawback to Mazzaro's is the parking.  

If you go on the weekend expect a crowd!
name: Brady

text: Unbelievably cool spot in a great location. One of the best arcade bars I've been to and our new go-to spot when going out after dinner in the Central West End.
name: Zach

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not bad for a quick meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: This place is pretty cool and the menu is so diverse! I can't wait to be back. I bought a smoothie but their food looks really good too. I also got some banana bread for my mom and she loved it.
name: Gi

text:
Rather a disappointment.  The sound system was lousy. I think the band was ok but the sound system muffled them terribly.
Service was friendly but slow. I had the pork chops which were over cooked and chewy. The garlic mashed potatoes were tasty but a bit over the top on garlic. My husband had the Nashville hot chicken with medium sauce. Not impressed. The fries were tasty. The cole slaw was good. Our friends had burgers and thought they were good. But not great. 
The roof top bar was nice. 
They really need to step up their game on the quality of the food.
name: Deanne

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Would return. For the price I expected more than this. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: You can tell they care about customer experience here. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Service timing was efficient even tho it was busy. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not bad for a quick meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Back again and the service still has major holes in it.  10 minutes without a waiter when the place is half full.  The front needs to tell waiters when someone sits down.  Not the waiters fault.  It is the lack of communication between the front and the staff.  Someone please fix this!
name: Douglas

text: One of my favorite places. It's bright and cheerful with a great diversified menu. The coldest beer in town. Lots of healthy options. Excellent po-boys and pho.
name: Maura

text: Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Worth checking out. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: The staff is nice but not my favorite restaurant for brunch. I ordered the chicken biscuit and didn't really like the biscuit but the chicken was good and very large piece.
name: Jess

text: Great spot right of bourbon st of authentic southern food.  Pleasant staff, quick seating with our large group and these "secret fries" are to die for.
name: Jake

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The wait felt longer than it should have. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: So we went to order a white iced chocolate mocha, and it was just plain milk with sugar. They re-made the drink but it tasted the same. The other drinks were good
name: Zoey

text: Lilly's is my go to takeout, and it's the best! They are always polite and repeat my order back to me over the phone, and they're so friendly when I go to pick it up.  Their vegan pho is so incredible!!!
name: G

text:
Not a prayer in the world that I'll ever come back here. Came on a relatively busy night and sat down. No one handed us menus or even came over to take drink orders.  One of the people in my party had to go up to the front to get our menus. Another told the waitress passing by to please take our drink and food orders as there was no acknowledgment we were even there previously which was met with "we're very busy and I'll get to you as soon as I can".

Dinner took god knows how long to come out, and half the dishes were not up to par.

To be blunt, dinner flat out sucked. This is NOT restaurant quality food.

Somebody in the kitchen went CRAZY with the cayenne pepper on the Cajun pasta, which by the way does not feature real crab, instead it's surimi. It was chokingly inedible. We're a party that doesn't send food back...we just wanted to leave quick and didn't want to stick around despite the poor quality.

I will bet you every red cent on earth the seafood ravioli comes from Restaurant Depot. No chance that is fresh pasta or sauce the consistency of wallpaper paste.

Pasta Primavera was tasteless to say the least.

Kids Mac & cheese was Kraft right out of the box.

Service was downright awful. Not even offered coffee or dessert, check was just dropped on our table with a "have a goodnight" from the most disinterested waitress I've seen in years.

A family comes out to a reasonably pricey joint and this is what they get? Fat chance I'll be back, it reminds me of that train wreck Gianino's on Lindbergh before they shut down too. Ciao Nicoletti family, I'm done.
name: Steve

text: Authentic and tasty. A different experience. And we had the chicken and the shrimp and they have some hot beef that's excellent.
name: Laurence

text: This is a new location in Saint Louis at the Galleria. We usually travel to Saint Charles for churrasca but this will be our new place! The meat selections are wonderful! They are very accommodating to your preference of how you like your meat cooked. The staff is very pleasant and helpful and the restaurant is nice and clean. Their drinks are really good also.

text: Do I really need to write a review? If it's not obvious after 100 years that this is the deli to go to then I what can I do to convince you? The owner is often on site making sure everything is done to perfection. I'm from the NY region originally and this place is as good if not better. They have pastrami that is not chewy but melt in your mouth and sliced to the perfect thickness. The latkes have good crunch and the applesauce they serve with it is great but if you like sour cream who am I to judge you for making poor life choices. They have all the Dr. Browns flavors including cel-Ray soda but I will never try that. The pickles are full sour but half sour are available for you snow flakes. The desserts are banging. I like to sit in the section where they have the old deli pics on the wall and not the politician and actor and entertainer section for the Johnny come latelies who show up for the photo op on their way to a cheesesteak place on their way to some other press nonsense. So leave center city and the burbs and come to the only deli that your stomach deserves
name: Glen

text: When we went last, there was salsa on the table. As this is one of the highlights of approaching a restaurant like this, we all dug in! Unfortunately, it was so spicy that it was almost unbearable. My whole family loves spicy foods and I make it a point to order spicy stuff when I can because I enjoy it. This was nearly inedible. text: I was in NOLA for a conference, and Domenica was recommended by a local. My two colleagues and I split a salad, pizza, and a dessert. It was the perfect amount of food for us. Great atmosphere, and excellent food. The wine list was decent as well.
name: Siobhan

text:
Cash Only. There is an ATM inside restaurant (but its best to just bring cash so you don't have to pay a fee). 

Nan Zhou Hand Drawn Noodle House is located in Chinatown, next door to Dim Sum Garden and 2 doors down from The Halal Guys. 

My husband and I came here a few minutes before 8 pm on a Friday night and were seated immediately. But we were lucky to get a table because it didn't look like there were any other tables left. 

Anyways, we were given menus and then ended up ordering:

Taro Smoothie, $3.25 prior to tax- My husband ordered this. This drink was on the sweet side and would ask if the sweetness level can be adjusted. Also this drink was powdery at times and would not recommend getting drinks here. 

Bok Choy With Fresh Garlic, $8.95 prior to tax- Tasty bok choy that is large enough to share with 4 people. Great garlic flavor but was oily. We did not finish this and had leftovers. 

Noodle With Peanut Sauce, $4.25 prior to tax- I opted for this dish since I prefer dry style noodles over noodles in a soup. I decided to get my noodles hand drawn (or hand pulled). But you can also choose knife cut, which makes for an even chewier texture. I liked the sauce that was used in this dish. Although this dish appears to be small, it was a perfect size for one person. 

Beef Tendon Noodle Soup, $8.50 prior to tax- My husband ordered this, as a recommendation from our friend who has dined here a few years before. He opted for the hand drawn style noodles too and thought it was a good texture for him. The tendons were tender and the soup was flavorful. A great portion for one but really could be shared with another person. 
------------------------
(Total= $26.95 after tax, prior to tip)

Service was fine for the most part. We had our water glasses refilled during our meal and we had dirty dishes removed. Employees did also check up on us more than once during our dining experience. 

Overall, the food was delicious, the price was pretty reasonable and I would come back here again if I was visiting Philadelphia again.

Please note that the restrooms are in the back, pass the register and down the long hallway. It was clean and adequately stocked with the essentials. 

Also the servers here do speak English so you shouldn't have a problem with making an order and eating here.
name: Vic

text: I love their Baguette!!! This is the softest baguette I've had for Bahn Mi. I had the Chicken Ga and the chicken is juicy. The Bahn mi is amazing!! Fast service. They don't have fountain soda though, just like any typical Vietnamese restaurants.
name: Vee

text: This place is an absolute gem! Friendly service,  clean restaurants,  gracious owner and amazing chef(s). The food  was awesome and plentiful. The soups were absolutely  homemade fresh, not overcooked bread hot and delicious.  I forget the name of our main dish but it had sausage, mushrooms, sundried tomatoes and pasta. I had it with spaghetti  my sister had the penne. We ate 1/4 of it was so good. We ordered a grandmother's  pizza to go, asked the split it into two boxes..no issue and that too was awesome. Just enough of everything. Cant wait to go back. This is not fast food and the minimal  wait is nothing when the food is this great. The owner came to our table  to find out if everything  was okay and we could not have expressed it better than to say it well exceeded our Hopes and everything  was delicious.  We'll  be back for certain.
name: KD

text: I was honestly very surprised. I haven't had good experiences with this style of restaurant but the employees were happy to take orders and answer questions. The burger was high quality and I'd highly recommend the blueberry ketchup - surprising but delicious. Floors were a dirty but other than that, fantastic!

text:
Quickly seated, quick food service and everything was delicious! Must try!

We had the Baron Benedict and the PBJ Chicken biscuit. Would recommend BOTH!

text:
Come hungry. Get Thirsty. 

Great margaritas, can't just have one! Sat at the bar for dinner and a margarita. Extensive menu, lots to choose from. Not sure what to choose when your stuck between two great options ask your waiter/waitress. We were recommend the the Enchiladas Rojas and the Chicken Tamales. text: Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. A couple small things kept adding up. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.

text: My son's redfish came out raw.  Not undercooked.  Raw like sushi.  You couldn't even cut into it bc it was so raw.  When we informed the waiter, he said;  "I'll get that out of your way." and left the table.   No:  "I'm sorry."  or  "Would you like something else?"  or a manager visit to our table.  I wasn't even sure if they were going to try and charge us for the raw redfish based on his response.  I had to ask him.  We left and had dessert elsewhere since my son basically did not get an entree.  I would have never written this review, but I emailed Seaworthy and they never responded or acknowledged my email.  The response from the higher ups in this company was about like our waiter's response to the raw fish.  Does anyone over there even care?  Seaworthy is not worthy of our dining dollars when we visit NOLA again.

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Overall, a strong experience. name: User

text: I wish I could give five stars because based on the food I would. For customer service, I would give 1 Star. I was super excited after hearing so many people talk about the vegan soft serve. Upon arrival, I noticed a really cute building that had a little fenced in area with chickens in the back. I walked in the building and asked for a bowl. I had never been here before so I wasn't sure how to order. She told me she just did the base. I was a little confused initially and she seemed annoyed at me. At no point was she friendly. Event the next person I dealt with had the same attitude and barely put any toppings on the soft serve. My husband commented afterward about how rude the customer service was. Not one smile or one "enjoy" did we hear. As far as the bowl goes, the soft serve was delicious and the ingredients tasted fresh. I had the matcha/charcoal mix with dark chocolate pieces, bee pollen, dragonfruit powder, fruit, and goji berries. The berries were kind of hard so I probably won't get them added if/when I go back. The price $9 is kind of a lot, but that's about the normal rate for these kinds of treats around here. My friend seemed to have a more filled bowl when she went awhile back which seems more worth the$9. However, I didn't regret paying that one but as it was so good and it's enough in my option to share with someone. You can always get just soft serve if you're on a budget that day! I recommend trying it because from what I can tell the customer service is hit or miss and the taste is worth it!
name: Savannah

text:
I came in the other day for some lunch with a friend and I must say I stoked on the "BBQ Salmon sandwich"!! We had Katty helping us navigate the menu. She had great recommendations and was very knowledgeable with there menu. We were both pumped on the food and super full by the end. We will definitely be returning soo 

HEADS UP!!! They also have a super cute back patio tucked back there!! Thanks for having us

text: The best coffee in Tampa ! The guys are super nice and the coffee is amazing. Replaced Starbucks for me completely

text:
I was looking for a new crawfish place bc all the places I've been to in south jersey and philly are pretty mediocre..  Love this place! Came here for the first time for crawfish and definitely coming back. The crawfish and shrimp are fresh, big, and juicy! The sauce is very garlicky, flavorful, not as salty (how I like it), and soo soo good! Also, got the sweet potato fries and Vietnamese yogurt! 

Didn't try it yet but they also have pho obviously from the name, BBH, banh boc loc, and banh beo. this is a hidden gem.

text: This is one of the great BYOB's . Service is really good and to vibe is out standing. Can't wait to go back!

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Food was fresh and service was quick. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Pretty happy with it overall. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text:
Read my lips...Order the Mac and Cheese.  This Ritz Cracker White Cheddar masterpiece is great the day it is made and even better as leftovers.  Salt and Smokes take on Mac and Cheese must be tasted to believe how delicious it is.  This Mac and Cheese is perfect along side smoked meats and other stand out side dishes.  

My favorite thing to order is the Bestie Combo - Two Meats, Two Sides, and a Cheddar Jalapeno Popover.  It is hard to choose between the Pulled Pork, Pulled Chicken, and Lean Brisket, I love them all.  The meat has just the perfect amount of smoked flavor.  This meat does not need sauce it stands on its own, but house made BBQ sauces are all nice and can be a good dipping sauce for Fries as well.  I always have leftovers, which make a perfect second dinner.

The best part of this location is the tiered patio seating.  I love all of the Salt and Smokes in the St. Louis Area and will return soon.
name: Kristen

text: I ordered by DoorDash and I was very pleased with my food. I got the chicken tinga empanada and the veggie quesadilla. The food was hot when it arrived and well packaged in the bag. I like that they stapled the bag so I could feel secure that the food wasn't tampered with. The empanadas were delicious and flaky and the filling had good flavor. The veggie quesadilla was also very satisfying and bothered made for good leftovers when reheated in the oven. Will def order/visit again.

text:
First time in NOLA and was very pleased with the Ruby Slipper. Eggs Benedict was delish! Bloody Mary was on of the best I've ever had
...double. Busy, but worth the 30 min wait!

text:
I really like this place. Actually, I'm falling in love with east Nashville more and more. The space isn't in the most ideal location, but the space itself is fantastic. It's super cute. The decor and lights are what draw you in. The drinks keep you there. 
I love that even before walking in there's an outside patio area that is super inviting. The ambiance is inviting. You walk into an even more inviting space. Queue comfy chairs and couches along with tables to gather. The bar is the right and has plenty of bar stools. There's a back room where events and tastings are held. The bottling area is downstairs. 
If you go back outside, there's a separate room to the right of entrance which is their merchandise store.  Buy bottles, cans, or other merch. 

I really enjoyed my time here and the white wine and rosé are fantastic. 

It's def a gem to try out.

text:
Dined here with my girlfriend on a Sunday evening during a recent visit to New Orleans. The space had wonderful ambiance while also exuding a "neighborhood" restaurant feel due to its location on a relatively quiet section of Magazine Street - seemingly suitable for both a romantic date night or a more casual get together with friends. 

We (of course) ordered the blue crab beignets which very much lived up to the hype. Perhaps I'm biased because I love blue crab, but they were lightly fried and did not feel as heavy as one might anticipate. In addition, we shared the apple and celeriac salad, a nice change from the generally heavy food of New Orleans dining, and the LPG cheeseburger, which was one of the better burgers I've had in some time - cooked to order with a well-balanced combination of toppings. Also worth noting that our drinks, an LPG French 75 and a sazerac, were also very well made. 

The service was somewhat subpar for a restaurant with the accodales that La Petite Grocery has received. After we had already ordered, we noticed there were specials listed on a black board in the back of the restaurant, however our server did not inform us of these. The television at the bar, while turned off, seemed out of place for an otherwise beautiful dining space. Overall, would certainly recommend if in the area and would happily return.
name: Rick

text:
Unique dishes. Great brunch options. Fresh ingredients. Service okay. 

A highly buzzed about brunch joint this place is as good as it gets for brunch. I only minused a star because our service was a bit haphazard for our group of 6. Reservations are only taken for groups of 6 or more on opentable. For their high tea, reservations can be made with credit card only. 

The space is large. With a clean modern look. White walls, with lime colored booths. The kitchen area has bright lighting and near the booths the lighting is more dim. Depending on the visit I would recommend this when asking for a seat. Although Sunday at noon there were no tables available and they were all completely occupied. 

Food was great. We started with the salmon gravlax with was was a perfect dish to share among 4 people. The flavours were tasty. With the pickled beets giving a nice bite to the salmon which was very unique. The homemade sourdough bread was hearty and crunchy just like in Europe.  They do make their own breads here too. 

I had the complete galette. A ham gruyere cheese crepe which had a nice saltiness in every bite. It was a savory crepe which reminded me of the famous French croque monsieur. I liked it. The buckwheat crepe was hearty and crispy which really gave it a earthy taste. It was a simple dish. But overall I was satisfied with it. My friend had the same dish and though it was too bland and simple compared to the rest of the dishes. We did share bites and the best dish I tried was the oeuf en cocotte. The rich dish was delicious and one bite was not enough...I will have to come back again just to enjoy that dish myself. The beef cheek farmers breakfast had loads of meat it you are into that. Everyone enjoyed their dishes overall. And let me tell you every plate was polished off at the end of of the meal. A great sign that the dishes were fabulous. Looking around it seemed everyone else enjoyed their meals too. 

Portion sizes are great too. Not too big or small. But I found price wise...the larger the plate the pricier the dish. For $2 or $3 more the portions were significantly larger. 

We all ordered tea or coffee.  Any specialty coffees came With a little sweet meringue cookie. Our teas were served in fancy pots on a plate. The drip coffee was very good and quite strong. I imagine it being the same as the coffee as the duchess. The tea was described all fancy. Like green tea with jasmine and hints of rose. But it was plain old jasmine green tea. The fleuris tea was a typical clover tea and the Earl grey the same. They were strong but the descriptions definetly sounded enticing and did not really live up the expectations. 

For dessert we decided to share all three. The pear ginger cake was delicious. Chocolate and warm it totally hit the spot after a great brunch meal and was not overly sweet. The lemon crepe was very good and simple. The grape crepe was unique and tasty. Honestly all of us liked each one and some preferred others. But I found them all unique and delicious. 

Service was friendly and good. A bit haphazard at times. My friend was given a tea pot with no cup. Our main entrees were delivered before our utensils. Our water cups empty unless we asked and not refilled unless we asked.(water refilled only to the person who asked and nobody else's was refilled in the process). So it was enough to minus a star. Although one of my friends is terrible and math and jipped the waitress 75 cents. An honest mistake but she did however have all those occurrences happen to her on her birthday meal. She even wanted a celebratory after meal drink but was never asked and didn't want to bother the waitress since they were closing up and cleaning the place. They even split our bill nicely without asking. Which kinda resulting in some math since not all of shared the appetizer. 

But overall. A very nice addition to the brunch scene. And my favourite in edmonton except for the fairmont Sunday brunch. A fusion of french and Scandinavian food that was really yummy. We all plan to return since it was that good.
name: Michelle

text:
Delicious food and great service, but expect a long wait for your food! We ordered food around 7:25 and didn't receive it until 8:15 or so. Fortunately I was in a bigger group and the time passed quickly, but definitely don't come if you have somewhere you need to be soon. 

Loved the ambiance, although it was pretty loud overall, and hard to hear the person next to me talking sometimes. Parking was also difficult on a Saturday night and I had to circle twice before finding a spot. 

We started out with complimentary bread that was ok. I ordered the funghi pasta and as a mushroom-lover, it was perfect. I'm glad it wasn't overly buttery/salty, and the notes of mushroom came through the yummy sauce. One of my friends ordered the HUGE lasagna---it was bigger than my face. Not surprisingly, she brought half of it home for her lunch tomorrow. Another friend tried the chicken spedini and liked it, although it's on the smaller portion size. She was the only one who finished all of her plate. The meatballs in the spaghetti were also really, really big. 

Overall, a delicious meal, and a great place to celebrate birthdays/anniversaries, and I liked that it was more affordable than other fancy places. Next time, I'm getting the lasagna!

text:
I used Panda Express for catering a luncheon and the  String bean chicken was burnt and tasted burnt. I took a photo of it and went back to the restaurant later that same day and spoke with the GM named Cameo. He was very apologetic and gave me a $30 credit to use at a later date. It was signed by him without an expiration date. Fast forward to  actually attempting to use it at the same place it was issued...the current manager Elana  would not honor it. She said that manager was no longer there. 
Would the goodwill of honoring the $30 credit hurt the profit margin of Panda Express?  No.  There was a wrong that was made right and it should have been honored. Even one of the workers recognized the signature of Cameo not to mention I was even spending more than the $30! Elana missed the point of doing what needed to be done to make the customer happy.
Here's the ironic thing... it was late in the evening and getting near closing time. I imagine there was more than $30 worth of food thrown out when they closed. She should have done the right thing. Will I be back? Doubtful, not with all the other options available in the area.

text: My husband and I chose to go to Grank Lux Cafe for dinner rather than the many other choices in the area; he'd had a really great business lunch at a Grand Lux in another location and wanted to give this one a try.  It was early for dinner, around six, but the place was crowded.  We were seated quickly at a long table with other twosomes next to us, a situation I'm not fond of but, in this case, we weren't directly in the laps of our seatmates, and we were hungry.  We were given a partial loaf of very warm, very fresh bread with a little tub of lovely butter as soon as we sat down by a helpful and friendly waiter.  We ordered a bottle of wine, one entree of three-way salmon and one of beef wellington.  The salmon was excellent, cooked to order, tasty and hot, served nicely with mashed potatoes,  crispy green beans and asparagus.  The beef wellington came with four fillets of sirloin steak, perfectly cooked (medium-well) and so tender you could practically cut them with your fork.  It, too, was served with mashed potatoes, fresh carrots and green beans and the only failure of the night: brussel sprouts that were so over-fried and oily that they were unrecognizable; the waiter had to confirm what they were.  He immediately apologized and offered a substitute.  And the mashed potatoes were warm, not hot enough.  But I'm very fussy about that; my husband thought his were fine.  All in all it was an amazing dinner for the price and we'll absolutely go back.  They also are open for brunch and lunch.
name: L.E.

text:
FINALLY! I've found an Italian food gem! I'm so grateful a friend treated me to lunch here. We sat in the bar area and hit the jackpot having Trey as our bartender. She was phenomenal! She made excellent food and drink recommendations. We received nothing but stellar service from her. Hands down best bartender in the bay. 

The food, oh my goodness, it blew my mind! We started with the pear and gorgonzola salad paired with a margarita pizza. Both were exceptional. If you sit at the bar you can see the person making your pizza, which was kinda cool. Everything taste so fresh and balanced. We couldn't visit an Italian spot and not have pasta so we shared the Rigatoni Bolognese. If you like heat ask for it spicy....y'all..... my foodie heart was singing a happy tune. The sauce on the pasta was to die for! Meaty, spicy, hearty, seasoned like a pro and absolutely perfect. I only wish they gave you a piece of bread to scoop up all that deliciousness because trust me, you're not going to want to going to waste. The pasta, which is homemade, was cooked to al dente perfection, and was the perfect vehicle for the sauce. 

They know what they're doing here. I'm told the owner is Italian and most of the chefs are Italian and  his mom checks in on them to make sure they're cooking the food right! That's what I'm talking about mama! Keep them in line LOL! Obviously, mom and everyone else is holding this place to a standard. It's obvious in the service and most definitely the food. So much so, I noticed that the bartenders and the servers use tongs to grab fruit, herbs etc for making drinks. Now this may seem like a small thing to some, but it's huge in my book. I'm low key OCD about germs and hate to see people dig their dirty, money handling fingers in a jar or container to fish out fruit for drinks. Not here, they have class and know how to do it right. I very much appreciated seeing that and it elevated my experience for sure. 

I will most definitely return! Very very soon!
name: Auyanna

text: The service at this Chick-fil-A is horrible.  I came to this location twice in the past week.  I always submit my order through the app to save time. Each time I arrived and received my food. They always forget to give me my drink.  Both times the restaurant was busy and a lot of people were waiting for their food.  This restaurant has some weird system where they have one or two pep[;e who give you only the food in your order and someone else then get's you your drink.  Well this system sucks.  I don't know ANY other Chick-fil-A that does this.  BOTH times they forgot to give me my drink. The first time I had to ask someone to give me my forgotten drink order. The lady apologized and upgraded me to a large drink.  Yesterday they forgot my drink order AGAIN. I waited a few minutes just to see if anyone would notice why I would still be standing there with my food just standing idly by.  Nobody cared to ask or inquire why I was there standing. I again had to tell a cashier my drink was forgotten again. This time she didn't apologize or upgrade my drink, she simply made me my drink and that's it, no apology.  I will never be coming back to this location. They need to give customers their COMPLETE food and drink order and not incomplete orders because both times my drinks were forgotten.
name: I.

text:
Omg this food truck is amazing. I ordered the Carolina Style Pulled Pork with Mac and cheese and collards. The bbq is kind of sweet, with a molasses style base. It's a sweet barbecue and not too much vinegar. The Mac and cheese is a shell style mac. It was creamy and really good. The collards were also on point. I usually ask for vinegar but these didn't need any extra. 

The cornbread was sweet as well and not crumbly at all. Totally a winner here. Great food truck.
name: Nancy

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. text:
Love this place! My fiance an I order take out from here probably around once a week. It's kind of become our "go-to" choice for Asain food. I would much rather eat here over any of the Chinese restaurants I've tried in Nashville.

Take out is always ready in about 15-20 minutes, and the food doesn't leave you regretting your decision to eat heavy Asian food.   Unlike some places...

We always get the Spicy Thai beef lomein and a spicy crab roll. If you can handle spicy try something else, but for the spice lovers it's a great choice!  

Delicious!
name: Morgan

text: Always pleased with the staff, food, and music. This place deserves more credit than they are given. Will always recommend and come here with my family
name: Linda

text:
It's such a shame, this used to be one of my favorite restaurants in King of Prussia.  Since I work 5 minutes away, it was my go-to for ordering take out for lunch.  Unfortunately, it has gone down hill under the new management and I will no longer be ordering from here again.
 
I placed an order for take out for dinner on my way home from work a few months ago.  When I got there to pick it up the man at the desk went to the kitchen to get it and told me there had been some type of mess up and that they hadn't gotten the order... so I ended up standing there for 25 minutes waiting for it to be done.  However, I understand that things happen and since it was one of my favorite places I was willing to overlook one incident.
 
So today my friend and I from work decided we wanted to order take out from here for lunch.  I called at 11:34 to place the order for 1 chicken schwarma platter and an order of tzatziki.  I was told it would be 25 minutes, meaning it would be ready at 11:59.  I got there to pick it up at 12:06, at which time the restaurant was less than half full.  After waiting several minutes for the woman in the front to come over, she then went into the kitchen to get my order.  At 12:11 I was told it would be a couple more minutes and she asked me if I wanted to pay, which I did.  At 12:18 I was told they were boxing it up.  So you can imagine that by 12:29 I was pretty annoyed at not having my food yet and I said something to one of the people working there.  I did not get my order until 12:33, a full 59 minutes after I had ordered it and 27 minutes after I arrived to pick it up.  Since I was told it would be 25 minutes from the time I ordered it, I assume that they didn't start making it until after I arrived to pick it up, yet again. 
 
On top of that, when I got back to my office with the food, I saw that the portion sizes have been reduced significantly.  The chicken schwarma platter used to have tons of chicken, but this time had about half the amount of chicken it used to have, and the sides were smaller as well.  What a complete disappointment.
 
I used to rave about this place to everyone I work with and recommend that they go.  No more.  This was one of my favorite places to eat for years, but I will not be going back.
name: Foodie

text: Great decor, great staff, plenty of seating, not enough parking, awesome menu, really great looking and tasting bowls and smoothies. There's also an espresso bar with coffee and espresso by Buddy Brew.

text:
The garden is beautiful, as are the courtyards you can sit and dine in. We were seated in the far courtyard by the hummingbird garden. The tables are nicely shaded and are mostly not in direct sunlight. 

The server was attentive and helpful as we looked over the brunch menu and made our decision. My mother and I decided to split the dos rancheros that came with two eggs, native fry bread, potatoes, calabacitas, ranchero and tomatillo sauces, and ham. The split charge was $4.00 but well worth it to receive a smaller yet still very filling portion. 

The presentation reminds of an open face sandwich with the fry bread on the bottom, sauce, and fried egg on top. Accompanied by the calabacitas and potatoes and either corner. Both were well cooked and well seasoned. The sauces added another layer of flavor as well. 

Overall our experience was very good and worth a stop before or after you stroll the gardens.
name: Christi

text:
I've always enjoyed coming to Domenica for a bite and have had a few different experiences. I've dined one on one, in a few large group settings, and most recently solo at the bar. Domenica is set within the The Roosevelt Hotel and it's a great place to imbibe and indulge in some delicious bites.

I wanted to escape reality and grab a few drinks and bites after a work related event. To dine alone is always a liberating experience and I genuinely wanted to meet some folks at the bar. The bar is open seating so it's a matter of just marking your territory and finding an open seat.

Wanted some small bites so I decided to go with the brussel sprouts and the meatballs. I'm not sure how to describe a scene of me eating the brussel sprouts at the bar and trying not to lick my plate clean. The sprouts were little bits of fireworks exploding in my mouth tossed with pancetta, fresh mint (such a great idea!), and feta. I'm not a big fan of feta so I was thankful they were able to use freshly shaved parmesan.

As a meatball connoisseur who has no professional licensing, you have to order these. The meatballs were served over a piping bowl of polenta and every bite was stupid delicious. To the point I used the bits of fresh complimentary bread to slop up the sauce. 

- Can I just say that eating alone is one of the best things when you don't have to share with anyone or do the obligatory wanna try dance? I'm horrible I know lol -

I've had a few of their pizzas and all are quite delicious! Their menu is pleasant and you really can't go wrong.
name: Tomas

text: I noticed this new spot 2 weeks ago while out with some friends. I was excited to grab dinner there with my neighbor, but unfortunately, it was pouring when we went to eat. I had no idea that there was an indoor seating area, and I was pleasantly surprised when we put our name in for a table. The setting is absolutely lovely and has a relaxed, romantic feel to it. We ordered the hand pulled mozzarella to share. It was pretty good--the fried capers were my favorite part of the dish. I ordered the daiquiri which was really tasty. For dinner, my neighbor ordered the swordfish and couldn't stop raving about it, and I had the burger which was delicious. I am excited to visit again when we can sit outside in the garden!

text: Really great place for healthy options.  Is clean and also have vegan/vegetarian options.  Loves the atmosphere. Definitely coming back
name: Clare

text:
Not the best first impression, but I wouldn't completely rule out a return visit. Overall, I thought it was pricey for what it was. Maybe it was an off night? Maybe I didn't pick the best items as an accurate representation of what they can do? I'm not entirely sure.

I accept full responsibility for this oversight and won't let it sway my stars, but I wanted to mention that I'd searched for Breaded Pork Tenderloin Sandwich and this had been a suggestion. Unfortunately, it's not a regular menu item. The server did confirm that they've had it before as a special but it seems to be offered sporadically. Honestly, that's the main reason I'd stopped here and it's hard to say if we'd have come otherwise since there was another restaurant closer to where we were staying.

I looked over the menu and went with the Grilled Chicken Salad. My husband got the Half Pound Bison Burger and added cheese. I also ordered a Black Pear Cider that was featured on the wall. The drink was the standout, unfortunately.

The grilled chicken was dry and the vinaigrette served with it was very bitter. I came around to it the more I ate it, but it wasn't an immediately enjoyable salad and not something I'd go for again. It wasn't an almost $10 salad, in my opinion. I think it's going to be an acquired taste. They have 4 other salads available that seem like they might be a safer bet.

The burger was good, but it's truly just a burger on a bun with some basic veggies for nearly $14. It's an additional $1 to add cheese. If a burger is going to be more than $10 then I want it to wow me. I'll allow a +$2 difference for a specialty burger, like bison. But the flavor's gotta be there to justify it. This didn't do it for us.

Our server was OK. She answered a few questions, took our order, brought the food and ran my card after the bill was dropped off. I can't recall if she asked us how everything was. We were in and out pretty quickly. I didn't find it very welcoming as a dinner spot, but I'm not opposed to returning to try something different.

At the very least, it seemed like it would be fine if you just come to drink and chill with some friends. They have a decent selection of their own beers and "OPB (Other Peoples Beer)" guests' on tap and in bottles.
name: Ericka
