text: A friend lives around the corner and took me for lunch. The food was so good I went back for dinner. I got the lemongrass soup, fried tofu with plum sauce, and vegetable panang curry...level 2 spice.
name: Melissa

text: Ah a Great new place downtown for walk in. The Seafood is fresh ..Great choices for bowls of goodness and alot of Healthy options to choose from ..
name: Carol

text:
First time here to his former China buffet turned pancake house. The parking lot was packed so we almost didn't go. We got right in. Th decor of this place is a hodgepodge. We were served immediately. The menu has your typical breakfast lunch stuff. I had the eggs Benedict. It came out crazy fast. The Benedict sauce was a bit runny for my liking but it was still good. I was watching the way the cook/plating was and it was so organized and clean. There seemed to be one person whose one job was putting the food on a tray to make sure it was correct. Not only that but he kept that area spotless and made sure the servers took the food right out. As packed as this place was all the servers were calm and cool and polite. 

We left around 10:45 and there was a bit of a wait but they were getting everyone in fast.
name: Chrissy

text: As my first time ever in Philly, this will hands down be my go-to brunch destination from here on out. My boyfriend and I visited during a weekday afternoon and was welcomed by a warm atmosphere with excellent and quick service. I got the huevos rancheros and they were phenomenal. My boyfriend got the pesto and portobello bowl and it was very healthy and filling!
name: Esther

text: Great pho! Glad to have a place close. The spices were great. I had the meatballs and they were a bit odd of a texture, a little rubbery for my taste. But the egg rolls and noodles were great.
name: Nick

text: I had brittany as a waitress! The best waitress I've ever had and that was saying a lot from a newbie from Kc! She was the upmost attentive, and responsive to her clients tastes! She was so personable and made me feel welcome! I will always come back because of Brittany alone!
name: Brittany

text: POOR SERVICE!!!! There were four (4) hostess/waitresses standing in the front. I was quickly seated and it wasn't busy at all (6:30 am). I waited for over 15 minutes, no one offered a beverage, to take my order a thing! The two ladies at the front literally just stood there. This is poor customer service and poor management. Dear Manager, your staff isn't working, the are socializing. The only worker that was actively working was the bartender. This was disappointing and unbelievably a piss poor experience. Save your time and the headache. Swetts is right around the corner in terminal C. They offer a fresh breakfast and friendly, fast service.
name: Cierra

text:
My girlfriend and I have been going here for brunch and dinner for at least once a month for 4 years now. That's probably all I need to say, but I'll continue. 

There are A LOT of great places to eat in Nashville and we try as many of them as we can. Maybe it's the convenient location to our house, but we always keep coming back here time and time again. The food is consistently wonderful and the service has ALWAYS been top notch. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a cool local spot for brunch and/or lunch and/or dinner. 

Get the apple pie for dessert. It's incredible. And this is coming from a chocolate guy.
name: Jeffrey

text: When I moved to philadelphia, I literally was one block away from the location. I'm a new yorker and i'm picky with my sweets but the cannolis and tiramisu are yummy!
name: Melissa

text:
Our reservation for party of 16 was for 1PM. When we got there, we were told that our table was getting set up and it'd only be a few minutes....yet by 1:30, we were still waiting. Finally we asked about our table, and they admitted that the table before us hadn't left yet. Ok, I get some customers overstay their welcome and there's nothing the restaurant can do about it, but don't blatantly LIE to your customers. Had we known we would've had to stand around for over half an hour then we would've just eaten elsewhere. Strike 1. 

We finally got seated around 1:40. We tried flagging our server down to get water, as we had a toddler begging for water and a CRYING teenager, but instead she kept holding up one finger and running in and out. We finally got our water fifteen minutes later. Strike 2. 

Food? I don't even know what to say about the food. When we tried to order, this breakfast place was OUT OF BACON, SAUSAGE, HAM. How are you a breakfast joint and run out of all breakfast meat? Well our friend also ordered the waffles with bacon crumbles, and she was individually told that her waffles would sti have the bacon crumbles because that hadn't run out. Yet, her waffles came out without the bacon. Surprising? Not really. When we asked the server, she said she'd bring it right out. But of course, after the waffles were already completely eaten, our server finally came back half an hour later to say they had indeed run out. We also had the fruit bowl which had ROTTEN blueberries! Apologies? Of course not. Not one single apology from anyone in this place for their error after error.  

Oh, by the way, did I mention that our party of SIXTEEN was seated at two tables that normally hold EIGHT people? Luckily we had 3 people cancel but still it was outrageously tight even with THIRTEEN people. 

Never returning, and never recommending. IHOP is close by,  and Cafe Lift is a trillion times nicer and better.
name: Carol

text:
Last night was our first time at Casa Toro. Food and drinks were great. To top it off we were very impressed by the attentive staff- the bartender, Justin, was excellent. We had two Perfect Patron margaritas which were delicious. Nachos were tasty & the fajitas were a very large portion. Only thing that prevented this from being a 5 star review is the guacamole- it wasn't terrible, but unfortunately didn't taste authentic nor did it have a lot of flavor. 

We will definitely give this place another try
name: Jessica

text: While this establishment has been here for many years this was our first visit to the quaint and beautifully lit restaurant housed in the old greenhouse of Robertson's Florist. From the minute you enter you are taken with the abundant natural light and fauna laden brick walls making the decor breathtaking. The service is very attentive and friendly and the menu offerings were original variations of classic standard lunch fare leading to quite flavorful bites. I would highly recommend this spot for either a relaxing quiet lunch with someone special or a fun spot for a brunch outing with friends.
name: Rifkah

text: Super fresh. Super tasty. Great prices. Fast and cool vibe. Love it.  My favorite is the tacos and my daughter says it's the best tuna she has ever tried!!
name: Wendy

text: Love the Fried Flounder. Flaky and tasty. Service is excellent... if fact, too good... the entree arrived 2 minutes after the delicious biscuits and salad. Next time I'm gonna have to slow them down. I love this place.
name: Stephen

text:
Went in on Veterans Day for a late breakfast with my daughter, there was no wait time and the place was essentially empty and yet we still had very poor service the food was cold and it wasn't very flavorful. Additionally I sent my food back to be warmed up and was offered to have it remade when I opted for something other than biscuits and gravy as it tasted like canned gravy on top of really dry biscuits. Decided to try my luck with the Benedict and it wasn't much better and it took forever for it to come out. It had a lot of sliced ham and the hollandaise sauce tasted like straight mayo and the eggs were solid. 

Our waiter was nice and tried to make things right but what an overall horrible experience. When we went to leave we saw 3 of the waitstaff by the beverage dispensers on their phones... no wonder I couldn't get my coffee refilled and my food was cold.

I can't believe people wait in line here to eat and I can't even imagine how horrible the service would be if it was busy.
name: Myrtle

text: Felix was our first stop while visiting New Orleans and we fell in love with their char-grilled oysters! They are simply amazing!! The service was fast and the food was so fresh! 10/10
name: Sarah

text:
I grew up in Idaho Falls where they had a Great Harvest branch located. It was always such a treat for myself and my siblings to have my mom to take us there. What was my most favorite part? Why the free sample of course! You can choose from a couple different varieties of bread or a sweet treat like a cookie, scone, or muffin. 

So when I moved to Boise and discovered they had a branch here I was thrilled! Everything they bake is delicious and I'm worth trying. Some of my favs include the cinnamon burst bread and the sweet potato pecan loaf. 

And now I have the privilege of having my kids experience Great Harvest. They always beg to stop for a sample and can't get enough. 

The only reason I didn't give them a 5 star rating is the hefty price tag on most of their items. I know it's homemade, but I just can't afford a $7 loaf of bread, no matter how yummy. 

However, the smell and free sample is worth a trip alone!
name: Alisha

text: Poor service and the restaurant smells really bad... we walked in and walked straight out because of the smell
name: Erica

text: Enjoyed the raw oysters and gumbo!  I would fully recommend this place. You get avoid the long lines in the other oyster bars along Bourbon and we decided to go here instead! This place is legit as it gets when it comes to raw oysters and good beer
name: Pedro

text:
REAL Italian food. Great service. Cute location in Edgehill. Amazing crust and ingredients. 

A hidden gem. Get after dinner drinks at Old Glory in the same little spot.
name: Sam

text:
Ok I'm going to start off by saying I RARELY ever make Yelp posts, but I re-downloaded the app to write about this place's wings.

I came to visit my friend at Swarthmore who also loves korean comfort foods as much as I do and we stumbled upon this place.

I was shook at how crispy the chicken was. The key to K chicken is getting the crispiness right and it was literally perfect like still shook

Hands down the best korean-style wings you will find in Pennsylvania unless you wanna make the trek up to NJ/NYC, but imo the wings here are made with more love (come to learn its two first gen korean immigrants)

Not a local, but if I'm ever back in the area again 10000% coming back

Thank you Grandma Seung!!
name: Kevin

text: Breakfast only Sunday. The eggs were cooked as ordered, over medium. I received two very small pieces of bacon which were tasty and crispy as ordered, I just thought there would be more than two half piece slices of bacon served with a meal. My spouse's meal was noted as average. Service is very laid back and took a while to receive our bill after we finished eating and was ready to go. The sour dough toast was delicious! Crispy!
name: Theresa

text: Good breakfast! Fast, courteous and new twist to breakfast. I had the most amazingly delicious kale apple green juice... I can have these all the time
name: Keun

text: I would rate it lower if possible! Let me give you all some pointers. First of all the waffle cornbread is a good idea but it lacks flavor and it's DRY. Also PULLED CHICKEN IS NOT a chunk of chicken breast with barbecue sauce on it!!!! Pulled chicken is slowly simmered in a flavor filled homemade sauce until the chicken is shredded.  And the wings... they tasted like frozen wing dings warmed up with again weak tasting barbecue sauce splashed on them. Lansdale is trying to come up and the food at this place isn't helping. The setting is wonderful, but if you want people to crowd into your restaurant FIRE YOUR COOK and hire a real southern chef!!!!!
name: Tracy

text:
The restaurant is family owned and the service was quick considering there was 1 waitress and 1 cook. This was my first time here and I have to say the food was delicious and definitely worth a 5 star rating.
I tried their he-man special well worth the price and the amount of food they give you. It included eggs  home fries bacon and choice of either  French toast or waffles with a juice tea or coffee. excellent I would definitely be returning in the future. 

Another great thing about eating there today we all received a honey  bun to take with us. I do recommend stopping in here if you are nearby because you won't be disappointed.
name: Bonnie

text:
I get in my hotel room and 
The meat was raw like pink raw 
I asked for well done because I don't 
eat raw meat or medium rare etc. 
the mash potatoes were soaked in medium rare steak juice when they were suppose to be garlic mash

The fries were a bunch of little cold pieces and I paid 
$27 after tipping $5 thinking I was getting food food. 

I can't even blame Uber eats because they didn't make the food. Now I remember why I don't go to Applebee's.
name: Lax

text: I wanted to try a new place for breakfast thar wasn't along my normal route and I came across Chi Cafe.  I came on a Wednesday and this place was pretty noisy with activity and patrons, which is always a good sign for a diner.  The service is superb here; they left me with an impression that they treat everyone that walks through the door like a long term patron, which is nice and refreshing to see.  In terms of food, it is a standard solid diner menu and quality.  And the price is really reasonable too.  Definitely a worth a try when in the area.
name: Stephanie

text: The food was as to be expected but the service was terrible. It took over 30 minutes for Kastle burgers and Larry David behind the counter should probably find another job if he hates this one. I'm not one to even post reviews like this but they need to make some changes over here. I did get a "free donut" when I tried to buy one after my meal because apparently the meal comes with a donut but I didn't find that out till I tried to buy one.
name: Glenn

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Definitely coming back. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Wow the buns at this place are to die for. Upon recommendation of the cashier, we tried the chicken katsu buns that were on special. We definitely plan on coming back to try the pork buns that are on the regular menus. We also got the boxed sake. I usually go for hot sake-but they did not have that. This cold, boxed sake was great. It comes in a little juice box and is the perfect amount to split. While you are sampling around at armature works, I highly recommend this as a stop.
name: Ashley

text: Walked in at 10:15pm on Monday night. Was pretty empty and the server told us right away that it's bar service only. I asked if the band was still going to play until 11pm (which is when they closed), and he said yes, so we thought we'd have a drink and enjoy the music. 15 minutes later they stopped at 10:30. We had full drinks and decided to make the most of our half hour left -until the place turned the lights up in the bar.  Now I know why they were not as busy as the other bars in the area. Too bad as the band was really good. You want business? Don't make your customers feel unwelcome.
name: J

text: It looked better online than it did in person. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Would probably stop in again if nearby. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Not bad for a quick meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Not bad for a quick meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Would probably stop in again if nearby. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
Went for restaurant week, thinking we could check it out, and they would have their best of the best as a showcase.    Not so.  My date and I had arrived, ordered drinks, and the three course restaurant week selections.  Our drinks arrived but still seemed slow.  Then we waited and waited.  Service seemed slow and unaware of our waiting.  We waited.   Interestingly, they seem to have plenty of staff buzzing around.  First course came, then we waited and waited.  Second course came.   Good food.  Not great.  Good.  Then our desserts.   Delicious. BUt then we waited for our check.   The experience was 2 hours.   Not a busy place at the time either.   

To duplicate another past review I just read, I dont understand what this place is supposed to be.   Is it casual dining?  Great, then why the 2 hours, and the food seems a bit on the high side if its casual.  If its not casual, and more classy, then why is the waitstaff in various clothing.   Some in long pants and dress shirts, others in shorts and tee shirts, other is workout pants?  And it was loud, so be prepared.

Meh.  Weird or eclectic?  Maybe just not sure what personality it wants to be.  Either way, I wont be back.
name: Joe

text:
Great menu selections, friendly staff and how can you go wrong with Pho Tai?
Bonus... they sell Nigori too !
name: Bill

text: What a fun place in downtown Boise to eat or just have a drink. I had the basil tomato fondue with bite size grilled cheese sandwich. It tasted so good on a cold winter day.
name: Wanita

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. For a busy night they handled it okay. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kinda leveled off after a few bites. It was decent, just a little uneven.
name: User

text: I walk here every morning from my house.  Love the new and unique bakery creations.  Always fresh.  The decor is rustic eclectic with some chunky moderns.  I always geek out over the copper rotating bar stools at the gorgeously glazed bar.  Really nice staff.  Really great coffee, thank God.  ;) Even beautiful live mellow music in the corner.  Not too distracting but adds to the enchantment of this soon to be- way too popular place!  Hope I can still get thru the door in a year!  :) Way to go, guys!
name: Caitlin

text: Hands down the best spot in Tucson for taco Tuesday! Are the tacos the best I've ever had? No, but the price and atmosphere make it worth coming nearly every week. The staff are always super friendly, the food is fresh, and the free chips and salsa make this place the best!
name: Katie

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Food was fresh and service was quick. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. A very pleasant experience. Food was good and came out fast. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Pretty happy with it overall. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text:
My favorite restaurant in Tucson!!!!! A little noisy but it's still my favorite!!!! The "pozole" is my choice! So many amazing flavors going on in every single spoon full!!!! My husband had the chicken was "Amazing"! Our friend had the trout! It's was also "Amazing"!!!!!!
It's worth the noise!!!!!! The service was also great! Can't remember the name of the young lady or better yet I couldn't hear what her name was!!!!!
I can't wait to go back this Wednesday!!!! Hey but make sure to make a reservation!!!! Bon Appetite!!!!!
It's AMAZING!!!!!!
name: Stella

text: Awesome. Worth the wait. Just wait!!! Fried chicken was outstanding, Mac and cheese and cornbread muffins...YUM!! Love the simple ambiance and the staff is great. Do NOT go to NOLA and miss this place!!!!
name: Debbie

text: For the price I expected more than this. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. A couple small things kept adding up. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Not bad for a quick meal. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. A very pleasant experience.
name: User

text: Awesome wood fired pizza and the cheesesteak egg roll is a defínete must!  Will be back on my next run they the area.
name: Luis

text: Love Jade Garden. I ordered food online, it came really quickly. Yummy food! love their chicken lo mein!
name: Cherie

text:
Every time we come here for lunch or dinner it's so good. The Won Ton soup is fantastic, as well as the rest of the food.

It's a great family owned place where you will probably eat too much and wish you have on your Thanksgiving pants.

Stop by.

UPDATE: Awesome as usual. The BBQ pork lo mein and Mongolian beef/chicken was fantastic. My wife got a cup of won ton soup, yes I had a little. It tasted so good. 

The flavors keep you wanting to eat until you can't anymore.

The food is so good and the prices are still very reasonable.

Update 3-19-19

The food is still fantastic. We ordered the Mongolian beef/chicken, pork fried rice and sweat and sour pork. It was so good, I couldn't stop eating it.
name: Mike

text:
Decided to stop by and try this place again because I see it all the time going to the local grocer and the last time I ate there was years and years ago and I think it may have even been different management. 

Long story short I didn't even order because the kid who was working the front seating area never bothered to look up to acknowledge and greet me. He just kept glued into his phone. I stood for 2 minutes before I just walked out of the place. I don't think I will be going back. I figure he didn't need the business as his phone seemed to be more important. There was 2 people eating and the restraurant was otherwise empty. I can't grade the food but am grading the customer service with a big FAT "F"
name: James

text:
There was no drive-thru here which was really weird. We stopped here on our way back to LA because we were really hungry and wanted something quick.

After discovering that there was no drive-thru, I ran inside to order our food. It wasn't crowded in there at all but the food still took a long time to make. The food was fine but this McDonald's definitely wasn't fast and convenient to stop at.
name: Owen

text:
Dinner was great and the beer selection was crazy amazing. Issue I had was wine selection was not very good.

Food: 
Australian sliders: outstanding
Chicken Marsala was good but not great. Light on flavor.
Parmesan chicken "amazing"
Devils pass pasta: I suggest substituting the chicken with the fennel sausage. I should have picked up on the option when our server asked if I wanted chicken and sausage or just sausage. I recommend easing for the sausage instead of the chicken.

Weird but notable: received high praise on the veggies: asparagus and broccoli were great. Subtle flavoring but cooked perfectly. 

Only issue is wine selection. Else 4.5 stars
name: Jay

text:
This place serves authentic Indian food which is super healthy and delicious. The owner Ravinder is so so sweet. I happened to mention it was my birthday and he didn't charge me for my meal, which is such an incredible gesture. I was so overwhelmed. 
The samosas were crispy and fluffy. Saag was amazing and the jeera rice and dal were the best I've had in the US. Go here for the delicious food and the beautiful people who own the place.
name: Shruti

text:
Oh Juice Merchant. What I like about you is that you have more options for add in than Boostin' Bowls, however the flavor just is NOT there.

The bowl I had tasted like mud and everything for the third time in a row was too, under ripened banana forward.

The gentleman who works there is very polite - always, earning them an extra start, but I'm just not sure how I can never like the food.
name: Lauren

text:
First timer at this location. 
Arrived about 6:30 PM last night for dinner.
Seated right away, party of two.
Server was Luis. He greeted us fairly quickly and took our drink orders as well as offered to take our food order as well. SURE! We were starving, so that worked out well.
Ordered all appetizers: Calamari, Pot Stickers & Wings. Wings we requested mixed the Nashville and the Buffalo Hot together. It's really good, try it!
Our food came zippy! We've never received such a fast turn around time from ordering to service. Kudos to the kitchen!
After we finished out meal the manager Jermey came by to grab our empty plates. I wanted to express to him how impressed I was with the speediness of our meals. Had a nice conversation with Jermey who was professional, passionate and clearly cares about his staff and the customers experience.
Keep up the great work here! Highly impressed with the entire team.
name: Carmik

text: Absolutely amazing! Vegetarian selection is fantastic. Get the chefs menu for sure. They even gave us free samplers of a couple new dishes. The lines can be long but just roll through early for happy hour and stay for dinner and you can grab a table easy with this hack.
name: Krithiknath

text: It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: I'm not vegan, but my daughters are, so I find myself eating plant-based meals quite frequently.  The barbecue wrap here was not just tasty by plant-based standards, but excellent for any meal!  Between the five of us, we also got 4 sides and each was delicious.  The staff is super chill as well -- helpful and authentically nice people.  Can't recommend Sunflower enough!
name: Rhett

text: Had the worst food of my life from this place. Ordered some kind of luau chicken wrap with a veggie medley. How could they mess that up right? Well for starters, the veggie medley was literally just steamed squash and corn. Like hospital grade vegetables. No seasonings or anything. And the wrap somehow managed to have even less taste somehow. Inordinately spicy, that's it. Bland everything. Such a bummer too because I had it delivered to the hospital so it's not like I could take it back or anything. Whomp.
name: Katy

text: Ordered the Satchmo sampler: jambalaya, red beans and rice and gumbo. Horrible is the only way to describe this trio. Food was lukewarm, jambalaya was average, gumbo was watery (this is NOLA, gumbo should be perfect), red beans and rice was ok, had better red beans and rice at Popeye's. Oldest daughter ordered shrimp fettuccine, again average, arrived lukewarm. Youngest daughter ordered the catfish platter, best meal at the table. Fish was crispy, battered perfectly, tasted delicious. Not a restaurant I would put on my list of places to visit while in NOLA.
name: C

text: This place was legit... good selection across the board on their menu ... appetizers, main dishes, vegetarian selections, and desert menu were all above average!!! Wait staff was friendly, and very attentive! Better than On The Boarder by far!!!
name: Roy

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Honestly, our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Basic airport breakfast. Really not the best food, but options are very slim in the airport. My husband had the Cajun Breakfast (eggs with ham and peppers, biscuit, and grits). He thought it was okay. I had the New Orleans Breakfast (scrambled eggs, choice of bacon or sausage, biscuit, and grits). The eggs were cold and flavorless and grits were flavorless as well. The biscuit was actually not bad, flaky and buttery.A couple of perks to this spot, we both ate for $20 and food came out quickly.
name: Lauren

text: Been hoping to find a great authentic korean place in town and finally found one!  The place is clean and modern but also reflects your traditional korean decor.  We went early on a Thursday night so no one was there yet but started to fill up as we were finishing up our meal.  Our food came quickly.  We had the seafood pancake, which I think was missing the dipping sauce but was very  nicely done, crispy but not greasy.  Korean fried chicken we had half with the sauce and half without....superb with the sauce, too plain without but our kids didnt seem to mind as they devoured them.  Bibimbap pot could have been a little hotter cuz the rice on the bottom didn't quite get the yummy crunch that I'm used to but it was filled very generously.  The short ribs on the hot plate flavoring was oustanding and pork in soft tofu was exactly what we were hoping for. Service was great as well...so thrilled that we now have a place to go to for Korean that met all our expectations!
name: Huong

text: If you are visiting sunny Santa Barbra, be sure to check out the public Market. The vendors are all super friendly and the food options are amazing. You want regret stopping in and trying out places like the Empty Bowl or green star coffee. There is a cut bar where you can hang with friends and a little market to get snack for the beach.
name: Brandon

text: Conveniently located in the Amish Market all the way in the back, this quaint spot delivers on taste. I was only able to try the impossible burger which came on a very tasteful bun. The texture of the patty has the same consistency as beef and closely tastes like it as well. I enjoyed my meal.l which came with plain ruffles like chips and purple slaw which was also tasty. The prices are decent, $11.00 for the burger. Wait time was about 20 minutes. Don't plan to dine in if you're coming during lunch as it's limited seating 4 tables with 2 chairs. The two staff were friendly and welcoming. I'd come here again to try other items on the menu.
name: CJ

text:
Consistently family friendly. Restaurant has good all you can eat family style fried chicken.  It's not always consistent but it's better than average on a bad day. Fried biscuits dipped in apple butter?  Yes, please...and please bring extra apple butter.  Menu has other options as well such as pulled pork mac & cheese, chicken and dumplings and a great kids menu.  Desserts are good not great but who needs pie when you can ask for more hot fried biscuits. 
Great place to pick in season fruits like apples, strawberries, peaches and even pumpkins...and the wagon rides to the orchards can't be beat.  
Market sells Boar's Head deli meats and is fun to browse. 
Parking is free and has lots and lots of space.
name: Amy

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was good and came out fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Friendly folks, tasty food and a great movie, what more could you want? Plenty of parking and quick and easy touchscreen ticketing. Seats are not the most comfortable but that is a minor issue.
name: Jeremy

text:
Ahhhh I loved this fun place for HH! Philly isn't known for its Mexican, so it was fun to find this spot.

I came on a Monday afternoon with a couple friends because we the PHS beer garden doesn't open until 5 (boo). Inside, there are a few 4-top booths, 3 or so tables for larger parties. Everything was very clean (although they had just opened, so that may have had something to do with it). I especially appreciated whoever carefully organized the chairs at the middle tables to be alternating blue and yellow... made my mild OCD very happy! Music was fun - I'll bet this place was BUMPING on cinco de mayo.

Their HH includes $5 margaritas, $2 for chicken/beef gringa tacos, and various other discounted fare. Tacos weren't anything mind-numbing, but as a SoCal native who's a brat about her mexican food, I was pleasantly surprised that they were decent. And for $2, I really couldn't ask for more.

Prickly Pear margarita (+$1, so $6 on HH) was yummy, but very sugary - I would opt for something with a little less sugar and more tequila flavor (but maybe that's just me being a booze hound). They offer pitchers for $29, and lots of variations on margaritas. There's even a trist on an old fashioned that I would love to come back and try. 

Great deals, fun music, and very clean/cute inside... highly recommend, especially for HH!
name: Bre

text: The food is delicious here--both main dishes and pho. It is incredibly soothing. We have ordered several different dishes and have all found them to be tasty--even among a few picky eaters in the family. We have always ordered takeout so I can't really speak to the dine-in experience. I do have some complaints about their staffing and availability, however. We used to order at least twice a month if not more, but had issues with them being understaffed or under stocked with ingredients and were unable to make numerous dishes (such as the fried rice dishes or potstickers) on numerous occasions. After a while, the ability to not get the dishes we liked became frustrating, and we have ordered there considerably less lately. I hope they get these issues under control, so that we will be able to order again without these problems.
name: J

text:
First time - great service, friendly atmosphere, decent prices.
Second time - Asked to sit in the room with table seating  away from the bar. We couldn't do that because the waitress was late. Yes, that's the reason we were given. And she laughed when she said it. Not so great service. Asked for old bay seasoning on the fries and didn't get it. Asked for Malt vinegar and didn't get it. Finally requested hot sauce to give the fries some flavor. It was delivered in a very small plastic container and we were CHARGED FIFTY CENTS FOR IT. Really? Are you kidding? That's like charging for ketchup. Asked for Swiss cheese on the sandwich instead of American. Waitress said that was fine and charged us a $1.50 up charge for Swiss cheese instead of American. I don't mind the charge (too much). I mind not being told there's an up charge. I am not cheap. I just don't like surprises and charging fifty cents for an eyedropper's worth of hot sauce is outrageous. I didn't subtract anything from the bill because we didn't get the malt vinegar and old bay seasoning AS REQUESTED. I didn't complain or send anything back because the order was wrong. But I'll tell you what, it will be a long time before I go back.
name: Annmarie

text: I almost gave up on this wendy's but Sandy at the register is a joy. Very efficiant, friendly and able to deal with the counter lunch line with ease.
name: Brenda

text:
3 1/2 stars :
We are just passing through and staying at the campground so picked up some BBQ for game day..

Pulled pork
And smoked turkey-   7 stars! 
Brisket-   Awesome but a little dry - 4 stars 
Ribs-   Gotta say they taste like supermarket pre cooked ribs - 2 stars 

Want something spicy?     Ask for a side of the chipotle bbq -   Spicy enough for those food challenge shows you see 

* disclaimer the owner said he sold out the day before and stayed up all night smoking so the ribs may not have been up to their usual par 

And he has only been open for 2 months so it takes time to get in a groove 

Would we be back?    Yes.  If just for the turkey and pork
name: Laura

text:
I wasn't planning on visiting this place, but somehow pass by. 

The ordering process was FAST, took about 2 minutes.  The order arrived FASTER than that, in a minute. Not kidding. 

I ordered the beignets and the cafe Au Lait. Both are delish. There was a guitarist playing at the time and that was something.  Call it snack and a show. What a treat.

In comparison to Cefe Du Monde, the texture of the Methner's here is slightly more chewy. The Cafe Au Lait is better than Du Monde, more silky texture and smoother. 

The dining environment is a lot better too.  Felt less touristic. Feels like a local spot.
name: Justin

text: This is a great little restaurant! My mom said her quesadilla was awesome, my veggie burrito was super, our waiters, Pedro and Martin, were super friendly and efficient, and even the salsa was great! Yum! We'll be back!
name: Renee

text: I was with a group of 10 for dinner this past weekend and the food and experience were superb. We all loved the wings in particular, and my shrimp etouffee was excellent! The live band made me feel like I was back on Frenchman street. The restaurant was also very accommodating for our large group, which included a baby. Not to be missed.
name: Diego

text: I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The food was good and the service was easygoing. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Pretty happy with it overall. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Great food. Small restaurant with great taste. Quick service and good prices. Small outdoor seating area blocking Kennedy Blvd with greenery. Would have given five stars but the man who gave me my to go order was a bit rude.  However, the next time I visited, ate in and server was most pleasant.  

In an older building. Go for the food, not the structure.
name: Misty

text:
An excellent spot to have vegan food. Service is super nice and efficient; food is great too! 

We had a philly sandwich with cheesy fries and salad. Everything was better than expected. The philly sandwich was great. Soft, tender and messy... As you can expect from all good philly sandwiches. My only comment would be  regarding the bread; I think they could improve that aspect. It was not bad at all but it was not as fresh as I expected. Cheesy fries? Excellent! You can't go wrong with something like that. Salad was the perfect component to add some freshness to the heavy meal and help to digest a little bit better all the delicious food we just had. 

I certainly recommend the place!
name: Josep

text: This cute cafe is located near downtown Nashville in the cutest little neighborhood. My friend invited me to try them. I chose an assortment of 6 chocolate candies. Im not a fan of dark chocolate, so some choices just were not good to me, however, the raspberry Cabernet and birthday cake were really good! If you're a Chocolate Connoisseur this place is heaven for you.
name: Angela

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Also, for a busy night they handled it okay. Also, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: Very poor customer service. Friend was given wrong order; called to tell them order was wrong, was basically called a liar. They told them the order that was placed didn't exist. There is proof of what was ordered, was still told it didn't exist. All they had to do was switch out the order. The order that was given was probably someone else's order that was mixed up. UNPROFESSIONAL and terrible customer service. Will never order from them again. Big mistake by them. Looks bad on a business to tell a customer they were wrong. They were also very rude.
name: Emily

text: We really enjoyed the ribs this trip. Usually we get the half chicken and it is good also. Most of all the sides we like but I especially like the bbq beans. We look forward to going back.
name: Steve

text: The food is pretty good. I got the Muffeleta and it was pretty tasty. I've never had anything like it.  I also tried their unique Americana Huckleberry soda--also not bad. It's hard to find a place to sit if you go in the later afternoon.  The decor is fun if you have nerdy side.
name: Madison

text: A friend and I went for a 2nd time and certainly not disappointed.  There was one server for possibly 8 tables and he never lost his cool or left anyone waiting.  Food was superb and the atmosphere is warm, quiet, and cozy. We'll be back.
name: Mary

text: Great late night food. Open past a lot of the other restaurants in the area, a great option to get some local Cajun/Creole food. Not fancy - Po Boys hit the spot.
name: Michael

text: The chicken is really good.  I mean the spices are infused with chicken. It's great.  The atmosphere is ok and everything else is ok. Treat this as your munchies after a hard night drinking on bourbon street.
name: Miatta

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It was decent, just a little uneven. It looked better online than it did in person. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Great place for very traditional Japanese fare.  If you're looking for a very true experience or to learn about Japanese language and culture this is a great place to go. This is Japanese food done by Japanese folks. Simple, but very tasty and affordable. There is also a market to buy Japanese staples.
name: Vinnie

text: Family casual dining just like you were eating at home. If I wanted to eat at home I would stay there and eat. Employee brought vacuum out and left there until her boss came and told her to move it. Another employee asked my husband to switch out the condiments she had filled. BLT did not have enough bacon and hashbrowns had no flavor even after adding a lot of salt and pepper. The charge extra if you pay by credit card so you have to pay the fee the credit card company charges. Not impressed and will not be back.
name: Jessica

text: With just moving into germantown, I am exploring many places. Many have brunch, but Henrietta Red really kills it. It's not your typical brunch, since you can shuck some oysters or get some fish, but don't forget the bloody! I got the juevo rancheros, and boy will I just commend the chef for the amazing flavor profile in the food. I will be honest, wasn't my favorite flavors that I know I love but boy did this introduce me to flavors I had no idea existed. Pickled onions, were that amazing touch to really tie the bowl together. My fiancee got a breakfast sandwich that had amazing bread and a again, the flavors were fantastic. Our service was excellent, very attentive as well as friendly. It isn't cheapest place but you absolutely get what you pay for, And that is quality and exceptional service.
name: Kevin

text: The food always tastes great, however I'm lucky to even get a parking spot let alone a table in a reasonable amount of time.
name: Ashley

text: This is definitely my favorite place to go at any time of the day. They have an amazing selection of choices from the menu but i always stick to one thing, the pork roll and cheese on a bagel. If anyone is to ask me what they should get from there it's definitely that. I'm always going different hours of the day and there's always an amazing staff on. They also have a selection of different desserts and an many cakes my favorite is the chocolate zanzibar. It's so good and i'd recommend it to anyone.
name: Brooke

text: Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Would absolutely visit again. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text:
We had been wanting to come here for quite sometime because we often drink beer from here at restaurants. The environment was really relaxed and chill and there were plenty of places to sit, both upstairs and downstairs. I feel like this would be a fantastic place to host a private party for a beer lover & guests! 

The beer was great and the prices were reasonable. I had a flight and I enjoyed the lighter beers. There was a food menu as well but we did not eat.

The customer service was subpar. No one was really smiling and everyone was kind of zoned out and seemed to just be going through the motions. Curious as to how they would operate in a busy setting.

Overall, I would come back again but it wasn't anything to write home about. I would be fine grabbing a six pack if I just wanted to enjoy the beer.
name: Stephanie

text: My brother and I were here in late-February for lunch and I was most impressed by the service as well as the food.  I started with a glass of Sangria, which was perfect in flavor. I opted for the 3-course Creole Luncheon, which included Turtle Soup, Barbecued Gulf Shrimp, and Creole Bread Pudding Souffle for dessert.  The food quality was excellent, served by a well-orchestrated staff.  The manager came around to each table to greet and chat with everyone while we were there.  I would highly recommend Commander's Palace as a great New Orleans dining experience!
name: Ken

text: Was here for a birthday dinner and loved it. The view was fantastic! And so was the service. The risotto I ordered was a little strange, not the best I've had hence the one star off. Overall, I'd go back in a heart beat.
name: Joanne

text: Went for lunch with the boss. He had the beef stew and I the chicken and rice. Both meals were great. Ample helpings and very filling. Felt like a nap after eating. Service is exceptional and on point. Will definitely return to try their dinner menu. Also want to try Cepas wine and tapas next door which is affiliated with terra sur.
name: Ed

text: When we ordered our hot food tonight the food was lukewarm. Fatty meat and cold soup! But here's the kicker...when I poured my fountain drink and was looking for a lid, the employee behind the cake counter came over and gave me hell! She said "what are you looking for?" A lid. "We don't have lids for those cups" and "your cashier should've told you that!" We were like "nobody told us" she says "well who rung you up?" Not an apology for being out of lids, nothing! Except harassing the customer because I was looking around???? Oh so the customers are wrong and get harassed?? They believe they are the only game in town and I can tell you they are not!! I once saw the female owner scream at a customer because they were dissatisfied with their cake. I could not believe that the female owner told this customer to leave. Obviously the employees have the same attitude as the owner! Never going back!
name: Rhonda

text: This is my go-to! They always greet me with great customer service, the food is delicious and it's convenient as I live downtown.
name: Megan

text: I live in Mt Juliet and you better believe anytime I'm close I come in. The pizza never disappoints. Definitely recommend stopping in and trying a slice!
name: Michael

text: The worst breakfast I ever had!! I ordered the Western Omelet..It was AWFUL!! The omelet was made with some gross nasty egg mixture..the ham, cheese, onions and bell peppers were mushy and disgusting! I wanted well done, it was mushy and runny inside..I almost barfed when I tried a bite! The toast was tasteless.. the hash browns even worse!! They made me another one, still the same, disgusting!! I would NEVER come back!..Waitress was very nice, tho..I would NOT recommend this place at all!
name: Deb

text: I travel from South Philly just to get dinner from here. They have the best Shrimp Egg FooYoung in the city.
name: Robin

text: When I'm in Philly this is one my favorite places to stop. Nachos are the  bomb and all the tacos were outstanding. Staff is always super helpful and friendly. Even on a rainy day this place is my little ray of sunshine  thanks for making this California girl feel at home
name: Regina

text: Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. For a busy night they handled it okay. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text:
5 for friendly & prompt service, fantastic beer selection (Weyerbacher! Dogfishhead!)
3 for food

Nice place--cute, a block from the river. Really friendly staff--genuinely friendly, not fake.

It was great that the chips were real corn tortillas, fried & crispy. The red salsa was tangy and slightly spicy, the green sweet. Refills provided for our hungry brood!

We ordered goat, chorizo, and carnita platters--these are 3-taco platters, no sides (extra cost). 

The goat was the universal favourite between the 3-gamey but flavourful, balanced spices. None of us lived the other two, which were way too sweet, as though a cup of white sugar was added to their stewpot. The chorizo was also oddly blended with almost a paste-like consistency. 

The tortillas were the right kind--thin, doubled up, over-stuffed with lots of meat--just eat over your plate, as there will be a drippy mess.

We prefer a dryer roast on our tacos--these seemed way too wet (fwiw, we can never bring ourselves to make bbq in s crock pot, as it gets too wet and mushy of a consistency; if this is your preferred style, you will love the tacos here).

So there you have it--friendly, bright atmosphere, great location, awesome beer selection, bonus for offering goat, but everything else was too sweet and mushy. 

I'd still return for the goat tacos, beer, and chips.

$45 for 3 plates of tacos (leftovers packed) & 2 cocktails, before tip
name: L

text: So dirty. So hipster. The backyard is pretty cool. Drinks are cheap. Cool signs all over the place. Not for me though.
name: Connor

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
I was looking forward to this.

Arrived on Oyster day and we ordered 3 full size p boys.  It took 20 min while everyone ahead was served.  Order food at counter and wait to be called. 

Finally good food started to eat and half way through I find a hair or piece of plastic or something which for me was the end of the meal.

Easily accessible via tram but not for me.
name: Sean

text:
LOVE this place! I used to live in Boston where there is a competitive market for Korean restaurants. This place is definitely on the top even compare to the ones in the big cities.

The taste is so authentic, all the side dishes are made in the house, service is nice and prompt. Oh and a delicious mint patty comes after a meal!

Only have great things to say, it's also my Korean friends' go-to place in town :)
------------------------------
Apparently now it's a new owner and I am pretty disappointed....the food doesn't taste as good as it used to be and also he portion has significantly decreased :( very sad about it and probably won't go there anhmore
name: Passionfruit

text: This place only opened last week but I've already been here twice. The food is delicious and the service is super friendly. I've been on the hunt for some good green curry and it definitely hit the spot! They also have bottled Thai iced tea which was a nice treat.
name: Laura

text: Excellent for brunch again. Perfect black mussels and my 2nd fav Bloody Mary bar in town.
name: David

text: Great food and service!  I tried the biscuits and gravy while a friend tried the breakfast tacos. Other than devouring our food we enjoyed the bottomless mimosas that complimented our meals.  This is also a great place to relax and unwind while enjoying some really good food and perfect-pour drinks.
name: Jasper L.

text: Delicious pizza and very nice to be able to BYOB wine. A favorite for our whole family!!
name: Juliana

text:
This place is a solid 3 stars and I mean that in the best way. We've been here a few times and each time I hope it'll be better than the last, but sadly they never exceed themselves. I've gotten food to go a couple times, and oddly the food is better when eating there. 

As another review stated- when we walked in, there was only 2 other tables seated and they still asked if we had a reservation (only 2 people). We did not, though I had called ahead to see if there was a wait and they said no and to come on in. I don't understand why they act all secretive and like they're doing you a huge favor by seating you when they clearly have empty tables and no tables with "reserved" on them. 

They shook my boyfriend's hand but not mine. It's neither here nor there, but in this day and age, maybe they shouldn't favor the man by only shaking his hand or should do that at all? 

The bread and pesto is nice. It is not super fresh homemade bread as some nice Italian place have, but it's good. Our waiter was really nice. 

Since they have the word pasta in the name, I would love for them to have really great pasta. But it's just not that great. They seem like they want to be a really nice and high end Italian place, yet they don't have homemade pasta or any more unique pastas? They only have run of the mill pastas and average Joe would know or that Olive Garden would serve. Even store bought pasta can be good with a really great sauce. The sauces were fine, but missing something. There just wasn't anything that brings this place up a notch from the cooking you can do in your own kitchen. 

It was a bit annoying how 3 different people are constantly rotating and asking you how is the food each course you get. I get it, you want to make sure there isn't an issue, but its hard to say anything when you have food in your mouth and many people asking you questions. 

There was also a fly that kept flying around our food and none of the 3 guys who kept asking how it was mentioned or did anything about that. Would've been enough to have our one waiter just check up on us and more pleasant. A fly actually got into my boyfriend's wine. I told him to say something, but he chose not to so that was on him. 

I would not go back here if I was paying or without a coupon unfortunately. I really think if they at least made their own pasta, gave the customers some space and didn't try to act pretentious they would have some potential.
name: Anna

text: Haven't eaten here but I'm from the south and I don't see anything on this menu or the pics I would call SOUTHERN
name: Denise

text:
Culver's is an 'upscale' fast food burger joint. The burgers are delicious! My husband and I really enjoyed the crispy onion rings. He loved the cole slaw.  We placed our order then took our seats. The food was brought out by a friendly server.  It was accurate!  We got only the condiments we requested. We didn't have to get anything fixed.  It may seem silly but we're picky and they did a great job. 
My husband loves their frozen custard. It is thick and creamy similar to Ted Drew's concretes. I can't wait to try it (lactose intolerant-need to bring my meds). 
I'm looking forward to trying their chili, my husband wants to try the chicken sandwich. They also had chicken noodle soup.  As we walked around all the food items looked great. We look forward to returning and trying items new to us from their menu.
name: Dale

text:
Maybe I had high expectations coming in. I know this place recently opened but it took some time before we got to put our order in (about 20 mins). After looking at the menu I was appalled by the price for the amount of tacos that came in the order, example: 2/17 or 2/13. Not even some authentic restaurants in the city are that costly. Then when we received out tacos, the soft shell tortillas weren't even heated, as if taken out of a bag and served.  Like I said, I know this place just opened but from this review I think it can only get better. I look forward to coming back maybe in a few months or a year (if they last that long) and seeing the improvements that they make to the menu. 

Out of the 3 tacos that we ordered, the mahi mahi were definitely the best.
name: Eden

text: As far as Carmel Indian food, this is the best! Hey quick, very good, and great portions. Let's be honest, I only order naan and chicken tikka Marsala...so my suggestions beyond that are limited. I like my food spicy and go 10/10 & they take the cake. Some other places, I'll still need to add sriracha to get it spicy enough. Also helps to order over yelp and pickup within 5-10mins.
name: Kyle

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text:
Might just be the best restaurant in Speedway. It's not right on Main Street but location aside, it has everything else you're looking for in a great restaurant. It's clean, has great service, awesome ambiance, and AMAZING FOOD!  Please, please, please check this place out! 

I had the ribs, greens, and Mac & cheese!  My parents had the pulled pork pizza and pulled pork sandwich. We all HAD to try each other's food and not a single dish disappointed!
name: Anna

text:
This review pertains only to the samosas offered at Nanee's Kitchen, but I felt compelled to write.  My husband and I were in town for the weekend, and we spent a lot of time at Reading Terminal Market.

We loved Nanee's samosas so much that we consumed 7 samosas in two days.  We had a chicken curry samosa while at RTM, and then within 5 mins, we ordered 2 more to go.  Today, as we were leaving, we picked up 4 more samosas (two potato, two chicken) from Nanee's for our train ride home.  They are the perfect portable food.  The fillings are delicious - savory, tender, and well-seasoned but neither too salty nor too spicy.  The chicken curry is our favorite, but both of these flavors are very good.  Our only advice is to ask them to pack each samosa in a separate wax paper bag to avoid oversteaming the still-hot samosas, which may cause them to go soggy.

Highly recommend.
name: LincolnHawk

text: Fantastic vegan options, and the staff is super nice about checking with the chef about ingredients.  Lentil soup is done the Greek way, with a kick of vinegar - very refreshing! The dolmas (stuffed grape leaves) are freshly made, and wonderfully minty. Hummus, falafel and the TLK salad (featuring cucumber,  tomatoes and fried eggplant, drizzled with olive oil and tahini) are all delicious,  but the baba ghanoush is exceptional - don't miss it! Very sweet and friendly staff, glad to have them in Bristol!
name: Cheryl

text: The neighborhood was pretty charming and there were many choices for shopping/eating. We settled on Bartaco and it wasn't bad but it wasn't great either. The menu is limited and you choose the portions yourself, Not  traditional but the dishes were interesting. Portions aren't that big but you can decide the amount you want as their menu allows you to pencil in more. The place was hot and humid and part of that was because we got a seat away from the fans and it was crowded. Staff was very friendly and helpful. We would still go back and do recommend it.
name: Tony

text: When this place opened up at first I was not very impressed to be honest. I almost would have never went back but just this past Sunday had some friends over and we ordered. Since live so close to it we walked up to get the food. I ordered the new philly sandwich and my wife ordered bacon cheeseburger to say the least I was impressed and the philly was really good and it also had jalapeños on it the right heat and the meat was seasoned perfect. The bacon cheeseburger was bigger than my wife expected and was delicious I even said damn should have got a burger it looked that good. The fries were good. One friend got the same as me and the other got the hot chicken and everything was good. I will be going back nice to have a good place where the burgers and sandwiches are good.
name: Marc

text:
Consistently delicious Thai food in a very unsuspecting location on the south side of Indy in Greenwood! They are typically pretty busy, so it's not that uncommon to have a short wait. Clean dining area with traditional Thai decor. Wait staff was very nice & attentive. 

As an app, the Thom Yum soup was super flavorful & spicy! I like a decent amount of spice, & I got the medium & it was a little more spicy than I would have expected. 

For dinner I got the Padd Kemau which is a wide noodle dish loaded with fresh veggies! The noodles were thick & perfectly cooked. I got medium spice & it was much less spicy than the soup. I probably could have gotten the hot for a little more kick! My mom got the very popular Pineapple Fried Rice with mild spice & it was equally delicious, especially if you like pineapple in a savory dish. The presentation was super fun coming in a hollowed out pineapple. 

The average price for a meal is between $12-$15, so it's more on the pricey side, but the dishes are definitely big enough to share & we both walked away with leftovers!
name: Taylor

text: Overall decent bar. Not super touristy but it is connected to a hotel. Service was kinda confusing - servers were unsure if customers had been taken care of. No designated tables for each server etc. drinks were good but on the spendy side. Interior decoration and bathrooms were awesome. Great job on that.
name: Stephanie

text: I've now eaten here 4 times.  Sticking by my 4 star review.  The first time they had some awesome 5 star specials.  Not since.  Just reliably very good to excellent food at a great price.  IMO their pho is delicious complex subtle.  Makes me think of a tranquil lake or a calming rain while savoring the wonderful flavors.  Definitely recommended.  Hopefully they'll add more specials.
name: Phil

text:
Love this place! Discovered it last year during "Hot August Nights," and made it a point to eat there twice this year.

I have yet to find a disappointing item on the menu. From their Chingalingas appetizer to the tacos, all great. Here's where it might get a little weird, though: if you are a fan of calamari, I cannot recommend the calamari steak enough. It is amazing, so tender and lightly breaded, with an incredible lemon sauce. This struck me as being completely off-the-wall for a Mexican restaurant, but I'm glad I tried it. I have to have it every single time.

The joint itself is pretty unassuming, just a basic restaurant with the obligatory laminate tables and neon bar lights. The food is what sets it apart, for sure.
name: JJ

text: This was a great find, authentic Asian cuisine.  I came here for lunch with the family.  We had bubble tea, green tea with foam, hot green tea, General Taos Chicken, Singapore noodles, and their fried rice specialty dish.  I was disappointed that they didn't have the Smoked Duck, but everything else was good.
name: Ann

text:
Pretty good! Recommend the Bibimbap - made well and the veggies seemed quite fresh.

An issue I have is that some of the items on the menu (ex. Tempura shrimp) are WAY overpriced for the amount of food you get which is disappointing
name: Lauren

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Will be back. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: We come to bartaco a few times a year. We live about 2 hrs away but often make the drive just for their amazing tacos. The salsa verde is out of this world and very fresh tasting. Cocktails are yummy with fresh ingredients. I will say that over the past few years, I've noticed a bit of a decline in how often the server interacts with the table. We had jenny last time, and although she was very nice, she came by our table a total of 3 times. Other people dropped our drinks and food off and we weren't checked on often. We will still be back, would just like to see the servers not too busy.
name: James

text:
If I had to issue a warning about Amore Pasta it's that eating here for lunch can easily lead to an afternoon food coma. The heaping bowls of pasta are customizable, delicious, and incredibly filling. With about 10 pasta types (including homemade and gluten free options), a dozen sauces, and many different toppings, and cheeses, the pasta combinations here are endless. What stays consistent across this wide variation is that Amore offers consistently great food and you'll almost certainly want a to-go box.

My personal favourite combinations include the house-made Strozzapreti with either the honey curry cream sauce or the rose sauce. If that doesn't have your mouth watering enough, you can also customize your pasta with different veggies and proteins as well as fresh cheese cooked right into the sauce.

Amore is reasonably priced, provides a wide variety, and has a nice, clean, and new location. Highly recommended as a lunch option if you bring a to-go box or as an underrated dinner spot!
name: Trenton

text: Best burgers in town.  Great dry aged beef, delicious bun and the way they cook the burgers? Damn! And the RipFries are amazing. These guys know what's up.
name: Ben

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The music was louder than it needed to be. I had a better visit than I expected to. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: Went to a party and they had a plethora of pizza choices from Fresca. Plain, pepperoni, ziti, chicken parm, shrimp pesto, onion and potato. They all looked good but I took a slice of the shrimp pesto. The shrimp and pesto topping was pretty good. But to me one of the best things about a pizza is the crust and unfortunately this wasn't great. Very doughy.
name: Albert

text: The food is good but the service is not. The check was dropped to us as soon as we got our food. Nobody came to see how our food was ok or if we needed refills. We had to stop another server for coffee and no I guess I did not want more water or a box for leftovers.
name: Timothy

text: Pizza tasted really good but definitely not ordering again after finding a metal strand in my mouth....so I guess take your chances besides that it tasted great
name: Tommy

text: BlueFin screwed us over on NYE. They had holiday hours from 5-9. We called at 5:01 and placed a order for 2 people. After our order was taken they informed me they were no longer taking orders for the night. Pretty bad business practice considering the circumstance. When was I supposed to call to order? Yesterday? I'm a frequent customer and won't be returning anytime soon.
name: Adam

text: I live close to this restaurant and have been there a number of times.  I usually receive excellent and courteous service along with good food.   I really enjoy going there.
name: Chris

text: Cute little place with delicious food! The French toast was perfect with the right sweetness. The crab cake egg Benedict was cooked perfectly. Egg white burrito with added crawfish was wonderful as well. Definitely worth checking out!
name: Lily

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Pretty perfect.  Good, real Chicago deep dish pizza. Got a pitcher of beer which was also tasty.  The food and service were very good.  I'd say my only problem was that ceiling fans were on but it was still uncomfortably hot. We left earlier than we wanted to because we were sweating inside the restaurant.
name: Lynn

text: Totally ruined our thanksgiving dinner. Made reservations 2 months in advance for family and they assured me that there would be a full a la cate menu available ( it also said it a full menu on their thanksgiving page on their website). When we arrived, we were told it was a fixed menu with very few options. No apologies, just take it or leave it and every other restaurant was booked up or closed. Food was cold, service was bad ( even fixed menu items brought out at different times so part of group had to either wait while the food got colder or eat without the others). Portions were ridiculously small and some food the waiter could not identify for us. He also did not know what the family style desserts were. Then I got the bill for $800 for 7 people. Thank God the company was good!
name: Gregg

text: Great customer service! :) they had what we wanted and we were in an out quickly! Best fast food within the downtown area
name: Maya

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I left full, which at least counts for something.
name: User

text: I wish there were more stars ! The Tum Yum soup is to die for! I'm on a low carb diet and that fit right into it
name: Brittany

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Just not for me. For the price I expected more than this. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: This place is spot on. I don't believe there is a bad item on the menu as we have had most of them. Sunday lunch was a house special pizza and large house special salad. They were both amazing. Fresh and on point.
name: Redfish

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The music was louder than it needed to be. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
I swear I am here every Sunday morning. The lattes are fresh and the muffins are fluffy. You can't really go wrong from there. Try the zucchini carrot muffin. Trust me. I am obsessed.

Daily Grind has the absolute best breakfast burritos that SB has to offer, in my humble opinion, but remember that they stop making them after breakfast is done (I think it's at 11 but don't quote me on that. I just remember being really sad because it was 1 pm and I strolled in asking for one and was told no). 

The overall atmosphere is so relaxing. The vibes are very grungy but with a bit of de la vina charm. Oh, and if you happen to accidentally drive past this, no need to fret, there's another one just down the street!! 

Parking is beautiful, but it'll take a while to pull out of the lot. Or maybe that's just me. 

This is a sweet place to study, read a book, chat with a friend, dog watch, or watch the city just living through that, dare I say it, daily grind. A sweet gem of a coffee shop!
name: Jennifer

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Kind of landed in the middle for me. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: I was in the drive thru and they for got my drink it wouldn't have been a huge deal but I was working for doordash and when I arrived at my customer and I had realized that they didn't not give my drink so I had to go back to jimboys and get it. I went to go in the dining room and and the doors were luck so I had to sit in the drive thru for 10 more minutes!
