text: Outstanding.... such nice people. The Oxtail and Pigs Feet are addictive!!! Can't wait to come back!!
name: Ty

text:
I won't say too much because it's pretty apparent that it's a very reputable restaurant from all the reviews and awards...

Definitely a cool southern experience especially if you're form out of town. Awesome to soak in the southern hospitality and culture...culture of absolutely gorging in savory and wholesome food.

Very reasonably priced for a buffet style and good quality meats and eats. I recommend getting there early and dropping your name down. There will usually be a bit of a wait and you can explore German town. There's the nearby WW2 memorial area and park also right within walking distance.
name: Rex

text: Nice to have Sarah back behind the bar. Great food and drinks as always. Best beer selection in the area.
name: Jim

text: Delicioso!  This is a must check out spot when in Philly. Sat on the back patio area (it's covered) and it has a really cute Italian village feel. The restaurant isn't large, so you don't feel crammed. Great setting and great food. Had the rigatoni alla vodka - must try!  The sausage has a kick of spice to it, so be prepared. But the food was fresh and authentic. Great server too!
name: Tyler

text:
Let my start out by saying this is a dessert place. And they do dessert well. We came for a late snack. Hot chocolate and a churro taco waffle.
The hot chocolate was good. I got the spicy Mexican hot chocolate with a dark chocolate base. The churro taco waffle was the star of the show! The cleanliness of the bar was lacking, as well as the menus. But as for the dessert, it was really good! I can see this restaurant being a tourist trap though. Stick with the dessert.
name: Lacey

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. It looked better online than it did in person. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: The J Dawg was delicious!!! Downtown burger was huge and good- the foie gras just added a weird taste for me. Tucson lemonade was delicious and strong!!!! We sat on the patio and had a great time! Service was ok, nothing spectacular. It would be great to see vegan options- there really weren't any!
name: Laura

text: For the price I expected more than this. The staff seemed tired but still polite. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Wouldn't really choose this place again. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Nice little spot, decent portions too. It looked better online than it did in person. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: The service here was utterly disorganized when it came to seating tables and organizing the people waiting in general. I had a reservation for 7:45pm and showed up a little after 7:30pm. At that point, the hostess told me that it was going to be a bit of a wait regardless of my reservation because they were running a bit behind. She had said there were a lot of reservations and walk ins that had been waiting and not sat yet. Note, they were sitting walk ins without regard to those with reservations, essentially over booking the place. An hour and fifteen minutes later, after continuous questions regarding wait time, un-sat empty tables, and beaten around the bush answers from the hostess we were sat at 8:45pm. Luckily the food and our waitress were impeccable and partially made up for the horrendous service prior to sitting down. Overall, the food was amazing and I'd recommend that to anyone, but the service was little to be desired. If you have a lot of time to waste waiting, I highly recommend going because the food is incredible.
name: Kasey

text: That is great oysters and beer is this place. My buddy and I took scooters to get here from downtown at the Hyatt. Great way to travel around, good beers, and great music at the bar.
name: Nate

text: Just another deli style restaurant. Only giving an extra star due to the fact that they offer really good pizza and food is good quality. Also the grab and go is very convenient.
name: Laura

text: Best order at the counter Mexican food around. California Burrito, Breakfast Burrito, Hard Shell Tacos.. Cant really go wrong here. Try the hot red sauce if you like it Hot!
name: Mark

text: Order from here all the time. The staff is great. There's an older gentleman that works there, think he's the owner. He's the nicest guy ever. Pizza is really good, you just have to wait a little long for it.
name: Tim

text:
When you are a newbie in town and are craving for some North Indian food, Little India is one of the most recommended places and a buffet house at that too! 

We went for their lunch buffet (CAD 16.95).

On entering the restaurant, you can find massive Indian statues. The ambience is very welcoming owing to the warm lights around and hanging lanterns; which also makes it an excellent place for a date or special occasions/gatherings. There are two halls with a good seating capacity. 

You are first served Dahi Papri Chaat (Indian savoury with curd and small fried puri topped with chutneys- lending it a spicy yet tangy taste). Amazing.

The buffet comprises of two soups, two types of rice, plenty of veg/non-veg options- Butter Chicken, Tandoori Chicken, Spicy Garlic Chicken Wings, Paneer Butter Masala, etc. They have a salad bar too with your veggies, fruits and chaat items, chutneys, etc. You are served naan bread- Garlic/Plain at your table and refilled from time to time.

Coming to the main part- the desserts, haha! There was Gulab Jamun, Jalebi, Rice Kheer and Mangi pudding. What I appreciate most about their desserts is the normal level of sweetness in them. Definitely makes for a perfect dessert; no sugar-rush :)

The staff are very courteous and always on their feet to tend to you.


VFM: 4/5
Ambience: 3/5
name: Eylene

text: This isn't a strong 4-star review but this place checks all the boxes for healthy, hearty fare. Outside of the burgers, it's very vegetarian/vegan forward menu (they do have an impossible burger, however). The food is good but not mind blowing, and the menu is actually pretty limited. The staff was friendly and helpful in making suggestions and recommendations.
name: Savitri

text: Salsa Verde has quite a large menu and because of this, it took me some time to decide exactly what I wanted to order.  (You walk in and order at the counter.)  I ordered the 2 soft chicken fajita taco plate.  The nice variety of items on the salsa bar made it easy for me to make my tacos up the way I liked, however upon picking the tacos up, the filling fell through the bottom.  I don't think the thin corn tortillas were briefly cooked at all to help hold them together.  The chicken was diced and had a pretty average flavor.  I did not care for the refried beans because they lacked flavor as well as seasoning.  For desert I tried the flan which was too sweet for my liking but presented nicely with whipped cream.  I'm not sure Salsa Verde is up there yet with the better Mexican restaurants in town, but I hope they do survive.  Competition here is pretty stiff.
name: Jan

text:
Super good, super fast, friendly and affordable.  Highly recommended!

The bread is fresh, quality turkey and the raviolis hot.  

Online ordering was easy and love the tracking to see when it's on its way.

This place has the quality and freshness down.
name: Alicia

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The wait felt longer than it should have. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Excellent beer, delicious food, and (weather dependent) outdoor seating.  It's a favorite dinner stop any time we're in Boise.
name: Steve

text:
I went there with a party of 4 on a Friday evening. There was minimal wait time.  The staff were friendly, courteous, and responsive to any requests from the table.

The family style dining style was very enjoyable and I am an introvert. The old house is nice and adds to the charm.

The food was good.  Homestyle southern American cooking, but nothing that was memorable.
name: George

text: No toppings to make açaí bowls, And they did not have it marked. So after checking out all of my airport options including their açai bowl menu, I came back ready to get this before my flight only to find out that they don't actually have açaí bowls. I settled for a smoothie and they made it relatively quickly.
name: Alyssa

text: If you are Filipino who grew up in the Philippines or ate Filipino food at home, don't expect actual filipino food. I understand it's a fusion cuisine but never have I ever come across halo2 with pineapples and strawberries :(. I was looking forward to it but putting in whatever ingredients with shaved ice does not make halo2. It just did not taste like halo2 at all. To be fair, the spring rolls were good and so was the pork belly steamed bun. I was just disappointed with the halo2, obviously, because I was looking forward to it. The staff were kind and the place was nice.
name: Elle

text: We've lived in the area for a while and just recently tried Goose Creek after hearing great things and looking for a causal dining option nearby home. The outdoor setting is perfect for a family. Lots of great menu options-- the cheese curds are a favorite and we love the seasonal options. Sandwiches and pizza are done right, ample portions. Would like to see more dinner classics on the menu but what they do is very good. Great salads, always very fresh. It is a byob but has beer and seltzers/cider available. Right in the back there is a park with a paved walkway which is perfect if you have a fussy baby or looking to walk off your meal.
name: Emily

text: Coming from me... a Vietnamese person this place was a no go..... food didn't taste good... it lacked everything... would never recommend this place to anyone.....
name: Lisa

text: OMG, unbelievably delicious food! I'm definitely coming back again! They use good ingredient like chicken and amazing sauces! Will come back for sure again!
name: CN

text:
Dude. Settle down. I asked for my pizza to be cooked a little longer because I'm highly disappointed in my soggy pizza every single time. I like the concept, I like the flavor but I would prefer my pizza not to fall apart and be sloppy wet. The guy behind the tap sternly told me that the chef will cook it whatever way he pleases and repeated his statement at least 3 times. I didn't know this was fine dining and asking to cook my pizza a little longer could be an insult to the chef. I ended up ordering a pepperoni pizza to be on the safe side, because anything else is just crap (I don't do soggy pizza). The rudeness and inconsistent customer service is unwelcoming. It wasn't even busy today, as it usually is. I doubt we will be back, Cosmos offers a better pie and price. We will bring our pizza and eat it on the deck by the fire place from now on.

The pepperoni pizza tastes like chef boyardee pizza. Not bad but not worth the price. 

Take the good reviews with a grain of salt. You get a free beer with purchase of a pizza the first time you check in.
name: Erica

text: This place is a must stop when in New Orleans! The food is good, the service is great and the prices are decent. They have amazing gluten-free, and vegetarian options. The crab cake here is to die for. Great for breakfast and lunch or to-go! If you ever catch the owners they have some  amazing stories and wisdom to share!
name: Chloee

text: Amazing food. Love the horchata. The service could have been better the girl behind the counter today seemed as she just wanted to go home. She seemed so lazy leaning on the wall pressing buttons with her pen taking orders with a attitude She took my order CHEWING GUM!!!!!! Who does that? Like I'm sorry but chewing gum while working costumer service is very rude and unprofessional...if the service matched the great food I would have 5stared it..unfortunately can't have it all. If I see her next time I come in I'm just gonna turn around and come back another shift.
name: Taylor

text:
Serial Grillers was formerly a popular food truck restaurant in town, and it was for a good reason, since the food here is great. I really enjoy the calzones, and the pizza is among the best in Tucson. In addition to that, the burgers are also pretty good. 

But for what was purported to be a high concept restaurant, I was disappointed. The place was serial killer themed, and has a menu inspired by them. In addition to that, there are some pictures on the wall, which led to a quirky vibe. However I wish it committed to its concept, because eating there was kind of boring. I'd like to see walls made of stainless steel and with more decorations. I could also see some of the servers wearing hockey masks. 

I heard this place just opened, recently, so there is a chance for them to turn it around and redecorate. But for now, I find it to be an underwhelming experience.
name: Robert

text: Do not go here!! We were looking for a good place to eat close to home and found this place. We did get right in and seated (1 star). The prime rib was not medium rare as ordered and extremely dry! We ordered a baked potato and it came as that, with no condiments. We ordered a hamburger as well but by the time we got condiments for both the hamburger and potato, food was cold and we were ready to walk out. Please do not waste your money. Spend that money to drive somewhere else.
name: Angela

text:
Plates were dirty and we had choose carefully.
Employees were arguing loudly in front of the customers about where they should seat people. Food was okay for the price but they charge kids 2 and up for $7.99 which is ridiculous. 12 years old and up for adults price is okay but how much do you think a 2 yearsold can eat?
name: Blue

text: The gumbo is excellent!! My husband had the trout almandine - best EVER. I had the $20 lunch which was outstanding.  They had $0.25 fruit martinis that were also excellent. We're never disappointed by Antoine's!
name: L

text: This place was awesome! Great vibes and great quality drinks. The overall experience was a lot of fun. The Mortal Kombat arcade machine was a plus too.
name: Jonathan

text: This place was fantastic. We ordered samosas, butter chicken, garlic shrimp and bread basket and everything was fresh and delicious. The service was also excellent. We will definitely be back!
name: Shanna

text:
3.75/5 value y'all, value.

so you're not going to make a pizza with every possible ingredient on it? uh, ok. i am, or at least get close to that. this obvs is catering to a student crowd, but since i still have the health habits of my younger self, i think this works. 

it's a sizeable space if you choose to dine in, and there's a lot in the back for off-street parking, since we know freret can be busyyy. i'll typically swing by if it's later into the evening and i am seeking a solid (read: gluttonous) meal for about $10 post-tip.

service may vary since it seems like they do have a rotating crew of pizza makers, but they will make it right to your specs (or remake it, per my one experience where they forgot to take my pizza out of the oven...oops!). 

[red sauce, maybe white, chicken, maybe bacon, spinach, red bell pepper, ovalini and mozz, mushroom, garlic, kalamata, oregano, lots of arugula!]
name: Alvin

text:
Found this little nook of a restaurant on Yelp when we were on our way home from Yule Tide shopping. The restaurant is completely outdoors but most tables are under cover or in the shade of an umbrella. They have two TV's to catch whatever popular sports are on. There isn't table service, you go to the counter to order. 

We were greeted at the counter by the sweetest most helpful girl who was happy to make a special request happen. I wanted a crab cake salad. Surprisingly they don't have any salads on the menu (although I highly recommend adding it because it was delish!).

We ordered the kids Mac and cheese, seafood quesadilla, 6 ounce crab-cake and my crab-cake salad. With drinks the bill came to a reasonable $34 after tax. 

The 6oz crab cake were the size of a baseball and were fried. They were packed with crabmeat...they were awesome! The flavor totally on point. They have an abundance of condiments on each table to choose from from hot sauces to all day or whatever else might strike your fancy. Highly recommend as long as your ok with fried. The seafood quesadilla had shrimp, cheese and a white sauce. The outside had what seemed to be old Bay and it comes with a side of salsa and coleslaw which was very good. Well executed and tasted super yummy. My daughter liked the Mac and cheese. It is similar to kraft Mac and cheese which is what she likes. Her meal came with chips which had great flavor but a few were soggy, others were perfectly crispy so not sure how that happened but we picked around them. By the way her meal was $3! Can't argue with that and I'm not the type to be icky picky with a minor issue. If we really had a problem with them I'm sure the young lady at the counter would have had no problem having them re-done for us. 

All in all, this is a great little hole in the wall to grab a quick awesome meal at a reasonable price. This will definitely not be the last time I go!
name: Shannan

text: Food was good and came out fast. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. For a busy night they handled it okay. Also, delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. so yeah kind of mixed on it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: I love Marathon. I have eaten at all three locations and it's consistently great. The other night I had worked the whole day at my job and even stayed open and extra hour to accommodate the influx of clients. I walked over to the Marathon at 16th and Sansom. I knew what I wanted but had never had it before. I was hungry and tired from the long day. I came in from the cold, and was greeted with a handshake and a smile from their manager Brandon. He's always friendly and greets me using my name. I head back to the bar and order a Bulliet Rye Manhattan neat with a side of ice. Matt the bartender whips up this amazingly perfect cocktail that is exactly what the doctor ordered. It's perfectly mixed and is delicious! I order the grilled barbecue chicken sandwich with a side of fries. I'm hungry! My dinner arrives like lightning. It looks perfect and tastes even better! I like that they serve it on a roll that's a parker house. It's all about balance when it comes to a delicious sandwich. It's so perfect that I came back the next night with a friend of mine and ordered it again! Marathon is like an upscale diner with fresh locally grown comfort food. It's a place you can go every week at any time of day and get a great meal. Great staff, solid quick service, and delicious menu. You can always find something to love, breakfast, brunch, lunch or dinner. And don't forget...a full bar in every location! Thank you guys, you're doing it right. Love new server Brittany at the 16th street location!
name: Charles

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. For a busy night they handled it okay. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot.
name: User

text: The wonderful live jazz was a treat. The seafood and steaks are delightful. For the #1 food city in the south, it is hard to be competitive, but Cafe Sbisa does so easily.  I'll return to this New Orleans favorite.
name: Laura

text: What a great find !  Food was excellent !  Combination of Chinese and Japanese , excellent food , service and prices. !  Service was quick, reliable and efficient    Lots of variety on menu   It doesn't look very promising from the outside but the place of great. We'll be back !!
name: E Marie

text:
This place, despite being a bit overwhelming at night, has the best seitan wings. Mostly lax service, nothing spectacular, and I've gone unnoticed multiple times, but I keep going back for the vegan food! Reminds me of living in Portland, OR. Vegan lovers, get the seitan! They also offer vegan ranch! 

Be prepared for loud music, random TV, and a bit of a wait. Other than that, a must try.
name: Leila

text: Honestly not that great. I ordered the spicy shrimp pasta and took like a few bites. I could make a much tastier pasta at home. It kind of looked and tasted like a new cook's first attempt at cooking a pasta dish at home. My boyfriend didn't really want his ribeye, and our friends split the fillet mignon and still left behind half of it. It was food, but certainly wasn't worth the price. Left Reno a little disappointed knowing that we could have ate so much better for so much less.
name: Elvira

text: Just had my first meal, post meat, and I have to say it was delicious. I ate a bowl with grilled veggies. For under $10, I could eat it several times a week given that it is affordable and healthy (eg full grain rice and decent fall greens). I bought some soup too for my work best friend. I'll have to  wait and see how the soup goes, but I'm a sucker for mushroom barley once the temperatures start dropping. Thanks for cooking me lunch, Tom!
name: Marcie

text:
Servers were great and had a super knowledge of menu and spirits menu.  Food was scrumptious.  Started w carrot appetizer, delicious and beet appetizer, ahhmazing.

I chose Denver steak which was prepared exactly as requested, accompanying potatoes and broccoli were roasted to perfection.

Daughter and son in law chose pasta and they gobbled it up.  Not an overwhelming huge portion, which was perfect.

Goat cheese panacotta to wrap up the eve.  

We ate outside as the weather was pleasant.  

Highly recommend.
name: Cathy

text:
My go-to restaurant for veggie/vegan food in Nashville. Recommended for anyone who can tolerate vegetables, even the meat eaters among us. You won't go wrong with the curry or burger. The soups are always spot-on. Reasonably priced, casually seating, great for a group. 4/5 stars because some dishes are markedly better than others, though that might just be a matter of taste or, perhaps, a slight nostalgia for the vegan restaurants in SF.

The staff--who are so friendly and warm you'll start to wonder if they've met you before and you are just forgetting--will let you sample anything, so just sample before you commit. Join their email list for food updates and specials--I put them all in my calendar, because each new dish is worth the trek.
name: Emma

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: Oregano's never fails. Waited probably 30 minutes to get a table but worth the wait. Ordered the Pablo Picasso salad and the pesto and chicken pasta. Both were very good and the two of us could not finish it all.
name: Mike

text: Been hearing all these good things about Cheu Noodle and the line is always out the door! That has to mean it must be amazing right? Other than the wings we ordered, the bibimbap and the ramen were mediocre at best... prices were fair... but don't see why I would be returning for anything but the wings and trying out their other appetizers.
name: Ju

text:
The food at La Margarita was fantastic. Would absolutely order the chorizo nachos and brisket tacos again. 

Do you hate when you get nachos with half an order of plain chips?? These guys got that problem solved, they spread the chips out and do one layer of nachos on a big serving tray. Genius. 

Beers were great too. I'll be back for the sours.
name: Matt

text: Guac and burgers were also delicious, but the street tacos were amazing! Just the right balance of flavors and heat! Great place to relax and have a nice lunch!
name: Joy

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Yummm! Very tasty naked lemon pepper wings! Delicious Mai Tai and the shrimp, sausage, corn, potatoes, and egg boil was also pleasing. Very friendly staff and the music was in point.
name: Elisha

text: I landed in Philadelphia we google the nearest breakfast restaurant, we found this amazing place. Sakinah the host had an amazing customer services. If I'm ever in town again I will re visit this delicious breakfast restaurant.
name: Francisco

text: Good pizza in the Tampa bay area! I wouldn't say it is New York pizza because nothing compares but it is still good pizza! The garlic knots not so much. They are huge and they just taste like they took a kaiser roll and slapped some garlic on top. Only the top has a mild garlic flavor. Stop by and grab a slice I am sure you wont regret it. Also I just want to make it clear I am a cheese slice kind of girl, I don't get fancy with toppings, if the pizza is good then their cheese slice should prove that and their did.
name: Bianli

text: Wasn't sure what to expect with a simple name like TOAST and a very unassuming storefront, but we were so pleased. I have read that crowds and time to service has been an issue, and I guess that depends on when you go, but we went on a weekday, mid morning,  and we did fine. The atmosphere while simple was charming and what you would think a NOLA neighborhood place should be like. I had the old reliable eggs and sausage and the sausage was terrific. Not the thin, tough, dry usual, but thick and juicy. Eggs over medium were perfect. And the toast, as you might expect, was great! My wife had something more exotic and she loved it. All in all, if you hit it at the right time, I think it can be a great experience.
name: Dennis

text: When we arrived there was a line out the door, but it goes quickly because of the unique set up. You look at a menu while you wait in line and when you get to the register you order your food and find a table to eat. The staff will bring your food out to you. After that it is impossible to get their attention which is the only downfall. I got the ribs, best ribs I've ever had, and an enormous portion. Mac and cheese side was delicious!!
name: Sabrina

text: I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was good and came out fast. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
Despite being a beautiful building and seeming quite nice, in an affluent area, this IHOP is worse than the ones in the city. 

Our server, Rachel, was incredibly rude and treated us like we were a nuisance to her. Not only was she rude, but she was so pushy. I have never in my life had a server not want to give me an extra minute to look at the menu, until today. 

The food was fine, nothing was particularly good. It was okay quality. However when we were in the middle of eating, she didn't even ask us if we wanted anything else, she just slams the check down on the table and says nothing! Not even "thanks" or "I'll take that when you're ready". I've waited tables for serveral years and even if you're having a bad day, you do not take it out on your customers. 

We will NEVER be returning. Awful experience.
name: Nikki

text: Great food, great service for our dinner.  Portions small for the prices though.  Would be nice to add draft beers.  Also need more indirect lighting for the patio dining.  Everyone needs cell phone lights for the  menus and cannot even see other folks at the table.
name: Bert

text: Wanted to like this place. We are in Boise for the weekend and this restaurant was within walking distance to our hotel. With a 4 star rating I thought it would be good. It was just ok. Gyro's had too much lettuce (which in my opinion doesn't belong in a true gyro) and not enough meat. Rice was bland and not very warm. We were all hungry and ate our dinner, but wouldn't ever choose to come back.
name: J

text:
3 stars ...

...because its open late and we all need our fix after a fun night of drinking and gambling.  Its pretty average - not that great but not horribly bad either.

The toppings are fresh and the price is right.  I'll give you that but maybe it would taste better if you ask for it to be baked a bit longer because it came out a bit soggy.

Again, the crust isn't crispy and its a basic pizza at best with all due respect to the other instant quick and super tasty BYOPizza spots like Pieology, Blaze, MOD, etc.  

It might be worth a try if you got the late night munchies because theres not a lot of options after midnight.
name: Christopher

text:
Not very inviting and staff can be hit or miss. But food has been very good. 
Will go back again
name: Kara

text:
This cute location gets busy fast on a Saturday, so expect long waits during peak brunch times. However, the wait is worth it! Try some of their signature coffee or cocktails while you wait. 

The croque madam was a dream. It was the perfect mix of egg, béchamel, slightly sweet sourdough, and grilled ham. I enjoyed every bite. I also got the potatoes as a side which is not listed on the menu, but you can request that or grits. They were amazing! 

The French toast was tasty, but very sweet. I do like they have half size for $5. Good for sharing at a table.

Would recommend, but be cognizant of time!
name: Heather

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Really good pizza with crispy crust...almost deep dish style...sauce also had good flavor.  Stopped by on way to ocean city but very glad I did...will return!
name: Hitendra

text: Chops was Amazing! The 16oz bone in filet was perfect. Their infusion cocktails were delicious (had the pineapple strawberry). Can't wait to go back.
name: Rory

text: We are in town visiting and decided to visit here after reading reviews. We were not disappointed.  The staff was really friendly and the food was great.  We had the burger and fries and they were delicious.  The prices are very reasonable.  I would definitely eat here again.
name: Judy

text:
The food here is very good and the service very personable.  The hostess waved us in as we just about talked our way past the entrance.  Got directed to the bar while we waited for the rest of our group.  Bartender was very knowledgeable, helpful, patient and served an outstanding Manhattan. 
Dinner was excellent.  Dan was our waiter and he was engaging and helpful.  His recommendations were spot on.  We had the fries (duck fat fried I think); outstanding!  Then I had the blue cheese burger with collard greens.  I went on a limb with the collard greens per Dan's recommendation.  I've never been a fan but they were surprisingly good.  Burger was very good.  Then we split the key lime pie, caramel chocolate trifle and tres leches bread pudding.  All three were excellent; I would get any one of them again.  We'll be back.
name: Rick

text: Dirty tables which I had to wait at for 40 mins when i was told 20, unprofessional workers singing loudly, walking around the store (off key at that), and the final nail in the coffin, how the hell do you run out of sausage at a mfn pizza place. Just ridiculous
name: Jeff

text: Super cute boutique hotel! Was there with a friend for the Essence Festival and the room was clean and we loved the decor. We were lucky to have a room with windows so the natural light was a plus. I also liked the fact that there was a coffee shop in the lobby as well.
name: Charmaine

text:
The burgers here are pretty good, but I have to give them 2 stars because of the fact that they secretly charge 50 cents for their water cups.  

Water is free.  Cups cost less than 5 cents.  

Charging $0.50 for a cup of water is fine, as long as they loudly inform you of it when you ask for one.  They did not.  I had to figure it out, by asking why my $8 burger was coming out to 9.22 when the tax rate is less than 10%.  

It was the $0.50 water I hadn't been told about until they moment.  If I hasn't have asked, I wouldn't have known.  

Now you know ahead of time.  

Enjoy!
name: Ron

text: If you don't like lines, I wouldn't suggest going here. We were lucky to come on a rainy day, so the line wasn't too long. We were told that the line often wraps around the entire building and can be over 2 hours long. We waited about 35 minutes. The staff was very attentive and made sure that we were satisfied. We tried the bonuts. We weren't too impressed with them because they were extremely sweet. If you don't like sweet, I'd suggest trying one of their breakfast sandwiches. I would have rather of tried one of those.
name: Christina

text: Excellent customer service. Waitress was very friendly and attentive. We actually tried a few items for the first time and they were delicious as expected. We will return when visiting Tampa.
name: Tonya

text: I love this place. The first time I went it was for a surprise birthday brunch. The food was amazing. The wait staff was superb. What's there not to like. I went back for dinner and was equally amazed. However the highlight for me was their catering of a  wedding I went to was so good! I loved it. The boudin balls, fish, pasta, gumbo. I mean everything was delicious. I have since gone back several times & have the same experience every time. Chef Leon and the staff of Messina's know exactly what they are doing. If you are looking for a restaurant off the beaten path this is my go to recommendation. I love it!
name: Misha

text:
So disappointed.  Went to Big Sky before the Repertory Theatre and was so excited.
Ordered a burger medium well but the inside ended up to be pink and rare with the outside crusty brown.
Next day I had severe stomach cramping, etc. Pains lasted a few days.   Will be sending back improperly prepared food in the future.
     Service was just so-so.  Won't go back because things did not feel warm or friendly and food was under par.
name: P

text: We went with our daughter. We told the server we were ordering for our daughter first so that we could get her food in before our daughter lost patience. The waiter didn't come back until after our daughters food arrived, which was some time. By the time we flagged him down, we were debating on whether there was still time to eat and got some attitude from the server and just decided to call it a night. Her food seemed good, but the service was awful. No refills on drinks. No offer of a to go box. Just went home disappointed. My daughters food seemed decent enough, on par with  what you would expect in south Tampa. Manager came over who was very nice. This was to be our last night out before having our second baby and was such a letdown.
name: Jason

text: Erneuter Besuch. Wieder sehr lecker. Nette Bedienung. Sehr schnelle Zubereitung. Der mixed Grill Teller mit 3 verschiedenen flllFleischsorten, top!

text: We visited friends for Mardi Gras season.  On the actual Mardi Gras we went to the Rex parade near to this restaurant. The actual Mardi Gras Tuesday is a holiday and many restaurants were closed. We were able to get a late lunch at this place. We enjoyed some good beers like the Abita amber & Tin Roof Voodoo. Spring rolls as an appetizer, pork belly steamed buns, meat lovers baguette and vermicelli. The food was tasty and of high quality. The service was attentive and the food came out quickly. Enjoyed it.

Had the white pizza, sub sausage for chicken, highly recommended! The wings are FRIED so they are crispy, none of that soggy chicken here! The service was great! Will definitely be back next time I'm in the area!

text: I love the outdoor area, spacious, picnic tables, corn hole. The food is just okay though: I'd recommend the cauliflower salad and the veggie bowl. Also, the mock tails are surprisingly good. They are a new restaurant which makes me want to give them a chance. I've tried them twice so far and each time I walk away just "okay".  But I'd encourage you to give them a try yourself.

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was fresh and service was quick. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Overall, a strong experience. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Great first visit w specials for hot chicken week. Very spicy and hot chicken served here for a great deal All week @nashvillescene #hotchickenweek. I'll be back for the regular menu. Love the old videos played and all the nostalgia on the wall. The food is good for a more comfy fast food type Food where you can take your time to eat.
name: Ginny

text: GREAT BURGER! Tried Bru for the first time and it did not disappoint. I had the Melt In Your Face burger and it was fantastic! Patty was flavorful and soft. Definitely a kick of spice but definitely not overwhelming. Bun was so fluffy and air that it doesn't sit in your stomach like most do. Can get kind of loud inside but overall great dim atmosphere and would definitely come back! Oh, also great margs

text: Gave this place a chance and we were completely blown away. Great atmosphere, awesome service and amazing food!! They hadn't even been open a week and completely exceeded our expectations. Great addition to Indy and definitely a must for locals and visitors. We had a large party (between everyone almost everything was ordered) and the servings are big, every single thing was delicious and the beers were great too! Welcome to Indy, Krueger's. We already can't wait to come back!

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
After too many times talking about it, we finally made it to Smiling with Hope Pizza in Reno during one of our trips up from Dayton.  I wish we'd stopped in earlier.  The pizza is the closest to authentic New York style that my born-and-raised in NY Italian husband has had in years!  It was delicious ... thin, crisp crust, exceptional sauce, excellent cheese; the house made sausage is excellent as well.  Walter and his wife were both so friendly and hospitable ... we'll definitely go back, and make sure all our local friends who haven't already heard of it will!

P.S.  How many of you know that Walter is not just a pizza maker extraordinaire, but also a REALLY good musician and singer?!?  He was kind enough to share a CD of his music - we think he should sell his recordings along with his pizza!!

text: Fantastic food! Friendly staff. The entire building is so anassuming. From the outside it looks like just another building. But once you go inside you can see the quality of work that the owners and contractors put into this place. A truly lovely experience. I will definitely be back!
name: Stephen

text:
Won't be returning here unless it is a last resort. It is a cool place inside but unfortunately there were a lot of things that turned me away after dining there.

We arrived and we were promptly seated which was great. However, the restaurant temperature was a bit on the chilly side and we all kept our coats on the entire time. No one who worked there seemed thrilled to be serving and our server was the only one serving the entire restaurant. We ordered coffee at brunch but had to wait 20 minutes to receive it because they had to brew a pot (this was at their brunch- coffee is usually a given), we asked for olives for the bloody mary 3x before we received them, the food took awhile and they were out of most beers on draft. These things may have all been fine should they showed some level of care behind the service- no one said sorry about anything once while we were there. 

The food itself was sub-par...poached eggs on the benedict were poached hard...very unappealing. 

Overall- not the best brunch spot.
name: Abby

text: Absolutely delicious!! Must try the sweet corn casserole! We had a great server and all of the food we had was brought out quick and tasted awesome!
name: Hannah

text: Their food was so incredibly good! I'm in town for a couple days to visit my parents, and we decided to give this place a try. I'm definitely sold on moving to Florida just for this restaraunt! Their milk yellow buns were SO yummy! Everything was wonderful! The tempura sushi especially was top notch! Great place, great food! The server was very attentive and got us our check once we had finished eating. My only complaint would be against the other diners.. old farts that have no manners.. but that's not the restaraunts fault
name: Shaina

text: Fini's is a good staple place to go however don't get offended when the owner goes to every table except yours.  Very casual and people are very friendly. The food is good, not over the top but a like I initially said, a good everyday hangout place.
name: Sheryl

text: Or first time here and not really a good experience. We've sat here for 50 minutes waiting for our small pizza and not once did the server apologize for the amount of time it was taking. I could possibly understand if the place was full or even half full but there are people here and it's Thursday night. Getting pizza to go, hope it's worth the wait...
name: Just

text: One person working Sunday if a holiday weekend. Out of chicken and steak at 7pm. Slow AF.
name: Barb

text: We had the roasted carrots in lebne and kampachi aguachile. I have since recreated the roasted carrots on several occasions. It's an amazing find here in Tucson with an amazing chef!
name: Dustin

text: Sweet spot on the beach. Great to come catch a sunset in treasure island beach. Out of Yuengling beer when we were there but most of the standbys were on draft. Fried pickles were the only thing we ordered and they didn't disappoint. They also had ladders and some other beach games available.
name: Ryan

text:
Incredible pizza and to know it is Vegan makes it a winner hands down.  They create complex flavors by creating in house lemony cashew cream and tasted their garlic, and greens for a completely delicious bite.  I liked the end slices for the crispy edges and the soft and chewy textures that made this one of the best slices I have had South of NY.
xoxo
name: Judy

text: Wonderful Mexican just the way I like it.  Not too fancy but really good. Loved the back patio and the menu literally has something for everyone.   It will take years to find a favorite. I'll be coming back
name: Melanie

text:
While visiting Philly doing some sightseeing and hanging out with friends, was in the mood for some Italian fare and had a decision to make at dinner time.  Stay in town and wait 1+ hour for a table for four at a place in the Little Italy section of Philly or drive a bit further out to the 'burbs for smaller "mom and pop" place.

A quick search on Yelp as well as input from my local guides, suggested rather than put our name on a list and wait in a cramped foyer, to make the short 20 minute drive to Norristown and check out Gino's Pizzeria and Restaurant.  There is a long history of Italian immigrants settling in Philly and it's surrounding areas, so I had a sense the food would be good here.

Gino's is a typical "old sKool" Italian joint that used to dot neighborhoods in Manhattan, Baltimore, Philly, etc. and the other early cities that were popular with Italian immigrants.  Gino's has been run by the same family for 40 years; longevity is always a good sign.

The interior is separated into two dining rooms after walking into a long hallway.  Otherwise, the décor is fairly "strip mall-ish" with drab carpeting, non-descript tables/chairs, along with some Italian themed art work.  But of course, you're here for the food.  

Your meal starts off with a basket of warm bread, and be sure to ask for some olive oil, and skip the pats of butter.  Take an empty plate, drizzle some oil mixed with salt and butter, and you have almost the perfect appetizer.  

And so many places are no longer doing this, but with most orders (we had 3 pasta dishes and one pizza), your meal also comes with a decent house salad.  A base of Romaine and iceberg lettuce is topped with wedges of tomatoes and sliced cucumbers.  It's nothing fancy, but still a nice way to start your meal.

Once the entrees arrive, you'll be shocked at the portion sizes, which are HUGE.  Like, one plate of pasta is enough for three adults huge; or enough for 2 1/2 meals huge.  Take the server's advice and get the baked ziti.  The cyclindrical cuts of pasta were nicely baked mixed with ricotta cheese, sauce, and generous amounts of the house sausage.  This is as old sKool as it gets.  Even after a leisurely meal of two hours (since that's what happens amongst friends and wine), my ziti stayed warm, unlike at some places where entrees immediately cool to room temperature after 15 minutes.

I nibbled on some of the other dishes and they were equally good.  Traditional fettuccini with spicy marina and meatballs definitely tasted like "all day" stewed sauce and the meatballs were moist and flavorful.  Pizza was also tasty, albeit, I wish the crust was a bit crisper and not so chewy.

It's difficult if not impossible to find Italian restaurants like Gino's anymore.  Friendly service, tasty food at prices that won't bust your eating out budget for the week.  Our share of the check came out to $40 (with tax and tip).  Super bonus in that like most places in PA, Gino's has a "BYOB" policy, so we were able to split two bottles of wine at the table - without having to pay a corkage fee either!
name: James

text: Someone tell me why I keep going back?! This was my 3rd time there this month (possibly last time too). There is something in the food that just doesn't taste right. I got a bag of chips on two of the visits and both times the chips have been stale. I work in the area in an office building and asked around and found out that many of my coworkers do not go to this location anymore due to my above mentioned issues plus some other issues.
name: Maria

text: Still good but not quite as good as the last time we were here.  Shrimp was perfectly grilled but the veggie of the day, the broccolini could have been cooked a wee bit more.  The grouper on the other hand was a tad over cooked.  I would still come back, and I would still recommend but had to remove a star.  The service was absolutely fantastic.
name: Clare

text: The best food and service I've had in a long time! And .25 cent martinis for lunch, you can't go wrong. Everyone was friendly and welcoming and very knowledgeable. Out waiter Johnathan H was awesome! The beef cheeks appetizer was to die for! My husband had the turtle soup which he loved, and the bread pudding dessert topped with whiskey table side was worth the wait! If you're in the area I'd without a doubt recommend this place!!!
name: Jessica

text: Ok I can not speak highly enough about Toms dim sum. When it comes to to Asian food in the Delaware county area I would rank Toms as number 1 and on a curve ranking the next best place would be seventh on their best day. The place is incredible just as good as anywhere I've eating in the city the staff are so nice. The lady whinny at the counter alone makes going to this place worth while. But the food is the highest quality I get the scallion pancakes and the soup dumplings every time
name: Nick

text:
I love Wingstop, but the employees at this location are always so rude and unprofessional. I've always been nice to the workers when I'm there, but I generally just get a head nod from them without looking up from their phones.

Also, any time we've ordered online or on the phone for pickup, they don't actually start making the food until we get there - completely negating the reason for us ordering ahead. They rarely open on time, and are really mad at you if you get there at 11 when they are supposed to open.

I love Wingstop enough to keep coming, but the service is getting pretty ridiculous.
name: Yale

text: First time here. The warm bread basket and dippings sauce, melts in your mouth. Bruschetta loaded with diced tomatoes and parmesan with the perfect crunch definitely get that again. My main course was calamari marinara with linguini, very flavorful and the calamari cooked perfectly. Will be going here again.
name: Tonya

text:
Just don't do it... this is a tourist trap filled with bad food.  I'm pretty sure no one that lives in Nashville actually eats here besides maybe the staff and probably they don't even eat that crap lol.  Not worth a visit much less standing in line for?!? 
First thing that hits you once making it through the door is an indescribable smell...like bleach mixed with chemically cleaning supplies, moldy beer & nasty bar bathrooms? You don't smell any food which I thought was rather weird. But maybe it's because you wait in line right in front of the bathrooms...gross.  
Anyway the chicken was too thick to be tender had zero flavor & was greasy, salty and rubbery.  I was told that hot chicken here is super hot and that you need to order down so I got medium which = zero heat & zero flavor for me even after soaking it with the hot sauce at the table this was not edible.  The fries were coated with too much seasoning salt, baked beans tasted like canned & were too sweet, mac & cheese was served luke warm and had no taste...I like to see some real cheese in there not just a cheese sauce....boring. 
Basically we took a few bites and tossed the rest right in the garbage where it belonged I hate to waste food but we just couldn't eat this.  Sorry to be such a negative Nancy but this was no good.  
On a positive note if you're ever in Chicago stop by Do-Rite Donuts & Chicken now that is how a chicken sandwich & tenders should taste they do it right haha!  Make sure to add the hot sauce they have on the side of you like heat.  And of course don't leave without some donuts they are bomb too get the old fashioned!!!
name: Chérie

text: The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The music was louder than it needed to be. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Glad we tried it.

text: This rating is not for the food, which was actually quite good, hence two stars rather than one but for the incredibly bad customer service.  I ordered through Grubhub.  When I unpacked the large order, one appetizer was missing.  No big deal.  I call the restaurant who starts arguing with me, claiming that there are cameras all over the restaurant, which will prove that they sent the item.  I again say it's not there and all I want is my $5 bucks refunded.  I ask the woman if she is accusing me of lying,  Dead silence.  I say well maybe it fell out or got lost on the way but whatever happened I paid for something I didn't receive and I want my money back.  She says it's not their problem.  I tell her I'm going to write some very negative reviews, complain to Grubhub, and is this how she wants to treat a first-time customer.  Again, silence.  I finally ask to speak to a manager, at that point, like I hadn't asked for it at the start of the call, she says oh, we can take that item off your bill.  I say that's all I wanted to begin with.  Plenty of other places to get Japanese in Philly, not ordering from this one again.

text: We've been coming here for a long time.  We love sitting at the bar and enjoying some drinks before dinner. text:
It's an airport bar. Meh. 

The ambiance is gorgeous and its definitely one of the nicer looking airport eateries I've been to.  This mornings visit was lackluster though.  We are traveling for a wedding and wanted to meet here for drinks.  They had enough for 2 glasses of prosecco. 

The bartender, while friendly, was definitely overwhelmed.  Service was slow and we ended up having to skedaddle and leave our bill to be paid by friends who were on a later flight as ours started boarding and we had been trying to close out for 10 minutes.

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. text: Excellent food for a bar. Little noisy tables are close but still intimate. Nice people nice staff good food

text: What an extraordinary dining experience in a casual, kid-friendly, small, neighborhood seafood market and cafe. We brought a bottle of wine and glasses for the imbibers and I selected a wonderfully fresh local lemonade from the cooler.   Howie and Juan are excellent hosts and chefs!  M had an exceptional steamed salmon, JB had conch fritters and I had fried shrimp so fresh it was as if Howie went out the back door to the pier to grab freshly caught shrimp! The place is nice, trendy and the service is good.

text: Favorite pho spot in Philly so far, including those in Chinatown. It's cheap & delicious Vietnamese food at its purest - straightforward with no frills and yet still a clean environment with good service. Broth is rich but still light and not over-seasoned, meats are grilled to perfection on the rice plates, coffee is strong. That's all you need in a local pho spot, especially at these prices.

text: I've known about it for years, but just starting coming here after some of our prior mainstays closed. I've only had takeout, but each time everything is super tasty and fresh - crisp egg rolls, cabbage, veggies, nicely cooked shrimp, fluffy and light fried rice, everything balanced and nicely seasoned without being greasy or overly salty. It gets a bit busy on the weekends and I've had to call a few times to get through, but the phone service/payment is always friendly and courteous. Dining area is small, but clean; I'd for sure consider coming to eat-in sometime. This is my go-too spot for Chinese in SB now!

I'm giving 3 stars because I've had better experiences and service in the past, but I'm not sure that I'm coming back for $20/entrées that are terrible.

text:
Raw burger, stale tasting bun, no chipotle sauce, nasty onion strings.

The bun was NOT toasted and it was a bit stale and squishy, it had absorbed so much juice from the tomatoes that is was soggy in places. We Also ordered onion strings that did not taste quite right, like the oil they were fried in was old. Left those alone! NASTY!

My boyfriend ordered a Cinco and he ordered it medium.. his burger was actually raw. As in pink juice, won't hold together, red meat..kind of raw. absolutely gross. Of course he was not able to finish that. 

This was my first time in this particular Burger 21 even though it is closer to home... I think we will drive the extra distance to get a GOOD Burger experience at the Burger 21 on Dale Mabry!!! This was just a wast of time and money.

text:
Indulgence. Decadence. Sinful pleasures. Chocolate. Of course you want to come here. And you should, because this little spot is a sweet treat! 

There is an amazing selection of macaroons that have seasonal specialities - like Peeps at Easter! There is also this absolutely FABulous dark chocolate croissant, but you have to come early for these! They sell out fast. 

My favorite treat is this Hazelnut Mousse dessert. It is AMAZING. I highly recommend it. I don't how they do it, but it is both light and airy as well as decadent and rich. It's just perfect and beautiful to look at.

And speaking of looks - check out Simone's cakes! They are gorgeous works of art!

There are also other baked good items, high tea, and catering services - all offered in a classy and artful setting by helpful staff.

The interior is beautiful and chic. 

My one complaint has to do with their hours of operation. I can't always get there before 2 pm close time - not on a work day. So, it has to be special visits and treats for me - which is maybe good for my waistline! LOL

The restaurant was fairly busy when we arrived at around 11:30 am. We got seated after around 15 mins for 4 of us. 

I got the veggie frittata, with home fries and Cuban bread. I've never had Cuban bread at brunch before and I love Cuban bread so that was a plus.

was to die for it was so good...place is a bit noisy with a youthful vibe, but well worth the visit for exciting cuisine and warm ambiance and good service with waiters who actually know about the offerings and are enthusiastic about everything!

text:
I almost didn't come to Peche after finding out they did not have the crab claws on the menu. However, I am glad I did! The restaurant is large and beautiful. The exposed beams, large windows, and reclaimed wood tables are something you would see straight out of Fixer Upper. 

I love that Peche has a lot of variety in their menu, making it perfect for sharing. We decided to share the following:

-1/2 a dozen of raw oysters
-Steak tartare
-Smoked drum salad (raw bar special)
-Smoked tuna dip
-Seafood gumbo
-Smothered catfish

My favorites were the steak tartare and the seafood gumbo. The steak tartare comes already spread on a piece of toast with a small salad on top. The tartare was very fresh and the flavors were well-balanced. The seafood gumbo rivaled the seafood gumbo at Commander's Palace. The stock was rich and full of depth. You have to get these two items when you're here!

My least favorite item was the smothered catfish. The sauce was way too salty and the rice was a bit undercooked. Many people also raved about the smoked tuna dip, but there was an overpowering salty/sour flavor that I could not get over. I prefered the smoked drum salad to the tuna dip. 

Overall, Peche was one of the better meals we had while visiting New Orleans. The ambiance, service, and food were all great! I would definitely recommend checking out Peche if you're here!
name: Jillian

text:
So this was a Thursday afternoon lunch. The room was not crowded so we were seated immediately. Our waiter Carlos arrived promptly. 

My companion and I are mature and need cheaters to read. The menu was difficult to see so we both had to use the flashlight on our phones to read the menu. A minor complaint. 

My companion ordered the Chimi Asada,and I had the Plato Pancho Villa. My only complaint was the carne cutlet was a bit overcooked and dry. The replenishing was perfection. 

We will certainly return again. Carlos service and attention was excellent and he is to be commended. We did not have cocktails. Lunch for two was $43.

text: I LOVE Nikka! Every time I come here, I get the pork belly ramen. I don't really understand some of the negative reviews on here either. I would say that it's definitely better than some of the ramen places I've had in Little Tokyo like Daikokuya, as well as the fact that the wait isn't even long for the food. Also, it's to be expected that ramen would be salty, as that's kind of the whole premise of the dish; I wouldn't let the saltiness of the broth to be something that detracts you from coming here! To be honest, I like this place better than Santa Barbara Craft Ramen which is in downtown, as I think it's a lot more flavorful, and it's a little more inexpensive as well.

text: Simple but great authentic mexican cuisine. Wood tables make this cantina super casual. Good margaritas made with Blue Agave Tequila. Great assortment of salsas. Self serve salsa bar. Hard working staff.  You order at the counter and take a number. Food comes out in pieces but everything was so good. Four of us had Chicken Fajitas, Enchiladas suizas, and Chicken Tacos. We Tried to order Tacos Pastor but they were out of pork. Everything is covered at the counter as there is no table service. Also young lady taking orders struggled with our special requests. Not her problem as I need to brush up on my Spanish as my son was laughing at my lame attempts. It was cold otherwise you have to try their outdoor patio. Watch the back parking lot as we struggled to get out once we parked back there. Very tight. Thanks for a good night
name: Jeff

text:
I'm not a big fan of Mexican food, but it's one of my husband's favorites, so from time to time I get to indulge him by going out for Mexican food.  Much to my surprise this was an excellent experience! 
Pueblo Lindo is a new Mexican restaurant in a very convenient location of Eagle and Ustick. The interior is clean and nicely decorated. The chairs are very comfortable and the ambience is all around inviting. 
It was not quite 5pm and the restaurant was filling up quickly. They were able to seat us without delay and despite being a new restaurant and busy, they did great with the service!  
You are welcome with bottomless chips and salsa but even better, ask for a spicier salsa and you have two options (jalapeño and habanero). These were excellent!!! 
The menu is quite long with many choices but we ordered the 3 Enchiladas Combo (shredded chicken)and the Carne Asada Tacos... and WOW!  The perfect sized servings of beans and rice that come with the entrees, and the flavors were spot on. 
The reason for four stars and not five is because the prices for drinks are a little steep and come with just one refill at that price and the bathroom facilities were just not very clean. 
Overall this was a great experience, great food, and friendly and quick service. For me... this restaurant made Mexican something I could do more often with my husband.
name: Destiny

text: This place is pretty tasty and has a variety of Asian cuisine. I'd definitely recommend it!
name: Kylie

text: Went looking for a brunch spot in St. Pete's that did not break the bank! I must say this gem fit the bill!! The mimosas and the bloody Mary's were meh, but the Benny's are to die for! I had the Florence Beeny and my companions had the Sea Bennys. A must have for reasonable prices!
name: Tamika

text: Really good food. Wish there was one in Framingham mass area. Red sauce is spicy good, white sauce is really good also but very unhealthy based on nutrition facts. Wish they would put more portions of chicken had to get double chicken. Went twice when I got to pa and left pa.
name: Dipesh

text: Sleek, sexy and super tasty. Incredible service and fresh food in South Philly. A gem in the neighborhood that should draw crowds from all over!
name: Ian

text:
This is a true 4.5... not quite in the category of "best eating experiences in the city," but a great meal without much room to complain. Of note - we came here for Restaurant Week $35 prix fixe dinner. As noted elsewhere: BYOB, cash only.

Service was good - quick, friendly, and able to offer useful opinions and advice about the dishes. 
The prix fixe menu was very extensive by Restaurant Week standards, 7+ options for both the first and second courses. Portions were surprisingly massive... we took home half an appetizer and half an entree, and we both left very full.
We sat at the chef's counter; it was pretty cool to watch them make all the food. The overall ambiance is 'neighborhood favorite' meets 'upscale eatery'... in a good way.

(Pre-first course: fresh baked bread... yum)

First course: 
Baby Arugula Salad (figs, strawberries, lentils, warm goat cheese): OMG I WANT THE WARM GOAT CHEESE ON ALL THE THINGS. 5/5
Whipped Ricotta: The fresh ricotta is deftly balanced with texture (butternut squash, pomegranate) and spice (cayenne cinnamon) 4.5/5

Second course:
Pappardelle (portobello, arugula pesto, sunflower seeds, Parmesan): a nice blend of distinct tastes that, put simply, works. 4.5/5
Whole branzino (spiced tomato ragout): the fish was tender and flaky, but dang.. so many tiny bones that constantly pose a choking hazard. Tomato ragout wasn't a standout. 3/5

Dessert:
Warm chocolate cake (strawberries, whipped cream): Quite possibly the best all-around texture I've ever experienced in  a molten chocolate cake. 5/5
Carrot cake (sesame-pumpkin seed brittle): I love me some carrot cake, and this didn't disappoint, 4/5

Will certainly come back outside of restaurant week to try more of the menu!
name: Mark

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: The french toast was out of this world good. My boyfriend got the mexican skillet and was raving about it. Really, really good breakfast place. Was of course packed at 11am on a Saturday but worth it!
name: Kerri

text:
Excellent service and laid back environment!

Upon looking at the near flawless Yelp reviews for Manolito, I decided to stop by this restaurant on my first trip in New Orleans. 

Located in French quarter near the water, the restaurant spans two floor but looks fairly small from the outside. Since parking is fairly limited at French quarter, I would recommend either taking an Uber or walking there. 

This restaurant is known for its extensive drink menu and good service. The regular food menu is fairly limited but you can get good Cuban sandwich or ceviche there. 

For entrée, I ordered the shrimp ceviche. The sauce was tangy and delicious and it had good amount of shrimp. Since I am a pescatarian, there wasn't a lot of other choices on the menu. Therefore, I would recommend this restaurant mostly for drinks and small bites only. For drinks, my fiancée ordered the mint cocktail and he said it was one of the best he tasted. I don't drink alcohol but got a sip and was impressed with the refreshing mint within the drink. 

As for the service, our waiter was very attentive and food was served quickly. If you are hungry, I would recommend going to other places for regular dinner and come to this place only for drinks. 

Overall, a hidden Cuban gem in New Orleans!
name: Ika

text:
One word: Laziness.

That pretty much sums it up. This spot is receiving two stars primarily because they have convenient hours and are consistent. Consistently, meh. Here is why I say they're lazy:

1) Constantly messing up orders.
2) I have had, on numerous occasions, the full shell on my shrimp while in a taco/burrito.
3) Again, I have had, on numerous occasions, the avocado 'stem' [or whatever that top part is that easily flicks off] in my guac. Yes, biting into that is as unappealing as it sounds. 
4) I always walk in, order food, and leave with a bill that is a fraction what it should be due to them comping all of their mistakes. It's the definition of laziness; why not correct said issues?!?

Oh well. I know what I'm signing up for when I go here so there are no surprises.
name: John

text: I wanted to give the wings 3.5, but that was based off appearance. I'll explain. When I received the wings I saw all the sauce down on the bottom of the container. I instantly thought I should have gotten more sauce. They charge 50 cents for extra sauce and I was being cheap. The wings are big and I was fearful that they would be dry. However, they were not. You see, they use a thinner sauce... I tasted sauces similar to this and their sauce did not disappoint. Very tasty, in my opinion. The wings were also cooked to perfection. (Not overdone and not underdone) This kind of sauce does not stay on the wings because it's too thin, but it's ten times better than the thicker sauces out there. I give the sauce 8.5 outta 10. Truthfully, it's an excellent sauce. Some may just have to order the extra for .50 cents. (It's worth it...) The service I cannot comment on because I ordered takeout. The pizza looked good also. I would order it again.
name: Lake

text: Wow this place is amazing the service is also amazing! It's a family ran business also!! a group of friends and I came last Sunday and even though they were closing in a bit we didn't feel rushed ! The food was AMAZING everything was so fresh and nothing made my stomach hurt ... (I have a sensitive stomach) it's also byob .. the food comes out fresh and the portion sizes are big !!! text: Came here with four on Mother's Day and the place was an efficient machine of delicious.  Four people give five stars- unanimous!

text: Great customer service, decent prices, and the food is super yummy! Def worth a visit if you're looking for a quick(and filling) lunch.

text: So, I liked this place but in comparison to some of the other local pizza places I was not"wowed". We arrived early on a Saturday afternoon, I guess for an early dinner or late lunch. There was really only 3 or 4 other groups there, a bit empty. But the restaurant was nice, clean and inviting. Customer service was good. There were 4 of us so we ordered 2 pizzas. text:
Close friend recommended this place and we were not disappointed. Absolutely loved the food and the service was great. There was a 1 star review of this place and how terrible the service was but that is definitely not the case at all. It's just that there is a language barrier and mannerisms were probably misinterpreted. This place definitely did not deserve that 1 star review. The owner was there in person and was so kind.

The food was delicious and so flavorful. Only downside was that we came when it was no longer crawfish season but we tried it anyways, and it was still delicious. The shrimp was also delicious and they were huge. Definitely worth every penny.

Saw several other people recommend the roast beef po boy so we ordered one to try and it was also delicious. I've yet to have a roast beef po boy better than this place. So if you're not feeling seafood, the roast beef po boy is the way to go. 

I definitely recommend this place and definitely would be coming back any time I'm in town.

text:

text: Excellent food served in a calm and elegant atmosphere. Very suitable for a romantic date night. My husband and I visited for Valentines Day and we were very impressed by the entire experience. Our sever was very attentive, comical, answered any questions we had about the menu and was able to make great suggestions.  The bread served as a starter was crisp and had cheesy undertones - we were addicted from the start! Our meatball appetizer was delicious and the beef was perfectly tender served in a sweet marinara sauce (which was perfect to dip the bread in by the way.) I ordered steak for dinner which my knife cut through like butter. Mashed potatoes were also fluffy and very good. My husbands salmon with scallops were light and drizzled in a really yummy sauce, I admit I stole a few bites. I will say that their Brussels sprouts were too salty and we did not even put a dent in them (which we normally would devour, we LOVE Brussels!) Other than that, the night was perfect. We passed on dessert because we were so full but we were given a free mini dessert platter consisting of a macaroon, blondie and a small cookie. All were very tasty and a perfect way to end the evening! We will be back on our next romantic date night.
name: Kate

text:
Had been dying to try this place and finally got the chance to. The only reason I would knock a star off is that they get so packed at seating can be uncomfortable. They basically added my party of 2 to a party of 4's large table which was a bit weird. 

Everything we had was really tasty. The cold cucumber app left something to be desired but everything else was a slam dunk. The pork and crab soup dumplings were so good that I seriously could have eaten 2 orders. The spring rolls were tasty, and the beef dumplings are on point. 

Definitely recommend this spot, and I completely understand why it's so popular. Absolutely worth a stop in when you're in the area.

text: Loved this place. We went for lunch on a Wednesday afternoon, our first time to a vegan restaurant. I went specifically for the Impossible Burger and was not disappointed at all. Everything was well prepared and delicious. Would definitely go back again!

text:
Came with my boyfriend for a downstairs dinner reservation and we both really liked it! We ordered small plates to share:

+ tuna tartare (one of our favorite dishes of the night. The tuna to avocado ratio was perfect, the tuna so fresh, and the crunchy crisps they added were a nice touch)

+ salmon sashimi (just melted in your mouth. Absolutely must order the salmon here. Came with 3 pieces so keep in mind when sharing)

+ edamame dumplings (I've heard a lot of rave reviews about this and I think they live up to the hype! I've never had these before and they taste almost like pierogies. They're served in a light broth and the dumpling wrap is nice and springy. Perfect blend of savory and not heavy)

+ shrimp tacos (so perfectly battered and lightly fried. Shrimp was so fresh. Just wish they'd added more avocado sauce)

+ Kobe beef robetayaki (very juicy, was not disappointed. Tasted great even without the recommend sauce)

+ pork jowl robetayaki (definitely my absolute favorite of the night. So tender and juicy, even my boyfriend who doesn't normally like pork loved it. I preferred this robetayaki over the kobe beef)

+ chicken teriyaki entree (this was just chicken, no carbs included. The meat was very tender and I thought the whole dish was well made but kind of underwhelming compared to the other dishes. For $17, I would not order again. It also got boring after the second slice of chicken. If this were a small plate instead of a larger entree I would have liked it a lot more)

+ seaonal eel over rice special entree (served with pureed avocado sauce. It was good, just a bit salty. This came last and we were too full by this point to finish it. Not sure if I'd order it again) 

Our bill came out to a total of about $130 including tax and tip so we were glad we hadn't opted for the chefs choice special, which would have been 60 per person (before tax and tip) and would have given us way too much food. We would have forgone the chicken teriyaki entree and the meal would have been perfect. Small plates definitely impressed us more.

They also gave us complimentary champagne because it was our anniversary. A complimentary dessert of chocolate and strawberry mochi was also served. They stuck a sparkler in one of the mochis and it was really fun and cool! 

Definitely recommend dinner here, especially for a date! Next time we're interested in trying out the happy hour upstairs.
name: Regina

text:
This place definitely deserves the 5 stars! 

At first, I was skeptical about visiting Kuma. A sushi restaurant with 5 stars and over 40 reviews was questionable... How could this be?! Nonetheless, I decided to try it out.. and I am sooooooo glad I did!

Kuma is located in a shopping center in Wynnefield, so parking was relatively easy to find. We arrived around 8:45pm on a Friday night and shockingly there was no wait for a party of two. We realized it is BYOB so we left to purchase a bottle before returning... still no wait. 

Our host Renee was the sweetest ever! We started with their Shrimp Shumai, which I was very happy to see as this is an item I have not seen on a menu for a while. It was so tase, would recommend as a starter.

We also ordered their Shrimp Tempura roll, Angel specialty roll (Tempura Shrimp, Avocado, Eel Sauce, Crunch Crabmeat) and a side of shrimp fried rice. All were prepared well. Very fresh! 

Great dining experience, great place for a date night. Will be back soon!
