What a nice place to "do brunch" on a Sunday morning! In full disclosure, I only even came here because of the $2 mimosas; the food wasn't something I was even that concerned about. $2 mimosas, people. $2!!!

So yes, I had a couple mimosas on the pretty patio on a gorgeously sunny and warm Sunday. And I felt fabulous. And fancy. And chic. So who cares that the actual food wasn't amazing? Not me. Because mimosas.

I ordered the stuffed French Toast. It was a chunk of baguette that had a small dollop of a cream cheese mixture inside. The outside of the bread tasted like French toast but the center was essentially just like eating a piece of baguette. Not horrible but not what I had hoped it would be. My side of scrambled eggs was good. 

But again. Mimosas on a hot Sunday morning on a flower- filled patio. Is there street noise on the patio? Yep. But seriously, who cares about that? Not me. You know why? I bet you guessed it: $2 mimosas
name: Cat

text: My first time to Villa Rosa was a success. Just moving to the area in December I am still checking out the local eats. I am a huge Italian fan and my dinner was exceptional. I got angel hair pasta with a pink sauce and meatballs. The flavor was fantastic. My waitress was super sweet. I will definitely be a regular patron to this gem in Burlington.
name: Christen

text: A gem of a place with magnificent "Donuts ". Delicious coffee...Great food and a wonderful atmosphere. We  were looking for a coffee joint while traveling....this was the best find in the area. So if you're in the area and you want some off the beaten path "stop in an visit Joe's Cafe" ...I rarely give five stars this place deserves it. Great customer service as well.
name: Jill Jones

text: Service was okay. Food was awful, ordered the big breakfast sandwich...cheese wasn't even melted and hash browns (tater tots) were old and cold . Sent it to be reheated and the whole thing (plate and orange slice included) was just put in the microwave. Hands down the worst meal I've ever paid for.
name: Colm

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The music was louder than it needed to be. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: There's not much I could say about this place that has not already been said. What I personally loved about this was the concept. I generally dislike people. There was something about sitting at a table with five groups of strangers. It was very warming. And the food matched with that feeling as well. Wasn't the best of foods. The atmosphere was fantastic. Now I'm not saying the food was bad. It wasn't at all. It's exactly what I would expect a southern meal to be. Just needed a touch more seasoning I guess. But this seasoning I got was from all of the guests I dined with. Where else can people from all around the country and Canada sit at one table and leave as best friends. We were also fortunate to have locals join us who just spread their knowledge upon us. Sometimes food it is not about the flavor, but the friends you eat it with. Even if you never met them before.
name: Satyam

text: I took my 3 boys here for my birthday dinner and everyone of us enjoyed the delicious food this family owned restaurant had to offer. Looking forward to returning.
name: Chuck

text: We walked into Bully's hungry....we left hungry. After sitting for about 12 minutes we weren't even acknowledged. Now I have a bit of patience when a place is busy and everyone is working hard....but that wasn't the case. Employees chatting with customers and other employees. After 5 minutes, my husband walked across the room to grab a happy hour menu off of a different table as our table nor any of the 10 or so empty tables around us had one on it. We spent 5 minutes looking at the menu, then another 2 waiting...with still no acknowledgement...then we left.   Did Bully's change to self service and I missed the memo???   Oh well...Famous Dave's BBQ was delicious.
name: Loretta

text:
He said, "It blew me away."  I loved Bait also. The decor, the ambience, the service and the food were all spot on. If you would like to dress up a little, this is the place for it. Here's a tip. You probably won't get in if you don't have reservations. They also have several vegan options available. And as Steven B. said in his tip, there is no bar to sit at. It's all table seating. They have valet parking which is $4.00. 

We started with cocktails while we looked over the menu. He got the Blood and Sand and I went with the pear margarita. The appetizers menu looked fantastic and we decided to share the duck Rangoon and the lobster fries.  I loved the Rangoon but I think it was because I loved the chili sauce that you could dip it in. The lobster fries were outstanding also with large pieces of lobster mixed in.  

Our main dishes consisted of the seafood chowder for him and the salmon for me. He said his was terrific but it was gone before I got a bite. My salmon was suburb with sweet potato mash and creamed spinach.  Yes we decided on dessert - the bananas foster which was very tasty. 

Would I come back here?  Yes, I already know what I'm going to try. If you see me there, stop by and say hello.
name: Joan

text: I can't even describe how much we loved this place. The four of us shared one medium and one large pizza, one was the Islander and one was a custom pizza. We were able to sit outside, plenty of seating, and I liked that there was no wait service, it allowed us to pick our seat and relax. The pizza was thin crusted, but SO delicious. I loved the pesto sauce, not too much pesto but just right. We will definitely be back!
name: C

text: The ambiance leaves a lot to be desired and the food is very good and close to exceptional, but it feels like a chain -which it is.  I can't recommend this beyond an above-average Italian restaurant (ala, Stone Creek).

Excellent cheeseboard, knowledgeable staff, setting can't be beat. The happy hour white wine is a delicious blend that pairs beautifully with the cheeseboard and free bacon always wins. The courtyard is beautiful and the setting amazing!
name: Matthew

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Overall, a strong experience. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Tiny little spot but sooooo delicious! So glad we stumbled upon it. The 76ers roll was very tasty, pink lady was pretty good as well. Decently priced too! Would definitely come back
name: Lindsey

text: First time in New Orleans and landed kind of late. Waited in line, mind you line here at night round 7 gets pretty long. Order the charbroiled oysters, and man they were good! Ordered another round. Drinks were strong. The catfish batter melts in your mouth. But forsure coming try this spot, all about the charbroiled oysters!
name: Sini

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was good and came out fast. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: The new owner is amazing. He cares a ton and the pizza is fantastic as always. If you haven't been in or ordered lately, make sure you come back.
name: Kirk

text:
Bear with me because it's really hard to type this as I teeter on the brink of a food coma. To start the wait was about 40 minutes but what makes it worth it is they don't cook your food until they're ready so even if you wait that long when it hits a table it's fresh.

We had the steelhead pizza, 2 lbs of wings, and the frachos. Sweet Jesus I can barely stand the smell of my breath, the garlic and spices are so rich. If garlic is truly good for your health this meal added 10 years to my life. Subtract the five that the frachos took from me and I'm still ahead.. 

This place is absolutely delicious and worth whatever the wait is. Get yourself a round of drinks, enjoy a nice conversation, I wait for the food at hit the table cuz that's when the show starts.

Service was outstanding, servers were very personable, and God bless the bartender... He rescued me when I thought I was dying from garlic toxification.
name: Ricardo

text:
It was my daughters birthday and she wanted to go here. I've never been so I was excited to go. We went for lunch. I don't eat a lot for meat so I got the Market Bar. Don't call it a salad bar because you will be corrected it's a market bar. 
  The market bar was amazing it had a lot on it. I tried a little of this and that. Charcuterie- meat and cheese- fresh mozzarella with tomatoes. A kale salad with squash and seeds,it was so good. Chickpea salad - chicken salad- apple salad- difference lettuce with topping and dressing. Quinoa salad - asparagus -peppers onions ,pickles ,fruit just to many things to list but I know one thing I'm ready to go back. Also had a steam table with soup - rice - grilled onions and peppers to put on your steaks. They bring rolls to the table and they were oh so good.  
 My daughter got the whole experience and was it and experience. The meat servers keep walking around with meat on a large skewers asking if you want some from steak to chicken to pork and sausage. Brought her a side of mashed potatoes and Fried plantains and fried polenta. 
 This was definitely an experience that you should try at least once.
name: Linda

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It looked better online than it did in person. So yeah, the portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: This convenient restaurant with a diner style breakfast in Maryland Farms is easy to get in and out of. My omelet and hash browns were tasty, and the serving size was generous. The service is ok. You order at the counter, and your name is called though when it is slower they may bring you your food. I've only had breakfast here so cannot comment on lunch or the salad bar yet. The restaurant is clean though my table has been "wobbly" in more than one spot here. They do play Fox News which was not enjoyable to me and may turn off some customers. I might suggest something like HGTV that everyone can agree on.
name: Jeffrey

text: We finally went back and had a nice lunch, the food was much better, the service was great. I ordered the trio... my only criticism would be the lasagna was mushy. The capellini was well cooked, the chicken parmesan was perfect.
name: Mike

text: The sauce is amazing and flavor is always on point. My only issue is sometimes the ribs are extremely tough; it's really hit it miss
name: S.

text:
Finally! A place in the neighborhood with good food, good service, and good prices. Akash was an absolute delight with his beer suggestions and conversation. Our table was completely stuffed from just a few appetizer selections (we cleared every plate - it was that good). Definitely try the samosas! The tamarind chutney is AMAZING.

I'll definitely be back!
name: Jane

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. You can tell they care about customer experience here. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. A very pleasant experience. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. It looked better online than it did in person. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text: The food is decent. Some hits and some misses. I ordered the double griddled-smash burger with extra cheddar cheese and French fries. The burger was under seasoned and needed more salt. The fries, however, were shoestring and had the perfect amount of crispness. My friends ordered the cornmeal dusted tilapia, Greek salad, and hummus (all of which were beautifully plated). I only had one bite of the tilapia; one bite alone, I found it too acidic. My friend was struggling to finish it because it was sour. The hummus was good, and you can't really mess up a Greek salad. The highlight of the entire meal was the dessert - caramel brioche bread pudding is a must! It is just the right amount of sweetness and I didn't find it too heavy shared among two people. Overall, I would come back just for this dessert.
name: Winnie

text: Super solid choice for lunchtime with a toddler! Very friendly and accommodating staff, kids menu w crayons, and great options on the lunch menu for adults and kids- like the baked crab Mac and cheese! Delicious chicken and waffles and market salad too. And the attached courtyard (restaurant is part of the Royal Sonesta hotel) is a gated, shady little oasis great for taking a break from the busy streets and letting yer kiddo run around for a minute.
name: Andrea

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Not bad for a quick meal. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. A very pleasant experience. Food was good and came out fast. For the price I expected more than this. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: This is a great old-school, thow-back pizza restaurant with an extensive beer menu. The pizza sauce was fantastic.
name: Joshua

text: Good food, generous helpings, and a fair price. There is also a bar and they have excellent beer in the fridge that you can grab and go. The salads are huge. This place is constantly good and the wait staff is great.
name: Shane

text:
Tableau is a fine dining restaurant in the middle of the French Quarter that is always an ease to make reservations with and consistently excelled itself with great service... Every time our small group visited we are quickly seated and had two waitstaff assigned to our table who take our drink and wine order with little delay. 

We usually start with the Grand Royale appetizer a combination of shrimp remoulade, crab cakes, fried oysters which are a delightful start to a meal.  
For entrees I recommend Tableau's 6oz Filet of Beef it is of the highest quality and cooked perfectly to order and served with a side asparagus. I also recommend the Roasted Half Duck which is surprisingly tasty and well prepared.  For a lite entree I recommend The Redfish Bienville with fingerling potatoes. 

If your looking for an fine dining restaurant for two or a small group I highly recommend Tableau for its superb service and excellent menu.
name: Bryan

text: Zac is The best. Delicious food and so much fun!!!!!! We love the wings! So good. Yum.
name: Elizabeth

text:
Our first time in The Reading Market Terminal. We were all very hungry, and were specifically looking for Amish cooked food. So we came across The Dutch Eating Place. The only seating was a counter top, okay. The waitress was friendly & prompt, very good. My husband ordered a bacon cheese burger & fries. Recv'd. his plate LONG after the rest of us. Said his food was ok -- wait was not. My older teen ordered a tuna sandwich, which came w/commercially made potato chips, said sandwich was "ok, nothing special; store bought chips were good." My younger teen ordered a hot open roast beef sandwich -- which she loved. I ordered a cup of chicken noodle soup, that includes corn in it -- not hot enough, & tasted like chicken sugar soup -- not good.  Also, I had a turkey melt sandwich w/mashed potatoes (inclds. Swiss cheese, tomato, bacon, & russian dressing on grilled bread. Disgusting!!! The bread was greasy, the cheese not fully melted, not enough or thick enough tomatos; & last but NOT  least --- their homemade Russian dressing is only a tasteless,  greasy mayo and an ever so FEW bits, of minced Gherkin pickle mixed in! And, they glob it on the sandwich! I feel nauseous writing this review!  I took two bites & couldn't eat it. I asked the waitress to please remake the sandwich w/out their "Russian dressing," & she was very nice & said ok. The second sandwich wasn't very good either. I didn't want the greasy bread again, so I took the sandwich apart, & ate small amount of tomato. Then ate a piece of the bacon & left the rest -- not good. The side of mashed potatoes were good, when I was able to get some w/out the enormous amount of gravy on them; which I didn't ask for -- not good.

We will NEVER eat here again.
name: K

text: First time here.  My wife and I were impressed with the decor and cleanliness of the place.  It's in Fountains Plaza.  She had a chicken tinga quesadilla and I had a chicken tinga salad with beans and rice.  We both ordered soft drinks, total cost just over $20.  Money well spent!  Food was fresh, delicious and filling.  Eduardo has a steady hand and careful attention to his food.  We will definitely be back.  Highly recommended.
name: Steve

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was good and came out fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Not bad for a quick meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Very generous portions & Guy is super friendly! Had the grilled catfish & shrimp po-boy--yum!
name: Carole

text: So tired of this Chipotle location. Every time we go something is out of stock. One day they said sorry out of forks. Next time out of Diet Coke and tortillas. Last night out of vinegarette dressing. You make it here I thought to myself. They just didn't want to make any. It's so annoying when you go in and 7 people in front of you and workers are cutting lettuce or standing in the back. How about you help the customers and go back to cutting lettuce in a few minutes. The chicken was burnt last night and tasted like charcoal. It's always something get your act together Chipotle south this is down right ridiculous and tell your staff to be a little nicer and appreciative that guests even come there. They make it seem we are troubling them to make us food.
name: Brad

text: We have been going here since it first opened and each time it's gotten worse. Today was the last time we will be going.  I used the restroom, their was no toilet paper. I informed the employee and she turned to another employee and they both sook their head and kept doing nothing. The young girl at the register was barely audible. The soda machine smelled horrific. Smelled like mold. It smelled so bad I started to gag, on top of that their was no flavor options and they were out of various different types of soft drinks. I wish that's all the negative i could say about this place. But it's not  the restaurant was filthy.  The tables were not wiped down, chairs had food on them, the floor was filled with food.  I had my son with me, the high chairs had food crusted onto them, two of them were so gross and sticky they could not be pulled apart.
name: Sean

text:
Really easy to explain

Mozzarella sticks - $11.00!! Breaded fried cheese right???
Cheeseburger -$13.00 who Pays that??
Caeser salad -$14.00 - romaine lettuce???

Ordered a pizza and left.
name: Matthew

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The wait felt longer than it should have. Just not for me. It looked better online than it did in person. For the price I expected more than this. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The music was louder than it needed to be. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text:
A Nashville must! I visited Hattie B on the second day of my trip to this amazing city. I loved the various spice levels that you're able to choose from along with all of the yummy sides. My only regret was not coming here with another person because I wanted to try EVERYTHING. So take note, drag a few of your friends here and have yourselves a feast!

I got the medium spice chicken (not hot at all), collard greens, cole slaw, and sweet tea (need this everyday). Will try the banana pudding next time I visit!!
name: Jenny

text: We have found our new favorite breakfast spot! Service was great, the food was exceptional, atmosphere was warm and inviting like a 50s diner.
name: Ashley

text: Just got my rental car and needed breakfast with my two teenage daughters.  This place came highly recommended.  It did not disappoint.  I had the french toast.  They make their bread fresh every morning in their bakery & my daughters had the cowboy skillet.  It was just as good and had a homemade biscuit with it!  Incredible!!
name: Jackie

text: All I can say is amazing! I was impressed there is a place in St. Louis like this. Gorgeous cakes and pastries. Women had their daughters there having tea. There is even a section to do cake tastings. I can see this as a regular Saturday adventure with girlfriends
name: Elisha

text:
This is a cute little coffee shop basically across from Clark park. It has a nice front area where you can sit outside and get work done. As far as the iced coffee; not super strong . The breakfast burritos are ok but they're premade and tiny. 

I also agree with the comments regarding some of the staff's attitude towards customers. Definitely not the warmest vibe which is honestly too bad because the place has potential!
name: Alyssa

text: I had a mashed potato turkey bowl. It was the best mashed potatoes, turkey, and gravy (with cranberry sauce) I've had since my mom used to make it! And that is five star high praise
name: Jeff

text: Great food, fabulous service, and the dumplings are to die for. Kitchen staff was very accommodating of my weird food allergies. Will definitely be back.
name: Alexa

text: Excellent food and service! One of my favorite places for breakfast!
name: Jacie

text: Came to Byrd and Barrel for lunch on the weekend and was thoroughly surprised. The menu is obviously based around chicken and I ordered the nugs. The portions were huge! You seriously won't eat all of them in one sitting. The nuggets were just okay, what they lacked in flavor was made up for by the dipping sauces they offer. Workers were friendly and even gave me a few free drink tickets. Did I mention they had beer and cocktails?
name: Briona

text:
Was really awesome to find a vegan place in Nashville. Food was really great, didn't need the hot sauce with my meal (which says a lot).

I'm coming back the next time I'm in town!

Note: I ordered the Breakfast Bowl with coffee (with their very creamy almond milk)
name: Sarai

text: Happened to be in the area. We eat mostly vegetarian so this grabbed our eye. We absolutely love this spot and will be back soon. We started with the super rolls.. ohmygod.. and the sauce! I could have sat there and ate those rolls all day. Everything was obviously fresh and incredible! We also ordered the grilled cheese with tomato basil, which was outstanding; as well as the veggie quesadilla, I really enjoyed this too, but it would have been nice if it had a little more texture. Something as simple as leaving the black beans whole. There were baked goods from scratch, fresh out on the counter, we had to order the brownies to go. One of the best brownies I've had. Not too thick or cakey.. just perfect. The staff was so nice and helpful. They clearly believe in their menu. Definitely try this spot!
name: Robin

text: The Hotel Zamora is the absolute greatest choice for a great vacation, staycation, or visit within 30min of Tampa or Clearwater airports.  The Zamora's location is magnificent as it offers the greatest sunset views from the 360° Rooftop in between both the Bay and the Gulf of Mexico with a bar on both sides after 3pm! The Hotel Zamora's employees are like the glue keeping the entire operation held together at higher standard.  The Hotel Zamora with The Castle Restaurant, the Rooftop 360°, and the Awesome pool with a Fabulous fully stocked bar, and docking station for visitors on boats, The Hotel Zamora is better equipped and capable, putting guests and visitors #1.
name: No

text: Holy Crepes has a stall in the French Market that makes regular and gluten free crepes with a nice selection of savory and sweet combinations, as well as a design your own crepe. Since I had already eaten some pralines the day before, I was looking for something I could eat while continuing to wander around the Quarter. I greatly appreciate that they take care to safely prepare the GF crepes and not have cross-contamination. This two person operation- one took the order and one makes the crepe. I ordered a Lisa Marie sweet crepes (peanut butter, Nutella, banana and added caramel. The crepes are then wrapped in a triangular paper container making it easy to walk for this take out joint. The crepes itself had a nice flavor and I can't complain about the innards since I picked them myself. As I walked it was a little messy but the crepes held up well to the last bite. Holy Crepes! with or without the exclamation point is worth a stop to partake in one of the French contributions to this great city.
name: Ron

text: Worse experience yet.. Came to Cheesecake Factory for Father's Day the service was terrible the host was incompetent or illiterate. After I complained to the manager she rudely brushed me off. To top it off food was burnt and order was wrong. I have came to this restaurant for the past 13 years and unfortunately won't be returning. Two thumbs down something has changed?
name: Lesane

text:
Always wish Tucson has a great Chinese restaurant. Finally I found Years last week! Great place and so many delicious foods!! 
If you need suggestions for ordering, don't hesitate to ask the staff~ they are all really nice and helpful!!'
name: Pan

text: Delicious!!! No meat- tator tots with Mac and cheese, ranch, scallions, and onions. Can't wait to go back and try more! A little pricey for vegetarian, but I'm used to it. Definitely tasted as good as I thought it would!
name: Meredith

text:
I have been to both locations. Both times I had Beignets (of course!) and they were delicious, fresh and warm...everything beignet dreams are made of.

The last time I was here I also had a muffaletta sandwich and the Satsuma Crush cocktail that was absolutely delicious. The muffaletta sandwich was perfect...I am an olive lover though...so throw olives on anything and I am happy. The meat, bread and cheese all tasted fresh. It was not extremely large and it was a nice lunch to have before a busy day walking and exploring. I added mustard (just personal preference). 

Both of the locations often have live music and it is so nice just hanging out and listening to the music snacking away. LOL. #goals right?
name: Randee

text:
Diceiving menu prices. Absolutely cheap trick to have customers !!!
Totally not worth at all to visit this place.
She just gave us a small piece of French fries, it was just the left overrs
name: Shilpa

text:
This Asian fusion noodle bar in center city has a lot of hype. I went with a friend for dinner on a chilly Saturday night. The restaurant is tiny so be prepared to wait. I had been dying to try the brisket ramen and it did not disappoint! As a soup lover I was thrilled to have a matzoh ball and kimchi in my ramen. The broth was good and the brisket was very tender. 


If I were to get Cheu again I would probably only get take out but I enjoyed their fun take on ramen!
name: Briana

text: If you love breakfast go to Surrey's! This place is further from the French Quarter it's closer to the garden district. Boy oh boy did we love this place! I had the shrimp and grits which were Delish with a capital D! I had a biscuit instead of the croutons it usually comes with and that was an awesome decision. My boyfriend had the blue crab omelet that you'll see a bunch of pictures of and he loved it! They told us that the bagels are made in house so he ordered an everything bagel and it did not disappoint. To end on a sweet note we spilt the bananas foster French toast.... do yourself the favor and order them!
name: Bianca

text: Kyle was awesome.  I called ahead and told him we wanted to watch the GS Warriors playoffs and he set us up with the projection screen and sound. He took care of us!!
name: S

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The wait felt longer than it should have. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Just not for me. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Food was tasty. Service was outstanding! Mattie took excellent care of our table.  He was a fantastic server and really funny.  I would recommend this location and Mattie as a server
name: Kc

text: It takes a lot for me to give a place such a bad review but this recent experience was bad enough to do just that. I understand when a server is busy and also when the kitchen is busy but what I cannot understand is a server completely forgeting your order and your appetizer. After 35 minutes we finally asked where our appetizer was and all of a sudden a 2 minute prep appetizer (edamame) was ready and cold. After an additional 15 minutes we finally got our food 50 minutes after having ordered it originally and the table next to us that had just sat down 15 minutes prior got there's right after us. I wouldn't be so bothered had our server been up front and told us she'd forgotten our food. To make it worse she only remembered 1 of my 2 Togo items making us have to wait an additional 18 minutes on top of what we had already waited. When I finally had enough and complained, the only thing I got for all of this was my forgotten item comped which cost a mere 8 dollars. Needless to say we will not be back.
name: Beth

text: Our family's favorite restaurant.  Consistent food quality, reasonable pricing and a great staff.  My personal favorite is the salmon with the aoli drizzle.  Warm and friendly atmosphere.  Brooke is awesome!
name: Howard

text: Yummy food, but small portions and high price. I got the pad thai with tofu and it was delicious but was really just not super filling. I went home and ate more and there wasn't that much tofu. The food did come out very fast and we had great service. My friends and I came out during a mardi gras parade and was happy to go into a place that wasn't very busy. It just wasn't really worth almost $18 for such a small meal, but nothing bad about the taste or anything else.
name: Tiffany

text: Oh how I love a good charbroiled oyster! My husband and I are always on the hunt for the best and desire is on the top of our list! There is something special about the garlic butter sauce they load them with that makes them melt in your mouth! We also had the gator, honestly best gator I've had in a LONG time! Gator can be tricky and get super chewy but not here. Perfectly cooked not chewy at all. Definitely a must stop every New Orleans visit!
name: Lauren

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Also, for the price i expected more than this. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated bc we didn't have a reservation. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. maybe I just came on an off day. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Best steak available- I go Dalessandros and then Mama's if your in the right frame of mind but, Dalessandros is the best.
name: Noah

text: Awesome environment! Everyone is so nice and the food is great! Love this place! Definitely would recommend!
name: Erin

text:
Booked a table for restaurant week, figured Ive been here before (years ago) and it was a nice experience, so why not go again.

We ordered the risotto and mushroom soup to start, filet and veal as the main course and dark chocolate, lemon parfait, and carrot cake to finish.
 
The food here was good with the exception of the starters, risotto being a bit too salty and the mushroom soup had a weird over powering taste that seem a bit sour. 

The main courses were executed very well, both the filet and veal were seasoned well and cooked to temperature. 

The desserts were hit or miss. The dark chocolate  was great, as was the carrot cake. However the lemon parfait left a bit more to be desired. It was creamy which it had best going for it, however the cherry tomatoes that were in it didn't quite fit well for me, maybe it works for others, who knows.

The service had its up and downs.
I expected the service at R2L to be very detailed based on how the restaurant was layed out and presented. The service was quick in the beginning and sluggish towards the end with lack of attention to detail. Our server (Taylor) left me with mix feelings, I wanted to say she was ok but at the same time, I felt like she had an attitude and didn't really want to be there. I mean our reservation was at 8:30pm on a Sunday, I didn't think that would be too late, especially during restaurant week. She recommended side orders such as the lobster Mac and cheese. She planted the idea of side orders in my head so I ordered regular Mac and cheese with fingerling potatoes. She forgot to put the orders in and when the main course were brought out, I thought the kitchen may have been behind so I would wait a bit for it. However I finished my main course and still no sides so I waited for her to come by and I asked. She apologized and I told her it's ok no worries. The desserts took forever to come out, and honestly it wasn't all that busy.  While waiting, I just sat there chatting it up with my girlfriend, drinking water, and what do ya know, we needed refills. Tons of employees walking by and not one noticed, it wasn't until I had to say something for a server assistant to refill our water. I'm not trying to be picky over water, but at a place like R2L, I would assume a certain level of attention to detail should be expected. Our server must've told the manager about forgetting the side orders, because he came over to check on us. He offers tea or coffee, we didn't want any extra beverages but appreciated the gesture. 

Overall, R2L was 3 stars at best. The food and ambiance were ok at best, service was a bit more to be desired.
name: Phi

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. You can tell they care about customer experience here. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it.
name: User

text: I pass this place up all the time going to work and finally had some time to check it out. This place is so cute. You are surrounded by cool artwork all over the walls. The dim lighting gives you sense of calmness. I loved that everything on the menu is freshly made and you can taste that when enjoying your meal. I got the spicy chicken sandwich. It was a play on a sloppy joe. If you are looking for a chili, smoked sandwich this is the way to go. Will be coming back to try their breakfast and cocktails.
name: Lindsey

text: A great place to eat and watch music when on Broadway in Nashville. Kid friendly. There are three floors, each with a different food theme. Floor one is traditional Nashville. Two is sushi. Not sure what is on 3. We ate on floor 1. I had the BBQ port sandwich and my son had BBQ ribs. Both real good. You order as you enter, then go find a table and they bring the food to you. Had a good band, fun location. I will go back.
name: Orphanthal

text: The Garden Table has an amazing atmosphere. They have music that is in the and a very modern set up. The tables were spaced out perfectly so you felt that you had privacy from others conversations but also felt like you where in a social place. The waiters and service was nice and attentive even though they were slightly busy when we came in. It was my first visit to this establishment and I ordered a cappuccino and their burrito du jur. While the prices are higher than most I paid around $20 for only my meal but I only ate half and took the rest to go so I believe I got my money's worth. I definitely wouldn't go here every day for kicks but if you're looking for a nice, fun place to treat yourself and a friend or even for a casual business meeting or brunch I would highly recommend.
name: Kristine

text: Count me in as a big fan.  Only been there once (so far) but will be going back.  Roll looked and tasted like Amoroso.  Very crisp on the outside and melt in your mouth inside.  Had tuna hoagie with the works.  Very fresh and tasty.  Ingredients well proportioned and balanced.  Plenty to eat.  Will definitely return.  Staff very friendly and accommodating.  Nice job, people.
name: Jake

text: Stopped in this place to wind down after watching the game at Raymond James. We felt right at home and absolutely loved this place. Great service & food! I would recommend this any day any time.
name: jenn

text: LOVE LOVE LOVE pizza. But not this pizza. It seriously is dessert pizza it's SO sweet. Just wrong. Sorry to all the candy sauce lovers... go somewhere else for real pizza and save this pizza for dessert...this is a big miss.
name: Chris

text: Last minute we decided to stop for lunch at this corky restaurant that offers a unique take on tacos. The restaurants interior has a cool beach vibe. The staff super friendly and attentive. The menu is cool tons of options and some unusual taco offerings. I opted for more traditional tacos and the kiddos enjoyed fish nuggets and a cheese quesadilla. The cocktails are strong . Overall for the price everything was great.
name: Rachel

text: Absolutely perfect. I love the service, and the food is even better. This place is family owned by wonderful people. The breakfast is really good, but I typically eat lunch here. I usually get the spicy chicken sandwich or the patty melt. The soup of the day is always good, they've got good coffee, and their orange juice is freshly squeezed.
name: Mikayla

text:
Pro tip: don't walk from bourbon street to city park. You'll understand in a minute.

Found this restaurant on google maps after visiting NOMA museum and on the verge of a major hangry meltdown. This was the only restaurant that was close enough to walk besides the cafe in the museum which didn't look too appealing. 

Walked in a bit after noon to a semi decent line and ordered the brisket sandwich (one with the caramelized onion) and the chicken salad sandwich with the rice+beans and brussel sprouts as our sides. 

The food came out fairly quickly and momentarily stopped all of my complaining. The brisket is one of the best briskets I've ever had. Granted, I'm from DC where the bbq is mediocre at best but still. It was tender juicy and melted in your mouth. Oh baby. That, a coke, and those brussel sprouts could solve A LOT of problems. 

Honestly, I'm so glad we found this place when we did cause we left nice and full.. and HAPPY.
name: Grace

text: Treat yourself and don't cheat yourself and get the Ribs! The rub they put on the ribs, they don't even need their amazing BBQ sauce on them! Add the ambience and atmosphere with the live music and it's a must stop when you're in Nashville! Steve the bartender is legit too!
name: Donta

text:
Pickles was located conveniently to a conference I was attending so I ran here for lunch one day.  I ordered the Genoa Salami ($7.49) with Swiss cheese on sourdough bread.  It was a simple order, but the food was good, and it even came with a pickle!  It's not a fancy lunch, but it is perfectly reasonable.

Service was a little rude when I went to pick up my food, but otherwise my experience was good.
name: Amanda

text: Dirty inside, slow service. The last few times we've gone , it's going down hill. Dirty floors/ walls , high staff turn over. Never crowded on the weekends. The only thing good on the menu is the open faced tamale with chicken. Margaritas are mediocre.
name: Katherine

text:
!!!Surprise!!! BBQ in a random warehouse!!!
This was even a shock to me when I yelped local eats and this locale came up. They had a huge menu, ample parking and reasonable prices. If you know me I am fully addicted to my 'Que, So I had my clipboard of approval here and it was not needed. 
The Quadruple platter was great! the sides were plentiful I almost didn't need to get more. for the most part $30 bucks is 4 proteins, 
(4) 4oz sides, and Corn bread. I was sharing some so it was plenty. I went with the briskets both sliced and Texas, as I am brisket girl. It was perfectly tasty. My sides were the Mac, Brussels, Spicy greens, and and some kind of beans I don't really remember anything beside the mac and cheese. Yes I am ALSO a mac and cheese girl. 

I have to say this was yet again one of those hole in the wall places that was a shock to me how good it actually was. But as they say "stop and take a look around" or you'd miss it. 

I'll be back with photos and soon. I can't wait.
name: Danielle

text:
So... We go for the all you can eat crab legs... Service was really bad! I was feeling bad for the waitress but her rudeness made that go away real quick! Walks by the table without even looking at us? Roll your eyes at us? Drinks needed and not helped.... We had to walk to the bar for water refills... 
Also... can the music be just a little lower? We couldn't even hear each other talking... It's Not a dance club.
Crab legs were good... wait was a little rough in the beginning but did get better... I also did like the Garlic option on the legs!
A shame... I really wanted to like this place. 
I will update this review if we decide to go back and get a better experience.
name: Frank

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was good and came out fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Great spot to take a small group of people for dinner In Broad Ripple. They take reservations and offer a full bar (cocktails, wine and beer) so everyone in your group can get their libation of choice. Louie's offers a great variety of appetizers, charcuterie boards and seasonal selections from the chef. If you like burgers, you need to order the Sinatra burger- you won't regret it. I've also had wonderful service from the wait staff as well. Everyone on staff is extremely knowledgeable of the menu and bar offerings. Make Louie's your next dinner date spot in Broad Ripple soon
name: Ali

text: Today I decided to try Masterpeace Grill for the first time. I ordered take-out, I ordered the buffalo wings hot and a grilled chicken Caesar salad. The wait time for the food was quick which was good and the cashier was nice. I was not impressed with the food unfortunately, esp. the salad, which consisted of romaine lettuce, tomatoes (which I asked them to add and they did at no additional charge), grilled chicken and Parmesan cheese which was the grated/powdery type from the container. The tomatoes were soggy and warm so I ended up removing those from the salad. The lettuce was fresh and crisp but the chicken was bland. I didn't end up enjoying or finishing the salad, sadly I was disappointed. The buffalo wings were ok, but not crispy, very sub-par. Maybe ordering other items on their menu would improve my view and give me a better experience, they are known for their cheesesteaks. Not sure if I would try this place again.
name: Shannon

text:
It's hard to find good Mexican food in the Northeast region. But this one is so worthy of the trip. I work in the Neshaminy area and was referred to this place by my boss. I was intrigued by their very affordable lunch specials . ( Seriously as low as $6 for a lunch meal?) 

I decided to order over the phone just in case it was crowded when I got there but to my surprise they were empty. I normally go to lunch around 1130 so the lunch crowd hadn't arrive yet. Since it was empty, I elected to dine in and enjoy the pretty ambiance. The restaurant is really nice, each table has different kind Mexican art and very colorful decor all around. 

The staff are really great and accomodating. I've gone there about 3-4 time and each time keeps me coming back. 

I've chosen the 2 flauta de pollo with rice and guac salad. At first it looked like it wouldn't fill me up but boy was i wrong. The chicken was seasoned to perfection, and the cheese was definitely a great addition. My favorite with the guacamole salad and the side of rice. My next favorite meal was the beef chimichanga ! The beef is AMAZING ! So much flavor ! I just love this place
name: Wender

text:
Spinach salad with grilled chicken added, was wonderful.

My waitress was Emily, a very personable young lady.

650 calories plus whatever the chicken was so I'm so glad she showed me that on the menu.

Made friends with a lady named Patricia and her children at the next table; that made my experience more like a diner experience than a sports bar experience, since I don't really feel comfortable in bars.
name: Michelle

text:
This is my 3rd time eating here and the quality and selection are always excellent. You can tell the staff enjoy working here as well.

It costs more than most Asian buffets in town but it's actually worth every penny.

Service was excellent as well and they are constantly keeping the place clean when there are no customers to help.

All in all it's worth a trip from the east side and no excuse not to make a weekly trip if on the northwest side.
name: Michael

text: Second time trying this spot.  The food quality is great, but the service, well, lets just say that from a person who worked in the food industry all through high school and college, I don't care how good the food is, if your service sucks, that's my limit.  I think the death knell of a restaurant is when they think they're so special, that the servers lecture you. On our first visit, we were warned by the server not to ask for the bacon to be done crispy because, I don't know, maybe the chef has some ego and thinks that everybody likes it fatty and limp.  We don't, so we asked for it crispy, to snap, and glad we did, it came out perfect. Hey, everybody likes it different.  Your bacon isn't some culinary invention that only you know how to serve.  Get over it.  Second visit, today, our server was a bit more aggressive. Maybe she was having a bad day.  Bacon did not come out well done and when we asked her to send it back to nuke it a bit, she looked at us like we had two heads.  It was all wrong from the get go because we asked to sub the bacon for the ham and asked for mixed green salad in place of the potatoes because on the first visit we noticed the table next to us do the same and it looked good.  She warned us, condescendingly that they don't like more than two substitutions so it might be a problem  - um, that was exactly two by our count.  Anyway, it doesn't really matter what the managers or owners think of our interpretation of the service - we own our own company and from our perspective of managing a team, if your service was bad enough to lead me to write a review, you've got an attitude problem with your team.  Won't be back because like I said, arrogant servers are the limit for us. Food mistake, I'll give you a pass, even several passes.  Make me feel like an imposition, bye Felicia.  Also won't be sending anyone here.  Scarlet Begonia owners/managers pay attention here - SB has too many choices, good choices for you to think this review doesn't matter.  We won't be back, but maybe you can salvage some other bad situations that are about to happen. God I'm glad I'm not in the restaurant business.  I don't want coupons, discounts, or a free meal and prefer no response if you're going to make excuses.
name: J

text: The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Definitely coming back. Food was good and came out fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: Coffee creme doughnut is more like a filled dossant, and I can't taste the coffee flavor in it. Nutella filled dossant is loaded one, very heavy. I am not a fan of the pastries here. I just don't like the dough. It's on the dry hard side.
name: Rae

text:
12 yr old It was awesome and I would go there again for sure.
I recommend you go because that was the best burger I have ever had. The service was the best and I recommend to ask for Kaitlyn because she very friendly and funny and engaging. Hope you can go there it blew my mind 5 Star

Me: really good +1 for Kaitlyn and enjoyed it.  Great charbroiled burger:)
name: J

text:
Came to a hot spot and found good and bad. 
The bad, the OJ is not freshly squeezed as advertised. 
Fruits were turning bad. 
However the Trifeca which is Eggs Benedict 3 ways was well worth it. However this is a plate for 2. 
I love spicy food which it stated in the menu that the Spanish omelette is, However it was not. Pass on that dish. 
Service was prompt.
name: Eli

text: Let me start with what I liked - the architecture of the building and the warmth of the decor (along with the many outstanding reviews) lured me in anticipation for a meal I wouldn't soon forget.  We ordered the Chef's tasting and put our fate in the hands of the owner.  Cocktails, though expensive were amazing and unfortunately were the best part of the meal.  Then the disappointment began.  The first course, though plenty was lazy.  Slices of  local in season vegetables cut and served without imagination.  A carrot served with a dollop of plain yogurt.  Ordinary pulled pork served in a thin radish tortilla. And finally turnips served with a dull pesto sauce kicked off this flavorless journey.  The second course, a goose egg served in shell with a bearnaise sauce and bread crumbs was again lacking flavor.  Then we were bright to the hearth room for the 3rd course.  Unfortunately the table by the fire was too uncomfortable due to the scalding flames from the open fire.  The falafel that was served with hummus, freshly baked naan and other sides was decent, but we were forced to return to our table after half eating before we were singed from the fire.  We then were served a $20 cheese plate which consisted of 1 slice of Brie-like cheese, chips and honey which was again unimaginative.  Finally, we had a cup of chocolate mousse for desert which was too little too late.  Overall, a $300 meal (more than I paid for the same chef tasting at Nobu) was a massive mistake.
name: Shawn

text: I thought this place would be bigger. It's pretty cool with a few places to do tastings and lots of different food options. My group tried out the taco place, the poke place and the pizza place. If we had to go back we would all just go to the taco place! Their tortillas are delicious!
name: Jane

text: it was fine, maybe a little overpriced. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It looked better online than it did in person. Anyway, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Honestly, everything was tasty and the place felt clean. idk I'd try something else next time.
name: User

text: I always have a good experience here. Service is always good and quick. The food is fresh and hot. Serving sizes are large and prices are competitive. Would recommend if you're in the area
name: Alesia

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: The staff is slow and you often have to repeat several times what you want. They give the skimpiest servings out of any chipotle I have ever visited and will charge you extra for what should be the full amount. They're always out of an ingredient and you'll be waiting 10 or more minutes for the Ingredient to come out. Save your money and walk a few extra blocks to 15th and walnut or liberty place.
name: Shekkita

text: First time to the restaurant. Very friendly and helpful staff with great service. Drinks from the bar were great and tasty. Hubby had fish and chip. Batter coating was way to thick. Chicken slider was good but wished the hot sauce wasn't so over bearing. Hard to taste the rest of the flavors. Wasn't terrible but unexpressed.  Would try again for sure.
name: Shari

text:
Cubaneo has just opened a few days ago and every time I drove by the place looked popping. So I came by last night to grab a bite. I don't remember when was the last time that I got a decent meal and a good cocktail after midnight in Santa Barbara. So heck yes I love the place.

They open from 4pm til 1am, also have late night menu serving from 10pm til 1am. You order food from Cubaneo and drinks from Shaker Mill. There are two separate counters. There was no hostess so I was a little confused at first but it's not hard to figure out. 

We ordered the Medianoche sandwich, a side of mama's beans and rice, and a pina colada. The sandwich was delicious, soft, melted in your mouth. I like the soft sweet brioche bread very much. The rice and beans were really good also, came with generous portions. They tasted so good with their homemade hot sauce and garlic sauce. We brought some hot sauce togo in the end. 

We also tried the Ropa Nueva - braised beef short ribs and Plato Mixto with marinated chicken and shrimps. They were all amazing. You got beans, rice, protein, fried plantains and yucca, and a side of salad. That is an ideal meal right there for me. 

The place overall looks great, with tropical vibe decorations. There is some remodeling in the back, maybe another business soon will come later. I see a lot of potential in Cubaneo and Shaker Mill and so glad to see they are doing great in this location since it had been left empty for a while. 

I will return and bring my friends here to try out the rest of their menu.
name: Lola

text: We absolutely loved our dinner! We were visiting from California because my father is being treated at Moffitt Cancer Center. Their lentil soup was so comforting and delicious. They had the best baklava and tiramisu we've ever had, hands down. The waitress recommended kunafa ... a dessert we'd never tried. Wow! Out of this world.
name: Christine

text: I had one of my favorite meals in Nashville here. Delicious food. If you are out with friends get a full bird. The bone in chicken made me smack my mama. She didn't appreciate that. Sides were great too. Would go again and would recommend.
name: Wes

text:
We love this place, but I'm a little concerned....  
I can't think of something even remotely negative about the food here.  Everything was delicious.  I don't like tomatoes, and cumbers are boring, but Marhaba even made those vegetables taste good.  

My biggest concern though, is their gyro.  It's too freaking good to be true.  A light crisp on the outside, tender on the inside, so delicious I could eat it every day.  I'm really worried they're harvesting unicorns or griffons or fairies, or all of the above, to make their gyros.  Although the food is outstanding, they may be dealing with mythological forces beyond their control and understanding.  I just hope they know what they're doing, and don't accidentally rip some hole into another dimension, ultimately bringing harm to their restaurant. They seem like really nice people.



Seriously though; the gyros are amazing, and all the food is flavorful and delicious.  The staff has always been friendly and extremely accommodating.  And it's a BYOB.  You can't go wrong here people. Don't wait to go there this weekend.  Go there now!
name: Matthew

text: Came today about 11:45. Waited for a seat although there were more than 5 open tables. Finally sat down to a table where we had to ask for glasses for our water, had to ask for silverware and napkins, plates were delivered with sub par food on hot plates that must have been sitting under the heating lights. So disappointed. I will never be there again.
name: Melissa

text: I ordered the meatball parm which is served on a sesame seed bun with hand cut fries. The bag with my order seemed to weigh about 6 pounds which makes me happy lol. The sandwich comes with 4 meatballs, well seasoned, a little too salty for my taste but then again I never add salt to my food so I may be sensitive. The sandwich was a solid four star!!! I deduct a star for ambiance, and seating accommodations but i would definitely go back for more great sandwiches.
name: Levon

text: Unusual that all dishes ordered by all group members were somewhere between fantastic and memorably delish.  Vegetarian sushi appetizer through the burger were just that.
name: Seth

text: I was surprised by this hidden gem. It's tucked away in a secondary strip mall you aren't likely to find unless you are looking for it. I ordered the chicken katsu app and was surprised that they got it right. At most places you get something along the lines of a flattened chicken tender. This chicken katsu was properly breaded and cooked. The crust was crunchy and had great texture. The chicken was still moist too, a huge problem with a lot of other alleged katsu. On to the main course. The sushi fish was fresh, very fresh. The texture and flavor was also quite nice too. The portions sizes were good and designed to highlight the quality of the fish. I got a spider roll and the deep fried crab was very nicely fried and had great texture. The service was pretty good too. This place is BOYB.
name: Paul

text: Overpriced and unimpressive.  Went there two weeks ago, found it not authentic and plain.
name: A

text:
I've been coming here for over 5 years, while my wife was pregnant with our 5 year old. Part of its charm is the Mom and Pop feel - they're always friendly and even play around with my son, who loves their fried wonton chips! It also helps that we fill our bellies with Thai Teas for under $50. (They also have boba!)

The food has been a little inconsistent at times in preparation and wok time but overall it's been solid over the years. It was probably the best on his last visit. They have so many options including Chinese, Thai, and Vietnamese stir frys and soups. Everything tastes fresh and handmade, including their delicious sweet and sour sauce. 

The interior could use some love but I'm fine with it if that means they'll raise their very affordable prices.
name: Nathan

text:
I read a bunch of reviews of Tànsuŏ before dinner and thought to myself...hmmm sounds like a lot of high expectations, colorful paper lanterns, pretty candles, dim lighting and disappointment, I hope we made the right choice for our precious cheat meal night(full disclosure I've been eating no-carb for 3 weeks, not one bone in my body went into this looking for a healthy meal:)
Our server asked about food allergies and knowledgeably discussed various menu items and their ingredients right down to the oyster sauce(for my dining companion with a shellfish allergy)
I pre-ordered the duck when I made the reservation(24hrs ahead). It was worth it. We ordered Lamb dumplings to start, they were my least favorite item if I had to pick one but hardly a disappointment. Thin almost translucent dumpling wrappers, savory lamb, the seasoned soy sauce was surprisingly the star and we ordered more for later! They present the duck to the table for our approval before carving, reminiscent of Chinatown Peking Duck house from my previous life growing up in NY. A nice authentic touch. We also ordered Shanghai Belly fried rice, that alone will keep me coming back. Everything's family-style and with four of us, this was the first to go. The Duck was as good as it gets, served on crispy scallion pancakes, sliced and shredded with all the traditional sides. I don't have a single picture of the food if that tells you how good the meal was and the presentation was photo worthy. We went expecting good family-style Chinese with an upscale twist and a price tag to match and that's what we got...in a cozy, dimly lit booth with a glowing lotus flower, delivered by our attentive but not too hover'y servers, was an epic cheat meal that will be hard to top... but I'm taking suggestions:)
name: Penny

text:
We originally wanted to go to One Shot Cafe the day we came here but we were not disappointed at all.

The decor and atmosphere is great! Really comforting, especially when coming in from the cold outside. As soon as you step in, you're greeted by a large lobby and bar that serves tea, coffee, and smoothies. We got teas while we waited which were fitting for the cold weather (green jade blossom).

When being seated, the area is quite small but packed. There's a homey feel to it as everyone is happy and talking away with their friends/family.

We ordered the turkey burger and all natural burger since we craved lunch food instead of breakfast food. 

You'd think that the burgers are just burgers but honestly, they were one of the best burgers I've had.

The turkey burger tasted nothing like turkey since it was so moist. I'd say it was more of a turkey patty with the texture of a breakfast sausage. Nice and spongy but without the grease! With the avocado and plentiful fries, it made a nice pairing that left you full but not sluggish (you know, the feeling after having a greasy meal).

The all natural burger was the no frills all american burger that came with bacon. I ordered it in a medium rare and it was cooked to perfection. This resulted in a nice and juicy patty that sent me to heaven whenever I took a bite. Beware though, it was extremely messy and I found my hands covered in grease/juice that made me wish I picked something else (but that's just me!). Regardless, it was an amazing burger and I'd go back just to order 2 or 3 more. 

I mentioned the fries briefly but I didn't mention they tied up the meal. Some fries are sad and soggy. Some are crunchy and stiff. These fries were right in the middle. This led to a nice soft interior but extremely crunchy exterior that created a party in your mouth whenever you had them after a bite of your burger.

Obviously, we could have gotten something different but it was 2pm by the time we got there and we were so hungry that we picked basically anything that we immediately saw.

That seemed odd to see that with the hostess and two servers. With two of the individuals I ask them questions about working for Ruth's Chris and how they enjoyed it. Their answers we're good answers, they spoke of benefits and opportunities for growth, but when I ask them about the meat market with you you need demographics of their current location, they seem oblivious to customers. Even when I looked around the restaurant and the bar and I pointed out the very narrow demographics of the over 60 year old age group that was there the you youngish servers insisted that it was normally many very young people in their 30s. The impossible burger was not my favourite but it was a good choice. I found the sliders were so delicious and a cute size. 2 were perfect for me. I'd highly recommend checking them out for their vegan options. Also this location is clean, efficient and has great service too.

text:
The.Best.Sushi.In.Town.

Chef is clearly in a league of his own here.  It's just an entirely different level of sushi.  Forget the places with 3 pages of rolls that just recycle the same ingredients into 78 permutations.  Nippon Tei has 19 perfectly balanced rolls that carefully present quality flavors.  You can taste the care that went into designing each roll and continues through every plate that leaves the kitchen.

So everything here is great, that is the fact.  Now just my opinion....  the lobster roll is wonderful but SO IS EVERYTHING ELSE THAT WAS HALF THE PRICE.  So you can come here on a budget and buy the $10 rolls and know you didn't miss out on anything.  For example, the Kani Maki and Ebi Maki were just perfection.

Again, this sushi blows everything else out of the water.  May I suggest updating the cocktail menu as well?

Loved Barcelona Wine Bar!!! Got here late about 10:45 pm, after picking up a friend from the airport. Wanted to stop and grab a quick bite and a glass of wine. Everything else nearby was closed, but there was still a small crowd here. We asked if they were still serving food and they cheerfully said yes. 

Our waitress came out, made some suggestions, took our order, and grab us our drinks. She was very friendly and kind as we could tell they were winding down, but she insisted that we didn't rush. 

Soon after we got our food Dan (Manager) came out and was a delight to talk to. He too told us to take our time and enjoy our food and drinks. He shared some great info about this location and other locations  They have. 

We had an amazing time! The food, the drinks, the service, the ambiance, the vibe were ALL Fabulous!!! I couldn't recommend this place highly enough. If you're anywhere nearby, you've got to check out Barcelona Wine Bar!!!

text:
Asian Sofrito needs to get its act together if it hopes to stay in business.  

We decided to give this new restaurant a try this afternoon.  We decided to go for a late lunch; figuring that the lunch rush would be done.  

We arrived to a chaotic scene.  One person behind the counter trying to take order with a computer system she clearly didn't understand.  Order was placed and the wait began.   60 minutes later our food was delivered to our table.  It was served only after we went up to the counter to ask if the food sitting waiting to be delivered was ours (it has been sitting on the counter for close to ten minutes)   Everything is served in Styrofoam containers; all utensils are plastic (very cheap plastic) and drinks in styrofoam cups.   

The food was simply OK with the exception of the egg foo young, which was good. 

Tables were not cleaned between diners and the overall vibe of the place is that they were simply overwhelmed and not quite sure how to run a restaurant.    We won't be going back anytime soon,

This is a higher end coffee house in a nice little town and they have recently begun locking their bathroom and making you get a key from the counter. I find this to be completely unacceptable in a place that sells $3 coffee and $9 avocado toast. I did mention to the girl running the counter that this change was distasteful and I would appreciate if she would let management know a customer complained about it, and she tried to engage me in argument telling me that "lots of places do it." Signage and calendars in the place are also out of date, advertising events already past. I'm am honestly hoping the owners are on vacation or something because I would really love to be able to come on and modify this review, because I really did like the place but seriously.
