name: Timothy

text: This isn't the first time I pulled up to the drive through (after waiting in a long line) and nobody talked on the speaker. I waited almost half hour last night and then could not even order my food. I left, came back, and the same thing happened. People were blaring their horns and everything. Get your sh*t together. Then you hear these establishments want $15/hr !!LMFAO. If reheating frozen food and dropping things in a fryer is too complex for you maybe find a new job.
name: Kaitlin

text: Jeeezzzz-is this place as much of a dive as the Meet Rack?  Tucson certainly isn't boring.  I can't wait to move here for good next month!
name: Tim

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Idk, everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text:
Thankfully I live within walking distance. This is one of my favorite restaurants in town. Their stuffed grape leaves are perfect. The hummus is so good I have literally licked the plate. And everything from the salads and appetizers to the dessert is fresh and tasty.

Service is almost always speedy. I always sit outside- even though they're on a somewhat busy street they've put up planters so you are kind of shielded from it.

Plus. The bill come with Jordan Almonds. How could you not love it??
name: Kristen

text:
Just had my second visit here & it was just as amazing as the first! My favorite is the grouper cheeks...yummmm;)
Great, fresh food-love the atmosphere-& the people working there are great.
Highly recommend.
name: Callie

text: I tried the Smokehouse Burger (a change for once from my usual order of the Philly cheesesteak) and it was a-ma-zing. It had a very flavorful smoky bbq taste and a bit of a crunchy texture from the tempeh bacon I believe. Super enjoyable and reminds me of a regular bacon cheeseburger! I had to take away one star though, just wish I got more for the price of $11 :(
name: Vicky

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. For a busy night they handled it okay. A couple small things kept adding up. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Wouldn't really choose this place again. It looked better online than it did in person. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
I have been here a few times and love the atmosphere. Everything is very fresh and it is just fun to go inside, walk around, and see all that they have to offer. 
They have a large selection of baked goods that always smell amazing! 
Their selection of fresh pasta is ample and I've had the spinach and cheese ravioli. The dough was so fresh and it was tasty. 
They have a fresh coffee section. I am not a coffee drinker but my boss loves this coffee so I go to pick some up for her. 
They have a wine and cheese room, along with a neat counter and a produce section. This would be a fun place to go shopping for a date night-get some fresh Italian food to whip up at home!
name: Lauren

text: I like the brunch service here but tbh it's really my fav spot for Mojitos and there's no wonder why. They are a certified Rum Bar and can hook up your mojito any which way you wannit! I'll have to expand more on this review after I finally get dinner here just once!
name: T.

text:
expensive af and pls don't order the crab rangoon lol so bad. 

ps
Monday bartender is dope tho i can't lie....or speak for any other night cause i've only been here for Monday's
name: Sarah

text:
My wife and I have visited the Texas Roadhouse on many occasions and have never been disappointed with the quality of food.

I usually order the Dallas Filet and I have always marvelled at how perfect it is.

The last time we ate at the Irvington Road, Tucson location and my wife had the prime rib and I  I opted for the steak tips. Perfect!

One drawback is the noise level.  I have no idea why loudness is attractive...
name: Brad

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The music was louder than it needed to be. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text:
Where are these 5 star reviews coming from??? The food was absolutely horrible.  Salmon & Shrimp, completely overcooked.  Bad sauce with the crabmeat ravioli, and canned crab for the crabcakes.

One of the worst dining experiences i've had recently in Bucks.
name: Harry

text: It's extremely hard to find burritos that are made with fresh ingredients, where the meats are grilled and put in right before you eat them. Another nice thing about this place is they put a neet twist on one of their burritos it is called a Mediterranean it has feta cheese cilantro hummus tabouli  green peppers and balsamic vinegar don't miss trying this one if you are in Kennett Square
name: David

text: They have good shakes, but I was outraged that they upcharged me .50 cents for whip cream on top. This would be like Starbucks charging .50 cents extra for cream with your coffee. Go to Friendly's next door for a better shake that costs less. Crazy price gouging!
name: William

text:
i had high expectations of suraya, and i'm happy to report that they were met. we were able to find a reservation on short notice, and were seating within ten minutes of arriving. the ambiance is lovely, with dim lighting and sections that look like tents in the desert. 

the menu was divided into small plates & larger plates to share. we got the fattouch salad, crispy potatoes, and the fatteh. everything was delicious, but the fatteh provided a flavor profile unlike anything i've tried before. it. was. delicious. 

we also had two different kinds of lamb, and topped off the evening with espresso. the bill came out to about $100--not bad for a celebratory dinner at a brand new restaurant. the service was great--attentive, but not *too* attentive. i'm a big fan of suraya, and i'll definitely return!
name: Fae

text: These donuts were so good. Definitely the best Ive ever had. Quality, fresh, amazing donuts. And the people working there are so nice. Also, they had water out with little cups. 100% recommend!!
name: Maddy

text: So so so delicious. Warm juicy burgers, amazing salty crispy fries. Best food I've had out in a while.
name: Jessica

text: This was the best sandwich and soup place ever! Matt and Will made each sandwich with love, and the customer service was the best! The food was delicious!!!
name: Janessa

text: Not your average Asian food.  Everything we have tried has been super.  The menu is extensive and includes a good variety of seasonings.  my only wish is for more vegetable dishes that don't include any meat or seafood.  The prices are good and the service was excellent.  The new management seems to have added to the menu in a good way.  I think it's a lot cleaner and brighter too.  Great place!  Try the mango and chicken dish.  Sweet and yummy.
name: Karen

text: Highly disappointed.!  My other 3 family members didn't want to eat here after a show a Walnut Street Theater but I convinced them based on the good reviews and seemingly good atmosphere. Of course they were crowded but it's a Sunday morning and they are a restaurant at 8th and Walnut- one would think they would be prepared for a busy brunch. We got a table right away but waited 10 minutes for a server to take our drink order and then another 15 minutes for 2 coffees and 2 OJ's. Finally our food came after what seemed like forever.  We had to ask for utensils, butter, syrup, water and napkins. The food was mediocre at best but it's the overall wait and experience that had us feeling like they stole $50 from us. Seems like a management issue ( not enough servers, not overseeing the dining room). Next time we'll skip it and go to Starbucks or Knead.
name: Kimberly

text: It's nice upstairs on the balcony. Had shrimp and and a boat load of crawfish both were good. Our waiter was nice service was average. Probably would have been 3 stars but the balcony on a nice day was great..
name: Dave

text: Same cut/paste answer from management I see on other negative reviews.  Don't bother, much better places in this lovely city to spend time and money with much better food.
name: Jeff

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Pretty happy with it overall. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
Authentic food and real tasty. Service is good and people are very pleasant.

Not a fan of the order your own at the counter concept but the rest was OK.

Parking lot is tight and a mess. I saw a few accidents happen in the short time that I was there.
name: Hiran

text: BBQ Brisket was okay, not the beat i've tasted.  Just meat with sauce.  Fried pickles were great!  Sliced covered with batter.  Crispy anf hot.  I'm not a bug fan of country music so i was getting sleepy while we were listening to the band that was playing that evening.  Typical bar food is served.  Fast service!
name: Christina

text: Damn good whisky sours, stick with the classic. Gogo dancers, good atmosphere, and disco. Favorite place to stop in Philly.
name: Megan

text:
This place is straight out of the 40's or 50's but their prices are clearly in the 21st century.

My short stack of pancakes were served hot and fresh on less than pristinely clean plate.   I am a firm believer that all good pancakes should be served with warm whipped butter and real maple syrup.  

Sadly my short stack came with two tiny little pieces of butter that were almost frozen solid and two plastic containers of artificial syrup.

Good pancakes should be served with good quality syrup and whipped butter. Bottom line this place is too expensive for the what they are serving.
name: Marc

text:
3/5 it's fine

i normally go to the other place (cough, cough), but decided to try this spot one saturday. it wasn't too busy for a late lunch, and the service was really attentive. so that's good.

the food wasn't too flavorful, though. i got the bento box that came with soup and salad, which both were oddly bland. normally i find miso too salty, but this didn't really have much flavor, kinda watered-down-ish. the tempura sampler wasn't too great either - you get 2 pieces of shrimp or chicken and then cuts of sad veggies. the tempura was really thick and wasn't that appetizing. the shrimp sorta had a weird taste, and so did the imitation snow crab meat. the rest of the bento box was fine.

so yeah, there's that other place.
name: Alvin

text:
Omg the best Korean food so far. I had a tofu stew and I was so stuffed had to take more than half home. 
I shall be back for more !!
name: Ol

text: I live in a delivery dead zone is lakeview and this is one of the few places that delivers to me. The food is great and the delivery was fast. Highly recommend.
name: Kathleen

text: Great food at reasonable prices. People there could not be nicer. My favorite dish is vegetable chow main.
name: Mike

text:
If you are reading these reviews then you are probably wondering if you should go.  You should go! The food was wonderfully prepared from the appetizers to dessert .  I haven't had better calamari since the Greek Festival 2002.  The six of us each sampled bites from our six unique orders and there was not a bad meal among us.

Now for the BUT.   This restaurant didn't get a 5 star rating because of the very sensitive customers that had 530PM Saturday reservations.  Let's just say they were older...a lot older and we are pretty old ourselves.   Because the room is so small a packed room is usually loud there .   To have any kind of fun conversation you do have to raise your own volume level. Also when you are at a table with 3 attractive cougars and their lucky husbands most likely the conversation gets pretty fun.  No cursing, no crude jokes but at a higher volume .  Well the patrons at this establishment shhhhh! us several times and yelled at us on their way out. Really,  your conversation is so boring that all you could do his ear silent and listen to us.

We wouldn't have held the star because of the over sensitive gray head crowd but the waiter crew , chef and owner were indifferent at best to our situation.  Our waiter was grumpy and claimed he lost his voice from an old cold but really from the start only slightly acknowledged and engaged in any kind of meaningful or helpful conversation.  Our total bill was reasonable at $220 so we left grumpy pants $300.  He did not thank us for coming or smile .   It was not because of all the noise complaints either because he was a grumpy pants before the girls got a little loud.  

I recommend but if you are noise sensitive please stay home .
name: Stephen

text: We came here after our son's small wedding on Butterfly Beach in Montecito for a celebration lunch (not a reception).  Our party of 9 was seated in their private room as soon as the restaurant opened at 11:30. Our server Jonathan was very attentive and helpful.  Everybody liked what they ordered, which ranged from New England clam chowder, lobster ravioli, fish and chips, fish tacos, lobster roll, to cioppino and more.  I took a point away (really should be less than a point) because the tortilla for my daughter's fish taco fell apart and so did the roll for my son's lobster roll.  The general manager came in to say hello and make sure we were being cared for, which was nice, but popped in a second time, which we thought was being a bit intrusive.  The sourdough rolls were delicious and abundant. The price was reasonable.  They brought plates, forks and serving tools for the wedding cake that my daughter made.  A perfect ending to a perfect occasion.
name: Diana

text:
My go to spot for coffee whenever I land here and even if the line is long it moves pretty fast!!! So do not let it deter you.  The staff works hard to ensure the line is moving quickly because they understand that time is of the essence. 

The coffee is always consistent and the pastries are always fresh and delightful!! They have a wife variety of eats along with drip, draft and espresso coffee drinks.

The Apple Crumb Tart was a good choice.  The crust was strong enough to hold the filling to the point that when you bite into it, you don't have to worry about it falling apart!! Not to mention it was delicious. 

Prices are aligned with the fact that they are in the airport. Coffee is extra hot so ask for a double cup!
name: Keisha

text:
We were driving around and decided to stop by TGIF's impromptu. Candice was very welcoming and nice 
. She took great care of us. She listened closely to our needs and made great suggestions. We were there for awhile and she didn't rush us. What a pleasant experience. The restaurant was pretty clean and organized.
name: Natasha

text: Came in for a quick brunch while in Jackson Square. The service was great! We were seated immediately and the food came out pretty quick. We got the Seafood Breakfast Platter and the Omelette Sandwich. The food was good but nothing super special or unique.  It was a good place for a quick bite.
name: Erica

text: It's been a few years...so glad to be back at Luke. Thank you all for taking care of us...Front of House all the way to the Back. Thank you Richie R. and Gary for taking such great care!
name: Beth

text: This place has the best tacos in California! And the prices are amazing as well! I also go with the steak tacos but I'm sure the rest are just as amazing! I was on a road trip up the coast and I just had to come back when I was coming back so the coast. If you're in the area this place is a needs to be on you're list of places to stop by! I just can't say enough about how good this place is!
name: Tom

text: Not good. A very low budget feel. I did like the 7 oz filet very good. The creamed spinach was horrible 80% creamy stuff 20% spinach really inedible. The tuna appetizer was very tasty and deviled eggs. There's a reason the martinis are 3.00 until 7 it's all juice. Do yourself a favor and order the traditional Martini or something else altogether. The place just smells like all of ybor unfortunately. One restroom for men and women to share -yuck. Waiter was good but the other servers are just not very skilled. They should be congratulated for working but need some good training . Overall would never go back or recommend.
name: Karen

text: I came here to buy some cupcakes for a friend's birthday. They were a huge hit! Great cupcakes and a super friendly staff.
name: Haleigh

text:
A really well-conceived place. Somebody below complained about the "small" menu, but I like that - doing well with a menu not as expansive as other places. The matzo ball soup was assertive in flavor, I'm going back next week to have it. Lots of onion, which I love, and dark roasting of the chicken bones.
I love the rye bread too.
when you order the malted shake (which someone below said was ridiculously small) it really doesn't seem too small. I actually commented to the server that the shake first seemed too small, but was pretty satisfying...really rich.
name: pamela

text: Lovely restaurant, excellent cuisine and competent service.  Owner leaves alot to be desired, however.
name: Linda

text: Wouldn't recommend this unless you're trying to waste money. The quality and service has declined drastically since they first opened. The food truck doesn't even accept card only cash app, super unprofessional. They run the 2 for $40 special and you only 1 crab cluster in that, not a deal. Juicy Crab and seafood kingz run way better deals, I figured I'd support a black owned business since I hadn't been a patron in a while, I regret wasting my time honestly. Believe the low rated reviews as it is the truth. I waited for 1.5 hours for my meal and was shorted sides once before at this same restaurant , people make it hard for you to support their business.
name: Kami

text: I enjoy subway sandwiches and I always get a BMT - this is the first time eating at this location and the sandwich made me very ill - I would suggest a visit from the health department likely something was spoiled on my sandwich
name: A

text: Good food. New leaf fried rice was good. Service was quick. Mango Smoothie was a little bland. Overall good experience.
name: Sahithi

text: Soooo where do I start. You get Amazing Fried Chicken & Fish with Cajun style sides not to mention hot fresh biscuits. While your getting great food and decide you want a drink there is a Full Margarita Bar with a variety of flavors. I HAVE NEVER SEEN Chicken and Margaritas at the same counter! This MUST BE a NOLA thing!! The food was beyond good and the owner must have OCD because the public restrooms have a code from your receipt that you must utilize to accessthe rest room! Never seen that either but I appreciate a clean public bathroom. So I really had to go.... had to use the men's and it was SUPER CLEAN that was a first!
name: Willa

text: Some good ole southern BBQ and sides. The atmosphere feels like an old cafeteria type of setting. Recommend for some good bbq
name: Cecilia

text:
We have eaten here countless times and were always very pleased. A bit pricey, but the taste and service seemed worth it.
Last month we ordered our usual two cubans without mayonnaise. They had a special of chicken gizzards that looked tasty. We left for the car show and found our cubans FULL of mayonnaise and the gizzards had human hairs in them.i called and was told next meal was on them. 
Today i called to get the comp sandwiches and was told it was buy one get one.
NEVER AGAIN will they get a dime of my money! 
CHECK your food for hairs...   Seems the hairs are FREE of charge!
name: Steve

text: We would have liked to be closer to Santa Barbara and probably should have stayed at the Four Seasons.  The Ritz had beautiful grounds but really needs an overhaul.  Lots of maintenance issues that really needed attention.  -- Our room decor was out-dated and not the cleanest.  It was obvious that there was no attention to detail as many items were out of place and not presented when we arrived.  This definitely lacks the Ritz-Carlton charisma we've grown to enjoy.--- on a better note, the front desk, valet and bellman were just wonderful.
name: Bonnie

text: We loved The Mockingbird. It has a great old school diner vibe and the food was delicious. I got the chicken pot pie, it was delicious. Drinks were also very, very good. I highly recommend the punch!
name: Haley

text: This place used to be a favorite of mine. When it first opened I never went here without wanting to give it a 5/5 for the quality of the food, but in the last few months it's gone downhill. The desserts have become heavy and artificial-tasting, and the main dishes have less flavor overall. I don't know if they had a turnover in the kitchen staff or if the ones they have are experiencing burnout, but my last two dining experiences here have been severely lacking. I will say that despite that, the service continues to be excellent and the waitstaff is charming and attentive.
name: Anna

text:
Service was excellent at the bar, for 8pm on Thursday the place was lively & had a good atmosphere. The carrot hummus was delicious. Definitely recommend. The couple next to me really enjoyed their shoshito peppers too. My drink 'organized chaos' was good if you like dry vermouth - it can be hit or miss for me sometimes. I'll definitely try another cocktail next time.

The filet left much to be desired. You really don't need chunks of an herb blend on top of a good steak. The meat wasn't as tender as I'm use to either. After scraping it off I'd give the steak a 3/5.  I'll be back to try one of their menu when I'm in town again for sure. I especially appreciate the gentleman in the glasses at the bar (forgot his name, ugh). He was awesome.
name: Rachel

text:
I joined a former co-worker for lunch at Casa Juarez to catch up on things.  We have been going to Chihuahua for several years but I noticed that Yelp said it was closed.  I called and someone at Casa Juarez answered the Chihuahua number.  The folks at Chihuahua have moved to a refurbished restaurant a block or two west of where they were.  The new place is clean and nicely furnished.  They have new menus, obviously since they have a new name.

R ordered grilled the Michoacan platter with chicken with chorizo and cheese which he used to have at the old place.  It appears to be still a good choice.  I always ordered carnitas or huevos con chorizo, but this time I just had huevos rancheros with salsa verde.  Both meals were fine.  I will need more visits to decide if they have kept the same food.  I always liked their carnitas and huevos dishes.

I miss that they are no longer an AAdvantage Miles participant.
name: Jon

text: King State was recommended by a friend for the pastries. Specifically the sticky buns. The sticky bun was everything the recommendation said it was! Warmed perfectly with crispy edges. Goes great with coffee so you definitely wanna add that to the mix The parking wasn't great. They were super busy! A good problem to have. I had to park in handicapped space to run in for my order. There was also a long wait to have my pastry warmed but it was worth it. Enjoy!
name: Tish

text: Chop 40 is only three miles from us here in Sierra Canyon.  We've eaten here many times, and almost always get the pizza.  Pizza is very well done.  He has a nice list of local and CA beers, and the house wine is reasonable.  However, the place does seem to have big turnover in staff, except for Kris behind the bar, and she is priceless.  Last visit, friends had tri-tip and it was dry.  Consider ourself warned.
name: Patrick

text: First impressions are EVERYTHING in a small place. I came in at 6:45 (dinner time....) and the waitress was outside on a bench. I walked up having never been here and she asked "are you placing a takeout order?" I said no, but that I could if needed. If I hadn't been in my tractor-trailer and hungry, I probably would have just left. (She apparently wasn't feeling well...but if that's the case, should she be there?) The pizza came out quick, hot, and fresh, so I can't complain about that. Portions are good and toppings are generous. In my opinion, the food is worth the price, which upped my rating to 4 stars instead of 3. I also love that they do NOT allow foul language or cursing, so it's family-friendly!
name: Bethany

text:
I really enjoy the food at Fat Dan's and I love that we have one in Carmel now! But, my husband and I went to the new location and we had a hard time getting there attention of the staff. It was not very busy and there were plenty of people working so that was unfortunate it. 

Our waitress was super sweet but I had a few problems with my order and I couldn't get her attention again after she dropped off our food. 


BUT! The food is great, love the Cuban, the tots, the meatballs, love that they have a pizza option with the old Crust pizza oven. 

I look forward to coming back and updating my review :) thanks for coming to Carmel Fat Dan!
name: Lauren

text:
Recently decided to come in during happy hour with the kids. I got a Burrata salad and husband got a lasagna. I will say this was the worst lasagna ever. The meat in between the pasta looked like a dried brown sponge and there was a aftertaste.  When my husband didn't finish the dish completely I took a bite to taste it since I always get a "take home free lasagna offer "in the email. I asked him if he to thought the lasagna tasted off and he answered yes, but he was hungry and ate it. (He isn't one to complain to anyone and would just say we aren't going back to a place) haven't been to a Carrabba's in years and remember loving it when I was in my teens. The food has really taken a tumble and s

Service was fair. But the lady had to keep asking what are drinks were.
name: Michele

text:
I've been here quite a few times. Honestly, the place is nice, the workers are good, but the food, is a hit or miss. 

The food is either fresher than fresh and taste amazing, or a bit old, overfried/cooked and just taste bland.
name: Sal

text: Heard about this place through an Uber driver. The food was great, service was not the best but you could tell the server was trying her hardest. She didn't seem to know much about drinks, I asked for a drink menu and she had asked what I was looking for. It's hard to know when I don't have a menu to go off of. But other than that this place was very good, food came out fast and hot!
name: Analysa

text: This place is phenomenal! Our waiter was perfect. Food was amazing and the drinks were delish. On top of this the prices were not over the top either! Highly recommend Frenchys thank you for the great experience! Also, the hostess was very sweet and personable. Just great over all!
name: Kim

text: I love the sushi here.... The Playboy and Miami is the best.... It's like going to cheers on TV when I get there they know my name
name: Ethan

text: Great King Cake, awful shipping, awful shipping prices, awful customer service. Ordered, called, confirmed, still missed the delivery date. Called, "we'll get right back to you," still waiting a week + later.
name: Rich

text: Had dinner at this place first night in St. Pete. Great food and service. Will definitely come back.
name: Tanya

text: Are there with the family today and had the Bucket for 2 with old bay. The food was very fresh and flavor was good. The hush puppies were great even though I prefer them with cocktail sauce over marinara, which they happily brought to us. My kids had the fried shrimp and to my surprise, my daughter who rarely eats her food ate all 8 pieces of her shrimp. Nice place and I noticed that they have a lunch menu so I will have to check them out for lunch one day
name: Ron

text: Amazing fried chicken!! If your in the area and want great fried chicken & mixed greens, stop in at Hattie B's.... it's definitely worth it!
name: Alisa

text: This was by far the favorite spot for Nashville Fried Chicken when I polled the locals... be prepared to wait at least an hour! (Even when it's pouring rain outside.) We ordered the half bird, chicken sandwich, and a few extra tenders - medium hot - and it was the perfect amount of spice that lingers on the tongue, but didn't cause anyone any painful trips to the bathroom. The chicken itself was tender and juicy. It was well worth the hour wait in the rain to order, and then the 30 minutes to prepare the food. There is limited seating inside, but they have a covered patio area. If you don't want to wait in line, you can order ahead of time for pick up or use a food delivery service.
name: Jen

text: The meal I received was mediocre at best. The fried rice was over cooked. It was gummy having the same consistency as oatmeal. The general's chicken was bland, the appearance very unappetizing. The sweet and sour pork dish was terrible. Over cooked so the breading was hard and the meat was dried out and stringy. Chicken chow mein was okay but greasy. Not a place I would recommend.
name: Don

text: Really solid seafood in a relaxed low key setting.  Service is great.  They make you feel like family. If visiting IRB definitely worth a visit!
name: Lawrence

text:
Dined here tonight. It's at least my fifth time at Old Hickory as the resort is a wonderful venue for meetings.  I live out of town. 

My one star does not take into account the steaks offered, side dishes or service. It's for a wine list that is completely void of half-bottle selections and for a by-the-glass list of Cabs that are simply average. Eh. Boring. 

They don't have Sea Smoke Pinot but its way overpriced. 

It's my last time dining here. We'll grab Uber and go off site. The by-the/bottle list is OK, and overall pricey. Very disappointed again and  whike I enjoy the decor, easy access in the resort I'm done visiting this steakhouse. If you fix the wine list that is reminiscent of an Outback or Ponderosa, perhaps we'll return.

How does The Marketplace retail store 100' away carry more 1/2 bottles than this steakhouse?
name: Michael

text:
This place is AMAZING! Being new to town I am learning all the places to get out of the house with a one year old. Wine or coffee say no more... I walked in and thought "these are my people"! I will be getting a membership! 

Side note- I felt the other moms there were attentive to their kids and safe space!
name: Lauren

text:
This was our "fine dining" destination that we planned well in advance, on our first trip to New Orleans.

We had the Coolinary pre-fixe menu, and it was great.

Our server was Sterling Armoure (Silver Love) and he was an attentive and engaging waiter, who gave us some of the history of the restaurant while we dined.

Afterwards we took a quick tour of the premises, including some of the banquet rooms and displays.
name: Gopal

text: The food was great. Fish & chips was delicious. Very large portions. I saw on a yelp review to try the mozzarella sticks, they were average out of the box. Clam chowder was amazing. My son tried the food challenge and failed but it was fun. We were all very happy with our experience and will be back!
name: Danielle

text: Really good food! A wide selection of creative and tasty dishes! Wonderful ginger beer, and some awesome desserts too. The peanut butter pie was out of this world!
name: Charlie

text: The bar is in a beautiful setting but is very expensive and very busy.   My wife and I stopped in for a drink and were able to find a seat, but it took almost 10 minutes before a server came over.  Once we placed our order they came quickly.  Drinks were great but way overpriced.  Paying for the privilege of having a drink in the Gaylord I suppose :0
name: Mitch

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text:
Loved it!  

Food, service, ambience, everything.  

This hidden gem will be one of our favorites.
name: Lori

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For the price I expected more than this. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Stopped for dinner on my way home from work. Two male servers, too busy flirting with the young bus-girls to take my order. The cook was obnoxiously loud and you could hear him clearly as the kitchen is open to the diner. I had an unremarkable straight from the freezer burger. With the cool hipster vibe, I would have expected the beef to be fresh. Fries were inedible - soggy, lukewarm, and dripping with grease. When I paid the bill and told the kid at the register, he didn't even apologize. Doubt I'll be back.
name: Kelly

text: What a gem this place is! It has a very down home feel to it. Customers become regulars and they know the staff by name. They have a great selection of fresh baked items you can come in and take home. I saw one lady come in and grab a big container of chicken noodle soup with some sort of bake she would be putting in the oven. They had soups, breads, flatbread pizzas, cinnamon rolls, and even cookie dough you could take home and bake. When you walk in the door turn to the right and they have a refrigerated section of all of the items you can purchase and take home. I saw numerous people come in and buy a fresh baked loaf of bread. They had so many options! The variety of desserts they have is astounding. Baklava, Neapolitans, giant Rice Krispie treats, and many more. My sandwich I ordered was the Meridian Kessler Melt. It was good. I would order that again. The chili was just as good. It's located right next to Graeter's ice cream. They have an outdoor seating and a nice seating area inside. I will probably keep trying different items on the menu because they have so many great sounding items!
name: Kara

text:
I'm a philly native so I know to stay away from places like this. But also as a Philly native, I decided to finally give them a shot. I ordered twice two weekends in a row. I feel as though there was an inconsistency with both orders. The first time, the roll and whiz were fine for the most part but the sirloin was too chewy.  The second time, the provolone wasn't even melted and the role was spongy and drippy having absorbed so much grease. There was a layer of grease covering the inside of the wrappper as I removed the sandwich.  There was no flavor to the sandwich at all. Both times I walked away disappointed. There was no magic invloved in the making. 

The experience left a lot to be desired. Management needs to step up its game. 

I wouldn't recommend Pat's to anyone and likely wont be going there again unless I hear there's new and improved management.
name: Gregory

text: Food is decent, cashier is an ASSHOLE. Like if you hate your life so much, find another job. Don't be a rude d*ck to people just trying to get a bite. His entire demeanor is rude and off-putting. Note to owners, change your cashier if you want people to actually want to approach your business.
name: Nhu

text: One of my all time favorite restaurants! Everything is amazing about this place. The fact that is in Safety Harbor is just a BONUS! Keep up the great work POP (Parts of Paris).
name: Chris

text: This restaurant was amazing. The host was very kind, bartenders great, server, Angie, was awesome and the food and cocktails were delicious. Oh, and the restaurant is beautiful. Definitely will go back
name: Jack

text: I had an amazing quick dinner and had enough leftovers for lunch tomorrow. Great, fast service. The ramen was some of the best I have ever had. Highly recommend.
name: David

text: For a busy night they handled it okay. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The music was louder than it needed to be. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Glad we tried it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
I was visiting a friend in Philadelphia and he insisted we try out this small BYOB outside of center city. Everyone I've been to Philly, I've never ventured too far off from center city. We barely got seats thanks to a last minute cancellation, but boy was I thankful that we got in.

The food was excellent. We order two appetizers and two entrees for two people and the food was enough to satisfy us. The pricing is reasonable for the quality of food they provide. I LOVE the farm to table concept and how this restaurant supports local farms with their cycling blackboard menu! 

The service was great too! She carefully explained every item on their menu and was kind of to chill our wine and pour our glasses when we were running low. 

Definitely check this place out and definitely bring a bottle of wine.
name: Paul

text: For the price I expected a little more care. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. It was crowded but still moved along. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: I just want to update my review on Lindy's On 4Th!   I went there with a few friends for a New Years Eve lunch, and we all had a blast.   I got my Dirty Sanchez burger...and it was cooked PERFECTLY medium.    I was feeling sassy, so I ordered the ghost pepper sauce on the burger....and.....OMG it was SO good.    Hot, but flavorful....and it added additional flavor to an already juicy, delicious burger.    I could never order this burger without this sauce again...(however I would order it on the side....so I can dip my burger too!).    Well done Lindy's!
name: Holly

text: Came down with 3 friends from Ithaca, NY hungry for some authentic gumbo. This place nailed it!!! The service was impeccable and the owner even came out to check on us. Ron made us a special desert...out of this world!!! If you're in New Orleans...check these guys out
name: Syx

text: The service was exceptionally great! Lupita was very helpful and went out of her way to make us feel welcomed! Definitely will return
name: Jonathan

text: Tastes descent. The shop doesn't really have any air conditioning but the service is really nice.
name: Christy

text:
This place is great, came for lunch one day, returned for dinner and lunch again following day, couldn't get enough! Very reasonably priced, friendly service and delicious. 
Menu is customer friendly and a cozy little outdoor area along with nice indoor seating.
Highly reccomended.
name: Sean

text: Max threw the sickest party for us this Wednesday. He hooked us up with discounted bottle service and complementary champagne. He brought custom made party hats for all of us. The drinks were fantastic and the live music was terrific. Couldn't have had a better night. Max is the guy to know if you're looking to throw a rad party.
name: Aubin

text: The food was really good across the board. However service was painfully slow and our waiter insisted on calling everyone in our party "bud". Really off putting. When we received the bill we also saw that we were charged $3 for mayonnaise to go on the burger. Per person. If you want $17 for the burger I suggest just charging that or accepting that someone might want mayo for it. Similarly we were charged $1.5 for ordering a cocktail up. You charged us to not put ice in a glass. That is not cool. Feeling nickel and dimed with undisclosed charges when you are leaving does not make for a pleasant experience. Again food was really good, but it did not make up for unpleasant wait staff and excessive over charging.
name: Ryan

text: Wow, what a wonderful spot. I really didn't know what to expect but I am so happy I tried this. The Marsala tea was heavenly. The mutton momos where superb with subtle seasoning. The thali was delicious. I will definitely be back.
name: Phillip

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Anyway, the wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It looked better online than it did in person. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Honestly, the service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text:
This might be one of my favorite places in New Orleans...everything was so delicious, and it's such a fun atmosphere. I want to try so many more things on their menu!

First, we happened to go on Wednesday evening, which happens to be rib night. Aw yeah. The ribs were phenomenal. My husband had the buckboard bacon melt sandwich, which the guy behind the counter described as the "staff favorite." It was delicious. Buckboard bacon is a type of bacon, just FYI for those of you who (like us) had no clue. This website explains it: http://nitratefreebacon.com/Buckboard-Bacon.php

Next time, I'd love to try the muffuletta and the gambino. Also would love to try their charcuterie plate and cheese plate with a glass of wine at some point. Oh, so much food and so little time.

Their cocktails change on a weekly basis, so I'm not sure it'd do any good to tell you what we had. I'll say the hurricane was good but not great (I might just not be a big hurricane fan), and on the whole, all of their drinks were really solid. My husband really raved about the drinks he had.

Tip: We went for an early dinner around 5:30 and had no wait. By the time it was about 6 pm, there was a line out the door. Yes, on a Wednesday. The line had died down by about 7:30 or 8.
name: Anne

text:
We ordered here via Grubhub and did not receive the full order , received compensation for items not receive, (pita bread / dressing.) after being told to contact Grubhub regarding the issue. 

Nonetheless, the food is always fresh and authentic otherwise it would be a 5 star rating.
name: Alexander

text:
I would give them 0 stars if I could. 

I walked in there tonight hoping to get soup. The manager walked pass me to grab 4 menus, did not speak, no hello, no acknowledgment what's so ever.  He grabbed the menus to seat 4 people that hadn't even walked in yet. 

He walked away to seat them as I skimmed through the menu. Then a waitress came over, no hello, or acknowledgment! So I said "Hello"! The manager then walks over and says "DECIDED"? Initially I didn't understand him because he had an accent, so I just cleared it up that I was ordering to go. And he basically yells at me in a very rude tone, " NO I ASKED IF YOU DECIDED WHAT YOU WANT". 


So I turn over to speak to the lady, because at least she wasn't yelling at me. I then ask her about the soup du jour. Then I asked if they had any vegetable soup, she replied rudely " NO WE DO NOT. (Period)! 

At that point I felt beyond humiliated and disrespected by how they spoke to me and treated me. I'm not prone to using the black card unless I know for a fact it's because of that. But what I will say is I am a young black woman! And that's how I was treated!
name: S

text: We had immediate issues with seating a large group and we ended up setting up a couple of tables to move from the crowded booth we were stuffed in. The food was great other than a minor miscommunication. It seemed to be overly loud while dining in and the drinks were watered down. I'll definitely go back in hopes of better service.
name: Rocky

text:
Too quick of a visit to truly judge but a quick stop in for quiche and a latte necessitated the good review.  Would love to come back to try the rest of the menu.

Be warned, it's a very popular spot.
name: Ryan

text: Best meal I've ever had in the area. Cute place with great small dishes for sharing and desert to die for
name: Andrew

text: Went for lunch and got the signature Philly Cheesesteak here.  The food was quite solid and delicious and service was good.  Note that the entrance is SUPER confusing, entering from the in-between area of a hotel.
name: Kryzak

text: I come here to eat soondae (blood sausage) soup on rainy days before grocery shopping. It's in a bone broth with perilla seeds. Sometimes nothing else can hit the spot. Split that and one of the dolsots w/ a friend (& grab a king bun from the mandu place, split it in half with a wooden chopstick as an appetizer). The seafood pancake is also pretty satisfying when it rains. They offer some seasonal selections as do some of the other spots in the food court, especially in the summer (season of the cold noodle soups-- look for kongguksu aka cold soybean milk soup but get it earlier in the day as they run out and it's better fresh).
name: yoohyun

text: Excellent new restaurant. Service consistently good!  Food creative and delicious Always something new to try. Fair prices. Highly recommend
name: Phyllis

text: Menu was small and we didn't love the rabbit and liver pate. I started with the stuff we didn't like because we loved everything else. The food was excellent, service was top notch and the location was convenient. If you are in NOLA and want something good outside the French Quarter go to Luke!!
name: Richard

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Took two and a half hours to get the pizza. Called multiple times, was put on hold. Kept telling me it would be ready in "30 minutes" every time we called. Unbelievably bad service.
name: Chase

text: Always a must stop! Whether it be a girls day or birthday. It never leaves you in a bad mood!
name: Candace

text: Came in for a quick breakfast about 10:30.The place wasn't busy at all. We walked right up to the register to order. Gal at cash register not overly friendly but quick to take our order. Order ready fair quick; however no salt or pepper on tray and none to be found for self serve. My husband loves the big breakfast. I wish they served at least one kind of burger in the morning.
name: Connie

text: Wow, what a great spot! Very laid back and chill. We went in for lunch and got to sit at the bar and watch the chef make boudin spring rolls. That's exactly what I had for lunch, and OMG so delicious. I eat boudin any chance I get, and these were absolutely amazing. They were stuffed with cheese, which was melting. My husband got brisket sandwich and it was amazing as well. Definitely coming back to taste other items on the menu.
name: Helen

text: Consistently delicious food at very reasonable prices.  Giving 4 out of 5 stars as their beer selection seemed a lot thinner than what it used to and you can only get a growler filled using their growler bottles.  Otherwise, a hit for dinner and especially brunch.
name: Greg

text:
Thank God there is a CVS and a Walgreen close by, because you are going to need to make a stop afterwards if you eat here. 

The food was awful, it tasted like burnt dirty oil like they didn't clean the grill or the oil for weeks before cooking the food. It gave my husband and I both stomach aches. 

The service was absolutely horrific. It took us getting up and finding another waitress to have ours come to our table after waiting 20 minutes just place the initial order. ( It was also slow in there) She also forgot to place our entree order.So, we sat and waited forever. 


The bathroom is also unsanitary.
name: Stephanie

text:
I have been here a few times for the wine tasting in their lobby, sat in the bar area with some friends during happy hour, and of course in the main dining area. I am finally getting around to write my review. 
I really enjoy the food here and the wine they carry of theirs is SO good. My favorite is the Coopers Hawk Red. It is a great blend of Cabernet, Merlot and Syrah. This is a wine I could drink all by myself just by itself. I love that they bring out their own decanter to put on the table and fill it with the bottle that you ordered. Nice touch. You can also purchase these large decanters at the restaurant. 
My last visit was to celebrate my girlfriends birthday. Of course we ordered a bottle of the Coopers Hawk Red right off the bat. I asked to start off with the Hummus, but unfortunately they were out of it. So, we decided on their side salad with a balsamic vinaigrette. IF you need a Gluten Free menu, they DO have one, but you have to ask for it. There is a lot to choose from...thank goodness. 
They also have Gluten Free bread they can bring to the table if you want to indulge in some other forms of carbs while waiting. Onto the entrees...I ended ordering the Chicken Madeira from their Gluten Free menu and my friend ordered the Cilantro Ranch Chicken Sandwich. Unfortunately, I did not get a picture of hers because mine looked so good that I started eating right after I snapped a picture of mine. 
The chicken was so juicy and had such flavor that this is now going to be my "go to" item. I substituted the potatoes for the kale instead and I am glad that I did. Greens all the way!! 
We both had no issues finishing up our food and there was plenty of room for dessert. The Flourless Chocolate Torte was the one for us. This dessert was surprisingly moist and topped with whipped cream and fresh berries. This is also on the Gluten Free menu. Since it was my friends birthday, the waitress brought out a complimentary plate for her special day along with a candle. What a nice touch. 
I really enjoy coming to this place whether it's for lunch, dinner or just simple wine tasting. If you have not dined here before, I highly recommend the visit.
name: Nicole

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Pretty happy with it overall. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. The music was louder than it needed to be. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text: It was crowded but still moved along. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Worth checking out. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: The  best char  grilled  oysters. EVER. During my trip, I went back twice in the same week because of those oysters. Months later, I'm still drooling over them. The next time I'm in town, this will be one of my first stops.
name: Anahi

text:
Great place for romantic dinner or family get together. We are consistent visitors at this place. 
Today we had Mckenzie as our server. She was amazing. My fish on the rice and veggie was light and tasty. Wow!!!
Love this place.
name: Emiliya

text:
Excellent coffee, great food, cool spot. This is heaven's waiting room for hipsters.

My girlfriend and I visited Nashville from Boston and we went to Barista Parlor for breakfast on our first day, since we were staying in the area. It's a very cool space, lots of old motorcycles and industrial decor. The music was good and not distracting like it can be at other places. It was playing from an old record player, which was kinda cool. 

Lots of seating available, which is a nice change of pace from Boston where you can't find a seat in a coffee shop to save your life. There was plenty of seating outside too, it was a bit too toasty for us northerners though.

We ordered the cold brew, which was good, and the bacon egg and cheese sandwich on a biscuit (served on a little wooden plank, which was different and fun). My God, it was delicious - the biscuit was flaky and buttery just like it should be, somehow my sandwich disappeared after a few minutes.
name: Tyler

text: A nice spot for a lazy Sunday breakfast. The soft scrambled was not 100% what I was expecting, but it hit the spot nonetheless. I was trying to save some room for the cookies because they looked ah-maz-ing but filled up from the breakfast. I'll be going back to get a peanut butter cookie or some macaroons.
name: Mal

text: I love this place! Overlooking Albert Whitted Airport, a small plane landing strip that we could watch planes land and take off while enjoying a nice quesadilla and salad. Richard was an excellent server and kept the drinks re-filled. Nice menu and would definitely try dinner.
name: Chris

text:
We REALLY wanted to like this place.  We sat at the bar and our sushi chef wasn't rude but he was definitely not friendly or even a little bit engaging.  I think one time someone came to clean up the dishes. A server never came to check on drinks and we had to stop one to ask for our check. The place was virtually empty so there's really not an excuse for that.
The sushi itself was fine.  Nothing really memorable and there are far better places out there.  Maybe it's better at dinner time, but I don't think we'd try again.
name: Mandy

text: BEST GRILLED GROUPER sandwich ever!! Definitely worth it. I like how it's in the middle of a neighborhood.  Kind of gives that Florida Keys feel, just not on the water.
name: Amy

text: I love Qdoba but this is absolutely the worst I will never go in here again. I have been twice both times they are out of a lot of things the staff is completely rude and unfriendly.  Very unprofessional do yourself a favor eat anywhere but this Qdoba.
name: Brian

text: This is a great lunch option if you are looking for a fresh Poke Bowl. Quick service and very clean inside. I tried the regular bowl (2 bases and 2 proteins). The make the prices based on the size of the bowl and then how many bases and proteins you get. The spicy tuna and salmon were delicious. They were running low on the regular Tuna so I wasn't able to try that one. Lots of sauces and toppings available. If you are a fruit person they have quite a lot of those, but not as many green vegetables as I usually prefer. Avocado was extra which I didn't love, but they did give an entire half of an avocado for the up charge which at least made it worth the $$. Overall a really good lunch option and a great concept.
name: Cassie

text:
Food: -
Crawfish Etouffee ($17): 1/5
Barely edible. Tiny portions of crawfish, very greasy, and the rice was over-cooked. Looked like microwaved soup. Left a bad taste in my mouth, literally. 

Price: -
$17 before tip. Not worth it at all. 

Service: +
The waitress was nice and helpful. 

Ambiance: +
Nothing too special, located on a corner of Bourbon Street. 

Overall: -
Food was terrible, nothing really more to say. My friend had the gumbo and it was just as bad as the etouffee. To be fair, my other friend had a po-boy and it wasnt bad. Disappointed as this was my first dining experience in New Orleans. Hopefully I find better dining options during my time here.
name: Paul

text: Besides being very crowded and the long line, we got our food pretty fast after ordering. I got the Princess & my friend got the Hummingbird Family Reserve. My chicken was crispy and my biscuit was buttery. Very good. I tried the Hummingbird and it was basically a cake with cream cheese frosting and is great for sharing since it's so thick and filling. The service wasn't amazing but I had no problem with it.
name: Lexi

text: Great place to eat at I had their fish and chicken dinners and both were good. I use to drive on the Northside of town  for soul food  but not anymore since  I've visited Jimmie's soulfood
name: Brenda

text:
Yay yay yay for good authentic Mexican! Tacos (with extra limes of course) were some of the best I had ever had and the service was quick! 
I've lived 10 mins from this place my whole life and never even noticed it. I finally did a few weeks ago and boy am I glad I did!
name: Bianca

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Would return.
name: User

text:
Great sports bar in downtown Tampa! The beers are fresh, the wings are meaty and the service is impeccable. 

When I arrived it was pretty much packed. I was worried at first that because it was a "seat yourself situation" that a server wouldn't find us. I was wrong! Within one minute a cute girl approached our table and asked us for a drink. She promptly brought us our beers in nice chilled mugs.  We ordered the Lightning Wings and a reuben with steak fries to share. If I had known the wings were going to be so flavorful, meaty and delicious, I probably would have just ordered more wings, but this way we got to try more of the menu. I'm a sucker for a reuben. This reuben was well prepared. It almost tasted healthy! The steak fries were a favorite of mine.

It's great to go to a sports bar with great food, amazing service and attractive servers that don't have to be almost naked to look cute. Next time in Tampa, I'll be sure to visit Hattricks again.
name: Nancy

text: Ordered a small pizza, mega fries and spicy chicken wrap. Went to pick up the food and the pizza wasn't there, and when I called and went back to get it we were refunded (for the pizza) and offered free soda. This level of service separates great from good! Oh, and the rest of the food was fantastic!
name: Chris

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Would return. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
This is actually the second time we've been here, but the first time it was 9:30 pm, and despite the online hours saying they were open till 10 pm, they were locked and dark...

So, try again the same week and got here for dinner at 5:45 pm. There were hardly any customers. We entered the long space and walked along the ice cream cases to the back. Because of my cilantro-aversion, I had to ask about several menu items, of which the guy at the counter didn't know and had to ask the kitchen workers through the pass-thru window. It was a bit tedious. So in all we got 8 tacos, 2 without pico de gallo which had to be redone because they had pico on them...

Nonetheless, 4 stars because the food was great. Even better was the ice cream! I got the mint oreo and my kid got the salted caramel coffee, both in waffle cones. Great, fresh flavors and very creamy texture plus the waffle cones were thick and crisp.

We wondered where everyone was! Parking was okay for us in the evening. Prices are cheap!
name: Suzee

text: It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Definitely coming back. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nice little spot, decent portions too. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Wolfies is a fabulous restaurant bordering the Geist reservoir. The decor fitting for gatherings and small bites. Although primarily a bar seating is available for children. Their menu is small but incorporates many items for the varied pallets. I truly enjoy this atmosphere and food.  The flagship store in Westfield is the best I encountered. The owner takes every step to ensure quality great service and memorable experiences.  A must try.
name: Starr

text: Amazing pulled pork sandwiches. Loved the fresh taste for food with lots of choice on the menu.
name: Karen

text:
12-12-19 Dinner for 2 ....7:00PM
Ambiance - dining area Excellent 
Menu - Excellent & extensive. Impressive 
Staff -  Extremely helpful and courteous 
Pasta Primavera - Delicious & Rich white sauce  with vegetables.  Large serving fresh and hot. I had to take half the order home. 
Pasta with eggplant - Delicious red sauce and very large serving. Ordered the eggplant served crispy - they kindly accommodated my special request. Could not eat it all so took remainder home for another feast. 
House salad was excellent. 
Bread - Excellent 
Highly recommend this excellent restaurant 
Parking - Good Street parking
Highly recommend this fabulous restaurant.

text: I've been here multiple times (never my choice). It's not very good in my opinion. The tacos are super greasy and on this latest occasion it took 45 minutes for my sister in law to receive her 3 tacos (only because I told the waitress). My husband never received his cóctel de camarón. My parents, brothers and I ordered the tabla de mariscos and ended up taking it to go because we waited more than an hour for it (mind you this tabla costs $70). Truly AWFUL service! On top of this they charged me $20 gratuity for their sorry excuse for service. This was the last time I step foot in that restaurant. If  I could give them zero stars I would.
