text:
Great place! Good selection of coffees, drinks, I like the ciders they have in winters and the seasonal drinks. Good vibe, love the location. 
Good for small or larger groups. 
I still wanna go here one day on a Wednesday for the evening wine - cheese thing, haven't had a chance yet!
name: Mini

text: My friend and I went to The Gaslight for happy hour on a Thursday night. The deals are great and the happy hour goes from 5-8pm which is an hour later than most bars in the city. I ordered the Glamour Gal 3 times! It is tasty and refreshing. The following weekend, my friends met me there for a going away dinner as I was moving out of Philly within the next few weeks. It was the perfect spot for myself and 7 friends. Everyone was very happy with their meal. I ordered the turkey burger and french fries and was not disappointed!
name: Mary Jo

text: Hands down the best Indian buffet in town. The food is always fresh and flavors are vibrant. I especially like going on Friday nights for biryani night - several varieties of biryani made fresh to order and included in the price of the buffet!
name: Gary

text: Came to STL for a wedding and was lucky enough to have my air B and B above this amazing bbq joint. They have a smoker outside that is cooking all day making the surrounding area smell heavenly. I order the fried Korean ribs which had a nice Smokey flavor. We also tried the fried cat fish (we ordered spicy and they're not messing around ) cooked perfectly with a corn meal breading. The fried green tomatoes were nice and had a tangy sauce on the side. Do yourself a favor and get some moonshine as well
name: Allyson

text: It was my first time here but I will be back for the Krispy Kreme Donut Burger. This time around I got the Double Bacon Cheeseburger. I did not enjoy the fries at all. Next time I will try the loaded fries and the small juices they have. Seating was limited and condiments did not have labels on them. The burgers are good but I'm not sure about the rest of their items.
name: Kelechi

text:
Food is great, but service is horrible. Our server was arrogant and rude. Not only he was super slow, he even ignored us couple times. He also made rude comments such as "is that all you want to order?"

When we finished eating and we decided to get dessert, he came to us with the check. We kindly asked for the dessert menu and he brought it like 10 minutes later. Picking a dessert is like 5 mins right, or not even. He made us wait 20 minutes before coming to take our dessert order. He was joking around with other people while us, the customers were waiting for him to come get our order. 

After he got the order, i asked him to please make it quick as we've been waiting for a while. His answer was "i have no control over the kitchen". So i said, "we've been waiting for too long so please"

His answer: "there are 300 people in the back of the restaurant"

Truth? The restaurant was quite packed, but there were 5 other servers and obviously there weren't more than 60 people in the whole restaurant. 

If you want good food, this is a great place, but I wouldn't recommend, as the server is rude and unprofessional. For service i'd give 2/10, for food 9/10.
name: Ryka

text: My potatoes were overcooked no seasoning the bread that they brought to the table for the crab claws was Honda as a rock the crab claws smell like fish it was not a guest is variance for me I have been waiting to go to this place since I am Ylance In New Orleans Dee the car was wonderful but the food was not up to par
name: Jennifer

text: This venue is perfect for a low key night on the town! I really enjoyed the rooftop area, there was live music and an assortment of wines and craft beers. The event I went to is held every third Saturday of the month and I will certainly be back. The decor is vibrant and colorful dispute the venues "attic" space. Try the chicken and beef empanadas. They were delicious!
name: Monique

text: The Cheesecake Factory is probably one of my favorite big chain restaurants. Their menu is huge, as are the portions. I ordered the shrimp and chicken gumbo with brown rice and it was delicious! The chicken was extremely tender--like it had been sous vided--and the gumbo had a wonderful depth of flavor. Our server, Kayla, was also fantastic. My only gripe is the size of our cheesecake, which I had it packed to go. Both me and my boyfriend's slices were tiny- it was almost as if a normal slice had been cut in half. The table adjacent to us had ordered cheesecake and their slices were huge compared to ours. Not sure if this issue is consistent with those who get cheesecake to go, but if that's the case, I would rather dine in to eat my cheesecake and pay an additional $1-2 tip for almost twice the size.
name: Joanne

text: Any time I come in to this restaurant they are pretty busy but everyone is always working so fast and maintaining a clean station. Overheard a customer being a stuck up a**hole to the ladies busting out plates during a dinner rush and they remained professional through ALL OF HIS CRAP. Best panda in Reno!
name: Nikita

text: Great food, the calamari was fresh and delicious, chicken tortilla soup was amazing. The service was perfect, and let's not forget the amazing view while your enjoying your dinner.
name: John

text: Our favorite local place. It's been through quite a few menu changes over the last couple years, some good and some not so much. But their most recent changes have all been perfect. The addition of the small plate happy hour menu is exactly what they needed.
name: Ashley

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Overall, a strong experience. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Fresh product. Inventive dishes mixed with the tried and true. Simple biscuits and gravy rock
name: brett

text: Really wanted to try this place. We came all the way from California and this was on our list of places to try. Sat in a 30 minute Lyft ride from our hotel and we were utterly disappointed. Everything, I mean EVERYTHING ran out. There was no brisket, pork belly, egg rolls, spring rolls... not even the banh mi BREAD was available. I mean, I understand that this place must be busy, but I think it's just poor planning to run out of everything, especially bread. My husband ordered the BMB without the pork belly (because they ran out) and the girl at the counter had to come tell us AFTER he paid that they cant even make the sandwich without the pork belly and banh mi bread (only po boy bread available). He told them to switch it to a bulgogi sandwich and she wanted him to pay the difference. I think it's bad business that they would need to do all that, especially since there was NOTHING else available. Anyway, we decided to just get the refund and go try some place else.
name: Lina

text: My friend and I decided to check out the vineyard last Sunday. There was an event as I had emailed to see if we could go to the tasting room or if it was only open for the event. I received a super quick response and was advised it was going to be super busy. I appreciated the heads up, but we decided to go anyways. It was a gorgeous day, but a bit breezy. We got there right when it opened and bought our tickets. It was really a donation for a great event, KassieKares. We found our way to the tasting room and it was already pretty busy. The ladies working were all great. Super informative, told us about Kassie, and helped us pick the wines to taste. The new rose was my favorite. If there is a D by the wine, that is made with their grapes. We purchased a glass and went outside to check out the vendors and pet all the pooches. We could not check out the upstairs because that was the VIP section for the day. This venue has so much to offer! What a great addition to the area. Even though there were plenty of food options with the food trucks that day, we opted for the margherita pizza and the brie plate and both hit the spot. We both loved the saltiness of the pizza. They have this little check out section to get to go orders and cold wine to take home. Seriously, I cannot wait to go back.
name: Erin

text: My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
Owner is fun to talk to and very friendly. The mozzarella sticks are bomb!! The pizzas are probably one of the best I've had since I've been to
Italy! The pomodore romano and spinach ricotta dolce are delicious!! The pomodore is topped with caramelized onions that gives the pizza sweetness but contrasted with the salty prosciutto. The cheese on the spinach ricotta is extremely flavorful. Highly recommend this place.
 
***this place is in the back! Walk around the entire building to the back!
name: Sonia

text: Great place, but they no longer serve the Gluten Free banana bread that made them stand out.  Worse, they still had the "GF Banana Bread" sign in the bakery cabinet!  But nice place with nice decor nonetheless.
name: Ed

text:
I visited the old location several times over the years and liked it. This is my second trip to the new location and I'm not very impressed with the kitchen wait times. If you want to waste a good portion of your afternoon come eat here. I seriously doubt we'll be back unless something changes.

Update: Server forgot to enter our order; or so we were told. Didn't see a whole lot coming out of the kitchen. Finally cut our losses and walked out. I saw another large table do the same. Definitely won't be back. Thanks for wasting our time.
name: Bryan

text:
So I had the pleasure of going to Commoner & Co for dinner with a couple friends. This is the sister restaurant for Prep & Pastry, my ritual Saturday morning breakfast spot, which is well...I'll get to that review next. Anyway, let me just say I was blown away by EVERYTHING. Met the owner, Nate, who is just a genuinely nice guy. First thing he asked was if we had any food allergies at the table so they could make any suggestions or adjustments. Everything is house made BTW. So we had the mussels and fries, which was weird to me, not going to lie, but that Thai Curry Sauce, ugh. OH MI GAWD, incredible. I also had the roasted beets, fresh and delicious. Then the main dishes of the special for the evening, pork chop extraordinaire, shrimp scampi and I had the gnocchi. Everything is incredible. We couldn't decide on dessert, so we tried it all. I was hesitant on the pistachio deconstructed cake. Whoa! Just whoa! I'm not a fan of cheesecake but that Smores cheesecake is delicious. They get their sorbet from Frost, so that was of course delicious.
Lastly, not only was the food on point but the service. Some of THE BEST service I have ever received, I was not surprised as I get the same AMAZING service at Prep. 
So if you have read this far and have not been convinced to give this place a try, your truly missing out. Enjoy the patio or the amazing ambiance inside. You will not be disappointed!
name: Rachel D

text: i was actually quite disappointed because captain receives such rave reviews but unfortunately my food was very bland. i ordered the crab mac and cheese and it was like alfredo soup with noodles and crab meat, very under seasoned. very cute place & great service, i'll probably come back to try another dish and hope for better luck.
name: Chris

text: Got "The CEO" cause I'm a bosssss bit%!...whooo, got carried away. Too lazy to walk anywhere in the rain right now and, so, I went to the closest spot to my hotel. BURGERFI was tasty. The CEO is double wagyu + brisket blend burger, homemade candied bacon-tomato jam truffle aioli, aged Swiss. You are able to order a single patty, if preferred, which is what I did. First time trying any burger with lettuce replacing the buns. Figured I ate not so healthy today so something had to give. Only critique is fries and drink are sold separately, no such things as ordering a meal, if that makes sense. I didn't think ordering Cajun fries would be so expensive but it was $5.14 for regular fries. I paid a total $18.12 for my meal. Five guys Cajun fries are better.
name: Vette

text: worst outback ever ! cold steaks , missing food order , rude owner , inept manager , horrible experience ! stay clear of this place . mcdonald's is better !
name: Alex

text:
Stopped by for a quick lunch after reading some reviews on it. Wait time was short although the restaurant was packed when we got there. We got our food quickly and it was delicious. I got the steak breakfast and my fiancé got the Jalapeño burger. I also ordered coffee of the month and it was delicious, did I mention pretty? Lol 

I would love to go back and try other options as well and their beautiful latte. Our waitress was very attentive and provided great service as well.
name: Angel

text: Great place for late night eats.  We had a burger with House-made chips, and it was spot on.  Best food you can get after midnight. The bartender was friendly.  The tunes were in the Nirvana genre.  Approved!
name: Carrie

text: This was one of the worst service I've ever encountered during my stay in New Orleans. Me and my girlfriend ordered the clam and mussels seafood platter, along with the shrimp and rice. They were both plated on the wrong plate, and was cold as if they let it sit there for 20/30minutes and then brought it out to us. I don't recommend that African Americans go here because they treat you different. I was also told the clams and mussels would be about 10 pieces each on the plate when it actually came with 4 pieces each for $30. Ridiculous!.... never again . They only get a one star because we got free beer out of this and was told we didn't have to pay for the cold food... thanks for that, it was the least you guys could do.
name: Steven

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
Chuy's happy hour is like none other. FREE nachos. That's the happy hour, nachos being one of my favorite bar foods I am a very happy camper when I make it in time for happy hour here. It's no frills--just simple, chips, beef, and light toppings. With a side of nachos, they offer some great frozen and iced margaritas. I've tried their watermelon marg, frose, lime marg--all delicious. 

It gets pretty busy in here, but there's also plenty of seating so you shouldn't have to wait too long--especially if you don't mind just sitting in the bar area. Being such close proximity to the mall, this is a great option for delicious food when you get that mid-shopping spree hankering for some grub. We actually decided to stop in for happy hour here before going next door to the movies. This was great because we ended up filling up, and avoiding the $$ expensive movie theater food.

Overall very happy with my Chuy's experience and will be back for more margaritas and nachos.
name: Nicolette

text: We walked out of our reservation because the manager was that ridiculous. Their first floor is really loud so we made the reservation way ahead hoping to be seated upstairs in a quieter area. Upon arrival we were informed that the second floor was closed because too many people canceled their reservations. When I went upstairs to check it out, there were plenty of people there having dinner. When we tried talking to the manager he told us that upstairs kitchen was closed and he couldn't care less if our party of 3 ate elsewhere. Good luck keeping your clientele.
name: Eva

text: If you like wood fired pizza this is great.  If if you like traditional pizza this is great.  I highly recommend.
name: John

text: We stopped by on a Tuesday night and got seated right away. Service was prompt and very friendly. Our server even recommended a few places to see that were in the neighborhood. Calamari was good, not the best we ever had, but decent. We had the seafood pasta, seafood platter, etoufee and a burger. Unfortunately, they were out of lemons on our visit which disappointed me. I put lemon on all my seafood. We managed to get full nonetheless. There was a band playing dixieland jazz and a few people were dancing. Fun, upbeat atmosphere in a very cool, hip new neighborhood! (for a very old historic restaurant)
name: Lisa

text: Great place for seafood, reasonably priced, big fan of the shrimp tacos, grouper sandwich was also good because of the sauce. Service was friendly. Definitely a must try.
name: Cindy

text: Immediately when my partner and I walked in we were greeted and given a rundown of the menu and how it worked. I got one of the bowls on the menu and swapped bran for spicy tuna and added fried jalapeños without a problem. My partner got a poke burrito that was plenty big and came with a side of chips. Everything was amazing from service to taste and presentation. I recommend this spot to everyone. Oh I also did half rice and half greens as my base to lighten my bowl up a bit. Definitely my favorite way to eat a poke bowl.
name: Devon

text:
I have been to this chain with big a parties a few times and they do not accompany well. We always get our food at various times and the servers are always way too in over their head it seems like. 
My sister and her friends had a large party and i could see the host very obviously making fun of the whole group, and the server was very very rude to this group of girls. 
i can not respect restaurants who hire service like this. 
do not recommend.
name: Abby

text: This was mine and my girlfriends first date spot. This place is fun and it's always poppin'. They always have great drink specials and everyone is so nice. Only downfall is the one ladies restroom they have inside. They also have port o potties out back which in my opinion aren't very sanitary but when you gotta go you gotta go. Maybe bring your own hand sanitizer. Overall, fun place to hang out at!
name: Jessica

text: Update. I found my dish. The scallops are to die for and the chocolate bar for dessert is spectacular.  Yumm.
name: Adam

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It was crowded but still moved along. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Pretty happy w it overall. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. For a busy night they handled it okay. Kind of landed in the middle for me. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: My boyfriend and I stopped into Envie by chance during our trip to New Orleans and we loved it! The staff was so friendly and inviting. The space is clean and the food and coffee were both amazing. I got the avocado omelet with sourdough & it was a game changer! Something I loved about this place is that they keep books on each table, which I thought was so sweet. Can't wait to go back before our trip is over!
name: Jenna

text:
I wasn't sure how this was going to be, but since it is next to my gym and I was craving pho I gave it a chance. I am glad I did, because it was really good.

I ordered my pho to go close to closing. There were only a couple of young people working there, and they were already cleaning up but they took the time to prepare my order nicely.

When you order it to go, the meat and veggies and sauces are all packaged in one container, with the broth in another. When you get home, you put the meat and veggies into the broth. It was tasty!

I will go back!
name: Rebecca

text: This place has rude people it's not very clean and the employees need a lesson on grooming and speaking not to mention the back of the building is filthy with employees loitering at the back door I think they need health inspectors  and to top it off I asked for no mayo 3 times due to allergic reactions came home and my burger was full of mayo. They told me they could not refund my money. And the hamburger never had a bite out of it and hung up on me when I called to let them know.  How Disrespectful. So my food went to the trash butt they kept my money. This is really sad  and she was told 3 times no mayo
name: Kimberly Dawn

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It was crowded but still moved along. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Food was fresh and service was quick. Definitely coming back. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: First time giving a poor review! Frustrated with the portions, quality, cost...bad meal--can I go on???!
name: Danielle

text: I love, love, love these tacos. I always over-order because I can't decide which kind of taco I want (there are MANY choices); I think I like the barbacoa (lamb) ones best, although the cabeza (head...work up your nerve and try it, it's so rich and flavorful!) is also wonderful. I order them Mexican style, and enjoy all of the sauces except the mild one because I don't do mild. If you are lucky like me and always have leftovers because you get carried away, then you get to have a great lunch the next day--a total win!
name: Lisa

text: I thought the Beef's in Fish Hawk was bad and then my husband and I went to this one. We tried this Beef's before but it was so busy and the waitresses kept ignoring us that we walked out. We thought we would try it again and see if it were just a bad night. First off, it is way too small for the amount of people they cram in there. There are four booths by the bathrooms in a little cubbie hole. That was the first thing that was wrong. We were not going to sit and try to eat with bathroom smells wafting in the restaurant every time someone opened the door. Next, I ordered a salad and found dirt or some other nasty black stuff in it. Disgusting. The worse thing was the waitress. It was like "oh well, I'll get you another salad". Did she really think I wanted another after that! One waitress said it looked like meat! What the hell would meat be doing by the salads!! By this time, I had just about lost my appetite and I WAS hungry after working a 12 hour shift. I ordered the Friday night special, Surf and Turf. The steak was so tough I had to spit the first bite out! It couldn't be chewed! The shrimp was suppose to be grilled but it looked like it came right out of the freezer and was ice cold. Whooppee they gave us 20% off our meal which could not be eaten and was disgusting - and then the waitress acted like she was doing us a great big favor for that! The waitress was rude and I'm sure must hate her job because she never once smiled. The whole thing really put a damper on the end of my day. We will NEVER step foot in this place again. Do yourself a favor, save your hard earned money and go somewhere else. I should have taken a picture of the salad but I was in such shock I didn't.
name: Kathi

text: They're closing in a few days. Get it while you can. Some of the beer taps are already dry. RIP.
name: Andrew

text: my friend liked it more than I did. The music was louder than it needed to be. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kinda leveled off after a few bites. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better online than it did in person. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Live around the block and order from here when convenient. Had issues with a large order and person on the phone(ERIC?) pretended he didn't understand but spoke clear English when required. He became an ass**** and hung up don't order from here there's too many places nearby and the sushi is poor to the cost and service.
name: Brian

text:
I have been here multiple times for breakfast lunch and dinner. 

And it's the same story every time... 

Food is fantastic, some of the best in town. It is well worth the money. Service is excellent as well. Atmosphere is great too. 

The only issue I ever have is the Hostess/Manager maybe? 

She is never in uniform like the rest of the crew so I assume she is in management. 

She is the absolute worst part of the restaurant. She is always overwhelmed with guests and request and then projects it onto the new customers coming in to eat. It is a horrible experience with her. She is very rushed and runs around unorganized making a the wait time way longer than it should be. She is very rude and condescending as well. 

One time specifically for breakfast on a Sunday, she called my parties name, we walked up to the host stand, she saw us walk up, walked away for about 5-7 minutes and came back to ask us what we were waiting for. She then proceeded to tell us we were supposed to be seated all ready and it was our fault for not sitting. 

She is the worst part of the place hands down, please find a competent host  that knows what they are doing and doesn't act condescending towards guests.
name: Jared

text: I had an omelette. It wasn't  as flavorful as I hoped for. The home made potatos weren't either. The fruit was fresh so that satisfied me. Unique environment and friendly  staff.
name: Jasmine

text: After reading reviews I had high hopes for this place as it is close to my house. The food and drinks were very good BUT I have been a server for over 5 years so I know proper protocols. One issue I had was that there were TONS of gnats flying around at the bar and landing on the pour spouts of the liquor bottles. Yuck. One of the bartenders was eating right where the kitchen places the food that is ready to be served, also yuck. Overall, I did have a good experience but the staff could be a little more sanitary!
name: Christine

text:
I tend to go here on off times of the day and week and there are always plenty of seats and options! I'm a fan of the 10am $5 movies on Sundays, you can almost always guarantee lots of seating options. There is usually enough parking and it is easy to get in and out of the parking lot.

I haven't had much of their food but I have liked their pizza and chicken fingers. Their seats are comfy, which I appreciate. Overall, a good place to go that isn't too costly. Not the best dine in theatre in town but a good option on a budget.
name: Samantha

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
We were waking down the street trying to decide where to eat when a staff member was standing at the front door told us we should come in. We asked to look at menus and I wasn't really feeling the place but we were tired and hungry so we went in. 

The lighting is so bright. Why?! Lol that's my one complaint about the decor. 

The staff were awesome. Our server Noel was a really sweet, articulate kid who really knew his job. He was on top of everything. 

The fried gulf shrimp deviled eggs were amazing. The spinach dip was pretty tasty as well. Many friends got the raw oysters and loved them. I got the Cajun stuffed fish because Noel expressed how much he loved it and I wanted to try something different. It was pretty tasty. The brussel sprouts were bangin and I really enjoyed the jambalaya. A couple friends got sandwiches and they said they were good.  

I think we all left pretty full and happy overall!
name: Emily

text:
I'm SOOOOO happy this place has opened up in Santa Barbara! I loved it!!!! This place was so delicious, great service, and overall just is a great addition to SB's food scene! 

My friend and I stopped in here last Friday for dinner. I had found this place on Yelp and since it was new thought we should try it! We were seated right away outside at a communal like table which I thought was neat. We got to sit facing state street which was fun. We had to wait a few minutes for our server to come over since it was busy. Once he came over he introduced himself to us and after that we had great service! He told us what he recommended and even brought us the specials list. 

We decided on getting bruschetta for an app and each of us got a pizza to try! I got the arugula prosciutto pizza and my friend got the basic margherita! Our app came out pretty quickly after we had ordered it. It was so fresh with lots of garlic which we both enjoyed!!! As soon as we had finish our app, our pizzas came out!!! They were both delicious!! Full of flavor, perfect amount of toppings, and the crust was cooked perfectly!! Overall 10/10! We even asked for extra olive oil and balsamic to put on our pizza so they brought us three kinds to try which was awesome!

I brought in a bottle of wine so instead of us trying their wine, we had the wine I brought. They charged us a $20 corkage fee which was fine by us since the bottle I bought was a $30 bottle!

Overall I had an amazing experience here and I can't wait to come back to try their pastas or meatballs which is what our server raved about! He also told us they are opening up a Wine Bar next door, which I think would make a great addition to this place. I'm excited to come back here again soon! Thanks for a delicious experience MIZZA!
name: Stephanie

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. For a busy night they handled it okay. Food was good and came out fast. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Decided giving it another try because there was a great deal on GrubHub. It is safe to say I still don't like their burritos. I think the main reason is that it seems like they mix everything together before putting it in the tortilla. What you end up with is a very dense burrito with a mushy texture start to finish.  I want to like Heffe, but it just doesn't do it for me.
name: Stephen

text: Food is pricey and they don't provide you a lot for what you pay for, real mad they took away the ping pong table. The beer is great though.
name: Jessica

text:
It is located inside Hotel Monteleone. Pricey. Not kids friendly at all. No menu for little ones. Food was great though.

We had their crab cakes and their jumbo shrimp avocado appetizers which were yummy. Had their mix spring salad with caramelized walnuts and it was one of the best salads I've ever had.

Dessert menu was ok. Flourless chocolate cake was a bit dry. Creme Brûlée was ok. 

Friendly staff. Great service.
name: Katie

text: Service is awesome and the staff is great. Always treat my young girls with patience and kindness. The rolls are unique and delicious.
name: Derwyn

text:
Came to Marsh house for a friends birthday brunch. I liked the atmosphere. We ordered a good amount of food, we weren't too impressed but I got the fried chicken and everyone liked that dish. Everyone else's dishes were just ok. Brussel sprouts were very salty, the "come sail away tower" which was a bit of everything- was ok. We didn't care for anything in the top tower cause it was a bit fishy, we liked the oysters but the shrimp was salty. 
Another thing I wasn't too pleased with is that we were all ordering mimosas and later I saw that they had bottomless champagne, I wish our server would have mentioned it to us earlier. So I ordered that as well and our server said "you can get that but you still have to pay for your mimosas" what made her think we weren't going to pay? That rubbed me the wrong way. But everyone else was very pleasant and helpful. They knew we were celebrating a birthday so they brought out the firework candle for our cake.

text: This is s great restaurant. Food is great. People working are very friendly. Bathroom is so clean!!  Seating is such that it is very quiet so you can hear your conversations

text: Don't. Even. Bother. Weird vibe. Food tasted good but the experience was far less than we expected from other Himalayan restaurants we've been to. "Vegetable" dishes contained only corn, lima beans, peas & carrots. White rice is unlimited.  The owner was our waiter, repeatedly insisting that we buy more items from the menu which we politely declined.  When the cheque came he began talking about extravagant tippers & ppl who tip too little. It was weird & uncomfortable.

text: a little run-down on the outside, but great atmosphere inside and good food.  The scrapple was great. Portions were large.   A old-school experience.

text: Best tap menu in the area, cool vibe, wonderful neighborhood joint with good food, juicy tender burger. Parking can be rough but worth it.

text: The atmosphere is bright, cheerful and trendy. We ordered the chicken tacos, fish tacos and chicken enchiladas. The tacos are the soft flour type. All three dishes were attractive and tasty. The chicken tacos were a small portion but the other two dishes were ample. There were no leftovers. Service was amazingly quick. We ordered churros for dessert. One order was enough for the three of us. They were OK. Next time I would order a variety of tacos to share.

text: This place  got extensive selection of Thai food and sushi. I was there for lunch so I got one  free egg roll.  I ordered a Thai milk tea Boba. It tasted okay.  I had combo # 2 that included Pad si Ew stir-fry noodle , California roll,  salmon sushi and tuna sushi , ginger salad. The food tasted Ok. The portion was big.  The sushi rice was a bit too wet and too soft for me. The service was good. The ambient was OK. I agreed with yelp's 3 and 1/2 stars. For the good pricing and the wide selection of menu items, I rounded it up to 4.

text: Where to start... The service is wonderful and fast.  The food was a great portion and so yummy.  The blackberry cobbler was delicious.  A great place to grab a quick to-go meal.  Can't wait to go get a bottle of the white sauce.

text: Food was good and came out fast. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.

text: Stopped by and stood by the door waiting to be acknowledged  and we were ignored. Customers inside saw us but staff was too busy to acknowledge  us.

text: Portions were generous and presentation was nice. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. text: Loved the food and atmosphere. Service was spot on. We hope to go back again before we leave the island.

text: Pretty good fairly inexpensive pizza. The staff is always nice and helpful! However the pizza is always inconsistently cooked- sometimes it's cooked just right and half the time the cheese is burnt- bummer. I usually carry out but delivery is also very prompt/expedient. Definitely a solid choice for carry-out/ delivery pizza in midtown.

text: For the price I expected more than this. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. A couple small things kept adding up. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..

text: We went to Bimini Steakhouse for our 25th Wedding anniversary and had a very nice dinner experience.  Our service was exceptional, the food was also excellent, and the atmosphere was very enjoyable.  We look forward to going back again soon!

text: I ordered barbacoa and lengua tacos. I have to say they were pretty tasteless. First off they both tasted the same, so maybe there was a problem in translation, but I don't think so. It was basically shredded beef with some bland red sauce. The saving grace was the salsa that came out afterwards. I had to question it when the staff brought it out because it looked like white mayonnaise sauce. But it was delicious, and really hot. My partner ordered the steak plate. That dish was really good. Flavorful rice and beans, marinated thinly sliced steak, and fresh tacos.

text: it doesn't get any better than this place!!! wow wow wow!!!! this restaurant is run by just one guy and it's pretty small so seating is limited but we've never had bbq so good, i couldn't believe the quality of the food!  don't be fooled by the exterior and the location, neither are very good but this place is hidden gem of reno!

text: The ambience was very cute and laid back. The waitresses were very nice and could always be found. This place has the homey feeling. You can sit at the counter if you want and watch your food be made. They also have great outdoor seating. The food wasn't anything special but the atmosphere is the reason to go!

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was good and came out fast.

It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Overall, a strong experience. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For a busy night they handled it okay. text: For the price I expected a little more care. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. For a busy night they handled it okay. Price felt a touch high for what it was. text: I get Louis Pappas all the time at TPA and they are the fastest and kindest service in Concourse C. Thank you for doing such a great job!!
name: Stan

text:
Wow, this was pretty good on both the cajun and the BBQ end.  I didn't have much time, so I phoned in a to go order and told them when I'd be there.  When I arrived, they were just bagging it up - like they said they would time it so it'd still be hot.  The young man doing all this was very pleasant.

Gumbo had a nice thick roux with a fairly dense flavor.  The mix of seafoods were generous, and there was a small amount of rice packaged separately that kept it from getting soggy/bloated until I wanted to mix and eat it.  It also came with a piece of corn bread that must have been about a quarter butter.  Yum!

Smoked wings were pretty incredible.  A flavorful dry rub gave an immediate experience when you bit in, and the meat was juicy and smokey.

Cochon de lait po 'oby is basically a confit BBQ pork sandwich, but with a spicy sauce and a (dry) slaw on the bun.  It had a pretty good taste, but I was a bit disappointed with the volume of meat.  I could have used double what came on it.  Chips that came with the order appeared to be home made, and had a nice crispy, spiced tased.
name: Doug

text: Great food & service! Some of the best Mexican food I've found in Reno. Not to mention the margaritas, which are really good too.
name: Bree

text: This is more of a warning than a review.  In an attempt to patronize local businesses we went to Bellevue Diner on a Sunday morning at approximately 10:00. We were seated  and greeted about fifteen minutes later. The food server was pleasant and took our order. In a small restaurant, turning of tables during the rush is important.  We saw tables with stacks of plates while patrons were still sitting there, we saw tables sat who went unnoticed, drinks empty at tables with patrons,  for significantly long periods of time.  In a full restaurant , maybe 15 tables at this place, the "host" should be checking on guests, refilling drinks, running food, busing tables, etc... Not sure anyone except Angel, the waitress, knew they were in the middle of a rush. Angel was doing all of it, cashier, food server, serving of food, etc....despite their being two other floor employees. After thirty minutes we asked one of the employees to check on our food, he returned to say "five minutes".  10 minutes later when our food arrived, it was not our food. The only connection to our food that was on those plates were the eggs-scrambled not over medium. That was it. 45 minutes after arrival we tipped our server, asked to pay the bill and walked.  Cannot remember the last time I have felt so frustrated in a restaurant that I walked. 12 minutes later we had hot coffee, toasted bagels, a bagel sandwich and a side of bacon sitting in front of us at City Limits, also local.  Now that I think of it, Angel was the only star there, some other restaurant in Bellevue is gonna be lucky to have her.
name: Jim

text: Those dry rub ribs, though!!! try to get a reservation if possible because they sell out of food.  Literally, this was my favorite bbq in Nashville and the ribs were so so bomb.  Baked beans deserve an applause too.  We had a 9:15p reservation and showed up and were told they only had wings.  Then we said we had a reservation and they sent us upstairs where we could pick from the whole menu.  I would definitely recommend this place to any friends and family visiting Nashville.

text: I love Olive Garden and come here all the time. I placed a to go order online and ordered the fettuccine Alfredo and a salad and breadsticks. When I walked in I was told my order was on the way, even though I placed the order at about 9:30 and to pick up at 10:20. I waited 15 minutes for someone to give me my order. When I got home I opened my food and my Alfredo was cold and so were my breadsticks and they also only gave me two. I thought it was at least 3 that they gave you. I'm not the type to go on a rant but this annoyed me.

text:
If you are looking for bad attitudes coupled with poor unchecked, service the waitstaff here will not disappoint. 

No one manning the hostess stand, vacant and zero recognition for 10 minutes.

Sat myself and waited another 10.
Ordered skillet queso and left after 25 minutes with no food. 

Rarely was more than a single waitress on the floor although at leasting were working.

Lady beside me ask for her check and received attitude and no help. 

Usually you have to go to the post office to receive this type of service

text:
Pretty disappointed in my experience at Fiore's. I came here seeking a dozen everything bagels. I walked in on a rainy Saturday morning around 11am. I was told by the young man at the counter that they only had a few everything left. I figured that made sense since it was later in the morning on the weekend. He was even nice enough to go in the back and check for more but to no avail. Anyway, I ordered an assortment of other bagels including sesame, poppy, and plain to go. 

Once we got home and were ready to take a bite, we noticed that the bagel was hard. And not just this one bagel, but every bagel was hard as a rock. This was pretty upsetting, especially since the name bagel is right in their title. The only reason, I don't give one star is due to the friendly service. Next time, I'm craving a good bagel, I will drive the extra 10 minutes to Sharky's.

text: Food had no taste, I was amazed because it had such good reviews...  however, they did make a killer Bloody Mary.

text: After waiting for 45 minutes in a line that moved like thick molasses, they ran out of brisket the order before us. We'd been counting on the brisket as they'd already run out of ribs, our first choice, well before that. After all that they didn't offer us any compensation. I understand if you're so popular that you run out of food and that restaurants have off nights, but can we have a little southern hospitality? As we expressed our disappointment, the woman at the register just stared at us blank faced like, "so what do you want already? ". No recommendations. No apology but she did say that we'd get our food in About 10 minutes because "everything is ready". Also concerning. And then we waited and waited and waited. Meanwhile, as we'd seen the entire time we stood in line, order after order piled up on the warming shelf. The workers moved pretty slowly to deliver food given the pandemonium with the customers. After more than 45 minutes we were now late to the show we had tickets for and asked for a refund. They agreed but only gave us a partial refund. WTH?? Very very disappointing evening.  On the plus side, the bartenders were really nice and helpful!

text: Delicious and healthy! The broccoli and the sweet potato hummus were awesome. Quick and easy to do take out as well. Staff was also friendly and helpful. I will definitely be back!

The driver notified me when he arrived at the hotel making it more efficient for me. I recommend this Papa John's location to anyone in search of some incredible food!

text:
In my husband's words it feels like we "travelled to Paris without even leaving California." Super cheesy I know, but also accurate! We stopped at Bree'osh on our way out of SB and it was fantastic! We were between a quick bite here and a sit down breakfast at Scarlet Begonia. Well I don't know how Scarlet Begonia would have been, but we are definitely happy with our choice! 

Bree'osh is a cute little cafe/bakery with a counter that you order at and a few seats indoors and out. We opted for a semi-shaded outdoor spot and waited for our food and coffees.

Within just a few minutes we were brought a hot quiche Loraine, egg and bacon sandwich, and an almond chocolate croissant to share as well as two americanos. Bill came out to about $40

The quiche was fantastic. I'd venture to say best I've ever had. Super light, fluffy, fresh eggs inside and a light, buttery, flaky crust. The meat inside added the perfect amount of salt. My husband enjoyed his sandwich as well, but when I let him try my quiche he said he almost wish he would have gotten that too. We decided to save the chocolate croissant for a mid road trip snack, so I still have that to look forward to.

Overall excellent experience and a way to leave SB on a high note. Too bad we love too far to make another visit! Highly recommend if you're in SB!!
name: Tiffany

text: Excellent place. Really fun vibe! If you like Reubens theirs is great! Ask for their horseradish!

text: We found this place on Uber eats. We love Italian food so jumped at the opportunity to try a new place. We ordered 2 chicken parmigiana with pasta & house salad. We also ordered a buffalo chicken sandwich. First off, bread was thrown in the bag loosely! It was being picked up for a delivery & they did not even wrap it. The salads were very sad looking. Basically a small handful of bagged salad mix. Then the salad dressing was basically red wine vinegar. It didn't have much of anything else in it. The chicken was decent & well cooked. The spaghetti sauce was just ok. The pasta was actually linguine noodles with red pasta sauce on it. They failed to bake cheese onto the chicken like a normal chicken parm dish. The buffalo chicken sandwich was different but very good. It was $11 and was a sandwich only. It was a good size sandwich served on a sub roll or Italian bread. It was cut up on the bread. The one thing that was bad was they cost it in mayonnaise! I'm not sure why mayo is on a  buffalo sandwich but it was. We actually noticed this on the description and put in the notes for our order NO MAYO! I guess they couldn't read that because it was still covered in mayo. Well, we tried it. We probably would not order again but at least we know now. If you like home cooked, well seasoned Italian food, this is NOT the place for you. Try another restaurant.
name: Jennifer

text:
Calvin Fletcher's was recently recommended to me by a friend, and I'm so disappointed that I've spent over 3/4 of my college career without making this my prime study spot.

Perfect location for getting work done or meeting up with friends. Calvin Fletcher's has some of the best prices I've seen around the city, while also keeping quality extremely high. During my first visit, the employees were extremely personable, friendly, and also provided recommendations for me. I ended up trying the ham and cheese croissant and the Calvin Pepper which were both amazing.

The space is enormous and has a great vibe to it. There is plenty of seating, as well as books and games around as well. All the people I encountered there were extremely friendly and this atmosphere truly enhanced my experience! I could spend hours upon hours in Calvin Fletcher's.

I can't wait 'til I have an opportunity to go back!

text: First of all this is one of the best wing places in all Reno. Also the staff is always friendly and nice. Robert Sweetin is always here when we come and is always giving his best customer service. Because of this I will never go anywhere else for wings. Not to mention the wings are amazing.

I loved the onions; as they melted into the soup, they added a special boost of flavor. I really enjoyed this dish from first taste to the last drop.

text: If you're considering somewhere to eat, I'd say stay away from here. Tried it twice in the last 6 months and both visits were disappointing. The last time we stopped in was for dinner. We were seated right as the place was not busy at all. We sat at our table for 18 minutes without a single person even recognizing us or saying they'd be with us soon. We ended up walking out.

text:
Super hipster vibes in this joint which is no surprise as it is located in the heart of fishtown. Top notch service! They were so friendly and attentive. My server even rushed over with chopsticks when I dropped one. 

We ordered the Burmese sesame noodles and the khao poon. Learn from my mistake and immediately take the pickled ginger out of the Burmese sesame noodles and if you are in the mood for pho skip the khao poon. 

Burmese sesame noodles were very good and would have been excellent if I didn't have to endure little bursts of pickled ginger throughout the meal. 

Khao poon is absolutely terrible. Soupy curry noodles should not be allowed to be a thing. I'm not sure why people rave about this. 

Although the khao poon was an absolute letdown I will acknowledge that it was still very well made and the flavor profile was very in depth and interesting. I guess it is my own fault for assuming it would be anything like pho. 

I will be back to try the bahn mi and chicken pho. I have a good feeling about those and I am really excited to come back.
name: Kyle

text: This is my favorite Thai place ever! Dining in or carrying out, it is sooo good! I like to mix the mild and medium spice level for just the right amount of heat. They give you so much food for the price and the spring rolls are amazing! I can't say enough good things about Thai Kitchen!

text: Amazing food, environment and staff! Thanks!!! Will be returning very soon! Chicken enchiladas with verde sauce was outstanding and the churro bowl was delicious!
name: Annie

text:
Brown Bag Bistro, you're simply delicious. I will admit, I am sort of a snob and prefer table service over ordering at the counter. However, your friendly cashiers made it such an enjoyable ordering experience. They created a casual conversation and I didn't even feel like I was ordering. Next thing I knew, I had a table marker and was heading back to my table. 

When dining at a sandwich shoppe, my go to is either a Pastrami on Rye or a traditional Reuben. If a deli/sandwich shoppe can master these two, they've got my patronage. BBB won my support with their Sammy Roo. Sammy Roo is a fancy creative name for a Reuben. Plain and simple, it was, Yummy! Their sliced corned beef, was topped with Gruyere Swiss, a sauerkraut mix with special house Reuben sauce is all stuffed between two slices of grilled marble rye bread. The bread was grilled perfectly, it still had a firmness and crunch. So many Reuben's get soaked from all the sauerkraut and sauce, but not here. 

My cousin who was one of my dining partners got the Rosie Roo. The menu claims it's Sammy's Mrs. It was a Reuben made with turkey, sharp cheddar, a coleslaw mix with a house Reuben sauce served on the same Marble Rye bread. We didn't share bites, but she said it was amazingly good and I take her word. 

My cuz had a friend join us. Well to be truthful, I heard where they were going for lunch and I was the luncheon crasher. Any way, her friend had the Bistro Club. It was huge, how anyone could get their mouth open wide enough to take a bite would surprise me. It was made with the typical club ingredients, all stacked inside a Ciabatta Sandwich Roll. 
What set this Club Sammie above others was the roll and their house cranberry aioli. 

They have a variety of "Bistro Beginnings", which I am sure will be extremely popular once they start having live bands on the outdoor patio. Being a fan of pretzels, I had to give theirs a try. The order came with four huge soft pretzel sticks served warm with two dips.  Normally, I favor a beer cheese, but the honey mustard here had me wanting to double dip. 

For those who need adult beverages, no need to fret. They've got you taken care of. They're offerings may only be craft beer and wine, but you'll be pleased to know that many of them are locally made. 

I'll be back? - Looking forward to patio dining. 

When: April 17, 2018
Why: Lunch with a cousin
name: Steven

text: Delicious! We ordered the mixed grilled meats platter and a salad to share. It was a simple enough dish (grilled meats, bread, onions, tomatoes, sour cream) but it was beautifully seasoned and really really good. The owner/chef was incredibly nice. I will definitely be back as there is more I'd love to try. You should check it out too. Two thumbs up!

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The music was louder than it needed to be. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I left full, which at least counts for something. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.

text: I've heard a lot about Morrow's over the past year and decided to check it out during a weeklong business trip in New Orleans. Out of the 7 days I was in NO, I spent 3 at Morrow's. The food, the atmosphere, and the staff are great! I went twice for happy hour and once for dinner.  All three times I went, I either personally ordered or had a colleague order the Seafood Delight pasta and the Oysters Morrow.  It's by far my favorite thing on the menu. The mac and cheese is a hit as well. Leia was our bartender 2/3 of the times and she was so patient with us. She had great conversation and told us all her favs on the menu. She was also great at making the cocktails.

text: The bartender Bobby 2 Times made our evening an experience to remember. Don't know what you want to drink? He will create you a one of a kind beverage. Great time! Will be back.
