The coffee is good, that's the most important reminder for myself. It doesn't matter how good the Hispanic breakfast is if the coffee is watered down alley dirt.  I'm looking right at you breakfast places I no longer will step inside because they cheeped out on the simplest of beverages. 

The service was super friendly and the food was good for a breakfast on the go that isn't full of saturated fat. Price was well worth the price. 

I find myself going back because of the sparsity of people in the morning, the music, the friendly service and good food are a welcome port from the hustle and bustle during the morning storm.
name: Nappy

text: Big disappointment. When a restaurant brags about it's "homemade pasta" I expect fresh, homemade pasta! That was not the case here. I ordered a special, porcini mushroom ravioli. I've had my fair share of mushroom ravioli, and I've had fresh homemade mushroom ravioli before. There is no way that ravioli was fresh. It tasted like store bought ravioli. And it was in a strange weak vodka sauce, which is not a sauce you should use for mushroom ravioli. It was $25! My boyfriend had the ricotta gnocchi, we've made ricotta gnocchi before and it should be delicate, light, and soft. The gnocchi tasted more like potato gnocchi, it was also in a super bland marinara sauce. I'm sorry, but marinara only belongs on pizza or as a dip for mozzarella sticks. Not worth the price at all. Our service was good, only positive aspect.
name: Karen

text: Very lovely and relaxing place to eat, with great food and amazing staff. Our waitress kerri was an extremely friendly and welcoming waitress, who went out of her way to make our visit great. Looking froward to coming back again soon.
name: Brit

text: FANTASTIC! I love thai cusine. Their food is outta this world and service is always on point.
name: Torri

text: First time to Thai Castle 2 Go. Very friendly service and warm welcome. Great price on lunch and dinner options. We ordered the shrimp pad thai (hot spice level) and the red curry with vegetables. Curry was okay/good and on the thin side; good flavor, not spicy. Pad Thai was good as well, and the spice level was just right for me (not incredibly Thai hot, but hot enough). Shrimp (extra charge) were medium sized and good. I had a Thai spring roll with my pad thai and it was a yummy little nugget. Will probably go back every once in a while due to the location and quick, friendly service.
name: Craig

text: I simply ordered a 6 pc combo and an extra cheese fry for my friend. I ordered online so I could get it fast because I needed to be back to class. I had to wait for the fries, no big deal. While I was waiting I decided to purchase extra ranch for 86 cents. I got my food and happily walked out. THEY FORGOT MY CHEESE FRIES AND MY EXTRA RANCH. FUCK YOU WING STOP NOW MY FRIEND IS HUNGRY AND I DON'T HAVE DIPPING SAUCE.
name: Addison

text: It's kind of a yuppie place inside a hotel that charges 10 dollars for some edamame pods but if you go during happy hour which lasts till about 6 all appetizers are half price so you can get what most people order which is the mini sliders (comes with two) and it comes out to a much more reasonable price. The food was good but I don't think it's worth the visit unless you planned on spending a lot or you're there for the special. If you're there though you should try the zucchini fries for 6.
name: Serena

text:
This property is absolutely gorgeous, the interior decor was New Orleans themed and perfectly themed for a getaway! Upon check in, the staff was very hospitable! 

Every evening the hotel serves gumbo, it is AMAZING! Don't leave without trying it!

It is also perfectly located in the heart of New Orleans and is walking distance from many attractions and restaurants!
name: Linda

text: Glad this place is here. It has great service, great prices, and great, moist fried chicken :)
name: Marissa

text: I've been to Pizzeria Vetri in Rittenhouse twice and have ordered take out multiple times through a 3rd party delivery service. Everything we've had is fantastic. It's pretty much the dream restaurant if you enjoy good food, don't want to burn a whole in your pocket, but also are looking to dine somewhere that provides ambiance and takes pride in the presentation and quality of your meal. They also have a fabulous happy hour, where you can eat Rotolo to your heart's content for cheap. I wouldn't do it justice to describe the Rotolo, but do yourself a favor and go try it. Oh and we tried a calzone the other night with prosciutto and ricotta, equally well executed! Service was great both times -- servers are knowledgeable of the food and beverage. Their Fairmount location is equally enjoyable.
name: Rebecca

text: This is without a doubt the best pizza I've ever had anywhere! The crust is always lightly crisp on the bottom but not tough. Toppings are generous and tasty. Never could figure out why it doesn't show up in the readers choice awards. But maybe it's better that way. They're busy enough as it is!
name: Ann

text: This place is a disgrace, food stinks and adult supervision is worse. Management has been a joke for 6 months.
name: Andrew

text: Great place for fresh seafood, good drinks, family gatherings, meeting old friends and making new ones. The nostalgic lakefront atmosphere and attentive service also make this place a great choice.
name: Julie

text: The wait is not as bad as you think! We got here on a Saturday afternoon around 1 and waited in line about 15 minutes, despite the line being easily 50 people deep. There is a ton of seating, so don't worry about finding a seat once inside. The staff were all so nice and attentive all throughout our meal. The food is incredible. It's basic southern food, but with a ton of flavor and everything is cooked to perfection.
name: Katie

text: Stopped in for a lunch with myself and four children. I expected it to be more costly than it was given their location but it was fairly reasonable for brunch. We ordered four children's meals including chocolate chip pancakes times two and two orders of mac and cheese with fruit. I had a corned beef hash scramble. It took a while for our food to be delivered and our waitress seemed to be in a hurry despite a nearly empty building. The mac and cheese meals were delivered 5 minutes after all the other meals and were cold. We asked for them to be reheated which took an additional 4 minutes. No refills were offered or brought until we were completely done eating, and even then we had to request them. We ordered extra toast as the kids meals were a little small for two of my older children. We had also finished eating before we received those. The variety was okay but the food was very Bland. Given all the options in the area for dining, I won't be returning
name: Breon

text: I have lived here for almost one year now and this is the place I come back the most. My wife and I finally strayed away from the individual dishes and finally delved into what EVERYONE  goes there for...the seafood. Of course we had to have the summer rolls for their huge fresh flavor. We ordered the pound of shrimp, mussels with a side of potatoes, sausage and corn. We had to do the traditional casian seasoning. The platter was marinating/bathing within the seasoning as we opened the bag to the treasure of goods. The experience was truly amazing and I know why people drop everything for the seafood!
name: Phil

text: I would have liked to have tried this restaurant, but they don't honor wait times or the order of your names on the list. Our table was given away by people that just show up so don't trust what they quote you at the door. The owner was very unfriendly and unapologetic towards us as we had already explained that we had somewhere to be and what we were told. She argued over 2 minutes.
name: Terri

text: Delicious muffalettas! Seriously, after a week of mostly delicious meals here in NOLA, this was my favorite. Also had the Englishman's Pimms which was refreshing and delightful. Highly recommend.
name: Gillah

text: If you want really great Mexican food and authentic  atmosphere go to Casa Molina's on Speedway just west of Wilmot . Jorge was an excellent server and the lunch specials are a good price and you get LOTS of food. The margaritas are tasty and you get a buzz unlike so many other places. My husband was born in Tucson and loves Mexican food. Their salsa is some of the best in town. Give it a try . I'm sure you will enjoy the experience, food and service. There are several Casa Molina's in town but the best is Speedway Wilmot location. We have not been disappointed. Stay cool and have a margarita or two.
name: Trish

text: I love Garbonzo's Pizza! This location is just as good as the Caldwell location! I ordered a small pizza this time and I was so happy that the toppings were just as plentiful! The staff was friendly! I ordered for dine in and had the place to myself. I noticed a sign outside that said "Pizza buffet lunch special $7.50(?) with drink. My cashier was really great about up selling. She almost convinced me to grab dessert to take home, apparently there is money bread for dessert! I can't wait to go back!
name: Stephanie

text:
First off, the egg soup has corn in it and I mean a lot. It smelled like I opened a can of creamed corn and was completely unappealing. I've never seen corn in a Chinese dish before, let alone the egg drop/flower soup, so it took me by surprise. Unfortunately I don't eat corn so I can't tell you if it tasted any good. It's too bad they don't describe what you're getting at all on the menu and then I wouldn't have ordered it. 
Went for lunch and ordered the Moo Goo Gai Pan. The portion was really small compared to every other Chinese restaurant I've ever been to and the flavor was not great. It was just so-so. Service was fine. I would not recommend this establishment and wouldn't bother giving it a second try.
name: Elisabeth

text: I really wanted this place to be a five star establishment based upon reviews I've seen. This place relies heavily on their portions for hype because the food is average. I had a platter with grouper and shrimp, it was edible, but nothing I'd come running back for. I think the biggest problem for me was that they were out of their special sauces and only had ketchup and tartar sauce to offer at the time. I think if they'd had a bit of their po'boy sauce, it may have made a big difference.
name: Jamesa

text: Charley's is my guilty pleasure when I'm shopping at the mall. I hate frequenting chain restaurants when there are so many local options but let's be honest there aren't that many choices in the mall food court. I first tried Charley's from a sample handed out at the mall and was really surprised how good it was. Their chicken California is what they're always sampling and it's the only thing I ever get. It has fresh grilled chicken with cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, and ranch dressing. They offer fries on the side with a variety of toppings. I usually get cheese fries which are made hot and fresh when you order. On the weekend for lunch they usually have a pretty big line but if you're resorting to eating at the mall it's worth the wait.
name: Haley

text:
Ordered 2 salads and quesadilla.  The salads hardly have any meat in it that would validate a $10 salad.  Decent salads, not the best I've ever had, my wife felt the same, disappointed.  On a positive side it is a very chic place inside and the Quesadillas were awesome.  

Overall average, but would give it another shot.
name: Davy

text: This place was one of our go to places to eat dinner once a week, went last Thursday got a different server ordered are normal two beer two chicken soft tacos small cheese dip.. it's easy it's quick.. food came out all beef I asked to have it fixed while waiting 10 min my food was cold I had to go to the kitchen to get someone to tell me mess ups are not a priority over food coming out.. WHAT??? Wanted to talk to the manager and she was on the phone the whole time and couldn't talk. Cashier took a 1.99 off our check that still doesn't cover there mess up.. cashier said we will see you again right.. No Thanks we won't return.
name: Andrew

text: Great food and margaritas. Even better customer service. This is a local family owned restaurant that hosts an excellent party of 12 like we had. We will be back for sure! Thank you Jose and the El Fuego team!
name: Reagan

text: This place is special. I love fried chicken and this is one of the best I've tried in the northeast. GO!
name: Kevin

text: The food was horrible. I ordered a 1/4 chicken meal, white meat. I was charged extra for white meat. When I got home, the breast, if you could call it that, had barely any meat on it. It looked like I got half a toad instead. Disgusting.
name: Cheryl

text: Amazing food, friendly customer service, and they have a super cute patio!!! Been wanting to try this place for a while, so glad I did and can't wait to go back! I got the beyond burger (vegan plant based burger) and fries and it was so tasty and fresh!!! New fav burger spot (:
name: Meg

text:
Love the ambiance here - clean, high ceilings and definitely the 'farmhouse' vibe you'd expect. We went on a Sunday for brunch w reservations and was shocked it was empty (maybe because of the rain?) either way we lucked out to be seated right away.

The French press coffee was probably the best coffee i have ever had, I would travel from CT to TN just for another cup!

I had the quiche special which was a very generous portion & delicious!! The fruit was so fresh you could taste the difference.
name: Lindsay

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Pretty happy with it overall. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Let me start by saying the food and service was awesome! I love supporting small businesses and it's even better when the food is reasonably priced and good! I had the El Plato and my friend had the Torta! I can't wait to come back and try the other items on your menu!
name: Sherice

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text:
Thank goodness i bought a groupon coupon for this place. Saddest burrito I've had in a while--absolutely no flavor. Also the tacos had no flavor. 
The bar is a bar. I will never come back.
name: Erich

text:
First off, kudos to Boon C. for his review of Pastries N Chaat, which compelled me to bring our party of five here for dinner.

Street food is always a compelling proposition - and as such, we isolated the truly "street food" items (Chaat) and ordered from there.  

We ordered all four Puris, the Samosa, the Papdi, as well as Apollo Fish, Goat Sukha, and Goat Curry.

I confess to be completely inexperienced in a non-buffet Indian restaurant.  For years, I've regularly avoided Indian for dinner because often it is not a buffet.  Here, we took the plunge and had zero regrets.

The array of desserts were a big plus of the sweet-toothed of our party - and we ordered one of each item in the display.  Yes, a gluttonous affair, but one that had to be done.

Thanks again, Boon C. for your diligence in covering Tampa - and plenty of other communities as well!
name: Daniel

text: Had been a fan of Mikes for years, both locations however after a bad experience and two hour delivery, I was told I had a credit on my account for my next order. Tried to order yesterday and of course they said there was no credit. Even after explaining what occurred and told them about the conversation i had with the manager that night, they would not honor the credit. HORRIBLE customer service, horrible delivery times. Do no tell someone 45 minutes and then not honor what a manager says after a two hour wait. The food is not that good! Will never be back and it is a shame!
name: P

text: This is one of our favorite Thai restaurants! Summer rolls are great, also my favorite place to get Pho! The sticky rice with custard is fantastic too.
name: Elizabeth

text:
Tonight was my first time to Grbic. It's a little off the beaten path, so I'd never heard of it. If it weren't for Sarah coordinating a little ISC action, I don't know that I would've tried it. 

Tonight I started out with their house Pinot Noir. It was yummy and did the trick. Best part, it was only $6. 

Before our meals, Julia R and I shared the Grbic salad - it was a bed of chopped feta, tomatoes, and lettuce tossed in their house made Greek dressing. Refreshing and delicious. 

Chicken cordon blue and the chicken roulden were our meal choices and they were both great choices. Chicken was tender and all white meat. The skin was perfectly cooked. On the roulden, there was melted feta and spinach stuffing and in the cordon blue creamy cheeses and ham. They were both delicious. 

We were too full for dessert, but they had some tasty options I look forward to saving room for next time I'm in!
name: Max

text: First time going to a Top Golf ever. Came from Louisville KY to Nashville for a concert at the Cowan then came and did Top Golf the next day. Since me and my boyfriend went before noon, it was only $25 for an hour. But we also had to pay a membership fee for both of us, so it ended up being about $37 or $38 with tax included. It was really fun and I didn't know there were so many different game modes you could play. We just stuck to the original one lol. The lady who helped us get started was us was amazing and funny. I forget her name, but I know it started with an A. Would definitely come back if we ever needed to come to Nashville again.
name: Leah

text:
Solid burritos -- especially the steak.  I went super plain with avocado, sour cream, rice and cheese.  For some reason my wife doesn't do beans and rice in burritos -- it's one of the other for some reason.  

So much good Mexican food in Santa Barbara / Goleta.  Just came back from Hawaii where great Mexican food is almost nowhere to be found -- kinda like NYC.
name: James

text:
We enjoyed a sunny then soggy lunch at this location on a Saturday. When we arrived, it was beautiful weather so we sat on the patio at an umbrella-covered high top. We really enjoy waterfront dining and this fits the bill until the rain rolls in as it typically does in Florida.
We shared the grilled chicken cobb salad and the crab & avocado stack -- both were presented beautifully and tasted wonderfully fresh. Once the rain really started coming down, we scarfed down the rest of our lunch and then moved to the covered bar to continue listening to the live entertainment. Unfortunately, the musician played a very short set, took an extended break and didn't return so we finished our drinks and headed out.
When we're back in the Tampa area, we'd definitely return for the outdoor, waterfront dining and live entertainment. We'll just keep our fingers crossed for great weather and engaging live entertainment!
name: Kristine

text: Wow what a gem ! I didn't get a picture that does it justice. There was a short line that moved very quickly. The service is prompt and friendly. Food is hot, hearty, and very reasonably priced.
name: David

text: Best Sushi we have every had!! And everything else we ordered was hands down amazing!!! So much flavor and hospitality! Can't wait to go back :)
name: Sole

text: Ordered beef brisket and pulled pork. Both were moist and delicious. Sweet fries and Cole slaw wee also good. Restaurant was clean and staff was friendly
name: Alicia

text: Went here for Thanksgiving because I couldn't go home. The experience took the homesickness away. My waitress Angelina was super friendly. Nice furnishings, love the music. Food was pretty good. Im going to try to eat lunch here sometime.
name: Joy

text: Great food and great service! I came here on a Monday night and had a great time. We shared a bottle of Chianti and both had pasta dishes. All of their pasta sauces are made on site and you can tell!  I ordered a pasta dish that came with chicken and had a creamy sauce and it was amazing. I def will come back again to try the pizzas!
name: Anj

text: Big mall to walk those miles. Was looking for western wear and boot and bling belts. A couple of stores fill the bill here at this mall. Boot barn had the most as far as selections and styles. The boot outlet was buy 1 get 2 free on boots but prices for 1 would cover three pair. But to each his own. Several stores are called the outlet. Like Old Navy, VF, Levi. There is a big Bass Pro Shops and Rain-tree Forrest restaurant, Chili's, Friday's and etc. I could only imagine the deals during the after Christmas sales.
name: Goldie

text: The hubs and I were going out in CWE and decided to grab dinner before hand. There is another sushi spot that we like but at the last minute, decided to check this out instead and I am SO glad we did! Starting with the food, everything was amazing. We had edamame, gyoza, sashimi, St. Louis roll and two pieces of smoked octopus that the server suggested. It was just all so. good. If you like sashimi, don't skip it. Big pieces of fresh fish with a few perfectly pickled veggies along side it. It's a really small space but we easily got a spot at the bar and the service was excellent. The sushi chef behind the bar answered our questions and the server was attentive but not over the top and he suggested some pretty amazing smoked octopus! If it all was enough, it was really reasonable. Dinner + drinks + tip for less than $80! We'll be back!
name: Olivia

text: My colleagues and I were in New Orleans for a congress and were craving Italian food. Based on reviews and their ability to still make a reservation for a party of 7 the same day, we ended up at this restaurant. We were all pleasantly surprised by the nice interior. The staff was friendly as well, but the star of the evening was the food. We had a cheese and charcuterie platter to share, which was filled with yummy things. We all had different pastas and cocktails, all or which were very good. Would definitely recommend eating here if you are in the neighbourhood. And if not, make a detour!
name: Chloë

text: I really liked this place, and if I am ever in St. Louis again, I would definitely come back for brunch. My friends invited me here after raving about their Bloody Mary bar, that they said could be a meal in itself. My friends waited about 20 minutes for a table, arriving before us. The restaurant was fairly crowded, but our server was really on top of everything. After taking a look at the very extensive offerings on the bar, I decided to just get egg whites and gluten free toast and to make my own scramble. They truly have everything that you can think of to add to your bloody mary's (I love them, but no longer drink them due to the acidity). And then a quite a few things that I wouldn't--candy, fruit, cookies! I think it was just to give more offerings to eat separately. They also had a nice selection of juices - orange, pineapple, grapefruit, cranberry...and peach! I've never heard of people drinking peach juice so that's what both my friend and I chose and we loved it. I choose what I thought was salsa--tasted like a tomato relish, cheese, hearts of palm (wasn't sure what was in the glass, but tried it and liked it!), tomato, bacon, and pico de gallo. It was really good! I also got a plate of sweet items and they were good. And, ok, SEVERAL plates of VERY crispy bacon that were excellent (though a little chewy). I tried my boyfriend's french toast and it was really good too. And I also tried my friend's hash and really liked it. All-in-all, I really thought it was a great dining experience!
name: Sarah

text: This is easily the worst BWW I've ever been to. I gave them the benefit of the doubt after seeing the Yelp reviews, knowing that typically chains don't get the best reviews. But this was seriously an all-around horrible experience. The waitress only stopped by the table 3 times: to take our order, to drop off our order, and to give us the check. We ordered some street tacos, for appetizers, but did not receive them until the wings came. The tacos were cold, and the wings seemed to be done very mediocrely. I'd understand if the place was packed, but there were maybe 3 other tables with parties in them, so there were no excuses. If you are craving wings, I definitely don't recommend coming here.
name: Abraham

text: My daughter dragged me here to get Pho. I didnt know what that was but Im so happy I got to find out. We went during a snowy hail storm as I kept asking myself if this Pho was worth the scary drive. It WAS worth it. We ordered Tofu Pho and pork dumplings to go and both were amazingly good. The base for Pho came separately from tofu and veggies, which was great as we could pick out what to put in our own Pho. It tasted so healthy and fresh that I cant wait to have some more soon. The person helping with out order was super sweet. He was telling my daughter about all the sauces that can be used with Pho. He gave samples and just chatted with her. Overall, this place is a hit for me. Their Pho is a hit for me. Decently priced, this is a must for people in the area.
name: Veeka

text:
19OCT2019 ((SATURDAY)) @ 1345 ((1:45 PM))
EMPLOYEE: REBECCA

Whoever the manager is of this papa johns store - and the other papa johns store that Rebecca usually works at - - - This employee needs a promotion, or at least a HUGE raise with accolades!! She is a WONDERFUL employee, FRIENDLY, CARING, KNOWLEDGEABLE about everything on the menu- this lady is awesomely amazing! She is definitely a gem. Great customer service- excellent attitude- i just had a very nice experience ordering pizza with Rebecca. Who says that! LOL  I truly did!
name: M.

text: We stayed here for two nights and spent $400 a night per room. We had seen their website and figured they were good. We paid for the rooms months in advance (we rented two rooms) and they put everyone at completely different ends of the hotel and told us there was nothing available close to each other and there would be nothing the next day... fine whatever. We got to one of our rooms and it was hot so we called the "engineer" up to check the a/c which he said we didn't turn on properly so we said okay and hoped it would cool off and we went out for the evening. Wrong. We get back and it's 86 in the room so we call the front desk and there is absolutely nothing they can do for us and that there would be no rooms available the next day but that they would send an engineer in the morning... okay. 11am no one and showed we go down to the desk and I politely let the lady know that no one had been there to check the a/c and she gets an attitude and told us she's giving us a new room (even though we were told multiple times there were no extra rooms). Both rooms were absolutely disgusting, they do not properly clean these rooms the showers haven't been cleaned in years you can tell by all the soap scum and how discolored the grout was. The valet guy upon arrival was absolutely rude!! He kept throwing his hands in the air and making really rude unnecessary remarks because we weren't moving fast enough for him, want a tip? Lose the damn attitude!!! At one point he threw his hands in the air and was like "ohhh good god!". All because we weren't moving fast enough for him.. we never made a comment to him or had an attitude with him to deserve the treatment he gave us. And while he's rushing us to get our stuff he's rushing us to find out if our room is ready (wtf do you want I'm not two people I can't unload and go to the front desk at the same damn time) overall the whole group of us had a bad experience there and we've been to multiple hotels in New Orleans before and this was by far the worst!! I would recommend staying at the Omni, Rathbone Mansions, or the Marriott. This hotel does not deserve your money!! And on another note for grins and giggles we looked online to see if they had any rooms available because they said they didn't and they did we could book a room that night for half the price!! WTH!! So we slept in a hot room for no reason at all. Go somewhere that deserves your money because everyone here seemed to have a freaking attitude.
name: Stephanie

text: I really like this place and order take out from here often.  The woman who works at the register when you walk in is so nice and helpful.  The food is very good and well priced.  There is a medium sized seating area if you want to dine in and there generally isn't a wait.  I did dine in once with 5 people.  It was Sat night, i called and said we'd like to come right over.  The nice lady sounded a little concerned but she made it happen!  I always get the beef lo mein.  Good food, good prices, and good service!
name: Alisa

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. For a busy night they handled it okay. Idk, really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
I think this place has potential and I thought it was pretty good overall but nothing is calling me to come back anytime soon.

The best parts for me were the ambiance and the service. The decor and overall vibe were great. The service was very friendly and helpful.

What I didn't like was the price/portion ratio. The food was good/fine but not large enough portions or high enough quality for what they were charging. We also ordered a cheese platter which came with brie and honey and yet wasn't served with crackers or anything to put those on. We didn't even have a knife served to us. We were left wondering if we should spoon the brie into our mouths? It just seemed like the plate wasn't completely thought through.  I must say though that we asked for crackers and some were brought to us free of charge, which was nice.

All in all, I think Mosto Crudo is OK and has potential but I'm not planning to go back in the short term.
name: Sarah

text: Good solid sea food.  We ate on the patio next to heaters as the fog rolled in... ordered Ahi nachos- great!  Clam chowder- delicious , and the crab cakes.... crab cakes tasty and fresh /the lemon dressing on the slaw was bitter and sour   Excellent wait staff.  Manager came around and checked on us frequently !
name: Sharon

text: Ok so my husband was going on and on about this place and how good their burgers are. I finally decided to give it a chance and we went there for lunch one day. I must say I was happy that we did because their burgers are delicious. I always ask for mine well done. I can't eat it when it's still mooing and grazing. My burger was cooked perfectly. It was well done but was still moist. And the fries!!!!! So good. The place was very clean and the service was excellent. I definitely recommend this place and will go back if give the chance.
name: Cynthia

text:
It was a delicious and fantastic experience, takes me back to having dinner with family. 
They didn't stop bringing plates to the table so pace yourself, they don't take any of the food  plates back till everyone is done.

They the cinnamon rolls, I'm sure you will what two.

Eat up and Enjoy!
name: Paulina

text: Great Mexican brunch/lunch place in the garden district of New Orleans! I had the Carolina bbq taco and chipotle shrimp with a side of Mac and cheese. Also loved my strawberry margarita! Would definitely recommend if you are visiting the area.
name: Amanda

text: Waited over 30 minutes on slow evening for cold food. Second star is for the $1 chips and salsa. I should have just had that as my meal to avoid getting a stomach ache from the chorizo tacos later that night. I would not recommend this restaurant to a friend.
name: Corey

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. For a busy night they handled it okay. Honestly, the menu wasn't huge, which i usually prefer.. So yeah, we shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Idk, they were out of one thing i originally wanted.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. maybe I just came on an off day.
name: User

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Honestly, pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Anyway, i got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: My friend liked it more than I did. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Food was fresh and service was quick. Overall, a strong experience. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
I love the enthusiasm they have being the only place that makes St Louis style pizza in the Tampa Bay area! We had to try it and try it we did. However, I must admit I'm definitely not a fan. I won't be traveling to St Louis to get pizza with provel cheese now, or any time in the future. 

I would not hesitate to get some other variety here but I will stick with Italian, New York, New Haven or Detroit style pizza in the future.
name: Dave

text:
I come here a lot now normally morning time and enjoy it a lot 

Inside :
* Diner type place dose have booths to sit in 
* very friendly atmosphere 
* prices are amazing and you pay for what u get 
 I think prices are good 
* breakfast is always good they serve lunch as well 
  Can't complain I like what I pay for now parking is a pain no parking lot street parking
name: Liz

text:
*Manly morris meal 3.5/5
*Queen Maggie
*Bossbabe burger
*Jeremiah
*lake tacos 

-Manly Morris meal, eggs, bacon, toast, and biscuits and gravy. This was a fun meal because it had everything. The biscuits and gravy were we're pretty good but the rest was just so-so/average. 
-Queen Maggie strawberry and banana French toast was very good. Probably the best thing I eat at this restaurant! Definitely worth getting and a good portion size. soft, thick, moist and not too dry or chewy.
-The potatoes with onions was very good and crisp! Came out nice and crispy and warm with a nice layer of onions and cheese to hold it all together. 

waited too long to do the review so I don't have the most information. decent food but would not do this again
name: Noah

text: My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The staff seemed tired but still polite. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Worth checking out. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text:
I was rather impressed in a town full of Vietnamese restaurants to finally have found a Thai restaurant I can get behind. The menu is fairly impressive (though I wish they'd cut broccoli out of their mixed vegetables), and their apparent signature dish is Khao Soi, an aromatic curry noodle soup. It was fantastic, with excellent contrasting flavors. I might have to find myself some pickled mustard at one of Westbank's Asian markets. Being coconut-based, it was also quite filling. The menu offers the option to get it with glass noodles if you want it vegan, which I didn't do mostly out of carelessness.

The appetizer menu was better than typical as well, offering a dedicated vegetarian selection (why their appetizers are more clear about being vegetarian than their entrees I don't know, but the menu isn't as clear on the latter). The avocado rolls I sampled were again filling and came with a warm peanut sauce with a dollop of chili sauce which seems like a nice idea that other restaurants should offer.

I was a bit baffled by the parking situation in the neighborhood before I found a space right in front of the restaurant; signage is notoriously unhelpful around here. Inside, however, was a nice experience with a very modern and clean space. I might have asked for faster service, though to be fair they were pretty busy even on a Tuesday night with bad weather. I can see why.
name: John

text: East Nash is truly blessed to have Mitchell Deli. I've been coming here for at least 10 years and it's always been fantastic. There are so many hidden gems too. I don't wanna say anything about the smoked chicken cuz I don't want it to sell out before I get mine, but wow. And I'm from Alabama. They could start a business just making that. Yo Dave! Hit me up!! Let's change the wooooorrrrrrllllld!! See y'all probably tomorrow
name: Hugh

text: Nice breakfast place near the Convention Center. I had spicy sausage, toast, eggs, etc. It was great. Coffee was good. Plenty of cream, sugar, sugar substitutes, jellies, etc. available - sometimes these breakfast places skimp on that. Service was very good. Menu was small. If there were more options available it would easily be 5/5 stars. Portions were good.
name: Michael

text:
Update...

They have added more items to their buffet every day, and its all delicious! 

I work literally down the street. My co-workers talk about this place quite often. Late lunch, starving, wanted something quick and fast. The restaurant is pretty spacious, but the buffet area needs more space. It has good selections, just cramped in a corner. Love that fresh naan is dropped to our table. Everything was delicious! I'm not an Indian food connoisseur so I can't tell you if it's authentic or not. It was just good. And at $10 per person, that's a deal!
name: Anna

text: Ironically, Yelp reported this location as permanently closed. It probably should be. My family and I frequented La'Berry before we moved out of state for a couple of years. We just moved back and brought the kids for some froyo. Man, this place has gone downhill. The employee looked like he knew his employment had limited days. The store is run down. The ice cream freezer is empty. Stacks of tile on the floor randomly. Scores of lights burned out. Holes in the walls from things that were ripped out and not patched. But, the kids enjoyed the yogurt. So there's one star.
name: David

text:
We went to this restaurant unintentionally after the one we wanted to eat at had a huge line. 

The food is okay nothing stands out but we didn't have anything horrible either. Maybe it's a better place to have appetizers and beers then call it a night. 

I ordered the blackened chicken and had some shrimp to share. The chicken was super tiny probably 3 oz worth but it was seasoned okay.  

You're better off planning better as to not to end up at this place.
name: Nav

text: Very good bar food. No complaints and would gladly come here again. Surprised that the personal pizza had a good unique taste and not like a frozen pizza. Meatballs on the pizza especially good. Had the wings (spicy and garlic Parmesan) and they were very good and  just a little smaller than the Pic wings. I had the Patty Melt and would rank that as good as any one I ever had. Not a lot of tables so I'm sure it's busy during peak hours.
name: AJ

text:
Just happened to stop by at the Staples at that shopping center and went to Bravo pizza for lunch. Everything was made to order and everything we've ordered was sooo hot and fresh. We were very pleased in this spur of the moment lunch. 
We just didnt like the seating area, where we were sitting right next to the bathrooms. 
We had 2 strombolis, 1 grilled chicken hoagie, 1 cheesesteak hoagie and cheese fries. They were served in less than 10 minutes.
Now I wont drive there just for the food. If I happened to be in that area I will definitely come back.
name: Cat

text: The people here are always friendly, and make some awesome coffee. I usually go with an americano, or cappuccino, but sometimes I'll get their Mexican mocha and it's amazing. Everything I've had ha been delicious. One of the best I. The valley, probably the best with a drive thru.
name: Tanya

text: Shout out to our waitress, Sarah. Super friendly, super attentive and made everything right. My husband had the Square Deal Meal and said it was delicious. Loved the pancakes. I ordered the Ham and Swiss quiche which they were out of so I got the quiche of the day. When it came it looked beautiful but it was lukewarm and the crust was soft. Sarah immediately offered to replace it. I ordered a Ham and Swiss omelette which was delicious. Despite the original snafu we enjoyed this place and would definitely come back.
name: Kristina

text: This Philly Cheesesteak restaurant was a great option for diverse appetites. The Philly for my guy, steak salad for me and chicken tenders and waffle fries for my kids. We ordered at the counter, they gave a number to place on the table, we found a table upstairs, and they brought us out lunch within 10 minutes. Everyone was happy, all of the food was great. They even have a bar; you can walk down to the bar and bring drinks back to the table. Only downside, we parked on the street 4 blocks away on a blustery day.
name: J

text: Worst Buffalo Wild Wings restaurant in the city. Bad customer service and they are always under staffed.
name: Cinthya

text: I'd been about a year ago and the veggie burger was so good, but when I went back today I was disappointed in the quality. It was a mash of veggies and quinoa but not in burger form. I loved the fries and milk shake though, so recommend those!
name: Katie

text:
Ok so we had to visit some touristy like spots during our mini vacation in New Orleans, and this is one of them! We walked by during lunch time and the line was out the door. We decided to wait till later and returned at night for dinner. What a great decision!

We were able to walk right in and only stood in line for about 15 minutes. The place has a cafeteria old school feel to it, but perfect for the food you have. I ordered a gumbo soup and their Famous Ferdi Special which has roast beef and their Famous ham. One bite and we were blown away! It was delicious and we highly recommend it for our meat lovers out there! Great portion too! We also ordered a side of fries which was the perfect add on. The gumbo soup was traditional and very tasty. 

The service was fast, efficient, and we genuinely enjoyed are experience at Mother's. We will be back for sure! Hope you have an amazing experience too :)
name: Denise

text: Fast food is not a concept at this place. It should not take 15 minutes to get a breakfast sandwich at the drive through. I live 30 seconds away away and I'd rather drive to another restaurant to get food in the morning.
name: Stacey

text: Fastest delivery, sub and pasta order was made to order, 4 stars because cheesecake delivered upside down by driver, crushing it.  Other than that, on point!
name: Amy

text:
I really wanted to like LPM, but there were a few things they need to get right. First, our salad (Metro House) had decent presentation, but it lacked flavor. Second, the specialty pizzas, while creative, didn't always work. We tried the Trinity Vicinity which was topped with baby clams, grape tomatoes, spinach, sweet corn, garlic, parsley, and mozzarella. Meh, the corn didn't work with the rest of the ingredients.

The cast iron wings had a nice taste to in, but the wings were a little small.

I may give it another try, since there are many pizza options I haven't tried yet.
name: David

text: Yum! We had a reservation before hand, highly recommended. There is a back room and a front room. We sat in the back, which was perfect for a larger group. They honored our reservation and the service was soooooo fast! There were so many amazing choices to choose from. I loved the food but also loved the blood orange mimosa! Head there for a fun time!!
name: Blair

text: Excellent food and surprisingly vegetarian. I really loved the pho and the tofu rolls. I've been 4 or 5 times and the food is great every time! Quick service and friendly too. The tea was also very tasty.
name: Nathaniel

text: Food was good, but not Maestros.  Fee for a split plate but we had to split the entree in two ourselves.  The hardest part to excuse is that the starters came out with the entrees.  Not acceptable for a high end steak house.
name: Tony

text: During lunch hour, it's too crowded and hard to navigate.  But around 5pm...amazing!!
name: Candice

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Food was fresh and service was quick. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. I had a better visit than I expected to. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text:
For starters I love this place, well... loved.
Valentine's day disaster. 630 reservation for 2 for their 5 taco valentines dinner. Sounds great right!!!?? WRONG!!!!! Under staffed, overwhelmed and rude. " it's a scratch kitchen" is what I was told. Ok so that means 45 minutes for tacos, which by the way were cold. Was also told a manager would come by, never happened and we left before we got our supposed choco taco dessert. The service here is always questionable at best but today the food sucked too. Very disappointed and hoping ya'll get your shit together sooner than later.
name: Justin

text:
Nice views and wonderful service.  Food was alright. We came here during restaurant week for dinner. Lucky we got seats with good window views. Sunset was beautiful! 
So there were 3 of us. We ordered different dishes. The chilled shrimp salad and toasted salmon carpaccio were awesome!! 
Then came the entrees....the Acadian Redfish filet was yummy. Roasted butcher's filet steak was good but wish it was a bit juicier. Overall it's not bad. 
The duck breast was interesting though. It was like a steak, it was raw duck meat!! I didn't know that duck can be eaten raw. I had a taste and didn't like it but my mother liked it. 

The desserts could have been better. Especially the "cookie&scream" parfait! Don't get that!! Better to buy a bunch of canned cookies at home then go to a restaurant order. 

If you want to be treated like VIP this is the place. If you want amazing food, definitely not this place :)
name: TuongVi

text: Best wings in town, ask for CAT outstanding service with her every time!!!! They have all you can eat wing Wednesdays and offer military discount. Thank you!
name: Sandy

text: The restaurant was clean and very cute. We ordered a couple items to split and had plenty of food. We tried the General Tso's tacos and bulogi nachos. Both items were good and had a lot of flavor. I really liked their house sauce, I believe it was called Comida sauce. I will definitely try the hot Cheetos corn and empanadas next time I visit!
name: Amber

text:
I've been visiting this establishment ever since I was young, and I've never been disappointed once.

All of their food is absolutely exceptional, whether it's their cheesesteaks, pizzas, or a variety of different pasta dishes.

They're easily one of the best places in town to grab something to eat. Check them out!
name: Gary

text:
We have dropped into this place in an afternoon and they got us seated really fast although it was crowds and busy. This place is right in the heart at Jackson Square. We ordered a BLT, Gumbo, Fried Oysters. The food was a little above average. 

The ambience of this place was the biggest disappointment. My waiter was very rude to us while taking, asking for any changes and giving us the check. This is exactly the reason this place lost its two stars. 

The place also didn't look very hygienic to standard. However, the food and prices are competitive for the area.
name: Saiteja

text: Cool space Very crowded at lunchtime but the line moved quickly.  Short menu but really enjoyed What we had. Fresh raw tuna was really good very fresh. It was called Tunisian salad.  Basturemas ?  A Jerusalem  bagel, Oblong in shape excellent in taste.  With A piece of meat in the pastrami family. Tasty. Unfortunately outed of burekas. Look forward to going back
name: Howard

text: Amazing presentation! Look at the size of those shrimp! Tony is amazing...Danny is on top of it!  The flavor is great...value is great...cant beat it.
name: Carie

text: Steak was amazing! The flavor from the wood fire grill was incredible. I will definitely return to this restaurant. Thanks Gary and team for the amazing service at the bar!
name: Ang

text: I gotta give this spot five stars. Went here for a late lunch after being recommended by a few people. The menu was legit. Place smelled wonderful all the smoking goodness in the air. Portions that are generous too. I had to get the HOG WILD SAMPLER which comes with a 1/4 pound of Chicken, Pulled Pork, Ribs, Sausage, 2 Homestyle Sides (I got collards and mac and cheese & Texas toast). I also got some burnt ends and it was candied style which took it up to another notch. The chicken was tender. The pulled pork and ribs were juicy until the last bites. The sausage was so tender melts in your mouth like butter. The sides you can tell were authentic. This was so full of goodness, that I can't stop thinking about it
name: Jerry

text: We went here before a concert. It was pretty quick about 45 min. I had a burger and it was delicious. Tots were pretty good too. Boyfriend had wings and he enjoyed them as well. He got the hot sauce and said it was one of the best he's had from a restaurant. They had a wide variety of beers on tap. We would for sure come back. We highly recommend it! Prices were very reasonable too.
name: Brittany

text: Excellent hole in the wall!!! We will be back.. thanks fellow Yelp users for a great recommendation..
name: Dan

text: The Hut was alright,  nothing fancy or exciting to brag about except the live music.  The mixed drinks were $9 which is about average for the location, the food was a bit pricy given the portion size.  The view in the back was beautiful,  the upstairs seating was different and cute.  We probably won't be back to The Hut tho.
name: Nyree

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time.
name: User

text: Decided to try this place out, great back story about the owner. Friendly restaurant the owner who also cooks makes his rounds around the dining room making sure everybody is comfortably. The food was also very good I ordered the chicken parm and it was exceptional! You should definitely get to this restaurant if you get the time.
name: Sean

text: I don't have any clue as to how this place gets such a high rating. When we entered it was empty, red flag! The health department should go in there. The cheese was so old I could only take one bight. My brother got a burger, same thing so he took the meat off the bread and couldn't swallow the meat. My kid liked the fries so we got a few fries for $40.00. Not to mention the whole staff of three stayed outside smoking and coming right back in to cook and when they were done right back outside. The waitress should have seen one bite and asked what was wrong, not here. The staff was friendly, but why or how would they serve something so terribly bad to people? Needs a real deep clean to take out the wet dog smell. I would not recommend to anyone
name: Theresa

text: I love this place. If your ready to go to carb heaven then this is the place for you. I love the malted shakes here and the cheese curds ! My absolute favorite of all time.
name: Brandi

text: A large group of us came here for a late breakfast on a Friday morning. There were a good amount of people there but it wasn't crazy busy. Our server was very friendly and great but it did take us a while to get drinks whenever we ordered them so the bar may back up easily. I ordered the Farmer's Platter and it was delicious and filling. Most everyone in our party enjoyed their food - with the exception of the s'mores crepe which was really just a Nutella crepe with a tiny dab or marshmallow cream inside and a marshmallow on top. I would definitely come here again!
name: Martha

text: Great place especially for salad lovers. It starts at the salad bar, I suggest a few plates on your tray. There are a variety or premade salads like Cesar, or you can make your own. Choose the type of lettuce you want and a great variety or toppings (no meat though). Wonderful selection of dressings and decide if you want a drink. Once you finish your salad there is a variety or soups to choose from and some cheese bread options. Then it is on to desserts, there is a plethora of baked goods and a soft serve station. I'm an avid meat eater and I still love this place, especially for lunch.
name: Joshua

text:
My portion of biscuits and gravy was huge! When I ordered the waiter asked me if I was going to want the sides of eggs and bacon and I thought "what kind of question is that of course I do!" But then I saw how huge it all was and wow was it impressive! I had at leaat half a to go container filled with leftovers after working pretty hard on it. 

My friend ordered french toast and egg whites and she regularly comes  in for the French toast so she is a fan! We came in with her beautiful newborn baby and our waiter was very accommodating, sat us right away in the back at a table with plenty of seating and room to place the baby. We appreciated that!
name: Janet

text: I finally got to visit Next Door after going to their opening party. I loved the samples then, so I was excited to try the full versions! We sat outside and even though it was raining it was still dry and comfortable. The service was incredibly fast!! We ordered an appetizer and within 2 minutes it was on our table. Our main dishes came out a few minutes later. I had their 50/50 burger. If you eat a lot of veggie burgers but still enjoy beef from time to time this is for you! The balsamic onions were strong but you can pick them off to lessen the power. The patty is very tasty! The simple salad is also quite good. The inside is also pretty nice and I can see the date appeal. I'll be coming back during their hapy hour to try more apps! I'm happy to see Next Door doing well in my neighborhood.
name: Nathan

text: Great service and great food! Had a great Barolo and their Caesar dressing is out of this world. Ask for Hasan!
name: Madison

text: Nice restaurant. Gets busy. The food was so delicious. I recommend the Chef Tasting Menu. You get to try a few items on the menu, the size is just right. I think the restaurant has a few different sections, there is a bar in the back that played some good music later on in the night.
name: Rashida

text: I had high hopes of this being a terrific place to have a couple of local brews, but the staff behind the bar was pretty clueless at answering any questions about the plethora of beers and ciders they had on tap.  I ordered a cool IPA and was told a few minutes later that they didn't have that on tap because they ran out, but he offered me a can of the same beer, which I thought was an acceptable substitute.  To my surprise, once delivered to me, the charge was $1 more than a draft...for what I have no idea.  I don't mind paying the asking price, but to arbitrarily add another $1 is not cool at all.  The cider my wife ordered was to her liking, but the bartender shorted her pour a bit, which at $7 a pour, was again, discouraging.
name: Matt

text: We had only had cocktails at Bank and Bourbon, they were a little pricey but you are downtown in a hotel tourist zone so to be expected. Service was ok, we sat in the lounge area with big TVs. Good selection of bourbon and scotch. I was surprised that there was no nuts or snacks served with the drinks. I would give this 3 stars on restaurant alone but location bumps to 4.
name: Aaron

text: This place has great signature cocktails and delicious food to match!! We love it!!!! This needs to be a must try in New Orleans!
name: Samantha

text: I love Popeyes! The chicken tastes great and there's a lot to choose from. We just didn't get good service from this location. We ordered a three piece chicken dinner in mild. We got up to the window and was told they only have wings. It's 6pm and you ran out of mild chicken legs and thighs!? The chicken strip meal we did get came with no biscuit. The lady at the window handed us the wrong drink. To finish the experience off there was no apology. As we drove away from the drive thru window there was no "have a good night" or anything. The drive thru lady just glared at us. We will be avoiding this location for awhile.
name: Eric

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The music was louder than it needed to be. Glad we tried it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. It looked better online than it did in person. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: If I could give 0, I would.  Arrived.  The manager, a female,  was literally yelling at an employee in front of me.  Neither looked up or stopped their tirade.  Next,  ordered the 4.99 chicken pot pie.  Waited 24 minutes because this is how long it takes for fresh ones.  GO TO Boston Market,  spend the extra 1.30, you will get way more chicken.  My pot pie was cream,  carrots,  and celery.. .maybe corn.  Hardly any chicken.  What a waste.  Next,  no one could tell me the cost of four biscuits.  Someone told me $4.00 for 2...another quoted me 5.89 for 4. Quite literally,  it was a mess.  It's a freaking side,  get it right.  Hire a better store manager,  know your product,  and keep the bs  at home.
name: Kate

text: I first saw this restaurant on my search for restaurants in my area. I was excited. A restaurant specializing in seafood, a semi pescatarian dream, right?. Nope. The food was blan as f&ck. I mean no flavor, no spice, no seasoning at all. If there was, my tastebuds failed me. I was thoroughly disappointed. It's not a happening spot just a neighborhood staple that mostly people who have lost their tastebuds (old) visit. It is a BYOB. The fried calamari was greasy, instantly wished I had selected the baked option instead. Would I return probably not but there's a part of me that want to go back try another dish to see if there's a difference. I had the scallops and risotto.
name: Michelle

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. A couple small things kept adding up. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: My husband recommended this place so we brought my parents to eat here. No qualms on the service, our server was just fine but my rating is for the overall experience. One bathroom, nothing on the menus so look on the wall for the kids and senior menu on a whiteboard (I didn't see it until after we ordered). Unorganized enough for me to not make another visit. Definitely a dive restaurant.
name: Alanna

text: 10/10 delicious. Crab Rangoon, tuna bimibap insanely fresh, and coconut creamy shrimp and grits. Sat outside and was given a chopped salad to share. Sad we just now tried it and Will definitely be back.
name: Mandi

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: I had an amazing lunch here with a friend that was in town on business. We wanted sushi and Kona was close by. It was the perfect choice and the weather was beautiful so we sat outside. Our waiter was great!  We had calamari and ordered 4 rolls.  We were able to sit and enjoy our food and conversation without too many interruptions- while keeping my tea and ice water topped off. The menu has a lot of interesting items so I'm ready to go again soon!  If you like sushi you will not be disappointed. I usually take more pics but we were so involved in our conversation that I forgot! Oops!
name: David

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: This is the worst subway ever. Took FOREVER as staff sat around chatted.  Did not have half of the condiments, breads....  brutal.
name: Brett

text:
If you enjoy Brazilian steakhouses then you must try Terra Gaucha! The restuarant is similiar to a large chain like Texas de Brazil but Terra Gaucha only has roughly 40 something tables inside so it's less crowded.

 I made a reservation through opentable for Friday at 8 P.M. and only half the restaurant was full. They opened two weeks ago so the hype is still building. We were immediately seated and asked about wine and given cheese muffins. Our waiter showed us a brochure with the meats Terra Guacha will cut table side. Each meat was absolutely delicious and what we've all come to expect from Brazilian steakhouses. The funny thing was literally someone with a different type of meat was tableside one after another throughtout my visit and in between that different waiters and waitresses would come by to see how things were going and ask if you would like any partcular meats cooked. The most I waited was five minutes for a dish. Every single time my water reached three quarters full it was refilled. The customer service here is insane and we were treated like we were the only table in the place.

The salad bar had mozzarella balls, lobster bisque, fresh fruits, fancy cheeses, different types of salads. When comparing it to other Brazilian steakhouses I've ate it the only thing Terra Guacha was missing was sushi and offered less soups. The containers of offering were smaller but had all the same items I've seen. The bacon offered wasnt as thick but was still very good.

My favorite meat I ate was the ribeye it was very juicy. My second favorite was the lamb which was juicy and blackened with some parts charred. I also enjoyed the garlic bread they bring by on a stick with some type of garlic butter sauce smothered on it. I enjoyed the bread so much I placed another order for it just before I tapped out. I literally ate until I couldnt anymore. 

Everything was absolutely delicious. When finished I presented my Yelp offer $30 for $50 and had no issues. The coupon brought my total for two from $85 ($42 a person for dinner) to $35. I checked in on Yelp and wanted to use the dessert offer but in the fine print it says you can only use it with the purchase of two full meals combined with no other offer. In order to redeem either coupon no paper copy is needed. My waiter asked I go into the Yelp App then "My offers" then select the"Me" section and click use coupon now.

I would highly recommend Terra Guacha. I will definitely be back. The service and staff were top notch and exemplified how you should really be treated when you fine dine. This place is more intimate and the deal they have on Yelp puts it over anyother and makes Texas de Brazil look like a crowded covention center with a salad bar in the middle of it.
name: Ken

text: The BLT burger with goat cheese is by far the best burger I've ever had. I can't help but order it every time. They also make some incredible handmade cocktails that are also always delicious. If I had to suggest anything else, I'd say the honey mustard chicken salad and wings would be my go too! But the BURGERS!!!!!! One word: Amazing
name: Tiffany

text:
This is a hipster dim sum place... actually.. it's more of a spin on dim sum and not a real dim sum place. 
There's not a lot of menu options.. it was so disappointing. However, it was decent. We liked all of our food, minus the fried rice.. not sure what they are trying to do with the fried rice. 
Also, they serve their cocktails in regular water cups.. which was not not favorite. Overall, it was a decent restaurant, just not the dim sum I was expecting.
name: Kim

text: My son just graduated from U of A, so we've been to Caruso's numerous times and always enjoyed the patio and the food is decent if pedestrian. The service has never been great, but last month when we went for my son's graduation the service was TERRIBLE! There were four in our party; three ordered pasta and I ordered an individual pizza. The order took a long time, as usual, and when it came out my pizza was missing. The waitress told me that when it came out the pizza was burnt, so she sent it back to the kitchen - WITHOUT ASKING ME FIRST. My family proceeded to eat their meals while I waited. Finally the waitress came back and offered me a dinner salad "on her" which I accepted because I was starving. Twenty minutes later, I asked her to cancel the order; my family had finished their meals and we were ready to leave. She told me she already put the order in and if I cancelled now "she" would have to pay for the pizza. I never heard anything like that in my life. I told her to box it up and I'd take it go. We paid the bill and I left the restaurant with one of our party and finally my husband came out with my pizza boxed up. Of course, we were staying at a hotel, so leftover pizza isn't much good. I don't like to cause a fuss in the restaurant, but in hindsight, I should've refused the pizza and told her to take it off the bill. I'm sure she wouldn't have had to pay for it personally. When she saw the pizza was burned, she should've come out and told me another pizza would take over 30 minutes to come out (because that's how long it took - probably longer) and offered me a FREE soup and salad instead. This event ruined our grad dinner with our son.
name: Ginger

text: I have had pizza from all over this beautiful country and a few slices over seas and this pizza by far is in the top 5 that I have had! Filling, greasy (how NY pizza should be) and just flat out delicious! Would order from here again.
name: Matthew

text: You need a reservation for this place as seating is limited. The food portions are large and have authentic flavours. The drinks were okay. The margarita tasted like it came from a drink mix though. The servers are friendly. Another Mexican option to try at least once.
name: D

text: Was so excited to give this place a try when it opened. Went in there with high expectations, the menu looked incredible, pretty pricey, but I figured it would be worth it. Ordered noodles, spring rolls, tempura, and dim sum. To be honest it tasted like everything was cooked days ago and none of it was fresh. Didn't finish anything, it was that gross, the shrimp tempura was mushy, the dim sum was off and mealy, and the spring rolls...just really greasy and blah. Once again none of it was fresh. I do have to add the service was very polite and friendly, my server was "yoyo"... she was very sweet and professional. I hope they turn this around because the prices do not reflect the value.
name: Maxwell

text: I'm giving Ming's 5 stars not just for being delicious fresh food BUT because they have several gluten-free options for dishes. I eat here at least once a week. When I was diagnosed with a gluten sensitivity I thought I wouldn't be able to eat Chinese food again unless I cooked it myself. It makes me very happy that I can stick to my lifestyle of being low carb and gluten-free here. They don't have a dedicated gluten-free menu but the waitresses are pretty helpful when trying to figure out what's adaptable. So far I've had the Garlic Chicken, Garlic Shrimp, Cashew Chicken, Beef and Broccoli, and Scallop Kew dishes which can be modified to be gluten-free. If you decide to eat the fried rice get the lunch special, they have nice generous portions. I stick to the entree's no white rice to stay low carb and 99% of the time I'm quite full. The scallop Kew was yummy but could have been bulked up a bit with more cabbage or other types of veggies. If you stop in for lunch ask for Kristin and tell her Whitney with Alligator-Pear.com and the girls sent you!
name: Whitney

text:
I've been a fan of Tired Hands for a while, but this was my first time making it out to one of their spots. Going in I already knew their beer was A+, but I was also really pleasantly surprised at how good the food was too!

We tried the sweet potato tacos, breakfast burger, and pumpkin waffle. All of them were delicious, and you could taste all the special details that go into the food (the cranberry salsa on the taco, the homemade whipped cream on the waffle...). Combined with really reasonable beer prices and the incredibly kind staff, I'll definitely come back for brunch and want to come back to try dinner!
name: Aj

text: Very solid eatery in the gulch!  All of their burgers are hand made everyday, fries are cut fresh and everything else is made from scratch.  Extensive bourbon list, probably largest in Nashville.  Service is great and attentive.  Very glad we made it in to try it.  Next time you're in the area, walk past peg leg porker and give stock and barrel a shot.
name: Travis

text:
Pearl Diver is absolutely stunning. The interior and exterior are so meticulously decorated and designed. It's an awesome surrounding for drinks. The drinks are great (and literally dozens of options) and the staff is awesome.
I think people are unhappy that you have to wait, but I'm all for a bar that doesn't feel insanely cramped. These people have probably never drank in New York, LA, Boston, London, Paris, where you routinely waited at a bar outside. It's normal and part of a city. I enjoyed that I could actually move around while inside.
Well done!
name: Hailey

text: Went here on a whim in a Tuesday afternoon and was presently surprised! This place is awesome and gonna be my go to place for buffet it was under 20 with drink at lunch time and it seemed like it was a full buffet no half lunch time buffet didn't see the crab legs everyone else is talking about but I think that was the only limitation for lunch. Dim sum was good sushi was good volcano rolls were superb! It's in a shady part of town with an even shadier parking lot but once your inside everything is clean and huge. I'll be back
name: Alex

text: This place is so nice. Love the environment. The staff here are so friendly. They have a great selection of beer for all the beer drinkers. Breakfast was delicious. I highly recommended this place if your looking for a nice place to eat.
name: Teresa

text: Came on the Doctor Gumbo tour to this little spot and man was it good! We sampled the catfish Poboy dressed, the muffelata, and the jambalaya. Oh man were they good! The muffelata was moist and cheesy and perfectly topped with olive tamponade. The catfish in the poboy was moist and tender and perfectly fried. My absolute favorite though was the jambalaya - so spicy and soulful and rich. It was fresh off the stove too so deliciously piping hot! Could have eaten the whole pot I think!
name: Martha

text:
I grew up in New York, and then later lived in North Jersey - so I know what a good slice is supposed to taste like, hows it's supposed to feel.  So take it from me, if you're looking for that hot, crisp familiar NY Style Pizza?  Look no further.

Don't let the name fool you, although you can get Chicago style pizza here too this is the closest thing I've found in our area to New York pizza.

Hakeem gives great service, and makes fantastic food!  I'm glad that I found this little gem!

Just an honest slice of goodness, what can I say more? It's fantastic!  Eat-in or take-out this is your spot.  Don't miss the chance to have a slice.
name: Jeremy

text: Probably one of the absolute worst restaurants in the area, my family had gone on a mid-week night - the place was basically empty yet service was extremely sure. We ordered the calamari app - it was horrible: the breading kept falling off & it was rubbery/chewy, like chewing gum. The entrees were bland boring: burgers lacked any flavor, the fish & chips were equally drab, their chicken over cooked and their steaks tough ... on top of the poor quality of food & service - it was an overpriced disaster. Skip it & go elsewhere!
name: Adrian

text: Horrible location. I have been there several times, and each time have had an issue. We normally get rapid order or takeout, and most of the time it is either wrong or missing something. I blame management because the one on BBD and In Lutz are wonderful and have never had issues. It's worth the drive, in my opinion. Stay away from Wire-grass location .
name: Jennifer

text:
I agree with the previous review. This Panera location has seen better days. I think it's time for a new makeover. I was also sad to see that they no long have the Sierra Turkey sandwich on the menu. That used to be my favorite sandwich. Yes, it has certainly been a while since I've been to a Panera Bread.

With that said, my mother and I were very satisfied with our menu choices today. We've always liked the Pick 2 menu and it looks like you can now get mac & cheese with a half sandwich, soup, or salad. We got the Modern Caprese with different soup choices. She got the chicken noodle and I got the creamy tomato soup. Both were very good. Mom's soup didn't have many noodles or chicken in it, but she actually likes to have more broth. It was a good choice for her. The creamy tomato is always good, and great for dipping bread into it. The sandwich was also very good. The menu description is as follows: Basil-white bean puree, sliced mozzarella, parmesan, arugula, smoked tomato confit, fresh basil, balsamic glaze, salt and pepper, toasted on Black Pepper Focaccia. It was tasty and fresh. I'd get it again. 

Another thing I like about Panera Bread is that you can place your order and pay for it online in advance. Then go straight to the pick up area and find your order without any wait. It's very convenient. Their bagels are pretty good too. Especially the asiago cheese bagel.
name: Karen

text: I want to love you...but.  I had the halibut special, which was really halibut nuggets with some nuts thrown on top.  Dry and tasteless.  My dinner-mate had the salmon, which was seriously overcooked.  The sides were good, the server was great.  We'll try again.
name: Linda

text: Terrible food, grilled shrimp came out ice cold. I finished my salad before the replacement shrimp came out. All we got was a sorry.  Manager argued that a steak with no pink was medium. Just not a great experience.  Too many other choices in the area.
name: John

text: I've been​ to Duo's quite a few times over the past two years(all of their locations are pretty nice) and this most recent visit has let me down. It seems as if they're​ giving out small portions at​ the same​ price. I got my ​usually a tofu balance bowl with a side of mac and cheese and was left with disappointment​. My bowl was filled with spinach and very little of the other toppings​ but I could get over it, what really got me was the fact that the side mac and cheese is now distributed with an​ ice cream​ scoop and was literally a few bites. In the pas,​t I would get an almost full side container. I wouldn't be mad about it if the price hadn't been the same. The food​ was tasty, but I felt really let down. Not too sure if I'll go back after this.

text: For the price I expected a little more care. Also, i've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Idk, the staff seemed tired but still polite. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not bad for a quick meal. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.

text: This place is huge with a lot of great options.
