text:
SHORT REVIEW: Wild Eggs is an award-winner as far as food goes. 
But I think something is amiss in the realm of drinks and overall experience.

LONG REVIEW:
-- LOCATION: They found a perfect spot for this, really; all things considered. Parking may not be the best, but as downtown expands and grows, it is an ever-more culturally acceptable challenge anyway. Inside, you'll find bright, clean, and pleasant breakfast decor; very on-brand with how Wild Eggs feels like it should present itself as.
-- FOOD//DRINKS: The food is very, very good. And the menu boasts some creative options that you won't very easily find in other places. So, hat tip to the Chef and team for this. Try anything and you will leave happy. The drinks, though, are a bit off-kilter. While they are equally as creative as far as mimosas go, they are few in number and not really comparable to prices for the same or similar breakfast & brunch drinks in other and nearby places.

Why didn't it get 5 stars? Well, really because of two things: 
1) 'Brunch culture' is swelling and has an increasingly more discerning opinion about the environment that plays well with its desires. Wild Eggs is not quite hitting the mark in this intangible, highly experiential area.
2) The drink prices are really not in-line with expectation. Shaving a solid dollar or buck-and-a-half off would feel more "right."
name: Brent

text: Fiesta Pizza has been around for what seems like most of my life. Me and my family and friends have been ordering food from Fiesta for years. I've never had any problems with the food and even if I did, they would be willing to get things right even if it meant making the food again and if needed making a second delivery. When I call to order, everyone is very nice and patient. The food is very good. I absolutely love their salads. The salads are so big. They are big enough for a couple of people or good for 2 meals. The Stromboli's and pizza are excellent. My mom loves their chili. Everything I've eaten there has been good. That is the only pizza shop in the area that I order food.
name: Yaya

text:
We love it!! I get shrimp tempura sushi rolls with spicy mayo instead of eel sauce and then we always get shrimp, chicken, and steak hibachi. 
It is always so fresh and good!! Big portions. Service is always fast and good. Place is always clean. No complaints We will continue to come here forever!
name: Taeler

text:
Very good cheesesteak and the pretzel was huge

Service excellent 

All 3 of us had very good lunches
name: Jim

text:
Excellent Fried Chicken and friendly staff.

We also got the marinated lamb chops which were great, but it's all about the chicken at this place.

Finger lickin' good.
name: M

text: WHOA super nice atmosphere, super friendly staff and awesome selection of foods. Lots of home cooking items with a twist. Chicken and Waffles, pot roast, cubans everything i have had was awesome. Be sure to ask for Nicole, awesome service!
name: John

text: What a great time we had at Datz today. Breakfast was superb and we stayed and moved over to Dough and continued our conversation for hours. We were celebrating my Retirement and my life long friends had a great time too. See photos from our visit we ordered the French Toast, the Cookie Dough Waffle. And a Breakfast Sandwich. Coffee was well worth the "Big" Cup for hour long conversations. Our Waitress was wonderful and even took a selfie with us as suggested. She even gave me a Mimosa to Celebrate! Great time with friends.
name: Desiree

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. A very pleasant experience. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Came in tonight with my son for a quick happy hour before our movie started. The service is always friendly and welcoming. We ordered the chicken wings, spinach dip with flat bread and the bruschetta (they gave us 5 huge pieces) all for around 20 dollars. Perfect place to go if you wanna grab a quick appetizer before seeing a movie. I wish we would have gotten our waitresses name. We will be back soon
name: Andrea

text: Stayed in NOLA for one night. Loved how you could see the kitchen and the food being prepared. Especially loved how the workers were all getting along and just making the space a great environment. Chicken was moist and delicious. Sides were pretty good but chicken was the best part.
name: Gynifer

text: I have officially found my favorites sushi spot in Nashville. The world is a better place. It reminded me of my favorite spot in Los Angeles. I know it's an Asian fusion spot but it's so hard to find a good sushi place. Glad i stopped in. Great service, great price, the shrimp tempura and Spicy Hulk was awesome. Need to come back and try the rest. Shout out to Tommy for making sure my drink was always full.   I will definitely be back, even if it's 10miles away.
name: Roman

text: Our server was really bad. She ordered our food to all come out at once. She forgot to order an item, forgot to add chicken to the pasta. She acted like to didn't care to wait on us. Perhaps it's because we had our child with us? I wouldn't recommend this place to my worst enemy.
name: Heather

text: This place has great food. The service was good. The atmosphere was awesome. Would recommend this restaurant.
name: Darryl

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would probably stop in again if nearby. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was good and came out fast. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Would absolutely visit again.
name: User

text: We had some issues with the bathtub in the room, but the manager (Mikaela) professionally/considerately handled it. Unfortunately, the front desk attendant was rude when we brought the issue to her attention; however, Mikaela was there to resolve the issue and improve our overall experience. Generally speaking, we loved our experience in the hotel! Our suite was spacious, quiet and clean. We will be back!
name: Dave

text: Tried this place for the first time today. Pretty tastey....I got the hot roast beef sandwich and i appreciate the fresh toppings.( onions, lettuce, cucmbers, and jalapenos) You can add oil and vinegar which I did, mayo, mustard or sriracha mayo. Everything was fresh and neatly placed on the *garlic bread* Id go back here for another lunchtime sandwich play any day.
name: Amber

text: Delicious Crabcakes! I would recommend to anyone who wants good authentic seafood without lots of fillers! They're expensive but worth it! Super friendly staff as well! If you haven't tried this hidden gem yet, you must! It's too good to pass up! Can't wait to try more things there!
name: Alex

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Worth checking out. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: If I could give a place 0 stars I would. It doesn't matter what shift I come in, day, night, weekend the amount of terrible customer service that I seem to receive is absolutely unacceptable. Always slow, always rude. And I always get the nastiest looks from the people working there. Avoid this place like the plague.
name: Michael

text: Easy shopping, all products appear to be naturally sourced and scrutinized for chemicals before shelving. Making shopping easier then other places ~ recommended.
name: Toni

text: Usually try to stop for a bite and brew before Lightning games. Food is always good. Service is sometimes slow but we plan for that. The fish sandwich I had last night was awesome. Fresh redfish. Highly recommend.
name: Dick

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text:
IF your a tourist OR non regular customer....DO NOT dine here. Your not welcome. 

UPDATE....I researched if Roberto is the owner...google says your the Chef. The owner is Mindi....please read for this story. 

I've dined here at least twenty times. I have introduced out of town friends on business here, who have decided Ned since, my mom's best friend who's 80, my oldest son and his friends who visit. Three retired couples who we worked together and moved here from California. Not to mention my old neighbors south end of Reno. 

I used to live in Reno but moved and retired else where. 

Last night after a long retired work day...yes I stay busy. I decided to wrap up my two week work stay with my favorite dish. The linguini, shrimp, artichoke etc. delicious. 

I arrived at 625, sat at the only available seat at the bar. Three thirty year old women to my left and what appeared to be know customer to my right. The bar is small, as I've at there and in the dining room. 

I waited almost ten minutes to be offered anything. I was polite, asked for a wine list, and dinner menu. I ordered a glass of wine house, and my dish. Since the bartender offered bread to the three women, not me, I asked for bread when he brought my small pour glass of wine. 

While I waited, the bartender said someone bought the women shots of tequila...(probably was the manager), so the bartender had a shot with the three women. He was doing his best flirting. Another glass of wine (FULL) was given to one of the women by the bartender. My glass was empty. He looked, ignored it and tended to make other drinks. 

It was now 7:05 pm, I had enough so I hit the restroom, came back, put my jacket on and walked to the end of bar where the owner hangs out. I stood there and thought, I'll just leave my $$ for the glass on the bar and leave. Too bad. 

I drove to my favorite Mexican restaurant in south Reno. As always, 5 star food AND service. 

I called this restaurant at 720, Cecilia answered. I asked May I speak to a manager. She asked why twice. I asked now to speak to the owner as I've chatted with her several times and she's nice. Cecilia said the owner is busy. Then Cecilia said she is a manager. I laughed, said Cecilia can I speak to a manager. She said, "Jesus Christ what's your problem." I paused, knew this place had changed now from a year I was there last. I said thank you and hung up. 

I called back at around 8pm. Cecilia answered again. I told her, I called earlier and can I speak to the owner. Roberto identified himself as the owner. I said, are you really the owner? He said yes what do you need. I asked, isn't the owner a woman. He paused...then said, they are married. I said that's impossible because my friend and her exchanged numbers a year ago. I introduced them to each other. He seemed awkward then said they are separated. I was now feeling awkward. I really thought, wow, and I ate here many times. 

So I explained what happened. To convince him I was a regular, I shared how MUCH MORE the long time bartender greets people as the front door opens!! He's great!!! He wasn't there last night. 

Roberto apologized finally. 

Look, in Vegas, in the burbs, I've never had bad service because it doesn't matter if you have visited in awhile. The service and food HAS to be good. 

During my entire conversation with them, I never cursed. Really just disappointing and sad. The restaurant wasn't even busy. 

I've seen the bartender favor women before so...try treating the customers who have dropped a lot of coin, have coin, dressed nice, polite, patient, have referred so many and they have dined there without me too with RESPECT !!! 

Two stars are for the quality of food, the Woman owner (ALWAYS NICE) the regular older woman hostess, the older guy waiter (I recognized him) AND the regular bartender who's trained everyone in town who wasn't there last night. 

Roberto...I don't think your the owner. 

Terminate the unprofessional bartender who's behaved like that once before I saw. 

If I still lived in Reno, I'd drive to Johnny's from my old place in Damonte Ranch rather than your "restaurant." I dined at Johnny's over 12 times. That's my style. 

One more thing...please continue treating California customers and new faces like last night. You'll find that your revenue will drop. 

Also, you should have offered to make it up but didn't. 

My reviews are mostly 95% complimentary and I WANT others to visit. 

I'm EMBARRASSED I brought so many friends, family and neighbors to your restaurant. 

I didn't deserve your treatment.
name: Derek

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Love the authenticity!!! The asada quesadilla and pastor tacos and the carne asada were absolutely perfect !! Randomly stumbled on this place!! Will be back!
name: Shaina

text: Come here weekly for lunch, and find myself here constantly with friends in the evening. It's in the perfect spot, the food is great, and everyone who works here is so nice. Always happy to accommodate an order change or ask the chef questions. An amazing spot!!
name: Cate

text:
My parents took me here to thank me for some yard work I had done. We all had the prime rib and it was excellent. The horseradish sauce was very fresh and sides were all very good. I will be back with my kids because the both love prime rib. Well worth a trip over here.
My parents also tell me they have had all the food here and it was all excellent. I will be back for more.
name: David

text: For the price I expected more than this. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The wait felt longer than it should have. Probably not coming back. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Not bad for a quick meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text:
This was our first visit to the Cup Café but won't be our last!   While the Hotel Congress had a deal going on that brought a large crowd the restaurant was calm.    We were seated on time.   Our waiter, Matt, was attentive and informative.   
We started by sharing the calamari starter which was excellent.   It was large and we changed our dinner thoughts because we were already filled.    Regardless my wife had a house steak salad and I had the fish and chips.   We enjoyed both with no exceptions.    I did feel that I should have tried something more specific and telling but the fish and chips were excellent.  My wife added blackened shrimp to her salad but felt that the blackening didn't complement...she would have shrimp prepared differently on that salad next time.
Many other menu items were of interest and based on the quality of the food we enjoyed we're anxious to return and check out some other options.
5 stars possible after another visit or 2!
name: Scott

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Definitely coming back. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text:
We loved our meal here, and we had high expectations as well! The menu is sorted into several sections (raw bar, surf and turf, veggies, pasta, main dishes), and you can order one from each section to make a worthwhile meal.

We enjoyed all of our courses, including the Arctic char, which had pomegranate seeds in it for color and texture, and the sweetness contrasted with the citrusy and bitter sauce. The sweet potato was worth $11, despite my preconceived notion that it wouldn't be; it also had great texture with crunchy things on it as well. Brussels were great, and the striped bass was perfectly cooked. We got the cheesecake and biscotti as well, and I think they were even better than the other dishes!
name: Suf

text:
Buca is great for large parties! We have celebrated many occasions here with both large groups and intimate date nights. The service is always great and waiters are knowledgeable about the menu options and able to give their suggestions on wine pairings or drink recommendations as well as offer their suggestions on how many dishes to order for the large group. They often have $10-$20 off special coupons sent to your email if you sign up for those. 

The online reservation and online ordering for takeout is awesome and very efficient.

Pro tip: always order the cannolis.
name: Erin

text:
We had such a disappointing experience here. First, our waitress was awful, she didn't know that her job is to actually serve people. We waited 5 minutes before She made it to the table to say I'll be right with you. Then it was another 6 before she was back. Water and iced tea took another 5 minutes to arrive. 15 minutes in the place before we even had a nonalcoholic drink!

So I could go on about the awful service but I think I made the point. Katherine should not be in the Server business. Then the food arrived-someone else delivered it- a dry turkey burger and an even drier morrocan chicken dish that didn't even have all the ingredients listed in the menu. 

Needless to say, we couldn't get outta there fast enough. It's loud and doesn't have a welcome feel. Save your money and patience and go somewhere else.
name: Laura

text: I came in today on Father's day. They were busy but I got excellent service at the bar from Asta. The staff are super friendly and attentive and they made our experience for our family lunch.  I tried the 28 day aged patty on recommendation from Connor and haven't had a burger that good in a long time.  I will definitely eat here again.
name: Brian

text:
My husband turned me on to Pho ( pronounced Fuh ) and I had never had Pho before. 
This is amazingly Delicious. 
It's very brothy and  has many noodles and veggies and you can choose a meat (eye round or Flank steak or even shrimp... also, most of the Pho bowls come with a Plate of Jalepenos, bean sprouts and Thai Basil sprigs to add extra fmany other selections depending upon the Chef) 

Pho Eden is nice and fairly quiet with very polite staff and they make awesome food. 

The crispy egg rolls and Fresh spring rolls are big Hits with us.  
Deeeeelishhhhh. 

We cannot say enough about this place.  
Super nice people mixed with Amazing food and Excellent quality. 

This is now our favorite place. 
Thank you so much for all you guys Do
name: Monica

text: Incredible food and service!! Would recommend the brisket. The restaurant has 200+ tables and great service :)
name: Meredith

text: I've gotten pizza here for a while and never understood the bad reviews. Today was the first time I had a problem. The pizza they made me stuck to the oven pan, so they made me a new pie and offered me any drinks for free for my extra wait.
name: Ben

text: Had yummy happy hour drinks and great fried pickles before dinner. Our server was kind and attentive. I had blackened mahi with pineapple-mango salsa and coconut rice. I ate every bit. Hub said his fish was good, as were his scallops, but he wasn't impressed with his grilled shrimp. Overall, a nice meal in a casual atmosphere.
name: April

text: Incredible experience! Great physical plant, friendly staff and incredible food. The bolognese is to die for
name: Donald

text: Very pretty restaurant with a fun and unique concept of hot stone cooking and all you can eat. I have been here 3 times now and love it! The sashimi is fresh and delicious, there are many food options. I have tried the steak and the shrimp on the hot stone and both were very tasty, I love the garlic butter and I would suggest the sesame sauce as a side, other dishes I liked were the pokey bowls, they come with a really tasty sauce and the mixture of ingredients are so fresh and delicious, the beef tataki  is really tangy with good flavours, the shrimp tempura and gyoza dumplings are tasty, the ribs are good as well. There are so many options you will definitely love the menu and besides that the servers are exceptional! I have had 3 different servers and they each were so great making your overall experience wonderful! I would suggest either the green tea ice cream or the sesame ice cream at the end, I highly recommend this restaurant and looking forward to visiting again.
name: Marsha

text: Yummm I loved the sweet kolache tried the cheese and fruit and the cinnamon rolls all delicious
name: Kellee

text: We had a very good experience here. They have water with lime available in the waiting lobby, which was refreshing and delicious. It was very clean and it has a nice environment. Our waitress, Alexa, was awesome. The entire staff was professional and friendly. The food was excellent. Coffee was great but they could have fresh milk available to add in it instead of just the packaged creamer, which is my only suggestion for improvement. Everything else was phenomenal. I highly recommend First Watch.
name: Justin

text: Before talking food, let's start with the service: fantastic! We got Seth as our server and he took us on a magic carpet food journey with the way he described flavors and suggested pairings. I got the shishito peppers which had a bit too many seeds and a sauce that wasn't exactly complimentary. I got the lamb ribs which were good but not the most tender- perhaps it would have been better if I got the lamb shank which Seth raved about. The peri peri shrimp were a bit overcooked. The drink I got, Rest in Pete's, was deliciously tasty and unique with sumac put on the side of the glass for added allure and flavor. All in all, I would come back for drinks and the service but have a main meal elsewhere.
name: Kristina

text: We had the BEST experience tonight! Came out for a special occasion to celebrate and Erica, our server, made the night perfect! It was a Saturday night so we weren't expecting the best, but thats what we got! The service was spectacular, the food was so good and came out super quick!! Definitely will be back! Thanks so much Erica!
name: Samii

text: Sorry-- crazy Friday night, short staffeD, customers told us 1.5 hr wait for food, hostess told us 10 min!  Yikes! Run!!
name: Sue

text: Unfortunately, The food at Los Betos is bland and tasteless. Not anywhere close to being as good as the taco shops in San Diego.
name: Melinda

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Like most i asked for suggestions about best places to eat.. made it here and the food was phenomenal. I'm just one person out of all these reviews but if u listen to anyone it should be me bc I'm a food addict and will fly for good food. Plus the drinks were real drinks. I think there are so many touristy places with sugary drinks and watered down everything that it was so amazing to get a normal basic capt & coke and jack & ginger. So let's get to the food. We were lucky and came at the perfect time bc they just got a shipment of soft shell crab  we got a soft shell poboy, 2 piece fried chicken that came with slaw and rabbit sausage jambalaya, and soft shell over angel hair pasta that was tossed in butter, white wine, capers, garlic, red pepper flakes and lump crab... holy goodness the combo of flavors was amazingggg and didn't feel heavy at all and the crab was fried perfectly crispy and so fresh and juicy with every bite. The fried chicken was also perfectly crispy and juicy... for the poboy i just added some mayo and Cajun spice that was on the counter and i was completely satisfied  def a must to visit here.
name: Anna

text:
I had been in the previous Da Sesto's restaurant and it was quite good.  I have to say this time was a big disappointment.  

I brought a number of friends and they too were disappointed.  The service was ok, but the food left a lot to be desired.  Friends split spaghetti and meatballs had 3 drinks and were charged extra for not having ice in their glass, having an olive and a split plate charge.  Their bill was $80 and they said they had better for a lot less.  Several of us had linguini and clam sauce and were charged an extra $1 for having garlic in it.  Excuse me but it's supposed to be prepared with garlic.  The Caesar  salad had anchovies which also resulted in an extra charge.  Others that had wine were overcharged for their wine as well.  It was a case of being nickle and dimed to death  for a mediocre meal.  Somebody else had cappuccino for $10 or $11 . 

If you are going to charge extra for every little thing it needs to be on the menu or the servers needs  to tell you.  Instead they were pushing the extras like it was part of the price.  Very bad experience for food that was only fair.  I felt terrible that all the people I brought were so disappointed.  BAD PR for sure. Just don't know what happened to this place since they moved next door.  Probably the last time I will go there.
name: Karen

text:
Looking for a straightforward tasty sushi joint? Come and try this place :) servers are really friendly and personable and try the Mexicali roll... If you love wasabi it's great! If you don't, just ask for the sauce on the side or ask for it without the sauce. Gotta love the huge rolls and nigiri- albacore done right here :)

If there could be one request... I'd ask for the restaurant to have some ambient music in the background, it was kinda like eating in a library lol BUT since there were a lot of people that night it sounded a bit festive. Will definitely come back to try the ramen!
name: Pierre

text: Having just moved to the Doylestown area, I was looking forward to trying several different restaurants during. "Restaurant Week"-Quinoa was a featured establishment for RW and I was looking forward to giving it a try. Once we arrived and our bottle of wine was opened we were told that the owners arbitrarily decided to not participate that day. Needless to say the owners just don't get the restaurant business and honoring a commitment made to the community. The food was ok but truthfully we were very put off so we have a hard time giving this place anything better then so-so.
name: Robert

text:
This is probably my favorite restaurant.  I've been going there a few times a year for at almost 10 years.  The food is always good and fresh - made to order, not frozen.  The garlic rolls are to delicious.  It's hard to stop at one (ok, two!).  My go to dish is the chicken margarita.  My husband loves their seafood dishes, especially the mussels appetizer in white wine sauce.

Our last visit, I had the arugula salad (love this one),  chicken margarita, which came with a side of potatoes (you don't need alot) or pasta.  Hubby had the Cesar salad and jumbo shrimp and crab meat over linguine.  Sooo good!  No dessert for us tonight, although the cheesecake was tempting.  

I took an arugula salad home (for lunch the next day, along with one my pieces of chicken) and he took home the mussels.

Our waiter, Joe, was very attentive and he constantly moving, checking on us and all of his tables.  Next time we go back, I will request to sit in his section.  

Note, this is a BYOB (no fees).  Also, they are usually crowded on Friday and Saturday nights, so plan accordingly.  Definitely check this restaurant out!
name: Michelle

text: I WANTED TO GIVE ZERO STARS BUT YELP WON'T LET YOU SO HERE WE ARE. So after an awesome two day experience at Gasparilla, we stumbled upon this place Sunday for lunch (close to the people we were staying with and they liked their food so why not). The waitress had warned us they were short on staff so food would take longer to come out. She told us no later than 30 minutes. We ordered an app and our food at the same time to save time. And after that, that was the last time we saw our waitress. No check up, nor the appetizer we ordered had come to the table. An hour later we saw our waitress walk by the table and we had to ask about our food. The woman WITH her attitude finally went to get our food. Everyone was fine with their food except for me. My sandwich was legitimately cold meaning the cheese wasn't melted on a damn hot sandwich. I mean COME ON. So long story short, we had horrible service and the worst food I've ever had. Hopefully no one else has the same experience as this here or anywhere
name: Davis

text:
I've been coming here ever since it first opened a few years ago and have been a fan ever since. I have tried most of the ramen menu and have been satisfied with them all. The broth is flavorful and compliments the noodles and toppings perfectly. The egg is always perfectly soft boiled and the pork slices are tender and fatty. Additionally, they have a variety of condiments on the side if you want to further customize your ramen. My favorite include the ground sesame seeds and fried garlic to add a little extra pizzazz to my meal.

It's a well-known place, so prepare to wait for a table, especially during peak mealtimes.
name: Phuong

text:
I've eaten their food 4 times -- 2 dine ins, 2 take outs.
Each time it took at least 30 minutes and up to 1 hour for food to show up, despite the place being almost empty.
Resulted in 4 episodes of diarrhea.
One time the waitress (or owner) sneezed while carrying my bowl of noodles, and she had the guts to calmly set it on my table without saying a word.
name: S

text: I had a nice breakfast date here. However I have not heard good things from others. The things that I did hear were not food related but atmosphere related. Such as staff coming off as pretentious, apathetic, condescending and some of the customers coming off in the same manner with an air of racism. People know when they are not welcome in a space.
name: Araceliz

text: Can't believe I'm just now finding out about this place after living in the area for almost 4 years now. I love their who set up and food is amazing. A menu like no other with specials that change daily. New favorite spot for breakfast or brunch.
name: Cynthia

text: Excellent food, especially the taco yaqui. Also, serves large groups very efficiently. Would also recommend trying the little cookies they sell by the counter!
name: Kathryn

text: This restaurant not only changed names but also changed the menu. The menu on yelp no longer reflects the food. We went in for Szechuan food but the menu had more typical Chinese types of food. The entire group asked for our dishes to be spicy and they just weren't spicy. The portion size for the noodles were normal but the size for the meat dishes were on the smaller side. The taste wasn't anything extraordinary. A bit bland but edible. The waitress was very nice. Will not be returning.
name: L

text:
This was my first time visiting and it was so welcoming! They happily explained the menu to us and suggested favorites to try. 

Once we decided what we wanted we put in our order at the front. Then sat down and once it was ready they brought it over to our table. 

The best part for me was almost everything on the menu was naturally gluten free! If you are celiac be sure to let them know when ordering and they will make your items in a gluten free area. 

Everything we tried was delicious! We will definitely be back to try other items on the menu. I had the passionfruit juice and it was fresh tasting- very refreshing!
name: Lea

text: Love Aether! Try the crab toast that just got on the menu. One of the best! Loved the sashimi too!! Very fresh and tasty! Full bar too if you want to order a drink of your choice. Bartenders are happy to make you one! Love coming for happy hour
name: Elif

text: Nada is by far one of my favorite places in Indy for tacos. If you like the idea of a fried egg atop your breakfast inspired taco- this place is for you. Coupled with perfect cocktails
name: Katie

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was crowded but still moved along. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I prob wouldn't get again. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Really good experience! I walked in during lunch time and decided to try the philly & fries. I didn't like that I felt pressured to get my sandwich the way the owner wanted me to get it-- I know what I like. Regardless, my sandwich came out how I wanted and I took it to go. You get ALOT of food but it is a little pricey and I don't like that there isn't a combo option. The food was delicious though! Greasy, flavorful & the 6in with fries fed me for 2 meals. This is a much needed option in Antioch and I'm glad to see it present.
name: Sarah

text: I've been to New Orleans twice during memorial weekend and this place never disappoints. The food is a amazing and definitely worth the price. You also get 10% if you check in, which could potentially cover your first Bloody Mary!
name: Rafael

text: Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Definitely coming back. It looked better online than it did in person. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: Second visit and the fascinating thing about Bru Burger is how they offer 4 restaurants in one. First there's a chic pub atmosphere tucked away with a large corner bar that is adjacent to a second area of booth and tables area that is primarily couples dining and also 'chill'. Third around the perimeter is family grown ups seating and fourth and last are large open tables by the front entrance for family's with kids. The great part is you can enjoy dining in one area and be oblivious to what's going on on the other side of the restaurant. We enjoy the pub section and the team attending have been pros each time - the kind that notice if you need another napkin or if your ice water only has 1/3 left and refills it when your not looking. What a great meal and night without breaking the bank - thanks Bru Burger!
name: Ron

text: We have this restaurant cater our work meeting and it was a great decision to do so. Once I found out that we were having Lebanese I got very excited. They did not disappoint us. All of the food as flavorful and I definitely recommend the potato chips and I also recommend anything on the menu.
name: Jonathan

text: Food is 10/10. We have gotten the tasting menu before but feel we get a better value by picking what we want individually (can choose more from each section for less $). The service is always good. Last visit it was quite crowded and even though we had a reservation, it was about a 20 minute wait. We didn't mind, we waited at the bar, but the manager came over and gave us a free appetizer for our patience. It's dark downstairs and sometimes a little noisy, but overall really good. Would recommend the double knot tuna sushi roll if you like sushi.
name: Jackie

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. For a busy night they handled it okay. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the price I expected more than this. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
Thai in NOLA is a sad, sad state of affairs.
Do NOT tell me about Sukko Thai (Sucko Thai) that is NOT Thai food and I challenge anyone who states otherwise.
Taste of Thailand is as close to good Thai as I've found in NOLA.
Only draw back is that they share a common wall with the Venue next door who was thumping some SERIOUS bass for their function they were hosting.
Photos on wall, actually shaking and vibrating.
But the Drunken Noodles (Pad Kee Mao) was to totally die for.
Flavors, are PERFECT..
Not a flaw in the place, except for the neighbor.
Give it a shot..
If you love GOOD Thai, you'll LOVE this place..
name: James

text: Long ass line, long ass wait just to be seated outside with small ass fans with the worst food I had in New Orleans. This place is overrated and we waited an hour to get seated just to be seated outside in the hot and humid and taste of New Orleans was crap! Dry ass rice and small portions into small 3 little bowls and the nastiest crawfish soup I had, Landry's was better! Come here if you wanna wait long and have not so good food
name: Thao

text: Needs a few tweaks. First, I don't like dining in at a place and getting everything, cups, plates, salsa bowls etc. in single use, disposable plastic. You'd expect a place selling $4 artisanal tacos to know that don't fly in 2019. Second, there was no option to make anything spicy. Tacos, guacamole and salsa were all extra mild and the shared sauces available had zero heat as well. Fish taco seemed like more fried breading than fish. The pork and beef had a nice grilled char on them and service was friendly and fast.
name: Brett

text:
I love the food here and really have never been disappointed, but I felt compelled to write today. I went here for lunch today. The restaurant was not very crowded, and we were seated at a window booth not far from the front entrance. 
After about a full 10 minutes our waiter, Frazier (sp), finally acknowledged us and gave us water. He then asked if we wanted anything additional to drink and if we needed further we time to decide what we wanted to eat. We ordered right away beverage we were afraid of how long it would take him to come back!
It then took a long time for us to get our order even though I only ordered a salad and my companion the ravioli. In the meantime, Frazier did not seem to have the time check on us or explain the delay.
Once we were finally served our food it was as if our waiter forgot about us again. When he did stop by, I asked for the check even though we were only midway through the meal because I didn't want to wait even longer than we already had to.
Frazier took a long time yet again so I tried to pay the hostess but she was busy on the phone at the front desk.
Finally we were able to give Frazier the check probably because he saw me up out of the seat looking for someone I could give the check to.
Unfortunately, this terrible service may keep me from returning to a place that I typically enjoy immensely.
name: Patricia

text: Awesome tasting coffee got the pour over Ethiopian and tasted like cherry and dark chocolate. Very cool building and will let you sample their coffee if u ask.
name: Trevor

text: Went with my friend from St. Louis and both of us had enjoyable sandwiches he had a burger and I had I French dip which is their homemade roast beef. I had half of his Burger that was blue cheese it was great and I also enjoyed my roast beef and he had half of mine and liked it as well. I had a house salad as a side which was really nice and he had fries which were also good. The bar itself is a wonderful Irish bar named after a local St. Louis hero. It has a wonderful dark interior and has the real Ambiance of an Irish bar. The staff were attentive and friendly and made us feel at home I was glad to go in the afternoon because I'm sure it would be very busy at night. It had the old tradition of having names buy several of the seats of regulars from the neighborhood. It is also about expectations and if you want a nice visit in a good Pub atmosphere with good craft beers in good bar food this is a good call. If I come visit again I will want to come see this place and enjoy the food and beer in the atmosphere another time.
name: Cliff

text: The review is NOT for the Hotel, but for there new Restaurant Paul's Landing!!! The food is terrible!!!! Who is in the kitchen??? Seriously?? Had the fish tacos, they were soooooo dry I could barely swallow them, like eating cardboard. My friend had some shrimp toast, if you could find the shrimp. Beautiful location and view. I am puzzled how a 4 star resort can allow this. I am not the only person complaining either. I have had other people I know eat there and were not at all pleased. I hope they correct this disaster soon.
name: Theresa

text: This restaurant has been at this location for many years. Recently taken over by new ownership and you can already feel a difference. They are in the process of bringing it up to date. Adding some new items to the menu. Service was excellent!The food was delicious and very reasonable. Looking forward to seeing the ongoing upgrades.
name: Shelene

text: You can never go wrong at the Egg Factory. My husband and I don't usually go out on Saturdays so were surprised at how crowded it was. However it was only about a 10-minute wait and the hostess kept us updated because my husband uses a walker and we were standing near the bathroom and I think she was concerned. Once we were seated our waitress had coffee to us almost immediately and thank you for serving flavored creamer. The waitress was real friendly and we had fun laughing and joking with her. Although they were packed our food still came out in a timely manner and my husband commented that he didn't think he'd ever seen a bigger slice of toast. Everything was yummy and nice and hot. It's so nice to get Jam in a little dish. I despise those little packets, especially trying to get them open. We never once had to look around for the waitress for a coffee refill she was right there before we even looked for her. Thank you Egg Factory for your continued good home cooked food and above and beyond service.
name: Nancy

text:
This place is a hole in the wall drive in and looks old on the outside and inside and looks like you are in the eighties like when it first opened.  They have an outside and a inside where you can dine in and eat as in Reno can get very hot or very cold.  You can also eat inside the car if you like as well as that part is shaded.  

I ordered their combo meal is the 1/3 hamburger, fries and a shake for 10.99.  My wife got the shroom burger which was much bigger than what I got.  The shake I got a coconut cream and tastes like a coconut pie. The shake is more on the thick side, but not so thick where you have to suck on the sucker hard to get it out.   I did not care for the fries however and I love the fries. They do charge for ranch so beware if they ask you for 0.50 cents.

Overall the burgers were great and juicy and hit the spot. Is it the best burger I ever had, no, but it comes there though as I love the farmer burger and my favorite burger of all time.
name: Keven

text:
I'm rating this place 5 stars because we just happen to stumble upon it and I have to say best place to have found. 
Friendly staff and helpful when they could see we were not sure what to get for our table of 3. Not a pricy place very reasonable prices. Plenty of space and even outside sitting, over all clean place.
name: Sandra

text: So i am a glutton for punishment.... went for valentines day dinner. Had the chilean sea bass again and this time it was overcooked. So was my daughters. Asked for butter for bread and waitress never returned with it. My sides were wrong and the rubber taste due to being overcooked ruined the night. NEVER AGAIN. I gave the 3 chances to get it right and the fell way short. This is possibly the worst seafood restaurant EVER!
name: L

text: Don't be scared off by the silly chain restaurant style spelling of their name. This place is fresh & DELISH. Been here twice - the shredded chicken mango salad and avocado toast dishes were really, really, good. Service is extremely pleasant. Definitely on par with any other farm to table lunch place in town. If you dare, their cinnamon roll is bigger than your head and also super yum. Nice kids menu. Smoothies. Iced teas. It's all here. Except for matcha lattes. Ahem. Please add.
name: miss

text: Not a full review as we purchased a beer and mimosa the morning we were walking at the French Market.  But, there's clearly something special about this place and they have some comfortable and inviting seating just in front of this bistro.  I'd use this as an oasis on a hot day and if hungry, I was tempted to try the muffuletta here.
name: Gary

text: I'm from Nashville and was hosting friends from out of town tonight. We walked in The 404 Kitchen to grab some cocktails and a few appetizers on the rooftop patio. The hostess was rude and said we were only allowed on the roof if we purchased a meal?! It's a Tuesday night. There isn't a line to get in, nor is it full on roof patio? Unbelievable. Instead we walked down the street for a more accommodating venue where they gladly accepted our business. Poor choice of "policy". Bad business.
name: Sarah

text: I don't understand the appeal. Soggy sandwiches with weird flavors. Not my first choice.
name: Vicki

text: I'm so happy I tried My Thai. I love yellow curry and pineapple fried rice, but haven't found any in St. Louis as good as what grew up eating in California, until I tried it here. The food is really fresh and so flavorful :) the yellow curry is what I've been looking for. I'm looking forward to trying more from the menu.
name: Danielle

text:
Finally made it by this establishment to try their food. I've driven by it a hundred times since it opened and took the plunge. Ordered three meals and Krab Rangoon. First entree was Mixed fish platter. Fish was cooked very well and the batter was crispy and it wasn't greasy at all which is typical of fish that has been over cooked. The shrimp were on average didn't expect fresh bay shrimp but it was on par for semi-fast food. Then the BBQ Beef, platter was kind of mediocre in size. The sides were small one being Lima beans. Two tablespoons per side the other being mixed vegetable and a small 1/2 cup of macaroni salad. Lastly the Beef Teriyaki bowl. Again, small and I was a bit disappointed in the 5 pieces of beef in the bowl mixed with cabbage, carrots, broccoli and water chestnuts with rice. The redeeming factor was it did taste good and I enjoyed it. Second part of the meal was beef lo Mein. Again mediocre portion size compared to local Chinese take away. But the noodles were very good and it had a lot of great flavor. Typical mix of noodles, flat iron steak and sauce it had a small amount of heat to it which was a subtle change from the mainstream Lo Mein. 
Krab Rangoon would have been a home rub of it would have had more flavor in the filling. But I haven't found Krab Rangoon that was cooked fresh and looked as good as they prepare anywhere else. $3.95 for 6 pieces. They were prepared the traditional way flower type wrap and not the normal triangle shaped pocket Krab Rangoon with was a pleasant discovery. Total meal cost was about $40.00 which is about average for three people these days. 

Restaurant was very clean and kitchen looked very clean as well. They had everything organized and you can tell the chefs were attentive to a clean work area. The decor was very sparse but I don't think many sit and eat there and mostly like Chinese takeaway people get their food to go as we did. Employees were very cordial and helpful.

I'll visit them again and try other things on the menu because the food overall was prepared well and the cleanliness of the kitchen really makes a customer feel better about eating at a restaurant. At least for me it does. I'd love to see them abandon the styrofoam containers and move to a different system of packaging food and if they increase their portion sizes it will be a total winner for the money. 
If you're looking for a average priced but good food experience on the go and you enjoy a variation of Chinese food mixed with a Hawaiian flare then you will enjoy this place.
name: Ken

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
Ordered my filet medium rare and definitely came out as medium....

We asked our server (who was very helpful) for a steak knife and she stated that the restaurant literally has only one as prior patrons have stolen them so the restaurant decided not to provide for steaks.... so we had butter knives for steaks.

Food was better than an Outback Steakhouse but not by too much :/
name: Amanda

text:
I was originally hesitant about visiting Moshulu due to some of the lukewarm reviews, but we had a great time! While it was really foggy the particular evening we came, precluding the Instagram-worthy (I don't even have Instagram) pictures we wanted to take, the ship itself was impressive nonetheless.

We were quickly seated near a window and greeted by our first server. I say "first" because we ended up having three servers at different times, but it all worked out. 

In my continuing quest for libation diversification, I ordered a Pyrus Mule. Let's call it a Moscow Mule but totally not a Moscow Mule--with Grey Goose pear, ginger beer, ginger liqueur, and lime. It was super refreshing. 

On the food food menu, we started with the chicken dumplings (solid choice) and wedge salad (that thing was HUGE). I had the French dip (I was going to order something else but the server informed me that it would have been fried in oil where fish was fried, so I appreciated the attentiveness to my pesky allergy). It was definitely a large portion -- everything is a large portion, FYI -- but the beef was pretty tender. 

Service was attentive and friendly. I was pleased to come to Moshulu and even saw a client here. Good spot!
name: Willie

text: The atmosphere was amazing. Right off the water with a great view of the city. The veggie burger was really good. Honestly, some of the best pesto sauce I have ever had with the bread.
name: Josh

text: They have excellent food but are closed at the moment :( was sad when I stopped by for dinner was so looking forward to their food again. I am looking forward to them reopening
name: Bryan

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Would probably stop in again if nearby. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Came here for the first time and loved it! The ambiance and service is great and amazing food! We had the sweet pea and avocado toast app ( so fresh and tasty) and for the main dishes: basil and white been ravioli and flat iron steak. Both were great! We will definitely be back.
name: Laura

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would probably stop in again if nearby. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Great food. Love the wings! They always taste well cooked. BBQ fried hard. Only downside...Girl at the counter has a bad attitude.
name: Danielle

text: I had the Salt & Pepper Chicken Wings lunch special that came with an egg roll and a choice of fried rice or white rice. The chicken was fried perfectly with sautee jalapenos and garlic. My sister always gets the same Pan Fried Noodle. The crispy pan fried noodles resemble a bird nest and is pile up with flavorful seafood and veggies with a thick sauce. Mom had the Roasted Duck Noodle soup. Mom's a lite eater but she ate all her food so you know it must be good. We also ordered the Choy Sim with garlic. It was delish, not overly sauce up like most restaurant we go to. Service was great as always.
name: Phuong

text: Dessert saved this a little. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: This is my favorite place to eat in the mall. The people that work here are the kindest people that I have come across. The food is a Mexican Korean hybrid and is delicious. My favorite is the chicken bowl. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a quick delicious place to eat downtown.
name: Cole

text: I don't like posting negative reviews but, today was a new experience... Tried this place out for the first time, and halfway eating the burger - which was decent - I found a hair in the lettuce. I proceeded to bring it to the counter, where they hesitantly took it back and I asked for fries instead. They brought back more fries - in the SAME tray WITH the hair still on the tray ‍ I was pretty disappointed. Won't be coming back.
name: Cindy

text: I want to like this place more than I actually do. I have been 3 times, last night was the last hopefully. If y'all charge $10 for 2 tacos, please fill them up to create a meal. Too much tortilla to filling ratio.  Im specifically talking about cauliflower, a super cheap ingredient. 2 people had tacos, apps, 2 orders of enchiladas, 2 alcoholic beverages & the bill was $180 with tip. Completely ridiculous pricing for what is still Mexican food. Is your rent really high? Can't figure out why the food is so costly & portions are meh.
name: Corrie

text: I went to this Chipotle for lunch with a friend today  (which I found out she has been oddly mispronouncing it Chipotay all her life haha). The inside and surrounding was rather clean with a welcoming atmosphere and friendly patrons. I ordered the chicken burrito. I opened it and it was split in half which made it almost impossible to eat without a fork/spoon. I also took issue with the cashier who seem to hate her job or maybe, was just having a bad day. Overall, I love chipotle fresh ingredients and will eventually give it a try again.
name: Kia

text: Great beer selection with live music and food. Outdoor/indoor seating in Nashville.  Reasonable in price and outstanding service.
name: John

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. You can tell they care about customer experience here. A very pleasant experience. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food was good and came out fast. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: Mmmm white lightning doughnut.  Always friendly employees !!! Love yum yum doughnuts !! First choice of local doughnuts
name: Snickers

text: The food is fine but I have never had worse customer service in my life. Ordered soup, pepper chicken, schezuan chicken and lo mein. I drove 40 min round trip to pickup my order after confirming my order over the phone TWICE. I also confirmed my order again in the restaurant and checked my receipt. I came home and opened the container of pepper chicken only to find out I was given pepper steak. The person who ordered the pepper chicken can't have beef so she didn't have a meal now. I called the restaurant and explained what happened and the cashier who answered said "oh it was a mistake." She told me I could come back and exchange the food. I explained that I wasn't going to drive for nearly another hour and I needed them to deliver the correct order. She insisted nobody could deliver the food and had me speak to the owner. When I spoke to the owner I explained the situation again and told her if she couldn't send someone to correct my order I would like a refund for the pepper chicken. She insisted that I bring the dish back and would only refund me "tomorrow". I wasn't comfortable with not getting a refund immediately so she told me that she could only immediately refund the whole ticket and if she did that she wanted the food back. I said I was happy to let someone come pick up the food for a refund but I wasn't going to drive 40 min again because I wasn't the one who messed up. She started yelling at me saying it was just a mistake and she couldn't do anything about it. I told her that was unacceptable and to please send someone and refund the order. After continuing to yell at me she said she refunded the order and then told me to take the food and throw it away and that she didn't want to talk to me anymore. Then proceeded to hang up. In no world is it acceptable for a restaurant owner to yell at a customer or tell them to throw food away because of their own mistake. Will never be returning and I'll be sure to let people know that coming here is a mistake.
name: Munira

text:
It's not a very exciting name for a restaurant, but what it lacks in creativity it makes up for in quality. This location is one of those suburban strip malls that doesn't look like much (a second one recently opened Uptown). Inside it is quite pleasant and a large space, and is a full service restaurant with a quiet, adult vibe. It wasn't my first choice for dining on the night I stopped in, but I was quite happy with what I ordered.

The hummus is legit, as it ought to be. However, the veggie platter I got was full of exciting choices, from an indulgent cheese eggroll with dipping sauce to lentils that tasted pleasantly of charred garlic. As a vegetarian, I could easily come back and order something completely different, which I always appreciate. I might be more inclined to try the second location than come back to this one, but regardless, the place seems to be doing well for itself.
name: John

text:
i heard about this place doing AYCE sushi but first time coming here, wasn't that hungry so i settled for a roll and yaki udon.

the philly roll is something simple and i think they did it OK, the roll job wasn't the prettiest but the fish seemed somewhat fresh. the yaki udon was OK, the sauce was average but it was a bit too oily for my taste.

all in all, this place is OK but i'm intrigued to see how their AYCE sushi is

text: Service was great,beer was cold good selection. However the food was disgusting. The shepherd's pie smelled like the mop bucket water. Sent it back got the meatloaf same smell. The macaroni and cheese tasted like it was made the week before. We won't be back. The 2 stars are for the great service of the waitress who was the only one that I saw.

text: I got a take out order.  The food was tasty and well prepared. The staff is friendly. The restaurant decor is older and needs updating yet it appeared clean!
name: Lisa

We started with the truffle arancini, had their special pizza of the night, some vegetables, trottole, scallops and duck (I can't remember the rest). We weren't rushed at all. The food was incredible with very healthy portions. My parents took home food for most of the week

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was good and came out fast. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Love their new location inside of TREO. Didn't take long for our food to come out & it was so fresh.

text: Time and time again I return to Cracker Barrel due to their consistency. I am always satisfied whenever I come here. I prefer Cracker Barrel over iHop, Denny's, Perkins, etc.

text:
Damn. Chap's Chicken REALLY blew me away. Best fried chicken in NOLA imho. It's super cheap, super delicious, and the people are super nice! I had recently injured my foot (dramatic toe stubbing incident the night before), and the woman there insisted on bringing my food out to me in my car. 

I went on a Saturday right when they opened, and they fried up the chicken for me right there while I waited! Since it's made to order, you should call ahead if you're in a hurry. They also have a bunch of yummy sides! I'm not even going to talk about how AMAZING the chicken was, just go get some for yourself!

They also deliver on Waitr.
name: Olivia

text: The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Went here with some friends on a Wednesday night. I had never even noticed this place before so I was excited to try something new to me. I love the space. It's quaint and cute. The decor catches your eye. The service was decent but we were the only people in there. The chips and salsa were good. The food was good as well. It came out pretty quickly. I ordered nachos with barbacoa and they were really good. It had tons of meat. I couldn't even eat it all. They had the meat, lettuce, pico, jalapeños, and sour cream. Plenty of jalapeños just like I like them. My friends all enjoyed their meals as well. I definitely want to come back so I can try their drinks. I had been drinking before going to eat so I decided to slow my roll so I'll definitely be getting a margarita next time.
name: Alexis

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later.
name: User

text:
Taking my kids to Dave and Busters falls along the same lines as taking them to Six Flags. They love it, I dread it. 

I've only been here twice, the most recent being this past weekend. When I think of D&B, I think of spending a ton of money, only getting to play a handful of games, and my kiddos leaving with some crappy prizes. It's just not a great situation. They are getting a little old for Chuck E. Cheese, but at least there you pay for a game card and get a few hours out of it.

When we arrived, I asked the front desk what the best deal was for games. I ended up paying $56 or so for what the employees said would last us a couple of hours. We ran out of game credits after 35 minutes. It was totally insane. Because I couldn't stomach dropping more cash on games, we decided to eat lunch. This part was actually alright... the boys enjoyed some chicken strips and pretzel dogs, and I was able to find a salad I really liked. Our server was wonderful.

She added $10 to my card for a few more games, which lasted us approximately 4 minutes.

We took our game card to the "prize store" to cash in, and left with two stuffed animals that I later realized were scented. Yes, horribly scented stuffed animals. 

I don't think we'll be back.
name: Aimee

text: Went here for a breakfast sandwich, and can't say I'll be going back anytime soon. Restaurant was pretty empty at the time of order but developed a line as I waited for my order. It was mid morning on a week day and they had already ran out of sausage when I ordered, had a limited bagel selection, and the order took forever to get. Seemed to be understaffed which affected service, but also the bagel sandwich was just meh. Definitely better options out there.
name: C

text: The best sushi we have ever had! We are sushi lovers.Extremely polite staff, very good service, the portions were huge! We will be back for sure!
name: Lee Ann

text: I have been coming here every Wednesday for lunch after work for about a year. Cheyenne is almost always my bartender and she greets me with a warm hello and knows what beer I'm going to order. There are a few of us that meet up for lunch when our schedules line up. Lately Cheyenne has been absent and it seems the Wednesday lunch crowd has disappeared with her. There were a lot of people that seemed to be pretty well regulars and I'm sure I'm not her only one, but regulars become regulars because they really like how something is. She knows our preferences and whether or not we want another drink or the turkey heated up in the Wednesday wrap special. I have just noticed a decline in the lunch crowd over the last two months or so. Nothing is wrong with the service in her absence, but it's just not like it was and it shows in smaller lunch crowd. The consistency and the rapport that she had with her guests is missing now.
name: Brad

text: Bartaco is such a great twist on a taco place. The atmosphere and decor is beautiful. You order your tacos off of a piece of paper, and turn it into your server, making the ordering process super easy. The Baja fish taco was my favorite and the guac is a must-try.

text: The best shrimp po boy I've had. We had the fried pickles too. You can tell that they use very clean oil for frying. The bread was perfect too.

text: Loved the atmosphere and decor of this place. Prices were fair and loved the $2 beer special. The jalapeño & cheese sausage was killer, but unfortunately the brisket lacked flavor and was pretty dry. The mac and cheese was good, but only big enough for one person so no sharing! The corn bread I also thought was pretty dry and tasteless. They had a good assortment of bbq sauces to try which was nice - I liked the smoky bbq sauce and the mustard the best. I would definitely come back for the sausage, but I'd have to rethink getting the brisket again.

text: My dad LOVES their Sordough bread, thin slices of course! We make a once a week trip to Panera to pick up his favorite treats. If it weren't for Panera I might be able to ever get him out of the house, lol!

text: Feel the burn!!! Pretty sure that's supposed to be a work out reference, but it seems fitting considering the hot strips had a nice, spicy kick to them. text: The cashiers were really nice. It was clean in there. They let me sample a spoonful of stuff before I purchased. They didn't act upset or impatient with my indecisiveness. The food was good and cheap. I'd def come back to this place.

text:
This place had THE BEST eggs Benedict I've ever had. I got "The Trifecta" which features their shrimp eggs Benedict, chicken eggs Benedict, and the pork eggs Benedict. The chicken was definitely the best and honestly to die for, with the pork being a close second. It's a must try! The shrimp I could've done without, but there was nothing wrong with it! Just not of my taste for brunch. 

We also ate a BYO omelet which was pretty good! We loaded it up with every kind of meat which was good, but just a little too much for me. That was my friends order.. lol. The potatoes that came with it were crunchy and good too!

To finish we had the stuffed French toast! They were featuring salted caramel and it was a perfect dessert still with a taste of brunch. 

I would definitely recommend this place but I would warn that it is very crowded and loud! The loudness didn't really bother me, but I was almost getting claustrophobic because of how close I was to other people eating out. Maybe 3-4 deer between you and table next to you. I'll be back regardless of that, just a forewarning!

text:

I had high hopes, but nope. 

Consider somewhere else.

text: I am going to give this place another chance. I will explain in the following review. This restaurant purely on food was disappointing. The stewed black beans w/pork was bland. The Baja taco fish was small and mostly just breeding not really seasoned at all with a pretty tasteless slaw on it. The pork pasture was very good though cooked well and season perfectly. There was a undercooked piece of something in the taco filling. The atmosphere although a little loud isn't to bad and it is a good place for people to get together for some drinks. The ordering is as you need which I enjoy not having a waiter always hovering over you. Although when I explained my opinion on the food the wait staff was very friendly. They genuinely wanted to make sure my experience was excellent. I thank them all very much and am looking forward to trying this place again. Restaurants to me are all about how good the food is so that is why the rating isn't higher for me. Maybe it was just those two items on the menu which is why I'm willing to try this place again. Also because the waitstaff and atmosphere of this place is wonderful. Price I would say it's ok the tacos are 2.5-3.5 but the portions are tiny so you need 3-4 for a meal. The are street style tacos but even for street tacos they where small. I would say give this place a try if not for the food for a cocktail and great service.

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Honestly, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated because that happens a lot. Anyway, the experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Idk, the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something i'm still thinking about two days later. not sure I'd order the same thing again. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. text:
Goodness, this little spot makes me happy. Maybe it's the striking crisp white subway tile behind the meat counter. Maybe it's the perfectly stocked shelves of Mexican spices. I don't know, this space is just beautifully designed, bright and welcoming. You're lured through the shelves of specialty Mexican grocery items until you finally come to the hot counter with rows of stewed meats, steaming chicharron, pozole, menudo and more taunting you from behind the glass. 

As you're salivating over everything you're offered free samples of anything in the cases by the most friendly and kind staff! The staff is so happy you're there. Want some meats to take home on the grill, they have it all. Marinated, not marinated, whatever you like. Don't have a grill at home or lets be real, you're just feeling lazy? Mr. Toro's staff will throw it on the grill for you free of charge! 

The Birria is top notch. The red chile pork is fall apart good, not spicy but that's okay because the flavor is wonderful. Green chile pork punching with flavor and just the right amount of heat for me. The breakfast burros, made to order are stuffed with anything you'd like on a soft flour tortilla. I've had one with chorizo and I would order again. Pork chicharron so crispy and tender, grabbing a bag to share is a must. 

You can take your meal to go after loading up on salsas and toppings at the salsa bar OR you can dine in, they have a few small bar style seating areas. 

Such a welcome locally owned spot in the current dining desert state of the Rita Ranch/Vail Area. Don't live in the area? Try a Tucson adventure, just drive East  on Valencia as far as you can, if you hit the dirt road you'll know you've just passed it. :)
name: Paige

text:
Trendy hipster spot, part coffee house with house roasted coffee, part craft beer bar, and part restaurant. We were a party of 7, looking for an affordable and interesting place in Sem Heights for college girl's bday. 

Food: The prices here are extremely reasonable for the neighborhood and vibe. The menu doesn't go too deep -- it's mostly burritos, flatbreads, burgers, sandwiches, not elaborate dinners. So everything is around $8-11 and PLENTY of food.  And in that price range, you still get some interesting creative ingredients and recipes, it is not a boring menu.  Everyone liked their food except one of us -  fried chicken and waffles, burritos, and the chicken flatbread were all great. The shrimp flatbread - meh, pretty bad, soggy, don't get that one.  

Drinks:  the coffee was WOW.  House roasted means crazy fresh, and they know what their doing in that department. French press. 

Service: Above and beyond! They positively doted on us from the start. Waiting for half of our party to meet us, we welcomed and chatted with. They checked with the chef about accommodating our Celiac diner (no problem at all).  The 2 staff that interacted with us just have that natural host personality I wish everyone in the industry had.

Decor: Love the furniture!  Really interesting lounge furniture, neat comfy oversized chairs.  Bike pedals on the bar stools. Old time pharmacy theme. interesting things to look at everywhere, very fun.

It fits in nicely in Seminole Heights.
name: Julie

text:
I would wager to say that 317 Burger is one of the most underrated burger joints in the city, and that's a big statement coming from a city who is inundated with solid burger joints. 317 Burger, tucked into the heart of Broad Ripple, seems to check all my boxes:

- lots of options that are totally customizable 
-great service that's never pretentious 
-affordable (you don't have to pay extra for your sides)
-and totally accessible, we rarely have to wait and they even have accommodated groups up to 20 for us.

Love that this spot is in my neighborhood and love to have a go to for friends that come to town!
