text:
Left a bad taste in my mouth (figuratively) and my kids mouths (literally).

Their policy of surreptitiously adding a 3.99% fee for using a credit card is a slap in the customer's face after they've just charged you up to $26 for dozen donuts.

When they ring you up and tell you the total (and you see the total w/ tax on the screen), THEN you see this additional "fee" only on the printed receipt.

When confronted they pointed me to a tiny 3x4" placard with fine print saying something about "use cash and get a discount" (when that really means "use cash and get the quoted price, and we'll charge you an extra fee if you use a digital form of payment"). Discount, my booty.

Not sure if they understand how business works, but when you can get upwards of $3-4 per donut (keep in mind the donuts are about 2/3 the size of a typical donut you get anywhere else), it takes some audacity to make the customer also pay your processing fees (otherwise known as "cost of doing business.")

I remember reading a news article about a restaurant in NYC that pulled this stunt and they got shredded in the news and on social media. Perhaps nobody else has ever noticed that Fit Donut is doing that, or they're just too low-profile.

I'll likely dispute the additional fee with my credit card company.

I liked the donuts OK, and I was pleased with the very low sugar content. The kids really didn't, none of them could get through one.
name: Brian

text:
If I could only eat one meal not cooked by my own hands per month... or even a year, it would have to be at, Ken Sushi & Asian Bistro!

Always celebrate the wonder and beauty of life and nature! And never skimp on what you put into your body! 

Magnificent dinner tonight! Thank you, Ken!

I am grateful for the gift of life and sustenance from my fellow creatures.  Namaste.  @ Ken Sushi & Asian Bistro 
*********
This is one of the best sushi restaurants I've ever dined at from coast to coast! Each dish is prepared to perfection with care and the specials will continually surprise with the personal touches finessed by Ken. Allow me to be specific: Ken's weekly oyster special is simply sublime. A cultural potpourri of subtle and unexpected flavors that melts the palate and tantalize the tastebuds. 

The tempura is always perfect! Clean tasting with no cross contamination from other foods. Just perfectly crisp on the outside and moist and flavorful within. The soft shell crab is sublime.

I love toro, but Ken passes over anything that not perfect and so while it's not always on the menu, when it is, it is a buttery deliciousness explosion of flavor that melts in your mouth. The Uni? Whether from Chile, the Pacific Coast or occasionally Japan is always creamy with the brisk briny flavor of cold winter surf.

And finally, Ken is a master of blue fish. I hesitate to let the secret out for fear of there being less for this greedy aficionado's greedy soul, but in the spirit of piscine brotherhood I will share some thoughts that cause me to drive all the way from the East Coast when I get word that a special order has come in. Succulent sardines rolled in basil? Pungent Spanish Mackrel served on the bone with just a touch of lemon and sea salt? Then finished with the center fried into a savory rich chip? OMG!

From service to freshness and quality to presentation, Ken's stands up and excels beyond almost any place you can find from NY to Los Angeles to Vancouver. If you order the last one before I get there, expect a reckoning!
name: Joseph

I understand they don't want to throw away food but whoever was in charge that day fails to understand that when you are at Reading Terminal there are always going to be patrons trying you for the first time. Anyone who ate the mac & cheese that day are customers that will never come back and could be Yelpers who are going to leave a bad review. text: It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Nothing about the space rlly stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. For a busy night they handled it okay. Worth checking out. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Good service and great atmosphere. My wife had the chicken pot pie and it was very tasty. I ordered the Ruben with home made pastrami and it was one of the best rubens I have ever had. Got tatertots with it and was not disappointed.
name: Mike

text: Great casual place for families with little kids. I'd give three stars for food, four for overall vibe/service. This is a quintessential Santa Barbara, low-key place for food. It's a perfect place to walk off Santa Claus beach and head into - no need to dust the sand off. Stick with burgers. The fish tacos are ok but kind of bland. Affordable. The grilled cheese for kids is a very generous portion - could easily be split across two small children.
name: Lindsey

text: Always one of my favorite! As expected, great wine pairings listed for each meal. The assortment of potato options help you find what you enjoy. I love the chicken parm. I have been in a large girls night, date night and an event and it's always the same quality. Easy parking and advanced reservations!
name: Sabrina

text: I would have actually given this bakery 3.5 stars if yelp offered half stars, but I didn't want to unfairly drag their overall rating down so 4 stars it is! I ordered a few items including a blueberry glazed donut, lemon bar, and spinach/feta pastry. The donut was a little bit dry but had a good balance of flavor with sweet and salty. The lemon bar just wasn't tart enough for my taste. The spinach and feta pastry was the most disappointing because it looked so beautiful with an intricate pattern in the pastry, but it was bland in flavor. The price point was great and I will definitely continue to support this local bakery. Perhaps I just ordered the wrong items.
name: Shabnam

text: Good flavor, the seafood was good, potatoes and corn also tasty. The salad with seared tuna also had great flavors. The interior was clean and had good ambiance, also in a cute local neighborhood. I'm glad we found this place on our trip to NOLA. Their review on Google is excellent.
name: Jade

text: I've been coming to this place since it opened! The quality and taste of the food has not wavered since I can remember! The restaurant itself is always clean and well presented! The staff are always so friendly and very helpful. Yes it can take a bit for them to attend to you sometimes, but again we all have to take into consideration that they are trying their best to juggle so many people and orders. I very much would recommend this place to anyone seeking great quality Vietnamese food! Much love to this place, great way to satisfy those pho or bo luc lac cravings!
name: Jo

text: I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Very delicious! Food came very fast and it was very satisfactory and yummy. The people were friendly and helpful and the service was efficient. I would recommend this place to anyone in the area because it is very good!

text: where you can go for a good quality japanese meal and shop the grocery shop. def top notch and consistent.

text: By far the best pho in town. My favorite is the brisket pho (+ add beefballs... and if they have the peppery ones add those for sure!) Also another must have is their lemongrass pork spring rolls they are just divine!
name: Karine

text: I had been wanting to try this place for a while, and it's right around the corner. So shame on me that it was my first visit. I will say that the clutter can make this place unwelcoming, but the hospitality and food more than make up for it. The food quality was beyond most places anywhere in the area for sure. It is not the usual daunting menu of endless specialty rolls, which can kind of throw you off because that is what I'm accustomed to, but the fact you can just build your own sushi and also there are some great specialty rolls makes it very interesting. We dined with a vegetarian who had so many options, which was great. The ramen was delicious as well (my wife doesn't do sushi) so it's really good all around. Definitely will visit again!
name: Paul

text: Awesome late afternoon Sunday brunch. No reservation so we ate at the bar. Keep your eyes peeled for seats because they go fast. The bar tenders are fabulous and really know how to handle a crowd. The crab bisque was surprisingly delicious with plenty of depth and well seasoned. The slight evoo drizzle and cream swirls were a nice touch...$18 for bottomless mimosas so of course I came thirsty! Must find street parking and be prepared to walk a block or two because the neighborhood stays packed and busy.
name: Deirdre

text: This is a MUST DO place for anyone in Tampa or visiting from elsewhere. We stopped at Armature Works when we landed from out of town, and we ended up going back twice in a long weekend! The restaurants are excellent -- so much variety -- and there are tons of places to sit: outdoor Adirondack chairs, benches and tables, high top tables, a spot in the middle with some misters on hot days, etc. They have complimentary sparkling, room temperature, and cold water on tap. There is an adorable little shop with goods from local vendors. They have free parking but it does get busy and full, so you may have to look around the area. Still, I can't say enough good things! You have to go!
name: Allyson

text:
After reading about the restaurant and the pedigree owners, it was on our bucket list to try the food.  Needless to say, we were disappointed in both the food and the service.  For instance, prior to ordering the pimento cheese from the Happy Hour menu, we asked our server if anything came with it.  She answered it was served with "saltine crackers".  It was not saltine crackers, but more of a wafer for dipping.  Although the presentation of the pimento cheese was elegant, there was not much in the dish.  In addition, it was very greasy.
  
We then inquired about the Hot Crawfish Fried Chicken Basket.  Our concern was how hot was it.  The same server told us it was spicy, but not so hot that you had to drink water after each bite.  Being the first time there, I asked if the basket included a breast, wing, thigh, etc. and was told that she didn't know what was white meat and what was dark meat, but that it came all together.  We ordered it anyway, and after a couple bites of the boneless chicken, our mouths were numb.  It was so hot, not even the cornbread biscuit could cut the hotness.  

We decided we had had enough and requested the remaining food be boxed up.  I doubt if we will visit this restaurant again.  If we are in the area again, we would opt to go to Reginelli's across the street.
name: Roy M

text:
I enjoyed my first visit to Dewey's! I was greeted warmly when I came in, was seated promptly and was approached swiftly by a smiling server. I ordered the calzone since I was solo. Most pizza places are best for couples or more because you can order a big pizza and share. They have a special pizza and then a variety of specialty pizzas that are always on the menu with interesting combinations. My eye caught the Don Corelone, but before I let myself get excited by reading the description, I ordered the calzone. No need to go overboard with tons of leftovers. But in the course of the time I was there, the don coreleone was ordered by at least 3-4 tables. 

The calzone arrived in a reasonable amount of time, and I was pleasantly surprised the dough was soft and pillowy, versus cracker-like and crusty. It was nice and hot, and came with the perfect amount of marinara- not too much that you felt guilty having leftovers but not so little you run it after a couple of bites. The manager stopped by my table and asked how was everything and he seemed happy to be there and liked his job, which I love! 

The O'Fallon location of Dewey's pizza did a great job and my first experience was good. Check it out if you are ever on I-64 and Green mount crossing on the side with the new hospital. It is worth a visit if you like pizza.
name: Tiffany

text: Made it out to Retreat Gastropub on a Saturday night around 7pm and got right in to sit at a table without any wait. The place was crowded, but comfortable. The decor is inviting while still being cool and modern. The cocktails were phenomenal - the menu is daunting, I was worried that my drink would be overly flavored or turn out to be a weird flavor that I would not like. However, it was delicious, unique, and hit the spot. The meal was delicious. We had the poutine, a seasonal salad, and the farmhouse burger with rosemary fries. All courses of the meal were top notch. Again, unique preparations that you won't find anywhere else. Service was great, our waitress was very friendly and knowledgable about the menu. I will definitely be visiting Retreat Gastropub again!
name: Paige

text: Anything you've heard about dat dog is absolutely true. This place is 100%. It's amazing after a long night of drinking down Frenchman and you need a late night snack this the place to go to. Cool vibe, awesome music and to top it off AMAZING HOT DOGS
name: Breia

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..

text: Food was good.  Perfect waffle, chicken fried just right. Heat was good w/ actual flavor as well. I preordered, and it was fast pick up. In and out, almost immediately. The only negative is that I asked for syrup and blue cheese and received neither. Not a big deal really, but I deducted a star. I'm sure I'll be back to update it to a 5.

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Everything was great!! Tried the cocquito, Spanish potatoes, oatmeal, and chilaquilles. Will be back for the pancakes, short rib, and Korean Benedict. Don't forget to BYOB
name: Chris

text:
We stopped in for a beer and meal after work and were impressed with the beer list and menu. Several IPA's I would have liked to try were kicked. Our server, KellyG came right over and took our order and checked on us frequently. We ordered the buffalo flatbread and the sauce had some kick to it which was nice. I ordered the pulled pork sandwich, which was pork mixed with sauteed spinach, and the roll was very soggy. 
The only complaints we had were an unfortunate problem with a few pesky flies, and very noisy guys at the bar to the point that we were yelling to each other to hear... and it was not crowded. Not an intimate spot, but then it wasn't pretending to be.
name: Rich

text:
This is another one of the many nice additions to Seminole Heights. The cityscape in this neighborhood is now changing with a newly constructed multi-story building next door to the front porch restaurant right across the street now. I almost barely recognize the area.

The food selections are pretty decent and so are the drinks. About 50% of the seating is outside while the rest is inside. The environment inside and out are very beautiful. It was definitely a nice use of the space on this neighborhood corner block.

The people who work in the outdoor bar were so friendly. They were really nice in helping me choose the wine I like from the list. It was that night that I discovered there are Pinot Grigios that I like. 

My favorite appetizer/side dish so far here is the grilled avocado. I also had the charcuterie platter and share the wings with a side salad. They were all really good. For the charcuterie platter, you get to pick out which cheese/meat you want for that order from a list of choices on the menu.  I haven't had dessert yet here, but hope to visit back soon.
name: Shuné

text: I mostly enjoyed everything this place had to offer. Besides it being kind of hard to find, the inside was beautiful and relaxing. Equipped with a little lounge room where you had to be barefoot and sit on the ground on pillows. Very authentic. The main dining area even had games on a bookshelf for entertainment and there were seats outside as well. I ordered iced matcha tea and the vegan spring rolls. My tea was delicious but the rolls were quite bland so I didn't finish them. If you're looking for a mellow place to study, this is perfect.
name: Allesse

text:
We stayed for the location but I doubt we'd stay again. When we pulled up the valet guys were chatting at each other and didn't come up to us until my husband asked if they could park the car. Later, he went to retrieve something from the car and found it unlocked. 

The room was clean but very dated and musty. The bed was comfortable. The main hotel was dusty and could use a thorough cleaning and TLC. While in the lobby bar my husband overheard the bartender telling another staff member he had found a cockroach in a menu .

The steam room in the spa was nice. The spa itself was dated. Staff were mostly friendly but everyone seemed busy and flustered.

This place really needs a renovation and management upgrade.

text: Just ordered a pizza from Papa John on the Williams location. Brought it home and the garlic sauce leaked all over the box and pizza. Gladly it didn't leak in the car. The sauce had to be open before they out it in. However, the pizza was good.

text: After a long day, Hollyhock was suggested by a colleague from Indiana.  This place is absolutely great ... and not just chicken! Apparently they just went through internal reno - perfect.  Had the Filet prepared with obligatory mashed with Kendall on the side. Service was impeccable, not too close or far when required.  Highly suggested if you want to steer away from boring chains and have a great meal in a unique space. Cheers

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick. You can tell they care about customer experience here. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. It looked better online than it did in person.

The staff seemed tired but still polite. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..

text: Not my cup of coffee. There is no private parking lot here, you have to find street parking. There is a beautiful view on the outdoor patio area, however it was bitter cold when I visited, no dice. I ordered two of their specialty lattes and they were nothing to write home about. They were regular tasting lattes that cost over $5 each that were supposed to have whiskey notes which I didn't taste. It could have been that Steadfast, the barista, or the coffee gods were having an off day and decided to curse me with what tasted like watered down lattes. However, my negative review isn't about the coffee, it's about my experience. The reason why I'm rating Steadfast Coffee 3-stars is because while I was waiting on my order of coffee the place was completely packed and I just stood in the middle of the cafe awkwardly for more than 20 minutes. I don't care to stand but it just rubbed me the wrong way. There were (several) seats taken by women's LV purses at the bar area and baristas that passed me said nothing. I didn't ask anyone to move their bag, however people clearly saw me standing with a heavy backpack and simply looked away. I originally came to sit and do some work, but I guess those seats are reserved for more important clientele.

text: I was highly impressed by the service at The Love on my last visit. We came with our baby and dog (sitting outside) and the service was exceptional. They are super family friendly while having excellent food and beautiful decor. It's expensive but the experience is wonderful.
name: Sheri

text: Really good food. I was impressed with their service, ingredients, and overall quality. If you're in the area this is a cool place to grab some dinner. This is a great place!

text: We decided to try Bodovino. It was excellent! The chicken, cremini mushroom, artichoke flatbread pizza and Baron De Funes White Blend chardonnay was amazing! Briana was a fantastic server. Can't wait to come back with friends!
name: N.

text:
Just Meh. Decent place to stop in for some shared small plates, etc. but overall nothing that will really make me go out of my way to go back.

We went in on a Saturday night around 7pm and were one of only 3 tables. In looking around, none of the other patrons had any food yet, so we tried to go on and put in our order in case everyone was seating at the same time. It took probably 15 or so minutes after ordering to get our food, so not a bad wait. The waitress was friendly and made sure our waters were always filled.

However, when we got our food, the portion sizes were quite SMALL for the price. I ordered one of their special appetizers for the evening which was their Asian BBQ ribs (around $8-9). You literally got 3 tiny ribs. While they were honestly the best thing we ate, and the flavors, sauces, and meat was delicious, it was a meager portion for the cost.

We also ordered the fried potatoes and there was probably the equivalent of 1 or 2 small potatoes diced and fried in the bowl. Again, flavors were decent on this dish, but the portion was minuscule.

When it came to the mains or their rice dishes, we decided to go with their bourbon chicken fried rice. To say "chicken" in this is a misnomer, as we literally had MAYBE 3 teeny-tiny shreds of actual chicken in our rice. The flavor was just 'ok' and nothing to write home about. Another in our group ordered the pulled pork fried rice and it was next to awful. The flavor was terrible and the rice was dry as could be. Even their house spicy soy sauce didn't add enough flavor to make this dish worth $10-12.

At the end of the meal we paid and left, but were still hungry and a bit regretful. In our experience, you won't get a bad meal here, but you won't get a great one either.
name: Adam

text: Paige is an excellent server. Eight of us came in to celebrate my father in law's 85th birthday. Since he's on a strict 100% fat free diet we like Great Basin Brewing because of their black bean burger. Plus, if they're not too busy they'll bake the fries in the pizza oven. That way they are not cooked in oil. And don't overlook the extensive beer selection. We'll definitely be back.

The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Glad we tried it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing.

Awesome fast service, and great deal on drinks, wise burger selection too and fries are to die for. Would recommend to anyone looking for a friendly, relaxed atmosphere.

If you every leave less than satisfied it is your own issue. Speak up and let a manager know if something isn't just as you expected and I assure you they will make it right!

text: Excellent tacos! I had 3 tacos: Asada, Fish, and Shrimp tacos and WOW they were good. My favorite was the fish taco because it was the best fish taco I'd had in a very long time. The only bad thing was that I didn't have room for more! 3 tacos is plenty of food but I'm willing to bet you'd want to try all of them! It's an awesome little set up right next to the batting cages so they also have stuff like burgers, chicken fingers, tater tots and so on. Overall, we had 5 tacos plus the house made chips n salsa and a drink and it only came up to about $23-25(i don't remember exactly). Great price for the quality of food we had. They're a great reason to come back to SB for sure.

text: Bridget is the nicest bartender ever! She is really knowledgeable about the drinks and knows what to advice you on depending on your interest. I highly recommend her and Not your average Joe's for a great time

text: Our first visit and it was well worth the 20 minute wait. Food was cooked well and it was delicious! We ordered the Italian Prekky, french toast and pancakes and each dish was cooked to perfection. We will definitely be back!

text:
Brought a friend here today. I've gone here multiple times before and this was her first. She was not let down by the cheese steak; I'm no aficionado so I don't know what to look for, but she said the bread they used was great and the meat wasn't greasy like certain other places she had been to in the past.

I'm partial to the Uncle Frank's Italian Style Pulled Pork. The cheese and hot peppers are blended into the meat rather than dumped on top, so everything is dispersed rather evenly. Unlike DiNic's, removing or keeping ingredients does not cost extra. The roll usually has sesame seeds on it but maybe you could ask for one without - I haven't tried that since I like sesame seeds.

Their pizza pies are 4.99 a pound with a generous square-shaped portion. The crust is thick and depending on the toppings, it can be quite filling; I'm partial to the vegetable one myself. The Carlino's Specialty Pie is good too, but they don't carry that every day.

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The music was louder than it needed to be. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. For the price I expected more than this. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.

We were there before 6 so we caught some of the happy hour pricing. There is ample parking. The lounge is comfortable, although could be a touch warmer.

text:
While walking around in New Orleans we happened to walk by this place and decided to come back for dinner based solely on the fact that it is owned by Aarón Sánchez. We came on November 1st so we got to see the Day of the Dead alter and decorations, which I did not take a picture of out of respect. We were seated promptly and given a combination of tortilla chips, fried plantains, and salsa. The chips and the plantains were very good and a great compliment to the clearly house made salsa. The salsa was fresh, had a good texture, and good spice level. Before this neither one of us had had fried plantains but we both liked them. 
For an appetizer, we ordered the queso. We felt that it was a good value because they were very generous with the amount we were given. It is a white queso with fresh cilantro, chorizo, and jalapeños. The queso was really great, arguably the best queso dip we have ever had. 
For entreés we ordered 1 cauliflower and 2 carne asada tacos, and the carnitas burrito. The cauliflower taco was good. The cauliflower was seasoned nicely, had good crunch, and the sauce (red pepper aioli) was a good compliment to the flavors in the cauliflower. My favorite taco of the night was the carne asada taco, which had steak, jalapeños, guacamole, and pico de gallo. The burrito was also very good. It came topped with crema and queso. It was much larger than we were expecting and was filled with pork, refried black beans, and Mexican rice. 
Our waitress was great, attentive without hovering, and very sweet. 


Queso- $10
Tacos (3)- $6/taco
Burrito- $14
name: Alexandra

text: Outstanding Customer Service and great food had to make a post to acknowledge the service and the food
name: Dawn

text:
The Good: Nice selection of steak and seafood. Consistent. I dinned with a party of nine. I had the fillet and it was good, although I ordered medium rare and it was served medium. Overall everyone enjoyed their evening and meals. Four stars rather than five because the food was very good but a notch below comparable restaurants in Nashville. I will go again for the selection, location, service, and food but if I am looking for specific steak or seafood selection in the Nashvile market this wouldn't be my first choice. In Knoxville the Connors location IS one of my top two.

Tips: We over ordered the calamari appetizers...they are large portions, which is good :).
name: Dan

text: Ordered Flat Noodles with Shrimp, were hot and spicy. The menu is simple and clutter-free. They have big space it seems, but at lunch time the space was barely full.
name: Larry

text: Their toast was so good. They had so many different options which was also nice and they change their menu so it's nice to get to see something different every time you go.
name: Natalie

text:
Went on Saturday 9/29 about 8:30pm. 
High points: 
- the patio was nice, lots of TVs, bistro lights 
- some games to partake in if you feel so inclined 
Low points: 
- hands down the worst service I've had in a long time aside from our server Ashley who was working so hard with zero help from anyone else.  We waited a solid 10 minutes for our server to arrive. We asked one of the many girls waltzing around out on the patio doing nothing and she said "I'll find her" -- you're not doing anything why not help your fellow coworker out? As for the man wearing the purple polo that evening, I suspect the manager, get it together, Sir. You had a server drowning on the patio, countless other servers doing absolutely nothing and tables that had yet to be bussed.  Perhaps better planning on game days is something to consider? 
- the beer pours were terrible. Both beers came out with about an inch missing from the top -- obviously sitting there long enough for the head to settle. The big ass beer comes with a steep price considering what is paid at other places so the least one can ask for is a FULL beer. 

I'm not sure I will come back here. I hope the service improves because I wouldn't mind enjoying the patio again. 
And again, shoutout to Ashley working the patio that evening. When I asked her name she damn near fainted thinking I had nothing nice to say about her or the experience. She was clearly doing the best she could.
name: S

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Would absolutely visit again. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text:
I love Mexican food; been eating it and preparing it my entire life. In all of my travels up and down the Baja peninsula, living in southern California, traveling to Mexico have I EVER seen American cheese used in any Mexican food. EVER. You're kidding me, right? What genius thought that one up?

Therefore, this is not Mexican food nor does it taste like it in any way, shape, or form. Bland, tasteless, mushy, yucky. Enchilada sauce=tomato sauce. American cheese=?

My husband and I each took a couple of bites and put our forks down, and trust me, the two of us love to eat and try new places. This is the worst meal we've ever tasted. 

The only redeeming factor to this nightmare was the table-side made guac. That was worth the 10 bucks. The rest of it was trash.

One star for the guac. Nuff said, enter at your own risk.
name: Jeanette

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.

Just entering the restaurant makes me inhale the wonderful coffee aroma. Their coffee isn't the least bit bitter--nothing like Starbucks.

text: We have been going to this location for several years. We have noticed that it has been going downhill. The servers are not the problem, especially the ones that have been there a long time. We go on Sundays for breakfast and the last time we went the food was not stocked, cold, soaking in grease or to salty to even eat. We spoke to our server James but there was not much he could do. text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food is always good and there is plenty of it! My hubs and I have been a few times now and they are always short staffed, so while they try and hustle, service can be slow.

text:
Tucson needs more places like this! It's a great place to bring a large group or an indecisive family. It's like a bougie cafeteria (and I say that with all the love in my heart).

There are lots of options to choose from -- poke to pizza, burgers to barbecue -- so everyone can get what they want.

On our visit, my daughter got a slice of pizza from Upper Crust, I went for a salmon poke bowl at Dumb Fish, and my husband and our friend had Greek from Opa. I also got a specialty coffee drink at Cafe con Leche.

We were too early for a couple of the places, so we weren't able to try the barbecue place or the bar (bummer).

The seating is open, but it was pretty crowded when we went. It took a minute for us to find a table big enough for everyone.

It's similar to a food court, so most of the places don't bring you your food. They holler out your name or text you. And, because it's really just a bunch of different restaurants grouped together, our food came out at very different times.

In fact, my poke bowl was the last. If I'm being honest, I think it had been done a while. But because of the chaos of the big place, it's highly likely I didn't hear my name. And unfortunately the text system didn't seem to work for my order.

All of the food was pretty good, though the only thing that stood out was my Cubano style espresso. It was, amazing. Seriously, I highly recommend it.

I think, the only thing that would make this place really perfection would be to really nail the ordering system and have more restaurants really craft something special (like that Cubano coffee...).

An added bonus would be to create an area for kids. Seriously, put in a small play area in there so that tiny humans have something fun to do while parents drink or hangout. I think there's room for something like this in this concept and it would really take it over the top.
name: Jessica

text: Talk about rude. The guy at the ordering in drive thru should be either re evaluated or moved to where he doesnt speak to anyone. Was very aggresive and when I went to pay he aggressively took my card didnt say nothing and just gave me the card and shut window. Wont come back here again. text:
Just had brunch here with family on Mother's Day.  What a horrible experience!!!!  We had a reservation this morning (30 minutes after they opened) and ordered within 10 minutes of sitting down.  The restaurant is about a quarter full at this point.  Sat there and waited and waited for our food.  While waiting we watched a number of tables that came in after we've ordered, got their food, ate, paid, and left.  We asked the waiter to check on our food several times. Just like the food we ordered, the manager never showed.   Finally, after over an hour, the food finally showed up but was just lukewarm.  Just to be clear, we did not order anything fancy that requires a lot of time to prepare: We ordered frittata and eggs with breakfast meats.  Totally unacceptable!!!  Throughout this whole experience, no one offered any apologies for what happened.

What a major disappointment!!

We will not be back - and would suggest that you do the same......

text: We have been fans of Sybergs for many years, love the food and the wings are the best in the metropolitan area.  Today's lunch visit was exceptional for the food ( of course), but the service and care was phenomenal.  My granddaughter is mildly allergic to eggs so we made inquiries into some of the menu items.  The manager was careful to explain about the items and how they are cooked to ensure that they would be suitable and safe.  That is customer service at its best.  Thank you!

text:
Great food! The ribs are a perfect dry rub and solidly meat! My brisket was delicious and they asked if I wanted it cut from the marbled or lean side! As someone who likes lean meat, I often get lots of fat because that's what many people like. So nice to be asked up front! The kick from the dry rub is yummy! The sauce is great but you don't need it if you like dry tub. 
We shared sides. The Hogwood beans are great! Full of pulled pork and not overly sweet. The kale slaw is yummy and more of a vinegar base instead of mayo so light and fresh with a hint of sweet. The green hatch chili cheese grits are a fave too. A kick from the chili and perfectly cooked stone ground grits. The ice box pickles were good but my least fave just because I love a really sour pickle and these are a tad sweet. Still taste good though just not my thing. Cool selection of cane sugar sodas with flavors like orange hibiscus cherry with tarragon and several other flavors! All in a self serve fountain! The atmosphere is casual and comfortable. Very friendly staff and they deliver a Moon pie to your table for desert! Definitely come here to eat! I will be back!!!

text:
The first time I came here was 6 years ago for my birthday, while it was under the direction of The Besh Restaurant Group. I remembered a fine meal, with boozy milkshakes and lots of laughs with friends. Years later, due to prior employment arrangements, I ate at the Sector quite frequently and came to realize under the new direction of Centerplate-the mega-corp that runs the same craft services at venues like The Smoothie King Center, The Superdome and other arenas around the country, just how much this restaurant has suffered from bad management and a lack of attention to detail. 

On any given day, the quality of the food wavered. What was available was overpriced, unremarkable and lacking inspiration. The service is overly casual, lackadaisical and unpolished. From stacking plates on the tables, to gripping piles of dirty silverware, serving ladies last and auctioning off food, there is very little care when it comes to service standards.

On one given day entertaining clients, the restaurant was very busy and on a wait. The hostess, lacking any professionalism, SHOUTED down the long museum hallway to notify the next guest their table was ready. It was so unprofessional and unnerving to hear someone SHOUT while trying to have a conversation. This happened a number of times throughout the meal, and each time, startled us.

On another occasion, while sipping drinks over happy hour, we tried to start a tab while waiting for other guests to arrive. We were told that we were "charged as we went". To which we replied, we weren't ready to close out our tab. The bartender insisted that they couldn't hold our card behind the bar while we charged drinks. I've been in grungier, sketchier places that would be happy to hold you card while you run a charge, the excuse was beyond comprehension. Unless it was a problem in the past and this was a way to circumvent credit card theft, perhaps your background checks and interviewing should be more comprehensive. 

Overall, I would skip the Sector all together, it's not worth the money and sour experience.
name: Emily

text: I keep coming back, like there is a drug in their food. I love the convenience from work, and the food is always consistent. I love the brisket burger.

text:
The cocktails are horrible. Just stick to beer or generic drink like rum and coke. My friend ordered a bee's knee cocktail and it was horrible.  It tastes more like tea. I prefer a margarita and it the worst ... reminded me of sour orange juice.  The bartenders need to get it together. 
The music is good here. They play everything so it will disappoint. It usually gets packed after 11:30. It is small but cool little place.

text: It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. name: User

text:
We wanted to get sandwiches to eat fast before watching fireworks by my parents. We always get Primo's but my husband suggested bringing home hoagies from here on his way home from work. I was hesitant at first cause I didn't see the roast beef mixed with turkey and cheese hoagie that I usually get from primos. But I decided to try the cut above Italian hoagie as something different. It seemed like they specialized in Italian type hoagies since there is a number of them listed on their menu. 

My husband and I split the hoagie but I wish I got my own. It had prosciutto, capocollo ham, salami, and provolone cheese. Everything tasted so fresh. The prosciutto melted in your mouth. The roll was fresh and very soft. Usually the rolls at Primo's almost break my teeth biting into it. I didn't get bloated after eating it either, that's how you know it's fresh. My only minor complaint is that it could have used more oil on it I didn't really see or taste that much on the roll. But I guess maybe they don't want to put too much on and it get soggy. Next time I'll have to ask for extra oil on the side maybe. 

Never want to go to Primo's now, want to come back here. My husband probably regrets telling me about this place. Now I'm gonna make him drive out of the way to pick some up anytime we go to eagles games or wherever. I kinda want one tomorrow but he said he's busy, but I'm still gonna bug him to go get me one.
name: Lauren

text: Ella's is always a great time. Their soul food Sunday warms my southern heart! I wish they had more live blues music. However, you really can't beat the atmosphere. The building boast eclectic trinkets and art and epic Bloody Mary's never a dull moment on a Sunday.

text:
This was a great stop. We had a hankering for pizza after getting doused in torrential downpour at a concert, but needed somewhere that could accommodate 2 people with a gluten allergy.

Enter: Zavino.

I'm not one of the people with the allergy, but wife is and I've gotten accustomed to certain things... and can I tell you that their gluten free crust is the best I've ever tasted?!? It stands up to many places regular crusts.

And the staff was AMAZING. Everyone there was kind, engaging, and an absolute joy to be around. I cannot recommend this place enough.

text:
We were finally able to return and happy to say that things were much better. The food was very tasty and there were no surprises with the lettuce wraps. Thank you to the manager for making things up to us. 

Edit: the manager contacted us and sent out a GC to try them again. Unfortunately as parents we don't get many date nights and have yet to make it back. Happy they were willing to make it better and will definitely update when we do go. 

I would like to give a higher rating but unfortunately I don't think it's deserved. When the lettuce wraps were placed on our table there were bugs on the plate. Of course we flagged down our waiter and pointed it out. At the end of the meal we were given our bill... no comped lettuce wraps. Not even a comped dessert. Disappointing. I will think twice before coming back that's for

text: Overcharged me and then tried to play it off. They should have just owned up to their mistake but stuck to what they said. Very disappointed.

text: I definitely recommend this place as a must eat while in Nola! Great food, great staff, and great atmosphere!! There's seven rooms of seating so the wait isn't long at all. Highly recommend the shrimp fettuccine Alfredo, very creamy and fantastic flavor. Our waitress Ashleigh was great and was on top of things the whole time.

text: This is a great sit down dinner with friends, family or for a date night. It's more upscale than your usual dinner spot in st. Pete. The drinks are hand crafted and unique. They have a wide variety of liquor which means a wide variety of specialty cocktails. They have a great beer and wine list too. The food is amazing from start to finish. We have sampled a lot of the appetizers but my favorites that stick out are the gnocchi, meatballs, and calamari. You have to get the fried chicken as your main dish at least once while visiting here. It is crispy on the outside and never dry on the inside. It's served with a pepper jelly which is great and my favorite- the Mac and cheese. It's a must. I also really enjoy the chicken Parmesan and shrimp and grits. You have to save room for dessert. Literally any of them will blow your socks off. They have plenty of parking and a great atmosphere.

text:
This was my 2nd time here with a large group, but the 1st time for dinner. Everything was perfect! The food delighted everyone in our group, and I will be able to have 3 meals from my veal parmigiana entree. Their special eggplant and burrata stack appetizer was to die for! Everyone gobbled and loved the seasoned spiral rolls served with peppers & onions. We got so happy eating that I forgot to take more pictures.

The ambiance was beautiful, and yet not too quiet for our large party. The live entertainment was a plus, and added to our enjoyment. Our server, Sunny, was pleasant, professional, and went out of her way to make us happy. I will be bringing more groups here!

A faire absolument.

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Maybe other people have better luck here. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: This is one of those restaurants that are always last minute for us. If you're ever craving some pizza, and some beer and you don't feel like getting carry out, or delivery then this is one to put on your list. It's alright...can't say that the pizza is good because you can get the same at any other pizzeria in Indianapolis.
name: Krishna

text: Growing up in the Northeast I never thought I would find the good ole traditional deli in the south. Mr. Pastrami turned that around for me. They serve up the most tender, lean pastrami sandwiches I have ever had. The pickle complemented the sandwich perfectly I found myself bouncing back and forth from the sandwich, homestyle potato salad, and the pickle. What a perfect balance of flavors. I must impress on how great the staff is.  They were polite and made informed suggestions on the menu. I felt more like I was in a friend's kitchen than a restaurant. Mr. Pastrami is now a destination for me they give me a taste of home on the coast of Florida.
name: Bruce

text:
I lived in Brandon for a year, and it was so fun to go here about once a month!
Their mixers (ice cream with some mix ins) are yummy, and IMO, better than Dairy Queen. 
The wings are pretty bomb, especially with the house sauce!
I've had a few other random items, and fairly decent, especially since what the menu consists of. 
A few seats inside and out. Friendly customer service.
name: Amanda

text: Open till 1 am Friday and Saturday and midnight every other day. There is no better late night Sushi in Pinellas County. Sushi chefs Ben, Peter, Kay and Joy are all great Sushi chefs and fun to talk to. You must get a Sushi Burrito, I prefer the Original with Tuna Crab and tempura shrimp. They can make it as spicy as you like. The late night sushi menu is very affordable.
name: Jason

text: I'm sorry to write this but it needs to be said. Ordered a chickfila deluxe and I guess the guy didn't hear me and rang it up different and gave me the normal sandwich. No biggie I walked up and asked the manager (one who drives the nice masi) and explained myself not rudely at all mind you as I work in a restaurant myself. The dude hands me a box with the condiments only. Not even remaking my sandwich. I thought was it a mistake, trying to cut costs? Come on chickfila. It was a sandwich, probably a dollar in labor and food. Hopefully won't happen again.
name: Brian

text: I love this diner. The service is fast, friendly, and overall amazing! the food is unbelievably good no matter what you get! i absolutely love it here and would recommend it to anyone!
name: Caroline

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Pretty happy with it overall. Food was good and came out fast. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Solid.  Good food and great service. Comfortable and tasty enough to become a regular area establishment on my roster. Brussel sprout tacos are amazing!
name: Cathy

text: Came here for Sunday lunch with my family, which we do every few months. I always get the muscles in white wine sauce which are fantastic. The toasted bread is a nice addition on the side of the muscles. The Antipasto was good. My dad loves their soups! Their fries are crispy and thick. I love them! The Chicken pesto sandwich was great as well. The Service is always on point, very friendly, quick and attentive.
name: Carissa

text: Amazing ramen! If you want a taste of japan without the $1000 airfare you've come to the right place! Unleash your inner Samurai!
name: Trent

text: This used to be my favorite place to eat. But they must have a new cook.  Heavy handed with the spices. And I don't think the health department would give it a high rating-- floors are dirty, tables are not wiped down. The Waite staff is friendly. The food needs to improve however before I return as a regular.
name: RaeMarie

text: We love John A's! It's a great place, with a family friendly atmosphere. The food is great! The music is great (and actual Country music!)! Big Free parking lot, instead of having to pay $30 to park downtown! And always great people! Players from several shows always end up at John A's after their shows are over, including folks from the Grand Ole Opry. John A's is a staple of Music Valley Drive. Don't miss it!
name: Dale

text: The food was better then I imagine it to be. I am a customer for life. Everything was so good. I had the bbq and the seafood. My favorite was the seafood. Their desserts are good as well. It's worth the 40 minute drive
name: Bertha

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Food is great, but too many times this yr I was told the price went up on a certain items.  3.00 increase???? Really! To much competition for us to deal with this!
name: Andrea

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Please save yourself a headache and do not go to this Noodles and Company location. They are a mess! I don't know if they have so much business they can't handle it or what, but we keep trying to go back and keep having issues. Today was waiting for over 45 minutes for 2 of us to have lunch with no food. The restaurant was full of complaining guests with no food after a long wait. they were busy filling online orders and a catering order to take care of the people actually in the restaurant to eat at lunchtime. The workers try but they can't get it all done. They are trying to do too many things and just can't get it done.  In December we placed a catering order and they took it, then the next day just didn't deliver. They couldn't do it but didn't call to tell us, so after waiting and not getting food we had to stop and order pizzas at the last minute.  This store is a mess. Try another location or only go when it is not full. Every table was full of diners WITHOUT food. 5 different groups complained about the wait time, 2 that had gotten food had issues with what they were given.  I feel bad, but want to save others from such a bad experience.
name: Amy

text: I placed my order online.   I ordered 2 -10 piece naked wings.  Flavor-hot.  1 order of mushrooms and 3 orders of celery and 4 sides of blue cheese @1.00 each.  $42.69.  My son ran inside to pick up our order.  While waiting,  he politely asked one of the girls to take a picture with him.  She told him "no. I don't like your phone" and walked away.   Maybe she didn't know but hes disabled.  Crushed his heart.   Anyhow, we get home and their was a blue cheese missing.  Not a normal issue.  Opened the wing box and they're all dummies.  I can't eat the drummies it's too tough.  I usually eat the flapper.  My fiancee took a bite and they were not hot but sweet.  Normally,  I wouldn't call to complain but it was the most expensive horrible meal o ever had to throw away.  I called and spoke to the manager who explained that the naked wings only came in all dummies and the term buffalo wings meant that the wings are breaded with special flavor.  Something the online order site doesn't tell you.  I explained what transpired with my son and the missing blue cheese.  I expected an apology.  Didn't get one.  What I got was an explanation of the wings only coming in drummies.  I repeated that the wings were sweet, not hot.  He said that's their hot flavor.   Ok, acceptable.  No mention of my sons treatment.  She could have decline politely.   Not even an apology for the way overpriced missing blue cheese.  My son even tipped them 5.00.  Needless to say we will never eat there again.   On a positive note since I had to give at least 1 star.  The mushrooms weren't bad.  I do not recommend their food.  We will continue to patronize Hooters.  They were awesome with pictures with my son.  Hooters wings rock!
name: Paula

text:
FYI: Cash only!! They have an ATM inside but if you're not about paying that surcharge, make sure you come with cash.

WHAT I GOT: Hiro's ten inch of heaven

PROS: Definitely a good competitor to the famous Terakawa. The broth was flavorful and the noodles had some great texture. Their pork also had a slight smokiness to it that really added to the broth. And obviously, an egg on top makes even great. I also appreciated their portion size. Not too big but just enough food to get you to satisfied. The ramen came out at a neck breaking speed too. Also, shout out to whoever decided to play some Japanese music in the restaurant. I was definitely feelin the vibe.

CONS: well...if you're not actively looking for it, you would probably miss it going down chestnut. It doesn't have the most obvious exterior and the inside is a bit dark. They also served us our appetizer (we got takoyaki) like half way through our actual meal. Um...not sure if y'all know what the meaning of appetizer is but it still tasted good so I ain't mad about it. Timing was a bit off.
name: Sherry

text: Trying to find a Chinese place on the west side has been a chore. Until this place. We had crab rangoons (not your typical shape, but has a classic taste), hot and sour soup which was packed with more than what i expected and was absolutely delicious, sweet and sour chicken combo meal (huge egg roll included) and cashew chicken combo (asked for veggie fried rice). The entire meal was fantastic. Highly recommend this place. Don't be scared off if placing a to go order, its a bit weird, they just really say mmmm hmm and ok but they are pretty fast and the food always tastes enjoyable.
name: Rhea

text: My friend liked it more than I did. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. For the price I expected more than this. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
We got the bison steak and pot roast. The steak cooked medium actually came out well done. The pot roast was ok... not much in flavor and the steamed veggies were all undercooked and overly crunchy. 

The best tasting thing we had was a side of asparagus. 

They served my pot roast with a chunk of Foil cooked into it - see photo. Also the waitress broke the bottle of wine and then broke the cork so it was a little uncomfortable. 

The staff was very apologetic and kind throughout the whole experience. I think the only thing that may be good here is the burgers? (according to reviews) 

We will have to try the burgers but we will be going to a different location. 

Not much luck here
name: Kearstin

text:
Impression when you first walk in, wow! Crystal chandeliers everywhere live music just beautiful when you walk in and fancy.
 We started with a few shareable plates shishito peppers, blackened tenderloin steak, and crab cakes. The shishito pepper are floured fried peppers with a soy sauce. I was skeptical about biting into a pepper but it was delicious it has an spicey after taste. Blackened tenderloin are served with a piece of fried cheese and a sauce that was amazing definitely recommend it. For the crab cake its 2 cakes the size of an ice cream scoop each and they are the best cakes I've had. For my entree I decided to go with the shalean sea bass served with veggies (broccoli and carrots) the sea bass was covered in a lightly sweet sauce 
  Our waitress Melissa was very knowledgeable and sweet had me sold on everything she recommended which was the sea bass and the special drink watermelon martini which by the way was refreshing. What impressed me was that we we given a complimentary chocolate raspberry lava with ice cream with a thank you signature for being first time guests. That was cute. Definitely going back
name: Josie

text: Where else in the world in this day and age can you go to get the best hoagie on the planet; they are closing but remain open to fill your order. Love this place!  Best rolls, best meats and cheeses and best customer service!
name: Toni

text: Fabulous lunch, the service was perfect and the flavors were amazing! Great beers too. My husband had the rabbit and dumplings and I had the braised beef sandwich. Sheer comfort food.
name: Peggy

text: Spent several days in New Orleans and this was my go to bar since we were staying at the Prince Conti. Drinks were reasonable, music & atmosphere was great. We enjoyed happy hour on a couple of occasions. Austin, bartender, and Bret, Manager, were delightful.
name: Eve

text: I had went in and tried the ayce and it was not good sushi at all. I ordered a roll that was supposed to have jalapeño and cream cheese, and the cheese was regular cheese? When I went to go serve myself a drink at the machine, the label said raspberry tea but unsweetened tea came out. They also never checked up on me and took a while to give me my check when there was no one else but me in there. I am not going back again not worth $18.
name: Sabrina

text: The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Overall, a strong experience. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Excellent! Fast, delicious, great customer service! It took me less than 10 mins to order and receive my food. I suppose their system was having trouble with the use of Apple Pay ;because after several attempts of trying, it still wouldn't accept my payment. Nevertheless, the cashier politely covered the charge and even apologized for the inconvenience! That's hospitality! The honey chicken biscuit was well worth the trouble! I'll definitely come back and suggest this restaurant to others! Nashville needs more restaurants like Rise!
name: Zaviera

text: Wow cute little place with absolutely fresh vegan food and super tasty. Everything comes with the soup of  the day and fabulous rich coffee. The blackboard menu changes daily. I took out my camera to take a photo of my lovely lunch but somehow forgot in the deliciousness and I am not even a full time vegan
name: Janie

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I left full, which at least counts for something. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. It looked better online than it did in person. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
I had dinner reservations last night. We were greeted and seated right away. Our table was upstairs on an outside patio with wonderful views of the harbor and ocean. I was especially pleased that they had an elevator for my elderly mother who would've had difficulty going up the stairs.  

We chose a nice bottle of wine and enjoyed amazing appetizers before diving into salads and entrées.  

Menu selection was extensive and the food was delicious with beautiful presentation from the kitchen.  The wait staff could not have been any kinder and we enjoyed ourselves thoroughly.  

We will definitely be going back and I look forward to trying their lunches. 

Very satisfying for all of us and a nice new delight in Santa Barbara.
name: Sheri

text:
An amazing cocktail bar. I had three drinks. I started with the Mezcal Old Fashioned, and it was delicious. It was clear (a bit odd for an old fashioned), but it had the smokey mezcal flavor, a very slight hint of citrus. 
I then had a sazorac, which was also tasty with the perfect amount of anise flavor, sweet, but not too sweet.
Finally I had Hoffa's inside job, which was also delicious. It was basically a hybrid between a Manhattan and an old fashioned. The luxardo cherry was wrapped in an orange peel.
After three cocktails, we decided to eat. The highlight of dinner was the pork belly. It was so amazing. Unlike most pork belly it was NOT chewy, but instead almost melted in my mouth. It had the perfect crispy shell on the outside. Truely perfectly cooked. The barbacoa tacos we're also delicious, and the meat was almost as tender and flavorful as the pork belly. The meat flavor dominated the tacos, but that was not a bad thing.
The rabbit rolls we're also tasty. The meat had a bit of a sweet BBQ sauce flavor to them and the bread was almost chewy. I liked it.

Overall impression, great service, amazing cocktails, and good food. I loved the pork belly, but I don't know if I'd come back to eat. However, I will be back for the cocktails. It might be my favorite cocktail bar in Nashville, but I do love rosemary in East Nashville (similar drinks, but a bit cheaper and a lot livelier). This is definitely my favorite cocktail bar in downtown.
name: Charles

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. For the price I expected more than this. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Noodle and rice portions are LARGE, as I suspect many "Chinese" restaurant's tend to serve. Very nice staff, serving area appears clean. My 11 year old LOVED the food, and the General Tsau (sp?) noodles were delish! All in all I found the food to be too bland for MY taste. The restaurant seems to he quite popular.
name: Robin

text: They have the best tamales!! My coworker brought some in today, she called in at 6am and brought them to work hot and fresh, lucky she brought me 5 and I shared 3 with another co worker! needless to say we are having a great day at work today, thank you !!
name: Laura

text:
This was my first visit here. I had heard great things but honestly I'm not impressed. Biggest complaint was the parking situation. Great that they have a underground garage but wouldn't it be nice for the hostess or waitress to mention they validate 2 hours? I spent $20 to park there when I was there for 3 hours.... 
 Also the prices of food are high for not that great of food. Will not be back.
name: Samantha

text: The food is really good here, standard Mexican for the most part, but good quality, prices and portions!  And my dad does magic here on Sunday nights, so obviously I'm gonna be biased, but even so!
name: Jocelyn

text: Turned away at 3:15 on a Sunday afternoon, less than half of the tables were full and was told a bunch of reservations were coming in. Nonsense, had a party of five one of which was in a high chair. We were willing to sit in a booth for four. They should've accommodated us given they had plenty of seating, and there was no way that those reservations we're going to fill all those seats between quarter after three and quarter after four on Sunday afternoon. (figuring we would've been there about an hour).
name: Gary

text:
I have stopped here a few times before visiting other nearby Tulane Ave drinkeries.  It's a word. Although I spent many years in D.C. where Caribbean food is abundant I will admit the majority of my exposure is coco bread and beef patties. So take this review for what it is worth.

The food is good. Not overly spiced but not dumbed down either. Patties are crisp on the outside doughy on inside and not greasy. They have all the classics you would expect.

 The atmosphere is Cheers except unless you frequent there regularly no one knows your name. In fact, the decor is very someone's kitchen or screened in patio. So you feel like you walked into someone's holiday party uninvited. For that reason I was excited to see they offer yelp ordering so I have switched to pick up and go. I am sure anyone willing could become family after a couple of visits.  And like family you can leave there with a full satisfied tummy.
name: Sebrina

text: Been dying to try their drinks since I moved back to STL and finally did over my bf's birthday. We were immediately seated at a hightop on a Friday night around 10ish and the service was fantastic. Our waitress (wish I got her name) gave us all kinds of recommendations. I opted for the Tommy's Margarita with jalapeno because one of my fellow yelpers recommended it and it was awesome- I think it could've used a little bit more jalapeno though. My boyfriend had the Planters punch and loved it. The next drink I got our waitress recommended to me- the Pickle drink, I was hesitant because I like pickles but not pickle juice lol, and this was amazing. Super light and crisp, very cucumbery and amazing. Apparently so good that they have it on tap- so try it, its amazing. Loved the ambiance and interior here- tons of awesome drinks on the menu and prices weren't bad at all. Will definitely be back!
name: Monica

text:
We had a wonderful dinner at Jamila's Mediterranean  Tunisian Cafe while visiting in New Orleans.  The Cafe is run by a husband and wife team.  The wife, Jamila, is a wonderful chef and her husband is the host.  The food is out of this world, but when you add the atmosphere, the warm welcome given to everyone who enters this establishment it is like coming home.  This was the best meal I had while staying in New Orleans.

Upon leaving the host escorts you out and looks forward to seeing you again.  This will  be my go to place when I return to New Orleans.
name: Paulette

text: It's Krystal, don't expect a 5 star review. But the lead employee, Ethan, at the drive through window has been there the last few times I've been a customer. He is always working very hard and try's to be personable and friendly. He completely my order quickly and efficiently. After previous reviews mentioned a poor experience at the drive through, I felt it necessary to acknowledge his great work ethic
name: Stephen

text: Sad they didn't think about seating in this place. The occupancy level is 112 but has seating for less than 30. The parking is also $24 an hour. The food was mediocre.
name: Johnathon

text: The food here is awesome. I love the sushi. My server was Bionca, she was very friendly and had great recommendations. I always ask for her when I come.
name: Arrienne

text:
Came after game Sunday to see Bobby Hebert! I have veggie slice. Want to give shout out to young lady who took order, i asked for no onions extra black olives. She first said can't do special order. Ok, i understand it's a packed house. After agreeing to eat as it comes, she changed mind & special ordered. Pizza was delicious! On point! One slice, huge.. i ate whole thing! Stuffed. When wearing Saints jersey, you can get a free 16oz beer. My PNC ordered blue moon(wearing Jersey thinking free) those not on deal.. which totally understandable.. bartender poured it out & replaced with Dixie. Granted, offer to charge & next one free instead of pouring out! 
Because, we weren't there just for "free" beer.. just happened to hear on radio on ride over. 
We did order & drink 2 more paid beers while there with pizza. Bartender turned OFF my PNC with that move. So i won't give 5 stars. We both enjoyed pizza. Bobby Hebert was gracious enough to pose for picture.. since He was the Lure for me! Ha. We will be back!
name: Rebecca

text: sat outside and it was a beautiful sunshiney day to enjoy brunch. i had the huevos rancheros and it was phenomenal. the presentation, service, and ambiance all are a 10/10.
name: Marisa

text: Ambiance is super casual...you would never believe how great the food is walking in. Love the agi tuna!
name: Maisie

text: Such a cute little restaurant. Our server, Brendan, was friendly,attentive and knowledgeable. The wings were EXCELLENT. Very happy with both the beer and bourbon selection!
name: Brittney

text: Elizabeth's Restaurant features a menu full of unique breakfast dishes with a New Orleans twist. My wife and I visited recently and I had the Praline Bacon and Eggs Florentine. The Praline Bacon is one of the more popular dishes for good reason. The bacon is soft and meaty and topped with a crust-like brown sugar and diced praline mixture. This is a very dessert-like appetizer. The Eggs Florentine was a phenomenal massive mound of delicious food. Yolky poached eggs sat on a bed of savory roasted potatoes and creamy spinach sauce and surrounded by tender briny fried oysters with a crisp peppery breading. Overall, this was a phenomenal breakfast experience which I highly recommend.
name: Nicolas

text:
This has quickly become one of my GO TO spots to order food. The food is all reasonably priced, super fresh and overall has a nice healthy twist/options. They are more than just burgers. Their salads are excellent as well as their other sandwich options. And they also package everything very nicely. They really have it down to a science to be honest. Their salad container is quite innovative. 

I still need to visit the actual location (I have passed by many times), but if you are looking for some nice healthy and filling alternatives check them out, I highly recommend!
name: Eric Clay

text: I have been going here since I was child. It is my favorite place to go. I know everyone there. When my family comes to Philly it is one of favorite places to get a cheesesteak from. YUMMY!!!
name: Tamika

text: Will not visit again. The food is just not good. The restaurant is very pretty, but the food sub par.
name: Yessika

text:
Great neighborhood grocery, restaurant, and deli. I stopped by here to try the delicious pasta that I had seen all over instagram and I was surprised to see that they not only sell pasta, but also cupcakes, cheeses, meats, and small items that you may find at an Italian grocer. 

I took two nests of the garlic pasta home and made a delicious meal inspired by the store. I hope to come back here soon to try some more of their tasty options. (They have some take home sauces and entrees sold in the store as well if you're looking for an authentic dinner experience at home). 

I heard that there is a Chefs tasting done here every once in a while, but it was already sold out for the year in February. It would have been nice to experience this and support a local business.. hopefully next year !
name: Naz

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Food was fresh and service was quick. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. idk I'd try something else next time. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: We just ordered from this place for the first time and they did not disappoint. The sandwiches are very filling. Fries were done just right. We found out about this place because last night the neighbors next had food delivered and I got talking to the delivery driver.  Will definitely order from there again.
name: Pat

text: This was a fantastic experience from start to finish.  The ambience alone is worth the trip and the food was amazing! We came at an off time so it wasn't busy and we were able to choose seats by the window away from the heat and not outside since it was a warm humid day.
name: Tracy

text:
They serve food, bar top gambling, their brewed beer and it turns into a night club with bands or DJ for dancing.

Bring your ID as they upload your info to their record, so behave.

I look forward to their specialty brews. This time it's a session Belgium, they do exist! The 9% Russian Stout did not dissapoint. Of course other standard variety of Brewer beers are here.
name: Joyce

text: The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Worth checking out. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: It's a good create your pizza place but twice we've been here the customer service has been awful. The people making the pizza will just not say anything to you to initiate the order, not a hello or what would you like etc. Don't be surprised if they don't talk to you at all as you stare at them across the glass shield. Customer has to initiate the conversations. The cashiers aren't any friendlier, made errors on a salad order of all things and didn't offer an apology just walked away. I've worked in customer service and I've never seen so many workers in one place disengaged. If you are a local, just make your own pizza at home.

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Price felt a touch high for what it was. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. You can tell they care about customer experience here. A very pleasant experience.
name: User

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Definitely coming back. For the price I expected more than this. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: I recommend the lobster mac n cheese! I had that and a bowl of shrimp and corn bisque as my entree. The oysters are delicious, as was the spinach and artichoke dip. I do wish po-boys were sold for dinner. I'm not sure why they are only sold at lunch time. Several of us were visiting and really craving them, but they said they weren't available. It would be nice if they allowed it upon request for dinner.
