text: Every time we come to Finney's it's always such a great experience! The staff here is so friendly and helpful. The manager Margo is the sweetest and we have started to stop in more frequently because of her amazing service! She has the best recommendations and we are starting to feel like family! If you are looking for a new go-to spot or just looking for a great place to eat while you're in town, I can not recommend this place enough!

text: Terrific Food! The last two visits to Tucson has led me here, and each time I enjoy it. The portions are plentiful, and the food is great.

text: Our first time and had a lot of vegetarian options really enjoyed it great service too
name: Himal

text: Everyone here is so great and welcoming! The food is always delicious! Daryl the bartendar is always on point. It's definitely one of our favorites when visiting boise!!!
name: Mashelle

text:
This gets two stars because the food is almost always good, but the service is almost always poor.  

We come here often because we live close by. Unfortunately, our orders are almost always messed up. 

Today, it took 24 minutes to bring us our food when there was almost no one in the restaurant. I walked in and all employees had their back turned towards the door so I stood there until someone decided to turn around. The young man had no customer service and I felt like he was upset I interrupted their chat. He charged me for two drinks when I only ordered one. My food likely sat out for a while because it was all cold when it got to me and my husband. 

I'm going to say shame on the managers here. This needs to stop. Wake up and step up your service. Lucky Dill is right down the road and we will go there next.
name: Amanda

text: Sadly, they no longer have steak and eggs, or frittatas. You can't be a diner and not have steak and eggs. And to the server who said they never had it... check my photos. #sad
name: Bonnie

text: My friend liked it more than I did. Anyway, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. maybe I just came on an off day. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: This is a great cheesesteak place. Lots of celebrity pics on the wall. Lots of locals stop in for takeout. You can order from a window on the street or sit inside at one of 10 stools. The cheesesteak with whiz is yummy, some people ordered chicken, too, but you can't go wrong with the cheesesteak. There's a second location on the same street.
name: Ed

text: THIS IS MY FAVORITE RESTAURANT!!!! The burgers are incredible and the fires are fabulous I here all the time and I never let's me down. It is a great place to bring a group and chat for hours. I would HIGHLY recommend!!!!!!
name: Jane

text: Stopped in to Malaga for dinner with a colleague while on business inHamilton, NJ. It was a wonderful fine dining experience from start to finish. The servers were extremely nice and took great care of us. For an appetizer I enjoyed the soup of the day. For dinner I had chicken cutlets in wine sauce with vegetable and fresh potato chips sides. My coworker enjoyed salmon with similar sides and yellow saffron rice. The food was tasty but I saved room for dessert! I had a wonderful spiced carrot cake. The perfect ending to a great dinner. Definitely a must-try if you're in the area.
name: Devon

text:
The large Soft Shell Crab Po'boy for here please (3am with Bourbon St. written all over my face). The large hit the spot for me and also the side of Fried Catfish. All fried items comes with a nice spicy hit.

Food made to order so be patient. Fries are great and po'boys have a great bread but watch out for that mayonnaise because they can pack it on.

Great late night joint after Bourbon St. or Frenchman St. Open late and everything hits that spot.
name: Juan

text: It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was good and came out fast. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. No big complaints, just a nice meal. For the price I expected more than this. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Perfect local coffee shops. I like to go here and read. Food is delicious. Coffee is free and perfect.
name: Linus

text: Portions were generous and presentation was nice. You can tell they care about customer experience here. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Will be back. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: This place is awesome!!! My wife and I have been several times and almost always stop by if in the area. The people there (pretty sure it is a family run place) are always incredibly kind. The food is really fresh and of great quality. I have gotten many things off the menu and they have always met my expectations. The wait can sometimes be a little longish, but they make everything on the spot, with fresh ingredients, so it makes sense. My wife almost always gets the vegan panini, I vary it up and have gotten the smoked salmon croissant, turkey panini, hot bowl, and grilled chicken sandwich. All very good! Highly recommend this awesome place!
name: Eric

text:
Service is just awful. The food is over priced!
There are May better spots in that area!!!
name: Mike

text:
This place is always packed, we were here at 7:30pm, waited for about 20 minutes, seated at the bar. We haven't seen people take young little kids here because  it got really noisy when it's packed. 

I had special of the day, shrimp scampi. There were 7 shrimps, it was too dry and a bit salty to me. It came with a salad, nothing special about it. 

My hubby had the Friendly's famous wings. It has about 20 wings. You can choose 2 type of sauces from the verity of selection to go with the wings. The wings were pretty juicy and tender, not too much flour on the outside. It's even still good for next day. 

We also had jalapeño poppers, it served with salsa. The poppers were deep fried, it wasn't so impressive. The poppers we had in Missouri was the best we have ever had, it wrapped with bacon and grilled, taste so good! 

For dessert, we had peach pie with ice cream. My hubby thinks it's reasonable.
name: Rebecca

text: It's buffet. It's the best in the area. The hibachi grill is great. They have great options. Although the food is mislabeled. The ham is in the fettuccine section. Lol.
name: Steve

text:
I have been to this restaurant often. Love the wings and love the fries.  The bar is in the middle and very busy. When you first enter the restaurant they greet you to see how many is in your party. FYI - Tuesday - wing night. 
Tuesday very popular with the young ones and believe me people park where ever  they can. Food is good and so are the drinks. 
I have personally tasted the wings and burgers. 
The waitresses are very friendly and accommodating. 
I would recommend this restaurant to all.
name: Maria

text: I love coming here if I need a quick sushi fix! Food always comes out super quick and tasty. Prices aren't too bad either! The bento box is probably the best bang for your buck and it gives you a ton of food for the price you're paying. Can't wait to try the other items on the menu next time!
name: Janelle

text: Great beer. We tried every single one and loved them all. If you like craft beer definitely try it. Even if Bud Light is your thing they have a great comparison. It's worth the try. Nothing else like it in Whiteland!
name: Elisabeth

text: Terrible customer service . paid 30 for the food and didnt recieve 2 of my orders of potato salads or maple butter. I was continuously laughed at and taunted by the young women over the phone as well as the person we paid to pick up our order. Very unprofessional and rude
name: Kay

text:
JUST GO! You won't regret it! Whoever I go with we usually get several plates from different vendors and family style pass the plate. Or I just try a new plate! My favorite has to be Fritai !  They also have vegan options and it's always so delicious ! Also a fan of the spring rolls and pho! There's a badass Mediterranean steak sandwich at the first vendor in the front on the right when you walk in! Cocktails at the bar are always good too! 

I always boast on this place and will continue to bring whoever comes to visit me here for an experience!
name: Ja'Na

text:
We came to this restaurant for a group event.

First good sign: 3 celebrity chefs also here for lunch 
Second good sign: high yelp ratings 

Decor simple and filled with light, menu laid out with no pages but lots of options. One of our party was celiac and the owner was very aware of the gluten in every dish. Food ingredients were fresh and the dishes were bursting with flavor. 

For the price and value, definitely a 5 star.
name: Annie

text:
First off I'd like to say the salmon nigiri is the best, most buttery, and freshest salmon nigiri I've found in all of Reno. I've lived here for 4 years and this is the first time I'm actually satisfied with AYCE nigiri.    

Now that that's out of the way, Oceano itself is a hidden gem within the Peppermill hotel. The service could've been faster, but the quality made up for it as our waitress was super nice. I'll definitely be coming here again (even with the slightly higher AYCE price point)
name: Harrison

text:
This place isn't one of my favorites. All the tacos are wrapped in blue corn tortillas which makes for a somewhat unattractive plate of food, especially if it's enchiladas covered in salsa verde - not a pretty presentation. The guacamole is more like an avocado salad, not terrible, but not really guacamole. I had the carnitas tacos and there was way too much meat in them, every time i picked one up it fell apart. The carnitas was not flavorful, lacked texture, and tasted like slow cooker pork rather than roasted pork. The menu said they came with cilantro and onion but mine were only topped with cheese. I make much better tacos at home. The chili con queso was nothing to write home about or to go back for. I'd much rather have regular queso blanco that i don't have to fight to get it onto my chip. Go for the drinks, but for food, stick with the chips and salsa they give you for free. 

The service was okay. We saw our server every 25 minutes or so but when we needed her, she was nowhere to be found. Wouldn't recommend this place unless you're starving and want a pretty margarita.
name: Basha

text: This is by far the best pho and banh mi I've ever had in the United States. Price is great, the food is magnificently seasoned and the bread is baked on the premises! It's a very casual spot and my best friend took me there for the first time today and I cannot wait to go back!!
name: Francis

text: I was sitting at work thinking oh I want wings so I logged on yelp. I work way in Slidell but was determined to get some wings. Due to that drive, I wanted to make sure it was a good place. I had the bayou hot boy and Thai chili glaze. I didn't like the Thai chili glaze. They weren't nasty or tasted bad, they just weren't as good as the bayou hot boy.
name: Geowanda

text: Disappointed. The restaurant was very busy. We waited for 45 minutes. Our server, Adrian, was very attentive. After waiting longer than usual, our meals arrived and my herb crusted salmon looked burnt. It also tasted strange. (Sidenote: we come here every other week and I order the exact same thing every time.) I wasn't pleased, and when the server noticed how it looked, he was also surprised, and took it back to get it remade. He said the head chef said there were too many herbs on it. I waited for another 25 minutes, while my husband ate his meal, and then it arrived plated to go as I requested. I took a bite, and it was gross...totally different taste AND get this...it was like warm (at best). How is that possible when I waited over 25 mins for a re-make and you couldn't even make sure my food was warm. Smh! Adrian got the salmon removed. But guess what I'm still hungry. And I missed a whole lunch date with my husband. I then called the manager over to see if something changed. His response was "herbs change with the season" as if I'm not aware of herbs. And no he did not ask if he could get me anything else. I'm so annoyed. So I wasted over 2 hours to leave and still be hungry. I'm giving 1 Star because our server was stellar and it wasn't his fault that the restaurant has failed under pressure.
name: Tia

text:
One of the two sushi places located in IV. If you're trying to get your sushi/poke fix then it will do its job. However, nothing too special. 

There weren't a whole lot of options when it came to the protein or toppings. The only proteins that I saw were tuna, spicy tuna, or the avocado ceviche. Usually I have a hard time limiting which toppings I chose because they all sounds so good but again there were only about 5 to choose from and they didn't seem to fit very well. 

I do have to say that I loved the variety of sauces. There seemed to be about 10 of so and you can choose how many you want to mix and can even put some extra on top of the rice.

Also the price is a little unreasonable. A bowl with just 2 proteins was over $13. I talked about the limited toppings and if I were to get some of the "better ones" there was an extra $1.50-2.00 charge. 

I think if I came here again then I would probably try one of their other options like the grilled burritos and tacos.
name: Brea

text: Limoncello is great! Delicious food, extremely nice service, always busy because everyone loves it here. The penne a la vodka was so good, as was the eggplant parm pizza. Free bruschetta and bread with dinner. If you don't dip your bread in their olive oil, you are missing out. Their olive oil is liquid gold. I would do anything for this olive oil. There are butterflies in my stomach, my heart just skipped a beat, and I am sweating just thinking about their amazing, delicious olive oil.
name: Nerine

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. My experience was honestly fine. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: I recently started working on this side of town and there are so many restaurants to choose from! I tired Monkey Burger last week and was not disappointed. Excellent burger with gluten free bun. Very tasty and reasonably priced.
name: Valerie

text:
Yes, yes, Y'ALL! Saturday mornings here at The Dutch are crowded, noisy, and full of JOY!!! The ambience is awesome and friendly. 

Will people bump into you? YES! 
Will be talk loudly? Yes! 
Will people stop right in front of you to decide on something that caught their eye? HECK YEAH! 
But, that will never deter from the friendly, attentive service!

They you greet quickly, take your order immediately, and bring your delicious and well-prepared food, expeditiously! 

The fares are inexpensive and and the food is certainly home-cooked. The Dutch is a staple in the Reading Terminal, so be prepare to have about a 15-20minute wait! If you are in a hurry, they do offer takeout; however, there is a wait with that also!
name: Crystal

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The music was louder than it needed to be. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat.
name: User

text: Awesome service. The menu is great. I got "The Bernie" and the fried jalapeños took my breath away. Obviously freshly cut and fried. Very delicious on many levels.
name: Josh

text: This is the cutest juice place I've been to by far! You can tell they can pride in how the bowls look and they're absolutely delicious! The staff is very friendly too and brought my bowl to me while I did some studying. I wish I lived out here so I could come all the time. I just thought this place deserved some recognition:)
name: Alli

text:
$35.00 for lunch. 2 teas, large Greek pizza (2 die 4), small order of hot wings. Superior friendly service and marvelous food quality. 
This place is off gulf blvd. from thunderbird hotel on Lt. side strip mall 107th ave. Plenty of free parking.
name: Gig

text: In town from San Diego and found this spot. It was highly recommend.  Tried the Clooney, it was awesome, perfectly toasted to perfection with a great flavor. Unlike George Clooney it was defiantly one of my top 5 sandwiches. It did not disappoint at all. Well rounded flavor with the right mix of flavor. Thanks for the great food
name: Brian

text: It was a very unique experience of Indian cusine. Loved the choices and sauces. Definitely try the hand wash-o-matic after you are done.
name: Nirav

text: Food is always good, plentiful, and well priced. Must pay in cash, but it is worth it as it lowers prices. Eaten here many times. Worth the stop.
name: Rebecca

text: Being a bbq place,  you think the meat and sides will be hot and juicy.  All cold meat and chicken was super dry.  Not coming back here,  better places for bbq in philly.
name: Chang

text: WING NIGHT. Best wings in town with out a dought. We've had them everywhere. Literally!
name: Karen

text: We just stopped by this McD for some fries but ended up getting a whole meal. They had great customer service and were attentive. I asked to add something last minute to the order and they were very nice about it. It has a family vibe with how the workers interact with each other.  Now the food was actually pretty good compared to other McDonalds. We dined in and the fries were served to us hot & crispy. Good fries. We also ended up getting Big Macs for the buy 1 get 1 a $1. Compared to other McDonalds, these Big Macs were not sloppy. It looked appetizing and was filling. We also love the large Eagles cups! Bleed Green! GO EAGLES AND this McDonalds!
name: Alyssa

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: First time here , seen it on yelp . I figured there was great reviews on this place , so I decided to try it out . I ordered a pepperoni deep dish pizza , delicious! It takes roughly around 30 -40 minutes to cook , but it's well worth it . Will be returning back when in town . Service and staff was awesome!
name: Sabrina

text: It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Worth checking out. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. For the price I expected more than this. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
Don't let the strip mall location fool you... close your eyes and you're in Italy...

I came here for lunch and was very impressed.  The food and service was great! We started with a glass of wine and then they brought out this heavenly bread coated in olive oil. HEAVENLY!   We couldn't decide if we wanted to try the calamari or the eggplant sticks so our server suggested getting half of each.  I absolutely loved this suggestion since it allowed me to not make a decision and try both!  For my entree, I got the chicken parm... nothing too special.. but I enjoyed it...  my husband got the Con Salsa Rossa with 2 meatballs.  I had a bite of the meatballs and they were delish.  It is probably the thing that will get me to come back... oh and that bread!  AMEN!
name: Lauren

text:
This location answered all of my complaints I had about the Carmel location. 

They have preselected combinations for those who are overwhelmed with options. 

They offer miso soup! There is also a soda machine for refills for those who do that spicy mix in sauce. 

This is comparable style wise to poke I have had in Miami, LA, and Chicago. 

The only issue would be that it is kind of steep price wise compared to the other locations I've had poke but that kind of goes along with any Indiana seafood. Service was fast and prompt.
name: Katie

text: Excellent meal. We shared the filet mignon plus an appetizer and there was an abundant amount of food. The filet was cut into bite size pieces and extremely tender. Soup, salad, grilled veggies, fried rice, and noodles completed the meal! The soft shell crabs were great. To top it off was a delicious plum wine. Busy and entertaining place. We did not sit a a grilling table but quite the show. We would definitely return here
name: Pam

text: So delicious! Will be a regular spot for us! They had so many options and all of it was fresh. I had the spicy tuna and it was amazing. And it was $12 for a HUGE bowl!
name: Lindsey

text: I would put 0 star if I could. It was the first time I had been waiting my order for so long in Mc. Even though when I had my order, I still didn't have my drink yet. I had to ask them to have my drink. I did try to be calm enough to wait. It was terrible. My food really worst than I expected. They forgot to put something in my husband hamburger. Do not want to be back.
name: Ngoc

text:
Today was my third and final attempt to carry out lunch in the last month or so from Union Loafers. First attempt I was told (after waiting in line almost 10 min) that my salad order would be 30-40 min. I left- it was later in the lunch hour and thought they had simply gotten extra busy. A couple weeks after that I stopped by and they were closed (during advertised 'open' hours). Third time was today. I arrived at 11:29 (according to parking meter that ended up costing me 20% of the cost of my lunch). Stood in the same line as before- one line for orders, bread purchase, to go order pick ups. Place my salad order and told 15-20 minutes. I asked if they would call my name and the guy said just to wait her- gesturing to the counter and area with the line. I sat at the counter (was asked if I was waiting for an order and if I wanted a glass of water. Then I waited. After a while an employee came up and asked if she could use the seat I was in for for a part of two. I got up, seething. My response SHOULD have been I'll be happy to vacate the seat when I have my lunch and can leave. 35 minutes is how long it took me to get my salad. Never again. There are too many good restaurants in town who respect and know how to manage a workday carry out lunch,

2 stars because the food is good but the rest of the experience deserved zero stars.
name: Lara

text: Divine!  A must for Mexican and we live in LA. Our food was incredible and the service was great. Thanks guys!
name: Rachel

text: My favorite place ever! The food is incredible and the service impeccable. The views beautiful and everytime I go I love it more and more. I have been going to the Columbia for years and all their locations are simply fabulous.
name: Katie

text:
Very good...delicious even.

Aloo ghobi good
Navratan korma good
Lamb Saag great

Rice soft and buttery..naan was good.

Very good!
name: Mike

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: Love it. A must for visitors from out of town . Right across from Jefferson Station go out the Western end.
name: Robert

text: Having getting one pizza here a month ago and really enjoying it we went and had company and ordered 4 yesterday. What a horrible mistake. They were all black. So overdone all black and just tasted burnt. Your hands had black all over them when you picked up a slice. And the absolute worst part was it was $80.00 dollars!! I had 3 family members over and was so embarrassed. Never again
name: Ross

text: Staying at Holiday In next door before leaving on a cruise.  We were a large group they had a room in the back for us.  Our server was excellent.  The BBQ was good, my wife enjoyed the white chocolate bread pudding.  If ever in NOLA again we will come back
name: Bruno

text: They lacked crucial ingredients and professionalism. I suggest choosing another subway.
name: Bella

text: Probably close to 3.5 stars. Great pasta, had the spaghetti and meatballs. Sauce is flavorful and pasta is cooked just right. Also had the margherita pizza- the dough is a little too doughy for my taste. Prices are a little high.
name: Ariel

text:
I like beignets, but the beignets here were just ok. They're good, but I've had better. The beignets here are served hot with a mound of powdered sugar, which is great. The coffee au lait is ok. The overall experience of this place wasn't that great... It's hot and humid. If it's not something you're used to, then a fan and a "light breeze" just isn't going to do it for you. 

The air in the area wasn't exactly pleasant smelling and the tables are very cramped together outside. The service was kind of rushed and not the friendliest. It seems like they've made a name for themselves so they don't even bother trying anymore. There are probably better beignets in NOLA.
name: Geekar

text:
Really enjoyed my meal here, and I am so glad I got to finally try this place! The atmosphere is a little bit all over the place, cluttered with signs everywhere. We were seated promptly, and each started off with a grande traditional margarita. They were delicious, and if weren't driving, would be ordering one after another. The chips and salsa were delicious, and I love that they added a bunch of chopped cilantro and onion on top for us. The service overall was pretty good, however a tad slow at times.

Their menu is gigantic, and they have a picture of everything on it so you can see what it looks life for reference. For the meal, I went with a burrito suizo, which was out of this world, and HUGE! I only at half of it, along with the rice and beans, so the leftovers will be great. I ordered a gordita a la carte, and overall was pretty good. I would love to come back and try so many more things on the menu!
name: Patrick

text: Hole in the wall with huge portions and very friendly service!  Came for a late lunch due to it having lots of good reviews.  Man working was very polite.  Brought home the spicy gyro, a small hummus, and baklava to share with my husband.  It was all very delicious and we still have some leftovers to enjoy!  Will have to go back to try again!
name: Alice-Anne

text: Ya so I was in Reno for street vibes and the wife and I decided to yelp a good place for breakfast to to which brings me to the review food was bland lacked and flavor prices were ok but I wouldn't go back
name: Martin

text: I love how fresh the ahi is here. There's a poke bowl place that's closer to my office than this place, but I take the drive over this place for the quality and freshness! Also the zucchini noodles option is awesome! Their sauces are great too, and they label the items that have gluten in them for those who have allergies!
name: Sara

text: Place was really good.  Ladies up front were friendly and were very helpful.  Pizza is yummy!  Reminds me of NY!  Not too spicy and very tasty!  Very affordable!  Even able to take some home.  Will be back and will bring our friends here.
name: Jen

text: What a pleasant surprise! Large portions, seriously excellent flavor, and friendly staff. My first time won't be my last time! The Pickles and Swiss sandwich was delicious and large enough to be two meals in one. My wife ordered their Crispy Chicken Cobb Salad, and again, more food than she could handle! Treat yourself!
name: Kevin

text:
Delicious 
We just drove from Charlotte NC and we wanted something fast and tasty! This hit the spot!
name: Marysol

text: *My review is solely for happy hour* -- I came here for happy hour (3pm-6pm) based on the recommendations of my fellow yelpers and was not disappointed! Half off cocktails, beer and wine, plus $1.25/fried oyster and $0.75/oyster. You are required to get the fried oysters in increments of half a dozen. They were some of the better ones I've had in the area; crispy on the outside, meaty on the inside, and were decently sized. The raw oysters were amazing- they were massive and good quality, and you can't beat the price.  Definitely some of the best happy hour oysters I've had in my life! Service was very friendly, refilling our water glasses frequently and checking in with us just the right amount. Would come back here in a heartbeat during my next visit to New Orleans!
name: Lauren

text:
I went last summer when the weather was really beautiful out. They had all their windows open and great outdoor seating. It was very cozy and the coffee was quite good. I don't know if it was good enough to warrant the price, I was expecting a better cup for what I paid. It has been a while though so maybe they updated their selection. 

It's a very small place so don't go with a large group and expect seating. They do have WiFi and it would be a nice quiet place to work.
name: Gillian

text: i kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
Okay. Yes the wait is a bit long HOWEVER this is not a fast food place. The atmosphere is walkway super relaxing and makes me sleepy, idk if that's good or bad for you but for me it's awesome. Always quite and her busy and the food is AMAZING. Never had an issue here. The waiter (never can get his name I'm bad with names) is a taller gentleman younger maybe mid-high 20s always driving my wife and I with pure awesomeness. He well aware of our drinks reaching below A 1/4 full which in my opinion is a great thing. 

Highly recommend.
name: Nicholas

text: This place is awesome.  Martin was our server and he acted like an owner. Was so friendly and so helpful.  Made us special vegetarian enchiladas. Our son had the pollo asada burrito and it was delicious.  He did a fabulous job checking on us and brought us extra chips and salsa and gave us to go menus for the future.  We ate off the specials menu and it had excellent prices.  6.99 and 7.99 plates of food.  Music was on but not too loud so you could have a conversation.   Bravo!!! Will be back for sure.  Spread the word.  Thank you Martin!!
name: Angel

text: Thank you DTB for a wonderful dinner.  Jordan was a welcoming and polished server.  I really enjoyed his recommendations, (crab claws and red snapper). The atmosphere is cozy.  The designer really deserves a high five. Tasteful touches of Louisiana from the light fixtures to the boudin balls. You have to try the ice cream sandwich!
name: Neela

text: Egg white's, Swiss cheese, fresh spinach on a croissant with delicious creamy grits and excellent coffee. Clean, quite, inexpensive, excellent service and a happy staff. Hole in one, totally unexpected.
name: Christopher

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Holy Cow.  Delicious breakfast.  Great service. Very fast and friendly. I ordered the sausage sampler.  Every sausage (chicken apple, Mexican and Italian) was flavorful.  My husband ordered the Alaskan salmon eggs Benedict.  He was wowed as well.
name: Tandice

text:
This place is a temple of food worship. 
This is an art museum where you eat the art and feel good about every bite. 
Seriously this place amazes me. 

I've been here with a wide range of non vegans and they all adore the food as well. 

Gorgeous atmosphere, everything is dialed in and great service every time. If you're looking for something epic, drive to Mesa Verde and splurge! It's not every day you get the chance to worship food like this and all so healthy and bangarang.
name: Daniel

text:
I remember coming here for the first time almost 5 years ago and having the corned beef sandwich that was pure magic. We made a stop here specifically to relive that magic, but unfortunately the corned beef sandwich this time was average at best.

++
I still like the buzz of the market, and waiting in line to get food does create some kind of anticipation

- -
Dry corned beef that, in my opinion, shouldn't be served to customers to begin with

Our sandwich was pressed even though we never asked

There was little slaw which, combined with little sauce, just made this sandwich that much more dry and tasteless


In the end, our stomachs were full, but that's not why we stopped here. Disappointed.
name: Hwal

text: This place is AMAZING!!! Hole in the wall so don't expect fancy...trust me, way worth giving it a try! Huge portions and some of the best seafood I've had since moving from Louisiana. The crab legs were cooked and seasoned perfectly, shrimp were HUGE!!! Everything was great, treated us like family. We will be back!
name: Laura

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. You can tell they care about customer experience here.
name: User

text: One of the most affordable downtown lunch spots there is. Always reliable service.
name: Robert

text: On our way to Medford. Then to this fabulous diner for bloody Mary's and brunch :) Haven't been here in over a year, took me a few minutes to look up didn't remember name soon as I saw  Starview knew was the correct diner. Such a unique name from the service and food delicious strawberry daiquiri I had last visit it's a must go when you're in the area. Bloody Mary for brunch See you all soon can't wait starving and very thirsty:)
name: Shannon

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Would absolutely visit again. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not sure though.
name: User

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: This is absolutely the worst service ever. As a professional bartender and bar manager, I never tip less than 20%. Today may be a first. She forgot everything, and then did the worst thing possible, avoided us, so things that could be fixed, never were. It takes a lot for me to be disappointed in service, but this was awful. I get bad days, or being weeded because too many servers have been cut, or crappy managers aren't providing support, but this is as above and beyond. There were no managers on site either. Managers,  show your serving staff some support, and servers, don't be afraid of your guests if you make a mistake. You can always salvage at table.
name: Britton

text: Great tasting food & fair service. I usually don't write anything negative because I understand the effect it does to people's business but I'm also sure I'm not the only one affected. The biggest problem I have with this place is the food poisoning I contracted on 8/8/18. I order coconut tai stir fry and 3 days later I still have symptoms of food poisoning. (Fever, Chills, Body aching, Stomach issues)
name: Tjrice10

text: I purchased the evening cruise without dinner for 3. Upon arrival we were told that the seats available to us were the tables in the back with black covers. We went up to the 2nd floor and were told that the area was for dinner guests only and we could only sit in the tables with black covers in the back and walk around the deck on the top. I felt as if they treated us like we were low class since we did not purchase dinner. My husband went up to the bar to order a drink and was pretty much ignored. I guess they only cater to those who purchased dinner tickets.I felt uncomfortable and so did my guests and we should have insisted on a refund. The thing I enjoyed was the music.
name: S.

text: Always come here for the delicious food and calming atmosphere. However my last visit wasn't the best. The food never disappoints! Always delicious. The staff could use some work. I had requested a booth and unfortunately they were all taken but were not even offered to wait for one. Before we were seated at a table I had stopped and asked the host if we could get the booth from the family that had just got up and she didn't seem too happy about that. Just unprofessional front of house. I'll continue to come here, but they need to do better.
name: Joseph

text: The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Everything I've tried here has been amazing.  But my favorite part is the fruity wines made from real fruit preserves! U gotta try the passion fruit!
name: Charlene

text: Blaze pizza stills gets a B. The pizza is so wonderful. The staff is friendly. The tables and windows needed some cleaning. I told the friendly guy manning the oven and soon the cleaning begun. Good job!
name: Robin

text:
Good food, Good Service and Great Ambience. I was craving for some Indian food on my work-trip to Tampa and I am glad I chose this place. Dined here for a dinner and the staff accommodated the off-menu items which gets them brownie points.
Will definitely try again on my next visit to Tampa!
name: Shweta

text:
Got shrimp pad Thai and Thai tea to go for $14. 
I thought it was kind of expensive, but totally worth it after I tasted the meal. This has got to be my favorite Thai tea in the area. The pad Thai is delicious and has plenty of shrimp. 

I am definitely coming back!
name: Lynn

text: I really love the food here, especially the megruli. The cheese blend is just to die for Clean and cozy atmosphere with great service. However, when calling or going into the store side of the restaurant, service could be a little friendlier.
name: Ariel

text:
The Philly Jawn was okay. But if a customer says they don't want the fries but will pay the full price anyway don't say you can't. The other customer got the look when he said leave off the chipotle sauce. Considering the less than crisp or hot fries were just thrown on top of the meat. When you can't adjust two totally different food groups this screams pre-made! It tasted just like warmed over fries. Nothing worse than lukewarm fries! Big boy at the window was less than pleasant and they were only open for 15 minutes. When people and not just me asked questions he gave customers the 'are you serious dumb look'. I should have taken the cue from my husband and the other customer who walked away.

Dam*! I forgot to take a picture of the rib eye steak that had a liver like flavor similar to when inferior meat it used. Overall I was not impressed by the food or service! Bye big boy not Big Boi!

text: Got here around 10 minutes from opening on a Sunday and had no line.  Ordered the East Nasty it was great!  Definitely a gracious quantity of food for the price and worth the wait if you do have to wait in line.  This place isn't call biscuit love for nothing best biscuit I have ever had.
name: Tanikka

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Honestly, the experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Also, the food was good and the service was easygoing. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. not sure I'd order the same thing again. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: You cannot go wrong with anything here! It's worth the wait! It's in a cool old house, so it isn't huge inside. But the food...to die for!
name: J

text: My boyfriend and I came here the other day. There were maybe three tables with people. The hostess literally sat us the dirtiest table (it had food visibly on it) and she didn't mention anything. So we sat ourselves, assuming she's blind. Food was decent, overpriced for the value and taste. After we left, we went to a bar and walked past Max Brenner after it closed. This is what we saw, chairs on top of the tables with the dirty legs on the table!! I understand you have to mop, but have never seen this. It's disgusting. Basically, your table has floor germs on it. If you mop, move chairs, but don't put them on the table. Won't be coming back here.
name: Kate

text: New little Chicago Restaurant in the new revitalized area in Brownsburg. The parking lot is behind this location since it sits on the street. Nice atmosphere and nice outdoor seating too. We had the Slam'n Sammy, hot ham and cheese sandwich and The Cuban Comet. Both sandwiches was very good. I have never had a Cuban so not sure if this is what it is supposed to taste like or not. We also had an order of the chili cheese fries. I thought the chili was a little bland and the fries needed cooked more but Karla disagrees with me on it. All in all not bad but a little joint, maybe a little pricey for what you get though.
name: Paul

text: Filthy. Slow. Chaotic.  There was a line to the door and many more customers standing in the lobby waiting on an order. The drive through was backed up and not moving.  The staff response? Indifferent and with no sense of urgency. Crew wandering in circles unsure of what yo do next or else just apathetic with glazed eyes. Shame on you, McDonalds.
name: Mark

text: So lucky that I am less than 5 minutes to RaeRae's - love everything there .... do ask what the hash of the month is ..... that + the biscuits and gravy are pretty awesome.  Love this place.  Great prices too!
name: Food Monkey

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. Just not for me. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was good and came out fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Being from Chicago, pizza hits close to my heart! Crescent City located on Bourbon is just wonderful. The slices are big and tasty. Not overpriced at all. There's definitely no shortage of toppings either. Just the right amount of cheese and it definitely hits the spot after an afternoon of drinking lol.
name: Mark

text:
This place is basically the Carrabba's of Mexican food..
Not bad, tasty in fact.
But not Mexican..
If you are looking for good Mexican, drive into NOLA, Taqueria Guerrero, or La Mansion await you.
But if you need a quick salsa fix, this place might be right for you..
name: James

text:
I really liked this place. Hostess was friendly and offered me a seat at the bar since I was by myself. Bartender, Steve, was friendly and was doing a good job managing all patrons at the bar and those who were walking up for drinks. 

Menu isn't huge, but honestly that is a good thing. Better to do less items well. I got the chicken sandwich and it was huge. Chicken was fried to perfection and sauce was very tasty. I could have done without the slaw, but just personal preference. 

Tried 2 drinks... the Strawberry Fields and the Pineapple Margarita. The Strawberry Fields was very good and I would get this one again. Margarita was good, just didn't have a ton of pineapple flavor. 

Atmosphere at this place is great. Lighting and interesting things that catch your eye in the entire restaurant. Saw a pizza oven in the back so next time I am in the area I think I'll order a pizza. 

Great spot. Will return.
name: Amy

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not bad for a quick meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Pickles & Swiss is one of my favorite spots in SB!! The sandwiches are delicious, cookies are to die for, & they have an awesome variety of beverages (beer & wine too!) the staff is always very friendly and helpful- especially Owen he always makes sure his customers leave happy. Don't forget to try their popcorn while you wait! it's really good:)
name: Sarah

text: Okay so my family went to get Genos yesterday around 4pm. We got one whiz with and one whiz without. We also asked for the hot sauce. When we ordered it, it came out in less than a minute as usual and the staffs were unfriendly as usual too. I do not mind too much about the unfriendliness as long as they are proud that they serve clean and good food since it is using a pick up your own food system. Our cheesesteaks werent hot which we thought was strange but enjoyed it since I drove 30minutes to get something that I remembered to be very good. My sister, within 12hours of having half portion of Genos cheese steak, had to go to the bathroom 6times and I, who ate the whole cheese steak went to the toilet more than 10 times. This is WITHIN 12HOURS!!!! I could not eat anything else yesterday. How dirty or old does the 'COOKED' food have to be to make people sick? It was not worth the drive, or the CASH ONLY 10bucks. Now I see why only tourists go there and not the local ppls. I will not return.
name: Liz

text: What a gem!  Love this place. Staff is so sweet, atmosphere is so cute and the food is fab!  I come here at least once a month when I visit Nashville.
name: Paula

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was good and came out fast. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: FOOD WAS AMAZING. The bloody Mary was pretty bad. It was basically watered down tomato juice with vodka. No pepper or hot sauce. The eggs Benedict was incredible!
name: Mark

text: Whiskey Joe's is good. Typical bar with typical barfood. I wouldn't trust the oysters unless it's a "R" month who knows where they get them from.
name: Charlie

text: Visiting for work and stopped in for dinner. Pulled pork and ribs are delicious. Might not do the bbq beef again though as it seemed a little dry.  Service was quick, sides were good (slaw and beans), and all for $22 plus tip. Already recommended to a co worker also in town for work.
name: T

text:
This was our first visit and we loved the place.  The staff were friendly and helpful and the restaurant was bright and comfortable.

But what really drew us was the food, amazing.  All the flavors were well balanced and complimented each other.  We had the lamb shank and goulash as the main course and both were perfectly prepared with buttered rice and noodles and a fresh bright salad.

The apple and shortbread desserts were lovely.  Not too sweet and refreshing.

Overall we have fallen in love with Bosnian food and Chef Alisha!
name: Brian

text: Great place - absolute shocked by some of these reviews, definitely not my experience with this location or their sister in Doylestown.  Highly recommend for sit down, but often I will order for take out and surprise the wife - she is never sorry to see their bag come in the house!
name: R.

text:
All the stars here are for the live music. It was excellent.
Service was not great. It was a holiday weekend and it must be the manager's first one because obviously they were not prepared. It was not a well oiled machine. All the servers didn't even say a word to each other. Sat for 45 minutes, invisible. 
The beers are good but is that really to their credit? 

Important:
DO NOT EAT HERE.
Food was horrible. It's a bit later on in the evening and even though I'm not that hungry, I *have* to get something right now, even if it's just to get the awful taste of that crap grease out of my mouth.

Go have dinner somewhere else, and then come and enjoy the atmosphere and the music here.
name: Nacho

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not bad for a quick meal. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nice little spot, decent portions too. For the price I expected more than this. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
We stopped here on Friday morning before heading out of town to pick up a few king cakes to bring back to Austin. BTW, Google maps will steer you wrong to a large office complex--Manny Randazzo's is behind that.

There was already a line at the door and a security guard...and Mardi Gras is still two months away! The folks in line were really friendly and giving us tips on how to keep it fresh (apparently the cakes freeze well). Everybody recommended cream cheese, so that's what we got, along with a couple decorative boxes since two would be gifts ($1 each for the small size). 

We didn't try the cake until Saturday morning, and even a day later, it was still wonderful. It's essentially a large danish with hints of lemon and the cream cheese isn't overwhelming. They seem slightly overpriced at $16.50 a pop, but since this was a one-time only purchase for us, no big deal. We're not king cake connoisseurs, but Manny Randazzos gets our seal of approval.
name: W

text: Food wasn't good, order was wrong, I ordered a bacon cheeseburger and received only a cheeseburger that was mediocre by any standard. The pickles taste kind of like bread and butter pickles as well, which I don't prefer on my hamburgers. We won't be back, we'll just go a few miles down the street and go to Culver's instead for some real food.
name: Katrina

text: I love the house salad with fried shrimp!  Always live coming back to the Midwest.  I can eat the things I love so much!
name: Karen

text: we waited nearly 2 hours for our pizza. theyre we cold and she forgot our drink. after calling when they were 30 late, they said the driver had been gone and then said it would be there soon... showed up an hour later....

text:
This is more like 3.5 stars.

1. Came in without reservation.  I only needed to wait for about 5 minutes to be seated at 7:30-ish right before Monday Night Football

2. Took the waiter more than 5 min to hand me the menu.

3. After ordering, a plate of two WARM dinner rolls, butter, and a glass of ice water were served.  The butter melts inside the roll.  Maybe I was hungry, but they were good!  4/5

4. Petite Filet Mignon (8 oz) 3.5/5.  Medium rare does come up medium rare, but i found the middle not warm enough for me.  Both sauce (butter?) and the plate were hot.  I had to dip into the sauce to warm up the middle a little bit.  I suppose the sauce compensates it?

5. Brussel Sprouts with bacon and butter 3.5/5.  I ordered with regular butter instead of honey butter.  With the bacon bits, it was pretty good.  A decent veggie side.

I felt they were understaffed.  You definitely don't get enough attention from your waiter/waitress.
name: Otto

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Nice little spot, decent portions too.

text: The worst.   It should be shut down.   McDonalds should be embarrassed.  Customer service is terrible.  Food...   not up to standards.  Just the worst.

Could not ask for a better option for the best Italian quality food.
The coconut cream pie is amazing.  Meats are the best in the area.   Fresh pasta and sauces are fantastic.  Feels like a little piece of Arthur Avenue in st Pete's

text: Think unfortunately there is a little resting on the laurels of their popularity. This is what the 1/4 of muffaletta I ate looked like. Purchased yesterday afternoon. Store wasn't as busy as other times we have patronized. Lots of people behind the counter and service is polite but quality is control is lacking. I would say check before you leave but it's wrapped and bagged as you pay and who wants to make a scene with unwrapping right there.  Think we need to look at one of the many other places that offer this delicious NOLA staple.

text: I usually get the chicken and lamb over rice and load it up with the white sauce. Been here several times and the choice in number of red lines is great. Today maybe a new worker was making the food because she was a tad bit stingy with the scoops but the food doesn't disappoint. Had to add more of the white sauce on my own. Sign up on their website for a few freebies too.

text:
Kingside Diner is aesthetically pleasing to the eye. It's ambiance is clean and upscale. 

The waitstaff was as very pleasant and accommodating. 

However the food was just mediocre.
name: Lisa

text: Since they have moved to MacDade I am completely addicted to the brisket! I care for nothing more. They have some stellar recipes. The wings, The corn bread, The pulled pork. TO. DIE. FOR. but my weakness is the smokey, sweet chewy brisket. moist! Frankly I should start walking to this place and work off the pounds. if you live within 50 miles of this joint and you are looking for some nice 'que stop on in,

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Price felt a touch high for what it was. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I left full, which at least counts for something. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.

Food was okay but nothing over the top. Highly reccomend the apple cinnamon french toast. Prices were reasonable.

text: Go on a day leeroy is working! He's wonderful and extremely accommodating! Our hookah lasted for over an hour, he checked back frequently and was always friendly and kind! It has a great vibe, open windows so you can look out on the night life. Great music and patrons. Would definitely come back again!!!

Not going back ever agin the customer service is really bad!  Charged for the beer with the fly in it and no customer satisfaction.

text:
Cup Cafe wasn't our first choice for our breakfast after our walk. The Welcome Dinner was closed due to smashing window encounter. With that said we had out biscuits and sausage gravy at the Cup Cafe at the hotel Congress . I hadn't been to the Cup for two years and I now remember why. The hostess most pleasant . The over all service very friendly and knowledgeable on service to the Resterante . They don't use free roaming chicken eggs or organic eggs which was a bit disappointing with the cost ratio of our dish. Creole Biscuits and sausage. I wanted to update on my explosion today. I met with the general manager and I was satisfied that he and staff disappointed that my friend and I got I'll after eating something ,never admitted blame which and understood that a disconnect happen at our table. He gave me pretty much what we asked for and I was off . To conclude 
The Cup cafe at the Congress is a great place to be seen and if your going to an event you won't be disappointed ,the venues at the Congress are outstanding .  When you want biscuits and gravy don't settle go to (the welcome dinner ).
name: Walter

text: Absolutely incredible food and even better service! Our waitress Molly made fantastic recommendations and was so friendly and welcoming! The sand dabs are delicious, as were the sides! Will definitely be visiting Lure Santa Barbara again, very soon!
name: Amelia

text:
I really enjoyed everything at buya. I love that it's a big enough place to accommodate a crowd. I never feel like it's too cramped.
I love the chicken ramen. I was beginning to wonder if most ramen just always had tough nearly inedible meat judging from a few other spots I had tried previously, not here though. Some people at my table thought the broth was too salty, but I prefer it. It's loaded with garlic, tender chicken, edemame and roasted corn. 
They also have a very mild mushroom ramen as a vegetarian option but it has a miso tasting broth that I don't prefer. I can't remember exactly what they were called on the menu but the dumplings were pretty good too.
I vastly prefer this spot to Ichicoro down the street. Overall the staff was very friendly and attentive, I'll definitely be back.
name: Alex

text: Food preparation and presentation was great. Plenty of hibachi grills for large parties. Huge food portions and enough to take home!
name: Pam

text:

text:
This is my favorite restuarant in Tampa Bay given the quality of the food, ambiance and the whole experience of the wine cellar tour and dessert room. I always choose this spot for date night to celebrate my birthday. 

Tips:
1. Make reservations at least 1 month in advance on their website if you want to eat dinner at a decent hour. 

2. Bring $5 cash plus tip for mandatory valet. 

3. Mention it's your birthday at the dessert room and you'll receive a free cinnamon sugar cookie with a candle on it.

4. For the salad dressing, avoid the ranch dressing because it tastes like taco salad. Instead I highly recommend the citrus or macadamia vinagerette which is very unique to Bern's. 

5. For the dessert room, you cannot make reservations if you did not eat dinner there. If you did, you automatically get a spot at the dessert room. My favorite is the Pineapple cake. Avoid the Apple pie (too much dough) and Brown sugar (cookie dough cheesecake was subpar). Must try the coffee because it's made from their coffee machine that's decades old. 

Overall, Bern's is such an iconic place in Tampa. You have to experience it once during a special occasion whether it's birthday or anniversary.

text:
Seriously one of the best sushi places. Ever. Hands down. If you're into fancy rolls and fancy ambience, then go downtown to another place. If you like fish and are a little adventurous, try the okonomiaki, grilled squid, aji fry, or baby octopus - they are all amazing. Forget fancy rolls, the sashimi is where it's at. The poke bowl has the best assortment of fresh fish in an extremely light ginger dressing.

text:
Food: 4-4.5 stars
Service: 1-2 stars

On a recent visit to St. Louis, we knew we wanted to eat on The Hill and found Anthonino's to be one of the highest rated. We arrived around 6:30pm on a recent weekend evening and were quoted a 45 minute wait. I'm not sure if the hostess was flustered with the amount of people waiting and partaking in the bar close to her area, but she wasn't the friendliest. Nevertheless, we were seated within 30 minutes, so that was a nice surprise.

We opted to get a drink at the bar while we waited. The keg for my husband's beer was tapped about halfway through his glass and they didn't have another in stock. The bartender didn't charge him for it which was sweet. My drink was made with cheap bourbon. What's worse than no bourbon at all? Cheap bourbon. I guess I should be thankful it was a weak pour. Once seated, a server brought bread and olive oil to the table, never speaking to us, then we waited. And waited. And waited a little more before our server came to the table, not apologizing for the delay or even stopping, and asked if we needed an appetizer. She never gave her name and once we indicated we'd like an order of the toasted ravioli, she was gone again. She returned, again, never fully stopping at our table, to get our order, then disappeared. The only other time she came by was to drop the check off, then walked by several times until we put our payment out, which she grabbed quickly. She never thanked us, wished us a good night- just dropped the change back off on the table.

Having said all that- the food was actually pretty good. I wasn't anticipating the filling of the ravioli to be a paste consistency, so that caught me off guard. Once I grew accustomed to it, they weren't bad. My husband had the primavera pasta and I had the pomodoro. Here is where Anthonino's really shined for us. You could tell the pasta was homemade and it was incredible. The vegetables used in our dishes were fresh and added so much to the pasta. Servings were fair and after the toasted ravioli, left us full for the night. Several tables around us had pizzas which also looked really good. 

I would return for the food, but the service definitely needs some work.
name: M

text:

text:

I've been following this place for a while on IG and I finally made it..... it took me 27 mins to get there and it wasn't fast enough, lol 

We were seated right away and LaLa was so nice and friendly. Later the chef came by and asked how everything was which I found to be thoughtful & welcoming. That doesn't happens very often so I definitely made us feel like she truly cares. Everyone was very  attentive and inviting. 
I ordered the crab  & Shrimp  entree. The shrimp were seasoned so well and cooked just right... not all shriveled up like some places. Now.... on to the highlight of the meal.... THE CRAB LEGS! These crab legs were cooked to perfection! You know when you can crack the shell and pull out the most perfect whole piece of meat that's juicy and sweet? Yea, that's how these crab legs were....absolutely cooked to perfection! 

My sister ordered seafood pasta (which I WILL be ordering next time...... next time as in tomorrow, lol) 
It was fanfreekintastic  !!!! The sauce was just delicious and it was riddled with salmon, shrimp and lump crab.... ridiculiciously delicious.

My nice had the shrimp entree which came with broccoli and she upgraded to the lobster Mac..... again, lip smackin delicious! In all fairness ... she did say the broccoli was cooked a bit too much for her taste but who really cares when the rest of the meal was a showstopper!!!!!

text:
As residents of Fletcher Place, I'm sad to say that we had one of the worst service experiences we've ever had at this restaurant. 

After waiting for over 1.5 hours for our food, we had to motion for our waitress to inquire about the status of our order. Multiple tables of similar size parties (4 people) around us had come and gone. No apology was given for the wait, instead we were told that they "were very busy that night." Looking around the restaurant, the place was about 50% at capacity. That being said, it was apparent that the restaurant was severely understaffed. Regardless, it became apparent that our order was lost in the shuffle. Had that been admitted and an apology given, this review would be different. 

We received our food nearly 1 hour and 45 minutes after placing our order and still paid full price. FYI - we did not have any unique requests on our order. By the time the food came out, we were late for our next engagement and frankly, the food was not great. 

Overall, very disappointed. Despite supporting our local businesses regularly, we will not be back.

Response to business owner: 

We arrived at 6pm. We ordered around 6:15pm. Our food was received at 7:45pm. The fact that there were no tickets that exceeded the timeline bolsters my assumption that our order was lost in the shuffle. We were seated on the patio. No mention was made of the need for a reservation - we were seated outside immediately without question from staff.

To be honest, your expectation that patrons must request to speak to the manager to have an issue resolved is misguided in my opinion. My expectation as a customer is that staff might anticipate the fact that an extremely long wait is inappropriate and at minimum offer an apology. Instead of receiving an apology or an offer for some type of reasonable accommodation after over an hour of waiting for food (only 2/4 ordered from the devour menu), we received the question: "Is there something I can bring you?" There wasn't even a recognition that we'd been waiting for entrees for over an hour. 

We are not unreasonable guests. We visit restaurants to have a good time and tip well. However, if the expectation is for me to have to cause a scene by asking to speak with the manager in front of visiting friends in order to be treated reasonably, we will go elsewhere.
name: Tyler

text:
This Taco Bell location is ok, and I mean that, just ok. It's nothing spectacular, but it's certainly not the worst fast food restaurant I've ever been to either. The employees always seem friendly and willing to take your order. The food always comes out hot & is always tasty. 

I will occasionally stop in at this location for breakfast, since it's close to work. My main issue with this location has pertained to breakfast, and that issue is that they always seem to be out of something or one of their machines aren't working correctly. One morning I stopped by and placed my order, then also ordered a coffee. The woman told me that their coffee machine was broken, and that they don't have any coffee made. What's the point of serving breakfast if there is no coffee available? Another time, I stopped by, and ordered (this time they had coffee available). The woman at the drive-thru window asked if I wanted any sauce, and I replied that I would like the breakfast salsa, and she said, "ok, no problem". I waited a moment or two, and she handed me my coffee and my bag of food. I pulled away, but pulled into a spot real quick to make sure my food was correct, as I usually do. I noticed there was no breakfast salsa in the bag. I went inside (defeats the purpose of going through the drive-thru), and said that my breakfast salsa wasn't in the bag, and asked for some. The woman, the same one who was at the drive-thru window, said "oh we don't have any right now, but there's mild and hot sauce over there". She didn't apologize for not having any salsa; she didn't apologize for not telling me when I was still in the drive-thru, nor for failing to ask if I wanted any other kind of sauce. I was pretty annoyed over the whole incident, and haven't been back since. 

Between the two separate events, I think I will avoid this location for awhile, maybe give them time to get their act together a bit before I return.

text:
I drove from Gainesville to have lunch with my daughter and her husband on my way south and they chose Terra Sur, MUCH to my delight. Peruvian restaurants seem to be de riguer these days and this was my first experience. I lived in Venezuela decades ago and some of the food origins are similar. Peruvian food seems to be a little "saucier" and who doesn't love a variety of great ceviches? That being said, I didn't have one!

I had the churrasco ($13) because I'm a sucker for it and it was delicious and not overcooked which is easy to do for skirt steak. It came with really good fries, crisp on the outside and fluffy on the inside. My daughter had the Aji de Gallina ($9), strips of chicken mixed in a slightly spicy creamy aji amarillo - yellow chili pepper - and walnut sauce with white rice and boiled potatoes. She loved it and the portion was generous enough for leftovers. My SIL had the Apanado a lo Pobre ($10), pounded, lightly breaded beef, pan-fried, topped with a sunny side up egg. It also came with rice and plantains. He NEVER has leftovers! They ordered the Dulce de Leche Cheesecake ($8) for take home.

Our server was Leslee and she couldn't have been more attentive and friendly. She was knowledgeable and was able to help us with our choices. I would recommend this to anyone for a slight twist on what they think they know about South American food!
name: Poppy

text: Not sure how to start this review. Do I say all you need to do is repeat the name of the business to figure out how good the food is? Or, do I ask how many restaurants can you find in Nashville that have a solid five stars? I have probably driven through the Nolensville Pike/Paragon Mills intersection 500 times over the last dozen years, and never knew this restaurant was just...right...there. Tonight we took the dive. Burgers, wings, Philly cheesesteak, and lamb gyro. All were incredible. Some of the best-tasting wings in Nashville, and my wife says the hamburger was one of the best she has had in town. Not sure where else I would get a Philly cheesesteak like the one I had tonight. Be patient...everything is made while you wait. $30 bought us more food than three people should have been allowed to eat. This place is worth it. I think I have found my new favorite Nashville hole-in-the-wall!
