text:
A friend sent me a message asking if I had tried Retrograde yet. After all, it had been open for 3 whole days... But I had just returned from the road and hadn't heard of it, so I did a little digging. They had me at "serving Onyx Coffee Lab coffees." Onyx, based out of Fayetteville, AR, is one of my favorite US roasters. 

On my first visit to a coffee shop, I often order the drip coffee just to see what's happening there. I've heard some people say they judge a Thai restaurant by the quality of their Pad Thai. I don't know about all of that, but Retrograde's drip was excellent. Not to mention, it was free... Pretty sure that's a 'week one perk only' type of thing, but was a pleasant surprise nonetheless. 

The space itself feels great - I stayed for about an hour and did some work. The hardwood floors are beautifully refinished, and the design felt warm and good blend of modern and throwback. 

Parking out front was completely full when I arrived. Tip: there's a lot in the back (almost feels like alley access off Douglas & Joseph) and then a stairwell up to the left hand side that takes you right into Retrograde. 

I'll certainly be back.
name: Christian

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The wait felt longer than it should have. Probably not coming back. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better online than it did in person. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
AMAZING SERVICE!! I'm telling you RIGHT NOW! Donald the server is the person YOU WANT!! He immediately brightens up your day and is guaranteed to make you smile! His service is exactly what my partner and I needed before we headed out on this trip!! Great assortment of foods and priority pass definitely makes it even better!! 

Cheers!
name: Mark

text:
I've been to MacNivens several times over the 5ish years I've been in Indy.  Beer is what usually brings us in, but we've gotten food a few times.  I saw I hadn't written a review yet about my experiences and I think that's the problem, there's not much to write about. 

The inside is cozy during the winter and nice in the warmer months when they open the front windows out to the street. Most of the time we are ponied up to the bar.  The service is just OK.  I don't get a super warm feeling or get into any good conversation with the bartenders.  I know I've seen a few of them that have been there for years.  

The food is where it lacks for my taste.  I have struggled the few times we have eaten there because I just can't find anything on the menu that sounds good.  It definitely best suits the winter months because the food tends to be heavy.  I have never thought of going to MacNivens when discussing dinner plans, unless they have a specific beer we are searching.
name: Kylie

text: To be fair, the food and the atmosphere are incredibly good, the downside is having unprofessional staff members who don't take the time to return phone calls. If they could bring the professionalism up to the bar the food and atmosphere are, this would be a great place to be. When the staff do return calls, there is attitude connected with their failure to communicate. Please do better. I will not recommended your business to anyone else.
name: Timothy

text: This was a really nice little restaurant, good for big groups. The food was pretty delicious and the portion sizes were huge. The best part though was the little plastic turtles they put in your drinks!
name: Laina

text: We sure do love this place! The fish is always fresh and the service is great. Vinh is always so inviting and makes us feel like family. Best sushi place in town hands down! I personally love the Fire Dragon roll with Albacore and my boyfriend loves the Happy Sumo! Try it!
name: Jaime

text: I recently moved to the area and have been missing my hibachi spot in my old city. I saw this place while I dropped my daughter off at school and decided to stop in after school one day. It was about 3:30 and we were the only ones there which was fine. I ordered the chicken and shrimp hibachi with a side of noodles and my daughter had chicken hibachi. The chef was OK, maybe not as animated because it was just 2 of us, but my daughter still loved it. I was surprised by the salad and soup. The salad had a really unique dressing unlike other hibachi places I've visited and the soup had a nice flavor, too. The portions were a great size l, the shrimp was huge and I was pleased about that. The host/waitress was also nice. The hibachi area is small and I'm guessing it gets packed at night and on weekends, so I'd probably make a reservation. Prices are a tad bit higher than other hibachi restaurants by a few dollars, so thankfully the food was delicious. I'll definitely be back.
name: Kristen

text:
I love this place!  Their food is excellent...especially the bbq meats, and of all things their astounding wedge fries!!  Double ×
Wow for the fries.  My server was also a tour guide pointing out different sauces and ideas i had considered as the 4th of July was my first visit.  My hot server was Brendon is by far the best server in Tucson.  I felt like all these new folk were family!     But go for the food, the home made mac and cheese is awesome !  Their bbq sauce is home made and they leave a container on the table So you can enjoy all you want. They also have live entertainment on Wednesday night...cool!  So glad I found this wonderful eatery to call my new home away from home. Horseshoe Grill I here I come !!   Oh..manager Cathy is wonderful too and you will LOVE the prices !! Enjoy !!
name: Karime

text:
Just picked up my burger... I understand yall are busy but like what other reviewers have stated, please change out ur gloves! 

One shouldnt be manning the shake machine and handling the kiosks... especially at a new establishment...

text:
We were in Indianapolis for the weekend, and found this gem! It was so good that we literally went there everyday while we were there. 
The restaurant is clean and cool. It's almost like a chipotle with Korean food. We ordered the chap chae, kalbi plate and bulgogi plate. Everything was flavorful and they give you plenty of food! The price is SUPER cheap and definitely can split into 2 meals. The rice was fresh and the (4) veggies you can add as toppings on your rice with your meat added even more flavor! 
The service was fast and excellent. The guy cooking in the back that brings you food is so welcoming and checks up on you often - maybe the manager or owner(?). 
Definitely stop by for some amazing Korean food!
name: Ayano

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. It was decent, just a little uneven. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Hilton Honors Lifetime Diamond so have stayed at lots of Embassy Suites.  Was nice to see the original interior.  Recent remodel was nicely done.  Had dinner in The Local and was so surprised how good it was - 3 amazing tacos and the sliders with fab onion rings. Room very comfortable.  Don't pass this up for a "newer" build.  Great staff.

text:
My wife and I came here on a recommendation and I'm so glad we did. We walked up and there was a curved waiting line outside. Somebody came out and asked everyone in line if there's anybody interested in eating on the patio? We jumped on the opportunity. On this 5th of July, hot day. 
We were brought inside and knew what we wanted from the menu after waiting 10 minutes outside. Quickly paid for it and enjoyed our meal. So worth it! We'd come back. 

The service was spot on and food was amazing!

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Would return. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
Stopped by Bourbon House for their oysters happy hours (4pm to 6pm) $1/per oysters and boy was I glad I picked Bourbon House! We arrived around 5ish PM and we were told to wait since the bar was completely packed. We waited around a bit and I overheard another waitress telling another party that they have a second bar in the back and it's not crowded so we head over there. The second bar is actually inside of Hotel Plaza so it was fancy and not crowded like the other waitress stated. 

We was seated immediately and we order two dozen oysters. It was shucked infront of us and was given to us super fresh. I loved Bourbon House's oysters, so big and so fresh. I highly recommend this place for their oyster's happy hour. :)

text:

The once amazing calamari was overcooked, greasy and rubbery.  Just so not worth the money !  Bottom line go to outback for 2/3 the price and still have the same bad food and service for less!

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Kind of landed in the middle for me. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
Unfortunate words follow, but management can learn and improve for everyone's benefit. 
I want to believe the positive reviews, but after last night I don't. 
Firstly, they took about a half hour to even acknowledge our reservation. We realized there must have been something up after the argument between the hostess and manager(owner?). 
Some food was served lukewarm, some was cold. Fish was unimpressive, veal was blah. 
To top it off, they made our entire group of 11 very unhappy by telling us they were out of the chocolate dessert. Turns out everyone in our group hates red velvet cake (which was stale) with a passion. Sorry guys, but you can't run out of chocolate, you just can't. Ever. 
Hey, about the wait and service staff: You guys did well, but got stuck in a bad situation of your employers creation.

text: This place was wonderful with a very homey feeling. The food was great as well! The desserts are absolutely to die for! We will definitely be back!
name: Giulia

text: My family ate at the new location on Charlotte Avenue last week. We got cheese dip, kids drinks for 3, 2 Coke's, 3 kid's meals and two taco meals. The bill was nearly $60 freakin bucks...for basic Mexican food! My 3 tacos were terrible, just hamburger meat and cheese thrown on a soft taco that tasted a little funky. My wife had fajita nachos, and on our way home she became sick at her stomach and we had to stop. On top of that, when we first walked in we all stood there in the entrance for about 5 minutes dodging people coming in and out before a guy acknowledged us. It was not busy. I was quite disappointed in the entire experience, will not go back and highly discourage you from going unless you're desperate. I'm not picky, I give places a chance, but this pretty much blew. If you want a good standard Mexican place, go a half mile down the road to Cinco de Mayo. You'll pay 20% less, be acknowledged, and at least avoid food poisoning. "Bye Felicia."
name: John

text: Try to stop by here everytime I'm at the factory. Great vibe & good coffee. I love that they roast their own coffee on the premises. A little pricey but with it.

text:
We didn't have reservations on a Thursday night and got seated, happily. Waitress and waiters were terrific. One of the dishes came out cold and waitress pleasantly took it back and returned it hot.
The other dishes were great - fish, duck, and shrimp fettuccine. We liked The ambiance and the atmosphere. Definitely recommend this restaurant during a visit to the French Quarter.

text:
I recently met a friend for a late lunch. It is so cool to be at a restaurant that completely case disease. I would've given 3 carat five stars however most of the dishes are either served with seiten or tofu. I'm not a fan of either so it made my pickings slim.

I will definitely visit again but considering that I eat gluten free I won't be able to frequent here.

text:
A decent taco place with yummy drinks, but the tourists are killing me here. This place is just a little bit too packed in a little bit too overrated. I've had better tacos, service, and dining experiences elsewhere. I think the Decor in this place is awesome, the concept is great, and the location is wonderful especially with the outdoor seating. I am not trying to knock this place for what they're doing, because I think they're doing it pretty well. But for a Nashville local these days, it is a challenge to find a great restaurant gem that is not overrun with tourists. This one happens to be overrun with tourists, making it me give it a lower rating. The wait is just unbearable for a taco place. I finally went so I could see what all the fuss was about, but I have had better and cheaper tacos elsewhere I am sorry to say. 

If you're looking for a cool, hip spot and a place to be seen while eating upscale tacos and drinking cocktails, this is definitely a spot to go. If you're a tourist, this is probably a good spot for you. You won't care that you have to wait 2 hours or deal with insanely loud crowds of people. 

If you are local looking for an amazing taco food experience, I would move on and look elsewhere.
name: Anne

text:
Our server Renee was very friendly and courteous!
She greeted us with a smile and right away asked what we would like to drink.
The menu is chock full of traditional diner gems.The prices are very affordable!
The food came out quickly and was delicious!!
Highly recommend it if you are in the area!!

text: This place is hit and miss. Sometimes the food and service is great, sometimes not so much.

Nice little spot, decent portions too. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was fresh and service was quick.

They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Definitely coming back. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..

Also the fountain drinks were $2.30, for what? And lastly they were out of almost all of the desserts. What kind of place is called sweetie pies with out sweet potato pie.

text: I travel a lot and love Cuban food because not just the tastes but the portions you get. But after coming here that has changed. When you spend over $9.00 dollars I expected like most to get a full size to go box but no I received some small little box that wasn't even full. Just about 4 miles from here I frequent a lot for just over 7$ you get atleast 3 times the amount which is normally what you get from most Cuban restaurants. The food was ok can't find fault in that but will not return here.
name: Steve

text:
Dashi Wrap Cafe, Brentwood's newest, restaurant, offers wraps with a definite e Caribbean twist and lots more. My wife and I stopped in there for dinner and it turned out to be s great choice. As a starter, our appetizer was the arepitas-mini corn cakes filled with bits of Gouda cheese plus two uncommon dipping sauces.

Our host from Curacao  prepared our Caribbean-style dinners. Of these, my wife chose the garlic buttered shrimp while my choice was was the charcoal grilled steak with Caribbean salad and a side of Caribbean rice. My grilled steak was served in strips and lay on a bed of Caribbean salad. I believe that this dish is part of the unique cuisine of Curacao, but I'll be sure to ask to ask the owner the next time  we're there. My wife's dinner...an ample portion of perfectly cooked shrimp on abc salad.

The dessert was coconut flan. As it was made without sugar, would the coconut really add a sweet taste? YES!! Every bite was a surge of flavor. It was the stuff that dreams are made of.

Now to rate Dashi Wrap Cafe. Being a little over a month old, was still a work in progress. I really liked the Curacao-style dinner. with the emphasis on vegetables. It got on my will-order-again list, but others will have to decide for themselves. I may return if only for a coconut flan and a cup of Cuban espresso. Four stars for Dashi Wrap Cafe.
name: Oscar

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Also, for a busy night they handled it okay. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text:
This place looks like any other smoothie place with a large menu, and bright colors splattered on the walls. Parking at this location isn't ideal since it's on state street, but it's also not big city parking so it's not too bad. Word around town is that this place is the bees knees, they weren't lying. Offering 2 different sizes, regular and large these treats are a delicious summer treat. As you walk you feel like you are partaking in the Santa Bárbara cult with the same cup everyone has. It's not exactly going to fill you up but it's a good filler item to hold you over. The ingredients seem fresh and they have plenty of add ons (regretted not adding some things). I got the red mango, because I wasn't living my best life it was pretty good. My girlfriend liked the strawberry colada and I thought she was about to drop a little rum in it. I wouldn't be mad if you did that just let me know how it tastes. She loved it the way it came. Take a look at the secret menu. They also offer other things like juices and debt, but stay away from it. 

If you haven't been, consider it jury duty, it's your turn.
name: Alfredo

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was decent, just a little uneven. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Would prob stop in again if nearby. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Right in the heart of downtown Reno, this place has live music, fresh brewed beer and great food. It gets packed, but worth getting there early or waiting.
name: Lewie

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Food was fresh and service was quick. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
As a native Chicagoan craving pizza in Nashville, gotta say this place gets 2 big thumbs up! I'm usually weary of uncharted restaurants claiming to serve Chicago style pizza, but all four of us found 312's to be the most authentic. They use cornmeal on the thin crust just like our favorites at home; all-around delicious pizza.

We ordered a couple salads that came in nice large portions, and the house-made dressings were a delicious touch. You can't go wrong with their Mai Tai either. Service was very friendly; thank you for a great home-away-from-home experience!
name: Lisa

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. We shared dumplings first and those were prob the best thing on the table. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Will be back. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not sure though.
name: User

text:
Interesting place; it has an outdoor play area. Obviously, they have a kids menu and booster seats. There is adequate parking in their lot or on the street most of the time. 

It is an eatery where you order your food and they bring it to your table. There is outside seating and a inside bar area if your nutritional needs are solely liquid. It is bright and airy.  Interestingly, they accommodate Uber food delivery as well as regular take out.

The menu centers around comfort foods and typical libations: mixed drinks, wine, and beers. There are also happy hour specials and combos. Sandwiches are large as are the sides such as fries. 

I had the hot (spicy) sausage sandwich served on a bun and it can come with your choice of toppings. Full dressed guy here. My wife did the smoked pork (prepared in house).  We both went for the fries and they were great. Crispy and shades of golden brown deliciousness. 

The hot sausage is two bun sized patties each about 1/4 to 3/8 inch thick.  Nicely spiced and tender. Not too hot but enough you know this is not a Jimmy Dean breakfast croissant. Likewise, the smoked pork (pulled) is about 8 ounces of smoked goodness topped with their own Cole slaw. 

The ordering and food delivery people are very warm and friendly. The prep time was reasonable for a Saturday lunch and it arrived at the table hot. 

This was our first time here even though we live only about a mile away. No doubt we will be back.

UPDATE

Stopped by this afternoon and sat on the porch with our dog.  Yay, porch is pet friendly. Killing time with a wine and a Parrish Ghost In The Machine draft. Thinking a snack might be appropriate. 

On special is a double Hatch chile cheese burger. Love the peppers native to the Hatch, NM region. Excellent flavor without the overwhelming heat. Just right.

Good freaking grief, way large burger and incredibly good tasting. And the crinkle cut fries were near perfection. Firm, crisp and just the right amount of salt. 

Added an order of muffuletta deviled eggs. I am not a fan of anything muffuletta. Nope.  But these egg were very good. Fully of soft, whipped egg yolk, muffuletta flavor and topped with bacon. I am a new convert. 

Hurry though.  The Hatch season here is short lived.
name: Paul

text: Really nice place. The food and the service are wonderful. We have been here twice and each time the food, the wine, the service were consistently extraordinary.  We will definitely be back.
name: Allan

text:
We have good and bad experience here, the food is good but is depend who your server is, you can have awesome experience or really bad experience, last time we went there there is a new server that Doesn't know anything at all and almost drop our food, the male manager is really nice making sure that we are okay, 
Couple days ago we Order Togo but when we got home our food French toast missing the sauce and cold like been left for long time, and the reason I give 5 star is the awesome male manager, he apologized and ask for our address to send "gold card" and couple minutes later he stop by bring our food and apologize in person. I feel terrible that he need to do that. We always love the place but you can't control how your employee work sometimes. But I believe that place is better because of him. So thank you so much for all the help.
name: Meidy

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
Decided to try out this place on a Friday night. No issues getting a table, large restaurant and can accommodate parties of 5+. It's a BYOB so you can bring your own drinks. 

First impression was that although the restaurant was large it felt slightly awkward that the kitchen was in the middle of the restaurant separating the front of the restaurant and the back. 

Waiter was great and super attentive to water refills and making sure we were satisfied. 

We ordered the following items:

- Vegetable Roti - Flavorful but very watered down 
- Indian Mee Goreng - The best dish, delicious!!
- Shrimp Pad Thai - Good but not the best I've had.
- Curry Chicken w/ Rice - It was good, not great. 

I would have given this place 3 stars but the staff and surprisingly delicious Mee Goreng, I had to add another star. 

Overall, good tasting and great bang for your buck Malaysian spot. Will give it another try sometime in the future.
name: Elliot

text:
This is an east coast restaurant chain in the Philadelphia area. I was reluctant to eat here but was pleasantly surprised by the food. 
I had breakfast at this location and quite enjoyed my meal.
The cheesesteak was decent, it was the breakfast option with scrambled eggs. It came out fresh and piping hot with a side of delectable fries. Honestly I would eat here again just for the fries. 
Food was good, service was friendly and fast.
name: Darla

text: The restaurant is beyond rude!  I went to the restaurant and tried to make a reservation for a special occasion.  I think I spoke with either the manager or the owner.  He very rudely said he could not accommodate 7 people "because they would have to give us a 2nd table but we are not 8 people."  I asked for the one large table I saw in the corner.  Same response.  "That table seats 8 and you are only 7."   Even if they don't take reservations, or don't want to accommodate, there is no need to be rude.  And why would you decline seating because we were 1 less than you wanted in the party.  This place is minutes from my home.  Lots of people rave about the food.  But you are in the customer service business - service and communication should be with a smile and kindness.  I will not patronize this establishment and certainly cannot recommend them if they don't want to seat me.
name: Barrister

text:
Ok Ok Ok. I love thai and was told to come here. When I arrived it was empty as it was the week day evening. I liked. 

Parking: metered street or parking lot a block up. 

Atmosphere: cozy and cool

Service: Our servers Melissa & Lowell were nice and personable. 

Food: I got the autum rolls: Root vegetables carrots , mushrooms, With a sweet chili Ginger mango dipping sauce. Not too bad. For my entree, I ordered Pad Ma Keow which sounds like the cats meow!!! lol ! it's sauteed basil garlic eggplant, carrots and onions. Now I love heat on my food so I opted for thai hot. Wellllll!!! it set my soul on fire and not in a good way!! I was sweating so bad I needed to fan myself with the table napkin!! my nose was running and no amount of water helped! I ordered the cocktail long Thailand ice tea which is the thai ice tea with liquor in it. I couldn't taste any alcohol though.  Well I drank that down too and finally after about 20 minutes the heat let up and I could concentrate.  omg! Be very careful when choosing the heat level. Melissa was gracious enough to bring me a mild sauce out as I could not taste the food because the heat level took that away. I dug out the veggies and put them on another plate. The heat was so intense,  it had set into the veggies and I could still taste it after I poured the mild sauce over the veggies and rice. I could taste the meal now and it wasn't bad.  

Overall my experience was good. I will be back to try something different.  Note to self: never get thai heat so I can eat.

Enjoy!
name: Delvia

text: Easily one of my favorite restaurants in the area! Terrain has such a unique atmosphere. Their menu is very diverse and I honestly couldn't choose what to get. The staff at Terrain are super nice and welcoming, and made my experience that much better. It's also BYOB, so you can't beat that. Highly recommend!
name: Dean

text: It's always difficult for me to decide if where I want to dine out.   I must say that I am overly excited that I decided on 1764 Public House!  We were seated immediately when we arrived.   Our waiter recommended his favorites on the menu which just happens to be what my wife and I was intrigued of.  Everything was delicious other than needing a hint of salt.   This will be my go to spot in the CWE from now on!
name: Walter

text: Rib tips are amazing, I love the sliders, and don't forget the macaroni and chips!! The bartenders name is Nat and she is fabulous at what she does and always does it with a smile on her face! We come here because the chill vibe! And of course Nat!!
name: Amanda

text: A great local option Bellevue. Been coming here for several years. Always pleased with the experience. It isn't fast food, so when they are really busy, you may have a slightly longer wait...but worth it for good food. The grits are the best in town!
name: Jeremy

text: Yum! As a carnivore, I wasn't sure what to expect... I loved it all! The atmosphere was so relaxed and welcoming. We ordered the pizza, toasted ravs, and French fries. They were all delicious!! The vegan cheese on the pizza was truly impressive and delicious! I'll be back!

text: I ordered two dishes for delivery. The garlic chicken was so bad that I had to throw it away. The Phad Kra Pao was atleast eatable. The food is bad, and its a waste of money.

text: I was very impressed with this place!!  We are from LA in town for four days and we could not ask for a great dinner. Everything we ate was soooo good plus service was excellent. You cannot go wrong with whatever you order.

text: Great service by Monica. Wonderful personality. She really connects with all guests at the table making it really a wonderful dine-in service experience. The table side guacamole and salsa was an oral fantasy. To die for!! Monica recommenced it a specific way and that's the way we got it. That's the way we like it.

text:
I ordered pizza from here last night. When I went in to pay for and pick up my pies the young lady at the counter asked me if I had already paid. I said no, to which she replied "sorry it was just shift change so I wasn't sure". Another customer jokingly commented that I should have said I already paid and gotten a free pizza. I said that I was just being honest. I then paid $39.14 for my pizza by credit card. Today I get a phone call from an extremely rude man who said he was calling from Tony's pizza and that I had picked up my pies with out paying. I relayed the story of the night before to him. He proceeded to tell me that I didn't owe $39 but $42 and that I wouldn't be getting so defensive if I had actually paid for it. I asked to speak to the owner who was apparently standing there during this conversation. And finally said it must be a miss understanding. Well to make sure there is no misunderstanding on my part I will post a pic of the receipt at the end of this post. Also he then tried to tell me that I ordered the same exact order today and not yesterday and that it was a man who called. 
Well, sir...
1. It's not my fault if your employees do not know how much to charge the customer, I don't work there, how am I supposed to know what I owe. I pay what the clerk tells me to pay.
2. Umm, yes, I am getting defensive, you just called and accused me of stealing and did not accept my story that I paid even after I told you that I have the receipt to prove it. 
3. How as a business owner do you think it is ok to ever call a client and accuse them of anything.
4. As a business owner how could you stand next to your employee and allow him to speak to a client in such an unprofessional manner.
5. The number I called from and that they called me back in is my cell and I can assure you no one else called from it and ordered the same order the very next day and then proceeded not to pay.
So you either have a problem with your system or a problem with your staff being completely incompetent. Again NOT the customers problem.

From just glancing at other reviews I can see that this is a on going occurrence at this place. As I am not the only one having been accused of stealing something that they did not. Maybe you should take a long hard look the people you employee so you don't loose anymore customers.
name: Dena

text: This is the gem of the downtown Boise dining scene.  The service, ambiance and food are excellent!  If you are visiting Boise and miss out on the Beignets for dessert, then you have missed one of the best culinary treats in the Nation!  Every time we have people visit they always look forward to to going to Bittercreek.  It's great food at a reasonable price!

The bread was amazing and you can dip it in olive oil at the table.  They also have craft beer and a wide selection of wine.

text: First things first, newer place so I'm considering this when doing my review. Went during lunch time and there was quite a line. Many people didn't know exactly what they wanted so it took even more time. There were two staff present serving which wasn't enough even for a small crowd. Many different selections available. I'm not too familiar with Indian food so of course my review is solely based on flavor and just overall if the food was good. I chose a quinoa bowl with chicken and tikka masala topped with kuchumba salad. It was very tasty, but the bowl provided felt a bit empty. Imho I believe they could've added more of the base (quinoa) for it to be more filling. They did an excellent job with explaining what food and sauce was what an measurement of spiciness (all with patience and a smile). Nonetheless, two important suggestions to keep people coming particularly since it will become a high trafficked area during weekday lunch hour - expand food serving area and add additional staff. In addition, there is plenty of seating in different areas with a pretty updated and modern furniture if anyone to dine.

text:
A unique (and filling!) restaurant that I've heard about but not experienced until this week.

I went at a quiet time between the normal meal times.  Understand that the dinner rush can be quite busy and that you may experience a wait.  That being said, I walked in and was seated immediately.

The seafood can be ordered a la carte (by weight), in pre-set combinations, or in a custom combination of your choosing.  After choosing your seafood, you choose a spice flavoring (I went with the combination, aka "Juicy") and heat level.  Potatoes, corn and sausage can be added depending on the dinner you choose.

The order is assembled, cooked (steamed) and brought to your table in a plastic bag that is full of the steam from the cooking process.  It is cut open and placed on a platter, and then, it's time to dig in!

The food was filling and I was surprised because I thought I was going to need more food and instead I wasn't able to finish my order!  My shrimp and mussels were cooked perfectly.  This is a good thing because many restaurants do overcook the shrimp.  The snow crab, on the other hand, still had some cool spots on several legs.

The service was friendly and the manager greeting us was a nice gesture that made us feel appreciated.  We will return, as I skipped the Dungeness crab and want to try it on our next visit.  One last note, they have an application in for a liquor license but it was not approved as of our visit a few days ago.

You order at the counter, get a number and place it on your table. We got the dozen chargrilled oysters, seafood gumbo, and jambalaya.

Food came out in less then 10 minutes. Verdict?

1. Chargrilled oysters- 4 stars, flavor was delish but a bit overcooked, crusty, and made it hard to eat with the bread.

2. Jambalaya- 5 stars, had sausages and great flavor

3. Gumbo- 3 stars. Flavors weren't all there for me and tasted like it came from a can.

Hoping better results at the original location. 

We also ordered a Moscow mule, and top shelf Long island at the bar ($22 for the drinks), a bit pricey but made great pregame for the slot machinessss

text:
Idk where to even start. I called initially to try and make some special arrangements for my birthday, but I was told there was "no manager or assistant manager on duty". There were no gloves or bibs. After I asked the hostess said they "ran out". Our server had just started that day, but besides that it's annoying because the servers type your order into, essentially a phone. So if you say it and it doesn't go in that phone more than likely, it won't come to you. We ordered a pound of snow crab legs each, two orders of garlic butter noodles, a side of rice, and corn and potatoes. Only three out of four crab legs came out, and were cold. We had to sit around and wait for another 10 minutes while they brought out the last person's plate. We then were told that there will be nothing done for the inconvenience. The last play of crab legs they came out were cold as well! When I asked the server what happened to our garlic noodles, he acted like he didn't even know what I was talking about. So I re-ordered the noodles and tried to keep calm. Another ten minutes go past and I remind the young man (Pierre was his name) of the Noodles. once again, he looks unaware of me ordering the noodles. Please keep in mind these garlic noodles are on the SIDE DISH menu. So why are they taking so long? I finally said it's ok I didn't want the noodles anymore (at this point we were done eating). Pierre rushes into the kitchen and comes out with two plates of garlic noodles and tries to put them on the table. I said no thank you we said we don't want them anymore. The server, Pierre, then tells me "YOURE GOING TO HAVE TO PAY FOR THEM EITHER WAY, YOU MIGHT AS WELL BOX THEM UP" 



I'm sure y'all can imagine I wanted to lose it on that server. Another server overheard and apologized for it being his first day and said of course they'll take the noodles off. There was nothing to do but get a business card and contact the manager or corporate later. In the end, I'll never eat there again.
name: Donna

text:
This place was recommended by a friend and well worth the drive for us. Versatile and inviting describes both the atmosphere and menu. We went for a brunch date, but this place seems well suited for catching up with friends, a working lunch or even dining alone with a laptop or good book. Everything on the menu looked so good we had a difficult time deciding.  Ultimately we ordered the mocha coffee (a cup the size of a soup bowl), the chimichurri steak and egg bowl with sourdough bread and the herb roasted chicken panini (I added chili mango chutney) and a side of roasted potato wedges with homemade ketchup.  

Rarely do I say everything was perfect,  but this time it was. Everything we ordered came out promptly and tasted amazing. I hate sandwiches, but the paninis sounded so good I had to order one, and I'm so glad I did! 

The customer service was second to none. The  staff was friendly and attentive (and very patient as we sat and talked instead of ordering). 

We will definitely be back!!

text: SO. DELICIOUS. Do yourself a favor and check out Addis, and try some fare that you typically cannot find in New Orleans. I'm vegetarian with gluten restrictions but my boyfriend is not--and Addis offers something for both of us, with incredibly low cost per plate for such great food. The Veggie Combo is yummy and the Red Lentils are rich and AMAZING, wish I could make them at home. Ethiopian flat bread is naturally gluten-free, made with teff flour, so you are good to go if you are GF. Owners/operators a very welcoming, the chef and the son of the owner came out to speak with us and the table next to ours to ask for thoughts and to share some of the ingredients/spices they use. The food took a little longer than expected to come out but was worth the wait, and the wait may have just been the time we were there. We'll be back to eat for sure!

text: We went to this place because of its great reviews and historical location. The atmosphere is great. Subdued lighting, chandeliers, and tasteful decor. The food is another story. The food is mediocre at best and the portions are too small for even women with small appetites. I ordered the butternut squash pasta, which consisted of 3 noodles (no exaggeration), this greasy sour cream tasting butter sauce, shavings of kale, and 5 tiny pieces of squash ($17 and barely a side dish; rating 3/10). Their beer seems reasonably priced ($5-6) but is served in a half pint glass, which they fail to mention. I realize that this place is going for the fancy upscale vibe, but at least call it what it is....small plates, so people realize they will have to buy at least 2 to make a meal. Of note, my sister said her pasta, some pesto and pork thing, was "okay" so maybe some of their dishes are mediocre. However, I wouldn't pay $17 for 3 mediocre noodles. I gave them 2 stars for the nice atmosphere and staff.
name: Danielle

text: Hands down the best place in Carrollwood to drink wine and eat Tapas. They have excellent service, wine specials and tasty food. Must try!!
name: Jason

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: Cute little cafe with excellent espresso & chai tea.  The raspberry lemon scone was also delish!
name: Bess

text: Phenomenal!! The service was great, the playlist was even better and the food was awesome!! We had items off the $5 happy hour menu and were extremely impressed! Highly recommend!
name: Cayla

text: Our first time here...we left full and happy! The wings are fantastic, buffalo cauliflower was amazing, French dip was so tender and delicious. We treated ourselves to some specialty drinks and they were well made. We were also happy with the service. We will be back soon!
name: Donna

text:
We signed up for a pub crawl. Which was more just a wrist band that allowed us discounts on certain drinks at specific bars. The Valentine was one of those bars, after verifying with the bartender that the wrist band did give us the discount, I thought we were all set. Instead at the end of the night when my bill was nice and big, the bartender called the manager over to enter the discount code. 

Well the manager came over and told me I was wrong. The discount code only works for drinks on the 3rd floor of The Valentine. I told him I We had no idea, and that the bartenders have been saying all night that we were good to go. Well the manager didn't care, instead he started calling me a "fu*king idiot" then threatened me and threatened to throw me out of the bar. Then laughed when I said I was giving a bad review. 

Listen I totally understand if you can only honor the discount on specific levels of the bar. It's kind of silly but whatever. But for the Manager to act the way he did, to make threats and to use such disrespectful language... that's just nuts
name: Anthony

text: Incredible. We had a group of four and did the chef's tasting menu. Every single dish was amazing. Ever.Single.One. I have also been to happy hour a few times which i also recommend. Get the Turkish hummus. Trust.
name: Shannon

text: Really neat spot for foodies or people needing something to eat. They literally have everything imaginable in this place. I took a couple people here and we split up and then combined our food harvest. This is the best way to try many places all at once and it was a fun and good experience.
name: Joe

text:
Delicious!!!!!! We went here the other night with a small group for an anniversary dinner. All of the staff was great! No one acted irritated that we had a larger group. And they were all very attentive. Everything was delicious too! The bread you get prior to your meal was awesome and it has this oil dip that has this slight spicy bite to it and it's just ridiculously good. I ordered a burger and fries and the fries were awesome. And the burger was unique which was nice! It had a flavor I've never had on a burger. Loved every bite of my meal. 
The bathrooms were also very very clean. This is probably too much information but I ended up vomiting during my time here (happens a lot to me...don't worry it WASN'T food poisoning lol) but anyways I HAATEE throwing up in public cuz it's so gross as it is and nothing makes it worse than a super dirty toilet or floor. But it was soooo clean so it made it much easier and less terrible lol. 
Anyways overall it was great. Loved it all. I told my husband I want to eat there on our anniversary.
name: Heather

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: Just moved to Tampa from California and I'm on the hunt to find my favorite food spot. Everything I tried here was AMAZING. I tried ramen once before this and it wasn't my  favorite, but Ichicoro completely changed my mind! Absolutely delicious! Best vibes!
name: Tori

text:
Love the bachata music and diverse employees. Makes me feel at home while also enjoying delicious vegan food. The prices are pretty cheap compared to other vegan places nearby. 

P.S their creamy vegan dip is spicy but nutty. Must try!
name: Karen

text: The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Great dining environment, fancy decoration, but the food is so so, it's not bad but not that good. especially when it comes to the price. I don't get it why yelp have 4 and half star. We paid nearly $20 for each person and i'm not even full...
name: Yingjie

text: Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Glad we tried it. Food was good and came out fast. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The wait felt longer than it should have. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Just not for me. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Not sure though.
name: User

text: I personally prefer Moe's to Chipotle across the street by a fair margin. They have more options for meats, toppings, and tortilla styles, and seem to be just a little cheaper. The also have a great salsa bar- the tomatillo salsa is my fave! I'm a big fan of the homewrecker burrito, reasonable, large and guac is included. Supposedly they are moving across the street next to Meijer soon.
name: Paul

text: Outstanding food and service period!  Eat here if you can or you'll miss out on a great dining experience.
name: Kenya

text: Very good food. Prompt service and good atmosphere. Awesome location also.
name: Mike

text:
My server, Langston, was wonderful. 5/5 for him. 

I decided to eat here because it is a sit-down, reasonably priced, restaurant right on Bourbon. It was slow at noon on a Tuesday and I got a table right away. There were a few other people in the restaurant.

I had the shrimp platter and the shrimp was perfectly seasoned and cooked. The hushpuppies were overdone and the coleslaw tasted like it had been scooped out of a mayo jar and sat out in the Louisiana sun for an hour. 0/5 for the slaw.
name: Micah

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Also, the sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something i'm still thinking about two days later. So yeah, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated bc that happens a lot. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart.
name: User

text: One of the best hidden gems in Nashville. Get the Bourbon Street Chicken and corn stew on the side!
name: Brendan

text: Delicious Korean eatery - set up where you can make your own combo (plates, bowls, soups with bone broth) or select one of theirs. Warning - Korean BBQ is hooooot! Went with the family and a few got that bowl and their mouths were on fire. I kindly asked the cashier is a bowl could be remade because it was too hot for my sister and she was so kind and said sure! Very friendly staff. I enjoyed the ahi tuna bowl, roasted beats, roasted sweet potatoes, and quinoa salad. It was nice to try something new! Would recommend and we will definitely be back!
name: Kayla

text: Jimmy sand bar was such a great place to watch the sunset and party afterwards. We had a great time here and dance all night long. I would recommend this place and can't wait to come back here again. The happy hour and  good were also great too.
name: Ray

text:
Cool vibe with artwork and slogans all over the place. The bar area has a few TVs to keep you interested. The bartender was very nice and helpful. 

Started with the cup of gumbo. It had a few chunks of meat and great flavor but that was the extent of it. Overall, I'd say it's a good option for an appetizer. 

For the entree, I went with the jambalaya (which I was very excited for) but ended up disappointed. It's a huge dish, very filling. When the food came it was compacted into the bowl like it had been sitting for awhile and had zero flavor, in addition, it was dry as well. After hearing such great reviews about this place, I was very disappointed.
name: Shawn

text: Certainly not the worst of barbecue have ever had but nothing to write home about. Perhaps go to Pappys instead of this place.
name: Eric

text: Tried this in Vancouver and compare to there, the menu is a lot smaller. The soup taste the same but the meat is lacking as in they don't put as much. Over all it is still worth to go eat as the soup and noodle is top notch. Still wish there was more side like they had in Vancouver.
name: Nathanael

text: Enjoying a outstanding Santa Barbara Style dog, highly recommend! Many tasty styles on the menu, try them all.
name: David

text: Wouldn't allow a certified service dog into a Bar. This dog is trained and licensed to serve a disability and we were turned away. If I could give negative stars I would.
name: Lila

text: Decided to just go in and check out the menu.  We are visiting from Texas and this was not a place I had on my list of places to eat.  I sure am glad we came across this place.  The servers are very friendly and they have a nice variety of dishes on their menu .  I had a Greek turkey burger that was amazing.  My daughter had a 1/2 pound bacon cheeseburger she had to share with her sister. They both said the fries were the best fries they ever had.  My wife had a chicken curry wrap which was so flavorful.  We did not have room for desert.  How much did we like it?  We are planning in returning tomorrow.
name: Ramiro

text: Great local establishment. Friendly, welcoming, and generous owners. Men's bathroom have baby changing tables
name: Particular

text:
This is probably my favorite brunch spot in St. Louis. Absolutely everything intrigues me on the menu. We started off with the buttermilk biscuits which was amazing! The ricotta and honey were so creamy together. I had the classic breakfast with poached eggs and everything tasted so fresh. My friend had the roasted salmon and she said it was one of the best things she has had. 

The restaurant is tucked inside a garden and market which makes it fun to walk around and more of an experience. My favorite part was the cat that roamed around the tables
I can't wait to go back for my birthday brunch :)
name: Angelina

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Price felt a touch high for what it was. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Pretty happy with it overall. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: I come to Boise frequently for work and I stop into A Tavola for coffee or lunch every time. I was there for breakfast this week and was surprised and very disappointed in my experience. I am unfortunately allergic to eggs which makes breakfast out difficult. I found there to be very few options for me here and when's I inquired if I might order a scramble but throw a few potatoes in place of the eggs I was met with no cooperation and a lot of attitude. I attempted to put together some sort of breakfast piecing together a few "sides" in attempt to create a meal which cost far more than an actual entree but was served without any of the care or aesthetic. I was being hosted there by individuals for a business meeting and the experience was quite uncomfortable. My hosts were appalled by the experience as well. I'll make a point to never plan breakfast there again.
name: Joni

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. It was crowded but still moved along. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. For a busy night they handled it okay. Price felt a touch high for what it was. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: For the price I expected a little more care. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It was crowded but still moved along. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
Places like these tucked away on a row that has artists and creatives to once you can see was pretty industrial brings a new life to the other side of Berry Hill.  I like the place because it has an identity. I'm still blown away by how coffee shops can great a niche buzz if they do it correctly and this one does.  Maybe because it's also a bar and a cafe as well.  They have a welcoming vibe and their food is actually well made.

I can say that they had a spot on mocha.  The chocolate was dark, slightly bitter and the milk didn't make the drink overly heavy.  It's meant so you can taste the espresso with the hints of chocolate.  I'll be back because there's a lot more to explore here or the one in East Nashville.  Well done and Stay Golden.
name: Mike

text: Stopped in for a few slices during lunchtime.  Closest thing to New York style pizza I've had since moving to Florida.  Super friendly and clean. Def will be back!
name: Punit

text: Very Good! I had the Matcha Chocolate Truffle Crepe cone. It is a nice little dessert for any day. The environment is cute and casual, with an order-styled counter at the front. The idea is cute but a little pricey for the amount of food. Very unique combinations you will not see anywhere else though!
name: Miranda

text: What an incredible meal!!! The restaurant is quaint but awesome atmosphere! The service was outstanding & the dinner was the best we had on vacation! Surf & turf delicious!!
name: Sherry

text: I've been coming here for years.... it taste like it should be, it's reliable and the price is good. I usually get general tso chicken and lo mein. I enjoy it.
name: Zahir

text: Excellent service.  Scallops entree to die for.  Olive appetizer scrumptious.  They know how to make great vodka martinis.  Coffee, cappuccino, and latte just right.  We'll be back.
name: Dusan

text:
This is a frequently visited place I go for lunch in downtown Lansdale.  I have always dined in but you can do take out.

The food is great!

On my Thursday December 19, 2019. I enjoyed the Burrito Buraccho and my wife had the El Pastor tacos. Another great meal!
name: John

text: Amazing hole-in-the wall bbq & seafood joint/stationary food truck on the side of the road just outside Tampa.  This is truly one of the hidden gems in all of the Bay Area.  The pulled pork is moist with few fatty parts.  But the best part is the bbq sauce.  I can't even describe it, you just have to try it to know.  All of their seafood is fresh and cooked to order so it's best to call it in ahead of time or plan to wait a few.  I'd recommend this joint for any bbq lovers out there.
name: Charlie

text: I came here for the first time tonight and I ordered a burger that came on an English muffin and I was not aware because the menu did not reflect this. I did not eat this burger because it was not good and my waiter did nothing to remedy it and I was still charged for a sandwich I took one bite out of. The way this was handled was unacceptable and inappropriate. I will never come back unless this establishment plans on reimbursing me for the burger I did not eat.
name: Emily

text: Only the Temple Roll stood out, with the delicious seared white tuna on the top. We had 2 other rolls that were very ordinary, something with lobster salad and another that was so forgettable, I don't remember the name. There were some strange combinations, such as cheese on sushi, that did not appeal to any of us. Yes it was packed, but I'm not sure why.
name: Lisa

text: I am a big fan of Turning Point restaurants. This was my least favorite trip and probably my only trip to this location. I called ahead as the other locations infrequent are usually very busy- even on weekdays like this was. When we checked in we were seated right away which was very nice. Our party was originally 4 people. The waitress (who never told us her name) took our drink order (2/4 of us) and then returned when the third person arrived to take theirs. We then learned our fourth wasn't coming but we didn't see her again for another 20 minutes to be able to tell her. Food took a very long time to come out- other tables got their food very quickly. The meal was good (as expected) but the coffee was burnt. The menus were in need of a wipe. When she came back to clear plates (after not seeing her since she took our order) she dropped off the check and walked away. Very unfortunate as it's location is equidistant from most of our friend group and would be convenient for us.
name: M

text:
Ummmm who knew garlic and butter belonged on steak cut fries! DO IT! Order fries, order all the freaking fries. I've never had French fries with butter, and man- I've been missing out. But gArlic butter fries, I can't imagine eating fries plain anymore. 

We ordered the bbq bacon burger and a drink. It comes with garlic butter fries. You walk in and order your meal, find a seat and they bring your food to the table . The food cane quickly, the staff is friendly, and the food is good.

Clean location, changing table in the bathroom which is amazing. Little games in the back for kids and a lot of seating options. 

I'd go back for a quick and filling bite
name: Taryn

text: Love this place. So much going on around the place, yet the bartender and manager made us feel like we were the only one's there. Both shared about their history in NOLA, graciously answered some questions that I am sure they hear all of the time, and taught us how to eat our Muffuletta (with the spicy dressing). The line for the Central Grocery & Deli - Home of the Original Muffuletta was so long that we passed on that option. I am so glad that we did. Our sandwich was bomb, the service was beautiful, and the place was perfectly located for a nice break from our walk of the Quarter. When I'm back in NOLA, this will be my first foodie stop.
name: Shawnti

text: Everything so far that I've ordered off the menu is fantastic!  The spaghetti and meatballs is yummy!  I finally tried cheesecake factory for the first time a few months back.  Now I order here quite a bit.  I'm actually sitting in the parking lot at meadow wood mall at the moment while my fiance is grabbing us take out lol breaded chicken parmesan with mashed potatoes and green beans and I got the crab spinach dip for the first time.  For dessert Linda's chocolate fudge cake!  Can't wait to eat!!  Always satisfies my hunger!
name: Samantha

text:
Rooster was good!

4/5

Sausage was a tad thick and more chewy than I like.
Food could've been hotter.

Think it was done but server didn't bring it as soon as it was done. So it kind of cooled off.

Potatoes was good, eggs was good, bacon was good, would ask for double bacon next time instead of sausage.

French toast was ok at best..

Friendly service, clean restaurant, good prices..would return to eat there again.
name: michael

text:
Mary Browns beats Popeyes every time. While my go-to is Big Mary with taters/dressing/gravy..there's no wrong answer.
Equally as important is the incredibly friendly service I've received every single time. I've seen previous posts that said otherwise. Can't imagine the same experience with the gentleman who has served me (possibly the owner).
Having arrived apologetically 5 min before closing time I was greeted with appreciation vs contempt. Incredible customer service.
name: Deann

text:
