text: The atmosphere is great. We all enjoyed our food and drinks. The service was really good. Fantastic margaritas!
name: Suzanna

text:
I went with a group of 6 on a Sunday night after dinner. It wasn't too crowded and we were seated right away. The ambiance is very kawaii- chic with lots of detailed decor. We ordered the Combo B which came with two of the bowls and the mango pancakes. We also ordered a side of mango mochi. The bowls come with a mango ice cream ( or sorbet?) which were very refreshing and delicious, and of course generously packed with mango cubes. The rice balls in one of the bowls were the star of the night, having a really nice chewy consistency. The mango pancakes were also very tasty, filled with a light cream that wasn't overly sweet, on top of a slice of mango, wrapped in a sort of sweet skin. The mango mochi was better than I expected. The mochi was very soft compared to other types of mochi I've tried, and each were filled with a cube of mango. It was such a unique combination of textures to me that worked well together! 

Our main takeaway from the night was that every dessert dish has FRESH mango in it. My friends kept raving about how sweet and juicy the mangoes were!!! Definitely enjoyed our experience and will be back!
name: Christina

text:
Really an excellent breakfast sandwich.

I ordered the Hershel walker. It came with fall apart pastrami, juicy and cheesy eggs, and a massive portion size.

I very much enjoyed this sandwich.
name: Jack

text:
Quite possibly the worst service I've ever had, surly, slow and sloppy. I had to wait 10 minutes to get a menu, the food was overly oily and slid off my plate. Instead of comping the meal, the staff joked about it, and kept repeating the story to more staff, lame. 

A pathetic level of indifference to the experience of the paying customer. Lost a customer for life because of poor hiring and training of staff
name: Ric

text: STRONGLY recommend that you go dine at Gris Gris!!  Visited last evening and the Whole Experience was fabulous.  I had the oyster BLT OMG ,  thought it couldn't get better and then my Pork Chop is served and (pork when cut into should glisten) oh, it was my favorite pork I've ever eaten at a restaurant. Service was great very friendly atmosphere. It is a Fun, Very New Orleans enjoy your meal experience.
name: Joan

text: I love this place so much!  They have great lunch specials, I never leave hungry.  I've gotten take-out also, very good!  The best sushi I've had in Tampa for sure.
name: Kaitlyn

text: Fresh and flavorful ingredients, the NOLA bowl at with crawfish at Aloha Lei was a perfect lunch.  A frozen espresso bean  drink from Coast Roast to wash it down was a perfect accompaniment.
name: Roger

text: The beer cheese was superb! Lots of German food and beer to choose from, I highly recommend giving Prost a shot!
name: Matthew

text: I don't usually write reviews for chain restaurants, however, the staff here definitely deserve it. I sat at the bar solo and Norman was such an awesome bartender. He was sweet and welcoming and we had great conversation! I ordered too much food and he and the manager made sure to take care of the things I couldn't eat (my eyes are bigger than my stomach!). Everyone from the hostesses, waiters and the manager were all so kind and took extra special care of me. I'll definitely be back next time I come to New Orleans!
name: K

text: Tried Dave's Dogs after seeing a review in the AAA Westways magazine.  There was a steady flow of people into the tiny restaurant we ordered 3 dogs: Western, Santa Barbara & Chilli Cheese dogs with a side of Onion Rings.  Everything was very good & reasonably priced - will have to return to try some of the other ones which also sounded interesting!
name: Lennie

text:
Came here for dinner yesterday evening with a few friends. When we came in, we inquired about the 1 hour parking rule that was in the parking garage across the street. The waitress did not know how to extend that time, and had to ask someone for help. When it was time to put in the parking information to extend the time, it was a struggle for them. 

The waitress was quick to find us a seat and take our drink order. She brought over chips and salsa right away. We then ordered our food in a timely manner, and there were some specific requests with a couple of the entrees (one of them being mine!). The food did not take too long, and my entree (with one of the special orders) came out correctly, but the friend who ordered a fajita salad with no cheese received a salad with cheese all throughout it. The waitress was efficient and did get the salad fixed, this time without cheese, right away.

Food was subpar. I had the trio tacos and they were pretty stuffed with steak and toppings. Flavor was decent. Two friends had the fish tacos which were described as "eh". The friend with the fajita salad said it was pretty good, and it came in a big tortilla shell bowl.

The visit was a solid 3 stars at this point, and then it was a LONG waiting game for our check. There were only 2 or 3 other tables present, but no waitress. She was just taking her jolly old time, wandering around behind the counter. It was nearly impossible to get her attention, and really was in no rush to bring us our check. We had to get up and approach the bar to pay.

I'm not saying that I would never return, but I would make sure that I had time in my schedule - even if I was just ordering take out. (There was a young college student standing around for at least 10 minutes just trying to get the waitress's attention to get his order that he had already placed.)
name: Savannah

text:
3rd indian buffet this week, and I've not visited here in a while. Definitely better than I remembered. Came for lunch, almost immediately after it opened, so the buffet was piping hot and fresh. The place gets busy quickly, but there is so much food to go around. First thing I noticed were the extensive vegetarian options. The chana masala is the freshest and coolest of the buffets nearby, on a giant warmed pan to the left of the buffet. The palak paneer was puréed, with the paneer melting in my mouth and so lightly flavored, it was perfect.

The chicken tikka masala was a great texture, and more cream than tomato. The show stoppers of the meal were the goat curry, vegetable rice, and chana masala. The goat curry was thick and flavorful, with fatty pieces of meat, while the vegetable imparted a smokey, lightly oniony flavor with a really great aftertaste that was great with everything on the plate. Waiters slink on the sidelines at all times and leave the water on the table, really efficient and quick to grab the plates. 

Come for the vegetarian sides, palak, and chana masala and samosas. Their mango lassi and drinks are really great, and they have desserts and salad as well!
name: Gloria

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. You can tell they care about customer experience here. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: I really enjoyed my experience at the new CPK. I had a brand new waiter named Jon that did a great job! I like the atmosphere, but it's slightly inconvenient for the waiters to have their bar in the middle of the mall. Anyway, I ordered strawberry lemonade and a Hawaiian pizza. I plan on having several more meals here!
name: Courtney

text:
I'm done with this place. The service is horrible. A few months ago I went to eat here and sat at the bar. The waitress ignored me for several minutes. I ordered a cup of coffee from one of the other waiters behind the bar and waited and waited. Then a couple came in and sat down after me and the waitress that was Ignoring me took their order right away. I waited a few more minutes for a cup of coffee that never came and the waitress continued to ignore me. So I got up and left. 
 I decided to give them another chance today and that was a mistake. I walked in today and there's no room at the bar so I waited for a table. A couple came in well  after me and were seated before me. When I asked the hostess why, she said it was because they had two  people in their party. I will never go back
name: David

text: Doesn't even deserve 1 star. This place needs to close down. I've given it a few chances the past year and literally every time, the entire staff acts like I'm the biggest inconvenience. They're always "out of everything" and extremely rude. I just left last time because of how dirty and rude they were yet again
name: John

text: The guys up front are extremely rude and condescending. It was dirty, musty, and very poorly upkept. I would NEVER return to such a terrible place.
name: Wes

text: Cool atmosphere. Food was really good, hot, and quick. Our server was excellent. Beer was great. Would recommend!
name: Rachel

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: We stopped here on the recommendation of a friend who lives in the area.  Had the Charbroiled Oysters, crawfish beignets and shrimp poboys.  The poboys were ok, nothing special.   Crawfish beignets were good but had a little too much sweet Chile sauce on the plate.  Charbroiled Oysters were great!
name: Jeanna

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Overall, a strong experience. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. For the price I expected more than this. For a busy night they handled it okay. The food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Idk, it looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: We have enjoyed two great meals at Argento's. Their marinara sauce is fabulous! I would've given it a 5 star except our waiter this last time was a bit rude and distracted. We will continue to frequent this restaurant and hope for a different waiter! The Italian pastry is incredible too!
name: Cathy

text: I brought my siblings in to experience a phenomenal burger and the bomb cajun fries... and was a little disappointed. Our order got pretty messed up. Cajun fries were not made cajun, when I went back and asked to have them remade he just handed me seasoning to put on top instead of re-tossing the fries. I also needed to go back up to repeat our shake order to the same gentleman three times. I remained understanding, but the restaurant was not busy. Burgers, however, were made well and we loved them. We also received extra shakes after we got ours... It seems that the location may need time to find their flow with teamwork. I'll come back in awhile and try again!
name: Alayna

text: Decided to try this restaurant while visiting the area.  The two stars are because the staff is lovely.  They were all very friendly and helpful.  The food is not very good.  We had the chili rellenos which were not at all good.  They were very doughy and the cheese was subpar.  Their speciality, carne seca was devoid of any flavor.    We were all very disappointed in the food and will not be returning.
name: Ellen

text: Cheers to you, Rebel Hill. All the beers I tried were excellent, if not damn well phenomenal. Excellent variety, great sours and awesome atmosphere. Highly recommend the Eaten Alive Raspberry Sour or Overslept Oat IPA if it's on tap. You can bring food in from other restaurants, outdoor seating and great bar seating. Get on this place, it's excellent!
name: Courtney

text: Love everything about this place. The food are delicious, although we haven't tried their frozen custard yet but I am sure that it will be delicious as well. Any burgers are delicious, especially if you add a little of their Freddy's sauce. The staff are always fast, efficient and friendly. We've been here plenty of times and will come back often for a quick yummy food.
name: Jill

text: Second time eating here. First time leaving a review. It's great had the Sonoran dog and a taco. Will be back again when I'm in the area
name: George

text: Called the manager yesterday because they messed up my wife's order and said they're the frozen lemonade was down and they only had chilled. He asked me my name and I gave him my wife's, but when my wife went to get the order again she was advised there was no record of her in the book and she needed to show the receipt as proof in order to be compensated when he never mentioned that over the phone. They have to get it together. All they say I'm sorry smh.
name: Jay

text: The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was crowded but still moved along. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Will be back. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: I was so pleased when Oliver's came to montecito. Santa Barbara was long overdue for a plant-based restaurant that's both chic and delicious. This is by far my favorite spot go bring friends- plant based or not. Try the jacksfruit tacos and apple crumble.
name: Christina

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. It was crowded but still moved along. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. It was decent, just a little uneven.
name: User

text: Came here today to try this new place in the old Dairy Queen.  The place looks great. It was very clean and inviting inside.  Music gave it a nice comfortable vibe.   Using a deck of cards for orders was a neat idea instead of calling out numbers or names.  Plenty of seating.  Management was very friendly and helpful.  I had their Super Hero Italian sub. It was very good and fresh.   Bread baked fresh daily.  They have tons of oven baked subs to choose from, and next time I will try the tator tots as my side.  Sandwiches can be ordered cold also.  The drive-thru also makes this a very convenient place for lunch.  I will be back and often.   Excited to have a new place in the area to try.
name: Diann

text: Nice atmosphere. Small but good food. Waitress Wendy was cordial and very good. Crepes are especially nice. Highly recommended. French toast was amazing. Read the history. It's enlightening. 3rd floor is haunted.
name: Earle

text: I really liked the environment and the food! Easy parking and ordering was quick and easy. They have a good variety of options, including tofu for the vegans/vegetarians. They have tacos and noodles as well as lunch plates. The place is clean and super cute! The bring colors really brighten up the concrete building itself. I will definitely be coming again to try something new. I tried the BBQ chicken plate with macaroni salad but those pork tacos were also very alluring. Very excited to have a Hawaiian go-to near me!
name: Ashleigh

text:
Very cool and trendy (at least for me) establishment that's been around since 2015. Local place that seems to be doing things right with a relatively small menu but well executed. Enough options to fulfill even a large party with some interesting twists on classic fare.

We decided to order a couple small plates for appetizers and small is not what I would use to describe these servings. The biscuits and gravy was substantial enough to provide a meal at $10 which was served with a heaping helping of their hash (only available during brunch). We also ordered some mussels which were well executed and devoured by the table $14.

Meals around the table were the southern belle salad $14, the BLT $14, the mill burger $13, and my Kimmelweck $13. All were served with a a side (other than the salad) but all were fairly large. I had half the BLT which was served on some nice soft and perfectly toasted Cuban bread. I then thoroughly enjoyed my half of the Kimmelweck which you can see from the photo, is stacked high. The crispy fried shallots along with the fried green tomato, lemon herb goat cheese and horseradish aioli made for an awesome combination of flavors and textures. Nicely done!

Service was informative, friendly, and well paced. Easily should be added to a regular rotation for anyone in the area. When we return for a visit, we'll definitely be back.
name: Edward

text:
I used to go here all the time when I lived in Tampa and I knew I needed to go since I was in town again - many years later. 

This place is like an old house - redone into a home feeling restaurant. The have porch seating and indoor seating. 

Very tall drinks so no need to worry about having enough to drink which is nice that you don't have to worry about getting a refill of water. 

Our waitress was very friendly and energetic. 

We decided to order the grande rib dinner since I can't eat a ton and we didn't want to bring leftovers since we were traveling. The dinners come with two sides which we got apple sauce and baked beans. I also got a side of corn on the cob. 

It comes out very quick which I remember from eating here in the past since I'm sure it was made earlier in the day in bulk so it's nice to not have to wait long. 

Our waitress brought us extra plates so we can share. There is regular BBQ sauce on the table and hot BBQ. Both delicious!!

I love the ribs being tender but also have crisp ends! Yum. Baked beans go perfectly as well! Prices are good as well. 

When you're done, the server leaves the check and you go to the counter and pay. 

Definitely one of my favorites in Tampa!
name: Mai

text: This place is great! It's so close to my home I cannot believe I just now discovered it. My friend and I sat on the patio and had a lovely lunch. This may be the best Reuben I have ever had! They cook, then thinly slice the corned beef on the premises. And the bread was a break from traditional rye but so good and perfectly toasted.  My friend got the meatball sub. I don't even care for meatballs but these were awesome. So tender and flavorful. The owner came by the table and said it's his grandmother's recipe. The fries were plentiful and nicely seasoned. Very different with a smoky flavor but delicious. Many other things on the menu I want to try and will definitely be back.
name: Marcia

text:
Hands down, my favorite lunch destination near my office. 

My team often ends up ordering from this lovely establishment if we have working lunches. Everything that I've ever ordered has been delicious. The salads are huge and flavorful. The sandwiches and delcious and filling. My favorite menu item has to be the fruit box... a small to-go container jam packed with berries, grapes, tangerines, and bananas and worth every penny.

The staff is always incredibly pleasant and personable.

If you're lookin for something tasty, filling, and cost-efficient, this place is where it's at! I'm yet to try their breakfast options, but I'm told that that's just as delicious as the lunch menu items.
name: DeAdra

text: Place was great. 2nd time here and enjoyed the food. Had the pei mussels which was great. Pork Oso buco was tender but the rest of the dish was bland. However the Bison Short Ribs was good. Tender and flavorful. But I would say the star of the menu are the cocktails. 'Be Holden' being my favorite.
name: Jethro

text: The wait staff was rude to me about 2 years ago, Emailed corp about it, No one ever got back to me. I will never patron another Smokey Bones... Ever
name: Jim

text: My family has been to 3 of the 4 Lure Fish House locations & have not been disappointed.  The food is consistently great at each location no matter what we order & the service is very attentive.  Our kids love the food here & so do the adults.  Even the complimentary bread & butter they serve is amazing.  It's a win-win situation for the entire family.
name: Hannah

text: Food was good and came out fast. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. not sure I'd order the same thing again. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
Holy shit. I was not expecting this place to be this good. I read reviews that were five star which had me intrigued. Finding myself in the neighbourhood after some furniture shopping, I spotted Hanjan from the road and remembered those good reviews! 
Husband and I decided it was a great idea to go for lunch after the stress of measuring furniture and rooms all morning. 
We walked into the cutest wooden vestibule that's clearly to stop the cold and it's a good job because inside it's a little bit of Korean paradise. I felt like I was sitting outside on a patio but in reality it was snowing and -20 outside. There is a balcony area, cute string lights, and parasols on some tables. The front of the room has four wooden panel booths for a bit of dining privacy. We opted for the booth, it was really cosy and we were happy to go with the date vibe.
We chose the Lunch menu A, which was for 2 people and bargain at $30 total. The amount of food was perfect and we both loved the spicy pork belly main dish. The fish cakes were very tasty and the mini plates that came out first were delicious nibbles of kimchi, potato salad and bean sprouts. 
The service! The young man who served us was attentive and looked after us well. All round great restaurant, amazing flavours, beautiful decor and wonderful service.
name: Pamela

text: Chris gave us excellent service.   For an appetizer we had the pillows. We had white clam linguine and pizza for dinner.  Everything tasted great. We will be back again.
name: Diana

text: Excellent service.  Vegan options, good ones!   Plenty of variety of everyone.  Pleasent staff.  Knowledgeable.  Offered complimentary ice water and orange slices. Everyone very friendly.  Clean environment.  I had vegan gumbo.  Highly recommend this stop!
name: Shannon

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text:
Hilltown Tavern is a go to spot for myself and my family. The beer and food selection is fantastic! The cheese steak egg rolls and the shrimp quesadilla are out of this world. The inside is a little small and can get really loud during happy hour but they have a fantastic outdoor patio that is dog friendly, they leave out water bowls for your furry friend. 

The take out beer selection is usually always on point as well- plenty of local craft companies and other seasonal craft selections to take on the go resonantly priced. 

The staff is overall friendly and efficient I have visited this place a lot because it's local and it's very consistent. We will definitely keep going back.
name: Ron

text:
Came here for "brunch" this afternoon because we really wanted lunch and the menu wasn't entirely breakfast stuff. I don't understand Philly's obsession with "brunch" honestly. I relocated from NJ to Philly two months ago and this was the first time my family came for a visit and we wanted LUNCH gosh darn it, not breakfast. Boyfriend suggested Smokin' Betty's - I don't know why I always forget about this place but never again!

We came in with 4 people without a reservation and were seated right away. However, it was busy and there was only one server downstairs (possibly due to private party upstairs?) so we weren't officially greeted for about 10 minutes or so. That's the only reason for 4 stars again because the rest of the meal was perfect.

When the server did come over (tall guy, name I am sad to report that I do not remember), he didn't come over in a rush. He stayed chill even though he was busy with a lot of tables and working solo. He answered our questions and even bantered with me about my suggestion that the cheesesteak egg roll dish should be one giant deep fried wrap rolled cheese steak instead of 4 pieces like an appetizer since the menu says Cheesesteak Egg ROLL not Cheesesteak Egg ROLLS. (Smokin' Betty's - get on that!) I ordered the Betty Burger and he suggested a slightly lower temperature because apparently Medium Well here is more like Well and I wanted a little pink. My boyfriend asked about the sliders and he explained it was like a sampler - one of each. After hearing the explanation, the rest of our party ordered the same. This all took maybe 5 minutes and he was patient and seemed like he was enjoying himself the whole time. I would not have been so kind if I was that busy, so props to him for his attitude!

When the food came out our jaws dropped. That burger was yuge! Everything was delicious. I thought some bacon might have been a better texture than pork belly for the burger because it was a little mushy but I ate the whole thing and it was still tasty. Everyone loved their sliders though I didn't try any so I can't speak to them personally. Two folks got mac n cheese as a side dish and liked it - and I can vouch for that from prior experiences! Option to add bacon on mac n cheese was suggested by my boyfriend. Seems we really just wanted some bacon today!

Overall, great meal. Family loved it. This place is definitely back on my map, especially for my next burger craving!
name: Tricia

text: It was an accident that I walked into this place.  Many things on the menu seemed unique, and so I went with it.  Octopus Stew.  Bacon wrapped dates.  And some kind of pasta thing that was made out of a vegetable.  Fanfreakingtastic! Loved it all.
name: David

text:
I LOVE ADEL'S! I love Adel the man too! He's a very warm & personable man who remembers you from your last visit (even if it was months ago).  Now for the food:

The spicy gyro is fabulous! I've tried gyros at other Greek restaurants but they were either too spicy or not spicy enough. Warning: the portions are HUGE! I usually end up taking home at least half the meat & it's even delicious cold. The shwarma & spanakopita are also great choices. The falafel is next on my list but I usually get the gyro. The hummus is really good as well. My husband likes the spicy hummus but I prefer the regular.  His tzatziki sauce is pretty good & I don't usually like tzatziki sauce. 

This is definitely a "hole-in-the-wall" kind of restaurant but it's well worth the stop. There are usually a lot of people getting to-go orders during lunch so be patient. Many times Adel is working alone. If you're lucky maybe he'll throw in some baklava at no extra charge...I've seen it many times over the years.
name: Shelby

text: People not very friendly.  This is the second time that I have come here.  The waitress Julie is very rude trys to fix her attitude half way thru being nasty.  Then will come back and do it again.  No matter what kind of day you are having try not to bite someone's head off for asking a question.  Take a breath slow down and you get a lot further by smiling and being a little nicer.  If it wasn't for 5 people in my party I would have walked out.
name: Carla

text: Like at any Chick-fil-A, the staff was phenomenal. I forgot to grab Chick-fil-A sauce on my way out for the fries, but that's my own fault I suppose.
name: Jonathan

text: Salad tasted like lettuce had been frozen. Only one salad dressing available. Scampi overcooked and though. Marsala sauce too strong, as if it had not been reduced enough. We won't be going back.
name: Carrie

text: This place has some AWESOME food! I moved out of Tucson 5 years ago but still always try to hit Little Mexico when I'm in town. Went last weekend and the food did not disappoint! I LOVE the salsa and white dip that comes with the chips. We also had a flauta plate, chili relleno plate, and the C6 which came with a cheese enchilada and a beef taco. Always great food and great service! Hope to get back soon!
name: Cam

text:
I came hungry and left hangry. It was such a long long long long long wait from ordering to waiting to paying to waiting to waiting. The food wasn't bad. I had escargot, scallops and empanadas. However, for the portion, taste, price and service it wasn't worth it. I spent a lot of money to waste time and didn't get the service I wanted. Food took so long and when it came was the wrong order. Then there were more waiting. And even when I wanted to leave it was a wait. The place is just so narrow and on that night there were live music, which I don't know how they could fit it all. And it became so loud. Too loud to enjoy the music. 

I liked when it was Bridgid's. And really wanted to like the restaurant. I had high hopes for the restaurant to be the go to neighborhood spot. 

To be continued.
name: KhanhMy

text: Loved this place! Always enjoy crepes but ice cream just makes it even better. PLUS They have JENGA!!
name: Sahara

text: Food was good and came out fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not sure though.
name: User

text:
Is there a long wait? Yup. That does not diminish the 5-stars. You should have read the reviews and know up front, that especially on a weekend, your wait will be long. Ok, now that we've gotten that out of the way.

This is an awesome place. Never experienced anything like this. It's an old house with like 4 or 5 huge, family tables. You put your name in and when there's a table empty to fill it all up, with you and your party and then other people. Their motto is coming in as stranger, but leave as friends. 

There's no menu. They serve everything family style, just like you're at grandma's house. They bring big bowls of food, fried chicken, catfish, pulled pork, and pot roast. Then there are the sides, corn casserole, greens, coleslaw, cucumber salad, biscuits and gravy, mashed potatoes, etc. You pass the food to the left. Eat your fill, but I dare you to eat more than a plateful.

The chicken was delicious, corn pudding and biscuits were so good. The pot roast was amazing, and so tender. You pay a set price and it's so amazing.

It's an experience you gotta have when you go to Nashville. I need to go back and have breakfast.
name: Stephanie

text:
Went here after an afternoon at Longwood gardens with my mom, grandmom and 2 kids.  From the outside it doesn't look like much, but go inside you won't be disappointed.  

I had a German style beer which was really delicious!  The food was amazing.  I had the mushroom soup and the portobello sandwich with a salad.  The salad wasn't just a pile of mixed greens, it had 2 kinds of beets and some delicious cheese on it.  My mom has a pear/cheese flatbread which she liked as well. 
 
The staff here was over the top.  From the moment we walked in, everyone was very attentive to our food and beverage needs.  However, what really impressed me was how nice they were to my kids.  They had coloring books, crayons, a bunch of board games and card games to play with.  It really was a great and a fun way to pass time and enjoy a meal with family.
I can't wait to take my husband back... we shall return!
name: Lisa

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Hedge Row's Devour Indy (through Sun., Sept. 2) dinner menu ($30 for 3 courses) was fabulous.  The heirloom tomato salad and pork skewer appetizers were both beautifully prepared and tasty not to mention almost entree-sized.  Our party ordered each of the entree choices:  shawarma beef salad, pasta bolognese and a curried vegetable bowl.  We were constantly trading "bites" because they were all great though I liked my curry bowl the best!  Dessert choices were their butterscotch pot de creme (yummy) and a berry "mess" made of meringue pieces, gelato and stewed berries.  They were also generous portions!  The wine list is small, but interesting.  I particularly liked the sparkling rose.  Isaac, our waiter, was personable, attentive and fun.  Our only complaint:  the music was too loud, even after we asked it to be turned down.  We were outside, which was delightful (great people and dog watching), but we couldn't escape the multiple loudspeakers.  It was a volume better suited for dancing than for dinner conversation.  Otherwise, we highly recommend it whether you're "Fringing" or just looking for a great new place to check out.
name: Robin

text: We were excited to try some local BBQ but I'm sorry, this place is awful.  I rarely post bad reviews but this just had to be heard.  First of all, we walked in on a hot day last week and there is no AC so the prospect of eating hot food with sweat dripping down my face wasn't enticing.  The chicken and pulled pork were dry, the sausages were charred with zero taste, the coleslaw was terrible, and I've had better corn straight from a can.  And I'll never forget the awful cornbread, it was dry as well and fell apart in our hands.  I'm really sorry to write this, but it all was completely unacceptable and a sad excuse for BBQ, probably the worst food I have ever had.  Sorry guys.
name: P

text: Well we picked up Papa Murphy's and our large sausage and pepperoni set off the smoke detector in a very short time.   Bad cardboard?
name: Doug

text: We went for dinner during the week and everyone there was old!! The food was decent, the eggplant parm was especially good. But the menu is general was not impressive. It was super hot and I wanted a salad and they didn't have any on the menu!! It was an average summer day but the restaurant was uncomfortably hot-one woman asked the server to turn the air on and a couple at another table was fanning themselves with their menus. The restaurant is also quite small and the tables are very close to one another. The service was only okay, the server didn't seem to be in a good mood and the food came out at all different times!
name: Megan

text:
We went on 12/29. We made a reservation as we expected the casino to be busy due to the new year weekend. Frankly, it felt the place was severely understaffed. We sat down and it took 10 minutes to get drinks (water and a soda). It took another 10-15 minutes to get bread (waitress said there was a large party that took it all but the largest part we saw was maybe 6-8 people which equates to 2-3 baskets at most). When she finally did take our order it took almost 45 minutes to get it. I even went as far and joked with the waitress that their kitchen staff was off their game tonight but was told again about this invisible large group. 
We were told it would be a few more minutes by our waitress and then 10 minutes later what appeared to be a manager (first time we saw her on the floor all night) comes out and said it would only be a few more minutes. I told her that's what we were told 10 minutes ago and magically our food appeared a minute later. 
By this point the restaurant was about half empty so as to why it was taking so long, I have no idea.  At no time were there any apologies offered by any of the staff. I did not expect any compensation for anything that happened that night but I did expect a simple "sorry it's taking so long" or some sort of explanation and not passing blame onto a mystery "large party" that wasn't there.
name: John

text: Love this neighborhood spot. Just had an awesome turkey wrap from here. All the staff were super friendly, and they even gave me some boxes since I'm moving. I'll miss being so close to this place!
name: Catherine

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: This trip to New Orleans we stayed on Solomon Street. Mandina's was convenient to be our first meal. AMAZING! Everyone in our party was pleased with the selection from their menu. I really wanted red beans and rice, but that is their Monday special and it was Wednesday. I ate the Ribeye with potatoes and string beans WONDERFUL! We ate there again on Saturday and I had the grilled Drum with potatoes and peas WONDERFUL AGAIN! I tasted my husband spaghetti, very good! He ate it both nights.
name: Melissa

text: Sushi was delicious. You definitely need a reservation for this place on a busy night, which was definitely a mistake on our part. We started sitting at the bar to wait for a table to open up, but ended up just eating at the bar instead. The food itself was phenomenal. Really delicious and fresh. The restaurant was *so* loud though. It was difficult to hear anyone speak, including the server or even just the person I was eating with. That's the only reason I took a star off. It really affected our experience, but I guess there's not much you can do from the restaurants perspective.
name: Jax

text: Pretty crappy services, was expecting and no delivery so pretty disappointing just in my emotions lol
name: Franklin

text: I have never been to a more unorganized restaurant staffed by such rude individuals. I called my order in and was told when I showed up that I'd be prioritized. text:
Ambler was jumping this past Saturday night. People were everywhere, restaurants were crowded, the Ambler movie theater was packed, the streets were lit as if for Xmas and street music was blaring. The most exciting thing for another couple along with my wife and me was 12 day-old Sushi Hatsu. From the time we walked in, we were overwhelmed. Despite it being an obviously Asian restaurant, it was quite contemporary. First off Harrison, the owner, greeted us several times. What a nice touch! Service was a little raw, but staff was very personable. 

The food was outstanding!! It bad the Morimoto (Harrison had his roots there) look and taste at a fraction of the cost. Edamame good but not different than other sushi houses in the area. The salads, so ample in size that they can be shared, were delicious. The salmon skin (cooked to perfection) was quite  a novelty. My wife, an excellent chef herself and whose salmon is top notch, admitted that Harrison's was better. 5+. Will try the sea bass next time. Diablo roll was a winner. 

I hope to go through the whole menu over the next few weeks. Really!
BYO. Can not wait to go back!

text:
Flavorful and apparently authentic.
 The next time I eat at Masala Zone, and I hope there will be a next time, I will request whatever meat dish I may order certainly if it is chicken to be prepared boneless.  I ordered the Desi Chicken it was extremely delicious in it's flavoring and impressive in the way it was served in a baked dish covered with a baked on dough cover, but a real chore to eat.  The pieces of chicken seemed to be random cuts with a saw or cleaver and for the most part did not resemble any piece of chicken I had ever seen before.  In fact I had my doubts that some of it was chicken but likely it was.  The dish was delicious, and I did not leave a drop of sauce left in the serving bowl.  So, maybe this restaurant is a little bit too authentic for what I am accustomed to.  And, as such, presents an opportunity for me to learn and accept that things may be done differently in other cultures.  And when I return to masala zone I will request that any chicken dishes that I order be made with boneless chicken.

text: I've wanted to try Heart Beet Kitchen for a while. I've been frequently visiting Leaf in Haddonfield and wanted to do a comparison, and today being my moms birthday, we decided to try it. The food was good. The girl taking h  orders was helpful and very nice: We came for brunch and ordered the Rosemary Grapefruit Mule to share. Very good and refreshing. All three of us ordered smoothies. Mom and dad had peppermint mocha, I had Cookie Monster. Dad wasn't a fan and mom loved it. The Cookie Monster was very bland. I was going to ask for a different one but it was cold and refreshing, nothing wrong with it, so I drank it. Would not order it again. Next for food- I ordered the coconut BLT. It was good. I saw reviews mentioning that you do get a bit more coconut flavor compared to other Coconut BLTs. So if you don't like coconut, I wouldn't order it. Dad ordered the portobello burger. He really enjoyed it. Mom ordered the Heart Beet burger and she enjoyed hers as well. What threw us all off was the side salad. All kale, and a little purple cabbage, which is fine. However, it had zero flavor. The dressing just does not do it one bit. It was very blah, and could use more Umph. It also threw me off that you have to gather your napkins, forks, knives, etc. yourself. Not sure why they don't just bring all of that out when they bring your food to the table. It was a little bothersome getting up and squeezing through the long line of people to grab utensils in the corner. The prices were a little iffy. For example, on draft kombucha is $7. Just can't see that when I buy a bottle for $4. Very cute atmosphere as well. Overall, we had a good experience. I would come back again to try something different.
name: Lisa

text:
Being an avid lover of Korean BBQ, I was excited to try this Japanese BBQ spot in Philly. Similar to Korean BBQ, it's an interactive meal experience because you cook your own meats.

This review is purely for the meat lovers combo. For $60, you get a prix fixe set of appetizers, meats, and a s'mores dessert. It's definitely enough quantity to feed 2 people. Since it was all basically beef (either marinated or unmarinated), it all ended up tasting the same. Even the marinated meats had no noticeable difference in taste from each other. It felt monotonous to eat. A plus was that the food came out pretty quickly (a little too quickly), so there wasn't much of a wait for the next dish to come out. 

The general atmosphere of this place could use some improvement. During my duration there, I heard various plates and cups being dropped/broken, bathroom cleanliness was questionable, and everything just felt sticky. 

I would return here again, but I would either get a set with a better variety, or just order a la carte items. 

Tip: if you sign up for the app, you get a $10 off $30 coupon through the app within a few hours.

text:

My sister ordered the wonton which she said was pretty good but they forgot her egg. They brought her one right away. They also were very fast about filling water. It was a good dinner. 

Ramen is typically from my experience in a large bowl, but they don't fill it all the way. I always wish I had just a few more noodles in my ramen bowl no matter where I go, so if you like your noodles you can get more for extra $$. Paying small amounts for added stuff is pretty normal with ramen. Sure it can make things a tad pricey but it's always worth it. I will be back with my boyfriend.

text:
OK,

Yes...I live in the Fort Worth-Dallas area, and yes, I'm a Cowboys fan. I arrived on Sunday, staying in Downtown Philly for a business meeting the next day.  I have had Philly cheesesteak sandwiches before, but the non-true Philly kind, and I asked the concierge where I could get a bite to eat that was close. I was staying at the Sonesta Hotel, and he asked me if I liked cheesesteak  sandwiches, and I told him of course and he sent  me to Cleavers.  It was walking distance, so why not.  

First of all, I know that being from the Fort Worth- Dallas area, I know, never tell anyone where you are from, as that creates conflict. So I tried to blend in like a local, bought an Eagles tee shirt, and headed to Clevers.

First, what a great place.  Small, hard to maneuver, but  I asked where is the bar was and he pointed me upstairs.  The small bar was packed, and the bartender asked me what I wanted, and I said what do you have.  What an incredible beer selection that Clevers has, and on his recommendation I had a few IPA's that were fantastic.

I ordered, The Cleaver, as is, as most of the imitation cheesesteak sandwiches that I have had were with provolone, mushrooms, green peppers, and mayo.  Well, it was the best steak that I ever had, and I made it a meal and had onion rings. 

After the game, the place cleared out, because the Eagles lost, and I told him that I was a Cowboys fan.  He laughed at my clever disguise, was dissapointed  that his Eagles lost, but more dissapointed that when the Eagles lose, they clear out, and it lost him over $100.00 in tips.

I understood his pain, ordered another IPA, and we talked about the good ol football days.

FYI...greatest cheesesteak I have ever had, and one of my favorite places on earth...but I will never wear a Cowboys shirt.

Stay hungry my friends...
name: Damon

text:
I'm joining the unfortunate review brigade that seems to plague so many Nashville establishments. Their mantra is "the food is GREAT, but..." and I will join their ranks by following the accolades with a "but the service is less than lacking." 

I love eating at Pastaria. I love the vibe of the decor and location and the good food, but tonight I have had the final straw with their service. The hostesses are always dressed so casually I have a hard time knowing if they actually work there or are perhaps guarding the stand until their more formally dressed pal returns. I have been for lunch where I was mistakenly under the impression that my chatty waiter was personal friends with the next table over (this impression was imparted to me when he HUGGED the customer's young daughters). Turns out he was just their waiter. I had to rather callously rebuff his attempts at engaging me in deeply personal conversation. This was unfortunate, but this is not about that.

This is for the server who never cracked a friendly smile this evening. She was brusque and short. Not unfriendly, but left my table's credit card sitting expectantly for nearly twenty minutes or more, only to grab it and return it in what my mother described as "a drive-by". I wanted to call after her "are you mad at me?"

I understand the stress of serving as I've worked in the industry myself, but also this is your job. It's to deliver a pleasant dining experience... or if not pleasant then at least friendly. Don't leave me wondering if you're mad at me. I don't know you, and I wish you were having a better day. I hope your management gets a better handle on their service staff. This place could be fantastic with better service.

Food good. Service bad, and if not bad then weird.
name: Rebecca

Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Worth checking out. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Just visited again last night (Oct. 15). So tasty! I swear I love their chicken chimichanga. It comes with rice, beans, and avocado slices. I almost always get this. LOL! The chips and salsa are always a win. I also like their guacamole. I sometimes get the drink- horchata. It's really good. It's a sweet drink made from rice milk. Service is always really good. I enjoyed some flan last night. It's kind of a custard and had chocolate drizzled over it with whipped cream. Def yummy. I want to try the churros next time.
name: Annette

text: Well known for the bbq yes, but the smoky chicken salad is off the chain!!!! A bit pricey but delicious. Just the right blend of spices and the green onions make it. The best thing is that the amount of mayo is just right for those of us who like to actually taste the chicken and don't like our sandwiches swimming in mayo! My vote goes to Walkers for the best chicken in New Orleans. By the way, get a side of peach bread pudding. Awesome!
name: Joni

text: Adorable cafe with excellent staff. Delicious macchiato in an edible shortbread cup! Enjoyed breakfast sandwich. Generous egg and they happily fulfilled my bread substitution request with their yummy sourdough. Side of potatoes was less than expected but they were cooked very nicely. Pumpkin whoopie pie for dessert, so good. Overall a great experience!
name: Marcie

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. No big complaints, just a nice meal. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It was crowded but still moved along. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
I should have given this place more stars.
It's clean and their staff is always nice.
The plaza is difficult to get through because it can get busy, but that is completely out of their control. I just wish people would get out of my way when I'm trying to get my delicious salad lol
name: Constance

text:
This spot was low key and literally the only pub with food open until 2AM in NOLA. We came here after our flight and decided to grab a late night bite to eat and this was the best place the hotel suggested as most restaurants close at 10PM. 

I had the option of Mac n cheese and wings on the appetizer list and my mom and friends are the shrimp po boy and cheesesteak. 

The po boy, Mac n cheese and cheesesteak was not seasoned whatsoever and the wings were half jelly flavored and spicy buffalo which in fact confused my taste buds. After seasoning my Mac with salt and pepper it was actually edible, however, unless I'm drunk I would definitely not recommend this place to enjoy food. 

Side note they said the drinks were actually extremely good and not very pricey. They specialize in craft drinks so if you're not looking for those sugary pre made drinks this is the place to be. 

Overall service was "Ok"

If you miss out in eating at this place don't worry, I'm sure your other choice was better and innately meant to be.
name: Kristian

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. For a busy night they handled it okay. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: We decided to try Gators for lunch, because they offer a gluten free menu. We were given the menu and were seated. I asked for any lunch specials and was then provided a lunch menu. I order boneless wings with fries. Parmesan garlic sauce was my choice of flavor.  The wings were a little tough but the sauce was spot on. My wife had the grilled chicken sandwich with Gatos own sauce. It came without the sauce so she had to ask for it. But it had a nice flavor. Overall, it was a good experience and would come back.

text: This place is so good my husband and I love eating here. My steak was really cooked good it was nice and tender my husband order fish he loved it as well. Our waiter was so nice and the manager is really nice too. We love the way the place looks and every time we go we can't stop eating the bread it's so good. We came here for our anniversary and we are definitely going back.
name: Christina

text: Absolutely criminal. They charge one dollar extra for very small cups of hot oil. I was wondering why the total was so much. When you ask for another one, the lady yelled very loudly. Unprofessional! Food is always cold and bland. Many more places in town with better service...
name: Mike

text:
I stopped here for dinner and was seated in the dining area. I was alone and was seated at a table for six which was weird. I felt like I was waiting for friends that didn't show up or something! Where I sat was cold and drafty and I didn't want to bother asking for a new seat even though there weren't that many patrons at the time.

The service was decent and the salmon salad I got was good. It wasn't amazing but still good. There really wasn't anything special about the salmon and I thought the salad was a tad overpriced for what you get. I don't drink, but maybe if I liked beer and sampled some of their brews it would have been a better experience. Having an entree, vs a salad, may have been more telling, but my salad did have salmon, so...

text: This location has gotten much better. Service attentive and food more consistent. Maybe new manager
name: brett

text: My girlfriend and I ate here because it was across from our hotel. We were very glad we did. Great food, including soup dumplings. Efficient and friendly service. Really good price. Would definitely come back.
name: John

text: I ate here for the 10th time. Honestly, I can't even count. It's always good here. They actually give you more potatoes and corn when you get the combo. I had the fire with their special sauce. It wasn't that spicy but still good. Hopefully they can make the fire sauce a bit more spicier in the future! ;)

text:
Guy says 30 min wait but ended up over an hour. 

Service was prompt when were seated, although the lady got an attitude when we inquired about their alcoholic beverages.

Food was nothing special, its like any other Mexican restaurant around Tucson and for that three stars.

text: Great beers from Ireland and Britain that are hard to find on draft here. Also, great selection of gins and a refreshing 'create your own' gin n tonic menu.
name: Yaj

text:
This has got to be the worst place on earth !
Employees are super rude and unfriendly!
How in the world can a burger place be out of burgers? I see how you need to cook more but to be totally out is crazy!   Won't be back

Parking is not the best but this place was awesome!  Had the veal with mushroom sauce, amazing and the service was over the top!

text: I can't seem to find a bad chic fil a. I've been to this one numerous times and it never disappoints me. The shift manager, Emile was super nice and friendly. Our food was brought out to our table quickly and they came by and refilled our drinks. I know that every chic fil a does this but it's still nice.

text: This restaurant changed ownership about 4 months ago. I wasn't aware, I ordered what I typically order. Portions are smaller, food is terrible and the wait is longer than usual. I no longer recommend this place.

text:
Great new joint to eat at!
Appetizers: fried okra and onion petals were perfectly fried. Very crispy and tasty. 
Burgers: Hatch Chile Burger is my new favorite burger of all time! Ems Stroganoff Burger was really good, but wasn't really to my taste. The burger patties themselves are super juicy and flavorful. 
Fries: Hand cut fries are the way to go, and some of the best around. Make sure to get a side of house sauce to dip them in. 
The only reason I don't have this as a 5 star is because on one of my visits the heater was making the atmosphere very uncomfortable and hot. This was not the case in my first visit though. I will be back many many more times!

text: I cannot rate.  Horrible service, didn't even stay to eat,  manager and wait staff extremely rude,  walked out due to inappropriate attitude

text: the bologna sandwich is delicious! seriously good. some creative BBQ that doesn't stray too far from what you know and love.

text:
Great beer selection, great vibes, great service. All around can't complain. The bar manager was great and gave me recommendations for different beers to try.

text: The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. text: Always awesome food, great specials on food and adult beverages, check the website. Small but nice selection of craft beers and spirits.

text: Good sandwiches and large menu can't wait to try the rest of the options though that'll take awhile! Had the tommy tsunami, the tsunami sauce was a bit too sweet for me but adding some hot sauce to it made it perfect! Fries were good, and service was speedy.

text: Worst service I've ever had... took over an hour to get the appetizer... took almost 2 hours for the last meal to come out. We had 4 adults and 4 kids. Each meal came out separately and it was a 10 minute gap between each plate. The manager came to apologize and offered us 4 servings of bread pudding... won't return or recommend. text: Portions were generous and presentation was nice. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was fresh and service was quick. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. For a busy night they handled it okay. The music was louder than it needed to be. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. text: Literally the best bartender in the world the night I came here. Super attentive despite being decently busy and drinks were great with awesome service. Highly recommend if you're in the area!

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Worth checking out. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. name: User

text: Food was delicious but presentation of the black bean and rice chilito burrito was lacking. It was visually unappealing but taste was excellent. Maybe sprinkle some cheese and salsa in too and that would resolve this issue.

text: One of the best grouper sandwiches that I have ever had, and I have had grouper sandwiches from many restaurants in the area. Amazing. Completely unexpected. We just stumbled upon this unassuming little place and we will be back again.
name: Tim

text: I haven't eaten here in years. I was there with a couple friends from work. I always pay cash at restaurants. (I've had my CC hacked and charged before, so cash is my preferred method of payment.) We had to give up a card for our tabs, even though I paid cash. Our meals were cold when the server brought them, and drink refills were slow in coming. I'm not sure if they don't have enough staff during lunch, but I wouldn't want to go there if I were in a hurry.  They didn't seem to be particularly busy when we were there.  When I ordered and asked about specials, I was told it was all on the menu. When my friends ordered, they were "offered" different sides that were not on the menu.  I don't think we'll go back anytime soon.
name: Jana

text:
Went in today and stood at the counter for over 5 minutes with no one coming to help.  I saw the cook through the window, we made eye contact.  He knew I was there.  Then he just walked away.  I then started asking (yelling) if I could get some help.  No reply.

How are you going to have a business if you won't serve your customers.  This was ridiculous.  Will not be returning!
name: Chris

text:
As I am getting ready to order the appetizers, the waitress tells me which apps I will be having. I nod my head. As I start to tell her what I want for our entrees, she tells me again what we will be having. Again, I nod my head. Then she finishes my order by saying, and for dessert you will have this. We only come here about 4 times a year and the waitress has now memorized our entire order. I can't help but give her a thumbs up and tell her how impressed I am that she remembers us. Of course, she said, you guys always order the exact same thing.

Burmese cuisine is totally underrated and not too many people get to experience the food. My husband grew up with a best friend whose family is Burmese. He was fortunate enough to eat some of his best friend's mom's cooking. My husband is the one who introduced me to Burmese cuisine. 

Here is what we always order here; Fish Head Festival Noodle Soup. This is a classic Burmese dish. When the soup arrives at the table, put some parsley, onions, lots of pepper flakes and squeeze a wedge of lime. There are tons of minced fish meat in the soup. We always lick the bowls clean. I can't even put into words how delicious it is. 

I love all the appetizers and desserts here. Their Thousand Layer Bread with curry potatoes is our fave. Many of their other dishes like a simple beef fried rice is especially delicious. It think it's better than most other Asian places.

The owner is a delightful sweetheart of a lady who always greets us with a huge smile. In the beginning when we ordered the Fish Head Festival Noodle Soup, she asked if we were Burmese. She said that usually only Burmese people order this.
name: Pamela

text: Love this place!! The food is excellent! And the portions are huge and cost so little! You'll always have something to take home and enjoy again! Everyone is very super friendly and the service is very efficient. They make you feel so welcome! Five stars!! Will definitely be back!
name: Scott

text:
We love the food and people at Greko. We tried a lot. Loved everything! Thanks Alex Darsinos for a great lunch! My family and staff loved it!
Dr. Marie Kelly and Kelly Vision Center
name: Marie

text:
We put our names down on a Saturday night and was told that the wait would be 20-30 minutes. We proceeded to see people who came after us get seated before us. When we went up to ask the hostess where our place was, she asked what our names were again and wrote it down...meaning she skipped us since we saw her write our name down :(. We got skipped at least 6 parties, even parties of 2 that came after us got seated. We then saw another party of 2 talk to the hostess about how long their wait was and she asked for their name again because she did not write it down the first time or skipped over them....finally, after an HOUR waiting we got seated. The hostess definitely kept seating random people regardless of when they first came in...we saw this happen throughout the night. 

We both got the tan tan noodles. They did not ask us how firm we wanted our noodles. They ran out of beef so we opted for the minced pork in our noodles. The tan tan seemed to lack some sort of depth, not sure if it was because they used pork instead of beef. Since we were still hungry so we ordered the hiyashi chu-ka. I grew up in japan so I like the traditional soy flavor or the one with sesame seed. This one tasted more citrus-y so wasn't my style. However, the noodles here are really good. 


When we were still seated, the same server proceed to push together another table eh ours to seat 4 people when we weren't even done yet. She could've literally waited a minute after we signed the bill and left. 

Overall, the hostess was terrible (servers were good). If this is the service at Terakawa I would not be coming back.
name: Alissa

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: There was about a 45 min wait but it gave us time to have a drink at a bar down the street.  It is very crowded but the service is very fast.  Of course, we had the alligator cheesecake which was very rich and delicious!  It did come out lukewarm, which was a little disappointing but not a deal breaker.  We also got the godzilla which was decent if you like fried things!  The cornbread was delicious.  An all around good experience and a must-see when in NOLA.
name: Candice

text: We tried this place twice and won't be returning. Both times they messed our orders up. First time they put onions on a pizza steak when we didn't ask nor was it on the receipt. Had to return to the store so they can make the correct one. This time we order one pizza steak and one chicken pizza steak. My wife corrected her twice on the  phone. The girl kept saying chicken steak. Get home it's chicken on a roll that's it. The pizza steak had American cheese on the bottom and mozzarella on the top. Call back they make the new one. Both times I have to drive back to the store and come home to the rest of our order cold. All she can say is sorry and grin. Definitely lost is as customers.

text: I got the baconzilla it was pretty good. I thought it was gone be nasty. The bacon was cooked right and the burger. Fries are always good
name: Shelley

text: The service was not good. It took over an hour to get our food and we were the only people in whole restaurant. We asked for medium rare burgers and they were SO over cooked. The beers all came out Luke warm and a couple of us got the completely wrong orders. We all left with horrible stomach aches. Overall experience was horrible.

text: Fast, friendly service and yummy options (yes, you can sample!). Was extremely satisfied with 'Fancy Nancy'; fresh and delicious!  A little cracker creativity might better compliment the homemade chicken salad (toss the generics!).
name: Paula

text: Overall, very disappointed. While the presentation of the food was great; the food was below par, with a lack of seasoning, lack of flavor, and overall just not very tasty. Moreover, I felt the cafe was also very dirty upon entering as well as in the outdoor seating area. Our cutlery as well as cups were also filthy.
name: Trent

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: When I first had Al's bbq he was in a food truck and about to open his establishment. Let me tell you something.. it has always been soooooo good. My favorite things to get is pulled pork and hot link, with greens and baked beans. This time around I got the Mac and cheese because he only has it on Fridays. My mouth waters thinking about how good the food is! If there's any left (because they are that good) get yourself a sweet potato pie. My boyfriend who does NOT like spp, was obsessed! The sweet smell made him want to have a bite, and then I had to fight him away from my pie! lol Al's is hands down the best BBQ/soul food eatery. Everything and anything you get will be amazing!
name: Tiana

text: If you're looking for delicious, well-prepared, comforting, home-cooking you can't go wrong.  Breakfast dishes are a great start to any day.  The daily specials are wonderful -- especially the southern fried chicken, home-made chicken and dumplings, chicken-fried steak with country gravy and anything that the Chef has chosen on Thursday.   And you'll hardly have room for dessert after enjoying any of these menu items, but you've got to try the Levee High apple pie or any of their fabulously scrumptious cheesecakes.
name: TracyAnne

text: Dirty tables and saw cockroaches running across the floor, never going to this location again.
name: Tanya

text: Don't underestimate the food here! Soups are ridiculous! Had some of the best nachos I've had in all of Philly. Generous portions. Friendly and personable bartenders. Great lunch spot if your working near Center City.
name: Ian

text: This location sandwiches are delicious!! Ingredients always consistent...when I have my food delivered it  is on time most of the time...the bagels and danish served are always fresh...if you download the app you get lots of perks for food/drinks...very clean inside and the staff are always polite and courteous..
name: Melanie

text:
We decided to go back to Bait to see if it was just as good as the first time we went or if it was a fluke.  It was just as good as the first time and I can't wait to go back.  As I've said before, make reservations or you will possibly have a long wait for a table.  They do not rush you at all.  Remember they have valet parking and when the weather gets nicer, they will have some outside seating.  We started out with cocktails (the pear margarita for me) and looked over the menu.

He decided to go with the Thai chili wings.  I did not try one but they looked outstanding and he said they were delicious.  I tried the oyster trio.  Three oysters prepared three different ways - black & bleu, spinach parmesan and roasted garlic & mignonette.  They were all good but I thought the last type was best.  My main was a special that evening, the Chilean sea bass.  It came with clams and fingerling potatoes.  Talk about melt in your mouth.  He decided on the lobster roll.  It came with French fries and was served the way they do in Connecticut - with butter.  We did do dessert which I believe was the lemon tart cheesecake.  Great way to end the meal.  

Would I come back here?  Of course, I need to try the seafood boil.  If you see me there, stop by and say hello.
name: Joan

text: Amazing experience on our first visit.  Very cool interior design.  Wonderful service.   And everything we ordered was delicious - soup, apps, rolls, nigiri and sashimi.   Wonderful addition to the neighborhood.
name: Chris

text:
Everything started off great. The young lady that was our bartender and she was great! Upselling me on 'Negroni Week', where you recieved a lovely light bulb glass. They make your drink in it, then you pour it over the ice yourself. The proceeds went to benefit musicians so I thought how wonderful! I'll order another, so I can give one to my husband. 

Well her shift must've ended, because the next bartender was terrible! Not sure if he was having a bad day or what, but dude check it at the door! I ordered the second drink, not only did he tell me I wasn't allowed to have the glass but he also tried to take the one that they had already sold me! In addition to this when he made the drink and poured it into the little lightbulb glass that they're supposed to hand to you and let you pour over ice. He takes it and poured it over the ice and hands back to me empty! It was so weird... the whole thing...

The food was good, but the whole Negroni thing left a bad taste in my mouth. Not sure I'll be back.
name: Catherine

text:
I had high hopes for this place .
Unfortunately it's not up to the standard sof other similar places I visited. 
It's also quite overpriced . 
I had the tacos and they were loaded with garlic and raw onions and skimpy with the " cheese " sauce .My husband hade the love bowl which was pretty much a rice bowl with a few veggies, no sauce and garlic overload as well.
The restaurant has a nice feeling to it though and  is in a great neighborhood.
name: Isabel

text: First time for vietnamese food and the vietnamese duck was amazing! It was extremely tender and juicy. The skin was also crispy and sweet. Also the bbq beef roll as an appetizer was tasty.
name: Erik

text:
A pleasant find during our visit to Tampa. Still has a new-restaurant look -- clean and uncluttered inside, but lacking any distinct Thai touches. Waiter was polite and attentive, and helpful when asked to recommend a noodle dish and spice level. I like spicy food, but I decided on the level 3 spice instead of 4 or "Thai." 

It took a bit for the food to arrive... which I take as a good sign, since it means they're cooking things fresh. My noodles (I forget the name of the dish) came with a fairly generous amount of veggies (and only a little of that was cabbage), and was well flavored and spiced (glad I didn't order it hotter!). My wife's soup was also tasty, though a bit on the salty side, she said.  

The restaurant was slow while we were there, and the waiter was singing along to American pop hits from the front desk when he wasn't checking in on us. It was a pleasant, even fun environment despite the generic interior. Not the most fantastic Thai food I've had, but solid for the area, and I'd return if I visit Tampa again.
name: Scott

text: Lovely spot to dine al fresco in the city surrounded by trees and fountains. I ate simply - yogurt parfait with fruit, granola and honey - serving was small but delicious. Staff was friendly. Would return.
name: Christina

text: It looked better online than it did in person. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. A couple small things kept adding up. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Just not for me. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. No big complaints, just a nice meal. For the price I expected more than this. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: We stopped in for dinner on a weekend evening. Quick service, beautiful restaurant, easy parking, plus good appetizers (we got the crispy spring rolls and the Tom Kha soup), and our entrées were a great value, tasted amazing, and left us full. We got the spicy pad kee and chicken pad Thai. And how can you not love the name?

text: Absolutely delicious. Staff was wonderful. We had 2 gluten free guests who were pampered and ate exceptionally well. Where to start. Carpaccio was tender and perfectly seasoned. Polenta was outstanding and the best I've ever had. Branzino was delicious and every bite made you enjoy the flavors more. Mushroom risotto has great flavor. Brussel sprouts were good too!  Certainly worth a visit or a few.

text: Doesn't look like much when you pass by it on the street, but this is hands down the best vegan food and best Thai food that you can get in the Tampa Bay Area.  It's extremely affordable, you get big portions, the ingredients are fresh and high quality.  There are also lots of gluten free options.  This is definitely the spot!

text:

Bacon egg and cheese croissant for me and eggs Benedict for the hubs. It's always a win win when you can go halfsies and try both. 

We will definitely be back to try some lunch and dinner options.

text: Rolled into town on way from Seattle to Tacoma on Saturday before Christmas. Waited but a few minutes for a table - worth every second. Had breakfast appetizer of Fried Beignets with honey butter - excellent. My Smoked Salmon Benedict was the antidote for previous day road food - daughter's oatmeal was a big bowl of delish. Go again? Most definitely!

text: I am grateful for the speedy service in their busy drive-through. They are always so polite and respectful. I like using the app as I get points and offers for free food! On the app you can "meet the manager" of the location. I like that too because it makes going there more "small town" & genuine. My order has always been correct and of course always fresh. The parking lot is a little scary but there is always ample time to leave the drive-through because of the light change.

text:
I've been to many a Tijuana Flats, and this one is the best.  Right off the highway.  The food was pretty standard for TF (hot and fresh on this visit- so good) but the service was outstanding.  My mom mentioned that it was her first time at TF, and they gave us a free basket of chips and salsa.  When we were getting ready to leave, they topped off the chips and salsa and packed up all of our leftovers.  All of the staff were attentive and kind (especially Gina- thanks Gina!) and the restaurant was clean. 

For you Tijuana Flats virgins- stop by on Tuesdays or Thursdays.  $5.99 for combo meals on both days- tacos on Tuesday, burrito on Thursdays, plus chips and a drink.
name: Jenna

text: Very hospitable -Debbie was great at the counter! Good food, not greasy. Had an egg white western omelette with feta. My husband had eggs over-easy with homefries and toast. We will be back!
name: Carrie-Anne

text: The food is soo good, i got the tacos they were delicious! i would say best tacos ive had around! She made it all right infront of me, i ate in and it was a very chill vibe. The women was soo sweet and the food didnt take long at all!!!! I will definitely be back for the tacos and also will be trying out the rest of the menu!! i highly recommend this place to anyone who wants good real mexican food.
