text:
I've been here for food twice before and had similarly experiences so I feel comfortable writing this. 

James was practically empty when we got there at 1:00 on a Sunday. We waited a significant period of time for water after sitting down (over 10 minutes) despite there being only three other tables with patrons. After receiving water, we waited another 15 minutes to order our drinks (despite telling our server when she brought water that we were ready to put in a drink order). For brunch food, especially in a place not packed (again- 3-5 other tables of patrons this whole time), there is no reason why it should take 25 minutes for eggs but that happened. The food came out late, wrong, and over cooked. Two orders were switched and had to be remade. The burgers, when fixed, ultimately came out okay, but the sides with them were burnt. My omelette and potatoes were extremely over cooked...the plate had clearly either been in an oven or under a heat lamp and the potatoes were completely dried and hard. Overall it was a terrible and expensive experience.

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. text: One of the places that will surprise you for sure. What seems to be a bar but with fantastic service and food, that knows presentation as well. text:
Not bad food for a not bad price in the French Quarter.

My daughter and boyfriend each had a po boy they came dressed. The waitress didn't ask and we didn't specify that they wanted them undressed so be aware of that. text: Paid $7 for a half sized Fuji Apple chicken salad. Not being a Panera Bread regular, I figured at $7 it must be a decent size for a half. Got home and it was the smallest salad I've ever seen. Figured they would make up for it in quality; sadly no. There were literally two small slices of questionable chicken on top, a handful of soggy lettuce topped with four wet apple chips on top. text: I walked a lot today and didn't hydrate as normal. So inching closer to Amtrak, I found this like hidden gem, but it's huge inside. Nice decor, great loud music and sports on big screens. Small happy hour menu with drinks and vegetarian empanadas (baked not fried). Quick little gourmet indulgence before I go godbye Santa Barbara... Mexican-American foods. text: Not real Mexican food. The burgers looked really goos but was r sry disappointed with the quesadilla that was stored with lettuce and got soggy. The beans in the bean and cheese burrito did not taste authentically Mexican. The steak burritos had lettuce in it.  But I saw someone get onion rings and they looked light and crispy.

text:
Overhyped. 

Came here on a Wednesday night after having a reservation for over a month. Best pizza in America? Not even sure if it's the best pizza in Philly.

Got the roasted veggies and the daily special pizza (mozzarella with garlic) with arugula and sausage. 

Roasted veggies: purple potatoes, beets, Brussel sprouts, and radicchio. I was expecting warm veggies, but cold was just fine. A little too heavy on the Caesar dressing, which made the overall taste too acidic. Overall I'd give this dish a 4/5. 

Pizza: good but not great. The crust was very burnt (see photo), and I was parched afterwards. Holy salt. The olive oil "drizzle" on top of the pizza was a nice touch, but it was more of a downpour than a drizzle. The arugula to pizza ratio was also too high, especially because the arugula soaks up the oil.

Two non-food notes (and now I'm kind of wondering if I should've given it 2 stars):

The service was not great. We tried to get the attention of our server a few times after we were done eating but failed twice. We then put the credit card on the table and finally got her attention to get our check. She said sure, and then came by with a tin foil for me to wrap up leftovers but didn't give us the check. Then we flagged her down again and finally got the check. Except then she never picked it up from our table. We waited and waited. And in the end, it was someone else who finally took the card.

The tables in the dining room were super smushed together, so we felt like we were sitting at one long table with other people. In fact, our table neighbors started a conversation with us and told us about their dishes. This was fine and dandy except for when we had to get up and leave or use the bathroom because we had to literally push the tables away to get out of our seats. You're charging $20-30 per pizza--you can afford to make better use of your dining space. I feel less claustrophobic in $2/slice hole-in-the-wall joints.

text:

We ordered Grilled Cheese for my friend and I, Cranberry Bean Chili, Tomato Basil Soup, My wife got a Chicken and Basil Pesto on Focaccia Bread and my daughter ordered a Turkey and Swiss. 

Everything was great, the chili had great flavor, chocked full of meat and beans and was slightly spicy but not too much. The Tomato Basil was one of the nicest ones I've had in Reno. text:

And when they were finally ready to take our order, a guy told us, "Finally you guys are ready to order." Um... excuse me? We were waiting on you. It might of been an attempt at trying to make a joke, but it sounded very rude and condescending. While we were ordering, he was slamming his knife onto the counter as well which made me very uncomfortable. He then used the same knife to make our sandwiches, which is pretty unsanitary.

To make the experience worse, as I was paying, the guy asked me, "Are you Hawaiian?" Uh... no? And even if I was, why would that matter? After looking at other yelp reviews, I see that lack of manners towards women is very common here.

On the bright side, the sandwiches were good, and the fries were nice and crispy. However, I wouldn't go here again.

The ribs we ordered came very dry/hashy every time, and not a lot of meat for what you pay. Perhaps the they're cooking too long? The tri-tip was tasty, but paper thin slices. 

The fresh cut fires are good and that sauce they make is decent. They also have a good salad bar.

text:
It is just about impossible to get a table at Andiario, so we trekked out from Philadelphia on a weeknight (the only night we could hope to make a reservation at a decent hour) to see what the hype was all about.

Every dish, from the super-fresh fluke crudo served with incredibly sweet Aji Dulce peppers, to the pheasant tortelloni served with chestnuts and an intensely savory reduction sauce, to the wood-roasted beef neck served with some kind of slightly acidic broth permeated with the flavor of charred bone and cabbage, was an outstanding revelation of flavor. The table favorite was the tonnarelli all-Amatriciana, which took me straight back to the first time I ever had that dish in a tiny restaurant in Rome. (I felt like Anton Ego having his flashback in "Ratatouille" - it was that evocative.)

If pastas are Andario's strong suit, I would say that dessert is their weakest - we had the paw paw cake, which unfortunately tasted like a really dense, slightly grassy banana bread and didn't quite capture the lovely tropical notes of the paw paw fruit. But the table next to us loved their pear galette and we heard our waiter tell them was his favorite dessert on the menu, so we probably ordered the wrong thing.

The Philly area has so many excellent Italian restaurants, it can be hard to stand out. But Andiario, with a menu that seems to pull strongly from regional Roman fare (at least when we went - the menu changes frequently with the seasons), has found a lovely niche of its own. No question I would love to come back - but apparently (and well-deservedly for Andiario), so does everyone else in the tri-state area!

text: Great place! Definitely stop in for authentic Mexican food! This place was so good. It's a hole in the wall joint, but the eating area was clean and the food was so yummy! The cashier- who I assume is probably the husband/owner was so kind to me and thankfully spoke English. I ordered the gorditas (3 per order)- I tried the steak, al pastor, and carnitas. Carnitas were very juicy, al pastor was my favorite. It had a delicious marinade. Red and green salsa was on point and not too spicy (which I love because then I can eat more of it).

text:
My colleague's go to joint. So when we were on the way here, she told me that we should come for drinks and a late night food trip. Why not, I'm always down to chill with the crew and smash a couple of plates here and there. Plus It's my first time here.

Off the bat, two things jumped out and grabbed my attention. The Crab Cakes and the Jambalaya Pasta. Grabbed a proper pint of Ragin Cajuns Kolsch, put in the order and away we go.

Crab Meat Cakes:     I am a big Crab Cake guy,, and yes I have been to Baltimore and my bar is set pretty gosh darn high when it come to that. The ones served here are really good. Definitely worth ordering specially the way they smother it with their shrimp and mushroom sauce. Two thumbs up!

Cajun Jambalaya Pasta:     Shrimp on every bite. It's as if the Alfredo sauce made love to Jambalaya and had an offspring. This would definitely the direct result of that. It's out of this world. I can't wait to have it again. Plus they give you pieces of bread to mop up what's left on he plate after you're don't smashing.

This spot is definitely a pretty good place to go to if you're visiting NOLA for the very first time. It definitely is touristy, but then what do you expect since it's just off bourbon. Would I come back here again? My answer would be a very strong YES.

Thank you so much for reading my review. I hope this helps with your decision making experience. Enjoy your awesome yelptastic day!

The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. I left full, which at least counts for something. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: We saw this chicken on a tv show and had to go. The line at noon on a Saturday took about 30 minutes. The chicken is moist, crispy skin was delicious. Had fried okra, red beans and rice and muffins. A must eat!
name: Deirdre

text: Poor customer service! Came in sat at bar was not even acknowledged while there person spoke with there friends at the end of the bar. Then they proceeded to take a phone call. We walked out and we were behind the 3 other people that had come in just before us and they walked out. If I was the owner I would not be happy having people walk out after they had decided to try it out. Sad cause I will not be back I know there pizza is good. Customer service is everything!!!!!
name: Trey

text: Ok, so we walked in and it was very busy. The hostess was very kind and attentive to customers.    We started at the bar and the owners wife was putting her fingers inside all the glasses!!! Ugh!  We said something,  and they replied our fingers are in everything!!!!   Ordered margaritas from the pre-mixed machines, not good, dont recommend.  The waitress was overwhelmed with tables,  but did her best to accommodate us. Fajitas were good, but it seemed very un- organized service!
name: Mar

text:
Love Truffles, I enjoy the restaurant as well as the bar side for happy hour.The food is simple and elegant. You can get a beautiful piece of sole or a great burger. If you go into the bar for happy hour they have same portions available on many of their usual offerings it's a great way to try things that you haven't tried, definitely give the B-b-que shrimp a try.
Duke the bartender is terrific and has been there forever, everyone who works there is great always kind and helpful,glad to offer advice or adjust an order.
name: Abigail

text: My friend told be about this place & I wanted to inquire on catering services & they kept hanging up when I asked for the gal she was working with.  They have horrible customer service, I would rather spend my money somewhere else.
name: Ms.

text: We went here for brunch and I was very pleased with the experience and meal. The staff was super friendly and the restaurant is very beautiful. I was impressed with my mimosa (A lot of champagne and very little orange juice) but my meal was delicious! I ordered the veggie omelet and  was so happy I did! It was very tasty, but light and filling. The fig jam they provided was also very delicious! I would absolutely recommend this restaurant.
name: Lauren

text: Loved it so much! Being right on Jackson Square, its a great location with a pretty view. The ambiance and design of the restaurant is beautiful and the service is amazing. We went on a super busy day during playoff weekend but got our table within 10 mins around 3 pm. However they are more known for their breakfast/brunch. I was so tempted to get some breakfast food if it wasn't so late in the day- looked amazing. Their strawberry lemonade was the best I've ever had. My only complaint was the complimentary bread- not the best and I've had it really good! They did the whole order and pay via the waiter's cell phone which was cool and convenient. Worth the wait if you're going during a busy time! Go explore while you wait for a table!
name: Marie

text:
My first time here, after years of trying to get here when in Nashville. I was looking forward to seeing if this was truly Chicago pizza, as usually when out of the Chicago-area, the pizza , even when advertised as real Chicago, disappoints. 

This place did not disappoint! I had a 12 inch thin crust sausage pizza, and to my surprise the sausage was actually legit, like we get in Chicago, not those tiny little sausage balls you see everywhere else.  This was a good Chicago thin crust!  They had a nice happy hour special of 2 for 1 drafts, which was a nice bonus!

I will definitely return!
name: Mike

text: Food was tasty, plentiful, quick, and the location is picturesque. Sitting outside in a pedestrian walkway, I was able to enjoy a nice breeze, the songs of street musicians and local birds. Wonderful. Food- I had the vegetarian bun with lemongrass tofu. It was a fantastic value at under $10.
name: Bailey

text: Great pizza & service! The location also is a plus! The only thing I was not impressed with was the chicken cesar salad. Chicken was bland. But will definitely be back for more pizza!
name: Alyssa

text:
We just happened upon this food truck when leaving an appointment at 101 W Elm in Conshohocken, and it has inspired me to book all future appointments for lunchtime on Wagon Wednesdays. This is the kind of pizza you build your life around. 

Our margherita was impeccable, with richly flavored sauce, pools of hot mozzarella, and a generous helping of basil (most places skimp, but not here!). The crust was beautiful, an ideal thickness, tender yet crisp. I don't know how they could have done it all so well, when most full-scale pizza shops are mediocre at best. Impressive!

Excellent quality for a steal. The pies here easily rival those of much more expensive wood fired oven spots, but for just $10 (including a drink of your choice). Service was fast and friendly, our pizza was ready in under five minutes. Perfect size for a solo meal if you have a strong appetite for perfection, or split it at your own peril.
name: Christina

text: There was a line out the door, though after my Brocato's experience, I can't imagine very many of them being returning customers. As I was ordering my food, a drunk came into the restaurant yelling about how his parents own the place, he then proceeded to grab another customers sandwich out of his hands, take a bite, and hand it back to the customer. According to him his name was Alex Brocado. If this is how the owners of the establishment raise their own to behave, I won't be giving them any more of my business. That said, they make a damn good sandwich.
name: Abby

text: I was craving ramen and decided to get the Tonkatsu ramen. I was really disappointed. The broth was so bland and tasted watered down. I had to add soy sauce and that still wasn't enough. The pork was okay, not as tender as I'd of liked but not bad. The flavor of the bambu shoots and the mushrooms were good but overpowered the rest of the ramen. What I will say was good though was the noodles. The noodles were great and they give you a lot.
name: Vivienne

text:
Servers are not very nice.

Food is okay.

Wifi is poor and they don't care if they get it fixed.
name: Daniel

text: Finally found a place that has tasty street tacos in St. Louis. Will order from here again.
name: Michael

text: Excellent appetizers. This was the first time I had alligator, and I enjoyed it! The entrees were not quite as flavorful and well cooked as the appetizers, but the ambience and service were great!
name: Megan

text: Burgers are phenomenal, taste fresh and flavorful. I usually get the brunch burger which is quite tasty. I like that they service liquor here. The onion rings are not very good but I liked the ranch dipping sauce
name: Shannon

text: One of New Orleans Finest!! Causual and inviting with a great downstairs bar and sitting upstairs with a view of Magazine Street. Food was amazing- had the chicken and dumplings! But even the appetizers were delicious! Staff is so friendly-Thank you  Gris Gris!
name: Annie

text: As a Wawa regular I'm quite appalled at this one.The whole side of there building is overloaded with trash.Its been like this for some time and I gather hadn't been addressed yet.Very poorly run and an eyesore.If the outside looks like this imagine how your food is prepped and there storage areas.
name: Jake

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold.
name: User

text:
I tried this place a while back a few weeks after it open. I was very surprised to find such a modern concept for a Vietnamese restaurant in St. Louis. I think a place like this is necessary. It gives you the authentic flavors you expect and the convenience of getting exactly what you want.

DD Mai if you don't already know means "fast" or "hurry up and go" in Vietnamese. While I don't think their food comes out that fast, I do think the food is well priced and deliciously authentic. I. I'm from California so I know how Viet food should taste.

I ordered the pork belly baos, the pork vermicelli, and the pork banh mi. Everything pork first because, in my opinion, you should get these right before you decide to go outside the box with something else. Great flavors and the fish sauce is not too overpowering, but still stays true to what it should be. Pickled veggies were perfect. You better not mess those up otherwise it's not a banh mi.

I loved the cute pictures they have on. The wall. Adorable and clever. When you walk in, you know that you aren't at your typical mom and pop Vietnamese restaurant, but that doesn't mean you won't get traditional flavors.

I think the westernized touches it has will encourage others who aren't familiar with Vietnamese cuisine to give it a chance. I hope this place lasts.
name: Hang

text: The food here is outstanding, and I am a frequent customer of the weekend brunch. I have been to the all you can eat experience 5 times prior to my experience today, and each time has been wonderful. Today, however, was a different story. While the food itself was still great, the restaurant decided to rearrange the brunch buffet; they shoved everything into one space so they could have room for a few more tables in the room they used to put the lunch part of the buffet. This created utter chaos when trying to get food. The lines were ridiculously long and everyone was crammed into a small space to wait. Furthermore, the staff struggled to keep all the food replenished and I had to come back 3 times just to finally grab a piece of French toast. Please go back to the old bunch arrangement!!
name: Kelly

text: Absolutely wonderful food. Courtney was our waitress and she was a sweetheart. We'll definitely be back!
name: Lisa

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Would absolutely visit again. For the price I expected more than this. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
The charbroiled oysters were meh. The good ones actually had melted cheese and were served hot. The bad ones were served warm and were runny with unmelted cheese. Our server was a nice guy but he was slooooow. We didn't get our first round of drinks until 30 minutes after we were seated. 

My entree was Cajun fish of the day (red fish). My fish was over cooked and lacked taste. The collared greens were served lukewarm. Overall my experience was meh. Lots of great places to eat in New Orleans. Do yourself a favor and skip this overrated tourist trap.
name: Ed

text: For the price I expected a little more care. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Food was good and came out fast. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text:
It  was an awesome establishment. I see some other patrons mentioned the menu was pricey? Well what do you expect when Patrons come to an establishment and listen to  free live music then do not buy anything inorder to support the business? I bet this is the reason for sacredgrounds closing. 
We have a great place to play with no drunks and bullshit to contend with then people take advantage and run it into the ground. Thanks moron non paying patrons.
name: J

text: The early bird special was a fabulous value the food was good!!!  The service was great.
name: Rebecca

text: My favorite restaurant! The parmesan crusted chicken Romano, the orange he chicken, pizza, pasta carbanaro, salads and burgers are all delicious. This is def a higher priced restaurant and not something you could do all the time, of a large family but it's always nice for a special occasion and a nice treat. I would say it's good to go before 5 and get the lunch prices on certain meals as the prices are much more affordable and I swear the portions aren't much smaller. It's in possible to go and only get meal as the cheesecake is beyond tempting and oh so yummy! If you've never been before, I highly recommend going with enough time to explore the menu because it is huge and can be overwhelming. Lastly, I wish they'd build one in Wesley chapel as both Brandon and Tampa are just too far...come out this way cheesecake factory! Wait maybe no...I'd probably gain 50lbs LOL!!
name: Tiffany

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Will be back. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: I ordered through bite squad.  I ordered the chicken Parmesan dinner, and the dinners come with a side salad and garlic knots.  I added a note that I wanted ranch for my salad.  I also ordered a chocolate cannoli.  I'm staying in a hotel, so I asked for utensils and napkins.  My driver brought my order, and it was wrong.  I got a chicken Parmesan sub, which costs less than the dinner.  No utensils or napkins.  I got charged for the dinner, and got a sub which was not that good.  Bite Squad refunded my money for that part of my meal.  The cannoli was very good!  This restaurant needs to read the orders better.  Not even one napkin.
name: Jennie

text: It was busy this Saturday around 10, but they sat us quickly. I loved the coffee, I could probably drink 10 cups. The fruit was cut fresh, the omelet was awesome. They take cash only, but I had cash. A fun Aussie find!
name: Justine

text: The food was probably good but I didn't get to enjoy it because of the food server attitude some old Ethiopian lady straight attitude for real people if u hate ur job quit!
name: Prez

text: This place is so solid!! We just went and the food and people are AWESOME! Really good spicy, savory flavor. Had the fish, hot chicken, street corn and Mac n cheese. Every single thing was excellent. Don't walk, RUN to try it!!
name: Hailey

text: I wasn't too impressed by Ruby Slipper cafe. The food was mediocre- the shrimp and grits were watery and the fried catfish wasn't seasoned. The drinks were amazing though- and I could really appreciate them serving you drinks while waiting.
name: Khamara

text: Chargrilled oysters were delicious. Definitely a must if you like oysters. The service is wonderful and it gets pretty busy. (Even during the day on Monday)
name: Caroljean

text:
First time here.  Place has a nice feel - feels like a restaurant w a movie theater.  Good variety of food, drinks and desserts.  Seats do not recline but were comfortable and spacious.  We ordered tickets ahead.  I hoped to have a free seat between us but the seats were almost sold out.  With the seat size though, I didn't feel encroached.

Service was acceptable.  The waiter was polite, food came quickly, was warm.  Actually tasted equal to a TGIF or Ruby Tuesday.  Got a milk shake, chicken sliders and Mac and cheese.  

I was nervous when the group next to me announced they'd be bugging the waiter a lot for drinks.  But, fortunately, they did not!  There are a handful of mild interruptions during movie - drink orders, delivery, take away.  But it wasn't bad and you have to expect it.

I look forward to going back - maybe a cocktail and appetizers next time.  Mozzarella sticks looked popular.  And I would definitely try a dessert.
name: Christine

text: While the pizza was a little too greasy for my liking, I loved the sauce to cheese ratio. It was absolutely delicious! The pizza was huge and you can tell this was fresh. The crust was toasted to perfection. The sauce was rich in flavor and brought me back to the best memory of pizza I had in New York. I promise this place won't disappoint.
name: Abigail

text:
The black bean burger was delicious! I wasn't expecting the burger to have so much flavor and have so many toppings! The plantain fries were scrumptious too, I never had those before and really enjoyed them.
I tried #9 smoothie-I know it had mango, apple, and papaya in it and I only got the small. It was a great size for the price but I loved the smoothie so much that I wish I got a bigger size!
Also, try their ginger shot, it will clear out your sinuses and help boost your immune system.
Highly recommend especially to any vegans/vegetarians!
name: Katie

text: We went here last night and I really enjoyed it. The waitress walked us through everything and I love the choices I have on the line. I can make pretty much anything I want. I will be coming back.
name: Laurel

text: Dino has good pizza, but is very expensive, no deals there. Over priced pizza. I wish they would pick one day and make it cheaper. Thats why alot of pizza shops fail. Over charging the customers.
name: Gary

text: Went around 630 on a Tuesday night and it was dead.  Kinda worried me.  We were seated immediately and the hostess was getting our drinks for the server.  On the menu they say the meat and three ends at 3pm however they actually serve it till they run out.  I had the pot roast and it was very good.  They also serve alcohol but be warned, they are expensive.  For being as dead as they were there were a couple of tables that needed to be cleaned and stayed that way the whole time we were there.  I kinda wonder if they will end up closing like the other restaurants at that location did.  The place is so big I can only imagine the rent is very high.  Kinda dont see it being a cool springs type of place but you never know.  All in all I wasn't disapointed, just wasn't overly impressed.
name: glenn

text: DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE! Unless you enjoy being told to wait 35 minutes for a pizza and actually end up waiting two hours. OH, and hope you also love cold pizza because they made your pizza when you called, but you still have to wait those two hours so IT DOESN'T MATTER. They will not rewarm up your pizza for you either. Just a lil heads up  Enjoy your dominoes
name: Taylor

text: 8 families - 10 people-  ordered ~8 pizzas & several salads 24 hrs in advance.  Delivery was missing 2 pizzas & 2  or 3 salads.  Best they would do is prepare missing items for pickup or delivery.  We turned down this "fix."  No manager on duty to speak to.  None of us will do business with them again.  Pizzas delivered were OK.
name: Bruce

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The staff seemed tired but still polite. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Pretty happy with it overall. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The staff seemed tired but still polite. A couple small things kept adding up. Probably not coming back. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the price I expected more than this. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Not bad for a quick meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: One of my favorite coffee spots in the city. The coffee is excellent, and there's plenty of seating to work or meet up with someone. The only drawback is the difficulty of parking, but the coffee is worth it.
name: Cody

text: The place is poorly run and sushi was average at best.  Literally never dusted the place and looks like never been cleaned since it was open.  No pride.  I won't go back as I have trouble eating sushi at a place that is not super clean.  I can only trust your sushi as clean as the front of the house is.
name: S

text: Upon entry I was really confused and thought this restaurant was really big because of the wall of mirrors but it wasn't lol. The waitress was kind of slow getting to our table and taking our order but I will let that slide on account that they have a really great lunch deal which includes apps, soup, and then an entree for like $10-$12 if I remember correctly. I would definitely come here again if I'm ever in the area.
name: Noora

text: Great prices Asian food. BYOB and the quality of the sushi are the only two factors that don't make this 5/5. The sushi is good, but nothing spectacular. You get what you pay for, and you aren't paying a ton for a whole sushi meal here, which is a plus! I would venture to say the sushi is basic, and there are also good items on the menu like bento boxes, soup, salad, and hibachi. Overall a great variety, and good food at a good price!
name: Kayla

text:
Literally never! We have tried numerous times to come to this place and they seem to just close whenever they want to, screw the times posted.
We walked in 1 hour before before their posted closing time and the idiot at the counter says "We closed early we are not going to take your order"!
What the hell is that!?
Completely ridiculous!
I will never ever try again!

text: Everything on the menu is so cheap and affordable. Came to Pennsylvania for a visit and was craving banh bao. Got the vegetarian, pork and vegetables, and the BBQ bun. BBQ bun was my favorite but they are all good. Also was able to try the green tea and white chocolate egg waffle, also great. Highly recommend for great snacks.
name: Kim

text: I mean, what can I say. This Mcdonald's is just like your classic Mcdonald's. The food is always as good as Mcdonald's can be. The only reason I give it 3 stars is because of the drive thru service. The people aren't necessarily mean or anything, but I've had times where I had to sit at the drive thru for a long time, waiting for someone to take my order. These are usually at 2 in the morning, when not many people are at Mcdonald's, either. I've also had times where I'm at one side of the drive thru, and 3 cars on the other side of the drive thru have their order taken  and they can move forward. Not sure if this is a technological issue, but I always notice it. Other than that, the food and customer service is pretty okay. I'd still come here though, they just need to fix their drive thru issues.
name: Wendy

text: Been looking for a tasty and affordable place for street tacos in Reno, let me tell you this is it. Grabbed some for a snack with my boyfriend and ended up getting enough for dinner (12). GREAT carne asada. Will definitely be coming back here.
name: Mahal

text: The service here is great! If you're ever in the eastern part of Tampa you have to try this Pilipino cafe. The halo halo and ube cake is a must try!
name: Lucy

text:
Wait staff is wonderful. Appetizers are pretty good. I got jambalaya as a main dish and I would not recommend if you're a jambalaya fan. Tasted very bland - the sauce was similar to a marinara. 

This restaurant has a great ambiance, charm, and good location on Broadway. I would recommend for drinks, appetizers, and a light, bar type meal. 

This review is for the restaurant in the first floor.
name: Erin

text:
Flamme Burger is solid! We went here for lunch and had a great time. Immediately upon entering, you can tell these are wood-fire grilled burgers. Just the smell inside the restaurant of burgers on the grill in mesmerizing. We will certainly return for the food and friendly service.

Food:Burger: I got a build-your-own burger with sharp cheddar cheese on a brioche bun. The burger was made to perfection done medium well-ish. The burger was soft and extremely delicious. I ordered fries with it and the fries were perfect. They were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. And the aroma coming out of the burger of being cooked on a wood fire grill was amazing. I loved this burger and it is definitely high on my list for burgers to eat in Indianapolis. 

Service:
The service was great. The waitress was very attentive and friendly. The manager, Seth, was incredibly courteous as well.
name: Mac

text:
No gluten free pizza!  Tried to give this place a try based on Yelp and TripAdvisor reviews mentioning their gluten free pizza.  Upon arrival was told that they got rid of their gluten free crust 6-7 months ago because there's too much flour in their restaurant.  I know those with celiac disease really care about their food being potentially cross contaminated with flour but there are many people like me that are just gluten sensitive - well they decided to get rid of the gluten free crust for everyone and they lost our group of customers.  

Oh, they did offer me a pizza bowl.  What's that?  They offered to throw a bunch of pizza toppings on top of rice.  Seriously?!
name: L

text: Lunch buffet is over priced at $13. Somehow they never seem to get around to bringing out the so called complimentary dosa either. Table service is non existent at lunch. Although I like the food it's not extraordinary and I'm kind of over this place.
name: Monte

text: I ordered chicken mughlai and garlic naan. I asked for it very spicy and everything about my order was perfect. I'm only visiting Philadelphia but this is worth coming back to. Friendly staff and quick service. It has been 6 hours since I walked in the door and I'm still thinking about it. Highlight of my trip.
name: Scott

text: Always get the Garlic/3- cheese burger and it NEVER disappoints. Best home-made ketchup that I've ever had. Tried the shrimp, sausage, Mac & cheese this go around and, man, it was delicious. Got the Apple/pear martini, peach margarita, and a few shots. Ended with the peach bread pudding which was fantastic!
name: Haleigh

Talks with an attitude and all you're understanding is okay and just like that he's hung up without you knowing what's going on. Who owns this place.... it's gotta go

text: The food & drinks were delicious! Nice portions, flavorful and made to order. We had a large group of 12 and our waitress was awesome!! We ate inside but the outdoor area was open and busy as well. They had live music playing and I can't wait to come again as the weather warms up and eat outside.
name: Kelly

text:
(Update) now they won't even take reservations for the football games. Without them And given they have a hard time getting any decent wait staff I won't be spending any money there anymore. 

Been going here for years to watch the Eagles but this place seems to just keep going downhill. Wait staff is very hit or miss. You're in a valley so there is virtually no cell reception and no one can get on the Wi-Fi because apparently they're working off of a decade old system. They never turn on the large screen unless it's dark out and less you get right next to a television they're too small to see from a distance if there's no seating. text: I love the hell out of Popeyes but this location is forever dropping the ball. Twice I've gone there in the 9:00-9:45 timeframe and both times they were closed or refused to accept any orders beyond the limited scraps available. Might be time to start rolling to Zaxbys....

So other than the two awful female servers. Great place to be at. We watched the game. Had a few beers. Really enjoyed the Oktoberfest flight and the food looked great. Would have been 5 stars if the two female servers decided to focus on their jobs and personalities.

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick. Price felt a touch high for what it was. text:
Returning to Drunken Fish was a solid 4-star experience. Bryan was again my server and provided excellent service. 
This time I tried the signature Drunken Fish roll from the lunch combo. Topped with flavorful tuna the roll included perfectly cooked asparagus and shrimp tempura inside. A sprinkling of micro greens added another splash of color in top. 
The lunch specials are definitely the way to go for a quick lunch. Hardly had I received my salad than the roll arrived. It was possible to be in and out in 30 minutes. Terrific timing if you work nearby and have a short lunch break.
name: Michael

text: Went with a large group and ordered a good chunk of the menu since we shared and all had a taste.  Everything was delicious - a range of traditional and more unique options.  Chips were perfectly crispy and not too thick and heavy.  Pico and guac were fresh.  Nachos were cheesy as a nacho should be!  Also had the shrimp tacos and Korean bbq tacos which were both very good.  Margs offer a range of tequila so you can pick your preference.
name: Meagan

text:
Yesterday my daughter came out to see her teacher sing at the Zen Den. As always, the service and kindness from the staff was phenomenal. Miss Annette greeted my daughter with a hug and made sure she and her friends felt right at home. Although there was a crowd, the energy in the room was positive. The best part is that Annette always offers food sensitive options AND supports a local coffee roaster/family in Lansdale called Backyard Beans. It's a shame that not everyone who visits the Zen Den feels the same way we do. Supporting a locally run business, a locally sourced coffee company, and made from scratch food is what we pride ourselves on. We find more joy at the Zen Den than we ever feel
at corporations like Starbucks. If you haven't checked them out, you are missing out! #findyourzen
name: Meg

text: Best place in Nashville, a must , great live music , great atmosphere, amazing comfort food ...
name: Dora

text: The menu is expansive with many items that all have a twist of flavors. One of my favorite places to eat and I like to try different things when we go. The French onion onion rings are amazing as well as the flatbreads. The fork and knife BLT is my favorite thing on the menu. Portions are large, service is always great!
name: Lindsey

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Also, the leftovers held up okay the next day.. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. For the price I expected more than this. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
Went for a brunch on a Saturday morning. Of course we expected a long wait for a group of 4 at 11:00, and we were lucky to have bottomless mimosas to accompany us as we waited. The bar staff was very diligent and friendly to refill our mimosas very promptly! I'm not going to say we were drunk by the time we sat down, but... well... crap happens. 
Anyway, we ordered the big ole biscuits and gravy and the sweet potato pancakes with some coffee to sober us up. The food was incredible! The wait staff was so friendly and they continued to fill our mimosas as the bluegrass band played.. This place was amazing and we had a great time!
name: Katie

text: The restaurant is really nice on the inside and rhere is plenty of seating. very nice ambience and the food is some of the best in the sp area. i got the soup of the day, the French onion and it was so yummy.
name: Arlin

text: My favoriteee Korean BBQ! The only con is that their food portions in the burrito are not consistent.
name: Brianna

text: It's a very energetic feel coming into the restaurant. Bright colors and pretty cool music. I went for brunch and the unlimited drinks were awesome. Sparkling Rose and mimosas, pick your poison. Food was great, portions are small. Not to worry, it's still filling
name: Chastity

text:
This is one of my favorite breakfast spots. That sign on the outside that says "one taste and you're hooked" is no joke. I get food there every time I have enough time in the morning. It's my fave! They always cook my food right (or close enough), and they're quick. I call them when I leave my house in the morning, and my food is ready when I get there. It's also only a minute from my job, which makes it pretty easy to indulge on a semi-regular basis. 

I've never eaten in their dining room, mostly because I'm always on my way to work and usually running late. So, I don't know anything about table or counter service, but the ladies who work there seem to be very no nonsense. They seem to work like a well-oiled machine!

All in all, I love this place, and as long as I work downtown, I will eat there for breakfast.
name: Lisa

text: They had good service and affordable food but my plate I had something different when me and parents went there for lunch. I had this plate called "Decatur Gator" and it was small that came out with some meat that was very salty and greasy that was laid on a green big leaf lettuce and we had recently gone on a Bayou trip and we have seen some little gators swimming around so for lunch the gator I had didn't want to be eaten so unfortunately I may have been sick from that plate with my guess that the grease and the salty gator I had made me sick with just me going to the bathroom a lot and it's annoying every time I go to places or tours I have to go use the bathroom. My mom has her food of course not the best either her rice came out cold and not warm and it wasn't the best. Will not be returning here for lunch during this trip.
name: John

text: We walked by this place so many times and finally enjoyed the lunch special, which is two super pie slices and a soda for 8 bucks! What a deal! We ate one slice and have another for later. The owners are really nice and friendly too.
name: Pinkie

text:
Lawdy!! This place is on point. The Early Bird burger is big, juicy, full of flavor, and one of the best I've ever had. Upgrade to the onion rings if you like Crystal Hot sauce and try them out. They're not hot and are slightly tangy...the right amount of heat. 

The restaurant is clean and the staff are ready to roll our customer service. 

Come by and have a nice meal. I sure did.
name: Myles

text: This restaurant is a hidden gem the smells and food were awesome had wonderful 10 tandori chicken and the lentil soup was to die for! The staff was very welcoming and attentive highly recommend this restaurant
name: Jenny

text: We were recommended Maggiano's by a friend and told about the 2 for $44 deal. Our waitress, Lisa, was very attentive and friendly. She made it very obvious that she cared about us having a great experience there, and took the time to give us a lot of menu recommendations. The fried zucchini appetizer, chicken pesto pasta, fettuccine alfredo, and cheesecake were all delicious and exceeded our expectations. I would recommend Maggiano's and our waitress Lisa to anyone. We will definitely be returning!
name: Kristin

text: A very trendy modern decor with multiple dinning rooms and an open kitchen. The service was fantastic! (Thank you, Alex!) The four course meal was perfectly proportioned and the filet was excellent. For dessert: The donuts! They are to die for! I would definitely go back!
name: Andrew

text: Absolutely love this place. The server I had previously was awful but I gave them another chance. Everything was so much better since that. The food is amazing, lobster ravioli is to die for. The calamari is ok could be seasoned more, also didn't like the spicy chili's on it
name: Leesh

text: Went in for lunch and sat at the bar. Service was great and the steak fajitas I had were incredible and they actually cooked the steak medium rare as requested. I'll be back for sure.
name: Gary

text:
Very cozy place to have my first brunch in Philly. 
Food is amazing, nice display and great taste. However, I really have no clue how to start to drink my coffee since it comes with A LOT cream on the top.
Service was great too, very energetic and attentive.
Price is decent.
Good brunch brings you happy day. That's so true!
name: Wenjie

text:
I have been a huge fan of sushi and poke from the moment I've tried it. So I know the difference between a fresh high quality cut of fish or low quality. I've also been to almost every place in this town that offers poke & have not been back either due to location, quality or the ordering process. Hoki Poki stands out to me & is my primary poke spot for several reasons. 

Quality: They don't insult you with those baby teaspoon ice cream scoop portions of fish. They give you nice BIG scoops of fish, as someone whose focused on weight loss, having a healthy lunch option & feeling full is important. The quality of the fish is fantastic & fresh. The toppings are fresh, plentiful & delicious including the sauces.

Quick: I'm on the go a lot, I hate lines so If you're about efficiency then you'll love the ordering kiosk. If you're not tech savvy the staff are available and ready to help you. I've gone in multiple times and every time they ask me if I've been and if I need help. My pro tip to them would be why not write the instructions on the wall in large print, for the folks like my mom who would be frazzled by an iPad kiosk (it's truly the easiest thing ever). 

I recommend this place to anyone looking for a fresh, light and healthy lunch.
name: Magenta

text: The food and service was top notch.  I'd only just in special occasions. This was probably my most expensive dinner
name: Constance

text:
When you are in Philadelphia, eat Philly Cheesesteak! I had heard about this place on a number of different occasions so finally got to try it with a couple of friends. The space is pretty large with yellow walls, brown chairs and booths, as well as light pink accents. It wasn't too busy when we arrived and we were able to grab booth seating by the window. 

I decided to try the Ishka Special Cheesesteak, which included mushroom, sweet peppers, onions, pizza sauce, and American cheese. I am not a fan of American cheese, so I asked if that could be substituted with Provolone, and they were able to do so without any problems. 

The wait time to get the Philly Cheesesteak was minimal and it came open faced, piping hot, wonderfully cheesy, filled with plenty of steak, tons of veggies, with a tantalizing smell. The steak was tender, flavorful with plenty of tasty seasoning. The veggies were nicely crisp and fresh, while the pizza sauce added a lovely layer of yumminess without being overpowering. The Provolone cheese was delicious. All the ingredients complemented one another and the bread was soft. I liked that the sandwich was not overly greasy. Also, the sandwich was quite large and definitely makes you full. 

I also ordered their signature drink: Gremlin, which is a mix between grape soda and lemonade. This was absolutely delightful, refreshing and not overly sweet. There was a strong taste of lemonade, which blended perfectly with the grape and I enjoyed the bubbly, sparkling effect of the beverage. 

I enjoyed the cheesesteak here and am glad I tried it. I would possibly come back, but there are so many other cheesesteak places in Philly that I would want to try those eateries first.
name: Kathy

text:
Slow, terribly slow

The service has certainly gone down. I've been here at least 3 times in past few months and it took over 30 mins for a simple breakfast order. Wow. The food is good but not the wait.
name: Paul

text: A hidden gem on 7th St. downtown. Very nice decor, lovely and clean. Green Curry chicken was sooo good. The curry coconut milk broth I could just drink it. I will return.  I hope they are successful!
name: Becky

text: Ordered from ubereats, and I am impressed. We got a few meals and for dessert, I had the guava and cheese empenada (OMG DELISH) and the churros. Both were excellent. The beans served alongside my steak were awesome! Everything was good. Highly recommend
name: F

text:
A 4 overall: 3.5 stars for food/drink, 5 stars for excellent service and ambience

Who/When: We came with a large group of individuals on a Friday lunch time. 

Ambience: A nice open-air restaurant, with inviting staff, excellent service that offered great suggestions.

Food:
-On the recommendation of our waiter, I got the Love special margarita (non-alcoholic) that had red guava and pineapple ($4.50) and a regular chicken pad thai from the lunch special menu plus a salad ($10) (note: lunch specials can also come with tum yum soup, which the other guests were raving about).
-The drink was sweet, well-presented, vibrant and did not disappoint
-The pad thai was a bit too spicey for my weak tolerance and maybe a little greasier than I am used to. The plate size was quite large, filling and otherwise delicious.

Service: Our waiter offered great recommendations for patrons regarding spice levels (1-5) and food/drink options, and for that, I think this place warrants a 4 stars. They consistently checked on our table. I would probably make sure to ensure a more timed delivery of plates for large groups as some individuals had to wait an extra 5-7min for their dishes to come out.

Tips/Takeaways:
++Tum Yum soup
++Lunch special pricing of an entree ($10-12) plus soup or salad
-Large serving sizes and great prices
-Would recommend return every 3-5 months for that Thai lunch craving
name: Victor

text: Had dinner with girl friends (which I have often). Menu is perfect, something for everyone. Service was awesome. Kyara was extremely accommodating and knowledgeable. The best service I've experienced there!
name: Lauren

text: I live in Tampa, but Thursday evening I stopped into Brandon for some drinks with old friends and a little Christmas shopping. While catching up with people i haven't seen...we decided to take advantage of the great specials at winghouse. Your bartender katie was just delightful! She always kept our drinks full and although the bar had plenty of other guests, we never felt left out. We all enjoyed ourselves and plan to have our next get together at winghouse; we will be requesting katie!
name: Jordann

text:
Average food, poor value for the money, lousy service and poor cleanliness. Can't say much more than that... but I will. 
Was looking forward to trying this place. Looks nice on the outside, decent reviews on Yelp.
Greeted, barely, by the girl working the counter who genuinely seemed bothered that I was ordering food. Maybe I'm "spoiled" by Chikfila and Shake Shack but you would think the person they put on the front line would have somewhat of a personality. This was McDonald's level customer interaction, basically. If I wanted that, I would have hit the dollar menu up the street. 
For 4 strips and zucchini fries with a regular drink, the total was over $10. While the food was decentit was in no way worth that much. Even the Coke coke machine, which I usually appreciate very much, dispensed a watered down vanilla coke. 
The soda, condiment area was a mess. Dispensers empty, trash overflowing.
Never again. 
Should have gone to Habit Burger up the block...
name: Vincent

text: The seafood nachos and seafood fries are meals y'all. Amazing seafood cheese sauce over fries had me eating them nonstop and could have been a meal by themselves. Their signature GOON JUICE was a sweet drink with an indescribably good flavor. The wings had a good amount of salt on them but that didn't take away from the overall goodness. The staff was all very nice and helpful. Not a huge dining area so if you hit them up during peak times you may want to get it to-go! Fair pricing for what you get in my opinion. Would like to make it back to try other menu items.
name: Josh

text: Hi, so I have a lot of good and bad to say. The Kung Pao Chicken was decent, but the Beef in the Beef Fried Rice was so bad that it actually made me sick throughout the night. The fried rice itself was excellent. Just what ever you do, stay away from the Beef at this place. Also, the service has spurts of good service, but ultimately we sat and waited for about 10 minutes just to get the tab closed out... Didnt realize you need to talk to the front. Maybe thats my fault. I think if youre wanting some chicken or shrimp dish for some quick food, then this is a mediocre or even in some cases above average place. Other than that, absolutely stay away from the cheap beef that they use. I hadnt been sick in over 10 years, but Phat Tai's beef took the crown.
name: Salvatore

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The music was louder than it needed to be. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Will be back. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: I had the cannelloni which was very good. Also had butter cake for dessert. Very sweet but very good. Cake was enough to serve two. I would definitely come again if I was in Memphis.
name: Tina

text: Always fantastic. Hot and fresh every order. Maple Bacon is excellent but can't go wrong with chocolate iced or even the key lime donut. Impossible to just eat one.
name: Jon

text: Great food and fast service... fun atmosphere.   Really enjoyed our first time here with the kids.
name: Ed

text:
Their biscuit was absolutely delectable - flaky, tangy with buttermilk and fantastic with butter and jam. It was my favorite bite in Nashville, for sure. My salad - honey chicken, bacon and pecans was a bit bizarre. Picture a hot, saucy mixture of ingredients (great for a sandwich!), on a bed of cold lettuce. It didn't look or taste that great. I read the menu for it to read honey mustard dressing with chicken, bacon and pecans so it was a bit of a confusing experience. I would order something different if I came back to visit.

Staff was attentive and I never felt rushed despite the onslaught of guests in the place on a Sunday late afternoon.
name: Megan

text: Went here for our Sunday night Family Night.  Staff is very friendly and attentive to your needs.  The food is delicious and the serve adult beverages without the noisy crowd.  If it was closer this would be a regular stop for me.
name: Dan

text: I love this place! The food is great and beer is awesome!  However I am greatly disappointed that they are not handicapped accessible!  We had our service dog with us so we anticipated sitting outside (totally fine).... however it was full and there were no low tables for us to sit at with a wheelchair.  The staff seemed not to be all that concerned that they could not accommodate us. Fortunately there was one low table near the door that some one was sitting at.  The nice gentleman sitting there offered to move to a high table so we were able to sit.  Just unfortunate that they don't have more handicap tables
name: Dez

text: Worst service ever.  Pulled into drive-in and waited 25 minutes to get up to the mic to place my order (only 4 cars in front of me).  After sitting for a minute, someone said welcome to Checkers and I started to place my order.  He told me to wait a moment and he would be right with me.  Five more minutes passed.  No cars in the parking lot - customer in front of me had driven off already.  Woman behind me starts beeping, and we start talking back-and-forth about how we can't believe the service is so poor. You would think this would trigger somebody hopping on the microphone and picking up where things left off but another five minutes past before that happened. Meanwhile, I called their corporate office and lodged a complaint -  all before getting my order.  Not sure what they're doing in there, but it's not taking care of customers or prepping food.
name: Kelly

text:
Brunch with girlfriends is always a treat! This treat was enhanced by great service and great food. The waiter we had was a joy. The ambiance was beautiful and the art was a delight! 

The menu had so many options it was hard to choose. After great deliberation, I decided on the chicken sausage omelette. This omelette was made with chicken sausage, spinach, and cheese. The omelette was served with a side of home fries. The omelette was delicious!! The omelette had ample chicken sausage and spinach. The home fries were seasoned well and the meal was served with toss. 

This place definitely is a great find! If you desire a reasonable meal at a great cost, this is a place you must try.
name: Shirlana

text: Took 2 hours and 15 minutes for my burger to come out and the place wasn't even that busy. The service was horrible. If you are going to go to a restaurant like this I recommend Capital Grill the food is 10x better and the service is 100x better. Had a horrible experience with J. Alexander's Redlands Grille.
name: Hubbell

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Anyway, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. For the price I expected more than this. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
Fun and super clean place. Love the atmosphere, tall ceilings, and lighting.

We came on a day that they had trivia and it was super fun. We were able to get four teams going and the competition was pretty good, and we scored second place!

Drinks and service were all outstanding. The very friendly service people made us feel welcome and valued. The food is okay... I think they need to work on a menu that can give some folks who don't like vinegar or mayo a treat!

Will come again!
name: Scott

text:
Teddy's is a great spot to have drinks or dinner, they're busy for a reason. Good happy hour, friendly staff and fair prices.
Margarita flight is awesome, ceviche, burger, salmon, tacos are also very tasty.
Pedro the manager is a really nice guy, always feel welcome even if you have to wait a bit.
Give teddy's a shot!

text:
Zero stars.... many months ago I had a very bad experience and received the comments below as well as an invitation to come back for a complimentary dinner.

Recently my son and I sent an email accepting their offer.  I was truly shocked to receive a response that apparently they cannot promise anything better than what I experienced and not to come back ... so I won't !

I am perplexed as to why Founding Farmers would send me an invitation to come back and then tell me they are not ready for my return visit?

text:
The first thing I think about when I hear, "Greek Food" is Lamb, gyros and and pita bread. If thats all you think walking into this restaurant, you are sadly mistaken, because not only is that included in what they serve but they have a GRAND variety of food ranging from fresh fish, pasta, sandwiches, and plenty more! 
The employees are incredible professional! I was with a group of 23 people and our waiters and waitresses handled with care. They were kind and professional and knew what they were doing. We asked so many questions about the food and our waitress knew absolutely everything you needed to know! They were so easily helpful! 
The appetizers were absolutely splendid! My table received a 'small' presentation in which the waiter came out grabbing all of our attention with a. Very hot dish of melted cheese and shouts, "OPA!" And lights it on fire! Very Creative! Never seen anything like it. Along with it, we had squid, which was very juicy and tasty! 
The only problem I had was that we were seated outside and we kept on getting blazed by the sun in which our table had to move constantly as we waited for our food! Also, the bathrooms were unusually small and not so clean but I'm sure someone took care of the mess. 
This place takes extreme care of there guests, serves excellent food and has amazing outdoor scenery! Give it a visit!

Keep in mind she just got there less than 5 minutes before. I walked away I would not ever give this company a dime of my money. name: Mark

text:
During the later 80's the Keg had been associated with high level dining. When I came of age in the mid 90's it was the place to take dates that I wanted to impress. The great food, service, atmosphere, and most importantly, the admiration from my dates was worth the extra money.

However during the new millennium, as city grew in size and places such as Von's and Jack's built a solid reputation, the Keg's  brand appeared to lose its mystique when it expanded its locations all over the city. Im not sure if they went down in quality or that more generic places like Earl's stepped up their game, but the overall feel was not quite the same since the 90's.

Now that I have a family, and it was my wife's Birthday(and pressed for time), I decided to take her out to this place where it was early enough to get a seat. We must have arrived during shift exchange because after we were seated, nobody attended to us. It was particularly unsettling when we had scores of servers passing by our table and after we asked for service nobody had any idea who was responsible for our table. Once this confusion was rectified, things went smoothly as our server was attentive.

To their credit, the food was very good. I had the prime rib, my wife had the Lobster. We were approached by the manager who apologized for the confusion. It would have been nice if she gave us a discount, although I was not expecting it. Overall, it was a pleasant experience.
name: Thomas

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. The staff seemed tired but still polite. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The music was louder than it needed to be. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Pretty happy with it overall. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: The place is cute and the food was fine, nothing spectacular. They do not have hot chocolate which is too bad particularly when it is only 40 degrees outside. I ordered the select your own omelet with spinach, feta, and onions. All the ingredients were on one side of the omelet, the other two thirds tasted like plains ole scrambled eggs.
name: S

text: We came here to celebrate my moms 70th birthday. We made reservations way in advance and I highly suggest doing the same as they were turning away walk ins. We were seated in the courtyard and our awesome server Lee and his assistant Eric took our drinks order and brought us water immediately .  We all got the buffet, so we at our leisure to get our food.  We all enjoyed our food and the service was amazing. For $32 I was expecting a lot more options for food.  I was a little disappointed the selection and the quality of the cold food items.
name: Kim

text: My family ordered food from them and did not receive what they asked for. The menu is way too confusing, and the lady on the phone was not helpful at all and extremely unapologetic. On top of that their orders were messed up. Never ordering from them again.
name: Nina

text: We were really excited to try this new restaurant and stopped by on a Wednesday night at 8:15. Although there were still people inside, the restaurant was closed! The manager apparently closes the restaurant whenever she is tired and is ready to go home.  This has also happened to several people I know who have stopped by after 8:00. If the hours posted say you're open until 9:00, you should honor those hours and stay open. As a person also in the restaurant industry, this is not an acceptable practice at all. Very disappointed.
name: Barbara

text: Absolute best place for ramen noodles, no other place in Tucson can match the quality of the food served here!
name: Travis

text: Old stand-by in the Palm Harbor area. Noting fancy but good drinks, sea-food and service.
name: Dan

text: Fabulous!!! I cannot wait to go again. Food cooked to perfection! Sliced filet was cooked EXACTLY to my liking. Shrimp lejon, calamari were outstanding. Sadly, I'm a picky eater, I'm usually disappointed with food when I order out. Creed's was spot on!
name: Geriann

text: This is probably one of the nicest Vietnamese restaurants in the Tampa/St Pete area. The owner really did a fantastic job when he built it, and again when he expanded it. Lots of dark woods, pendant lights, and shiny granite. If you're been to most mom and pop Vietnamese places, calling them ahem "humble" is being pretty generous. Honestly, I think it's the best thing it's got going for it despite having consistently OK food. I add the consistently OK because at least you always know what you're getting. I'm a sucker for Bun Bo Hue and Bun Rieu and rarely order pho when those two are options. On a crappy day, I find the food bland and the broth too young (simmered for too short a time). On a good day, it's pretty good. The problem is all the GREAT Vietnamese in the area within 10 minute radius with whom they are competing. So why would come here? It's a good place to come when you're introducing a shy eater to food outside their comfort zone or someone who doesn't mind OK Viet in exchange for a really nice atmosphere. Kudos to staff. Always nice, friendly, and quick!
name: Sophia

text: My friends and I came here for lunch one day. The food was outstanding and the service was top notch! The hostess, Da'-Jhonay was extremely friendly and helpful when we asked about things to do in the area. Our server, Jeremy provided quick service and was super helpful when we had questions about the menu. The manager Tasha, was AMAZING. She was so friendly, welcoming, and provided an excellent ambiance. She went above and beyond to make sure we had an enjoyable experience in the restaurant. The food portions were generous as well as the bottomless mimosas. I highly recommend this place!
name: Alice

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: I always have such a great experience at Gringo! The restaurant is set up so beautifully and all of the staff is so friendly.  I brought a friend for her first time and our server, Zach, was so attentive and seemed more than happy to answer any questions she had regarding the menu, making a great suggestion to get the churros for dessert! Even the supervisor of the restaurant, RC, took the time to check on how our experience was, and we had to let him know it was fantastic as always.
name: Paula

text:
This review was initially going to be a bad one, but Juan (Manager) turned my whole experience around. 

The three times before my experience were bad. Whether busy or slow, they never have peppers and onions. One time I ordered off the kids menu and I didn't realize the couldn't make a child size bowl for a child. The lady behind the counter threw everything into the trash in a huff and made me feel like was a huge inconvenience for her. The final straw was when I ordered food and the cashier checked me out, ran my card, said thank you and pushed the bag across the counter for me. I got home to a "Hangry" crowd to find out that the quesadilla was missing. Hey, mistakes happen, I wasn't upset but wanted to be taken care of. Their initial reaction wasn't great, blame being solely put onto me for leaving without it. Let's just say I wasn't super receptive to that reaction.

Luckily Juan saved the experience and made it a good one. I returned later with my burrito bucks and Juan recognized me and asked for an update. Juan rescued three stars in the process. (Well actually 4 stars but yelp won't let me leave 0 stars)

To who ever owns that Chipotle franchise, Juan deserves a pat on the back (I would even support a fat raise if that is easier!)
name: Corey

text: Excellent service and great food. We went to the Bercy to celebrate our daughters 17th bday and brought w us a custom cake. The hostess and staff were super accommodating and went above and beyond to ensure the celebration was special. We will definitely return frequently.
name: M

text: This place is definitely one of my favorite restaurants in Santa Barbara! The food, service, atmosphere, everything here is amazing. It's a tapas restaurant and the server suggested we get either 4 tapas or a paella and 2 tapas but we were a little hungry so we went with the chicken and chorizo paella, the patatas bravas, pulpo, and vaca. Everything we had was so delicious and flavorful. I order patatas bravas everytime I see it on a menu and this was the best one I've ever had, it's crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and went amazing with the jamon serrano. It was a little too much food but we took home the paella and happily finished it later that night  We came here for my boyfriend's birthday so they gave him a happy birthday card and free dessert at the end which was also cute. Would definitely come back to try other dishes and the seafood paella!
name: Linh

text: If I could give this place 10 stars I would! They excelled in every area I consider important for a restaurant- the food, customer service, atmosphere, cleanliness, and ability to serve larger groups. Not only did Neyow's happy serve my party of 8 an hour before closing, but they also put no rush on is to leave. Our food was piping hot and just as good as everyone says. I ordered the fried catfish, carrot soufflé, and Mac & cheese with a Bow Wow on the side. The catfish was seasoned and fried to perfection and the portion was huge. The carrot soufflé was so interesting and tasty that I'm already trying to figure how to get my hands on it again. There was a perfect balance of sweetness and aromatic spices. I was almost convinced that it had to be candied yams. The Mac & Cheese was a big surprise for me. I'm not completely used to it being served with spaghetti noodles but Neyow's made me a believer. The cheese stuck to the noodles and overall it was creamy and flavorful. I enjoyed every bite and happily stumbled out after drinking half of the Bow Wow. When I tell you that drink is STRONG but good. I heard there may be a Houston location coming soon but I'll still make the trip to the NOLA to stop by the original because it's just that good!
name: Kayla

text: Went to Honey's for the first time on Sunday for Brunch with Shayda and a few of her friends. I was intro'd to the Pancake Bomb, amazing La Colombe Coffee, and soft, scrumptious grits. I thoroughly enjoyed the meal. Looking forward to Round two!

text: Man this place was amazing! First of all the inside is beautiful. Second the service is fast and good. Last but not least food it to was amazing and more than enough for two people. Great place for a date if you're a romantic person.lol

Price felt a touch high for what it was. Glad we tried it. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the price I expected more than this. text: Amazing restaurant. Love their Thai noodle dishand pineapple chicken noodle with their spicy red sauce with diced cucumbers.  AAA rated.

text: We originally visited 417 Union for the prime rib hash, which did not disappoint. We also tried the pulled pork hash and the chicken and waffles. All of the food we ate was delicious. The biscuits were light and fluffy and the homemade jam is out of this world. Every employee treated us with courtesy and friendliness. We ate here 4 mornings and loved every bite!

text:
My family came here to celebrate my daughters bday. It was nice some of us got the all you can eat sushi and some ordered off the menu. The sushi is pretty solid and comes out fast. I love that you can get fried rice as a side, salads m, edamame ice cream etc w your sushi meal. 

Love the lazy Susan on the tables. Also the decor is very cool. 

Service was top notch. The guy was on top of things for our party of 15. The all you can eat sushi is $22.95 pp but you can eat till you are full.

text: A great spot in Fountain Square for both drinks and food. The food menu does vary but the fried chicken is a definite get if available. While the food is good the cocktails are the highlight. There are cocktails for any palate. In addition to a large selection of cocktails there is also good whiskey selection. Always a great spot to wind down the evening.
name: Joseph

text: This is one of my favorite quick vegan spots!  So far everything I have tried here is great!  The shakes are amazing. The sandwiches are flavorful and can cause you to forget you're not eating real meat!!
name: Bernie

text: It blows my mind that Anthony's only has an average of 3.5 stars. The pizza and wings are nothing short of amazing! I highly recommend the cauliflower pizza, right now your probably thinking 'cauliflower, on a pizza'? Trust me - it is delicious!! The meatball and ricotta pizza is phenomenal as well! The wings are wonderfully unique, as there seems to be a rub on them, as opposed to a sauce. You must try them!

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was crowded but still moved along. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. text:
Always looking for real authentic Thai food and Asiatic Thai Street Food & Noodle bar did not disappoint. Looking in Ybor City Centro with a bunch of shops and dining options, Asiatic is good place to start your evening, maybe grab a bite before a movie or comedy show.

The staff is nice. There's beer and wine options for drinks. Plenty of food options for both meat lovers and vegetarians. We got a roti to start. It's a very small portion for the price. The roti is really thin, not like how I've had it at other restaurants. Also, the small dish of curry sauce for dipping was barely enough. For the price, I would've expected a little more. 

Their Kua Kai noodles dish was delicious though! I would highly recommend. Great flavor and lots of chicken and crispy squid. Tossed just enough so the noodles are a little crisp on the edges. Lots of green scallions and bean sprouts inside too. 

The beef boat noodles is a traditional dish where you can order on the water and boats will deliver your meal to you. Here it comes from the kitchen but the taste is still authentic! It is not very spicy but the broth is very rich and has blood in it. If you're not a fan of blood, this is not your dish. The meatballs were good and there were a lot of beef slices. Overall worth visiting if you're craving Thai.
name: Linda

text: I had the green falafel pita and it was perfect. Very fresh and light. Not rock hard fried tasteless falafel like I've had in the past. Looking forward to coming back and trying there vegan chicken shawarma
name: Morgan

text:
Absolutely wonderful doughnuts! We just tried them today and will definitely be back! My family had a mix of sour cream doughnuts, blueberry cake doughnuts and eclairs.

The prices are very low especially for such soft high quality products
name: Kim

text: Boston Creme was the doughnut of my childhood and I thought I'd never taste one again after going vegan. When a friend brought me my first vegan BC from Dottie's, I was like an animal. I'm serious. A client made an unannounced visit to discuss something serious with me while I was eating it and I just kept eating. I am embarrassed to say I check their Facebook page for the featured specials every day, fully willing to drive nearly half an hour to buy one if need be. They have some really exotic ones. Staff is friendly, place is intimate and quaintly furnished. Love this place. And guys, please bring back the Creamed Boston!
