A cheesesteak with peppers and onions with american cheese for me and a cheesesteak for my friend with mushrooms and onions with sharp provolone. We proceeded to wait outside with the rest of the crowd and headed back inside 20 minutes later to retrieve our sandwiches.


Yeahhhhh buddy. Time to eat. I'm so excited. I had fasted the better half of the day and I am ravenous. Basically foaming at the mouth for this sandwich at this point. That being said, at the first bite I was so disappointed. There was zero flavor. How can a sandwich that looks so delicious, that has people lined out the door at 10pm leave so little impact on my tastebuds. Maybe I should've gotten cheese whiz. Maybe I should've asked for salt and pepper. Let me know guys..did I completely drop the ball here? Don't get me wrong I will be back for more as I am determined to find a cheesesteak worth raving about.
name: Song

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way.
name: User

text: How is this place still open. The food is completely inedible and the place has not been remodeled in 40 years. The coverings on the bench seats are actually falling apart.  The food is so bad that the three of us could not even eat our meals. The servers look miserable like they constantly get hammered with complaints. I would give this place less than one star if possible. I would rather eat at McDonald's and I don't eat at McDonald's
name: D

text:
I've always wanted to try this place and happy I did. Hearing Talula's and Starr teaming up is the perfect icing on a cake.

Service: the service and ambiance was impeccable. I did not catch her name, but our waitress as well as other staff members were very attentive yet did not constantly interrupt us like some restaurants typically do.

Food: Salmon Poke for apps was just okay to say the least. It did not have flavor at all, and I felt the could have used a pinch of salt and more lime pulp to enhance the flavors of the salmon. For dinner we had the aged steak and the southern fried chicken. The steak was cooked perfectly and was so tender it melted in your mouth. The remoulade was deliciously creamy with the perfect balance to the steak and potatoes. I had the chicken and it wasn't the best I've had. It was cooked well but a tiny bit dry. The crunch of the batter was so good I could have had just a plate of it! Not salty at all. But I would die for the whipped sweet potatoes I could drown in it!! And the mustard greens were cooked with black eyed peas which was pretty tasty. 

Overall, great experience. Probably not worth the price tag with each dish. I felt that the sauces and remoulade and sides made the dishes rather than the protein.
name: Cee

text: Fantastic! Traveling in the area and wanted a good sushi roll. This place does not disappoint! From the cheery smiles and welcome when you walk in to the orange chunks to stop my mouth from burning, this place knows how to please. I had the Fuji II Roll but I substituted the avocado for cucumber and added some fresh jalapeño. PERFECT! I also had the cucumber salad and the clear soup. Both were very good. I will absolutely return when I am back in the area.
name: Jodi

text: BESSSST SUSHI IN INDIANAPOLIS!!! I remember driving by and thinking"hmm no way this is the spot" tried it and omg. This is the spot me and my family go to. The Louis roll is amazing!!!!! Or is spelled Luis.... shoot. Well that's the owners name and his wife works there too! Cutest couple  ask him his name then say "can I get that roll" it's delish!!! And easy to remember. The roll is his name lol. And the dumplings!!!! Are BOMB!!!! Def give those a try. Lastly the fried rice with pork on top. So so so good. Their food is so authentic and just great! Give it a try you won't regret it!!
name: Nicolette

text: This place has some of the most excellent Thai food I've ever had, including meals I've had in Thailand. The price is reasonable and the service is friendly. You can't go wrong eating here.
name: Lynn

text:
I'm sorry to report our first visit wasn't as positive as others had. We went into Soul Bear BBQ to place a carryout order. This was our first visit even though we drive past often. 

As we entered three people were in the back and one came out to take our order. We had reviewed the menu online so we were prepared. We placed part of the order and the woman turned to leave. We stated the remainder of our order to her back but she never acknowledged she heard us. We basically felt dismissed as she went to the back. Another woman brought our food out and just dropped the bag on the counter in front of us. We weren't feeling the warm and friendly service others mentioned.

The menu is what you'd expect from a barbecue restaurant. Ribs (slabs and tips), chicken (whole, half or dinner), fish (perch, Whiting, catfish) and pulled pork (sandwich, 1 lb or dinner).

Our order was three pulled pork sandwiches, two with mac & cheese and the last with baked beans. 

The tender pulled pork was a generous portion with lots of spicy hot sauce. The mac n' cheese was tasty and again a nice size portion. I was told the baked beans were good as well. The sides are a la carte and a large is $4.88 or $2.38 for a small order. All of us enjoyed our sandwiches and side.

Their open 7 days a week and  offers a Sunday Buffet from 11-6. Uber's Eats also delivers. Even though the food was good I'm not sure we'll return due to the lackluster service.
name: Wanda

text: Place needs to be closed down. Sat in here for 30min. While the whole staff stood around and talked . Literally no one was working.  Food didnt arrive until 10min after they FINALLY decided to work. Never again. Do yourself a favor and save the trip!
name: Margarita

text: Love the street corn, and they also make a refreshing margarita. I like the style of service, very casual.
name: Brett

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Kind of landed in the middle for me. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text:
The worst tuna sandwich I had in my life. Very salty and no taste at all. My husband got and eggplant sandwich which the eggplants were paper thin and full of oil dripping 
If you know anything about decent food stay away from this place
name: Ann

text: Cafe Olé is a cute cafe located in the heart of Old City. With as many coffee and tea options as a normal coffeeshop, plus an extensive food menu, it's a great place to get work done and camp out for the day. Weekends can be a little busy because they also serve a great brunch. One word: shakshuka. Hands down the best I've had in the city, and affordable at $11. The portion size is huge and comes with fresh bread to soak up all of the extra sauce. With so many options, there's definitely something for everyone at Cafe Olé!
name: Nancy

text:
So I served for 7 years... I totally understand the restaurant business. It takes a lot for me to leave a negative review but I feel our service this afternoon was ridiculous.
I understand that we walked in at 4pm, which is typically shift change. 
Things started out well, young lady took our drink and food orders. That was the last interaction with her- she then went and sat at the bar top a few seats down from us with her other co workers on their phones.
In any restaurant I ever worked in, we were not allowed to sit at the bar in uniform- on or off the clock. I think it's a great idea.
At this point, we are the only customers in the restaurant.
We never got a "I'm heading out, so and so will be taking care of you". So we were clueless as to who was now our server. 
After waiting 30 minutes for our appetizer, I finally asked a man if he could check on our food, he seemed annoyed.
Another 10 minutes go by with no answer.
Meanwhile this whole time, there are 2 managers sitting right next to us.
Not one time did they check on us, acknowledge, or apologize for the long wait, after I'm sure they realized it.
Food finally comes out- it was mediocre, not special.
Took us over an hour to eat our appetizer and burger that we split with no acknowledgement that we received poor service.
The staff was way too concerned with chit chatting than the only 2 customers in the building.
We live close by and was really hoping this place would work out, but with service like this, they probably won't last long.
name: Chelsey

text:
Was here with friends for lunch. First and the most important thing is they have a sanitary rating of 100, which means a lot and it definitely shows how much effort the management has put in terms of cleanliness and hygiene.

Let's talk about food. We had Chili Corn Pepper which had the perfect amount of spice. The Paneer tikka was super yum and do were the spring rolls. For main course we had Palak Paneer and Vegetable Salna along with Garlic Naan and all the items were excellent. The gravies tasted very fresh and flavorful and both sauces had their own flavors. 
And for dessert we had Double Ka Meetha and Gulab Jamun. Both were yum, but the Double Ka Meetha was just beyond words. It was extremely authentic and the best I ever tasted. 
A must try restaurant if you are around this area!
name: Lalitha

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. By the time the food came out I was already annoyed. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Just not for me. No big complaints, just a nice meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better online than it did in person. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: I love sushi and eat it around 1-3 times a week at home in Florida. This was some of the freshest tasting sushi I have ever had! When I want sushi and I am in town I would go here for sure!! Well worth it and good service !!
name: Allie

text: This is NOT real sushi. Do not eat here!!!!! Too expensive for what you get. It sucks. I live down the street and love sushi! Do not waist your money. Kids meal $9 ridiculous. That's just the start.
name: Charity

text:
This Mexican establishment is like forward thinking and couple that with service with a smile and 5 paws come to mind here. 

Great salsa bar, and ceviche!!! 

Boo yeah
name: John

text: The ambiance and decor is rustic and cute with accents of bright colors . theres not to many people so its clever that's its a few menu items . the mock tuna tastes like tuna and the salad dressing tastes like ice cream its so good . I got lavender mojito Kombucha and my mom got turmeric tea or golden milk . the shopkeeper let me try switchell which is a colonial drink of ginger and apple cider vinegar . she also posed for pictures with the kombucha .
name: Samantha

text: The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was good and came out fast. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. It looked better online than it did in person. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text:
It was my first time and the location of the restaurant is in what used to be Allen's stove factory. 
This place is a bit like ordering at a fast food outlet. You get in line and when you get to the counter you put in your order. I will advise those of you who are visiting for the first time that you will be asked for a tip right there and then when you pay. This was surprising & a little off-putting as I had not experienced the full service or tasted the food yet. I'd very much have preferred to tip after my meal. 

The food is tasty and of good quality. I specially like the red and green salsa which you can pick up near the drink machine. It's great to see that they serve Fairtrade Maine sodas which reminded me of the NZ Phoenix cola. Just beware that the salsa verde is rather spicy even for someone who grew up eating spicy food. 

The price is on the steep side with $4 per taco or 2 tacos with tortilla chips (some were heavily salted) for $9! 

Will I be back? Let's just say it might be a once in a blue moon visit.
name: Simo

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text:
Lunch spots like Bodega are my favorite.  Quick, easy and delicious. Passing through and was told The Cuban was legendary. It was.  Everything was on point.  Bread, meats, etc... No mustard on this sandwich, only mayo.  Hit the spot!  

Sleeper was the homemade lime soda.

Staff was great.  

Eat here.
name: George

text:
Like so many others have already posted, we too had a terrible experience. We went tonight to give it a try.


We were seated quickly about 9pm on a Friday which was a good start. After a long wait for a server, a waitress came over and her first question was did we speak Spanish. We said no and that was the end of our service- literally! No other server was ever sent over to our table to wait on us so we got up and left. 

The Spanish speaking waitress never even brought us water for our wait (we assumed she was going to send over another server who spoke English to serve us or at least take our order but that never happened).
Based upon the reviews of others, this is common level of service for the restaurant.

Save your time and just go to another restaurant where you can at least grab a glass of water !
name: Tina

text: This restaurant is painful to see.  It sells itself as serving "Israeli" cuisine, but everything on the menu is appropriated from the indigenous Palestinian, North African, Iranian and Iraqi cultures.  Israel being only 70 years old has not created it's own cuisine. Rather like they stole the land, they are also stealing Arab and Persian food.
name: Susan

text: WOW-Delicious and beautiful food. Croissants and macarons just like in Paris! A treat for the eye and tummy-savory sandwiches also. The Reid Team are food artists.
name: Cindy

text:
We've eaten here a number of times.  Never outstanding but typically decent.  Not sure what has happened.  Last night we celebrated a birthday there.  All 10 dinners were terrible.  My 'house specialty' rigatoni with broccoli was cold, overdone and unseasoned.  I ordered a bottle of Prosecco but they brought an undrinkable sparkling rose.  I told them it was wrong, but they still included on bill.

Would have sent every thing back and left but we had a large group.
name: Peter

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. My experience was honestly fine. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: This is a great Thai restaurant, definitely worth going out of your way to check out! The atmosphere is fresh and trendy and the service is top notch! Some of the best crab rangoons I've ever had are served up here! Great wine selection as well. One of the best in the city!
name: Jordan

text: I booked this room for a 3 night stay and was pleasantly surprised! I chose a 2 queen bed because it was 2 adults and 2 children, beds and pillows are very comfortable. Rooms come with a mini fridge (but no microwave; WHY!?) I was annoyed because the cleaning crew failed to remove someone's old Panda plate so the fridge stunk like garlic, thankfully I'm a clean freak and took my Clorox bleach wipes so I easily cleaned it up as well as wiped everything down in the room just to make me feel more comfortable.  AC unit is awesome also didn't like that only 3 towels are left in the room and 3 are given to us when requesting more so had to constantly bother housekeeping. Gaming area for the children is awesome also the shows are super spectacular! We will returning soon.
name: Vanessa

text: AAAAAAAAAAAMMMMMMMAAAAAAAAZZZZIIIIINNNNFGGGG Drag brunch. Chef was there the whole time meeting and enjoying with everyone. What a wonderful dining and entertainment experience. 10 stars!!!
name: Eliza

text: This place is so cute and has the best ambiance. The prickly pear frose is bomb! But, the food is always mediocre at best. No flavor! Bland bland bland!!! Dont bother eating here! Just come for a drink and call it a day. I've tried several things on the menu, queso... cracklin...  flautas... tacos. They all have something in common... bland!
name: Kristina

text: Stopped in here for a slice and really cool place. They had tons of choices but the jalapeno and prosciutto pizza was calling for me. Super fast service and received my piping hot pizza in minutes. Really liked the cheese on this and the spice with the prosciutto just took this slice to the next level. They are doing construction so if you do not know the place you may not see it, but its right on the corner of Frankford Ave. Definitely a place to checkout.
name: Joe

text: This place is awesome! My fiancé and I went on a Friday night at about 5:30 and got a seat right away. I was surprised by this considering everywhere in the Nashville area has a wait. You can tell right away that this is a family restaurant with a family environment. We got a margarita pitcher and they are really good with a great price. We split the fajitas for two and I can say without a doubt it is some of the best fajitas I have ever had. The chicken was cooked perfectly along with the peppers and onions and tomatoes. The flour tortillas were a great addition. This place is definitely somewhere you should consider going! 5 stars!
name: Sawyer

text: Great BYO with some wine options available. They have three front doors with some upstairs apartment doors in-between, which made entrance a bit confusing for a minute. Vince was our waiter and he did a fine job. He said it was his second day, but he had me fooled - he could have been a lead waiter for years because he was very professional yet warm and down to earth. All of the staff were nice. The appetizer wasn't what we'd expected (sausage and figs - pretty inundated with sauce with the underlying sausage tasting quite dry) but the entrees (Linguine Aurora & Pollo Avanti), desserts (cannoli & lava cake) and service were outstanding. The ambiance was warm, the prices were agreeable. I'd give 9.5/10 stars but I can't, so I'm rounding up to 5 instead of down to 4. Would definitely return again!
name: Carl

text:
Good food, friendly service. 
Line was out the door, but our party of 3 was seated in less than 15 minutes.
name: Kelly

text: went there today for lunch with my wife for the first time...horrible time we will not go back.Both of our plates came with cold food and i even had to ask for napkins...no thank you again
name: Terry

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Honestly, the fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Anyway, everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Also, delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. idk I'd try something else next time.
name: User

text:
Surprisingly busy for lunch on a Monday; I would definitely make a reservation! 
I got the pulled pork sandwich and my mom got shrimp and grits. Both were really good. The bbq pulled pork was the best I've had in the area. Not much fat on it and really good sauce. I definitely recommend. 
We got the cream brûlée for dessert, which was okay. Probably try something else for dessert next time. 
Our waiter was very nice and put a candle on the brûlée for my mom's birthday. We spent about an hour and fifteen minutes enjoying lunch. 
Will definitely recommend. The aesthetics inside are very nice too.
name: Elizabeth

text: My Cousins and I just ate at this restaurant while on Vacation thinking we will get great seafood. We were SO wrong. 1st it took 45 mins for us to get our food which honestly it's was not great at all..! Food was over cooked and with no flavor whatsoever. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone since the food it's overpriced for the quality of the food. Our waitress Aly checked on us 1 time.  When my cousin was paying and brought up that the food was over cooked she got a lil attitude with her. Also when she brought my change she literally just threw all the coins on the table and walked away. I gave it 1 star because I had no other choice, all tho the place it self it's really nice and a great place to hang out the food and service it's horrible. Save your money.
name: Stephanie

text: Really not that great at all, go to Giorgio on pine, la viola, little nonnas in the city instead if you want some real Italian food
name: Ashley

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. For the price I expected more than this. Food was good and came out fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
No problems here! My wife and I each had the veggie burger with all the fixings, then she had the potato salad (just a smidge too much mustard in it) while I had cucumber and onion salad plus the broccoli in butter sauce and home fries (all three were perfect.) Both of our orders and meals were served pleasantly and quickly by our server. Drinks were refilled quickly. So far, so good. Then our server brought out the dessert options... So much for staying on our diets (oh well-you only live once) I had the chocolate fudge pie and my wife had the pecan pie.

The number of vegetable sides options are decent - you get to choose between small or large. 

With all that we had the tab came up to a reasonable amount.

Service and personality of owner and servers make it a wonderful "down home" feel.
name: Jerry

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
This place is absolutely amazing, and if you think that Liberty One's observation deck has a great view of the entire city, prepared to be blown away. The glass elevator ride to the 60th floor is only the beginning. Every staff member is eager to chat and show off the area. Every corner is instagram heaven. 
Around the corner and down the hall opens up to a two story open view with lounge seating, and a bar, and even more down below. There is not a bad seat in the house, but the tables of four along the windows are prime real estate. 
The service is 5 star, and the atmosphere is relaxed without the posh stuffy feeling I expected. The food was top notch, and our server Flo was the best. We loved everything that came to the table. We got the watermelon and goat cheese salad & heirloom tomato salad to start. Each cube of melon (red and yellow) were perfectly stacked, each topped with a cheese crumble, and drizzled with olive oil. The tomato salad had a great tangy bite. Next, the mushroom pizza was topped with a perfectly cooked fried egg, and the fries with herbs were delicious. They have a great cocktail menu to to go with it. 
I can't wait to go back for dinner and see the views at night.
name: Mel

text: Walked in from the WWII Museum for lunch, sat at the bar during peak lunch time and still got our food 10 minutes after ordering.  We ordered some small plates to share and a few vodka tonics.  We highly suggest the well vodka, Cathouse Vodka, which we found out was a local vodka; better than Tito's!  For food we ordered the gumbo, shrimp flatbread, and fried gator, all great with traditional NOLA tastes with a modern presentation!  We watched the bartenders making specialty drinks and swore we would come back and try them all, including the Millions of Peaches drink.  It's a "must visit" place!
name: Matthew

text:
May I suggest: 

I've been coming here for the past 10 years since I've started Nursing School and I love it every bit as much now as I did then. But I definitely have a few favorite items that I just can't live without. Their wraps in the current order: Chicken Bacon Caesar Wrap (bacon DOES make everything better), Turkey Avocado Wrap (I had bacon. WOW). Their burgers in this order: Salmon Burger (add avocado to feel extra coastal!), Veggie Garden Grill (actually the best tasting veggie burger in my opinion, especially because its not greasy. Add onions for more texture and crunch--its free). When not getting a burger or a wrap, I like their air strips as they have no grease (I've had chicken strips since in other places and could REALLY tell the difference between EVOS and other places. The other places are still good, but I could taste the grease in it). Make it a meal with airfries. I REALLY love the sweet potato airfries and can't get enough of them with the honey mustard sauce. Last but not least, if you're in the mood for something sweet; their chocolate chip cookies are the BEST. They're made with organic ingredients, and ever since this location got the new oven the cookies taste ultra soft and gooey like fresh baked if you put them in the microwave 15 seconds in case you save them for later. Make sure you finish of the meal with a delicious and fluffy milkshake. I'm very partial the their cappuccino.
name: Carolyn

text: This was some phenomenal fried chicken! It's not overly breaded and heavy. This was one of the juiciest pieces of chicken ever. The meat was tender and not dry like a lot of other chicken places. The "worlds best" fried chicken comes with three pieces (light or dark) and a side. I personally got the Mac and Cheese, which also came with peas. Overall, quite tasty and enjoyable! The location is a bit out of the way. It's a good hike from the French Quarter, so I'd recommend ride sharing to get there and back. Supposedly, there's a line to get in and out, but we had no problems around 6 on a weekday.
name: Kristen

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The music was louder than it needed to be. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Great ambiance watching the sunset from the Fish Market. They have a great draft beer list with lots of local and small brew beers. Very reasonably priced beer and house made sangria. The smoked fish spread was really great! Perfect amount of Smokey flavor. Service is fast and friendly.
name: Jolene

text: Hotel recommended this place for delivery as I was stuck working and couldn't go out. Delivery was a tad slow so the pizza was not hot when it arrived, but that was the only drawback. Reasonably priced (hotel gave me a coupon and the driver gave me the same one, so I'm assuming that they are freely available), good NY style pizza (and not too greasy). If you need a pizza delivered, this would be a good choice.
name: J

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty happy with it overall. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
Went to Caleb's on a whim late Friday evening and I'm glad I did. It was a excellent experience.  The restaurant itself is very modern and is full of natural light and bright colors.  To be honest it kind of had a Apple store vibe to it with its modern and simple look.  Another big plus for me is that it's a BYOB.  What I liked Calebs did that most BYOBs don't is leave a standing wine bucket with cold ice next to the table. 

The food was excellent and definitely took me to flavor-town.  I had the salmon with white rice marinated in coconut oil, cucumber, mango, and red bell pepper.  The salmon was cooked through as I asked and the coconut rice, which I was skeptical on at first, worked well with the dish adding a layer of sweetness and texture. 

As if the evening couldn't get any better, at the end of the night they offered the table a complimentary mango liquor.  Who doesn't like a night cap on the house!  

Overall it was great food, service, and ambiance. I would highly recommend.
name: Gunner

text: My friends and I had brunch here this weekend, the weekend after the 4th of July. Apparently since it was a holiday weekend, the price of their brunch is $35 per person. In my opinion that is greatly overpriced for what they serve. Coffee is also not included and at an extra $4, brunch for almost $40 per person without any alcohol seems absolutely ridiculous. The food is good but nothing out of this world. Some of the highlights of the meal were the brisket, Nutella crepes (ordered off menu), captain crunch French toast (ordered off menu), and the waffle bar. The rest of the food was very average. The decor is beautiful though and a really cool and fun atmosphere. The service unfortunately was slow and nothing memorable. I can't say I will be returning to Sinema sadly.
name: Nicole

text: I was in town for business but brought my family along for the trip and we had done a bit of research for good reviews on a pizza place since we like trying new places. I gotta start by saying it was huge! It was delicious and between 4 adults and a toddler we still had some left over. It tasted great, flavorful and definitely closer to New York style than even places I've eaten when I've been in New York. Definitely recommended and would eat here again.
name: Tiffany

text:
Pretentious to the Nth degree.  

Although I live in Los Angeles now, I was born and raised in Nashville.  I am happy to see my hometown undergo a trendy, metropolitan phase, but slow your roll.  I asked for "four shots on ice" at this coffee shop and was told: "We don't serve our espresso over ice."  OK.  I asked if they had ice and if i could have just a cup of ice.  I was told NO again... I can't have a cup of ice???  OK. If you think your espresso is too good for ice, and you refuse to let me pour it over ice myself, it must be amazing, right?... NO.  Not only did it take 15 minutes to get A SHOT OF ESPRESSO, but it was also scorched and bitter.  I give it two stars instead of one because they have parking (a commodity in the Gulch), the pieces of dark chocolate were a nice touch and because even the barista acknowledged "I don't make the rules, I just make the coffee."

Slow down Nashville...you're losing that southern charm...
name: Austyn

text: The breakfast we ate here was really good; dinner was not quite as good. Too bad Moe the owner is such a douchebag.
name: Sean

text: Had food and drinks here. Great fun vibe for the group of girls friends I was with. Clam chowder and lobster bisque was delicious. Had scallop fettuccine wasn't the best but was pretty good. We had oysters they were delicious!
name: Sherry

text:
This place is located on the main floor of Cummins Station. It is great spot to grab a quick pre-made salad, soup, wrap, or sandwich. They also have made to order selections, but honestly, in my 15+ visits I've never ordered anything from that menu. The selection of ready made options is always so good that I just pick from the fridge in the corner. This is one of the only places in Cummins Station you can grab lunch for under $10.
On the side of the cafe they also have an espresso bar. I swear every time I walk out with my to-go lunch I tell myself I am going to order a coffee next time, but then I get so distracted by their daily soup selection that I forget. Maybe tomorrow M Market.
name: Julia

text: Went on a Friday night and it was full of lovely people and our server was on point!  I wish I could remember her name. We had cocktails, frites and carpaccio. Both were delicious. Sadly they closed awfully early and the manager would not let us treat our fun server or the bartender to a shot as they closed. It was still a wonderful experience and I will definitely return.
name: Melody

text: Just tried Thai Basil in Boise. Oh my gosh! Best Thai I have ever had.  I want to eat there every day! Their green curry and their peanut sauce chicken dish-to die for!
name: Rachel

text: Delicious fish tacos! The fish to breading ratio is perfect (good amount of fish..not all breading). The spicy crema and salsa fresca on top is amazing. We will definitely be back for more very soon. Thank you!
name: Vanessa

text: After a less than desirable breakfast elsewhere, Goat Tree saved the day! Beautiful pastries and fantastic drinks. I can't believe this is rated so low, it is definitely a 5 star establishment.
name: Becca

text:
The Chase Club is always our back-up restaurant to go to when the other restaurants in the Chase Park Plaza are full.  This really should not be a back-up because it can stand on its own and I don't know why we don't come here more often.  It's also a convenient place to go to after seeing a movie at the Chase.  In the warmer months, they have a great outdoor patio to sit at that overlooks the swimming pool.

He got the Chase Dip which is a steak sandwich with au jus and it came with French fries.  As usual, it was delicious.  I went with the steak salad which came out looking like a wedge salad.  There were tomatoes, avocado, blue cheese and a great horseradish salad dressing.  The steak was excellent also. No room for dessert since we had already had popcorn at the movie theater.

Would I come back here?  Of course I will.  If you see me there, stop by and say hello.
name: Joan

text: I had been wanting to try this place for the ridiculously huge Bloody Mary. However, since I went solo I decided to get something simple. I had an awesome local brown ale and their Hot chicken tenders. Everything was delicious! I sat at the bar and the bartender was amazing. I've never been to Nashville so she told me about some things to do. Definitely give this place a try.
name: Samantha

text:
I haven't been in Olde City in quite a long time, so while walking with coworkers during lunch was pleasantly surprised to see a Korean restaurant.. It's not your mom's traditional Korean restaurant, it had some modern/hip feel to it, and appears to have been a renovated bar.  The narrow entry way leads to more spaced out, dimly lit seating in the back.  

The menu was pretty standard of a Korean restaurant, appetizers such as korean wings, entrees such as bibimbap, spicy noodles, etc. I got the short rib Bibimbap for $15 while my colleagues both got the spicey soup.  Because it was a new year special, they provided a nice little rice cake soup, nice touch.  

Overall, the food and service was good, no complaints.  The portions, could've been a little bigger, but nothing.  I'd come again if in the mood for Korean food.
name: Tom

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. For a busy night they handled it okay. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text:
This place is so cute! I stopped in for their soft opening and again a week later. First, they offer decaf espresso. THANK YOU! Second, they have vanilla oat milk, I never want to drink a nut milk again. Third, they have soft serve. What more do you need? Oh a really great bookstore connected to the coffee shop? Yes, they have that too. Seating? They have a living room area and tables, take your pick. Lastly, they are kid-friendly. You get coffee, your kid gets soft serve. This is a win for everyone. If you aren't a coffee drinker they offer 3 teas, one of which is caffeine free. It's a rose tea and it's delightful. I really, really enjoyed my cup. 

I might be biased since this is right around the corner from me, but I love having it there. It's a great addition to the neighborhood and I love to support local. I also really, really love The Bookshop and I'll take any excuse to stop in.
name: Kristin Marie

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Ribs were decent but the cornbread was dry and tasteless.  I feel like maybe earlier in the day it might be better but not an hour before they close
name: Brent

text: Okay this review is long overdue. I have been going to V&S for several years. I am originally from NYC and I was searching for something close to New York City pizza (specifically Brooklyn) in PA. V&S pizzeria comes very close. I am so happy a friend recommended this place. I have tried several things on the menu and it was all good. Great pizza. Great service.
name: Nikki

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Price felt a touch high for what it was. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
First time to A.K. I felt like I was transported out of Tucson Arizona.  Loved the decor, the vibe,  great setting and service.
Had the wings for an appetizer,  followed by the Chorizo burger, accompanied by the draft pinot noir all were excellent.  
If you are looking for a special date night location, or fun place for a group wanting a "new" setting, I'd highly recommend this restaurant.
Although it is downtown,  it is easy access,  off the Link,  also has great parking.  I can't wait to go back
name: Suzi

text:
Great location and attentive servers.  I went with four friends and we all ordered something completely different.  Sushi, steak and vegan. 

I had the NY strip steak, which was cooked perfectly.  It was very good, the potatoes au gratin were good, but needed some salt/pepper.  Asparagus was good.

The grilled veggie platter looked great!  Definitely a good place to take folks with a diverse palette.
name: Aaron

text: Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Worth checking out. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food was good and came out fast. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was good and came out fast. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better online than it did in person. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Starting with the phone call to order my food, the young lady who answered Lanasia sounded very unenthused to be at work. Almost sleep. When I arrived the young man Stephen who (Didn't) great me says "Are you ordering or picking up?"  What ever happened to "Hello. Welcome to Wingstop'? I guess this is a different type of establishment who missed the customer service class. He then states "Phone order? That's gonna be awhile". Well damN! I ordered 10 minutes ago. Needless to say, I won't be coming back to this joint.
name: Rob

text: it tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It was crowded but still moved along. For a busy night they handled it okay. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Not bad for a quick meal. The menu wasnt huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Best authentic Mexican food in the INDY area!! Chili Arellano are awesome! Margaritas and assorted beer also!
name: Steve

text: Always delicious Caribbean food! Service is excellent! Prices are good. This is my go-to place for when I need my Caribbean cuisine fix. Having oxtails today with yellow rice and Mac n cheese. Awesome!
name: Barry

text: Great local business--clean, friendly, fast, courteous.   Food is great--and has been since they opened.  If you're not familiar with "Middle Eastern" food, just ask--explanations are always forthcoming.   Or, unless you have food allergies (like me, sigh)--just order something---it WILL be good!
name: John

text: What else can I say that hasn't been said? Place is amazing. Love that such a gem is right here in the neighborhood.
name: Stephen

text: We love this place! We've been multiple times since they opened and every experience has been top notch. The only downside is the parking but you can easily valet or park at the movie theatre and walk over.
name: Jamie

text: One of amazing steaks eaten. Philly cheese steak done right. Husband ordered a beef extra loaded with pepper Jack and I went for chicken cheese with blue. He loved his. For me it was good, just not a fan of blue cheese.
name: Silpika

text:
If you're a fan of beer and mussels, look no more! Monk's Cafe has both of these for ya!

Came here for mussels ($16.95), so we ordered two: Monk's and Thai Curry. Monk's is mixed with Allagash White, fume, garlic and parsley. It was light and refreshing to eat. Thai Curry had more flavor because it was mixed with Monk's Cafe Flemish Sour Ale, fume, Thai red curry, basil, garlic, and coconut milk. 

Each order comes with 1.5 pounds of mussels and a side of fries. The bourbon mayo that comes with is to die for! As for beer, I was able to get Pliney the Younger, woohoo!

Service here is lackluster, but we definitely enjoyed the beer and mussels!
name: Christine

text: Went here for the first time a few weeks ago when we moved to Tucson, this is my absolute favorite breakfast place now! I can't wait to go back, the food was amazing and the staff was so nice! If you're in town for a visit or even live here and haven't tried it, you definitely should!
name: Michelle

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. The food was good and the service was easygoing. We shared dumplings first and those were prob the best thing on the table. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. It looked better online than it did in person. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Very dirty. Cashiers have disgusting attitudes. Food thrown together and wasn't even hot
name: Janice

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. Also, my friend liked their dish more than i liked mine.. Anyway, they were out of one thing i originally wanted.. It looked better online than it did in person. So yeah, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated because that happens a lot. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
I don't usually write reviews on food places, in fact this is my first yelp review ever. But man... this was the worst diners I have ever been to. There was one waitress for about 12 tables. We received lukewarm coffee. We never got the waters we asked for until after we finished our food. I ordered a western omelette that was supposed to have salsa and sour cream; but guess what they had no sour cream and the salsa was old and It was poured from a jank bottle that was in the back of a fridge. Also, there were bugs EVERYWHERE. As you see on the photo, there were 2 bugs just on the photo next to our booth. 

The reason why I gave this 2 stars is because the waitress gave us toast even though we didn't even order/ask for It. She must of confused us with another table. A shining point amongst the many negatives I had about this place.

Overall, I will not be going back.
name: Jake

text: This may be the best bbq place on the south side of Indy!  Saw them on Yelp and Facebook, and we decided that we had to give them a try.  We are so glad we did!  My wife had the large rib tips dinner.  They were tender, juicy, and so flavorful that they didn't need any sauce.  That didn't stop her from using the Carolina gold sauce on them.  She also got baked beans, mac & cheese, and collard greens with it.  They were all very good, she said the greens were the best she's ever had.  I had the double burger with fries.  Huge, juicy burger with very good fries (I love when they put seasoned salt on the fries)!  The mild bbq sauce went very well with the burger.  They have several different sauces to choose from.  Just grab a bottle and lay it on as much as you like.  My wife finished up with some peach cobbler.  Their brisket was sold out, I'll have to come back and try it soon.  Delivery via Grubhub.
name: Tom

text:
This place punches above it's weight for this type of restaurant. The food is expertly prepared and the service is super excellent. Pricing is reasonable for the quality.

We went last night and had the salmon, which was perfectly cooked and seasoned, wings, an ahi burger which was also perfectly cooked but unfortunately it was a bit sinewy according to the person who had it. The salad that came with my salmon was large, fresh and delicious. The wings were the bomb too.

The cocktails were great.

I highly recommend Saguaro Corners!
name: Thomas

text:
My wife and I went here for lunch and it was mixed.  I got wings (fabulous!), and my wife got a pizza.  It was good but they screwed up the order.  
The good news is, the comped the pizza, and were very courteous.
Definitely come back here if I'm in town.  
Bottom line: pricey but worth it!
name: John

text: I was very disappointed in what I ordered!  I ordered camarones with trifungo and the shrimp was very mushy.  I seemed like it had been in the feeezer for over a year!  We sent it back and the waitress came back out with the shrimp and said the the cook said it was good!  Disgusting!  The fish was good, but the rice was too oily and the red beans too salty with too much paprika. The pina colada was amazing!
name: Dee

text: It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. The music was louder than it needed to be. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Will be back. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Kwok, congrats on your new restaurant. I haven't been to your place but knowing you and your expertise in Chinese cuisine, I'm quite sure that this is another success. Your menu is exquisite and yummy. All the best and we will visit you when we're back in Reno.
name: Alex

text:
Stopped in for lunch take-out cuz it was right across from my dentist's, but cross town from my home. I ordered a chicken enchilada lunch  combo, not bad, but when I mentioned I liked really spicy Mexican food, an extra spicy chile colorado Ranchero burrito was ordered. Hoo haa! Blew the top of my head off! Fantastico! My mouth waters even thinking about it.

Problems: I ordered sour cream and guac with the enchilada, but it wasn't there, even though I was charged for it. Plus they charged me for a two-enchilada combo even though I ordered (and got) the one. I'm sure they'll take care of that when I return, and I will, but check your check!
name: Susan

text: Slowest service I have experienced. 45 mins in the drive-thru. They have ratchet music playing in the kitchen and I can barely hear the cashier in front of me. Claims they have burnt fries and no chicken tenders. Get this- my McFlurry was even stirred. It was such a long wait the people behind me in the drive-thru started aggressively honking. Aggravating experience to say the least.
name: Avery

text: This is a staple in our weekly nights out. Taco Tuesday at Los Camaradas is by far one of the best places to get real authentic tasting tacos in the city. I absolutely love their Baja fish tacos, and the chef special is usually a hit with everyone! The masa fries appetizer is definitely a must try, and their guacamole with any of the add in's or just by itself is worth it. I have also previously worked in a tequila bar myself, and I can say that the tequila and mezcal options at Los Camaradas is ideal for both a nice dinner out, or a night out of drinking with friends! I can't wait for summer to come back so we can eat outside again!
name: Rachel

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would probably stop in again if nearby. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was good and came out fast. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: It was a work event to head here.  Been here once for drinks and enjoyed their infusions and herbs grown on site.  The table got started with drinks and I enjoyed the WC OLD FASHIONED that contains Old Overholt Rye, simple syrup, and angostura bitters.  It hit the spot.  We got some appetizers; including deviled eggs and hummus.  The eggs were alright, nothing exciting and the hummus was good.  I went with the chicken and waffles and thought they were nothing original, but was filling.  After dinner got a tequila recommended by the waiter and it washed it all down.  It is a nice restaurant and perfect place for a group of people.
name: St

text:
Divvy is an great restaurant with amazing cuisine. Great quality and a variety of choice. It can get expensive for dinner but they have a very good value $12 lunch offer (their sea food bisque is to die for).

One can also just so for dessert (e.g. $16 for a selection of 5 desserts, I suggest crème brûlée, s'mores, brownie and the peach crumble personally).
name: Thomas

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Would return. The food was good and the service was easygoing. For the price I expected more than this. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: I had dinner with a small group at Villa Barolo tonight and had a disappointing experience. While the waitress was nice, the service was very slow. It took more than 10 minutes after we sat down for her to come over and offer water and tell us about the specials. After placing our order, it took more than 15 minutes for the wine to arrive. This was on a Tuesday evening with the restaurant being nowhere close to busy. The food wasn't great with a couple of exceptions. The calamari was bland and the special eggplant appetizer had more sharp provolone cheese in it than eggplant. The seafood risotto was undercooked and the jalapeno overpowered everything else in the dish. The Mediterranean salad was okay but not a good value at $17 for a basic salad with a couple pieces of crab. The lamb chops were good though. We also ordered the Apple Tarte which apparently takes 40 minutes to make at the same time as we ordered our entrees and were excited to end our meal with it, but found out after having our plates cleared that the waitress forgot to put in that order and we'd have to wait another 40 minutes if we wanted it so we left without getting dessert.
name: Boris

text: Enjoyed the beef ribs for our great national holiday. Worthy of this great country. Great addition to the expanding Spring Garden experience. Recommend to any authentic BBQ connoisseurs.
name: Dan

text: My husband and I went last night for his birthday dinner. He really enjoys watching noodles making. We got crab cheese Rangoon and it was ok, the pan fried potstickers were to die for. I had hand pulled noodles with shrimp and he had soup with same noodles and beef stew. We enjoyed our food very much. We will definitely come back.
name: Zhenya

text: The cutlet sandwiches are seriously out of this world. I got the looch which came with long hots. Every bite just screams quality and fresh ingredients. I cant wait to try the "drunk" cutlet sandwich that comes with their vodka sauce. The fries were alright but their sandwiches can not be missed out. I've looked everywhere for a good cutlet sandwich in philly and finally found a home.
name: Gundeep

text: Always enjoys going to the Flowing Tide!  Doesn't matter what you order the food is always good!  My go to is the Tide Turkey!  Keep up the great work everyone.
name: Jessica

text: The food was AMAZING!! This will be a definite stop every time we visit our daughter in college.
name: Char

text:
These are the best tacos in nashville hands down. The food is phenomenal and the service is even better. In addition to enjoying an A+ avocado and chicken taco made with love, my friend took a little tumble in the restaurant and they took the best care of her. They salvaged her dinner, and were so genuine about her tumble it was AMAZING. You will thank me later for your visit to mas tacos I promise. BEST. TACOS. EVER.  

PS get the iced coffee and horchata and marg
name: Perry

text: Such a great place - amazing menu, great atmosphere, and wonderful people. I will definitely come back next time I'm in St Louis. Also glad we got to meet Angelique on her first day! She was fantastic!
name: Colette

text:
No fillers, just amazing desserts you can eat with quality coming first. 

Located near the spiraling staircase that leads to founding farmers, the bakery is located on the bottom. Very small space to gather around but this is a bakery to grab and go. Not meant to have large parties like a Starbucks to lounge around. Which is understandable as there just isn't that much space available to squeeze more table and chairs. 

Got a box of donuts with 6 different ones and man o man, eat them while there hot and you'll be on cloud nine. With that soft dough, you'll bite right into the strong taste of a fresh donut along with great toppings. The one with the icing on top was great for me because I like to keep things simple. I also tried the vanilla ice cream which tasted amazing. Instead of that strong sugary taste, it's subtle with the vanilla shining and a light, melt in your mouth bite. do me a favor and get it on the come, cause that way you'll get a better picture haha, definitely recommend.
name: Bobby

text: Horrible customer service from the second you walk to the hostess stand. Food was good but not worth the poor service and unfriendly staff. Will not be back.
name: Chelsea

text: We wandered in before the movie and the staff was very helpful and patient in explaining the concept. They even play a looping video explaining how to choose, mix and eat your bowl. Really nice for something quick, easy and different.
name: Rose

text:
I ended up going back because this place had gator so I wanted to eat it before I left. I also had planned to redeem a bread pudding but I ended up being too full. The waitress was kind enough to let me do half and half for a po boy with half fried shrimp and half blackened oyster. I did enjoy the fried shrimp. The gator was alright but that's not the restaurants fault. It was a pretty good po boy. It came with fries and those fries were good!  
Would recommend Oceana as they have a lot of unique dishes, well priced, and excellent service.  A solid 4+.
name: Daniel

text:
This is one of the best hidden gems we have ever found!  Woke up on a Sunday wanting brunch and not wanting our typical routine. We ventured out this way and were surprised to see this little "hole in the wall" restaurant. 
I almost don't want to review it because I want to keep our secret but it's too good not to share. 
The restaurant is run by a wonderfully sweet Polish family, everything is made from scratch, and you can tell! 
I could eat their bruschetta every single day for the rest of my life and while I've had a million versions of avocado toast, this one was the BEST! 
To top it off Anneta (whose husband is the wonderfully talented chef) brought us a complimentary croissant filled with Bavarian cream that we swore we had no room for in our happily full stomachs, but alas, one bite in we knew we would finish those too. 
Get off the beaten path of Nashville brunch hot spots and do yourself and your taste buds a favor. Come eat here! 

Wonderful service, even better food, you will leave so happy!
name: Hannah

text:
Kanaloa Seafood is fresh, delicious and satisfying. The service is friendly and fast. We tried the fish tacos and a poke bowl. Delicious ! 
You can sit outside on a sunny patio with a great atmosphere. There is also a cute coffee shop adjacent to the patio if you are needing a caffeine fix!
The tacos were so good we plan to head back today and try the other types! The tortillas were soft and warm and tasted homemade.
name: Anna

text:
OK!  I have ordered from this place multiple times.  The food is OK but not anything to jump up an down about.  My review is about the service,  Every time we get food delivered from this place we get the same driver.  He knocks as hard as he can, waits like 1 second then rings the door bell and peeks in our window as if he is in a huge hurry, what a freak show. 
He hands off the food like he is passing a baton in a race.  Already turned around facing the opposite direction and not even looking at you when he hands off the food.  I have almost dropped the order on more than one occasion because of this guy. Our most recent delivery was different, this time he did all the same shit but yelled "Hurry Up" just as I was opening the door, did his baton hand off and took off.  This is the last time I am ordering from this place and from the other reviews I am seeing not a moment to soon. 
  
Good riddance!
name: Bill

text: I live in the San Gabriel Valley and visit SB frequently and I always make it a point to go to Chase for lunch or dinner or just cocktails. I've been going to Chase B&G for at least 20 years. Have always had superb service and tried different entrees and have never been disappointed.  I have gone there for Thanksgiving dinner as well and the menu is excellent.  When the devastating fires and mudslides occurred this past year, Chase emailed their customers a comforting invitation about providing service to their loyal customers and new customers. I will be visiting SB in August and September and plan to have dinner at Chase while I'm there.  I definitely give Chase 5 stars!
name: Georgia

text:
Very friendly service. Our table ordered Black Pig, Gates of Hell, Inch of Heaven and some sides... broths were all surprisingly unflavorful and my egg was old :( 
Portion for price was a great deal and our server was really nice, restaurant & bathrooms were clean.
Definitely not the best ramen you'll ever have, but worth $10 for sure.
name: Jenni

text: Best seafood ever! Try crab legs- you won't be sorry. Sometimes a wait -but worth it. First place we go when we come to Santa Barbara
name: Gerald

text:
The service could have been better. The cashier wasn't very friendly. The menu is confusing at first. I hate it when the payment option includes the option to leave a tip--I have to stand at a counter to order then stand and wait for my food, I'm not tipping for wait service. 
So why five stars? The burger is unbelievable! The cashier could have called me a fathead and I would still have to give this place five stars. The meat is high quality and well cooked. The buns are perfectly baked, then fried? I don't know but they are unreal. I had the classic beef burger and sweet potato fries. The atmosphere is also a redeeming quality.
name: S.

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Also, no big complaints, just a nice meal. Also, the menu wasnt huge, which i usually prefer.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, tho the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Food took a while and didnt rlly feel worth the wait. Honestly, food was fresh and service was quick. idk I'd try something else next time. Not bad for a quick meal. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Food was fresh and service was quick. text: I don't understand how people give this place good reviews.  Don't order anything with chicken in it because it's likely to be so old tasting that it probably isn't even fit to eat. text: Really great Pizza, very Jersey-esque.  Staff were excellent, both them and the pizza deserve the 5 stars.  Price was crazy good too.  My 2nd Feraros' location visit in 10 years, each time I went way out of my way to try them.  Worth the detour for sure!

text: This used to be a great restaurant, but over the years the food quality has significantly declined. What's worse than the food, however, is the service. text: Finally, great Chinese/ Sichuan food near conshohocken! We have only had take out but had a great experience overall. Highly recommended! ....they are also a BYOB which we can't wait to try!

& The service was awesome .

text: The drive-thru line at this location is ALWAYS a train wreck, and especially so after 8pm. On multiple, multiple occasions I've been in line and parked my car for 10+ minutes at a time. Often, it takes me 20 minute to progress from the point of ordering to exiting. Sitting outside the drive through windows for minutes at a time, you get to know the work habits of the people working inside.  Needless to say, I've been less than impressed with the amount of hustle observed of the restaurant's staff. Employees standing around on their phone or talking each other, seemingly oblivious that they are the only barrier standing between me and my chicken nuggets + small fry.  I've been burned so many times by this place's drive-thru... why don't I learn? Why do I keep coming back?  They may deliver it at a snail's pace, but I'll be damned if I don't have my McFlurry at 10:30 on a weeknight.

text:
I really wanted to like this place. The concept is great. The fact that it's an up and coming place is a plus. The building and interior decor is nice. The service is friendly. The limited menu makes sense. However, the food (which I came in for anyway) was just ok. I like the sashimi option the best. 

A friend and I went there and ordered 6 items plus 2 dessert options. Out of 6, only one was ok. As for the desserts, I had the ice cream float option and it was just ok either. The cocktail menu was just ok. Overall, I wasn't wowed by the food and cocktail list. There was a lot of hype and excitement and perhaps that's the reason why I expected a lot and only to be just "ok" with my dishes.

text: Worst experience of my life tonight. However I must say the sweet bartender saved me from giving zero stars. Once seated it took 50 minutes for our order to arrive. name: Rachel

text:
Do NOT eat at the Deanie's location on Magazine St. They deserve 0 stars but I had to choose 1 to leave a review.

By far the worst service I've ever experienced. My husband and I went to dinner tonight with two good friends. One friend ordered a dozen charbroiled oysters, which were undercooked and not prepared to her liking. She notified our waitress after eating only one oyster and the waitress then notified her manager. The manager, Chris, lacked every bit of customer service. He told my friend that the oysters are always prepared a certain way and suggested bringing out some butter to "resolve" the issue. My friend declined that offer and sent the remaining eleven oysters back, which were then thrown away by the manager. 

Then comes the time to pay for our meals - of course they charged for the dozen oysters that were sent back. My friend was going back and forth with Chris, who at that point was telling her in an aggressive tone that she was going to pay for the oysters along with the gratuity that was included. She refused. Chris called in their "security guard." I'll call him Sasquatch since he refused to give us his name and doesn't even deserve to be referred to as a security guard. 

Sasquatch came over and we explained the situation at our table. In a nutshell, he said either my friend would pay for the oysters or he'd call the police and told her she'll go to jail. Guess what Sasquatch did? Called NOPD. We sat in the restaurant over an hour after we finished our meals while Sasquatch was "guarding" us and Chris was off somewhere avoiding us. At one point, our waitress even snuck back over to our table when Chris wasn't around and begged us to take $20 from her to cover the oysters and said she didn't know why he didn't remove the oysters from the bill. We all told her we didn't want to take her hard earned money and after all of this back and forth, it wasn't about the money, but how poorly her manager was conducting business and the lack of customer service. 

Three NOPD officers and a Garden District security guard arrived at about 11:15pm (we went to dinner for 8pm). The officers came to our table and we explained to them the issue. Everything else that we ordered had already been paid for with the exception of the oysters. One officer then pulled my friend off to the side so that she could speak to him and the other officers alone. The rest of us got up from the table - you know since we paid for everything else and were finally ready to leave - and then Satchmo began raising his voice telling us we couldn't go with her and we had to stay by the table. 

Sasquatch then formed a barricade to prevent the three of us from going closer to our friend (I have this on video). The officers heard her story, yet again, about how she only ate one oyster and had it sent back and then they looked at Chris like, "Is this a joke?" Chris continued to be very adamant saying that this is their policy... blah, blah, and more blah. The officers took Chris outside to basically tell him he's ridiculous then one came back in to tell us we were free to leave. And no, my friend didn't have to pay for the oysters.

All of this over $20. Way to display customer service, Chris and Sasquatch. You both thought you had some sort of authority - especially Sasquatch - and were proven wrong while looking like complete idiots in the end.
name: Allison

text: Was visiting Philly for a day and went here for breakfast.  Couldn't decide between the chicken and waffles with scrapple gravy or the blackberry bacon pancakes.  Our server was fantastic, she suggested I get the waffle with a pancake on the side.  Great idea!  Both were excellent.  I am a bit of a pancake aficionado and this was one of the best I've gotten at a restaurant.

text: everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would prob stop in again if nearby. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food was good and came out fast. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. text:
Love this restaurant! It's like a killer diner where you have a great menu and even the pickiest of eaters can find something. 

They have a full bar which was awesome for our party of 20! We called ahead because we had some high maintenance people in our crew and didn't want to deal with the belly aching. Pete made sure we were happy and kept checking in with us as well as backing up the server so we didn't have to wait for anything or have dry glasses. 

Food was killer!!! We had flaming cheese and they even yelled "OPA!" when the host lit it. So much fun even for a spur of the moment/ last minute trip to hang with some military friends when they came into town. 

Oh, and super clean! I peaked into the kitchen on the way to the bathroom. 

They have an outside patio and that is where we requested so it was really nice to be accommodated on short notice. 

Thanks Skidders, you guys are awesome!!

text: I really don't understand how this place gets such great reviews.  The food was ok but the shakes were terrible-my kids asked if they had been given flavored milk...that was the consistency.  I don't anticipate going back here the next time I'm in New Orleans.

text:

The atmosphere is wonderful. Small place, tight tables. Italy in the burbs. Five stars. 
Bring your fav bottle of wine. It's BYOB.

text: Every Indian restaurant would do well to emulate Apna Indian Kitchen. They have a limited menu, but they make everything from scratch -- and how it shows! Your patience for waiting a few extra minutes will be handsomely rewarded as you are presented with fare very different from the indifferent mush most Indian restaurants serve. A pleasant surprise and hopefully a regular fixture to come in Santa Barbara.

text: I stopped in here for a quick drink.  I had the sparkling Malbec, which was delicious.  The service was really good and our server was very friendly. I'm not saying that it's a bad thing, but want to give you a heads up if that's not what you're looking for.  Cheers!

text: the restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Service timing was efficient even tho it was busy. text:
We had great ribs at Bogart's - not fall off the bone, but more so pull off the bone, but not at all fatty.  For the most part, they do not come with sauce on it - which I like.  You can choose which ones you use at the table.  Pineapple, Regular, Vinegar or Voodoo.  Voodoo is great and spicy.  I used that one the most.

The sides left a little to be desired.  We got the raved about potato salad - which I thought was a little bland and dry.  We also got the pork skins and fire and ice pickles.   Neither of which were great either.  I would stick with the BBQ here and skip the sides.

Oddly - we got there about 5:30 on a Friday night and there were only two other tables taken then.  I was anticipating lines out the door and many food items gone.  I was happy that wasn't the case!

text:
Ordered takeout for dinner for the first time tonight. When I got there my food was already bagged up ready and waiting. When I ordered I was told it would be around 45-55 minutes until it was ready but it was done within 15 minutes so that was great. The lady who was working the counter was very friendly and made sure my order was correct. 
I got two dinners, one was with the bbq spare ribs and the other was orange chicken. Both dinners came with fried rice and an egg role. Both of the dinners were alright. The rice was good and the egg role was great. The only complaint I had was that both meats were dripping with sauce. There was a pool of sauce at the bottom of my plates and the rice soaked it all up so that made it taste a little funny. The orange chicken was supposed to be spicy but it tasted and smelled really fruity just like an orange which I wasn't a fan of because I was expecting it to be spicier.
This place wasn't bad, it's your typical Chinese takeout. I'll be back forsure to try something different since they do have a big menu. If I could I would give them 3.5/5.

text:
My girlfriend and friends stopped by for brunch Saturday. The current rating of 3.5 stars is HEAVILY underrated. Everything on the menu is locally sourced from farms around the area and plentiful of gluten-free option, which was superb for my girlfriend who has an gluten allergy. Food was PHENOMENAL. I got the Short Rib SOS and have zero complaints. The shredded short rib was so tender it melted apart in my mouth with each bite. The biscuits with gravy were amazingly fluffy and just the right amount of salty. We finished our dining experience with creme brûlée and chocolate panna cotta...all must haves! Our bill was under 150 between the 4 of us and we all got dessert. Really affordable. 

Bonus:: they have fruit loops infused ice cream that we just narrowly missed out on. They said they create various flavors every so often. Regardless, we will most definitely be back for more food...and the creative desserts!
name: Jason

text:
I hope this place survives. It was excellent. 

I think there used to be a factory over here that threw parties. Other than that it relatively barren. This little gem is hidden amongst the unfinished construction. 
The decor is pretty cool. Parking is easy. Food is awesome! 
We got the Brussels sprouts and cauliflower to start. Both super good. Then I got the mushroom salad and my wife picked up the meatloaf. I really liked my salad but upon tasting her I think she won this round. 
It's a little ways from everything I know so you'll probably have to drive. I implore you, try it. Multiple times. 
Only you can prevent foodie deserts.
