text:
Let me qualify my rating a bit - this is for the HOTEL not the casino itself.

Normally, I wouldn't be staying here since we live in Reno, but we were attending Brew-Ha-Ha and figured getting a room was cheaper than getting a DUI. 

We had stayed here in years past, and the upgraded rooms in the West Tower (AKA Resort Tower) are a definite improvement. We had a Standard King on a high floor and it was quiet, clean, and comfortable. 

The room was huge with a very high ceiling and a large window with a scenic view of I-80. We were next to the elevators, but the sound-proofing must be excellent as we didn't hear a thing all night. The new carpet, furniture and overall decor is sleek and modern without being "trendy". Clean, subdued comfort. 

The Bathroom was very large and stocked with a Kureg Coffee pot (the coffee was actually drinkable) the usual toiletries, and generous sized thick towels. 

The bed was wonderful. The perfect balance between firmness with a soft cushiony top. The sheet were silky, the duvet light and the pillows were large and plentiful.

The only negative was a lack of convenient outlets for electronics. There were extra plug-ins on the night stands and by the desk, but there were none convenient to the seating area - very minor quibble. 

The Hotel Front Desk and the Elevators are a LONG trek from the parking garage, but both are convenient to the Valet Parking and the surface lot on the west end of the property. 

I would recommend the hotel for the overall comfort.
name: Nancy

text:
City house is on 4th near barista parlor and 312 and many others options. There is street parking but you can count on it being tough to find a spot. There is a lot near by that works as well. 

It's an old house - but you can guess "city house" but you can't see the sign unless you walk to the side which is that entrance. 

Once you walk in you immediately appreciate the rustic but foodie vibe. 

It was our first time so we tried several dishes.

Liver toast - it wasn't too bad but felt as though you could even make at home. 
Sausage - tasted very good, but not a wow factor
Margherita pizza  and bacon/onion- yum! Perfect text in the crust and flavor
And then there was the meatball sandwich. I didn't know what to expect but I love Italian meatballs so I had to try. This was the highlight of the night. Full of flavor, well prepared, well cooked. 5+++ Stars. 

Drinks were delicious as they have a nice selection of cocktails and wine. 

Service was prompt, courteous, and knowledgeable. 

Would highly recommend and I plan on going back sooner than later

text:
Top notch Turkish Cuisine and service!

This review is for both Dinner and breakfast.
It is a pity that Turkish Breakfast is not as well known as Turkish Kebab. It is actually the best part of our cuisine in my opinion. Isot has done several things quite awesomely. 

I will start my review to their breakfast/brunch. We did a reservation for 10.30am on a Saturday. The place was yet empty. Our waitress greeted us with a smile. We ordered a Turkish Breakfast for 2 and cheese gozleme with coffee. The portion was huge! It had several cheese pieces- traditional khaskaval and more- olives, jam, menemen, borek with cheese and greens as tomatoes with cucumbers. It was traditional in presentation (with pomegranate sauce over tomatoes) and delicious. I just didn't like the small ball type cheese - which was probably goat- which didn't suit my taste. The plate also included french fries and pita bread. It is really stuffing even for 2 people. We also ordered a cheese gozleme, it was also delicious but we hardly finished all... overall the price was very reasonable ~40$ for this huge portions.

For dinner, we found a table for two quite easily on Friday night and the place was packed. We ordered a mixed meze platter, which had traditional Turkish meze samples as hummus, haydari, shaksuka acili ezme and more. While waiting for it, we had complimentary kisir that was sent by the chef. All meze was fresh made and delicious! Hummus had distinguishable tahini taste and haydari was creamy. 

We ordered Manti as main course, as this is a very traditional Turkish dish, and hard to find a well made one. This particular manti had real meat inside the small dumplings, quite rare finding again!!. It was seasoned with olive oil infused with mint and red pepper. It was perfectly tasty. The only critique I had is that it was really spicy for me. I wondered how I will digest this by the end of the night with my sensitive GI system and would have a problem or not... Eventually I did not had any problems,  thankfully. 
As dessert we ordered kunefe, dessert from southern Turkey. we waited 15min as it is best when cooked when you order.I am definitely not a sweet tooth but oh boy, this kunefe was sooo delicious. The cheese inside was authentic texture and taste and the sweetness with crispiness was just right. 
Again the dinner price was appropriate for this quality and service- around 65$ + gratuity. We really liked personally the hospitality of the chef and also very kind waiters overall. 

At Isot, We really felt like "home" and genuine Turkish hospitality.  This place lives up to the high expectation put forward at their slogan: "same taste in Turkey". If you are in Philly, looking for good tasty Mediterranean food in a cosy ambience, look no further, go to Isot!

text:
All in all this is just another Holiday Inn, but I can't recommend that anyone stay here if you have another option. Nothing was bad enough to warrant changing hotels, but I did not enjoy my stay here. The long and short of it:

1. Rooms. First off, everything (not just the rooms) has a certain smell to it. I'm not sure if this is just the air in PA, but it's noticeable. This off-putting start lead to my next discovery, the windows don't open, making sure the smell was going to be a permanent part of my stay. The fact that the windows were bolted shut lead me to crank up the AC, which I was less than happy to discover was loud and only mildly effective. The room itself (aside from all of this) was your standard room, with a smaller desk than most chain hotels. All things considered, I was less than happy.

2. Gym. The gym here is as small as you may expect, but it was obvious it had been neglected and forgotten. The area itself was messy, with trash in the corners and dust on some of the equipment. The equipment included a set of weights, 3 treadmills (only 1 fully working), 2 ellipticals and a stationary bike. All equipment seemed on the older side. There were 3 TVs which was nice? Seemed excessive for the space. Overall I was happy the gym was there, but it could definitely use some work.

3. Service. Check in/out went about as smoothly as expected, and the people at the front desk seemed friendly enough. My issue was that I was there for 4 nights, and they turned my room down for 3. Maybe a bit knit-picky but I don't think it's too much to expect that your room get turned down every day. Nothing ruins a hotel stay like coming home to an unmade bed and running out of towels.

4. Bar. As far as cheap hotel bars go, Holiday Inn Lansdale has a pretty entertaining one. The drinks are overpriced and the food is decent but expensive, but there's a group of locals that gather there that couldn't be more fun to grab a drink with. Would recommend diving in if you're here over the weekend.

5. Location. You're in the middle of nowheresville PA so I'm not really sure the location matters, but this Holiday Inn is within walking distance of a convenience store and a few restaurants, which is probably more than most hotels in this area can say.

Honestly, there's a Marriott right down the street, just give that a shot. Maybe it's all the same but it would be worth taking the risk. I would use this hotel as more of an overpriced bar than a place to stay, though I guess there aren't a ton of options in the area. It is what it is.

Overall Grade: D
name: Everett

text: After a long drive with a hungry family, we decided La Pina would be the perfect place for dinner. We were pleasantly surprised to see they now have outdoor seating. We have eaten here several times since they opened and our experience gets better with every visit. The food is so flavorful and fresh, not over saturated with sauces which allows you to taste the well chosen ingredients. We started with the Nachos de la Casa and I have to say, the presentation is amazing and sooo delicious! The grilled octopus and shrimp appetizer with pineapple had both sweet and spicy flavors blended together...a definite favorite!  I had the Pork Carnitas tacos and my husband had the Carne Asada tacos which we both agreed were cooked to perfection. We would have ordered the table side guacamole, but since we had that on past visits, we decided to try some new things. But if you have room in your belly, get the guac....it's amazing and fun to see it being made in front of you. As far as the adult beverages go, I really like both the white and red sangria. My husband is a big tequila fan and loves the array of choices they offer. He especially likes the Smoked Mezcal Old Fashion. Being that we frequent NYC restaurants, our expectations are high and La Pina continues to please! Family friendly and priced right too!!! Can't wait to visit next time we come to town!

text:
Why did I wait so long to visit you, dear Milktooth?  That in itself is an enigma not to be repeated!  
Milktooth has that laid-back, hipster cool restaurant vibe reminiscent of Bucktown/Wicker Park in Chicago.   If you want cheap, generic brunch food, it surrounds us here in Indiana.  Milktooth is not that place, and deserves kudos for its unique offerings and chef-driven (thanks, Mr. Brooks!) menu.    You will also pay more for said offerings, and should never rate an establishment based on your inability to recognize this factor.  Ok, rant over!  I can understand why MT has been nationally recognized, and my experience was no exception.   A diverse, ever-changing seasonal menu is what makes this place exciting!  
I chose an "of the moment" selection, white beans stewed in turnip top italian salsa verde.  It was amazingly flavorful and delightfully salty given the feta cheese and olive component.  A beautifully positioned, slightly poached (?) egg topped off the dish.  I truthfully could have licked the bowl, it was that good!  I noticed the gentleman next to me also ordered the same dish and left not a scrap, either.  
My server was very friendly, albeit a tad slow but the restaurant was full so I'll give her some credit.  The hostess pleasantly refilled my coffee without any hesitation.  
The restaurant's decor paid homage to the Indy 500 (see my bathroom photos), which is very cool in my book.
 I'm proud to say Milktooth resides in my town, and I am happy to support it!
name: Mandy

text:
It wasn't really anything special.

I was near here during a major snowstorm. This was one of the only places still open reasonably late and hadn't closed due to the storm. I actually felt kind of bad for the staff but business is business I guess. 

Although it was pretty cold outside, there wasn't any heat on in the restaurant so automatically it was somewhat unpleasant as we eagerly waited for our food to help warm us up. Of course, the ambiance was dead as we were only 2 of 6 people in the restaurant. 

I guess chips and salsa are not mandatory as we had to ask for them while we waited for our food. 

The food came out. I had the grilled veggie fajitas. The only flavor was the char of the grill. No actual flavor or character. Actually, all of the food was that way. No seasoning it appears...just char. 

Then the waiter disappeared for quite some time. I guess he felt his job was done since the food was on the table. Our cups were empty and we waited patiently for boxes to take our leftovers. Finally, the waiter came back. No need for refills now, just boxes to go. I would have probably ate more if I wasn't so cold, but we decided just to take our leftovers and go back to the hotel to eat as it was warmer. 

I don't want to say this is typical Mexican food because I've had a lot better, but for a restaurant by the mall I guess it's to be expected.

Finally found my favorite all-purpose donut shop in St Pete (after being left disappointed in the others - and I've tried them all)

Buyer beware: all of the donuts are built upon a plain mini vanilla cake donut base - on which the flavors and toppings are added. Some folks aren't that excited about cake donuts in general, but they happen to be my favorite. They say chocolate donuts are available on the weekends, but there were none when I visited.

Bottom line: LEGIT donuts with quality toppings. The small size (each is about 2 bites) enables you to try a bunch of flavors for variety, and I did not have a single "bad" one (and I ate waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaay too many of them). It's easy to skimp quality & freshness on the toppings, but everything, including the bacon, was fresh & tasty.
name: Thomas

text:
My husband and I sat down where we were seated and ordered drinks. It wasn't long before I noticed that the silverware looked "filmy" and just not quite clean. Not wanting to make a stink I switched my silverware with the set on the table next to me, only to find that not only was it filmy but it also had food particles on it as well. My plate also shone in the ambient lighting with dishwasher residue...which was oily when I wiped my finger across the plate. ~sigh~
After I drank my Blackberry spice Martini I had the waitress take away the plate, used my husbands silverware which I purposely did not look at, and decided I am healthy and probably won't get sick from these unclean dishes.
The food was good, and the staff was nice & friendly so there's your 2 stars. I however will not be returning. I cant handle the anxiety of the question....If the dishes they give me are this dirty, how clean can the kitchen be?
name: Jennifer

text:
Opening Day & they nailed it!

I can already tell you, this is going to be the place to meet your friends, before and after a STL Cardinals game. The bar selections and the food are top notch. 

I always judge a bar by their ability to make classic cocktails. Today, I tested them with a Manhattan and an Old Fashioned, two favorites. To my surprise, they were made with extreme care and professionalism. I'm tempted to say, the Manhattan was one of the best I've had in 2019.

Another go to for me when seen on a menu, is Fried Green Tomatoes. 
Theirs was prepared with a thick, crisp crust and the green tomato still stayed firm. Nice. The tomato jam and the tomato aioli were nice accents to the flavor. When reading the menu, I questioned the ricotta in my head, but was proven wrong. To swirl my bites of the tomato in the ricotta before eating, added to the flavor. 

I knew my eyes were bigger then my stomach, but I could not resist. I wanted it all. I ordered the Sampler Platter and got it all. It consisted of; 3 ribs, brisket, pastrami, pulled pork, turkey and 2 Smoked wings. Of course I did not eat it all, I have a fantastic lunch for working OT tomorrow. 

Brisket - Best in the city. 
Pulled Pork - Moist & Flavorful 
Turkey - Seasoned well & fork tender. 
Pastrami - I am in love. Replaces my old time favorite from Soulard. 
Ribs - Dry Rub, thick & meaty. 
Smoked Wings - LARGE & meaty. Not a fan of the tips still being attached, but I dealt with it. 

Sides: Mac-n-Cheese and Pit Beans. The Mac-n-Cheese reminded me of Grandma. The Pit Beans, were just okay for me, but I'm sure others will love'm. 

Service was top notch. Ben has recruited an incredible staff. 

Chances of returning? - Hell, yes!

When: March 1, 2019
Why: Opening Day
name: Steven

text: This is the best brunch in The city! It is unlimited champagne. The only downside is that it lasts as long as you have food but the food is so good that it is worth getting multiple courses! I had the steak and eggs and I 10/10 recommend this! The service was great and it's an extremely picturesque place!
name: Veronique

text: Amazing place. A groupon brought me here. We had both the baby back ribs and meat ribs. Both came right off the bone, and were delicious! For sides we had a baked potato, mac and cheese, beans,  and fries (all the carbs!) But you have an option for salad and vegetables if you want healthier choices . The service was phenomenal! The staff was super friendly and inviting. I would definitely return. Give it a try!
name: Jennifer

text: We had a great dinner at Provision. They had several delicious cocktails on their menu. My favorite was "Off to the Races" which was a bourbon drink. I had a filet mignon for dinner which was cooked perfectly. I thoroughly enjoyed the bacon potato terrine which was very spicy. Great atmosphere but prices are high. Great for a date or business dinner. They have outdoor seating.
name: K

text: The food was okay. I got the bacon and jalapeño Rangoon would not recommend at all..  I also got the chicken sandwich half steak. It is definitely overpriced for what you get. I would try it again definitely for bubble waffle and ice cream!
name: Seaairra

text: Super great!  Fell upon this gem on a Saturday morning.  Coffee was delightful.  Come early if you want to get in without a wait.  They were hopping!  I had the savory crepes and my husband had the steak and eggs.  Both were yummy!!  You won't be disappointed.  I wanted to try everything!
name: Kourtney

text: The gumbo wasnt too spicy, the food was fantastic. My mom had grilled pork chop and gumbo. Best ever! My son had a burger and fries and he loved it. I had the shrimp po' boy and fried green tomatoes and it was delicious. The decor was nice like a bar and dive mixed and you can buy the art straight off the wall. The waitress we had was attentive and friendly.
name: Tiara

text: Ordering for the first time online and checking with the store I order from not a good idea. Nobody knows anything the girl was yelling across what sounded like the restaurant to find out everything she needed to do. Was not able to cancel my order they did not know how since I've paid with a credit card. Absolutely no training nobody has a clue will absolutely never go to a jersey Mike's again
name: Jack

text: Great food, excellent service. If you plan on going there in the evening before the sun goes down, don't! I did send them a message and ask if they could by chance possibly get window covers, and they said they would think about it. So we went there last night for dinner, no window coverings. So we had to sit against the wall. So I guess if you go at night, get it to go.
name: Kerry

text: HORRIBLE SERVICE AND BLAND FOOD! Need more than two servers on a Friday night.  The food was sooooo bland and not good at all. Service was horrendous
name: BJ

text: It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The wait wasnt awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Megan was amazing.  We sat down at her bar and she made us feel very welcome.  She provided great drink specials and met all of our needs.  Fun, relaxing bar.
name: Tosh

text: Great gelato! Creamy and so decadent! The service, though, is more like 3 stars because if you're not there to dine in, you're ignored and that was amiss at this place. Guess they know their gelato is good enough to have people overlook that.
name: Jenny

text:
Update from my previous review!!
I gave it another try for this place and it seems much nicer !!food was delicious!!place looks lot cleaner than it use too!!
I was told the new female manager keeps the place nice I love Ihop and I'm glad the owners made changes for better
New manager thank you! We will be back
name: Steven

text: Our visit was good, enjoyed the happy hour. Surf and turf roll was awesome and spicy tunas were good. Seaweed salad had cucumber and was very good. Would have given 5 stars but they only have beer wine and sake. We had their sangria but it was super sour. They need add some simple syrup to make it palatable.
name: Justin

text: For the price I expected a little more care. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Incredibly impressed - Italian and Indian fusion that was very flavorful and unique. The dessert menu is excellent and we've already made this our go-to spot for dessert and wine (once they get their license very soon)!
name: Kristin

text: An amazing place! The build your own Charcuterie is the best I've ever had! The Cuba, Missouri sandwich is phenomenal also!
name: Kelley

text: This place was right next to our hotel and had a great assortment of coffees and teas. We were impressed with the decor and feel of the restaurant. Food was a good portion and we shared a lot of different entrees! Had a wonderful time!
name: Michael

text: I dont want to compare one mexican restraunt to another....El Jalapeno is nicely located just off 465 an 31 ....I tried the mexican  chicken soup....big bowl full of tender shredded chicken and a plate of cilantro onion avocado an diced tomato .....add all those to the soup made my taste buds happy as can be .....Two thumbs up ....good food good service
name: David

text: This market is amazing!  They have fresh homemade pasta, dessert bar, ready made real Italian food, large cheese selection, and a huge wine selection. They have everything you'd need to make a Italian meal.
name: Eileen

text: Ive heard about this place for years but never stopped by till today. I have been missing out on authentic mexican food. I ordered 2 steak tacos and a mini chicken quesadilla. So far i only ate the quesadilla...I WAS STUFFED!!! They don't skimp on the fixins! So hearty and filling. I'm sure the steak tacos will be amazing
name: Erica

text: So I came here because it was on a list of places to go for gumbo, but what really blew me away here was the service. the woman who was serving us was phenomenal ! to the recommendation to the patience and going the extra mile and taking our photo for us. at first i was confused coming in because this place is on bourbon st but does not fit (sooo much more classier) and they take their time giving you the menu after sitting you to take in the atmosphere. the food (although i couldn't eat much at the time) is really good. the gumbo was not bad (pretty small for $8) but what really blew us away was the crab and the fish!! my sister really loved her speckled trout with almonds and my crab was very tasty (not fishy) ! overall, we really had a good time here (although it was on the pricier side)- spent a little under $100 for the both of us (two entrees, one appetizer and one drink) but the service was well worth it!
name: Sue

text:
The first time I had the noodles here it was good. I would've given it 4 star. However the second time when I was here, the waitress was extremely rude. We won't given utensils and water, so I asked for utensils, and the lady turned around looking at me impatiently and said "don't you see I'm already getting them?"

I was a bit shocked and couldn't react to it, but that completely ruined my second experience here. I wish I had found out that waitress's name. I couldn't taste the noodles the second time and they don't taste as good as I remembered it. Probably also because it's has been filtered by the terrible attitude.
name: Jing

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The staff seemed tired but still polite. A couple small things kept adding up. Probably not coming back. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Came here to play some pool and had a great time! Got a couple of PBRs for less than $5. Played a couple canes of pool, like $1.25 a piece but $10 for 10. Cool atmosphere, loved it!
name: Leigh

text:
This used to be my favorite place to go in Dunedin when I lived there. My parents had their wedding reception here. I recently went back to meet up with my parents are was somewhat disappointed. The atmosphere is still AMAZING as I remembered it. The view, the pool, the decor, etc. I was disappointed in the food, drinks, and service. We went on Friday 2/23/18 and it was packed. Upon arriving, valet staff was not friendly, no greeting. When walking to the host stand, again no greeting. All the hostess said was "reservation?" we said no, and just proceeded to the open seating area and the hostess was very confused by that. Our server, a young blonde guy was nice but not personable. The food was mediocre as well. We had the calamari, which is served with thin fried onion rings. We ended up having way more onion rings than calamari.

All in all, this place just isn't as good as it used to be. The atmosphere is excellent though. I would go back again, but I just need to accept the service and food I am going to receive.
name: Derek

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nice little spot, decent portions too. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text:
Fairly crowded for a lunchtime on a Wednesday.  About a fifteen minute wait at noon which was unexpected as most places in the Bala area that are normally not that crowded.  

Ended up getting the corned beef sandwich and nova lox on everything bagel.  The nova lox was incredibly salty which didn't hamper the flavor only enhanced it.  The corned beef sandwich was excellent as well.  There is a free pickle and premade salad bar.  There were sliced pickles, whole pickles, spears and also brined cucumbers.  On the salad front they had a non cream (vinegar) based cole slaw.  They also had potato salad which was good and macaroni salad which I dot not try along with a couple other choices.  Salads/pickles are free if you eat in but are around $5.99/lb if you are taking out.  Well worth the dining in experience.
name: Matt

text: All I can say is wow. If you are in the mood for some wonderful sweets this is the place to go. The atmosphere is nice and quiet, perfect for a romantic date or a girls night out. The food is stellar. I had the blondie brownie and ice cream, it was so sweet and the brownie that wonderful combo of crisp but soft on the inside. Their drinks are strong but well made, they have a decent bourbon and rye selection. The staff are all attentive and charming.
name: Susan

text: Omg huuuugeeeeee pizza!!!! Totally will try that challenge soon!!! Price are great and so is the staff
name: Nina

text: I've never had Filipino food before, but having had many other types of Asian food, this place was quite good. I got a pork belly dish and fried okra my first time in and on my return trip, I tried the flying pig. Both were excellent and I would recommend both of them. I also really liked the calamansi cooler as a drink. It was unique and had a citrus flavor that was very refreshing but not too strong. It's also pretty reasonably priced, and has a very chill atmosphere.
name: Nathan

text: We visited Cafe Beginet at 7AM on a Saturday and had a wonderful experience. Our family had a few orders of beignets, omelettes, fruit cups, lattes, and chocolate milk, and it was all wonderful. My husband tried to go back later this week while still in New Orleans for his conference, and the line was out the door, with good reason. Delicious food and friendly staff make this a place to stop in the city. My kids also talked about Sammy the cat for the rest of the day!
name: Stephanie

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. Price felt a touch high for what it was. It was crowded but still moved along. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. For a busy night they handled it okay. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: Always a great meal. Been to all of their locations and each has a different vibe. All good across the board. Great food, friendly service and fun atmosphere.
name: Larry

text: Was excited when this place essentially reopened, basically same stuff as last burger joint that was here.  Been here three times first time was great, missed this spot!! and was like heck yeah got that good burger joint back!!! The burger was good fries nice and salty, with that signature sauce and fried onions awesome!!!  But last two times burgers were hockey pucks!!!  Way over cooked, onion still had skin on it one of the times, and honestly was a bit worried at the lack of attention to detail.  Its a burger guys c'mon!!  Having worked in kitchens if your missing simple things like this what other things are you all not paying attention too? (hygiene wise) and not saying I noticed anything like that ya'll but something to consider your customer will take notice on.  I'll try it again but only cause I'm hoping Nolesnville will have that burger spot we like to hit up twice if not three times a month.  But its gotta be good otherwise we're hitting up the chains.
name: Food

text: OMG this is my favorite place to eat for comfort food. All the food is customizable and it tastes amazing! Must go to. People are super nice and it's very clean.
name: Brittany

text: Love Chick-fil-A!  Great location and excellent customer service.  The food is always fresh, fast, and delicious.  I highly recommend this location and visit often.
name: Gregory

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. My experience was honestly fine. Food was fresh and service was quick. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Definitely coming back.
name: User

text: Awesome! We had a party of about 15! and they were great! Beer / Service were great! Plus the Pizza was perfect! Thanks Albert :)
name: Nick

text: We came to Tampa for my sons 16th bday and since our AirBNB wasn't ready yet, the owner suggested coming here to wait. I ordered a Thai Iced tea which was delicious but a bit pricey. I think it was 5.99 or something. The ambience was nice and they had live music which some may like while others might be annoyed by it. There was also a selection of baked goods.
name: Angela

text: This is an amazing find and delicious breakfast and they have a breakfast happy hour!!! Serve is outstanding we will definitely return when in town
name: Heidi

text:
A few co-workers of mine  recommended this place.  So I decided to give this place a try.  So I placed an order through the  Grubhub  App. I ordered the  Boneless Fried Catfish Fillets, Fresh Fried Corn (I did get corn but it wasn't the fresh fried corn like I'd ordered ) and Sweet Potatoes $13.99. I also ordered the  Fried Duck Wings with a Citrus-Chipotle BBQ  sauce ( which tasted like Sweet Baby Ray's Sauce) $6.99.  My food arrived not long after my order and it was still pretty hot. 
The yams were  delicious and the catfish was perfectly cooked. Although the catfish  was well cooked  it was a little salty  for me. The duck wings were pretty good also.  Overall I enjoyed the food.
name: James

text:
This food truck is awesome! We loved all of our sliders, especially the Americano one. We came starving and were worried sliders wouldn't fill us up, but wow -- just two sliders really hit the spot and we were so happy & stuffed! We also LOVED the covered tent to eat in. It was drizzling on and off when we visited, so the tent was perfect. Also, who doesn't love having the option of Netflix while you eat?! Super cool place! Two of us got the mac n cheese side and it was definitely one of the best any of us ever had! Soooo good. 

I really hope this place continues to do well & we will definitely come back to eat here whenever we're in Nashville!
name: Nicole

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. Also, the menu wasn't huge, which i usually prefer.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. For a busy night they handled it okay. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Best pizza ! I'm not a person that craves pizza, but I can eat from here anytime !!!! The chicken wings are amazing as well. Doesn't matter what you order, you will like it!
name: Lacey

text: Came for breakfast on a Sunday and waited for over an hour to get breakfast for two.  The establishment wasn't even busy, there wasn't a wait for tables, and there were tables empty the entire time.  Despite this and having around 20 employees working, we and many others sat for over an hour waiting go eat.
name: Emily

text:
I always looking for a good burger so I tried Belly Burger because Yelp gave the a 4 Star rating.  I ordered the Cheeseburger Combo and substituted
Onion Rings instead of fries (a $2.50 upcharge).  The burger was average
but was barely luke warm when they brought it to my table.  My final comment... I gave them a try but I won't be returning.
name: Dennis

text:
The waitress and the other employees were extremely rude and were all over the place. I observed other customers concerned the same way I was.

Furthermore, my girlfriend and I ordered burgers and fries, which all tasted very dry, outdated, and almost has that "microwaved" mushy taste. I brought the concern to the waitress but she rolled her eyes at me and said "Really?" as she turned her back on me as I addressed my concerns.

There is a reason why the restaurant has that "Help Wanted" sign because no one looks happy to be there!
name: Andy

text:
I might be addicted to Poke King... 
Its name is totally fitting, it is the KING of all poke.
I've tried a couple other Poke places in town but none of them live up to Poke King.

I always get a regular bowl with white rice. By the way, I LOVE that the rice is warm.

Next you add the protein... my favorite is salmon and tuna. I always do two scoops of the salmon and one scoop of tuna. They also have a spicy tuna option if you'd like a little kick to it. Their fish always tastes fresh, I've never had any issues with it.

Now it's time to decide what sauce to get. I ALWAYS order unagi and spicy mayo with green onions. They mix it all up with your protein then they add it on top of the rice. 

Last but not least, add your toppings!! I get cucumber, crab salad, sesame seed, then top it off with more spicy mayo. I love that they don't charge you extra for toppings like other places. 

They also have avocado as an option for extra $, but to be honest, their avocado is the one item that never looks good. It always has a tint of brown to it, so I skip it. 

The best part? They have a reward system where when you build up enough points and can get a large poke bowl FREE!
name: Katherine

text: By far is the best restaurant in New Orleans. Ambiance, service, food, drinks, and dessert. Unbelievable. Congrats. I hope to come again to visit you.
name: Moises

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The food was good and the service was easygoing. A very pleasant experience. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Great food and very good service. I recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting or local of Florida. Met up with a few out of town friends and they truly enjoyed the food and service as well. The restaurant was very busy considering a 100 person party walked in and yet the food was prepared right, hot, and came to the table without waiting too long. Cocktail choices are a lot to choose from and reasonably priced. Went there on a Wednesday and a live band was playing. Really good restaurant conveniently located.
name: Paul

text: This was the best restaurant we found in New Orleans. Sadly, we found it on the last day of our trip. Was reasonably priced, great atmosphere, nice outdoor area, friendly service, and amazing food.
name: Unhappy

text: There's no way to define the cuisine here except awesome.  We gave our waiter the keys and he curated a great meal.  Apps from fried pork loin fries to oysters and charcuterie.  Mains included brisket, lamb chops and shrimp and grits.  Great bourbon selection as well.
name: Ryan

text:
Delicious food! We walked in on a Sunday night around 7 and there were only a handful of people there. I think just because it's so new. 

Drinks: we ordered sangria and ginger lemonade (non alcoholic). Both were very good. 

Food: kale Caesar. Had cornbread croutons that were amazing. Shrimp tacos that were even more amazing. Big hunks of avocados. Pickled red cabbage that added the perfect sweetness. 

Would give 4.5 stars if i could. Since there weren't many other customers, the food came very fast which made the experience feel a bit rushed. And one entree came out about five minutes before the other which was odd. But overall, great and will definitely return.
name: Kate

text: Ordered two chicago dogs. I received them within seven minutes. They were on the proper poppy seed buns with vienna franks. They were good. This is a family run business. They were friendly and the prices were resonable. I would eat here again and try other items
name: C.

text: I've only tried this place out twice and I've enjoyed their food both times. Today I got the Gobbler Panini that comes with peppered turkey, feta, artichoke hearts and sun dried tomato mayo. I ordered mine without the artichoke hearts, just because I'm not a big fan, but the panini was still great overall! It comes fresh and warm and served with your choice of side, I ordered the potato salad. The panini has a great taste to it, the melted feta and the sun dried tomato mayo was delicious. The bread that it's served on soft and has an abundance of flavor to it. I'd definitely recommend this place
name: Rose

text: We stopped in for lunch and we were not disappointed. The nachos are a great way to start a meal with the table or would be fine as a meal on their own. I ordered the Wedge Salad. It was one of the best salads I've had. The food was very fresh and they presentation was wonderful. The food was the perfect amount. Their Raspberry Cider was the perfect pairing with the salad.
name: Rachel

text: Can't say enough good things about this place. Small, intimate and cozy. Love the verbal menu. As for the food, simply outstanding. Will definitely be returning. Owner comes around to each and every table to welcome guests and ask if all is good. A must for anyone visiting the area!
name: Ed

text:
This is the best kept secret of New Orleans. This hole in the wall has something called All that Jazz poo'boy Shrimp sandwich to die for. Just loved it! No one else comes even close to what they have to offer. 

Ps. I believe I did post this by mistake for some other one named Sports bar or so that I thought was this but once you write something on yelp you can't delete.
name: Saam

text: Had lunch here with a gf, and we really enjoyed it. You can sit at the sushi bar, at a table, or a booth. Service was efficient and attentive, and the prices were reasonable. We ordered alot, and shared it. So here's what we got: tuna tataki, Kalbi short ribs (with sushi rice, stir fried beansprouts, and salad with carrot ginger dressing), volcano roll, spider roll, and eel roll, with tea, all this for $49. All was very good, but what stood out like a shining star was the delicious perfectly cooked and seasoned Kalbi short ribs with the salad and sides, for a mere $8.95. I've had to pay $20 or more for that at Korean restaurants, and it wasn't this good! The Kalbi alone would bring me back for another meal. We were very full, and had to get a small container for 3 pieces of sushi and a piece of tuna, a nice little snack for tonight's Netflix shows.
name: Lita

text: I came here for breakfast with my family (including 4 somewhat picky eaters), and everyone was impressed. I had their Farmhouse skillet breakfast, and would definitely have it again! Delicious and filling!
name: Joshua

text:
Ahhhh so delicious. The line is for a reason!

We only had to wait maybe 20 minutes on a late Monday morning. We ordered bonuts, southern Benny, and an egg plate which came with eggs, grits, a biscuit, and bacon. I upgraded to chronic bacon and it was the best decision I've ever made. 

The bonuts came out literally the moment we sat down. My goodness. They were absolutely amazing. Our food came out shortly after. My plate had regular bacon, and when I let a server know she brought the chronic-ness out in about 30 seconds. The regular bacon was delicious, but the chronic was on another level. 

So glad we came, we almost skipped it because of the line. Prepared to be in a full on food coma afterwards.
name: Jessica

text:
I took my friend here for her bday dinner. Food was ok. The cone was pretty good. Service was horrible! 
Half the things we ordered did not come. They charge $33/person for dinner all you can eat. I didn't even eat close to $20 worth of food cz it didn't come! 
Even after complaining to the server and her taking another order saying that she will put thru again. Only 2 out of 8 items I reordered came. After waiting for 30 mins for the rest of the stuff we decided to leave. So disappointing and a HUGE WASTE OF MONEY! please don't bother coming here. They always pull this shit. I swear they purposely don't bring some of the items to save money. They know you're not going to remember everything that u ordered. Every time I come here they miss at least 2-3 items , even when it's not busy!
name: Grace

text:
I've had several meals here. It's the best Mexican food in Smyrna. Period. If you want loud and noisy, go to Camino Real. If you want bland food, go to La Siesta. This place, in the old Thida Thai location, is authentic, delicious and cheap.
Be sure to get the hand made to order corn tortillas.
name: Sean

text: Service was slow to non existent. Food when it finally came out tasted burnt and i sent it back. Would not recommend.
name: Robin

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. A very pleasant experience. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: I have tried a few similar restaurants in the area and this is the one we keep coming back to. My favorite is the sweet and sour chicken with a side of pork fried rice. I usually order for takeout and they answer the phone so quickly and have the food ready in under 10 minutes which makes it so easy. The staff is always very friendly and makes the whole experience a pleasure. There is parking right in front of the entrance which makes access easy.
name: Kimberly

text: Staff is very friendly and the restaurant itself is quaint and clean! As far as the actual food, I had the SEC and found that the biscuit was super crumbly instead of soft and fluffy and I was still hungry after I finished. However, my boyfriend loved his food so maybe I just ordered the wrong thing. Worth a try but not my favorite.
name: Erin

text: Such a cool place! U get to choose the type of potato, sauce, and seasoning of the fries! You also get to choose the type of meet and toppings for your hamburger! It's all pretty much custom which I'm a fan of. "Just the way you like it." Super creative flavors all around. We ordered it right before beginning the 5 hour drive home to UT and made the drive way more entertaining trying all the types of sauces with our two flavorful types of fries. We tried a beef and turkey burger and the turkey was for sure one of the best we have had. Smaller burgers, which was great since I was hand feeding my husband who was driving the car, decreasing the mess, and we were able to easily share the burgers making it just the right amount of food. No one wants to feel over stuffed when ur on a road trip. Loved it! Friendly staff too!
name: Brandi

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Worth checking out. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Food was good and came out fast. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: The pizza was so delicious, and the Italian bread (I think it was called). Definitely a cool spot to check out if you're in the area. We sat on the rooftop deck, which was great! Would receive five stars if there were soda refills (it's about $3 for soda and refills cost extra, that's so dumb). It also only accepts cash, though there is an atm in the restaurant. I think we'll go back, but it is on the pricey side in my opinion. Definitely overpriced, but that's to be expected for the area it's in
name: Ryan

text: Very impressive pho. The place is new, clean and spacious. There are over 20 tables. They have a modern form of ordering, with intuitive computer screens for ordering and paying. I approached and ordered a large pho with rare steak and meatballs. My pho was ready in about 5 minutes. The pick up counter was up a ramp behind the ordering screens. I picked up my giant bowl of soup, and found one of the many tables in the spacious seating area. I really enjoyed the pho here. The broth was tasty and not overly greasy. The portion of noodles and meat was awesomely huge. I managed to finish my bowl, because when it comes to pho, I got no chill. But I was full for a long time. Nice addition to market street!
name: Gus

text:
I dropped off for a quick breakfast stop in between appointments. I ordered the blueberry muffin. It was very good. A large muffin with a crispy/sugary sprinkled top. A perfect companion to a cup of coffee. Adequately priced at $3. 

This is a good spot for a quick bite when you have limited time. I think it closes at 3pm, so don't arrive for a late afternoon break. 

The egg sandwich looked delicious. I hope to return and try it out.
name: Chris

text: This is delicious gut busting fried chicken! The food was fresh & piping hot. I could not get enough of their fried green tomatoes with a side of ranch; I ordered two servings! I could not finish my whole plate...Thank God for to-go plates!
name: Autumn

text: Such a great poke bowl. Can taste the freshness of the ingredients and the price is great for the amount that you get! Definitely recommend!
name: Jenna

text:
This is some legit BBQ.  We got there a little late, and the place wasn't too crowded.

The pork ribs was solid.  It had good flavor and was very meaty.  I liked the rub they used a lot.  It complimented the ribs well.

The smokes pastrami was very unique.  It had a nice flavor profile.  It wasn't overly smoky.  

The burnt ends was pretty solid.  It wasn tender and not too sweet.  

Overall, I like Pappy's the best, but this is pretty comparable.  This place is great too!

text: Great value and good quality food. Kids meals are excellent and made a change from the usual choices in kids menus. Had a great server called Jared who was attentive and good fun

text: SugarFire 64 on opening day at dinner time had a worthy crowd. I was so tempted by the daily special, the Red Hot Riblets, but I refrained from the fried ribs with Cheetos dust! I ordered the 6oz Brisket Plate and chose chili and au gratin potatoes as my sides. The chili was hearty and well spiced. The au gratin potatoes were creamy and cheesy. The brisket that should have been in slices was like chipped beef. The flavor was there but the texture was not. As far as the SugarFire sauces go, all your favorites are there. My favorites are the Texas Hot and the Alabama White. The line was moving slowly but I would expect this on opening day. The guy who was dishing out the sides left a couple of times to deliver French Fries and that slowed things down a lot. The building is super cute. They alleviated a lot of issues I'm sure they have at other locations by building a separate door and counter for carry-out orders. Plenty of parking. O'Fallon, IL actually has a decent little food scene and no doubt SugarFire is a welcome addition. I'm sure I'll be back for lunch from time to time.
name: Michelle

text:
If you are in a rush, come back at another time.

Food was okay but not amazing enough to surprise me. I went there for the vide. However, the waiting was a bit long. We waited for about 10 to15mins. Then, the waiter came to take our order in another 15mins. Another roughly 20mins was waiting for the orders to come. 

 This one waiter is friendly though. He apologized for the waiting hence I thought it was understandable!

The star of the plate was the street corn.   Very nice atmosphere.  Service was phenomenal - props to Angelina.  Great time!!!

Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Worth checking out. Food was good and came out fast. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: We had brunch here this morning. We most usually enjoy their brunch. Today was amazing. Had great seating. Had great waitress. Had great cocktails. I said most usually as we went their last Easter for brunch and nothing was good but it was right on today.

text: Great service, but they got my order wrong.  We ordered the Bloomin' onion which was excellent.  For an entree I ordered the Alice Springs chicken with the honey mustard on the side.  It came with a cup of honey mustard on the side but was also slathered in it.  They remade it for me and I ended up eating later than the rest of the fam.  I felt this should have been comped but it wasn't.   Service otherwise good.

text:
Been here a couple of times and the cheese steak never disappoints! There is usually a long line but it moves fast, you also do not have to be in the front to order. The waitress? will yell and ask who is next to order. If this if your first time here be ready to stand VERY close to other people lol but over all the cheese steaks here are definitely worth $9. I also heard a lot of people ordering a Italian hoagies and I want to try this next time my wife and I are here. 

Cheese steak= $9
Parking= street parking
name: Bryan

text:
BEST. CLUB. EVER. Well, amongst gentlemen's clubs, I mean. I visited here about a month ago, but we had so much fun it'd be unfair of me to not review this place and give it the credit it deserves.

I arrived first and had a couple doubles of Jameson. Each of those set me back $15. YIKES. But we had previously learned about a $60/2 hours deal, so I was just waiting for the rest of the gang to arrive. Once they did, we paid our money and were told we could sit at any of the VIP tables overlooking the bar. We found a spot with a good view of the main stage, and then our personal waitresses informed us we could sit at the Bubble Pole if we wanted. "WHAAAT!" So we moved over to the pole, which featured a glass pole with bubbles floating up. It was pretty cool. And then the real fun began...

We. Went. HARD. I'm talking doubles of drinks, shots, and every dancer visited us before they hit the main stage. And each and every one of them were incredibly nice and just fun to talk to! One in our group had never had a lap dance before, so I picked one of the best dancers that we saw and sent them away. When my friend returned she told me it was the coolest experience. (I pat myself on the back.)

We had started at about 8:30 PM and our time was up at 10:30. But we were allowed to keep the seats until we decided to leave, which wasn't much later because we were F******KED UUUUUUP!

We all agreed that of all the clubs we had visited together, this one was the best. I don't know why other folks gave it such low marks but we had the best time here. Yeah, having EVERY dancer come to your table does get expensive, but we NEVER drop this much money at any club like this because they've always been subpar to this point. So I guess it was justifiable. (lol.)

And to the beautiful blonde who was also a theater arts major but I was too damn drunk to talk to: I love you.
name: John

text: We held a large company dinner here. Everything was amazing! The staff were so kind and professional. The food was delicious. They were very attentive to our party of 45. Highly recommend!!!

text: This place was pretty good the wings were tasty but not crispy.  The spicey fried pickles were awesome.  The pizza was also good all and all it was pleasant experience.

text: The wait was longer than it should've been for a pretty normal dinner service. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. not sure I'd order the same thing again. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Will be back. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.

text: Dessert saved this a little. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text:
Mimi Blue came through!!!!

First, I want to say I was finally contacted about the "over billing" error during my visit.  I wasn't contacted by just "some person", but I was actually called by one of the owners!!!!!  This tells me Mimi Blue cares about their customers!  The owner first apologized for me having to wait so long for someone to respond back to me, then he "listened" to me explain the problem.  As we were talking on the phone he was investigating my issue!!

He didn't say, "I'll get back to you later."  He took the time to do that while on the phone with me because he wanted to make sure he had a satisfied customer.  I didn't expect that kind of service.  That was great!!!

Second, I want to say an employee of the Indiana Pacers was 100% correct about what he told me about Mimi Blue.  He let me know with absolute confidence "they will take care of the situation" and they did!

Finally, I want to say the food at this restaurant looks good and tastes even better!  I've been there one time and I must say the "macaroni" is addictive.  Don't leave without trying the macaroni.

Thanks M.C.(owner) I'm really glad you took care of me.

text: Their all you can eat is made to order! They are fairly quick to bring your food out. I love how you can pick from the sushi to apps to soup and it's included with the all you can eat. Try the salmon teriyaki!

text: So I heard about this place that makes fresh donuts. I've been wanting to try It so yesterday was the day.  I got 4 donuts and I have to say.  They were awesome .  Matt was working the register and one thing I noticed was he was really nice.  Explained the process.  And the girl behind the counter Alana was very nice too.  You get zero attitude here from the workers.  All in all it was a cool experience.

It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I left full, which at least counts for something. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. text: What can I say other then this place has great pizza. It's my neighborhood steak and pizza joint and has been a family favorite probably for 30 years. Yes the pizzas are smaller compared to other pizza places and yes they're a much higher cost of other pizza places but it's family run, homemade with great ingredients.  You won't regret the extra cost. Another favorite dish is the T-bone steak dinner with baked potato wonderful.

text: Um... This place is open quite late and serves better food than one should expect, quite late; however, delivery person should probably not carry pizza around like it's a text book :-/ #shmooshedpizzablecch

text: Went here for the first time and it's a pretty cool diner. We ordered a cheeseburger which my husband said was really good, my kids got breakfast items and really liked their meals. You can get breakfast all day which is a nice perk. I ordered the Cajun chicken pasta which said it came with a creamy Cajun sauce which I assumed was a white sauce...however, it was a red sauce I did not care for. There was nothing wrong with it just not a personal fan of red sauce. I did ask if I could take it home and order something else, I didn't want them to take it off my bill as there wasn't anything wrong with the quality or taste, I just don't like red sauce (honestly was my fault for not asking). I got the pork and Mac/cheese special and it was absolutely delicious! When I got the bill they didn't charge me for the pasta even though I really didn't want them to take it off and I was taking it home for kids to eat sometime....but was very nice of them and excellent customer service. We will be back!!
name: Tiffany

text: So, the service is very good and friendly. The decor is nothing special. But the food... Very bland. Jasmine rice is plain white rice from an ice cream scooper. At close to $25 a plate, def not worth it. I won't be back. I'll fry fish at home and put up with the smell!!
name: Brian

text: Folks are surely entitled to their opinions and experiences but I truly do not understand any negative reviews of Bellissimo. I am a gourmet cook and eat out a great deal. Food was excellent and full of flavor. Portions are like getting 2 for one as you will indeed have leftovers, and you know Italian food gets better the next day! Lou was gracious, personable and attentive, as was his wait staff. Every dish was delicious and the Tiramisu was orgasmic! EAT HERE!!
name: Brock

text:
**I am updating my review after the owner Rose reached out to me regarding my bad experience. She is an owner that cares, and that is not always found in today's world. She was apologetic and asked us to come back and give us a second try. She advised that they had recently let go of some employees, and were aware of issues they were having.  My now fiancé, no longer boyfriend and I went this past weekend with my Best friend and her husband. The waitress we had was stellar (wish I could remember her name) The wine selections were excellent. I had the almond chicken which was delicious, I will be back for that dish again. My best friend had the cider pork which was also amazingly tasty. My fiancé wasn't too thrilled with the duck, but his grapefruit gin cocktail was different and delish. Our second time around was very enjoyable, romantic and the restaurants ambiance is very cozy. I am grateful that the owner Rose handled our experience the way she did, and she definitely gained return customers. The hotel has some beautiful rooms as well. We may come back for an evening get away before our Wedding in October. 


**
I wish I could give less than one star. Just walked out of this establishment with my boyfriend. We had planned a romantic day in Lamberville/New Hope. Walked in and the wine cellar was full. We were told "Sorry folks I have no room for you". 
So we proceeded to the bar where a couple was getting up. I asked the bartender if it was seat yourself.... he said "Can you let me clean it off first? I don't really like wiping crumbs into people" Just then two seats opened up at the bar. We sat down, and for 15 minutes NOT ONE bartender acknowledged us. Not one. 
If ya ask me this place is way over rated. For a fine dining establishment your staff should be more kind and catering to guests. 
We left and went to Karla's in New Hope!
name: Kim

text: Great for a healthier version of "fast food" or you can get some excellent friend chicken. They have a great selection of sauces as well.
name: Gel

text: While visiting New Orleans for Mardi Gras we wanted some good ole crawfish !! So after a few suggestions and looking on Yelp we decided to try this place out. We came here on Sunday night and let me tell you they were packed! We waited outside for 40 mins before we were even were let in to get into another line! The seafood is already pre-boiled and ready to serve so the biggest problem is getting through the line. They do have a huge selection of items to order so it's almost like a regular Chinese restaurant, convenient store, liquor store and ice cream parlor. Lol this place has a lot going on! So after we placed our order and sat down to eat I will say the Turkey wing was the bomb! For me the crawfish was ok but I've had better but they will fill your craving. I believe the crawfish ran about $7 a  pound which is pretty cheap but I will say they were sooo small, I was bored of peeling them only to get nothing and Im an avid crawfish eater ‍The snow crabs were overcooked and tough! I literally couldn't even peel them or break the claws. The boiled shrimp was overcooked also so I'm thinking maybe the heating table added to this problem. After eating the crawfish for a while I noticed they had a strong smell to them so I have no idea the cause of this unless they were frozen prior. Needless to say I don't believe I will visit on my next trip it wasn't worth the wait in line for me ‍
name: Dawn

text:
We ditched another sushi place to come here for my birthday celebration and I'm so glad we did! The food was great, from the dumplings to the Cardinal roll to the premium individual sushi pieces we got. The drink menu is huge and the drinks were tasty and cute. And when I told them we were celebrating my birthday they hooked me UP. I got free sake and a birthday roll! The bartender was very nice.

I'd love to come again. My one critique might be that I hope next time they have then non-alcoholic cocktail menu up and running for the non-drinkers. It's very cool of them to have the option but they only actually had the ingredients for one of them.
name: Rachel

text: This place is a must go to when we are in Doylestown.   Love the food.   The homemade desserts are the BOMB!!!!   I would post pictures of the food but I forgot and by the time I remembered it was too late.   LOL.

text:
I just missed their lunch special hours by a few minutes, so next time, I need to remember to come in a little earlier.  Ordering piecemeal makes for a very pricy lunch otherwise.

FIrst off, the staff were really nice and helpful.

I opted for the miso soup to heat up my cold, dark heart. That was $2 for a cup. It was very good.

Next, I ordered something that sounded different, some kind of mango / crab appetizer, plus one sushi roll of unagi (two pieces).The appetizer was small and bit overly sweet and ice ice cold, baby. These two were close to $6 each.

With tip, it came out to around $17.  Note to self - come back earlier and make sure to opt for the lunch specials. Very likely worth it and better for my wallet.

Also for the record, it was pretty cold inside the restaurant. I kept my coat on the whole time.

text:
This want-to-be brew hall has some work to do. They are new, but they clearly haven't mastered their customer service. We have attempted this location several times, and we have consistently left after the 1st drink every time.

Staff despite not being ultra busy is not an attentive group. We have gone well over 10 minutes while seated at the bar before receiving a beer. This has happened multiple times. When seated at tables, the service isn't much faster (our groups have only ever ordered draft beer and our party sizes have always been 6 or less). 
From our experiences, wait staff seems to be great at making excuses, and less about improvement. 

Their beer offerings are pretty good. So if they could button up their service, this place has the potential to take off.
name: Casondra

text: Staff was SO rude, especially the woman in the front. She told us we had to wait outside because people by the door complained about people breathing on their food. bs. Also charged us wrong. I got to Belgian waffle that could either have chocolate or fruit. I got fruit but they charged us for the fruit. I don't recommend. Go to mothers or even McDonald's

text:
No reservations and no call ahead, so be prepared to wait. We were fortunate and walked right in. They were out of fried cheese!  
Standard food quality and huge overwhelming menu selection. Ample parking. Easy location at mall

text: Elephant in the room, it's a chain pizza place, set your expectations appropriately.  That said, for a chain, the pizza is a fairly good quality, the lunch buffet is a really good value for the price, and I've yet to deal with an unfriendly employee.
name: Michael

text: This Hooters is by way the worst. The hostess sat us right next to the door that goes to the patio which was so hot. We ordered a piña colada and it looked like a slushy from 7-11. We ordered fish tacos which was good. The fries tasted like cardboard. The waitress we had was nice but the atmosphere was bad. Bad location as well.

text:
TL;DR LAO STEAK. 

Alright, so full review: this place is gooood. I'd been meaning to find another Lao restaurant to check out, and Maliwan did not disappoint. Really clean and quaint place. Also BYOB!

We started off with the papaya salad, which was probably one of the best I've had--very crisp and flavorful. You have a choice of 1-4 peppers for spice, with 2 being considered spicy and 3-4 very spicy. My friend and I settled for 2.5, but as a Lao person, I didn't think it was that spicy and definitely could've handled more. 

Next, we tried the laap, which can be ordered Thai- or Lao-style. I usually like to order beef (or pork), but since I was getting both those forms of meat in our dishes to follow, we settled on fish. Cooked well and served with fresh lettuce, cucumbers, and a lime slice which I generously squeezed over the dish. 

The sticky rice is something I think Maliwan can work on. Instead of in traditional bamboo containers, the sticky rice is served in plastic wrap on a dish. It was warm, but not hot, so it just wasn't as glutinous as I'm used to. The Lao sausage I had it with was great, though! 

The winner of the night was definitely the Lao steak. We had it medium rare, and after we ate it, I wished we had ordered a second helping. 

For dessert, we ordered mango sticky rice, which is one of my favorite desserts (often served on a banana leaf). It was alright, but not amazing. Definitely very hot rice, but personally would've liked a little more coconut cream. :)

Overall though, a good experience and would definitely go back!

text:
Overall Value:  Good atmosphere and beer, but food was just ok.  I would probably come back for happy hour or to get a few drinks either before or after grabbing dinner somewhere else.  

The Food: We got the Fried Chicken ($15) and Italian Wedding pizza ($15), along with a few draft beers.  The fried chicken is advertised as "Best of Philly," but I assure you Philly can do better.  It was a decent portion, all dark meat (duh, the only way to go), and super crispy, but on the downside, the chicken was pretty dry and kind of flavorless (other than salty).  The homemade pickles were by far the best thing on that plate.  The Italian Wedding pizza wasn't any better.  The crust was a bit chewy and dry, and the flavors of the pizza bland (again, other than salty).  If you want pizza and beer in West Philly, you are much better off going to Dock Street.  If you want the best fried chicken, you are better off going to Bud & Marilyn's (it's a dollar more but comes with fries) - the search continues for our West Philly chicken spot!  That said, the beers they have on draft are great, so I will still come back for some drinks.

Space and Pace: We came on a Saturday night, and the downstairs was pretty crowded and energetic.  We were seated upstairs at the bar without a wait, and it was much more chill up there.     There is only one tv so I would not recommend it as a spot to watch games, but it  was a nice atmosphere, and we definitely could have hung out for a while.

Service: Bartender was friendly and gave good recommendations for beer.

text:
If you have a large party, group outing, or business luncheon, avoid this restaurant. They will not be able to accommodate you. The organization of the staff is not where it needs to be. 

The restaurant has an archaic reservation system and poor communication amongst the staff. This is not the restaurant for visitors with large parties. I spoke to a staff member, first name, Bowen on August 13th @ around 9 pm to make a reservation for a private room. It was discussed that it was a semi-private room and that was okay with me. I booked the reservation. I called on August 23rd to confirm the details of a semi-private room on my reservation. At the request of another patron in my group, I did my due diligence and called the restaurant again on August 29th to confirm the details of my reservation (semi-private room and 15 person party with space for a wheelchair) during the same call, my server was confirmed to be first name, JJ.

The day of my reservation, I called to confirm the time my party would arrive. The person who picked up the phone was my server, JJ. Upon arrival, the reservation was not as expected. We were not in the semi-private room and the chairs were not set for the size of my party, nor was there room for a wheelchair at the table.  After taking the opportunity to speak to JJ about the accommodations, I was informed that none of the details were on the reservation. At this point, JJ, retrieved the restaurant's notebook and showed me the restaurants' shorthand writing which should have explained the details of my reservation. None of the previously discussed details were on my reservation - only the date, my name, and number of people. 

We requested to speak to a supervisor and were met by the owner/manager. She indicated that the details in their book were final and that no changes to my reservation could not be accommodated on short notice. At this point, I asked if there was anything we could do to make good on the restaurant's error. The manager indicated that her and her small staff could not make it right. She then suggested that we should leave since our time at her restaurant had started so poorly. My party and I made the decision to leave.

I was very interested in trying this restaurant, but the communication, customer service and organization was poor. The staff member, JJ, was respectful. The manager was unfriendly, intimidating and stern while speaking to her. After such poor communication and the lack of intention in honoring the reservation, I cannot recommend this restaurant to anyone. Until this restaurant steps into the 21st century and implements an electronic reservation system, avoid this place!
name: David

As we sat there, two other patrons had complaints as well. The woman next to me had ordered the crawfish Mac n cheese and said to me it was "bland". The other couple ordered wings and a burger.
