We've been planning to come here for a few years, even pulled into the parking lot in the past but couldn't find a spot so put this on the back burner, should have left it there

Ordered end cut of prime rib, waitress didn't skip a beat and flat out said no end but. Ordered the special Center cut instead. Got my soup (dining partner waited so long for her glass of wine I was on my 2nd soda), and by now waitress tells me oops, out of prime rib now.  What kind of POS system are you using for orders?

I decide now to go with a gyro. I pronounce  it Yee-ro as it should be, this is a Greek restaurant after all. Waitress says "What is that"?  I have to point to Gyro on that menu.  Oh I'm new she says 

My dining partner ordered fish tacos 
We waited over 40 mins for our food, so long that a girl filling water glasses asked if we were waiting for anything.   Oh, just our dinner

Very disappointed in the fish tacos, overly fried , too crispy, the fish is barely able to be located inside the breading.  They seemed re-fried    Only ate 2 of 3 and "ate" is an exaggeration

As a diner, the food and service were not what  I would expect from a establishment with the reputation yours has 

I won't be back and I've told others to not waste their time either
name: Lisa

text:
During a merciful extended lunch hour as a break from day long beginning of the month meetings, me and about 8 coworkers decided to treat ourselves to some bbq at Dalie's.  This was my first visit and my eyes widened when one of my colleagues mentioned it was essentially a west county branch of midtown STL stalwart, Pappy's. 

From that moment I knew I had to order the ribs, and decided to add some brisket too because...heck why not.  The ribs were phenomenal, every bit the equal of those I remember at pappys. The macaroni was a standout as well.  The brisket I thought was just ok but it could've had something to do with my infatuation with the ribs.  

Overall I'd recommend it for anyone in the area with a hankering for bbq.
name: Christopher

text:
Congratulations to Pokezone to making it for a year. That is a really job well done especially in such a high turn over area. It has been a while since we last been here because my boyfriend no longer works downtown, making it not as accessible as it used to be.
It is sad to say, but true, the quality has gone down since I have last been here. The rice was massively overcooked to the point of mush, servings were hardly amounted to any quantity, and they did not put on even close enough sauce for even well cooked rice, let alone one that needed an additional flavor support.  At least they have additional sauce to the side although they switched out their house sauce with regular soy sauce for the area where you help yourself. The fish was also decently fresh... pretty good for Tucson... as were the veggies. We decided not to get drinks this time because no one was at the bar again and we decided not to wait for one to appear like we had to last time, but no big on that one.
Service was fine - more unremarkable than anything. The last time we were there it was pretty close to superb behind the food counter and not so great behind the bar.
I hope that today was simply an off day for them for they can easily flip back to the quality they were at previously.
name: Paige

text: So very good. The food & service was phenomenal. Karris & Bradley were the best servers. Very attentive, informative, friendly.
name: Jenny

text: Awesome breakfast!  Excellent and fast service. I highly recommend!!  Bacon burger, kids pancakes, eggs and apple wood bacon were all fantastic!
name: Sean

text: Great steaks and great guacamole dip!! This place really takes note of quality and consistency. We will always come back for more.
name: Joe

text: Have come to this place several times. I just went yesterday. It's a really good hotpot restaurant. Best small hotpot in santa Barbara. People are nice there.
name: Wenqing

text:
Walked around Downtown Tampa on a weekday afternoon in search of a decent Lunch place. A lot of businessmen were leaving Hattricks so I decided to give it a shot. 

I ignored the daily specials and tried the Cubano Sandwich. Although the ingredients were good, I was not a fan of the overall taste. Noticed that nearly everyone inside (approximately 60 customers) had either a Cobb Salad or Buffalo wings in front of them. I admit I made a mistake. I'll be back soon to ask about their daily lunch specials or during their Happy Hour Wing promos. 

Good service. I'll be back soon but will avoid ordering any sandwich options from here.
name: Luis

text: Looks like a dive, but the food is excellent. Order from the specials board. All fresh seafood. We had cornbread stuffed with crawfish, Creole style shrimp and grits,  and spicy steamed shrimp. Everything was fabulous. Cold beer, blues music, and plenty of locals in the joint.
name: Jessica

text: My god, the slowwwww line. For whatever reason there is only ever 1 register open, even during the lunch rush.  Expect to spend 15-20 minutes in line.
name: Bradley

text: Love the noodles and bourbon chicken. Egg rolls are nice a crispy. Love this for a fast Chinese food option. Decent pricing.
name: Danielle

text: If you're prepared to wait over an hour for a mediocre fast food burger then this is the steak n shake for you. The staff have no idea what's going on & it was a sh*tshow
name: Xavier

text: This is a great spot for a casual lunch outside or to grab a drink. Absolutely loved the BLT and wedge salad. Their fries are also amazing. They have a good selection of beers and cocktails reasonably priced. I love coming here to sit outside out front or on the back patio when it's warm out. Would highly recommend checking it out! And for dessert the warm skillet cookie is an absolute must
name: Lauren

text: This place is as good as you are going to get in this area. The quesadilla is packed with meat and cheese. They don't skimp but it is also extremely greasy. The burros and tacos are pretty good. Not the best. The super fries are good and loaded with toppings. The beans and rice aren't that great. Don't order the enchiladas. They are small and bland.
name: Jenifer

text: I should have gone to waffle house. Breakfast was terrible. Eggs Benedict was the special. No seasoning on the eggs, the English muffin was cold and untoasted, and the potatoes were a touch warmer than raw. The $40 bill for two subpar breakfasts was the insult to injury.
name: Nadia

text: Love this place.  The food is so good and the staff is always friendly.  Its not stuffy, its very New Orleans local that makes it feel at home.  Its also BYOB and while the wait is usually long, we added ourselves to the list before arriving and it wasn't to bad.  We just enjoyed a glass of champagne while we waiting.
name: Kyle

text:
Good restaurant with some awesome New Orleans staples. Our server was friendly and attentive. This place accepts all forms of payment, however, they won't do split checks if the restaurant is busy. Keep that in mind if you're dining with several friends. 

I ordered a Cajun shrimp po boy. The server told us the sauce was pretty spicy so I ordered it on the side just to be safe. It ended up being perfect. I used it as a dipping sauce for my onion rings too. The rest of my party was was happy with their orders which included a po boy and shrimp and grits.
name: Angel

text: Our group got red beans and rice, catfish sandwich, shrimp po boy and the roast beef po boy. The po boys were huge, easy to share! The food is spicy but still very good
name: Jessica

text: Today decided to stop by for a nice lunch. Diego was our server and could not have been more pleasant and knowledgeable. They have a great lunch menu you are able to build your own. The Sangria was incredible. Not too sweet, and large. Our food came out hot and was perfect. I loved the background music too. Was just perfect and the price was right. We will definitely be back.
name: Mary

text: One of my most favorite places here in Boise. I been now 5 times and had the steak 3 times and I'm in awe each time. The hot stone is cool as heck and the Cognac sauce is amazing. I had the pot pie it's incredible, the sides are pretty awesome. Definitely come and try the steak then come back and try anything else. The quail was super tasty. It's comes with the "when pigs fly" pork chop and quail
name: Raymond

text: I love Jersey Mike Subs - they have it all figured out but today they went above and beyond! I picked the wrong sandwich - halfway through fixing it I realized it. On the spot they added the meat to make it what I wanted no problem. What customer service! Then went Italian Mike's way ..... perfect!
name: Lori

text: The crab soup was a 5. The mussels in garlic white wine broth was a 3. The bread was a 1. French restaurants should be known for their baguettes but the bread here is dense and horrible. Like a soft pretzel instead of bread. Very disappointing. But the crab soup was dead on!!!
name: Wendy

text: Friendly service, great gyros, cheaply priced, small cozy inside!! That's all I have to say, I just need to make this longer or it won't post, try this place though, you will love it too.
name: Heather

text: Great place. Great beer. I think a lot of people come here for Pliny the Elder which is a great beer that is difficult to come by elsewhere on the east coast. There are a lot of other great beer options as well though. The food is also good. Went yesterday for h second time and the staff was very friendly. Will definitely come back next time I am on Philly.
name: Matt

text: My favorite Mexican Food Restaurant!!! The al pastor taco's & nachos are amazing is always my go to and there horchata is so delicious !  My boyfriend and I love this place and the staff is amazing and helpful. Highly recommend this spot to anyone who loves Mexican food!
name: Alethea

text: I was here last night, absolutely enjoyed it and almost forgot to do a review. So here it is: two thumbs way up! And another two  thumbs for Bartender Courtney, who kept me steeped in  Lagunitas IPA and treated me like a king from the minute I walked in. Kudos to the kitchen, too, for the tasty Black and Blue burger! Oh, they allow smoking, be which really sealed the deal for this man of many vices!
name: Briggs

text: I could eat the tortillas by themselves all day long.  My only complaint is I want a grilled fish taco!!
name: Chris

text:
First time there on a Saturday night. Horribly mismanaged, untrained staff who only seem to care about themselves. Had to pay 3 separate tabs because the bar and food service are separate. One due to a shift change at 6:00pm on a Saturday night. Bartender eating instead of tending to any duties while a bunch of other staff  congregated around point of sale in center of rest blatantly ignoring patrons.

As far as the food and drink, it was very average. Unimpressive! My partner was served an unshaken Prickly Pear Margarita, which costs $10.00 and was easily a $6 drink--way overpriced. I had the Cherry pepper hot wings which I will honestly say we're good. My partner, hiwever, got the Honey chipotle shrimp which were small and the texture was rubbery. 

Will not be back!
name: Kathy

text: My family and I have been going to Gino's for at least 15 years.  When our children were young, Gino himself would come to our table and talk to us and ask how everything was and always complimented our well behaved children too.  Really meant a lot!  The food and service are phenomenal. Best marinara and pasta, bread and garlic oil  I've ever eaten...and I've had a ton of Italian food in my lifetime even in little Italy.  Some of the best servers in the valley work at Gino's.  Love this place!
name: Sue

text:
So cute

When we walked into Thai Sa-Moot for dinner last night I noticed two things right away, there were no other tables occupied and the décor was colorful.  While there were a few wood carved items here and there, the room was more paint and items and lights.  I really liked the tasteful look.  The background music was also very appropriate.

We were greeted as we walked in and shown to a table.  From start to finish service was subdued and excellent.  We enjoyed our visit.

As for the food, it seemed fairly typical and a little pricey.  I tried one of their Chef Specialties, Cashew Nut Chicken.  It came with jasmine rice and what was described as a smoky secret sauce.  It tasted good.  It was not spicy at all but spices could be brought to the table to be added.
name: Art

text: Empty plates say it all. First time here.  4 tacos for $10, add some salsa and queso and a few drinks and end with a great evening. Friendly staff and very reasonable prices. Nice little place right on main Street.
name: Greg

text: Absolutely delicious! Went a few months ago with my friend from college. We did the build your own platter since I'm vegetarian. Every item was delicious, the shiro always being my favorite. We also had the tea. The inside is real casual but clean and the service was friendly. This food is very similar to Ethiopian food but has slightly different flavors. I'd definitely go back!
name: Rachel

text:
First trip and wouldn't be my last. 

Alcohol served, great food, clean restaurant environment with clean bathroom facilities, and an amazing staff that really caters to your needs. 

My brother in law and I pulled up on our bikes and there was ample amount of parking spaces. Walked in and were greeted by not one not two but three different hellos from staff. Was a seat yourself place so we took a window seat. From beer to wine to fountain drinks there was a variety of choices. The food was really good and served in a very timely fashion. 

All great things to say. I would highly recommend, prices were reasonable too.
name: Chris

text: Awesome place!! The food is fast and amazing!!! I haven't had curry this good in a long time!!!
name: Melissa

text: We weren't even hungry but it smelled so good from down the street we had to come in and give it a try! Fall off the bone smoked chicken and ribs, delicious homemade cornbread and BBQ sauce. Friendly service. Highly recommend if you're looking for one of those ridiculously good little hole in the wall places like you'd find in Hawaii. We've got one here in Goleta now!
name: Jessica

text: Great family owned ethnic restaurant. I am of Turkish origin and I can assure you that the LAHMUACUN is made very much the same as you could get in Turkey. I highly recommend you trying it among many other delicious Turkish and Mediterranean dishes.
name: Mehmet

text: Went Thanksgiving.... Restaurant was crowded. Opted for take out? No big deal, only getting burgers anyway. Burger was hard and dry, bun was burnt.. Crispy fries ???  NO ! Soggy and greasy !! Never again !
name: Pam

text:
If you are in Philly and you have a taste for a cheesesteak this is the place to go! 

I was recently in town and stopped here to get a quick bite to eat for lunch. On the advice of my daughter I ordered a cheesesteak with PEPPERONI, provolone, peppers, onions, mayo, mustard and ketchup. Let me tell you, I was skeptical about the pepperoni but mmm mm it was the highlight.  Now that's what you call a sandwich!

They had a special fry of the day called dirty fries which had hot peppers, bacon crumbles and of course cheese.  Can I say delicious?!!?! 

It gets crowded in there, but don't worry there is  seating on the inside and outside. The next time I am in town, I am definitely going to make a beeline to Sonny's for sure!!!  Smiling just thinking about it!!! Mmmmmmmm!!!
name: Alicia

text:
This place should make a movie, hire Harrison Ford to be the lead actor and call it "Indiana Jones and the Lost Lonestar Burrito". 

Look, I've been here and it's usually a crap shoot if they get it right. First round of drinks, not bad at all. Went upstairs to snag a table and get some dinner. This is where the plot gets interesting. 

We ordered our meal from the bartender upstairs. Didn't write our order down and knew he'd be back to take it again because like a wet sponge, we gave him a little too much to absorb. Came back and wrote it all down. Watched him tuck away that little black leather book down his apron, never to be seen again. Watched him never put the order in. 

Totally cool. We're drinking and enjoying each other's company. Made a bet he'd lie about putting the order in since he never made it to a kiosk since our order. PLOT TWIST: He lied. Mashed uncontrollably to put order in and then we waited as if we placed said order at the DMV. 

Long story short, you guessed it, food never came. The GM Sarah was nice enough to make her rounds, apologized and  offered to "box it up". We didn't come for leftovers soooo, no. 

Even better when another manager Eric wants you to know that if you "grab a card from up front", you can let him know if you need anything. Yeah Eric, I need you to teach your staff how this whole thing works. 

I'm a creature of habit. I'll probably be back because I live nearby, but can't wait to share the next adventure with you all.
name: Pj

text:
Today is the third or fourth time I've gone to this restaurant. I took my fiance and almost 2 year old daughter. They have high chairs and cute little plates for the kids. There's a kid menu as well. The cutest part of all was that they placed a plastic tablecloth underneath her high chair for easy cleanup. I just couldn't believe how welcoming, accommodating, and prepared for patrons of all ages these people are.
My fiance didnt really like thai food when he first tried it. (I didn't really pay attention the first time we tried another restaurant here and he ordered some really weird dish that a first timer really shouldn't try). I've been trying to convince him to try thai food again for such a long time. He got the orange chicken today and loved it. He also ate the egg fried rice with chicken our daughter had leftover from her meal. He really couldn't get enough, and already had a list of things he wants to try in the future. He also loved the curry puff appetizer.
As usual I ordered my staple meal of green curry with eggplant and zucchini and added some tofu (I love tofu in thai food). It was excellent as always. The food is very flavorful and fresh. 
They also do a very good job of getting their 1-5 levels of spiciness to be pretty spot on. 
I really like this place and can see why it's always busy. The entire staff teams up to make sure all of the customers are taken care of. I feel like I never wait too long to be seated (even if it's crowded and looks full), and everyone is polite and courteous and appreciative of your patronage.
I absolutely love Thai Lotus. Thank you for your great service, and a lovely and delicious dining experience every time!
name: Ducky

text: It takes a long time to get your food. If your in a hurry don't come here. It took more than 10 minutes to get your food.
name: Naty

text: Wow! Excellent!  We are only visiting Nashville or else this would be my newest favorite restaurant.  The food was not only excellent but the service was as well.   Prices are very reasonable for very generous portions.
name: Cathy

text: We walked in and didn't understand that you had to go to the counter to order and seat yourself. Employees looked at us but didn't tell us what to do. There was no signage to makes things easier. When we went to the counter and asked two cashiers questions about the food they had no idea how to answer. The manager told us bu you would think employees could learn the short menu. Also , when the girl brought my food she just seemed in a hurry not placing the dish with the spoon on my side of the bowl. Then they expect you to bus your own table . Not sure why they have employees for the little service they gave. The chairs are incredibly uncomfortable.Food was good but the rest was frustrating enough to not think I will go back.
name: Laurie

text:
Well, all good things must come to an end. Couple of years ago I gave Antonio's a (deserved) Five-Star rating, but as of last night, my most recent order, I have to take it all back.
The quality has been slipping the last few months, and my order last night hit rock bottom; I won't be coming back.
We ordered three things:
Pepperoni Pizza: It was cold, and the pepperoni was hard to find.
Hot Wings: They were actually tasty, but they the breading was a gooey mess, giving an very unpleasant mouth-feel, and
Baked Ziti: This was awful. The pasta was cooked to the consistency of library paste; the sauce was excessive, and it was some creamy, goopy, sloppy, tasteless glop. I took one bite. My wife took one bite. My daughter refused to take a bite. And then we all agreed the dogs would get it. (One dog wouldn't eat it either.)
I'm searching for a new go-to pizza joint.
name: Steve

text: Quaint friendly environment. Daughter is a French student that wanted to try this place. Went for breakfast. Large servings, I had the open faced omelette and couldn't finish it. Reasonable prices, waitress was awesome. Bakery cases were mouth watering. Daughter had the ham and cheese croissant and loved it. It was huge and she finished it.
name: S

text: Best sushi in Brentwood hands down. I've been to all of them. I've also been to all the Namas definitely my favorite. Fresh sushi and good service. It is over behind Del Frisco and Uncle Julio's. You will not be disappointed.
name: Alisha

text: Ordered three different rolls, all were good. Service was so so, got ignored for long periods of time. But I will return here to eat their sushi again. I will say the sushi although good was somewhat poorly put together. Seemed just messy and not tightly rapped. I would however recommend eating here if you are a fan of good sushi.
name: Michael

text: Great service, great presentation, great flavor. Solid date night meal from start to finish. Get the pork belly appetizer, garlic bread and short rib gnocchi.
name: Brian

text: I love this place!!!  They are all about honoring those who served. That makes me want to keep coming back and supporting this restaurant. The service is very friendly. The food is amazing. I love the turkey. A little insider tip is to ask for the Alabama White sauce. It is amazing.
name: Tom

text: Excellent Brazilian food. From the empanadas through the risotto to the feijoada. Plus, the caipirhinas! Love it. If it's nice weather, sit outdoors.
name: Greg

text: Love love love this place. Been coming here for years. They are always the sweetest to our girls and us and their food is consistently fast and on point. If I'm having a bad day this place always makes it 100% better.
name: Alicia

text:
Food always piping hot. Tastes great. 
Only and big complaint is, why are you forgetting the egg so often on the spicy pork burger and the avacado on chicken burger?
name: Larry

text: Both ordered eggs, bacon, and hash browns with my hash browns well done. Wait for food was longer than it should have been. Constant customer line but also constant empty tables and booths. Server did not return after taking the order. Coffee refill came when food was delivered by someone other than server and we asked them for more. The bacon was room temperature, limp, half cooked. Not only were my hash browns not well done, the hash browns on both orders were barely cooked in middle. Server returned to drop off check. This is located about 20 minutes from our house. Not worth the trip even if around the corner.
name: Tom

text: Superb!  We love to meet our friends there especially when it is Lobster Fest.  Tercel (? - not sure if I got the name right) was probably one of the very best waitresses I have had.  She was so very interested, fast and happy .... wow! Enterprise, see you soon.  We are most happy.
name: Bonny

text: Great food. Party grits are the way to go. Best grits I've ever tasted of my young existence on planet earth.
name: Richard

text: My husband and I randomly picked this restaurant to have lunch today and we r so happy we did.  The food was delicious.  You select and pay for your order on the screen.  This was a quick process.  The food was prepared and served hot.  We had the avocado salmon and chicken parmigiano sandwich with a side salad.  It was a nice presentation and so very good.  We will definitely be back.  We want to post this feedback to inform Yelp readers of this place.  Enjoy a scrumptious Italian meal at this spot!
name: Janette

text:
The best thing about this place....they have frozen coffee ice cubes for the iced coffee. No watered down iced coffee here!

Now that, that is out of the way. Everything about this place is awesome, from all of the tasty pastries and cookies to the wonderful cakes we get to see being made next door.
name: John

text: Best Shrimp fried rice I've found since I moved here. Delicious! This place is nothing fancy but the food is good and huge overwhelming portions! Spring rolls were very good as well, nice and fresh unlike some of those places where they've been sitting under a warmer all day. My husband had orange chicken and he said it was really good as well. Looks like we found our go to take out Chinese place!
name: JoAnn

text: Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Pretty happy w it overall. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not sure though.
name: User

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The music was louder than it needed to be. My experience was honestly fine. For the price I expected more than this. Not bad for a quick meal. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: Excellent food and selection ! Staff nice, fairly attentive. Excellent take-out, all at reasonable prices and good proportions. The restaurant could be cleaner. I certainly have returned and will continue !
name: Lee

text:
Friday night in this spot. Ordered up a broccoli rabe and sausage pizza. All ingredients are fresh never frozen they say. The waitress was very nice and accommodating. I will visit again! 
Cheers
name: Daniel

text: I cant believe I haven't submitted a review here- since it's my kids favorite place to eat, we have been about a dozen times the past year. Service is always good. It's a great place to bring the kids as it isn't uppity. Food is good and comes out hot.
name: Niki

text: This Subway has recently changed ownership and it definitely shows! The store is exceptionally clean and the staff seem eager to help customers in a timely manner. I love the cookie samples they offer and the manager, Nicole, is extremely friendly! This will be my "go to" Subway!
name: Erin

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better online than it did in person. Anyway, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. So yeah, my friend liked their dish more than i liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: If I could give it zero stars I would. I ordered at 11:10 am and it was 11:42 my food wasn't even out yet. My niece was so hungry she was crying. I asked for a refund but instead of the cashier giving me back my money he went to find my food. No I do not want it anymore. Not to mention the cashier is rude af. I was in there for 40 mins and witness two arguments. I underStand working in the food industry is hard but come on now, it shouldn't take that long for a 10 piece nugget, Big Mac and a cheeseburger. It wasn't overly busy and I saw plenty of people working in the kitchen. I guess some people just don't have the sense of urgency
name: Lannie

text:
Been there often and NEVER dissapointed with their service , sandwiches and good will. A top food HOAGIE SHOP!
SAY HI TO PAT
name: Eileen

text: Love, love, love this place. The owner is always there and you can tell she really cares and is excited about what they are doing. I honestly have zero complaints about this place.
name: Jonathon

text: Breakfast casserole was over cooked. All I could taste was pretty much bread. Otherwise okay for this out of towner.
name: Pam

text: My server was Marcelle, she was great! Food was great and came out fast. This was our first time here and we will definitely be back!
name: Sara

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Will be back. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Went there on a Saturday night and the food and drinks were amazing!  Awesome decor and loved the actual black and white photos that they had in the women's restroom and gave the bio of each one and where you could go next door to the gallery to buy them.  Service was prompt and very attentive throughout the entire time.  Deserve all the praises for the 5 stars.  Will definitely be coming back!
name: Jess

text: Found this Italian spot on Yelp and drove all the way up from Franklin to try the freshly made pasta and sauces. We were not disappointed! Decided to go all in for Fatty Friday so started with the calamari and lasagna bites appetizers. The lasagne bites were so good! I loved how there was hardly any cheese in them, really only on top. The sauce was great. The calamari was ok, nothing amazing but not bad. For dinner my husband had the Tuscan Stew which he enjoyed, especially the sauce. I had the linguine bolognese and man oh man that pasta was perfect! The fresh pasta will have me coming back to try more for sure. The chocolate cake was recommended by our lovely server and she was spot on. It was fudgy and so decadent. I practically licked it off the plate. Try and save some room for dessert! We are driving home with our pants unbuttoned and couldn't be happier about it!!!
name: Karen

text: Delicious!! I was beyond excited when a Bubble Tea spot opened in N. Wilmington. They did not disappoint! The Tea was fresh brewed and the options were plentiful.
name: Ann

text: I ordered here last night for takeout .  I have ordered takeout here several times and it's been mediocre.  This time the cookies were crumbled and the potato salad was bland and tasted old.  On previous occasions, I have encountered the iced tea instead of green tea and sandwiches that were missing 1 or 2 ingredients. There hasn't really been anyone wrong to warrant an actual complete until my disappointment yesterday.  I learned previously to just bring water or tea.
name: Angela

text: Ever look for a true family feel with the convenience of not having to cook? Well, here it is. Amazing staff. Even better food. And there is something for everyone. Yes, the menu is small, but everything is fine right and made with love. Yes, the place is small, but it's BBQ TAKE OUT, meaning to take it home. This place is great. Troy has a great sense of humor. The staff make you feel at home and it doesn't break the bank. Love love love!
name: Jaime

text: Music is too loud. Service is slow even when the wait staff outnumbers the customers. Caters to transit hotel residents so no interest in doing the job it would take to get repeat customers.
name: Michael

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. For a busy night they handled it okay. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food was fresh and service was quick. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
I had wanted to go to this place for a while. I mean, you hear an Iron Chef opens a place in your city, you kinda want to go. 

The set up was pretty modern-standard, lots of stainless steel, and you order from the counter takeout style. No qualms with that, and I feel like you get your food faster in this format, which is a plus when you're hungry, which I definitely was.

I came in wanting blue cheese on a burger, so that's what I got. Blue cheese on a burger isn't for everyone, but I fricken love it, and they decided to add a fried jalapeño to it, which was awesome! 

I assumed it'd be breaded, but no, it was just a blistered skinned beauty. De-ribbed and de-seeded which I thought was a shame, but for those that don't love heat, probably welcome. The peppers and reduced onions worked really well with the meat, and though it lacked acid, I think it was a good, albeit one note burger. Very nice and very rich. The brioche bun was perfect. A perfect foil and perfectly soft and fluffy. 

Overall a good burger at a nice place. The fries were crispy but just meh. Not bad in any extent, but I'm at a burger joint for the burger, and it delivered on most levels. Yes, it needed some mustard to balance out that rich cheese, well seasoned beef, and broken down onions, but overall, it was a good burger at a decent price. I'd eat that again for sure.
name: Garrett

text:
Love, love, love this place! This is always a must stop when we visit Boise. The concept of Bodovino is genius! They have tapas and desserts. Buy your card and you can try any wine you want to. We ordered flatbread pizza (The Tony) and the pork taco. We also ordered their tiramisu (which is made in house) portion size was outrageous but awesomely delicious and rich but lite.  Happy Hour all day Sunday is also a plus!

**Updated 7/1/18** Still love this place however, they were out of their Charcuterie plate (disappointed to say the least), how are you out of stuff? On Happy Hour Sunday?!

Im pesciterian so I got the vegan wings, the buffalo were the best & then the vegan beef tacos which were also great. The two others I was with got chicken burrito & tilapia tacos. We called to verify for the happy hour times and the hostess didn't pick the first call, put me on hold the second call, and the third call after the 7th ring I hung up. text:
In all honesty, the food is worth 3.5-4 stars. BUT it's the experience that deserves extra credit, bringing my review to 5 stars overall. We did the full four-course couple's special, complete with cheese fondue, salad, meats, and chocolate fondue. This is a 2-3 hour adventure that's engaging, fun, rewarding, and memorable. Plus, the staff went above and beyond to make our meal enjoyable and romantic. 

The reason I say the food deserves lower marks is that you're really only getting shredded cheese heated up and chopped up pretzel with some ok-ish bread and fruit. Things I could buy at a supermarket. The house salad is like a slight step below Olive Garden (small iceberg mix with some cheese and croutons). And they give you garlic salt to put on top. Tasty, but not gourmet. The meats was the most fun part to cook, but also came with some basic veggies and sauces I could find at the grocery store dressing aisle or McDonalds. And the dessert is melted chocolate with cheap stuff to dip in. 

So why is it 5 stars and expensive? Presentation was beautiful, service was excellent, and it takes time for all this to happen. It's a full experience. Instead of doing dinner and a movie, just go for a melting pot dinner and enjoy! Definitely go hungry!!
name: Elizabeth

text:
When we moved to this area we struggled to find a good pizza.  We weren't really thrilled with any of the local options...until we tried Dino's!  Not only is their pizza spot-on in terms of sauce, cheese, and crust ratios (not to mention taste), they have so many other delicious menu items, you really can't go wrong. Dino's has easily become one of our go-to's.  It doesn't hurt that we always feel welcome the second we walk in the door - I love our little community and the businesses that support it! 

Some stand outs?  I've only ever stolen bites of the spaghetti and meatball kids meal, but it's amazing.  It reminds you why cooking Italian at home, while simple, is not the same as good Italian.  I can't wait to try more of their Italian dishes! 

I also had an amazing salad- one of their lunch specials - It was perfectly proportional and there wasn't a lot of junk lettuce (I hate really bad lettuce).  The topping to base ratio was fantastic and the flavor combination was top notch. 

We've also tried a number of other foods and have pretty much liked them all -- the wings are a little more bbq-y then buffalo, but they're still good (although I will say I prefer a crispier wing, but that's just a preference of mine, I wouldn't go out of my way to order theirs, but I wouldn't not order them).  

Oh and the garlic knots...amazing!!  We cut carbs, so a lot of complex carbs got the boot, but I always sneak a little bite when there's a garlic knot from Dino's in the house!

Final verdict? Check out Dino's for a wide variety of deliciousness- there is literally something for everyone!!!

text:
amazing food!

They had tacos, burgers, hot dogs, chicken strips, and chips and salsa. They also had one bathroom and plenty of seating during the lunch rush. Parking lot is small and most people get their food to go so a spot is always opening up. 

We ordered 3 Spicy Shrimp tacos. BOMB!
Fish tacos, ahi poke taco (with a cripsy won ton taco shell), and kbbq taco. They were good. But my appetite craved for more of the spicy shrimp. 

Their salsa and chips are ok, would like to see a bit more flavor to the pico de gallo. 

Prices are $4-5 per taco, but if you get the Triple combo, its $9 for 3 tacos any choice. 

After we ate, the kids hit up the batting cages and its so laid back! No helmet needed, and did it in flip flops. I know its dangerous..but it was fun. 

Glad we stopped by. Yelp categorized this place as a bar, but it's not, they serve beer along with your food.

text:
When the total was the cost of a month's rent.. it better be the most delicious meal you've ever consumed, right?

This is definitely like.. upscale, special occasion kind of place with high ceilings, impeccable service, and phenomenal food. The cocktails were amongst the best I've had in the city and the wine menu is extensive. There are a few other steakhouses in the area, but I think Butcher and Singer narrowly eclipsed them all. Aside from steaks, the other protein offerings were also perfectly prepared (the pork chop was huge... and juicier than I thought pork chops could be). The sides are also massive, much larger than we anticipated, which led to over-ordering. Also a side note, this place has the best biscuits I've ever had in my life.. because I normally hate biscuits.

All in all, would make a perfect dinner spot for a special occasion, or if your wallet be THICCCCCC.

name: Lara

text:
My wife and I had dinner at The Pelican Club on 8/22/2018 for our anniversary. We initially reserved a table but open walking in and being greeted by the bartender, Jason, at an empty bar we decided to join him at the bar. This was proven to be a great choice, as Jason's service was superb and easily the best service we received during our stay in New Orleans. Jason was friendly, funny and very proficient at his job. 
The food was easily the best meal we ever had, in New Orleans or anywhere else for that matter. I do not say this lightly. We each chose a 3-course meal from the Coolinary month menu. My wife had the Pelican Club Oysters, 1-lb Maine Lobster and Vanilla Cream and Brandy Creme Brulee. I had the Crab Cake, Louisiana Cioppino, and the Bourbon Pecan Pie. We were making all kinds of right choices that day because every single morsel was consumed. 
The Crabcake was lump and not full of filler. We live near Maryland, and this was by far and away the best crab cake we have eaten. I've never had cioppino before but this set the bar very high for cioppino and am seriously considering flying back to New Orleans for this dish alone. The scallops in the cioppino, which I am normally not a fan of, melted in my mouth. Being from the South, I consider myself a pecan pie connaisseur and I love bourbon, needless to say, the bourbon pecan pie was out of this world. My wife who grew up near Maine, also stated her lobster was the best she ever had.
If you are still reading this and trying to decide where to eat in the French Quarter, do yourself a favor and go to the Pelican Club. If you want to enhance the experience, sit at the bar. The atmosphere, food, and service was exceptional and highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting the area in the future.
name: Michael

text:

text:
While my experience wasn't as phenomenal as the other Yelpers who reviewed Wiz Kid, but my food was average/good. 

I ordered their most popular dish "Wiz Kid Philly" with a side order of "Okonomiyaki Fries" and a "Pot Hole" cookie. The sandwich wasn't a home run for me and I came away expecting more--I've had better vegan Philly's outside of Philly. The sandwich was missing something, like maybe more cheese or maybe mayo? The seitan was nicely flavored but I think the sandwich missed the mark in total. The fries were recommended by an employee and these were a little gross to me--I didn't realize just how much nori they'd put all over them, but I don't think these this flavors meshed will with the sauces (for me) and the nori took over everything. Finally, the cookie was really good but it could have been better without the jelly. You can't please everyone, I suppose. Overall, my total was about $20 for all of this.

Kudos to them for offering vegan junk food. I'll give it another shot next time, but WK won't be first on my list. 

By the way, I also learned that Wiz Kid is owned by the creators of Vedge (the best vegan restaurant in the world).

text:
This is one of my parent's favorite places to visit and after this last visit I can see why. I've always enjoyed their breakfast but never had their dinner selection. 

Food: I had the cod fish and it was so good! They really put the southern cooking into this meal. I may have been indeed hungry, but everything came out fresh and hot. Enjoyed the vegetables and the unexpected biscuit that usually set for breakfast. The strawberry lemonade was really refreshing and had real strawberry chucks inside. 

Service: Izzy my waiter was wonderful. She provided great customer service from the minute I sat down to the minute I had to leave. She made wonderful suggestions, made sure to refill my drink without asking, and presented everything with a smile. I also noticed that other staff was assisting each other and noticed that staff was cleaning areas when there were moments of downtime. 

Overall: I would truly recommend visiting this location. They have a great staff for dinner hours and they work well with each other. The entrance to this location can be a little tricky to find but it will well worth it. Prices of items are reasonable, and they have great specials. I hope they can keep up this great vibe and hope to revisit them soon.
name: Jermaine

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The music was louder than it needed to be. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
I've been coming here for years since it's a highly known GREEN BAY PACKER bar! Sunday's the place is packed from wall to wall with Packer fans and I love it, but unless you get there super early good luck getting a seat. 
As far as the food goes - I love it! You can't go wrong with their wings, burgers, or pizza. They have Wisconsin cheese curds which are also amazing! 
The servers during the games hustle and work their butts off but come in on a regular day and service is really lacking. Overall it's a great place to come in and watch some football & have great food - just try and be patient with the service.
name: Shayla

text: My favorite drinks place to imbibe before a show in Ybor. Kyle is spot on every time with what is seemingly the exact thing I want before I even know it. Also, the nachos. Trust me!
name: Nicole

text: Ordered the chicken Caesar wrap. Not sure how it even qualified as such. There was a random slice of melted cheese on it. Not even sure if there was Caesar dressing. Super disappointed, will not be ordering from here again. Gross!
name: Ginger

text: Joeys is  the best in the New Port Richey area. Their pizza is the best I have had in Florida. The veal is like being back in New York and DIANE is the best server around. Always a great meal at a good price. If you are in the area, give it a try. You will not be disappointed. Joey's is the best, and Diane too!
name: Michael

text:
Friend and I were in Reno for a live FFL auction draft the following Sunday. We were looking for all you can eat sushi and this was recommended. 

We definitely got our money's worth and our sushi chef hooked it up with something different every few minutes. We arrived an hour prior to them closing but they didn't rush us out.

Great service, hospitality, and price for all you can sushi.

Much appreciated Sushi One!
name: Anthony

text: My go to place I always go here. Honestly the best Pho I've found in Goleta in comparison to the ones in LA.
name: Jennie

text: did not like the Piergois, I like mine fryed with onions, theirs are just boiled. The other items on the menu were just ok
name: Rebecca

text: We haven't been here in a while and we were so disappointed in our choices today. Our burgers tasted like pre-made patties, without any grill flavor, and their texture wasn't pleasant. One of my favorites, that comes with lots of fried onions, simply didn't have them on the sandwich. The burgers here were terrific when it first opened.
name: Susan

text:
I will preface this with I have only been there once. However it was a Saturday evening and busy as there was an art walk going on and perfect weather for an evening out. However, the server (apologies for not remembering his name) was great! The menu was described perfectly and the suggestions were spot on. I chose the swordfish wrapped in prosciutto. Awesome! The 3 others in my party also were pleased with their service and meals. 
The atmosphere is comfortable and rustic. Also should note that we enjoyed an appetizer of chicken pate...never would have thought I would enjoy...but was tasty with a perfect amount of caramelized onion and served with lemon slices.
name: J

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Food was fresh and service was quick. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. It was crowded but still moved along. Glad we tried it. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Fantastic service. Great food.  Best Jamaican food in Tampa bay. We had both samplers, it was more than enough for the 4 of us. The beef patties were delicious and the pineapple soda was a nice treat.  The rum cake and bread pudding were great as well
name: Honest

text: Whenever we need a chicken fix on the go we find the closest Chick Gil A!  This location was very clean and well run, which can't be easy when they are so close to Sesame Place.  Our food came out fresh and hot and so fast I questioned if we were given someone else's food in error!  Loved the lime avocado ranch dressing that came with the wrap sandwich, and always appreciate the handi wipes for the end of the meal.  And kudos for the stick-on placemats for young kids.  Biggest compliment goes to the chocolate chip cookie, seemed like it maybe has some oats in it?  Soooo delicious and full of chocolate chips, almost as good as my husband's homemade creations!!!
name: Kris

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Definitely coming back. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text:
I had lunch here during their opening week. 
So far, I was pretty impressed. The food was good, the flow of the building is great, and it's one of the only places on Lower Broadway that doesn't blast the live band so loud that you can't hear the conversations of the people sitting next to you at the table. 

The view from the rooftop bar is wonderful of downtown, and I can't wait to experience it more on a happening night. I think this place is getting it right straight out of the gate, and it can only get better.

I'm ready to give it a few more chances and a few more goes as it keeps progressing! Great job on the place here.
name: Chad

text: This is a great restaurant. Clean store and bathroom. Just one complaint. The service is pretty slow. I went and it was empty and it took 30 mins for my drink to come. It was 1 Sprite. Otherwise, friendly staff and great food. I would recommend coming here as long as you don't mind a little wait.
name: John

text: This place is amazing! Their food is always tasty and done probably.  The staff is always friendly and they treat the customers well. My only complaint is they aren't open for dinner.
name: Megan

text: This is a nice place to chill, get work done on your computer, study, etc. It's cool if you want to meet up with a group. The name speaks for itself the vintage. It has an old fill to it... I sometimes would come here for a quick little snack. A single facet being a, being a bites or a muffin. Everything is made fresh in house.
name: Akilah

text: My favorite place for breakfast in Reno! Love the presentation and the food. Generous portions. The place is always packed, so it's better if you aren't in a rush. Their coffee could be better (they could offer dairy-free creamer, but I'll bring my own for the time being).
name: Eily

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. For a busy night they handled it okay. The music was louder than it needed to be. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Bagels were pretty awesome and they have a great menu. Counter staff was friendly as well. Different types of cream cheeses and butter for grab and go. We will definitely be back.
name: Susan

text:
***** 10 STARS *****
My wife and I moved to Indian from California and struggled to find any decent food around Greenwood. People here seem to love mediocrity.
...The we tried Oaken Barrel and my first thought was, well, HOLY $#!T!!!
This place, for the price, is near perfect. The pizza is so delicious, burgers are amazing, beer was fantastic and the atmosphere was both family and sport friendly. If this place had a small cigar zone and sold cigars I'd never leave :)

Tired of bland food,? Want to know what a smart business looks like and how it operates? GO HERE. 

Best food in Greenwood, and probably for 30 miles.
name: Brandon

text: Well we we tried this place tonight and sat at the bar.  Service was good but the girl behind the bar should not be in the service industry.  She has zero skills talking to the patrons.  My wife ask for a wine list and she looked like a deer in the headlights.  Clueless.  We will come back because we know this place is new and we support new businesses.   Btw my wife loved the burger!
name: Nicky

text:
The wings were amazing. I'm still sitting here feeling so tired from all the wings I ate. The workers here are super friendly and I feel like I'm at home. 

I had the regular and bbq wings, they were juicy and hot. The fries weren't great, tasted old, like they were reheated. Come here for the wings but skip on the fries, you won't miss much.
name: Kori

text: Great sushi at a good price. Location isn't bad. Friendly customer service, although there's a bit of a language barrier
name: Jarod

text:
I almost gave this place 4 stars but I don't want to be the one to break their 5-star streak. I had the steak and brisket pho. The broth was definitely one of the better, if not the best in Boise. It does have an oily feel which leads me to believe it was slow cooked with fatty meats for hours. As someone else said, there is a faint sweetness to it, almost a slight taste of star anise. I doctored it up as I always do, with Hoisun and Sriracha. My only criticism is it was a little noodle heavy and a little light on the meat. The steak and brisket was so good that I kept searching fruitlessly through my mass of noodles for more but came up empty. Then after minutes of searching I saw that one slice of brisket was stuck to the side of the bowl hidden by the broth. That last precious bite of meat was extra heavenly. 
Just wanted more for $12 you know? Also you do get 15% off right know but still. More meat please!
The waitress was very sweet. I used to go here when it was Pho 76 and I hope the owner of that place and his daughters are doing well. I do think about them. This will be my go-to pho place if I'm over in that end of town. Don't be alarmed by floating things in your water, it's just bits of lemon or lime they place in the pitchers. A nice touch for sure! Will come back, and look forward to trying more menu items!
name: Sarah

text: had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Also, delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Food took a while and didnt really feel worth the wait. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Excellent takeout. Never disappointed. Quick service. Extremely friendly and accommodating!
name: Lynne

text: I always love going to Sabrina's Café. Big portions and good food. I got the ultimate mexi scramble with a side of turkey sausages and man I had a hard time breathing after that meal but it was really good!
name: Jess

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Kind of landed in the middle for me.
name: User

text: My favorite coffee shop in tucson hands down! The coffee is so fresh and yummy, and the cookies are to die for! Especially the rumple stilkson butterscotch one! The staff is very friendly and hardworking and the inside is super clean. Good vibes in here too, I love the crystals around the shop and the positive energy in there. I am now a regular because this place is so good. Support local! Head over to enchanted cafe!
name: Megan

text:
Get here early, before they run out of all their traditional, Louisiana side dishes. 

I'm not a huge fried chicken fan, but somehow they get their seasoning inside the crispy, crunchy, greasy breading and into the meat of the chicken. It's always busy, but a great mix of all kinds of people (young and old ... tourists and locals) so there's plenty of people to chat with as you wait in line. Plus they keep the tables turning so even a long line feels like a manageable wait. 

Super kind employees and reasonable prices for New Orleans. I'd say a must visit if you're hankering for southern cooking near the French quarter.
name: Maddie

text: Took an hour to receive the delivery after ordering online. Delivery guy seemed to not know what he was doing and unprepared. Drink was spilled all in the carrier bag food just mediocre. This is probably the worst service I've had from Hotbox which is unfortunate.
name: Darrian

text: We went here while we were in town and got the Italian trio and king cod sandwiches. I am glad we did. They were delicious! Had them both on the cheese bread and it was so good.
name: Alex

text: Went for lunch here and honestly could not have been happier. The server was just amazing, he helped us pick  wonderful meals and wine. We had a house salad and Caesar salad to start the dressing on both was great - ALL the garlic. My Aunt got the salmon and I got the supremo- we really enjoyed both. The portions were very generous and the seafood curry sauce on my pasta was great. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone.
name: Lisa

text: 3.5. would be my score. Party of five with a small dog. We were in the mood for some Italian food while vacationing in St. Pete. Food was very good. We ordered the gnocchi, penne ala vodka, spaghetti bolognese, frutti de mare and pizza. Definitely hit the spot. Only downside was that outdoor seating for us was right in front of the restaurant. It is located in a strip mall so scenery was not the best. There is outdoor seating in the back but dogs are not allowed (obviously because the dog would have to go through the restaurant). Restaurant definitely gets busy so reservations are highly suggested.
name: Katherine

text:
Pleasant Indian restaurant near Boise! 

Food is delicious here. Got goat vindaloo, lamb korma, chicken tikka masala, and don't forget the garlic naan bread. All were good and prices are reasonable. 

Even my mother loves this place, it's how she got into Indian cuisine. She's been missing out all this time until now lol

I like creamy dishes and if you're like me go for any korma dishes, they're heavenly! 

Other than their regular dining hours they offer lunch buffet on Sundays only! I believe for about 11 dollars? Save your next Sunday for this place you won't regret it.
name: Phung

text: Great food and the people that work there are so sweet! Very fresh and short distance to main line and City Avenue.
name: Debra

text:
Stopped by here for a late night meal and had a really great experience. The food was fantastic and we had a really cool server. Fair warning, there's no diet food on this menu. 

I was with my mother so I didn't try a cocktail, but they had some interesting looking items on the cocktail list. But I was surprised by the steep drink prices. I think they are aiming a bit too high in that arena for the location. 

The reason I remove a star is because I tried going back a few weeks later with my husband for breakfast and the venue wasn't open. It should've been. It was normal hours, but the lights were off and the chairs were on top of the tables. Not even a sign on the door explaining why they were closed. 

Still, I'll try again. The food here is great.
name: Stephanie

text: Drove past this little place for years.  What an unexpected pleasant surprise!  We stopped here because we HAD to watch the Eagles preseason game 1st half.   I ordered snow crab legs & wings, the crabs were a nice portion although it said two legs, served  in a delicious broth without too much butter, cooked perfectly. Delish. My husband ordered mussels in the red sauce & wings, did I say homemade red sauce?  All sauces and dishes for that matter are cooked to order.  Although we both ordered the wings, we could have shared an order of wings, generous portion and size wings cooked to your palate.  The staff was very friendly. A great find in Tabernacle,  I highly recommend that you don't pass this one by.
name: Tina

text: My husband and I had a great date night here last night.  Started with a great bottle of wine and oysters.  We ordered from the restaurant week menu and shared a delicious soup and NY strip steak that was amazing! Had the Brussel sprouts on the side.  (they were great, but finished a bit salty for our taste). We finished with a red velvet cake.  Our server, Jay was amazing!  Also, the runner (I didn't get his name) boxed up our steak bone for our dog and even found her another one from the kitchen to take home too.  She loved it!  I thought this was so sweet of him to do.  We will be back, food was great and atmosphere was really relaxing and beautiful.
name: Sabrina

text: Absolutely delicious roast beef sammie!!!! I love this restaurant and enjoy coming here. It's a very dark bar not much of a restaurant but it's delicious. I love seeing them hand carve the meat. I love Sandy's.
name: Rose

text: The food was great. The service was awful! We have eaten at Saltgrass in Pensacola and in Biloxi, and this one by far is the worst. The only reason it got 3 stars is because of the food. Otherwise, it would've gotten 1 star. The managers were not managing the restaurant. They didn't speak to the customers, instead they moved a few tables and yelled at the staff. The wait staff was VERY slow. The table beside us actually got abandoned by the waiter and a couple got up and walked out because they never got served. We definitely will NOT be back to this one and we'll make sure to let our friends know this was a bad experience.
name: Amy

text: Wow! It's wonderful to find a restaurant with a HomeTown feel these folks at Chill go out of their way to make your dining experience perfect. We feel like we made new friends! The food was delicious! They couldn't do enough for us to make sure that we were happy with our  meal and had everything that we needed. The atmosphere is  great and the entertainment was fabulous can't wait to go back!
name: Shelle

text:
Great Place for a quick lunch.

Food is very good and is a great stop for a healthy-feeling and tasty lunch (though a bit pricey for "fast food" if you choose to grab and go).  

Bread is the star, as you'd expect and their sandwiches are very good.  The Frenchie is my personal fave.

Salads are always fresh and they usually have an interesting seasonal one that I always regret when it leaves.  

Soups are hit or miss.  Always tasty, but more brothy than you'd expect and sometimes surprising by what they're missing... example.  Split Pea has no peas in it.  Some of the mushroom soups have been similarly lacking in their namesake.

All in all, a good  and convenient place grab a bite on the weekday.
name: Neil

text:
Zio's, previously known as Cesarina's is a largo staple. This little bakery/italian bistro is a marvel that must be experienced to be understood.

When I tell you that the Sandwiches are the size of your arm, I am not joking. Should you get a Meatball Sub, the Meatballs are the size of Croquet Balls. Juicy and Delicious

Zio's has about everything a guy could hope for in an Italian Shop.
name: Steven

text: Had dinner last night here, first time.  The martinis were awesome.  I had the ribeye and spinach, incredible as it should be.  My husband ordered the surf and turf, petit filet and lobster tail.  The first lobster was very tough, over cooked and stringy.  The second was a little undercooked, edible and a little stringy.  The waiter and waitress couldn't have been more pleasant, top notch.  Beautiful restaurant, table very clean.

text: Went here with a couple girl friends for happy hour  before watching a movie at the Chase. Our server David was very friendly and attentive. I ordered the shrimp margherita flatbread and a couple martinis, which were both delicious!
name: Sophia

text: Awesome indian food at a good price .. Excellent staff! Super friendly! Always makes me feel comfortable ! Nice ambeience ! Just love it !
name: Nadia

text: Admittedly, you can find a course in the area that is in better shape, but given the layout of this course, the scenery, the amenities, and the price, this is one of the best value courses in Tampa Bay.  Of all of the courses I have played in the area to date, Wentworth is my favorite.  The biggest problem I have with this course is just how narrow it can be at times.  If you can play this course well, you'll have an easier time playing most other places around.

text: Odd location but their waiter was very attentive.  I'm all about service and this guy was waiting on the whole outdoor space! Kudos young man.  Sadly my friends and I won't be returning because we didn't care for the weird menu choices and lack lusty beer brew.  It's not a bad spot if you're stuck in Exton for the evening but if you want good beer and atmosphere, heard over to WOB.  Sry sun

text: I am extremely disappointed in the ShopRite at the Garden State Plaza. I patiently asked one of the butchers that was on duty on Sunday. I had asked him to cut me two fresh pieces of London Broil that was on sale.  I needed each piece to be 3 to 3 1/2 inches thick approximately 4-5 lbs each piece. I explained that I was looking to cure the meat and it needed to be this thick. He told me to come back in approximately 20 minutes. My wife and myself continued to shop. We returned about 20 minutes later and had to wait approximately 10 more minutes. When the same gentleman brought out the meat it was incorrect. It was approximately 2 1/2 inches thick. I told them it was way too thin for my needs. He said " if you wants me to re-cut it then you'll have to come back in about a 20 minutes more. He attitude was very unpleasant. Needless to say I did not purchase the meat from ShopRite in Cherry Hill.

text: My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Would probably stop in again if nearby. For the price I expected more than this. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.

text: Beautiful location! So much bigger than I thought on the inside. I came here to celebrate a friend's recent engagement with drinks and hors d'oeuvres and had a lovely time. text: The music was louder than it needed to be. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Food was fresh and service was quick. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.

text: So I came here the other day for lunch while we were hosting some applicants. It was pretty nice and quiet. It was well decorated. Not too dark with plenty of natural light. I ended up with the crabcake sandwich. We got brussel sprouts as apps. The sprouts were pretty good. They came with a mayo based sauce that enhanced the flavor. I could've used a sauce or more seasoning with the sprouts though since they were a bit bland when plain. The sandwich was good. Crabcake wasn't too breaded.  The aioli was good. Bread wasn't too thick.

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. It was crowded but still moved along. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. For a busy night they handled it okay. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Food was fresh and service was quick. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Not bad for a quick meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: The number one thing that i love about Elbtaco is the never ending variety of option. There are so many possible combination as well as toppings to make your meal your own. The meat itself is very traditional in taste but taste of good quality. There is not too much seasoning in the meat so its great for combining with the various sauces and toppings they have available. The portions are hearty and definitely fill you up. Overall I Love this place and recommend it.
name: DAnna

text:
A coworker and I stopped in for lunch in the middle of the week.  One of the great things about Nashville is that there is live music in every single restaurant and bar you go into on Lower Broadway.  They had an excellent musician playing her guitar on stage.  What a voice!  The only downside to having live music is that it is hard to have a conversation, especially since restaurant has an echo.

We sat at the bar and had a very nice bartender serve us.  He didn't rush us or make us feel bad that we were not ordering alcohol - it was a work day.  Best not to get fired before the holidays!

I ordered the Chicken Torta.  It was really good.  A soft, squishy bun lightly toasted with chopped chicken in an avocado mash.  Messy but good.  My coworker ordered the Hot Chicken taco entree - two tacos with rice and beans.  

Cerveza Jacks is not where you would go if you want authentic Mexican food but it is not a bad stop for a quick bite to eat in the middle of a work day or while bar hopping in the area.
name: Angela

text: I don't want to say awesome things about this place because every time I do, 6 months later it's so packed we can't get in! But...man this place is a hidden gem. Wife had shrimp and grits & I had the chicken caprese. So delicious! Will return soon as local hangout for good food and cold beers!
name: Christopher

text:
"Rocky" and his assistant, "Angie" were very attentive and really rendered exquisite service. 
We had some "Caesar Salad" and "Burrata with Heirloom Tomatoes" for starters. Appetizing, refreshing and really good!
For our entrees, we had "Linguini with Giant Scampi" and "Halibut with Asparagus and Red Onions." They were very delicious! 
For dessert, we had the "Chocolate Fudge Cake." Wow!!! Six layers of amazingness! Best dessert ever! 
The only disappointment we had was we couldn't have "Cappuccino," because they don't have an "espresso machine."  Apparently, they haven't had one for several months already. How could this possibly be in a "high end" Italian restaurant?! 
We felt bad for the wait staff since they were so apologetic. Well, whoever is in charge should get on the ball with this. 
Hopefully, next time we dine at Romanza, we will be able to enjoy some cappuccino also.
name: Malu

text: Came for the first time today and placed an order to go. The hostess was hostile and unfriendly. I didn't feel welcomed or accommodated and don't think I will be coming back because of it. Sushi was alright, wish I hadn't tipped.
name: Amanda

text: For the price I expected more than this. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. Maybe other people have better luck here. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. For the price I expected more than this. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
I've lived away from South Philly for about 15 years and was home for a visit. I was staying about a block away and my extended family drove in from SJ to meet for dinner, so Ralph's was a great option.

They arrived and valet parking ($10.00) is absolutely the best way to go.
The guy was fast and friendly and street parking can be a pain.

I had made a reservation on Open Table and they had a table ready when we arrived.

Our server came by to get drinks, the busboy​ brought a basket of bread. The bread is what south Philly is known for, crunchy outside, slightly chewy but light and fluffy inside. 

The server seemed a little annoyed when my brother-in-law asked for a glass for his beer and we only had one appetizer,​ but it's also part of the south Philly charm.

The place is old school, iconic and the oldest Italian restaurant​ in the county. It's an old three-story​ "Trinity" {livingroom, dining room​, kitchen, straight shot, front to back}. It's got great old tiles, historic pictures and you sit right on top of the next table.

Not much has changed in the last century, which is why it is so amazing.

My brother-in-law ordered a Meatball and Ricotta Cheese appetizer. it was two good-sized, hand-rolled​, perfectly​ seasoned meatball in homemade​ gravy with a dollop of whipped ricotta. {do not share this, get your own and use a lot of bread to wipe up the gravy}.

I had narrowed my choices to about six things, {you just don't great Italian food in Florida}. 

Two people at the table ordered Chicken Parmesan, Veal Parmesan​ and split them and shared. The veal was pounded thin, lightly breaded, tender and covered the large oval plate. The chicken was two thicker piece cutlets, both were perfectly covered with cheese and gravy.

The other dishes, Veal Rollatine , ​and a penne dish got rave​ reviews.

I decided on the Lasagna, I was served a nice size portion, perfectly layered and firm where the ricotta cheese and gravy stole the show and the noodles and ground meat were there to hold it up. It was pretty delicious.

It's not fancy, it's home, it's​ not sauce, its GRAVY, it's homemade, its history, it's South Philly.
name: Mark

text:
I came here during the Collision conference bc all the food cart inside were terrible. 

The wait was quite manageable and food was really good. I ordered the egg white crab meat omelette With the grits and found it to be very filling. The food doesn't come out that quickly, but the service was really good. The grits were really creamy and tasted really good with the crystal hot sauce.

Breakfast and lunch menus are available all day. I'd def recommend this spot if you are at the convention center.
name: Juliana

text: Their pizza is stellar and reasonably priced! I really love the spinach white pizza and the garlic knots are delicious. The pizza is always fresh but is still ready quickly and the service is great!
name: Alyssa

text:
Outrageously delicious shrimp wrap. Crunchy, fresh, juicy, bacon... yas.

Great ambiance & beautiful location.

Definitely would recommend!
name: Carlos

text: Came here one day randomly, and the place was sweet, romantic, and had a great ambiance. The coffee and toast was also delicious!
name: Sal

text:
I love Chick-Fil-A! I was so happy when this location opened, as the closest one to my house prior to this location was up at the Montgomeryville Mall which is a half hour away (as opposed to just living 5 minutes down Allentown Road from this location). This location quickly became a favorite of mine. Whether it's with the family for dinner on occasion, eating inside with friends or going for lunch when I used to work on the other side of the shopping center. The store is clean, the employees are friendly and the food is great from the classic chicken sandwich to the nuggets! 

The only downside I have to this location is as others may have mentioned, the parking lot. The lots are narrow to begin with and it doesn't help the way to the drive through is passing through the lot closest to the store where many people would be walking around to get in. There are 2 ordering stations but they converge into a single lane that curves around to the window (not to mention the waiting line is next to a window with eating customers, akaward for the both of us). Finally,  the drive through exits at the first narrow parking lot where many customers will be leaving (it's exit only, on the other side of the entrance to the drive through). Add in the fact it's almost always busy no matter what time of the day it is and it makes for a real fun time.

This parking lot makes me want to avoid the drive through all together and park in one or the further lots and walk in (on some cases it's quicker than the drive through) and other times it gets so busy, crowded and congested that I just skip it all together and go somewhere else. Overall it's a great location and I've gotten used enough to the parking lot that I keep coming back, but it's because of the parking lot it isn't as often as it could be.
name: James

My Dad likes the food and often does takeout, so since they have this new fancy location, I decided to take my Dad there for Father's Day. Boy oh boy- why did I do that? There was a wait but Im cool with that. Once they called us for the table, they cleaned it off and we sat down. The table was super wet and it got all over my arms and clothes:( We called over someone to dry the table and the waiter brings napkins to us like we work there! WTF? Ok so Irked #1 -- Next, the waiter comes over with his pad and just stands there- He did not even say the customary, "Hi My name is... I'll be your server for the day." Ok, so next I attempted to order french toast- Mind you they serve breakfast all day- ok so the waiter proceeds to tell me that they have no bread!! WTF? How is your main function- breakfast and you have no frickin bread for french toast??? Unacceptable!- Irked #2--- Next, we ask for a coffee refill and 15 minutes goes by and we see the waiter filling up someone else's coffee, so we say we're still waiting and he says Oh you wanted coffee? WTF? The restaurant only has about 8 table and he only had like 2 of them!!!- Irked #3---- Next, the waiter brings my Mom's lemonade and puts his whole hand over the top of the glass and puts it down on the table. WTF? Totally unsanitary! You never put your hand over someone's glass!!! My Mom was so disgusted! Irked#4--- They also messed up my Mom's order and served some of it cold!!! Overall, it was not a good experience. Unfortunatley, I cannot recommend this place and I will not be sitting in again. May still do take out but that's it! text: The first time I tried this place out was right after it opened. The server was extremely nice and a bit overly friendly, the food on the other hand wasn't anything special.
