I also wrote about it on my FB page, Flannel Country Dining.
name: Marc

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: I had the chicken and waffle Benedict, I enjoyed it but my husband had an omelet and found a long hair in his food.
name: Rancis

text: Stopped in about a month ago to see how it was.  Pizza looked amazing, but i went with a cheese steak.  They did it right.  Great slices of rib eye.  I got mine with provolone and fried onions.  They used an excellent sesame seed hoagie roll.  Some of the purist might not like, but the bread was fantastic and I liked the texture.  I'll be back
name: Tony

text:
Pegs has fantastic food and great service, you can't go wrong with any form of Eggs Benedict, and the huevos rancheros are a good choice too. My favorite dish is probably the salmon Benedict.
You get quite a lot of food, and I almost never finish my meal. 
But if you're going on the weekend, get there early. You're gonna have to wait for a table. 
Parking can be tough in this part of town, luckily it's very walkable.
name: Michele

text:
Best shrimp Po-Boys I've found anywhere 
They get a bit crowded at times and there is very little seating.  The ladies at the counter are wonderful and the food is well worth the wait.
name: Su

text: Had a great time here service is so amazing. Ginger is an amazing bartender nice relaxing place to just relax and hangout.
name: Jennyfur

text: An awesome speakeasy. This place is great. Very quaint. Has an exclusive type of feel to it, like you need to be on the "approved" list to get in. You don't of course, but that's how it feels. I only had a couple Old Fashions, but they were the best drinks I've ever had. So smooth!  Will definitely be going back to this place the next time I'm in Nashville. I think the wife will love it too.
name: Jason

text: Are you kidding me?!? A one hour wait and I counted 8 tables open. Hire some more people!
name: Alan

text: Simply the best breakfast in town!  Food and service are 5 Star!  Make sure you take advantage of the call ahead seating
name: Thomas

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text:
Basic. 
Waited such a long time for my order of chilaquiles and was even wondering why it would take so long. When I got my chilaquiles, they were cold!!!! On top of that, the server didn't apologize for the wait or anything just came and dropped off the bill without eye contact or a word. ??? Whatever. If you're craving quality chilaquiles, you're better off going else where. They weren't even tasty or spicy.
name: Tania

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
I've had brunch here a couple of times over the last few months and there's always a wait.  Service is wonderful for how busy are.  But the food is just "meh."  I haven't had anything worthwhile that has made me crave it enough to come back.

Cinnamon Roll - ginormous but dry on the outside and doughy and uncooked in the middle  (sorry, but I'll be sucker for Cinnabon any day)
Bloody Mary - Pretty good with nice pickled fixins'
Fresh-Squeezed OJ - really good
Spicy Burrito - it was ok...potatoes were spiced well, but not crispy
Huevos Rancheros - meh again, same story with the potatoes
Frensh Dip - Actually fairly disappointing.  It was bland, the meat was minimal and fairly chewy.  The au jus was an unappetizing color of cloudy with bits floating.  Side of fries were crispy, but completely unsalted.
name: Patricia

text: Great atmosphere. Guacamole dip is made table side! Had pollo, pulled pork, and vegetarian tacos and they were excellent.
name: Michael

text: The burgers rock here! But everything else we've ordered has been good. Do yourself a favor and try the Rancho Deluxe
name: Ivan

text:
Beautiful ambience but unfortunately terrible food, have been there for both dine-in and take out, disappointed both times. Tried buffet lunch on a weekend, it was just an average food, the flavors and aroma was missing altogether.
Ordered their chicken biryani which was soggy n under cooked and again missing flavors. Chili chicken loaded with tangy, sweet gravy (btw, I ordered dry) not worth trying.
Btw, the food is not authentic at all, way too compromised in taste and quality.
name: Navneeth

text: Took a friend to lunch today, 10/26. Waited almost 10 minutes for hostess to appear, and when she finally did she was dour and offered no apology for the wait, just a curt "Table for two?". All the warmth of a haddock. Not the norm here, but from that point forward the service and food were: excellent.
name: Timothy

text:
Very nice sushi spot. 
Ate here at 6:15 on a Friday evening for our anniversary and had the place completely to ourselves, not by design of course. 
Owner said they get busier later at night. 

Started with miso soup (above average and solid) followed by the dragon roll, playboy roll, and yellow tail nigiri.  I LOVED the fact that he fried the tempura fresh on each order. Most places do this ahead of time and simply broil it before placing inside the roll. This changes everything! 
Second round was salmon & avacodo roll along with the rainbow roll. 

$58 with just drinking water. That's totally fair considering we were choosing the more expensive rolls. The basic rolls are $5 - $7 and the specialty rolls are $11 - 14. 

Would most definitely go back!
name: Matt

text: I ordered a carry-out meal tonight and about halfway through my chicken teriyaki bowl I discovered a long hair. It definitely wasn't mine. Now it's just something to be wary of. I don't plan to return since this experience tainted Sushi Ai for me
name: Patty

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. For the price I expected more than this. Idk, for a busy night they handled it okay. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Anyway, our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. So yeah, no big complaints, just a nice meal. so yeah kind of mixed on it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not bad for a quick meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: My family has eaten there multiple times and would be glad to go again. The food is delicious and service excellent.
name: Brandon

text: Not at all what I expected! Sunday eve, you would have thought it a Friday or Saturday night! Sushi was so good! But when I ordered Volcano Chicken i didn't expect an 8 oz delectably fried tempura chicken breast sitting on top of 2 1/2 cups of crispy steamed veggies! And their brown rice was awesome! Highly recommend this place to everyone!
name: Jim

text:
Visited 6/20/19 - This is dang good bbq!  OK, don't take offense at what is or isn't BBQ, just give it a try!  We had a little time to spare and grumbly tummies before catching a movie at the Galaxy Victorian, and boom, there was Golden Rotisserie! 
The menu is varied, and the prices were good, and the food was fresh and prepared quickly!  And because everything tastes better when you share, we ordered the Taco Trio with tri-tip, and rice and beans, and hubby got their juicy golden rotisserie chicken & tri-tip combo plate, and chose their potato salad and yummy, tangy picked cucumber salad as his sides.
The meats were delish, juicy and flavorful, and the salad sides were bomb, too!  The rice and beans were a hit with hubby (best when shared) and pro-tip, if you like heat, order their hot salsa!  That stuff isn't messing around!  Great with chips and on the tacos too, and so spicy I had to get some water!
I hope that they do well down there, it was basically empty when we arrived!  The whole downtown Sparks redo near the theater is gorgeous and easier than ever to get to with the expanded parking garage.
So whether you call it BBQ or not, (to paraphrase Andrew Zimmern) if it looks delicious, just eat it!
name: Kathe

text:
Love the food and beer, but the amount of times lately that the hostess has simply declined to seat us, without even providing a wait time, because of the current guest volume has left a sour taste in my mouth. Especially after a 20 minute drive.

I don't expect to be seated immediately during the dinner rush, but being told "I can't do that" for a party of 7 and then walking away is neither a professional nor pleasant experience.
name: Jason

text:
Where do I begin? This place was wonderful. 

Date night for the BF and I. Since having baby we haven't had any real time to be alone and the drive up the coast to this little place was magical. The place is so cute and romantic. 

This place is right off the beach. There is plenty of street parking so that wont be a problem. They do close kind of early for all of those who like to go out late. Closing time is 10pm. 

We got carried away ordering. Good thing BF said for me to order away. 

Appetizers:

Ahi cones - so delicious... if it were up to me it would be in a salad with the crunchy cones as croutons. It was too small, that's how good they were. 

Grilled octopus - the last time I had octopus this fresh and tender was in Cancun Mexico. YUM!

Steamed clams with chorizo - This was so good also. who doesnt like clams? The chorizo made it more savory. 

Main dish:

Braised short ribs w/mashed potatoes - hearty and delicious. 

Roasted chicken w/risotto - also so good. 

All in all, I cannot say anything was not good. We ate everything and could have probably ate more. Definitely will come back when we have another night away from the kids.
name: Nancy

text: Great restaurant I eat there many times and I can tell this is the best place for Kabab and falafel
name: Amer

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Worth checking out. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Honestly, really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Honestly, nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. not sure I'd order the same thing again.
name: User

text: One of my favorite Tampa Bay hotspots! Great food and fun atmosphere! It is an upscale mix of eateries. Perfect date night or venue to catch up with friends! Also, the venue is absolutely beautiful with modern decor to match such a relaxing vibe! A must go-to location for great eats and good conversations!
name: Priscilla

text: We had the taco app, Caesar salad, and meat lovers pizza, shared everything and we both thoroughly enjoyed it all!  We will definitely be returning!
name: Trish

text: My Dad chose dim sum for Father's Day. We normally go to the big one on Page but the last couple of times we were there it was so bad I suggested we get out of our box and try something new. Enter Wonton King. I had been once before for lunch but never for dim sum. I timed it perfectly and we were walking in at 10:53am and they open at 11. Turns out by 11 it was completely filled. It took about 10 minutes (totally understandable) for the carts to come out after we sat down. I'm going to try and remember everything we tried. Pork shumai, shrimp shumai, the puffy buns filled with BBQ pork, a rice roll filled with shrimp (cheung fun), a delicious dumpling filled with shrimp and green onions, turnip cake, a red pepper stuffed with shrimp, Singapore noodles with vegetables, pork belly, pineapple buns, and maybe one or two other things but I can't remember. My favorite bites of the day were the puffy buns filled with BBQ pork and the pork belly. The BBQ pork was tender and had a sweet red BBQ sauce but the bun was light and airy. The pork belly skin was thick and crispy and the meat was oh so tender. The only thing that got a bad review was the turnip cake. I can't personally comment on it because I wouldn't eat it. My stepmother ordered it because she didn't know what it was! I'm not a dim sum expert but it tasted as if they make all of these dumplings instead of using the premade frozen variety. While the selection at Wonton King was not vast the quality of their offerings more than made up for it. We found our new dim sum place. No need to return to the latter. Loved it! I'll be dreaming of dumplings until the next time!
name: Michelle

text:
This is a terrible place to eat. Service is super slow and unapologetic. I don't understand why it is so hard for people to serve me in a timely manner. There's like four people in this restaurant and I haven't seen my server in an hour and a half. How can you call it bottomless boneless wings if you only bring one serving and never show up again regardless of the order I put in. Do not eat here. They are pretty lucky I paid my tab in all honesty.

In response to the comment below. There will not be a next time, as I have been turned off of WingHouse most likely for the rest of my life
name: Sean

text:
My wife and I are just passing through Tucson and we saw an ad for this restaurant and wanted to try it. Can't pass up a bbq joint.
It was great! My wife had the brisket while I had the pork ribs.  My wife had so much meat she had to take some back to the hotel. I got three good sized ribs with lots of meat and a nice char on the surface. Each meal came with bean, coleslaw and potato salad. Price was $13. Coke cost $2.00
Nice place with good food. Strangely situated in a KOA campground.
name: William

text:
Best Mexican Food Ever!!! This place is not only the best food in the Reno area, it rivals anywhere in California as well. We had a party of 6, ordered tacos, burritos, enchiladas, nachos, and Flautas. All of them were top notch, we are going back for dinner tomorrow. Service was as friendly as ever, clean restaurant and prices are very very fairs.

It's on the side of a strip mall, a little hard to find but there's tons of parking and very much worth the short 3 minute drive off the freeway.
name: Real

text:
Very under whelming.  It was like the energy was sucked out of us as soon as we sat down. Food was average, we did the lava rock cooking and it was just ok. We had to ask for silver ware, no plates with our appetizer, service was just average at best.
Parking is a challenge!!
name: Bob

text:
Went back for some appetizers with my kids. 

Bree was our server and did a great job. 

It would be nice to see some more gluten free options and perhaps more specifics on what is GF and what isn't. Got the nachos and they thought they "might have gluten".......that doesn't really cut it. 

We like the food there and we enjoyed sitting outside on the covered patio. Definitely will go back. Maybe by then, there will be more GF selections...... :)
name: Kristine

text: Very good food! It was fast, waitress super kind, and we love the music. We had the general chows. Very cheap too.
name: Mandy

text: Have been here a few times and it has been good. Last night was AWESOME!!  It was a work event and they were still talking about the dinner this morning. We started with the house made smoked fish spread and the artichoke dip. Both were devoured!!  Three of us got the gulf snapper with curry sauce. The sauce was very flavorful but not over powering. I had a taste of the shrimp and grits. Bradley's is a country store outside of Tallahassee that started in 1927 that specializes in grits and sausages. It was best best I have had - creamy grits, shrimp and sausage with just the right spice level. The star for dessert was the banana bread pudding.  Served hot in a cast iron skillet with ice cream. It was gone in minutes.  Will be going again soon
name: Mary Jo

text: Delicious food!! Delicious food!! Large portions and decently fast service. Waitresses were friendly. Beer is too expensive and no where to drink it while waiting to be seated. But overall, best place so far in Nashville.
name: Sara

text: My friend and I had a great lunch at this amazing Italian eatery. The bread and the homemade pesto was out of this world. We both had the Muscles in a white wine sauce on a bed of angel hair pasta. It was delicious paired with a perfectly chilled Reisling. For desert we shared a tiramisu and it was equally amazing. The atmosphere and the service are great and even though we were a gay couple casually dressed we were treated well. We did get some looks from a few Snohomish, pretentious guests but who cares our money's spend the same as theirs. We plan to go back soon.
name: James

text: I've been here three time and three times it was for the same thing - the burger. Make sure you have no plans afterwards because you'll be so full and satisfied you'll want to go home and nap on your couch afterwards. It's one of my favourite places in the city to take friends visiting Philly for the first time!
name: Maya

text:
The boiled shrimp was excellent - fresh and spicy.  The bread pudding was also great with a warm bourbon sauce that will knock your socks off. 

Unfortunately I was not pleased with the "handmade stuffed crabs". From the description, I expected a crab with stuffing. Instead. It's more like a crab cake and not a very good one.  Also the cole slaw was on the bland side. 

Service was good. The restaurant is not fancy but is clean. I would gladly return for some more boiled seafood.
name: Debb

text: Ehhhh. We waited a while to get our order taken. Ordered a pepperoni combo. When we got it they had forgotten to put pepperoni on it, so we had to wait even longer for another. The pizza was pretty bland. Maybe if they seasoned their sauce it would be tastier. The honey that they give you for the crust tasted like honey and plastic. Maybe they should store it in glass jars.
name: M

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Glad we tried it. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text:
Great restaurant! I absolutely love the decor and the ambience.. I was initially looking for the movie theater close by, and wanted to get a bite to eat beforehand- so I chose this place out of the others around and it was a hit! 
Ordered guacamole and so glad we did they make it right in front of you offering mild, medium , or spicy I went with the medium, although There was no kick whatsoever , next time I'll probably get spicy. But it seems every place can be so different when ordering spice levels that's why I wanted to play it safe lol. 
Had the salmon salad- very good! 
Drinks - awesome!
Hubs had the filet mignon / he ordered it medium rare but it came out black and blue which was a tiny downfall but overall awesome place. Will definitely be back..
Service was very good too!

Also FYI they have pretty good vegetarian 
Selections..
name: Yanna

text: Good breakfast spot. Quick service, fun options!
name: Heather

text:
I've had the pleasure of trying The Dandelion's Afternoon Tea, Lunch, and Dinner and I've loved all three of these experiences!!

Recently, I had Afternoon tea with 3 friends. My friend made a reservation for Sunday afternoon, and was sure to note the different allergies of the group (nuts + cucumbers).

The 4 of us shared "A Royal Occasion", which was a 3 tier with sandwiches, pastries and tea. However, when we got our order we weren't sure which foods were free of allergens. When we informed our waiter of the table's allergies he was quick to apologize for not separating the dishes and took it back. When he returned he told us he got new sandwiches and pastries, and separated the foods the were free of allergens. 

My friends and I were pleased with our waiters care and attentiveness, but I would just remind those with allergies to remind their waiter before they order!! 

Overall, the food was delicious and were pleasantly surprised by how full we were!
name: Stephanie

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: If you don't get the table side Caesar and the crab cakes, you're missing out. This was one of the best dining experiences I've had in a very long time. I can't wait to go back
name: Jessica

text: Everything here is just like the name! The kitchen is open and you can see they use and make everything extremely fresh. I got the vegan panini and it's one of the best vegan sandwiches I've tried!
name: Kasey

text: Friendly staff and excellent service.  The food is okay.  My daughter is a big meat eater and she was fifty/fifty on the selection- the bacon wrapped chicken was salty and a slice of beef had gristle.
name: Evelyn

text: I met business colleagues here for lunch during the week. I love the concept of serving only breakfast, lunch and brunch with an extensive menu that is sure to please everyone. The place feels like an up-scale diner - the food is well prepared and presented in a pleasant, casual atmosphere. This a great place to enjoy a good meal and comfortably get business done as well.
name: Pat

text: This one of the oldest restaurants in Plant City. They have been here since 1967. They accept cash only, they don't have a drive thru, no tv, and I do not know if they have wifi. What they do have is great food, friendly people,  nice prices, and they have a walk up window, instead of a drive thru. They have a bucket of shrimp,  a bucket of fish, deviled crabs, fried fish, chicken gizzards, and so many other items on the menu. Back in the day they were high priced. Now the are very good on what you get for your money. An example would be 3 deviled crabs and 2 sides and a roll for $7.75 this I think is a super buy. The only thing I reason I gave them 4.5 stars is the parking is limited. Everything that is fried is in peanut oil. So if your ever in Plant City, this is definitely a place to try.
name: Keith

text: Ive been here twice now and I really wish I lived closer. Food was incredible and the service was amazing. Mo was our server and he was fast, kind and made really great recommendations. You must try the wings! So yummy. Cant wait for our next visit
name: Adriana

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The music was louder than it needed to be. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: GTP has become like a 2nd home for me. Ed, Lucas, Brandon and the entire kitchen staff treat you like family. I eat a ton of chicken wings, but GTP is one of only two places in town that have great ones and they might be the best I've ever had. My 2nd favorite on their menu is their Nashville Hot Burger.
name: John

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Price felt a touch high for what it was. For a busy night they handled it okay. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Well there sign says open at 11am but the door is locked at 1105am. Waitresses inside see us but won't open doors or at least let us know why the doors are locked. Don't think we were welcomed.
name: Richard

text: Water tasted like bleach. I won't even begin to describe the food because it does, in fact, get worse than drinking bleach.
name: Alysha

text:
First time to Sugar Creek Brickhouse. We were greeted at the door and seated at a table. The table was just inside the entrance and it was cold out, every time the door opened we got a blast of cold air across our feet and our table top. I thought the service was fine and the wait was not too long. Although our waitress asked us the same question four times. 

We ordered a barbecue chicken flatbread, and sweet potato fries, applesauce, and breadsticks with cheese. The flatbread was not really flatbread it look like their pizza crust just made into an oval shape. The the toppings were okay. The breadsticks were nice and hot and soft and nothing special about the cheese it came out of a jar or a can. The crinkle cut sweet potato fries look like they came out of a frozen bag.

At first glance nothing I would really go back for.
name: Tyanna

text:
If you have ever been to a great deli - this is not what you are looking for!!!!!!!!! The deli and prepared food looked very dirty and food looked horrible and very old. I would never order any of it. The deli workers were the most unfriendly and sad workers- they acted like it was a chore to wait on you. The whole place just gives off a bad vibe and I hope this review can save other vacationers from making a bad choice.
Go to Publix for your great deli sandwiches - they are 100 times better than this place.
How the ratings on this place or so high I do not know!
name: Linda

text: Good strong (strong enough to know they didn't forget the liquor) house Margarita. With the exception of 1 particular waiter, great service. Great food. Only complaint (and why 4 instead of 5 stars) is that the food isn't served hot enough...  I want to see steam coming from my delivered plate and I don't want to bite into something that room temperature that should be hot..  Heat brings out the flavor.
name: Tom

text: Yum yum yum. This place is delicious. Yes, it is expensive but you taste the quality and every single penny is worth it. The staff is incredibly friendly and accommodating.  They are genuine and not overly pushy which is nice. The quality of the meat is also exceptional.  The sirloin was to die for, I honestly could have spent the whole night with just a skewer of that. I suggest making a reservation or going after the rush. We had a 7pm reservation and by the time we left it was fairly quiet. I can't wait to go back once I've saved up some dough. Haha
name: Samantha

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would return. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: It's a small place but luckily they have outside seating in the back. Though on a hot or cold day it's pretty much useless. They have a great selection of beer if that's your thing. I can't say that about the food I had. I ordered a cheese steak. Come on it's Pa. they know cheese steak, right? No, you can actually find bad cheese steaks in Pa. Sad but true. When you get a cheese steak there are four things you look for. 1. Is the bread it's got to be fresh 2. Quality of the meat 3. Real cheese or cheese whiz 4. Size of the sandwich. Let's face it when you order a CS half the reason why is because your hungry and know CS's are pretty big, you know a big man's meal. Well this one was built for a kid. Too Small in my opinion, not that tasty either. It was dry and no real flavor. Worst of all it was cold. A cold CS? C'mon. Burgers are Ok. French Fries are really good. Wings are good. This place is know for their craft beers, so if you want a great place to hang with some buds after work on a Friday, this is the place. Food is above average pub food. Even if their portions are kind of small.
name: Rene

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was fresh and service was quick. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Would return. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. For a busy night they handled it okay. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Idk, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Not bad for a quick meal. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: I had a pretty mediocre experience here. It was later on a Tuesday night. I waited for awhile at the host stand for someone to come seat me. Our server was very nice. I ordered enchiladas, and they were fine. They weren't really anything special, and I've certainly had much better enchiladas at places not too far away. I was hoping to be in and out pretty quickly, but we waited a really long time for the check. And then waited longer to pay. And then longer to get the receipt to sign. All in all, the payment process took around 25 minutes. That would have been more understandable had it been busy, but there were maybe 2 other tables occupied. I could hear the staff in the bar area talking and goofing around--that didn't bother me, but what did bother me was that it seemed like they were goofing off instead of helping customers. Given that and my overall "meh" feeling about the food, I don't think I'd come back or recommend this restaurant, but I wouldn't actively discourage others from giving it a try.
name: Leah

text:
I've been here several times and I always have a great time when I go! The music is just right-just the type of music I'm looking for ranging from hip-hop and R&B to "Trap" music. The bartenders and waitresses have always been attentive and the crowd is always pretty cool but can be a lot younger sometimes depending on the day that you go. 

Downstairs when you first walk in is an open area with the dance floor and main bar. On the side are small sections (I'm assuming VIP) for drinks and hookah. Once again, depending on the night it can get to be super crowded in here. Upstairs is the roof top where it's a different DJ but it's a lot more room to breath and there are fire lamps upstairs if you go during the colder months. 

Overall, I've had fun on both my visits here and really couldn't find anything negative to say about this place!
name: Uneka

text: Pleasantly surprised at the delicious cauliflower crust on our pizza. Crispy, flavorful, and healthy alternative to wheat crust. We each ordered the 10" white pizza with a couple of additional toppings and loved it. Service was fast and especially attentive thanks to our personable server, Bill. We live in the neighborhood and we will be back. The Grandkids will love the playground. It looks like they  handle large groups well, too.  And we noticed that there was a party happening in the private dining room.  Highly recommend.
name: Judi

text: I love this place and I'm not even a big fan of pizza. The easiest way to describe it is like a subway that doesn't suck but for pizza. Choose your own sauce and toppings and they cook it right in front of you. Or if you'd prefer they have their "classics" on the menu with everything picked out for you. The place is small and friendly and it's a great place for a quick lunch. The one and only downside is I always end up overeating here. Everything is just so good. Try it and you won't be disappointed!
name: Colton

text: THIS RESTAURANT is By far The Best Middle Eastern Restaurant in Kenner City ,and surrounding areas. -The food is Beyond Exceptional, with culture and Authenticity seeping through Every Plate that I have ever Tried at this establishment - (try the stuffed Grape Leaves) -  not to mention the family Like service that Is Given here, Especially by one server-Aly, is the best food and beverage employee anyone can acquire-she knows me by name every time i walk in and can recite my order to me before i know it , Always thanks Ally!
name: Mohammad

text: When you walk in seeing Mexicans eating in a Mexican restaurant, it's a good sign. I wouldn't trust anyone's pallet more on a south of the border cuisine. There salsa is the best Mexican salsa I've had. It has just a little more spice then most competitors. But not enough to make it to hot. The food is great and they have candy for sale at the cash register. All is right in the world when you're  eating here.
name: Shawn

text:
Rebel Taco (Bourse) offers a nice, varied selection of tacos and other popular Mexican items.  The food is fresh and the taste is above average.  Its a little pricey- I paid $8 for two tacos  which I ate in under 5 minutes and was still hungry.  In all fairness to Rebel, that's standard pricing for the Bourse.  Plus I do have a big appetite, so $8 might fill you up just fine.  
The offer your standard drinks, plus Mexican sodas and alcohol.
Overall, definitely a place worth checking out at least once, especially for taco fans (and who isn't?)
name: Brad

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Will be back. Not bad for a quick meal. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: Food is always burnt and not fresh serves days old food the cornbeef hash comes out of a can 4 of the servers are sweet out if 6
name: Courtney

text: One of those meals where nothing is exactly wrong but you're not excited either. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: What a cool place! You want a local spot? You got it here. Super casual, feels off the grid, and in a cool part of town. I waited in line at Flamingo down the road for an hour (the bouncers were letting all their friends in ahead of us in line) and after being so frustrated by it we left and started walking and discovered Never Never!! I'll be back, not a ton of sitting area, not a ton of fuss, it's the perfect low key spot for a brew with the buddies.
name: Caroline

text:
Food was decent, nothing to brag about, service was okay and the mimosas were worth the wait. Sorry not worth elaborating about. Just ok
But that damn biscuit amazing. Fat boy in me just wanted biscuit and mimosa lol
name: Grow

text: Chicken Burrito & Bowl. Both just what you would expect to get at Qdoba. Tasty but nothing to write home about. Good people watching spot lol.
name: Doug

text: A huge disappointment. While I applaud the ambitious move into Moorestown for this long time favorite, they seem to have left customer service at the original location. From the disinterested hostess who may have been having a bad night to the waitress with a touch of memory loss things went from rude to worse. The wait at the bar was fine, waiting 35 minutes for bread and water was not. Having the Manager ask if we understood what one of our party ordered after the wrong dinner was served by reading the menu to check the ingredients has NEVER happened to us. Your apology was appreciated, taking the meal off the tab was the right thing to do, properly training your staff is your only chance. Having servers walking up and down the bar, with dishes in their hands ,asking who had ordered which dish was hard to watch. There are countless Italian options in the area, your name carries the weight of a reputation well earned, you need to live up to it.
name: Eric

text: So I would consider myself a person that doesn't overreact and shrug off bad service. I get it, people go through stuff or mistakes happen. The woman that was helping me was very pleasant, and she was the only reason I wasn't even more disappointed. I ordered pizzas online with a 15 minute order time. I got there around 25 minutes later and none of it was ready, which wasn't a problem, I understand that it's an estimated time. However, the problem was they ran out of an ingredient and said they tried calling me and everything. I didn't receive a single call, nor missed any calls or voicemails. So when I got there the pizzas weren't done. I waited there for awhile, I didn't keep track. All of this to say, I didn't get a refund (I didn't ask) because I didn't want to get more mad, wasn't worth it. However, the woman helping me was very pleasant and was trying to make me happy. I don't blame her, I just blame the guys in the back on there phone or vaping outside. The experience was just annoying.
name: Parker

text: Let me start by saying I love poke and decided to try this place because I was in the area... not thrilled. The fish was old and chewy and everything seemed to be extra. I'll stick to the normal place I go.
name: Alison

text: Update to my previous review. I have not been back to three wiseman due to distance, however I will say that the management and customer relations person, Shelby, with Scotty's Brewhouse (I believe they own three wiseman) went so above and beyond to make up for our previous experience. She was genuinely concerned, listened, and again went beyond to make it right. We will be trying Three Wiseman because of you. Thank you Shelby!
name: Lindsey

text: The best steakhouse I've ever been too! I had a rib-eye steak that was melt in your mouth good with creamed corn AMAZING (the mashed potatoes and Brussels sprouts were also delicious). Do yourself a favor and get the Lemon Cake--probably one of the best Lemon Cake's I've had EVER. And get the VIP drink infused with pineapple so good. Do yourself a favor and uber there. We a had two. Excellent atmosphere and service. I highly recommend this place!
name: Barbara

text: The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: This is a great place to eat! It is one of the few places all of my friends can eat since we have a wide variety of dietary needs. Staff was very nice, helpful and knowledgeable about the food.
name: Emily

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. Honestly, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was fresh and service was quick. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: I ordered the smoked chicken dinner plate since I  only like white meat they agreed to pull the meat and chop it. Unfortunately after they chopped the the meat the gentleman working behind the counter proceeded to take all the chicken and squeeze it with his hands to make sure there were no bones in it. You can imagine how unappetizing it must've been to look at this man with gloves that had touched trays, the counter, counter  door and utensils squeezing and smooching the chicken into small pieces that I was about to eat. I did not eat the chicken. Very unappetizing and unsanitary. the baked beans were good the jalapeño macaroni and cheese was good. Unfortunately my experience today has left me with a very bad taste in my mouth for this establishment
name: Simpson

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: I really like this place, the prices were reasonable the food was really good and our waiter was awesome. I'm sorry I did not get his name. He was very handsome though. I went with two friends from work and they love the place, and my coworkers hamburger look delicious and my other coworker got chicken mushroom Dijon I think it was that look pretty darn good too. I would definitely go again.
name: Cynthia

text:
Love the service here. The staff is so kind and welcoming! Prices are pretty reasonable for the huge portions they give you. I like the variability of sandwiches, pho, seafood.

I am a vegetarian and love the options they have for vegetarians. Ordered their tofu banh mi, wow so filling!  They also have deals some days like $4.99 Mango Rice!

The food comes out hot, fast and fresh. My boyfriend and I love coming here at night.
name: Alice

text: Our waitress, Helen, was fantastic and don't skip the queso appetizer! There were 8 in our party and she was on top of drinks and chip refills. Unfortunately there were quite a few refills because our entrees took longer than expected to arrive even though they weren't too busy. We asked if they had chimichangas even though they weren't on the menu. 4 of us ordered chimis and found out why they're not on the menu.  Smelled some fajitas on the way out that make me want to go back!
name: Alexis

text:
I've had better pizza in my life, but for walking in and walking out 5 minutes later I gotta hand them a solid 4. It's like a subway, you can order a sandwich they invented or pick your toppings. There are limited salad options too. 

We were greeted when we entered, helped promptly, and I think what I liked about this place is that the employees seemed to be having fun. The work area is open so we can hear them all talking and I liked their vibe. I got a Mod Mad Dog pizza (sausage and pepperoni). The pizza crust is tasty. 

We ate on the patio which was much nicer than the inside. Especially on a gorgeous November afternoon! I got a can of House Rose. They have compostable straws. :) That made me smile. 

I'd come back.
name: Christina

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I left full, which at least counts for something. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Love this buffet, great food and great atmosphere,  join players club for $5 off every time
name: Tabitha

text: 45 minute wait for drive thru food. I work in restaurant industry, but come on..... it's just a burger
name: Lauren

text:
I went with a friend and we were both really disappointed in our food and service.  She ordered a regular size spicy tuna bowl and I ordered a large shrimp bowl, loaded with everything.  Even though I paid for a large bow, I received a regular size.  There didn't appear to be any difference in how much food we got.  Her tuna was completely bland without a hint spice.  Even adding soy sauce and chili sauce didn't improve the dish at all.

The shrimp in my shrimp bowl were laughable.  They were cocktail shrimp out of a jar and about the size of my pinkie nail.  They had no flavor whatsoever.  Considering all the toppings I had ordered, I expected it to have a ton of flavor, but again, it was completely bland.  I went up to get extra ponzu sauce but after waiting for a few minutes, I gave up because I was completely ignored.  

So, I was overcharged, received the wrong size and our food was terrible.  Customer service was non-existent as well, so I'm not inclined to go back any time.
name: Kristen

text: Came here the night of Memorial Day for dinner after a long day of drinking in the sun. I loved the atmosphere, it was very relaxing and chill outside but one of the inside bars had some good hip hop music playing and people dancing which I thought was cool. I didn't think the place would be that big from the outside! Service was attentive and quick for how busy they were but they did forget about my boyfriends ENTIRE meal so he couldn't eat with us and took it to go since they were closing so that was a bummer. I'd recommend this spot
name: Marissa

text: Excellent hole in the wall or Korner in the wall place for breakfast. The service was very friendly and always prompt. The food is very simple here and is excellent. Don't come here expecting too many frills and thrills on the menu for the place itself. I really enjoyed my simple hometown cooked meal. I'll be back seeing that it took me a minute to find. It's kinda hidden. I got the two eggs, bacon with toast n hash browns / coffee for about $9.50
name: Bob

text: Checked out this neighborhood coffee and cafe shop. Welcoming team managing the front and back offices. Clean and tidy work spaces and facilities. Coffee reasonably priced. Other selections also available to keep fingers on the keyboard busy, or just time to read. Outside seating in good weather, nice space, on day we visited, for legacy newspaper readers, who were also trying to learn two-handed smart phone techniques. Productive day. Concluded with the chicken and grape salad on a fresh English muffin. Nutritious and fulfilling. Delish! Recommended.
name: Freddie

text: Service is absolutely HORRIBLE. We saw our server maybe 3 times while we were there, the food took forever, our order got messed up and the waitress was incredibly rude. The food was fine but not worth the bad service.
name: Samantha

text: Be warned.  Food was fine.  Took forever for tacos to be made.  Ordered guac & chips and 7 tacos & beans for my party of 4 with two young kids.  30 min later no sign of food.  Went up and requested at least the guac, which they brought out.  Then tacos came on two trays.  No containers for kids to eat on-fine I'll go ask for one.  Go request a container and guy makes me wait, passive aggressively, as he slowly continues an order with said paper containers within arms reach and will not just reach and hand to me.  Jerk.  I in no way interrupted the order in progress but we had already been waiting forever for simple tacos.  And kids were hungry as was I. Beans we ordered and paid for never came.  Do not recommend.
name: Shana

text: This is a nice little neighborhood restaurant, but it's worth coming from out of the "hood" to enjoy.  The food is well prepared and the menu is extensive for such a local place. Service is very good and friendly.  Quiet ambiance, so plan on having nice conversations with friends. Quite reasonably priced.   I come here often and it is consistent.
name: Denny

text: I really like the food at Viman Thai.  They don't seem to have a big staff so service is always on the slow slide. They would really benefit from having an extra person in the kitchen or dining room, especially on weekend nights.  Overall, I definitely recommend!
name: Katie

text:
Soup dumplings galore! Haven't had this good of soup dumplings since Boston. The line was really long when we came in but it moved quickly and was worth the wait. My favorites were the spicy soup dumplings and the shrimp soup dumplings. The dumplings were the perfect temperature, not burn your mouth hot but still hot and the consistency of the dough was great. Not a single one ripped when taken out of the steamer! I always appreciate some good dumplings and these were impressive. 

Hint: not your typical dim sum place, this is more of a dumpling house than a dim sum one
name: Phuong

text: First time trying the food. It was great. Huge portions. The 12 in philly was enough for my wife and I. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is they left off the extra mozzarella. Other than that, I recommend.
name: Tomi

text: I love this place! everything I have ever ordered has been amazing. It is a little pricey but you get what you pay for in life. I highly recommend the mushroom gravy on anything.
name: Sarah

text: Went to Sardi's on a Tuesday evening (10/23).  Used Chowhound to place the order online for 8:30 pickup.  Food was not ready at 8:30 but they said it would be ready in 10 minutes,  I sat and waited until 8:50 and noticed there were two boxes sitting near the pick up counter and the lady working pickup was walking right by it for 10-15 minutes,  She had no clue.  She didn't include the sauces or plasticware.  Then I get home and they do not have the correct order for one of the meals I ordered.  Called and talked to the GM (Hector) and he said they would give me the correct order next time.  Said they were having problems with the quality of labor.    Food was cold since it sat a long time.  Kind of a disaster.  You will see if you go there and observe.........
name: GMan

text: I got the bazooka toast, it was amazing! A little bit pricey but totally worth it. So good it inspired me to give my first yelp review :)
name: Amy

text: I love this place. Recently moved a short walk from there and it's a great pop in for dinner place. The inside is so cozy feels like you're eating in someone's kitchen. The food was good very authentic, and they have good specials during everyday. I'm a huge fan of the homemade salsas that they serve you. Definitely great and will visit
name: Nicole

text: So happy we found  this Pizzeria via Yelp while we were on vacay at JW Marriott..They accommodated our large party of 10  via reservation and the food was DELISH. For starters, the bread and bruschetta were so fresh. The dipping oil was a big hit. We ordered 4 different Pizzas to share and still  had leftovers. Get the mixed salad...so yummy. But the best review goes to our server Erick. He was so helpful, cheerful and took care of us. Do yourself a favor and eat at this Pizzeria
name: Odette

text: Food was very very good , we  got the wings, calamari,  korean beef tacos and goat cheese and onion burger was all delicious,  only down side was the server was rude and seating was to tight, would definitely  eat again
name: Kyle

text: My go to spot for good Korean food. Would have given a 4 star but they are a little on the pricey side but, when you need your fix, you'll pay.
name: Danielle

text: Definitely one of the best places to eat in NOLA. Recommend making reservations and checking the dress code before heading down there. If you do have a wait, there are lots of sights in the Garden District to check out.
name: Joseph

text: I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was fresh and service was quick. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: I went with a group of six! We made reservations for brunch which I would definitely recommend. I had the Which Hunt breakfast sandwich and it was good but the potatoes were over cooked and had been sitting under the heat lamp for too long. My friends got the Merica breakfast and the chicken biscuit with gravy. They fussed at the table about the Merica breakfast and said it wasn't anything special but in my opinion there really isn't anything special about eggs, bacon, toast, and potatoes...  it sure what they were expecting but it looked and tasted exactly how it should have looked and tasted in my opinion! It was good all in all but I've gotta rate it four stars for the fact that everyone's potatoes were over cooked and had been sitting out too long! Fun atmosphere, too.
name: Casey

text: I have the turkey bowls or pork sandwich  a couple times a month. Always good. Muffins are always fresh also
name: Ed

text:
Great food,  great ambiance! Happy hour 2pm-6pm, by one get one free, well drinks and house wine.  We were looking for a local dinner place to take our father for a birthday dinner. We have driven by this place but never stopped in, what a great surprise! 
Highly recommended, very New England style feel to the restaurant. 
Ashley was our server and was wonderful!  
Will definitely return and spread the word!
name: Titia

text: I ordered the enchiladas without sauce and halfway through dinner I bit into a rock hard piece of what I think was charcoal, about half the size of a tooth.  I brought it to the attention of the waitress who said she would speak to the manager about it.  15 minutes later, no manager, so we asked for the check.  10 minutes later we get the check and it was then that I felt angry about this incident not being addressed.  So 10 minutes after that I asked the waitress if she could comp me "something" for the foreign object, and she said again that she would speak to the manager.  5 minutes goes by, the manager comes over and said he would comp the meal.  Another 5 minutes and we get the check back.  Another 5 minutes before the waitress comes to pick up the tab, another 5 minutes until we pay.  No wonder there is such a slow turnover of tables!  And we were seated in the bar area, in very close proximity to the waitress station.  The actual enchilada was awful, btw; four tasteless hard pieces of chicken.
name: Barbara

text: Came here with the guys for a bachelor party dinner. Food and service was amazing. I had the gulf seafood al ajillo. This may of been the best dish I had in New Orleans. I also tried a piece of steak that was ordered to the table and it was delicious. Can't wait to go back when i am in town
name: Denard

text: We drive 45 minutes to eat here.  This is the best Indian food restaurants I have ever been.  The staff remembered us from the start.  The food is worth every penny.  You must check them out.
name: Null

text: My first Good Burger visit. The burger was good, not exceptional, ingredients were good, nothing unusual, the bun was stale, the service was extremely slow - my buddy and I and one other customer were the only orders at the time, no others there.
name: Steve

text:
This place lacks luster. The music is hitting and wait staff have great personality but not much of an experience on a Sunday afternoon. 

PROS: 
- Decor is nice, chairs and longe area are comfortable. 
- Area to step out and smoke a cigar 
- Eager young ladies that try their best
- Great customer relations - across the board 
- Music! 

CONS:
- inexperienced wait staff

NOTE: Did not try the food, might be great
name: JT

text: This was a great barbecue place!  Everything is homemade fresh.   The staff are super friendly and courteous.  A host came up to us and started talking to us after we ate.  She was really nice!  I highly recommend this place.  They support a lot of great causes but the focus is veterans / military / police / fire.
name: Eric

text: Good very good my first time having there Chinese food and they have really good Mexican food especially their tacos
name: Lewis

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Parking was annoying, although that's prob more about the area than the restaurant. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text:
Great service and food. I was really surprised by how delicious the food and desert was. 
It's a must go to
name: Khalid

text:
I had dinner here tonight while in Nashville for work.  The space is bright, beautiful, and inviting.  I sat at the bar where Nathan promptly poured me a glass of water and handed me a menu.  After asking for his suggestions, I went with the Good Samaritan cocktail - a creative and unique drink that isn't really comparable to another bourbon cocktail.  It included banana liqueur and a good amount of lemon flavor.  I liked it and was grateful for the suggestion.

Nathan suggested the Ham-wrapped TN Trout, Scallops, and Lamb Ribs as some of his favorite items.  Normally I would go with a suggestion, but I was in the mood for something on the lighter side and decided to order the Mahi.  It was cooked perfectly with a lightly crispy crust and was delicious.  The sweet onion soubise sauce complemented well.

While I love bbq, burgers, and hot chicken with the rest of them, Marsh House was a nice break from the countless "southern-fare" restaurant options that popped up while I was looking for a dinner spot.  If you're exploring the Gulch area, I'd recommend at least stopping in for a drink!
name: Aaron

text: It looked better online than it did in person. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. A couple small things kept adding up. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Probably not coming back. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
We came here after my wife attended a Yelp event at the Ironworks hotel where they got samples of the Blue Sushi food. We don't often get to the 86th St area anymore but we did have to go up and decided to try Blue Sushi for lunch.

1. Get the cucumber sesame salad. Tasty!
2. Black tuna sashimi. You will thank me.

We also got a vegan sushi roll and a cabo roll which was tuna. Everything was delicious.

Do not miss dessert. Raspberry sorbet with chocolate torte was to die for.

And wash it all down with either the ruby red mule or the siracha bloody mary! 

We will be back since our bill was less than $50 including drinks!
name: Alex

text: Tried the Duo Burgers, Buffalo Wings, IM fries and a beer. The buffalo wings were crispy and medium on the hot spice level.  Burgers were super fresh and a nice size. Restaurant was very clean, family friendly, very upbeat atmosphere.  Our wings came out with the wrong sauce and they were quick to get us fresh ones. Overall very pleased.
name: Cathy

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. You can tell they care about customer experience here. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Would return. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text:
I Truly enjoy having a local coffee shop close by.

Pass by this place all the time but never get in to try. Came on a very cold morning because I was craving some coffee!! I ordered a large cafe au lait and a breakfast croissant. Everything from the coffee to the sandwich was awesome! You could tell the bacon was homemade. My lady had a delicious coffee and sandwich as well. 

Truly enjoyed the homemade appeal of the place. The food and drink was excellent! Really cannot wait to come try it again.

text:
Very flavorful meats, but quite difficult to get anything less than medium well done. I like my steak rare but would be happy if they had anything Medium showing pink. Eventually waiter walking around with the meat ordered a rare steak for me. It was low grade sirloin seasoned well and paired with the wine. 

The Snow - their Malbec from Argentina goes great with the red meats.
name: Sean

text: This is one of my favorite noodle places. The service is fast for the amount of customers that are always there. It's always clean no matter how busy it is. The bowls of noodles are the perfect amount, not too little and not too much. The food is so flavorful and the noodles are the perfect texture. My favorite is the sizzling garlic, it's a must try.

text: For Filet, this is my favorite place, hands down. Not one of the many steakhouses that headline the Indianapolis restaurant scene. Always perfectly cooked, with a delicious sauce, sitting on a nest of seasoned mashed potatoes. With soup or salad and mini-dessert, their Spring special ($29.99) is a great deal. The potato leek soup is delicious too. Everything I've ever tried has been a winner. Their wine and cocktails are exceptional and not over priced. To finish, the mini-desserts are the perfect sweet taste...but one is never enough.

text:
Amazing meal, fabulous experience in this beautiful restaurant. Everyone in our party of four was enthralled with their meal, and we did a lot of sharing too. 
Buffalo Cauliflower--athrowback special--was so yummy, as were the hash browns and butternut squash ravioli. The mushroom pot pie was savory and lemony. Octopus, steak, monkfish--all great! Really, this is all delicious comfort food reimagined as gourmet. 
Service was extraordinary. Amber was excellent!

text:
Perfection in every way....from food to decor quality is no exception! My most favorite place to go in Montecito. You are guaranteed the most delicious meal in the most beautiful 
environment

text:
I went here with my friends today and we ordered chicken wings as appetizer. I'd say the wings were amazingly fragrant and delicious. The Firepoint burger I had was definitely cheat-day worthy. text: Food was delicious I ordered the fish and grits everything was fresh and hot definitely would recommend to friends

text:
We stopped by Sweet Box Cupcakes this morning. The place was small and empty, but very cute. All of the desserts looked amazing, so I was really excited to try something. I got the Lemon Bar, and my boyfriend got the Dirty Jawn. 

Overall, we were both pretty disappointed in what we got, especially considering the great reviews. The textures were great but the flavors were not good. The lemon bar didn't taste lemony. text:
Who doesn't like to pick their own steak ? I love it! As soo as you walk in they're right there to get your menu selection off to a good start. text:
What a gem in downtown New Orleans!

With a party of 8, we were seated almost immediately.  It helps that we came at the right time - around 5 pm on a Saturday night.  Any later, we would have been waiting for about an hour.  After the waiter took our order, the line was wrapped around the building.  Our server was great!  He was very attentive and very friendly.  As busy as the restaurant was, he checks up on us often.  

Food:  What can I say about Southern Cajun food in the Big Easy but it was terrific.  Complimentary fresh baked bread were served with butter.  For appetizers we had the alligator sausage - it was delicious especially with the sweet chutney-like sauce.  We had two different gumbo - seafood okra and chicken andouille.  Both were good but i like the chicken a bit more.  We also had the crawfish etouffee that was service on rice.  The dish was decent.  The Creole platter was great since it had jambalaya, shrimp  creole and red beans and rice.  For sides, we had the garlic mashed and sausage and rice.  All the dishes were comfort food that warmed us up in the cold weather there at the time. 

My favorite are the alligator sausage and chicken andouille gumbo!

text:

text:
Service was phenomenal. Pizza and garlic knots were just A-OK. 

During our stay in Nashville, we found ourselves craving pizza. So, I searched the Yelpternet and came across this pizza place with fabulous ratings. We pulled up in our Lyft, and it looked promising. The place was pretty busy, and our group of three agreed that it was kind of cool that they had different sections for takeout, window, and dine-in. We went to the dine-in. Luckily, there was no wait (Monday night around 7:45pm). 

Our waitress was really great. She was super friendly, checked in on us a bunch of times, made sure to refill our cups whenever they were low, and even let me switch from basil lemonade to regular lemonade, when I discovered I really really don't like basil lemonade. 

So, since we're on the subject of lemonade... Basil lemonade is weird. There is a lot of basil, not that much lemonade. In fact, there wasn't much lemonade flavor in the regular lemonade either. 

We ordered half a dozen garlic knots to start with. The knots were huge and the bread itself was fluffy and tasty, however, they were very light on garlic/oil. I love garlic, so this was a huge disappointment to me. I still ate two knots though-I just made sure to dunk them in LOTS of marinara sauce. (Side note: we didn't finish these, so I decided to take them back to the hotel. The awesome waitress gave me a box with a new dipping cup of marinara.)

Now, the pizza. I ordered a slice of pepperoni and a slice of prosciutto and basil. (Basil is a big thing here. They put slivers of it over the knots too.) The pizza was good. The crust was thin (NY style) and the toppings were evenly distributed and tasty. However, that's it. Good pizza, but nothing that makes it stand out enough to deserve a higher rating. One of the members of my group was actually disappointed, considering how I told him it had rave reviews. He noticed that some of the cheese on his slices wasn't fully melted. 

If I lived in Nashville, I'd probably grab a slice again if I were in the area, but I wouldn't go out of my way or wait in some crazy line for this pizza.
name: Merly

text:
Stumbled across this place on Yelp a while back, but never had the chance to go. I'm so glad I finally did though because it's pretty amazing!! HUGE portions (and I'm used to eating..A LOT for this little body of mine!) Very decently priced for what you get. 

Swamp fries: We ordered this as an appetizer and it was great to share! Comes out piping hot and covered with delicious gravy and roast beef.
Rib eye steak: We ordered 2 and they were very good for just $15 each. It doesn't come with sides, but I didn't mind. Usually would use A1 sauce on the table if the steak was bad, but none was needed in this case. It was perfectly seasoned and JUICY.
Crawfish étouffée: Delish! Perfectly seasoned. The garlic bread that came with it was also really yummy.
Shrimp and catfish platter: WOW is all I have to say. Really big serving (yeah yeah, you get the idea. Everything was huge!) Comes with fries on a bed of greens. Served with tartar sauce and horseradish ketchup?? (Not entirely sure, but that ketchup was amazing)

Great little hole in the wall type of place! Love the art pieces on the walls. The kitchen has a glass that you can see through, which is great!

I've been recommending this place to several friends already. Can't say enough great things about it. Service was excellent as well.

text:
tl;dr this modern take on traditional Indian cuisine never quite hits the mark

Veda sits on the first floor of an apartment complex, just off the busy intersection of 20th and Chestnut. While the waiting area itself is bright and white, walk through Veda's automatic sliding doors to immediately be ushered into a chic Rittenhouse restaurant with tall ceilings, whitewashed exposed brick, and vibrant red walls. Desi art and Urdu calligraphy decorate the walls. The host counter is flanked by a cubby bookcase, stocked with Ten Thousand Villages-esque trinkets and books. Low-key, modern music echoes softly against the chatter of the restaurant-goers. My partner and I stopped by just before 6PM on Saturday to take advantage of Veda's everyday happy hour. Be warned, while you can order any normal menu items in the bar area, the happy hour specials are limited to the bar. By 6:30, the entire bar area was filled, while a line of parties trailed into the waiting area. Service was quick and friendly, and the bartender walked me through the draft menu to choose something I would enjoy. My partner enjoyed her Laila cocktail, while I opted for a 2sp Delco Lager.

Like many Rittenhouse restaurants, Veda amps up its decor (and its prices), but the food never quite lives up to the hype. My partner and I ordered an assortment of happy hour dishes to split: the Calcutta Pork Ribs, the Paneer Masala Tacos, the Goat Cheese Naan, the Malabar Fish Fry, the Desi Tadka Lentil Risotto, and the Goan Crab Cake. The 3 ribs were good, but not great: they had a nice char and were coated with a generous amount of chutney; however, while the glaze had a small zing, it only faintly tasted of mango. The 2 tacos were probably our favorite dish of the night -- the achari mayo nicely complemented the paneer. The only critique was that there was no crunch besides he single jalapeño topping each taco. On to the naan, the first piece (of 4) didn't have any goat cheese, which was a shame because it was the goat cheese in the middle transformed it into a dish rather than a side. Like the taco, I feel as though the naan could've benefited from being crispier and butterier. The crab cake had lots of meat and tasted good overall, but the chutney tasted more like pasta sauce. The fish fry reminded me of fish sticks, but the batter seemed undercooked and the sauce was underwhelming. The risotto was by far the worst dish of the bunch -- it was dry (shockingly, for risotto) and one-dimensional, and smelled more like peanuts other than it tasted.

Overall, Veda was decent and little more. I've had better Indian food, and I've had better fusion food. While I didn't feel bad looking at my $50 check for two, I can't imagine spending full price for some of the happy hour specials.
name: Austin

text: We went in for drinks before our dinner reservation close by. The service was awful.  Super slow and even non existent at times. text:

text:
This place is my staple downtown. They have outlets all over their bar and free WiFi. Their happy hour specials are insane. It's 3-6 weekdays except for Tuesday when it's 3-Close! The $4 wines are good quality and keep me there a while. The best special however is the $0.99 salmon, albacore, escolar and shrimp nigiri. I usually get 6 salmon and 6 escolar. Both are so fresh and the escolar is even somewhat creamy in the best way possible. I always pair it with chili oil. Super satisfying meal. You can also get half off rolls under $9 which is a great deal. Some of the appetizers are half off (approximately $6) as well. I would opt for the nigiri over the truffle salmon or lemon fish though because the portions are bigger and the fish seems fresher for some reason. 

I haven't been super satisfied with the servers. They're a little rude, slow and dismissive. Sometimes I even feel like they're making fun of me for what I order and as a regular, that's not acceptable. That's the only reason I gave this place a 4. The food and location deserves a 5.
