text:
We arrived at 8:45 on Friday without reservations it was packed even the bar. The hostess was very accomadating and found us a table quickly. I had the sea bass a speciality. It was a bit salty but still great.
Jalapeño au gratin for two was plenty we were very happy.
name: Terry

text:
Definitely not coming back here again and I do not recommend going here based on my experience.

Sat down at the bar with my boyfriend and two friends. The bartenders were simply not attending to our area. We waited for 15 minutes and they didn't even come over to us once. I had to wave my hands in the air to catch someone's attention before they finally bothered coming over to take our order. (Full disclaimer, the bar was NOT busy/packed at the time. It was way past happy hour. They were serving people who arrived after us and right next to us, who were doing take out orders.)

We all ordered 1 drink and all different tacos. Sometimes it concerns me when servers don't write down orders and our server didn't. She had to come back and ask me twice to clarify my order. I ordered a glass of red sangria and two tacos - Chile mole shrimp and mahi mahi. I guess it was my mistake to think the seafood would be good down here. I personally didn't think it was worth the $4/$5 per taco price tag. The others in my party agreed that the tacos were pretty mediocre. We all ordered different tacos - bahnmi, al pastor, carnitas, etc. We all did agree that the drinks were good at least. The outside porch has great ambiance. It's unfortunate we left pretty disappointed with our service here because my one friend has been wanting to try this restaurant for awhile.. Saint Anejo no bueno!
name: Angeline

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. Just not for me. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It looked better online than it did in person. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Not bad for a quick meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: It looked better online than it did in person. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. A couple small things kept adding up. Wouldn't really choose this place again. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. For the price I expected more than this. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text:
Finally, a good bbq place by campus. Prices are reasonable and the portions are just right. Tri tip with horseradish was on point and the collard greens were flavorful. Brisket is on point, too. If Will is in the kitchen, ask for the Will burger; it's a secret menu item that's basically a carnivore's wet dream. 

What surprised me the most was how flavorful and non-greasy everything was. I left full but not bloated. All the dudes there (Will, Matt, and Mo) were chill. Will definitely be back again. Thanks guys!
name: Nate

text: They have  a small nice very clean restaurant in the far back right side.  They have the best Thai food in town.  Their pad-thia is the best I have ever  experienced anywhere..Staff are very  clean, courteous, well informed and speak fluent English.  They also sell beer in restaurant and store. Their store is awesome, you  can find  almost anything you want to purchase.  The fresh meat department is so so very  fresh, and  very  inexpensive compared to the local  grocery. They also have a hot bar to go, and a cold meal already cooked  to go.The best grocery store..
name: Angie

text:
I prefer supporting locally owned restaurants and had wanted to try Rooster for a while. There are usually pretty big crowds there on the weekend and since my usual brunch partner and I were both off on a weekday, we thought we'd take the opportunity to check it out.

What a complete disappointment.

We both decided to try the veggie benny since it's our go-to when having breakfast out. I wanted a side of avocado which ended up not being available since the restaurant didn't have any that were ripe. My companion ordered a side of turkey bacon which sadly, other than the watermelon garnish, was the best part of his meal. The veggies on the benny consisted of a slice of tomato and romaine lettuce. (Who on earth thinks that lettuce is okay on a benny???) The hollandaise sauce was sparse, which turned out to be fine since it was mostly flavourless, was broken, and barely edible. The potatoes were dark so appeared to be overcooked, but in actuality they were very much undercooked in the inside. The few I managed to eat seemed to just be old and reused from a previous day. The bagel that the eggs came on wasn't toasted or even warmed, and didn't even have a hint of butter on it, leaving it dry and not worth salvaging from this substandard meal.

On top of it all, the entire meal was cold.

Service from the kitchen was incredibly slow for a place that only had 3 tables with 7 other patrons seated within. The server did offer to return the meals to the kitchen to fix whatever was wrong, but we didn't bother since there was so much wrong with the meal that it wouldn't have made a difference. What all was said and done, I ate less than a quarter of what was on the plate, basically the eggs, tomatoes, and the slice of
orange and watermelon used as garnish.

There are so many great breakfast and brunch places in the Whyte Ave area with great food and a warm atmosphere. This is not one of them. Spare yourselves the disappointment and waste of money and go elsewhere.
name: Chandra

text: As you can see by my last review a few years back we took a break from coming here. Tonight we ordered carry out fried chicken dinner. The 4 piece white meat dinner box had only two pieces and they promptly corrected the order. The reception was very friendly. The food was delicious. I think the new owners have done a great job working out any early difficulties. The atmosphere is nothing fancy but it is welcoming. The noise level is average and the service is great. For anyone out there who hasn't given this place a try over the last couple of years I highly suggest you do and I think you'll be happy you did. They have a monthly special menu that I included here and they serve everyday until 8:00. We will back!!
name: Susan

text: If I could give them zero stars I would. I ordered food from them on Ubereats. I waited for two hours as I watched the time on the oder increase run down to 10 minutes and then increase another 8 minutes over and over again. Finally I was notified the they decided to cancel the order. What a crappy company.

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Food was fresh and service was quick. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Worth checking out. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Awesome location! Received our order very quickly and the staff was extremely courteous.
name: Fernando

text: I had ordered the chicken enchiladas and I was skeptical. I typically enjoy just plain chicken enchiladas and I was worried about all the extra items on the plate. I have never tasted a chicken enchilada like this before. The flavors paired so well and were amazing. This is a little hole in the wall place and parking can be troubling but definitely go check it out
name: Shawn

text:
Wow, what a find. We've walked past this place 50 times and just never considered it because we usually have other breakfast places on the list. I looked at Yelp reviews early one morning, and thank God it was early, because this little shotgun room (maybe ten tables) filled right after us and by the time we left, there was a queue around the block.

I had the Cochon Eggs Benedict (with an upsell of a blob of crab), and it was sublime. Rich and creamy and the pork was deliciously smoked. The husband had the Eggs Ranchero (with an upsell of andouille) and was transported. I don't think he spoke until he asked for the check. I had a bite and it was super spicy and so freaking good. 

The staff! Fantastic! Our server was sassy and weird and fast and funny. We tipped the shit out of her.

Again, if you want to go (and you must), get there when the doors open, or you're going to cry on the sidewalk for an hour.
name: Donna

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: This is a great place.  Prices are great. Margaritas were awesome. Tacos were wonderful but may be better if double wrapped. The 7 pepper spice.  Damn.  Great service.  Thank you.

I always have to ask multiple multiple times for more veggies...otherwise I end up with a sad empty bowl of lettuce and beans for $9. There are plenty of other options in the neighborhood. Chipotle, step up your game!

text:
my first time in here.. everything was awesome! 100% recommended
california roll, dragon roll, rainbow roll, red hat roll and flaming tree roll... on the separate photo by itself  butterfly roll
name: Johanna

text:
This restaurant is a 'Must see' when you're visiting the French Quarter.  We were out for a walk in the afternoon and popped in here for a quick bite.  This building is beautiful and the hostess and waitstaff are awesome.  

We sat on the 2nd floor and Dominique G was our server.  She brought us ice waters and menus then introduced their specials.  We ordered the BBQ Shrimp and 1/2 doz Oceana's Famous Oysters from the Appetizer section and a side of fried Crawfish.  The shrimp and crawfish came out first, the crawfish were tasty but damn, we were not ready for the deliciousness of those shrimp...!  Calling them bbq is dishonest to those shrimp.  They were delicious...!  

But then... the OYSTERS came out...

These char grilled ocean delicacies are covered with the most delicious garlic & cream herb Cajun sauce and dusted generously with Parmesan & Romano cheeses.  These oysters are the MUST HAVE if you are ever lucky enough to visit the FQ.  I only say 'lucky' because we were on a spur of the moment driving road trip from Pittsburgh, PA with very little research or planning.  

We finished all of the above and rather full but the thought of having to travel all the way back down here for more oysters forced me to order another 1/2 doz.  

These oysters were so good that when another table was sat next to us and they mentioned never being there before and ordering an appetizer- I had to lean in and suggest them.  They ordered them and fell in love, just like me.  

Thank you Oceana and staff for an awesome lunch.  And another thank you for helping me out by finding and selling me that particular 'shirt' I was interested in.  I love it...!  

Reppin Oceana up in the Burgh...!
name: Denny

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. Anyway, the food was good and the service was easygoing. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Food was fresh and service was quick. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
Really wanted to love this place. I've been numerous times since they opened. At first the food quality was great and kept me coming. Now, over the past 5 months or so, the quality has dropped dramatically. One example is The French onion soup. It used to be my favorite, now it comes way too greasy (all I taste is oil) and with raw red onion. It lost its depth of flavor. Home fries are WAY too soft and mushy. The last 4+ times I've eaten here the food was bland, uninspired, and overall cooked poorly. I think a menu revamp would help along with more consistency in the kitchen. 
I will say, service is always very pleasant.
name: Maria

text: Fantastic food with a great family atmosphere. Everything we ordered was delish.... especially the scallops! If you want fresh off the boat seafood, stop in. But go early. They often run out.
name: Kate

text: Good cheese, good tomatoes, but just an okay sandwich. Meat to bread ratio was terrible.. Could barely taste the prosciutto on it. Chips that came with weren't crispy and tasted a little bland. Took a long time to make, but came out nice and hot which was good for my chocolate chip cookie I got inside the terminal as well!
name: Kayla

text: My uncle-in-law loves the Kick A** BLT and cheesy baguettes here, so it's literally the first place in town he took us. I have to say the shrimp tacos are top notch as well. The portions are very generous, enough for two people, or one person who skipped breakfast while getting rebooked from a cancelled direct flight onto an indirect flight. Once we found parking, we sat outside to watch the people and trolleys (outside is first-come, first-served, seat-yourself; inside has a maitre'd). Service was a little uneven, but I would give them another try, just so I could sample the crab and shrimp cakes. Unlimited refills helped while we waited for our food.
name: Kristen

text:
It's hard to review a place when you have great food and terrible service.  The food was slightly better than average for a restaurant of this calibur, while the service was way worse. So two stars it is. 

For a few years, I've had Compère on my list of must try restaurants. It opened after I left the area, but it always showed up on my Yelp searches. I was in town for a friend's surprise birthday party and decided to bring him to this restaurant while the surprise got set up.

Walking up to the restaurant, we saw a buddy leaving the restaurant. He told us how good the food was and I got even more pumped.

We ended up sitting at the bar. And unfortunately, the service at the bar was awful. Not only was it slow, but the female bartender who waited on us bordered on rude. My friend did ask a seemingly silly question about getting the pasta with meat sauce without the pasta. But her facial reaction and response made it seem like my friend was the stupidest person on earth. Mrs. Waitress, he is just living that keto life!   

Other than the rude interactions, the staff barely checked up on us. Overall there was a lack of service, which was probably better than receiving rude service. 

My buddy works as a bartender in another high end restaurant in the area. He left hoping he never treats one of his guests that way. 

Then there was a bar back who wasn't rude, but was a little too eager to ease drop and jump into our conversations. He had nice intentions, but he didn't seem to understand how to complement a conversation vs dominate it. 

The food was great, which is highlighted in all the other reviews. When we went to the surprise party later that night, we saw our buddy again. Turns out he had terrible service at the bar as well.

My advice? Seems like you should avoid the bar at all costs. Maybe the wait staff are better at making the experience go smoothly.
name: Russell

text:
My only wish is that it was closer!  Whatever your idea of breakfast is, they have you covered.  Healthy options? Check. Sweet pastries? Check.  Juice shots and strong coffee? Check.  You can order plain Jane if you wish, but oh the lovely unexpected flavor combinations--balsamic zing on tomato and bacon; tangerine on avocado and egg.  Then the veggies and fruit--fresh, nicely arranged, and in interesting texture combinations.  You really can't go wrong here.  

Also, make no mistake, this is a little cafe.  It's tiny.  It's order at the counter--and peruse the baked goods assortment---and find a seat. That is part of it's charm!!  I hope it doesn't change a thing.
name: Ellen

text: Decent spot. Definitely have good drink specials. Typical bar food, good sandwiches, pizzas, n quesadillas. Food a tab over priced but constant with the neighborhoods dubious self worth. I would definitely go back. The outdoor porch is nice.
name: Megan

text:
3 stars is based on overall experience, others in our party were very happy with their meals. I had a burger, taste and texture hinted to me it was a frozen patty, over cooked, and lacked flavor.
Service was OK but slow. A table next to us went un-bused for at least a half hour, dirty plates etc...just sitting.
Personally, I could maybe try it again, but wouldn't recommend this location.
name: Corey

text:
I haven't been to chili's in years , I don't think I will ever be back . My family , I got to chili's at 9pm after the mall closed, our waiter Dusty was nice but as he informed us it was his first night starting chili's  , so our service was slow , we didn't get are dinner until 10:30pm and Im not over exaggerating . Whenever he made a mistake his first response was he will get the manager the first time I was ok with that , but after the third time I said we don't need the manager , please just get our order right ! At my table for our appetizer we got trio app - southwest egg rolls , honey chipotle chicken crispers , Burger mini bites , he took are drink order as well 2  margaritas , 2 Ginger ale , pink lemonade and 1 water . That was the only drinks we got the whole night he never asked us if we wanted any more beverages , he was no where to be found the whole time we was there as well . They really should of had someone helping him , there was a table of 11 people behind us and 5 people beside us that got there food , left way before us , to be honest there was many other customer that came in way after us , already got there food and left . For dinner we ordered two Cajun chicken pasta , 1 steak with mashed potatoes and broccoli and shrimp, 1  smoke chicken with chicken crispers dinner with French fries and corn  
it was supposed to come with garlic bread,  pickles but I didn't get it , I had to ask for it , also  I had to ask for honey mustard,  barbecue sauce forks and knives . We all ended up taking are dinner to go . Andrew the manager did help out a lot whenever Dusty called him over . We got out of there a lil after 11pm , I didn't get home until after 1am . Food wasn't bad , it wasn't the greatest  either . The bill was $114 That's not bad , we still left him 20 percent tip . We left $137. The waiter beside us was complaining about the big mess the table of 11 people left ,  tipped him less than 10 percent I felt bad for him , for us as well !
name: Tiff

text: Not saying it's perfect, but some reviews make it sound way worse than it is. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Fantastic drinks and great service!   Duck fries!!! Ok so I read the reviews and thought since I was visiting, I would drag a friend to check it out.  There was a Halloween party going on... we were there sans costume!  We had a great time.  Everybody there was pretty nice.  The door man, my server, and the bartenders were fantastic!!!!  You have to call ahead to get the password.... the vibe is great.  Good place to chill and have a good time.  Will definitely visit when I'm in town again!  I'm over 40 and found that all ages (over 21 of course) were pretty good to go. Go if you have the chance!
name: Ernestine

text: You know this place is ok. My husband is Hispanic and there are a few things here he likes and can't any where else. The Chile relleno platter I love. They are usually very good. text:
My friend had a party at Chef JJ's and she asked if we should let them cook or if we should do the game show option. Um of course, game show! Well it was really just a competitive dinner with teams. But they really make it fun. 
There were I think 20 of us and we were each were handed a ticket that told us what work station table to go to. I actually didn't know many people at the party, but this was a fun way to get to know everyone.  The chef does an introduction and explains everything. They take drink orders and brought smoking Goose meats and tulip tree cheese and a really yummy lemon curd sauce for the bread. 
The cooking is all done with Big Green Eggs. They had a huge set up of grills on the outside patio area. This was a warm summer evening and I never got hot running back and forth from the grill to our station. We picked one person to run the grill. I liked helping with the next course and planning, but everyone could help out with whatever they wanted. 
They bring you a big box of numbered plastic containers you had to sniff and taste each one to guess what spice each one was. Points were  awarded depending on your accuracy. There were several we had no idea! And we didn't write in the correct answers, which hurt us later. We made our salad dressing with spicy mustard. We all just assumed and no one tasted it. 
Each team made their own dinner, which consisted of salad, flat bread, chicken, steak, veggies, and red potatoes. We had to come up with recipes using what we had in our box.   In the box we found among other things an apple, an onion, an orange, all kinds of vegetables, a lump of dough, and salad greens. Plus all the spices to use as well as pepperoni, blue cheese and a shredded cheese. 
It was fun coming up with what to use for the courses. We used our orange in the steak to make it tender and we used the honey and soy sauce with our chicken. We should have used the oil and vinegar to make the salad dressing, but the mustard seemed fun, till none of us could even eat the salad.
As each course gets done we make the chef a small tasting plate. Our team won best flatbread and I think best plate design for dinner. They had a number of different things to win, not just best dish. We were having so much fun talking and eating I didn't pay a ton of attention. 
You eat and drink while in-between rounds. You spend most of your time with the people at your table, but the running back and forth and "spying" on other tables was fun. 
We all had dessert and coffee while they tabulated the winners. My friend got gift bags for the winning team. 
This was a very unique dining experience and would be a fun team building event, shower or birthday party. 
The space was super nice. We were downstairs and had the patio. We also got to go upstairs for a few minutes to take some photos with Lucas Oil behind us. I know my friend said they had tons of options and you could really specialize the way you wanted your event.
The only thing to make it better I thought would be each team to explain their dishes for a minute. We tasted another tables chicken and it was fabulous. Might be nice to have a quick explanation on where the inspiration came from about the food we all cooked.
name: Chrissy

Also be sure to get a cocktail! They're delicious!
name: Katherine

text: Amazing food. Everything was in point. Lamb kabob was perfectly cooked. Very juicy. Fresh. Their kunaffa is of the hook. Must try for everyone who's a good lover.
name: Haseeb

text: This is a great local restaurant. It's a BYO cash only no frills Mexican. It's cute, clean and family run. It's a lot of food-the chilaquiles, even with green sauce still has some spiciness to it.
name: Lady

text: Our favorite date night place to go. Love the martinis and steak. Nice selection of appetizers. The stone crabs are phenomenal!
name: Francis

text: Excellent Gyros for the price. The place isn't fancy, but the food is great. The Kabobs are very good, the French Fries are crinkle cut and plentiful.
name: Steven

text: As a confirmed introvert and singleton, I love that they do personal-sized pizzas. I had the most delicious shrimp pizza there (pardon the bite I already took out of the shrimp in this picture). The staff were lovely and the beer menu looked extensive, though I didn't get a beer that day. The waitress was very nice and my little pizza came quickly.
name: Caitlin

text: Wery  a good service nice food good price I really like it me and my friends always going there for dinner launch I do appreciate for services thank you
name: Khasan

text: As others have said, the atmosphere is amazing. Cool old motorbikes, turntables, and some futuristic space-age looking coffee brewing contraptions highlight the space. I think the coffee is good, not great, and therefore overpriced.
name: Aaron

text: So, on Saturday July 13th evening around 7ish my cousin wanted some Mexican food which I suggested a more authentic Mexican restaurant in Broad Ripple which she hasn't been before. When, my cousin and I both arrived at the restaurant around 8ish at night it was a warm humid evening & night packed on their patio, and inside had a nice crowd. The restaurant is this yellow house turned into a Mexican restaurant, with the history of the restaurant, and even art on their walls from Mexico. Everyone, was having a good time there eating, laughing, and celebrating a birthday. The restaurant is kid friendly,  decent servers, delicious margaritas that's not strong, and most importantly the prices on the menu are very affordable. For, me when it comes towards Mexican food I'm simple more like a plain Jane with food(picky eater). Anyways, I ate from the a la carte menu where I had two soft tacos with only ground beef, white shredded cheese, and sour cream. When, the Server brought me my dinner they put lettuce on it so they had to remake it. So, when I got my food again it was hot, fresh, plenty of ground beef, white shredded cheese, and sour cream. I was glad I only had two soft tacos since I was full. Also, for my drink I ordered a 16oz frozen margarita which in my opinion was just okay could had been way better. My margarita didn't have any flavor in it. Although, my very first time there I had 16oz mango margarita which was good, very fruity, not a strong alcoholic drink. Also, for the nachos they gave everyone nacho chips along with salsa I wanted white queso for the nacho chips which tasted better. What I didn't like was been charged almost $4.00 for having white queso sauce for the nachos chips instead of the regular salsa sauce.  Oh! There's plenty of places to park by restaurants for free, and it's actually in a great location, and by the Monon Trail so eat, drink, laugh, and walk the Monon trail what a great combination!
name: Ashley

text:
Food was really good here when i ordered from here for dinner. We ended up eating the chicken and broccoli, crab ran goon (which were so hot and fresh) and my daughter got the chicken lo mein. 

We ordered delivery and it came quickly with not much wait. The driver was very friendly and had delivered everything and even gave us a bunch of extras like sauces, tea bags and crunchy noodles. 

The food was hot and fresh and was very flavorful. This was one of the first times I have eaten food from here and me and my daughter were very satisfied with our orders. We will definitely order from here again in the near future.
name: Dana

text: If you are looking for a really good breakfast in New Orleans this is definitely the place to go. My girlfriend got the biscuits with the sausage gravy and it was so good! I got the boudin breakfast biscuit with scrambled eggs and grits and it was AMAZING!! They have two locations on Magazine St, so go check them out!
name: Thomas

text: Today is the day before Mother's Day. The food is above average, two dishes we ordered were miss, the other two are good as indicated in the picture. The service was good to start with, but afterward they were pretty insensitive trying to hint at us to leave after they gave me the check (the waiter came to us to see if we need anything else three times within five minutes period and finally the manager in blue suit literally came ask if we enjoyed the meal and literally stood next to our table until we got up). And to clarify, I was with my parents to celebrate the mother's day and we were there for less than an hour (one appetizer, three entries and one desert, very reasonable to take up or slightly more than an hour)  and they were pushing us to go. Very rude, particularly on the holiday.
name: Lulu

text: The pizza is rich and delicious, but PLEASE, 312, hire waiters who know something about service! Our waiter was clueless - we had to ask several times for everything. He seemed overwhelmed by the simplest waiter tasks. We loved the outdoor patio, as we could bring our dog out there. I appreciate having an authentic Chicago deep dish place around, and in fairness, the other waitresses seemed very efficient. Maybe our guy was new, but his poor service diminished an otherwise enjoyable lunch.
name: Gwen

text: We came for the all you can eat ribs special on Wednesday. They were served lukewarm. When I pointed it out to the bartender she apologized but didn't seem to know what to say next.  (Example what can we do to make this right for you?) I said I would not eat these and pushed the plate back to her, so did my husband.  He decided to order liver and onions instead, but I needed a minute to look at the menu.  I ordered fried chicken figuring it had to come out hot and freshly made.  But when I ask a few more questions about what time the ribs are cooked and what time we should arrive in the future to get them hot and fresh she was not especially helpful. Apparently they're cooked earlier in the day, and then moved into the warmer oven.  She said they start dinner service at four so at 5:30 they should have been hot and she didn't really know how to handle a disappointed customer.   The chicken was great and my husband loved the liver and onions. The bill reflected everything we ordered except 1 of my $4.50 cocktails.  Did she take one off as good customer service? Why didn't she comp my husband 1 beer.   Can't say I'm impressed and as a local ( not a tourist) we won't be back.
name: Jodie

text: This place was really good! I had the steamed sui mai which I didn't love (just wasn't something I'm a big fan of, but other people liked them), but there were some other dumplings and dim sum which were super delicious. I also had the spicy and sour seafood ramen, which was incredible, though be forewarned, as it was quite spicy. It was so filling, I had to take half of it home and eat it the next day. I would definitely order this ramen dish again and again and again. I got these two items (the ramen and dim sum) as part of the 1+1=3 menu (if you order ramen and dim sum, then you get a "free" iced lemon green tea). The iced lemon green tea was one of the best (nonalcoholic) drinks I've ever had. This place is BYOB, and we brought wine, for which we were not charged (meaning, I did not see an uncorking fee on the bill, even though a waiter did in fact uncork the wine for me). The waiters and waitresses were extremely attentive and helpful. Very happy I went here!
name: Gina

text: I was visiting Clearwater from NY and after arriving at my hotel I was looking for a quick bite to eat and stumbled on The Taco Bus and all I have to say is move over Chipotle! This place was amazing with lots of choices for meat eaters and vegetarians alike. Though I'm not vegetarian I do love my veggies. I ordered the twin grande tacos with butternut squash as my protein and OMG! Yummy and fresh tasting. This bus needs to make a detour to NY!
name: Adreana

text: Incredible food! off the beaten track. Green curry was fantastic, price was super reasonable. BYOB BYOW. LOVED THE EXPERIENCE!!!!
name: Dave

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Not bad for a quick meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Awesome, I've eaten here for over 15 years and have never had a bad meal. I started with General Tos Chicken, then Singpour Mi Fun, then Schetzwan Chicken, then moved to Jalapeno Chicken, and my new favorite is Yum yum noodles! For Take out or eat in its GREAT.
name: Terri

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
Easy to miss!  Hidden in the corner of the big strip mall on Eastbay / Belcher - The non-descript front hides a gem.  Sushi and Thai.  Lunch and Dinner.

Nice variety of rolls and lunch combos -  if you eat food this place is great!  I'm giving 5 stars based on food - the interior is nice and clean but very basic (2 stars for ambiance) 

Note - Sushi Spot is in the  same mall as Pho One - really good Vietnamese!
name: Kevin

text:
Went here for the second time with friends to celebrate signing a new lease together. Everything was delicious!! We sat outside on the patio - the ambiance was great, and the space heaters were perfect for a chilly(ish) April night. We started with cocktails - The Winemaker (strawberry sangria),  the Farmer (Spicy Blood Orange Marg) and the Peacemaker (Vodka, mint, cucumber). All were delicious, but the favorite was probably the Farmer or the Peacemaker. 

We started with the Petite Italian Meatballs, the Sautéed Sugar Snap Peas, and the Beets & Ricotta. The meatballs and beets were excellent, the peas good but would probably not order again. For entrees we split the Goat Cheese Gnocchi and Pea and Arugula Risotto. Goat Cheese Gnocchi was the clear favorite - one of the best pasta dishes all three of us have had in a while!
name: Sara

text: Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Glad we tried it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: I am still not very familiar with Mediterranean cuisine, but over the years, I've always enjoyed every dish I ever tried at Norma's.  Authentic... fresh... consistently delicious.  Well-worth battling the Route 70 traffic!
name: Anna

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not a bad stop, just not one I'm rushing to repeat. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: This restaurant is fantastic. BYOB in old antique store. Open kitchen, amazing food, warm service and great atmosphere. Perfect date night with my wife! Such a great addition to the Lambertville scene. Already made our next two reservations! See you soon!!!
name: Richard

text:
We ordered food at this Domino's tonight at 11p. The delivery was made an hour later but the food was not prepared according to the order we placed. We couldn't write it off due to a food allergy, so the order had to be replaced. Now it's midnight and we're expecting to wait another hour for another pizza. Fine. Whatever. We're hungry. A hour and a half goes by, and we hear nothing from the store or the driver. We call the store only to find out that the driver has delivered our pizza to another address. 

You should not expect anything resembling customer service if you order from this location. When we called back to get them to correct the order, staff was rude and combative as if it was our fault they got our order wrong. Calling back to find out where our replacement order was got us more of the same and no food. The final call to get a refund got the driver out to us in 15 minutes but at that point, we had been waiting for over two and a half hours for a medium pizza.

Please don't waste your time.
name: Gajuan

text: Wednesday night doesn't work at Bacco. Have met friends here and had great service multiple times. Tonight waited for 1.5 hours for dinner. Had to box our dinners because we had to leave. Manager made excuses. Wait staff was still excellent. Tipped my waiter.
name: Agnes

text: O.M.G.  Came for brunch, really just because it was across the street from our hotel. Let's just start with bartenders MJ and Jake.  Super nice, friendly and helpful.  And darn good bartenders too!  I had the Bam Bam bisquit.  Delish!  The pig candy was uh.maz.ing!  Hubs had a BYO omelette, which got 2 thumbs up.  The Ruby Slipper mimosa was quite tasty as well.  Pretty sure we will be here EVERY morning we are here.
name: Leanne

text: Lovely quaint atmosphere. Fantastic food. The sushi rolls are fresh & yummy. The green tea is the best...light, crisp & delish.
name: Maisie

text: This location is close to my office so I am a frequent customer here for a post-lunch pick-me-up. The baristas are super nice and efficient, and I think their coffee and espresso beverages are delicious. Get the Vegan PB cookie if you're hungry!
name: Annie

text:
Today was my third visit under this ownership. These are at least the third people to operate here in 6 years.
I have now sampled Saint Louis ribs, pulled pork and beef brisket. Having grown up in Kansas City and North Georgia, I understand barbecue at the molecular level. In 70 years I have eaten BBQ in the Carolinas, Georgia, East and West Texas,, and the hybrid stuff hey do in Louisiana and Mississippi. This food is GOOD!
The people working here are efficient but also personable. The place is clean. I mean tables, chairs, floor, bathrooms.

Every table has a big roll of paper towels. You will need them. Every dish comes with a healthy serving of sauce, but also with the juices that should be there if you are eating real pork or beef.
If you are a beer drinker, there are several good options, including at least one from our local Barrio.
You owe it to yourself to try th
name: Thomas

text: was bland as anything the marina seemed dry as if it was out of the can but slices were cheap
name: Rahman

text: Wine was good. Sangria was terrible. Service was fantastic. Scallops were meh...not worth the price. Beef empanadas and calamari were excellent. Garlic potatoes were good at first but we got tired of the sauce. Hanger steak was also really good. Pork belly was flavorless and relied on the sauce for flavor.
name: Michael

text:
*****UPDATE to ORIGINAl a review below which was 1 Star *****

A month or so had passed and my colleague convinced me to go back to Yuki Sushi .... she was craving their sushi.   So I went and am very happy to report that the food AND SERVICE was excellent.  

On a separate note The waitress was fully aware of my original review and profusely apologized for our poor experience the last time we were in to which I told her that she had absolutely no reason to apologize and that we actually felt for her.

I believe my original review had some impact on management.

Therefore I am changing the rating to 3 stars with the hopes that in 2019 I can return and have another positive experience and update the ratings 

Original review: 
I have been going to this establishment with co workers for two years

A week or so ago a co worker and I went to a late lunch because our schedules dictated so

While our meal was great the way we were treated by management and possible owner was disgraceful 

We were the last ones in the dining room from lunch and we heard a commotion aka the managers or owner yelling at our waitress to hurry us up as their lunch had arrived yes their lunch ... the owner and staff ordered from outside the establishment and were rushing us out so that they could eat at 2pm 

Ok I understand you are trying to turnover the dining room but it had been by the examples staff with the exception of our sole table of two ... and I further understand that you like to eat prior to dinner service but the way you went about so was disgraceful

We felt bad for the poor waitress ... who was merely the messenger 

Everyone is entitled to a bad day but the way that you treated your staff and is your customers was disrespectful 

Needless to say I will be going elsewhere for my sushi burritos and Kani salads 

There are plenty of other dining establishments In the area of Newtown Square who would be happy to serve us 

Shameful 

**************
name: Kristen

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would absolutely visit again. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: My fellow foodie friends and I have been waiting for YB to open. They don't take reservations but they do have the NoWait app which helps. We came on a busy Friday evening. The place was hopping. The service was very pleasant the staff was eager to serve. We waited for our table at the bar. (Which was full) one of the bar staffs immediately came and brought us a menu and took our cocktail orders. Many Cocktail choices and may I add nice and strong!  Our table was ready not too long after. We ordered several plates for sharing. We enjoyed everything. They have large platters that serve 2-4 pp the menu choices looked delicious. I will be back to try the platters
name: Yolanda

text:
I have been frequenting Jamba Juice much more recently with the addition of my braces-it's a great place to grab a smoothie when my teeth are bothering me. 

I'm a creature of habit and typically get the Razzmatazz. I love raspberries and it has a little sour bite to it so it's great. 

The customer service has always been awesome and the location is always very clean and well kept. I definitely recommend it!!
name: Erin

text: Great food. Great people. Keep it up. Order the cajun platter.  Perfect red beans and perfect catfish
name: Andrew

text: Not impressed- ordered a pizza for pick up and was underwhelmed by the quality of our order.  We didn't care for the cheese or italian sausage.  The red sauce was bland and crust was chewy.  Had high hopes but we will be moving on...
name: Andrea

text: This is my new go to Mexican place.  We had the bean dip, which was just bean dip and cheese dip mixed. It was so good though. The chips are made in house and are nice and warm when you get them at your table. The salsa tastes fresh.  I had the lunch special, which was 3 pork tacos.  They had corn tortillas (my fave) and were topped with cilantro and onion. They also provide a red sauce and green sauce to top off your tacos with.  The red sauce was pretty hot, so I opted to use the green sauce. It was amazing on top of my pork tacos. The pork was so tender and so filling. They do not skimp on the fillings at all. My husband and I both had the tacos and bean dip for lunch and everything all together was under $20!  Granted no one had any beer, but for this price and quality we have designated this our new close to home go to place.  Can't wait to go back and try their other tacos.
name: Angie

text: Service and food were spot on, you could also see the kitchen and it was as clean as could be. Couldn't ask for a better laid back Sunday lunch experience.
name: Jeremy

text:
My god I love this place. It's every Disney fan's dream. There's tons of seating and usually no wait in line. They got everything from amazing coffee to crazy waffles, and that nitro ice cream that makes you look like a dragon.
And the theme? Everywhere you look there's amazing art, pillows, toy figures, replicas of all your favorites. From Studio Ghibli to Simsons to Up to Pulp Fiction to Monsters Inc. 
Every time someone new comes to visit me in the city I have to bring them here. I mean with Disney music always playing and a Disney movie always on, how can you ever go wrong?
name: Er3yn

text: What the hell?!? I've been going to Haskell's Beach for my whole life. Went today for a small Celebration of Life for my Sweet Sollee...my dogs love going there. I've had a few guests give me a hard time about my dogs being off leash. Today that wasn't the issue. The only trash can was over flowing, no toilet paper in the women's bathroom as well as it was a total mess! With the money that the Ritz makes from MOSTLY people who don't live here is just not right! I won't spend a dime at that resort, nor will most locals...get it together Ritz!!! The Bacara was almost as bad. If I paid the money that they charge as a guest, I would complain to the management! On a positive note, my dogs "memorial" was beautiful!
name: Kim

text: Great  food.  The pasta and Alfredo is super. Great and reasonably priced.  The menu has many choices. Staff is very helpful and kind. The delivery is within time you are told on the phone.  Great choice for a night in and watching a movie on tv.
name: Melissa

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. It was crowded but still moved along. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Kind of landed in the middle for me.
name: User

text:
In town for work, stopped in yesterday and got #1 cheesesteak meal and a #2 , lamb kabob dinner.... Mannnnn, this is day 2 of me coming right back here...
Now, I got the lamb chop meal with an extra lamb chop, a lamb cheesesteak with old bay fries and an order of broccoli bites.

And I will be back tomorrow to get something else...

If you're in the area and you need some good kabobs or food, this is THE spot.

Holla at Waheed.....

~HAM~
name: W

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I left full, which at least counts for something. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didnt have a reservation. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. A couple small things kept adding up. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Solid place. Good beer on tap and the food is great for moderately adventurous people.  The one thing about this place is the upstairs men's bathroom. There is a bar right about chest height going across the urinals. Nobody, not even staff know
Is the purpose of these bars. But everyone has the same conclusion for them...resting bar. If there is someone that know the answer to why they're there, please post. Thanks in advance.
name: Ryan

text: Their pho not impressed...spring rolls is crispy but not excellent. But their price was reasonable.
name: Ada

text:
This is the second time I went there. The service was awful the first time but thought I would give it a second chance. Don't waist your hard earn money. 

Paper on top of the tables. The dust on the heaters and other areas was a half an inch thick. Just filthy.  Don't look up

Nobody came to take our order, had to flag someone down. Then my meal come.  It wasn't what I ordered. I was told that was on the ticket. It was nothing I would even eat ever. He offered to take it back but I wanted to eat with my friends not an hour later so I suffered. I was trying eat it. Hated it the the guy came back saying it was an error and gave me my meal I ordered. My friend said he served the meal to someone behind me. I already tried it. UNBELIEVABLE 

NEVER EAT THERE go anywhere else. 

We spent over $350 for dinner UNBELIEVABLE BAD RESTAURANT.
name: Sharen

text:
Whatever you do, don't try to eat at The Den.

We placed an order at The Den when there was no wait. Keep in mind the restaurant is very small, and should churn out food relatively quickly. We waited 15 minutes, and multiple people who ordered after us got their food. After checking on our order, it was simply forgotten about. No apologies were offered, but we assumed they would make it a priority to get our food out.

After 20 MORE minutes we had to check on our food a second time, at which point they had forgotten it AGAIN. What should've been a 20 minute dining experience took over an hour. The level of incompetence displayed by the employees was astounding. Never, I repeat never, eat at The Den.
name: Cam

text: this is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Idk, the wait wasnt awful, just longer than i expected for the time of day.. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Not sure though.
name: User

text: Has been around for quite some time and the food is always great. Expect a fairly classic menu-it doesn't change all that often. They always nail the calamari in this perfect tangy sauce. Their salads are also very good and a good size too. Like other CRG places, expect crossovers like a few burgers from Bru and flatbreads. I would definitely recommend the hot chocolate in the winter as well.
name: Sam

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. For the price I expected more than this. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
Loved all the selections and the owner was great. She was very busy and although we had to wait a little longer than usual it was worth it. It's great to have another healthy option in the bay!

I started with the Clean Eatz bison burger which was served on a thin piece of flat bread. Excellent flavor and with the limited calories I could have had two!

I can't wait to go back and try more of the menu!!
name: Shawn

text: When I recently first heard about this place, I was hoping that I had possibly found Heaven.  Tried WOB 2/22/18 and found it to be pretty great, but not Utopia. The beers and food I had were very good, no complaints about the quality.  What keeps me from 5 stars is the draft beer menu had a lot of mainstream brews (PRB, Blue Moon, etc.) and not as many special craft brews as I would have hoped.  They had maybe 30 beers on tap.  If you're going to call yourselves World of Beer, then step up and have 75-100!  They also have a big selection of bottled/canned beers.  The food menu had a lot of interesting options, and I was torn between several choices.  I'd like to see some smaller appetizer options like nuts, olives, and other hand-items.  WOB also has a lot of TV's which makes watching sports easy, and they had live music that was good and not over-bearing on the noise level.  I will be back!
name: JC

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Food was good and came out fast. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
When ever we go to Cheesecake factory, its ALWAYS been great.
 But I wanted to take the time to single out our waiter who went the extra mile and provided top notch service today! 
It made today's meal a truly enjoyable dining experience. 
We had Nolan, and although it was quite busy in the restaurant and in his section, my husband and I felt like we were his one and only table. Drinks refilled before we even got to the bottom of the glass, bread refilled right away, food came out perfect, fast and evenly spaced. He didnt forget one of the 3 condiments I asked for. At the end of our meal, check came right away. We didnt have to sit there waiting for anything. He was right on the ball. 
Im 9 months pregnant right now so Its fair to say I expect certain things done the right away. (Especially since I've worked in the restaurant business before).
Nolan was everything an efficient waiter needs to be. He even got me a to go water right before we left since it's over 100 degrees right now in tucson. If any of the managers read this, make sure to reinforce his work ethic. My husband and I were VERY pleased with everything today and its solely because our waiter made it that way. Will be back!!!
name: Nicole

text: Average at best. If it didn't have sushi I would have given it 2 stars. They did have freshly made Chinese offerings that were a little above average, but for a buffet that costs over $20 for lunch I expected better.
name: Dan

text: On a high note the guacamole is still pretty good but that's about it. I ordered a margarita thinking that it would be a safe bet....I love margaritas and have enjoyed them here previously, perhaps the mix was off or the glass was dirty - it tasted awful and I subsequently just abandoned it for water. text: I checked out Steam Boys for lunch yesterday, and I thought it was a decent lunch. I do think the menu is really limited: bao, dumplings, and soup. That seems like a lot of options maybe, but for bao, there's vegan and there's pork. And that's it. (They do offer steamed or fried bao.) They have a few lunch specials; I ordered the bao sampler lunch combo, which  is described as "any two steamed bao and any seared bao" for ($12.00). I was brought four bao (1 steamed vegan, 1 steamed pork, and 2 fried pork). The way I read the menu, I thought I was getting three bao, but maybe I read it wrong (or maybe I ordered paid for an extra; not exactly sure what happened). With tax and tip, it came out around $18, wasn't quite the deal I was expecting for a lunch combo, but definitely not a terrible price for lunch in Nashville. Of the bao I tried, the steamed pork bao was easily my favorite. The steamed vegan bao was pretty good - big chunky pieces of vegetables (napa cabbage, shiitake mushrooms) that were pretty flavorful. I definitely preferred the steamed to the fried, but that's just my preference generally (I like the texture of steamed bao better). It was an a-okay lunch: nice, casual eatery with plenty of seating, pretty quick service (you order at the iPad at the counter), and pretty good food. I liked it, and I'll probably come back with vegan friends and family (since I'm always on the hunt for vegan eats for them in Nashville), but I wasn't blown away by the menu or food. But there aren't a lot of places making bao in Nashville (I previously lived in Houston where bao are everywhere, it seemed), so if you're craving them, check out one of Steam Boys' locations (one in Donelson and one in Germantown).

text:
We drove fairly far (45 minutes or so) specifically to get to this place and it ended up being completely worth it.

The staff is super friendly and chatty, which is good, given how much customization is required for orders (there's probably a smoother way to do it, but oh well). We got cheese fries (we went with mozzarella and no toppings, but I'm sure there's plenty of fun to be had here with all the options), and tried a Wagyu Beef burger, a Chicken sandwich, and the Impossible Burger.

You can throw all kinds of stuff on the sandwiches, but they all come with cheese, pickles, lettuce, tomato, and their secret sauce, so you really don't need anything else. Everything we got was great - we had each with pretzel buns and grilled onions... The Impossible Burger might just have been my favorite. Best one I've ever had. I know that sounds hard to believe, but it was at least as good as the Wagyu Beef one. Chicken sandwich wasn't QUITE as good, but it's a high bar to clear.

The interior strikes the right balance of being fun while still maintaining a certain intimacy. When we went in there, though, for all the TVs, none of them were showing anything other than burger-related facts. I'm not sure if that's how it usually is, but having a sports channel running would add a lot in giving people reason to sit for a while.

Either way, the food is fantastic. If you're anywhere near the area and want a burger, this is the place to go.

text:
This was THE BEST meal I've eaten out in a LONG time.  Everything was so delicious.  My husband and I sat and moaned in delight from everything we ate.  Not an exaggeration!  Let me explain . . . 
It's New Year's Eve, I reserved a table for 7:15.  We arrived a few minutes early.  Our table was ready.  (Yay!)
We ordered 2 cocktails (gin and tonic and some bourbon drink that I am failing to remember the name of). We also ordered bacon chips for hubby and shishito peppers for me.
They arrived shortly and the servings were large.  I don't eat pork, so all the bacon chips were for hubby, and I shared my peppers.  They were salty and spicy-perfect with my bourbon.  I couldn't even eat them all, and I usually clean my plate (s).  
We came for the Impossible burger.  Both of us don't eat beef, but hubby was really missing burgers.  I just wanted to try it after hearing about this burger that tasted just like beef, but was vegan and delicious.  I ordered this with a side of chips, while hubby ordered fish and chips.  We had decided to share our plates with one another ahead of time, just in case the impossible burger did not meet up to the expectations and turned out impossible to eat.
Well, we ended up really disappointed that we had to share the burger . . .because it was AMAZING.  Tasted like a burger, texture was pretty close, and it helped that it was on a really soft but grilled bun.  So damn good.  
Fish and chips were also AMAZING.  I don't even care for fish and chips that much because deep fried isn't my jam . . .but these were light and perfectly done.  Chips and fries were also delicious.
Finally, service was great, the ambiance at Granite Street is perfect for me.  I love dimly lit and comfy booths.  I love having a window seat to watch the people walking by.  I love that they leave you with a bottle of water because I drink A LOT of water.  It made for the perfect beginning to our evening.  Full bellies, happy bellies, great conversation, laughter, relaxed, and totally hydrated to go and celebrate the New Year.  We will be back for the Impossible burger very soon.
