text: Nick is killin it solo with the cook on a Saturday night..  Think he needs a raise!  The mood was good and his sense of humor and engagement made the night very memorable with my lady friend.  Hope you all join us to enjoy this little "hole in the wall, short of heaven".
name: Mark

text:
Updated review. Still One Star. And I always try to give a second chance. 

This time... greeted by a staff member that did not know of any of the specials televised on national TV every 5 minutes. How could the employees not know about the garlic knot pizza?!? This is your company's biggest promotion item. 

He was also more interested in assisting drive through customers rather than the walkin' customers right in front of him. Nice flannel shirt by the way. Probably not Pizza Hit issue. 

Only one guy in the back making all pizzas so nothing is timely.

And.... the bathroom smells like dead farm animals!

Wow. Do they have less than 1 Star on Yelp?!? AVOID!! AVOID!! AVOID!!
name: Christopher

text: NEVER eat here.  My family and I have been customers for many years, and the one time I call to report that the pizza I ordered, which took over an hour was cold, the employee answering phones rudely told me she will not do anything, not even offer an apology.  Not only was the situation handled very unprofessionally, but the employee was a distasteful representation of a so called family establishment.  I am a huge supporter of family owned businesses in Lansdale, however I will no longer suggest such an establishment that can treat valued customers in such an ill appreciation.  I will be sure to notify all my friends and family of what transpired-- it's very disappointing.  Rays Pizza does not even deserve my one star.
name: Rochelle

text: My husband and so love to eat here - particularly for lunch. Others have figured it out as well because it is always packed! 30 minute wait at noon today so we sat at the bar. Their lunch menu is HUGE and CHEAP!  Service was fast, even with the bar being busy. The bread and olive oil is always warm and fresh. We both had different soups. Lobster bisque was flavorful, although not necessarily the best I've had. Husband loved the steak chili. He had a side salad and we shared two sides - deviled eggs and sweet potato fries. Everything tasted great. We've eaten here many times - dinner is great, but the lunch value is what keeps bringing us back!
name: Natalie

text: I really liked the shakes the  sandwiches were good pretty big portions also the soups are probably my favorite over the sandwiches lol this place is different but good
name: Gabrielle

text:
Slow slow slow. Food takes at least an hour. Food is expensive, high in calories and not very good. 


The games are lackluster. They are free mobile games turned big. How lame.

Increased by 1 star because the bartender saw the food was made incorrectly right away.

Mistaken food was comped. Up another star.
name: Robert

text: Best Brazilian steak house in Tampa Bay.  We went here for a Birthday lunch for my husband.  The meat selection for lunch was great. Best tasting Brazilian we've had in the Tampa Bay. We like to save room mostly for the Picanha. The salad bar was great, don't miss the lobster bisque soup it's delicious.  The salad bar does not have white rice but you can request it.  Since we were celebrating a birthday we got a complementary dessert.  You can't go wrong with the chocolate lava cake so delicious we were all fighting for the last bight.  I like that the restaurant is a cozy size.  There is also outside seating.  The customer service here was great, our waiter was awesome. Parking lot was easy access and plenty of parking. This is definitely our go to for great Brazilian. Great for large parties.
name: Jamie

text:
Excellent service, (this coming from a 20 year veteran server of fine dining) and pretty damn good food, from what I've tried. 
2 flatbreads, bacon was cooked perfectly on one, (btw, I've NEVER said that about any bacon as a topping for any dish ever) 
soup was subtle and delicious
Mushroom flatbread was built odd to me, with arugula drizzled with balsamic redux placed off the bread(looked great tho) and sporadic bites of overpowering goat cheese
In theory, these flavors work great, but something didn't quite deliver
Dessert solid. Drinks well made
But again, best service I've had for quite a while in stl.
Thanks 2 female servers of whom i forgot your names!
name: Colin

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Kind of landed in the middle for me. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: Now that's some good hot chicken. It was tender, juicy, moist and HOT! We did Damn Hot. We also tried the shut the cluck up but I won't recommend that. I liked the banana pudding but I have had better. The Mac and cheese was nice too. They have a great selection of beer and drinks and water is self serve. Make sure to wash your hands or use wipe if you're going the hot route.
name: Sach

text: Everyone was so friendly! The drinks were reasonably priced. The food is also priced well. The bbq chicken pizza was amazing! The ranch is definitely something to write home about! The wings were cooked to perfection-crispy enough and flavored very well! And they partner with people to do fundraisers!
name: Sonia

text: This place was a gem! Delicious sushi, their miso soup was on point. Service was great and the atmosphere of the whole place and location is incredible. I came to Philly for a conference and walked by this restaurant. No regrets at all!
name: Yessika

text: Grateful food and great staff... Ask for Nick he'll take good care of your dining experience!!!
name: Tony

text: Great customer service, very nice. Thai tea is great. I had the gluten free chicken fried rice (no soy sauce.) Very fresh and served piping hot! Hope this review helps any fellow gluten sensitive folks. They don't seem to so pad see ew noodle dish gluten free due to the soy sauce but plenty of rice dishes  and curry options for you.
name: Lacey

text: WORST SERVICE EVER! I don't actually even think that is an accurate statement. Rather, if you want to not be served, this is the place to go. We sat at a table for over 10 minutes. Had menus thrown on the table. No drinks offered, water never poured. After more than 10 minutes another family came in, were greeted and sat immediately- while I had to track someone down to figure out if we were supposed to seat ourselves or wait to be seated - and immediately had water poured for them. I have never eaten here and I guarantee I never will. NEVER.
name: M

text: This place cancelled my Seamless order without a word of explanation and it's going to take me 5-10 business days to even get a refund. Their food is good, but I'm not ordering from them again.
name: Larissa

text:
This review is for Exton Location. I used to go to this place earlier under different management and different brand name. Wanted to give it a try. I stopped there with my son for a buffet only few people. Staff was attentive and friendly however the food is very normal 

The owner seems to be very caring and attentive only request is the taste of the food has to be good.

If the taste is addressed on buffet it will be a good opportunity in the area .
name: Ramesh

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
Burgers are great on a rainy Friday evening and this place was close by. 
This place is a lot bigger than it looks from outside and I love the decor. The bathrooms are small but have art by Amberella, which I love so much! 

Highly recommend the mac & cheese, I wish they sold it by the pint. It's the perfect comfort food. I had the veggie burger, the patty was mostly black beans, and it was good! I just wish they had more options for those that don't want meat. I will definitely​ return ​to try the tater-tots.
name: Mariya

text:
The food was amazing!!  We ordered the Seafood Gumbo, Etouffee (with fried crawfish), and the Chargrilled oysters.  My favorite were the oysters for sure, but the Etouffee was surprisingly good as well (better than I thought it would be).  

Yeah, the wait was about long (about 30 mins) but the service was great and fast, so it was well worth the wait.
name: Gerard

text: Had dinner there the other night for the first time.  The food & service was excellent.  The portions were good. From appetizer to dessert & everything in between was delicious. The food was a bit pricey but was worth it.  The mark up on the bottles of wine are outrageous.  This is definitely a place for a special occasion in my opinion.
name: Nancy

text:
4 stars for hooks because the majority of the food was delicious. Crab ragoon you have to try, it's prepared different than what you would traditionally get still good.I think just about every appetizer we ordered was amazing. Some sushi rolls orderes were great! 

The service is what is giving this a 4 star not 5. She hardly checked on us and we ordered the spiciest sushi roll and she almost insulted my friend about ordering it. Once we got the roll it looked like cat food on the top I wish we took a picture for proof. I wouldn't suggest that item in the menu. Overall pretty good sushi for lower prices and ok service. Still would recommend
name: Serena

text: I understand prioritizing getting hot food out to waiting customers but we were left standing at the door of a half full restaurant for a ridiculously long time. No eye contact from staff and orders being taken and tickets rung out while we stood and wondered what was happening. Is this a regulars only restaurant or does everyone feel equally unwelcome.
name: Sara

text: The retro home fries are to die for. Never had a bad meal here. Service can be spotty at times but they have a great atmosphere. Worth the wait for breakfast.
name: Steve

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. Food was fresh and service was quick. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Food options were minimal, but the ambience is pretty cool and that's why it gets a 3/5. I'm also a vegetarian so my view might be bias, just not a lot on their menu for us.
name: Priya

text: They have variety of ingredient for your hot pot and a couple of hot pot base!Everything is clean and the staff is very friendly and hospitality!$22 for each all you can eat hot pot and sushi,we are so full that we couldn't even try the sushi!Go support your local restaurant!
name: Christina

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, bc everything else nearby had a wait. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Parking was annoying, although that's prob more about the area than the restaurant. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
Biscotti's has a pretty amazing brunch buffet! It's pricy but probably the best quality buffet in Reno (not to mention it includes mimosas and champagne!) 

Service has been EXCELLENT every time I've been. The servers, manager and cashiers were all top notch! Expect some amazing crab legs, duck eggs Benedict and a array of other choices. The cherry on top is the dessert room. Yes, an entire room of desserts.
name: Kekoa

text: Has some keto friendly goodies that were so good that I started doubting if they were actually keto friendly!  Staff was very friendly.
name: Alberto

text: Ordered through Uber eats. I had the veggie sandwich with added Swiss and avocado on wheat. Exactly what I was craving. The grilled veggies were cooked perfectly. My boyfriend had the T burger med rare with garlic fries. We both are looking forward to ordering again.
name: Summer

text: Great food and atmosphere, love the pasta with chicken, shrimp and sausage. Yum...
name: Lynda

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. The staff seemed tired but still polite. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. Food was fresh and service was quick. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: I highly recommend this cafe!! First of all their coffee is well-brewed, organic and high grade! The French toast was the best I've ever eaten with a nice-sized portion! My husband had a pork roll with egg and cheese sandwich which he thought was excellent! The owner was very friendly and gave us free cookies as we were there close to closing time! The atmosphere is calm and homey with a nice decor and friendly staff! We are from Ohio and randomly found this gem and definitely plan to visit in the future!
name: Rachel

text:
Food is sub-par at best. Prices are a bit high for the portions. The service varies but more often than not the staff are rude or they rush you. The food never looks fresh either. It looks and tastes like they made it hours ago and then threw it into the wok for a few min to heat it up. 

Maybe you will get lucky and catch them on a good day otherwise don't waste your time.
name: C

text:
I had passed this restaurant a lot but never had the urge to stop in. Our work team went to lunch here today so I finally got the chance to try it.

I didn't know what to expect of this place since I had never heard of it before. I loved the decor. The bright and out of the box decorations. It was very festive.

We got seated immediately at lunch rush. As soon as you're seated, you get chips, salsa, and this ranch jalapeño mixture dip. They had a good sized menu full of yummy options. I ordered the appetizer platter because I wanted to try multiple things at once. It came with nacho bites, flautas, chicken quesadillas, and queso. It was all really good. The flautas were the best part in my opinion.

Our service was good. The waitress was attentive to our drinks and checks.

This place seems to be pretty popular and busy, so that's a good sign!
name: Teah

text: Today was my first visit to Lennie's.  The guy who helped me out was happy to tell me what they offered.  Very friendly as well. The place was clean and most importantly,  the food was excellent.  I love that they don't fill your hoagie up with lettuce like other places do.  This is now my new go to place in roxborough! Well deserved 5 star rating!
name: Chris

text:
Don't go here! The food takes over an hour to come out! We Came here for our first time and ordered an appetizer and two burgers and our burgers came out an hour and 15 minutes later and THEN our appetizer came...After I was half done with my burger.. 

I tried to give it a 2nd try and ordered to-go... On the phone they said my food would be ready in 20 minutes, i gave them 35 minutes and i still had to wait and it took an hour for my food! I asked for a well done burger and it was sure as hell was not not well done.. I also did not get my fries. I called and the women really had the nerve to ask me "what do you want me to do?"  Don't waste your time to go here.
name: Thairy

text: Just ate here earlier today. The food is great and the customer service is phenomenal. The burger I ordered along with soup is fresh and flavorful. I really enjoyed the burger the most. The server I had(forgot his name already sorry) is very friendly and easy to talk too. The decor is really something, meaning it looks really good. I like the paintings and the multi colored bottles with water in them. Overall, the experience is awesome.
name: Adam

text: A friendly and nicely appointed Cantonese restaurant up in the Dove mountain area I happened to stumble across the other day.  The food was really good but I only tried the chicken and broccoli lunch special.  Nevertheless, I was quite happy and look forward to returning again.
name: Es

text: Great donut burger, and amazing fries!  3 stars based on the atmosphere, service and food.
name: Dana

text:
I've been coming for green market cafe for years now. I really like it because the options are moderately healthy when compared to competitors, and the service speed is great. 

This recent visit I got a buffalo Caesar bowl with romaine base (see picture). Their Caesar is really good, has a great authentic flavor. My girlfriend got a buffalo chicken wrap which was nice and flavorful as well. 

One thing that's really cool are the vegetarian options! They recently added an option to substitute meat for the impossible meat. I haven't tried it yet, but I think it's great these options exist for people with dietary restrictions. The hummus wrap is also AMAZING, even if you're not vegetarian. 

Of course, you have to mention the obligatory frozen yogurt that comes with your meal. The coconut vanilla is always my go to with the strawberry syrup up top. 

I also want to mention this is a local business. When they had Sunday brunch at the gulf to bay location, I saw the owner there getting his hands dirty and working. I really appreciate seeing a local business owner put in work and represent his business like that. 

Overall, 5/5. Come check this place out!
name: Benjamin

text:
Let me start with the positives. The waffles are DELICIOUS! I had a,savory waffle with artichoke spinach and mozzarella chesse..yummy! My partner had a waffle breakfast bowl equally yummy. Her sister had a strawberry shortcake,waffle. Unfortunately Ihave no idea what that tastes like. Which leads,me to the negative and reason for 3 stars. We all planned to have a great sunday brunch TOGETHER. Unfortunately that was,ruined because the strawberry shortcake,waffle didn't come out until we were FINISHED with our food. We ordered right after one another and people that ordered well after us,received their food. Now I understand people make mistakes. My problem is,when they are not acknowledged. They kept saying her order was on another ticket. Instead of just admitting they forgot or mixed something up. The server even came outside with a,order that NOBODY ordered! 
What made,matters,worse was she ended up getting her meal to go and there was no apology or anything. They could have AT LEAST aoologized for the,wait!!! Good service goes a,long way. Nobody seemed concearned at all. After those,amazing waffles..I was,still left with a bad taste in my mouth..
name: Erica

text:
I went here for lunch and ordered an apple Gouda melt as the servers recommendation. The service was good and quick and the place was clean and organized..food came out quick, but I wasn't impressed with the taste/flavor or the apple Gouda melt.

Probably just my preference, I'll go back and order something different.
name: Lorri

text: We had some of the best sandwiches of our lives here! I had the pastrami and my boyfriend had a muffuletta. Both were delicious!! The pickles may have been my favorite part. Thankfully they sell them by the jar. Also the potato salad was delicious as well. Definitely try this if you prefer a warm muffuletta.
name: Lynsey

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would prob stop in again if nearby. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
Do not order here under any circumstances. I was told that my order would be ready in 20 minutes after ordering online. As of right now, I'm still in my car 1:15 minutes later waiting for my order. They folks At curbside are super unhelpful. They tell me that the online ordering system does not take into account the "call in" orders. Just really an unacceptable situation.


After another fifteen minutes the order finally came. Pick up time was 5:46 and I have food at 6:56. Guess what? No side dishes in the bag. No help at the front desk. They just keep answering the phone and ignoring the four frustrated customers standing and waiting. Do. Not. Order. From. Here. 

If I had not paid online I would have already left.

Just to add one more thing. I bought a car at Franklin Dodge, just next door, and spent less time closing the deal and signing papers than I did at this damn O'Charley's.
name: Will

text: I loved my experience at this restaurant. The atmosphere was so cozy and perfect for date night. The staff was incredibly kind and absolutely wonderful. The food was also some of the best Italian I've ever had. I will absolutley be back.
name: U

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Food was good and came out fast. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text:
This place came up showing as Hot and New on Yelp when I was browsing local food places. Drove there after school a couple of days ago since I was craving for Bubble Tea. Unfortunately, they were out of Tapioca Pearls since it was almost closing time but they had fruit pearls instead. I had my Taro tea with fruit pearls and they taste way better than the tapioca ones. They just burst in your mouth and they give you that fresh fruit taste. Their egg tart was super yum! I was not sure how they would taste so got one and once I ate it I got a few more 
A must check out place. The guy behind the counter, (think he is the owner) was super nice and friendly. Will visit again soon.
name: Lalitha

text: Food is delicious- prices are very reasonable. Staff is fantastic!! The portions are quite generous. I've enjoyed each thing I've ordered here. Great local place!
name: Rachel

text: This is my family's new favorite restaurant. My wife, three kids, and I went today. The kids ate all their food and loved it. My wife had the pizza and loved it, and I had the fish tacos and they were great! Highly recommend this place. Plenty of TVs to watch the game too.
name: Ryan

text:
Best pizza in Tacony!! Our favorite: New Station Extra Special Pizza!!
Delicious Greek salad too
name: Kathleen

text: This is my favorite stop for NY pizza and wings. We normally get delivery and it comes fast and fresh.
name: Shoaib

text: I love this place! I haven't tried one thing that was not absolutely amazing! Definitely a must go to. Parking & getting to it sucks but it's definitely worth it
name: Being

text: Had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Food was fresh and service was quick. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Love this place. I have not had one bad item from here.  Sampled the various types of Thai food and all were great. The sushi rolls and sashimi were all fresh and perfectly prepared. I've always done takeout but looking forward to actually dining in. The staff and nice and friendly. The place is overall very clean. Looking forward to dining in for sure.
name: Jabie

text: I was in town for a business meeting and came across this place! Their crepes are phenomenal both savory and sweet. They also have daily specials so make sure to ask about that! Aside from the crepes they have a wide variety of coffee choices and other specialty drinks. The staff is super friendly and attentive. I'll make sure to visit this place whenever I'm in Reno again!
name: Paula

text: I went here for dinner for the first time and everything was great.  Our server Amy was very sweet and helpful with helping us make our drink, dinner and dessert choices.  Everything was delicious and we were seated in a nice quiet table in the back.  We will definitely be back!
name: Karen

text: The coal oven pizza was fantastic!!! I came here for my lunch break and sat at the bar. The bartender, kris, was very pleasant and accommodating. I will definitely be back soon, and encourage everyone to try this place!!!
name: Eric

text: I was a frequent customer to the original location when I lived in East Nashville. I tried the Hillsboro location tonight (via UberEats) and was highly disappointed. My pasta barely had any sauce and as such I only ate about half of it.
name: Ashley

text: I came with a group of my friends for dinner and we were all so pleased with out meals.  I ordered the cioppino and it was absolutely delicious.  The seafood was cooked well and the pasta was so fresh.  This wasn't the first time that we've come here for dinner and we'll be back again!
name: Christina

text:
If I had to base my review on the Yard House dessert, s'more, I would've given five stars. It was so good I won't order it again out of fear of addiction. It's that good. However, unless you are looking just to drink and a decent happy hour, the Yard House is a bit overpriced for what you get. Although they offer an extensive menu, I find the quality of food lags behind Iron Hill. In addition, the portions are smaller.

The wait for a table can be long, so I recommend call ahead seating. It also can be pretty loud in the restaurant so this is not the place for an intimate chat...unless you are hiding from someone. Still, it is a fun place to go and try a dessert to end on an up note.
name: Heather

text: I love breakfast!!!  I went here with my parents based on other Yelp review and the fact it was hot and new.  The breakfast potatoes were flavorless and under-cooked, my eggs were a bit runny and the jam is a mixed berry in the little single-serve packets.  The coffee was watery so I stopped at half a cup.  Given the prices match that of other eateries, coupled with the other yelp reviews at the time, I expected more, especially by way of flavor.  With so many other great breakfast joints around town in the same price range, I doubt I'll be back.
name: Ronda

text: Absolutely love this Taco Bell! Every time I come to this exact Taco Bell all the workers are so nice and are so genuine!! Especially the night crew! So funny! Love those guys! Plus the foods always great and the lobby is always clean!
name: Codie

text: Came to Philly for the famous cheesesteaks sandwiches. Well let me start that, it's very clean outside, great sitting area. Customer service was great, and fast (we got the cheesesteak within seconds agreeing ordering). We got the whiz with onions. Well after taking the first bite I wasn't pleased, it was too cheesy and salty. The cheese was all I tasted from the sandwich, I couldn't taste the steak or the onions. We also got fries, they were fresh and hot.
name: Mariell

text: I'm going to give this place a 5 star review. Cool little dive joint with really good food and $5 drafts across the board. I had clam chowder which was awesome. I'm use to New England version but this was more of a broth but super fresh. The some buffalo shrimp which I'll dream about. I thought about 4 stars because it's outside and I'm a wimp with hot and humid, but they shouldn't suffer because I'm a wimp. The king of the show might have been a key lime cider. Good lord that was good. Anyway Cheers.
name: Dean

text: Got in before breakfast rush. Sat at counter , menu already there . The waitress had my coffee and water quickly and order taken. When I got my food , I ordered scrambled eggs , sausage, Hashbrowns and Toast. I kinda laughed in my head when I saw it. It was like I made it in my Kitchen, Drunk at 3am in the morning, I thought it was going to be a classic separate type item breakfast, but everything was thrown in the same pan mixed together besides the toast and sprinkled with cheese and had Huge chucks of green peppers ( i dont mind em) by the time I finished the plate it had a ring of green peppers on the outter lip from picking them out . Could of gotten wrong order but I didn't care I was Hungry and Hungover.....
name: Dukesofhazzard

text: This place had the Rudest people I've ever encountered in a service oriented business.  Do not waste your money
name: Robert

text:
Tried this place for Sunday​ brunch when I was visiting Tampa and I'd say this is hands down​ a very relaxing waterfront romantic type spot during the day (Haven't checked out at night, will do next time!) Brunch times can get pretty packed, def recommend to make reservations ahead of time. Although we didn't, we were just lucky enough to get seated right away! Our server was quite prompt and did a great job checking up on us every now and then. 

Their Maine Lobster Mac & Cheese is a MUST have! Don't even leave the place without having it! It's a good share for 2. We also had their Chicken Panini and Beef Fillet​ flatbread, both were excellent. Prices seemed reasonable, for such great food-service-views I'll pay more than that.

Can't wait to be back in Tampa and go to this place again!
name: Raisha

text: It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food was good and came out fast. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly, just kinda slow once the room filled up. The music was louder than it needed to be. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Will be back. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: The only reason for 4 stars is I stopped by the day before and asked how late they were open and was told 8.  When I came back for dinner that night to try it the doors were closed.  As far as the taste it was good.  The burger was cooked well and the tats were crispy like they should be.  I heard the owner is looking for a brick and mortar place.
name: Mark

text: The food was decent, but beware of the overly "posh" culture they attempt to surround themselves with. As soon as I entered I was welcomed nicely by the hostess but the experience only got worse after that. We got our appetizers and a waiter approached me and said "we have a collared shirt policy in the restaurant, we can either offer you a polo shirt to wear or you need to wear your jacket". The fact that someone came up to me after I have already been seated is ridiculous, not to mention that it's very pretentious for the restaurant to force people to dress a certain way to make the dining room "more formal". They seriously need to embrace a more modern culture or understand that coming up to guests and requesting they dress themselves different even after they've already sat in your dining room is rude and very disrespectful. The food was decent but definitely wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.
name: Pritak

text:
Reading some of these reviews make me think people never actually went here. 

I came here with my wife and 2 kids. We were served immediately by our server Brittany. I ordered the Firehouse Mac 'n Cheese Grilled Cheese with Pulled Pork fries. My wife and daughter got the Buffalo Chicken Mac 'n Cheese Grilled Cheese with Buffalo Chicken Fries and my son just got the kids Mac 'n Cheese with a side of fries. It was sooo filling that I had leftovers for lunch tomorrow. 

It wasn't too busy, and the place was real clean + 80s Spotify music (can't go wrong). 

Our waitress "made extra" strawberry banana smoothies and gave them to our kids for free.

Please, please give this place TONS of business. Sure, it could use landscaping in the parking lot but it's what on the inside that counts, right?
name: Christopher

text: Good food, poor server. Came here for the first time with my boyfriend. We like trying new places and wanted to get some drinks and share some apps. From the time we came in we were rushed by our sever and seemed to be nothing but an inconvenience to him. I don't understand how you are a server and respond openly annoyed at every question that is asked and can't even fake a smile. Nothing annoys me more than being rushed out of a restaurant. He brought our food out and forgot our blue cheese and was annoyed that I politely asked for it. Then we asked for another drink and seemed annoyed. He has to be watching us eat because as soon as we finished our last wing he came out and cleared our plates and brought our check, without even asking if we wanted anything else. It's a shame because our exact words were that we really loved the food but the experience sucked. We love taking our time and talking ... that's the point of going out to eat. I find it super rude and annoying to treat a customer like they aren't welcome. We will be back, but I will definitely  ask for a different waiter. Looking back I wish I would have said we were not ready to leave, but I didn't want to be that person.
name: Amanda

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Would return.
name: User

text: Always come here for Anpan and other Japanese pastries. Always fresh and great prices.
name: Jessica

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Glad we tried it. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
If I could put 3.5-3.75, I certainly would. Overall, a very good and enjoyable dining experience. My wife and I were first timers here and we were joined by another couple who had been once before for brunch. Being a first for dinner for all of us we were pretty excited to give it a try. 
First off, the cocktail menu is something else!! Lots of interesting concoctions with some surprisingly delicious combos. The ladies ordered a bottle of wine with the assistance of the staff member who was extremely knowledgeable about the wines that they had to offer and had plenty of recommendations. 
The small plates definitely offered the most options. We ordered the Calamari, Tartine, and Cheese Plate. The Calamari was by far my personal favorite of the small plates that we ordered, and judging by us fighting over the last piece, it was the table's favorite as well. The Tartine was good, but you have to be a fan of mushrooms and arugula.  It was served like an open faced sandwich. As a group that is always a big fan of a cheese plate, we weren't really thrilled with this offering. Three rather small cheese portions served with rather generic crackers. It was decent, however I wouldn't order it again. 
Overall everyone was pretty pleased with the entrees that we ordered. I had the filet, which was good. but as a guy who doesn't eat a ton of red meat, I was hoping for better. My lovely bride had ordered the scallops (small plate) with the local salad. She said it was very good and the scallops (3) were certainly large enough to be an entree. The couple that joined us ordered the fish and pork chop and both stated that they enjoyed it.  
Overall, a good experience.  Certainly not against trying it again and ordering some different items.  A recommend for sure.
name: Tim

text:
I have passed this restaurant numerous times and have wanted to stop to try the buffet.  My family was very resistant to this idea but we finally stopped in for lunch after church because it is my birthday week and you can't say "no" to mom on her birthday week!  What a little gem!  Great selection of buffet items and super friendly and accommodating staff.  Many items were a "new food" for my family and they were initially hesitant about trying them but loved everything they tried.  My husband and daughter repeatedly stated they would be back.  At $10.99 per person, it was priced well for such fresh and varied foods!

Loved it!  It will be a weekly staple in our eating out rotation.
name: Joan

text: The wife had a gift card so we decided to use it tonight, bad idea. She ordered take out and ordered it for pickup in 1 1/2 hours prior. Upon arriving our order was not ready and she had to wait 20 minutes. Only to have the manager apologize and said if she would wait longer for a dessert she would comp. the dessert. Really wait longer so my food can be that much colder, Nice. Now the wife arrives home and upon me cutting into what is supposed to be a medium steak I find out it is raw. Now I have to finish cooking a steak that we paid someone else to cook.
name: Me

text:
Portions are large but it is pricey. The meat comes smoked and very dry. There is an assortment of bbq sauces that are complex and all a little weird. 
Sides are all great but i wish they offered meat that was smoked wet and a more simple sauce option (nothing wrong with bullseye bbq sauce)
name: Rich

text:
I was a fan of Jet Wine Bar. It has a great atmosphere and some fun seats by a window that opens and faces outside. It's a little small, but it has a nice intimate vibe that's needed for a wine bar. My friend and I went for some wine, cheese and meats on a random afternoon. It was empty but still a great spot to chill for a bit. 

We each ordered a sparkling flight, and I really liked two of the wines in our 3-wine flight. We also ordered a cheese plate with 2 cheeses and 2 meats.  It's a great place to try all types of wine since you can order smaller ounce glasses.
name: Gloria

text: I quit coming here for years then a friend told they were much better. New manager or whatever it was they are doing an awesome job! Free Guacamole & Queso plus more options makes this place better than Chipotle.
name: Elvis

text: Always good food and service from this location. Our last order Memorial Day weekend they were maybe 15 minutes late with our delivery, no big deal. Not only did they send an additional large pizza, but a coupon for another large pizza at a later date. Very impressed.
name: Nicole

text: My 2nd visit... its ok definitely not the best that I have had.  Had the Bigfoot sandwich... they should just call it the Mac and cheese sandwich... the meat was almost absent.  I had the Mac and cheese as a side and that was maybe room temperature. Service was ok the woman that waited on us seemed to be bothered by the fact she was working.  I don't think I'd be going back any time soon
name: Mark

text:
Why haven't I gone here sooner?! My fiancé and I wanted to try something new, so we ordered a number of different items from here. The crab rangoons were good, but I wish you didn't have to order them in units of ten. The steamed dumplings were delicious. They're similar to the ones Bamboo House used to have, so my fiancé is thrilled. We each got a pork egg roll, but we could have split one. The egg rolls are twice as long as most restaurants'. But I'm glad we each got one, because they are the best I've ever eaten. 

The chicken fried rice was very good. The special Singapore mein fun was also quite good. Although the spicy chicken was flavorful, I'd probably try something new instead next time. Finally, the general Tso's was just alright. It wasn't the best or worst I've ever had. Just Tso-Tso ;)

Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant and will be coming back.
name: Kent

text: I really can't even give a review since we never even got a drink. Waited 10 minutes and never even got greeted. As we got up to leave, a server finally acknowledged us and asked if we changed our minds-I explained that we had waited an awfully long time to even get a drink. She responded that we didn't have to wait THAT long. Disappointing-but there are plenty of options for a burger in Plainfield to wait that long without even getting a menu
name: Ginny

text: My go to place in East Falls for pizza carry out or delivery. Great. Solid. Pizza. Those two young ladies ( ok the guys there too!) are the sweetest.
name: Scott

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Honestly, pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: While it was very much out of our way to get here, it was worth it!  My husband had a veggie burger--which he liked-- and I opted for the Taco Tuesday special.  The BBQ Taco was amazing.  The black bean and sweet potato was a bit predictable as far as flavor.  The ingredients were quality and the staff was incredibly nice.  Overall, the menu had a wide variety of options proving that vegan and vegetarian cuisine isn't limited to pastas and salads. Totally diverse crowd in the restaurant.
name: Kelly

text: Honestly? Really good food, just poor service. Had to ask for water, fork, had to about wave the bartender down to get my check and i was sitting at the bar by myself. Just because I'm sitting alone doesn't mean i like to be ignored. Here on business. Again, good food, just annoyed by the service.
name: Sir

text: If you come to Nola and don't come here, it means You didn't visit the New Orleans. Strongly recommended.
name: Emaad

text: Dinner reservation for 5:45pm. Got there about 5:50pm. Got sat right away. Quick service. Friendly server & staff. Bread and butter were really good (or we were very hungry lol) Octopus appetizer was so light and fresh. I know my octopus.  Loved it. I had the short ribs & fries, my friend had the duck confit with side of sauteed mushrooms.  Ribs melted in my mouth and taste was fabulous.  My friend also like her dish! For dessert we wanted chocoLate so we had their home made icecream (bl- we were not impressed by the chocolate one (Im used to the amazing piccola gelateria- perhaps Justine's should consider outsourcing from them) but did love the coconut which seemed more like a serbet than it did icecream. Our bill for 2 was $130 plus tip.
name: Giselle

text: The Gyros remind me of the ones in New York.  Great food and atmosphere.  Perfect for anyone who needs a break from all the New Orleans seafood dishes.
name: Rusty

text:
There is always a wait! If you get pizza your waiting 40 minutes minimum. 
I was not expecting this. 
It's good but, not great. 

This is just my experience with pizza restaurants,
Great pizza from Grimaldi's or Juliana's do not take this long for great tasting pizza. Just saying... 

Also I guess it was cold in there because the doors were open to the outside. But that was only bringing flys inside.
name: Jonathan

text: Let's see... My wife's bagel sandwich was completely cold and my $14 "Montecito" lox bagel was a total rip off. I'm sorry, but for $14, there better be a good amount of lox. This thing had less than an ounce. IV Bagel charges less than $10 for the same dish, only gives you more lox! Definitely not worth the money. Also, anyone who owns a bagel shop should know that you always put the capers ON THE CREAM CHEESE! OTHERWISE THEY JUST FALL OFF!
name: Jeff

text: the soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Also, pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: Meatball Parm Sandwich, homemade meatballs. To die for. Pretty much everything is great. Sometime very busy though!
name: Charles

text:
Not a good example of Mexican food. The waiter was nice, but had a hard time understanding that what I ordered was actually what I wanted. That being said, the Hornitos margarita was awesome! 
The rest of the meal was not. The  alambre tacos were dry and the bacon non-existent. Save your money. The chilaquillas were a massive heap of melted chips, indiscriminate cheese, and I'm sure some kind of meat product, it may have been shredded beef. Anyway, my suggestion would be, save your money and go to an actual Mexican restaurant that will serve authentic Mexican food in such a way that you appreciate Mexican food. I would say this is like literally one step above Taco Bell.
name: Louie

text: Boy oh boy, do I love sweet shops!  This one has fudge, caramel apples (the big ones), and ice cream. They give free samples of the fudge. I am partial to the butter pecan.  It's loaded with nuts.
name: David

text: I'm a fan of their happy hour here. The fact that they have happy hour on a SATURDAY, they deserve a star for that. Happy Hour is from 5-7pm (Mon-Sat), certain drinks and tapas are $6. You can't go wrong with their battered sweet potato fries, pork tacos, and bacon wrapped dates (bc bacon obvi). Food comes out quickly but service can always be a hit/miss. The first time I was here, our server was great but that was not the case when I came in for the second time. This place is a chill spot if you want to grab drinks and nibble on some food.
name: Elisa

text: They miss a selected topping 3 out of 5 times, skimp on toppings and never consistent with quality.
name: Bharath

text:
I'm worried about SnS.  Too many closings. I cant imagine a world without SnS.  PLEASE MAKE IT 4 FOR $5.  I'D EVEN PAY $6.  
I love this location. Everyone has ALWAYS been very nice.  Thx Alisa.  So what i had to wait 15 min for a table.  So what it took 15 min to get the food.  Geez people, get a life and quit complaining about the little things.  If you want immediate,  go to...somewhere else.
In Sight, it was right.
name: Jimmy

text: Came after the monumental half marathon to celebrate with friends and family. We were able to make a reservation for a larger group, very clean, good brunch menu, waitress was very nice and accommodating. The brunch salmon is cocked, strange. The brunch pizza is not an innovative as I thought, the eggs are just on top of pizza. None the less, food was good and service was great. Will probably come back and try dinner and wine.
name: Tia

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I left full, which at least counts for something. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Really enjoyed this spot! Oysters were huge, although not very briney. The snapper wings and shrimp plate were both excellent!! One of the better spots in the area. Very friendly bartenders and great vibe at night.
name: Emmy

text: Love the atmosphere and decor. You can have a very different dining experience depending on where you sit which is nice. Fancier "British" food with very good quality. British food however is not known for its culinary diversity so definitely a big upgrade from typical pub food. Great drinks. Staff is always friendly, knows their menu and gives good advice/service. I've been back multiple times, I'll be back again.
name: Katie

text: Got the gyro and fries.  Was reasonable priced.  The fries were fresh and hot with a tasty seasoning and the gyro was also surprisingly good.  Wish it had a little more meat though.  Would eat here again.
name: Amy

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Anyway, my friend liked their dish more than i liked mine.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It looked better online than it did in person. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
TLDR: Super fun market with local makers and good eats!
___

Came here with a group of friends for a little afternoon stroll and was pleasantly surprised by how large and how many vendors there are.

Local vendors making soaps and jewelry. Gourmet mustards and popcorn. They seemed to have a really good variety.

Ended up going with  a BBQ plate and sausage sandwich for $15. The Sausage sandwich was great. The BBQ a LITTLE dry, and I wish I had slathered a little more sauce on. The sides were excellent though - especially liked the potato salad. We snagged a table and munched out. 

Overall a really nice market to check out Saturdays!
name: Blue

text: This place was amazing! A brand new restaurant, part table service part go to a counter and get your food.  Amazing tacos and quesadillas and world class margaritas. It was packed with people that were all having a great time. Service was really good, friendly and helpful, which was amazing for as busy as they were! HIGHLY recommend this restaurant.
name: Clifford

text: Stopped in here on the way to the airport.  The coffee quality is inconsistent. The food is a bit overpriced.   It took forever to get my simple order of avocado toast, even though there were at least 3 people working behind the counter. There's a seedy laundromat next door.  Maybe needs a bit of time to straighten things out.
name: Karman

text:
Worth the hype and the wait! Luckily we were directed to wait at a plant ship next door which worked out quickly. 
I went for waffles but discovered they were the most boring thing on the menu because everything else looks so flavorful and was presented so nicely! I will definitely be back!
name: Sumita

text: Great quality food and best service in lansdale, no arguing. I have no complaints with the food or service here. I recommend at least trying it before judging with other restaurants!
name: Sam

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. For the price I expected more than this. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Anyway, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: The food came out fast, which was good because we were starving. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text:
Went on a Friday night. Super slow food service. I mean the waitress was fine but I think the kitchen was way understaffed (especially for a weekend.) took a long time to get the food. To be honest we asked for our order to be cancelled but were assured ours was being cooked then(still took another 10 min.)

When the food got there it was ok.... edible. But far from the best Indian food I've had, even in Tucson. Got the garlic naan, which was under flavored and the chicken tiki masala, which again was really under flavored.

Do yourself a favor and drive a little farther for much better Indian food.
name: Kelsey

text:
We ended up here at lunch time after picking up some jewelry next door, (oh darn!). Right in time for their lunch specials, which are really reasonable. I had a taco and an enchilada, which were under $10, and both really good. I love their refried beans, they are definitely not out of a can, and one of the things I look for in a good Mexican restaurant.

My husband had fajitas, his go-to, and they came out hot and sizzling, and he said they were really good, cooked perfectly, and we both had enough to bring home for another meal, even from the special menu, another plus.

Service was excellent, very pleasant and quick, and I would say that we would go back to this location again. The only negative is that it's so far away from our house in the North Valleys. I wish they'd put a location in the North Valleys, we'd eat there all the time!
name: Sherril

text: Honestly don't think I can give a fair comparison of cheesesteaks since this was my first real cheesesteak but I have to say that it was worth 20 mins of waiting inside a cramped space!! I got the original cheesesteak with grilled onions and cheese wiz. Also with a side of chili peppers. Don't forget the chili peppers because they make it that much better! I can't wait to go back to philly just to have this
name: Eugina

text:
Tried several local Chinese restaurant's and every one of them is average or less than. 
Li's is a step above and the food is just tasty. 
General Tso is crispy even with delivery. The cashew chicken is great and the Sweet am Sour pork is crispy and great as well. 
Delivery is quick and amount of food is abundant. Leftovers for days. Fried rice is great too. 
The only thing that was not great is the fortune cookies as they aren't crunchy as other places but that's nothing in the grand scheme. 
This is now my go to for Chinese and that's a great thing in a city that has horrible food choices and limited standards. 
5 Star for taste
name: Mike

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Worth checking out. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: Um definitely has lost the luster of when they first opened. Service was incredibly slow, my wife thinks our wait staff was taking smoke breaks in between checking on us. It definitely took longer than it should have for her to come back and at least check on us. Not horrible service but should have been better. My wife ordered a steak so that she could get a baked potato but the server didn't let us know that they were out of baked potatoes when we ordered, she came back 15min later to tell us they were out, so we substituted fries, and they tried to charge us for the fries which replaced the baked potato that they were out of. Not sure what the thinking was there, now we are waiting to get it straightened out but still waiting on server to come back. I had the catfish which comes with 2 sides, fries were over seasoned and the baked beans were on the cold side. Just very disappointed in the experience, I doubt if we will be back. On the positive side, my margarita was awesome!
name: Tony

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. No big complaints, just a nice meal. For the price I expected more than this. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text: Delicious meal....and this is coming from someone who is not a fan of seafood! I had the Sautéed Gulf Shrimp & Grits and my husband had the Creole Jambalaya Risotto. For dessert we had the bread pudding ( this is worth the calories!!!). One recommendation would be to make a reservation as there is a wait to be seated of 1-1.5 hours. The atmosphere is perfect, causal and not too loud.  Great place.
name: Desiré

text:
Brick and Barrel is pretty much your typical craft brew pub.  Its got the old fashioned brick and stone masonry, hard wood floors, and slight upscale ambiance.  There is ample parking (Philly Yelpers are googling that right now).  Under the bar there are plenty of outlets which also have USB ports.
The craft beer menu is on par with the other craft places.  There's plenty of good selections ringing up at around $7-10 a beer.  Food is slightly pricey with some fancier items available as well.  
Monday has half price pizzas and some other items (see my picture) so great time to score some quality food at a decent price.  I got the Margarita Pizza for only $5.  It was tasty and big enough to leave me leftovers for later.  One of the best five spots I ever spent.  
From the signs it looks they have live music and trivia nights throughout the week,  Both times I went were not during special events and the crowd was fairly light.
Definitely a place worth checking out for craft beer fans or anyone looking for a  nice, quiet dinner and who doesn't mind spending a few extra bucks.
name: Brad

text: My review is based off of customer service and drinks only. No food was ordered in this visit. This was my first time at Los Agaves and I came in not knowing that they closed early due to the holiday and in a bad mood. I initially felt super guilty because it was only roughly seven minutes before close and the bartenders on duty let me know in a heads up this is what is going on type of deal not in a get out of the restaurant type. The margaritas were great and the service was very friendly. I am also a server so I feel a lot of guilt when I come in so late but they were genuinely nice and I still received excellent service. I didn't catch the bartenders name but shout out for being so awesome! I definitely think I found my new Margarita spot (not so close to close though.)
name: Katie

text: Didn't see a mouse like the others review but I believe it.   Piss Poor service the last time I was in there....
name: Mina

text: My Fiance and I spent a beautiful night at Victory Field watching the Indians.  Afterwards we walked across the street to grab a bite and a drink.  As you walk in the the place warms you with their decor and lighting.  We decided to sit at the bar since we knew we only wanted to share a bite and grab a drink.  It took about 15 minutes for the bartender to greet us in a pretty empty restaurant.  The waitress was very nice and did take care of us after that point.  We selected the ravioli which wasn't bad but for the price point of $14 I was hoping for more than 6 lonely raviolis on a huge plate.  My cocktail was delicious and just what the doctor ordered after a long day in the sun.
name: Cristian

text: It looked better online than it did in person. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. A couple small things kept adding up. Nice little spot, decent portions too. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: We have been looking for a great Mexican place, and we just found it. We had the fish with garlic sauce and grilled vegetables and cheese enchiladas. The vegetables were amazingly cooked and the fish perfectly tender (and the garlic sauce on top was killer)! We will be making this place one of our regulars for sure.
name: Rick

text:
First time to the restaurant.  We were seated in the front section and while nice ambience, I would have preferred seating in the main dining room. Energy seemed higher. 

Service was solid and maybe a tad intrusive with the table touches. 

Started with the bread and enjoyed thoroughly. Had carpaccio and grilled squid as starters.  Flavor was good in squid but didn't enjoy the size of the pieces. Very enjoyed the carpaccio!  Great for sharing!

Had two pasta dishes;  Calamarate and Bigoli. We enjoyed calamariate more but neither blew us away. 

For entree we had Branzino and New York Strip. Both were really good dishes. 

Overall good experience but not great. Not my fav Cunningham restaurant.
name: Anne

text: Great service but when I picked up my food at the time they said it would be ready, my fries were very cold and wilted, I ordered lemon pepper and got mild. The rest of my wings were right. I usually come here and my food is right and fresh but today I was saddened. This was my bf's and I Valentine's Day dinner and he didn't get his lemon pepper.
name: Savanna

text: Sign said they had slices so I stopped in. The girl at the counter wasn't very pleasant. $2.50 for a slice. They pulled it out from somewhere, looked like a boboli crust. Slapped sauce on it and cheese and threw it in the oven. Put it in a box and served it to me. I saw the cheese wasn't even melted, literally was still cold. Asked for my money back and left. I'm sure ordering a whole pie would be different, maybe don't offer slices then if you're going to serve it like that. Wish I would have taken a picture.
name: Kevin

text:
Oh child! Ripped right from the Big Easy! This was a nice spot to stop in after our 'float spa night out.' I can't tell you enough how it was so much like N.O. it wasn't even funny. 
We sat in the back dining area so it was quiet and cozy. I could see how it could get crowded in that general area, but we had a nice spot. There was band playing closer to 9 pm and it drew in an older crowd. As we all know the students of West Chester, are often unsupervised drunks from 10 pm - 3 am, but this was a nice spot out of way. The parking was a little annoying seeing the streets are small it's to be expected. The Restaurant itself had a funky vibe to it. Again if they are looking to offer a New Orleans motif, this was it. 
As for dinner, I mean this was a meal!!!! I was torn between so many things but I stuck with the pistachio chicken with the hottest mashed potatoes I've ever eaten. Seasoned so well, which is all around the best part about the meal. The server told us who ever was cooking in the kitchen wasn't even from the south they were simply classical trained in cooking and wanted to offer a southern experience. 
I look forward to going back, there are so many up and coming restaurants in that area.

Check out the menu too, you can buy a round for the kitchen....and yes they deserve it!
name: Danielle

Standing out front on a cool Friday night and peering through the windows of Homegrown. I can't wait to get inside. The place is so inviting.

text:
Sorry, but I'm really not a fan of this place. I guess you can call this place a tourist trap on State Street. Food was okay overall but pricey for what it is. 

First off, I just want to say that customer service is really important to me, no matter how great the food can be. Starting from the moment we got there, none of the staff were very friendly. Our waitress was okay, but she disappeared throughout our meal and we had to ask other waiters for help. 

My friend ordered chicken fajitas, which came with tortillas, sour cream, and salsa on the side for you to eat however you wish with your grilled meat. She had to ask for more tortillas and sour cream more than twice. After about 15 minutes waiting for them, they finally came. When we got the bill, they charged us $1.50 for more tortillas and an additional $1.25 for one small scoop of sour cream which is a little petty if you ask me. Okay, I mean it's a couple dollars extra, so that's not a big problem, but what I didn't like was that they never told us it costed additional $, and we had to ask more than twice for it. Asking for more water and the bill in the end felt like pulling teeth. 

If you're in town for a visit, I really don't recommend coming here. There are plenty of restaurants on State Street that I feel can be more welcoming and serve better food.

text:
Everybody's got that one friend -- you know, the one that can cook anything and makes amazing, blog worthy meals at home on the daily.  So when 'that friend' asks you to go get a bite to eat, you know you have to find THE place...it's gotta be different, and the food and service definitely have to rock.  Thank you, Salt on Mass for coming through on on all points during our very first visit!

We entered Salt later in the evening around 845pm for dinner on a Saturday and were happy to find that - although we were asked if we had one - we did not need a reservation for our party of 4.  We received a very warm and welcoming greeting as soon as we stepped in the door, were given our choice of tables, and were immediately led to a tall, 4-top table near the bar area by the nicest gentleman who later turned out to be a manager.   We were quickly greeted by Daniel - our server - once seated.  Daniel was absolutely the perfect amount of attentive without being hovering or annoying.  Definitely added to our awesome first experience here.

To start, we all got something from the bar -- Dark & Stormys and a few local craft beers on tap ($7/pint, rotating).  We shared the Rock Shrimp and Calamari as appetizers -- ALL amazing.  This visit we each got something different at the table and shared. We tried: the Grouper, Rockfish, Wahu, and one other that is slipping my mind.  ALL amazing - perfectly cooked and paired with a complementary grain very well suited for each fish.  For dessert, we opted for the Pretzel Caramel brownie goodness ... and we tore it up.

Fast forward a few visits for purposes of this review, as Salt on Mass has now become our go-to restaurant for special occasions. I came here with a girlfriend for my birthday and then again for our wedding anniversary and had amazing experiences each time.  We have learned to try to get the catch of the day if available, as it never disappoints.  We were lucky to get Chad as our server for the second and third go round.  Chad was also an amazing server and added to our positive experiences each visit as well.  

For our anniversary, they provided us with personalized menus and offered several other touches that illustrate how they will go above and beyond to make every diner feel special.  The manager came to the table to wish us a happy anniversary and felt my scallops looked "sad", so he brought me new ones!  Add complimentary dessert to the mix, and you have officially won my heart. 

Thank you for being amazingly consistent and my fav Mass Ave spot, Salt!
name: Krysha

text: I just found out today that they closed this restaurant in the very quaint eclectic factory in Franklin. A friend and I visited here while traveling from Florida on a promotional modeling business trip in 2007. I feel so sad and dissapointed as this restaurant was one of my very few all time favorite restaurants. It was a true "experience" eating here. The ambiance and atmosphere here was classy and unique and eclectic and the food was AMAZING; it melted in my mouth. I couldn't wait to return again someday and feel so sad they had to close. text:
So let's go through the progression of events again and this time I'm going to keep a copy so if you delete it again I can just copy and paste it.  I was just going to stick to Facebook but now I'm going to go out of my way and post it other places as well.
Me and a friend took a 40 minute turnpike drive from Willow Grove to pheonixville because we were excited we just found out about a new place called bacon me crazy.  When we arrived we were told it would be an hour wait.  About 15 minutes into our wait we noticed 2 empty and cleaned tables sitting there, we waited for another half hour to get seated.  One we got seated the waitress took our order and brought us coffee.  Half an hour after that a person who I assume is the owner brought a free piece of bacon since we had been waiting so long.  The bacon we brought for 2 people was one piece cut in half and cold.  We sat and watched as every person who was there when we got there left, at one point the restaurant was less than half full and still we had no food, I was on coffee cup 2.  Soon we watch as people who had arrived after us started getting their food, some of those meals were things we ordered.  Eventually the table next to us has people seated at it and 5 minutes after they ordered they got food, again the same thing I had ordered.  Eventually the person who I assume is the owner came and apologized for the wait.  We told him we needed the food to go because my friend was going to be late for work. He said he would see how long it would take and if we were able to wait that long.  After about 10 minutes our waitress came back with a business card that had "free meals for 4" scrawled on the back and she informed us that after 2 hours and her putting our order in twice that our food want even cooking yet.  I understand first weekend kinks but sitting for 2 hours only to be told that our food wasn't even cooking is unacceptable.  We also watched as waitresses walked over to tables with armfuls of food delivering them to the wrong tables at least 5 times.

They have your standard burger fare as well as some more inventive options so there's something for every taste. The onion rings were pretty good, but could have been crisper, Cajun fries were on point, the Mac & cheese was a disappointment (akin to cafeteria food), and the biscuits were really good!

Cons: Staff is not the friendliest, helpful yes, but welcoming... not so much. Gets so busy that you may have to wait for people to get up and leave for you to find a seat, or join another group of people if there is space. When they sell out, there is no more, so do not waste your time heading over if it is past noon.

Tips: BRING CASH!!! Gets very busy- get there before 10:30 am. All seating is outdoors, so prepare to be warm during the summer. If you want to enter temple, make sure your shoulders are covered and your shorts/skirt is not too short. Out of respect for the culture, there are dress code rules to enter. text:
I think this is a hidden gem tucked away in the Garden District among old world homes and narrow streets. It does not have glittering neon signage and lacks any resemblance to the cookie cutter chains that seem to dominate our lives. Take a short drive and enjoy breakfast the way it was meant to be.

My wife and I visited on a wet overcast Saturday mid-morning recently. The weather was not so bad that we could have eaten on the sidewalk but chose to enter just in case the rain really started to come down. (which it did) Upon entering this quaint establishment you are immediately taken back to a bygone era of local neighbors sitting quietly, sipping coffee, eating a weekend breakfast, and just moving at little slower pace. Wonderful!

We started with a weekend standard to drink. A bloody mary ($6.50) for me and a fluted Mimosa ($6.00) for my wife. My bloody mary was a balanced blend of spice and juice and vodka. Not heavy or overburdened with excessive ingredients like so many places have gravitated towards. Many aficionados will be offended that instead of a celery stalk, crisp green beans were substituted, but I enjoyed the change and was not taken aback in the least. I don't know if it was the best I ever had but I will give my ultimate compliment and say I would order it again. For me, Mimosa is Mimosa is Mimosa, so with that being said it was a Mimosa.

Now my breakfast was yummy. Corned beef hash benedict ($11.95) I don't eat a lot of corned beef hash but when I do I like it prepared with just a hint of crispiness like it has been pan seared or slightly fried. Well these folks must have read my mind because they were perfect. Of course when you put a couple of eggs benedict on top with an olive for an eyeball how can you can go wrong? The eggs were cooked to perfection and placed upon the corned beef hash dead center. The mix of a well done corned beef hash and a properly cooked egg is almost beyond words. Yes, I will go back and get this again. If there was a weak spot it was the potatoes, they were piled upon a second plate in some standing grease. I know that to cook these you need some grease or lard or butter but try not to present the plate with the cooking medium standing beneath the food. Even my wife commented "too much grease honey!"

My wife had the huevos rancheros ($8.50). To me they were unremarkable and were not served with tortillas which is a mortal sin in Texas. There was an abundance of black beans, the guacamole was scarce, and the salsa was lacking in much after taste. My wife enjoyed the dish and couldn't understand my lack of enthusiasm. So my admissions is that as a native Texan, Huevos Rancheros has a different meaning to me. I know I am not supposed to compare cross border cuisines but when you are suckled on Tex-Mex from the time you were a toddler you can't separate it. So I will tell you again, my wife liked the dish and I did not. We will settle for an average rating for the huevos rancheros. (Try one of their other "New Orleans" breakfasts) Sorry honey.

All-in-all I highly recommend this establishment both for it ambiance and the food. Let's not forget great service and a tucked away location that harkens back to another era. Go ahead and go. Tell a friend.
