text:
I was very impressed with this place. The atmosphere of the place is a very chill vibe. They have very fun decor throughout the restaurant and bar. 

My impression was that this is a very nice spot to come grab some drinks with friends and have some food options that are good for snacking while you drink and socialize. 

The service here was very great. We had a very friendly waitress, who made sure to help with any questions we had about the food. This place also brings out your food as soon as it's ready. That way it's always fresh. So if your food is ready but your friends isn't, they don't wait around. They will be sure to brings yours out. Once your friends food is done, then they will bring it out. No waiting around, which I like that concept! 

After studying the menu for a little while, I decided to go with them Sesame and Chill Salad. I'm not 100% sure of all the ingredients but from what I remember it was made up of chicken, cucumbers, egg noodles, of course some sesame seeds, bean sprouts, and had some kind of peanut dressing. I may be missing an ingredient or two. This was a very delicious salad. It was a tad bit spicy (which is right up my alley) but, if you don't like any type of spice, then I wouldn't recommend this. However, if you like just a bit of spice, you should definitely try this out. You will not be mad. 

The pricing here is very nice as well. Just your normal eating out pricing. Overall, I was very very impressed with the food, the service and the atmosphere of this place. I will for sure be coming back to try some other menu items! Be sure to check this place out!
name: Travis

text: These are probably the best donuts money can buy. Loved the environment and the staff was super friendly. You best believe when im craving a donut... or 12.. I'm coming back to hole in one.
name: Andy

text: Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. It was crowded but still moved along. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Worth checking out. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text:
I really want to give them 5 stars however the food was just ok. From the atmosphere I would expect better. The atmosphere and service is 5 star. The Kale salad is 5 star. The Trout (minus the bacon) is 5 star. From the brunch menu I ordered the Lobster something.(they tried to be cute with naming items but to me it was annoying and confusing. I should not need an interpreter for a menu in English)  It was explained to me as a Lobster quiche. It was not. There was no crust. It was more like a frittata. It was ok. I give it 3 stars for effort but it wasn't hitting the spot,I ate half of it. 
The grits were ZERO stars. They were not cooked and the server told me thats how they are supposed to be. They tasted exactly like raw cornbread batter. She said 'our grits are different they are more like cornmeal thats how they are supposed to taste" What!? That's ridiculous!!Someone needs to go down South and learn how to cook grits.  
The margaritas were great but not strong enough to make me eat these terrible grits. 
The macaroni and cheese was very cheesy but basic and not fabulous. The oysters were 2 stars. They were barely warm. Im used to chargrilled oysters in NOLA and Memphis. These were not worth $18 
The grilled asparagus was good but basic. I could grill it at home.  My friends had the half chicken. They said it was so so. Good enough to take home and pan fry with some extra seasoning. 
Basically this place has a fantastic atmosphere and I will go back but I don't know if I will try as many things. I was disappointed in the food. I will have the kale salad with extra anchovies and some drinks. ( they literally have me one anchovy on a big salad  not cool)  
There is valet parking which is a nice bonus in such an active area.

If they could work on the food it would be fantastic. I wanted to give them 3.5 stars but I rounded up.
name: Julia

text: Hands down the best pizza in town. Mom makes amazing lasagna to bake at home for guests as long as you give her enough lead time. Eat in, take out or delivery. Calzones are delicious, especially the vegetarian fillings.
name: Erin

text: This restaurant never disappoints.   The portions are gigantic and the service friendly and great.   Come check out the Loco Moco and the pancakes.  Family had a great time.

text: It's like Hooters on steroids. They have a good beer selection, decent food, and of course attractive waitresses. I like the giant log cabin feel of this restaurant and it's usually a good place to grab a beer after work if you are wanting to get served quickly.
name: Tyler

text: Do not come here in a rush, the service is sooooo slow. Our table started off with a round of drinks. Beer prices aren't bad, it's an airport beer. I ordered the pierogis and kielbasa for dinner and the dish was just okay. I do like Iron Chef Michael Symon unfortunately Bar Symon fell short of expectations.
name: Stephanie

text: First time here, there were 3 of us and we all enjoyed our meals. I had the blackened grouper sandwich that was delicious!! The fish was so fresh!! I had it with fries that were nice and crispy and served hot!!!! My friend had the Po Boy sandwich and they give you lots of shrimp that were so tasty!! There was a really great seasoning on them and she loved it. Mom had the lobster roll which she loved, it was small though for the 21 dollar price tag. There is a big selection of beers, I had a Sea Dog lighter version (forgot name) very very good. I also enjoyed a piece of key lime pie, it was yummy. The place has a great layout, we sat outside, you can see some water and boats, they have a couple bar areas and a good amount of parking. My only complaint is that the floors where we were sitting outside need attention!! They were very thorough cleaning off the tables but completely ignored the silverware, crayons, cardboard coasters, and food all over floor. It looks bad and needs to be addressed. Also the prices at this place are much higher than most restaurants along the beaches for the same items.
name: Theresa

text: Awful Christmas Eve dinner. Clam chowder was too thick, lukewarm, and bland. Wedge salad: they must have removed many of the green leaves because I got the core. text:
I've fortunately have been blessed to visit the Yee-Haw Brewery location in Johnson City, TN multiple times because I'm there every other week. 

I thought the Nashville location would meet the standard but they don't. You'll spend two hours standing at the bar waiting for a bartender to acknowledge you until you just give up and walk away. I've been to the Nashville location 5 times (for the white duck tacos) and every single time I try to get a beer, the bartenders will look right past you like you're invisible. It's not a race or gender thing because the bartenders are diverse but it happens each and every time. 

The bartenders are slow, not tentative, and don't really care about delivering decent service. I attended a work party and at leave 10 others had the same experience. 

I was hoping to call this my home Yee-Haw since I live in Nashville but I'll stick to the four and a half hour drive to Johnson City, TN to get better service. Very disappointed.

text: Good food but very rude service at the front desk. My wife and I went for brunch and were meeting friends. When we arrived, we indicated to the man at the front desk that there was a reservation under a friends name for a larger group. Admittedly this was our first time here and did not know they didn't take reservations - We were only going based on our friend telling us she made a reservation the previous day. Regardless, the man, who appeared to be management, rudely stated he had no idea what we were talking about and they never take reservations. Which is fine, but there was no reason to be condescending. We continued to state that we were meeting friends who likely were already seated and he continued to treat us like we had seven heads. After providing our friends name multiple times another woman finally came up and indicated that they just seated her and the rest of our friends... we were finally shown to our table. The most frustrating and disrespectful part was that as we were walking to our table, we overheard him turn to a coworker and say something along the lines of "I still have no idea what the heck they were talking about", in a very impudent tone. Instead of treating someone like they are stupid, perhaps going forward assume that your customers have not been there before and don't know your policies. Try to be helpful maybe. To be fair the waiter and rest of the staff was great, but if that was the manager he should probably keep away from the customers.

text:
Life changing! When you go to NOLA, you have to eat charbroiled oysters. My coworker raved about this spot. After a quick bus ride, we got there around 5:30 on a Thursday. A line was already formed when we arrived. We probably stood in line for less than five minutes before we were seated. They will seat you at the same table as another party. I wasn't aware of it, but the guests already seated were nice.

We started off with a half dozen of the raw and charbroiled oysters. OMG! The charbroiled oysters were good and glad they give you bread to soak up the seasoning. Delicious. We also tried the New Orleans medley. Everything on the plate wasn't bad. It comes with gumbo, jambalaya, red beans and rice and smoked sausage on the side. I have to say that the oysters were the highlight of the meal. No pics of the charbroiled oysters since it was inhaled upon arrival.

This place gets very busy. There could be a wait outside so be prepared. The server was very nice. Can't wait to try it again.
name: Michelle

text: my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Definitely coming back. The whole meal felt kinda uneven. Food was fresh and service was quick. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Grand Opening, Happy Hour and a FULL house!! We met up with some friends for a total of 6 of us, including two kids. We sat inside because we arrived before the rush and once that happened there were too many of us to grab a seat outside. 

Inside was air conditioned, and the atmosphere was fun. Service was great and we enjoyed ourselves.
Outside was fun as well with live music and rooftop access. We ordered drinks from the rooftop bar and the bartenders were fast and friendly. We sampled The Crowley, Swamp Donkey and The Elder Bull. Elder Bull was my favorite as the others were a bit too sweet for my taste.

As soon as the place became full, it appeared as though staff was overwhelmed at the bar and it took awhile to get our order in. However, Kay stepped up and turned it all around. She definitely wanted customers to be happy and thanks to her, we were!! Also, Walter had set our table up with waters and appetizer when we arrived and kindly checked on us throughout the evening. 

The food was delish y'all!! 
Banks Street Burger: 10oz burger! Was big and tasty, fully dressed and the fries were crisp, fresh and seasoned perfectly.
Drinkery Crawfish Queso dip: Great appetizer! The dip was full of crawfish and we loved it. We ordered a 2nd one but it never made it to the table, but understandable as it was crazy busy.
Chargrilled Oysters: Sizzling hot and oh so yummy! Coming back for more of those.
Red beans and rice: I didn't taste it but those who did said it was great, large portion and not skimpy on the sausage.
The Tremé Pasta: This was the best pasta I've had in a restaurant. The flavor was delicious and the portion size was enough to fill you! There was shrimp and/or crawfish in every bite. 

Overall, cute little place with easy street parking, fabulous staff, and delicious food.
name: Maria

text: Moiz is amazing! The food is amazing and so was the service. So glad to meet a new friend! This is definitely better than some of the others in Nashville! I would recommend this place to anyone!
name: Jack

text: Just ordered from here under the restaurant's new name. I've been ordering from this location for a couple of years now, and this review is reflective of my overall experience. Let me just say-- they dont often get the order right, especially when it's To Go. They've forgotten to put in key features of dishes before (even forgetting the rice today, which is supposed to always come with the chicken tikka masala I ordered), and will not tell you if they are out of something but still charge you for it (like their homemade "lime soda"). The only reason I tolerate this as much as I do is because there arent as many other good flavored indian options in the area, and this place has a good location. Often, they drop the ball on your order and you pay for it. The management doesn't seem to take their business seriously. How sad! Oh well. Not sure of I'll keep ordering from here since they keep wasting my time with incomplete orders. On top of that, one time I ordered the chicken tikka masala and they delivered me a completely different dish. Also, if you're ordering two of the same dish and want them to be at different levels of spicy such as one mild and one medium or hot, they both will just be medium or hot. Bummer.

text: Food was good. We always do the happy hour, 6 dollar plates which are super good. Service was good. The restaurant is very clean. There is a full liquor bar. The margaritas are awesome !!! text:
Situated on the 2nd floor of a food court area, this is a cool Korean restaurant in Chinatown. We've gotten take-out from here in the past but this was my first dine-in experience. 

As usual, we try not to over-order but are general fans of trying multiple things. As a result, we ordered too much food here! We ordered the seafood pancake as an appetizer which reminded me of bacailitos in the Puerto-Rican culture. So yummy. We also ordered fried gyozas which were delicious and fried perfectly. 

For dinner, we ordered the Galbi ribs, and spicy pork. I was so full by the time the entrees came out but could not stop picking at the pork. So freaking good. 

We also each ordered soju but would probably split one next time since we didn't realize how large they were. 

Service was attentive and friendly. Great experience at Dae Bak.
name: Tina

text:
Great neighborhood pizza spot for takeout or delivery. Their pies are spot on and they are generous with the toppings. Even the plain slice is strong. 

Portions for the appetizers and sides are all a good value for the money. The wings and old bay fries stood out as being particularly good. Even their cheesesteaks and sandwiches are better than you'd expect. All around a go to spot if you're in the area.

text: Have you ever been really hungry but too lazy to go to the grocery store so you open your fridge and just stare? Then all you can find that's edible is like an old chunk of lunch meat ham.... so you eat it and it's not disgusting but just makes you sad?? And then you just give this look of discontent and realize it's time to open that cooking book your mom gave you for Christmas last year and maybe like uh go to the grocery store and learn how to feed yourself like a normal human? Well anyway this restaurant simulates that effect but they also make you pay $30 for a chunk of "grilled chicken" which is actually just old lunch meat placed on top of a small handful of lettuce that they may have illegally called a "Mediterranean salad".  So save your money and just eat that weird scrap of food in your fridge or...heck just eat some dog food and you'll be happier than if you eat at this restaurant!
name: Ruth

text:
If you dont know exactly where it is, you might not find this hidden gem of a cafe. Its located off 56th street, behind CVS, in what used to be one of the historic Fort Benjamin Harrison horse stables. The space is pretty rustic with the wood floors and exposed brick walls. Its a smaller space, so the tables are pretty close together. Unfortunately, they day we were there, there was a group of 8 or more women who were cackling and carrying on like they were at a bachelorette party. This was fairly unpleasant, as we could barely hear ourselves talk over the noise.

The food...pretty tasty! 

We shared the cinnamon roll pancakes, which are pretty amazing, and they pair well with their fresh brewed french vanilla coffee.

The breakfast burrito is packed full of eggs sausage and cheese, and is served with a generous helping of potatoes. It was good, but nothing real special about it. 

The girlfriend got the breakfast sandwich on a bagel and a side of fruit. She said it was "very good"

We will definitely be back to try more of the enticing options they have.
name: Nick

text: Dinner was amazing with the beautiful outside atmosphere.  Would highly recommend Amelie. Gumbo was delicious and the staff was very accommodating and friendly.

text:
Went here for lunch, arrived 20 minutes before they opened and it was hilarious to see all the people that were waiting for them to open at 11am. Then you hear the church bells ring and people just started coming from all directions! 

Anyhow, menu is displayed inside. I got the chopped brisket, with sweet spoon bread, and added the brussel sprouts. They served it with a slice of bread, white onion slice, and pickles. They have multiple sauces: sweet, spicy, vinegar, and a white bbq. IT WAS DELICIOUS, my only complaint is that I wasn't able to eat it all!!! 

You order at the counter, and they give you a number to put at your table, it took about 10 minutes to get our food and staff came around periodically to clean up tables and take peoples trays. 

Will certainly come back here and you're missing out if you haven't been! 

My only real complaint is the finish they have on the tables make them feel sticky, at first we though our table was dirty but after feeling the table next to us we realized that's just how their tables feel.
name: Rachael

text: If you're in Philly for a convention, then this location cannot be beat. It is super convenient, with direct access to the convention center. It's also located right next to Reading Terminal Market, one of my all time favorite spots for breakfast and lunch. However, as others have pointed out, this place is so old and tired. I was in a tower part of the hotel right above the convention center, and it's kind of an odd walk and less than convenient to the rest of the hotel. I stayed in the same tower with my family probably nine or ten years ago, and I don't think it's changed a bit since that time. The room was ok - just old and worn like the rest of the place. Housekeeping didn't do the best job cleaning the room. Elevators were really slow. It all may sound picky, but I think I would have enjoyed a much more updated and fresh looking hotel, even if it was a little less convenient.

text: Would have loved to enjoy the breadsticks but was not able to enter this establishment due to what I wore. The bouncer complimented my outfit but then asked if I had a t-shirt. It was 11:30pm on a Saturday night. I was dressed as if I was going to a bar not church. I asked why we couldn't enter and his reply was " we are a privately owned bar and we make our own rules." text:
Tahyo Tavern is a little ways off the beaten path from the "touristy" section of New Orleans, and honestly it doesn't look like much from the outside (or the inside if I'm being honest). But let me tell you it is absolutely worth the walk and if you don't order food your'e 100% missing out. 

We were looking for place to grab a drink and Tahyo sucked us in with the idea of giving money back to dog shelters with every purchase. The beers we had were all pretty delicious, but the real winners were the food. We had the fried brussel sprouts and the goose fat french fries and they were both to die for. I've had duck fat fries before and they were delicious, and apparently goose fat is equally as amazing to fry things in. The malt vinegar aioli was so good I would have licked the cup it came in if I wouldn't be judged. Whatever seasoning they put on the brussel sprouts was absolutely amazing and were some of the best fried brussel sprouts I've ever had. Both appetizers were huge portions for the price you pay and easily fed four of us. 

The only downfall of Tahyo Tavern was the service was a little slow, especially since it wasn't that busy when we were there. That being said if you're looking to slow your vacation down a little bit and don't mind the wait then head on over here. It's 1000% worth it!

text:
Been wanting to try this place as I've been to very nearby places and knew of its existence for a little while now.  It's a tad deceptive from the outside as there is really a ton of room inside with plenty of open seating.  They really maximized the space well with a great floor plan.  We were warmly greeted and asked if we had been here before.  We then got a brief explanation about the menu, the coffee, and the ordering process.  We were invited to take a seat while looking at the menu and we did just that.

I ordered the Farmer, along with a side of the mac-n-cheese (or the Smokey Mountain Mac & Cheese as its titled).  The farmer had a really nice blend of amazing flavors, from the pecanwood smoked bacon, to the house made apple butter (never even heard of such a thing).  As for the chicken, it was just ok.  I had hoped for some sort of spice on the breading.  It was a tad bland for my taste, but still ok, especially with the salt-n-pepper that was on the table.  The mac-n-cheese was spot on and I especially liked the cheese cracker topping.  A friend of mine was not so lucky with his mac-n-cheese as he discovered a very lengthy piece of hair in his.  We notified the employee that took our order and she immediately apologized.  She returned a short time later and made everything whole.  I get that these kinds of things can happen, but there are precautions that should be taken to avoid this from happening.  I'm guessing even some health code rules that should be enforced as well.  That being said, it didn't ruin the overall experience and it wouldn't prevent us from returning here.

They do have a little work do to in order to earn a higher star rating from me and I hope they can pull it off.  This place, and its story really contributes to the success of the Burg.
name: John

text:
I can not help but compare LemonShare to Poke Loa.  I am new to the Poke game, so these are the only two stores I know about.

So LemonShark is pretty decent.  There store is super clean and nice inside.  It's fast casual, so you head up to the bar and begin your ordering process.  For me, I went with one of the signature dishes which involved ahi tuna and the spicy salmon.  It had all kinds of stuff in it.  Whatever sauce was used, it had a sweet taste, which I did not care for.  But overall, the ingredients seemed to be of decent quality.  Greens seemed fresh.  The protein, in my case tuna, was quite tasty.  The only thing that burned me was the sauce.  I'll try again and this time get maybe a variation of one of the signature dishes.

Compared to Poke, they have more options at least from a protein standpoint.  There were a few kinds of tuna, salmon, shrimp, scallops and octopus.  It's hard for me to talk about the toppings because they are all foreign to me.  That stuff kind of runs together.  That's one of my main reasons for ordering a signature dish.  

Anyway, it was a nice place and the food was decent.  I will probably repeat and give them another go.  Next time, I'll try some of their sauces to find one I like.
name: Chris

text:

Although it does not look like much of a variety the taste is definitely distinctive between the drinks.  And it was nice to find a local brewery that is not crazed over hops, hops, and more hops! Because of the hop craziness I gave up on a few other local breweries because I was sick of everything being pumped with hops. But Tin Lizard had plenty beers to choose from that didn't rely solely on the hop fad. 

The Sampler food was perfect. It is tough to beat their wings, brisket, or ribs. Nothing was too dry and everything had great flavor. The cornbread was fabulous if you like yours more sweet. And I liked how the baked beans were not dripping in gelatinous syrup. 

Ambiance was kind of loud but it's also a bar so it is expected. Very nice staff and I thought the price was reasonable for what we ordered. The Sampler is plenty of food for two people. In fact we took about a third of it home for lunch leftovers. Will definitely be back!

Had a terrible experience here that the manager turned into an OK experience.

My wife and I came here with our baby at around 3pm which is a dead zone hour.  I think there were 4 tables down including us.  Our server must have been changing over because no one came to talk to us until about 15 minute after we sat down.  We ordered our food immediately  and began to wait.  I got the Prime Rib Sandwich, and my wife got the Portabella Burger as it was the only option for her on the menu as a non meat eater.  This was a concern for her as it puts her in a tough position with only 1 item.  

The time ticked by, and our baby was cranky...this further agitated the remaining wait for the food.  I checked the time and we had been waiting 20 minutes at this point (as 1 of 4 tables sitting down) for our food.  **Prime Rib is cooked night before, and Mushroom does not take very long to make**

I finally stopped another server as we could not find ours and let her know that at this point we have been here for 40 minutes with no food (15 before server came, 20 waiting for food, and 5 exaggeration) .  She got our server who apologized and said "I'm not sure why it is taking so long, I am really sorry".  About 5 minutes later our food arrived and dropped off at our table with another apology.  I was holding the baby to allow my wife to eat as she has to leave sooner than I did.  While holding my baby I was picking at my food and noticed that my meat inside the prime rib was cool to the touch so I had my wife hold the baby and took a bite....aw man...cold!

We stopped our server and let him know the issue and he took it back.  My wife finished her burger and said it was delicious and she would go back just for the portabella burger! +1 star  She took the baby and left.  I still did not receive my food.

Finally the manager comes back with my food and it i steaming.  She apologized and left.  I took a bite.....clearly microwaved up to temp.  Sigh.  I have a feeling that the prime rib is cooked the night before and then microwaved up.  It was terrible.  For $16, I expected something much better than microwaved meat.  I was so angry at this point i just wanted my check so I can leave.  The manager personally delivered the check with the Prime Rib off the bill which gives them the other +1 Star.

Either way, I doubt I'll come back unless it is for my wife wanting the Portabella Burger.

text:
Harry & Izzy's... hurts so good.

A good friend of mine recommended Harry & Izzy's to me during a trip and I subsequently wanted to visit them two more times while away. Twice at their downtown Indianapolis location and once more at their airport location for the road before heading back home. Each visit, I had the same appetizer and dinner, because I enjoyed them so much.

While Harry & Izzy's is a chain, they are a rebranded, slightly more casual restaurant that is based on a really old, formal steak house. From my understanding, and any server will give you the 411 if you ask, the meals are the same only the atmosphere is slightly less suit and tie and more jeans and a polo.

The two dishes I had were the St. Elmo's Shrimp Cocktail and the Seared Scallops on a bed of couscous with a side of mashed potatoes. 

The St. Elmo's Shrimp cocktail is world famous and what H&I is known for. I can't say I am surprised because it leaves a impression.

How can I put this, imagine asking to be sprayed in the face by pepper spray. Delicious, delicious pepper spray. Imagine for a moment you are a masochist who just wants to cry tears of joy... Yeah this thing is basically a fireball. A tasty, edible, fireball. 

You see, the St. Elmo's Shrimp Cocktail's shrimps are deeply submerged under an ocean of cocktail sauce that is so heavy on the horse radish that it will feel like you are having a stroke the first time you take a bite. I mean, white hot flashes where you wonder for the briefest of moments if you have made a horrible mistake as the burn runs like a screaming lava banshee down your throat then back up through your sinuses and behind your eyes. For the smallest of moments, you think, "please don't hit the brain please! I choose life!".

Then, almost as quickly as the flash bang grenade in your head went off the pain recedes and is replaced by a very flavorful after taste. This one two punch of pain and flavor produces a sort of culinary ecstasy I think one must experience at least once, or in my case, three times in their lifetime. The dish comes in four and I believe six or eight (shrimp serving sizes) and I highly recommend going with four your first time. Build up a tolerance.

After the cocktail, I enjoyed the seared scallops on couscous dish. The scallops were large, tender, and buttery good. They were the right texture and flavor. Not too firm, not too mushy, and just the right mx of good butter and fishy in taste. 

The mashed potatoes was a nice complement to them as the butter cross saturated both parts of the meal in a good way. The greens and couscous were a nice clean, light finish to what was a pretty heavy meal.

I realize that neither of those things are steak and that this is a steak house but all I can say is they were both so good I didn't even want to try something else. Given the price point, which is on the high side, I think that this is likely a testament to how good the food is there. 

My wife also let me try their calamari, which was accompanied by a tangy, "not marinara" sauce that I don't recall the name of but which I can only describe as a sassy duck sauce which was, in my opinion, a better sauce than marinara for calamari.

The location in downtown is better in my opinion but the airport gets the cocktail right so you can still get the experience there.

I recommend Harry & Izzy's. If you want to try a dish that blurs the lines between pain and pleasure, and to have a unique culinary experience that will almost certainly leave you in tears, give them a try.
name: Asaf

text:
The only reason why the rating isn't lower is that dinner (in person) at Tre Lune can be a really nice experience. The service and food quality can be top notch.

Ordering take out is another experience altogether.

Sure ordering for pickup automatically excludes us from getting a level of service that is often expected from a Montecito restaurant but we didn't realize that ordering takeout also meant that we would be subject to huge swings of food quality/consistency. After all isn't food quality the one thing that a restaurant can exhibit huge amounts of control over?

The latest takeout experience involved ordering Garganelli with chicken and mushrooms. One order excluded the chicken and the other order assumed that we would enjoy having the chicken added as an after thought - on top of the dish as if it were an over easy egg. We have pictures of the incredibly appetizing meal (being facetious of course) but there doesn't appear to be a way to post those while writing this review. Keep in mind the cost of the meal is the same for takeout or dine in.  The same price applies even when no chicken or mushrooms are added.

Our advice - don't order takeout at Tre Lune.  If you are in pinch and find yourself looking over the menu, then place your order and clear your calendar just in case you need to stick around the restaurant while your dish is being remade the correct way.

PS. And no, these are not the only examples.  There are others but clearly we didn't learn our lesson and continued ordering.  The last experience may have sealed the deal for a long while.

text: Much better. After my previous review I was invited back. This time, after ordering my burger "medium", it was still well done, but juicy, and not squashed flat. Fries were hot and fresh, and the lemonade is still great. And this time, the ketchup dispenser was working. I'll probably be back.
name: Mark

text: Haven't been here in a while. Had the #2 combo, cheeseburger, fries and medium soda. Love the option of a slice of raw onion. To me it makes a fast food burger a lot more tasty. Since my last visit they have changed how the fries are made. Previously they were very thin and resembled potato straws. Now they're thicker but are devoid of any potato flavor and have the consistency of styrofoam.  Not a winner for any burger chain.
name: George

text: Waitress barely came around and when she did we got berated because not all of our party ordered at the same time. But after she took 1 order, she left the table before I could even place my order! And the ones she took the order from came on after me! My drink was never refilled, and the food was not all that great.
name: Sara

text: Great Pizza! My wife is from Chicago and we always look forward to getting pizza when we visit her family it is nice that Gino's has opened a location in Nashville! Service was fast and friendly we have been here three times since finding out they have opened. Getting a deep dish pizza is a must if you come but I also recommend the buffalo mozzarella cheese sticks.
name: Jason

text: If you know someone that works there you get served 1st.. Dirty floors, disgusting bathrooms.. Warm food
name: Debi

text:
We moved to Tampa from Seattle where we were really fortunate to have some of the best, freshest sushi stateside, so we were very happy to discover Soho Sushi.  We've only been there for lunch, so my review will focus on the lunch crowd.  For context, we go there every few months to get our sushi fix and were just there the other day.

The sushi is very good - not over the top amazing - but consistently satisfying.  We've had a variety of rolls, both raw and cooked.  The spicy tuna has always been fresh and flavorful.  Same with the hamachi.  The spider roll is a typical rendition of the classic.  The cajun roll is very inventive and delicious- full of perfectly cooked and seasoned crawfish. 

The star of the show, however, is the agadashe tofu.  It is coated in a perfect panko (thin) crust and quickly fried (not at all greasy).  The sauce it rests in is delicious.  The addition of broccoli is a nice touch as it is blanched & adds some texture. 

Tip: parking is ridiculous - frankly, given their success and the wait, I am surprised that they have not moved to a larger location with better parking.  Thus, if you can, get there by 11:30 to 11:45 to ensure a parking spot.  There will be no parking by noon; however, if you time it right, the first wave of folks (i.e. people like us!) will be leaving right around 12 or just after.
name: Ryan

text: The food was good. But the kids got milkshakes after their meal was done and over with. Not the waitress fault. But really come on. But a nice place to eat.
name: Laura

text: Great events, great food, great company, nice jazz overall I would come back anytime for any event. Prices are very reasonable
name: Erika

text: This is the best Chinese food that I've had on Tucson by far. I almost always get the Mongolian beef with soft noodles, and it has a ton of flavor.
name: Jason

text:
I had the tenderloin and my wife had a salad. She loved the salad and I thought the tenderloin was very good.

The service was awesome. Wish I remembered the dude's name. He was exceptional. Tall guy with facial hair. You will know him if he waits on you. He is good.

The tenderloin will give all the places in town a run for the money. Well fried, juicy, thick enough and fit on the bun pretty much. What else can you ask for, this is Indiana. We have had several salads there and all the ones we tried were very good. This place might make it on the lake!
name: Gary

text: My favorite spot to grab a sandwich in st pete. They have 2 veggie options and both are absolutely delicious!
name: Catherine

text: Went here 5pm on a Sunday. We were the only ones in the restaurant. Food was okay. We got miso soup and split three rolls. Honestly rolls were nothing special. Also, the atmosphere felt like it's geared towards college students. Music was bumping and bass was rattling the walls. Waitress was very nice.
name: Ashley

text: I was in the area for a business trip and saw favorable reviews of this place and it did not disappoint. If memory serves correct, there were only 6 or so doughnuts to choose from making the decision process easy. Prices were reasonable and there was hardly a wait time when I was there (slightly after lunch hour on a weekday). Overall, the doughnuts were solid.
name: Jonathan

text: I've eaten here a few times. My top 2 favorites are the western burrito- that is fajita inspired, and the taco truck tacos. I've always had pleasant customer service experience, good food, and my food comes out in great timing. I will definitely return.
name: Schuyler

text: We are sauce people but the dry rub ribs are AMAZING! Especially if you get the mild, hot and white sauce to choose from with each bite. The green beans, baked beans and Mac and cheese are all stellar compared to other bbq joints around. They're unique and full of flavor. My favorite are probably the baked beans with all its peppery goodness. I also highly recommend the pepper jelly and saltines as an appetizer! Big enough to share amongst a group of people. Basically this is all to say this place is worth the line and wait! Especially when you can immediately order a beer at the bar while you wait.
name: Hannah

text:
Soooooo close to 5 stars - and definitely 5 star service from Jack today for a leisurely, late lunch (L.L.L.) including that fantastic "power green" soup.  I just love it.  (Does contain dairy so not vegan - and very rich with cream and parmesan cheese thus negating the veggies.)

You gotta try that soup.

So delicious.
name: Karen

text: I like the cocktails and ambience in the restaurant, but thought food was not nearly as good as other Cunningham restaurants. The concept is southern style, bbq cuisine. The menu has exciting options, but they do not manifest well on the palate. Portions were small for the price, and flavor/quality was not what I have grown to expect out of Cunningham restaurants. The highlight other than the drinks was the fries. The fries were very good, with awesome sauces. Otherwise, unimpressed foodwise. Recommend if getting drinks and snacks, while watching a game at the bar. Do not come for the food.
name: Jake

text: Always have a good meal here! Would definitely recommend if you're looking for an old school Italian restaurant. The spaghetti and meatballs and homemade gnocchi are really good!
name: Ashley

text: Grouper sandwich was awesome and I had the lunch serving of chicken in pineapple chutney. Everything was delicious. Service was very good and we were able to sit outside, in the shade and have an enjoyable lunch.
name: Ron

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nice little spot, decent portions too.
name: User

text: Steak was very tough ordered medium well got medium rare overall service was good but food needs work
name: Richard

text: I've been here twice and both were very disappointing. I don't get all these good reviews. Tamales had no meat either inside or on top. Just corn meal. Beans were ok but rice was dry. Chips were stale and salsa bland. Enchiladas had enough meat but no enchilada or tomatilla sauce. Just cheese. We were disappointed the first time but kept reading these great reviews so gave it another try. No more.
name: Mark

text: This is one of the best restaurants in the country. Places like this the reason I became interested in Yelp, taking pics & writing reviews.  Listen if you are in Indianapolis & you don't go to this establishment you either are a vegan or lost. Whatever you may be doing in Indy probably isn't as important as stopping at the fine steakhouse. I know that is a bit strong but for whomever is reading this I'm doing this for YOU! Professional waiters greet you & they offer all the finest menu options. Ask for things that aren't on the menu. My friend ask for something other than the complementary navy bean soup, they suggested a seafood bisque that he said was far & away the best he's ever had. We are from Eastern Long Island & the best bisque & shrimp cocktail are in Indiana, too funny! I requested the cold tomato juice because last time I had the navy bean & wanted to try something different, it was very good. I hope they use that for their bloody Mary s. I have to catch a plane, go there.
name: Rob

text: The manager Craig has refused to pay multiple sound guys after there gigs. It has been a pain in my butt trying to receive the money I earned over a month ago. This is by far the most I've ever been disrespected as well as my colleagues. If you are a sound engineer DO NOT take a job here. Also, If you are eating here know that you are supporting a restaurant that stiffs people they've hired.
name: Austin

text: Excellent food and staff! The steak was the most tender and scrumptious we have ever had! Everything was really good. Waiter was funny and attentive. We'll be back every time we visit!! Thank you!!
name: Melissa

text: I give this place five stars after coming across their Instagram page. Myself being a diabetic I understand the struggles to sometimes find diabetic friendly foods that don't taste gross. Having a friend who suffers from celiacs disease it was great to be able to find a place that serves not only gluten-free items but vegan friendly items for my vegan friends. It's often a challenge to go out to bakeries with them because of dietary restrictions. The day that I went here they had on special a Mexican hot chocolate and I got there gluten and vegan free banana nut muffin. When eating the muffin you would not know it was gluten-free or vegan friendly. It tasted like a regular banana nut muffin that was moist and had tons of flavor. I loved sitting outside even on a hot summer day drinking some Mexican hot chocolate. Interestingly enough they also have a menu where you can order some extra dishes such as pancakes which I would like to try in the future. I really like that this is a local place as sometimes the chains don't always have the greatest quality of food or drink. However, like a chain there will definitely be a line of people and because the location of small seating can be limited. Just keep that in mind when you come for a visit. I highly recommend this place and I know that I will be back here especially when coming with friends that are looking for a cafe type option.
name: Kristen

text: First time visiting this place. Felt like pizza and decided to give it a try. Glad I did! Was yummy! Ordered a medium sweet jalapeno bacon pizza to go. Was a nice combo of sweet and spicy. Wish it had more bacon because I love bacon. Will be back!
name: Deb

text:
I enjoyed my stay at this conveniently located hotel. The check-in was delightful, as the staff was friendly and charming. I was able to request joined non-smoking double rooms while staying with my elderly grandparents. I was also offered a set of vouchers good for any restaurant for opting out of daily room service for our 3-night. There is a senior and military discount. 

The rooms were okay! Not much to complain about. Room service food came quick and staff were happy to bring up additional toiletries. The beds were comfy and the linens were clean. It was a non-smoking unit, but--perhaps because we were on a lower level floor--I still had some trouble with the smell and feeling of cigarettes in the rooms. It's not the cleanest hotel, but it didn't send this germaphobe running and screaming either.
name: Louie

text: The Lark and Thomas the manager are a MUST visit in Santa Barbara!! After I made a reservation at the wrong restaurant, Thomas worked his magic and made our first visit to The Lark amazing. The food, service and atmosphere scores at the top of my list. Thank you!
name: Heidi

text:
Billy G's is a bustling Restaurant and Bar in the heart of Kirkwood.  Billy' G's is known for its patio seating.  Go on an "off meal time" to get a great seat.  They do have the ability to seat large parties, which is great for big families.  You can get lost in conversation, good food, and good drinks on the Patio. 

Two of my favorite thigs on the menu are the Chicken Spiedini Sandwich and the Trashed Wings.  The Chicken Spiedini Sandwich comes with a roasted garlic butter sauce that is so good you can dip fries into it.  I always ask for the sauce on the side.   Sweet Potato Fries at Billy G's are warm goodness with a crispy skin and chewy center.  The Trashed Wings are a perfect item to order when seated at the bar.  They are so crispy you almost do not want to order wings anywhere else.

They offer a Brunch Menu on both Saturday and Sunday Mornings.
name: Kristen

text: I heard good things about the food- what a disappointment. We had them cater a luncheon and it was terrible. The food was lukewarm at best and bland. The sauces might as well have been sore bought canned. Total disappointment and will not use again!!
name: John

text:
We are so thrilled that we found this gem of a location for our wedding!  After looking at numerous venues throughout southern California, this was the only place that ticked all of the boxes.  It was everything we wanted and more.  Both of us really liked the beauty and the versatility of the Riviera Mansion, allowing us to plan an outdoor ceremony and dinner, with the option of moving things inside at the last minute if the weather did not cooperate.  As it turned out, we had a perfect day for our ceremony outside on the lawn under an enormous and incredibly beautiful old tree.  Dinner on the patio under the twinkling lights was magical.  Having exclusive use of the entire facility and being able to have music until 11:30pm were additional benefits we did not find in other places nearby.  And there were so many different rooms that we could keep the guests entertained from ceremony to cocktail hour to dinner to dessert to dancing, each in different sections of the mansion and grounds.  

Two other real standouts we cannot fail to mention were the food itself and the staff of the mansion.  So many guests raved about the food!  Chef Jamie West was spot-on and the dinner exceeded everyone's expectation for a wedding meal, being more like dinner at a fine restaurant with exceptional attention to each course and each serving.  A few of the guests even told us it was the best steak they ever had (we had the filet with port mushroom sauce).  In addition, we also cannot say enough about the staff at the mansion, headed by event coordinator Breanna O'Toole.  Breanna was simply the best, answering all of our questions in a timely manner and guiding us through the booking and planning process; and the entire staff was very professional, accommodating and helpful.  We cannot recommend this place enough!

Jeff and Cathy
name: J

text: Great Mexican food with a wonderful happy hour. Their menu marked gluten free items. Additionally, they were knowledgeable and attentive to my needs, taking efforts to avoid cross contamination. I really enjoyed the street tacos!
name: Hillary

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Not bad for a quick meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: I like this grocery and I like to support local businesses, especially local businesses that support local businesses. That being said, I think they excel at a few things (prepared food and produce boxes are two highlights) and have some work to do on other things. For instance, I was there on a Saturday morning (prime grocery shopping time) and their cold, prepared food case was mostly empty which just baffled me. Over time they seem to have added more products, but there still is a lot of empty floor space that could probably hold more goods. In general, the product selection is too small for me to do my main shopping here so I tend to go for special purposes (like picking up produce boxes or checking out special events like pastry days). I think they have a lot of potential and I'm looking forward to them growing with the new name change.
name: Emily

text: I'm not even a BBQ, but I love bourbon ! However, I got the brisket plate and it was very good . The creamed corn needs some improvement as it's bland and soggy . We got 4 drinks between us ...the sauzarec, which was only ok, not as good as any I've gotten elsewhere . However, the Salt & Smoke was excellent as was the French sounding one (ha, the name just slipped my mind). We will definitely be back . The sauces were pretty good too .
name: Eryn

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Glad we tried it. For the price I expected more than this. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: This is our second time having breakfast here. Dining room and staff are very nice. Clean tables and super polite staff. Prices are very reasonable and the food comes out quickly. We have only had breakfast but they are open for other meals as well. I would highly recommend this little diner based on value and overall image / performance.
name: Curt

text:
We hit up the new Shake Shack in Metairie for the first time last night for a quick family dinner. We've heard mixed reviews, but had a good overall experience on our first visit. 

I REALLY enjoyed the SmokeShack burger... I like the way they cook the patties and found the smoked ranch bacon and chopped cherry pepper spread to be very unique and full of good, spicy flavor. It was one of the better fast food burgers I've had in a while. 

My wife had the Chick'n Shack fried chicken sandwich... also very good. She commented that it was better than the Popeye's sandwich (we had a slight disagreement there ;) ...... 

We didn't try the shakes... hope to get to that next time. 

BOTTOM LINE: A great new addition to the fast food scene in Metairie. I will definitely be back for that SmokeShack burger.
name: Matt

text: Walked out after sitting at the bar for 10 minutes and not even get a water or menu. Looks like they weren't ready to open yet they were open. I've worked in restaurants. When the doors open you are prepped and ready to serve. Terrible management.
name: Brad

text: This is one of my favorite spots for a good Philly Sandwich.  It's a guilty pleasure indeed.
name: Terence

text: Great addition to the neighborhood ! The Apple Fritters are amazing (actually the best). The staff: courtesy and helpful.  Very clean.  Highly recommend
name: Rick

text: Wow!!!!  Such a good dinner.  Everything put on our table was delicious.  Presentation was so " magically eye appealing". Taste was even better!  Our waitress was THE best ever!  Hit a personal level with her.  Will go back soon! FYI.... We were celebrating and we grabbed appetizers, main entree and dessert!  Left happy and full!
name: Brenda

text: Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text:
I was hoping this place would be amazing because of the reviews. It was pretty good. Very limited seating. We sat at the bar to avoid the wait. I had a full view of the kitchen- which I didn't like because I was over assessing every detail and moves the cooks were making...or not making.  
The entrees come with their specialty "chop salad" which I don't prefer. I wish there was another choice, I'm a caeser salad kind of girl. 
I opted for sautéed broccoli instead of potato which was wonderful. 
My filet mignon was cooked perfect and juicy. My husband did not like his ribeye. He likes it grilled, not broiled. 
Beer and wine at the bar only. Coffee is from a Keurig. 
Overall, okay. Probably won't go back.
name: Brittney

text: The fried green tomatoes and noble pig pizza are amazing! Great service as well as drinks. Will be back soon.
name: stacy

text: Shio Ramen was excellent, the broth was light, but rich enough  with a well rounded balance of saltiness .  Chashu was tender and still had a good amount of chew , flame char cut down the richness of the fatty meat and added another level of flavored . Service was prompt and kind . This place has taken a notch up on the ramen game in Philly .
name: Vinh

text: For the price I expected more than this. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The wait felt longer than it should have. Just not for me. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Had to get up early for a day of swamp and Plantation tours so we need to get breakfast early. Stanley was right down the street and opened at 7:00am which was perfect.  Was the first inside and was seated with a great view of Jackson Square. My wife and I was served quickly, our breakfast come out super fast and was delicious. We both ordered the Stanley classic or favorite, can't remember exactly what it was called but it was scrambled eggs, potatoes, bacon and toast. Everything was great but the potatoes were seasoned with something that made them amazing. Highly recommend Stanley, great service, food and the perfect location.
name: Jason

text: Sigh. I keep trying this place but I think today was the last time I'll go in. Took my favorite person out to lunch and we both got chicken. It had zero flavor and was rubbery. We didn't even eat half of our dishes. I let the wait staff know to give the kitchen a heads up and was offered a re do of the dish (um, no thanks why would I want more rubber chicken?). At least the fries were tasty but they couldn't save the meal. On the plus side, the wait staff was very nice but I'm not going back.
name: Sherri

text: The sushi here has its good and its bad days. Today was my first time returning and the staff was rude, they don't serve the salad anymore with the soup, and it took long to put our order in. The only reason I come is for the happy hour but other than that, I won't go there.
name: Leila

text: HORRIBLE service at this location.  The African American woman with short, curly hair is an absolute horror. We arrived and were treated with her attitude and utter contempt.  She sighed and rolled her eyes numerous times when we tried to ask her questions.  She intentionally repeated everything we said incorrectly and sighed like we were bothering her when we tried to clarify our order and questions.  What a miserable individual you must be to behave in such an ugly manner to people you have never met before.  Wow.  Never again.  We are visiting from out of town and this location will not have to worry about us bothering them again. Avoid this place!
name: Danielle

text:
I wish Yelp allowed me to rate food, then rate service, then ambiance... and then have a magic algorithm to score. 

I love the food here. I love the ambiance. The service though. Ouch. The staff is usually bored and preoccupied. It's like they'd rather be doing anything other than serve you. Oh, they have ignoring you down really well. 

It's a shame, because the staff does the food a great disservice.
name: Sarah

text: I never could get into the Gulch location due to the long line. The line was much shorter here, and I'm glad I finally got to experience this place. I ordered the hot chicken, which had a great flavor and was really juicy. Could have been hotter, but I'm used to Bolton's. Do yourself a favor, get the bronuts. Staff was super fast and friendly.
name: Shawn

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. A couple small things kept adding up. Probably not coming back. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: This place has perfected the Cuban, in my opinion. Get the "hand carved Cuban" and be happy you spent the few extra bucks. They've got a new creme brûlée bread pudding that is one of the best desserts I've had. If you like chocolate, try the toffee brownie! Yum!
name: K

text: We came to Solvang and stop by the beaches around and find this amazing place where the service, food and people are awesome  hope to make my next trip to try it again. Thank you guys soooooo much
name: Javier

text: Ordered delivery from this location, although I don't know why. I don't think I have ever gotten a complete and correct order from here, and this time was no exception. Everything was delivered in a timely manner, however It was missing 2 items from my order and another was done incorrectly. I guess from now on I know to stick to the good pizza places in Reno. Bummed out.
name: Chad

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: Food was rather average, cooked correctly but nothing spectacular. Service was good. Atmosphere was nice.
name: Jana

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text: I had not been to Clementines's in about 6 years and was pleasantly surprised at how much we enjoyed our experience.  Our server Gina was amazing and truly went above and beyond.  She guided us through the menu and due to the large portion sizes was able to help us make the right decisions and packaged up all our items we could not finish.  I loved the relish plate, the warm bread, the soup was delicious and the fried chicken did not disappoint.  We enjoyed our pie at home and was a nice treat!  It was just an overall wonderful experience and love to see this local business continuing to thrive.  I look forward to coming back next year on our annual vacation.
name: Joe

text: Very modern sports bar that has live music on occasion. Typical bar food nothing special there but it is good. We come here mostly for the vast beer list. Try everything! Servers are great and will take care of you.
name: Steve

text: I ordered my pizza online for carry out here. This was my first time to this pizza hut as I am not from this town. When I arrived my pizza and wings were ready. The guy that was working the front was super nice and provided the best customer service I have had in a pizza hut before. I looked at my pizza and it had two topping on each slice when I actually wanted half pepperoni and half sausage. He immediately went in the back to have another pizza re made. He also place my wings in the heater so it can stay warm while the pizza get ready. I went back to my car to wait on my pizza. He actually came out and brought my pizza to my car door. He gave me the other pizza because he said it would've gotten thrown away anyways. So I ended up leaving with two pizza and wings. I didn't get his name but his service is awesome and he is definitely making a good look for this pizza hut. He deserves great recognition from management.
name: Rochelle

text: Average food. Their honey crisp chicken salad is very strange. I honestly couldn't finish the entire thing because the dressing they use is just so gross. It would've been great had they used a different dressing or revise the one they use. I also ordered their brownie delight and holy shit it was horrible. The brownie had a strange consistency, almost like they reheated it. Basically, I didn't finish either one of my plates, nor did I request a to go box. The waitress I had was pretty nice.
name: Parisa

text:
We had European Seabass and Ono as main dishes plus a cup of seviche for lunch. Well cooked and tasty. Portion is huge to fill us up the rest of the day.  Also price was more than reasonable.  The Young waiter very attentive and polite, too.
It is A G.
We will swing by next time around.
name: Wen

text:
Whether you get meat or no meat this restaurant is delicious. Do not pass on the chocolate cake...
The owners seem to care about quality and quantity which is refreshing. They could use a little help with efficient evening waitstaff, especially when it's busy. Everyone is friendly if not quick. The pricing is fair and the food delicious.
name: Kaci

text:
Wonderful place.  Great food for a large group
 Not a long wait at all.  Eggs Benedict were amazing! Bring the whole family!
name: Frederick

text:
Great good,  bustling atmosphere,  nice wait staff.
I used the "Join Waitlist" feature on Yelp, and it shortened our wait time considerably. I was never aware of this option, but will be using it whenever offered from now on.
name: KL

text: It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Food was good and came out fast. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Came without a reservation. I live in the area so I know better. It was my niece's 11th birthday and I knew she would appreciate the view. Although they were fully committed, the layout has the bar and the cocktail lounge with seating on either side of the bar in the front end of the dining room. So even if you can't grab a table you won't feel like an outcast. The bar and both sections of the cocktail lounge are adjacent to the dining room. I had the clam chowder and a chop salad. Both were unique and different than what I expected but delightfully so, and extremely delicious. My niece had the nachos which  also wrre different than what she was assuming but very delicious. We both had fillets. Cooked to perfection at medium temperature. I skipped dessert to slurp down a third bloody Mary, while my niece enjoyed the warm vanilla cake and a decaf cappuccino. Everyone was very pleasant and full of smiles. Sarah who  took care of us was knowledgeable of the entire menu and extremely pleasant as well as overwhelmingly beautiful. Her & my niece hit it right off. I greatly appreciated her going the extra mile with my niece.  All said and done I'm glad we wound up in the cocktail lounge, in the very capable hands of Sarah and we really enjoyed this night. Thank you guys.
name: Anthony

text: Understaffed, no customer service, messy food. It's time to shut that place down. My 15 minute pie took 45 minutes for pickup.
name: Shannon

text: I used to love Barbareno, but the past few times have been highly disappointing. My husband and I recently went and had an absolutely horrible service experience (among other things, weren't checked on-he waited 20 mins before ordering another beer from the counter when we could see the waitress chatting with another employee at the other end of the bar). The tri tip was good as usual but the starters, Animal Potatoes (over dried as if they had been sitting, too hard to eat) and Brussels sprouts (wayyyy too smoky a flavor) were not super edible. I'll wait to come back until I hear the service and menu are back on point.

text:
I hate to leave a bad review but I wish I had known just HOW bad their pizza is. 

Got a simple cheese pizza because this was the only place open on a snowy night and it wasn't even edible. It took thirty minutes and was still somehow not cooked through. The sauce is flavorless and the dough is raw. The cheese floating in the boat of sauce is not melted. The crust tastes like what I imagine cardboard tastes like. There is absolutely no flavor.

Super bummed to have wasted the money here.

text: I love this place!  Come get your street taco fix!  It's fast but has incredible quality of ingredients and authentic flavors.  Pleasant atmosphere and the price is right!!!  Staff is very friendly and helpful.
name: Jodi

text: Fairly priced. Quick service. Decent cup of cold brew. Gave me light ice as requested. Kept me awake while I waited for my plane to arrive.

text: For lack of better words, this place is a complete shit show. I have never dined at the restaurant, but the bar/ nightclub is the most disorganized, poorly managed cluster fuck that I've ever seen. My friend and I were looking forward to a fun ladies night out -- not so much. There was a line about a mile long to get in to the club, but we waited patiently. After almost 30 minutes in line, one of the staff members told a large group of us at the back of the line to follow him to another entrance outside. We did so, and we weren't even halfway there when a tall, African American bouncer started yelling at us to go to the back of the line. When myself and several others told him we were just there, he said he didn't care, and he forced us to the back of the line. On the way back, we ran into the employee who told us to follow him, and I explained that we were sent back. He apologized and told us to we could go ahead in the door. At that point, another bouncer yelled at him and at all of us customers, and forced us to the back of the line yet again. At this point, my friend and I were ready to leave. We were appalled by the way the staff were yelling at each other, and yelling at us, the customers, even though we were just doing as we were told. At this point, I decided I wanted to speak with a manager, simply to report what was happening outside of the club. A few minutes later the same, tall African American bouncer who had just yelled at all of us to go back to the end of the line, approaches me and says he's a manager. I questioned him about being a manager since he had so rudely just yelled at a huge group of us to go back to the end of the line. Then this bouncer told me that he was not only a manager, but he was the owner. Um, no I don't think so. This man looked like he was the leader of a gang, and he was shaky and fired up with adrenaline like he had been using cocaine. A quick Google search later revealed that the owners of American Social are Rick Mijares and Paul Greenberg. I attempted to explain to him the situation at hand and the chaos that was happening around us with people screaming, cursing and pushing one another. But how do you explain that to someone who is a part of the problem and is lying about being both a manager and an owner of the establishment? This is the case of someone on a power trip, and most likely high on drugs, who thinks that he has the right to say and do anything he wants. I kept trying to talk to him, but he couldn't even stand still for 2 seconds to listen to me. He kept cutting me off and saying that I needed to hurry up and that he didn't have time to talk to me and that he needed to go. I asked him politely to please slow down and let me speak. He continued to interrupt me, he wasn't listening to me, and he never maintained eye contact. I realized that there was no talking to this man who couldn't even stand still. At that point, I said forget it. I believe my words were, "This place is a shit show, and I won't be back." This bouncer claimed later to the police that I touched him? I am a petite Caucasian woman who is only 5'1" and I have NEVER been in physical fight in my entire life. If I did "touch him," it must have been very fast and in an expression of anger and frustration, because I said I was leaving and walked out the door. The bouncer then grabbed me by both of my wrists and would not let me go. No one has ever grabbed me like that in my entire life. He squeezed my wrists so hard that I couldn't move at all. Today I have swelling, bruises, redness and marks on both my forearms and wrists from where he was holding me. He then marched me outside of the club and paraded me around to the crowd like I was a prize. I screamed for him to stop, but he wouldn't. I kept screaming, "please let go of me, you're hurting me," but he wouldn't let go. I was scared like I've never been scared in my entire life. I didn't know what to do. At this point I went into "fight or flight" mode and my wrists were burning like fire. I could barely move my body because he had me pinned so hard, but I tried to kick him in the legs and in the nuts so that he would loosen his grip from me." Let's not forget that I was 100% sober and had not even set foot in the club. He then paraded me around back inside and called the cops over. The cops had to tell him multiple times to let me go. I knew then and there that I had been assaulted. I gave my statement to 2 policemen, but they did not fill out any type of incident report. They also took a statement from the bouncer. I was shaking and crying and my wrists were on fire. The cops said that it was his word against mine and they didn't even offer to look at the security footage. The police told me that the witnesses both inside and outside of the venue did not matter. They also said that my friend who was with me was not a witness. I was then told that if I ever stepped foot in American Social again that I would be arrested.
name: Kim

text: I love Nashville hot chicken and Hattie B's does it right. The service and food are amazing and they make you feel at home.
name: Gus

I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Pretty happy with it overall. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.

text: They're always steady. I like it there. Maybe not my favorite but consistent, good vibe, good beer menu, food is good. No complaints.

text:
Whenever I visit a new city, I always look up the best burger in the city. This place got a decent review so I thought sure. I have lived in Reno for several years and never heard of this place.

I got the "Awesome Awesome" (because I love the "Awful Awful") and it was the greasiest burger I have ever eaten! I also love garlic fries so I got those also and it was normal fries with uncooked minced garlic on top. I had 2 fries before I threw it away. I was only able to eat half the burger (and I am a bigger dude so it was not the proportions that were the problem) because of all the grease! text: My mom and I went through the drive thru earlier this morning and asked what kind of munchins were available (not the kind we wanted) so we asked how long it would take for them to make more only to be told they don't make more during the day because the baker's apparently only work at night. Okay, fine, so we tell them nevermind and drive away. As we drive past the window, she yells out of the window "HAVE A NICE DAYYYYY" in a taunting, obnoxious tone. This was completely uncalled for and we immediately called the store to speak to a manager. Lily (the manager we spoke to) answered and obviously does not know how to handle upset customers. My mom was very upset at what happened so as she was explaining what happened, she did start raising her voice. Lily continued to talk over my mom, belittling our complaint and further upsetting my mom. When my mom asked her to stop talking over her and to actually listen to her complaint, Lily hung up on us. Completely unprofessional. You do not talk over a customer and you NEVER hang up on one. text: This place had great quality pizza and a lot of flexibility in choices. Chicken wings are super good, and I was really pleasantly surprised that, when they accidentally gave away my wings, they gave me both my original order and the mistaken order of wings. Overall, pleasant staff and great food.

text: This location is tucked in a strip mall by Sam's club on hwy 56 in Wesley Chapel. Staff was friendly whether we ordered. We ordered two items To go and it was ready in about 7 minutes and was delicious. My only complaint would be the staff were giving out new t shirts and they were literally yelling right across the restaurant at their coworkers right where I was sitting. The staff member did realize what she was doing and apologized but customer service and awareness was lacking at that moment. They have a parkimg lot that they share in the strip mall and there's additional parking in the back.

text: It looked better online than it did in person. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Probably not coming back. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better online than it did in person. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. For the price I expected more than this.

text:
This place has coffee and comics (obviously) but it also has food options, squashy couches, great music playing, and movies that show on TV screens. I think there is a ton of potential in this place but at the moment, it's a bit sparse. There are comic books and collectibles but most of the space is used for tables and the coffee bar. It's a unique idea and one that could be very successful and I I hope this spot finds its audience.

text: Wow, that was a very good Po-Boy. The PB came loaded with Beef and fixins, or as they say in New Orleans, "Dressed".  I usually like pickles when I order, "Dressed" but could have been left off by accident. Bread was ok, which most New Orleanians will tell you makes or breaks the sandwich. I am also used to sliced Beef and not chopped. Gravy was thin but made the sandwich nice and sloppy as it should have. I also had a side of Onion Rings which were very good. All in all I will definitely be back, most likely today lol. I feel you what, a 9'' Po-Boy and a side of Onion Rings for around $8.00? You can't beat it.

text: Good rice noodle soup and the quality was good as well. They were accommodating for our group of 15, granted we were the only people in the restaurant at the time.

text:
Everything I've had here has been amazing. I've been splurging since I discovered it and don't regret it one bit. It's pricey, but you are paying for quality that you taste and feel. 

I was skeptical of the food items I purchased because I've seen raw foods go very wrong, but everything exceeded my expectations. The Aztec wrap is bomb (should be a little more filled but flavor and textures are on point), the brownies (so rich and dense that a few bites are satisfying, worth the price because you can make it last), and how in the hell are the truffle kelp noodles so savory, simple, and perfect?! 

Juices, shots, and smoothies are the best I've had. I have never devoured a smoothie as quickly as I did the Bliss & Beauty one. Never! 

My wallet wants to give this place 0 stars but too bad. It's So. Good.
name: Gabrielle

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Not bad for a quick meal.
