text: Make sure to make a reservation! This place is on the smaller side; definitely has that older Louisiana vibe with antique decor. The staff is super courteous and efficient. The menu is on the smaller side of the spectrum, but it's surely for the best upon selecting. Everything had it's own unique flavor with a home made feel. We ordered the chicken gumbo, peppered gulf shrimp, brussel sprouts, and tomato bisque. Recommend it all!
name: Zechariah

text:
Man, the food here was great, our burgers perfect (spicy burger, and turkey burger) The secret sauce for the fries was bomb! 
The Service was even better. Stacy was a great host, she even helped us with trying to figure out how to get home because 80 was closed, very thankful for her.
Price seemed a little high for 2 burgers,  1 basket of fries and 2 drinks. It was almost 40 bucks, but I wasn't upset, it was a treat and I won a bet so I didn't have to pay :)

text: Love the atmosphere. Great outside area, quick bar service and great food. Perfect place to start a night on Mass Ave.
name: Kristen

text:
巨难吃 酸辣粉做的跟狗屎一样别去谢谢。 有机会去吃吃周边的新川园 川园。 
Please try new Szechuan garden&mandarin palace, downtown China pavilion and ming dynasty. You will find this place a piece of shit.

text: Today experienced another of several recent disappointing visits to our Catalina Arby's.  Ordered Cajun fish ... response "we're out of Cajun sauce".  Do you have crispy fish?   Yes ( and after you get your order and ask why there is no lettuce on the sandwich, I'll tell you we're out of lettuce.  And by the way, our crispy fish is not crispy). Came in for Cajun fish. Left with Arby's apparently new menu offering ... limp, soggy fish served plain with a dab of tartar sauce.  Hmmmm hmmmm good.
name: Grant

text: Great find in Odessa.  We sat at the bar and the Service was excellent. The food was great and many choices from quesadillas, burgers, wings....the jalapeño poppers are a must try!
name: Susan

text:
I'll start by saying they have a very reasonable happy hour, which was the reason for our visit this afternoon. We walked into the bar area and were hit with a very unpleasant odor. We sat at the bar and ordered our drinks, a margarita and a beer. The margaritas are not made to order, rather a pre-made mixture which is disappointing. We ordered our food, and while we were waiting for our food I watched in disbelief a mouse run from the dining area to behind the bar. While I am sure there are many places I dine on a regular basis that have mice here and there, I have never seen one so close to me. The bartender came out with our food and I informed her and she responded with "I will let the managers know" followed by another comment that led me to believe this is a common problem and not the first complaint. She went to the back and came back out to let us know she had reported it. No manager ever came out to apologize. My boyfriend and I were disgusted so we ate a few bites of our meals and wanted to leave. She was apologetic and probably embarrassed and it's not her fault. Having worked in the business, We should have been approached by a higher up. We then began to look around at all the other visible dirt and grime surrounding the bar, including flies and dust. We've been here several times before where they leave chips and salsa sitting behind the bar.. imagine the flies landing on them.. or the mouse that may have ran across that surface prior to their opening of the restaurant that day. Again, I understand mice happen from time to time, but to see one a few feet from me is a completely different story. We definitely will not be back until this place is cleaned up and it's a shame because the food is pretty good. 

Chef mark I noticed you responded to my review. Obviously you didn't read it. Because no manager ever came to talk to us, which I stated above. But thanks anyway.
name: Lauren

text: Hole in the wall place, but man was it tasty.  Had the gumbo with a side of red beans. To bad they only serve lunch during the week or i would be going more often. My son and the crawfish étouffée  combo. Also good flavor he said.   Will be going back to try the boiled crawfish.
name: Lyle

text:
I honestly wanted to like this place and wish them success, as I'm aware that the young couple who own this place are brand new to the business, but they really need to learn how to run a bakery, and learn that quickly, or else I'm afraid they might not stay in business very long.

All other Asian bakeries in town are located close to Asian grocery stores and restaurants. The Foundry is inconveniently located in the midst of auto repairs, small corporations, and a children hospital; their customer base (presumably Asian Americans) would need to really go out of the way to patronize them. And since they sell desserts, breads, and drinks but not lunch items like sandwiches, they are not effectively attracting workers who seek lunch in the area.

But that's not the worst part. Their bakery items are good, though not great. Tried their taro bun (above average) and pineapple shortbread (definitely made of real pineapple as I got a mouthful of chewy fibers). The milk tea tasted oily. Prices are all right. But you simply can't run a bakery with most of the shelves being empty! And I'm disregarding their absolutely chaotic opening day; I went there THREE times on that day and left empty-handed. I went there last week, which had already been several weeks since they opened, and there was still only one type of "pastry" (pineapple shortbread), two types of buns, and one loaf of bread (not one type, but one LOAF) on the shelves. I can understand the owners probably wanted to provide the freshest items to their customers, and I saw them running constantly between the counter and the ovens. And the 3 stars are for their efforts; otherwise, I would have given them just 1 star. But seriously if they don't take care of their baking capacity, I'm afraid they might not survive past next year. And I truly hope I am wrong about that.
name: S

text: Best pizza in Plant City and its not even close. Not sure how but they seem to be affiliated with palace pizza in Lakeland. I have ordered from here several times and all the various combinations of toppings have been good. You can order by slice or whole pie. My favorite is to order a margarita pizza and add sausage. They have an authentic Italian feel and im sure whoever is reading this will be more than satisfied with the pizza here. Im a big proponent of supporting local businesses so if you looking for pizza choose this one over the chain places, its fresher, tastier and your supporting a local business.
name: Ken

text:
Used to be noisy and fun counter help. Now a bit subdued with tofu always having to be cooked to order then brought to table way too hot. Was on the line before for their popular tofu type bowls.

Still a four for the food!
name: BB

text:
We came here for restaurant week and it was a little busy, so service was a bit slow which was fine. We were able to get a salad, entree, and dessert for $20.18. That's not bad at all. I had a house salad with a blue cheese vinaigrette, the Carolina trout, and a delicious key lime pie that wasn't too sweet and too tart. I also ordered escargot to try it. I was feeling pretty adventurous that evening.

Our meal came with complimentary rolls. The rolls were very good. They were slightly chewy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, like the Chinese donuts you get at the buffet or take-out. Apart from the salad for our starters, we had their escargot. 

To be honest snails have never really appealed to me. I've only had snails similar to this when I was a child and I didn't know what I was putting in my mouth. But hey, you never know if you'll like something until you try it. Honestly, it was good! The snails were served in mushroom caps, then topped with a delicious seasoned cream cheese and garlic butter. It came with some perfectly toasted crostini. I couldn't taste much of the escargot. The mushroom, garlic, and cheese overpowered it a bit, but that was completely fine, especially for someone who was pretty much eating snails for the first time. I would definitely try it again after this meal. 

The trout was a little disappointing. I wish the skin on the trout was just a little more crispy. The creamy sauce on top was good and added some flavor to the fish, but I wished they had done a little more to the fish itself to liven it up. I just wasn't that impressed with it. I found some bones in the filet as well. That's fine. I don't expect them to be able to get every bone out. I'm just glad I caught them before swallowing them. The roasted potatoes that came with it were good, but some of them were under-cooked. They were pretty much raw in the middle.

Despite a disappointing entree, the rest of our meal was good. I would go back again, I will just pass on the trout though.
name: Hong

text: To be fair, I've never ordered a sandwich from here so I'm not saying their food is bad. I stopped in because they use boars Head, which I know is a better quality lunch meat. The first time I was told $10 a pound for corned beef..ok no problem..a few weeks later it was $11 a pound..ok, I figured maybe boars Head raised their prices so mi pals upped theirs. I have no problem with that, I'll pay for good quality. A few more weeks go by, now it's $12 a pound. I don't know if the guys all make up different prices depending on who's working or if they are just trying to see what they can charge since there's no prices anywhere. It's not even like 12 is too much..that's not my issue. The issue is it's always a different price which isn't cool.
name: My

text: Gross ...Dirty inside . I ordered wings dry .The wings were the color of dirty oil with bits of other fryer foods stuck to them truly disgusting never again.
name: Dawn

text:
I've been to several La Hacienda Mexican Restaurants across the city and this location seemed to be the same as the others. Great staff, quick service, clean space, and good food. I could tell this was a popular location because it opened at 11:00 am and it was packed with the lunch crowd around 11:30 AM. We were seated immediately and the hostess brought us a small wooden bowl filled with homemade salsa and tortilla chips. 

I only order water, but my friend ordered the Strawberry Margarita. As soon as it came, I wished I had ordered one too. The drink wasn't too strong and had a good balance of flavors.

Our food came out within 10-15 min from ordering and it was hot and ready to enjoy. I had the lunch combo that included a Chicken Taco, Beef Enchilada, beans and rice for $5.95!  The only thing I did not like was that my the chicken in the taco and beef was a little salty. Maybe the cook was having a off day, but overall, I enjoyed my budget friendly meal!
name: Dinah

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: My wife and I had the best dinner there this evening. She had the chicken parmigiana, which was served on a big bed of spaghetti and was the most delicious I have ever eaten. I had the Asian chicken wings and they were super sized and had so much flavor. We will definitely be going back for more. Have to try different items on their menu, which has WAY more than pizza. The staff and owners are super friendly! Great people all around.
name: B

text: Super fresh and delicious seafood!!! This is a great place to celebrate a special occasion. Everything from the shrimp cocktail to the drinks and dessert were fantastic.
name: Danielle

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Will be back. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. For a busy night they handled it okay. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: I was very disappointed with my dining experience at shepards buffet. I liked the Cesar salad, and the prime rib. The sweet potatoes were very good too. But I went there to be able to enjoy dessert. The dessert bar was awful. Jello, cookies, etc. The carrot cake looked like it had been thrown on the plate. There was noting else!!!! And the ice cream machine was broken. Needless to say, we spent alot of money to be highly disappointed. All we heard was how goid the buffet was. Well I can tell you that when we come back again, we will not be eating at the open flame!!!!  Would like my money back!!!#

text: Snobby service and mediocre pizza. I am not keen on spending the amount of money we spent on our dinner and receiving very soggy, not very flavorful pizza. There are many other pizza options in Tucson that do pizza much better, for less money.
name: Amanda

text: A great restaurant deserves a great name. Sugarfire is both. This is the place for good tasting, fun food. There's variety here. Their great reputation is well-deserved. Don't let a long line dissuade you from getting in the queue. You'll need time to decide which terrific meal to select. And the line moves along pretty quickly.
name: John

text: Best girls, best experience, nice clean club  come here every trip. A lot of the laws in NOLA have changed and the clubs change with them. This one stays clean and delivers the best entertainment IMO.
name: Kara

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Service timing was efficient even tho it was busy. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Would return. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
I would have given five stars but on my second visit the manager made a tremendous faux pas. We ordered sushi, when the plates came out there was no wasabi and no pickle ginger. The last time I was there wasabi and pickled ginger were on the plate, this is the standard one serving sushi. When I asked why there was no wasabi or ginger, I was told the management change this to by request only.  (I know crazy, right)

I can only assume this was some type of cost savings measure. But as I stated before every restaurant that serves sushi serves it with wasabi and pickled ginger.

Unfortunately the manager was not there the evening that I went or I would have had a conversation with him. This may sound trivial, but when I go out to dinner to an ethnic restaurant there's a certain level of expectation. 

I have been a sushi lover for more than 20 years and was just in shock at the simplicity of the plate. Sushi dishes are always served with flair. So to just have a roll on a white plate was very disappointing to the eye. 

Other than that the food was good and the staff was great.
name: Maria

text: Do not go if you are in a hurry.  Decided to give it another chance, but even slower then last time.  Only one guy working behind the counter.   Food is good but wait time is horrible.
name: Matt

text:
Very cool inside!  Food was excellent. Ordered the Lamb Shank and Pork Chop. Healthy siZed servings for the price and the Brussels Appetizer and also the chicken deviled eggs were mouth watering. Hope to see this place take off. Of course the Peanut butter ball for dessert was tasty as well!

(Tip to mgmt: help the newer/younger servers practice the basics...opening a bottle of wine. We are an easy going people but our server struggled as he said it was his first bottle of wine. We had fun with it but it shouldn't be his first at a restaurant of this level.  Luckily we made some jokes about it with him and it was fun!!)
name: Edward

text: Finally, reliable Japanese food comes to the east side. This family-run restaurant serves sushi and teriyaki dishes as well as Korea offerings like Bulgogi and Bibimbap. Sushi options include California rolls, spicy tuna and spider rolls, alongside Maru specialties, like a shrimp, eel and crab-stocked sushi burrito. If you like spice, try the Baja Fresh roll with yellowtail, jalapeño, cilantro and avocado. Fresh food with friendly service in a clean, bright space formerly occupied by AMOT. I'll be back for sure.
name: John

text: First time eating here today Sunday in which the restaurant wasvti be open at noon. They were not, at 5 after they roll into parking lot saying they open at noon. Duh! I can read the sign! Crew seemed very young and not  apologetic and set us in the farthest corner, didn't ask if we'd prefer to be seated somewhere else. Had the music cranked up, had to ask it to be turned down a little. You get plates, paper tray & plastic, you must ask for, as well as salt, pepper, catsup and etc. The server was attentive to fill drinks, which was taking your plastic cup to refill it. Just seemed too pricey for the type of dinning experience.
name: Diana

text: This place is great. It's consistently good and the staff are very friendly. Overall a good time with good food. The duck rolls, Szechuan chicken and orange beef are the best!
name: Coco

text:
I used to come to Coppa before the fire when I was a young kid, but now that they have reopened I thought it would be a good idea to try it out again. My mom, dad, and I came on a weeknight after work. We were seated right away and our waitress was very nice. 1 weird thing -- the seats near the stone walls were SO COLD! There was some sort of insulation issue near the windows, and it felt like you were sitting outside. We moved to a warmer table no problem, so all was okay then.

The pasta I ordered was awesome! I got the lobster ravioli. Portion sizes were huge! I am so happy that Coppa is back to what it used to be, I will be back!
name: Elise

text: Great food! Been coming here for months.  Everything on their menu is consistently well-made & always delicious!
name: Marissa

text:
I always love to see a restaurant that is trying to use products that are antibiotic/hormone-free, organic, etc. Graze does a great job with this. My Niman Ranch burger tasted terrific, plus I always prefer brioche buns over sesame seed.

Their fries are fresh cut Kennebec potatoes, twice-fried Belgian style in non-gmo rice bran oil, seasoned with kosher salt and they were really good. I loved how they offer multiple dipping sauces, like ranch, curry ketchup and Sriracha mayo. Round out your meal with a Maine Root (organic cane sugar) soda and you're good to go. 

Definitely a good burger place find for Tucson dining!
name: Christine

text: Can't really comment on the food here. We went in and took a table. We were the only ones at a table. The two young women behind the bar pointedly ignored us and continued chatting with the 5 or 6 guys sitting at the bar. Too bad, looked like an interesting place.
name: Dick

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..

text: Nice and inexpensive. The eggplant salad is very well done. English here is tough but the kebabs are tender.

text:
The perfect place for Fish N Chips . Monday's are a deal with a BOGO for $14.99!
They have a wide selection of other great dishes too , Shepard's pie, corned beef , bangers and mash even liver & onions. 
If your not into that they offer wraps , meatloaf, pulled pork.
Happy hour is everyday EXCEPT Mondays now due to the BOGO Fish N Chips.
They also have live music but I'm sure of the schedule.
Last but not lest they offer a great beer selection!

Slainte!

text: Stopped in for a drink and was blown away with the decor. Felt like I was walking into a 1920 nightclub. Beautiful.
name: Carol

text: I stopped for a late lunch and opted for the veggie combo with a soda. The food was delicious! And yummy! And flavourful! Using the bread to scoop up the food (5 options of cabbage, collard greens, chickpeas, lentils and potatoes/carrots) was niiice. What added to this was the gentlemen that took my order, he was informative, and attentive without being intrusive. Place is a gem

text:
What can I say about this place?  They treat us well every time we are here.  We always start off with the lobster tempura appetizer.  Also ordered the calamari as per my usual at any establishment they has it on the menu.  Both were fantastic.  
  I can't remember the name of the steak I ordered.  I think it was the "Lucky Steak".  It was great.  I love this place.

text: Once again visiting NOLA and couldn't think of a better place to eat!! The food was delicious the staff is amazing and it's a must go to place for dinner!
name: KimAnn

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. Also, the leftovers held up okay the next day.. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Idk, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated because that happens a lot. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Idk, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up.
name: User

text: Ordered some take out from their website. Easy enough.  It was ready soon as I got there, 15 minutes after I ordered.  It was very hot when i got home, they use really good containers.  The sweet and sour pork was great but the fried rice was not fried rice.  The pepper steak was ok.  Very bland and the steak was watery. Not impressed and again my fried rice was just regular rice.  Way more onions than peppers or steak.  All in all i enjoyed the food but will probably try someplace else next time.  Really picky about my peppersteak and rice lol

text: Food was okay, but two of the three of us got sick and vomited after eating here. Not fun
name: J

text: had brunch here over the weekend and it was kind of a mixed bag. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. A very pleasant experience. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: I just had dinner at the tasteful kitchen for the first time. I had driven past this restaurant several times in the past and always meant to try it and finally went for tonight after doing one of those New Year's cleanses. When I looked at the menu I was a little suspicious, wondering whether there was going to be anything that I liked. It turned out that I liked everything. We got the sushi, the miso eggplant, the green chili polenta, and the Portabella mushroom steak.  Everything was fantastic. Also, the decor was very pleasant and the music was great... My hipster son and his friend were Shazam and all of the music they were playing and it was just great. To top it all off, the service was impeccable. Everyone who works there is just so incredibly nice. I cannot recommend this restaurant highly enough.
name: Charlie

text: The Seminole Hardrock is coming together nicely. I dig coming outbtoeat in any of their restaurants . Thanks guys
name: Jay

text:
Wow! This is the location of the former Europa Restaurant. ( and a few other names and owners before that)

Globe... now open. Well let me try this diner dive again. The moment I walked in ...WOW.... a total gut remodel. New floors, new ceiling, new booths, new tables , new chairs..... new counter, new bathrooms, new everything down to the plates, cups and silverware. 

Then dressed impeccably in slacks and a white polo, a smiling man greets me and extends his hand. Its Nick, from one of my former favorite restaurants. He had sold it about 4 years ago and retired. He informed me he got tired of being retired and decided to return to his love and passion of running his restaurant.

The waitstaff gals were on top of things and he has a really good cook. My simple breakfast delicious. I am confident this new place will do well. 
My only critique is the name... Globe? Neptune, Saturn, or Blue Moon Cafe.... ( Nicks old restaurant was named Venus )
name: Kc

text: Nice selection of delicious food. Perfect portions for us. We had unique cocktails and good wine. Staff was very nice and informative. Service was good after a start that tried to rush us into ordering.the main courses looked good but we are three appetizers each, and every one of them was delicious and beautifully prepared.
name: J

text:
You get what you pay for.

Great deals. Service is nice but horribly slow. Food is low grade which is understandable for the price.

Silverware, tables, menus all dirty. I'm sure it is hard with some of the patrons that come in here. 

If you're on Yelp, you probably care just enough to be aware of these things. So, try somewhere a little higher priced if you dont want to be disappointed. 

Overall. Is what it is, cheap.
name: Hungr

text: My only problem is that I got to go m the way to Tampa for this , can we sign this petition and bring you guys to Miami already .the food is too great  and yet so simple .
name: Carl-Frederick

text: This place is amazing. We flew in from Chicago for the weekend. The best Bloody Marys I've ever had. Very friendly waitstaff. Lisa took very good care of us both times we visited. We happened upon it on Friday, and we loved it so much we came back Saturday morning. Get the Shrimp and Grits, you will not regret your decision. Daisy Dukes has definitely made our trip to NOLA unforgettable.
name: Steven

text: Worst service ever. We had to wait 30 minutes just before we ordered our drinks, then the drinks took another thirty minutes so we didn't get get drinks until an hour in. At that point we finally ordered our food and then had to wait another 45 just to get food. Worst service in the world. Make sure to avoid this place.
name: Golf

text: Finally got to Hopskeller. This place is awesome. Their beers are the real deal. Really good diverse flavors. And their pizza is the bomb! Staff are so fun (and patient- it took us a while to get our sampler chosen and they were very helpful). We shared a sampler and midnight rambler. Sooo good.
name: Susan

text:
What a great place.
Super cool place and interesting and unique menu.
I has Rubenesque Egg Rolls for an app and they were so amazing I can not do them justice speaking of them. Dressing was just as incredible. 
Had a bacon cheddar burger and it was delicious. 

If you're considering stopping in, do it.
Its fantastic.
name: Sebastian

text: Awesome chicken, really liked the choices for sides. The restaurant was cool, staff was friendly and fast. Very casual feel which is nice. Very good value for what you pay. Will be returning.
name: Justin

text: Our waitress Diane went out of her way to care for my family - we were four people and a very large stroller. Diane had a section completely rearranged to accommodate us and keep the baby out of the way of traffic and safe. She was the fastest waitress, friendly, and just extraordinarily happy and truly cared for her customers. The food was great but we'll go back and only sit in Diane's section!
name: Kat

text:
Ya'll are overly harsh on this place. Its a nice casino that is clean and not too smoky (sugarhouse is much dirtier and has a ton more smoke). Good food options, and they have a beverage area where you can get your own soda/water. 

Lots of slots and a fair amount of table games. 

Parking is adequate.

Every time ive been the dealers and pit bosses have been very friendly. Make sure you get the rewards card!
name: Tiger

text:
I live in the area so I'm super skeptical about the peddlers village tourist restaurants. Years ago i ate at earls before I lived nearby and it was pretty average. 

Tonight at the peak of Christmas shopping ons. Saturday night we decided for some reason we wanted to go out to peddlers village to eat and i thought of earls. Well the food was pretty damn delicious. I had a pork chop that might have been one of the best I've ever had. Came with polenta and you could tell they cooked that for a long time to coax out the corn flavor. My wife's dish of short rib was equally good.

Might have to come back here and grab some more food soon.
name: David

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The food was good and the service was easygoing. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text: This is one of the best places to get food after 12 PM. The service is great and the food is more than most can handle. The serving sizes are very great and can take care of almost anyone's appetite. I got a banana shake and a chicken Gyro with fries that were cooked to perfection.
name: Bryan

text: This is the best poke place! Always fresh and delicious. I go there about once a week! The one thing they're missing is a loyalty program, everyone would seriously love that!!
name: Rachel

text:
Amazing customer service and such DELICIOUS food! A family hit and a perfect place to go after finishing our swim lessons!

Be sure to let the amazing staff help you pick the perfect meal and drink combination for your preferences!
name: Lisa

text: We should have heeded the warning on the door... Help Wanted. They were quick with the drinks, but took forever to get the food. They brought my husband's food out first and asked me what I had ordered. By the time my husband was about finished eating they told me mine would be right out. About 15 minutes later my food was served, long after my husband had finished eating and our drinks were empty. What they brought me didn't even match what the menu said. Won't be going back.
name: Amber

text: Food was good as hell. Catfish and shrimp. Boneless bbq wings, chicken strips and bone in wings. Really big order. Very foodie energy. Will eat here as often as I could. Visiting from California.
name: Shamron

text: This was my first time in a Mission and it was a great experience! The young kid that took our order was incredibly nice, polite and respectful ! Some places you go I'm not so sure the business realizes just how important that can be with customers!!! I had the pulled chicken sandwich and my only complaint was the chicken was barely room temperature. Not sure if this is how they serve the chicken or it just needed a coat to keep warm!! Other than that it was a good sandwich! Had the cold slaw as a side and it was good! The Smoky Mountain sauce was my favorite and Texas Twang was a close second! My daughter had the mac n cheese with a side of fries which was also very good! Dip the fries in your fav sauce for a potato party in your mouth!!! The place was clean and had a nice friendly vibe! Most important... they support our veterans, the men and women that make a true life sacrifice for our freedom!!!!
name: Joseph

text: We came in this evening and sat at the bar. After 15 minutes of waiting we finally got our drinks, one was incorrect. A waitress passing by got us chips and salsa after we asked. We never got the queso we ordered. The restaurant was busy but service was terrible nonetheless. We won't be back.
name: Sydney

text: It looked better online than it did in person. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Not bad for a quick meal. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos.
name: User

text: Ordered delivery tonight, and the delivery itself was on time and very friendly. The food is middling - not bad ... just not really that good either. Pad Kee Mao tasted fine, but missing lime wedge and was overall a messily done dish with one unrequested shrimp and very little basil or peppers. The stuffed tofu was in a pool of its own water. The pineapple smoothie was yummy though. Would I order from here again? Meh.
name: Julianne

text:
We kicked off our meal with the mix of spicy pig ears and beef tendons. Both were so delicious and packed with flavors! However, I did prefer the pig ears since they had more of a crunch from the cartilage. They were super greasy though and can be overwhelming even when eaten with the pickled vegetables. Highly recommend sharing if possible. 

As for the noodle soups, the hand drawn noodles had a nice chew. The toppings were tender and flavor. Although the other aspects of the noodle soups were good, the broth, which should be as much of a star, was a little lacking in flavor for my taste. We also found out that the broths in both sliced intestine noodle soup and lamb noodle soup were the identical.  

Cash or venmo only!
name: Yiwen

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The wait felt longer than it should have. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Maybe other people have better luck here. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Food was good and came out fast. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I'd maybe go back, but I'd order differently next time. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text:
Stopped in because we were close and the reviews were positive but our experience wasn't as such.  The server seemed annoyed that we were there and the salsa was a weird consistency.
Our mains were alright, nothing outstanding, but overall good.
Just expected a little more.
name: Kelly

text: My favorite place when I need a healthy dish or not feeling well. Everything is always fresh and full of flavor. My go-to is the bone broth and lemongrass chicken noodle bowl. My order always comes out fast and with a friendly face. There is indoor and outdoor seating so plenty of room to spread out. Haven't wanted to try another Vietnamese place since I've had Vui's.
name: Rachael

text: Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The food was good and the service was easygoing. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Will be back. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text:
My husband and I just had a breakfast sandwich - the egg was burnt , there was very little meat and only a half piece of cheese. I nicely brought this to the managers attention, he was nice and  offered to make a new one. I didn't want my money back nor a new one. The cook just needs to be a better cook and stop sacrificing taste and quality. 
Oh and the coffee pots were empty as well as the store. 
Awful tasteless breakfast
name: N

text: Sam the cook here is AWESOME!!!!!!  Loved this place & the atmosphere.   Best Cole slaw I have had since my grandmother's 30 years ago.  Shrimp platter & cat fish platters were great!!!  seasoned perfect and huge platters.  Hush puppies were definitely home made & fresh & hot.
name: Elizabeth

text: The vibe is modern. Good service, comfortable booth. Our table had steaks, seafood, the Asian salad, and a burger - all great.  Reasonable prices. Varied menu - something for everyone.  I think this is a real contender in the boise steakhouse scene and we will definitely be back.
name: Lee

text: Used Grub Hub to order Crab Rangoon, two sushi rolls and one special roll. Food was fantastic! Prices reasonable and staff was friendly.
name: T

text: Did not even get in the door. Made my friend dump her water that she's carrying around because it's 100 degrees out. Told me I could not come in because I had a backpack. It's a small backpack that's a purse. Needless to say, won't ever go to this damn place. No loss, plenty of other better places to go in this fine town that are okay with water bottles and backpacks.
name: Traci

text: Awesome dinner!!  Charbroiled oysters and Redfish Pontchartrain were fantastic!  Great service and a fantastic meal!
name: Miles

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was fresh and service was quick. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text:
A young lady came into where I work quite a few months back with samples from here. I  am not a fan of bbq or smoked things but my husband is so I took the samples home. We both actually liked the pork and he liked the bbq sauce. We drive past here everytime we go to Olive Garden or Outback and tonight Olive Garden was packed so we ended up here. 

Located in what was built as a DQ not very long ago. Really surprised the DQ didn't make it. Interior is nice enough although they could use a breeze way so cold air doesn't come rushing in every time the door is open. When we pulled in the parking lot an elderly couple was just going inside and I could see the bored staff standing and watching the football game. There were zero tables seated except for I'm guessing manager / owner at a table on his laptop. 

I ordered the Brady Bacon Burger minus the slaw and aioli on the side with fries . My husband ordered choose 3 with pulled pork, chicken and brisket with mashed potatoes and fries. 

The Brady Burger was very thin yet very dense and dry. It seemed to be a frozen processd patty with quite possibly fake grill marks. The burger itself was not good but the pork and bacon was. The French fries were quite good. The pork on my husband's plate was the same so it was good. The brisket was quite good as well as the chicken. The mashed potatoes were a big dry lump which is disappointing because I love mashed potatoes.

Based on tonight I'm not sure I'd be willing to go back. But if hubby want to I'd find something to eat even if if were just the fries.
name: Phil

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. For a busy night they handled it okay. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell.
name: User

text: I have been here several times and I'm not sure what has taken me so long to write a review! I absolutely love this place. Always fresh ingredients. Staff is always pleasant, it's definitely the best Pho in Clearwater. I have tried several things off of there menu, but the Pho is definitely my fave. Always flavor. You get a nice amount of food for the price. However, if your not into Pho they also offer other great selections like Bahn Mi (so fresh), Teriyaki Bowls and much more! Oh! They also have really tasty boba selections and teas :) I love this place.
name: Sabrina

text:
The Butcher & Bee was a surprising delight.  While it had good overall ratings, it was better than I expected to be and would highly recommend it for those in town or visiting Nashville. 

Highlights:

-Whipped Feta with fermented honey - delicious and came recommended
-Avacado Crispy Rice - Not like anything I have had, soft and crunch and very tasty
-Blistered Shishitos - Very good with cherry blossom sauce
-Grilled baby Eggplant - again, I have had eggplant many times but this presentation with the baby eggplant plus the cherries was very interesting, different, and delicious
-Braised Giffords Bacon - Nice piece of pork belly over handmade pea cavatelli
-Turnips - Is this a Turnip or is it pasta?  Holy cow this was great.  I didn't know you could make a turnip act like pasta and the almond pesto finished it nicely
-Nutjob - I loved this cocktail and would drink it all night

I would highly recommend it.
name: Ryan

text: Came to New Orleans from California. After a long night of drinking Pho is a must. Stumbled upon Lilly's and hands down the best Pho I've ever had. Best broth, egg rolls tasted homemade. I wish I could bottle this up and take this joint back to Cali with me. Do not go home without coming here.
name: Augustine

text: They have excellent food.great service. Best French toast around. Convent located .... All i can say is there food is really good and you get alot of it.
name: Debbie

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: My husband and I really wanted some good chicken wings tonight so we turned to our trusty yelp reviews and hit the jackpot with this one. It's a little far from our house but the drive was worth it! We started with mozzarella sticks which honestly were not anything special but I was starving so we ate them. We ordered a Greek salad to share plus a mini fried pizza and wings. The Greek salad was so fresh, lettuce was crisp and the dressing we good too. (I feel like most bars done have a fresh salad like this!). Let's go back to the pizza- yes I said fried pizza! It's an 8' "personal pan" size and we got the meatball and ricotta toppings. It was crispy and delicious! The crust almost melts in your mouth. Finally the wings... they are large wings that are fried, tossed in your sauce (they have about 7-10 to choose from I believe, we got medium bc that's just what I like) and then they are flame broiled. They are juicy and tender and just amazing and the sauce was a perfect medium. OH! And their blue cheese is made in house and it shows. Great atmosphere, we loved the travel theme! We'll certainly be back!
name: Brittany

text: Nice restaurant with plenty of parking. Ordered sushi deluxe, which comes with soup and salad, and mixes of sushis from the menu. Very decent quality and very reasonable prices. Definitely will come back and visit in the future.
name: Thomas

text: This place shall be my go-to sushi place. The sushi is so flavorful and even when sitting at a table with friends, the sushi has arrived accordingly and the presentation for the sushi was phenomenal. I love the service there too. They were attentive and treat you like family. Will go there again.
name: Gisela

text: The soup wasn't as flavorful as other places I've been before (Ippudo for example), also way too salty. I had to chuck my green tea after a couple bites. Noodles and the other sides were decent.
name: Niki

text: This place is awesome for a night out in the summer. The most beautiful views of the city are on this rooftop. It looks very deceiving from the outside that you are entering into a school, but it works for their secret bar vibe. I will be back when it gets warm again!
name: Elise

text: Great atmosphere! Trent, our server, was personable and sweet. He gave great recommendations and knew the food really well.
name: Camry

text: Had read that there were some excellent Italian restaurants in St. Louis, so decided to stop into Cunetto's House of Pasta. Real down home Italian restaurant and family operated so I knew it had to be good, and it was. Ordered the Vitello con Granchio (veal topped with crab and cheese sauce) with a side of Cavatelli con Broccoli (noodles with mushrooms, broccoli I  a cream sauce). Was so good and definitely worth the trip.
name: Barry

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Anyway, the host got us seated quickly, which i appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Idk, nothing was awful but i left disappointed. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. maybe I just came on an off day.
name: User

text: We were visiting our family in Nashville and dined here our last night.The care with which our dishes were presented and delivered was far more than I expected. Chef Matt served us personally and made the experience all that more enjoyable. Each dish was interesting and thoughtful, my favorite was the Day-After Fried Rice with pine nuts, currants and fried bits of beef that made it rich and flavorful. Also noteworthy was the Fish & Chips. Fish was battered and fried to perfection and "chip" was perfectly crisped. And, of course, we tried all the desserts that the pastry chef had to offer (shared). The Fluffernutter Sunday had so many rich but not too sweet flavors of salted peanut ice cream, a brownie, raspberry fudge and marshmallow cream. I think my favorite, although all pretty much tied for first place, was the Melon Panna Cotta with cantaloupe ice cream. But be sure to try the Buttermilk Chess Pie with sweet corn ice cream and the Hazelnut Cream Puff, the most decadent by far. This was a fabulous end to our visit to Nashville and I will definitely return on our next trip.
name: Anne

text: They aren't the friendliest so be prepared but they have killer crispy chicken tacos! Best I've ever had. Put your feelings aside and try it!
name: Andew

text: OBSESSED! Great service, great food and awesome bottomless mimosas!!!!! This was a little gem that we found walking for brunch!!! The manager Sunshine was the sweetest, and absolutely took care of us! COME HERE!!
name: Brande

text: Great value. Great view. Excellent food and outstanding service. Our server, Anthony, was unbelievably good! There were 15 people in our party and our orders were taken promptly and delivered promptly. Excellent attention to detail. Great place for a couple people to go for dinner - and an excellent place for scheduling your large group functions. Everybody raved about Anthony - thanks bud!
name: Robert

text: Great food and fantastic service !! Nick was our waiter several of the times we were there. You would never imagine how good it is from first appearance of building.
name: Gregory

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. For a busy night they handled it okay. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I prob wouldn't get again.
name: User

text: Newer building right next to a bunch of hotels in an office park. Easy access. Lots of space to park or run through the drive thru. Clean for a McDonalds. Food is hot. Ordered a variety of items for my family for breakfast and everyone was satisfied. I enjoyed a bacon, egg, and cheese biscuit. The coffee tastes great. It's a light roast and reasonably priced. Great service.
name: Drew

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. I left full, which at least counts for something. It looked better online than it did in person. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: We came here for brunch on a Sunday. The atmosphere is adorable. It's cozy but now crowded and noisy but not loud. You go up to the counter to order your food and then they bring it to your table. The food is simple but still inventive. We all enjoyed our meals and can't wait to return.
name: Rebecca

text:
Finally stopped in here after a year of
'We need to stop'.... BEST daiquiris I've ever had - anywhere. Friendly staff / owner, inexpensive and delicious drinks...haven't tried the food - yet, but I will next time I'm in - next week!
name: Stephanie

text:
Nice newer place to get pizza.  I like how they cut the pizza from the center on a square pizza.  If cut traditional, the center slices would have no crust.

I don't know if they have a deep dish or thicker crust.  If they do, I will try next time.  If not, I suggest adding that to your menu.
name: Steve

text:
My wife and I have lived in Oro Valley for 23 years and have seen restaurants come and go. We're hoping Just Kabab stays around for many years!!!
This was our first visit. The food was excellent and with a variety of choices it made our experience very pleasurable. The Baba Ghanoush was absolutely the best that I have ever had. The flavors and the texture were incredible. Also the Falafel was a perfect crispiness and rich with just the right flavors.
The picture menu on the wall was a nice touch to help us decide what entree we wanted.
We were greeted by the co-owner and she was very engaging and helpful. Her husband (co-owner and cook) came out and talked to us a couple of times. It was great to see his passion for food and cooking and the desire to have success with the restaurant. We liked that their kids were in the restaurant - a nice family atmosphere. We will absolutely come back to try other dishes and to support this families dreams!
name: Mike

text: Hear me out! This place is a HIDDEN GEM!!! Free sample of Brisket on your first visit and creative daily specials. Best Brisket I've ever tasted.
name: Bryan

text:
This is the best Chinese food in Nashville. This place is a hidden gem. It is seriously hard to find good Chinese food in Nashville, so if you are looking this is it.

My order rarely varies so it's usually beef fried rice, crab rangoons, egg rolls, and wonton soup. It is so good every single time. I usually do Uber eats so I can enjoy this feast from my couch and it's quick and easy.
name: Elizabeth

text:
This is one of my boyfriend's favorite lunch spots, but I can never make it to the city before it closes. Finally, we came here over the weekend so I could see what all the fuss was about. I've been to Zahav and know how smooth and creamy the Solomonov hummus is, but I was excited to try it with toppings and such. 

Just my luck, I saw the green bean hummus on the menu as they were sold out and taking it down from the menu! I settled for the beet hummus while my boyfriend went for the beef, a favorite of his. Had I know the plates came with a beet hummus perhaps I would have tried something else. It was still delicious nonetheless. The dip was served with roasted golden beets on top that was very sweet and delicious. His tip: ask for condiments; they have harissa and other spices. 

I opted for cucumber slices instead of pita to be healthy, and every single slice was so crispy! I tried a piece of my boyfriend's pita, and boy are they fluffy.  The beet salad that it comes with is pickled and funky but also good. He said sometimes there is a cucumber salad on the side, which I would definitely be more interested in. 

Some other of his favorites are lamb, Brussels sprouts, and long hots. I love that even though it's "just hummus" there's a menu that is constantly changing. Who knew it could be so exciting!? We also want to come back and try the shakshuka for brunch on the weekend. Plus, something about a chicken dinner?
name: Victoria

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. The staff seemed tired but still polite. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The music was louder than it needed to be. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text:
TWO THINGS: best SHRIMP N GRITS I've ever had (I live in TX) and best PECAN PIE I've ever had (literally melts in your mouth). 


That is all!!!!
name: Aida

text: This place is fabulous, went for the first time and I will be back. It's not easy to find nestled in a plaza off Lumsden and King in Brandon. I ordered the special "Filet La Septima, it was a steak dish which is pounded flat and breaded grilled and served with an awesome compound butter sauce, served with over the top roasted garlic green beans and a decadent yellow rice. I started with a mixed green salad with house made bleu cheese dressing. The menu has a wide assortment of dishes for everyone. For dessert I had the flan, a creamy creation served with a delectable sugary caramel sauce.
name: Claude

text: Every time I come here I like to get the Montecito Burger. It's really good and I love how 'stacked' it is. I also like how the fries are prepared pretty crispy; the ranch is also super delicious too. The burger patty itself was alright, I wish it was a bit juicier had a little more flavor, but it's okay because the other aspects in the burger compensated for that. Would recommend!
name: Tam

text:
Don't believe the haters for a second: Carmen's greasy cheese bomb sandwiches are the quintessential reason you came to Philly in the first place you dingus!

The 1 hour wait is worth it | there I said it.

 Bonus: the super stereotypical sarcastic Irish Philly dude working the grill station is the @#$% man!
name: Christopher

text: Legit. Such a fun time and show. Don't let the price sway you from enjoying dinner here, it's sooooo much food!! Totally worth it. The food is delicious, the chef is fun and waitress friendly. My only complaint and the reason I'm giving 4 stars instead of five is that most of the food is way, way too salty. The chef just added too much sauce and too much salt, especially on the shrimp appetizer. The taste was still wonderful. The fried rice is the best I've ever had. I highly recommend this place especially for a special night on the town.
name: Angelina

text: Very nice place. Inside and outside service.  To go too. Seating for 22 inside so it is small. But the food is fresh and tasty. Certainly a great place for lunch but they serve breakfast too. They have lunch specials.  If you like BLT, theirs is the best!
name: Dwight

text: This place was recommended to me by a friend. Didn't realize it was so close to my standard haunts here in East Nashville. Had the breakfast sandwich with avocado and man it is DELICIOUS! Ordered with avocado for extra but it was worth it. Cool, cozy travel themed atmosphere, staff was really friendly and great food. What more could you ask for? Looking forward to my next visit!
name: Sean

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Worth checking out. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text: Magnicficet service! Food is way under priced, to our advantage (Which is fine)  accommodating schedule and see most of the neighborhood in for dinner with the family and friends! Beyond impressed given what the short time they've be open! Will be back with family and friends! Fabulous job, Del Pietro's
name: Ashley

text: I love Mr Wish because I'm from Taiwan and always am a fan of Mr. Wish. With that being said, giving a three stars is hard for me. I was so excited to drive 45 min to get Mr. Wish. I always order pearl milk tea with latte milk, not the cream powder. Every bubble tea shop I've been to always is able to adjust based on my need. The lady?that was taking my order, apparently it's the manager told me they cannot add milk to black tea to make it latte milk based milk tea. If I want whole milk, I will have to order the red bean milk or just boba with milk, basically only milk with topping, no tea. I explained to her I want tea and milk, if she can just do that for me. She said no, with no explanation. She was the worst! I was so frustrated, if y'all have tea and milk why not just add a bit of milk for me. I ended up ordering black tea with boba. After I finally got my order, just to find that she put the wrong order for me. She put in lemon black tea. It was very annoying, but at that point I was irritated enough I just grabbed the tea and left. Terrible customer service from her. Boba was good tho
name: Lily

text: Mess up your order twice in one evening, that sucks!  Busy Friday evening for them, people picking up their orders one right after the other.  But as they say if you can't stand the heat get out of the 'pizza' kitchen.  I'll forgive one screw up, things happen, but when the order is triple sauce and you miss it the second time too that's too much.  You should have checked the order 3 times to make sure you didn't screw things up again but apparently you didn't.  Love their deep dish but this experience has got me looking elsewhere for my pizza cravings.  Wasn't sure why the bad rating in Yelp before this but now it's making sense.  You might get busy on Friday evenings, pick up your game Jet's.  There certainly didn't seem to be a shortage of workers just a shortage of customer care yesterday.  Gave me free wings for the screw up, I didn't order wings, the pizza should have been free after the mistake.
name: Al

text:
This was the best Chinese I've had in quite a while. Forget the buffet stereotype here because the quality is just excellent.
The shrimp Mei Fun, teriyaki beef, and pork fried rice are beyond words can describe as far as tasteful and not found at any other buffet I've visited (and I've been to A LOT around the US and Canada). I sampled several other items and the only one not finished was the ice cream.
Under $15 with a Coke and I left with a smile.
name: Tim

text:
As far as Burger Kings go this one isn't bad. I ordered in to try the Impossible Meatless Whopper and the restaurant itself was newly renovated, very clean, and even had free WiFi. The staff was also very friendly and accommodating. Note however that they don't honor any coupons from the BK app as they don't accept "corporate promotions."

There's a Coke freestyle machine inside and it was pretty busy both for the drive through and dine in lines during the lunch rush so you know the food you're getting is fresh.
name: Jonathan

text: We love this place and especially our boy Jake !! His family owns and runs it. The best food ever. Omelette perfection!!!
name: Rob

text: Such a wonderful place to have breakfast at, It was really amazing to have a relaxing Saturday breakfast with all worries aside, I got myself a Breakfast bowl, It has all the nutrition and the way Sourdough bread bowl was filled with lots of different variety of protein was so mesmerizing, Nothing can beat their pancakes as they are the fluffiest and tasty to have. Will surely make my visit again with friends and family to have a little Funtime
name: Lauren

text: Visiting from Cali and had to try some local Q and wasn't disappointed! Long lines generally mean good food and this was definitely the case. Awesome ribs, brisket, pork, and wings plus killer live music with some tasty local IPAS  to sip while enjoying the local scene! Tons of super cool nostalgia on the walls, great service, Martin's will not disappoint!
name: Dennis

text: The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Will be back. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.

text: First timer here. I told this lovely staff lady that it was our first time here and she was more than happy to walk it through for us. Major points for that. I ordered the XXL pulled pork sandwich which was delicious. Mac and cheese with Green beans and a sweet tea. The sweet tea was lovely and the Mac n cheese was so good my son stole mine and said it was the bEST! I would argue that my green bean were the best! They were like my Great Grandmother's recipe from Wheeling WV. The best southern green bean ever. . My husband ordered a chicken pulled and a really good potato salad. He also liked the choices of sauces on the table and the sweet tea. My daughter got the baby back ribs which she loved and bbq beans and cornbread. The loss of the fifth star was for those sides. Your baked beans needed brown sugar or molasses and your cornbread was dry and needed more buttermilk or butter. My son had Mac n cheese and ribs and said he loved it and wanted to live here. My husband said to tell the restaurant I would give them a fifth star. If my brothers entry for the smoker wins lol. Great idea for a Father's Day entry.

text:
Popped in for another weekend happy hour last weekend. Food and drink was solid again (lamb burger needed texture ... it was a flavorful but mushy experience, finally tried the French onion soup and that was so good my partner had to order his own bowl because splitting was no longer an option... pretty sure the cocktail special never changes or at least not on Saturdays) but I could have done without the miserable bartender/manager woman in my life and so I still can't give this place a 5 star rating. 

Sitting at the end of the bar, you hear a lot of the employee conversations and I have been a server and hostess myself (albeit a decade ago) so I am not averse to the usual complaining about the rush or some weird patron's request. But everything out of this woman's mouth was a complaint or a barked order to someone else and that's not the bartender vibe I want in my life. Maybe she was having a bad night because of the Hamilton crowd (UGH, THE HAMILTON CROWD *shakes fist*) but if I walked in and saw her alone behind the bar I would probably walk out and go somewhere else.

Super nice people at Xpress Pizza and Subs and their quality and taste of food matches their wonderful personalities.

text:
Bemiston Cocktail Club is exactly what its name says, a cocktail club. There are no bells and whistles. It's a just a great place to go and enjoy an amazing, masterfully made cocktail. 

It's a simple little bar tucked away down a long hallway. There's no table service. You order your cocktails at the bar and then select your table. When your cocktails are ready they'll set them at the end of the bar for you to retrieve. Eliminating the server is reflected in the price. The prices here are much lower then some of the more popular bars in the STL area.

I am a lover of the "classics". By that I mean, I love the classic cocktails. You know what I'm talking about. Give me a Manhattan, Old Fashioned and a Dirty Martini and I'm a happy boozer. During this visit I truly enjoyed a masterfully made, Old Fashioned. When I was ready for a second one, I was torn. I didn't know if I should go with a Manhattan or try their Dirty Martini. After chatting with the bartender, I knew it had to be the Dirty. He informed me, the Dirty Martini was one of their most popular. It was so popular, that they made them by the pitcher to keep up with the demand. 

BBC's focus is cocktails. They have a very limited menu, but it offers just enough to have a nosh to accompany your cocktails. I choose the, Fried's. It was a basket of tater tots and onion rings with two dipping sauces. Tasty tots, but my rings were a little overdone. However, I did enjoy both dipping sauces. Good nosh, but on the next visit I'm going for the Nacho Popcorn. 

If your group is small and you can sit at the bar (limited sitting), I highly recommend it. I did and I enjoyed chatting with the bartenders. I also enjoyed watching them make all the other cocktails. It was like a floor show. 

I'll be back? - Hell, YES!

Why: Needed a cocktail.

text:
There's a rumour that royal pizza has a spaghetti pizza, so when my kids got to pick the food option and chose pizza; this was a clear winner since it was close by and has the option for dine-in. The interior reminds me of a small mom & pop kinda venue. Simple, clean, a few TVs and small pictures of neighbourhood areas that my kids recognize...think of it as a small town restaurant. It's very family friendly, offering high chairs & having a change table. There's also coat hangers at the end of the booth tables. It's fairly quiet inside, but with steady amount of customers. 
Wait time for food is average, service isn't overly attentive, but it's friendly. 
We ordered a medium spaghetti pizza and it fed 1 adult and 2 kids with a few slices leftover. I have to say that both my kids really liked that pizza, I've never seen them eat that many slices and finish it in one sitting. At the end of the meal, kids are allowed to choose a small prize in a treasure chest that the server brings while you pay the bill; cheap dollar goodies, but a very special moment for the kids and I'm glad we tried this place out. I'll probably be ordering takeout for spaghetti pizza in future since it was such a big hit for the kids.

text:
Merchants is in a great location on broadway next to all of the honkey tonks. While you can watch the chaos around you, the restaurant blocks out the loud music from outside and allows you to focus on your meal and company. Also, because of its location, this is a great place for tourists or to take out of town guests, but ubering is your best bet since parking is expensive downtown. 

We started with the deviled eggs which were awesome! The drink we ordered was a small pour for the price, though I guess that's broadway for you. The pulled pork sandwich was a bit dry and needed some extra bbq sauce on the side. Though the show string onions on the bbq pork is what really appealed to me. The burger and chicken sandwich were average and nothing to write home about. The sweet potato fries were the real show stopper, I recommend them with a side of ranch. Mmm! Overall, the food was tasty and reasonably priced, but not somewhere I'd rush back to unless I already happened to be on broadway.

text: I have gone to this hospital MULTIPLE times.  All three of my kids were born here and I had 3 miscarriages here.  I was naive with my first miscarriage and didn't know what to expect.  They never did a hemoglobin test to see if I had lost too much blood.  I ended up anemic and with Sheehan's syndrome years later.  My last birth was by C-section, which got infected.  I presented years later in the ER with extreme cold, shaking, nausea, and confusion.  They accused me of being drunk!  FINALLY, they did blood work and found hypothyroidism.  Had they looked further, they would have found I was in Adrenal Crisis from the Sheehan's syndrome they did nothing to prevent!  I am lucky they didn't kill me!  It took them 45 minutes to get over their belief I was drunk, realize mercury thermometers don't have batteries, and that I had lost my core body temperature beyond the thermometer's ability to measure it.  Don't torture yourself, don't go there, if you must, you are better off dying on the street.
name: Vicki

text: Came in for lunch with a large group (parents/teenagers) and we were seated at two tables across from each other. No split checks for families & two different servers (not at all convenient!) - we did our best to tip well, but they sure didn't make it easy on us! Bloody Mary was good & pretty spicy. Flat Bread had SO much garlic on it, it was almost inedible. Caesar Salad (w a twist) is good. I sampled a friend's Hot-N-Spicy pasta and it was very tasty and very spicy.

My husband ordered croissant with eggs, I had the shrimp tacos and kids had grilled cheese. Each was solid, classic foods- very well-made, flavorful and each was open to modifications. I absolutely will be back..

text:
Possibly the best meal I've ever had in New Orleans. I'm not sure if my experience was unique (given some of the grumpier reviews) but it could not have gone better. 

Since other reviews had mentioned issues getting a table, I made sure to make a reservation a couple days ahead. No big deal - a quick phone call with a friendly woman. Done son.

As soon as we arrived we were greeted and seated (my husband and I). Then another friendly woman came over with menus and offered us waters. A couple minutes after looking over the menu our waitress, Gabriella, greeted us. She was absolutely wonderful and attentive through out. Our water glasses never got below a couple sips and we never had to seek her out for anything. She easily transitioned between Spanish (for my husband) and English for me (my Spanish is only so-so) to make sure that everyone was comfortable and everything was understood. 

The decor is really beautiful, the music excellent, the atmosphere upbeat but relaxed. 

We both ordered mojitos and they were so fresh and delicious - again possibly the best mojitos I've had and I've had quite a few. 

To start we had the Mais de la rueda and the Yuca Frita. Each dish came out individually, with a little time in between, which is exactly as it should be. If you want the Chili's experience of a table filled with your apps and entrees and gallon size Coke refills all at the same time, don't go here. My husband and I are not from the US originally and this is how we expect a good dining experience to be - served slowly with lots of time to enjoy, converse, drink, etc. But it certainly didn't take a long time to receive the food; it was just spaced in a way that you could enjoy each dish and didn't feel like you were being rushed out the door.

For our entrees we chose the Chori-arepa and the Carnicera arepa so we could share each others plates and get a taste of both. All of the food was fresh, flavorful and plentiful. Every single bite was seriously a joy, including the fresh made sauces. After 2 apps, 2 arepas and 4 mojitos we were stuffed and very happy. 

For people that took issue with the neighborhood - if you think that's a rough neighborhood you obviously are not from New Orleans. No area of New Orleans is truly "safe" but this one is far from what I would consider scary. 

I hope my experience wasn't a unique one because we will definitely be going back - excellent!
name: Vasula

text: I was really looking forward to dining here. As a single diner at 8:20pm I was turned away because they were closing at 9:00. They promptly seated a 2 top while I walked out the door. I don't know the situation but I felt like it was extremely rude and it diminished my perception of this establishment.

text: I've been to this place quite a few times now and although it's not the best diner I've been to, the portions are kinda big, theirs a buffet and the food is quite tasty. text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. text: Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. text:

The food was quite good. I had a fish taco and a chicken taco. My dinner companion tried the beef and the steak. All were really delicious and available in either a corn or flour tortilla. I finished dinner with a seasonal strawberry shortcake they were offering. It was good, but next time I'll stick with the tacos.

text:
Seems to be and establishment that specializes in oysters. Not a very extensive menu. Music way too loud during dinner hour.  The waitress we had had a very thick accent and was hard to understand. Also, she was not very well versed on what was offered on the menu. Every time we asked her about an item she said she would have to go and ask the chef.
I would definitely recommend the charbroiled oysters.

text:
If I could give this place 0 stars I would. Along with a take out order that arrived late, the food was ice cold. The portions were tiny (10 fries in an order of sweet potato fries) And they also forgot part of our order. So Yelp called me and offered to refund my money or I could reorder my missing item. text:
My friend had heard good things about this place, so we decided to try it out! The parking lot isn't very big, so prepare to valet your car! 

It was a Friday night so we were expecting a bit of a wait. But truth be told, we must have gotten there at a good time, because we only had to wait about 5-10 minutes. After we were seated was when they were hit with a rush of people!! 

Our waitress was awesome. When she greeted us, she brought us two waters and asked if we wanted anything else to drink. She gave us some insight on what was good, what was popular, and what her favorite was! 

I ended up getting the Thai bowl. And oh. My. Gosh. That thing was amazing!!! I had been craving Asian food for awhile, so that dish definitely hit the spot. When it first came out, the presentation of it was perfect. Felt like it was a good portion size, maybe would the right size to have some dessert afterwards, but it actually left me feeling quite full! I probably could have taken some of it home, but it was one of those dishes where you just kept wanting to eat it!! 

I would say for the quality and quantity of the food, it was definitely worth the price. 

Will definitely try this place out again! Maybe next time, I'll bring my parents!

text:
Since I was dining as one they recommended that I use a bar top table, it wasn't very crowded? I ordered the 12 ounce ribeye which had great flavor along with the asparagus and garlic mashed potatoes and white gravy. There wasn't any salt or pepper on any of the bar tables...odd? Order the food had good flavor it was seriously lacking in seasoning. I downloaded a free appetizer coupon and ordered the deep-fried pickle spears...YUMM!!!(I highly recommend).
There was a family of six waiting for their table in the bar with two teenage boys were part of the party. The boys were not allowed to sit at the bar but told by the bartender that they can stand behind the adults. This put their backsides within a foot of me. Each time a waiter obtained their drink order they had to excuse the boys to move out of the isle. This happened at least 15 times. This also means that I too had to move out of the way or risk being bumped or having drinks spilled on me. I could see one of the boys felt uncomfortable and in fact kept going up to the front entrance. 
Grandma kept asking the boys if they wanted a soda both replied no we will take our soda at the table when were eating I could see the boys were much better behaved than the parents and grandparents. 
I love to see families out enjoying one another however grandma came across a bit rude and discourteous about those dining around her. She kept jamming up the boys about their sports, future dinner plans, birthday cake and party, as well as buying more cleats for baseball and future golf games with grandpa. Again, I love the family aspect however I didn't feel like I need to be part of it and grandma should I had more consideration for those around her.Bottom line excellent food and atmosphere not so great the two young teenagers very respect for their parents and grandparents not so much. I will definitely return the next time I'm in Reno
