Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: Alright so let's get into it. We got here on a Monday shortly after lunch time and there wasn't a line of people so we were seated immediately. However once we placed our order, we then waited 1hr 10min to have our food come out. The Fried Chicken was amazing but they were out of Fried Catfish which was disappointing. Their lemonade was also too sweet. Truthfully we enjoyed the chicken so much and it's surely probably the best in the US but the wait time and small other details are what held me back from giving this a perfect rating.
name: Kadeem

text: We have enjoyed Jack Daniel's twice in the last 14 months.  The wait-staff are outstanding.  Their recommendations are on-point and the beer, entrees, and desserts have been consistently wonderful.  We will return next time in Nashville!
name: Bill

text: Amazing Italian BYOB restaurant right off of south street. The atmosphere is very authentic and cozy and the food is delicious. We started with a fried gnocchi special they had that night which was awesome. Then I had what I think was the best lasagna I've ever had in my life - highly recommend getting this. We also had a seafood pasta special which was delicious as well
name: Sophia

text:
You should definitely check this place out. It's easy to pass by (I accidentally missed it the first time) tucked in with the other warehouse-looking buildings, but swing by again and make sure to stop. The interior has a cool, laidback ambiance, perfect for business lunches, a break from construction work, or a casual meet-up with friends, all of which was happening when my roommate and I stopped in for lunch. 

The menu is extensive enough to give you plenty of options to pick from but not so many as to overwhelm, and it offers fun twists on classic deli sandwiches. I got the #6 and it was delicious. Even better, it was really affordable (all sandwiches are $7-10) and left me full after just a half which means...leftovers! Can't get much better than two tasty meals for $10. 

The staff is super friendly and quick, and the restaurant also offers a selection of craft beers. I don't know what you're still doing reading. Get to Clawson's!
name: Amanda

text:
Caveat:  I did not eat any food.  Just beer!

Love this new location.  Great building, great bar area.  I can't wait to see what the outdoor set up looks like (any chance there could be an area out there year-round?).  Service was surprisingly good for only being open for a week.  The place was packed - no doubt they will continue to do well.
name: Carla

text: Haven't been here in 15+ years. Originally discovered this place when I went to the chiropractor down the avenue. Went after the lunch rush and originally wanted to get breakfast. Saw the $7.50 specials and focused on the chicken coquettes, eggplant parmesan and homemade fish cake. Great deal. Substantial fresh salad or cup of soup, main course and one side plus coffee. My bleu cheese dressing was 50 cents extra. Got 2 wonderful croquettes, moist, filled with real white and dark meat, celery, carrots and potatoes with good gravy and a dab of mashed potatoes to hold them on the dish. Coffee good and strong. I had deep fried potatoes as my side. Ice cream additional. Service excellent. Very clean. I'll be back with Senior Management to see if it meets her high standards.
name: Gerry

text: Definitely one of the better pizza places in the area! Tried their pizza twice now - nice people, fast service, good toppings. Also tried their gyro too, but it was mostly sauce, limited meat, and overall just super underwhelming - probably one of the worst I've had in Philly... It might even be beneficial for them to just take it off their menu because now I'm nervous to try their other non-pizza items!
name: Carol

text: Addicting and delicious Filipino food. My favorite is the Bicol express which has a coconut base with ginger, tofu and veggies; another favorite is the lechon kawali. The lechon kawali is crispy and delicious with a side of dipping sauce. Other lechon kawali I have had in the past from other Filipino places just wasn't up to par to the crispiness. The garlic rice with all the meals pairs well with all the proteins.
name: Marie

text:
Super nice people but just terrible, overpriced food.

Came for an urgent breakfast, and wished that I had walked a bit more.

3 egg omelette was fine. Toast that came with it was buttered and soggy.

No options for wheat toast nor milk alternatives for coffee.

TL/dr: Better options elsewhere for brekkie.
name: Julia

text: Extremely unimpressed with the menu. Lunch menu is very minimal, and the quality of the food was terrible. Although our waitress was wonderful, I was ultimately unimpressed and underwhelmed with the food.
name: Tiesh

text:
This was my second time dining at this restaurant and I was beyond satisfied. For starters the staff was very friendly w/my 5yr old and entertained all the questions she had (it was A LOT). They also allowed her to watch them roll sushi at the bar and explained each ingredient that was used. This warmed my heart.

For dinner my husband and I ordered Bento Boxes. I had the teriyaki salmon w/a California roll and he had the teriyaki chicken w/shrimp tempura. For the 5yr old we ordered her a smaller portion of teriyaki salmon w/a side of sticky rice. 

We also enjoyed Japanese sodas that were pretty cool. All in all we LOVE this place and will def be back!
name: Keia

text: The best place for quality food and proper portion. The food is well thought out, beautiful ACE Coffee and gorgeous wine and cocktails, not to mention the best patio for brunch or drinks.
name: Pamella

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasnt expecting at all. Glad we tried it. Food took a while and didnt really feel worth the wait. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text: This is the worst location of McDonald's in the city. They never get an order right (there is always something missing) and the last straw was the wrap I ordered on Feb 6, 2018. The lettuce was rotten and there was mould on the wrap. This location needs some serious changes.
name: Katie

text:
Been here at least five times and each visit was exceptional, but today's lunch was especially amazing. Between three of us we had mussels, polenta, carpaccio, a panini sandwich and minestrone soup.  Each was well-prepared and served in a timely fashion. 

But what made our visit special was our server, Missy. She was pleasant, helpful with menu choices  and very attentive. She made sure each course was served when we were ready for it. Thank you Missy.
name: Fred

text:
Gluten sensitive review!

My son and I had an absolutely fantastic experience dining out here. The staff was all extraordinarily helpful and really seemed to care that we had the best experience possible. 

As a person who is gluten sensitive, it can be very challenging dining out. Ok, so not this time. Can you say gluten free southern biscuits as a free appetizer?! Sounds like an oxymoron, right?! Oh my, were they good!

My son more than approved of the mac and cheese and his own biscuits and corn bread. (All carbs, yes, I know. Vacation dinner. Lol) My dinner was more sophisticated but delightful. I had a small beet salad and then their steak on asparagus with a side of charred root veggies! I was so stuffed, it was a crime! Further, as someone who has to ask how every single thing I order is prepared, the fact they were both vested in my requests and then delivered perfectly (including the cook on the steak) is something of a Herculean effort!

I would highly recommend giving this restaurant a try, especially if you have 'needs' when it comes to food.
name: Ian

text:
I really enjoy Sea Salt a lot. I've been twice now; typically has been on a weekday right after work since I'm located downtown and can walk. 

There is a back door on printers ally for those that may not know.  The service has been prompt as the waitress or waitor that we get know the menu, great wine and cocktail options. 

The food is also delicious. Both times I've had their fish first was salmon and second was snapper and both were amazing.  The shrimp wrapped with bacon is a must. 

Definitely a regular post work/happy hour/dinner location that never lets you down.
name: Huy

text: My family and I were looking for a spontaneous New Years Eve dinner.The food was delicious and the service was great. The pizza dough was very tender with the right amount of yeastines would definitely visit again.
name: Erin

text: It was our first time trying this Hotel. Overall it was ok. I feel like they should be more upfront that they are not actually on the beach. The pool area was nice, but the overall hotel service wasn't that great. I got there early but couldn't get a room til the normal check out, which was fine, at 4pm, but didn't actually get checked in till almost 5pm. They only had one person working the front desk. If your check in is 4 on a Labor Day weekend why is there only one person at the front. I felt the rooms were a bit small. They come with a mini fridge but most of the fridge space is taken up with their items that if you use you get charged for. We need the fridge space don't put all those extras in there to make us pay more money. My biggest thing that made me upset is we were going to have dinner and met the owner/chef Luis and he told us we should try out the restaurant, and that he was cooking and since it was our birthdays he would set us up and treat us right. So we made reservations and lo and behold, it was his day off!!! Are you kidding me! Don't try and get me to come and spend money and then not be there. I felt the food was just ok and way over priced. We spent over $200 dollars on the 4 of us, we could have gotten a lot more and better quality food at some other local place. I felt like I was totally mislead by the chef to just once again spend more money at his hotel! That really pissed me off! It was a nice location, but little service issues and then the whole being lied too by the owner/chef is the main reason for the bad review. Overall we had fun, but not sure if we will be back!
name: Joseph

text: Love this place! The mac and cheese and wise guy pizzas and chocolate cookie are amazing! The service is fantastic, and they always have good craft beers on tap. We love taking our out-of-town visitors here!
name: Malia

text: I went here for a movie tonight and loved the experience. The service was great. I love that they have call buttons for when you want to place an order. The food was just ok. I got the Road Trip for Two sampler. The chicken fingers were hard and overcooked. The fries and pretzel were ok. The stuft quesadilla was good. I also tried the Raging Bull pizza that has steak on it and it wasn't good. There wasn't enough sauce and the cheese and steak were just ok. The ranch was really good. Next time I will try the chicken pizza instead. I ordered Korbel champagne which was good of course.
name: Mandy

text: Family favorite! Delicious hot and authentic food along with a very nice atmosphere and decor. Only downside is that food quality changes but it is never bad
name: Jennifer

text:
It is years since we visited this venue under different name and I assume different ownership. It is Saturday night and decided to Gove it a new unbiased try.
We arrived at the place that was totally packed.
We waited a few minutes realizing that the restaurant is severely understaffed.
We finally got seated  and had a sip of our BYOB wine. We ordered the grilled octopus and the native Greek  bean dish. Both were delicious although I could forgo of the raw onion that was served with the octopus.
I ordered the grilled Bronzino, Although we specified the garnishing the dish -it was delivered with none of the ordered items. The fish was delicious, perfectly grilled. We then realized that our server had a serious attention deficit disorder.
My wife had the vegetarian Mousaka., presented beautifully in a small crock. Unfortunately it was not edible. Half the dish was filled with béchamel sauce and the remainder with half cooked raw vegetables.
We returned the dish and ordered the chicken Souvlaki  instead- with special request for it to  be well done. The two skewers were delivered with apologies by the manager. However the chicken was not marinated at all, was absolutely RAW- totally undercooked despite our clear request. My wife could not touch the raw chicken . We left the dish intact. Total bill $72.80. We left a total of $90.00 ( despite the fact that the waitress was not attentive to our requests) and in turn removed the restaurant from our phone directory.
name: Ierachmiel

text: Excellent food--the ribeye was amazing!! A great dining experience, and could not ask for better service!
name: Jeremy

text: Very good for take-out. Portions are large, food isn't too greasy, the place is friendly and clean.
name: Renee

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Would absolutely visit again. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Just tried out this place and wow THE BEST SANDWICH SHOP EVER. Prices are fair and they sell a gigantic size sandwich for just 12 or 13 bucks but can feed 3 full grown men!!
name: Phillip

text: We alway's enjoy PF Chang's including our recent visit. Our waiter Josh was excellent in his attentiveness, knowledge of dishes and recommendations. Our selection of crispy shrimp and Korean steak bowl was delicious.
name: Kathleen

text: A local favourite! Most people who go here are 50 and over, and those experienced taste buds know whats good! Roosterfish serves up delicious seafood daily. Make sure you make a reservation for dinner, as it usually fills up very quick. Last time I was here, I had the mango mahi mahi. It was cooked perfectly. It also comes with two sides. Make sure one of the sides is the garlic mashed potatoes. I would order a plate full of those alone. The margaritas go for 3 dollars and are quite large. They also have a special on margaritas certain days of the week as happy hour. Stop by this local seafood joint and taste what the ocean has to offer.
name: Anna

text: Overall a nice experience...went there for a work related dinner...we had reserved the large conference room on the right side...the room was spacious and the place was ideal for dinner meeting and discussion...we had course meal menu which had diverse items...the pastas were tasty...salmon was excellent...tiramisu was one of the best i have had in the city...service was good...i had a bad experience at sorrentino on the south side, but the downtown location is excellent and high end...recommended
name: Muhammad

text:
The line had decieved us into thinking this is a must-try while visiting from Minneapolis. I had the southern benny, the sausage gravy was very tasty. Biscuit was dry but they usually are.
The thin layer of ham was ok but I generally prefer a thick slab of ham for my benny's. 
I tried some bacon and it was good. The orange juice tasted fresh and was very sweet almost sour. I guess I just expected more after waiting 45 minutes to get in.
name: Joe

text: Not quite sure what the hype was about. Waited 45 minutes in the rain for average to good biscuits. The Bonuts and chronic bacon were highlights, but the nasty princess was just average. Chicken was too crispy and not moist. Gravy was not particularly flavorful. I do have to say that the customer service was exceptional. It was pouring rain in the outdoor line and a hostess brought us an umbrella and overall made the line tolerable. Cashier and server were great too. Just wish the food was 5/5 like it has been hyped-up to be!
name: Lindsay

text: For the price I expected more than this. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: Delicious BBQ & great atmosphere! Beautiful wall murals & lights. We got the brisket dip sandwich the brisket was so tender, flavorful. Loved all of the BBQ sauces! Highly recommend Sugarfire BBQ.
name: Kenda

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. My experience was honestly fine. Not bad for a quick meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
the food was good(especially the beef skewers!!) but service was unsatisfying... the girl at the cashier was using her phone the whole time that she didn't realize our food was ready until we approached her 20min after... :( 
We got the 3 skewers+rice+Cambodian coleslaw but they forgot the coleslaw and gave us a piece of lettuce  wish their service was little better because I really like their food
name: Manae

text: I'm generally not a fan of sushi but went along with the choice for the evening (this was also my first time in). The drinks were not strong but the food was amazing! The ambiance is very nice and the service was great! We came in during happy hour (drinks are not included) and there were plenty of options on the menu to choose from. I'd definitely come in again!
name: Sadiya

text: Very good food and service. They give a generous amount of side dishes. I like spicy pork, chicken wings, and kimchi or seafood pancakes.
name: Gregory

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Overall, a strong experience. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was fresh and service was quick. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: When you're on vacation and missing home just a little, head to Skidders to get your fix. We had the best time and everyone treated us like family! Don't get overwhelmed with all the menu options, anything you choose will be delicious! Make sure you get a glass or three of Pete's homemade sangria.
name: Kacy

text: It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The menu wasnt huge, which I usually prefer.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which prob says everything.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food took a while and didnt really feel worth the wait.
name: User

text:
Overall a fun time. I'm not sure who their target audience but here's a few things that could be improved. 
1. Book a lane online for $25.  Bit that does not go toward the lane thats a booking fee. 
2. When you arrive you have to give a name, phone number and email to register, why?
3 after you register they text you to update the status of your lane, seriously go study a bowling alley. 
4. When I called ahead they gave me the lane cost, never mentioned the $5 per person lane fee- again with the cell and email to register, kids have to give a date of birth, why?
5. When we went to the counter to check Into the lane, after our text message,  we had to stand there and wait for a text to get our lane, what? So we all just stood there looking at each other waiting for a text. 
6. They want a credit/ debit cares for everything up front, lane, food, alcohol. We ate at the restaurant and they wanted our card up front. 
7. You get to the lane and wait for the staff to arrive to help, why were they moth there? 

Sub par customer service but the concept is fun and we had a blast.
name: Tracie

text: For quick easy meal to get and run, this was a decent stop. It's $20 per person at entry, good luck getting seating though. 3/4 of the tables are full of dirty dishes waiting to be bussed and all 4 hostesses stand there waiting for the 1 bus boy to clear them. The food is actually really yummy and the bottomless mimosas (included with the $20) is a win!!
name: Jessica

text: We really enjoyed this place. It had a great, clean open and modern vibe with high top tables and a Lazy Susan on the table, making it perfect to share plates with everyone . We had impeccable service with the food coming out as it was ready at a perfect pace. The hostess was super attentive and frequently came over to see what we thought of the food. I was especially impressed with her as when we were leaving, there was a homeless gentleman with a wheelchair in front of the restaurant. I thought she was going to try and shoo him away and she was actually going outside to check on him.  Our meal was delicious. We started with the garlic bread which was outstanding and probably one of my favorite items of the evening. We also got the brassica which was an interesting combination of broccoli, Brussels sprouts, very thinly sliced apple and pumpkin seeds. It was not a very large portion and was a little scanty amongst five people but good just the same. We loved the pizza margherita and the crispy potatoes.  We shared the bucatini pasta (They were very kind to make it vegetarian style for us) and the Tagliarini pasta which was squid ink pasta. I would say that it wasn't as well received as the other dishes, but I really liked it. It had a little spice to it and I loved the orange zest in it.  We enjoyed the zeppoles for dessert but our favorite was the delicious dark chocolate pudding with a hazelnut topping and chocolate paper!  It was an ample amount and we were tempted to order a second.  This would be a great restaurant for larger parties due to the ability to share and the great square tables that seat 8.  You won't be disappointed coming here. Great atmosphere, great food and great service where they pay tribute to the icon Sophia Loren with photo montages and art work. It was also very easy to find parking on this quiet, serene street on a Sunday night.
name: Jill

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. It was crowded but still moved along. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Will be back. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text:
Excellent service and food. Place was very clean and waiter was very knowledgeable of the menu. I got the crab avocado salad which was very filling. The lobster toast was also delicious. 
It is pretty pricy here - just as a heads up.
name: Jessica

text: Took 2 hours for us to receive our food. Tables were empty around us, not sure why it took so long? Slow service every time I have been here. The venue is awesome in the courtyard. Not sure if it is worth the trouble.
name: Gianna

text:
There are so many things to say about this place. First off, the atmosphere is super cool, probably a little cooler than I feel like I fit into but hey, I was comfortable sitting on a couch so it was great. 

We got a crazy amount of food and drinks and the thing I will never forget is the Amaretto Sour. Pretty sure no other Amaretto Sour will ever compare. For appetizers, my favorite were the tots and the fried broccoli. For food, we split the steak and our friends got the pot roast and it was all so good we couldn't handle it.

Service was great, other drinks and food were great too. Parking was simple. We'll definitely return here at some point. It's a such a great place.
name: Lexi

text: Came here for lunch and tried the Mu Shu Tacos and chili glazed potatoes. The tacos were simple but flavorful. The pork was the star and the asian flavor was stronger than I expected. I wasn't in the mood for a typical taco so this hit the spot. The potatoes were yummy but very sweet. I wished they were a bit spicer because they didn't taste very mexican but asian instead.
name: Sydney

text: Had loads of fun it was my birthday and all my friends flew from all over the states. The hurricane is a must try. I had such a good time other guests were fun too and we hung out we a lot of strangers. The vibe is young and fun. A must go!!
name: Tejeshvi

text: This is good if you are near the airport. We had the wings, half chicken, Mac n Cheese, and greens. Mac and cheese was awesome. Greens were just okay, but not bad. The chicken was good. It was not as hot as I expected/wanted. I prefer Hatti B's, but haven't tried Prince's yet. I'll definitely come back to BJ's when I am staying near the airport though.
name: Shadrya

text: Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text:
Great options for gluten free and non gluten free diners. I was in town for a concert and wanted to grab some food beforehand. My husband and I sat at the bar and shared the bricklayer nachos which were awesome. I loved the spin on traditional nachos with queso, jalepeno aioli and black bean corn relish. I opted for the shrimp tacos for my entree which were made gluten free by swapping out flour tortillas for corn, I loved the crunch of the asian slaw. We ordered a couple double Titos which were fairly expensive but strong. I had a yelp offer for a free coffee which somehow disappeared but the nice server gave it to us anyway. 

There must have been a better way to park, we used the public lot a street over and was $15 plus a pain to use the machine to pay. I saw a garage nearby, that may have been better but being from out of town we just went with what was closest. Great experience overall and we would surely come back!
name: Carey

text:
Came here for a random work lunch on a recommendation of a coworker. It was a group of 5 of us. The restaurant was pretty empty but we were not given much of a service, which is ok I guess, it's not fine dining and we were there for the food not conversation. 
My colleague, who is Chinese, ordered, so can't really say what we had. We had an assortment of dishes: fish, pork, vegetables. The spice level was fine for me, but some might find it spicy. It's typical of Szechuan food as I understand it. The food was good, very good, some dishes better than others. It was not, however the best Szechuan food  I've had in the states. Far from the best.
name: Irina

text: This is probably the best Mexican restaurant in Brownsburg.  There is a good variety of food and everything is delicious.  The staff has always been friendly. The place isn't fancy or anything but the food is sure to make your tummy satisfied.
name: Aaron

text: Stopped by after work because I was nearby and hungry. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. A very pleasant experience. Would prob stop in again if nearby. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text:
I would bathe in that mole sauce...no questions asked. 

El Limon is quick, cheap, and tasty.  I am a huge fan of the shrimp mole enchiladas but I do not hesitate to order the occasional shrimp tacos (with another side of mole of course). Also be sure to rock out with your guac out.  It tastes awesome and is only $2.50 for an extra side. So do it.  And if you are a fan of spicy be sure to grab a side of the red sauce.  It is smokey and spicy. 

I always take out and they are quick to have everything prepared.  Always a delight.
name: Alex

text: Came here with a decent size party on a slow Monday night I waited 2 hours for food and another hour for a drink refill. Service was so slow I would give it no stars but that's not an option.
name: James

text: My kids and I ate here today. I used to come a lot when I lived in Summerland and loved it. It took 20 min plus to get our food yesterday and the place was soooo dirty. I'm not a neat-nick germaphobe but this was really gross. Old food everywhere and greasy, dirty surfaces. The cook was touching the food he cooked without gloves on. I hoped he hadn't been scratching anywhere first. The back room smelled. We literally had to go sit at the red kettle tables because we couldn't find anywhere clean to eat. I hand sanitized my kids and hoped they wouldn't get sick from anything the cook had.  I wondered what the health department would think. My kids, who love eating out, said they didn't want to go there anymore because it took too long and smelled!  Maybe this was a moment in time....  food was okay and friendly staff tho.
name: C

text: Excellent ghost pepper beer along with smoked brisket sandwich with pit beans. Was very loud and we could not talk to people in our group. Too many TVs and way to loud for dinner.
name: Craig

text: Just fed 14 out of towners D&S Hoagies and Cheesesteaks and WOW!  Rave reviews!  Oh, and since I'm a local I am happy to report that we LOVE their hoagies and cheesesteaks AND they have EXCELLENT Sicilian pie.  Do not hesitate to drop in on D&S or call ahead.  You will not be disappointed.
name: Angel

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. Honestly, the service was off and the meal kinda followed that energy. Idk, nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Anyway, the staff seemed tired but still polite. For the price I expected more than this. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text: The hype didn't live up to the food. Was not blackened catfish, smoked pork chop was OK, blackberry  cobbler was gelationous. Hamburger was good, vegtables were good, but have had better meals at Cracker Barrel or Black Eyed Peas. Oh and add an additional +$10 or more for parking... Maybe at night with the music food taste better, but pricey for serving sizes.
name: Pamela

text: I was such a doubting Thomas when I saw this place, thinking it was another chain. But the service was the best we had in this part of Nashville over 4 days. The smell is fabulous and the taste doesn't disappoint. The chef (brisket preparer) gave me a HUGE handful of bark bc I said it's my favorite part. Everyone in my party of 7 loved it!
name: Jaime

text:
The nubs & beer cheese are unbeatable, this place was a "before and after" moment in life. I've been to New York and tried the "best" pretzels but didn't even know I liked them until Zwick's. 
Eating at this place will BLESS you!
name: Jonathan

text:
I had a superb dining experience with my parents and boyfriend at Salt this evening. We had attended an awesome performance of the Nutcracker at the Atheneum and the restaurant was literally across the street. It was all of our first time. I ordered the sheepshead special, my boyfriend-the salmon, my mom- the scallops, and my dad- the flounder special. The restaurant provided several little plates so that we could all sample each other's dishes. All four fish selections were delicious and extremely fresh. The restaurant's commitment to providing ocean-to-table dining in a landlocked state sounded ambitious, but it was executed brilliantly. I have never had such amazing seafood in the US (I have had heavenly sushi in Japan that is impossible to surpass). I had two of the House craft cocktails,  Polaris, which was also extremely on point. It was also very refreshing. 

Our waitress, Callista, was very sweet, personable, and knowledgeable. She did an A-one job. 

The setup of the restaurant was very modern and chic. I also loved the recurring seahorse motif. It was very cute. 

We will definitely be back again when we have another special event!
name: Hope

text: Our favorite sushi place in St Louis!  Waiter Tyler is amazing and made the evening a wonderful experience!  And you can't beat Tuesday nights when their world famous rolls are $6!  Thanks for the superbly fresh sushi!  We are forever fans!
name: Sandi

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.

text: I have wanted to eat here for some time and was really looking forward to my meal. The staff and service was excellent! Everyone was friendly and helpful. BUT... The food was just okay. I was so disappointed, I thought I was going to have an amazing meal and didn't.  I would recommend the warm shrimp salad and the Profiteroles, but that is about it.

text: Came back tonight and it hasn't improved, service was good but the food was so so. Calamari app were ok, my sausage and broccoli rabe Stromboli was disappointing. Very amateurish. When I cut into the stromboli, it had about a cup of liquid from the broccoli run all over the board. It pooled around it making it soggy. I recommend draining the broccoli and chopping it so it eats better. Nothing worse than having stringy stems of the broccoli rabe and chewing it. The bitterness from the broccoli juice also effected the stromboli making it bitter and over powering everything.

text: Celebrated a milestone birthday for a man who was not physically able to go to the restaurant, but our family was craving this food for a birthday brunch. We did a carryout catering, the food was fresh and delicious and all our favorites. Lenny's is the Best Breakfast in Clearwater and the service and staff is top notch. text: We had a party of 6 and Everyone's dinner was amazing.  Appetizers were delicious.  Fried Boudin and crab cakes. text: Parking was annoying, although that's prob more about the area than the restaurant. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. text:
You've got to have the right perspective to go to Waffle House. I remember it as a kind of dirty place where people sit, drink coffee and smoke cigarettes. 

The cigarettes are gone now, but all else remains the same. Food is average at best. Ok, some of it is awful. Waffles are a safe bet, but don't expect anything fancy. 

This is simple food based on a fifty plus year history unimpeded by progress.  As long as you understand that you will survive. Also remember, the bluish tattoos the cook has are from time served. He's repaid his debt don't judge.
name: John

text: Ok so I read a post about how often people review a business only when things go bad and I have had some rough trips to the downtown location but we keep going back. We have been to the midtown location twice in the last few weeks and again great pizza. So why 5 stars?  Comfortable and friendly even when we bring the kids. The gluten free options are always and issue and gluten free crust is a beast in its own right. The WRANGLER is the five star option. This is hands down my favorite pizza ever. Everything about this pizza is exceptional. The blend of flavors unmatched anywhere. The fact that if I am at the Nextdoor bar with no food service instead of being bitter about my drinking the neighbors beer they deliver my pizza Nextdoor at that bar. text:
We Eat here every time we are in Florida and we always have a Groupon or living social to use as well! Our visits never disappoint and that's what keeps us coming back. It helps that we stay nearby as well 

Their chips and salsa are average. You get a carafe of mild salsa and a little cup of the spicy salsa. I like to mix them together so as to get the flavor and the kick!

This last visit we ordered the poppin' poppers with cream cheese. They weren't very hot jalapeños which could be a downside to most.

I always order the tortilla soup and they always tell me that it's a big bowl (so more like a meal in itself). It is indeed filling but it's not a typical tortilla soup. You do get the chicken, avocado, and tortilla strips but it also has a ton of rice and corn in it too. It reminds me more of a chicken and corn soup as far as the ratio of ingredients go but it's still tasty.

My entree was 3 chicken enchiladas with sour cream sauce. You have your choice of meats and about 10 different sauces!

Of course after having chips with salsa, a few poppers and the bowl of soup I was pretty full but still managed to eat half my meal and got to take the other half home for another meal another day!

My boyfriend did the pick 3 and chose a taco, tostada and one enchilada all ground beef. No complaints from him either.

Waitstaff is always friendly and welcoming

text: Chef Oya's The TRAP serves up deliciously dope seafood in their stomping grounds of 46218 that keeps loyal patrons returning rain or shine, lunch break or day off.  Staying true to the tribe, Chef uses her culinary trained gifts to lessen the food desert that has restricted fresh food access to the people in the surrounding area.  Been trapped for over 2 years now, and I can't seem to find my way out...not that I want to anyways.  From lobster, to crab, shrimp and salmon, crawfish & chowder the trays are ALWAYS served in generous portions that almost never seem to make it out of the car uneaten.  You WILL need a few napkins, and you WON'T want to share.  ProTip: order any fully loaded tray (newly added Lil' Trappers Tray pictured) and get the OG Garlic Herb Buttah, with a drizzle of Sweet Thai Chili Buttah for a lil kick. You're welcome. ⁣⁣

text:
This place is fantastic! I came here with my family 12/28/17 around 6 for a birthday dinner. We were greeted by a friendly upbeat bartender/server (with a killer beard if I might add) and he sat us at our table. He recommended some good wines and then we met our server. I wish I could remember his name because this guy literally killed it! There was so many specials and I don't know how he memorized them all so perfectly but he did. Also I should add that my family is by no means easy to serve especially my father. He seriously asked this kind waiter if they could make their mushrooms like the restaurant chucks makes theirs...wtf dad?? Now this waiter took all my dads bs like a champ he was friendly and didn't get impatient or flustered whatsoever. He also makes some killer recommendations, thanks man for recommending the swordfish for dinner and tiramisu for dessert I was in a food coma for the next few hours. Also to the busser, you are so on top of the game. Got our plates out the way in a timely fashion and constantly filled our waters cause I drink like a fish. And for the bartender again, thank you for not judging me when I ordered a third bread basket after I'd eaten dessert. don't even get me started on the bread, I wanna come here just to eat the bread  anyways, you guys absolutely killed it your food is incredible and your staff is even better! Sincerely, 
Girl who apologized for family manners

text: Hands down the Best place to grab a sandwich and side in Carmel and probably the entire Indianapolis area.  Do not miss out.  Sell your house and move here if you don't live close enough!  Do the kids really need a college fund?  Probably not..  Use that money to stuff delicious sandwiches in your face!  This place is the reason Guy Fieri has a tv show.  He just doesn't know it yet.  The marinated steak sandwich will make you slap your friend who took you there for not taking you sooner.   Everything on the menu is crafted and designed to please the senses.  There is no bad choice.  However the ipa braised beef and debris po boy are guaranteed to please also.  In short, sell you house, buy an rv and park out front and eat at least 2 meals a day here and you will never stop smiling...  You're welcome!

text:
My partner & I got lunch here today. She had the cali burger. We both thought it was okay. There wasn't much contrast in flavor, but reminded me of a cucumber-cream cheese sandwich in the best way. 
I had the ramen which reminded me deeply of those terribly, delicious ramen packets you eat when you're broke. It was salty & gingery & so so good. 10/10 would recommend. 
Also, our server was very sweet & attentive.

We got the salad bar for an extra dollar, it was modest but worth it. The calamari was crispy with tasty sauce. The bruschetta appetizer was massive and tasted great. The eggplant parm was delicious. Overall, we all thoroughly enjoyed our meal and would gladly come back!

Their fried eggplant with mozzarella and marinara was my appetizer and was great. I had the beet salad for dinner which was really good, good portion. Other than location and price for quality I have no complaints and wouldn't decline if it was brought up as a place to go get a light dinner.

text:
Makes a change to see a store with such a healthy choice. I had to go down for breakfast and give it a try after I enjoyed lunch so much last time I went.

The breakfast looked good and tasted it too!!! 

Very friendly service, even though the poor girl serving looked like she was about to pass out, and I can see why!! You'd think a restaurant that has customers dining in would have working air conditioning?? I found it rather unbearable and I only had a meal and left, they have to work a whole shift in there?!

Only other issue was the amount of staff. When I went for lunch there was a queue halfway round the store and only the same girl serving, they clearly need more staff during lunch, the queue barely got shorter the while time I was there. Seems way too much for one person.

Other than that, food is great, restaurant is nice and clean, plenty of seating, great service. But don't think I'll be going back till it's cooler weather or the air conditioning is fixed.
name: Greg

text: Interesting concept and something I've never experienced. The restaurant is tucked away behind a wall and bushes in a residential parking lot. This place is 30% food and 70% drinks. The drinks are very good. Probably one of the best drinks I've had in a while. The Ciro burger is very good as well. It's a nice place to have a private dinner in one of their enclosed booths. Call ahead to make a reservation and to get the "password". Otherwise you'll be directed to the bar for dinner/drinks. Parking is a little bit of a pain, but overall, great experience.

text: Great food, drinks, and service.  Our bartender Josh was great.  He was very friendly and knowledgeable .  He also made some great drinks for us.   We will be back soon.
name: Radu

text: I had my first Cooper's Hawk experience here and I have nothing but amazing things to say! First off, the wine and food selection was amazing, nothing but good things to say. But the best part was our waitress, Nikki! She was personable, easy to talk to, and her knowledge of the menu was helpful and impressive! Everything she suggested was to die for. Overall, 10/10 experience! Would definitely dine here again and would hope to be helped by Nikki!
name: Brittan

text: I ordered through uber eats and after paying almost $40 Then waiting 40 mins for my food, half of my order is missing. I called the lady on the phone was very nice telling me I would get a refund for having to drive all the way back up here to get my food. Not one manager came up to me, no reimbursement nothing. First time here and will probably be my last. Thanks for your great service Newks.
name: Samantha

text:
First I want to put this out there....I don't understand everyone's beef with the service.  From the moment we arrived till after we left the service was impeccable.  

Arrived on a Tuesday to take advantage of their BYOB night.  We ordered the meatball, taccozzelle, swordfish and brodetto.  Each were prepared very well.  My fiance was especially impressed with the homemade pasta.  After moving down from NYC in February she thought this was the best pasta she's ordered.  Can't wait to come back.

But what I want to talk about is the service.  I was nervous about coming here after reading all the reviews.  But everyone that waited on us had a great attitude.  The service really shined through when there were troubles running my gift card that was issued from a third party.  While we were at the restaurant they tried to run the card 3 times, but couldn't figure out the issue.  After leaving the restaurant I was finally able to get in touch with the company that issued the card and they told me how it should be processed.  I called Le Virtu and there were no issues.  They altered the amount that was charged on my card after running the gift card.
name: William

text:
Bottom Line: Their Breakfast game is strong.  Their lunch game...not so much

I have to downgrade to three stars based on the tacos I just had for lunch, especially considering that they were $11.

This plate was not great.  The tacos were bland, uninteresting and uninspired.  The rice and beans were totally par for the course.

It was the equivalent of going into a sandwich spot, ordering and getting a sandwich the brick of obviously, prepackaged meat like you get from Vons.  If I can easily make it at home, and its no better than I make at home, what's the point?

I had the Chicken Shack Ranch which was awesome and very filling. Can't wait to go back and try the Benton.

text: We decided to have an adventure tonight and just go downtown and eat at the first place we thought sounded good. We looked at several menus and finally settled on Yard House. The atmosphere in Yard House is like a classy sports bar. The place is large so the noise has a place to go. Even with a lot of people, it was not too loud. I ordered Abuela's chicken. It was very delicious. The chicken was well seasoned and had a nice crust to it. I also really enjoyed the street corn and the appetizer of fried mac and cheese. The wait staff was helpful and treated us very well. The only thing that needed changing is the huge mound of boring white rice. I did not eat it all. The dish would be better served with less of it and add more of the chipotle sauce on top of it. While the food was a little pricey it was a great dining experience and we will surely be back.

text: Delicious! Have been here multiple times and it has never disappointed. Staff is friendly, place is clean and it has a good environment. The food is always fresh and hot. The taste is really good. The variety is always good also. Plenty of Peking on site.

text: Every single thing we ate was amazing. Unique setting, special food, impeccable service!

text:
Great service-- we loved our waitress, and the host at the bar was funny and efficient.  The food was underwhelming.  This place and its menu seemed undercut by its own desire to be trendy.  We ordered:  

1) Shiso Kombucha
2) zucchini with pistachio and squash blossom
3) Japanese cucumber salad with breadcrumbs and wiscorino
4) Anchovies
5) Beef tartare
6) Trout
7) Panna Cotta
8) Coconut and blackberry sorbet
9) Peach pie

The kombucha was so sweet it was more like soda.  After a few sips I sent it back-- they clearly had added a syrup or extra sweetener to it.  What I love most about kombucha in general is the fermented/sour taste, and you could barely detect it in this drink underneath the sugar.  It was a bright pink color, which was pretty, but that's about all I have to say in favor of it.

The zucchini dish was very yummy, and probably my favorite thing here.  It was so small that it was finished in a few bites, but it was much less oversauced than the rest of the dishes, and I liked that I could really taste the distinct vegetables.  Still too small for the price, but quite tasty!

The japanese cucumber salad was quite a strange dish ..  I did not feel that the cheese or breadcrumbs paired well with the cucumbers.  The cucumbers were light and refreshing, so I just scraped the breadcrumbs and wiscorino off of them and ate them by themselves.  

My sister ordered the beef tartare, which had very odd seasoning.  It reminded me of cough syrup a bit!  Not my fave, but fortunately it was her dish.

The trout was decent and well cooked, but shared the same negative qualities of most of this menu of being too small and over sauced.

The dessert portions were bigger than the other dishes, and we really enjoyed both the peach pie and the blackberry/coconut sorbet.  The panna cotta was much too sweet, and we stopped after a few bites.

We would not go back here again-- too high on seasoning/style, and too low on actual food/satisfaction.  However, if you wanted to impress your friends/work colleagues by taking them somewhere trendy with an unusual menu, this might work well for that goal!  All depends what you want out of your evening.

text:
This newcomer brings Central American street food: pupusas, tacquitos, tostadas, and churros, to Rittenhouse.

We stopped by for a late afternoon meal on the opening day- Saturday, May 5. The inside is casual and spacious, with painted graffiti-esque decorations and bright yellow and blue accents. We were greeted by friendly employees who patiently and knowledgeably guided us through the options. We placed our order at the self-service screens at the counter: a pupusa tacquito combo (1 each + 2 sides, $10) and an order of tostadas (2, each with up to 4 different toppings, for $5.56). 

We eagerly awaited our food, though it didn't take long- maybe 5 minutes before our food was brought to the table. They were served in brown boxes with wooden utensils, true to El Merkury's image as a street food vendor. The tostadas are taco-size corn tortillas deep-fried in their flat form, then piled with toppings. You can choose up to four toppings per tostada. We got one "enchilada style," which means layers of pickled beets and beans, raisins, olives, a mix of beef and pork, and a sprinkling of cotija cheese. I enjoyed the variety of salty, savory, and sweet flavors and the contrast of crunch from the fried tortilla and beets with the soft meat. The second tostada was pork mechada with refried beans, guac, and salsa. The flavors were more bold but less unique on this tostada. Overall, the tostadas were delicious, but we would have enjoyed them even more if they had been a little warmer and the tortilla a little more crunchy. Still, we expect that might have been because it was only their first day serving food at this location!

The pupusa was a little smaller than the tostada, but hefty: a substantial stuffed white corn pancake. You choose your filling: we got carnitas chicharron (pork). The carnitas had a nice fine texture to it. I thought the pupusa was a tad soggy and a little dull in flavor, but my partner assures me that's just how pupusas are- they're designed for dipping in sauce! 

The tacquito (we got chorizo panela) was piping hot, crispy and richly flavorful, with a substantial spicy kick. The pupusa and tacquito combo came with two sides: we chose plantain chips and elote loco (grilled corn with cotija cheese, chili flakes, and a green sauce). Both of the sides ($2 each on their own, but included in price of the combo) were gustatorial adventures :) We loved the char on the elote and the complex mix of flavors. The plantain chips are fried to slightly sweet, crispy, salty perfection. 

We would come back to El Merkury in a heartbeat: for their excellent service; and for great value; and most of all, for their unique, well-crafted, and delicious food!
name: Clarissa

text:
My fiancé and I went on a date to Old School and were blown away by the entire experience. We took the advice of other reviews and 1. Made a reservation and 2. Arrived early for our reservation to take our time and enjoy the farm. We got there 30 minutes early and were asked if we'd like to be seated early since there was room, but we decided to spend some time sipping ciders in the beer garden first. They offer a handful of different ciders and beers for around $7. There was also a nice wine list and some fun seasonal cocktails. 

The sun was setting and it was a beautiful place to enjoy a drink. We watched some dogs play in their dog park and enjoyed the flowers surrounding the garden. We headed in for our reservation and chose to sit in the school room over the bar since there were more windows and it had a brighter feel. The atmosphere was perfect for a date night, but there was a huge community table that seemed great for a large group or a family meal. 

We started with two small plates - the BBQ okra and the Heirloom tomato salad. The salad was the perfect end of summer treat and we still can't stop talking about how good the okra was. We then ordered the ricotta pasta and ratatouille galette as our main meal. They encourage eating family style so we shared everything. The dishes are normal portions for appetizers and the pasta was entree sized, but sharing was the perfect way to taste more dishes! The galette convinced us to come back for brunch and try the pastries because that flaky crust was incredible. We were super impressed with the pasta as well since both the noodles and ricotta are made in house.

We ended with peach cobbler + sweet tea ice cream which was HUGE and a perfect end to this meal. We felt super welcomed here and our server helped explain the concept, making us appreciate the care and quality ingredients in each dish. I especially appreciated the number of vegetarian options available knowing that all the vegetables used were grown out back on their farm or purchased from a local farm (within 40 miles). 

Old School was the perfect escape from the city while only being about 15 minutes from down town. 
I loved enjoying a meal that highlighted the best summer veggies.We're already planning our next trip and can't I even contain my excitement for those croissants during brunch.
name: Kelsey

This place is awesome! As recent transplants to Brandon from just outside NYC, my hubby and I know what great NY-style Italian food should taste like. Vito (owner) is from Brooklyn and knows what he's doing!  We've had many different dishes on the menu and have never been disappointed.

Great find in Brandon for truly authentic Italian food. Mange!

Laurie G.
name: Laurie

text: Gal Bi Tang is soooooo good! Well everything was good but GAL BI TANG was my favorite. It was flavorful, soupy, hot and delicious. The beef was fall off the bone. I really tasted everything collectively that was in the soup. It felt like I got my money's worth in the end. The side dishes were a plus. I don't remember the names of what I ordered, but believe me when I say you can go wrong with any of the dishes - they are made to perfection and you'll walk out feeling completely satiated. The service was great, quick and attentive. I definitely recommend this place! It's the best Korean Food I've had in the area.
name: Jamie

text:
Located in the Broad Ripple, this is usually hard to get to if you're driving. Street parking and meter parking is usually taken depending on the time of day and week. Regardless, this is a nice spot to pop in and out to grab a quick bite if you're not feeling a local spot. Service is fairly quick but nothing over the top. I didn't know they started offering different taco options so we ordered 3 varieties. 

I got three Drunken Yardbird, two Two Timers, and a Gladiator Taco. The best one was the Gladiator! Honorable mention was the Two Timer which comes in a hard shell, wrapped in a soft one with their famous queso in between.

They have three small iron tables outside so we were able to grab it to go and eat it outside with our dog prior to a Monon walk.
name: Megan

text:
This place is FANTASTIC!

I love the inventive menu options, the service is spectacular, the coffee is fantastic, and food comes pretty quickly.

I've come here several times with my fiance and then also with my sister and nephew yesterday.

My sister, who's a big breakfast person, said this is her new favorite spot.

Yesterday we were told there'd be a 20-30 minute delay to be seated but the wait was actually probably closer to 10-15 minutes at most. 

Here's what we got yesterday and the reviews:

Bacon lollipops - I've never seen "breakfast appetizers" before, but we thought we'd try these out. They're delicious! I'll attach a picture so you can see how neat they look.

Waffles - My nephew finished his plate completely for probably the first time in his 5 year old life. He LOVED them.

Veggie omelette - I asked for the veggie omelette with feta cheese instead of whatever it came with. It was delicious!

Chicken sausage - This was just "OK", probably not something I'd order again, particularly given how filling the omelette is.

Eggs Benedict - My fiance usually gets this and loves it. Yesterday was an off day as he said his egg was overcooked, but most of the time he thinks it's flawless.

OMG French Toast - This was french toast w/ mascarpone (which I don't think was in there?), candied walnuts, and chopped bacon. My sister was quite happy with this.

Service - The service here is always superb. Any substitution we ask for are always made. One time I mentioned I didn't want an English Muffin and the waitress offered me more potatoes or fruit. Coffee refills are fast and we get a pitcher of water at the table so we're never waiting. Everyone is always very friendly.

The other thing I love about Turning Point is that it's in a great shopping center. When we finished our meal yesterday we walked over to Learning Express to pick up a toy for my nephew. Sometimes we go to the bookstore after. It's so nice to mosey around after a very satisfying meal and support local businesses.
name: Rachel

text: This was a gigantic miss!!! My gut told me when they give you 1000 points on open table to go there that it's probably struggling. I'm not sure if they were struggling but it was not good. The male host wore a dress with calf high black socks and black shoes. The female host us were a lovely skirt and top with combat boots. Most of the staff also wear combat boots. It was offputting. The ambience of the restaurant was lovely of very nice dining atmosphere. I even found a spot that had a plug for my iPad. Wi-Fi worked and that's a huge plus. The nettle toast was sold hard by the waitress but they forgot to toast the bread so it was more like nettle slop. The cache Pepe missed on almost all counts. The worst of the three dishes however was the main course the lamb Milanese. It tasted like a mix between chicken livers chicken fried steak and absolutely no lamb whatsoever. The rice that came with it was also a mess. I would not repeat in case you were wondering. Seem more like an overpriced tourist trap trying to make some kind of statement but did not know how to put a high-quality ingredients together and make a coherent dish. Also if you go you're going to have to park in the CBD and we all know how problematic that can be. Nothing like going to dinner coming back in finding out the city may have towed your car! That happens a lot in New Orleans! It didn't happen to me this time so I guess I have something to be grateful for
name: David

text: Amazing Nachos! So fresh and perfectly balanced. Cant wait to try more delicious food from here!
name: Sara

text: The staff seemed tired but still polite. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Price felt a touch high for what it was. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
Saw the many reviews on yelp and decided to give this place a try. Immediately when walking in, a waitress told me to wait for a table that they were in the middle of cleaning up and said that I was able to get seated there with my boyfriend after. A few moments later, another waitress told us to sit at a small table towards the back of the restaurant. We wanted the bigger table because it is more convenient for us and the first waitress had told us before hand that we would be seated there. When my boyfriend told the lady that the other waitress told us we could have the bigger table she told us that we weren't able to because that table was reserved already for another party. But after arguing for a bit, we got the table anyway. Moral of the story, the service was shitty. 

We ordered the Beef Brisket Noodle Soup with Pork and Chives dumplings. The food was amazing. The dumplings were an appetizer but we ate it throughout at meal and towards the end, the bottom of the dumplings were still lightly crispy and not soggy. The meat inside of the dumplings were juicy and the vinegar soy sauce that it came with complimented the dish immensely. Moving on to the reason why we came here, their infamous hand drawn noodles. Yes, these noodles were great especially with the warm soup that it came with, perfect for a chilly winter night. The portion size is huge, I got full after eating 1/3rd of my noodles and I was not able to finish it at all. My only complaint is that the soup is a bit too oily, but that would not stop me from getting this again. The beef brisket is so tender it kind of just melts in your mouth as you chew. You can tell that the noodles are hand pulled in house from the texture and taste of it. I wish the noodles were a bit more al dente but it was still good soft. 

FYI this is a cash only restaurant.
name: Emily

text: Needed a brunch stop on a Saturday morning. We were the only customers. Service was fast but the food was a bit too greasy for my taste. Price and portions were good.
name: Barb

text: My friends and I were looking for places around Reno to try new food. We've been here about twice now and we absolutely love it. I enjoy their vegetarian dishes, especially the Mesir Wat, which is lentils cooked with spices. I look forward to coming back and trying the rest of their dishes. text:
Um, what's up Idaho? I gave this a shot thinking it was fun to try something that doesn't exist back home but yikes I wish I didn't. There is no darn way in heck this is a 4.5 Star spot. I have to balance the scales here so I'm being a bit harsh. 

Food tasted fine enough; most things were frozen between meats and veggies. One type of noodle so I skipped it since I'm gluten free and they were ramen noodles. Sauces looked and tasted watered down; the peanut sauce was almost clear liquid.

The restaurant was dirty, almost all the tables along the wall we were seated needed to be bussed. We got our food cooked and at the table faster than the drink order we placed before putting our bowls together. 

If I was local and for some reason craving this I'd take it to go; but I'm guessing pretty much anywhere is better than here. Sorry folks. This Cali girl was not impressed.

text: This is the worst example of what your chain is. The service was very bad. It was obvious that cleanliness was as far from the minds of the employees as the customers were. The ONLY good thing about this place was the gentleman that made our food.

name: Matt

text: Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Definitely coming back. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
Came here on a busy Saturday night. Aside from the long wait time to get seated, everything else was fast and delicious.

Saturday night at a lot of places have long wait times though so I don't count it against the restaurant. Just nature of the beast :)

They had a nice seating area outside and if the weather is nice, it truly isn't bad just lounging outside and people watching while waiting to be called in.

text: Not impressed at all with their pizza. It seems to focused on gimmicks - eating contest, 30" pizzas, large gumball machines...  The product was just not very good. We had Pizza, meatballs and wings and was not wowed by any of them. It was ladies night, so after you paid for your food, you had to go to the bar and wait 5 mins for someone to serve you, then pay separate instead of being able to order and pay once. Stand in line for food and pay, then stand in line for bar drinks and pay. Not to mention being charged incorrectly and having to question it and have the charge fixed. The tea is bag in a box and not brewed tea, which is gross if you drink tea, but they have a nice wine list.
name: KC

text: Overall this place was pretty great. My friends and I tried it while visiting Nola over the weekend. Great atmosphere and food. Also, they have bottomless mimosas for $18 which is not bad if you have a few. The wait was long, and you have to make a reservation to remotely be sat though. The guest seemed really nice although the staff seemed angry or upset. I get it, you're busy but it's also an establishment that we pay good money for. I paid for my friends and I so it was around $118 so I wish the staff would have been a bit more courteous. I will say that I'm giving this place a 4 overall because once we found seats at the bar the bartender was nice, attentive, and overall gave good service. It's also getting a 4 because of the environment and the bottomless mimosas! I'd definitely try it if you're in nola but make reservations days ahead!
name: Joseph

text:
I stopped by here with a friend on a Saturday afternoon after dropping someone off at the airport. We were both starving and looking for a place that had great food and great beer. The Raven was a perfect choice!

ATMOSPHERE: The exterior is a bit deceiving because the entire building is painted black and kind of looks like a dingy bar. There is a decent amount of parking and the parking lot is open to another strip mall which makes for more spots. The entrance is located on the side of the building which also makes you wonder what you are going to walk into! But once inside, the decor is themed to fit an Edgar Allen Poe poem - dark and classy. The food prep area is open to view and there are two sections for seating: one with low tables and a bar area with hightops. The bathrooms are small but clean and located right by the entrance. 

DRINK: One of the main reasons we came here for of course! And did not disappoint! This restaurant is part of the Barley Mow Brewery family and a local let us in on a secret...Sea Drift is their rebranded name. I had a Double IPA called Dead Man's Fingers by this new Brewery and it was awesome, especially at $5 for a full pour! The Raven is focused on Barley Mow and Sea Drift brews at the moment but also have several guest taps which are priced right too. During happy hour, house beers are half off!! They have small pours too if you want a taster instead of a whole pour. Full bar and great cocktail menu also available. 

FOOD: I was hoping the fried olives would still be on the menu, but they were gone :( 
I've read other reviews and it seems the menu changes often so I would recommend to call ahead if you have your heart set on something. My friend and I split a Queso Quattro pizza which had olive oil, garlic, mozzarella, parmesan, fontina and chevre ($15). The size of the pie was large enough for both of us to eat and take home leftovers. SO much flavor and it really hit the spot!! All of their pizzas sounded amazing. I heard the couple behind me mention that the Chipotle Bacon Mac & Cheese that was on special was the best mac and cheese they've ever had in their life. The menu has plenty of vegetarian options as well and overall unique ingredients. 

Great service, great food, great beer and reasonable prices. I will definitely be back to try something new on the menu!
name: Amy

text:
This is a great place with a veritable smorgasbord of food.  All you can eat and believe me, that is what people do. EAT, EAT, EAT.  It's not a 5 star restaurant but the service is great and the food is prepared and non-stop.  

If they don't have it, wait 5 minutes and the plate will be replaced and more food will be on the way.   

I enjoy it from time to time.   I recommend this place for good food, and family friendly atmosphere.
name: Wayne

text: It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. For the price I expected more than this. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text:
This place is really cool! You could spend and entire day here if you really wanted to! We walked in to their tasting room and purchased their $10 tasting which included 10 moonshine shots of pre-selected flavors and a 12oz draft beer of any one of their YeeHaw beers.

They have a huge gift shop with all different kids of merch and all of their moonshines and whiskeys. Too bad I didn't bring a checked bag so I could bring some home! We're in one of the states that they don't mail to so bummer for us!

Their main bar area has a stage with a huge projection screen for tv viewing. In that area is their taco restaurant. The outside is really cool, they have lots of games and a separate room with an arcade. They also have a display on the history of moonshine making.

Their beers are reasonably priced at $6 and $4 during Happy Hour. Their employees are extremely present and quick to clean up after guests that are done. I highly recommend making this a stop on your trip to Nashville!
name: Nicole

text: Excellent, unpretentious restaurant. I have enjoyed two visits so far. Try the Chicken Enchiladas in green sauce. Very reasonable prices. Based on the number of reviews, highly positive ones at that, Rosales has not been unrecognized in the swarm of Mexican restaurants in town. Certainly worth a visit.
name: Marvin

text: Tried the milkshakes. Worse ever. Nothing mike than chocolate milk really. Real runny. Took forever to get our order but food was decent
name: Gene

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.

The owner is constantly in house waiting tables with his staff which to me speaks volumes! He has even been known to whip up more of a dish if they are out for the day! text:

Shortly after moving to Speedway I called and ordered a PMS pizza, got some breadsticks and ask for recommendations on the sides and the team gave me all of their favorites on the list to choose from for my family to enjoy.

After making the selections everything was made fresh and delivered to my door within 25 minutes! It was lightning fast and very hot without any complaints at all. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Definitely coming back. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. For the price I expected more than this. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: The food was ok. Texture of the vegan chicken was kind of rubbery weird, but pretty realistic from what I can remember. We ordered takeout and we did not get any of the sides or sauces we ordered. We ordered the combo with boba tea and they tried giving us cokes instead. We had to argue with them to give us the boba we already paid for. I'm not impressed and wouldn't go back. The portions are large.
name: Amani

text: Had a large party here on a Friday night. 14 people....I had made a reservation 6-8 weeks in advance. Table wasn't ready when we got there, but they got it together quickly. Drink service was slow- in my opinion you need to have an extra server or helper on hand when you're going to have a large party in your establishment so things run smoothly and your guests aren't waiting for a drink... and their food order to be taken. (Unless of course you're not good for large parties- don't take the reservation). Drinks were great, everyone loved them. Food was really good as well. A few people had the burgers, coconut shrimp, ahi poke, and they all really enjoyed their food. They all did mention how spicy the food was! And it was! But our family loves spicy so that was a plus for us... but be cautious when ordering and ask for possibly less heat if you're not a fan of it. The waitress was nice, food and drinks very good. One star away from five because of the slow service which put a small kink in the otherwise nice evening.
name: Alex

text: Came here for dinner after friends recommended we check out this beautiful landmark. My husband and I were pleasantly surprised that the service and food were just as wonderful as the setting. It's an old historic hotel with a small but cozy dining room and bar. From start to finish the service was on point, (I believe the servers name was Jaime?) but he was accommodating without being intrusive, and always within eyesight for anything we needed. We started with a refreshing yellow fin tar tar and split the roasted mushrooms and melt in your mouth short rib for our entrees. We were too stuffed for desert but can't wait to come back and try them all. The drinks were also made perfectly, bartenders know how to make a great classic manhattan and I'm usually quite picky about these things. Wine list was also great and my husband really enjoyed his cab franc.  Overall great experience in stunning atmosphere, one of Philly's best hidden gems!
name: Jennifer

text:
This is my absolute favorite place in Tampa. I bring all my guests here - multiple times if possible. The pastries, coffee, empanadas, oh man! All so good!!

We esp love the fruit filled muffins, coconut and apple pastries, almond crescents, and more.  The Cuban sandwiches are also good. The people who work there are so kind and fast which is awesome bc the place is so busy.  I just love it there. And you can order online so you can skip the line and pick things up when you're able.

text:

text: We were fortunate enough to sit at the chef's kitchen counter & able to enjoy the action going on. Extremely welcoming and friendly staff. On special that night was a grilled corvina (fish) filet on top of a scrumptious black bean corn cake & roasted red onion petals. SO DAMN DELICIOUS! Dessert had us moaning in pleasure with the olive oil almond cake. Chef Paquette knows what she's doing!

text: Well I hate leaving negative reviews but this place is ridiculous. It's not a huge place and on a Friday night the place is NOT packed. We (party of 3) waited for over an hour for 2 appetizers and then another 45mins after that for dinner. Honestly no matter how great your food is (which they are not, mediocre at best) it's not worth the aggravation. By the way we weren't the only table complaining tonight, there were 5 or 6 other tables that were super upset because they all waited a long time for their food. text: How do they fit so much good flavor into their food? I had the avocado Piada (did not add an additional meat) and it was amazing! Normally with these wrap type sandwiches I end up picking off a lot of the extra breading, but even the actual wrap was delicious. The most amazing thing was that it was all super cheap for what you get. This would be a great date location or to grab some delicious and fast takeout. I'm already planning my next visit!

text:
This place made me wonder if I've actually ever had a donut before today. Fresh and delicious. Me and my snacking companions had a variety of donuts and all were amazing. (Including maple bacon and the seasonal apple crisp)I also had a sausage and cheese croissant which was super tasty as well. 
In addition to all that goodness we were given some free glazed donut holes and got to sample a fancy flavor they were going to try out. The store itself was very clean and well taken care of, the staff was very friendly and helpful.
