text:
Italian food is one of my favorites, my mom is Italian so I was raised surrounded by authentic cooking. With that being said, and how we live in a small town that doesn't have a lot of Italian restaurants besides pizza, Caffe Torino just went to the top of the list on my favorite Italian food. I do plan to go back and order pasta soon, so I will update my review as time goes on. 
As you enter the restaurant, there's a large dining room with comfortable booths and tables. To the left, a large bar which looked like full service from where I was sitting. This would be a great place to meet friends for a drink or some appetizers. There was a nice ambiance. As soon as we walked in we were greeted, and the restaurant was fairly empty so we were told to sit anywhere we like. We ordered two appetizers, the Calamari and the Caprese salad with shrimp and prosciutto added. Someone had posted a pic of this dish, it's not on the menu but I was able to show the server a picture of it so she knew what it was. While waiting for our apps, we were served fresh focaccia bread with olive oil and butter. So good!
And now, the appetizers arrived. 
If you're a calamari lover, this place is spot on. Crispy, tender perfect breading, and there were delicious pieces of fried zucchini or onion as well. 
The Caprese was delicious, fresh shrimp, sliced prosciutto tomato mozzarella and basil, all those flavors are so perfect together. 
The only thing I missed seeing on the menu was ravioli, but if the pasta is as good as I hope that won't matter. See you next time Caffe Torino! Ciao.
name: Lara

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Would absolutely visit again. Food was fresh and service was quick. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not bad for a quick meal. Not sure though.
name: User

text: My wife and I have eaten there five or six times since it re opened. Today we were there with our granddaughters. We are only rating breakfast. We have not had a bad meal yet. Find everybody to be very pleasant and food is definitely a step up from some of the other local places we go to. Wish them well!
name: Dennis

text: Very friendly staff and the best budget sushi lunch special around. 2 rolls soup or salad $6.99 can't beat it.
name: Raylan

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Glad we tried it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text:
We're in town from Cleveland Ohio and we looked up seafood restaurants via Safari. Best
Decision! Great place! Authentic & friendly people!!
name: Tenayesha

text: The service is slow and very unorganized. Waited 12 minutes to get coffee, brought water after asking two times. The manager had to take our order as the waitress never appeared at the table, she was too busy gabbing with her co-workers. Food was fine, but not worth the poor service.
name: Benjamin

text: Spent $140..... wasted money. The market price grouper dinner was supposed to be fresh caught. It was $26, and it was tough and overcooked. The bottom of the blackened fish was like leather and as for being blackened, it was not.... it barely had any flavor, very bland. This blackened grouper is by far the worst I ever had, and the clam chowder had big pieces of potatoes that were hard and crunchy not to mention the young blond waitress was clueless (maybe not trained well) that had to be told all the time to bring things to us that she would forget to bring. The well drinks were very weak....barely any vodka in it. The food took a long time to come out for my family. I will never return.

text:
Love Helm in Kensington. One of our favorite, go to restaurants in Philadelphia. 

The menu changes and EVERY time it's amazing all around. Don't sleep on the sides, they're fantastic.

Highly recommended

text:
My favorite Mexican spot in King of Prussia. We came on a Friday night (who wants to cook?no one) and it was super busy. Understandable. 

We waited about twenty minutes and then got our table. Their tables are pretty big, so for a party of two skinny people we had plenty of space. 

I ordered big margarita. Unfortunately it was pretty weak and I wish they added more alcohol. That is why I took one star off. The drink prices are decent. Then we ordered guacamole and it was definitely worth watching how it was made from scratch. Guac is really awesome at this place. It is never enough. They we got tacos al pastor and fajita for two. It was delicious! 

The waitress was checking on us periodically without being super annoying. It is a definitely a spot to check out when you are in the area. Bring fam or friends and don't forget to order guac!

text: So tasty! The shrimp and halibut tacos were so flavorful and although on the pricier side, it came with a lot of food, worth the price.

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up.
name: User

text: We are staying at Weeki Wachee and wanted to get out for a bite to eat. It is a cute/simple outdoor place. We met some nice people and ordered appetizers, calamari was good, poppers etc.. everything was hot and good. Nice music to hang out! We will come back and try something else on the menu.

text: We started with the delicious buffalo cauliflower bites which were the perfect blend of hot and cool with the bleu cheese. My tilapia was cooked to perfection with risotto. I tried the Short Ribs and they were very tender. I'll be going back soon to enjoy the charming atmosphere and try the other dishes.

text: I was super excited to see 312 open this Woodbine location. We had never been before and really appreciated the server telling us up front how long the deep dish pizzas take. We decided to enjoy our wait and ordered a couple rounds from the great beer list to pass the time. They didn't give us a copy of the vegan/vegetarian menu when we were seated - maybe you have to ask for it? - but I had done my research online and knew that there was a vegan Reuben calling my name. It was just a delicious as I had hoped. My boyfriend ordered the Capone deep dish pizza and really enjoyed it too (all week long - the thing was huge which led to plenty of leftovers!). We will definitely be back (maybe sooner rather than later - thinking about that Reuben again is making me hungry!)

text: Union Loafers is one of my favorite restaurants in STL.  They make simple, delicious.  Great staff and always a great time in there.  I don't know what to recommend because it's all so good.  The Cuban sandwich is always great but their pizza is actually my favorite in STL. It's HUGE and the seasoning is just right.  Go here and you won't be disappointed!  Also - don't forget to get a loaf of bread to go on your way out.  I would place a reservation!

text: amazing salad, friendly employees, nice and clean... just feels like home. 10/10 would recommend.

Thanks again for a great lunch

So fun and always a wonder to go in and explore! Great service- not a
Lot of parking. Excellent desserts

text:
Totally Wonderful Experience - - - My wife and I dropped in on Sunday evening (10/13/2019) at about 7 PM. The place was packed! We waited near the bar for about 20 minutes so I would recommend you make reservations. We had a house specialty citrus infused vodka drink that was crisp and refreshing (and strong) $13.00, while we waited. One of the waitstaff casually answered out inquiry regarding how busy the establishment was and concurred that it was ALWAYS busy especially on Sunday evening. The restaurant itself is small and intimate. The hustle bustle of patrons & waitstaff just adds to the ambiance. We were actually greeted by the proprietor who we were told was normally at another location.

So let's start talking about the food. I asked the waiter (Mark) to order his own recommendation for an appetizer. His choice was the Oysters Rockefeller ($13.95) - Fried Oysters with sambuca braised spinach then baked with parmesan cheese in a lemon cream sauce. --- --- --- Delicious! Layers of flavoring, melts in your mouth. They have perfected this dish and I can only tell you it is a great start to you dining experience. 

Next was the house salad. I had the blue cheese vinaigrette dressing and my wife had the ranch. It was accompanied with fresh hot baked bread and a garlic infused soft whipped butter. The house salad is included in the price of your main course. It was crisp, fresh, and nicely presented. Nothing noteworthy but it is something that could easily distract from a meal, which it did not.

Let's move on to the entrees. I will start with mine. I had the Canneloni! ($22.95) - WOW! Homemade pasta stuffed with ground baby veal, pureed spinach and parmesan cheese baked on a bed of alfredo cream and topped with a red sauce. This is obviously a signature dish or at least should be. I will return to have this again and soon. No, it is not healthy, it will clog your arteries, raise your cholesterol, and most likely shorten shorten your life expectancy but it is exactly why you go out to an Italian Restaurant. At least one person at your table must have this dish. Don't forget to ask for more bread and dip it in that delightful sauce. Let's just say my plate was clean.

My wife had the Parmesan Crusted Chicken ($19.95) pan sauteed and served on a bed of creamed spinach finished with a champagne beurre blanc. She enjoyed it and almost finished it all. I tried it and went right back to my Canneloni. It was a waiter recommended dish, it was good but I think we will try something else on our next visit.

Finally, we had a bottle of  2014 Napa Valley Merlot ($50.00) We never order a whole bottle but enjoyed this wine as a wonderful accompaniment to this outstanding meal. My recommendation is two thumbs up, if you like Italian food then by all means go here for the food, the aatmosphere, and the welcoming and well informed wait staff.
name: Robert

text: I just came from the mfing juicy blue! And that mf juicy!!!!! I got poopoo platter, it's was really 3 different meals! And when I say it was hmm hmm good! I'll wrestle a bear about them dam snow crabs in Cajun mild
name: Tarrence

text:
This place was put on my radar because of its ties to Tennessee State University and the raving reviews on Facebook . I have a daughter who attends TSU and she raves on how great it is. This is a big compliment since she is a very picky eater. This was our first stop when we arrived for homecoming. Before reviewing the menu, I went to the restroom , I had to ask myself " When did you fall in love with Hip-Hop?". The decor in the restroom had me reminiscing of my college days in the 90s. 

It was time to finally order our food, I became overwhelmed because I couldn't make up my mind if I want a Slim or Husky. I chose a Husky and was so glad afterwards I did!! The amount of topping choices are endless which is great because you don't have to get the same typical pizza when ordering from chain restaurants. 

My entire family ordered Husky's size pizza  and we were completely satisfied. The only issue I have is the lack of "seating " but after being on the highway for 4.5 hours that is very minor.  Keep up the good work, will return on my next visit.
name: Marie

text:
I brought my daughter here for a special lunch, and it exceeded every expectation! I don't know why she got in her head that she wanted to try it, but it was such a nice treat for both of us.

2 waiters introduced themselves, took our drink order and brought bread (soft pretzel sticks, and sourdough bread). Yum.

We ordered the Prime Sushi roll, which was filled with tempura shrimp, a little cream cheese, and a little avocado. The roll was topped with thin carpaccio and eel sauce. It was divine. At $19, it was pricey for a sushi roll, but it was delicious, and you don't go to Ocean Prime for a cheap meal.

I ordered the seafood cobb salad and it was so gorgeous I may have gasped when I saw it! It tasted just as good - really loaded up with lobster and shrimp! The proportions of all the toppings was perfect. My only complaint is that there were only 2 little pieces of bacon on it. Which I only know because the bacon was so good I wished there was more! I may not ever order anything else there again, it was so delicious. 

My daughter's kids meal was a 5 oz. Filet, with applesauce and whipped potatoes for $12. The adult filet mignon is $39, so I thought this was a pretty great deal. She is a foodie, and said her steak was delicious. It was cooked as ordered, and I tried her potatoes and loved them too.

Service was good and food came at a reasonable pace. Before tip our check was about $65. Perfect place to have a special lunch date!
name: Brooke

text:
Our family came in for dinner this evening. Our milkshakes came out quick and were delicious. The employee at the register was very friendly. We ordered two medium well burgers. One cheeseburger (the #2 on their menu) and a bacon cheeseburger (forgot which number). 

The #2 was missing the lettuce and tomato and was very undercooked, really red all throughout. 

The bacon cheeseburger was missing the bacon and was undercooked as well. 

We ordered the mix of french fries, both the regular and sweet potato were soggy. No crisp at all. 

We did not wait long for our food but made the mistake of leaving without double checking everything. Although the customer service was good, I was worried about eating my burger since it was very undercooked. It's a shame because our last experience was much better which brought us back.
name: Valeria

text: Best noodles around mayfair! I would definitely recommend the Mount Qi beef noodles! Mild spicy! Squeeze a bit of lemon!
name: Patrick

text:
We pretty much go here every Saturday or Sunday. The weekend before last we went both days. Everything was delicious as always. Always get the apple fritters which are to DIE for! Also get a couple glazed twists and my son gets a couple of the decorated ones (usually smiley faces) 
That being said, the younger African American girl (the one with the longest braids) has a HORRIBLE attitude! She glared at everyone both days that walked in the door. When we ordered she would not make any eye contact and when I asked her a question she wouldn't speak up or look. Just grumbled under her breath. Not someone who she be at the front of the house of an establishment.
name: Laura

text: Spectacular. Came here alone and received some of the best service. Ate at the bar and was welcomed and patiently served all night. Took it course by course and everything was delicious. From the crawfish pie, to the gumbo, to the oysters. Everything was amazing. Hard to pick a favorite.... actually it's the andouille sausage in the gumbo. Amazing, could eat it all day. It wasn't just the food that makes Cochon so great. It's the whole dinning experiences. The wait staff was kind in recommending dishes, checking in to see if I needed anything and just genuine.  Can't wait to return.
name: Daniel

text:
We had reservations for a special celebratory dinner back in July. Sullivan's has an awkward mix of fine dining, casual, and corporate touches.  The meal pacing was genteel, which I liked, though there were indications it was due to lack of staffing than a desire to give us ample time.  Our server was gracious, though seemed wary of overstepping corporate boundaries of permissible casualness.  I'm all for the austere formality of the rarity of fine dining, but this wasn't quite fine dining enough, so our eventual banter with the server felt stilted and disingenuous.  I would have preferred, given the atmosphere, of someone who bowed and gently walked away, or the opposite, a "hey, ya'll, how we doin' tonight?"  but this was somewhere in between.  I didn't sense a pride in the restaurant from the server, but more of a wilted obedience.
Corporate steakhouses are commonplace (not like L.G.s in Palm Springs, which cannot be matched), and there's a typical ambience one expects, but the standards fell below some other steakhouses.  I had a much more impressive experience at the Denver airport believe it or not, at Elways.  Here's a steakhouse that sticks to its high standard regardless of where it is.  Airport?  A challenge, sure, but we'll make it happen.  And they did.  Their servers stand behind their moniker and proudly represent Elways, and there's a confidence in their brand.  And there's a formal yet friendly approach that works. And when the food comes out, one can see there's lots to be proud of.  The confidence is there, and when the food comes out, it's proven.
So now to the "meat" of my review, which is the food at Sullivan's -- and what's more importantly, the steak.  Firstly, it was meager.  I received a disappointingly thin ribeye that was overly peppered and salted, and fatty.  Sure, it was listed at a 16 oz rib eye, but I wanted something better than what I get at Safeway.   I was hoping it would fill me, but I finished it quickly and left the unedible fatty parts to the side.  It was probably the most disappointing steak I've ever had in a steakhouse.  Now, Flemings hasn't maintained their service quality lately, but I've never had a lame steak there before -- I mean, the product is still the star, as it should be.  The sides were not memorable.  I've had juicier, thicker mushrooms before, and the broccoli was the definition of dull, if not al dente taken up a notch.

I did like that the server's crumber was active, again, a touch of formality, and we had a cleaned table for our rich and filling banana's foster.  You see, I was hungry because the main failed to satisfy.  We also got a cute   photo that with a signed frame for our celebration, a nice, more corporate touch.  These were good moments, though I'm not sure I would come back.  I really wanted a good steak, no matter which one I choose, and lacking that, what else need I desire?
name: John

text: I've been here several times and the food is ok but the service has always been terrible. Tonight, the food was mediocre and the service was terrible.  Not sure if I'll be back.
name: Lisa

text: We love this place. It's a great place to have a nice dinner. Food is creative and always delicious. The service is always good. This is a welcoming place where you can have a nice dinner and enjoy some creative foods as well,  a bit of a twist.  New Orleans inspired.  For today we started out with the bacon popcorn. Very tasty. Then we had the New York strip and fries oh sooo good. The garlic encrusted prime rib also pretty amazing. For desert the mixed berry tart with marshmallow fluff and balsamic reduction. A perfect ending. Not overly sweet just pretty perfect. Their twist on a mimosa well worth trying. A great dinner, again.
name: Ileana

text: This place is great to grab the homemade version of a egg/cheese/bacon sandwich. Tons of options, 5 different breads, any way you want it.  Fast, reasonable prices, and near center town.  The Cheesecake was , hands down, the best I have had in my life.  Nice surprise, good eats
name: Michael

text: I purchased an Elmo cupcake to take to my grandson for his birthday! To say they sold me a stale cupcake is an understatement, the cupcake was so hard the candle could barely be put on it. The girl behind the counter should have known  not to sell it. I knew the moment I lifted out of the box. Maybe they just don't care.  If your buying ask if the product is fresh!
name: Carolyn

text: This is a great breakfast restaurant. It really surprised me because I've been a long time Cracker Barrel fan. Some of the food here is way outside my normal breakfast routine but has been a great alternative to regular eggs and bacon, but they have that too. You've got to try the A M Super Foods Bowl. Coconut milk chia seed pudding with fresh bananas, berries, blackberry preserves and housemade granola. Served with whole grain artisan toast topped with almond butter and Maldon sea salt. Seriously good and filling! Also the banana granola pancakes are excellent. I had one and was stuffed. Also, my waitress Jamie let me borrow her phone to call my breakfast date because I had forgotten my phone. Thank you Jamie. Most plates are between $8 and $11.
name: Robert

text: A typical East Coast Dinner. Great menue, lovely pastries in South Philly favorite. Louise our server was very attentive and friendly
name: Gory

text: The pizza was very good and the women at front had to have been the nicest most accommodating person on the planet.
name: Hugh

text: I went for brunch on a Sunday afternoon. I wanted to check it out because of reviews and ratings. I ordered Chefs Strada, because I'm a quiche, frittatas type but that was a big mistake. Most brunch menus offer something similar to a traditional breakfast with a unique twist for those persons that don't get too far out of the box. The wait was extremely long, for the type of food that was ordered. I also noticed I smelled like food when I left. Maybe not a good exhaust system, I'm not sure what that was about. The restrooms could use more lighting as well. Complimentary pastry, can't remember proper name for them but they were great. I might try dinner to see if it will be a different experience. I would like to have a five star experience, but brunch was not impressive.

text: Our group had brunch this past weekend. The atmosphere is decent, but we were quite disappointed with both food and the service. From start to finish the service was not very good - it took forever to get drinks (and refills) and the waiter was a ghost throughout brunch. One of the people at our table had the pizza, which was really good, but the rest of us were largely disappointed with the brunch items. Very bland and the food came out room temperature.

text: The food from appetizers (shrimp rolls, buffalo cauliflower, oysters), to main course (lamb chops), to desserts (all of them)- was a great culinary experience. Quality of food was very good. The only downside is that it was a bit loud for a large party to talk. Overall, great spot

text: Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.

text: Bad experience there.  Ordered coffee and simple toasted bagel with butter.   My toasted bagel sat and sat while the one person helping people took new orders.  I finally had to ask for my bagel and another woman begrudgingly buttered my bagel and I had to say three times not to wrap it for take out.  And bagel was soggy.   Won't go back.  Used to be so good there.

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Kind of landed in the middle for me. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..

text: Cheap beer, solid diner food, calmer than the insanity of broadway and had good old school country.  Take a load off here between nashvegas bars and you'll be glad you stopped by.

text: Give them the very limited amounts of legitimate seafood options in the area, the boiling is a great place. Their prices are comparable with what you'd expect at a creole/Cajun restaurant and I thought the food was really good. If you aren't in the mood for making a mess with a boil, they have a good sushi menu as well.

text: This is my go to place whenever I want good food and beer in Carpinteria. Nice craft beer selection (I really like the Saison). Very good food ( try the Ortega burger) It's a small vibrant place with a nice patio area and bar. The service is really good too!

text: I dont really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The staff seemed tired but still polite. It was crowded but still moved along. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. For the price I expected more than this. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..

text: Azian is my favorite restaurant in Tucson!! Everything is amazing-except the service. Prices are unbeatable and the actual food is great!! However, waiting for your food to come can take anywhere from 30-55 min. Sushi takes the longest, while the fried rice comes out in less than 10 min. Great place if you're not in a rush!!!

text: Ended up here pretty late, maybe around 9:30, because everything else nearby had a wait. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Overall, a strong experience. Food was good and came out fast. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Cute little hidden spot in Tampa, it's unique and vintage and I used to enjoy their pizza. It used to be a spot that my boyfriend and I loved to go to. However, the service is AWFUL. Our server took our drink and food order, and never returned for the rest of our stay. She passed our table several times and didn't even look in our direction, she didn't ask how our food was, she didn't refill our drinks, every time we needed something my boyfriend had to chase her down. I didn't get her name but she was tall, wearing bright pink lipstick and darkish hair pulled back in a bun. Didn't even smile at all. I'm a server so I know what bad service looks like. The pizza was mediocre this visit too.

text: Not mucht to say , substainable seafood. Fresh produce. Awsome wait staff. Tons of beer. My kinda place to watch my football .
name: Jon-David

text: Had a good experience here.   Food was solid, especially the shrimp, sausage, corn.   Krab itself was good, but not my personal highlight.  It was hard to determine where the line to order was at first, but food came out quickly once we got our order in.   Only real negative item was they didn't have any of the shell crackers with our meal, when I asked them for some, the response was- "we don't have any clean right now".    So I was definitely leaning towards a 4 star review here, but the owner stopped by our table to say hi and checked on our experience.   Seemed to be a very nice guy who cares about his business, asked for feedback etc.   Couldn't leave anything less than a 5 star at that point.   We will definitely be back soon!

text:
My Mom is in the process of moving to this area.

After a hectic day, we were craving pizza and decided to give Joto's a try.

I figured since they have been around since 1974, they must put out a pretty decent pizza here.

I was right!  Their pizza has an excellent crust, decent sauce, plenty of cheese, and they do not skimp on the toppings.

It was exactly the sort of pizza experience were we hoping for, to end our busy Saturday.

I look forward to my next visit...

text: Hands down the nicest and most accommodating hotel in Nashville. They went over and beyond making our stay memorable for our anniversary. I just can't say enough good things about it. Hopefully we will splurge and stay here again for our 10 year Anniversary.
name: Tabitha

text: Such a cute place! Customer service was on point. Food was great. Lots of choices. Good location. Will def come back :)
name: Marianne

text:
I'm giving this bar a 2 star rating because I got immensely sick after one ONE DRINK here. I came here hoping to love it. It seemed a bit mysterious and quirky. Not a ton of info about it online. 

Upon entering I was digging it. Interestingly decorated. They have fish bowl drinks. Bartenders were friendly enough. 

But then I had one drink and though I felt fine at the time, about 20 minutes later was sick as a dog. Like maybe the sickest I've ever been from drinking...except I only had the one drink. I ended up having to ditch my plans for the rest of the night and go home. Not sure if my drink was drugged, or this drink was just INSANELY strong or what, but I am hesitant to ever go back.
name: Emily

text:
Very interesting concept of a restaurant, with lots of options, whether you want something savory or sweet. I met up with some friends there for lunch, and it was a cool place to grab a bite together.

Parking is plentiful - you can park on the street, or you can park in the garage behind the stores. To get into the restaurant, though, you do need to take the long way around out of the parking garage.

The way it works inside is that you choose the items you want (there are prices there), then when you leave you tell them what you took and pay for it then. Honors system seems to work pretty well there. They have pads that you can borrow to write on so you remember too. There's also a station serving coffee.

Prices are a tad high, but the quality is great, and it's just a real nice spot to hang out without feeling rushed or anything. I'd check it out again in the future!
name: Will

text: Don't waste your time. They can't get the order right. Mediocre at best. Used to be my favorite place for take out. This place has become the worst place in town for food. My recommendation is to go to Roman Delight on Street Road in Warminster.
name: Sandy

text:
Stopped in with my Yelp crew for International Supper Club. My first, might I add. I am fairly certain I was the least adventurous of the group, even so, I thoroughly enjoyed my experience. 

I kicked my meal off right with their red blend. It was so delicious, I had to have two! I skipped an appetizer and went straight for the gusto. I got green curry. The taste was to die for. I also LOVED that they gave so much rice. I am one of those folks who's just always still hungry, so I loved having a huge portion. Only problem was, when I mixed in the rice the dish could've had more sauce. Otherwise, it was perfect and yum-city! 

Loved the space too, it was modern and very clean. It's pretty tiny, but they easily accommodated our group of 14.  They service was great for basically one server in the whole restaurant. If it were any busier tho, I feel like they'd need more staff. Overall, had a great experience and was glad to be introduced to this little gem!
name: Max

text: Awesome food!! Everything that we tried was awesome... all the food was well prepared tasty and very good quality.. the shrimp roll was plentiful and tasty but the very best was the parpadelle pasta with duck!! Very well executed!! The service was quite good even though they were busy !
name: maria

text: I love the idea of this restaurant! They have a great menu, cute decor, low prices, and authentic food. text:
We had made another trip to Philly so that we could have more time in the city as our previous trip was very short. Of course one of the to-dos on our list for this visit was to try another Philly cheesesteak and compare to the previous one we tried from Jim's.

After reading reviews of the restaurants around us, we decided to try Sonny's. There seems to be a lot of controversy (as expected, haha) over who has the best hoagie; but, we went with the one that was mentioned most often online.

The restaurant is located near Center City and is surrounded by other small shops and restaurants. It's a really nice place and was actually one of our favorite places that we visited during our trip.

It's a smaller sized restaurant and has that old school vibe inside. There's not much seating; so, I could see how finding a place to sit might be hard during their busier hours. The food station is set up like many other sandwich shops - they have a glass divider between you and the prep counter/grill. After they take your order, you can see them prepare your sandwich. 

My fiance and I both ordered the cheesesteak, equipped with cheese whiz! That's pretty much what it was, too: steak and cheese whiz on soggy bread. There was so much cheese whiz on the sandwich that I really couldn't taste anything other than that. I think it also contributed to the soggy bread. 

In hindsight, I wish we would've tried the cheesesteak HOAGIE as it comes with lettuce, tomato, red onion, mayo, and cheese. It may have tasted better. We didn't realize there were two types of sandwiches on the menu so that's on us. I do think they should double check with you to make sure you want one or the other - especially for us out-of-towners. That's just a suggestion, though!

Nonetheless, I liked Jim's version of the cheesesteak hoagie much better than Sonny's. It had more flavor and there wasn't an overpowering amount of whiz on it. 

Really, I'm just thinking the cheese whiz steak hoagie thing isn't for me...
name: Chrissy

text:
Went there as a central meeting point.  I got there first, got seated and had to wait about 10 min for a hello from our waitress...she was a creeper, came from somewhere behind me and started talking to me.  (Scared me.  She commented she gets that reaction a lot.). She was quick to get my drink order and our waters in.  Whoever brought my sister's water wasn't paying attention, and put the paper end in her water.  (She wasn't amused when she got there.). The waitress did the creep thing on both my sis and our friend...not sure how she did that with out the others of us seeing her.  I think she tries to do that!

While I was waiting,decided to splurge on the table side guacamole--mainly so my sis could eat it since she has issues with onions.  Came super fast, the gal making was fun.  However, this was her first time.  One of floor managers walked by and told her to cut the avacados in half rather than peeling them.  (She ignored him.) It looked good, but her avocados were not ripe and she forget to add lime so we had lumpy mashed avocado with stingy amount of cilantro salt and other ingredients...seriously like a tiny pinch of what was requested--eventually asked our waitress for a bowl of lemon/lime wedges and added salt to try to correct it. Also because guacamole girl was peeling/separating by hand, rather than cutting and scoopin, our spoon was coated in avocado.  We kept asking ourselves why we kept eating this mess instead of saying something.

The salsa is fair, but the chips are super thin.  It would have been nice to have a refresher while waiting on our food...but was not offered to us until after our food was on the table.  My sis ordered a quesadilla that she was underwhelmed with.  My friend said her burrito was just ok.  I ordered street tacos al pastor--they were decent, but it's hard to mess those up. (Well, the choice of salsa was wrong.)   I would have preferred carnitas but that was only an option for their other tacos.  We ordered a side of coconut cilantro rice, but they were out...early evening on a Thursday and no rice?!? 

Bottom line, they are trying to be upscale shi-she Tex-Mex, to match the Des Peres area, serving common items for twice the price! Nothing extraordinary except higher prices.  Happy hour price onthe Rosie margarita was fair...and a fair marg, not stellar, but not the worst I have had.  Servers need a finesse on issues from water service, not giving customers gooed up serving spoon, or scaring them.

I literally came for the Bloody Mary, but whatever, and I had already started eating the cheese curds. Well damn if the cheese curds were not phenomenal and the dipping sauces were simply delightful. What started out as a disappointing experience was turned around by amazing cheese curds, a super nice server that was dealing with my hangry attitude, and a few glasses of local beer. 

Follow up: I came back the next day and tried the Bloody Mary, and it was pretty damn good. The place was packed on a weekend! Overall I have to say the few things I tried here and the fun, pleasant staff made this a great stop for a snack and drinks.
name: Mia

text:
Not vegan friendly at all. The whole menu is misleading. They have vegan gravy but no vegan biscuit. I'm eating hash browns at a biscuit shop.  Total let down. Probably good food but I'll never know.  Total waste of my morning.  Why offer vegan gravy if you aren't going to offer a vegan biscuit?

However my friend did love all of her food, and she even returned a second time telling me it was again, just as good as the first time.
name: Shannon

text: Some seriously great Honduran fare, as good as any I've had in the New Orleans area.  It's in the boonies a bit, but worth seeking out.  A cozy family dining spot.
name: Victor

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Food was fresh and service was quick. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Only been here twice, but both times that me and my wife (who are total foodies) have been here, we have said this is the best sushi we have had. We have probably been to around 20 sushi joints in Reno and this one is now our favorite and go-to sushi hang out. The mermaid and captain crunch rolls are amazing! The restaurant is always clean and the service is great, friendly servers and chefs that will make you anything you want.
name: Dominic

text: People are being a little dramatic in these comments honestly. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Maybe expectations are just off for some people. It looked better online than it did in person. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: Worst milkshake ever do yourself a favor and don't go there. Taste like a slushy milk with sugar it was truly awful.
name: Emily

text:
Looking for a healthy chicken brought us here to Chicken Nuevo. The location wasn't the greatest. We ended up on the wrong side of the building. Walking in we got greeted. Asked about the coupon we got off their website, the girl looked annoyed and had to call her manager. Wasn't a very friendly welcoming feeling. 
Upon arriving home, the chicken was good but not nothing to talk about. Tortillas were delish!! the Salsa was meh.
name: Marcella

text: Cheesesteaks are amazing. They make their own bread fresh daily! Plenty of steak coded with cheese throughout the sandwich. Going to go out on a limb and call it the best cheesesteak in philly. Pizza is also awesome and a must try!
name: Nick

text: Huge menu. Great pricing. If you're ordering Chinese tonight, don't waste your time or money going anywhere else.
name: Honest

text: My wife and I were introduced to Eva's by our neighbor. We have had breakfast there several times as well as dinner--chicken souvlaki, chicken pot pie, and meatloaf. The food is excellent --that's why we return. And the portions--every time we have had enough for a second dinner. Everything is homemade and made to order. Eva's husband is the chef and Eva runs the front of the restaurant.   She makes everyone welcome and happy to be there. And the soups-- which come with dinner-- are great. All of this at a great price, compared to other restaurants. Don't miss this gem in Dunedin.
name: Ken

text: Swarmed the parlor with our large family but the staff were very attentive to us while also successfully juggling other customers. Staff were friendly and humorous, and entertained us while we waited for everything to be made. Great service and great scoops! I couldn't recommend this place more. Owner is a sweetheart
name: Michael

text: I can't believe that a place that delivers until 4 am is this good across the board. Fast and HOT delivery, we ordered super late three times during our week in NOLA and every time it was delicious. I wonder how many lives this place has saved over the years, I know for sure at least two! (Ours!). Fried green tomatoes are killer, as are the po boys. If you get back to your hotel and realize you've had too many and need some sober up food, this is hands down the place. If you're sober and just want some damn good food brought to your door fast and hot, this is hands down the place.
name: Zachary

text: Pleasantly surprised by this place. Really wasn't sure what the expect when we arrived but highly recommend now. The inside is very cute. The drinks were made quickly and were very good. Overall, a fantastic place.
name: Katie

text: Awesome Cheddar Burger and Shore Lunch. Staff is very friendly. After only a few times coming they know our names and what we want to order. Highly recommend.
name: Tim

text: Service was a struggle... maybe a new waiter? Food came out looking great. Smaller portions for the price. Glad I tried, but not worth the fight with Manchester rd.
name: Jason

text:
We got up early to come here. Didn't know what to expect for a breakfast joint. 
We are the only people in the place! 
The waitress / host was so fun and engaging. 
Lots of baked food! Breads, cookies, cupcakes, cakes! 
They even have some vegan options! 
They have ciders ( angry orchards ) wines, mimosa.
I had chicken fried steak with eggs and potatoes. Amazing! 
Hubby was excited to have biscuits and gravy! (He wanted to have more gravy) 
Kids had pancakes that were so fluffy!!! 
We got a a lot to go for our stay. 
French bread (brought out fresh) 
Cupcakes 
Key lime cheesecake
We felt like prices for breakfast prices were okay, however every drink was $3.5 that was kids milk, coffee, orange juice. I feel they have to make a little extra someplace.
name: Jennifer

text: ordered a few things and liked most of it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not sure though.
name: User

text: No wonder this place is so empty all the time. These people have a serious attitude problem. The punk ass they have working behind the counter named George refused to provide an ICE WATER to-go with my order, which is an overpriced $20 order of fajitas "on special", mind you. To add insult, he refused to speak Spanish to me when I walked in, and lied about only speaking English, moments before speaking fluent Spanish to another customer on the phone. If that wasn't enough, when I tried to ask "his mother" for a plastic silverware set, she shut the door and sent her jerkoff son back out to deal with it. Then after I decided to have a few bites before leaving, I was chastised for eating there. Like you'd get a tip anyway, you douche bags. I'll never be back here.
name: James B

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Worth checking out. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Disappointing visit. We ordered the steak on special and it was full of gristle and the side dish portion was tiny. All for $42. The empanadas were outstanding, though.
name: Camille

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Pretty happy with it overall. Nice little spot, decent portions too. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven.
name: User

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. The music was louder than it needed to be. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Good food , the fried fish is not greasy. The only negative is the long wait but it's all worth it!
name: Shirley

text: Very good vegetarian rolls. The agedashi tofu and tempura vegetables were also very good. The service was alright, but it was a busy day. Overall, I think it was better than most of the sushi restaurants in Reno, excluding the ones in casinos. I think they could make the drinks a bit more fun and get sake bombs or other mixed drinks.
name: Eily

text: Thought I would try it since I haven't had Cici's in a while. The place was not very inviting! The girl at the counter did not welcome anyone that came in just wanted you to give her money and leave her alone. No employee had a name tag or anything saying if they where manager or employee! The place itself smelt of standing water and smelt of restrooms, the place needs tremendous updating. Half of the pizzas where cold and none of the food had any heater or heat lamps to them that I could see! The only people I saw where possibly people that wanted something cheap for the whole family to eat! That is why I only give it one star!
name: Joseph

text: Went to Senor Salsa last night for dinner. I had the chicken & beef burritos. There was soooooo much red sauce all over them, I couldn't see what they looked like. & on top of the red sauce was lettuce, tomato & cheese. They were not that good, just ok. The server was just ok also. I had to ask for his name, didn't introduce himself. I read other reviews & they were 50 bad 50 good, so I said, let's try this place. I will not go back. Everything is just ok there.
name: Kay

text:
This place is a freaking joke. No, I'm not a tourist either I'm a local. My husband and I went into the quarter to grab a bite and decided on this place. We had never been; and saw some pretty good reviews. So we went in and said party of two. The hostess response was well you can sit at the bar or wait 25 min. We chose to wait. She then says you
Need to wait outside. Ok, we walk outside and stand around the corner away from the draft. After about 10-15 min I notice a group of 3 walk in and get sat right away.  You have got to be kidding me. So I walk inside and ask the hostess how much longer for our table. She says I walked out side a called party of two. I say we were standing right around the corner. She said oh well you can sit at the bar. Umm we don't want to. As we are talking, a lady walks up from her table and says excuse ma'am can you close the door. The hostess responds with yes when we are ready to shut it we will. What kind of employee speaks to people this way?! Needless to say we just left.  Please find another place to eat, where at least the hostesses treat you  better.
name: Renea

text:
I have been a fan of the Chestnut Hill Grill for years!  I enjoy the laid back vibe and the staff are usually friendly; attentive and the food is consistently good!

While my Mom and Auntie were visiting Philly..we found ourselves in Chestnut Hill around dinner time..not mine...the early bird special time (4:30 or so....lol) and the Grill was open and ready!

My Mom has the lamb and Auntie enjoyed a large salad and chicken dish!  They enjoyed how well the meal was prepared and flavors....oh you ask-what did I have --Drinks..liquid dinner..as you can imagine keeping guests entertained is exhausting and mind numbing at times...so I needed a pick me up and it helped!  Lol 

I was pleased with the value of the dinner along with the good service!
name: Shane

text: I want to move in. Every fixture and style choice is glorious. The food was wonderful. The cocktails (mezcal yes please) were wonderful. The service was great and he knew all the tricks to avoid gluten. Gripes: I hate paying for parking in my own city and the happy hour menu was super limited - but even saying that I still really liked it and look forward to a return.
name: M

text: Absolutely awesome food, very good atmosphere and service!  Be prepared to wait to be seated though, virtually every night.
name: Garrett

text: This place has been a South Philly staple for years.  The ribs are really good but if you are headed here try their signature Country Chicken Sandwich, it is off the charts.  The Fillet Mignon sandwich is another great pick.  If you order from Grubhub they usually have it ready within 15-25 minutes for a pick up so wait time is very minimal. Great lunch or dinner spot.
name: B

text:
Take out lunch for me and my 14 year old came to just under $25.
She still loves that (fried) Sesame Chicken.  Pork Fried Rice.  Egg Drop or Wonton Soup.

I had B&B  - Beef 'n Broc.

Solid.

Great service, too.
name: Karen

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Overall, a strong experience. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: Very fun place and clean bar. Menu has a good selection and the staff was very friendly. A must stop place for sure. We had the mussels and they were good even though half didn't open, the waitress had them removed from our bill , without us even asking.
name: Lee

text: I have been hearing a lot about this place and I finally got to try it tonight. I placed my order to go. The shrimp spring roll with he traditional peanut sauce was really good. The spring roll contained red cabbage which is a little different but the flavor was good. I ordered the little Boa boa steam buns with basa fish. The order came with 2 and they were good. I went to DD Mau because i wanted to try the PHO. I was disappointed when I arrived home to find that the rare beef was in the broth in the container. So it was fully cooked in the broth. The other issue which swayed my ratings to 4 star was the amount of meat in the order. It was possibly 1 slice that was all just bit and parts. The broth was really good so this took away the sting of the meat. I will definitely be going back.
name: Denise

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not bad for a quick meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was good and came out fast. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Such a great experience. The service was spot on and the food was delicious. We went for Mother's Day not knowing what to expect and it was absolutely fabulous. Everybody had a great time and enjoyed their meals thoroughly. We will definitely be back. Highly recommend this place for a special occasion!!
name: Amanda

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Worth checking out. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. It looked better online than it did in person. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: My waitress name was Melissa she was really good I like her if you come make sure you get her she's very polite and she do make sure you have your order right
name: Sherna

text: the food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. It was crowded but still moved along. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text:
This was a healthy way to kick the day off near our hotel on Market Street in downtown Philly. We popped in twice during our three day visit and I especially enjoyed the green smoothie bowl filled with kale, spinach and banana topped with mango, strawberries and granola. My addition of the almond butter dollop took it to the next level (so good). It seemed like the bowl could use a little more banana in the puree/smoothie portion to help offset the frozen/not creamy texture. In addition to smoothie bowls they offer a fairly extensive menu of smoothies. It seemed that most of the customers I encountered were there for the smoothie acai bowls. 

The staff was friendly enough and the space offers a hand full of seats in the lower and upper portion of the space. Note that outlets are hard to come by so its not the most ideal spot to work for a few hours with a laptop. If you're staying in a hotel and have to roll out early in the morning, they're also willing to pack up your smoothie bowl toppings separately so it'll keep overnight.
name: Brittany

text: The space is clean, the portions are generous and the food is DELICIOUS!!! Also the staff were very friendly, service was on point and price range is worth the taste and amount of food you get.
name: Eilene

text: This has got to be by far my favorite tapas restaurant in Tampa! Pretty certain the tables book up super quickly, which is why we had to sit at the chefs high bar area (those need reservations too). A must have Is the fried chicken grouper cheeks and the fried okra. Delish! Our waitress was super friendly and knowledgeable of the menu which enhanced our experience! Must try!
name: Ashley

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food was fresh and service was quick. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Would return. Not bad for a quick meal. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text:
Came here for some wings and shrimp wasn't disappointed! Very popular spot based form all the tv coverage so had to check it out.
First the staff is super friendly and helpful , extremely patient at explain the menu and their sauces. Gave good recs on their wings.
The wings were cooked to order and very tasty! I like mines on the spicier side and was very pleased. Would definitely come back here.
Only down side is it's more catered for take out, small countertop seating inside.
name: Peter

text: A hip spot serving fast food inspired meals for vegetarians. I love, love, love their sweet potato fries! Either I am just cheap, or HipCIty Veg is a little pricey. My fries were almost $6! Although pricey, well worth it. Everything is made fresh to order! Although I have not used it yet, there is an option to order in advance online.  Besides the price my only other complaint is the lack of seating.
name: April

text: Very high quality food! Very private type of atmosphere great for birthdays and parties
name: Raven

text:
Brewer's Cabinet offers average beer, a below average selection of beer, below average service, and average food.

The hostess at the front was rude. She told us there was a wait to sit outside even though we could see 3 available tables so we had to wait for 35 mins. The waitress was not very friendly either, but she was an improvement over the hostess. The bus boy and the waiter that actually brought our food out we're nice and were working very hard which I really appreciate.

We ordered the pretzel as an app. We went on Wednesday, which I would totally recommend because tacos are $1.50!! My husband had both meat options and preferred the pork. I had the black bean, which while they were pretty good, I would like something with a little more going on for a veggie taco.

There's a lot of beer in Reno and I think that their beer is just ok, and they don't offer the selection of other brewers in the area.
name: Chalan

text:
I have been here 4 times now.  2 visits were very good and were around the time it opened. Pizza was top notch, crisp, and flavorful.  Salads are very very good. Wine list is excellent. Service has typically been average though as they leave a feeling like the patron should be grateful to be there. 

The last visit was about 4 weeks ago and I took my parents. Quality control was not on point. The dough was flat..not sure if didn't rise properly or ferment 24 hrs but not up to par. Was a bit soggy as well. Corn pizza seemed to lack corn. Not sure what was going on. 

I don't like leaving a mediocre review but with great hype, press , fanfare comes great responsibility to be on point; Especially at the price point.
name: Tim

text: Amazing. Very busy. Went on a Sunday morning/afternoon. But it was Well worth the wait. I would definitely go back here. Maybe not the Broomall location because of the room. It is too cramped for me. Can't wait to go back.
name: David

text: Wow had the broken yolk sandwich!! amazing, great combination of foods. services was great, everyone was very nice.   Good coffee too.
name: Ceelos

text: I was craving a good Philly Cheesesteak sandwich and this place just hit the spot. Kind of far away from St. Pete's where I was visiting but nice to get out and explore sometimes. This is a classic mom-and-pop place where the owner is working there and there are sports collectibles on the walls and locals all around. I got a cheesesteak with onions and jalapenos so sort of the basic but with a California twist maybe. It was good. The bread comes out a little wet I guess from steaming it or the juice from the meat was soaking up. The sandwiches were a little messy as stuff falls out when eating it but they are good and very tasty. There are so many combos but this was my first time so went with the cheesesteak and fries. I was good. The knock I have on this place is that they don't accept credit cards. The biggest sign in the room says they don't accept credit cards. I get it that they are a small shop and fees on credit cards just eats at his cashflow but its rather inconvenient for people. I travel a lot like I did that week visiting St. Petersburg for the week and I just don't like to carry around cash. Everyone accepts cards so it was just an inconvenience for me that I was there and had to use all my cash for lunch. That's just me, sorry. But this place is great for a cheesesteak sandwich. Go for it.
name: R

text: We enjoyed our visit to Blackbird. The decor was sleek which is unusual for a Santa Barbara restaurant. The space could use some noise dampening as if was difficult to hear my partner across the table. The service was good despite a slow transition between the hostess and our waiter.  The cocktails came out quickly after we ordered as did the rest of our meal. The salmon was my favorite. The rabbit and the spaghetti were on the edge of being too salty.
name: Mary

text: We stopped by this place just on whim and was pleasantly surprised. Quite a varied menu or food and drinks and the owner was telling us about the live music and events they have in the evenings sometimes. Will have to get back there. And the fries are delicious and notable.
name: A

text: We were given a gift certificate to Bordeaux.  With all the restaurants in New Orleans, we'd never heard of it.  So glad we did because our meal was the best we've ever had in the 23 years of living in Nola.  From cocktails to appetizers to entree, everything was unique and full of flavors.  Staff was attentive.  They have a small bar outside with multiple fans, and several outdoor covered seats.  Inside is small, but quaint.  We can't wait to go back!
name: Lisa

text: LOVE this place! Our favorite hideaway place in Santa Barbara, it's such a little gem. Everything on the menu is delicious, especially the scallop!!! The service here is one of the best, very well trained, especially Ross - He is just good. Very smooth, polite, and his attention to details is just wonderful! Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a phenomenal dinning experience in SB!
name: Vivian

text:
I am pretty down on pizza in the state of Delaware, but this is downright good pizza...for anywhere. It's definitely the best I've had in Delaware. 

Super light crunchy, chewy crust, semi-sweet/tangy sauce, great cheese blend. 

I'm a tough pizza critic, but this was good. 

(I would like to see a 16" option one day).
name: Chuck

text:
Visited the Gramophone on a few occasions for drinks and loved it, they have a really nice beer selection (tap and bottles), and make some delicious mixed drinks. You can almost always count on live music on the weekends, which I personally love, and overall it has a great, inviting atmosphere as a bar. 

Just had their sandwiches for the first time this weekend and was SO impressed! They claim to be the sandwich kings and honestly I agree. I had the Delcortivo, which I would highly recommend, and my husband had the Rueben, which he said was delicious. Also I think they serve food till like 2am, which makes it that much more of a late-night Grove must.
name: Stephanie

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Right near Longwood Gardens we stumbled into Agave Mexican cuisine it was outstanding! From the salsa and chip appetizer to the short rib burrito it was refreshing different and delightful!
name: Andrew

text: I have been a fan of Lucky's for 3-4 years, stopping in for breakfast on occasion bc they have an option for Bloody Marys at breakfast. However, today was horrible. I waited 10 minutes while the staff gawked at someone getting engaged, there was egg shell in my eggs, the server combined my check with someone else's, after she separated it and I went to pay she charged my credit card for his bill (not mine), then when I paid a $24.50 bill with $30 she put the bills in her purse and didn't even ask if I want change. I'm all about a 20% tip and do so 99% of the time, but today was not a 20%+ day for a substandard experience. I'm sorry Lucky's, but you lost me today. Hope the 22.4% tip was worth it.
name: Matt

text:
Boom Burger!!!
Me and my wife went for lunch. I had the boom burger and she had the mussels entrees, and we shared the beer cheese dip. Our waiter Josh was awesome. He went out of his way to assist where he could. Food was amazing. 
Only downside - the chairs seem to be worn pretty bad. They tried to fix them with duck tape. 
Overall great place for lunch.
name: Timothy

text: I just finished my second meal at this restaurant. Once again, the food here was superb! The seafood was fresh and cooked to perfection. The slaw was fresh and crisp as well. As an added bonus, the tarter sauce was also quite good. The staff is courteous and sincerely intent on making sure guests are satisfied.
name: Paul

text: Old time New Orleans steakhouse vibe. We came here because someone in our party has Celiac and is on a gluten free diet. The menu clearly denotes all gluten free choices. My meal was great - wedge salad. Creamed spinach, petite fillet steak, giant baked potato. Wine list excellent. Wait staff were attentive. The only downside - my companions steaks weren't warm - seemed as though they had been sitting under the  kitchens warming lights. The restaurant was super busy so we didn't send it back but I suspect they would have been accommodating. A place to try once for sure - we will likely go back because it is also a great option for gluten free diners.
name: Brandee

text: A beautiful restaurant but extremely noisy! I ordered linguine bolognese that was the worst I've ever had. First of all, I didn't get linguine but another type of pasta similar to spaghetti but thicker, and there was maybe a tablespoon of meat in my bolognese. My husband had a pasta with seafood that he said was terrible. We were with friends who loved it so we didn't make a fuss, but we will never go back.
name: Pat

text: I love my general two chicken here. Egg roll on point. Just wished the delivered. So far we order here several times. Never a problem. Nice staff
name: Vanity

text: FINALLY a great boba place in town ! There are others in town but this is by far my favorite because of the simplicity , convenience ( hello right next to target ) and customer service . I wanted to try the place out and finally I was able to drop by and check it out . Greeted immediately and I wasn't rushed to look over the menu . Who doesn't love that ? When my order was up the owner stopped me from getting an imperfect order . How amazing is that ? I was going to take the 3/4 of the way filled drink and call it day but that attention to detail just blew me away . I will definitely come back and tell everyone about this establishment.
name: Jannine

text: My friend liked it more than I did. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Honestly, nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. not sure I'd order the same thing again. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: I love love loved this place!! My friends went to NOLA and I decided to hop on a last minute flight to meet them. Sooo happy I did! We stayed at the hotel next to the restaurant, and started each day off at the bar area with Mishawn (sorry if I butchered her name)! She gave us the best service, such a sweet woman and always made sure we were attended to. Hurricane's and Bloody Mary's were by far the BEST I've ever had! I don't think our girls trip would have been the same without her great service! See you again soon! :)
name: Raquel

text: Love their tacos!!! The al pastor are my favorite neto really knows how to make them. Also their chicken burrito is amazing with their green avocado salsa. When i want tacos we come here definitely the best by far. Thanks for the weight gain lol
name: Isamar

text: This is a review for brunch. Cute neighborhood spot but the food was just ok.  Had the avocado toast which was underwhelming and nachos which were solid at best.
name: Christina

text: Excellent food.  Massive servings.   Also love the old school decore and commercial size garlic powder at each table. Great local/neighborhood.
name: Geoff

text: Very fun place; finally a place for DnD and tabletop gamers to go and play or just hang out. There is a large selection of games to play or buy, and a big selection of minis. You can buy spell card packs, and other related items. Very cool dice gumball machine, too! One of the workers also sells handmade earrings, which I find very adorable. There is a space in the back for larger parties as well, which feels conducive to immersion as it's darker, and the front portion is naturally lit, so you have a choice of ambiance. Very kind people, I recommend any player to check this place out! A friend of mine frequents their adventures league on Tuesdays, and they run other games too.
name: Daphne

text: It was pretty busy, but once we got to our bay the service, food and drinks were all awesome.  Definitely recommend for anyone looking to have a great time ... not just for golfers.
name: Pablo

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Pretty happy with it overall. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. For the price I expected more than this. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day..
name: User

text:
I believe this place is under new management. The menu is not extensive, there is 4 soup entrees, 1 chicken rice plate & couple different Banh mi combos. I overheard the owner saying sometimes they have weekend specials. The staff/owners are very friendly, just be patient with them when it's busy. They have a couple different smoothie flavors with boba. If you're expecting fancy dining then this is not the place for you BUT if you want just like home flavorful food, this is the place!

I have been craving mi quang for years & have been on a quest to look for something decent..finally found it. It was so good! They don't skimp on the veggie dish either which is real important. There was plenty of banana blossom which a lot of other restaurants don't include because it is expensive. 

My husband got the spicy beef soup (bun bo hue) & it was better then Cafe Diem's. If my mom doesn't make it at home, I am comfortable coming here to order it.

Pricing..I think it's fair. Some might think it is a little high but the food is good, so it's totally worth it.

This is my new favorite spot.
name: Gigi

text: This place runs a scam with local law enforcement authorities. The scam involves setting up their bar patrons for DUI arrests without any proof that they are intoxicated. BEWARE OF THIS PLACE AND AVOID IT IF YOU DON't WANT TO BE HARASSED BY THEIR PARKING LOT ATTENDANTS AND THE POLICE.

text: Had a great lunch of crawfish and shrimp boil plus split a shrimp poor boy. Good beer selection and atmosphere for lunch. Had such a great experience that we may go back while in town. A must when in NOLA
name: Morgen

text: Visited this charming spot for the first time yesterday and was incredibly pleased. From the service, to the food, even the restrooms, everything was top notch! My husband and I tried the watermelon bruschetta and WOW... so good! Also had the scallops and the meatloaf, both plates were delicious... the right amount, excellent flavor too! Our server was very personable and upon discovering that it was our 1 year wedding anniversary, he went above and beyond to make our visit extra special. Would definitely recommend this spot to anybody looking for a nice spot to eat and have a good experience in downtown St. Pete.
name: Gabby

text:
Take away from this long review- if I could only visit one restaurant in all of Clearwater and Tampa, it was surely be SHOR

SHOR shocked me. I didn't seek it out- it was our hotel restaurant. 

I expect a solid 3 stars for hotel restaurants, it's not their main operative and I just don't expect to be dazzled. SHOR dazzled me, and I'm ticked because I drove 30 minutes to be dazzled by Bascums Chop House for $250 and I wish I hadn't visited SHOR first because they didn't measure up to SHOR at half the cost. 

SERVICE
Our server was so nice and accommodating to death. I got the vibe that if they had the ingredients for it they would literally make whatever I requested. She applauded our decision to choose a different side than the one set by the menu with our entrees. I'm not joking- she was excited. She was so honest with every question I asked about every menu item. She was amazing. I was nervous to order dessert and she gave me real feedback and a firm nudge in probably the best direction. 

DRINKS
Great cocktail options, and beer and wine. Nothing to complain about here. I ordered from the bar throughout the trip and we decided it served most of the best drinks I had on the trip. I liked the burnt orange most and least the Paloma but I'm picky. 

FOOD 
Ok let's talk. I am a Dallas born steak snob. Everywhere I go- I find the best steak house. I ordered the Filet Mignon with low expectations at SHOR and it was top 5 filets I have ever had. I'm salty about that because Florida has no beef claim to fame and they are now in my top 5. My husband is equally snobby and would only relent that his NY strip was top 10 but I would consider that significant since he dines fine regularly. I almost forgot to mention the pretzel bread before dinner that tried to ruin my appetite and haunt my delicious dreams. So good. Worth the carbs. 

DESSERT
I actually didn't love the dessert menu. The Jaffa cake inspired chocolate cake sounded amazing, it was ok. I do love actual Jaffa Cakes but I found their homage to the flavor to be really subtle and restrained for such a contrary flavor pairing. The texture was really great so it was technically a good dessert- I'm just more indulgent than the designer. I don't hold that against them. I'm sure one of their desserts would have knocked my socks off.
name: Samantha

text:
Stopped by this cafe shortly after their opening. There's not a lot of seating but the ppl I were meeting up with were able to grab us a table. 

The menu is small and consists of gyros and tacos. I got the Mediterranean tacos that came with a side of fries.  Everything was eaten up and was delicious.
name: Julie

text: my family and my fiancé always go here, and every time we come we always love the food. they have such an amazing food and excellent customer service. Will be back soon :)
name: Alliah

text: Amazing Ramen and friendly staff! Never had a bad bowl, and portions are huge. Definitely a neighborhood jewel!
name: Malini

text: This is definitely an easy one to give 5 stars to. The food is cooked to perfection, the service is on point and the side of bacon is huge!  I've only been here for brunch a couple of times, but I definitely plan on checking out their dinner as well.
name: Ramon

text:
update: who cares

I sounded like a douche in my last review so I retract everything. I've not been there in a while so I don't know what it tastes like. Go try it and tell me!
name: Ian

text:
Here in NOLA for a conference and I heard great things about this place... so a few colleagues and I decided to give it a try... and I do have to say the food was delicious, the service was on point and the manager checked in with us. (Server Richard and manager Tanya) we had a variety between the five of us and it tasted great.

So your probably wondering why the four stars...originally I was going to give them 5, but we came here the next day and the food came out luke warm (no pun intended) we had to ask to wake it up again and it just didn't tasted the same. Service was still great.. and the manager was very apologetic. 

I understand things can't be perfect all the time... will I come here again, yes... do I recommend yes.. just a warning it depends on the day.
