These are just some of the things that happen whenever we have Amato Brothers.  We are willingly trying almost everything on their huge menu without disappointment yet. We recently tried their chicken Caesar salads and once again - Magnificently Impressed!  When a deli/caterer prepares food with such precision and skill, making sure every bite is filled with passion and care, it no longer is just a deli.  It becomes legendary. This Is what Amato Brothers has become.  By far the best hoagies in the area and well worth it if you have to make a drive.  Don't just read this and continue patronizing your local boring shop because "they're convenient". Get in your car and come to this amazing establishment. You won't regret it. 
Our favorites: The Classic Italian, Angie's Italian, Jacked Up Tuna, Italian Sausage, The Big Papa...need I go on??
name: Bryan

text: Ordered food at 5:45, told 6:15 pickup at 7:20 they finally gave us the order! OVER 1 HOUR after we were to get it!!! Some of it must have been sitting as it' was cold! They made what was to be a wonderful Mother's Day a nightmare! SO PISSED OFF!!!! Will NEVER go back!
name: Studmuffin

text:
My boyfriend took me for our anniversary dinner Saturday night. The food was amazing but service could have been better. Took awhile to receive water in our glasses, we were brought butter but had to ask for bread, and lastly there was 4 or 5 employees standing at the front just chatting. Normally I wouldn't be so picky but this is supposed to be a high scale restaurant and intimate. 

The food was amazing tho and the special dessert my boyfriend called and ordered before hand was delicious. Staff was very nice as well. Overall great experience, just a few things to work on!
name: Jordan

text: Delicious food! Especially the filet. The ribeye was also very flavorful and tender. Don't miss the au gratin potatoes! Interesting cocktails, too! But not a great choice if you're in a hurry - service was... less than prompt. Overall, we're loved it! Oh and don't show up in shorts or you have to eat at the bar. :)
name: Kate

text:
Where do I start? Here is my punch list:

* Dining room had no air conditioning.  It was at least 90 in there.
* New Crispy sandwich was dry.
* Ear-splitting rock music blared from a wall-mounted TV.
* Floors and tables were sticky.
* Potato wedges were cold and dry.

A request to have the music volume lowered was not fulfilled. I had to stand on a chair and shut it off.  Dining room erupted in applause. 
  Manager apologized and said the location is due for a rehabilitation, but it's too late for me.  I'm never going back!
name: Peter

text: Best grilled cheese I've ever eaten. Start with the grilled cheese on Rosemary & Olive bread and then get the tri-tip skewers and shrimp skewers. With the IPA and IIPAs, you've got a perfect meal.
name: Steve

text: Not only is this the best food truck in the city, it's one of the best places to eat lunch in Philadelphia, period. Portions are very generous, quality is incredible, and price is more than reasonable - I try to come here at least once a week.
name: John

text: Came during morning rush on a Sunday, stopped in to order take-out, the 2 mgrs I'm guessing we're busy jumping on an off register an searing people. It seemed to me that the rush was being handled well, didn't see any empty tables but as they got up they got them seated pretty quick, the only down side to the visit was the food was cooked in my mind on a higher degree so everything in the order seemed a little more "done" then should have been, but as fast as they were pushing it out I can understand it wasn't a totally bad thing but good food fast service that day I was impressed especially for a Denny's the past few times I had been to others it wasn't even worrying checking in at....
name: William

text: Oh, how I miss you! It's been awhile since I had a burrito from Chipotle. This was my 1st time at this location, and I was not disappointed. There was plenty of seating and room for the lunch rush, and there was enough staff to handle it accordingly as well. We managed to arrive right before the rush. I had a super veggie burrito with corn, grilled veggies, lettuce, rice, beans, salsa & of course, GUACAMOLE  Thank you for always giving me a reason to return!
name: Elaina

text:
Super popular/ trendy burger joint over in East Nashville. I really do love this place though! It's a perfect place to try when the weather is nice! They have an awesome bier garden out back with lots of picnic style tables! However, this place can get REALLY busy on nice days/ the weekends. I suggest using the no wait app to reserve a spot ahead of time! However, they will not seat you without your whole party being there. 

They serve burgers, brats/ sausages, beer, milkshakes and "old fashioned" sodas. The burger selection is creative and the buns are fresh, soft & delicious! My favorite burger is the stroganoff burger- it's topped with mushrooms, Swiss cheese and sour cream  and my favorite side is their tator totes dipped in the curry ketchup! The fries & potato salad are also very good. I also really enjoy that they have a great selection of rotating local, craft & German beers!
name: Tiffany

text: Uninviting employees. I felt so out of place. Not welcome at all.. I used to live close by and now live 95 miles away and stopped by to bring home a pie and I feel like I wasn't even appreciated as a customer.
name: Jessica

text: The food is delicious.  The Mac and cheese there is delicious.  My significant other loves the barbecue and the burger/ fries are delicious. The salads even look scrumptious.  The beer is fantastic.  The staff is friendly and kind.  The cost is reasonable.  This restaurant is a wonderful lunch or even a great date night place to go.
name: Melissa

text:
Went in on a Sunday night, and probably be the last time we will go back.
The time before we went there we're getting a bad vibe from the place
like something has changed.
We just wrote it off as maybe they're having a bad day. Not this time!
I asked my wife do you think the owners sold the restaurant? It was like a whole new vibe in the place. We were completely ignored, it was like we were invisible.  After 15 minutes we just got up and left.
Too bad, because we really liked this restaurant, NOT anymore.
name: Sam

text:
A fast casual BBQ place that has the workings of a higher end BBQ place.  It's situated next to the Brass Tap bar in Wiregrass mall and nestled in the "dining/drinking" area of the outdoor mall.  Unlike alot of other BBQ places you find in the Tampa Bay area which tend to be older, a little less clean (both inside and outside), have the bbq pit or a smoker or griller somewhere in the restaurant and a feature area where the cut the meat in front of you, Union72 is a little more refined offering a beer, wine and liquor selection while you wait for your meal to be served.  The restaurant is very clean and has numerous sitting areas.  You order in the front of the restaurant and the food is delivered to your table.  You don't have grab your own napkins, utensils, bbq sauce, etc, the waitress will get it for you...

I order the Bahn Mi sandwich with a side of the candied bacon Mac & Cheese.  The Mac & Cheese was very decadent and tasty.  The Bahn Mi was a little too artistic for my taste after eaten many more authentic Bahm Mi's in my day.  It came in a fancy baguette with cucumbers, bean sprouts, and a few other pickled items along with alot of mayo?  I chose the recommended beef brisket option.  I thought the pickled vegetables were a little too strong for my liking and it overwhelmed the taste of the beef brisket.  We also got an order of the ribs and chicken platter and both had the bbq sauce served on the side.  We didn't notice bottles of any "famous" bbq sauce on the table or on the counter, so we presumed it only came in one flavor lol.  Both the ribs and the chicken were ok with and without the bbq sauce, the meats were dry but not make you choke on the food type dry.  I didn't really get a sense of the BBQ flavor I was hoping to get.  Nonetheless, I think the dining experience here was better than most bbq places but the meats were medioacre at best.
name: Jay

text:
Went here for lunch with my 2 yo daughter. We shared the tempura udon, crab rangoon, and a spicy tuna roll. Everything was delicious! Udon broth was really flavorful. Tempura was light and crisp and the shrimp were very tender. Crab rangoon wasn't overly sweet like you get at so many places. Roll was fresh and tasty. 
Can't wait to take my wife here and try more of their  actual sushi!
name: Lewis

text:
Very clean,  great pizza,  little extras that make a difference.   It's in a safe place and you can get your 420 within walking distance while waiting for your pie to be done.   

Treat yourself to something better than your normal phone and go franchise pizza joint. 

Do it this week
name: Sevan

text: My brunch friends and I went to Chuy's for lunch. It was pretty empty @ 11am on Monday. Several people ordered the 1/2 salad with chicken. It looked really good & they said it was good. I ordered the grilled mahi kebabs. They were a tad overcooked but they still had good flavor. The sauce the waitress brought for the fish dishes was delicious. Service was attentive and someone brought out pitchers of water & lemon slices so we wouldn't run out.
name: Anita

text: I ordered smothered turkey chops. Only thing missing-the gravy for the "smothered" turkey chops!!!!  It hasn't been the first time my order has been incorrect. I tried to support but this is pure laziness. Completely unacceptable.
name: Deanna

text: Sadly, Zoe's is NOT what it used to be. Bought out from the owner over a year ago really shows. Looking so forward to having our favorite pasta salad that has been a staple for years, we were saddened to be served an orzo salad instead. Trying to remain positive, we figured, hey, it will probably be good, since it is Zoe's. Blech! Mushy and far too over herbed, one bite was all I ate. My husband is a "Mikey likes it" eater, and even he only ate two bites of this pasta. The dependable chicken roll-ups were half filled, and each had a piece of gristle running through them. When i hit gtistle a third time on the last roll up, i was done. My husbands chicken kabobs also had gristle! Shame on them!Also the roll ups are now served with tzatziki sauce, instead of the salsa that was perfect for them. The hummus was tasty, as always, but was served with an inadequate amount of pita bread. Since i had half a tortilla from each of my poorly filled roll ups, that is what we used to enjoy some of the hummus. The greek salad side was fresh enough, but had only two kalamatas and two small grape tomatoes and two cucumber slices. Loaded with red onion. So, we got a piece of the sheetcake that we love, and that has changed as well. If you are like me, you loved to treat yourself to that delicious cake, with its yummy homemade frosting gritty with real sugar and butter, and the fudginess of the cake. All gone. Replaced by a very dark chocolate cake which had good flavor, but with smooth icing that glistens from oil. Not worth the calories...half tossed in the trash. It was so disappointing! This has been a place we have regularly enjoyed. Really, too bad!
name: Shore

text:
Amazing feel to this cafe/restaurant, with decent, slightly expensive prices and good food. I ordered the steak scramble and a mocha, and the portions were good, but the hashbrowns were a little unimpressive. You take a buzzer and sit down, and your order is delivered to you. 
The place is crowded and lines form, but move quickly. The cafe is a lot bigger than it looks, bustling with college kids and familes and businessmen, with the environment of a rustic coffeeshop. Will definitely be back when I visit the Nashville area.
name: Sara

text: The music was louder than it needed to be. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Worth checking out. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Food was good and came out fast. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: They have the best Peach tea I've ever tasted, & the food was good & a nice portion size too. They even put fruit in all the iced teas & Lemonades & the staff is nice.. I couldn't choose from a few items so we will definitely be back to try more..
name: Esha

text:
Sauce is a fast pizzeria. 5 of us ate here tonight. Here's the down low....

Bottom line - it's  worthy. Thin crust (I'm not normally a fan of thin but it works here just fine.) we had salads, mushroom arugula, lasagna, chicken Cesar, chicken sausage. My favs were chicken Cesar and the mushroom arugula. So damn good!
name: Steve

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. For a busy night they handled it okay. Idk, everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Anyway, nothing was awful but i left disappointed. Honestly, really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Anyway, they were out of one thing i originally wanted.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Bar service was extremely slow this evening - as in, I waited about 5 minutes when I first sat down to be waited on. When I was ready for another drink, the bartender walked past me 3 times (twice to grab food from his plate behind the bar) and finally I had to ask for another drink. Food was good, but pricey for burger & fries and 2 appetizers... Within walking distance to the Fox Theater and adjacent to a hotel, but overall, I'll make a different choice the next time I'm in the area.
name: Julie

text:
We tried this place a few months ago and were impressed with the friendly bartenders, food and staff, (5 star experience) so we decided to give it a shot during Bordentown's recent restaurant week. The place was packed but our Open Table reservation got us seated right away.  The noise level in the dining room was quite high with lots of kids. I tried the pork bruschetta and was disappointed with the skimpy plate. It consisted of TWO small overcooked rolls, about the size of a typical shrimp roll cut in half, and some mixed veggies. It was in stark contrast to my companion's plate, I think a veal chop, that was huge. Even our waiter commented when he saw my reaction to the tiny portion and would mention it to the manager.
The "manager" kid came by and explained that the restaurant week menu was supposed to be a taste of what they can do, not a regular portion for 3-courses for $30, then left. What they managed to do is turn us off to visiting again. Our server was excellent.
name: Rich

text: We went there for breakfast for the first time and it was awesome! The food was great and reasonably priced, the service was the best I've had since I can remember, our server Tammy was so informative and fast with everything, I never had to ask for a refill for my coffee before I finished she was already at the table refilling it. We will definitely be back!
name: Nick

text: alex was the best worker and so welcoming in the pretzel shop i would give him 6 stars if i could. wow what a worker!
name: Nicole

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The music was louder than it needed to be. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text:
Beautiful interior of a building in a neighborhood that is restoring it's cool factor. Large dining room and with a reservation, we sat right away. 

Great mocktail-esque ginger hibiscus soda. 
Summer vegetable salad was good. 
Pizzas were as well. We had Sopresotta pizza and Eggplant pizza. 

Great service.

Very similar to city house.

4 out of 5 as I'd like to see more of a variety of "large plates" - perhaps a fish offering. There were only three choices for that part of the menu.

Overall lovely meal. Definitely great for a date night.
name: Corie

text:
My husband and I enjoy ourselves today at Chili's bar and grill on 66th Street North in St Petersburg Florida. We had a great waiter with great Hospitality his name is Cody. He was very knowledgeable about the different foods and all the new items including the great drinks. Our food was great I ate the Margarita Grilled Chicken and my husband had the BBQ Smokehouse Burger it was delicious. My Husband and I enjoy good food, good conversation and good drinks. Afterwards we tipped our waiter well and ask to speak to his Manager which is Soha. 
I tell her what great job Cody had done serving us and I also told him I appreciate his Hospitality also. Overall I walked away with a couple of gifts because the manager thought I was just so sweet so nice but I was being honest, which I like her personality a lot.  I love great Customer Service and great Hospitality I don't look at myself as a customer, I look at myself as part of the Chili's Bar and Grill Family.  Thank you all, see you soon.
name: Adalya

text:
Loved this place! They were nice enough to let us get half and half for our entrees

1/2 1/2 gator $12: must when you're in Nola! Wasn't expecting gator to be so delicious. It was very fresh and crispy
Seafood platter $26: to die forrrr. 
Cajun fries: had Cajun sauce on top. Wish I knew the recipe to make at home

Service was perfect. We came in during after noon. Wasn't that busy. We got to watch a Nola band jazz on by through the window.
name: Lynn

text: We visited right after they opened on a Sunday. Service was not as fast as would be expected. Had to ask for the butter for the rolls. The music was way too loud. The food is surprisingly good. The portions are huge. I was redeeming a teacher appreciation coupon I received in May. The food was excellent. It is not the type of place I would seek out if not for the coupon: a bit too noisy and slow.
name: Sallie

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food was good and came out fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. It looked better online than it did in person. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text:
Based on my experience yesterday (March 17th), I would normally only give maybe 2 stars. However, keeping in mind the crowds and sobriety (or lack thereof) of the crowds, I had to be a little generous.

Our group stopped here for a quick bite during the bar crawl. Now, I understand the building is located in downtown, so space is limited. There were a grand total of four tables in the lobby. On a normal day, this probably isn't enough. Everyone adopted the "Well, I'll just wait until some space clears out" mentality. You can probably imagine how that worked. 

Ordering was not a pain. I only waited a couple of minutes to be helped. The girl on the register (poor thing) looked overwhelmed. She didn't seem to have much help on the front-end. 

I ordered six breadsticks and a drink, which I assumed were pre-made. I got my drink and waited. And waited. And waited. I only got my breadsticks when I went to the counter and asked for them. All in all, I waited about 30 minutes. The line was so crowded, however, that getting through any earlier would have taken just as long. 

The breadsticks themselves were delicious! Well seasoned and perfectly sized. I could only eat three. I gave the remaining to a panhandler who also said he loved their bread, so obviously it's consistent in taste. The remainder of my group enjoyed a pizza called "The Hot Chick" and said it was very good. Three grown men downed an entire large pizza. I don't know if that's any indicator of flavor, but it seems promising, so...

My biggest criticisms of this particular store are:

The size. They seriously need to figure something out, whether it's moving locations or tearing down a wall. (Lol.) Nothing about that aspect of the experience was safe. 

The kitchen staff. I counted no less than five of them - at any given time - standing and looking at phones. The girl working the register deserves some type of recognition for simply dealing with everything the way she did, and I will make sure the store is aware. 

The wait times. Now, given the circumstances, this is probably not a typical experience. 

I'm sure I will revisit this store at some point, but it won't be on a Saturday afternoon with a horde of drunk people.
name: Stacie

text: This is a very nice Waffle House!  Food cooked to order.  Angie was an enthusiastic friendly server.  TJ checked on us and was a great reflection of Waffle House service.  Friendly and willing to serve.   I had breakfast.  Eggs, bacon, toast and hash browns, smothered, covered, scattered and peppered.  My husband had the same with a waffle.  Delicious!  And the bathrooms was very clean.  Another star for  that!  Highly recommend!
name: Yvonne

text:
This place is the great gimmicky place you'd expect. We were sat by the tigers that were so loud it scared my coworker every time it growled. Which was funny but annoying too. 

They also have so much stupid fog come out of the fog machine you can't see anything! 

I paid $26 for a VERY subpar meal. I would definitely not come back here.
name: J

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Maybe other people have better luck here. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
This place definitely needs some attention, to both food and service.
I keep coming back to see if any changes have been made and have been disappointed.  We keep trying happy hour just to see if this might be the case, and it's pretty quiet, but service is still slow, even at the bar...ordering fish tacos, but there's no fish available for any dish that night? How is that possible, and it's not the first time we've encountered ordering a dish that isn't available. Not sold out, just not available. So we won't be back to try for a 10th time......bummer, as it's close to home for the Sparks folks but it's not worthy.
name: Diane

text: Wonderful ambiance, and you can't beat the view of the ocean from the outdoor patio area!! Service was amazing as always, as well as the food.
name: Matt

text: Had a lovely brunch here today! The stone ground grits and poached eggs tasted delicious and the yolks were perfectly unctuous! I made my reservation using Resy from their web site. Was seated immediately when I got there a few minutes before my reservation time. I'm looking forward to trying their sister restaurant next door, Olive + Oak, as I've heard good things about it. If it's as good as the food I ate today, I'll be a happy diner!
name: Diane

text: I absolutely love their 49¢ ice cream, but I'm disappointed that they took their chocolate ice cream. They're usually clean, but sometimes they're completely disgusting. I still hold them for high esteem for cheap food and snacks! I just wish they would keep on top of their cleaning, not becoming laxidasical.
name: Dakota

text:
I was in the area visiting a friend who suggested we grab dinner at Sushi Kingdom late on a Friday night. My drive to Mount Laurel took 5 hours and I was starving by the time I got there, so all you can eat sushi sounded pretty amazing.

We arrived at the restaurant at about 8:30pm on a Friday and it was pretty quiet. We brought a bottle of wine with us as it is BYOB.

I had never been to Sushi Kingdom before, but I was glad my friend knew what he was doing. I would have been lost had I come here myself. 

When we were seated the waitress gave us two slips. The slips are sectioned off with different types of sushi where you check off which items you want and how many. The waitress then comes back around to collect the slips, but doesn't stick around long enough for you to ask questions. 

I'm not very knowledgeable on the names of different types of sushi rolls, and there are no descriptions underneath the names on the list. Luckily my friend frequents here, so he had suggestions for which ones he likes.

Once our waitress took our order it was only a matter of minutes before she brought back our plate of sushi. The sushi itself was fresh and tasted very good. Since it is all you can eat, you are able to order as many times as you want.

Now is it worth driving 5 hours for? Probably not, but if you are in the area and are looking for great all you can eat sushi, I suggest you check it out!
name: Janelle

text: We had a WONDERFUL family meal @MCH in Ewing! They got everything right! From the service, to the food, to the atmosphere! We ordered from seafood, to Italian, to a burger; everything was delicious and plentiful (although hubby wishes the seafood bowl could've been an all-you-can-eat deal )! We will definitely be back! Thanks to our gracious host, Pete - Good Luck with the new place!!
name: Megan

text: If I could give this location a negative star rating I would. Service was extremely terrible, we barely got served. The server took longer than 20 mins to greet us when we were first seated. We only got one serving of water the entire 1.5 we were there! Let alone the food never came. Will never visit this location again.
name: Brielle

text: While we were walking down Canal Street we were looking for somewhere cool to come eat with a New Orleans Kick and we found it here! The waiter was very cool and suggested a local light beer which I loved. I got the Gumbo Soup and my wife got a PoBoy sandwich.
name: Khevin

text: In line with most of the other reviews, the place is clean, well maintained, the staff is pleasant but the kitchen is a disaster.  The service is slow, very, very, very slow and they do make mistakes.  Today I waited 8 mins for  a plain bagel (not toasted) with plain cream cheese.  It's doesn't sound like a long time but there were order after me with eggs, meats and speciality sandwiches coming out before mine.  I'd write it off as an oversite but several weeks ago they gave me the wrong order and a few months ago again completely forgot my order.  The food is good, not great but good.  If they can get the service issue resolved they will be successful.
name: Mark

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: We stopped by for a quick meal and were so pleasantly surprised by the quality of food and the prompt and friendly service we were given! Fresh and delicious. Glad we stopped.
name: S

text: The wait was long but worth it! Staff was great and friendly. Our meal was great along with our appetizer. We celebrated our one year wedding anniversary here and glad we chose this gem. Very popular and always busy but worth the wait! The grilled shrimp plate was amazing!!!
name: Kylah

text: Ok this is my second time at wisdom diner, the first time the experience was satisfactory just another ordinary diner.  The second was a debocal.  I went because my sisters family took me.  I ordered onion, mushroom, swiss, egg white omelette.  What came out was normal yellow omelette.  In had it sent back and sometime later a pepper and onion egg white came out.  No mushrooms no cheese.  I sent it back and had it taken off bill.  I understand mistakes happen. But not twice and no waitress apology.  Again second time there and really nothing special about it.  I won't return.
name: Craig

text: We had the BR and the Mushroom burger and both were cooked exactly to order (medium rare). The tots and the homemade chips were almost as good as the fried pickles. But really, I think the burgers alone are worth a visit!
name: Blair

text: I have eaten her 4 times in the past few months. Every time has been an online order, and every time there has been an issue. Today was the first time my order was ready at the stated time. The other orders were not even started by the time I arrived. Today though, the order was wrong. I ordered a burrito and received a bowl. The woman at the counter took the bowl and dumped it onto a tortilla. I gave her the benefit of the doubt and assumed she fixed it. But no. One whole side was rice and salsa the other meat. No one at this location cares. There is food on the ground, and customer service does not exist. The only reason I'm giving 2 stars is that besides today, the food has been consistent.
name: Chris

text: Good atmosphere, but bad everything else. I ordered a mary burger, it came with shredded lettuce. Even though leaf lettuce was pictured. I removed the bun, and everything else that was contaminated with the terrible shred. The meat was over cooked, even though the menu said that they cook all burgers to medium unless otherwise requested. It was completely dry. The server didn't introduce himself, he didn't ask how we were doing, he didn't seem to mind that I didn't eat 90% of my meal. He seemed completely bothered we were there. The fried pickle spears were good, even though they were served without appetizer plates and napkins. The server didn't spend 30 seconds at the table and was difficult to track down. This was well past the lunch rush and we felt much worse AFTER leaving the restaurant than when we arrived.
name: Lawson

text:
This place is really good! The food here is your typically mom and pop Chinese food store with the huge menu. I come here for the chicken wings and love how flexible they are with customizing your meal. The place is small, it can seat about 15 people. Its a takeout place so don't expect anything fancy. 

I got fried chicken wings tossed in General Tso sauce(instead of the honey or buffalo sauce) with white rice. I'm not a fan of fried rice so I never get it. I appreciate the fact that they cut the wings in half. My order came with four pieces of chicken wings and they tasted great, like always lol! I've ordered the honey wings in the past and they were good too! My total came up to $7.44 (they charge extra for the General Tso sauce)

Would I come back? YUP! 
If your in the mood for quick Chinese food this is the place for you.
name: Rachelle

text: Had a very good 9 oz sirloin tonight, tasty & tender.Also I love the blue cheese wedge salad and it's only a $1.00 additional charge.They forgot to put the balsamic drizzle on the salad but promptly brought it as a side. It makes the salad , it's good without it but fantastic with the balsamic.
name: Mike

text:
Such high hopes for this place! Wilmington finally gets it's own food hall and I couldn't wait to try it. My friends and I ordered a variety of items from different places they offered. We also got a few cocktails there as well (cocktails are pretty fantastic but they didn't have watermelon juice for the one watermelon one I wanted ?). 
First was the chicken and waffles. Disappointed out how small the chicken was compared the the waffles. They just put chicken tenders instead of actual fried chicken which was strange. Chicken pretty good. Alittle dry but maple syrup smothered over the chicken and waffles made it pretty good. I got the BBQ pork bahi mi at Phubs. It was alright. Veggies could be more flavorful and same with the meat. The fried shrimp and pork rolls were pretty good with the fish sauce that it comes with. I think prob the best item I had there. 
My friend also got the spicy pig from the pizza place. The bread was really good but the pizza itself seemed alittle underdone. The toppings/cheese slid off while trying to grab a slice. Overall an okay pizza. We also tried the tiki marsala chicken bowl. That tasted pretty good. Another friend got two sushi rolls from the sushi place and it was decent. Nothing amazing. Overall food is okay. Not amazing but okay. The pop up kitchen looked like it was supposed to have bbq but noone was there so we didn't get to try them.
name: Lana

text: Phenomenal!! I am very picky about my sushi and on a whim decided to try this place for lunch today. My new favorite sushi place! The presentation was amazing, the sushi very fresh, and everything so tasty. I will definitely be back as this is one of the best sushi places in Tampa.
name: Angela

text: I come to Sparks a few times a year for work.  FBD never fails to satisfy.  Sandwich places usually can be good in a few areas (great meats, bread, cheese, toppings, service, atmosphere, price...) Somehow this place excels in every category!  The meat is amazing. The bread and cheese are mouth watering.  All the toppings are fresh and high end.  The service is outstanding.  The atmosphere is unique and refreshing.  And finally...  The price is exceptional for what you get.  This is a "must stop" location for Reno/Sparks!
name: Brad

text: It has a really great atmosphere but the lunch is only okay. The staff is super friendly, but if the food was better, it would make this place so much better.
name: James

text: great spot for hotpot! would recommend the tomato oxtail broth (mild; i added chili/nut oil) and the brisket-wrapped enoki mushrooms. for a smaller party (we were 2 people) it was more cost-effective to choose items off the conveyor belt rather than getting full orders off the menu. if you're a first-timer, no worries--the staff is incredibly warm and can help guide you. Vikki was a wonderful server--thanks for a great meal!
name: Cailey

text: Price felt a touch high for what it was. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Food was fresh and service was quick. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. It looked better online than it did in person.
name: User

text: First went on my trip to Santa Barbara, cute place. Loved the vanilla bean whipped cream! It was amazing! I had it on the cinnamon honey latte and on the hot chocolate. The hot chocolate was the second best I've ever had! The paninis were great and very filling. The cupcakes were delish and moist, although the frosting was a bit sweet for me. My fav cupcake flavor they had was the strawberry, it was very fresh and tasted like strawberry. They have cute mini cupcakes which is useful for tasting which flavor you like better. Overall I will be going back on my next drive up to Santa Barbara.
name: Keisha

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The food was good and the service was easygoing. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Worth checking out. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Food was good and came out fast. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Also, the food was good and the service was easygoing. Also, i kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. For the price I expected more than this. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Great atmosphere. Had the chicken ramen dish that was good. I didn't eat the chicken because it had skin but that's not my preference. The taste was great. Also had the spiral fries with the mayo... absolutely amazing. Started to get loud the closer to 10pm it got but considering the area it was tame.
name: Sabrina

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. So yeah, they mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. idk I'd try something else next time.
name: User

text: Great service. Arrived about 12:30 for lunch with a party of five. Ordered a glass of wine, 2 cokes, water, and the truffle chips with blue cheese to start.  Also ordered for lunch: the broasted chicken and grilled Brussels sprouts, the salmon, and the club sandwich.   The chicken was so dry, we didn't eat it. The Brussels sprouts were hard. We have prepared them many times and never had that happen. I am not sure why they were so hard and not tasty. They look over cooked. See picture. The lunch came to $100.00 for five. With tip $120.  It just was not worth it. I would go somewhere else.
name: Nancy

text:
I have never seen a more poorly run Primo location.  
Food is never ready at scheduled time.  And they don't seem like they care. 

Routinely out of items. 
Register personal don't seem like they know what they are doing. 

It's actually amazing because I think they are run by the same person/group as the Havertown location and that one runs like a clock. 

Avoid the hassle and go to Havertown
name: Bill

text:
Way to treat your GLOBALIST(highest level) member guest! If I could give zero stars I would...My overall stay at the Hyatt Regency Indianapolis was absolutely horrendous. The entire stay was a disaster and the rooms were beyond deplorable. This trip to Indianapolis was supposed to be special as my mother and I were visiting to celebrate my great uncles 90th birthday. I battled between staying at the Hyatt and Hilton since my mother is a Diamond level member. I convinced her that the Hyatt was a better option and I was terribly wrong. I was thoroughly embarrassed to have her witness all of the horrible situations that took place on this trip. 

For starters I think that the front desk staff should be educated on how important it is to properly inform the guest. I called in prior to my arrival and spoke with Eugene who confirmed that upon arriving, I would have a room available for an early check in. My reservation was for checking in on 11/10-11/12 and because I was arriving so early on the 10th I wanted to make sure it wasn't necessary to book an additional night on Friday (11/9) I was assured that this wasn't necessary and he would note my reservation about this. Well to my surprise when I arrived at the hotel on 11/10 around 1:30 AM or so I wasn't greeted promptly. It was no front desk agent in sight until about 5 minutes or more passed a gentleman came from the back. Stating he was working on paperwork.. That's neither here nor there and doesn't excuse the fact that the front desk was left unattended for as long as it was. My reservation wasn't found at first and he was having difficulties until he finally located the reservation. At this moment I wasn't aware that he or somebody in the hotel changed my reservation to a 3 night opposed to the 2 WITHOUT telling me which resulted in additional nights fee's being charged to my card WITHOUT anybody telling me until checkout. First I was told that there wasn't any room available and then he said that the room that I was assigned to wasn't ready and then it was, very confusing. I was told that the original room I was put into was a "Premium" room since it was located on the club room level. 

The room was far from premium. Complimentary premium internet is a complete joke. This Wifi connects and kicks you off. There was an EXTREME amount of dust and garbage that was behind the dresser where the TV sits on. My mom dropped her ear ring behind there and this is when we discovered all of the nasty things that were behind the dresser. I took plenty of photos and went to the front desk to show them the ridiculous amount of dust and junk that was found. I had a really hard time sleeping because I kept sneezing and couldn't figure out why.. well the DUST everywhere from the corners of floors to the incredible amount of dust located along the baseboard of the beds would explain this sneezing. Absolutely ridiculous. Fast forward, I was changed into another room which was clean to the naked eye however it contained some problems as well. The vent in that room obviously needed a new air filter because when we turned on the heat it blew out an extreme amount of dust ALL OVER THE BEDS. Completely unacceptable. To add to the long list of things that went wrong with the rooms, the tile inside of the bathroom was on its last leg and was on the verge of coming down and crashing into my mother head while she was using the bathroom. Another unbelievable thing that transpired and really made the stay beyond frustrating. 

The ice machine on our floor (18th) was out of service for the entire time we stayed. I called down on the 2nd night to speak with another unpleasant employee by the name of DALTON. After several attempts to reach the front desk he finally answered without giving his name. I had to ask for it which doesn't seem like the guest standard for Hyatt. Nonetheless he had a very nonchalant attitude while speaking to me and even made an absurd suggestion for me to go to another floor to retrieve ice. I shouldn't have to go out of my way to go get ice, the problem clearly never was fixed and I wasn't going to spend any more time calling downstairs about this. 

The last thing that I didn't understand about this hotel is that the club room is closed on the weekends. I honestly wouldn't have booked this if I would've known this prior to making a reservation. The day that it was finally open which was on that following Monday 11/12 I had no access to the room. Called downstairs to inform them about this and was told my room key showed I had access but I didn't. The card wasn't deactivated as I was able to still access my hotel room. Went downstairs to have the key re done and once again it didn't work. Too much of a headache and based on everything I've just shared this hotel caused so much stress. The trip was supposed to be fun and it wasn't because this hotel. Being refunded a total of 8,000 points was an insult! Barely enough to compensate for this atrocious stay.
name: Alexander

text: First of all, there was no water at all. They only had sweet tea. They were out of a slushee flavor, and asked which flavor was wanted. After calling to my kid and asking, I told the employee the new flavor. The cashier (with glasses, didn't get her name) rolled her eyes at the customer. Extremely disrespectful. Then, we checked out order. I got 4 piece tenders and my boyfriend ordered 6 piece tenders. However, I had 6 and he had 4. So they completely switched up our orders but luckily we were there together so could just appropriately switch the tender meals. Horrible service. The cashier should definitely be fired. You cannot disrespect customers. Please avoid this McDonalds at all costs.
name: Maddy

text: Delicious food. Tad on the trendy/expensive side. Slight wait for just a few basic breakfast items. The menu is fun for sure!
name: Laura

text: Got two vegan pizzas to take to Bonesaw Brewery:  pepperoni and sausage and pepper.  Pepperoni was great.  Sausage and pepper too spicy for me and it had no red sauce.  The vegan sausage is good.  The owner of the Fishtown location said she the vegan sausage crumbles are made by Dibruno's.  Not sure if this location gets them from there.  Nice selection of vegan choices.
name: Wyatt

text: Terrible. Will not be going back. Their idea of cooking is drawling it in olive oil- no matter what you order. They also forgot to give us our leftovers but tried to make up for it with free dessert. Tread carefully.
name: Audra

text: I almost don't want to tell others this place, cause I won't be able to get in! Hopefully they can expand next door ;-) My favorite is the Spicy Thai Basil. Best Thai food in town.
name: Mrflorida55

text: this is a cute neighborhood bar! came by with some friends and had a great time. the service was attentive and fast. i got a cocktail and some shrimp quesadillas. both were great! can't wait to come back and try the other dishes
name: Jenny

text: For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Food was fresh and service was quick. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Glad we tried it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: Loved the pelmeni! I tried the Siberian pelmeni, the filling  a mix of pork and beef. The homestyle fried potatoes (french fries) were also very good, they really taste just like homemade fries.
name: Kate

text: The Waitresses was NOT friendly .. The food was not great  The bacon was over cooked Let's say breakfast was Not great we were very disappointed
name: Maria

text: The best pastrami rueban this side of town. The place is owner operated so food, service top notch. Place is clean. Great spot for lunch. Must try
name: Zee

text:
Very surprised by the quality and quantity. The food truck was homey with a little patio in the front to have a quick date. 

I ordered the tom yum and a pad woo sen. the sour and spicy ratio in the tom yum was perfect with lots of protein and veggies. 

The woo sen was a little watery but the flavor was perfect with lots of veggies and shrimp. 

Thai hot was asked for these two dishes. It was about a 4 out if 5. Could be spicer but I grew up eating ghost peppers on the daily.
name: Ni

text:
This is the best place in saint louis to have halwa puri and cholay. Their puris are very light, crispy and non oily puris. They serve it with aalo walay cholay and halwa. Too good !! 
Recently we have tried their samosas too. They were like pakistani baray wala bakery samosas that you have with chai. Delicious!!
name: Manahil

text: I can say enough about this place. One of the top brunches in Philly! Make sure to order the French toast and the red velvet pancakes!! They are both to die for. Be sure to come hungry, portions are huge! Be prepared to wait on the weekends for a seat, this place doesn't take reservations.
name: Margeaux

text: You're going to pay restaurant prices and wait restaurant times for your fast food quality food. You're better off deciding wether you want fast food or restaurant food and going somewhere else.
name: Ryan

text: Awesome service from both bartenders Diego and Sherron throughout the entire night! I never leave unsatisfied from this location. Also, Miguel who is one of the managers, kept checking up on us making sure everything was okay! 5/5!
name: Carlos Rodriguez

text: Nice little spot, decent portions too. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. So yeah, the whole meal felt kind of uneven. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. maybe I just came on an off day. It looked better online than it did in person. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: amazing gluten free noodles, service was great. The Broccoli was phenomenal, the meat was super tender and flavorful.
name: Amanda

text: While trying to find a place to eat we stumbled across The Mockingbird. While there were open tables, there was a little bit of a wait because they had recently started serving lunch and had unexpectedly had more customers in. Once we were seated we ordered the Meat & Tray which came with  the chef's choice of half a sandwich, which was the sloppy Jose (brisket), fries, salad a cup of their heirloom and bean soup and a cookie. This was a perfect sampler of everything. MY boyfriend ordered the I'll Have What She's Having which was bourbon cured jalapeño, pastrami, white cheddar, beet mustard and a corsair bun. Everything was great and I hope that they continue to have success.
name: Sammi

text:
The quality of food here has really declined in the past few years. The last 3-4x we have either dined in or taken out has been disappointing. The queso is decent but seems to be hit-or-miss as to what batch you get that day. The guacamole is just average, nothing special or really worth getting. I used to love their "Sweet n Green" quesadilla that had sweet potato, bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms but they discontinued it and their regular chicken quesadillas are so bland and dry. Enchiladas are just OK, again no real flavor and are somehow dry even though they are covered in sauce. I have tried their jerk nachos once which were good, at least they had more flavor than the other dishes. Their margaritas are great though and my favorite is the pineapple cilantro or mango. 

It's decent for drinks and queso but that's about it.
name: Hanah

text:
I've been here a couple times and haven't really been "wow'd" by their food, and I thought that I'd at least give it another try. Once again, the wow factor was not there. 

I ordered the carne asada burrito that comes with guacamole and salsa. Their beef is pretty dry and hard to chew and I didn't like the fact that this burrito had too many onions in it. I took a bite and I literally got a big piece of onion in one bite. I felt like there wasn't a lot of flavor in it and I was just bothered by how overpowering the onion taste was. This place definitely does not live up to the hype. I think the only upside to this place is that they're open late for those people that are craving a late night snack.
name: Rose

text: I went here for Happy Hour. The service was excellent and attentive even though they were busy. Happy hour prices for drinks were very reasonable as low as $5.  Unca Dukes bbq shrimp was very good. I disagree with other reviews that said they were salty. They were just right with A strong taste of Worcestershire sauce. My only issue was that the shrimp size was small, so for $7 you got 3 small sized shrimp. I also wished the toast were served not on the sauce because it soaked up the sauce and I needed the taste of the plain bread to balance the strong sauce of the shrimp. The crab bisque was very good but not excellent. It was very sweet and had a good amount of crab pieces in it, but the bisque itself was not so rich and creamy.
name: Ann

text: Over priced !!!! Over priced, over priced !!! Don't let the "its been around for years fool you" I have had better food for less money. Did not like it ! Please don't go there when it's busy also they will not give you attention at all.
name: Amanda

text: Had an omelette and wanted mushrooms goat cheese and grilled onion. Out of mushrooms and omelette was underdone and bland. Breakfast sandwich for the wife was good. Avocado toast for son was good but one piece was 8 bucks. Had a lot of avocado but should have for the price. Had to ask for butter jelly hot sauce bit I guess it is partially self serve   Pretty mundane fare, service, etc. can do much better in other area restaurants.
name: Rick

text: This market is beautiful. It makes you want to buy everything. I like their precooked foods, everything I've had has been delicious. This is a great place to grab something to eat and sit outside. In the winter months there is a fire pit near the tables where you can order from the outside of the store. Also a great place to bring a date. It's casual and there are so many choices you're sure to find something delicious, even for the most picky eater. The butcher almost always has something on special. Ask and he will tell you what the best deals are. There were three items that I haven't been able to find anywhere else. Since I was in the verge of buying them online I happily snatched them up. I'll be back soon!
name: Lara

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I left full, which at least counts for something. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. For the price I expected more than this. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Fantastic food. Had the burnt ends--yum!  Mac and cheese, southern green beans and grilled bacon wrapped jalapeños--all very tasty. Everything was great and have burnt ends for tomorrow. Husband and mother-in-law had ribs, and tried the fried okra which was very good as was the Cole slaw and corn. Definitely a repeat!
name: Charlotte

text: The food was amazing, the decore was nice, but the service was a little lacking. A little bit more connection between the wait staff and the kitchen staff would go a long way. This place is a five in the making.
name: Jay

text: First time here! Working in a similar restaurant back home. I can say the steak and chicken fajitas were very tasty. Beans were ok, but the rice was a bit on the dry side. Good service very attentive! Came in on lunch time, tried out the $1.99 margaritas and had to get a second margarita because they were very good and potent! Highly recommend the margaritas. Will be coming back if I have a chance...
name: Rigo

text: Service was nice, kitchen was just moving kind of slow. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. It was crowded but still moved along. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: What a beautiful place. Top quality sushi and delicious everything. The burger was so good, the fries too. My wife loved the chicken sandwich. Incredible location and view. The service was impeccable too.
name: Tom

text: Like this place for a drink and people watching. It's afternoon so can't say how it is for nighttime. Good atmosphere and easy accessible for wheelchair. Nice bar and tender.
name: JJ

text: I frequent this location when I visit my mom.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  The food is always good.  I love the corn cake, you don't get that everywhere.  I read a review that was offended by the statue of a monkey at the checkout desk.  That monkey has always been here and makes me chuckle every time.  If you have a sense of humor then it isn't offensive.
name: Karen

text: The potato salad alone is worth the wait, but the chicken is bog standard for Nashville. Bring your parents, or send visitors there. Otherwise go to Churchs chicken and dress it up at home with sawse (sic) or your choosing. Boom, food Network star
name: Dee

text: I was in Tucson this weekend and had read that Fiamme was worth a visit.  The review didn't do it justice.  This is absolutely the most amazing pizza.  I was in Italy this summer and this is better.  I'm so impressed and will literally make the drive to Tucson just for the pizza.  Thank you!!!!!
name: Jen

text: The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Overall, a strong experience. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: So far, best tacos I have had in the Tampa area. I go here about once a week. The staff are very friendly. I will continue to come back as long as I live here. Closest thing to home, Texas, that I have found.
name: Rose

text: I just ordered a veggie omelet and bacon to be delivered by door dash from this location. I had a few special requests, which were all followed to a 'T'! The food was delicious and hot. I tried to call, but the phone number wasn't working. Please pass my heartfelt thanks on to the chef and staff. Very pleased!!
name: Laura

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. so yeah kind of mixed on it. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Came to watch the 49ers play KC. Sat at the back bar. Service was horrible. It took a while to receive our food, even then we didn't get forks or napkins, or condiments with our food. Waitress took a while to come back so I got my own ketchup. Very slow. Food was okay. One order was wrong but we were so hungry we just ate it. Boneless wings are the only reason I would come back. Even then, there's many other places I can get better wings, and service at.
name: Marisa 'Misa'

text:
food was kinda pricey for what i ordered. a small grilled cheese totaling to $5 was crazy although it was a very good sandwich
my server was very sweet and fast when taking my order and bringing the check.
name: Layla

text: Staff speaks limited English. a suggestion turned into a $15 unexpected extra charge.
name: Jean

text: Ideal bar in Painter's Aly. Two floors of great music, kickin bar food and cold beer. If you're looking for a dive bar away from the Broadway shenanigans this is it! It's cozy, comfortable and clean. The blues that was playing when we walked in was out of this world. Can't wait to go back.
name: Kaitlyn

text: By far the best Chinese resturant on the southside. Food always fresh and flavorful. Excellent pricing and the steamed dumplings are to die for.....
name: Toni

text:
Not surprised! I had already been warned about the food, especially the service. It was late and very few places are open so I decided to stop and order take-out. 
The service was terrible, and when I got home the order was wrong; we ate it anyway, did not want to go back to change it.
I called the next day just to let them know and they could not care less. Same rude, condescending tone from the day before when I placed the order.
name: Claudia

text:
Bimini is a pretty bougie steakhouse located inside the Peppermill Resort. I've been here many times with my parents whenever they feel like coming to Reno for a small weekend getaway. 

We had reservations at 7pm on a Friday night and when we informed the host we were seated immediately. After browsing the menu for a bit I decided to get the jumbo prawns piccata (been craving some kind of pasta) and a side of Brussels sprouts and the lobster whipped potatoes. My parents decided on the prime rib and pan seared scallops. 

The meal started with complementary bread and butter as well as some sort of palette cleanser - a guava sorbet topped with Prosecco. The prawns were prepared table side and it was quite an entertaining show to watch! I enjoyed all of the food, and I'm a big fan of the whipped potatoes! I also appreciated how the prawns used were actually quite large! 

Would recommend this place if you want to treat yourself to a nice dinner! Also, I really like how they give us hot towels at the end of the meal - quite nice!
name: Stacey

text:
ALL MCDONALDS ARE NASTY. 
Food is always greasy, just go to Burger King, Wendy's ir Hardee's instead.
name: Jorge

text: My favorite part about this place is the staff. Our waiter was fast, efficient, and just down right honest. I ordered the buffalo chicken po boy (which is huge by the way!) and he told me that it is not what people expect making sure i was okay with how it was made before ordering it. He was nice as can be and overall made the experience for me and my family. Food was delicious too and definitely a good bang for your buck in regards to pricing
name: Tatiana

text:
The food here is pretty good. The bowls are super fresh and I like that there aren't too many choices so you don't get overwhelmed. It's also nice to see that they use local ingredients like the granola from Made Fare Co. I love the original acai bowl, as it's more berry-forward. Their blue bowls are beautiful and tasty but I'm not a huge fan of tropical fruits, so those aren't my favorite. 

The atmosphere here is clean and modern, with the white and wood aesthetic lending to a pleasant work environment. It isn't really a place that's cozy, but more a dine-and-dash vibe. 

The main reason I knocked off a few stars is because of their plating choices. They served my friend's smoothie bowl in a plastic container when we were eating there, rather than a glass or ceramic bowl (mine was in glass bowl because I asked after I saw hers), and didn't give us coffee mugs but instead take-away cups. With everyone being environmentally conscious these days this actually really bothers me, to be wasteful in a situation that isn't necessary. My friend also ordered avocado toast and it was served to her on a Chinet paper dinner plate; it was awkward and looked sloppy. Half of the reason I eat out is to have a nice experience with visuals, and the toast on the plate like that didn't cut it for me. Hopefully in the future they'll ask people if they're dining in or want the food to-go, because I think this would make a huge difference in the experience here.
name: Madison

text: It's a great little mom & pop shop that gets pretty busy. Seriously though stop in and get a muffuletta I promise you wont be disappointed. Although the cashiers and deli workers could be more friendly, they are often VERY rude to the customers. Im sure they've had a few walkaways due to the nasty attitudes they give people.
name: AriLynn

text:
We had the greatest evening at Puckett's Grocery in Franklin.  The live music was AMAZING!!!  The skill and variety of the Jolly String Quartet kept our toes tapping through our entire time there. What a talented and engaging group.
Our server, Lori, was the best.  She gave us the yummiest recommendations and everyone was a hit!  She treated us with great care, just like family.  We can't wait to come back!!!!
name: Cindy

text: BE AWARE, they charge extra without telling you!! I ordered a cheesesteak hoagie and the cashier asked if I wanted it "spicy". I said OK thinking that it means they add hot sauce or some peppers. They charged me an extra $5 for jalapenos. FIVE DOLLARS. Thats half a sandwhich...when I asked the manager about it, he said "well I asked if you wanted it spicy, did I not?"...please somebody, help me find where on the menu it says "spicy means an additional $5"
name: Emily

text: Perfectly balanced desserts. Sometimes desserts are too sweet one can only eat a little at a time but this was amazing.
name: Sunil

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Love this place. great food. Great service. Homey feeling and thoughful details, such as coffee station and soup appetizer that comes automatically with each meal .
name: K

text: Sat at bar quick drink and order taking asked for bread n dipping while having cocktail and waiting for pizza. No joy bartender blew it. Not busy. Pizza yummy.
name: Jaye

text: We came for breakfast and it was packed! Using the app to set our arrival time was fantastic. But the food...so fabulous!! My Daughter, wife and I shared plated and were totally satisfied with the portions. Quality was awesome and totally unexpected flavor combinations were great. I had the German #2 and the girls shared the pancakes with apple and walnuts. You can't go wrong here. Enjoy!!
name: Frank

text:
Glad they opened a Thai Town closer to where I work.   The other one was not too far tho and always worth the drive.  

The lunch specials are definitely worth the price.  You get plenty of food, egg roll, and Tom Yum soup.  The food here is outstanding.   The service is great.  
 Great menu selection for lunch and dinner.
name: Jeff

text: The atmosphere was very nice. Friendly service staff. The food was good. One of the best burgers I've had in a while. Kinda stingy with the bacon, but that was just due to the cut. Still a great burger
name: Andrae

text: Found this gem. Every 3rd Saturday is a buffet which includes a pretty good variety of food 16.99$ a little pricey but worth it if you are hungry! I went there and got to Heavenly Fried Rice, which can definitely feed two people. The atmosphere isn't that attractive in which if it was would probably make this place a 5 star and the staff isn't very welcoming or attentive but the food is great and prices are good. Happy about this new vegan place for sure!
name: Nina

text: The waiter greeted us pleasantly enough. Unfortunately, it went downhill from there. All the food was delivered at the same time, like a cheap buffet. The soup was tasty, the little of it that I tasted before the steak was rushed out. When you have to move your plates over to make room for the entree, you know it's poor service. The steak WAS delicious and cooked the way I wanted, but there's nothing like poor service to ruin an experience.
name: Annie

text:
This is the 2nd time i've given this place a chance because the food is actually pretty good, but the experience is sadly just not worth it. Its fine dining without the fine. 

Our recent visit clocked in at 3 hours for a round of drinks and dinner. It wasn't a busy night, but somehow drinks took a good 30mins to arrive, but it was nice out so we still went for it and ordered dinner. MISTAKE. As the night got colder the server turned on another table's heat lamp, but didn't offer to turn ours on- so we sat in the cold, without a drink or food for another 30 mins until I decided to climb the table and turn on the heat lamp myself (servers watched on). After about another 30 the server came by to take another drink order and a mild apology for the wait. It took another 30 for a full apology. Finally our food arrive 2.5 hours into the ordeal. Mine was a cold plate so I was absolutely floored at the wait. 

Note to management. 1. It felt like there was absolutely no management happening 2. If people do have the courtesy to sit in the cold for 2.5 hours maybe offer a drink or a fee app or something. I'm disappointed to cross this spot off of my list, but 2 strikes and you are out.
name: Becky

text: I have read the reviews and they are all over the place. My wife and I went to dinner at Blu last week. The Chestnut soup was superb. We had the specials: Blue Fish and Monk Fish with mussels. Our meals were delicious. The service was well above average even though there was only one server. BYOB. On street parking.
name: Tim

text: I was part of a group who had reserved the upstairs room for lunch after a conference in the morning. There were probably around 30 of us, but we dribbled in over the course of maybe e 20 minutes; we didn't arrive en masses.  I was with the stragglers. I loved the rustic old-style architecture, the casual décor., the very interesting menu, and the great selection of craft beers.  I think we were ordering from the brunch menu (it was a Saturday), and I had huevos rancheros, which was delicious. However, the service was disappointing. It seemed that the server either was not aware that we were a group, or the server didn't know how to serve a large group. Instead of waiting for the whole group to arrive, she took orders as people came in. This meant that some received their food while others were still waiting for theirs. When I arrived, and the server came to me, I asked if orders were being taken for drinks or food. The server said "You can order whatever you want." :-\ I ordered a craft beer (21st amendment brew-free-or-die IPA was great!) and huevos rancheros (delicious!) . The beer arrived, but my food was delayed long after everyone else's. The server said it was "sent to a different table, and I would be getting another order soon." So, I had to wait even longer, and started to eat while others were finishing up. This all made for a confusing eating experience. I would definitely visit Strangelove's again for the great food, beer, and ambiance, but I would suggest some training for staff who serve large groups.
name: Patricia

text:
At first, sadwiches and poke bowls at the same place didn't sound as something common, however, I like both so I decided to check it out.

Altough all the poke ingredients looked mouthwatering, I felt like a sandwich will do better that day, so I went with latter. The [guy who seemed to be an] owner told me they do the best cuban sandwich in town, and it appeared to be absolute truth. The bread was grilled to golden-brown crisp, cheese melted to perfect softness and the meats were super fresh as well. I've requested the one with no pork, and they made the custom sandwich no questions asked. Among other condiments, they have this delicious yellow sriracha and black pepper grinder. I tried sriracha at random, and I do recommend it on this sandwich, while you all know that freshly grinded black pepper is much more flavorful than just ground one; and I appreciate this nice little touch. I wish everyone would switch to these grinders.

We have just arrived to the beach, and it was raining all day. This guy promised, it won't last forever and the sun will come out soon. This came true either :)

One little detail, after I got to the hotel and took my tee off, I felt like it caught a some of that frying oily smell. I think the exhaust fan doesn't do its job well and needs to be changed, or another one added. It wasn't too bad so I can't take star for that, I'd say its just a little advice.

Overall, I loved this place, and I'll definitely try poke here this week too.
name: Silverok

text: The fries were probably the best part of the meal, honestly. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. idk I'd try something else next time. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Food was fresh and service was quick. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text: The appetizer, steaks, and all sides were delicious and cooked to perfection. The waiters were also very attentive and friendly.
name: Corina

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. It was decent, just a little uneven. Food was good and came out fast. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Awesome food and great hospitality received while at this establishment!! I've had the chicken and waffles along with cornbread; amazing!! I'll definitely be back when in town!!
name: Carol

text:
It was a great surprise when we were coming out of Death and Taxes that a taco shop would be right around the corner, in the alley. However, it took forever to get our food: 30-40 minutes for 6 tacos. The tacos came with all the standard toppings. I grabbed the chicken and my body the fish. He thought of it as being a decent taco. The chicken was a bit dry for my tastes, but the tacos were packed to the brim with ingredients. 

I have experienced a few better, quicker taco shops i.e. Wells Taco Truck. If I was around Midtown Tacos and craving something to eat I would check the wait before ordering.
name: Andrew

text: I have moved here to Tucson from Maryland last year 2018. I have ordered a variety of food 3 times and i kick myself each time as to why i've ordered supposedly asian food from this fast food asian food. Ok, i will no longer order food from this place. The food is obviously pre-package like out of a can or package and egg drop soup is definitely canned soup. Spring rolls are obviously packaged and NOT spring rolls. Im so so disappointed in this establishment and i do not know if they have anyone back in the kitchen actually cooking or just opening up cans or packages!! They are horrible!!!! And they are EXPENSIVE!!   Do not order!! Tucson has some great asian places this is NOT one of them!!
name: Beate

text: Great Bar and the Roast Beef is on point. Real friendly staff and will definitely come back when I'm in Philly
name: Dennis

text:
Believe the other posts - service is slow. Not sure why that's the case, but due to all of the comments, it's obvious management has an issue that needs attention. 

I ordered the tenders (medium). It came with 4 tenders and shoe-string type fries. The medium is not quite as hot as other places. I might go one higher next time. The fries were good, but I'm not a fan of shoe-string style. All of the food came out hot and fresh. To be honest, the tenders were not as good as others in town, but they were good. Limitations on sides makes Hattie B's or Pepperfire a better option. 

We were there on a Saturday night, so I think it was more of a bar atmosphere due to college football. It was loud inside, so we sat on the patio. 

This is a good place to hang out with friends and watch a game (and have a beer). Be careful about parking across the street. If you're not parked in the appropriate spaces, you will get towed. 

Overall, I say an average place. I hope it hangs around in Donelson. We'll be back.
name: Chris

text:
NommingNomad Approved.

I've been going here periodically over the last three years ever since I discovered it. And I have never tasted anything that is not freaking perfect ever. It is a small place that is family run and authentic with limited seating but you will feel so welcome and taken care of. They do have an a la carte menu which is served family style but I've never tried it. 

I always get the rice and 2 veg/meat combo and I used to love their fish dish which is just amazing but now that I'm no longer eating fish the tempeh tofu is my absolute favorite and a must try. I've also tried the spinach/collard greens, the jackfruit, chicken rendang and the potatoes. Like I said, you can never go wrong with anything you get. 

If you like the spicier things in life, definitely go for the sambal that comes with the meal. All in all I love it and when I need a tummy hug, I know where to go!
name: Deepika

text: While you won't exactly be in a garden upon entering Inchin, you will feel just as serene. The decor of the restaurant has dark tones that create a warmth to the environment, and by taking a look at the cocktail menu, you can drink some too! I have had three drinks from Inchin in my most recent experience (on-a. Friday), and all of them were excellent and thoughtful. Moreover, the presentation of the drinks was exquisite. It truly provides an experience. I forget the names (east movement, volcano, and another whiskey based drink) were all filled with several flavors and decorated with beautiful garnishes. If you're lucky, the drink may even come with a gimmick to further fill your cup when it has runneth dry. We started out with the hot and sour soup and egg roles. The spring role were very warm and tasted fresh. The soup came out perfect temperature and had a unique spicy flavor left on the palate. I enjoyed both. We concluded out meal with sweet and sour chicken and Hakka noodles. Both exceeded expectation and were further supplemented by the complimentary white rice. The vegetables mixed in the two dishes were crunchy indicating their freshness which is always something to write home about. I went to Inchin on their grand opening and enjoyed their cocktails, but this was a large turnaround from that experience. This is a great spot to get a few drinks at to start the night or take a girl on date night.
name: Daniel

text: Very good, prices are mid range but not unreasonable.  All of the food is made fresh, daily I'm pretty sure.  The selection is huge, I'm surprised to see this high quality of food on a college campus.  There are lots of things to choose from and they all look great.

Adam was our server and was quite personable and knowledgeable about the menu and chef. This was a nice  surprise to find as we are traveling from out of town.
