name: User

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
My husband and I hosted our Newly Wed Brunch at Mere Bulles the day after our wedding, and there aren't enough words to describe how amazing it truly was.  From their DELICIOUS brunch (arguably the best I have ever had, and I live in NYC), to the most pleasant and helpful staff, everything was fantastic!!! 
Caty was wonderful to work with leading up to our private party, always available for communication, she was kind, caring, and professional. She was focused on every detail, and helped make the day perfect. 
Vernon worked with us on the day of the brunch, and he is also incredible! His service was impeccable, it almost seemed as though there were Vernon clones based on how he was able to be in multiple places all at once! He was warm and welcoming to every single one of our guest (all 100+), greating each person as they entered. He lead the staff helping us that day effortlessly. He brought a smile to the face of every person he spoke with, and made each of us feel very special. A truly one of a kind person! 
Let's talk about the food for one minute, Oh my goodness! If you ever go for brunch, you MUST try the creme brulee French toast, it is TO DIE FOR! Not to mention the fact that they provide the best brunch buffet selection! 
The wonderful service and delicious food was accompanied by the beauty that is the mansion that this restaurant is situated in. Filled with classic charm, a beautiful balcony on the 2nd floor, and wonderful decor, everything looked perfect.
I would 100% recommend Mere Bulles for any party you are planning, a Sunday brunch with your family, or a date night with your significant other. You cannot go wrong in this beautiful restaurant!
name: Janelle

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. My experience was honestly fine. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text: Don't go here on a Tuesday night (BOGO Wings) unless you are comfortable with waiting over an hour for food. I've been to this location a few times, but this was the worst experience. I asked for a booth, the hostess said there were no booths even though I saw two open booths which remained open for some time after I was seated. I place my order. After 45 minutes I asked the waiter if the food would be coming shortly, he responded "just a few minutes it's almost ready." A few minutes to me is 3 minutes. So after another 20 minutes of course the food comes out and the order is incorrect. I did not accept the food because I wasn't going to pay for a wrong order that I had to wait over an hour for. Then the manager came over and basically told us that it was the hostess' fault for not explaining to us that it would take 45 minutes to get food. He also didn't make us pay for the food that we didn't eat... what a joke.
name: Thomas

text:
While walking around Fishtown for my wife's birthday, we passed by Kensington Quarters.  I've wanted to check this spot out for awhile now, but I never wanted to bring my wife here for one of her special days.  I thought she would like it, but it doesn't scream her name.  I decided to book a reservation for my birthday a month later.  

We arrived on a Sunday evening and sat outside in the back.  We wanted the tasting menu and since I can't really name everything we had, I won't...  Service was definitely not rushed, which called for a pleasant evening, but it did lean on the side of slow. Might have ordered another cocktail or two while we waited, but no one came around.  Fortunately, there was a bottle of water on the table, so my water glass didn't go empty.  

For the cocktails, the Green Velvet might have been my favorite drink.  Peas, mint, pepper, and gin?  Seriously, Peas?  It had this great flavor and it was velvety.  

As far as the tasting menu went, things were really good.  A few things tasted a bit salty, even for me, but overall I'm happy we went.  The bread was so delicious.  Loved the charcuterie, with the squash salad.  The homemade pasta dish tasted nice with some sort of ragout.  

We were destroying this meal until the final course...  A large plate of smoked meats.  Right then and there, we knew we had to take food home with us.  No way we could finish this.  Duck confit, super smoked ribs, steak, sausage, pork.  We loved those ribs, such smokey flavor.  We ate as much as we could and ate items we knew would turn out the worst if we reheated it.  

At the end, we looked at the menu and got the chocolate pudding with oats and apples.  A great way to end our meal and not that filling, but still a sweet way to end the meal.
name: Matt

text: Went for lunch on Sunday the  5/26, sat ourselves. Waited bout 10 minutes for a menu and to place our drink menu. There was about 18 people at the time. Ordered a bloody Mary and a beer and the waitress picked up the olives with her fingers and put them in my drink. UUGGG! We ordered a turkey wrap and the Mac and hotdog with cheese on the tater tots. After over 35 minutes we gotta turkey sandwich and cold Mac with no cheese on the tots. Waitress never came back . We watched 2 other groups walk out cause no one ever came to the table and someone else brought over our check. NEVER GOING BACK. Shame. Not a lot of bars in meridian

text: Good food. Great music - love that Grant Garland Trio on Tuesday nights! Check it out!!

text: One of my favorite bars in Philadelphia! The crowd is always awesome and everyone is super chill. The place is decorated in a cool fashion, and it's right next to the El so it's easy to get to via subway. The drinks are huge and $6, which is worth I.T. Love coming here!!!
name: Colleen

text: Best cheesesteak ever! Steak cooked fresh to order. Roll was perfect too. Delicious hand cut fries too!

text: There are a lot of mixed reviews of this place and I can see why. The food is hit or miss depending on what you order. We went on a Friday night and there was no wait and the food came out really quickly. BYOB is always a perk. We started out with the bahn beo not knowing what it was. Loved it! We ordered the quang noodles and pork clay pot. Quang noodles were a little bland and definitely needed some spice added to it. Pork clay pot was amazing. So much flavor, loved it!

It tasted alright but they definitely DRENCHED it with dressing or it was sitting out too long. It was also pretty loud inside but overall it wasn't a bad experience and everything but the salad was perfect and well proportioned. Would recommend!

text: It's literally been years since I've written a review, but I had such a good experience here that I'm taking the time to do this. I'm in Philly for work, and needed a quick, fast breakfast. Oddly enough, my hotel wasn't serving hot breakfasts (odd for a higher-end hotel, IMO), so I decided to walk down the street and see what was out there. Randomly came across this place and went in because it was open. SUPER friendly staff who really elevated a potentially blah experience into a "Wow I'm a good mood today!" experience. Food was tasty and fast and good value. You can come for the food and the value, but really, come for the friendly service. It made all the difference!

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. text:
This place is excellent.  Large space is perfect for big parties.  They have tvs to watch the game, including a huge movie screen in the bar room.

The food is delicious -- fresh burgers, chicken, and salads.  It's great, scratch made bar food.  There is something for everyone...I took 30 people there for the UA/ASU game and everybody -- adults and kids -- was happy.

The service is solid and very friendly.

And, of course, the beer.  This is Tucson's original hometown brewery. With the Gentle Ben's legacy, Barrio turns out great beer.  My favorite is the Rojo.  But from wheat beer to the citrizona to Barrio Blonde and everything in between...you can't go wrong.

Highly recommend.  Great place.  Great for groups.
name: Dev

text: Food is great.  Service is slow every single time we have visited.  Food is worth the wait if you have the patience.

text:
Downgrading to three stars. I've been to this place 5-10 times now, and my visit three weeks ago was enough to make me never return again. My friend and I ordered ahi tuna tacos and a prime rib to share. The ahi tuna tacos--which are usually so good that I'm intensely craving them for hours before my visit--were slightly burned such that the burnt taste overpowered the usual flavor. My friend ordered a margarita and the waitress brought the wrong one, acknowledged she brought the wrong one, and told my friend to try it and if she didn't like it, return it. Um, what? Why not just bring the correct drink when you know you've made a mistake. My friend didn't like the incorrect drink and had to wait for the waitress to return and tell the bartender to make a new one. 

These two issues are forgivable but what really got me is that the prime rib did not have the taste and consistency of their usual prime rib. It was tough and chewy rather than melt-in-your-mouth tender and fatty like every other prime rib I've ordered from this restaurant. We continued to eat while we were waiting for our waiter to return because we were starving, and when we asked her if it was possible that the kitchen hadn't given us a prime rib, she told us that each steak is going to differ. Then she told us that we'd already eaten most of the steak anyways. No attempt to even check with the kitchen if there had been a mistake. Honestly, the thought of returning sounds extremely unappealing if each steak is going to differ to the point where a prime rib might not have the flavor and consistency of a prime rib. Very disappointing experience.

text:
Growing up in San Diego (right next to Mexico) I was spoiled with great tasting Mexican food.

When I moved to Reno several years ago, I had hope to find something close or similar to what I was accustomed to. I searched and searched and nothing came close. 

I'm glad to say that I found something that made me feel back at home... D'Javs, who, I was surprised to find wasn't on Yelp yet. I actually ran into them last summer but wasn't able to write a review, but now that I figured out how to, well here it is LOL. Let's call that Filipino time. 

My friends, they have authentic tacos made by authentic Mexican cooks. They're very delicious and full of flavor. Carne Asada and Al Pastor(pork marinated in chili, spices and pineapple) never fail.

I love how they're wrapped in foil to keep the heat in and their hot sauce is very spicy, which I'm into, but isn't for everybody. I've had better, but I'm not complaining. I'm just happy it doesn't taste like watered down hot sauce. 

Their horchata has great flavor too, definitely not commercial. 

I took a chance at ordering one of their burgers. I ordered the Hawaiian, which came with bacon, ham, a meat patty, a pineapple slice, lettuce and tomato. It turned out to be a big portion and delicious. 

I understand that the market isn't saturated with great tasting Mexican food so I understand that the prices are a bit higher. I'm willing to pay a little extra for great tasting Mexican food that hits the spot. 

I didn't see them in business during winter so I'm assuming that they're only out during the summer, but I will double check with them and make sure to update this review. 

While you're there, 168 Asian Market(they share the same parking lot with D'Javs) has a lot of Asian staples and products, much cheaper and more authentic than what you'd find in commercial stores. A lot of times, they also have prepared Asian foods from their kitchen, a lot of which are Chinese and Filipino foods.
name: Katherine

text:
The Rec Room is a fun place to spend a few hours, so many great games available to play. Personal favourites include the giant PAC man, Mario Kart, and the all new Halo game (can't get enough Halo in my life). The Void is another great addition to the Rec Room's arsenal, I'd recommend everyone goes and experiences the secrets of the empire! 

Where the Rec Room falls down (and this is also true of the south side location) is the food and bar service.  Let's be honest, it's not on the cheap side, $7 for a pint of Lucky and $8 for a pint of Budweiser is really reaching. What's worse is when it takes over 25 minutes for said $7 pint of Lucky to appear, on a Sunday, when there's not really anyone in the bar. The server was pleasant enough and apologised profusely, however during the 25 minute wait, they could maybe have saved a bit of time by asking for our food order. Which then also took an age to appear. Thank goodness they give you a bag of popcorn to snack on, or we'd have starved to death. 

Like I say, I enjoy going to the rec room for the games, but if you fancy food and a beer after you're done, maybe try somewhere else.

text:
Convenient mall Chinese food--but how does it taste? A lot of you young 'uns may not remember this, but back in the 1980s women's magazines in America would have these startlingly inauthentic "Chinese" recipes. You'd see recipes like "Chinese pineapple surprise" which was boneless chicken, pineapple, ketchup, and just a hint of soy sauce for that "unique Asian flavor." 

I remember my mom cooking those sorts of things. And the food at this place tastes just like that! You don't taste garlic or rice wine or pepper or sesame oil. Just plain ol' chicken and soy sauce and rice. It's not terrible but definitely not worth a detour. Cheap as heck, though: my two-entree meal was like $7. (See pic.) Fellow Gen X and older folks, relive the American Chinese food of the 70s and 80s right here in sunny Delaware!
name: Akash

text: Papa Bear never returned after waiting over an hour. Several cars came, waited and left. What a shame to run a business this way. I do not recommend Papa Bear Chicken to anyone.// So after we left and had dinner at Mug n Bun, I called to see if this place was open yet since he was to return in 15 minutes-lol. 31/2 hrs have passed and YES Papa Bear Chicken is open. We drove back, went in and was greeted by Papa Bear. I had purchased discount coupons from Fox59 which clearly state that no more than two may be used at one time. Well, he refused to accept more than one. We just had to go with the flow and use one, and hope and pray we can find him open again. We ended up ordering 10 lemon pepper drummettes, and 10 garlic Parmesan drummettes. I did try each when we got home. The lemon pepper was my favorite. I was pleasantly surprised. I ordered them because so many others raved about them in their reviews. The taste of lemon was distinct yet not sour or bitter, but pleasant and delicious. The pepper was there to add to the flavor, but not hot or overpowering. They are yummy! The garlic Parmesan surprised me. I guess I don't know much about wings because they were wet and I thought they would all be dry rub. For my taste they were ok, but I prefer bbq wings or hot wings or all lemon pepper! I will return to use my Fox59 coupon, but after that...no returning for me. I am leaving my rating a one star because when your sign says you open at 5pm, you need to open at 5pm. When people have certificates that say they can use two, they should be allowed to use two.

text:
I enjoyed the variety of food on this buffet but their price is way out of line. If you are a senior you can get one meal a week at half price so you might want to check that out. As I was having my meal there this evening I got up to go visit the buffet again and I left my plate on the table about halfway thinking it would be safe. Wrong! When I got back they had cleared it. I would never waste that much food intentionally so I was very disappointed.

Update April 2019:

I have visited Toucan Charlie's buffet several times since my last review and I am now ready to update my star rating to 4 stars.
My son and I both enjoy a buffet meal, do not mind serving ourselves and have found Toucan Charlie's to be the best in town. When he is in town on a Monday evening we often find ourselves enjoying the two for one, senior special on Monday evening.
I have solved the problem of coming away from the buffet with that stuffed feeling by taking very small portions of many different foods offered.
We are usually seated in the east end of the dining room and I rarely make it to the Mexican section anymore. I don't make a huge effort because we often frequent Mexican restaurants in town. 
I love the salad section and always begin there. Their latest offerings in the appetizer section are amazing to me and I add some to my salad plate. 
The carving station always has interesting offerings. I tend to ask for the items that I never cook at home and usually do not order and other restaurants. They always have lamb around the major holidays and I find that a real treat. 
I do not order the Mongolian barbecue because that would be too filling and I want to try small portions of the regular Chinese dishes. 
The seafood selection is not large but sometimes offers wonderful delights like steamed clams and steamed mussels.
Be sure to save room for dessert as the selection is huge and includes gelato and many sugar free items, to say nothing of the fresh cotton candy!

With very few exceptions the wait staff does an excellent job.

One thing that is going to be showing up in my reviews whenever I see it is the cleaning of the floor with those small vacuums or even a broom  and dustpan while the diners are still eating. It is a disgusting practice as it puts a lot of street dirt into the air. They do it at Charlie's and I don't like it!

I didn't have a bad experience here - on the contrary, service was great and it's so cute inside, with lights strung across the ceiling over the bar area. However, if I am completely honest, I don't think I would come back simply due to the cost/benefit ratio. To be fair, I was there for happy hour. 

The happy hour menu consists of 4 drink specials (a Pilsner, house red, and two cocktails) and a mix of 7 seemingly random food items (cheese plate, oysters, fries, shrimp cocktail, brussel sprouts, deviled eggs, and a burger). It's definitely one of the more expensive happy hour menus (for food): $12 for 6 oysters? $10 for a small bowl of brussel sprouts?! 

I opted for the P&K "Single" Cheeseburger, which came with iceberg lettuce, fried onions, and dijonnaise. Admittedly, it was pretty good, but I wasn't asked how I'd like the meat cooked and the portions were pretty small. The bun was also a bit too big for the burger itself. My other critique is that my food was lukewarm. The fries were average. 

I have no problem paying more for quality but unfortunately I just wasn't impressed.

text:
Whenever we passed this place during lunch and dinner time, there was always a long line outside the door. And we finally got to check out Felix's in an afternoon. 

We began with a catfish Po-boy. The sandwich itself tasted amazing, with the catfish cooked perfectly to golden brown, and just the right amount of seasoning. It looked and smelled amazingly intriguing. I only wished the fries were cooked for longer. Some of them were quite wilted. 

I had always been interested to try out the turtle soup. And to be honest, I was not as impressed as I imagined I would be. The seasoning was quite overpowering. It really didn't make any different what ingredients were in the soup. Adding on to that, with everything diced into small pieces, I really couldn't tell what I had. 

The stuffed catfish had to be the highlight of the meal. I didn't even know catfish could be delicate like this. It even gave me the illusion that I was eating cod lol. Felix's really did bring the piece of catfish to another entirely new level. 

We really enjoyed everything we ordered. What a fantastic meal!

text:
Welcome to Nashville's new temple of Indian street food, presented by the cuisine's highest priestess, Maneet Chauhan. Chauhan's Ale and Masala House is Nashville's most reliable source of fine Indian dining (with a Southern flair). Chaatable continues the tradition of excellent food, service and atmosphere, but with a street food twist. Maneet and her husband and business partner Vivek Deora have repurposed the former Salt and Vine space, and it's a feast for the senses. The decor is lively, with a wall of bangle bracelets, and whimsical lighting fixtures made from brightly colored parasols hung by their handles. 

Come for the atmosphere; stay for the food and service. The servers (especially Vincent) were professional, efficient, and they really knew the menu. 

We started with the "Street Ballin" potato fritter vada pau sliders. I'd describe it as the best knish you ever had, with amazing chutney and spicy green finger chilies, served on a butter toasted bun. Crispy, spicy, savory, soft ... I could eat about 100 of 'em!

We then tried the "Shammi the Way" spiced lamb kebab slider with mint chutney, garam masala, and picked onion slaw. The slight gaminess of the lamb was perfectly accompanied by the spice mix, and the lively acidity of the onions. 

We were surprised with a "build it yourself" bhel puri, served in an authentic tiffin, compliments of Maneet herself. The puffed rice was perfectly crispy, and the chutney and vegetables combined to make it a delight on the tongue.

Then we moved onto the the "Curry On" pork belly sorpotel curry. It was decadent; the pork belly was unctuous, and the curry was dark, with multiple layers of flavor. I'm still trying to figure out all of the flavors in that sauce!

We also had the "Goan Deep" shrimp; 5 plump, juicy, perfectly cooked jumbo shrimp with a tomato based sauce. In a town that cooks seafood to death, this dish was a breath of fresh air. The sweet brininess of the shrimp was a great foil to the subtle cumin, tomato and mustard seed sauce.

Then onto desserts. We had a chocolate mini tart shell filled with dark chocolate ganache, and pieces of sesame/honey crisp. So dark, so rich, so delicious! We couldn't resist trying the "Full On Falooda"; pistachio-cardamom kulfi Sunda with "rose" noodles. A perfect ending to our meal. 

Go with a group; order everything on the menu. You will NOT be disappointed. We are SO lucky that Maneet and Vivek have adopted Nashville as their own!
name: Marc

text: I have only had one sub everytime i go because i love it so much. I normally have the club on a sub with grape sprite. And its honeslty amazing. I love ecerything on it and wouldnt change a thing.
name: Addison

text:
Take out review: certainly deserving of high stars! But this is a limited review because we simply walked in and walked out. 

Staff was friendly on the phone to take my order but they were certainly busy!! Easy to order and was able to switch fruit out in the order instead of potatoes (although they did charge me extra for this without telling me). 

Omelettes were on par- nothing extravagant. Toppings were spinach and roasted peppers! And my gf loved the potatoes. And I must say it was the best fruit salad I have gotten at a cafe. Cantaloupe, blueberries, strawberries, and fresh banana! Totally yum. Rye toast (two pieces) can't with each omelette. 

Take out came with utensils and napkins and also little ramekin a of a pad of butter and ketchup! So nice! 

This place was fast and easy and delicious for takeout!
name: Lea

text: Terrible front desk service especially the little troll with the green hair. Super rude to the customers should go back underneath her bridge. As soon as we walked in she had an instant attitude so bad we got up and left. Unfortunate though because the menu looked amazing
name: Hannah

text: I enjoyed the food both times I dined there. However, each time they always seemed to run out of things. One time it was soda another time cocktail sauce, no vanilla ice cream, etc. While I understand its relatively new I do think they need to ensure to stock up on what I felt were basic perishables items. Especially, at the price they charge for dinner. I will give them another try in a few weeks or so to see if there has been any improvement.
name: Juanita

text: Very good quality. Small family run place with a huge selection albeit in a very small space. Their sandwiches are on the small side but very good quality; worth the money. The seeded rolls are the way to go.
name: Mark

text: Great margaritas! JP the bartender is amazing and has fantastic customer service skills, very personable! The fresh made salsa is to die for! This restaurant is fantastic!
name: Sherri

text: Just being at the Arizona Inn is amazing. The grounds and restaurant are beautiful. I've eaten breakfast here twice and it's very good. Prices are good and service was wonderful.
name: Karen

text: Burnt Ends are a must.  Restaurant has a really cool vibe and can be pretty busy so don't be mad if you have to wait, it will be worth it.
name: Michael

text: Don't leave without trying the apple cinnamon pancake, it's covered with cinnamon crispy bits. I was going to get the chocolate chip pancake but was rightfully told by Donovan that those are for kids. I also tried the Chicken Fried Chicken & Chicken Fried Steak. I usually love the taste of fried chicken more than anything else. But the steak was better than chicken. The BACON was amazing, if you get the country fried chicken, make a little sandwich with the eggs, bacon and toast. You won't regret it!
name: Exsenet

text:
Absolutely terrible experience. We had booked 2 rooms - over $6000.00 for two nights. You would imagine for this money one would receive top drawer service. One of the rooms was never cleaned at all.
Second room -
Upon check-in the "bungalow" room we booked turned out was not a bungalow at all. Management said new room would be available immediately - never was 
The room we were put in smelled like rot ($1700/night) - new room promised, but management was never available.  
the first night this $1700/night room was cleaned dirty half filled cups of tea were left as well as the melted ice cream. 
This "bungalow" room was a handicap room with railings everywhere. We did not request nor need to have this room - we were promised a new room - this too was never provided. 
The managers were unresponsive, incompetent - with frozen smiles on their face, promising to fix the problems by doing absolutely nothing 
24 hours after we left the hotel a manager called back and instead of apologizing, providing a discount or acknowledging the incompetence claimed that we booked this rotten smelling handicap  room. 
Four Seasons once stood for excellence and luxury.  Now this Santa Barbara resort stands for expensive mildew smelling rooms with incompetent management, poor service and lack luster failure to live up to its heretofore reputation. You will walk through the halls and you will see many people smile and greet you - there is No substance to this just robotic smiles. Maybe they should take the four seasons name off its title. So people will not be deceived into thinking that they are receiving four seasons service. After 10 years of staying here ... no one should come here !
name: Kathy

text: Came here with my mom and grandma at the end of my junior year. All of the food was amazing. Really fun, young atmosphere that was nice and welcoming. You MUST get the milk and cookies dessert, simply amazing and a crowd pleaser. I will go back one day to buy more desserts and treats in the bakery.
name: Lauren

text: We went on a Groupon. I had never heard of this restaurant before Groupon. We had the mare monte And my husband the fettuccini and both dishes were wonderful. The pasta is homemade. We also indulged in the tiramisu. My husband tried to resist but could not. All in all it was a great experience. We will have to return.
name: Regina

text:
Was extremely excited to try out this place based on the yelp ratings, unfortunately it did not live up the hype of the rest of the ratings.

Pros: ambiance was quite nice, chef (I think as she came from the kitchen wearing chef like clothes) was very sweet along with the other male server..

Cons: Our server was not quite up to par and seem overwhelmed upon another couple arriving to eat at restaurant. 

We arrived fairly early to dinner and was really the only people there (4:45-5ish). Our server did not get our order right and only remembered it upon dropping off our food, the side dishes were forgotten and I had request it 2 times, 2nd time was directly from the chef..and at which point brought one tiny bowl of 4 pieces of fried plantains for 2 entrees.

As for the entrees: I wasn't impressed, we had the 8 jerk wings which I expected to be extra spicy per the menu description.. was not spicy rather quite mild  however good flavor..I also ordered a jerk chicken platter, I had better jerk chicken at jerk hut and obviously Jamaica.. it wasn't spicy rather quite mild and portion was not as big as some of the pictures on yelp (I had 3 pieces of chicken as part of my jerk chicken entree for $17.95) comes with rice/peas and a side salad (and fried plantains - apparently just 2 pieces and must request for it as it doesn't come with meal), my mom had the combo platter with oxtail stew, jerk chicken and goat curry which we requested to be swapped out for brown stewed chicken- which our server forgot to do so until the food arrived).. oxtail has good flavors but not amazing and brown stewed was quite sweet(so mediocre), the jerk chicken (2 pieces) - same as mine.. $25.95)

I also ordered a soursop relaxed (aka with alcohol) drink- $12.95 (I don't think there was a drop of alcohol in it mainly bc my mom doesn't normally drink and she gets bright red with two sips of beer let alone alcohol and had no reaction and couldn't even taste it in the drink) I did ask the server if there was any alcohol in it and she said yes, but neither myself or mom could taste it.

Also- there were no homemade hot sauces like jerk hut, when I asked for hot sauce(again- I had to ask twice, my server was really not on par at all even with no one else there until the tail end of our meal).. she brought tobasco (yes-tobasco) and a bottle of scotch bonnet (not very hot) -- note: that I did shared that I had been to Jamaica and enjoyed extremely spicy foods.. was very surprised to only get 2 mild hot pepper sauce meanwhile via yelp- I have seen 4-5 bottles for other customers in the picture.. 

Overall- not worth the hype or the price ($85 for 2 w/tip). I would suggest jerk hut over this place but if you are looking for nice ambience- I would recommend this place just for that.

Too pricey for lack of good service!
name: Renee

text:
This is a pretty cool spot.

Pros:

- unique menu with lots of options. I'm not vegan but enjoyed a lot of the cool twists on vegan food
- easy to order and food is ready immediately
- great outdoor patio
- not crazy expensive 

Cons:

- the food isn't amazing to the point that I'd want to quickly go back on my own. But if it was suggested as a place to meet up with friends, I wouldn't say no.
name: Greg

text: I used to love this chipotle and would go out of my way to come here, staff was always awesome and the portions were great but this last time was a thorough disappointment. Payed $20 for 2 burritos and they were literally half the size of what I used to get. Sad to say I Won't be coming back
name: Michael

text:
This was my first time visiting a Waffle House. Our friend picked us up from the airport and since I had never been to Tennessee or Waffle House, we stopped at this one which was near our hotel. It looks a little dingy and dirty from the outside. Sitting down it was definitely a bit sticky, but what classic breakfast restaraunt isn't? It appeared as if we had arrived just after a small rush. This is a 24 hour spot and we went between midnight and 1am.

Our waitress, Chelsey, was incredibly kind and hospitable. I told her it was my first time there and she was in disbelief! She brought me a waffle house hat and explained some favorites. I ordered the all star with biscuits and gravy since I hadn't eaten much after flying all day. My boyfriend also got food. Our experience was To Go, but she made sure we had a wonderful experience here while we waited. She is awesome!!!!! After a long, disappointing travel day it was just the perfect service experience.

We took our food back to the hotel and I seriously devoured it. I've never been to a chain breakfast spot that tasted so delicious. My waffle was sweet and perfectly cooked. The eggs were standard. The hashbrowns (i got with mushroom topping) were perfect. Biscuits and gravy were good. Even the wheat toast with jam was fantastic!!!!! She remembered to pack plenty of napkins, utensils, and spreads for us. I can honestly say this was a breakfast game changing experience. I only wish we had them closer to where I live!
name: Camille

text: We have been dining at Sang Kee for years. We were away for 3 years a nd just returned to the main line of Philadelphia. We are dining tonite at this great Asian restuarant. The food is really great Asian cuisine. As a Producer I have been fortunate to travel to many countries and this Sang Kee is a fine dining experience for fair prices. Don't miss it go often you will never be disappointed.
name: Tom

text: Please tell the kid that kept saying "okey dokey" and calling me his "good sir" to stop talking to me like I subscribe to his YouTube channel.
name: Tyler

text: The food was OK... no one in our party of four was overly ecstatic about their meal. Don't order the Marsala because it had no flavor. The whole experience was terrible because it was like an ice box. I tied two black napkins together to make a shawl. The waitress gave us a bit of an attitude when dropping off the checks. I won't be back.
name: Kimberly

text:
Filament found in tomato pie

The company doesn't stand behind its products. I ordered a tomato pie and picked up on December 23rd. They were closed on Christmas Eve and did not open until after Christmas. We found a filament in it but the manager either played dumb or did not understand customer service. She asked me to bring in the pie, but who would keep a no good pie for three days?  They refused to give me any remuneration.  Honestly, who would spend time and efforts over $10?

Reasonable price and good value, but the company does not do the basic thing right.  They've lost my business.
name: Hazel

text: Excellent food and drinks !! Pork chops were the best ever and a blackened grouper sandwich that melted in my mouth!  We will definitely be back.
name: Matt

text: Really fun local place with indoor and outdoor seating.  Good prices on Yeungling draughts @ $2.  Lovely when the weather is good and you can sit outside and they have the place all opened up.  Daily specials rock and they have a very good kids menu.
name: Adam

text:
Totally overrated. The garlic bread is disgusting, the kids pizzas were so bad I almost vomited when trying a bite, and I found hair in three of our dishes. 
Also, my bill was $87 and I handed the waitress $120 cash expecting to receive change and was never given anything back. 
Hands down, worst dining experience I've ever had!
name: Brianne

text: A favorite old Millstadt tradition that has been restored and managed better than ever. Not a better fish sandwich on the planet than you can get at Ott's!
name: Rich

text:
Ordered types of gelato today, "salted caramel" and "decadent coffee". $5 for two little scoops, which would have been totally fine if there were delicious.

The salted caramel was good though not great. I've had better and I've had worse. The 2 stars are both for the salted caramel.

The "decadent" coffee was a HUGE disappointment. There were a lot of ice crystals, making it much more like a sorbet than a gelato. I suspect there was too much ice on the top and the server just skimmed that off for us. But that's not the worst part. There were A LOT of coffee grounds! Did they not even care to filter them away? Overall it was icy, grainy, JUST ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING! I brought it up to the server and the response was "that's how it's supposed to be because we use coffee".

Oh come on... That kind of attitude ALWAYS chases away customers.
name: S

text: Absolutely amazing service. Owner is a sweetheart  food is so good! Something for everyone and every tastebud
name: Giuliana

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Idk, the fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. For the price I expected more than this. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Excellent customer service!! I ordered one large plain pie and a chicken and broccoli alfredo dinner. My husband went to pick up the food and when he got home we realized it was one large chicken and broccoli alfredo pizza! It looked absolutely delicious but unfortunately not what we ordered. I called back and explained and the woman was so apologetic and said we can keep the pie and pick up our correct order with no extra charge since it was an error. (Our correct order was $6 more). She even said she'll throw in extra garlic knots with our order. We order from here often and it was so nice that they cared and wanted us to be happy with our dinner tonight!
name: Marissa

text: Today was the first time I had Famous Crab Cakes. Even when they were located on chester pike.. living right down the street from them, I've never attempted to try them. My boyfriend brought home the menu after seeing it when he was getting coffee at Dunkin. So today we just went for it. I got the jumbo lump crab cake sandwich and my boyfriend got the supreme crab combo. Both were absolutely amazing. The best crab cakes I have yet to have in delco. He crab meat was fresh, juicy and flavorful. No fillers added as some pizza places do around here. The special crab sauce is amazing. Will definitely be back . Highly recommended.
name: Nicole

text: Went in on a Friday night just after 7 PM. The person who took my order was obviously distracted the entire time. I was told it would be 25-35 minutes. After 45 minutes what looked to be my order was up but instead of my name "Holly" being called the name "Paulina" was called. No one claimed the order and the very same person who took my order called out "Paulina" several more times. Then gave up. He proceeded to count tips from the tip jar. We went up to the counter just to verify that he heard my name correctly and those two pizzas getting cold weren't ours. He quickly said "No. These are for Paulina. Yours should be up next." After another 15 minutes I overheard other employees trying to figure out what order we could possibly be waiting for. I then went up to the counter to verify my order and it turns out it was the "Paulina" order. THEN the man who took my order had the audacity to say "We called your name." I expressed that my name was not Paulina and that I had tried 15 minutes early to confirm the order and was told no. In short, the service was garbage
name: Holly

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It was crowded but still moved along. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Wish I could you you zero stars food was cold & bland order online at Grubhub restaurant is  10 mins away by the time my order came food was cold and my lasagna tasted like abc spaghetti out straight out the can. Read the reviews before ordering this place sucks
name: Freak

text: Love love love rays! My friend and I went a few months ago and I just had to come back! The first time we went we both got the siphoned coffee and it was excellent. We also got the dumping sampler, I was in the area with another friend and was raving about the dumpling sampler on Saturday and went back to show her. They have a special that's 13.99 mic&match for an entree and two items, whatever you choose that's on that menu, can be an appetizer and drink, two apps, two drinks whatever you wish. I got the dumpling sampler, the shrimp roll and the bubble tea. The shrimp roll was perfect, cut in half and made just right. The dumpling sampler is something I will always stop in for it I'm in the area. There's two of each dumpling (you can split with whoever you're with, it's a lot of food and I ended up taking some home) it comes with two pork, two vegetable, two chicken curry and two more (drawling a blank on what kind they were...) my favorite is the chicken curry. It was seasoned so perfect and just excellent all around. The space is a small little shop right off 9th. There's plenty of on the street parking as well as a parking lot right down the street. If you're in the area I suggest you stop!
name: Roxanne

text:
Wife and I love this place, takes hours to look at everything they have from all over the world.

Stop in and check it out, you won't be disappointed and I bet you leave with something very neat to try at home
name: Bo

text: Very casual pizza joint with delicious pizza. Don't expect a waitstaff. The employs aren't very attentive, but the place was clean and they were nice.
name: G

text: I ordered 2 pizzas and when I picked them up I paid 36.00 for both. When I got to the car they were less than 12 inches in diameter and super dry with minimal sauce and cheese. What a ripoff!!! Last time I go there
name: Julio

text:
The Vine is a regular stop in our week! It can get pretty busy in the middle of lunch so we like to go right when they open or a little after 1pm. We always choose the patio when the weather is right! 

Usually, we start off with their amazing hummus and unlimited pita, which is a total win. We are addicted to their chicken shawarma. Julia gets the wrap with fries, plenty of food and amazing value. I get the entree with extra garlic sauce. You get a side salad or soup and I change it up every time because they're all delicious. 

We also take advantage of their carry out, whether we're picking up some hummus or getting trays of food for a party, they are always so accommodating and get our order right. 

Friendly and hardworking staff, delicious food, tons of options? What more could you want!
name: Max

text: I've order takeout for two dinners one with sirloin steak and the other sirloin and lobster. When I got home I've noticed they forgot the lobster. I called them and the said they would compensate me for another dinner. They sent me $10 gift certificate when the dinner that they was messed up  was $16. NEVER WILL I GO HERE AGAIN!!
name: Kevin

text: I got bubble tea here and was disappointed by it for multiple reasons. It was weird to me that half the drink was filled with ice and that made it harder to get the bubbles, which were hard. The taro flavor itself was okay, but the drink was overflowing the cup and there must have been a hole somewhere because for some reason while drinking it I kept spilling the drink. I'm not usually picky about bubble tea but I didn't love the experience. If I come back it will be to try other things on their menu.
name: Judy

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Food took a while and didn't rlly feel worth the wait. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not sure though.
name: User

text: Very rude. I came in with a large parcel and a camera, and the server tried to seat me at the tiniest table with no space for my camera bag without risking it getting bumped into or spilled on. I asked for a booth or bigger space - The restaurant was not more than half full at this time. She shot me a dirty look but she sat me at another booth. Then after waiting about five minutes someone came around to take my order, and I asked if instead of having both soup and spring roll with my entrée if I could just have a different soup instead. I explained that I have a dietary restriction and a food allergy, but the server cut me off and did not care, she stated that that would be impossible. She said it would only be something they could accommodate if I paid an extra five dollars, And then I still wouldn't even get the other two items anyway, so essentially I was paying five dollars extra for a smaller meal. I decided it was time to leave so I got up and left. Now I get to go back to work with no lunch, so I really cannot say that I suggest this place if you were looking for something quick on your lunch break. They were rude, and don't care about people with food allergies.
name: Anna

text: I've tried plenty of sushi places in town, and this one is definitely my favorite. My wife and I have never had a bad experience here, and they started to remember our order after only going there a handful of times! Definitely worth a visit.
name: Aaron

text: This may be listed as a "dive" bar, but the place is fun. Great moments with friends old and not yet met! The owners are involved with the customers, not stuffy. They meet and shake hands and welcome everyone to their place. They are also responsible for the people they serve, I've seen that first hand. They would call you a cab rather than say see ya. If you have a chance, I would recommend every thing on the menu. Food is great too. You need to come in and see for yourself!
name: Joann

text: This is my family's long time favorite breakfast, lunch and dinner restaurant to eat. We have been coming here for years and the experience always getting better. The staff is always smiling and has the best customer service. Sean was the all time best, he had my family and I smiling and laughing as soon as we walked in until the time we left. Deky was also great she always came to check on us, was super sweet and always had a smile! The food was great as always, would recommend the crazy spicy skillet!!
name: Bella

text: Very good cheesesteak with lots of meat BUT something is keeping me from getting excited about Louie.  I may have had too high expectations.
name: James

text:
Always hits the spot whenever I order food from here.
Try the combo platters, the pork fried rice here is made well.
name: Aj

text:
Well put a pumpkin spiced latte in my hand and stick me in front of a mural because this place has basic white girl written all over it.

I mean that in the nicest way possible. Kokos has a quality product in a trendy space (Mad Men meets Palm Trees) that's located in a really fun area of town. I got the chocolate and was as happy as a clam. Other flavors that stuck out were cookie dough and mint chocolate chip. Tastes exactly like you think it would.

The ONLY feedback I have (and this is reaching) is to have more than one person working in the prime ice cream times of day. My two friends and I got there around 8 pm and no one was there. Ten minutes later she had an 8 person line. 

All in all "nice cream".
name: Sally

text: Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Honestly, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Also, the sauces helped more than i thought they would.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. so yeah kind of mixed on it. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not bad for a quick meal. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text:
Fresh, fresh, fresh and the perfect portion.  This is one of the best Poke bowls i've had with very fresh ingredients and light on the sauces.  The brown rice is a mixture of brown rice and quinoa which was unique.  I was very satisfied with the food quality.

1 star off because when we went to order food we were told it would be at least a 5 minute wait because the guy was working by himself and had a huge order.  We decided to wait since we stopped here specifically for this place.  Once he finished the order he was working on, he was very attentive and got us our food quickly.  I mostly felt bad for him not having any help and being mid-day on a weekend.

Definitely worth the wait.  Parking is available in parking garage below and the first 75 mins are free so this was perfect for us.
name: Debbie

text: It was really good but when we got there they were sold out of ribs and brisket. We tried the burnt ends and enjoyed that better than the pork platter.
name: Isabel

text:
The food is average but a little on the pricy side for Thai food. This is most likely due to their location. Sadly this part of the city is lacking many Thai options, so we eat here every couple of months, but I wish there were more Thai options in the neighborhood. 

They can do gluten free, but we are suspicious of cross contamination due to reactions my wife has had a few times after eating there.
name: KJ

text:
Great new restaurant in the Cool Springs area. Clean. Good barbecue. Our favorite sides were the potato salad and baked beans. The Mac and cheese was OK. Needs a little sharp cheese added. The red beans were my least favorite. However, the guy next to us said they were the best he ever had. I think they have too much cumin. The spice didn't go well. Good bread.

Update:
I wish this were a counter service meat and three type place for lunch. It can get pricey with a tip for lunchtime.
name: Kelly

text: This is one of my favorite restaurants in town. My only issue is the parking around 12-1 is insane as the plaza gets packed. I recommend you plan an early lunch around 11:30 or after 1. If you want to try a bunch of different things I recommend taco Tuesday and you can pick one of each for a low cost to find your favorite.
name: Joshua

text: This is the only Thai restaurant i have ever been too, and this is probably my 3rd or 4th time coming to this place. I placed a carry out order for Hawaiian fried rice and thai dumplings( my favorite). If you enjoy very spicy food I recommend ordering your food "thai hot", your lips and tongues will be on fire! Lol. Also the rice portions are a nice size, big enough to share with 2-3 people. I've tasted their red curry( which was my first time ever trying thai curry) and spring rolls a few months ago which were pretty tasty also. Inside the restaurant is pretty small, but the atmosphere and decor is very inviting and relaxing. Great Thai food in the Avon area!
name: Jada

text: The food was pretty great, got the wings, Flagler burger, and grouper sandwich and they were all awesome as well as the wine and ciders. However, the service was not the greatest. Servers seemed inattentive and they only waited on us when we had to ask them to come to the table. I will say though that most, not all, were very pleasant servers as well as very apologetic when they realized we weren't too happy. I would definitely come and try it again though.
name: Karlie

text: Food was okay, nothing worth going out of my way for to be honest. We got the food late night via UberEats. I got the wuzzam chicken wings, lemon pepper wings, and the ranch fries. The ranch fries were delicious!! The wuzzam wings were average. The lemon pepper wings were good, I'm usually not a fan of dry rub but i was really surprised. They're more on the lemony side and very zesty. Overall it was an okay place to visit - it's nice that it's open so late.
name: Seleyna

text: Good Chicken except they don't tell you it's Halal Chicken till after you buy it and They Don't sell any other Chicken  with no Choices so I give them 2 stars
name: Randall

text: We had the baked scrod the other night. It was just like We have had in Boston many times. Well prepared and nice portions. We also had a nice bottle of wine and were happy to find out it was 50% off on Wednesday night. Service was perfect. We had a great date night. Well done!
name: Mark

text: I had the light clam chowder, tuna, and Kung Pao Caulifllower.  It was all really good but the meal, which was all appetizers, was a bit overpriced.  The waitress was really nice and on the ball.  I would definitely go there again.
name: A

text: Fast service. Delicious food.we shared an omelette and hash browns.  There was a good amount of food. We both were satisfied and full.
name: Shelley

text: It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Will be back.
name: User

text: We have been going to Jilly's for over 10 years since they first opened.  Always enjoyed our dinners, always gave them nice reviews.  The last couple of visits have not been the same and today was the worst experience yet.  We actually had a birthday coupon today for "up to $10 off 2nd entree".  My husband and I ordered the petite flat iron steak, salad and baked potato.  Our "medium" steak came out well done but still we didn't make a big deal about it.  When our server came back to the table and said we have a little problem, "the manager went to the bank and I can't take the coupon without him here" we were not real happy but he was supposed to be back soon so we would just wait a few minutes. Well, for a Sunday there must have been a big line at the bank because he never came back.  The server figured out how to deduct $10 from our tab, we paid and left.  As much as we've bragged on this establishment and told people they need to check it out...not any more.  They've gone from bringing out baskets of great bread including carrot cake muffins to 2 cold dinner rolls, on our birthdays we were always treated to a small birthday dessert to having an issue using a birthday coupon.  Sounds like they need to step it up a notch or the few loyal dinner patrons they have will be dropping off quickly.  As a side note this is a very rare occasion for me to write a less than raving review.
name: Sheryl

text:
The new buildout is sleek, clean, and modern. 4/5 

We ate here for lunch and ordered the falafel bowl ($14)  and the chicken gyro ($10). 

The falafel bowl features falafel and several sides, overall very good, but the restaurant uses iceberg lettuce. 4/5

The chicken gyro had way too much tziki sauce and the side salad also had iceberg lettuce. 2/5. 

I want to return here for dinner and will probably order a platter, I am optimistic that maybe the chicken gyro was a misstep. Overall 3/5 stars.

 food check em out!! AWESOME EVERYTHING IS GOOD!!

We did not have dinner- just the goat cheese appetizer and a glass of wine prior to our dinner plans- but all of the entrees we saw come out of the kitchen looked fabulous, and I hope we will be returning soon to experience everything this place has to offer. The goat cheese app was very good, but maybe had a few too many raisins on it for my taste, and it was very rich- too much for just the two of us to finish. This would be better suited for a group of four possibly. Overall, the service was very good and we will be returning.
name: Sara

text:
I'm glad I made my reservation before the Craig LaBan 3-Bell review came out!  I might have not been able to get a table!

Came here as part of the birthday gift with the wife and family pre-ballet Romeo and Juliet opening night performance.  We had a wonderful time and great meal. 

After checking out the menu, we inquired about a tasting menu, which we found out they do not have but have accommodated with other customers in the past.  We discussed with the staff what we did not want (octopus) and what we did want (anything Craig LaBan liked and anything meat) and agreed to $50 a head for each of us (two adults and a 15 and 13-year-old) and they could bring a Chef's choice.

This was definitely the best way to go.  We were served multiple courses and got to try a lot of different menu items.  

Like individual personalities, we each had our likes and not-as-much likes.  My huge hit was the lamb ribs along with my son.  A family high was both types of cheeses - one baked mozzarella and one fried and more runny.  Lots of flavor.  I liked the Peri-Peri shrimp, but wife was meh.  The broccoli salad was so-so for all, but the lemon zested balls I pictured were like candy.  I was not a big fan of the shakshouka, and the wife and kids said the version at Cafe Ole was better.  We all loved the roasted carrot hummus, and I enjoyed the cauliflower.  The homemade naan was a winner. So were the triple desserts.

The meal was paced perfectly.  We had to be at the Academy of Music by 7:30 and our meal started at 5:20.  We got in our seats by 7:25!  

I had a mixed drink, glass of wine, and a cordial.  Wife had a mixed drink.  Kids stuck with water.  Too bad this is a Pepsi instead of Coke restaurant.

Service was very professional and they appeared to really like their work.  Their interactions with us were not overbearing, answered all our questions, and seemed excited that we were going to the ballet afterwards.  One had a friend who used to be in the company so it brought him some nice memories.

I highly recommend Spice Finch.  If you're vegetarian this is another outstanding choice in Philadelphia.  If you eat meat, this is another outstanding choice in Philadelphia!

$260 not including tip for four.  Off menu Chef's Choice agreed $50 a person. Includes alcohol.
name: Michael

text: My wife and I went to this place for a date night. Everything about this place was amazing. The food was out of this world . This was the absolute best date night experience! Our server was amazing. I would recommend the meat lovers and add on the Kobe beef. There was soooo much amazing food in the package ! 10/10 would definitely eat here again regularly!
name: Ross

text:
My friends and I all got together for Gasparilla in Tampa and this was the first spot our resident friend brought us.  I loved the overall look and decor of the place especially the artificial grass at the entrance which houses the outdoor seating area. It was too cold that day to eat outside though.  Our waitress was very nice and knowledge of the menu. Actually all of the staff were great. There so many mouth watering items on the menu that it was hard to choose.  However, I ended up going with the chicken and sweet waffles. 

So my review/rating mainly for my dish although I did try my friends dishes as well.  What I loved about the dish was the chicken! It was fat, juicy and fried perfectly. It was well seasoned also.  I liked the flavor of the waffle but it was just too crisp for my liking.  I'm not sure if it's meant to be that way or if it was just overcooked.  Also, the the gravy that comes with the dish is really good. It gives it the savory along with the sweet syrup. There was a small issue with my dish and I notified the waiter immediately.  Since my friends were done she has a new meal to go for me. 

As I said early, I tried a bite of my friends dishes as well which were the breakfast pot pie and the local.  Both tasted really good in that one bite! I wished I had gotten one of those... but next time! Overall, I recommend this spot.
name: Vincent

text: Amazing food. Best pork chop I've ever had. Great macaroni and baked beans. Loved the chicken and waffles too. The owner came around and checked on everyone (twice). Friendly staff. Very very impressed.
name: Mo

text: I usually do not write reviews but I had to on this visit to the Scoopers in Reno. We just went there for 3 meals and shakes and the last couple times we went the food and shakes were awesome as usual but the front cashiers customer service has been lacking. The lady today was so short with us while she got our order and would not make eye contact with us. She was also had a headphone in so I wasn't sure if she was distracted by a phone call or listening to music. I thought that maybe it was just us so while we waited we watched her interaction with another couple and it was the exact same. She was cleaning behind the counter and slamming doors loudly and just overall did not seem to be happy with her job. When she called my name for my order she seemed like she couldn't of gotten us out of there fast enough. When we got home we noticed they forgot a whole meal so I had to drive back to get the order. When i got there she was leaned on the back counter faced away from the front on her phone and I had to call her to get her attention. The cook gave me my missed order and said "here ya go" and at no time did anyone apologize for missing a whole order on my second trip there. I am not sure what happened to this location and if it doesn't care anymore and it's just relying on local customers. The food and shakes are always good but if this is business as usual with bad customer service I will make sure to never go here again and let everyone know the same.

text:
Having read all the negative reviews, it was somewhat surprising that the food and service were not half bad! I live in the neighborhood and I had driven by numerous times since they bought the place and started remodeling. Didn't get a chance to try them out until today (Saturday) for lunch.
They've obviously spent quite some time and effort remodeling the place. Very nice decors. Much roomier than their predecessor, Chihuahua, which I had visited several times.
Service was excellent. Some of the servers seemed new to the business but all of them were quite friendly.
Food portion was HUGE. I had the All of Mexico, and it could easily feed two people with a smaller appetite (good thing I worked out a lot this morning). Everything seemed to have been freshly made (except for the free chips that tasted like store-bought, but they were of a pretty good quality). Now, I read comments about the food being under-seasoned. There might be some truth to that; yes, the food came less salty than those at some other Mexican restaurants, but I kind of like it that way.
My only two complaints (and thus one star off):
1. Percentage wise, they've moved the prices up quite a bit (vs. old prices at Chihuahua). I understand they've probably spent a lot of money on the place and are anxious to earn it back, but still...
2. The men's bathroom looked very clean but it smelled terrible. It was only 11:15 and there was just another table of customers that came before us, so it shouldn't have been heavily used. They need to either up their cleaning act or have better vent.

text:
Robert is out of town with Grace. Mathilde is @ Sam taking summer classes.  Eleanore is at a slumber party.  So, tonight, it was just me & Adelaide. I asked her what she wanted to do tonight. She responded, without any hesitation at all, "I want to go to dinner at Commander's Palace, Mommy,". Now, this is coming from a child whose diet consists solely of pizza, chicken tenders, macaroni & cheese, waffles, bacon, & the occasional bite of something green, followed by a "yucky" face.  So, I asked her to check out the menu online & told her they did not make any kids' food. She was unphased. 

Our reservation was for 6pm. She was in her pretty blue dress, hair washed & brushed, teeth brushed, & shoes on by 4:30. She is my youngest who hates showers, brushing her teeth, hates dresses, & usually has a giant bunch of knots in her hair. 

We arrived promptly at Commander's Palace at 6pm on the dot. She insisted that we not be early or late, but arrive exactly at 6pm. 

We were the first dinner arrivals & were greeted in traditional Commander's Palace style, all waitstaff lined up, welcoming us & we were shown to our table, adorned with 3 beautiful balloons. 

When I made the reservation, I told the operator that it was Adelaide's 9th birthday. And, Adelaide had no clue of this. So, as we were led past the line of servers, sous chefs, and other staff, Adelaide was wished a Happy Birthday by each person. 

We ascended the very narrow staircase upstairs, through a series of tables set perfectly, and were seated in the Garden Room. The celebration began with Adelaide ordering an Abita Rootbeer. She was a bit hesitant to drink it at first because the bottle looked like beer. I promised her it was really rootbeer. 

She ordered the Shrimp & Tasso Henican,  the Commander's Palace salad, and the Filet Mignon, medium to medium rare. I asked our waiter if he could "split" everything & of course, he agreed. 

I almost had a coronary when the first course arrived. She ate about half of the salad and one of the three shrimp. The garlic toast, as she put it, "melted in my mouth!"  Next, the Filet Mignon arrived, split in two over a bed of greens and creamy potatoes. Her eyes widened. "Mommy, I'm sorry, but this steak looks much better than the steaks you make."  Ummmm, ok. I did not realize she had even paid attention when we had steak (on rare occasions, of course).  She ate every bite of her meal, no elbows on the table, used the correct forks & knives in the correct order, & even insisted that I not put her rootbeer closer to her. "Mommy, the drinks go above the knives, not next to my plate!"  I was simply trying to make it easier for her to lift the real glass tumbler. 

Yes, with a house of 6, I regret to inform you all that we usually eat on paper plates, with plastic utensils, & paper cups. Occasionally, we will break out our casual dinnerware, but not so often. With the emphasis on "break", yes, some piece is usually accidentally broken. 

Finally, our dessert was brought out, chocolate ice cream with whipped cream in a lace cookie cup & one birthday candle for Adey & blueberry crisp with a dollop of creole cream cheese ice cream for me. 

The Maitre'd also brought her a menu signed by the chef & a Commander's Palace chef's hat. I have not ever seen Adelaide look so excited and beautiful. She was, apparently, completely in her element. 

Our dinner conversation was unending. We discussed what sports she wanted to play in the fall (too many), how she likes her summer reading, & her excitement for Toy Story 4. Much to our surprise, Lally Brennan approached our table, sat down, wished Adelaide a happy birthday, & had a good 7 minute conversation with her about her name, Adelaide, being such a beautiful name. Adelaide said meekly, "my Mommy named me, I think it is a family name & I love it!"  Lally was tickled pink!

After the check came & went, we descended those stairs again, through the now bustling reception area, & handed the valet our ticket. When our car arrived, she hopped in, balloons, menu, & chef's hat in hand. 

On the drive home, she said something that made my eyes well up with tears of joy, but also a bit of sadness. "Mommy, that was the best dinner I have ever eaten & you were the perfect date. Thank you!  Oh, and I love you more than beans!"  

Such a fleeting moment, such a special evening to spend with my youngest baby. There is usually chaos in our house, but tonight was her night. She savored every moment & was the happiest 9 year old on the planet. 

So, enjoy those rare moments with just one of your babies, even if you think she will order French fries and chicken tenders. She may surprise you. Happy Birthday, my sweet bunny......7 months late. Mommy loves you more!
name: Kirk

text:
So I'm guessing LOCAL is like the Canadian version of a smaller BJs or Yardhouse? ... from the vibe I got (just from brunch!) and its menu. Large TVs lined up in a row, a large rectangle bar in the center, booths and tables against the walls. Definitely a happy hour/hangout chill spot. 

I came during brunch, so it was pretty empty. And although we sat in a booth in the corner, the service was good. My boyfriend and I ordered the breakfast sandwich, cheese pirogies, and the huevos rancheros. My cousin and his girlfriend ordered the eggs Benedict and steak & eggs. 
-cheese pirogies were verrryy hot, and definitely cheesy. I really liked the savory caramelized onions and the sour cream on the side. the wrapping it was in was a little hard though
-huevos rancheros: this was actually my first time having it LOL. The salsa, avocado and that gooey cheese was amazing, but holy shit there were so many black beans hiding under the tortillas! I'm not a big fan of black beans but I still enjoyed it
-breakfast sandwich: I basically called this a rainbow sandwich! it was gorgeous to look at. the sourdough was toasted and buttery, the FRIED EGG was so delicious and runny (honestly the best part). What I liked most is the this breakfast sando came with a little berry smoothie in a shot glass! 
I wasn't able to try the eggs Benedict or steak& eggs, but they're regulars, soooo im sure they know what they're ordering  

Really enjoyed this spot! Glad to have tried this chain while visiting Canada!

text:
I really like Planet Sub so it makes me sad, but I have to dock them a star based on my last visit. I was thrilled to see they were on Groupon and bought three vouchers. The first time I tried using one, the cashier didn't know how it worked, but they took it without question.

On my most recent visit, I was grabbing dinner to go for my boyfriend and myself. I ordered a Big Dipper for him and a half Green Turkey for myself and specified the order was to go. The cashier was a really young kid who seemed very clueless. He asked a female worker how to do everything. When I presented my phone to use the Groupon, the kid once again asked her what to do and she said "We don't take those." I was confused; I know how Groupon works and they kinda have to take them. She said, "I'm sorry but an employee put us on Groupon and he wasn't authorized to do so. You'll have to contact Groupon." I was annoyed. My order was $18 and change, which is pricey for two sandwiches. I might not have come without a Groupon or special deal.

I had already ordered so I sucked it up and paid full price. I got a drink while I was waiting. A lot of options in the Coke Freestyle machine were out. When the young cashier brought my sandwiches out, he had only packed one to go. I admit by this point I was perturbed and short with the kid. I said "This is to go." And he said, "Oh. You wanted both sandwiches to go?" and slipped my Green Turkey in with the Big Dipper. I suppose I could've wanted to eat in and take my other sandwich to go, but that was weird. The lady was nice and apologetic for the apparent Groupon mixup.

When I got home, I discovered my Green Turkey wasn't what I ordered. There was no guacamole, no onions, no sprouts, and no salsa. It appeared to be a Turkey Club instead. I was super disappointed. I'd give them two stars, but I really want them to be successful, and my boyfriend was pleased with his sandwich.
name: Ashley
