text: Recently came here on a trip with restaurant family and it was amazing (went more than once!) You need to go here if you want crawfish! Three different seasoning sauces to choose from and lots of other awesome seafood options. The bourbon basket is a great deal for a ton of crab class. Order the gumbo too! It's so flavorful. The oyster Po'boy is one of the best I've had in New Orleans. The yakamein has a great broth, but it wasn't as great as everything else on the menu. Tim and his staff are super friendly, charismatic and attentive. They have a no-holds bar when it comes to sly humor and our group was all for that. He definitely knows what he's doing! Can't wait to visit here next time I'm in the Big Easy.
name: Madeleine

text: The interior is unique, the la picada was fantastic and the ice cream was amazing. Stopped in here to kill an hour between a wedding and reception and it was perfect. I can see it getting a bit noisy when full, but they haven't even crammed the tables in like sardines, so it wouldn't feel too crowded.
name: Christy

text: This place is incredible. Right on the water, beautiful views, great food and awesome service. We got stuck in philly for a day and this was a great place to spend our time. Our bartender, Angela, was the best. Highly recommend!
name: J

text:
Use to order from here all the time because they had excellent food and great prices. Not sure what happened recently, but they increased their prices and now their service is horrible. 
Their delivery person just asked me how much my order was because he lost the receipt. I canceled the order after waiting 10 mins for them to correct the problem. They then "offered" to make a new pizza which I would have to wait another 40 mins to get delivered by a new driver.
name: Guy

text:
Nothing really special. It was a pretty good burger. I had the Spanish and my boyfriend had an Angus Beef. We both though they were pretty basic. I liked mine more than he liked his because mine actually had some spice kick. I wasn't a huge fan of the potato circles in lieu of fries, but they weren't bad. 

They do serve beer, which could be a redeeming factor. I think next time we go we will try the wings and sweet potato fries and see if that changes out mind. 

Service was good though. A gentleman was walking around and helping people making sure everyone was happy. I was going to give a 3 rating, but the service kicked it up to a 4.
name: Nicole

text: Decent burgers. Super affordable prices on everything. Service wasn't the best. Waited a long time for everything from waters to the check. Their pies however...5 stars. We have the butterscotch, banana cream, and key lime. All very tasty.
name: stacy

text:
Excellent Wings especially the parm!
Don't forget to order the donuts too...great addition to WT!!
name: Tony

text: Food was okay and the service was even worse... so unorganized and that one guy seemed like he got mad every time you ask a question. I ordered, as I was waiting for it, I wanted to order some corn that my friend recommended.... I went to the cashier, and everyone was making food. I made eye contact several times and he still didn't take my order. Not worth going back.
name: Sabrina

text: My brother always says great things about this place. And I have been a couple times before but I don't know what happened tonight. It was AWFUL! I asked for a well done steak. It was medium. Couldn't even cut into it. My steak was cold. My Mac and cheese was cold as well. The bartender was so RUDE!!!  Barely deserves her tip. The only good thing was our chips and salsa but it's hard to mess that up surprised they didn't.
name: Bailey

text: I have not been here since they first opened. I ordered 2 cheeseburgers and a medium fries online. My order was ready as soon as I walked in the door. The burgers were delicious. They were not greasy and seasoned perfectly. The fries however were soggy to the point that the grease was leaking through the bag. I prefer my fries to be crispy but there was no option for that on the web app. All in all a good experience and I loved the burgers. Cook those fries a little longer.
name: James

text: Being a restaurant owner and foodie myself I find Brown Shuga Soul Food to be a very very good and authentic place to eat not just soul food but other delectables. Yvonne and her crew show great customer service skills along with a passion in creating the dishes unseen by many in the industry. The food tastes so authentic you can tell she puts a lot of love into it and she is a teacher, not afraid to show others but"how to do it right".  I've seen her on many occasions showing her staff how to get things just right, temped, plated, and packaged for dispersal.   If you haven't tried Brown Shuga Soul Food you need to.  Might I suggest a mamoth turkey leg, moist pulled pork sandwich, or some of the best gumbo made.   she's always in the community and on TV trying to teach her skills to others.  I rate this food right up there with the best!   Five stars!!!!!
name: Carlas

text: i was just looking for a toasted everything with cream cheese. disappointed with the freshness. won't be back
name: Jen

text: Great place to grab some good seafood. People line up across the street at Acme this place is just as good if not better without the wait. I'm glad to see they reclaimed the portion of the restaurant. Gives much more room and doesn't feel as crowded.
name: Marc

text: I always look forward to working in uptown to come here for lunch. Then I came for karaoke at night and now looking at property in the UPT. All jokes aside, the food is yum and the atmosphere welcoming
name: Pierre

text: Yesterday I went to QDOBA because I was starving.They had the nerve to give me they leftovers.Then they was running out of stuff...I asked for lettuce and they tried to give me three pieces of lettuce I wasn't having it so I left. I don't recommend you going to the QDOBA on Lindell because they are trash.They are not professional & they look confused. Stop by wing stop next door...they get you right.
name: Taylor

text: SO. GOOD. The atmosphere is the perfect combination of fun and fancy with that perfect CRG touch that combines people of all ages! The pizza dough was awesome and the portions were great for the prices. The only down side was that the pizza comes out fast so if you order entrees and someone orders pizza for their meal it doesnt come out at the same time. We went for my 23rd birthday and they brought me cake and sang. Can't wait to go back! I hope they also get on Uber Eats!
name: Corinne

text: The dining experience was excellent for my party of 12.  The food is amazing and the service was great. The dishes recommends by the owner for the party were spot on and the atmosphere in the back garden was like being in a different country. Many thanks for the experience.
name: Emil

text: Terrible service. Food AND drink came out wrong. Never got a refill on my beverage. Music is BLARING.. apparently the waiters can't even hear you to get your order correct. Food is below average. Not only do you have to pay to park but you will get a ticket if your parking expires for a couple of minutes. Go somewhere else to eat.
name: Bailey

text: I am visiting from NJ and my family suggested IPC for delivery. I ordered  buffalo wings and a pizza with green peppers and pepperoni. The pizza crust was only ok. It appeared to be pre-made and didn't have good texture. It is beyond strange to me to have cheddar cheese mixed with mozzarella, I didn't really care for it. Not bad, just nothing special. The wings were ok. Usually wings are fried then sauced leaving the wings crispy. The flavor of the sauce was ok but the wings were soggy.
name: Al

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Follow up . . . I returned for my refund on the iced tea I was overcharged for on my visit last week. The owner, Lidia, apologized profusely for the error and cheerfully gave me the $6 back. She asked me to please come back again and I told her I would.
name: Russell

text: This place was small with limited seating, but the ambiance was nice. I ordered the signature ramen without spicy, a mini tonkatsu curry bowl, and the fried calamari. The signature ramen came with white noodles instead of the classic yellow egg noodles but all the toppings complemented the ramen nicely. Although it was slightly salty, the chasu melted in my mouth and was delicious. The mini tonkatsu curry bowl had a kick of spiciness to it and the tonkatsu was crispy. The fried calamari was pretty good and came with a side of spicy mayo. I would definitely come back here again to try the chasu buns and a different ramen on the menu!
name: Jenny

text: Love coming in town just so I can stop by this restaurant! Such a great restaurant with great food! Love seeing Mrs Susan and all the staff! Def a must when in Nola
name: Jessie

text: The only pizza my husband likes better is mine. They even have pb&j pizza for picky kids, and a great variety of dipping sauces.
name: Amber

text: Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Will be back. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..
name: User

text:
Accidentally found this gem last night with one of my vegan kids.
The food was fantastic .
   We ordered several items, Fatoush which was an incredibly fresh flavorful salad, beef schwarma sandwich wow what a surprise and at 6 dollars best sandwich on South Grand.we also had Falafel I was already familiar with and Batata Yarra a spicy fried potato dish with rice. All very good and Really fresh.
name: Keith

text: Love, love this restaurant! If you are in New Orleans looking for a great place to eat, stop here! I will be back!
name: Ashley

text:
Ok i have had 3 meals here now. Beer is cold and variety on tap good pour.
Order the greens and grains first night and hooked. Fresh greens beautiful presentation and great balance of flavors. Just plain unexpected in a beer place. Grapefruit and avocado salad the next day with chicken. Same thing..... just plain great.
Hotel restaurant left me sitting for 20 minutes and all I could think about was this place so here i am again. Accommodated me at  the bar tonight. 
So chopped salad and the yes crab mac and cheese . 
Service exceptional. Strongly recommend.
name: Linda

text: This place is delicious. I recently had the boudin chimichangas and curry fries. Very filling and flavorful. The turnaround time on orders is pretty quick as well.
name: Katelynn

text: I Love Squealers, I only gave them 4 stars because there are not enough selections that are not pork, which is common in Indy.
name: Danette

text: The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. A couple small things kept adding up. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Nice little spot, decent portions too. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. For the price I expected more than this. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: I have only been here once and was not disappointed. The service was fantastic, pleasant, professional, helpful in offering recommendations, attentive, and not at all overbearing. The food was very fresh and very yummy! Everything the restaurant offers is farm-to-table. I opted for an appetizer, entree, and a dessert to experience as much as I could of the restaurant. I was not disappointed. Everything is moderately priced. The restaurant is very clean, pleasant, and has good atmosphere. Parking is ample. There are even options to dine outside on the deck. Looking forward to coming back. Highly recommend this establishment!
name: Emilie

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: This place is undergoing renovations while open.  I hope it's for dine-in.  Don't forget to feed the meter!  The food is great.  I ordered both a cheese steak and a hoagie.  Both delicious.  I will return!
name: Reggie

text: Fits the current Seminole Heights theme well. Novel food idea. Small parking lot. Tight quarters. Decent food. All in an older building with character flaws that make it charming, yet stuffy. I get it. It's fine. The fries and pickles are absolutely outstanding. The chicken tasted mighty fine, but it was shockingly greasy. Some people will enjoy that greasiness and can handle it. I'd tell others don't jump in until you have Rolaids on hand and a gallon of water in the car. The reason? Because the iced tea sat empty the whole time I was in there so your option is ridiculously sweet Kool-aid, tart lemonade, or a can of soda. I wish them well and am thankful they're contributing to Seminole Heights new found vibrancy! It's a great idea that Tampa needs more of. Privately owned small restaurants instead of chains. I love that. But my 3 stars are based primarily on chilly-aloof-bizarre service from weirdo kids with no soft skills. You're standing there ordering and they're on a distant plane you're not part of. Watched one young girl storm around and rant loudly about something as she was marching back and forth through the little gate to the kitchen. Awkward.
name: J

text: Best burger and fries in town! Support your local burger joint!! True hidden gem! Think 5 guys but a fraction of the price.
name: Gina

text: So.....this place is amazing!! I had the avocado fries and Korean tacos! Yum!!!  George you are amazing!! Thank you for everything! Katie, you were amazing too! Staff is hella nice, happy hour is totally worth it!! Check this place out when you are here!!! So fun!!!
name: Joy

text: I went here yesterday so i can't check in but this place is cool for hookah and food and happy hour they have outside seating and u can bring ur dog
name: domenique

text: Closest thing there ever will be to authentic mexican food in the treasure valley. I am a native san diegan and i have searched idaho high and low for a place to deliver amazing mexican food. Each one of my searches came up empty handed until this place. Every single meat is marinated, 3 different types of verde sauce, a mexican coleslaw...you can tell that there's a lot of love and thought that goes in their dishes. I am definitely a fan for life and constantly rave about this place to anyone who will listen.
name: Katie

text: Great sushi and overall packed menu of seafood, steaks and kinky extras. The staff are pros and there's a upscale yet casual vibe. Stroll by the fresh fish display and oyster/sushi bar. It'll inspire your menu choice. I'm cutting carbs and the sushi chef was kind enough to wrap my fresh roll in cucumber instead of rice! First class.
name: Marsha

text:
I mean where do I start??? You can't go wrong with Metro Diner. Your only mistake would be coming during its busiest times because then you'd have to wait to experience all the yumminess-other than, that you cannot go wrong visiting Metro Diner. 

With that said, let me share the details. 

This was our second visit (first time we ordered carry-out) but this time hubby and I decided to dine-in. We've visited the Casteton location a couple times so we were familiar with the menu. I've become quite fond of their chicken and waffles so I was torn as to if I would venture out and try their other tasty options or stay with my tried and true. On the list for me this visit was their Crab cake Benedict; their cinnamon roll pancakes or ole faithful-chicken and waffles. (Is your mouth drooling yet?!!?)

So as I thought I could eat all these-I quickly realized that these portions are HUGE and there was no way for me to indulge in all three- I decided to go with ole faithful. This time, I added strawberries on top ($1 extra). And to put my sugar conscience at rest, I ordered a side salad (lol) Food took about 20-25 mins to come out (about average) so no complaints there. My hubby was a bit more adventurous than I, as he ordered the cinnamon roll pancakes with an order of chicken with a side of fruit. So our table was soooo full. Our waitress Alex was probably wondering where we were putting all this food-but no worries we put a nice dent in our meals. We had to take to-go boxes of course, but still. 

Also, hubby tried both their "Jamaican me crazy" coffee (yum) and their peach iced-tea. 


Our meals were delicious. Alex was great; as she answered every possible alternative hubby requested and was patient doing so. She was on point filling coffee before we asked; refilled water and teas very promptly-she was great.

So no disappointments with Metro's second location. This visit still held the standard as its north location. My only regret was I didn't have enough room to try their avocado toast- but next time! 

Come hungry leave veeeeery happy!
name: Laquetta

text: Very good hot dogs. Highly recommend. Will be taking my dad here when he comes to visit.
name: Kelcy

text: We had a less than stellar experience with both food and service. The first round of drinks came out minus two of the beverages, and it was 10 minutes or so before the waitress came back. Two of our appetizers came out at the same time, but the third didn't come out until 15 minutes later when the other two folks had finished theirs. I ordered a fig and pickled grape salad that didn't have a single piece of fig in it. Then I had the Geaux fish, which was redfish. It was overcooked and rubbery. The risotto was okay, but too salty. Overall, my entree seemed like Outback Steakhouse quality. My husband did enjoy the sausage beignet appetizer and his duck was good. No one else seemed too impressed with their food. Portion sizes on the small side. One person's burger was almost a slider size, and oddly seemed to be a pork sandwich instead of beef. We skipped dessert after another long stretch of not seeing our waitress.
name: Michelle

text: Very nice servers. I had the Sheppard's Pie, very delish. Hubby had the turkey burger with sweat potatoes fries, regular fries, and mashed potatoes which he enjoyed. And two of our friends had a chicken pasta and chicken and waffles which they enjoyed. I also had a perfect margarita that was made perfectly!
name: Yacobia

text: This place was louder than I expected and that sort of shaped the whole meal. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The music was louder than it needed to be. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Food was good and came out fast. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text: JC noodle house has a very good selection of soups,hibachi, and other asian dishes. They have a very unique delivery method for the food via monorails that deliver the items to the table. Although this restaurant has good dishes to choose from the service is very poor and unorganized. Both times we visited we waited 15 after being seated before someone came to us to take our drink order. Also on one of visits the manager (I believe it was the manager) was arguing out loud at one of the servers.
name: Micheal

text: Excellent!  Ate here twice!  My husband had the wasabi tuna both times. I had the coconut shrimp and the blue cheese crusted filet mignon. Great service too!
name: Sherry

text: Got takeout from here twice now so I feel like I can say a little more. Parking was annoying, although that's prob more about the area than the restaurant. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Price felt a touch high for what it was.
name: User

text: The sauce carried most of the meal. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal.
name: User

text: This is awful. I would never come to this McDonald's again. We are from out of town, and we came here looking for a quick bite of breakfast, and it took 5 minutes for someone to take our order. When we get up to the window to get our food, the drinks had no ice and were lukewarm. When my mom asked for a cup of ice, we were told to pull up because the line was too long. Awful service, rude employees, and overall this is just a BAD McDonald's.
name: Mary Grace

text: I am on my 3rd visit and I hope it is better than the last 2.   I'm willing to give a place another try.  Even a 3rd try, however with so many outstanding restaurants in the area,  I won't go back to a place whose owner responds to reviews in this manner.    Sir -  you need a good course in customer service.    It's difficult,  I know but the Customer is Always Right.   Don't write words that are going to send prospective customers running elsewhere for much better Italian.    Case in point -  the outstanding, constantly consistent quality of From the Boot.
name: K

text:
How is it I spent over $100+ on Dinner and I get lobster with NO BUTTER shrimp with NO Cocktail sauce a DRY Dinner unbelievable 
You have to care about take out customers too we go there a lot this isn't good thanks
name: Damon

text: Tried to plan my rehearsal dinner there. My bridemaid called, I called, my fiancé called. We each called this location and Ambler and were constantly told someone would call us back. I even got "can I call you right back?"... Not a word. Wrote a review on Facebook and got blocked! Guess they don't want business.
name: Meggie

text: My family loves Ciconte's! We love the food, Tony, the fact that it's a BYOB, and the casual (but better than pizzeria) atmosphere. We were very disappointed when we ate there this weekend to find that one of our favorite dishes had been taken off of the menu, along with other popular items. The chicken lemoncello was a unique dish that often brought us to the restaurant. My children were equally disappointed to see that the grilled cheese was no longer available. These changes came shortly after another favorite- Chicken Rosa was removed and replaced with a very salty chicken dish. I understand the restaurant is in business to make money and I'm sure the menu changes are in response to number-crunching. It would seem though when a  popular dish that brings customers in is taken off the menu, it must be counter productive to the bottom line.
name: Erica

text:
Took a nice bike ride to Dunedin Brewery on Christmas Eve and was so happy they were open and good. 
Didn't know what to expect, but wanted to give them a try. Popped in....got a table right away. Looking at menu, we wanted many different things....so we ordered them ha!

The brewery itself is pretty fascinating and really does serve good bar good to compliment the beers there.

Of course I had to order a few different apps to taste a few things.
Pretzle bites, beer cheese wontons, wings, and the lava burger with Cole slaw.
The Pretzle bites were so deliscious and buttery, with the slightest amount of salt.
The the beer cheese wontons were crispy and cheesy. The wings were fall off the bone good and the lava burger was exactly what was hoped for. Nice, big, and juicy

Staff was friendly and service was great.
Nice big seating area to enjoy your meal....with an area for live music. It was a win friends....can't wait to go again sometime!
name: Terri

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. My experience was honestly fine. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: Steak n Shake Operations?  Hello? Anyone there who pays any attention to yelp reviews? This must be one of the most under performing restaurants in Indianapolis/Greenwood. There attention to detail is completely absent, as they always get something wrong on my orders... Always. I ordered a cajun steakburger just the other night and actually came home with a cajun steakburger without any cajun seasoning or cajun dressing. It's actually sad because Steak n Shake was once a very nice restaurant in the day. I actually worked as a curbside jockey in high school. Now it's just another greasy spoon.
name: John

text: This is a cute little cafe! However, there definitely needs to be some improvement with the staff. I came on a Monday morning with my boyfriend and my friend. Normally at any cafe or coffee shop there will be more customer volume during that time. Here, however, it was not that busy yet the staff were taking all the time in the world to get everyone's orders done in which other orders were backed up. Additionally the place is not big at all so there were just a lot of people standing and waiting. We went upstairs to eat and I was still waiting for my chai tea latte (was waiting for 15mins). Turns out they forgot to make it. They upgraded my drink free of charge which was nice, but they shouldn't have forgotten. I'm giving this place 3 stars because the staff was courteous, however, please pick up the pace.
name: Mia

text:
Came here for dinner based on yelp reviews with a teammate from out of town. 

Sat down and checked in on yelp. A birthday coupon popped up even though on the menu at each table it says you get a free appetizer. When I showed the girl she started talking about having proof of me checking in and I was confused because I was literally showing her my check in to this very establishment. She starts thumbing through my yelp and clicks on review and it defaulted to 1 star...she goes, please don't give us 1 star. I was like well, please don't click through my phone when I already showed you the check in. Anyway, she finally went ahead and gave us the appetizer. 

We ordered seaweed salad and edamame to start. Both were solid.  Seaweed salad did not smell or taste like ocean which is a plus.  To drink I had the Thai ice tea and my colleague had the ice green tea. I thought the Thai tea was a little too sweet for my liking. She really enjoyed her green tea. 

The special rolls were calling us so we ended up getting the foxy lady, American Dream, catching fire and tuna lover's dream. All were fresh and delicious and very generous portions of fish. 

We did not have room for dessert but I definitely will come back to try other rolls. 

The decor is very cute here and they take great care with presentation of food. We saw a group getting their food and things were lighting up and smoking.  Next time I want those!
name: Laura

text:
This time I tried their signature dish that the man - the owner? - I spoke to when I was last here two years ago told me I must try, eggplant stuffed with shrimp.  To begin with the rice was hard, like it was half cooked. I put a little water on it and microwaved it for 3 minutes. It was still hard. I had good cooked rice of my own, so I threw it away.

I was careful with the takeout box as instructed and only drove a couple of blocks but it still leaked. Fortunately they had wrapped the frail box in plastic so the sauce didn't get all over everything.

As for the eggplant with shrimp, the eggplant pieces were allegedly stuffed with chopped shrimp, tho it didn't really taste like shrimp. The sauce - no loss that it drained out - seemed to be predominantly soy sauce and chopped garlic.

PS This was nothing like the eggplant shrimp dish Michelle describes below.
name: Maynard

text: Best lasagna in town. Cute little spot with character, love, and great food. The lasagna and the pizza are my favorites. The garlic bread is yummy too. Love to bring family and friends here from out of town. Make sure you get there early or make reservations and bring cash. They fill up quick and cash is the only form of payment. Opened in 1937 oldest restaurant in Sparks/Reno.
name: Gena

text: We were in the area visiting. Yelp brought us here, let's just say we will definately be back. My mother is from San Pedro Tlaquepaque. She was also with me today. And we both enjoyed the authenticity in the food.  Peruano boiled beans, Mexican rice the shrimp and fish tacos. The ginger lemonade with  chia seeds. The pineapple in habanero. All these delicious small touches to add to the food were fantastic. Thank you for a great experience.
name: Monica

text: If you were to come here 12 times, you would have 12 unique, delightful and delicious experiences. VAST menu makes decisions difficult, but that is what return visits are for. All house made barbeque sauces are vegan, if that matters...so much thought and precision in each dish. Worth the wait, as wait times are Little long. Have a drink, enjoy the scenery (they've turned and old steel casting factory into a alt-BBQ Mecca for the area) and absorb the whole experience. This place is singular and sublime. Try the brisket, it is well beyond any tired hyperbole about flavor and tenderness. We will be back often enough to try the whole menu.
name: Eric

text: To say this place was a disappointment would be an understatement. Prepare to be profiled the second you walk in. If you're a tourist, your service will certainly be based on whether you decide to wear entire net worth on your and your guests' bodies regardless of if you're that type of person. My wife and I would have enjoyed the atmosphere and menu for hours had we be given the chance however, our server could not even be bothered to offer wine pairing suggestions even after asking numerous times. This part was actually the highlight of a mediocre meal given my sommelier wife with her 5 star restaurant background as we decided rather quickly to just embrace that level of industry profiling in order to salvage what should have been a great experience. Food was decent, service not so much. After eating at Skull's Rainbow Room the night prior, this place really disappointed, especially at the price point.
name: Justin

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. It was decent, just a little uneven. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. Anyway, our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text:
This place is warm and welcoming; cool without being snooty. We were greeted as we entered, and they took great care of us without being intrusive. The food was amazing!! My daughter had the Cuban and loved it. I couldn't make up my mind, so the owner made the suggestion of the grilled honey ham and Brie on sourdough. The surprise is a mild raspberry jalapeño jelly! Absolutely delicious! I overheard that the potato salad is a new recipe- this is the one to stick with. I love a place that makes its own salads- and this one is definitely homemade. 
On the corner of 8th and Central near tins of cute shops, City's Bistro is a great lunch spot. next time I'm coming for breakfast!
name: Joanna

text:
Everyone we talked to told us to go to Frenchmen street.
One of the locals had mentioned to us about cafe negril- here is the cool thing is that they are free of cover 364 days out of the 365 day year.

One of the to do on my list for our NOLA trip was to go to a sweaty jazz bar where I could dance till I couldn't stand any longer- success!
The live band was incredible sounding and had the best energy- if ever I needed some good soul music it was in this time.  It was  a bit crowded but I made may way to the stage with my drink and danced the night away.

I highly recommend this club to EVERYONE!
name: Brandi

text: Can we please talk about how adorable this place is?? I have been trying to taper my coffee intake, and was searching for a tea house that offered artisanal teas and a place I could relax and gather with friends. I have found exactly this at Tea Witch! This cozy corner shop has an enchanted vibe (hence the witch in the title). There was a great selection of unique teas brewed to order- I tried the "7 Wicked Spindles" with lavender, passion fruit, chamomile, cardamom and mint.  I like that the employees provided tea suggestions, like one tea they explained was helpful for headache relief since it contained feverfew. I found this spot by way of a vegan brunch pop up event, which South of Eden does there every Sunday. Freshly made coconut yogurt with fresh fruits from the farmers market and granola, what a treat! I want to make this my weekly tradition! Indoor and outdoor seating.
name: Daniella

text: This place does not sell bear nor wine after midnight but they don't provide this information on their website. When I suggested to the waitress that it would be fair to add this information (since we drove for a while to get here and waited in line) she started yelling at me, she appeared to be intoxicated.
name: Bart

text: Better get here now because this place is going to get crowded. The food is Much more authentic than that other place across the street. The service is awesome and it is very clean. The four of us covered the board with tacos, nachos and a quesadilla. All of it was excellent!
name: Paul

text: This is an amazing brunch spot! I broke my vegetarianism for their *cinnamon pecan bacon*. Totally worth it. It was my bffs birthday and we had the absolute best service with Ned as our server. Thank you! And the bottomless mimosas .
name: Sarah

text:
Too bad this place is hidden in the Sheraton Hotel! This place is pretty darn good and is consistent. I've stayed at the Sheraton a few times for work and usually end up at the Glowbal for dinner. 
The place is usually not that busy and they have happy hour until 7. The HH menu has around five bar snacks for under $7 and deals on drinks of course. 
The full menu is very cool and it actually glows. There is a wide variety to choose from such as pizza, burgers, sandwiches and full plates. I have tried the salmon and the curry chicken. Both are delicious. I also like their tots. So crunchy and good. 
The only thing they can improve is the ambiance. They need to get this place poppin. It is way to dead and boring to have all that good delicious food.
name: Felicia

text: I was craving some lemon chicken and Shanghai noodles, and as this place was close to me, thought I'd try it out! What a mistake. Everything seemed like warmed up frozen food you'd buy at No frills. If that. It was the worst Chinese food I've ever had by far. I wish I could say something positive.
name: Ashley

text: Wow! Was waiting to go in and a group of guys came in. Not wanting to wait, they told the staff that they would pay $20.00 to be seated right away. The cashier told them to talk to another staff member. Two seconds after they talked to the other staff member the guys were walking in, while everyone else continued to wait. Staff should have said "No".
name: June

text:
Outback used to be the spot to go for steaks.  No matter what day or time they were packed but the wait was worth it.  They even setup their restaurants on sites that are less desirable because they are a dining destination.  For this location that shipped seems to have sailed.  

We've visited this Outback a number of times over the past few years.  Unfortunately what should be consistent is far from it...their ability to cook a steak.  Almost every time a steak temperature is far off the mark.  For a business that deals in beef in the quantities they do, I find this a tough pill to swallow.  

What is consistent is both good and bad.  The bad is their bar staff that works Friday and Saturday nights.  Not much of a personality to speak about and if you're in the dining room you're waiting on them for a very, very long time for drinks.  The good is the serving staff in the dining room.  They are attentive, polite and accommodating.  It just gets old when the service staff has to constantly apologize for long waits on drinks from the bar and steaks that are not cooked properly.
name: Josh

text:
My wife and I are locals and
dIne here quite often. The food is pretty consistent however, the staff can make or break your experience.  We like to sometimes sit at the bar to eat our meals, which includes a $60 bottle of wine, and make our dinner selections. We avoid Emily based on her lack of personality, as she would be better suited at a fast food restaurant.  She is all business and would be better off not dealing with the public. Our typical tip is deserving of some type of gratitude.
name: Chris

text: Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. A couple small things kept adding up. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Just not for me. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text:
Johnny Sanchez is home to the best taco I've ever had.

My friend and I came here on a Friday afternoon for the happy hour specials - $2 select tacos, half off Johnny Sánchez margaritas (single or pitchers), half off all beers, half off all mixed drinks, and half off all wines by the glass!

I was pleasantly surprised by the free chips (both tortilla and plantain) and salsa brought to our table - they were great. I ordered a Cauliflower Taco (crispy cauliflower, salsa verde, queso fresco, and roasted corn salsa). It was absolutely incredible. The flavors and textures were nothing less than perfect. It is definitely the best taco I've ever eaten.

I also got the Holy Roller IPA on draft, which was a great accompaniment to the taco. I tried my friend's Johnny Sanchez Margarita (tequila blanco, triple sec, fresh lime, orange, agave, salt rim), which was also delicious.

My only complaint is that the Cauliflower Taco is not one of the tacos included in the $2 taco deal for happy hour. Vegetarians deserve happy hour food specials, too!
name: Elizabeth

text: Today my family and I went to have lunch here. We've been to Roscoe's several times before. The cashier who took our order messed up and didn't get our order right. Instead of them apologizing and making it right the manager and the cashier who took the order was rude and unkind. They literally made me get back in line which was another 20 minute wait from start to finish, and I had to pay for it. I told the manager and cashier that at least they could've apologized for their mistake and she actually shrugged her shoulders and began talking about me to her other employee. The cashier acted the same disrespectful way. We will never eat at that Roscoe's again. I held back tears the whole time while I was waiting to get my order taken for the 2nd time. My family had already finished eating by the time I finally got my food and was able to sit down with them. I've never in my life been treated with such rudeness and blatant disrespect from anyone in customer service anywhere. Lesson learned, if I ever have anything like this happen again I will demand all of my money back from the whole meal and leave.
name: Sheila

text: Fido.  Great brunch.  Long lines but it's just for ordering.  By the time you order and sit, your food comes out quickly.  Food tastes great, staff is friendly, and restaurant is clean. Definitely a must try if you are looking for a good breakfast
name: Troy

text: I came here with the expectation of "the best burger ever" maybe not the best ever but at the moment I could not think of anything better. My boyfriend and I were here for happy hour, we ordered the fried oysters and we were not disappointed. Then we decided to split the Luke burger as we were not super hungry. We were brought out a sliced burger and fries for each of us. The burger was delicious and were happy it was already split between us. Would definitely recommend it to others.
name: Laurin

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Food was good and came out fast. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: i like this place. its totally divey and they have decent seafood. We tried the char grilled bienville oysters which were great and we also had the crawfish pie- comes in little half circles, about half the size of your palm and totally yummy, stuffed with sauce and crawfish. I tried the Iberville drink, but would definitely recommend the margs. my brother tried the po boy with shrimp, its a lightly fried batter shrimp and comes together in a really light airy sandwich. Yes there are better seafood restaurants, but this is a good basic one, and they definitely do the oysters right. sadly, we were there really late and so they couldnt serve us any dessert. I tried the red beans and rice, this comes with andouille sausage and is amazing!! I would definitely repeat this. I will say that the wait staff was run off its feet, but they were kind and curteous and really helpful throughout the meal. Come at least once.
name: Rits

text:
Before I start, I'm mainly basing this review on the oysters on the half shell, which are 50 cents each during happy hour, which is between 4-6:30 pm (I'm an avid consumer of them).
The oysters were superb - plump and most were considerably large. The size of the aphrodisiacs were much more impressive than the last 50 cents oysters I had, so I was a very happy camper.
Since we were there during happy hour, we had to order drinks! The frozen mojito was pretty good, and though it's not on the happy hour menu, the Paloma was good as well - it tastes like sugary white tequila. 
I also tried the crawfish and crab bisque as well as the gumbo - both were great. I would recommend the bisque over the gumbo. Additionally, the service was great, and they start you with a complimentary loaf of bread and butter. 
PS. This is a slightly upscale restaurant, so outside of the happy hour menu, the food can be pricey!
name: Mandy

text:
Menu looks great and the service was EXCELLENT but save your time stopping by here if you actually want good food. While nothing our party of six had was horrible, nothing qualified as delicious, either. Most dishes, including the Parmesan encrusted chicken, shrimp scampi and dressings on the Caesar salad and blue cheese dressing were woefully under seasoned. Even the cookie that came as a desert with a child's meal was unremarkable. 

If you are in Indianapolis and find yourself starving in a bad way and this is the closest restaurant, order the chicken strips off the kids menu or the baked potato soup; those were the best items on our table. Other than that, keep driving until you find a different restaurant to explore.
name: L

text:
I don't usually review things very often but I was soooooo disappointed in this meal that I had to make a review. I ordered the Jerk Salmon Alfredo with broccoli and candied yams with UberEats and I was so excited to get it. I took one bite of my pasta and salmon and stopped to take a picture because I was appalled. It was clearly jar Alfredo sauce. Actual jar sauce. Disgusting. From scratch Alfredo sauce only has a few ingredients-Parmesan/Romano cheese, butter, garlic, heavy cream. So simple and makes a HUGE difference. Jar sauce is disgusting. The broccoli was frozen and had almost no seasoning. It was also too hard. The candied yams were from a can. The salmon was dry and overcooked. Disappointment in a platter. I tossed it. 


I'm only giving 2 stars because they were nice when they called about my order, honestly.
name: Precious

text: This place has great food.  Service can be iffy at times but order from the bar.  Cheese steak s are constantly good
name: Chris

text: The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Food was fresh and service was quick. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Glad we tried it.
name: User

text: You can tell they care about customer experience here. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Overall, a strong experience. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine..
name: User

text:
Willie Mae's is definitely a must for many people visiting NOLA and after trying their fried chicken I can see why. The establishment is located near the Treme district and hidden from the main streets. I would recommend getting a ride here or walking because there is no parking lot/free parking in the area is tough. 

The food was closer to a 4 stars rating for me but the service experience was closer to a 2 stars experience so sadly I had to knock the overall ranking down.

| MEAL |
 
Fried chicken! The meal here is $15 for 3 pieces, 1 side, and peas so enough to feed 2 people or last 2 meals. The winner of this dish was definitely the chicken. The chicken was HUGE, moist, and had a great crunch. I thought the batter had just the right amount of spice and coated the chicken well. Some thought that it was a little too salty for their liking but see for yourself. 

By the time we got in line at 4PM the only sides available were mac n'cheese, mashed potatoes, and rolls. I thought the mac n'cheese was OK but nothing too crazy about. I tried some of my friends mashed potatoes & gravy and I thought that was a much better option. 

CONS: 
+ Wait times - We came around 4PM with a group of 6 and waited about 1HR and that's probably because they ran out of many of their sides. When we asked how long the wait would be they said "we don't do timed waits here" which was a little off putting 
+ Service - We came with a group of 6 and after waiting 1HR another group of 6 was seated before us. When we were going to be seated another group of 6 said they were before us and got seated first without them even checking the list. It didn't seem like they really took into account the list and how long people were waiting which was disappointing. When we were seated too we also asked another waitress if she could get us water since it was 90+ degrees outside and instead of obliging she asked who our water was and walked away. :\
+ List process - My friends and I came and went straight for the line. You would think that because there are ropes that they would follow the order of who got their first so it took us about 15 minutes to realize you also had to put your name down on a list. From our experience they didn't really follow one or the other so it was confusing.
+ With groups 5+ they automatically charge you a 20% gratuity charge
name: Keizzel

text: Love this place.  Having always worked in Center City Philly I was feeling sad at the food selection when I got a job in Wilmington, but this place is great.  Love the coffee and lattes.  Also, I go at least 2x a week for the Grain bowls and salads.  I highly recommend!
name: Alicia

text: Me and my wife came here a few weekends ago to fill in the gap in between a wedding ceremony and reception. The burgers were mouth watering and wings were amazing too. We can't wait to go back!!!
name: Dennis

text: I wanted to like this more than I actually did. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. Honestly, the experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Honestly, the food was good and the service was easygoing. so yeah kind of mixed on it. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Loved everything we ate but dropped a start because my coffee mug flaked first time I washed it. I've never had a coffee mug do that so didn't think to hand wash it. Just a heads up if you're buying any souvenirs there :(  Seems cheap.
name: Carolyn

text: Stopped again while in town. Ordered a Cuban on the recommendation of a friend. It was my first ever. Was very pleased with the flavor. Great sandwich.
name: Tom

text: We enjoyed our meal at this restaurant. The staff is very attentive. The portions are large. We went around 7 p.m. and it was very busy. The decor could use a little bit of updating but the food is excellent
name: J

text: Would probably stop in again if nearby. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Both my husband and I and another couple ate here tonight being at the restaurant before 4 PM, we all wanted an early dinner to get back to work. We waited a half an hour for hors d'oeuvres and I asked our server why there was such a delay and why all the employees were in the bar. She informed us they were having a Restaurant meeting and there is only one person in the kitchen to do the cooking. We were in a hurry and there was only two other tables in the whole restaurant.  Our server seemed baffled as to why were a little upset because the waite time and chili coming out cold. Just because you're having a restaurant meeting the patrons should not have any less of a dining experience as if you were not.  So much for customers first!
name: Susan

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Amazing pizza place. I am not a fan of pizza but like their mini pizza for the first time.
name: G

text: This place was definitely on my list to try.  I looked over their menu and they had the most unusual/unconventional pairings, but they all looked mouth watering and appetizing. I decided to check it out on a Tuesday afternoon, my waitress told me I was in luck because of their Fried Chicken special. Their fried chicken special came with four pieces of fried chicken, macaroni and cheese, and their string beans with smoked turkey.  All very very good.  The waitress did inform me that their fried chicken is one of the more popular items on the menu and told me I wouldn't be disappointed....so I tried it.  Although the fried chicken wasn't out-of-this-world fantastic.....it was good.  I have definitely had better fried chicken, but High Hat Cafe held their own....Now their macaroni and cheese....was hands down the best mac n cheese I have had in New Orleans to date. I'm not playing y'all.  My server was attentive and very helpful.  The ambiance was on chill and laid back - I loved it.  The food was good, but that mac and cheese....whew!! Please excuse me...I'm having flashbacks...lol. I did try their desert of the day....some type of blueberry and peach pie...didn't strike my fancy in other words...didn't like it, but you know what I did like...I mean love?!?! I fell in love with their watermelon lemonade.  I mean neva in my life have I had something so refreshing and just so...so...good!   I had 3 cups it was that good.  I am coming back y'all and I plan on telling everybody.
name: Cristina

text: Been to this place a couple of times and willing to spend a little extra because their crust is good. But this time spend 35 dollars on a large and pesto chips, which were burnt and stale. The large pizza was BURNT and because it was burnt the sauce on the pizza was so dried out. Really disappointed. Probably wont be going back.
name: A

text: Dint like the juice was not tasting good and was very expensive .will never go to this place again. I wouldn't even give one star.
name: Sushmeetha

text: I love pho in Saigon And curry chicken rice very good the food good service great I will come back soon.
name: Van

text: We enjoyed a delicious authentic Polish meal at the Polish Cottage. The rustic design brought back happy memories of spending time in Poland. A very nice surprise a great find in Tucson.
name: Roxy

text: It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Portions were generous and presentation was nice. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Food was fresh and service was quick. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would absolutely visit again. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: This was a very bad experience for me in terms of taste. I am writing this review from the restaurant and what I am currently experiencing . The branch in Clayton is far better than this branch. The pancake was not cooked  to complete.... more like un cooked batter
name: Naga

text: ordered two cheese steaks and cheese fries , I requested relish and ketchup for the steaks, which came dry and the cheese steaks came with no cheese and no taste beware of these omissions that you pay for; oh yea the cheese fries were no better than the plain steaks
name: Ira

text: Food was good and came out fast. The food was good and the service was easygoing. So yeah, solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Also, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Also, for the price i expected more than this. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Food was fresh and service was quick. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Not sure though.
name: User

text: This place has really grown on me over my last few visits. It is a great spot to hit on your way to or from the beach and also offers some great inexpensive late night food. The prices are always very reasonable and the staff has always been friendly and quick. The place would surely be considered a local dive bar and it has a ton of character.  It gets quite busy at times, but you can usually get a seat after a short wait. The front is open and they allow smokers on the porch, so you can sometimes get some smoke coming back in the restaurant, but it has only been bad one time in many visits. Parking is a tough one as they only have a few spots out front and a few next door. Park on the side street or 1st S if really busy. Overall, I enjoy the food and bar options and it has become a regular stop of mine if in the area.
name: Joshua

text: Honestly I think I ordered the wrong thing. It looked better online than it did in person. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. idk I'd try something else next time. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
Made another visit back for bkfst. It was the same as before on the last trip . Parking is abominable! There is no where to park !!!
 Park near apts. you get towed.  
 I always liked the food & service , but still very loud inside.  Doubt I will return , too bad it couldbe great.
name: William

text:
I'm not a huge fan of oysters, but they have the best dang oysters here! 

We waited about an hour and a half, there was a line going out the door.. and the store was closing at 10pm.. i was worried we wouldn't get inside in time. I was slowly losing faith seeing how busy  and fun Bourbon Street was, I thought we could find dinner elsewhere that would be just as good and spend more time drinking, but I'm so glad we stayed in line!! They have dressed oysters with cheese and green onions, and raw oysters, and let me tell you, these were the most plump and softest oysters I've ever had. I'm from San Jose, CA and I've never found another oyster that could replicate the ones I've had here! My bf really wanted to come back here and get oysters every day for our trip and I wish we did! 

Service was friendly and attentive. I ordered a mint julep thinking it was gonna taste like the mint julep from Disneyland and I was wrong. It's an adult mint julep for sure lol, the bourbon punched me in the face, but a great drink for sipping nonetheless. We also tried their red beans and rice, which was good. Their popcorn chicken wasn't memorable.

It is a oyster bar in a tourist area, so the aesthetics were a little overwhelming from the many neon signs inside, and the red checkered table tops, and old timey pictures, but what more than a NOLA welcome. 

Come here for their oysters before you go drinking on bourbon street! It's worth it!
name: Theresa

text: Went here with a party of 8 on Cinco de Mayo at 5PM. Place was half full when we were seated. We ordered at 5:15PM. We then waited for 2 hours (without exaggeration) there were several tables around us that turned over 3 times. When we asked our waiter (who was very nice) he said that he didn't know why the kitchen wasn't making our food. He put it in the system at 5:15. Our food started to come out at 7:15PM one plate at a time. One person in our party didn't get his meal until everyone else was finished. We approached the manager who blamed the waiter and the waiter blamed the kitchen. The ownership of this place has no clue what customer service is. People were complaining the entire time we were there with no response from the manager. Food is decent here but we will not be returning.
name: Dan

text: I haven't been here in a long time.  My son got the enchilada platter, dip sampler, and we got the Grande meal.  We were all stuffed and very happy.  They bring out theee different kinds of salsa that we loved and their chips are fresh and thin, which we like.  The price is a little more than I would like to pay for drinks and dips though, otherwise 5 stars.
name: Christian

text: Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Glad we tried it.
name: User

text: Cute place, not too busy but they charged $3.50 for a glass of ice tea and didn't offer a refill. Shame me once.
name: Janet

text: Went to The Dutch Eatery with a group of 12 people last night.  The first time I have eaten there.  The menu is weird and nothing Dutch about it. Four of our party ordered the special which was seared scallops.  I can say that this was one of the worst meals I have ever had.  The scallops were not fresh, were  over cooked, dry and tasteless.  The risotto was awful as well.  The others who had the scallops all felt the same way.  No one in our party liked what they ordered.  The bread they bring out is stale and tasteless.  I cannot believe that they would actually serve something so bad.  I will not be going back to this restaurant any time soon.  Maybe we just caught them on a bad night.  It happens but our experience was enough to never return and not recommend this restaurant to anyone.  We have a lot of very good restaurants in Tucson.  The Dutch Eatery is not one of them.
name: Terry

text:
Do you not wait over 10 minutes for this place. It's not worth it. Being fro. New York, I love a great, hot, fresh donut, and while these are most of those things, they're pretty forgettable after. Cannot be compared to Brooklyn's legendary Peter Pan Donut Bakery.

The blueberry fritter is by far the best and even that, after three bites, you're ready to move on. The rest - the apple harvest, the apple fritter, the chocolate cake, the crumble - are too heavy and frosting-laden, and the frosting isn't high quality, especially the chocolate.

Skip this and head to Dutch Eating Place for the best dessert in the market: the hot apple dumpling. No comparison.
name: Bonnie

text:
This is my second time visiting this restaurant and I am never disappointed. Definitely my favorite restaurant in St Louis. There is usually a wait BUT it is worth it. Our service is always amazing and the food is even better. For an appetizer we get the bacon and the delicious fries. A MUST have. They both knock my socks off every time. My friend and I spilt the duck and the shrimp and grits. The duck melted in my mouth. Cooked to perfection. I was nervous about the grits but they were amazing. Very flavorful and different. 

Overall the best meal I have had in St Louis. Every time I visit I MUST dine at Shaved Duck
name: Debra

text: Important business dinner. Top-notch service from Sean and team! The filets were tender and cooked perfectly. Big fan of the roasted corn. Thumbs up for the calamari app as well.
name: Mike

text: Food portions were huge! The place was very busy on a Saturday night. Probably waited 45 minutes but it was worth the wait. Only complaint was the ventilation of the place. It was very Smokey in the waiting line. That said we will go back on our next trip to St. Louis
name: Rick

text: Great breakfast, cool atmosphere. My wife has been here a few times and finally got me to come and it did not disappoint.
name: David

text: This place was kind of hard to find, if it weren't for the sign up front I probably wouldn't have found it! So It's not really a speak-easy, but it sure has the vibes! Very 1940's  post prohibition feel with low-lighting and everyone dressed up. I ordered an old fashioned, but was unimpressed. The food was great! Even though I ordered A medium Rare filet Mignon, it's really hard to mess that steak up. I mean look at the photos, looks like the cow still mooooing, LoL. text:
Though it is rare that I review a chain business, I have been eating at Pollo Loco since the 80s and still have it almost weekly so I feel it deserves a spot among my Yelp reviews. 

First, so we're clear, this review is specific to the Pollo Loco in Sparks off of Prater in the Iron Horse shopping center. They have amazing service and quality assurance. 

I am crazy for Pollo Loco (yes, yes, I did just do that) because it's the only fast food joint that I can feel totally guilt-free eating. Many fast food joints falsely advertise fresh ingredients, but there is no nuked birds (they cook them right there for you to see on an actual grill!)and the salsa bar in itself is proof of fresh ingredients laid out right before your eyes.  

The salsa bar. Let's take a moment, shall we? Fresh chopped cilantro, onion, lemon wedges and whole pepper jalapeños all laid out in abundance for your convenience. The salsas: my favorite is the spicy avocado, but I also love their house salsa- fresh tomato, cilantro, onion-simple, but delish. They also have pico de gallo and a spicy/smoky red salsa, both also good. 

The chicken is always cooked to perfection and with that signature Pollo Loco rub that I just can't get enough of. It's the Mexican aroma equivalent of McDonald's fries-one whiff and it's like food crack that makes you want to stuff your face silly! Or in the words of PL, "crazy you can taste!" (Yes, yes, I just did that)

For the sides, I stick to the standard pinto beans and Spanish rice. Oh and their guacamole is pretty bomb too. 

So the next time you get a hankering for Mexican food, but don't feel like going out, definitely hit up the Pollo Loco in Sparks!
name: Katie

text: This is one of several food choices if you're near the Circus Circus big top (shows, arcades) - just make sure you give it a try! This location is in a clean, well decorated and open dining and food court, with a couple of more restaurants toward the rear. ..But, The Habit is right up front so you can't say you didn't see it! The menu offers their burgers, of course, along with salads, signature sandwiches, sides and frozen treats and shakes. And kid's meals, as well! We opted for some appetizers, the fries and the new to us tempura green beans. For the kids we got the Charburger (with cheese) and the chicken nuggets. And for the rest of us, we got the tri-tip steak sandwich and the veggie burger. As a treat, we ended with a cookies-n-cream (Oreo) shake and a seasonal pumpkin shake - also something new to us! The food was ready quickly, in spite of the place being quite popular and busy. The appetizers were good - and the tempura beans were very good! Thick but tender green beans, moist and battered in a light tempura coating were a cool break from the fries, onion rings or whatever. A light and tasty treat. The kids meals were just right, with fries included and a little "gummy" hamburger candy for dessert. The tri-tip sandwich featured generous slices of hand-cut, marinated steak, along with shredded lettuce, tomatoes, mayo and choice of BBQ or teriyaki sauce - we had the BBQ sauce, so sweet and tangy. The meat was juicy and properly cooked. At the other end of the options, the veggie burger was also very juicy and tasty, featuring a toasted bun, on a bed of leafy lettuce, tomatoes, onions and - cucumbers! Yet another surprise, as I can't remember ever having cukes on a burger! I added cheese and with the sweet mustard dressing the whole burger was finger-licking (needed!) good. The best was in a sense for last, though, as the pumpkin shake (mine) was a delight of many sorts. Cold, creamy and indeed frozen, it was a great flavor - if you like pumpkin. If not, there are other flavors, and the cookies'n'cream was as good a choice. When you're ready for a break from gambling, gaming or gazing (I love just people watching in these places!), give The Habit a try - it may indeed become your habit.

text: How is this possible? A five star meal upstairs at DiBruno's at a really good price? I am tempted to keep this a secret but the Elite in me is telling me that I must share the details of a recent lunch there. The upstairs at DiBruno's was always a pretty space but when they decided to ditch the cafeteria style offerings and open up Alimentari, they spiffed up the space even more, with a padded banquette straddling one wall and more upscale furnishings. Even the stairs leading up to Alimentari have a gray tinge to the wood now to match the rest of the upstairs. And the food has been kicked up several notches as well, and to be perfectly honest with you, some of the things we ate would be right at home being served at the likes of Barbuzzo or Vernick Fish. No I not on drugs. What we ate was really that good. Our meal started with our friendly server, Mike, offering us a choice of complimentary still or sparkling water. We were informed of several lunch specials and we placed our order. A complimentary bread basket featuring some crostini that they sell downstairs and two types of bread, one garlicky and another with cranberries, came out next. It was decent enough but not like the bread basket at Parc or anything like that. My dining partner and I split an  enormous root vegetable salad to start. It had chopped carrots, Brussels sprouts (I think), beets, cranberries, bread crumbs, thinly sliced Parmesan (maybe?) other stuff (definitely) and a maple glaze (thinking so) that was to die for. I wish I knew what was in it since the menu posted here and online is the summer one and has since been changed. I could eat this every day and be perfectly happy. It was that good. My wife had a grilled panini with ham and cheese that we added Parmesan (and something else, of course) kettle chips to that was really good. I enjoyed a juicy, perfectly cooked, glistening, mouth watering (you get the idea) piece of roasted branzino that was served over pasta that no doubt has an official Italian name that looked liked tiny BB's. The fish was just as good as what is served anywhere else in town. Seriously. And although it was a small plate, at $13 it was a steal. Since my lunch was entirely too healthy I decided to spring for the bombolini with dark chocolate hazelnut spread and chantilly cream for dessert. It consisted of a number of small addictive beignet-like donut holes that were coated with cinnamon sugar. They were really good and really bad for you I'm sure. Thai Braised Ribs - SEVERAL TIMES

Beans barely warm and the Mac and cheese just warm as well. We then asked why did they serve 3 of us and not wait until we could ALL have hot chicken?  No answer given.  He goes to the kitchen, gets the server and she runs the chicken plate to my friend.  All of our plates are even colder now because we wanted to wait to eat until he was served.  The solution? They offered dessert but to be honest we were so done by the experience we were just ready to pay the bill and get out of there. text:
Hendersonville might not be known for its culinary hot spots BUT Moby Dicks is a hidden treasured gem. Immediately after moving to Hendersonville from the west coast I was hesitant to try ANY seafood in Tennessee (in general) but Moby Dick's kept popping up as a recommendation on my Yelp app. So during one of those the weather is too beautiful to cook kind of evenings we said YOLO and  headed to Moby Dicks. BEST.DECISION.EVER.PERIOD The food incredible, the atmosphere amazing, the service fantastic. This isn't a fancy shamancy joint. This is a town jewel where locals know each other and stranger leave feeling like they belong. 
The restaurant is located right by the lake so you have an incredible view, plus they seem to have resident ducks who will wait patiently for you to feed them, but don't listen to them they don't need human food. Plus you might enjoy your meal and not have any left over for the ducks. The food really isn't exaggerating when you think about the quality of fish. There's nothing more frustrating than paying a high price for fish tasting fish. As contradictory as it sounds fresh fish shouldn't taste fishy! They have fun and delicious sushi menu in the evenings which I highly recommend the Commando Roll. 
In late spring/summer months it get CRAZY busy so good luck finding parking despite their parking space being pretty spacious.
