text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The staff seemed tired but still polite. It just never really recovered once things started off weird. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The food was good and the service was easygoing. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: The service was too bad, two people gave us a very tiny  table, I have no place to put my clothes, and when I borrowed a chair to put clothes, the waiter forcibly took it, and the waiter did not pour the water. No service... So bad, I will not come again!!!
name: Liliana

text: Came with the family of 6, which includes 2 vegetarians.  The menu makes NO attempt AT ALL to provide any type of vegetarian meal (they have a caesar salad, but a bowl of lettuce is not a meal). Our family just left without ordering, since 2 of us could not eat there.  Guys, its real simple to have at least a veggie burger or SOMETHING.  Even McDonald's and Burger King have vegetarian burgers now. Gave you 2 stars instead of one because the location really is nice.
name: Dan

text: Stopped by this place while in the area based off all the previous ratings and yelpers don't lie this place was awesome. We ate here around 4:30pm on a Saturday and they happens to be running there happy hour specials which we got and was 5 tacos for 10$ not bad and several options to choose from. we got fish , carne Asada , chicken and al pastor which were all great but especially the asada tacos. They did have a nice salsa bar with several salsas and pico. And as long as you spent like 5$ you could get chips as well which were also really good. I would definitely stop here and eat again .Also if this is your first visit they have a check in offer of 1 free taco with check in so just another added bonus.
name: Chris

text: This was my 2nd visit to Culver's and again the food was delicious and the service solid. The buffalo chicken strips are spicy and are quality beast meat, so bonus points for that. I love custard, so their concrete mixer desserts are perfect in this warm Florida weather.
name: Michael

text: First time in Nashville, one of our favorite spots! Sean at the bar could not have been more welcoming, needless to say we were at FGL more than once. Food is great, and you can't go wrong with Nashville's own "Green Tea", just ask Sean!
name: Evie

text:
The place is a very small, loud and cramped dive bar.  Also, parking can be difficult to find.  I ordered a custom grilled cheese sandwich (mozzarella, pesto and bacon) from their "Stack Your Cheese" selection along with a bowl of tomato bisque.  They were really busy that night and my food took almost 40 minutes.  However, my server was very attentive and nice, often checking on me as well as apologizing for the wait.  She also gave me updates on when my order would be out.

Once my food arrived, it was well worth the wait.  The sandwich was perfectly cooked with a generous amount of cheese and the soup was creamy perfection.  Everything was delicious, needless to say.  A perfect meal for a cold, rainy night.

So why only three stars?  I wasn't very fond of the loud atmosphere or the terrible parking.  I'll have to give this place another try; hopefully at a less-crowded time.
name: Sean

text: Best brunch I've had ever. The monte Cristo is absolutely amazing and the flavored mimosas are delicious
name: Marissa

text: Good Burger has truly wonderful burgers. All the way from buns to meat, their burgers are quality all the way around. Their BBQ, Fry Sauce, & Ketchup all taste homemade. Their self serve tap wall is exciting and unique. The atmosphere is both hip  and calming. Would recommend & will be back
name: Matt

text: The food came out looking rlly good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, tho the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Will be back. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: A native Nashvillian recommended I try this while in town, and I wasn't impressed. I had one pasta dish and a kale salad; they were both memorable, in that the composition of the dishes was not very harmonious. I get that they're trying to be fresh and seasonal and local, but neither of the dishes were well-spiced or intuitively combined with tastes or ingredients that enhanced their flavor, making them somewhat lacking. (The presentation, service, and decor were quite nice, though.) For dessert, I had the Japanese cheesecake - which, mercifully, was removed from the menu - and it was rather bland. My take - if you're a food snob, and you're coming from NYC, L.A., S.F. or Chicago, don't go.
name: Molly

text:
Second time here in last two months and not any better. Even the bartender and waitress knew the "Roux butter" was way too spicy for the wahoo after it was served. When the dish was brought back a second time the presentation was worse than the first time (minus the Roux butter).  The Andouille in the Andouille crusted wahoo was nowhere to be found.

According to the staff Roux fired the executive chef recently (since my previous visit).  Guess the replacement won't make things better.  Apparently Roux is part of the Datz chain that is just another food machine.  It doesn't matter if its national or local, a food machine is a food machine and not made for human consumption.

I lived many years in New Orleans and Roux resembles the pits of New Orleans.
name: Steve

text: Just learned about this new Honky-tonk. It is the real deal. Great food and atmosphere. I feel like I am in the movie "Tender Mercies" and waiting for Robert Duvall to take the stage. Looking forward to many happy returns.
name: Jeff

text: Mediocre poke. It fulfills any craving, but they skimp you on the protein, seaweed salad and almost anything they charge you extra for. At the end of the day, you get a large bowl with extra protein for about 15-18$ pending your toppings and almost always end up asking, "where's the rest?" Fish isn't as fresh as sushi places such as veekoo or competing poke establishment pokebros.
name: Vito

text: I have already been here a few times and love it! The staff is very friendly and helpful. The Mac and cheese burger and Poutine are two of my favorites. I'm sad to move because I won't get to eat DB anymore. Seriously delicious! Best burgers in Tucson!
name: Melissa

text:
First time here. The food is excellent. I love the atmosphere. I will for sure keep going. I live in wesley chapel so the drive is  far but hopefully with this area growing, they will open one out here. Please please 
The food is all healthy.   I can't wait to go back. The only one thing is the young man working behind the counter was not to friendly.
name: J

text: A higher quality panera bread! Love love love the apple fritters here- a must try! Also don't miss the tuna salad in the cold case. Only thing keeping this from being a five star joint is the service. They could also benefit from an experienced barista. Specialty drink orders take a while to fill here.
name: Anthony

text: They should do everyone a favor and close the doors to this shit hole. Sweet tea wasn't bad.
name: Alex

text: This place is crazy crowded on the weekends but the food is really good, we went for the chicken fried steak and a side of biscuits and gravy (we were not disappointed). Everything was cooked well and tasted delicious.
name: J

text:
The first hamburger joint. The first pizza parlor. Both probably raised eyebrows: "an entire restaurant just for hamburgers?" That is what I thought when MBM opened on Mass Ave years ago. I first attended during its opening week and as many restaurants have some kinks when opening - they sure did. Thank goodness they worked those out and have expanded!

Each meatball combination has been enjoyable and I was very pleased when the sriracha glazed made it to the menu from the specialty balls. I have also heard great things about the chicken but have not had the pleasure yet. It is difficult to make a helpful recommendation when you enjoy the menu so go ahead and explore. 

We typically door dash from this particular MBM once a week when work gets busy. The order is accurate and arrives warm. We even had them "cater" an event at our house by ordering 80 balls and it was all perfect. 

Their wines and draught beers change so always take a look at the menu. You might get lucky and attend on an evening of Zombie Dust on tap!
name: David

text: Best ever! The staff are so nice and seemed to know the majority of the people in line by name. You can tell that they genuinely care about their costumers and the food they prepare. I had the Cuban, which was filling and had a good amount of spice. However, my wife had the Reuben, which was FANTASTIC! Paired mine with the lobster bisque. Not a single spoonful without lobster chunks and was a great addition to the lunch. More than enough food and a place that is well worth eating at if you are in the area!!!
name: Rian

text: Wow! What a great concept and restaurant!!  Seen the place several times and just visited it this past weekend.  The food was great and the service was great.   Will definitely be back and bring the whole family.
name: Aj

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. I had a better visit than I expected to. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. It looked better online than it did in person. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Staff was attentive and get everybody straight during a busy lunch hour rush. Food was amazing! Will definitely be returning
name: Samantha

text: Ordered takeout because I didn't feel like cooking and it held up okay. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Also, they were out of one thing i originally wanted.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Wow! First of all, I absolutely LOVE the whole aesthetic they have going on. Decorations are too cute. I'm all for they're gluten free, no hormones menu! Everything is healthy. You get a pretty good amount for what you pay! They have a variety of options. Super quick service. Friendly atmosphere. I totally recommend going if you're in the area and want something tasty but good for you too!
name: Eileen

text:
Overall disappointing. I was kinda overhyped by their ad somewhere coz the lobster roll looked really good. Had high expectations for this place but ultimately fell flat.

1) chowder: okay. Like a chowder you could get from Old Nelson. Similar portions as well.

2) lobster Mac n' cheese: loose the "lobster" part and it's a decent Mac n' Cheese. Small portion tho.

3) lobster roll: smallest roll I've seen, ever. And I'm not saying just coz it's 20+ bucks. Could be served as cocktail snacks. Totaled three bites for me. Lobster was soggy. 

It is saying sth that I went to a Honeygrow for a stir fry after.
name: Joseph

text: This was our first time at Tijuana Flats and we love it. The service was unbelievable for this type of restaurant. We were greeted at the door and asked if we had been before. Everything was explained and all our questions answered. When they bought the food they noticed we were sharing, so they brought an extra plate and put more chips on it. We were sitting at the table eating and wondering if they would give us a refill on the drink when one of the staff came over to make sure everything was okay and asked if we wanted a refill. We had several staff come by to check on us while we were eating and they cleared away the dishes we no longer needed. On top of all this, the street tacos were excellent and had so much on them they would barely fold over. We liked the option of hard and soft corn tortillas as well as flour or wheat. We tasted a lot of the hot sauces and found several we liked. We will definitely be back.
name: John

text: We were so happy to find this little cafe close to the National Park. You would miss it if you didn't have the address. There were 4 of us and we were all very pleased with our lunches. They also serve large portions of ice cream.
name: J

text: I had to laugh/chuckle at some of the reviews on the "all you can shove down your gullet" seafood night, especially the ones about the snow crab leg shortage. From what I have observed, as soon as a hot steaming pan stacked high with these crab legs comes out, there are about 4 to 7 chow hogs that attack these piling their plates 10 to 12 inches high with $11 per pound crab legs with the complaints coming mainly from the crab hogs that are late to the trough. Greedy folks should realize that higher priced items are placed on a seafood buffet as a special treat for loyal customers, not as a main bust a gut course. Overall, Jumbo has very prim and proper wait staff; all young Chinese girls and boys who cannot hardly speak a word of English and better yet they don't spit onto your food as do some of the lower class fast food establishments do. The selection seems very diverse. Even a hibachi bar & cook top complete with a cook, who volunteered for the spot for the tips, which are far and few between as I have noticed. Most of their foods are fairly good to great with a few, "I'll never eat that again" dishes. Lunch time is the best time and best price, 11 a.m. early, or 1:15 p.m. when all the workers have had their fill. My only complaint is lax mothers...you know, the ones who let their 3-7 year old kids touch and handle everything on the buffet twice before choosing the chicken nugget or corn dog or pizza slice that finally gets loaded onto their plates. All this to say, it's a fairly good experience if it weren't for 10% of the customers who should seriously think about eating at home only. I for one do hope this family run business continues to be a thriving Kenner business. BTW, heads up, don't go here on Christmas Eve after 6:30 p.m. unless you want to wait for a table for a long time. The Cajun Cannon's place + The Boat, and all Chinese restaurants in Kenner & Metairie had lines out the door during that time period. Stay home and drink your egg nog and make yourself a hogs head cheese sandwich instead...live a little!
name: Dexter

text:
The skin of the Xiao Long Bao was not as thin as it usually was when I ate at other Shanghainese spots. But not bad, worth a try.

After I signed the receipt, the waitress couldn't wait to take it away and look at it. I felt a bit uncomfortable about it, but might cuz some people tip little at this place?
name: Essie

text: I stopped here for a quick lunch in this part of town and saw this on yelp. I decided to check it out and was thoroughly pleased. It's a nice casual spot to get your burrito or taco fix definitely. I had the California burrito and tried it with the three condiments/sauces that were offered to the table. It was delicious! I would definitely consider coming here again.
name: Shuné

text: I'm from Texas. I'm really picky about street tacos and these were delicious. Just the right amount of seasoning and cilantro. Lots of chips. I got one with bang bang chicken and one with pulled pork. Can't go wrong.
name: Bradley

text: Delicious!!! We got al pastor pork burrito (mild) and chicken burrito (hot), we opted out of sour cream.
name: Emily

text: I am greatly disappointed at this facility which I do not consider a resort. I have stayed here many times when John Ascuaga owned it and it has gone down hill.  There are no controls over the kids at the pool. The buffet is closed on weekends, the steak house opens at 5, and the Oyster Bar prices are now outrageous. No more cocktail lounges. The rooms are crap and the tub fills up with water when showering. Never again!
name: Maria

text:
Ordered takeout and the food was exceptionally delicious! The Panang curry and papaya salad topped all of them at over 5 stars and the others were 5 star. The person who took our order was friendly and attentive to details to ensure the order was properly taken. The Thai iced tea was so delicious but also super sweet. Still, it's one of the best I've had among U.S based Thai restaurants. 

There are a couple Thai Kitchen locations, but the one in Maryland Heights is not the same owner. After talking to some friends, sounds like there was confusion for some reason. The one in Maryland Heights doesn't come close to authenticity of these dishes. 

Thanks for the great takeout experience. I hope to dine in sometime soon!
name: Mona

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Not bad for a quick meal. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text:
This was my first trip to Pokeworks and I'm sure it won't be my last. They're located on the outskirts of Lakeside Mall, right next to Sucre. I was lucky enough to find a rock star parking spot.

My daughter and I were warmly welcomed when we walked in, and there were only 2 customers ahead of us, so our wait was very brief.

PW is an assembly line style poke restaurant, so you can build your own bowl or choose one if their creations. We built our own, and were happy with our choices.  I was kind of sad to find that they don't have octopus.  It's one of my favorite poke proteins, so I felt like I was missing it. My daughter was all good.

Just a little blip - there isn't much seating, so come early if you plan to eat in.

I was jazzed to see that they offer burritos and salads in addition to poke/rice bowls.  They're great alternatives.

So - everything was fresh, service was excellent, flavors were top notch.
name: Patricia

text: Drinks were overpriced. Food was mediocre. I order the adult grilled cheese and got a wonder bread sandwich grilled cheese with added tomatoes and bacon. I love an adult grilled cheese and this one was a joke amongst the 20 people in our party. People asking if I wanted some of there food. Atmosphere is nice but if you considering buying anything I would rather go to a dive bar and get cheap beer and greasy food.
name: Jeff

text: "Roberts" is definitely a place to have a good time. I did feel that the bar itself is a bit congested and tight on space. Besides that, everything else was pretty cool. Good drinks, great music, positive vibes. Staff were friendly and attentive!
name: Sarah

text: Had to check this place out after seeing all the fabulous reviews. I will definitely have to come back in the summer when I'm not pregnant because it's definitely a drinking environment. I was not sure what to expect, but It's basically a bar that serves burgers.... so you get a drink, start a tab, and then get in the burger line. You have about 1-2 drinks by the time you get to the window to order your burgers and fries from a super friendly guy. Get another drink or bucket at the bar and head out to the patio or into the dining room to wait for them to text you (5-10 minutes). When they text you go pick up your food and enjoy. I would of had 3-4 drinks before getting my food if it was a typical evening and would have spent $100 minimum.  Tonight we had two burgers, 2 fries, 2 beers and a soda and spent $50-$60. The food was simple and delicious. The atmosphere was awesome! Loved the patio!!!! They had picnic benches on both sides, couches in the middle, had a fire going in the middle, and they have a super cool game garage that was all graffitied out with old school games, a vintage couch, and a pool table. This place even has a dog station with water bowls and a faucet and they have hooks on the picnic table for your 4 legged friends. This place is pretty damn cool and we will definitely be regulars!!
name: Kelly

text: This is little place from heaven. Everything about this restaurant was great from the food to the service. My son is probably the most pickiest eater ever and he even enjoyed his food. Our waiter Johnathan was outstanding. This restaurant has only been open for four weeks now. Once word really gets out, they should definitely be a local favorite.
name: Marcus

text: Took over 80 minutes for delivery that was quoted at 55. Even scratching that, lets say it was 100% doordash (which i was told it wasnt) -- would not pay $10 for this taco salad... just bad. 2 stars because chicken sandwich was slightly redeeming.
name: Ana

text: My husband, a friend and myself had dinner here last night. Dinner was one of the best in Philly. We sampled several appetizer, tasted each other's entrees and had a delicious tiramsu and coffee ice cream for dessert. I ordered monk fish wrapped in prosciutto with a delicious tomato based compote. Along side this was a nice perfectly toasted bread slice topped with, i think, a parsley or tarragon pesto. Oh my...amazing! Both my husband and our friend totally enjoyed their dinner. The service was outstanding. Darryl, Diva and Tori were perfectly attentive. A friend recommended it and we will all definitely go back...again and again and again. FYI...it's a Byob but they do have some selections of beer, wine and cocktails. All which worked well with our meals. Definitely worth the trip!!!
name: Donna

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The music was louder than it needed to be. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. It looked better online than it did in person. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was good and came out fast. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: We came sliding in right before 2pm and the staff couldn't have been more welcoming and helpful! It is in a food court upstairs in an office building. I've been to NO many times and never knew about this place...I ordered the famous "surf and turf" and my husband ordered the Ricks special...they did NOT disappoint! The steak had great flavor and grilled to perfection mixed with bell peppers and onion and mushrooms. Definitely come by here! They close at 2pm though!
name: Kathy

text: Definitely one of the finer sushi places to eat within New Orleans. Service was nice and friendly regardless of the busy traffic that comes through there. Food was pretty good, i wouldn't say the best but it was okay for the price. Location is a bit on the difficult side to find parking. Other than the small hiccups, i would recommend this place to someone.
name: Dan

text: Great, quick quality meal.  The variety of calzones will please anyones taste. All came out fresh and hot.  Great flavor and plenty of food for each person.  Will be back.
name: Bo

text: Very rude, was not properly greeted, my order took 20mins and i was the only customer in the lobby. I only had 2 happy meals and 4 tenders. I approached the counter for ranch , no one came to the counter because everyone was in the back shouting. They were Cursing in front of children. Unprofessional. I hear so many bad things about this Mcdonalds.
name: Andreonna

text: New to the neighborhood we decided to give this place a try. We got the combo of all five meats with 3 sides. The sides (mac n cheese, collard greens, and baked beans) were all delicious. However, the meats were extremely dry and I couldn't moisten them up with the sweet and spicy bbq, because it was very, very spicy.
name: Savanna

text: The best food and atmosphere I've ever experienced. The food is diverse. I got a pizza and my mom got biscuits and gravy and they were both equally phenomenal. My waitress, April, was so nice and efficient. Definitely will come again
name: Angelle

text: Best crawfish etouffee I've ever had. Kids fish/fries were super high quality. Gumbo real good too. Bowl is huge (almost a meal). Cup is tiny.
name: Lee

text: What a great location nestled in Safety Harbor.  That outdoor seating was so nice.  This is a must when you visit this cool little town. Joey and the staff serve up fresh,fantastic pizza, sandwiches and delicious desserts.
name: Cindy

text: You cannot go wrong with anything at Milktooth. They change up the menu pretty regularly but I've never had anything that I did not like. The Dutch baby pancakes, biscuits, and savory dishes particularly stand out. They also have fresh squeezed juice and coffee drinks that are unique and tasty! Can get very crowded and they don't take reservations so try to come early or be ready to wait- it's worth it!
name: Teresa

text: New owners took over Dimples Deli.   I met the owners and received a very warm welcome and great service.   The food was fantastic!  I had a ham, bacon & Swiss croissant.  It was huge and the thick bacon was so crispy.  They also had a great salad bar set up, a wide variety of speciality sandwiches, wraps, salads and soups.  I will definitely be back and highly recommend!
name: Barb

text: Interesting grocery store and restaurant.  Tried the the buffet and found yo be very good. Definitely will go back.
name: Chris

text: Last night a small group of us came for dinner but the doors were locked. Lights were on but nobody home WTH!
name: TMarie

text: We have heard good things about stout.  We were sorely disappointed.  It has a cool atmosphere but the food portions were very small compared to the prices.  The servers were not attentive.  In addition, I would not characterize this as craft burgers.  These are just plain burgers.  If prices were lower, we would consider coming back.  But there are too many great choices in this area to spend higher dollars on less than impressive food.
name: Jon

text: Stopped in for breakfast - the food was delicious and HOT! Service was great! Had the breakfast skillets - country and greek. Will have enough for another morning of yumminess also.
name: Kelly

text: No big complaints, just a nice meal. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Overall, a strong experience. Food was fresh and service was quick. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Would prob stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: They sent me a coupon for free bang bang shrimp for my birthday. I never heard of that before and I had never been there before but I tried the bang bang shrimp and I LOVED it. I'm hooked. I haven't been able to find it anywhere else that tastes as good as they make it. It's a little bit expensive but I was treated like a Queen so I'd definitely go again.
name: Sylvia

text: Been here probably 20 times and never had a bad experience. Service is always great and sushi is always really good. They even have a punch card for a free AYCE with the purchase of 1.
name: Zsera

text: I was really excited to try this place after all the great reviews.  Our waitress killed my excitement as we sat for a while before she even greeted us and then she brought my friends coffee but not my drink and then "computer"  glitches made it necessary for her to retake our order. Food was just ok.  The Turkey melt was made with lunch meat not oven roasted Turkey and was good except for the lunchmeat taste.  The fries were good extra thin.  The avocado blt my friend had was just ok.  Noise level was a bit much with crying babies.  Do not need to return.
name: Lisa

text: Yummy yummy get in my tummy BBQ!  You can smell this place upon approach which makes your mouth water.  We usually get the pulled BBQ and chicken with the Mac and cheese and fries and or potato salad depending on our moods. The selection of sauces are very tasty . The house blend is our favorite.  When we're around we show up for our fix of smoked meat!  Check this place out if your in town .  If you drive by it , make a U turn and go back.
name: Eric

text: I recently ordered a pizza from this dominos for my three children and a sitter. I have ordered many times before and there has never been an issue; we live on a major street easy to find. I was notified by the sitter one and half hours later that the pizza didn't arrive. I did realize I missed a call earlier (we were In a movie and I didn't hear the phone ring). When I called dominoes, the person who delivered pizzas answered and said that there was confusion about my address and he couldn't find the house - I live on Carrollton Ave. and they have delivered there many times before. He got the manager who was extremely rude and I was told it was there policy if you don't answer a call they don't deliver (the other guy said he couldn't find my house).  They would not redeliver or refund me. I will not be ordering from dominoes again.
name: Katie

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Anyway, they were out of one thing i originally wanted.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Also, delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. For a busy night they handled it okay. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better online than it did in person. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: The only thing I like from Eegee's is the slushee (the "Eegee") and their sweet potato fries that's a seasonal treat. My partner raved about this place when I first met her and when I finally tried their food, I didn't care too much for it. It's just a sandwich.
name: Kristina

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: One of my favorite DTSP spots! The atmosphere is relaxed and they have inside and outside seating. All of their food is amazing and their drinks are delicious too. I have been here many times and ordered food from Uber eats and the quality of food is amazing! My favorite food items to order are the slider trio, tots and pretzels!!
name: Jackie

text:
My favorite sushi spot in Philadelphia! The staff is friendly, the sushi is fresh and it's BYOB! 

The staff in Bleu Sushi always put does themselves. I was here last night ands our server gave us complimentary dessert and was funny and fast! With the large amount of regular rolls and special rolls you will find something you love! The Eagles roll is my personal favorite. The miso soup and edamame is also great as a starter.

The ambiance is nice with large windows in the front that they open when it's nice out. I prefer a spot by the window as the rest of the restraint is darker. Great for a date! The tables are pretty close together but I never felt as if I was right on top of another party. They do deliver, pick up and done in.
name: Victoria

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Definitely coming back. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: Had dinner at Juniper last night with friends.   One of the specials was a red curry seafood dish-- had the largest scallops I have ever seen, and may be the best curry dish I have ever eaten -- and I have eaten at a lot of fine restaurants in my 52 years.  Well done, Juniper-- food and service were top rate.
name: Jeffrey

text:
I've visited this place at least 3 times and it's just been okay. When they first opened, I figured they have some kinks to workout since they were new . Unfortunately only a few items improved. I would avoid their breakfast items and bland fish tacos. Pop on over to Los Agaves if you want fish tacos and good, fresh salsa to choose from.

I only enjoy their fried dishes here. In particular, the fried shrimp plate.
name: Claudia

text: We had the cheesesteak, root beer bbq wings, and the habañero wings.  Everything was delicious!  My favorite was the cheesesteak.  This was my first vegan cheesesteak and I didn't have high hopes for it.  It was absolutely delicious.  I prefer the taste of the root beer wings over the habañero wings.  I usually like spicier food but the root beet wings had more flavor.  The texture of the wings were perfect.  There was a nice crunch when biting into them. We definitely plan to return so we can try the spicy sweet wings and pizza.
name: E

text:
Well I've noticed some good reviews and we wish our experience was positive - unfortunately it was hands down the worst experience we've ever had. 

Where to start?  We asked for a quiet table and were given an area where noone was currently seated. Two minutes later they seated an entire birthday party group and kids next to us. 

Our waiter was very pleasant and personable and promised us the best experience ever. Wish he had come through as promised. The food was - in a word - horrible. I tolerated my cheese laden seafood pizza even though it was charred and burned to a crisp on one side and as was the crust but only because I arrived hungry. My wife attempted to eat her seafood cannelloni but the pasta was also charred and overdone to the point of being rubbery - it had just one shrimp. Reluctantly she sent it back and received as an alternative, a monster sized bowl of linguini. Unfortunately they took away her cutlery with her first dish and didn't replace it. It took several minutes to get someone's attention to get it replaced and when they did so, they brought her a large steak knife to eat linguini and no fork. 

We were told side salads came with each entree. Mine was the smallest Caesar salad I've ever seen!  And, they charged me $6 for it despite being told twice salad was included with entrees. 

What next? Service took forever. Ordered coffee which arrived tepid and 15 minutes ahead of dessert (most folks like to have them together). 

Waiters were very apologetic for the charred food and our main waiter said there would be no charge for the food items. And we'd get a free dessert. We were indeed granted a n/c dessert but they charged $18 for the linguini, contrary to what we were told. 

Never, never again.
name: R

text:
Rybrew is a neat little place.
very friendly and helpful service.
a great beer selection.
the Bahn Mi was excellent.
and the ice cream flavors, omg!

highly recommend!
name: Nathan

text:
If you are have come to this yelp page wondering if you should go to NaBrasa Brazilian Steakhouse, ponder no more. Take this as a sign. Out of all the Brazilian Steakhouses I have been to, Nabrasa takes the cake for the best fine dining experience all around.

If you have not ever been to a Brazilian Steakhouse, let me break it down for you. You walk in and are seated. The waitstaff takes your drink order. You then have an all access buffet, filled with delicacies, including assorted cheeses, bread, sushi, lox, and salad sides; Along with a hot bar that includes things such as hot wings and roasted potatoes. To your side you will see little square, previously round, cutouts. One side is red, the other gray. When you are ready to be served delicious cuts of meat, simply flip it to red. The wait staff - gauchos I believed they are called, walk around with skewers with various cuts of delicious fine meats. If your card is flipped to the red side, they will simply stop at your table and ask if you would like the cut of meat they have, My favorite thus far has been the bacon wrapped scallops & the parmesan pork loin. When it comes to steak, they will ask you how you like it done, then carve the meat table side! 

On top of having so many mouth watering options, I really have to give a shout out to all the waitstaff. They are all genuinely friendly and personable. I took my 4 year old to the Rodizio for the first time this past weekend, and I have to say, they made sure my little guy was taken care of. They were checking on him periodically to make sure he had everything he needed , and even brought him ice cream at the end ! Very attentive. 

So if you are in the market looking for a good Rodizio, I would strongly suggest you take the drive and check out Nabrasa. Just make sure you bring a a big appetite!
name: Mezz

text: The customer service alone makes this place amazing. The food was great also. We had pizza and chicken wings. Yummy experience.
name: Delia

text: I hate to write this review because it will probably increase my wait time, but they deserve it.  I had been meaning to go here, but just had my first visit.  I met Garrett, the manager, upon entering and he took my name because there was a short wait.  I had two, yes two servers, Keily and Stacy and their service was impeccable.  Garrett was everywhere ensuring the place ran like a well-oiled machine and that the customers were happy.  I tried something different and went with the tomatillo mary cocktail; it was unique and good.  I had an omelette for my meal and it was delicious as well.  The coffee was good, steaming hot and served in a mug - nice touch.  Fortunately, it's next to a free parking garage if there's no street parking.  As a result of my great initial visit and extensive menu, this will be my go-to breakfast spot and it's close enough that I can ride my bike there.  A shout-out and big thank you to Garrett, Keily and Stacy!  See you next time - Dee
name: Sharon

text:
We are on a family road trip and decided to check out Nashville for a day. After reading about this place online and checking out yelp reviews, we ventured in! You will not be disappointed! A few things to note that would have been helpful for us (especially since we are out of towners)

- small parking lot...we came at lunch and it was full. Park in one of the lots surrounding the restaurant.

text: Delicious! Deliciousness! Perfect for brunch, and a nice day like it was when I went! They have inside sitting and outside too. Definitely a place to check out.

text: The food was delicious! The bartender was so nice and let me sample the beers I haven't sampled before I bought one! I had the wings and the burger and everything was cooked how I wanted and I was surprised especially for the time of night I went. The atmosphere is warm and inviting and the bar is a neat place. I can't wait to come back for some beer and good food!
name: Leilauni

text: YUMMMM !!!  Excellent, well-prepared food and very fresh.  Décor of restaurant was very cute.  Most Italian restaurants in the area look like beat up garages so the quaintness of this did not disappoint.  The food is as good as the look.  Go try - It's delish !!!

text:
A great local Pizza spot. Service is always good, friendly and efficient. Love the Shiitake Mushroom pizza, one of the best pizza's in the city. Side dishes are are also very strong including the Caesars salad, Meatballs (which comes with a bowl of pasta), Arancini and house salad. Nice rotating beer list as well. Be sure to take a look at the small paper menu with the daily specials, always some interesting selections not on the main menu. I've done takeout a few times as well and the food is just as good/ 

This particular Nomad location has delivered a consistently goods experience over the four years I've been going. I personally think this location is significantly better than the nearby Locust St. location. 

Highly recommended

BK
name: Billy

text: I had lunch yesterday with my two sisters and had a wonderful experience which started with our waiter named Michael. He was extremely polite and friendly and knew the exact times to come and check on us and refill our water.  We shared the chopped salad and the hot Italian pizza which was perfect for the three of us because of the large portions.  The salad was extremely fresh and the Pizza had just enough hot peppers and meat to satisfy us.  To my surprise and also my embarrassment Michael took it upon himself to bring out a delicious cannoli with a birthday candle and two other waiters to sing to me after hearing my sister mention it was my birthday. In my eyes nothing can make a really good restaurant great than to have a wait staff who is friendly and caring and efficient and that's why I will be returning to La Scala's in the very near future.

text: We stumbled into this little hole in the wall after we had dinner and it was damn good! Five different kinds of dessert pies and a number of other foods too. The pies are personal sized for $5 each. We had the cherry cordial pie and then hung out on the back patio area. It had a great ambiance with pretty eclectic design and various board games around for people to play. The lady working the counter was really friendly and gave us some tips for various places in the area to check out that weren't on the normal tourist radar.

text: Stopped in for a Saturday lunch.  Cute place.  Has a speakeasy motif out front and they have a small theater in the back.  Sat at the bar along with a few others.  Gave us menus which were falling apart.  Not a lot to choose from .  Typical bar menu.  Burgers dogs and salads.  Wife had a fried chicken salad and I had a dog with fries.  Both were okay.  Not great but not bad.  Dog was a little dry despite the chili and wife's salad lettuce was kind of wilted.  Service was rather slow.  Bartender seemed to be more interested in talking to the couple at the other end of the bar.  Lots of places in Safety Harbor.
name: Al

text:
I've eaten here several times and each time find it rather bland. I don't believe they take the time to cook and savor flavors and ingredients. I ordered a large wonton soup and it was extremely small and tasted like really watered down onion soup. I also ordered rice and it was greasy and the veggies hardly cooked. 

I spent over $20 and was still hungry afterwards. Portions are small.

text: Just don't to this place. Staff is unfriendly and service is terrible. Would never come here again.
name: Charles

text: Get the Peking duck for two!!  If you want delicious and inexpensive take out you can get a Peking duck to go for $10.  The wonton soup is amazing. A rich chicken broth loaded with fresh vegetables and delicious wontons. The fried rice is hands down the best fried rice I've ever eaten. And on top of all this the staff is friendly and attentive!!!  You can't go wrong if you want the Chinatown experience of great food.  They prove that Chinese food can be great and is nothing like the dreadful Americanized Chinese food at malls or that serve buffets.
name: Dejohn

text: Playing the Starbucks stars game today. Need to keep my gold card status for the little one in our life. The service today was excellent. When I went up to the counter to get a free refill I was asked how I liked the Pineapple Black Tea and I said I didn't. They happily switched my refill to strawberry green tea. Much better.
name: Kathy

text:
I often pass Big Apple Baglels and decided to stop in. Entering the plaza is easy but exiting is not as convenient. I ordered the southern breakfast bagel with sausage and it was pretty good. The prep time in making the sandwich was rather fast considering it was a decent crowd present. Upon entering, I was unsure where to place my order- the register or the food prep counter?! I had to ask after a few seconds of trying to figure it out. (You order at the food counter) The service was very mediocre. I told the person taking my order this was my first time and she just looked at me. It would have been nice for her to explain the menu, go over their most popular items, or simply said, "Thanks for visiting us today."... anything besides giving me a stare. The young lady that gave me my food just called my name and handed me the bag so I feel that exchange could have been more welcoming or thanked me for my order or a "Have a nice day."... something a bit more pleasurable and less awkward. 
All in all, I probably would visit again as I enjoy supporting local small businesses and my bagel sandwich was good.
name: Priscilla

text: The staff shouting and swearing.  Talking about how lazy the other workers are (as I sit here for ten minutes for a combo).  Absolutely least professional staff I have ever encountered.  There isn't even any music playing to cover the profanity.  After 15 minutes waiting, I asked for a refund.  The assistant manager Alexi should be embarrassed- and fired

text: Finally made it here for their Stuffed Baked Potato Sunday special.  Whoa is it good!  I'm not a huge brisket fan, but my hubby is and I may have to change my stance now.  This thing was loaded high with the most amazing brisket, bacon, and cheddar cheese.  I ordered two to go (because, you know IT IS a take-out place) and the boxes were so heavy and the smell was amazing.  I received the olives, jalapenos, sour cream and sauces on the side (because kids...) and with 5 people eating we had plenty with a bit leftover.  Loved the different sauces and the brisket was very tasty.  The place is small and they do have a few counters to sit at if you absolutely cannot wait to eat and I don't blame you if that is the case.  From walking in the atmosphere felt like I was at a friend's house with the wonderful tantalizing aromas of BBQ, and the friendliest people.  It was my first time, but I will be back and can't wait to try more of their specials.  Quality and quantity was on point for the price and well worth it.  So... get your rear down there and try it!
name: Courtney

text:
City Restaurant is everything you want when you think of your classic neighborhood diner - the kind of place you want to be a regular at. The waitresses knew a lot of the regulars and they're order, and we're extremely polite and friendly to us first timers - we felt right at home. The menu has all your diner favorites at low prices, and the food's very good!

We had a breakfast plate with two eggs, turkey bacon and potatoes; a greek omelette; and banana pancakes. The eggs were cooked correctly, the turkey bacon was crispy, and the potatoes had a nice crunchy layer on the top. The greek omelette was huge and filled with feta cheese, spinach, olives, + tomatoes. The pancakes were nice and fluffy, topped with a sliced banana - perfected with a maple drizzle.

A great neighborhood spot without the frills!
name: Rory

text:
This place is pretty consistent. I think consistency is key. I was out the other night though, and stopped in with my wife. 

We put our name in and asked the server about how long the wait was for two she said she did not know and they did not give out wait times. She said we could go to the bar and have a drink if we wanted.

 We weren't interested in hanging at the bar so my wife and I went a few doors down to a coffee shop. We came back in less than 10 minutes to check and they said since we weren't there they had to give a table that came up away. 

This policy of not giving a time is frustrating. Every place we go they give you a time. I guess they're trying to drum up bar business. Isn't it the hostesses job to gauge the restaurant and figure out how long tables are going to be available?
And to make matters worse while waiting again for the table I checked in to make sure she knew we were on a bench outside. I asked how long it was going to be and she became rather dismissive. 

Seems counterproductive to make your customers walk away without giving them an estimate of a table wait.Given the very many Gastropub places available in the area. There's town tap down the street there's places in Ardmore Teresa's in Wayne and the goats beard among many other options. I hope this policy of not giving a time goes away it will definitely make me hesitate to go back to brick and brew.
name: Matt

text: Just finished dinner with my husband and service was terrible. We've eaten here plenty of times before and never had a problem until tonight. I'm not sure if our server, Britney, was new or what but everything took forever to be brought to us. Never received refills and getting breadsticks was a joke even though she was visibly standing by doing nothing. Not sure I'll return. We'll have to go out of our way to go to the on on US 19 I guess.

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nice little spot, decent portions too. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.

text: The staff is stellar and friendly.  Matches well with amazing home made soup and wing sauce that rules!!! Garlic parm wing sauce is second to none.
name: Larry

text:
I really wanted to give this place a better rating, but I just can't. I do want to come back because I want to give it another chance...

So, we used to live right across from this strip back when Gondolier Pizza occupied this space...we had it once and never came back because it just wasn't good. I was driving by and noticed it was now a Taco spot...but not really. I thought it was a little taco place, but when we came in there was a full dining room to the right and a full Mexican menu. Okay, so the name is a bit confusing...especially in Tampa where you find taquerias east of Westchase...should've known we weren't getting anything that cool. I'm okay with another Mexican restaurant as long as the food is better than the ones around here. 

I was impressed with the cleanliness...but they just opened. I was also impressed with the music that was playing. I was very impressed by the hot chips and salsa. Very good chips and salsa that kept coming...the service was friendly and fast...the the good impressions stopped when our entrees came out.

I got the Enchilada Suizas. It wasn't suizas at all. Yes it had tomatillo sauce, but it wasn't creamy. There was no cheese...at all. I have never had an enchilada without cheese. The chicken was dry and unflavorful. This was basically a chicken enchilada with no cheese, topped with tomatillo (verde) sauce, shredded lettuce and a dollop of sour cream. A suiza is supposed to be a bit saucier and creamier...with cheese. 

HubbyStanks got the juevos racheros. I was so excited that he got a combination plate because I love trying refried beans. I had a bit on my fork and it was way too salty. I then had some of his eggs and the red sauce on top was too salty as well. This is not good for the blood pressure. How did he have a plate with too much salt and my chicken had barely any flavor?

My daughter got the flautas with beef and although I didn't try it, the meat inside looked extremely dry. My son had a chicken burrito. It was huge. I tried a bit and it was okay. 

I will say that in addition to the great chips and salsa my Agua de Jamaica (Hibiscus) was good. It was just right. Not too sweet and not too tart. I also like that they have a good variety on the menu. 

Again, I do want to come back and give them a chance with tacos, carne asada dishes, tamales and chile relleno. Papi and I kind of argued on why I shouldn't give them another chance...especially because it's a more expensive Mexican Restaurant, but doesn't live up to the flavors of the Mexican restaurants you can get a better bang for you buck at...but I think I will give it a chance on a small to-go meal to see if things change for the better in a month or so.
name: Melony

text: Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. Worth checking out. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was good and came out fast. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: One of the best authentic Taiwanese food I ever have in United States! Came from a big city who have a large Asian population, I still cannot believe that I cannot not find any of them to compare with this one. The restaurant itself is not big, but crowded. Waiters are super nice and friendly. And of course, food is delicious! Totally recommend.
name: John

text:
Tasty, quality food, & great deals!

I tried their borscht the other night and was pleased with it. The spices were interesting... different than my own recipe in that I tasted more cinnamon or nutmeg than the usual dill. Still very good though, and it comes with a nice little garlic roll. Only $6 a bowl!

Also tried the fries and there were so many, I shared with the rest of the table. Good crisp "real" fries, as my friend put it. Again, only $2.50!

My friends got sandwiches and pierogis, and I was heavily envying the latter. Please, Green Room... if you read this... add a vegan pierogi to the menu. Cheese messes me up, but damn, I love them.
