Hoping prez comes to do a review cause he'd def rank it 9.9/10. (He don't ever do 10 after the Lil Caesar's incident). Recommend the Upside Down pie. Way to go Angelo please no more fires!
name: Lauren

text: Food has always been on time and the restaurant cleanliness is "almost" always on top. Front desk greeter should be always professionally mannered which isn't always the case. It gives off a bad impression when the desk greeter isn't put well together. On top of that for several months a curtain has been hanging loose like it's broken off next to the greeters desk. Now if this is a prestige restaurant how hard is it to replace the curtain to make the front entrance look decent??!
name: Inessa

text: My family and I have started ordering scones from Dish Cafe ever since the coffee shop by our house stopped carrying their scones. Their scones are delicious! They have 6 traditional flavors that they usually make. In the photo there are cranberry white chocolate, coconut, lavender vanilla, and lemon blueberry. All of them are equally delectable! Dish Cafe's service is excellent, and they really value their customers. It shows in the way you are treated and the quality of their food. I have not been inside their restaurant for their dining options but I definitely plan on it.
name: Krista

text: This place is helping to fill the void for fast yet nutritious food options. Yes they are great for those with food allergies, but it's also just plain old DELICIOUS! I don't even like kale as a general rule, but I enjoyed every bite that was in my bowl! In my dream world Real Food Eatery would own up locations along the turnpike so that I'd never have to eat a gas station sandwich again.
name: Jessica

text: Food is good but way overpriced. The sushi is what you would expect but there are not enough hot food items for it to be a "fusion" restaurant. Just a sushi bar really.
name: Mark

text: Reading some of these complaints now feels a little overblown. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: had this food from here and it was amazing,especially the chicken pad thai ,general Tso chicken and the grilled pork chops order it had great flavors  really really recommend it a little on high price but worth it.
name: Mario

text: Great food and great service! I have been to all three locations and they are all very good, but really loving the new Clayton location. You can't go wrong - it's all good. A few favorites...wild mushroom soup, pretzel rolls, apple gorgonzola salad, maple bourbon pork pizza and pretty much any desert. Also, the blood orange wheat beer is very good.
name: Derek

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Food was fresh and service was quick. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Ordered a few things and liked most of it.
name: User

text:
The ramen is decent but this place is seriously overpriced for this type of very casual establishment. Amazing ramen at this type of restaurant is seriously like $7 in LA so it's hard for me to fork over $15 for a bowl of soup. I think the tonkotsu is better at Two Ten Jack and it's the same price there, but with better ambiance and service. They won't let you have regular wavy noodles in the tonkotsu for some reason...they "don't do that anymore" I guess...? K.

I got chicken broth ramen here once and it had less flavor than Campbell's chicken noodle soup, I shit you not. It tasted like water. I should have sent it back but I was starving. 

Basically, if someone brings you here your food won't be bad but you'll be broke and still hungry and probably kind of mad when you leave.
name: J

text: One of our favorite places in Media! High quality authentic Mexican food. I usually order the chicken enchiladas. The enchilada sauce is amazing and the portions are just right. It's BYOB and you can get a pitcher of margarita mix for $10. They have daily specials which I highly recommend, they are always very good. The servers are always friendly and the service is great and fast. The prices are a little overpriced but worth it if you are looking for a quality Mexican meal.
name: Alexis

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
I had high expectations when I saw the menu on line.  I visited during the bay areas taco week which was great fun.  I was surprised when I walked up as the whole strip center looked trashy and unkept, a total surprise as this was Davis Island and I expected something a little more upscale.  The place was drab and empty although the one server was very nice.

I ordered three kinds of tacos, being the venturous person that I am, I went for fish, shrimp and scallop tacos.  They came out very quickly which I took as suspect since you would hope that you cook would take the time and effort to present you with a dish made with pride or care.

The scallop and shrimp tacos were terrible, they did not belong in a taco and would have been better off over some rice pilaf.  A great disappointment.  The fish taco had a very nice piece of fried fish which by itself was tasty.  Unfortunately these folks do not know how to dress a fish taco properly and it too disappointed.  As i write this maybe I should have given them a one.
name: Robert

text:
I still love this place. One year later, they've still managed to satisfy my cravings for good food!  What - fried chicken and donut! To go!  

That Jawn (meal) was super Dope! Don't judge me until you try it . Savory and sweet? YUP! Please include flatware with take out- there are many hotels nearby.
name: Evelyn

text: Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. Food was fresh and service was quick. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Worth checking out. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish.
name: User

text:
We heard nothing but good things about Deanies while visiting NOLA. We finally made it over and order the sampler and broiled oysters, both of which were amazing. The restaurant was clean and the greeter was very sweet. 

But our waitress Kelly was horrible. She was never anywhere to be found when we needed something and she was rude when we order the 1/2 order sampler for our family. She said it was only intended for two people. In the end, we still had food left over which went to waste because we had a flight to catch. To top it all off she added gratuity to our check so I was forced to tip here. Pretty much robbery!

Food was a 10 but ask for a manager if your service isn't up to snuff, I wish I had the time and patience to have talked with them because that isn't right.
name: Adam

text:
If you're in the mood for Mexican this is a great little place to go for dinner, drinks or both! If you're a cheese lover order the queso fundito, it was so delicious and perfect for sharing! The tacos are also very authentic and fun to trade if you like to food swap. There are lots of vegetarian options as well if you're not a meat-eater. Unfortunately I got there after happy hour but they have different deals during the week!
This restaurant has its own unique style as well as a giant wall projector for movies or the big game. I believe you can rent out the lower level of the restaurant for private events as well.
name: Janet

text: Excellent seafood in an upscale setting. It feels like you walked off Rittenhouse Square & into a hip restaurant that could just as easily be in Santa Barbara - with its Spanish decor & candle lit ambiance. Overall, The Love is a really great spot. Call ahead to get a reservation as it gets crowded after ~6:30pm.
name: Sam

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The staff seemed tired but still polite. I had a better visit than I expected to. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. It looked better online than it did in person. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.
name: User

text:
Very reminiscent of a minimalist Parisan cafe. Very clean, black and white decor. Waitstaff was extremely helpful and friendly. 
The quality of the ingredients in our food was outstanding. Good portion sizes considering the quality. I ordered the chicken pita salad with curry, it was slightlly too vinegar-y for me but aside from that, it was layered with flavor and the kabob was extremely tender. 
My friend got an egg bowl with roasted tomato and avocado...I had food envy. 
Would come back if I am ever in the area again!
name: Malea

text: This place hits the spot every time I'm out in St Pete. Arrived here after a night with friends and the shrimp burrito was excellent and filling. The bartenders were attentive and are drinks were very well made. The setup and design of this place is very well done. If you prefer to eat outside, there is an outside patio bar and seating area. Inside is comfortable as well and the wait was not long at all. We will make it out here again for sure!
name: Darnell

text: Good vegan food, a little pricey and the garlic Mac and cheese had a funky flavor. And I LOVE garlic. But recommended to any vegan/vegetarians
name: John

text:
Went back yesterday after our regular poker session at Harrah's and received wonderful service from the same server as before. In fact, she remembered us and APOLOGIZED for not delivering great service as she was stretched thin as a result of working half the bar plus the main dining area's drinks.

I can certainly give credit where it's due and her apology was well received. We even had a chat about work!

I enjoyed a delicious flat iron steak cooked to medium perfection. This dish comes with onion rings - the last time I had the thin shoestring onion rings and this time I had the thick cut ones. Both are delicious and I kinda like to be surprised! My +1 had a burger - it's actually his burger craving that got me back into Manning's but I'm so glad I did.

Glad to have my previous experience rectified and can't wait to come back after our next Harrah's session!
name: Simi

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Food was good and came out fast. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: Local bar with very high quality food, burgers are amazing. It's super loud inside, hard to carry on conversations, they should consider some noise abatement. Decor is pretty basic, they have an outdoor space but it was too hot when we went.
name: Justin

text: What a great little breakfast spot! Friendly employees and a rather full and inventive menu (lemon cream pancakes) makes this a great stop for a casual breakfast. Will be coming back for sure!
name: Mark

text:
1  rack of ribs 
Burnt end platter
Pork platter
All comes with sides

Mac and cheese
Potato salad
Banana pudding
Brunswick stew
Collard green

(One is the dish with Grits casserole)
name: Susan

text: Great food and service for a great price! Totally recommend the gumbo, crawfish etouffee and chicken Alfredo. Drinks are also flavorful and strong! Definitely one of my go to restaurants whenever I visit New Orleans!
name: Courtney

text: I've always liked this Red Robin. The food is always good and the burgers ate fresh and tasty. Although you get all the fries you can eat the burgers generally fill you up. Although, maybe it was the onion tower that was the cause!  The only problem you have here is that there is usually a wait. But there is plenty of seating inside and out and the wait isn't long.
name: Dwight

text:
I love the original Thai Phooket and decided to give this one a try since it was much closer to me when the woman and I got hungry.

We both ordered:

Egg Rolls: They were perfectly fried and tasted fresh. Loved them! 

Dumplings: I love the shrimp dumpling here. They are so fresh. I really wish my gf would not have liked them so that I could eat all 4!!

Chicken Pad Thai with a medium spice level. Their medium is nowhere near my medium, it was much more like my HOT. The flavor of the sauce was perfect, the portion was huge and I enjoyed it as much as the original Thai Phooket location. I just know to skip the spice next time so that I can really enjoy it.

They were very attentive. Asking if wee needed anything and checking in often.

If you are in the mood for some really good Thai food, make sure to give this spot a try!
name: Vince

text: I enjoy dining out, but when the silverware is filthy, I wonder what other problems this restaurant may have. I asked about the ICD warning regarding lettuce, and the waitress's response was "oh we get good lettuce." The food was average, the waitress was indifferent to the dirty silverware, the table was filthy and the fact that she didn't bring the appropriate change determined I won't return. Where is the management in all this?
name: Leslie

text:
I used to go here years ago when it was called Haru! I'm back today for dinner with friends and it's still as delicious. 

The staff is always kind and the food comes quick. Generally a low price point for sushi and sit down meals. It always has multiple parties in and they also do take-out. 

Definitely the best sushi in Turnersville and there's plenty of vegan and vegetarian options. They also serve the Japanese sodas too!
name: Justine

text: Arguably one of the best places in St Pete to grab a some food and  drinks. I really enjoy their Sunday brunch the most-if your there for that make sure to get one of the brunch cocktails! Happy they have a happy hour now. They have an interesting menu with a variety of tasty options. One of my only issues has nothing to do with the food. I will say that the live entertainment they occasionally have can be a little bit loud and hard to chat with the people you came with.  Otherwise a great choice!
name: Natalie

text: I've gone here one other time previously, so I decided to give Mr. Chris another go. Not only did he provide me with attentive customer service once again, I must note that the new young lady Dorothy among others ensured that my bottomless mimosa stayed  full and my oysters stayed in abundance. This restaurant is truly a gem off the beaten path.
name: Katelynn

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: For a busy night they handled it okay. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Definitely coming back. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: I had the large Cuban and it was great and I had the Cole slaw and rice and beans definitely be back again
name: Edward

text: My husband and I decided to try the new bbq restaurant. I ordered a pork steak, which was tough, overcooked and way too spicy. The green beans were undercooked. The potatoes were ok but cold. I can grill a better pork steak at home. We spent $38.00 for 2 meals. What a let down.
name: Rhonda

text:
Pros: Food was amazing, service was great, waiter was knowledgeable, place was clean, food was prompt, decor was authentic especially the lights.

Cons: Entrance is through the kitchen essentially, place is cramped very tight. Not the best impression as you're walking through. Not easy to find the place, finding parking is atrocious.

Went here for my birthday last month, brought my 5 year old and my friend. I was slightly claustrophobic at the table we were sitting at, but overall the food and the lights and service just overpowered the cons. 4.5 out of 5 stars. They would really excel in more of a center city location, but I would definitely go here again.
name: Ling

text: the fries were prob the best part of the meal, honestly. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Disappointed... 1st off you walk in the air smells and feels heavily greased. Hubs got a coffee that was super weak and a French dip. There was very little meat on it. Average. I got the meatloaf sandwich. It was just ok. I wanted the meatloaf plate but they don't offer it until 4 so I got the sandwich and asked if I could have green beans instead of fries... nope. For an extra dollar you can... green beans were swimming in grease. Won't be back.
name: Charmae

text: The South Indian at Amma's is super authentic. And the dishes are consistently good. We tried Mysore Masala Dosa, Chettinad Masala Dosa, Mutton Kuttu parotta, medu wada and non veg thali. Each of the items was consistently authentic, fresh and of very good quality. The Mysore Masala Dosa though was a bit too spicy for us. Would definitely love to go back. Parking is an issue as the place is in Philly downtown and is a medium sized establishment that tends to get packed super quick.
name: Pallavi

text: Food was fresh and service was quick. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Will be back. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly.
name: User

text: This is our 5th time trying Indian Twist. I have so say they are so consistent. We love the chicken tikka masala. we get it every time that we have gone and we always try a new dish. We have tried all of the chicken dishes except the butter chicken and they are all fantastic. they allow you to choose your spice level mild medium or spicy and we have done spicy each time and it has a nice kick to it. The restaurant is nicely decorated and there are two or three TVs playing in the game or Bollywood videos. today, we went in 10 minutes before 2:30 and we did not realize the restaurant closes for an hour between 2:30 and 3:30 to set up for dinner and owner still a lot of stuff have early dinner after his waiter let us know that they were closing soon. We really love that they were willing to do that. Overall, the service is great and the food is great and has a nice flavor profile. We definitely will be back!
name: Drew

text: Do not get their Togo beer. I frequent Ron's a lot. I got a 6 pack of craft beer from them this time around. I made a variety pack of funk and different breweries. But when I got home to drink them something was off. I opened the first can. Beer was nasty poured it down the drain. Then second can same thing. So I take a look at the beer, it's all from December of 2018. It's so stale and gross and has so much yeast sediment. The beer completely lost its profile. At 6 dollars a can on some of the craft takeout this should never happen and the beer should be checked. The earliest one is from February of this year. How can all 6 be so out of date. How can it be this out of date? I attached some of the cans. Other two I threw out before I knew what was going on.
name: Mike

text:
So in all honesty the food was good if not better, however the management and the way they handled an issue I had stunk.  First off, while waiting for our table a staff person offered us a sample of what he called the Chopped Salad.  It was VERY tasty.  Fast forward to sitting at our table.  The four of us (Two Couples) are ready to order and when my wife orders the Pork Porterhouse, which comes with a Side of Signature Mash Potatoes and "Signature" Salad.  I put the word Signature in quotes because although listed in the description of the Porterhouse meal, NO WHERE on the menu is there a "Signature Salad"  Just a House Salad or a Caesar Salad.  I point this out because there is a listed (besides in the meal description) "Signature Mash Potato".  When we asked for the "Chopped Salad" we were told it was an additional $1.00 because it was a "Premium" Salad (which is listed in the menu).  Personally I don't care about $1.00.  However, when I asked for an explanation, our server couldn't answer me.  She said she would send Manager over to explain.  He came, and the first words out of his mouth were and I quote "We used Quality ingredients in our Premium Salads" to which I asked, what are you using for your house salads.  He had no answer.  Had I been the manager I would have waived the $1.00 fee just for that reason.  He did not.  He kind of just walked away.  Not Outback's finest hour.  Two other things, 1) We liked the chopped salad and we all ordered it despite the "Up" Charge.  2) I wrote to Outback and absolutely no one responded.  Go figure.
Lou Tardona, Jr.
name: Lou

text: It's always busy here on the weekends but it's worth it. Down stair is non hip hop, upstairs is the dance floor  I've seen so many funny shhit here bring your camera you'll be cracking up at the crowd coming in haha. Bartenders and servers here are fast and friendly. Love this place
name: amber

text: We biked here for lunch. We were very sweaty and excited for a meal. My wife's friend told us to come here and get the onion rings. When we arrived we were sorely disappointed. It was dark inside, smelled funky, and the service was despicable. We waited 45 minutes for mere burgers, and there were only 10 other people there. Multiple parties who arrived after us were served before us. The onion rings turned out to be pretty good. We were overall disappointed as my wife's friend said it was wonderful. We will not be returning
name: Emily

text: The drive thru was pretty quick. We asked for our ice cream to be served upside down. When we got to the window, they handed us a bag with the blizzard inside. When we took out the blizzard, ice cream was all over it.
name: Maile

text: After an amazing birthday week , my fabulous stupendous , smart , loving and mainly handsome man took me here to end my bday week with a bang . ( he may or may not have a yelp account lol ). I've been looking forward to coming here for a long time so we of course  showed up 20 minutes early as I couldn't contain my excitement any longer . We were welcomed to go up to the lounge while we waited to be seated . After 15 minutes at the lounge ,no one asked us if we wanted a drink ,so we left that area to wait to be seated again. Fast forward to getting our food . They forgot my mans vegetable tempura which wasn't a huge deal because our waiter was no less than amazing and attentive . Place was busy . I ordered the chef special sushi and the beef carpaccio . I enjoyed it very much and it made for some fun and trendy Instagram pics . Now the food in my opinion was good at most . It wasn't great or anything out of the ordinary . I've been to hole in the wall sushi places that were far more delicious . I believe this is a great place for the foodie looking to try out a fun spot as it was very happening + trendy .  Also great for groups . I however don't think it's the place to go if you're  mainly looking for delicious food. There is absolutely nothing extraordinary about their food .Maybe first time wasn't a charm in our case but we need to try it again to get that 5 star feel ? Regardless we did end the night with a bang  thanks to their delicious cock tails . Thank you Morimoto !
name: Rita

text: Every review of this place I read said upscale dining. There is nothing elegant or upscale about the ambience, the staff or the environment in this restaurant. The staff are dressed in jeans with plaid shirts and it looks like they work at the farmers market or behind the counter at the butcher shop. The tables do not have tablecloth and are wood tables with vinyl chairs that you can get from the discount furniture store. The people that eat in this place are typically in T-shirt and shorts or jeans and open toe shoes. It is not by any measure of the word elegant. The food was however very good and the service excellent. The food is simple and delicious and creative. If you want simple delicious food with a southern flavor, this is the place for you. But it is not elegant as is stated in description. It is very casual. Come in jeans and T shirts and enjoy.
name: Dr.

text:
Juan's is a cool spot with unique dishes, but average service. I've been coming here on and off for over five years now, and the one thing I can say about this place is that it offers a nice fushion of Mexican, Carribean, and New Orleans flavors. The dishes range from simple and recognizable to complex without giving off the impression that the chefs are "trying too hard" to come up with the newest, coolest food idea.

Sometimes the quality here is a little inconsistent. For example, sometimes my husband gets a burrito, and it seems to be smaller or larger than usual. Also, the service is ok. Although, one time I went in and the kitchen staff was goofing off. I usually don't mind a little goofing off, but they were being loud, repetitive, and borderline obnoxious. 

In any case, come here for the novelty. Skip it for peace and quiet.
name: Jessica

text: I'm giving this one four stars in hopes that next time  I visit, I'll have much better service. We were there on a Sunday morning with only a few other tables and plenty of staff. Our food, coffee, and check all took forever. On a positive note, the white bean hash on the brunch menu is awesome as is the coffee. My biggest food complaint is that the avocado toast is served on Texas toast. While it was good, it was greasy, and I definitely prefer a healthier bread option. Overall the menu and prices are good, and it's a great location. I'll give it another try sometime soon!
name: Valerie

text: Sa Ri One is a place I can count on to be better than the last visit every time. My girlfriend and I will go for any occasion from a random lunch date to a birthday dinner. The food is absolutely amazing. We usually get BBQ and cold noodle soup. If we're able to save enough room for dessert, the fried ice cream is literally a party in your mouth. The kimchi fried dumplings actually changed my life. If you're looking for something new to try, this is a great place to go to explore. It's also a great place to go with a lager group because they have huge booths and the BBQ is perfect to share with everyone. I've also seen a lot of couples go and grab a lunchbox for a smaller meal. Something for everyone!
name: Hayley

text: Can I give this place 6 stars? Our server Keira was awesome. Had the Brussel Sprouts and Cider Mussels which made it 5 stars alone. The Pizza was phenomenal. Even with drinks are bill was around $60. Will definitely come back again!
name: John

text: Large biscuits covered in the right amount of gravy and seasoned well, I chose a side of sweet potato and fresh coffee
name: Ranay

text: Went to Mungo's Saturday night and was extremely happy with the excellent food and service. We were there after opening time and it was crowded, but that didn't affect  the service or quality of the food we had. Great job Mungo's and Good luck on the new location!
name: Debbie

text: Love the vibe, it was four of us and we all just ordered food from different spots to try some of everything. Rae beans were decent for shrimp and grits were pretty good, Vietnamese poboy was ok. But the biggest disappointment was the chargrilled oysters. They had a decent size but liked a lot of flavor.
name: Jason

text: Absolutely clueless as why this place has such great reviews. Unbelievably overpriced (which is fine if the food is good), the food is consistently bland and completely unrememberable . We've been several times bc of the reputation and tried many things. Food delivered luke warm and mostly cold. Flavors are non existent to poor. Easily the last place for Spanish food I would choose, as there are hundreds of others in Tampa. The 1905 salad is good and the cocktails are good as well.
name: Rob

text: I almost skipped this place because of the ratings and that would've been unfair. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. It was crowded but still moved along. Not saying it's the best place ever, but it was totally fine. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would probably stop in again if nearby. Not bad for a quick meal. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Not sure though.
name: User

text: This place is in Tampa, and honestly, I'm finding reasons to go back! A little bit expensive, but it was worth it. The tropical drinks were delicious, the staff was all helpful and smiling, and I personally recommend the buttermilk fried shrimp with the sriracha sauce. Perfect! I'm uploading the pictures from my table and the front of the restaurant. Definitely a little slice of the tropics. For aficionados, the have a decent cigar selection, as well.
name: Jessi

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
What a little gem this place is!  Seven of us dined there tonight before the Eagles concert. They are one block from the Belgravia/McKernan lrt. 
Three specials tonight -chicken & waffles, a seafood pasta and a burger with bacon and spicy cheese. 
Four of my companions had been there before and recommended everything!  Curry pot pie, meat loaf, burgers, salads. 
There was a single server managing the whole place until a 2nd person arrived after 6 pm. The fellow managed to handle a pretty full house on his own though. Good for him!
Three of us had the chicken& waffles with a corn relish on top. The acid of the relish really meshed with the chicken which has a slightly sweet sauce. Two large waffles were also on the plate - fluffy and flavourful!! I couldn't eat my 2 nd waffle but one of my companions enjoyed it. We also had the scallop and shrimp pasta, meatloaf and mash and the apricot chicken salad at our table. The portions are generous. My friends said the seafood was done perfectly and served in a white wine sauce. The meatloaf dinner was hearty and well seasoned. The apricot salad with chicken was defect for a warm evening.  Loved it all. Can't wait to go back!
While they don't have any outdoor seating their entire front windows open and it's like eating on a patio anyway.
Nice touch was the water glasses with a cucumber slice!!! It felt so summery!  Small but diverse beverage list  -something for everyone.  Do try this spot but better make a reservation!!
  Next time I go I am eating of the Starter menu. I want the corn fritters as a start and then the fried ravioli. Unless they have something yummy on special again....... Go there!
name: Audrey

text: I think it's hilarious that anybody would give this place less than 4 stars. We have gone here many many times over the past year-and-a-half and it is always been absolutely delicious with pleasant service and a wonderful atmosphere. I would recommend this place to anybody who enjoys candlelit dinner and absolutely deliciously made crab cakes. In fact these are literally the best crabcakes I've ever eaten in my entire life and it's what we get virtually every time we go.
name: Jim

text: I loved the food, the coffee, the atmosphere, everything. I ordered the breakfast combo which was lost bread, some kind of sweet rice balls i forget the name of, & a yogurt parfait. The lost bread is D E L I C I O U S!! The rice ball things were not my favorite, but good nonetheless! My cold brew coffee was also great. I would return again just for the Lost Bread!! It sounds like it would be similar to french toast, but it's really not. It's a very thin piece of bread deep fried with powdered sugar on top, so it's nice & crispy & hot & sweet & ugh just so good. I highly recommend it!
name: Jessica

text: Very tasty - no doubt! But the portions are quite small, especially for the price. I'm a skinny gal that doesn't eat a ton - and I was still hungry after eating the green curry dish.
name: Andrea

text:
Really disappointed in our food experience here. The atmosphere and space were intimate (almost romantic) and we have been looking forward to trying this out for some time. 

We started with the fried burrata - literally FRIED CHEESE - how could we go wrong? It wasn't bad, just lackluster. The burrata itself is a generous ball but the sauce it sits on, which the cheese kinda needs to sing, was barely there - felt like a smear for color but the plate needs more. Also, the decorative greens on the plate looked wilted and we were offered two small pieces of bread for what was a mini football of cheese. 

I also ordered the house salad and was excited for the fresh greens/veggies, and goat cheese, along with the white balsamic dressing - we read that the restaurant is a scratch kitchen and so they make all their sauces and dressings (I love a good balsamic from scratch). The salad itself was fresh (I was worried when I saw the greens on the burrata plate) and they were generous with the goat cheese but the dressing had such a sharp bite to it that I couldn't eat it -- initially, I thought I had gotten a heavy dose or a bite with a lot of pepper or something but I found my jaws tightening with the tang and coughing after every bite. Interestingly, the salad didn't seem overly dressed, it just seemed like someone stubbed their toe on....something...when mixing the dressing. I returned it, nearly untouched and the server (we sat at the bar) didn't even inquire about whether it was satisfactory or not (service was otherwise very good).

We also had the Brussels spouts with bacon - pretty good, just needed a touch of salt, and the crab cakes which my hubby thought were decent but noted that the pork belly (which I thought to be an odd paring with crab cakes) was "superfluous" and didn't have a ton of flavor. 

If there is one thing I thought I would NEVER hear my husband declare, it's that pork belly is superfluous. 

The main star was the cup of gumbo - a special of the day - that my husband had and loved; very filling and satisfying, especially on a cold evening.  In hindsight, he wished he had ordered a bowl of that.

For what we had, mainly "meh" food with a bill that surprised me ($100 with tip), we won't be back.
name: Jessica

text: Great place, had the seafood gumbo and the jumbalaya. But the best part was the service we got from James C, extremely helpful, polite and even gave us recommendations for the rest of the night! Will come back for poboys, looked excellent. The ambiance was very layed back, casual. Right in the heart of burben St. Can't go wrong here. Prices also very good for the location and the food.
name: Danny

text: Medium rare turned out like beef jerky. The shrimp is cooked to rubber texture. It isn't horrible considering there's nothing else in Springfield, but if you want real hibachi, go to Nashville.
name: Gordon

text: Great food! Good ambiance. I would def come backs again. Absolutely loved Kelsey!  She recommended the fried chicken which was delicious.
name: Truth

text:
Every week at my school, I do a food ABCs with my kindergarten class. Last week was the letter D, and since it was the week before Christmas break I decided we could have a sweet treat instead of our usual healthy choices. I of course immediately thought of donuts and saw that bakers dozen was on the way to the school I work at.

I stopped in and was greeted with a strong whiff of sugary donut goodness. I ordered two dozen glazed, and they must have a special (one free donut per dozen) so they gave me two free additional donuts of my choice. Since they were for my students, I decided to stick with glazed and not go crazy (five year olds can be quite picky!).

When they gave me the boxes, they were steaming hot so I knew the donuts must've just been made which made my drive to work all the more difficult. Do you know how incredibly hard it is to sit in a car with two dozen freshly baked donuts next to you without taking a bite of one? I don't think my car has ever smelled that good ever. Ever. 

So once I brought the donuts to school and gave them to my students, there were enough left over to share with some teachers so I split one with my coworker and it honestly might have been one of the best glazed donuts I've had in my entire life. Like, if I could eat an entire box without gaining any weight I would eat the entire box within a matter seconds. That good. And obviously my students loved them as well!

So long story short, you should go here for some delicious piping hot glazed donuts!
name: Brianna

text: Just went through drive thru the young lady was very nice! The service efficient and the food was delicious! It's a great experience.
name: Melissa

text: They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. For a busy night they handled it okay. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Glad we tried it. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough..
name: User

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. So yeah, nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Honestly, pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Anyway, the wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. so yeah kind of mixed on it.
name: User

text:
Be prepared.... you will blissfully eat your fatty face full of an assortment of AMAZING burgers and yet still PARTAKE in a euphoric feeding frenzy of some of the best French Fries you'll have in Tampa bay...
If you finish a burger and large fry consider yourself an Olympian gold-medal eater...
The veggie burger is 5-star
name: Nick

text:
Disappointing dinner experience all around. We needed to go find our server on multiple occasions, like to get a check, then to pay the check, etc. We had to find our own utensils, even after asking for silverware the food came & we had none. 
We got a short rib flatbread which had good flavor even though portions had no toppings the bread was good. Roasted brussel sprouts which were awful, and I love sprouts every day. They has a huge amount of blue cheese on them which was overwhming, you couldn't taste anything else. Lastly, the MAC n cheese side, I had such hope for you but no taste at all. A bowl of elbow macaroni would've tasted the same.
name: Jen

text: I've been to hooters across the country and this one is EASILY the worst I've ever been to. Always waitresses sitting on their cell phone and not paying attention to anything. Ordered 20 wings an appetizer and 2 mixed drinks when there with a friend. The appetizer came before the drinks and when one of the drinks came out wrong we couldn't find the waitress anywhere. Finally went up to the bar where I was told I have to wait for the waitress. Food was delivered by another waitress who thankfully was able to correct my drink. Manager didn't come by once to see if everything was ok even when he knew we had a problem, I know this because we were given a discount. Honestly don't waste your time here. I've been coming here for the last 3-4 years when I come in for Colts games and it just continues to disappoint. Had one good experience out of 5. Definitely will not be back. Kilroy's it is next time
name: Mike

text: Love going to this place!  Crystal was an excellent, attentive server.  First time being seated and serve in a quick manner.  The was great to eat something other than turkey!  Can't wait to our next celebration at Benihana!
name: Kumbia

text: We ordered 2 pizzas, chicken wings and crazy bread today. But when we arrived to pick up the order, we were told that it wasn't there and had to reorder all over again. Very disappointed with the experience.
name: Michael

text: Below Average food, bad service! Waited 40 mins before the waiter acknowledge us,  not all the food came at the same time. Some of us were done eating while some were just receiving their food!
name: Jonas

text: This is the speakeasy of Poboy restaurants! This place is tucked away in the back of Erin's rose so don't miss it ! The Poboys are not your traditional take but have a interesting spin. If you like Asian influence get the seared shrimp ! This is a must try when you head to New Orleans .
name: Damien

text:
This new spot opened up last month looking like Starbucks and Caffe Lucce will have some competition from anyone willing to pay an extra $.50-1 for their order. It took over the old bike shop's space at St. Phillip's Plaza and turned it into an open, industrial-type setting. Not the warmest or coziest setting, but there's enough seating and a decent enough space to get some reading/studying done. Plus, you can always take your order to go and wander around the plaza. 

The staff is fairly friendly and the owner was there both times observing and crunching the numbers on her laptop at a table in the corner. First visit, I ordered a plain, hot Americano. The espresso is bold and smooth, and not bitter at all. I'm interested in trying the Fat Americano sometime, as well as some of the food options. 

The cold brew is decent. A little more on the bitter side but had a nice roasty aftertaste to it. 

While it's in the beginning stages, I think it has potential. 

A few small-ish improvements:

It would be nice to invest in commercial-free music as they tend to keep the volume up a bit louder and the ads are distracting. The Americano came in a truck stop diner-style mug, and while cupware isn't a dealbreaker, a hip coffeeshop might want to invest in something more modern. The menu is also very difficult to read. I don't know about the bold, futuristic, block lettering, but it seems like it would be difficult to read for anyone who has eyesight issues.
name: Alex

text: Me and my wife got the two person meat platter, my son got  the quesadilla with chicken,  and two drinks. The mojito had no alcohol, the lamb was not prepared right and we could taste and smell the wild game.  Overall we were not impressed.
name: Tony

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Anyway, the sauces helped more than i thought they would.. So yeah, my pasta was decent and not overcooked, which i appreciated because that happens a lot. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. not sure I'd order the same thing again. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text:
This Resturant was highly recommended and it did not disappoint. Valet parking available or you can park along the street and walk a bit. They do take reservations but we didn't make one and we got in quickly. Waiter was friendly and attentive. Order of chips and salsa free with an entree. Salsa and chips were both homemade. Medium has a nice kick to it. Guacamole was perfect!  I ordered a simple tostada salad with avacado and a cilantro dressing. I do have to say it was the best I've ever had. Nothing negative to say about this place. I highly recommend.
$$
name: Michelle

text:
Came here for a 6-course pre fixe. I was expecting too much, probably. Great service but I wasn't impressed for what we had to pay for the amount of food we got, even AFTER Groupon discount. I also was daunted that it was in a strip mall for such upscale restaurant in Clearwater. For this kind of price point and being in Clearwater, I expected a better view. The interior decor us nice, however, and very classy. 
Additionally, around course 3 to 4, there was an extremely long wait. Like all my food had digested from courses prior and I was ready to eat butter. 
And the food was decent, but nothing super impressive. The portions were very Tony, except for the chicken mail course, which I did not get. 
My friends who cane here in the past that they've had better menu in the past, so maybe we just didn't luck our with pre fixe de jour.
name: Jisoo

text: Not sure why this place has such split reviews, but my experience was mostly fine. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text:
Fresh! Kitchen! Yes! Please!

I've heard about and seen this place countless of times through Instagram for the aesthetics, but of course, I've only recently tried it for the first time. I was a bit startled by the options, because they all sounded delicious. The hesitation prompted me to ask the employees for their suggestions and whatever they ended up choosing for me was delicious that I ate the entire thing. That sounds normal until I tell you that three of my male friends couldn't finish it, because they were stuffed. Expect the higher prices because for some reason, healthy food is more expensive than junk food.

Definitely hoping for a state-wide expansion of restaurants, because I need FK in my life 24/7.
name: Kelly

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. It was crowded but still moved along. Dessert was weirdly the highlight, which I wasn't expecting at all. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: Great vibes, good food and tasty drinks ! The Mac and cheese fritters are amazing and not one bad drink on the menu. Ample parking in the rear, good location and a mixed crowd.
name: Joy

text: We had never tried East Park before, but decided to try them for our gender reveal party. We ordered 2 dozen donuts. The process of placing the order to receiving the order was pretty seamless and they offered several options to me along the way. The donuts not only tasted great, but were so cute! I'd definitely recommend.
name: Bekah

text:
A highlight of my trip to N.O. The wife and I had the butcher board which consists of just about everything on the appetizer menu including chicken liver pate head cheese pickled beets pickled cauliflower pickled zucchini there was also the best cracklins that I've had in a long time and some glazed BBQ pork that was lacquered or something to that effect also really good. 
I  had the couvillion. Shrimp and redfish in a seafood roux served with crab fat dirty rice. Wow. Killer. Crab fat rice was the most amazing thing that I've had most of my trip down here.
Our dessert was a TaTa Boullie. Chocolate silk pie with a hard as a rock Graham cracker crust. Our our waitress saw us struggling to cut through the crust and said I know you want to eat that but I just can't let you and she comped  it for us (took it off of the bill) 
Service was spot on and charming. Bullseye!
 Overall it was an amazing experience. Highly recommended.
name: Flamedrinker

text: Even though I feel the quality of food has gone down hill over the last year we continue to go however I am not sure if we will continue. Last night me and a friend went and were seated at a table and asked if we could sit at the booth right next to the table. We were left standing for what seemed like at least 3 mins for them to agree to seat us at the booth. The waitress seemed to have an issue with this and it showed in her service. When our food finally arrived I could not believe they let my plate out of the kitchen. I ordered the tour of Italy which was swimming in water and had sauce all over the edges of the plate. It looked as if they put my food on someone's used plate. I then asked to speak with a manager who quickly took my plate to have it replaced and said he would come back to listen to our concerns. He never came back and took off an appetizer which we were sharing so only took $6 off each of our bills. Mind you I had a meal and my friend had one and 3 to go. I was not happy with the $6 nor was I that the manager never even came back to the table. Not sure if I will be returning.
name: Patricia

text: Love, love, love this place!! But then again any place with a quality salad bar wins my heart pretty quickly.... They have an extensive salad bar, excellent deli with sandwiches, have a parking lot across the street (always a plus...), and the staff is pleasant in general. (I think) they also have an expresso bar, and may serve alcohol as well. Overall, an A+ for a deli!!
name: Jennifer

text: Great cheesesteak sandwich! We had the cheesesteak with American and and a mix of sweet and hot peppers. The bread was fresh and the amount of meat was generous. It's a busy at lunch, so call your order in so you don't have to wait 20 minutes. Three of us shared a large and it was plenty of food! There are a few tables outside, but this really isn't a place to sit and have lunch, it's more for takeout orders.
name: Jenny

text: Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Food was fresh and service was quick. For the price I expected more than this. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: I eat here almost every week. The brussel sprouts are addicting. Never had a bad meal or experience in this restaurant. Top notch service and quick food!
name: Morgan

text:
Blanco Tacos + Tequila is a part of the larger Fox Restaurant chains, which are known for their great service and good menu choices.

The atmosphere is very nice and has a trendy vibe. There is indoor and outdoor seating, and if the weather is nice, I highly recommend sitting outside because the view is fabulous! For a date or large group, the outdoor patio is very accommodating and comfortable. I've been to this location 3 times, and it's a pretty average tex-mex restaurant. Nothing really amazing but still good quality ingredients. It's not the place to go if you're looking for an authentic Mexican food experience, but if you're looking for a "fancier" version, this might be a place to consider.

Overall, I would recommend only coming here during happy hour. The prices, otherwise, aren't really worth the quality of food, in my opinion. Happy hour margaritas are delicious, and don't forget to sign-up for their emails to get updates on menu specials they have! Their happy hour tacos are the same size as small classic tacos you'd expect at a food truck, just with upgraded ingredients. The meats lack a little flavor and were on the drier side when I've eaten there. And the churros were definitely over fried. Their guacamole is really tasty and they give you complimentary chips and salsa with free refills!
name: Abigail

text: The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. For a busy night they handled it okay. The wait felt longer than it should have. Probably not coming back. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Not sure though.
name: User

text: Third strike and you're out. 20 minutes to make two standard salads and it's the third time I've waited this long. The food is good but I won't be back. The salad is not special enough to wait that long.
name: Catherine

text: Best steak you can get anywhere. The rolls and butter are to die for. Super friendly and helpful stafff above and beyond. Anything you order is good. Price is very reasonable , just don't tell them it's your birthday lol.
name: Jeff

text: Came here today for a quick drink and a bite to eat. Me and my friend got a drink and the bartender with the long curly ponytail thing in the back of the bar where the pool table is didn't not once ask us if we were okay after giving us our drinks and the food was a disappointment as well the waitress with the thick wing eyeliner and tattoo and her chest back there brought us the wrong food then when we complained to the manager about the long wait after she brought us the wrong food she came over and said "you don't want ya food" I completely ignored her and my gf just asked for the check so we could go ... never again ignorant and have no customer service
name: Alexis

text:
It's a good, straightforward pho place. They cover the basics; ribeye, flank, tripe, tendon, meatballs, all in hot broth with noodles. Hoisin and Sriracha on the table.They do banh mi and spring rolls, milk tea and bao. If you've been to any given pho place in America, you've been here. And that's not a knock, mind you. The place is clean and spacious, the herbs and bean sprouts were fresh and vibrant, the soup came out fast and hot, and the service was attentive. The price is right for the food, too. A little under 10 bucks for a "small" bowl that strains the definition of the word small. You won't leave hungry. 

So, the place isn't ground breaking. They're not out to redefine pho or get a Michelin star, but they do what they do well. And in the context of Riverview dining options, it dutifully fills a banh mi and pho shaped gap. I'll certainly be back to slurp up some more noodles.
name: Freddy

text: Great place,great food. Good prices and the best gooey butter cake ever. It you don't come to eat,at least try the cake.
name: Theresa

text: This place is a gem. The people at the counter are always nice. The food is always wonderful and it has a cute cafe feel. I would recommend this for sure very European feel and Tampa doesn't have many coffee shops or cafes like this. Very nice overall!
name: Miriah

text:
Now that I've eaten here a couple times when visiting for a convention, I can honestly say that Pho Cali has been a welcome addition to our dining plans when we are in downtown Philly.  

Though small, it's usually not a long wait to get a table here and after ordering, food is usually up within 5 minutes.  There is nothing like a big steaming bowl of Pho on a cold evening.  I had the chicken pho last time I was here and after dumping in lots of sprouts, sprigs of basil, and a bit of their sauce, I relished my bowl even though I couldn't finish it.  

The menu here has lots of other options for starters, but there isn't any reason to not order the pho.  Pricing is reasonable and you can expect to get out of here with a dinner for 2 for under 25 bucks - not bad!
name: Brett

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated bc that happens a lot. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The music was louder than it needed to be. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. I wouldn't write it off, but I also wouldn't hype it up.
name: User

text:
This is the place! I Love Guido's in Boise so much (not to take away form this gem!) The field these two play on is so different. The best toppings and cheese combos can't be beat. 

The week side is the bread sticks with sauce. The sauce is a bit too thick. Like tomato paste. The salad bar begs for something like beets or something sweet (even canned would be fine). 

It's a bit pricey but worth the attention to detail for pizza. Staff is top notch and the beer is cold. I can't ask for much more than hot sauce at the tables. 

The kind of local pizza chain you should love and admire.
name: Taylor

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text:
Since it was for my birthday, i decided i wanted to eat at a restaurant out on Clearwater Beach, since we rarely go out that way. So, i made a reservation through OpenTable for 6 of us at 6:15 on Monday. Despite being beachfront, it's more correct to say that this place shares space with the Hilton, as it doesn't have any beach-front seating. As much as i love a good view, i was really there for the food. We got there early, but had to park. That beach is a madhouse, especially during spring break, when everyone wants to hit the beach.
As soon as we arrived, we were greeted and seated, though the hostess did have to go find menus for our party. (They must not have a lot of menus, because I heard her make the same comments several times through the course of our meal.) Next time we go, we'll ask to sit on the deck, or at least by a window. We were seated in a back corner that didn't have a ton of lighting, and in fact, I couldn't really tell you what the salsa looked like.

Trisha was our waitress, and she arrived at our table with a few menus and took our drink orders (Pepsi products, a few imported and domestic beers, and a full bar). She returned with our drinks and then with chips and salsa. None of us wanted appetizers, so we went ahead and ordered our food.
Two of us went with the Tierra Y Mar Burro - and I HIGHLY recommend that dish! It was amazing! The filet and shrimp were just perfect, and the combination of all the flavors couldn't have been better. The meat was well seasoned, and was well-complemented by the sauce. The burrito isn't wet, but does have a small amount of sauce squeezed in a zig-zag over the top. My husband ordered the taco plate, and he also found his food to be delicious (a note here - if you're a picky person about sauces and the like, they are served on the same plate as the tacos, not in a separate dish). They were slightly smaller than a "street taco," but not the size of something you'd get at Taco Bell. I think they were four to a plate. Our kids went with a plate of nachos (this was an appetizer, so big enough to share, but not so big that one hungry person couldn't get through them alone), and a kids quesadilla. He finished his, but she didn't make it through her nachos. Our sixth person ordered the enchiladas (there were two on the plate, one red and one green), and he didn't say a word until his plate was clean, so I assume that he was as satisfied as the rest of us.

Overall, we're really looking forward to going back. My Naranja margarita was delicious and refreshing (would have loved a bigger size, though), and none of us had complaints about the food. Our one complaint was that our waitress didn't really check in on us much. The drink refills we ordered were taken by the supervisor of the restaurant, not Trisha. She did come by once to ask how we were, and then again to drop our check. I was willing to drink a few more margaritas and look at dessert, but when the service was as spotty as our waitress, it just didn't seem worth it.

Don't be put off by the difficulty of trying to find parking around here - just make sure you leave much earlier than you think you need to in order to find something. The food was awesome!
name: Samantha

text: We were a party of 30 with one waiter. My sister ordered a pizza and salad and her order was given to someone else. I got the chicken Parmesan with stuffed shells and it's full of salt and Garlicky. Not impressed. For a party of 30 there should have been more than 1 waiter/waitress. and I never got my side salad. I would never come back to this place
name: Ro

text: I can only recommend the drinks, breakfast items, and the pastries/snacks they have over the counter. The actual food is just not worth the money. Super overpriced for what you're getting, especially the food on the right of the counter as you walk in. I think they don't list prices anymore on the packaging for those in a hurry because the train station is right across from it. I got some kind of mozzarella chicken sandwich and a bag of chips one day and it totaled around $12. If you're in a hurry, just get a snack there as I feel like they're trying to rip you out of your money with their ready-made foods.
name: Mary

text: Just fine... the food is underwhelming and the beer is good. Admittedly I live in cities with very strong food scenes so I might have moderately high standards. My girlfriend and I are also vegetarians and this is for some reason difficult to find options in Florida? So far as our experience has gone. So at the least, props to Mad Beach for offering several options on the menu. Service was painfully slow at first. We were seated in no time and then left alone for ages before a drink order was taken and I had to ask if we could order food as well. We ordered the onion rings as an appetizer; they were great and the grainy mustard dipping sauce was a good pairing, but holy cow they're a lot. They're enormous and by the time we got through 5 of the 6 we lost our appetite for our mains or any room for more drinks. We had the falafel sandwich and the taBrewleh salad. The falafel was fine.... not great or all that memorable but at least it wasn't dry. The salad was about 75% barley. After onions rings and one beer it was clear this was just too much grain. In the end I wanted to like this place more after finding it on Yelp, but I left pretty underwhelmed. My suggestion: just go for drinks.
name: Chris

text:
So when the hubs says he wants to get dressed up and go out  (bday for me, Feb '18), and leaves the rsvps up to me, you know that means #FoodPorn pics are coming! 

Hadn't been before, and always wanted to go, as I'd heard good things. Nothing special from the outside (in the strip mall where the Bed Bath & Beyond is at Keystone), but a nice classic yet cozy atmosphere inside.  Excellent service.

Everything was top notch. Whole Bronzini for me, expertly fileted at the table, asked chef to pair a wine (he picked a Black Stallion Sauv Blanc, and it was perfect).  Pork cheeks for the hubs, plus shaved Brussels sprout salad, roasted veggies, French press and house special sticky toffee pudding to wrap it up. Stick a fork in me, I'm done!

text:
My lady and I came to Brio for a postponed Valentine's Day dinner in hopes of having a fine meal. I had been looking at coming here for awhile, but was always on the fence. Honestly, the food snob in me dislikes the idea of eating at a chain restaurant, but I overcame this snobbery and discovered I can enjoy myself - even at a chain restaurant. It's not often that a restaurant inspires a "coming of age" moment.

The restaurant was packed. People trickled in while we waited for our table and made reservations for any open times they had. Soon, we were sitting down and looking over the menu. The idea of a starter was suggested by the waitress, but, after looking over the options, we declined. Honestly, for two people who were planning on sharing a dessert at a nice restaurant that would all but guarantee giant portions, the appetizer seemed an equally unnecessary expense and calorie bomb. So we opted to stick with the main dishes. In the meantime, our waitress brought out some bread and butter. 

As for the bread, it was crusty on the outside and soft on the inside and came with a harder flatbread that had been sprinkled with spices and seeds. The flavor of both was just okay, but it was warm and we didn't come for the bread. Surprisingly, however, our dishes were out within minutes of ordering. 

I ordered the "Pasta pesto" and she ordered the "Chicken Limone." My dish was a healthy, but not gigantic, portion of almost hair thin spaghetti pasta with grilled chicken, feta, spinach, and thinly sliced red peppers. From the moment that I took a bite, I loved the flavor and, as it turns out, I love spaghetti noodles thin enough to make angel hair feel like foam pool noodles. Aprils dish consisted of a bevy of delicious roasted vegetables, thick mashed potatoes, and two large, filleted chicken breasts. She loved hers as well and as we exchanged tastes, we both got a chance to enjoy the flavors. For dessert, we ordered the Valentine's Day special: chocolate lava cake, adorned with raspberry ice cream and white chocolate pearls. It was really good.

The only downside was what happened afterwards. A new couple had arrived at the table behind me and someone ordered a fish dish. I love fish and well-made dishes containing the bounty of the sea, but what came out left a wafting trail of the strong fishy aroma that often makes enemies of coworkers or turns people off from seafood. The smell is often attributed to fish that is not fresh or fish that has been overcooked. Being too much to take, we took our conversation to go. All in all, I can see why this was packed. It was a lovely, delicious experience for the most part. While there may be better Italian restaurants in the area, this is an easy recommendation based on our first experience. Enjoy!

text: I've been here quite a few times and 9/10 I leave full and happy. It's a good place for seafood when you're in the mood and don't want to spend all that extra money. Their prices are pretty moderate and you get a lot for what you order. The best thing is from 3-6 PM it's food happy hour. That means chicken wings, clams, oysters and shrimp are 50 cents a piece during that time. That is a good deal if I say so! I always have to get raw oysters by the dozen during happy hour. And they have 2for1 drinks all day every day! I've tried many items on the menu. The ribs are a great choice if you're craving it. They are seasoned nicely, saucy, and the meat usually falls off the bone. The fried grouper nuggets po' boy is huge. The whole plate is filled with your sandwich and two sides. Definitely a bang for your buck! The calamari is decent, but I think the sauce choice for dipping could be improved; I'm not a fan of marinara alone. The salmon fish dip is pretty good. It doesn't have an overbearing fishy taste and is great in saltines with a hint if lemon and Tabasco. The boatload of mussels is good because you can't go wrong with mussels, but the butter parmesan sauce is a bit too rich. I think if they cut the amount of sauce down, it would be better. All in all, it's a good place to check out if you're at Wiregrass Mall walking around and get hungry and have a craving for some good food. The service is ALWAYS great. They are constantly checking in on you and making sure you enjoy your order and if you need anything else, plus a manager will check in on you as well at some point during your visit. Oh. And let me not forget, you should sign up for the free emails and coupons. I receive one or two coupon deals a month! Usually it's 10% off your whole meal. I love saving money!
