text: Went for restaurant week and was disappointed with most of the courses.  The wonton soup was pretty good - slightly better than your standard takeout fare - and contained some nice big shrimp. The black pepper pork was extremely dry - essentially a plate of heavily fried cutlets heavily seasoned with salt and pepper but that's about it. Minimal sides and no sauce. The fish entree was similar - very basic seasoning - 1 dimensional and nothing particularly interesting. Overall I would not recommend this place considering the steep prices for uninspired food.
name: Mike

text: Great space, casual dining with a lot of open space!! Great warm noodle dishes (quality noodles!!) that my 1st gen parents approve of (wow!) friendly staff and laid back environment
name: Sian

text: The first time was great. 2nd and 3rd not so much. My order both times were wrong and not tasty. Customer service wasn't great either. Front counter person last two times obviously didn't want to help me. I tried to love it because I was hoping for a new local place but I'm done.
name: Sarah

text: It is in the old Tony Angelo location in Lakeview.  I heard many good things about the restaurant so we decided to try it with some friends.  Our table ordered the pasta dishes and everyone was really good.  The veal dishes were homerooms and our waiter suggested the wine pairings which were excellent.  Great dinner spot.
name: Chuck

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. Pretty happy with it overall. Not bad for a quick meal. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Food was fresh and service was quick. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: I've been to this place half a dozen times and it never disappoints. People travel from all over to come here. There is always a line and always a wait and it is well worth it. The fried chicken is some of the best I have ever had, and I travel a lot. Top 5 in my opinion. Always tasty and the fried green tomatoes pare well. Not to be missed. And if you have to wait, just dip next door and see some live music or grab a cocktail. This is real New Orleans food. Oak Street has changed a lot in the last 10 years, but the quality of the food here is always spot on.
name: Jerry

text:
Nice location with outdoor seating.

Friendly hostess and waitstaff made sure we felt at home. Outdoor seating has live music on Saturday's. Steel drums made me feel like we were in the topics! 

Happy hour specials Saturdays. $2 domestic drafts and $2 wine/wells. We ordered the appetizer special calamari. A bit over salted, and there were more french fries the calamari rings. Overall $6 for a calamari appetizer not a bad deal. I had the blackened shrimp with corn salsa with a side of sautéed vegetables. Shrimp were very big and tasty, but not a lot of flavor. The vegetables were very tasty, wish the side was a bit bigger. My husband had the honey buffalo wings. Very saucy but had a lot of flavor. 

Overall a nice local spot for a few drinks and bites.
name: Melissa

text:
I don't usually go to Chinese restaurants because of the high enough of sodium, but I was surprised that the pan fried seafood noodle was on point. Initially, we found this place on yelp and wanted to come in for sushi but The waiter warned me that sushi was going to take a while because everyone ordered sushi and they had a full house. We were in a hurry because we were going to watch a show in a hour. Calamari was fried but rubbery, mapo tofu was decent and vegetable lo mein was good. 

For improvement, they need to hire another person to help out especially during the dinner hours. Love the people that work there but they should get more help.
name: Freddie

text:
The experience here was top notch! I came here with my family for my sister's birthday. They decorated the table with rose petals and balloon shaped confetti. The restaurant also gave her a card. All the servers and staff wished her a happy birthday, which she really appreciated! It is definitely a great place to come if you are celebrating something special.

I ordered a glass of wine. They have a huge selection! I settled on the New Zealand sauvignon blanc and really enjoyed it. To start, we shared the calamari and truffle fries. The truffle fries were perfectly crisp with a great thickness. The calamari at first glance seemed a little plain. It does not come with any sauce, but it is so flavorful that it doesn't need it! The red peppers with it are very spicy. I like spicy but be warned if you don't!

For my entree, I had the American Maine Lobster tails. It came with two good sized lobster tails. They were so tender and the melted butter was super warm and tasted great with the tails. We shared mashed potatoes and asparagus for our sides. Everything was top notch! Even thought the items are a little pricey, it is what you would expect at a steakhouse and the quality is worth the price. 

We were too full for dessert, but they brought over a complimentary dessert (small versions of their cheesecake and flourless chocolate cake) with a candle for my sister's birthday. It was very nice and she was kind enough to share. The cheesecake was amazing! It has bruleed sugar on top which made it really unique. Next time, I will save room and get a piece all to myself!

Overall, this restaurant exceeded my expectations. Matt, our server, was excellent, as well as all the staff that helped us. We will be returning for sure!
name: Cara

text:
The employees are unfailingly polite, friendly, and mannerly with(old-fashioned manners in danger of dying out.) They are obviously committed to ensuring that customers are satisfied with their purchase and experience. The environment outside is picturesque. The atmosphere inside the store, has that old world charm, with a wholesome appearance. Food preparation area is in pristine condition. Customers are provided with fast service and affordable prices. I can confirm that Sam's Po-boy is committed to providing their customers with the highest caliber of service, an act that demonstrates a genuine desire to satisfy, if not delight, a customer.
Gmarie/Tasha
name: Gmarie

text: Food concepts could be great but not well executed. Tried the wedge salad and lettuce was decent but the blue cheese dressing lacked proper consistency and flavor. Flatbread lacked flavor and was limp and somewhat soggy. Friend said her chicken and egg plant dinner was good. Pinot Grigio didn't disappoint. Server seem scattered. We had to ask for bread and olive oil. Nice seating on side patio. Probably won't be back as there is much better food to be had.
name: Katrina

text: Food was good and our server was nice. It was a little cool and loud in the restaurant.
name: Kim

text: I love this little hole in the wall restaurant. Literally could eat it everyday. You don't come here for atmosphere. I mostly do take out. Food is always delicious and hot. Yum!
name: Charlotte

text:
Our food was incredible!  Kids had waffle and pancakes.  They loved them.  My wife had the market scramble and I had eggs/waffle.  Probably the best waffle I've ever had.  Her market scramble was unbelievable and fresh!

Service was outstanding!
name: Branden

text: A very happy new coffee spot that's super close to home! I typically like to stay away from dairy in my coffee, so their other options are almond milk and oat milk. They make their own vanilla and mocha flavoring, the vanilla was sweet in a good way and warm. The mocha was like a dark salty chocolate, really great flavor! Their breakfast options are really tasty, my husband had a breakfast biscuit and I had the biscuits and gravy. Really delicious and full of flavor. I like that the options for food are unique from other coffee shops in town as well. There's a nice outdoor and indoor seating, great lighting and atmosphere as well. Looking forward to making this a frequent place to visit!
name: Charlene

text: Baba Xavi is an Indian inspired pop up in the old Spare No Rib space in Gravois Park.  Only open for one more month, Baba Xavi takes Indian flavors and  fuses them into burgers, salads, curries, fish n chips, etc.  the food photos don't do the food justice.  It tastes much better than it looks and the signature drinks are HUGE.  Worth a visit.  Go before the end of June 2019 or you will miss out!
name: Kelly

text:
Ok here we go. The brisket pulled pork and beans were off the charts. Excellence.  The waitress was friendly and apologetic. The 50 min WAIT WAS COMPLETELY UNACCEPTABLE.  Next time I'll call ahead show up an hour later and sit in the dinning room.
Oh and by the way. Yes I counted at least 8 leaving because of the wait and poor service.
name: Paul

text: I just did a take out order for $22 they wanted to charge me 50 cents for condiments as I was walking out the door I you kidding me can you say cheap
name: Peter

text: This place is gorgeous.  There are 60 lanes and everything looks brand new. Tons of seating. Pizza place, arcade, concession, pro shop. I don't know who picks the music, but someone else should do it. It definitely sucks. Super depressing. Also, one of the head guys that walks around comes off as totally snooty and approachable.  He needs to fix that too considering the business he's in. However, overall, this place is a definite 5 star. We visit lots of bowling alley locations all over Florida and this has been they most impressive.
name: Kelli

text: They don't listen very well - requested an Iced Pumpkin Latte w/one pump of syrup, but they loaded it up on sugar, so I couldn't drink it at all. I finally was able to circle back later on in the night to get it remade correctly. Even if they gave the original Latte to me for free, I would've chucked it away, which is what they did at the counter. Also, I rarely ever ask for drinks or food to be remade.The employee that remade it wasn't friendly compared to his coworker. Service needs love for sure. Lastly, I'm not even that picky of a coffee connoisseur compared to others! Geeze, get it together, Dunkin!
name: Joy

text: Fork came with a lot of hype. The restaurant is beautiful inside! We went for brunch on the weekend back in February. The breakfast sandwich I ordered was excellent! Bob didn't care for his biscuits and gravy, but he is pretty picky when it comes to that dish. We also ordered the infamous jumbo cinnamon roll to share as a dessert after brunch. We were disappointed. It was too chewy, and didn't have the consistency of a nice warm cinnamon roll. The Bloody Mary bar is pretty epic! I have never seen so many spices, condiments, juices, and other accoutrement for a self-serve bloody mary bar. The service was good, and I would definitely go back the next time I am in town and try a different meal.
name: Adam

text:
What an awesome experience!  I am embarrassed to say that I have NEVER had a true Philly cheesesteak.  I was in the area and though "why not".  I Yelp'ed the best cheesesteak and landed on Dalessandro's.  I arrived a little before open and there was already a line.  A line that didn't slow down the entire time I was there!

Ordering was quick and painless.  The ladies taking orders operated like a well oiled machine.  A cash only spot seems to not be a deterrent.  

My friend and I grabbed a seat at the counter, listening to the orders to see what was the local preference.  We landed on a cheesesteak (a couple
of options on this) with American cheese and onions.  About six to seven minutes later or sandwich O'plenty was in front of us.  Now I feel like I have joined a certain society or brotherhood and I will say "come on in - the water is fine".  Man this was a good sandwich.  I like peppers and they had a full compliment of peppers to smother all over that bun full of hearty ness.  I was very happy with my choice and though I have nothing else to compare it to I vote this place tops!
name: Jody

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Not bad for a quick meal.
name: User

text: This is a must do for any Tampa foodie. The food is incredibly fresh, authentic Thai goodness. The noodle soup never disappoints, and the dumpling and pad Thai are delish as well. Word of advice, get there early! Food is first come first serve and vendors pack up when all the goods are sold. Enjoy!
name: Nicole

text: The worst place to come if you want to get fast service this restaurant of Burger King put fast food at a different pace it should be called slow food you go there and you wait forever in the drive-through then you think you go inside and get past the drive-through now not even then I recommended no one attend this place because unless you want to wait a long time
name: Jose

text: The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated bc that happens a lot. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Pretty happy w it overall.
name: User

text: The atmosphere was nice. The restaurant is in a historic building, not tacky....very classic French look. I ordered a basic Caesar salad and the filet in a bordelaise sauce. Perfectly cooked and seasoned nice. The only reason I would give this place 4 stars is because of the gnocchi. It was extremely greasy and overpowered by citrus. The creme brûlée was very good; tasted like a vanilla roasted marshmallow and by request they added strawberries. I would return to tableau and would recommend to anyone looking for French cuisine.
name: Ashley

text: Did someone say Cheddar and beef croissant? Yes, please! First time I ever tried Portillo's was in Arizona then Chicago. Yes ChiTown. The real deal! and Brandon didn't disappoint. I try not to eat here often because when I do I eat a cake shake along with my buttery beefy cheesy croissant. After eating here you'll feel terrible but that's part of the experience. Don't wear real pants, break out those jeggings or leggings or loose fitting dresses so you can fully enjoy your meal and not realize that your gut has grown 4 times it's size! And yes this is a good review! Did I mention a cake shake is a giant milkshake with a full piece of Portillo's famous chocolate cake blended into it? You can't go wrong! (Unless you wear those skinny jeans)
name: Margaret

text:
Honestly, the BEST sushi I have ever had. Traveled all over the world, and have never had better sushi than at Samurai Blue.  

The ambiance is gorgeous. High vaunted ceilings, brick walls, modern decor. 

Now let's talk about the sushi. Fresh, delicious, and scrumptious. Fav rolls include

- Kyoto Roll
- Red Dragon
-Tuna Summer of Love
- Volcano
-Samurai Roll

The ginger dressing on the salad in vinegar based and the best! Go here! You won't be disappointed!
name: Marcus

text: So good, we went back twice this visit. We were smart enough to make a reservation the second time. MAKE A RESERVATION!! Or you will be standing on the street for a while. Place an order for the "secret fries." Trust me, you won't regret it. Service both times were amazing. I enjoyed a repeat performance of the Redfish Oceania and it was as great as I remembered. The second time, I ordered Cajun Jambalaya Pasta. It was delicious. Everyone in our party raved about their food.
name: Kristen

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Very disappointed in the wait staff. We were standing on the sidewalk and the young lady approached us. I told her we weren't staying to eat and she proceeded to say  "well you must not like dogs".  Seriously!?!? Little did she know we have spent money there and yes we do LOVE dogs. We currently have two adopted dogs from out local shelter.  I will come back and spend money because I know Tia is doing great things that I want to continue to support, but the staff there needs to not be so hateful and nasty to customers.
name: Stephanie

text: This is our new favorite must have stop when in Tampa!!! The food is delicious and fresh!!! The employees are super friendly!!
name: Patricia

text: Ms Carolyn was the best server. If you on the weekend for brunch they have free mimosas. The food was decent and the free mimosas were fantastic.
name: Edward

text: Great menu and atmosphere. Go with the St. Louis pork steak to take place m the local flavor. The meat is tender and the taste is complemented by the crisp apple slaw. Highly recommend. The staff allows you to take your time or order quickly to meet your needs. It is a great stop.
name: Tom

text: Loved my Finbomb burrito!  Tony, the owner, was so sweet!  Like 3 suishi rolls in one for a great price and you can make your own.  Loved it.
name: Karen

text: South is a solid option for good food and great jazz. I've come for dinner and another time for the music, where my date and I enjoyed drinks and a cheese plate. I'll admit the decor on the dinner side reminds me of a plantation, which doesn't give me the fuzziest of feelings. And, I mean, I get it... the place is literally named "South," so I don't fault them, but the plantation aesthetic can throw you off a little when your skin is brown. Nonetheless, the food is great and music even better. I only wish their bar area were a little larger. I came here a couple times for happy hour with friends, but we ended up going elsewhere because there were no seats available... so if you're going for HH, arrive early!
name: Dara

text: This place was remarkable! Out here from Chicago working and stopped by this joint. Food was good and the atmosphere was very old school/new school mixed in the downtown area. Live music was really good. Me and a couple guys from work enjoyed the open mic night. Good time and very good food. Stop by!
name: Adam

text:
Please be advised that this business has changed Owners. 

Prior to today, I loved this place! Sadly with new management, not so much. Rating 2, hopefully they make adjustments.
name: Claudia

text: We were in Reno for a basketball tournament and enjoyed a delicious breakfast at Two Chicks. We had about a 20 minute wait for a table and helped ourselves to the self serve coffee. Our waitress was attentive and knowledgeable answering many questions. Food is priced accordingly and quantity was plentiful.  Great spot w in walking distance of the casinos
name: Patrice

text: One of my favorite bars in the city. Always new taps and things to try. Never a bad spot to try to get a bite either. My go-to is the Pub Burger adding Bacon and Goat Cheese!
name: Joshua

text: Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, tho the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Price felt a touch high for what it was. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Will be back. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text:
Absolutely abysmal service at this location tonight! The kitchen messed my order up not once, not twice, but THREE times. I had to ask for a manager twice; and, when she came out, she came out defensive and defending this location's service "You're the first complaint we've had. We got an 80 top taken care of without any mistakes."

When I told her I own and operate a quick turn business and that messing up one order means the crew isn't doing their job no matter how many previous plates went out right her response was "Well I don't see it that way."

Really. Hand to God that was what she told me.

I tried to have the Shrimp and Parmesan Sirloin. She said she was helping the 4 cooks push plates out. I told her that somebody didn't pay attention to what the term medium rare meant she came at me with "we sent it out 3 times and it was you who wasn't happy." Well ... the first time is was medium so I sent it back. It came back with more Parmesan sauce on it ... the same steak. I pointed it out to my serve and told her it was still wrong. When the new plate came out it came out with the wrong sides so of course I sent it back.

The management came out defensive AT me. When I questioned how come an 80 Top was more important than my 3 top THEIR management said, "there are kids at the table behind you so I don't want to go there with you."

DIDN'T WANT TO "GO THERE"????!

Again ... hand to God that is what she told me.

I never cursed at her. Ever. No f-bomb. Nothing. I will freely and openly admit was angry and raised my voice BACK at her. SHE basically refused to apologize for this whole screw up and came out on the defensive attack. 

She said she would give me her name, the GM's name, and the area director's name. 

She gave me Randy Martin's card; the GM. Only number is the store number and it's obvious he wasn't working.

She also gave me Moises Zayas's card; the area director. I called the cell number listed and had to leave a voice mail.

I will be emailing both of them my complaints as well as complaining to/about this on every social media platform I can find.

Absolutely inexcusable behavior from management. I would fire a manager for that kind of representation of my brand if she was my manager. 

Disgusted doesn't begin to describe how I feel.

Hungry and disgusted doesn't either.

No wonder their brand is suffering. Their corporate culture is "we only got one complaint so we are doing great."
name: Cynthia

text: Love this place. Every time we go uptown this is the place to go. Such a wide variety of food you most often don't know what to choose as your meal.
name: Matthew

text: Good food, good drinks, good atmosphere. Seated quickly. Prompt service and friendly staff.
name: Hanna

text: Let's start off with when you order a salad usually the dressing comes with it, I had to sit and wait for the waitress to bring dressing after my salad was brought to my table she was just chatting it up with another waitress so  to that. Also as pricey as the drinks are if actually like to taste alcohol in my beverage instead of just juice. When the waitress brought my appetizer we had a table of 13, so we were sharing everything well I had to get up again and search for the waitress (chatting it up) to ask for plates, when she brought them over majority of them were dirty with old food stuck on the dang plate
name: Vicky

text: Excellent. Had the BBQ duck, shrimp, and habanero chicken. Also had the guac and the chili con queso dip.  super yummy and unique! I tried my boyfriend's "cho-fu" taco though and I think that was my fave.
name: Rachel

text: Just went back with some friends the other night. This place never disappoints. I had the sherry: goat cheese stuffed burger with homemade ranch and mushrooms on top. My daughter and I also enjoyed the custard of the month for April: coconut cream pie. Great atmosphere and employees with friendly faces. I'll definitely be going back and recommend to anyone who loves great burgers and custard.
name: Dana

text: Was not a fan. The waiter was good until the end. Host stand and the lady that seated us weren't very welcoming. I ordered the Cajun chicken penne and my boyfriend ordered the bourbon chicken. My pasta was all oil. It was basically soup to the point I couldn't eat much of it so I tried he bourbon chicken from my bfs plate and it was just dry chicken covered in sauce. Not very good at all. I decided to take my pasta home in a Togo container and when I was tilting the plate to let the oil drain to the other side and scoop the pasta into my container the waiter grabbed the plate out of my hand and was like let me help you. It didn't help. I managed to spill pasta on then table and he was tilting the whole plate towards my container letting me take the oil home with me so at that point I took the plate back and said I got it. I had to seriously insist on doing it myself cause he was so determined to do it for me. The oily pasta upset my stomach and now I'm trying to give it a try for lunch to not let the food go to waste but I can't. There's no fixing it. I won't be back
name: Mekayla

text:
Slowly and delightfully making my through their whole menu. As a self-proclaimed "sandwich guy" there are a few baseline requirements to win my full support: excellent bread (yes); sound construction (definitely; these guys hand craft with LOVE); and excellent/unexpected condiment enhancements (hoison? miso? masala jam? yup.).

This is a great spot to grab breakfast or lunch- would highly recommend the So Long Sal, which tastes exactly like an italian sub should but has some fun twists; the Surfer; and the Pho-gie. They're also really quick with a helpful suggestion if the options are just too much to handle.
name: Emma

text: This is a really good place if you are in the mood for heavy comfort food - which we were!  Food was DELICIOUS!!!!  I got the Egg Plant Parmesan and tried their Potato Salad......EXCELLENT!  My husband got the Gumbo plate and others in our party enjoyed Fried Catfish and the Chicken Parmesan - all dishes were shared and thoroughly enjoyed!
name: Sybil

text: Dessert saved this a little. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. For the price I expected more than this.
name: User

text: A great hidden gem. The bacon cheeseburger is consistently awesome. They seem to use Martin potato rolls for buns, and you really can't ask for much more. I love this place!
name: B

text: The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Not bad for a quick meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent.
name: User

text: Found this on Yelp and it was definitely worth the drive. Tried the Gordo taco, which is fried breaded shrimp, chile marlin and a breaded fried whitefish along with fried onions. The food was extremely fresh and tasty. The extras bar was also very clean and fresh. Washed it down with a Mexican Fresca. A little difficult to see from the road and there is a very small parking lot. Will definitely be returning.
name: Chris

text: I was craving Pho and decided to give Ha Long Bay a try. We were very satisfied! Food is great. Price is fair and portions large. Service is excellent.
name: Bill

text: Lee's is a cool spot!  Pizza was great. Local beer selection is awesome.  I'd recommend going with one of their menu choices for pizza. We did a half & half pie... and "The Message" plus pepperoni was way better choice than our custom half with meatballs & ricotta.  People raved about the wings so we had to try them. The hot wings were not hot at all, but still tasty.  3.9 stars overall!
name: Nicole

text: They are very disrespectful. They don't pick, they keep you on hold forever and then get smart with you when you ask them why. The is not that good for them to treat customers like they don't matter..
name: Pretty

text:
OK, I thought I was losing my mind after my visit today, but after coming home and reading some of the reviews I realized it wasn't me.

I've seen this place several times while going into Pet Smart. It's tucked into the strip mall next to a pizza place and dollar store.

It's lost in a time warp, I've read they've been in business 25 years and the shop looks it. Signboards​ have items painted over with handwritten signs stuck all over it and the display cases. 

The French cafe with French music playing in the background is quaint, it loses something with the pink plastic tablecloths​.

The woman working there is very sweet and polite. I ordered a Chocolate Croissant​ and she offered​​e to warm it, which was a nice touch.

I took it to go and eat on the run or I would have gone back in​ and played twenty questions.

Warmed, it had a slight crispness to the nicely​ browned outside. However, it wasn't warm enough to heat the chocolate interior, so the chocolate center was still hard.

As I ate more I realized it wasn't actually a croissant, it was brioche dough​ baked in a crescent shape. 

It completely lacked the light, flaky, buttery​ texture of a good croissant. It was rich like an eggy brioche with a fine crumb that gave it texture but it was very dense. Which I'm guessing paired with its size is probably why the​ chocolate never melted.

Not horrible, ​not amazing, but not rushing back.
name: Mark

text: This place gets 3 stars ONLY because the artichoke dip is sooooooo good! The rest of the food was just okay. It was edible but not great. The location is amazing. It has an amazing view from the patio and has so much potential. The inside needs some serious revamping. It looks really outdated inside. Also there was bugs on the booth we were sitting at. I understand you can't always control those things but I have been here twice and both times there was some type of bugs on the table. I ordered a sirloin steak medium well (don't judge me, I can't stand pink/bloody meat), the steak was okay. It did lack seasoning as did the veggies. The salad and ranch dressing tasted good. If I were to come back it would be solely to get the artichoke dip. Seriously, it is amazing! If they could get the rest of the food to taste that great they would be golden.
name: Katrina

text: Atmosphere is great. Service was okay. Drinks are way over priced. The hot chicken is ignorant hot. The chicken and biscuits was bland and rubbery.
name: K

text: This place has gotten a facelift since our last visit! The new interior looks great. We love this family operated place. The food is delicious, reasonably priced, and has huge portions. Service was very quick even though there was a huge group in the back that ordered when we did. We will be back and will recommend it to our friends.
name: Caitlin

text: The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. For a busy night they handled it okay. Price felt a touch high for what it was. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Pretty happy with it overall. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Would probably stop in again if nearby. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: The food here is ok.  The customer service should be updated!  The managers don't always pay attention to the LACK OF ATTENTION BY THE SERVERS!!  You have to motion some of the servers to get refills or if you wish to add something to your order.  I use to go there more, but the lack of attention by the servers, I go elsewhere more..
name: Sherri

text: Happy, friendly restaurant with delicious food. Started with great empanadas, then the entrees and salad were wonderful. Though very full with dinner, so glad we also had dessert. Get the flan.
name: Bill

text: Despite all the terrible reviews we still came here- I wanted a Slush. I didn't catch his name, but the old man who served us was fan-friggin-tastic. He couldn't understand my husband so he skated out to take our order. Our drinks and shakes arrived very quickly and they were all perfect. I suppose if you come here and you get the old man, you're in for an excellent experience.

text: This is the combination you never knew you wanted. Good wings and an amazing rice that they put a really tasty sauce on that go together perfectly.
name: Kade

text: This was a decent brunch restaurant. I had the pancakes and corn beef hash. The hash was great, the pancakes were so-so. We had to sit at the bar because it wasn't a ton of space available and it would have been a longer wait. The bartender was a nice guy. He let us try the Bloody Mary, which wasn't that great. My girlfriend had the Eggs Cochon, which was good, she also had the Chicken St. Charles, but it wasn't as good. A couple things I didn't like were, there were a bunch of flies and they didn't have a huge selection on the menu for food and especially for drinks.

text: The habañero chicken taco is my current fave but so many are delicious and my favorites rotate between portobello, Chofu, soft taco, habanero chicken, and shrimp respectively. YOU CAN NOT BEAT THE HAPPY HOUR just make sure you tip appropriately!! Love mission taco
name: Baylee

text:
Creative takes on traditional Italian dishes and an emphasis on interesting regional Italian wines are a winning combination.  House made pasta and very well prepared seafood, chicken and meat dishes are the core of the menu.  I found the pizza toppings tasty but heavy crusts that are apparently aimed at the American preference did not please me.  

This is the business formerly known as "Ciao Villagio".  It was converted into the same concept as Convivio in Carmel.  It's the same menu and that's a plus.  Something that needs to change quickly is the noise level.  I found it very bothersome.  It reminds me of the late 80s when urban restaurants adopted the "industrial" style of hard flat surfaces, bare tables, and cement floors.  It's dated but it keeps renovation costs low.  The problem is every sound is amplified to the point that waiters struggle to hear the customers and customers can barely hear themselves think.  It's rather like having a meal in an airport terminal at rush hour.  My constructive advice is to get some fabric in the place - rugs on the floor, decorative throw pillows, large silk floral arrangements, fabric hung from the ceiling, and do it very quickly.  This is a classic new restaurant mistake, but this is not really a new restaurant.  The room nearest the entrance is quieter than the back room but still too noisy.  I would have given another star but for this issue.  I will do take out only until and unless it's addressed.
name: A

text: This is the coolest coolest breakfast place ever, everything is fresh and delicious the waitstaff is so congenial. I would've posted some photos but all the photos are posted the presentation of your plate is delicious fresh fresh I absolutely love this place. And the photos don't lie!!! your plates are full.
name: Joyce

text: The manager Alex came by and welcomed us as first timers. I had the kabob with vegetables. The meat was perfect. The vegetables needed to cook a bit longer, but I'm a southern girl, enough said. I substituted green beans for the potatoes and they were very tasty. Hubby had the blu cheese filet. He said it was very tasty. We saw other food being served that we thought looked equally delicious. Yes, I'm definitely coming again. As I was writing my review, our waitress comes out with Creme Brûlée cheesecake, we didn't order it, she said they wanted our first experience to include everything. Ok, I'm impressed. Thank you Firebirds.
name: Donna

text: I loved this place. A lot of my coworkers were HIGHLY recommending this place & it's a small restaurant but damn their food is good. The $2 pork bun was astronomical. The shrimp dumplings were also amazing and just in general the food was awesome. Very cheap and you are definitely dreaming of your next pork bun after leaving.
name: Aileen

text:
I took a friend and his wife to dinner here for his birthday. I had made a reservation and we were seated very quickly. We all ordered a round of drinks and reviewed the menu. 

When the waiter came back he gave us several options that we're not on the menu. I was already determined to get the prime rib. 

My salad came out, which he mixed at the table and served it to me. I liked the little touches of "experience" that they try to provide. Is it necessary no, but it's great that they still take the time to do it. Definitely helps make it feel like more of a luxurious experience. 

My prime rib came out great. A touch undercooked for my liking but good. I'm never one to send it back. I was still pleased with it. 

The meal was quick which I appreciate. Not long waits in between courses. 

Great place, great service. Definitely recommend
name: Bill

text: Service was excellent and food was good. Atmosphere was overlooking the bay. Beautiful view. A bit pricey for lunch.Some choices were a la carte but the presentation on the plate was picture perfect. Overall would recommend and return next time in the area.
name: Dawn

text: The first time I went here, the server, who was an older lady, was wonderful, friendly, very attentive. Yesterday when I went, the waitress was surly, looked at me like I was a pain in her boondah, and never came back to ask if I needed anything. I drank my coffee while I waited on my breakfast and the cup was empty when the busser brought me the meal. Waitress never came back except to literally sweep under my feet. If she were doing her job she would have seen my empty cup. Funny she could be so rude as to invade my space, but couldn't notice the empty cup. I asked for the manager/owner who didn't seem concerned and told me that I should have asked for coffee. Whu' tha whu? I told him I shouldn't HAVE to ask for something that is to be expected from a server. She wasn't busy with anything else, although I appreciate a clean floor. I was ready to pay and the owner told me, "You can go." The worst part is that they didn't seem to understand the principle of customer service, nor my rationale.

text: Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The wait felt longer than it should have. Just not for me. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Food was fresh and service was quick. It looked better online than it did in person. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. The sauces helped more than I thought they would..

text: The food was delicious. The manager came out to meet us and our server Breanna was wonderful. My overall experience was great!! Thank you all!

text: Omg. If I'm bad, I want to be bad all the time. This place was incredible. Great Happy hour specials and the food was even better. Please try the fish tacos. They are mouth watering amazing. Not to mention, the manager Jake will make sure you are not only welcomed but have everything you need and more. I guarantee youll want to come back. Tap that!!!

text: Always have a good time here! The service is always  amazing! I am always not only greeted with a smile but am always being checked up on. They really take care of you here. The food is always fresh and just a heads up during the week you get free sake with ayce sushi. Definitely recommend this place  to everyone!

text:
I was visiting Nashville and wanted to try some chicken that wasn't from the famous Hattie B's. McDougal's was one of the top rated restaurants on Yelp for "hot chicken" so I decided to give it a try. The cashier was very kind to my boyfriend and I and asked us about how we were enjoying Nashville. At the end, she gave us a soda on the house. So sweet!

I shared the Large Basket with my boyfriend and we got our chicken fingers tossed in the honeybee and gold sauces. Plus we got to choose 3 dipping sauces as well! The food didn't take long to come out and the 1 dish was big enough to feed us both. If you like sauces, then this is THE place for you. The chicken fingers were drenched in the sauces we ordered and were SO good. The gold sauce was my personal favorite. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a delicious, quick bite.
name: Kanika

text: Their tomato pie is best I've had in Philly, but the plain pie is no slouch: thin crust, cooked well, flavorful sauce. I'd put it up against any slice. These guys are a worthy successor to Beddia, no doubt.
name: Ed

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted..
name: User

text: Love this place! Love the waiter Dom. Love the food (especially the steak and mushrooms app), drinks, ambiance, and view. You can't go wrong here!!
name: Emily

text: When planning my vacation Bearcat was number one on my list of places I wanted to visit. I must say it didn't disappoint. The food was amazing. My fiend and I ordered a few things so we could share. The building had a great look to it. The only thing I would change is larger water glasses.
name: Anna

text:
A Mount Juliet hidden gem that's running circles around a lot of the local restaurants. 
I've eaten at this establishment one time before after finding it on Yelp! (Thanks you guys!)
I was quite upset with myself for not finding this place sooner because I have a sick obsession with tacos lol
The first time coming we ordered togo just about everything that's on the menu mini tacos, a burrito, enchiladas, and churros. Nothing was disappointing! 
I ordered carne asada and chicken tacos, the meat was tender and juicy. 
The burrito we ordered was huge! Stuffed with steak and fries. 
The enchiladas were great! The green was spicy and delicious the red was not spicy but full of flavor. 
The churros were delicious filled with cream. 
This is my new spot in town.
name: Contia

text:
I have received multiple recommendations for this place.  I have seen it many times driving up 1st Ave, but I haven't tried it until now.  
Your first impression of it is that it looks sketchy.  And to be honest, it is sketchy looking on the inside and outside.  I think the location and the way the building looks was one of the reasons I hadn't been in earlier.  But the food by contrast, will make you forget your first impressions.  The food served here is a combination of Caribbean and Asian fusion.  So there are Chinese options and Puerto Rican options.  I thought it was really good.  I was impressed by how well the food went together. My friend and I both got the Mofongo combo.  (Mofongo is mashed plantains).  The combo comes with chicken broth and a choice of 1 entree.  The recommended entree is chicken enchilado, with varying degrees of spiciness.  I think I went with mild or medium.  But it was plenty spicy.  My fiance got the broccoli beef combo (b/c he doesn't like to try new things).  
The way you're supposed to eat the mofongo is basically dunk the whole thing in the chicken enchilado and eat it like that.  But I think I was eating it incorrectly.  I was eating it separately.  Oh well.  Next time for sure.  
This is a popular take out place.  While we were eating, at least 3 or 4 different couples came by and picked up.  I would love to return or get take-away from here.  10/10 would recommend if you haven't tried it.
name: Anne

text: What's the deal with the double drive-thru lines I believe it's made things slower and more frustrating if you get on the wrong side the run two or three cars to the other side before they even come and take your order

text: Great coffee. Drinks are a tad expensive but their food is nicely priced so whatever. Always friendly service and an easy place to sit and enjoy a cup of coffee or just get some work done.

text: Went in around 6pm today, the male working the front counter was SO friendly. The food was delicious and the server that kept helping us made it the best experience possible. Couldn't believe how incredibly kind and attentive he was! Will be back!

text: Went Sunday night again for my 3rd time. Danny was our waiter and he couldn't have made the service better. Will definitely be back. The chicken and Mac and cheese were amazing.

text:
Sunday brunch. This is the place.

I generally order the breakfast bowl which is $15. It's a hearty mix of potato's, cherry tomatoes and sprouts. A poached egg is included and 3-4 strips of bacon can be added for $3. The meal is filling but District Cafe receives 4 stars because the service and wait time aren't managed well. Wait times and extraordinary long and staff need to smile and be more enthusiastic.

text: I am in love with this place. Been here a couple of times and it never disappoints! Food comes quickly, orders are taken fast and efficiently, great customer service. Very clean place as well. The food is amazing! I always get the lamb shawarma sandwich and it is to die for! I will always come back here.

text: Visited here with my husband post flight from California. We had no wait as we reserved a table via opentable on our way to the restaurant. Our server was very nice and helped us narrow down our menu and drink choices. It was a bit loud as we were seated near two large groups, but not so much so that we couldn't enjoy our meal. Food and drinks were great, would come back again!

Make sure to try the broccoli  & Brussels Sprouts! Out of this world. The Avocado & Fennel Salad is also a must.

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text:
Delicious food!  This is a new place attached to Olivia apartments in Carmel.  I LOVED the decor.  Old beer/wine barrels on the walls and the cool carvings on all of the booths were very neat.  I went for lunch and had the lunch fajitas.  They were super hot and delicious and a ton of food for the price!  I really enjoyed their salsa as well.  

The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the service was very slow and inattentive.  It was lunch, and it was steady but not crowded, so there was really no reason for the server to not check on us, bring items in a timely manner or even give us our check.  I wanted some hot sauce for my fajitas but after delivering our food, the server never came back.  Once we were finished we had to actually flag down a different server to get our bill.  It was kind of ridiculous.  

There is a large side room that looks like it's good for groups or private events.  The door was open and I noticed servers going in and out.  It looked like they were all sitting in there hanging out in between waiting tables.  I found that a little unprofessional, they could have been doing side work.  Or at least keep the door closed.  It was clear they were hanging out because all were hanging out on their phones.  

I will go back and would like to try dinner.  Maybe the service is more attentive when it's busy!
name: Kira

text: I came here on a mission...all I wanted was to try their infamous  chargrilled oysters.  I ordered a dozen for take out/carry out and I couldn't wait to dig in.  Needless to say, I was disappointed. I had high hopes for this place as I had just came from Neyow's the night before and their chargrilled oysters were BOMB AF! I had the same expectations for this place based on the word of mouth, yelp reviews, and recommendations.  They weren't bad, but I can say I definitely have had better.  I am not opposing to coming here in the future to try different things on the menu...I just know I won't be getting the chargrilled oysters from here again.
name: Cristina

text: Been here a few times. The food is consistently fresh and good. Usually get the table side guacamole. That doesn't leave much room for the meal so we get a few tacos. Today I had a chorizo and a pescado taco. While different, they were both very good. Oh...and thanks for the tequila shot Rocco.
name: Bob

text: We have been Desert Museum members for many years. Therefore we have eaten here for many years. We ate here this week after not for about a year. The food was terrible! I'm so disappointed. The green chili cheeseburgers taste frozen and not charbroiled and the green chili is now tiny pieces, when before it was large strips. We couldn't finish them. The kids ordered cheese pizza kid meals. The pizza was so bad they didn't eat it?! No kid meals either-they used to come with animal cookies, etc. but now it's a horrible 'pizza' and drink. I can't say how disappointing this was and now we will choose to eat elsewhere before we visit the museum.
name: Audrey

text: Best wings in life. Great customer service. The food is fantastic. Everytime I come here I attempt to to something different however I usually end up getting a 10 PC wings or chicken and shrimp quesadillas. The wings are delicious. Different flavors include lemon pepper, sweet and spicy, Peach Wings (yes I said peach) and a few other ones. You can throw a dart at the menu blindfolded and what ever it lands in you will not be disappointed. The food is that good. I guarantee it.
name: Aaron

text:
We absolutely love this place. We have been here several times on our way up north and we are literally never disappointed with the food. 
I appreciate the fact that they have a ton of vegetarian and vegan options. 
Reading the other reviews kind of surprises me because we eat here all the time and have never had any issues, and we almost always eat something with seafood as one of us is a pescatarian. Never had any issues; always fresh. 
I will say that the one criticism that I have is that their service is painfullyyyyyyy slow sometimes. Do NOT go if you're in a big hurry haha because they are slow. 

The last time we were in, we were helped by Jasmine and Jeanette. Both were amazingly polite and Jasmine was a wonderful server. Positive attitude, prompt, even brought a water dish for our dog. In the past, we've had some young servers who were not the best (like we saw them once the entire meal, then MIA, had to ask a busboy for water lol), but Jasmine was awesome. 
Our food is always fresh, always creative, and I have never left unsatisfied. I think they could train some of their younger staff members a little better, but other than that, amazing place. 
The food is absolutely delicious every time.
name: Jera

text: We went to the vegan buffet the other night and I was at first skeptical but so pleasantly surprised with the food! They had a huge selection of yummy vegan dishes . Not just o3 or 4 I think I counted at least 6-8 not counting the salad and desserts. It was definitely worth the money. The food was very flavorful too and I will definitely be back ! Thank you for providing vegan options !
name: Manuela

text:
First time trying French food. It's definitely a new experience. But we love it! The place has great reviews and few of our friends recommended this place. They weren't wrong. Once you step in, you can feel the coziness and the atmosphere can be a romantic place for a date. The service was wonderful and the food too. 
We selected the 3 courses meal. For appetizer we had the Terrine De Foie Gras and the Escargots A La Bourguignonne. Absolutely delicious! For the main course we had the Lapin Roti A La Moutarde which is rabbit with house-made tagliatelle and Gigot D'Agneau Accompagne Ratatouille, lamb shank with ratatouille. The lamb meat just comes of the bone and it melts in your mouth. As for the rabbit dish, the protein was nicely cooked and the flavors is balanced. However the tagliatelle was a little hard to chew. So it's a little undercooked. 
Finally the dessert we had Mousse A La Rhubarbe, chocolate mousse and Mille Feuille Aux Framboises, caramelized puff pastry with vanilla cream and raspberries. 
The price for a 3 courses meal is only $35. That's a good deal to try something new. If you have chance. Come by here and check for yourself. Maybe a good place for your next date 

Food: 4/5
Price worth: 4.5/5
Service: 5/5
Atmosphere/vibe: 5/5
name: Kalvin

text:
This is the best breakfast place I've ever been to, hands down. Their latte was perfect in every way- my coffee loving bf was raving about the quality of their coffee beans. It was perfect with an almond chocolate croissant :)) I also ordered a croquet madame, while my bf got a ham n cheese croissant sandwich. His was sooo good! Mine seemed a little dry for me, but still had great flavor! Also the salad on the side has a really pleasant lemon Parmesan dressing!

I will def be coming again and think you should too!! Not a lot of seating, though.
name: Nicole

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. Also, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. maybe I just came on an off day.
name: User

text: Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Food was fresh and service was quick. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. Pretty happy with it overall. Not bad for a quick meal. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. It looked better online than it did in person. Food was good and came out fast.
name: User

text: Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. You can tell they care about customer experience here. Portions were generous and presentation was nice. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Price felt a touch high for what it was. No big complaints, just a nice meal. The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. Would absolutely visit again. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. The leftovers held up okay the next day..
name: User

text: We had a reservation for 12. Super long day of board meetings and we were really looking forward to it. When we arrived, they unceremoniously announced that because we had failed to answer the phone all day, they had canceled our reservation. No "let us see what we can do", no "I'm sorry", nothing but "goodbye".  Unforgivable.
name: Laura

text:
I went to Cinder House with my wife and her family. I didn't know what to expect going in. I knew it was in the former location of Cielo in the Four Seasons downtown but that was about it. I have to say that I was impressed. The food was excellent. Everyone got a different dish, and I didn't hear a negative word from anyone at the table. Just outstanding food. 

In addition to the terrific food you have a nice view. Sadly we went in winter, but in the summer there is a large patio and a pool just outside the restaurant. You also have a pretty solid view of the arch. This has to be just a great place to get drinks on the patio then dinner afterwards when it is warmer. We will definitely come back.
name: Brian

text: It was crowded but still moved along. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Back Bay Pizza and Cocktails is new to Reno and I hope it stays around! You can smell all of the tasty pizzas as soon as you walk through the door. It was mouth watering!   

The dinning area is large enough to fit 7 families, while the bar area is a little more spacious. We celebrated a birthday and have 20 people in our party. The bar area was able to accommodate us. Some of us were seated at the high tables, some and the bar, and some standing. 
If you are looking for a large group putting, this could be the place for you. 

Now let's get to the food. The pizza and salads were amazing! 
The mixed green salad, comes with pecans, Gorgonzola, dried cherries, and bacon vinaigrette! The flavors works together beautifully. I ate every last bit of that salad! 
For pizza, I ordered the Big Papi, garlic sauce, mozzarella, chicken, bacon, cherry tomatoes, and fresh basil. WOW! So delicious! 

The cocktails were also very impressive. I had 'the met.' Elderflower , cucumber, violet, and Prosecco. The drink is a blackish-Blue color and feels very cosmopolitan. 

All in all, I had an amazing experience and am hoping to visit again soon! 

It is located in the same area as Pine State Biscuits and Sizzle Pie. There is parking in the front.
name: Rebecca

text: Loved this place. Pretty close to Belgian food but not quite there yet. Definitely the best frites and Belgian leigh waffle I've had in US. Greg, our waiter, is an amazing guy! We were very impressed with the place.
name: Sanjana

text: I think this is best best dinner with the best food and the best services in the whole Philadelphia area. I live 20 min away but will travel just to eat here. It's small but the wait is short because the food comes out in minutes.
name: Sam

text:
Yep,  Tumérico is one of my favorite restaurants now, in my top ten in Tucson!
Wendy crafts some very flavorful menu items and the portions should more than satisfy everyone in your group!
name: John

text: Tried-and-true Alehouse will be a totally great asset to the north side!! Great food Great service!! So excited to take my friends and family this weekend
name: Deborah

text: Service is terrible. Managers are rude and unprofessional, no one was wearing gloves at all and there was so sense of urgency. I ordered at 8:50 on the app and got my food 45 minutes later. Completely unacceptable. Please fix this!!!
name: Arthur

text: This time, our service was great but the Food was ordinary. Everything is a la carte, so I feel for the $, your entree is small. I don't think my guy wants to return.
name: Patty

text: This is a friendly and good little cheese and sandwich shop on a popular stretch of Central Ave near the baseball stadium. There are a few tables inside and few outside. The sandwiches are very good and the cheese is excellent. The owner (or one of them - I'm there may be another, since I haven't asked) used to be the cheese monger at Dean & Delucca in Manhattan, and he really knows his cheeses.
name: Michael

text: This was my first time eating here. I had the biacuits and gravy and they were pretty good for a restuarant. I always complain that restaurants tend to get skimpy with the sausage. They were more sausage filled then most restaurants. I will definatley come back, if I ever can get the fiance out of bed early enough to eat breakfast.
name: Shawn

text:
Me and my girlfriend popped in because it was the first restaurant on the way to our destination. Boy did we mess up there. 

We got there and I ordered the Breakfast Burger with Cajun Fries. She ordered the OG with Cajun fries and a side of red beans and rice, and we placed our drink orders. She had a water;  I had a coke. 

She came back with 2 waters. Ok no big deal I don't mind the water, needed it anyway right?

15 minutes later we had our food... kinda. They gave me the wrong burger and hers was no where to be found. On top of that we weren't given Cajun fries, we got regular fries AND THEY WERE COLD. 

So by this point I was like ok whatever I'll just eat the burger I'll let the waitress know that it was wrong but I'll just keep it so the kitchen doesn't have to go through a whole fiasco. Not a bad burger btw. 

20 minutes after that she got her burger. Which was the og. A basic burger. 

They did take 3 dollars off the ticket for bringing the wrong food out, which is nice, but I don't think we will be visiting there again.
name: Clayton

text: Bagel cafe is the tits. I dare any New York Native who says differently to suck down one of these stickless salt lollipops without busting a shameful half chub. The skin is crisp, the dough is airy, and the cream cheese is laid on thicker than your uncle's inappropriate rendition of your neighbors that you keep telling him is politically insensitive. Theres a lot of it. Not such a bad thing in cream cheese's case. I eat here every morning, which is probably why I always smell like garlic; Worth it. Bagel Cafe for president.
name: Shai

text: Great service and sushi! First time and got a to go. Will definitely come back for a sit down.
name: Sam

text: I ordered a 2 topping  xl pizza with extra cheese it was horrible no sauce and very little bacon I called the manager his response was, we're only to  put 12 pieces of bacon well I had  bacon bits very disappointed with Imos on 6845 Olive
name: Mary

text:
Oh my goodness we have found a new favorite.. food was awesome .. the service great.. the place spotless .. prices really good too
.. we will certainly be back.. wow!!
Been there 3 times in 2 weeks .. so obviously enjoying it lol
name: Debbi

text: My family and I were in town from Mobile,Al and decided to have dinner at The Cheesecake Factory as we love the food and the great desserts that they offer. Dinner was a disaster starting with the drink orders that took three times to get correct.We were informed bread was coming, appetizers were order as well as entrees. Entrees arrive still no appetizers or bread and two of the entrees were wrong, spoke with manager and he only addressed one wrong entree while ignoring the issue with the other one, still no bread and the wrong order that was addressed basically came back out wrong and still no bread. Worst experience ever at a Cheesecake Factory!
name: Sandra

text: Delicious phillys and great service! I would definitely come back! I had the "hot philly sandwich" which is jalapeños and hot sauce added on to a regular philly, It's so good!

This is what makes it cool- like any second some 18th century pirate is bound to stumble out drunk from one if it's doorways. However, that's about it. The food options are extremely limited and the service was not the best; it took forever to get are food (it was an extremely slow night) and when it did arrive, the arrangement was subpar. text: Read some reviews.  Seeing a common theme for yelp: Local, or what appears to be real reviews, are not good.  Out of town, or serial reviewers, are lavishing praise.  Let me set the record straight on McGrath's once and for all:  This was the proverbial second chance, and they fell so hard on their face even Artie Lange said "DAMN!"  1 hour wait.  In the mean time, drinks refreshed once.  Checked on twice.  On each visit the waitress said, "it is a couple minutes out."  Finally, at the hour mark, the excuse of "there was a 25 top that came ahead of you."  Bottom line: Don't lie.  I walked through the other side of the restaurant, as that is where the restroom is.  No such table existed that evening.  What I did see was clearly the manager's friends or family seated at a table that helped themselves to drinks from the bar and had clearly received their order in very good time.  Bad move.  To the food, my plate was the mixed grill.  Baked potato was obviously from the night before.  How do I know?  The skin was leathery, and the potato while cooked, was hard and cool on the interior.  Not a prawn skewer either, it was shrimp.  Texture of a twizzler you left in your hiking backpack from a year ago, and clearly had been sitting under a lamp for a while.  Salmon bites?  I have literally pulled salmon from a tinfoil packet that was juicier and more tender, not embellishing for entertainment.  The worst?  The crab cake.  Obviously a store bought packaged dollop, stale nasty breaded exterior and a mushy tasteless and cool interior.  Not turned off yet?  Maybe you deserve to eat at McGraths.  I know I won't be back.  I have no social media accounts, and have only on one other occasion felt compelled enough to sign up and remark on service.

I had high expectations for this location in smyrna since the one in hermitage is by far one of my favorite restaurants to eat at hands down. but in all honesty, i think taking the further drive is much more worth it for the quality and taste of the food than here. 

I hope one of these days, the kitchen can troubleshoot and fix the way they cook so they can match the quality of the juicy seafood in hermitage. i understand that with opening up a new restaurant, there will be many problems in the beginning. but i let too many things slide the day i came to eat here. 

i always order my juicy special seasoning with extra hot spice at the one in hermitage so it was only right to order the same exact thing at this smyrna location. when the food finally came out, my food wasn't hot or steaming at all, it was kind of cold like it was sitting out for a while. (i thought to myself, no wonder why it took so long it was probably sitting in the kitchen.) the seafood came out before our appetizer, and even then we had to wait another while for our appetizer. but oh well, it's here now. it's fine. they're pretty busy. my tray of seafood looked so bland and dry like it had no seasoning. the potatoes and corn weren't drenched in the sauce like im usually used to. it just looked like it was just sitting in a pool of butter. (not even drenched, just oily with no seasoning or spice) literally. there wasn't any spice at all and when i asked for the extra hot seasoning, after 15 mins of waiting for my side of extra seasoning, they brought me a little cup of cajun...... i asked the server to bring me a sauce, instead of a cup dry seasoning of cajun lol.. i then waited another 15 mins for the right sauce and wondered why i couldn't get this when i originally ordered it that way... i had to wait damn near 30 mins for something i shoulda had in the beginning lmao... the server had apologized and said the kitchen doesn't speak any english. i mean after i got the right sauce, by that time my food was just completely cold haha. the taste after adding in the correct sauce was alright, but not at all close to being as good as hermitage. 

i was highly upset that this was a franchise, because as a franchise it should be a close match to the quality and taste of the original. it shouldn't be in competition with its own business. opening up a location in smyrna was not a great decision if you aren't going to match up to the original or be better. it causes disappointment. i really hope the one opening in murfreesboro reads this and makes sure that the quality and taste matches up (if not better!!!) i could care less about service i just want to eat good food and not feel the need to drive so far when i have these same exact locations much closer to me. it's sad. please whoever is the ceo or manager of this company please make sure the murfreesboro location tastes similar to the one in hermitage!

text:
Another city, another hotel.... 

Choices were kind of limited this go around, but I stuck to my standards, and Mediterranean food is one of them. Right around the block, in a non-descript strip mall, there is the Gyro Company. Totally not what I expected. The place was clean, trendy, with glass and stainless steel... A couple of vertical broilers on the far wall, with rotating goodness that sets off the aroma... Two guys are behind the counter, with big smiles, and big hello's. Right off the bat, one asks me if I've ever been there before, and I respond "Nope, first time!". Before I could say anything else, he recommended the "Supreme Gyro", and asked if I liked Feta. "Feta makes it betta", I replied... Looking at their menu boards, I also ordered Falafel and their Spinach Pie. 
While they were whipping up the food, I found out they are brothers, and we started talking about Istanbul and the surrounding areas of their homeland. Their faces lit up. Excellent guys right there... took care of me really well, and it showed in their food...
Everything was absolutely delicious, and the product exceeded the value. The Gyro was fully packed, tender and tasty. The Falafel was also very tender (on the inside), with a nice crispy outside. The Spinach Pie, however, took me by surprise... Instead of a full sheet of pie, cut into squares or triangles, they were individually folded into perfect triangles... If any of you have worked with Phyllo dough before, then you know how much a pain it is to work with... these Spinach Pies were a labor of love...
So, if you're in the area, and you're looking for some kicking Mediterranean food, visit the boys over at the Gyro Company!!
name: Scott

text:
I was debating between 4 and 5 stars, I'll give the experience a 4.5. 

There is no doubt 5&T is one of the top places to dine in Nashville and they deliver more than the hype. Because the concept is sharing plates, they are very generous with their portion sizes. If you read most of the reviews, people struggle to finish the food ordered and the reviews aren't lying. You will leave stuffed! 

The ambience indeed is candescent and appealing. Dim lighting, paintings lined up on one side of the room, bar, outdoor seating to the right and the dining room is segregated by a wall of candles. Right in the center is a statue of Francis Nash to whom Nashville owes its name. You also have a view into the open kitchen, where the food is lined up to be served. The ambience is romantic but I am not sure if I would say it is very private or quiet. So my husband did mention it was an anniversary dinner but we got a table in between a booth and another table. It's not like we were having a conversation that needed privacy. But we were so close to the next table, that I practically heard all of their conversation. The occupancy is high, so naturally the place will get loud and consequentially people would have to speak up, that may lead to overhearing conversations. 

Since, most people kept raving about 5&T as romantic, just be wary that although romantic, proximity of table to table is really not that private. Just putting it out there, to those who are planning. 

Now to the service and food, I would say incredible for such a busy evening. We went on a Saturday evening and the place was packed but our server was with us right away and the food came to us in good time. We ordered an app, two mains and dessert. So we got the beef tartare and our server told us to enjoy everything on the plate in a bite. We followed his advice and totally enjoyed the well balanced flavors. I highly recommend it if you enjoy raw meat. The capers, parsley, acidity from the lime, with the horseradish condiment and creamy richness of the poached egg truly made the tartare addictive. They also gave us a second helping of crostini. 

As mentioned the quantity is plenty, and I am delighted to speak highly of 5&T as a place that truly delivers quantity and quality for the price. However, they do charge a $5 split fee on an entree, which got us to order two mains. But honestly two mains between the two of us was a lot of food. We would have been fine with just one main because the portiond are generous and indeed to be shared. Each main comes with a good helping of mashed potatoes. Because we ordered two mains, we requested one to be mashed and one to be fries, which they kindly obliged. 

The beef cheek hands down is a must have. It is delicious delicious throughout. The beef is as soft as cotton, the lumps will melt in your mouth. The gravy is a beautiful rich and hearty flavor. And there are a few pieces carrot, zucchini, tomato and celery leaf garnish. That gravy was to die for. The mashed potatoes were silky, smooth and creamy and paired so well with the beef. Enjoyed every bite and I can see why that is so popular. The second main was the beer can chicken. The gravy is poured out of a beer can, which is a cool touch. The chicken is succulent and delicious. However, my advice would be to have this main before the beef, or do not order along side the beef cheek. The flavor is milder and not as rich as the beef cheeks. In my case I started with the beef and then had the chicken, so I didn't enjoy it as much as my husband who had the chicken first and then the beef.

The fries were good, a lot and I could only get through half of it. They were thin cut, crispy and  balanced out the rich creamy textures. However, can't say it was the best fries I had. 

We decided to order a dessert in spite of being stuffed. We got the lemon berry icebox cake, which was new on their menu. It was a beautiful refreshing flavor following the heavy main. Since, I don't bake lemon cakes I loved the softness of it with the cold blackberry ice-cream like filling, topped with berry meringue. Meringues are so tricky, as simple as they sound, it requires skill to get the right crunchy texture. I loved the berry flavor, the crunchy texture with the soft cake and cold blackberry ice cream was like a party in my mouth. The only negative thing is the blackberry ice-cream was so cold it was very hard to scoop out a bite. It was truly an icebox we couldn't cut into easily. 

The evening nonetheless was memorable. And we look forward to visiting again.

Fyi, they offer complimentary parking- Pretty fancy because you can let them know through the website you are checking out of the restaurant and they will have your car waiting by the time you exit. You can also tip the valet boys through that. Sweet arrangement!
name: Zara

text:
Oh wow!! 

Sometimes the fella gets it so right it's scary!

Today we had the cable guy coming out to install service at the new house, when we got there, the air conditioner was not working... we waited from 10 til 2 for the cable guy and were hot, cranky, and starving when we finally wandered out for food. We had 2 hours until the ac guy came so the fella suggested we head here as he had seen it mentioned on Reddit.

We arrived at the restaurant easily enough, good parking in the back if the front is full, I would have appreciated that more if I weren't beyond hangry right then.

We were greeted cheerfully as soon as we entered, and told we could sit anywhere. The restaurant was very clean and tastefully decorated. It was late for lunch but there were still a few other tables occupied.

We ordered way too much food and topped it off with a very large dessert! Everything was absolutely delicious! Huge portions for the price as well. The cinnamon iced tea... I'd stop in just for that!

We were checked on throughout the meal and the food arrived quickly from appetizer on through dessert, it's possible we looked ready to eat the table leg when we walked in... but I think they treat everyone this well. 

Drinks never dipped below half full, and the check was delivered after we had eaten, but before the food coma rendered us unable to move!

All in all, this is a meal I won't soon forget! We walked out happy, full, and ready to wait for the ac guy to come save us!

text: Went for HH and had brussels sprouts, smoked chicken wings (Seoul sauced), and brunch burger.  Everything was really delicious and portions was very generous.  The brunch burger was one of the best burgers I've ever had...the patty is amazing and the egg made it extra special.  Burger, fries, and 2 beers for $15 is a great value but the fact that it tastes amazing makes it even better.  The brussels sprouts had a nice smoky and sweet taste...the portions are ginormous and we ended up taking most of it home for later (yay).  The wings were good too but our least favorite among what we got...the sauce was great but the meat was a bit dry and the kimchi was just so so (I'm a harsh critic on kimchi though because I'm Korean born/raised).  The restaurant is a bit hidden off of Carrollton Ave...thanks to GPS we didn't miss it but we wouldn't have seen it just driving by.  Small parking lot and no problems finding a spot.  Service was fine...nothing spectacular but straight to the point.  Restaurant was pretty empty with a few people at the bar and maybe 1 or 2 tables.  Not sure if they're always that slow but really hope they market their restaurant because I would hate to see them close for lack of business.  They seem to be trying though as I'm seeing favebook ads, owner posting on fb food pages, and offering specials.

Well, I enjoyed the Motha Clucka so much that I am giving the Plum Bistro 5 stars for now.  It was just so good, and so different, than any other sandwiches I've come across in the area - jam packed with smoked chicken, apple slaw, steak fries and a hot-but-not-too-hot jerk sauce.  Seriously - it was yummy.  The candied walnut salad that we got was also very good, although one of my girls complained that the walnuts were "too candied" - I'm gonna just blame that comment on the health kick that she's on because I adored everything about that salad.

That said, we decided that the paninis were just okay - they could use some sort of sauce or something, like a garlic aioli maybe - just for a little more oomph. And while we liked the décor in the place, it just didn't feel very cozy and we couldn't help but notice that the table was wobbly and needed to be wiped off.  

Anyway, I know they opened very recently so I'm sure they will just keep getting better and better.  I can't wait to try their brunch - friends of ours have been there several times for brunch and just keep raving about it.  Will be trying that ASAP!
