text: Great seafood. The San Francisco was to die for. Had the crab wantons and clam chowder was also very good. Little bit busy, but service was great.
name: Chris

text: Awesome crawfish étouffée. The crawfish bread & the firecracker shrimp appetizer is my favorite. I love being able to sit outside on the lake. The servers always have such a great spirit & so friendly. It is a great place to go.
name: Sydney Claire

text: Service by two employees was extremely rude, felt like we were bothering them to order. The food was not looking right we took it back. They said what looks ok then laughed, I got my money back and will never go here again. Manager was less than helpful.
name: Chris

text: The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. A couple small things kept adding up. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Maybe other people have better luck here. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: Came and decided to try this spot out. Atmosphere okay. Gets pretty busy when it first opens so I could only imagine how busy it is during lunchtime. Seems like a local spot. Food I thought was okay but a bit overpriced. Was good to try but probably won't be eating here again.
name: Malia

text: These oysters are delicious! I have eaten them 2x per day and I want more! I also had the stuffed crab and the stuffed lobster. The dishes were okay. The filling is like a stuffing or dressing, but I came back for the oysters!
name: Shirley

text:
I had a very bad experience here a couple of years ago and haven't been back since. I don't know what happened to my original review so I can't update it is here's my new review. 

The service is much better. The music isn't blaring any more. The sandwich was good but it ain't Jersey. I don't know what happened to the bread they used to use but it was what made the sub feel like I was back in Jersey. The bread I had today was the same as all the other sandwich shops in town. Hero/sub rolls back east have a crunch to them. Not here. 

I went today because it's charity giving day. I don't know if I'll go back

In response to the owners response I am from the East Coast. As a matter of fact I'm from New Jersey. Don't know how you bake or store your bread but it tastes nothing like sub rolls I'm used to.
name: Joanne

text: Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Idk, the portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. For a busy night they handled it okay. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.
name: User

text: I ordered Uber Eats from here and found that the Picadillo was just okay. The taste wasn't anything to brag or boast about. I was disappointed that it also contained peas in it which I ended up picking out. I did love the stuffed potato though! If you're looking for amazing Picadillo, check out Habana Café in Gulfport.
name: Jennifer

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. It felt a little understaffed, especially near the end of the meal. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Maybe better dine-in than delivery, hard to tell. Food was fresh and service was quick.
name: User

text: Medford Burger King. Manager & cook, dirty, service terrible, food terrible. Nobody goes there because it is horrible ! Seriously, this place should be SHUT DOWN !
name: Jack

text: Highly recommend!!!  My nephew wanted BBQ for his rehearsal dinner out on the west coast to remind him of his Southern roots and Neighbor Tim's delivered.  They showed up early with a professional staff in uniform and set up the buffet style food and drinks flawlessly.  The BBQ pork ribs and beef brisket, mac and cheese, beans and slaw were delicious, and there was more than enough food for the 80 plus guests.  We were planning the event from out of state, so we were very thankful to find a reliable vendor and the accommodating friendly service.   They remained unflappable when the Tent Merchant from whom we rented tables and chairs failed to show for set up.  They worked with us and were very understanding when we were left on our own to unstack chairs and set up the buffet tables and drink stand.  Their professionalism saved the day!
name: Kim

text: Burgers were awesome! Natural fries were freat! And I tried their veggie burger and it was amazing! Customer service was mediocre otherwise I would have gave 5 stars! Would just like to have someone smile at you when ordering vs staring blankly.
name: Jametria

text: Sat outside for dinner at 10pm, it was great! Ordered the Lobster Mac & Cheese, fresh and bubbling from the oven, it was awesome.  Service was great.
name: Lew

text: Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The food was good and the service was easygoing. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
Really enjoyed my lunch here today. Stopped in based on other favorable Yelp reviews and was not disappointed. The service was very friendly and the food and drinks were excellent. 
           The Falafel Sliders were outstanding. The Falafel were as good if not better than any I have had in good Middle Eastern restaurants. They were crispy on the outside and tasty creamy inside. The vegetables that came with the Sliders were fresh and crispy. 
             My Pan Seared Cod with Baby Clams and Chorizo Sausage was perfectly cooked and the butter broth was delicious. I only wish there was more bread to sop up all that goodness. 
               The Salmon with Soy Ginger was also a hit. The cabbage slaw and Brussel Sprout Noodles were a healthy base for the fish.   Definitely a return trip to this comfortable place is in the cards.
name: Steve

text: My favorite restaurant in Westchase! I've never had a bad meal here. It's also super great for vegetarian food--a ton of options! My favorites are the truffle fries, truffle mac n cheese bites, caesar salad, and grilled cheese! I take pretty much all of my friends and family here when they're visiting.
name: Dede

text: The photos made it look a little better than it actually was. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. This feels like a place where your order choice matters a lot.
name: User

text:
I called to reserve a spot to see a BB game I didn't want to miss. 
I talked to Chris, the bar manager. He assured me the game would be on and my seat would be ready. 
Wow, was he right. 
Not only do they have terrific TVs, they bring you a speaker box TO THE TABLE! How great is that?
Zoo's is now my go-to place for watching games and having a good meal and an adult beverage. Their list of craft brews is crazy good. 
The service was terrific; my meal came out in minutes and, to my surprise, Chris who was actually off duty, came to my table to check that everything was as I expected. 
I'd say they exceeded my expectations.
name: Dan

text:
We are from out of town (7 hr drive) and needed a quick bite to eat.  The breakfast hash wrap and bacon egg biscuit were very good. However, the high volumes of uber eats and to go orders this morning is insane.  They have 1 person making the food for all eat in orders and 4-5 for the to gos/online orders.   I would've given 5 stars had it not been the 60 min wait.   My party of 4 all got our food 12-15 mins apart.  As I'm writing this review, the last order in my party still hasn't gotten her food yet.  I would definitely come back again if management streamlines the whole process.  

The last order of food is here now and it's good.  The only cook assembling eat-in orders was very nice and I see her working constantly.  

Foods good, service is good.   Management needs to rethink its priority of uber eats vs order ins.
name: Jung

text: Absolutely delicious! The service was just as good as the food. My boyfriend and I will definitely be returning. Everyone was so kind. Shoutout to Alejandro, the cook!
name: Jamya

text:
We had a terrific dinner here on our 1st night visiting this city.  It was within walking distance from the Kimpton where we have set up camp for the week.  The girlfriend did her search and said this restaurant had good reviews.  She said the prices are good and people have said the food is pretty authentic.  
I'm happy with Italian food any day of the week plus I was famished after my power nap and totally able and willing to eat a damn horse.  
We had the Mussels (white) to start off.  I ordered the Crabmeat ravioli and she had the Veal satimbocca.  I told her we are Californians and eating Veal is tantamount to blasphemy.  She shrugged & said, " I'm going to hell anyway."  The poor woman ‍.  
The food was delicious and the veal was superb too.  Mmmm mmmm delicious.
name: Michael

text: Three of us seated pretty quickly. Overall not very busy but we noticed no one that was seated had their food yet. A gentleman walked in right after us and left after not getting a waitress for ten minutes.  After 20 minutes of us waiting without any food and the waitress letting us know that the dishwashers were cooking the food we got up and left. Staff wandering aimlessly it seemed. Have been previously for drinks without any issues but today was SLOW.
name: Jacob

text: Loved it.  Wasn't what we expected. We thought it was a regular sit down and order restaurant.   You get in line (because it's popular) and order at the counter.  Once you order they find you a table and then they will bring you your food.  We all loved what we had and the portions are big.
name: Tom

text:
We have been getting food from Ateethi for a while now. Some of their food is pretty good, should try their chicken biriyani. 
But dine-in is very lackluster. I have been to the dine in more than a couple times and each time worse than the previous. The last time I was there about  a week ago, the food was dull, the tables had no table cloth and disposable plates and it was  dark. One of the guests had to request to have the lights turned on. There was absolutely no ambience and uncomfortably awkward. Please pick up your game.
name: Mellie

text:
We decided to go out and try Dave's for dinner tonight since we had a gift certificate left over from Christmas, that one of our friends had blessed us with. 

I decided to try the burnt ends since I love brisket and Micah had a hamburger (his go to favorite item no matter where we go). 

The slaw, corn muffin, and Wilbur beans were all very tasty, but I was a little disappointed with the portion of burnt ends, even though they tasted great. It just seems like every BBQ place I've been in the last week has had small portions (but then again, they have been chains...so that probably answers it).

For being a chain however, Famous Dave's had some pretty good food which didn't taste like it came out of a package and was just reheated and served. I will probably bring the whole family back and give them another try in the near future.
name: Mike

text: For the price I expected a little more care. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Parking was annoying, although that's probably more about the area than the restaurant. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text: Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. The whole meal felt kinda uneven. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Not sure though.
name: User

text: Always great service and food. Sitting outside when the weather is nice is awesome. Love when the fire is going. Also, their spicy margarita (I think I just order it and it's not on the regular menu) is my favorite in Indy.
name: Song

text: This is probably one of the best ribeye steaks I've ever had. It was cooked to perfection with just the right amount of rawness. I was hesitant on the side of Onion rings but they were also a great compliment to the dish. My buddies got filet mignon and that wasn't too awesome apparently. Shoestring fries are a hit too!
name: Jon

text: This is my first time in the area, scouting out colleges and trying to see if I can find places to go and eat frequently. I bought the spicy grinder, ate it at the hotel, and almost cried. It was the best sandwich I have ever had and I don't think I'll have one as fantastic as that one, ever again. The slushee-type drinks were so good, and I'm going back later today to go try the iced tea one. Honestly, what a sandwich shop. My expectations have been set so high, only Eegee's can reach them now.
name: Kitty

text: Really disappointed, as this place had been tip-top previously.  The food was probably great when it left the restaurant, but it arrived cold and pulverized.  Nobody wants to have to scrape cheese off the inside of the box and try to re-assemble their food and then re-heat it.  I essentially paid for ingredients.  The preparation was on me.
name: James

text: Excellent tasting burger and their fries are delicious! I would strongly recommend them & I'll definitely be coming back again!
name: JB

text: Gave this place two chances and both time service and food quality was sub-par. The staff seems so unhappy working let alone having serve customers. Rice was so overcooked and not fresh (pieces of skin like flakes in the white rice). Sweet chicken also was not fresh. Only redeeming quality was the teriyaki sauce. I'll stick with the Bear location thanks.
name: Kimberly

text: Portion size looked small at first but it was actually enough. Parking was annoying, although that's prob more about the area than the restaurant. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon. Would probably stop in again if nearby.
name: User

text: I never go out of my way to post but this place was so bad I had to. I ordered a chicken parm sandwich and got coldcuts on bread with little to no sauce and a little amount of cheese. I had to throw the whole thing out. How are you going to call that chicken parm and call the store "the original Italian pie". Any Italian knows you use chicken cutlets. I will never order from here again.
name: Andrew

text:
Nope nope nope! 

I am from Reno and just moved to Vegas a month ago. I have family here so my plan is to come up once a month and stay for a long weekend to visit. Nugget use to be my recommendation to friends and family visiting but I will not recommend this place, nor stay here myself. 

To start, I checked in on a Wednesday night... 1 person working the desk and 12 people in line. It took me 45 minutes just to check in. The girl at the check in counter was very sweet and let her know I would like a room by the elevator and she a accommodated. 

Get to my room and my door want closed... it just pushed open, but if you think I am going back down there and waiting in line for 45 minutes, you're crazy. 

I put 911 on my phone and had to clear my room to make sure no one was in there. 

Ok, I'm safe. I think. My room is in the casino tower... do you have to request a nice room to get the nice tower? The room is eh, but it's after 10pm at this point and I am exhausted. Since it took so long to check in - room service is closed. Front desk girl said it closes at 10. So I walked down to Rosie's cafe to get food. 

They were nice enough. Food was ok. The lady behind the counter was fighting with one of the servers... it was awkward. Got my food and left. 

The bed was so uncomfortable. No matter where I moved there were springs poking into my back. I tossed all night. 

Got up to take a shower.... and there was a roach in my bathroom (pic included) so now I am so grossed out. The floors in the bathroom were disgusting, dirt and black hair all over... I am a strawberry blonde... this is not my hair.

I turn the shower on for about 30 seconds and it started to fill up... so I was taking a shower in a bath of water and having to turn the water off every few minutes to let the water drain.

I never felt relaxed here and it was just a disappointment all around. 

(For some reason my photos won't save)
name: Jayme

text:
I heard so many good things about this place, so we came to try it out. 

We ordered the fish taco, el pastor taco, portobello taco and some friends got the carne asada. Everyone said their tacos were good but the weird thing is no one said they would come back. I thought about it and I wasn't sure I would come back either, as I am more of a chicken and pastor guy myself and didn't think the pastor they had was anything to come out of my way for. For all the hype though I expected more I guess and for $4.00 price per taco, I felt the quality should be better and maybe increase the quantity to make it more of something to desire. La Barca tacos have my attention and their prices to me are appropriate especially for their great taste of marinated chicken and iconic red sauce on the shells.
name: Nilay

text: We came her after a movie nearby because of the reviews. We were pleasantly surprised at the good quality, friendly, clean restaurant. it's not fancy but clean and delicious food. Lots of southern fried yumminess!!! There were Tv's with lots of college football and it is a fun atmosphere. Loved the fried pickles, and my hubby loved some BBQ. The mac n cheese was good and the sweet tea delicious! We'll return for a fun, good solid meal!
name: Tamara

text:
This charming place is comfortable, quant, and conveniently located. It's an easy walk to many of Lambertville shops and historical places.

The open area is a wonderful spot for relaxing and chatting with others. Every morning there are fresh flowers, coffee, tea, plenty of snacks, and baked goods. The owners are fun and considerate- even in a snowstorm they thought of every possible outcome and were prepared.

I can't wait to stay here again!
name: Carole

text: Amazing breakfast and fast friendly service! I ate every single bite!  I loved the shredded hash browns and my eggs were cooked perfectly. Will definitely be back.
name: Jessica

text: Wondering what happened to this place, after hiroba left why did it change so much? Its like eating sushi at a gas station, you can try it out for yourself but know that you have been warned. Im so disappointed i saw the good reviews and gave it a try but i guess nobody will find out until they try it out for themselves.
name: Daniel

text: Fabulous restaurant went here on a date with hubby. We enjoy the atmosphere and the lighting. This is a restaurant with delicious  food I absolutely loved  the chicken hands down it was very tender and juicy. You would have to try it. Hands down 5 starts and I will definitely visit again.
name: Maritha

text:
Service was very slow. Waitress was pleasant but had far too many tables. Steak was not cooked as ordered but the shrimp was good. However for $45 for surf turf would expect it to taste a little better. 
My sushi was good.
Expect to spend a few hours here. If planning a slow moving evening with lots of chatting and you enjoy seafood probably a better bet for you.
name: Dani

text: This probably was an off night for the restaurant, we ordered the Korean fried chicken due to the rave Yelp reviews and were not impressed. It seemed like there was more batter than actual chicken. But the owner came by and explained to us that " that is how Korean friend chicken is". The sushi was subpar, reminiscent of something you would get out of a supermarket. The fish just was not fresh. I may go back to give it a re-do but the chances are slim.
name: Jasmine

text: Love Adam's! Come every time I'm in town, right around the corner from my sister's house. The Po Boy's and all food from the grill are 5 star! You can also find most sundries you may need. If you go around lunchtime be prepared to wait a bit longer, all the locals eat there. Also, I only get half a Po Boy bc they are so large and filling!
name: Cynthia

text: The worst steak and shake ever! Was really looking to one being closer and on the south side of reno. I went to the one on the other side of reno and it's nothing like this one in South reno . This place gives steak and shake an awful name. After waiting in the drive through for 10-15minutes after driving over 30 minutes away and wanting something alright we finally got our order it was completely wrong. No sauce there was sauce, The food was soggy, and The milkshake was one of the worst things I've ever tasted. It tasted like ice and syrup. The girl at the window was completely rude and unprofessional as she was trying to fraternize with my so with my child and i right there. We will not be returning and we will not be recommending this place to anyone.
name: Sierra

text:
Great stop on a hot summer day, they have many items  to choose from and many toppings to go along with the base of your bowl.  

Downside with extra rollins, the price can get up last $8.00 so watch out!
name: Ashley

text: Love honey-grow when I'm in the mood for a good stir fry. The ginger soy sauce is amazing. Only giving four starts because it is on the pricier side.
name: Marissa

text: 3.5 stars. I'll round up because I'm probably gonna eat there again so I guess I'll give it a 4 star. Tried this place twice and I'm trying really hard to love it but it falls short. Wings were fried to a crisp the second time we ate there. I said I wanted the pizza crispy! Instead the wings were scorched instead of flash fried. Tasted like they salted the wings after they fried them. I could see salt crystals. Not good. Wings were better the first time, no complaints the first time). The pizza has decent flavor but it's just missing that wood fired cracker crust and I don't think they understand that so I'm just gonna stop asking for it. Their dough is very soft. If you watch YouTube pizza making reviews or if you've actually had real world class pizza you'd know that a good proper pizza dough and crust will give you a good little crispy "crunch". Great pizza is not supposed to "flop" like a limp noodle. Great pizza dough is not super soft. C'mon man get some crunch! Please for the love of pizza! Epic search for a nice cracker crunchy pizza pie.
name: Sam

text: Went to the Diva's brunch on Sunday. The show and entertainment were top notch. If this review were based on good quality alone, it be a 2. But because of the high quality of the entertainment, I am rating it higher. Because of the small crowd, they only offered the buffet brunch (rather than having regular menu items available). The brunch was so-so at best (we were among the first to get there and the food wasn't at temperature. Also, there were items that just weren't cooked properly - the bacon was soggy and limp, the pancakes altered between over-cooked and crisp and floppy and undone). The brunch was only $15, but for the quality I felt that it was over priced. They also advertised a "make your own Bloody Mary bar" but all it consisted of was pickles, olives, banana peppers, a few different kinds of hot sauce and two different kinds of mix. Having lived in Wisconsin and having some pretty epic Blood Mary Bars, this was disappointing at best. I would definitely recommend this place when you can order off the menu and get fresh food...skip the buffet... definitely check out the show!!
name: Lesley

text:
I recently went here for brunch with my BF on a Sunday afternoon. I ordered the waffle platter and he ordered the French toast platter. My food was okay, the waffle was good. The menu has about 5 choices on it for brunch, not too extensive.

I would go back but for lunch or dinner, the brunch menu was just okay.
name: Rosanne

text:
I wish I could give them 0 stars 
A few months ago I came here in my lunch break and the lobby door was locked and had a sign on it that read "lobby us closed due to no employees" so I left. Then I tried them for breakfast it was great the first time! I came back 2 and both times my order was wrong I got a breakfast scramble and it was just potatoes and cheese. I go there today at 9am. There is a line of 2 cars in front of me and one behind me no one is answering the speaker in drive thru. Line continues people get pissed and drive off then I get to the speaker no answer I go to the window no one. I go to the front door just to say can you at least put a sign up or a headset on to let us know! I see inside there are 2 girls hiding by the grills in the back. Poor people wasting their time! I drove around and let everyone know not to sit there forever. This is the worst Taco Bell I don't even know why I try to go there.
name: Ursa

text: The food was  good but somewhat overpriced.  Unforgivable, however, is the fact that our order was taken by the chef himself -- who then got it WRONG.  When we told him this, he just shrugged.  Did not offer to bring the correct dish.  He became suddenly silent, placed the dish in front of us and walked away.    We were speechless.  I don't like to make a fuss in front of other diners, but maybe I should have. I noticed another reviewer had the same problem with the same results.   Will never return.
name: Karen

text: Always clean! The lady on the phone is a bit harsh but they are always good for your basic Chinese American fare
name: Mark

text: We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. The music was louder than it needed to be. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nothing about the space really stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. Glad we tried it. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: The first few bites were promising and then it kind of leveled out. It was clean enough and the tables were being turned over pretty fast. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again.
name: User

text: I don't really get some of the harsh reviews on here. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. I had a better visit than I expected to. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Food was good and came out fast. For the price I expected more than this. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing was awful but I left disappointed.
name: User

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The place has that neighborhood spot feel, not fancy at all. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold.
name: User

text:
Excellent hoagies. Get it "Mike's Way" and that oil/vinegar/spices concoction is just right on an Italian Hoagie! And since we often take-out from here, they accommodate my request to put the "Mike's Dressing" on the side so the hoagie roll doesn't get soggy on the ride home! Every sandwich we've ever gotten here has been tasty and good...bacon/chicken/ranch, Italian Hoagie, hot roast beef and cheese...all great! Choice of white, wheat or seeded rolls, as I recall. Some sandwiches come in a "mini size" too besides regular and large, which is actually quite generous since the rolls are WIDE, but some you can get in only two sizes, and not the "mini." 

Recommend. Nice kids work the counter. Pepsi products only is my only complaint as I prefer Coke products!
name: Elissa

text: Holy smokes.  Avocado Toast supreme was fabulous.  Nearly groaned with pleasure while eating.  Thick whole grain sourdough bread.  Nice temperature (not a big fan of cold toasts).  I had a similar order at the highly rated Willa Jeans the previous day and this was FAR superior and 30% less expensive.
name: Ruth

text: This location just opened & there is nothing like a nice clean restaurant to try. I haven't had Zaxby's in over 10 years and was hoping the food was as good as I remembered. The location can be a little difficult to get to unless you're driving south on Belcher, but worth the few turns it takes. There is plenty of parking available wrapping around the restaurant. There is also a drive through. I tried a chicken finger plate. It came with the # of tenders you request, cole slaw, garlic toast, fries, zaxby sauce and a drink. The price was spot on. The do charge for extra sauces, but it's $.20 so not that big of a deal. And I switched my fries out for chips at no charge & the seasoned chips are delicious. They have one of those state of the art soda machines so your options of a drink are pretty limitless. The food was delicious. Tender chicken well seasoned, crispy chips or crinkle fries. Their cole slaw is pretty average, but still tasty. The restaurant was clean and the staff was friendly. The turn around time on our food was quick, as it is technically fast food, but not the greasy drippy kind. We're glad to have this in the neighborhood and will probably be there quite frequently.
name: Caryn

text: Basing my 4 stars on their margaritas more than their food. Their food isn't bad but just same ole Mexican fare. I like to get to Guadalajara special which is chicken-and shrimp combo with side of Chihuahua cheese. Food arrives quickly. They are very good about serving plenty of chips and salsa. As I mentioned their margaritas are pretty darn good. I usually get mine on the rocks however I tasted my brothers frozen margarita- wow was it strong. Not sure all the frozen margaritas are that strong or there was a little extra in his pitcher. They also let us a bring a cake in so that was nice.
name: Renee

text:
After moving to Fishers, I was extremely excited at the prospect of a butcher shop in our town that we could rely on. Sadly, I was super disappointed by Moody's and ended up going back to my tried and true, Joe's Butcher Shop in Carmel. 

My partner and I were interested in getting a Picanha cut of meat, which is top sirloin with the fat cap still on. We went in on a Sunday and the Moody's staff were very friendly and nice, and we put in an order for exactly what we wanted and were told to come back tomorrow to pick up our meat. I came the next day and Moody's staff told me that I should come instead on Wednesday and they would get their shipment in then. I was disappointed that our meat wasnt ready, but they promised us a discount so I felt slightly less crestfallen. 

On Wednesday, I called the store and was told that their butcher had a family emergency and would be unable to complete my order until Thursday, but on Thursday they would call me first thing in the morning and let me know what was going on. After not receiving a call Thursday, I called the store and was told they DIDNT HAVE MY ORDER. After assuring them that they I had put my order in on SUNDAY no less, and called multiple days in a row, they said that they found my order, but that they couldnt find what I ordered and they'd call me back after they found it. 

After never receiving a call back, I called Joe's who had my Picanha wrapped up and ready for me in less than 30 minutes. I am incredibly confused how a butcher shop, who most likely makes a substantial amount of money on orders, was unable to complete my order with so many days notice. Do yourself a favor if you want something more complicated than ground beef or sliced bacon, go to Joes.
name: Sarah

text: Outstanding burger, the best I've had in a long-time. Comfortable atmosphere, service was great. Try the shrimp rings.
name: Steven

text:
First time ever here.... not sure if the server was busy before we received the food we ordered or what but he didn't ask us what we wanted to drink or anything.  He just came to ask us what we wanted to eat and that was It. No refills, no check ins, or anything. 

After we ordered our food he brought It to our table then checked on us once and then gave us the bill. He didn't say thank you for coming or anything after he gave us the check back. Another waiter even came to tell us thank you since he did not. There wasn't many people in there so im not sure what was up. But you never know. 

I always share the BBQ chicken and ribs with my boyfriend. I was extremely surprised, but the chicken barely had any sauce so It was very plain. The Thai ribs were good though. I've never had a problem with ordering this meal, I've gotten this meal for many many years and never had any issues, I always love It! I was very upset with my experience here since I love Zeas so much. :(
name: Ashleigh

text: I have never had a bad dining experience here !  The ginger curry chicken & shrimp is AMAZING !   Just watch the spice level, 3 is my max !
name: Stacey

text: This location is very clean... They offer plenty of choices. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. And the price is great too!!
name: Kathleen

text:
Lovely patio area! The food comes in large portions and is comparable to most other pub fare. We had the Asian Tots appetizer and really enjoyed it. I ordered chicken sliders but they were like full chicken sandwiches! 

Tip: don't go with the French fries - they weren't so great. I would recommend the fresh fruit though! 

Our waitress was very friendly and prompt.

Parking behind the restaurant with plenty of street spots if that's full.
name: Amy

text: I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Food was fresh and service was quick. Will be back. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Food was amazing. While it is a bit pricey, it's well worth it. Probably some of the freshest seafood in town. I would recommend the scallops, which were cooked to perfection , or the fried clam strips, which were seasoned perfectly. The server was very knowledgeable, friendly and only checked in when something was needed, leaving us for a prefect night.
name: Matthew

text:
My first experience at Sardella occurred on Monday for lunch and it was pleasant for the most part. This restaurant is beautiful and has a bright, sophisticated airiness to it that was refreshing. I admit, my waitress was nice but my service could have been better. I asked for sweetener with my unsweetened tea and waited for a while before she came back in which I had to remind her that I asked for the sweetener. She was stretched as there were only three servers working the entire restaurant. Even the hostess was bringing out dishes to tables. 

I was prepared to reflect the waits with my service in my score, but my burger was FAN-TASTIC! My waitress recommended it and I'm glad that I followed her suggestion! It was well-prepared, juicy and had lots of good flavor with the mushrooms, carmelized onions, and delicious melty cheese! So good! I'll definitely return here, for that burger if nothing else. It took a long time to arrive but it was well worth the wait!
name: Caprice

text: Horrid service, we waited 1 1/2 hour and both manager and hostesses blew us off. We were told 1 hour and watched many get seated ahead of us. They say no reservations but you can call  and they will give you a spot in their line. Uhm isn't that a reservation???? Poor people skills! Manager kept saying if you stop yelling at me....when the rest of the people sitting with us in wait (none that we knew) said our voices never raised. Very frustrating indeed.
name: Bobby

text: I am obsessed with the MDF. I love their flavor combinations and their prices are pretty reasonable in my opinion. They can be on the slow side if you go when they're busy. But honestly, this is to be expected. This is not like a regular donut place where the employee just has to grab donuts and put them in a box. Each donut has to be glazed, decorated, drizzled, etc. If someone in front of you bought a dozen different donuts, it could take awhile! But I think it's well worth it! The ONLY reason I'm leaving 4 stars instead of 5 is because there isn't a changing table in the bathroom and the counter isn't big enough either. A place with mini donuts is obviously going to attract families, including ones with children in diapers. It was not fun changing my son on the bathroom floor.
name: Erin

text: This is my go to Chinese take out in Philadelphia. I have tried others and the General Tso's is the best here. My other favorites are their Crab Rangoon, egg or pizza rolls, and their fried wings are also delicious. I order more frequently then I should! They are extremely consistent.
name: Amanda

text: Excellent food and service.  We love to bring family when they come to town. Always a great experience.  All of the servers are so nice and go above and beyond.  Tonight our server made an origami frog for my son to enjoy!
name: Kristy

text: The food is horrible and the customer service is even worst. I was only stopping through while in the airport for a quick bite and this was the absolute worst choice. The pasta was burned (picture posted) and my waitress was very rude!
name: Britt

text: This truck is awesome. Definitely unique in its offerings. From jerk chicken to oxtail, it's unlike any truck in the area. The flavors are great. The price is a bit higher than other trucks but the quality and portions are well worth it. The sides are also amazing. I highly recommend this food truck.
name: Gus

text: So, I've been here a couple of times now, typically just to grab drinks. However, we decided to come on a Sunday for brunch. They have an all day brunch deal where you pay a certain amount (I think $15, sorry this is a late review) and you can eat whatever you want. I tried quiet a few things and everything sounds and looks good, however, everything is mediocre. They did have a DJ which I thought was cool for a Sunday morning. Anyways, here's some pics

text: Carl's is a great example of Americana dining.  Real burger joint food and drink that is timeless and delicious. I could wax poetically but it's all been said. Crispy juicy burgers, great fries and onion rings. Lunch is crazy busy so be patient, take in the ambience. Worth the wait.

text: Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. The music was louder than it needed to be. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. The food was good and the service was easygoing. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. Would probably stop in again if nearby.

text:

Let me tell you, their tacos were amazing! especially with the green and red sauce on the side- I think the red sauce was crazy hot but it was perfect for me. You can't beat the price either! I'm definitely going to be going there to grab food many times!

text: The staff coouldnt be bothered to even open on time and just stared at customers waiting outside to get in.  Id suggest a different option.

text: I wish I could give Salty's 5 starts, but due to the service I cannot. Our service left a sour taste in my mouth that even the delicious food could not cover. While we were being seated, my husband politely asked that our group of four be seated at an open corner table as opposed to a table that was in the middle of other occupied tables. Once we sat down, my friend headed to the bathroom and overheard our waitress made a snide comment to another girl working there about how we were sitting at her table. Um excuse me? text:
stopped here for lunch on a wednesday afternoon. the restaurant is cute and of decent size. i love'd the booths, super comfy and plush. it seemed like there were two ladies serving, an older lady (did not like her very much by the end of my experience) and a younger lady (who was really sweet, and made up for her older colleague)
we ordered: 
green onion cakes - really good
spring rolls - your average spring meat spring roll 
#22 brisket, flank, tendon, and crunchy flank pho - decent broth, the flank was almost to soft though, almost not crunch to the flank. however, they are very generous with the noodle and meat portion. Personally i prefer a little less noodle and more soup. But I won't say it's a negative. Also, the older server did not bring out my aromatics/bean sprouts for the pho, i had to ask her for the plate- definitely was not impressed. 
#43 three colour vermicelli, sub rice - the meat was very taste 
i also didn't really enjoy the taste of their fish sauce, had an odd taste in comparison to what i'm used to.
i noticed that table maintenance was also not great. my friend and i were there for about an hour and a half and the servers weren't really cleaning up after people left. they would just leave the booths with plates for at least 15 minutes before coming to clean, or if customers requested the dirty booth. 
when it was time to pay, the older lady did not know how to split the payment for the two appetizers and almost demanded that my friend and i two just put one dish on each tab. thankfully the younger lady came and split the tabs as we desired. 

overall, it's not an amazing pho spot in terms of food and service but if you live southwest it's nice to not have to travel far for some vietnamese cuisine.

text: My grouper was amazing!!!! It was a pretty thick cut and I had Mac and cheese, cheddar grits and collard greens! For an appetiZer i had the chicken flatbread, tasted kale Caesar salad and had garlic Parmesan oysters. My friend had the fillet cooked medium rare and said it was super tender.
name: Rita

text:
Holy fish grail. I found it... the best sushi in town. And that's saying a lot. 
Forget what you know about local sushi. This place isn't that.
It isn't all you can eat...yet it's better for it.
Today was a rough day. I was emotional and needed something to soothe my soul. Enter my girl Gabbi. She invited me to come eat lunch with her at her new favorite place, Cove.
Cove Sushi has familiar favorites with little twists added here and there. Things like Mountain, Spider, and Godzilla rolls grace the menu as local favs, while also adding new interesting options such as the Lilly pad and Chameleon. 
We started with hot tea to drink which was offered by the owner himself, there to roll sushi for us! It was cold so that sounded perfect!! 
We all ordered. I ordered the baked mussels, and opted for the rainbow poke salad instead of the dessert. (Best Poke I've had in a long time). The Sun Rise long roll which has crystal shrimp, cream cheese, salmon, lemon slices and spicy crab. I also ordered the salmon skin hand roll and a quail egg shooter. 
The owner, whose name I didn't get...(is an absolutely gorgeous man by the way)... and talked with us about his passions in his restaurant. His vision and what he wanted for it.
It was truly great to get to talk to and be served by the owner himself. It shows the amount of dedication and heart he puts into it.
The sushi was phenomenal. Silky, melt in your mouth consistency and beautiful, vibrant reds and oranges, proved that this fish was extremely fresh. The presentation was beautiful. The fish was beautiful and honestly, the way the menu is set up leaves plenty of room to mow down on enough sushi to fill up on! 
Seating is limited...yet I imagine this place taking off and having a larger location in no time.
I seriously can't wait to come back and try different items and explore more that Cove Sushi has to offer!!!
name: Stephanie

text:
Day before thanksgiving for lunch was very empty. May have been to our advantage since I've heard since the opening it has been packed and take a long time to get food. 
Environment and decor was just beautiful! I haven't been to Germany myself but I came with my mother who has lived in Germany before and visited multiple times the last 10 years and she quite enjoyed herself. We split one of the sausage dishes and I ordered warm beer cheese on the side to have with the pretzel. Very yummy! Not as big as I'd hoped but my husband got the burger and was huge! I also got a side of the spatzle which was pretty good, not known to be very flavorful but just add a little salt. Fries were very good with the burger. Burger had beef and pork mixture so it does taste slightly different than a regular burger but was alright. 
German food is different, and having been to the UK this past summer I can definitely attest to food in the states being more flavorful.
name: Emily

text: This place is great.  I live close by and go often.  Don't let a line scare you it move right along.  The staff is very friendly.  Everything I've had has been great. text: I always wondered about Bevo Mill (now called Das Bevo) having grown up in St Louis.  So when I suggested eating there to my 90-year-old mother and family, she jumped, having never been there in all her years.  We were impressed by the grounds and interior appearance.  Service and atmosphere were great.  But, let me tell you: none of us will ever eat there again.  My sister and I ordered with wiener (Pork) schnitzel with braised red cabbage and German potato salad.  Food was served promptly (probably sitting in a warming try!) and at a good temperature.  The schnitzel was kind of tasty but tough as shoe leather; the crispy bits from the outer breading were good.  The "braised" cabbage completely disappointed me; it was cooked well but tasteless -- no seasoning, not even caraway seeds graced it.  It was like they sliced up some red cabbage, boiled it, and slapped it on the plate.  So I turned to the German potato salad: halved red potatoes, again boiled, but drenched in plain white vinegar that stung the nose and mouth.  What?!!!  The other dished they served (sauerbraten and short ribs) were equally unimpressive.  Nobody of the five of us at the table had anything good to say about the food.  And none of us will return, fun windmill or no.
name: Keith

text:
4 stars because the yellowtail was stringy and not buttery like a good yellowtail should be. 
The rest was good.  
Ordered 2 pieces of yellowtail nigiri and a roll with salmon, yellowtail and avocado.  Roll was pretty good. The yellowtail cut in small pieces inside the roll was a lot more palatable and easier to eat.
Kind service with a smile.  They really try to accommodate you. 
On the other side of the restaurant there are some hibachi tables.  People were enjoying and it looked pretty good. 
You might want to stop next door and get some wonderful fresh bagels to take home. Pretty delicious New York style bagels.  
This Asian restaurant not worth a long drive, but if you are in the neighborhood, worth trying out.
name: Monica

text:
I've been trying different local BBQ spots when I'm in town, about once a month.  This was my first stop at Hogwood.  Great choice.  I would definitely recommend.  The staff was super friendly and offered recommendations.  The dude recommended Brisket but I'm a pork guy.  

It's sort of cafeteria style but not exactly.  You order at the first counter and the go past the prep line from there.  I was the only guest in line at my visit but it looks like they're set up to serve cafeteria style when busy.  They brought my food to the table, along with a full bottle of regular and spicy sauce.  At the end of my meal they checked back (for the second time) and dropped off a miniature moon-pie.  Nice touch.
  
I'm currently on a low-carb diet so the only thing I had was a half slab of ribs.  They were outstanding.  Thick and meaty.  They come served dry with 2 sauce options on the side to slather or dip to your preference.  They really didn't need any sauce, I ate my with and without to get the full experience.  The ribs were quite tender requiring just the right amount of "pull" to get the meat off the bone.  That's a tricky balance.  I had unsweet tea and it was also very good.  Not sure if they fresh brew it or not but it tasted like it.

My only knock would be the sides.  I didn't really want any this trip anyway but had I wanted some, they didn't have any that appealed to me.    How about some smoked bacon green beans or natural cut fries or something?

Not in the top 5 of best BBQ I've ever had but a darn good choice.  Every meal can't be best ever but I'm sure glad I tried Hogwood tonight.  I did buy a bottle of the spicy sauce to take home to St Louis.  I'm confident my wife will love it.  I learned they actually mix it up in-store using their regular (Red) sauce as a base.  Prices seemed very reasonable.
name: Mike

text: The staff was professional and attentive throughout the meal. You can tell they care about customer experience here. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Would return. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Nice little spot, decent portions too.

text:
We came here for a birthday fiesta and what a hidden gem!  I had no idea this existed.  I knew of a few outdoor courts in other parts of Tampa Bay, but none at all like this.  

The fact that this is indoors, serves alcohol and food makes it a great night out location.  This would be a great location for a date night, party, or even a team building event.  The food exceeded my expectations of typical bar food.  It seemed made to order.  We had the chicken nachos and two beers.  The bartenders were agreeable and chatty (if you wanted to be chatty, that is).  The place got busy as the night continued.  My only negative would be that as it got busier, it got very hot inside.  It was a relief to go outside (which is saying something for summertime in FL).

text:
Five stars does not indicate five star dining in this review. The high rating is because this establishment hits every mark for the category it is in. Casual dining that gives more than we've come to expect in Edmonton. 

Self seating was in effect but somebody welcomed us and told us to sit wherever we would like.  Efficient. 

Upon first glance the menu looks small but don't judge there is a lot to choose from. We arrived hungry and ordered fried pepperoni while we perused the menu choices. We were back and forth and between three of us we ended up with two pizzas and one lobster roll with side salad. 

Pepperoni - we weren't sure what was going to arrive but make sure you try these. Hot or mild with honey mustard dip. 

Donair pizza - lots of places have this pizza on the menu but be sure this one is better than any one you've tried previously. The donair sauce is generous and on point. 

Zambian Pizza - it was good but not memorable. 

Lobster Roll was perfectly flavoured. We took away the chips and bun and added a side salad. It came on a bed of coleslaw so the salad wasn't necessary.  I requested a grilled lemon on the side which was a good addition. 

Blueberry Donuts - order and discover for yourself. 

We will return and already know we are going to have pepperoni, mussels, donair and fish tacos. 

Almost forgot about the decor - very well done. Thanks Blowers and Grafton well played.  Shout out to Michel who was our server and took great care of us.
name: Amanda

text:

The best thin crust pizza and outstanding Chicago style Deep Dish pizza. The salads and appetizers are delicious . This restaurant is charming with an open air feeling !  They deliver as well.

text:
I wish the waitresses wore name tags because we were served by a lovely lady who was very efficient and friendly. I ordered the Construction Burro $7.99 (I chose sausage, jalapeno bacon and tomatoes) with a side order of hash browns $2.49 and my girlfriend got the Eggs, gravy and biscuit combination $9.79 and switched her bacon from jalapeno bacon for $1.33 upcharge. I showed the waitress and she was very apologetic and put in a rush order for the correct burro which came out in 5 minutes and was delicious. I would definitely return here and get the same thing because it was a really good meal at a great price.
The only reason I didn't give 5 stars was the mistake with the food (last time my girlfriend came here there was a mistake with her order too) and the fact it's really loud in here and it can be hard to have a conversation because of this (maybe this is why the waitress didn't hear my order properly, not her fault at all)

text:
I love Mexican food, so when my daughter suggested we eat at Rocco's Tacos last night it was a no brainer. Rocco's Tacos is a newer restaurant at International Plaza in the space that was previously Blue Martini. The decor is amazing...great casual atmosphere with beautiful and authentic Mexican art, furniture and fixtures. So kudos for creating great ambience. The tableside guacamole is super yummy. My daughter doesn't like spicy so we asked for mild and they gave me some jalapeños on the side so I could spice mine up. Guacamole is $13 but they give you a generous portion. Tacos are $3.50 - $3.75 for street taco sized tacos. Didn't order any drinks: stuck with water. Austin Queso was $11. Saw meals priced $15-$18. 

I was not impressed with the tacos or the service. We waited for our table for about 25 mins after being told it would be a 10-15 minute wait. Wed. Night it was moderately busy not slammed. There were several empty tables within sight that just needed to be cleared, wiped down. They got one of our orders wrong and we waited a while to get a replacement which was wrong again. We ordered tacos. Not that hard. 

Staff were pleasant enough but didn't seem concerned with providing great service or being cheerful to customers. After trying to get attention of our server 3x while we were waiting on our tacos, I got up to ask another server to have our server come to our table and he seemed like he didn't want to be bothered. Our server walked up just before I walked away and told me "I'll be right with you." About 5 mins passed then he strolled over and said, "what did you need?" as if it were a minor annoyance. 

Overall I was very disappointed. After dining many times at upscale Mexican restaurants in New York City, Washington DC and all over Texas, where the experience is amazing, Rocco's is not getting it done. The quality of food and service does not match the price level. Guacamole was good; tacos were so-so, I make better tacos at home. I will give it another try soon and will update my review when I do.
name: Yvonne

text: 14 dollars for 1 and a half chicken tenders... not a good value, this was a special and I should have known no to get the special, but requested to get i little more food and they told me it would be extras.

We ordered and of course we were standing right in front as they cooked our food. We got the prime rib sandwich. The head cook was multi tasking as most do but his helper kept walking away. We herd the cook ask the helper to watch the prime rib I should have known right then & there the sandwich wasn't going to be good. It was 80% fatty & I think I am being kind with that % for the amt. of money it cost they should be ashamed of themselves. I will never go back there. So disappointed.
name: Tee

text: This place is great!! Amazing ramen, pho fried rice, I could go on and on. Not to mention, super inexpensive!
name: Soha

text: This restaurant is a great gin bar. If you like gin, they have it. Try the Mad Men gimlet-it's tasty. Their falafels are some of the best I've ever had. The service was expeditious & they sat us right away. The prices are right too-not too expensive. Definitely worth the trip !
name: Lynne

text: This place was really cool and really phenomenal with just a great vegan Burger... This whole annex with the shipping containers is just really a cool thing and hopefully will be supported
name: Jim

text:
This used to be my favorite sushi restaurant. Loved the food, loved the area, loved the service. They have the best chirashi bowl I have ever had. After moving to New York almost 2 years ago, their chirashi bowl just wasn't comparable to Zento's, which was shocking to me since rumor has it that New York supposedly has really good sushi. 

However, I'm disappointed to say that during my last recent visit to Zento, the quality of the chirashi was not how I had remembered it. Not sure if they were going through some changes in their sushi chef since we were informed that they were pending approval in their liquor license, but I was both disappointed and embarrassed that the chirashi did not live up to my expectation after raving so much to my boyfriend about how great it was.
name: Lily

text: We've been here a few times trying different sandwiches but keep going back for their Beef n Cheddar. The other sandwiches ( French Dip, Garlic Butter Steak, Beer Braised Brisket,  Turkey Club) were okay but the old standard is still worth the trip there. The help is young and polite but could still use a little training. When placing a To-Go order it would be nice to see some napkins in the bag. Next trip I'm trying the sliders!
name: Elyse

text: Very entertaining tour guide and great food and beer menu
name: Pranesh

text: We looked up the restaurant on google/yelp, it had 4.5 stars, it should be .5 star! For a cpl of reasons, service, unless your Italian looking- avoid, if you are not a regular cust-stay away. If you want to wait an hour and a half just for garlic knots, and 2 cpls came in after us had a large calzone/large pizza, and another had a large pizza, then you are in the right place. The chef came out to talk w/ tables that had food or cust that are regulars that just came in. (Never once came to our table) When asking for refills on drinks, they totally have forgotten about us! The chef, instead of making things right, he was making excuses, ie: we dropped the pizza, the oven door keeps opening and closing, depending how of the orders came in!!! REALLY....They still had the audacity, and the willingness to charge us for the food that wasn't even prepared yet. We explained, that they can keep their food, just charge us for the drinks. They said "we have to charge for something, can't give you everything!" I could keep going, but at the end of the day, the heading states "What do you recommend about LITTLE ITALY's FAMILY RESTAURANT & CATERING? My recommendation is KEEP DRIVING, you will get better service from a high schooler at Hungry Howies making $10 hr!!!!....funny, how can we eat our food when it wasn't there! I am glad you have cameras in your restaurant, then you can see the time stamp of how long we waited for our food and how many times we asked the waitress and cook how much longer the food will take! Then if you notice, when I talked with your staff, I was nothing but polite and monotone, not raising my voice or using abusive language! Furthermore, we left the clams and pasta, we took the 2 pizzas home due to the fact the one time your waitress came over my 3yr old daughter asked "can we get pizza?" (With a big smile) If you consider that being abusive to your staff, maybe you should get your staff sensitivity training! ... I also tried to call, right after you posted your rebuttal, (13min after posting), nothing but voicemail! So you can call me at you earliest convenience so we can talk about why your staff made excuse after excuse, even though tables coming in after us and eating their entree before we even got our appetizer, I will be more than happy to speak with you! Saying goes, I embrace solutions, not excuses!!!
name: Presley

text: Came from out of town based on previous yelp reviews. Great value for what is served, along with taste. Huge portions along with side salads, soup, and bread. Shoutout to Samantha-she was great!
name: Kaleigh

text: I saw this place had 5 stars, not sure why at this point. The Geyoza tasted just like the kind I get and cook from schnucks. We all ordered and I got the tempura chicken roll. Once my parents food was brought I had to wait another 5 minuets for mine to come that was fine but when it came it was wrong it was some kind of seafood roll. Sooo then I had to wait another 10-15 min for them to make it. By the time it came my parents were almost done eating. Also the bulk of the food you get is just fried vegetables. You're better off going to sushi AI in O'Fallon they have much better food for the price and it's more authentic. Will not be coming back. Food also lacked flavor. I don't go out to eat to just me served a mound of fried stuff. Almost couldn't even tell what was inside each fried thing. I don't like to eat if I can't tell what's even inside. Had higher hopes based on pictures.
name: Sarah

text: Slow slow slow slow! Do not come here expecting to grab a bite to eat before heading to a game. The service is slowwwwwww. Great location, but that is the only reason we would ever come back.
name: Megan

text: I really wanted to rave about my recent visit to Jason's Deli. And I really hope to give them another try soon. Because all I have to critique is the chicken salad, which I did not care for at all. Pineapple (IMO) does not belong in chicken salad. That said, the croissant that it was on was delicious. Unfortunately, I ultimately threw away my lunch because I couldn't eat it.
name: Suzanne

text: Place your order first thing in the morning and give them most of the day to get it ready, if your lucky you'll only have to wait 45 mins when you come to pick it up later on.  Shut down already and reopen under new mgmt. Never going to this location again.
name: Dan

text: I love this place. I come here at least once a week. Staff is friendly, quick, and pleasant. Food is super good. It is tiny but the at home atmosphere is welcoming. They really do have the best bun bo hue in the city. No one else compares.
name: Lauren

text:
3/5 for Red Mesa Cantina. This trendy, mexican/latino fusion restaurant is in DT St. Pete. There was limited street parking around the restaurant and a garage across the street. I went after a Ray's game and parking was only $6. I wish I would have spent the time looking for free street parking since that was $6 I didn't think was well spent.

We walked up to Red Mesa Cantina and were seated pretty quickly, but it was also 4:30pm. They had a cute patio and inside themed with luchador masks. Our server was friendly.

We got the house margaritas and they were on the stronger side. I think they were only $6 and honestly I don't know if you could tell the difference between a house marg and one with their more expensive tequila. We also got the queso with meat (chorizo, I don't remember) and chips and salsa. It was OK. You shouldn't come here expecting the most authentic experience or food, it was slightly over priced.

For dinner I ordered their filet mignon tip burrito and it came with their rice and beans while my friend ordered the seafood mofongo. The burrito was decent, spicy, and a little soggy. The rice and beans were good. The mofongo was OK. My friend and I are from PR and know what real mofongo tastes like and this was decent. They blend plantains with yuca versus just one or the other so that was different.

Overall this looked like it was a little more lively and fun later in the evening. The food was over priced and overall OK. I probably wouldn't be quick to recommend it unless someone was looking for the specific vibe. I am not local but probably wouldn't go back. I'm sure there are cheaper, better restaurants to go to.
name: Christine

text: Went to see Spider-Man tonight and I was extremely impressed with their customer service. From the greeters at the door to the servers, proactive in identifying your needs and very efficient with their workflow. Impressed!
name: Unicorn

text: Food was good and came out fast. Also, solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. Idk, food was fresh and service was quick. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Food was fresh and service was quick. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text: This is a small bakery with very, very, very limited items, and what they sell doesn't even taste good. Strike one they don't sell pound cake by the slice. Hello, Not everyone wants a whole pound cake. Strike 2 they only sell about 7 different types of cookies and use the same bland white cookie dough for every one, even chocolate chip. White, tasteless chocolate chip cookies anyone? I'll pass. Strike 3 I tried 2 of the 3 types of donuts they sell and they just weren't good at all. Not even worth going here unless you live like right around the corner, want sweets and have no other options.
name: Carol

text: This place is great. Hip, young vibe but for an any age crowd. Good music and great food. Love having poutine in the South! Try it! I had the Phillycheese Steak and it was delicious!
name: I

text: As others have noted, very "hip." Perhaps vague and disinterested help and prices out of synch with quality should be expected. Sausage rolls were skimpy and boring. Egg item was undercooked and under-seasoned. Maybe it was a bad day at prime breakfast time, but not 5-star on our experience.
name: tegen

text:
Found this place through a client and gave it a shot this weekend. It's nice having a Carniceria in the neighborhood. 
We opted for marinated chicken, couple different types of tortillas and couple salsas. 
We weren't sure if the meat was going to be flavorful because it didn't look as marinated as we are use too at this type of market. But to our surprise it was fabulous. 
It bbq'd up nicely and was very flavorful. The small flour tortillas we got were insanely good. Green and red salsa was on point. The only reason for 4 stars was the cost. Def more expensive than other Mexican markets. But I'll def be back!!
name: Kirsten

text: The falafel might be the best I've ever had. Maybe because of the bread?  The sauce?  The fixins?  Dunno, but I crave it. And generous size, super filling.
name: Doug

text: Sooo first the ruby slipper mimosa was very good I think I had about 2. I which they had bottomless but we would probably never get inside. There was a long wait but I added my self to the wait list on yelp so it helped a little. This place is very good and a must go to for brunch if your in New Orleans.
name: Katrina

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The staff seemed tired but still polite. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The leftovers held up okay the next day.. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It looked better in person than in the online photos, weirdly enough.. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: I came here the other day with my friends for breakfast and to do some work on our laptops. We all got the New Orleans style iced coffee, which was so smooth and delicious. It was the best coffee I've had in a long time and was the perfect amount of caffeine! For food, I got the biscuit sandwich with turkey, which melted in my mouth and was really flavorful. The only negative thing I'd say was there weren't any outlets in the place, so it's hard to sit and work all day, but it's definitely an excellent hang out spot besides that! I can't wait to come back on my next trip to New Orleans.
name: Kara

text: If you ever go to Santa Barbara you must eat at Black Sheep. Insanely delicious. Get the tasting menu. You won't regret it.
name: Robert

text: Food was absolutely delicious..it's byob so take advantage. They give you a nice size portion. I got the crab legs and shrimp and even had shrimp to take home. Spice and flavor delicious. I'll be back for sure! Service was great too.
name: L

text: Let me start off by saying they have the worst customer service EVER! Our waitress was super rude and felt like since we had a party of 8, she didn't have to provide any type of customer service.  She didnt give us silverware or plates and when I asked her for some, she rolled her eyes and walked away from me. Another waitress had to give us our utensils. She was all around mean and very unfriendly.  We drove 3hrs and picked this place to eat at it. Although the food is tasty and the restaurant is clean, I will not be coming here again. They need to hire workers who are somewhat friendly!!
name: Clarina

text: Everything is cooked fresh and was excellent. The hot was really kicked up. I am looking forward to returning.
name: Michael

text: Just stopped in for a quick margarita with Hubs after running some errands. It's a great large place with a nice large bar. We ordered the El Heffe margaritas and nachos. WOW! Both were amazing. We'll definitely be back for a meal. In the way in we saw a large sign about a Sunday brunch, so maybe we'll try that!
name: Lisa

text: This is my go-to pizza delivery place when I am in King of Prussia. The sauce is incredible, with a smoky sweetness. The flavors are absolutely spot on. I only wish that the crust was crispier. I usually ask for it extra well-done, hoping this will help, but the crust can't really carry the weight of the heavy sauce. Honestly, it's a minor complaint though, considering how tasty the pizza is. Worth it!
name: Sam

text: Great place great prices. Get there early to avoid the wait. No high chairs but we worked it out
name: Nancy

text: Not a place for a large group. I went here with my daughter's class and it was completely chaotic. My daughter and her friend waited for more than 30 minutes to receive their food and it still was not the correct order. Decent food but TERRIBLE service. Also, pretty expensive. Not worth the cost. Anyway, with a small group, I am not sure, but with a large group, I wouldn't go back.
name: Christine

text: Enjoyed lunch at Ford's Garage. Stopped by on our way home from the mall. It was very cool ambiance, old Ford's and automobile themed. Loved the napkin holders! The food we had was typical bar food, nothing too special.  Loved the neat car theme though that carried throughout the place, even in the bathrooms! Any car enthusiast would like it!
name: Carolyn

text: I have enjoyed this restaurant in the past, but today I walked out after the woman behind the corner was very rude. My son asked her what something was behind the counter (it wasn't labeled). I guess she didn't hear him. So, I asked and she answered curtly. Next I started to order for my kids. Then someone walked in and I decided to let him order first since I hadn't decided what I wanted yet. She very rudely rolled her eyes at me. Excuse me for being considerate to a customer who I knew would be quick to order. I left the restaurant. Who needs to be treated like that?
name: Christina

text: For being so close to Jackson Square (read: touristy area), this place was really tasty and reasonably priced. I ate at the bar, and the bartender was really nice and helpful. I had the grilled fish with salad and jambalaya, and was impressed with the flavor. The fish tasted fresh and had a good seasoning on it, but the real winner of the dish was the jambalaya. It wasn't overly spicy, but full of flavor. The food and service were top-notch.
name: Michael

text:
Finally a center city presence!!! This place is really phenomenal. The food is just wonderful you really can't go wrong. Even just the chips and 4 sauces they bring out to start is an experience with fresh ingredients in each sauce daily. If you like spicy, I am obsessed with their hottest option and the presentation is great, it looks like pickled slawed veggies but it's a hot sauce and I really just love it. Tacos are great, particularly love the fish and carnitas. The margaritas are great too. 
Cool atmosphere with outdoor seating options and heat lamps in the colder months. Friendly and professional staff. Great great spot
name: Riley

text: Best donair in the city! If u haven't tried these guys, put this place in your list, especially if you are a donair fan. They grill the donairs and add some spices to the outside so maybe thats why they are so good. Meat, veggies and garlic sauce are SO good
name: Tracey

text: This restaurant has a wonderful atmosphere, with both indoor and outdoor seating. My waitress was attentive, without being overly so, and very welcoming. The bruschetta was incredibly filling; I almost didn't have room for my entree of mussels in white wine with linguini! I visited based on a recommendation from a friend, and I will definitely be back.
name: Matt

text: corner 17 was a great, casual Chinese food place! I got dumplings and bubble tea and they were both really good! Would recommend!
name: Leah

text:
Came here on a Monday night in January. Wasn't exactly busy for being primer dinner period, and the hostess seemed completely uninterested in seating me when I arrived. This should have been my first clue to just leave. Once seated, I ordered the Roast Half Chicken with salad. Here's where this all goes downhill quickly.

First, the salad came and the prep staff couldn't be bothered to slice a cucumber into reasonably sized pieces. What I got were pieces the size of a dollar bill folded in half. Sadly, this was the positive part of the meal. The entree arrived next.

It was the driest, most overcooked chicken I've ever tried eating. Sawdust would describe it. Vegetables -- one was overcooked and devoid of any flavor, the other was cold and under-done. Shockingly bad. Not one for the win column on this visit, perhaps one of the worst diner experiences I've had in Jersey. Wait staff was disinterested -- I'd have sent this back for something else if my waiter bothered to even look in my direction, he did not. I suffered through a bad meal and chalked it to a bad experience. 

Then I go to pay. That hostess from my arrival? Wasn't at all interested in taking my payment, I had to drag her away from a personal conversation with another staffer. 

Bottom-line: Keep driving down Route 38, there are too many other good places in a short distance, this isn't one. They're not even making an effort at trying.
name: Andrew

text: The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Food was fresh and service was quick. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.

text:

The half gyro, fry and drink combo is priced well at $8.50.  They gyro was spiced to my liking and was tender.  The pita bread was fresh and the condiments were also  fresh. The fries had good flavor too.  I'll be back.

It's a decent atmosphere but the food (which was cold) and the service was AWFUL. Go literally anywhere else. I didn't even touch on the food (which was terrible) as the service was even worse.

text: Food was excellent! The burgers were delicious and the sweet potato fries were some of the best I've ever had. The only reason I cannot give this place 5 stars is because of the service. Our server never came back to check on us after the food was delivered (not by her, but another staff member), we had to find her to ask for drink refills, and I had to hunt down silverware for our table. I highly recommend the food and just hope you get a better server than what we had!

text: Such a cute place for small appetizers and a drink. The drinks are good. The bartenders actually know what they are doing. The service is nice and quick. The food is pretty good. There is both indoor and outdoor seating. Inside you can dance on the dance floor. The crowd was a much older crowd however. We like to sit outside by the water. The water is obviously dirty but it feels great eating by open waters.

text: This is a solid place to grab a burger & a beer in Dogtown! They have a great patio, perfect for groups. I love their burgers & sweet potato waffle fries. The portions are huuuge & their pitchers are well priced, so great bang for your buck here. Go with a group, order some beer pitchers & burgers and enjoy this St. Louis staple!
