text:
Just stopped in to try Hogwood BBQ after seeing an ad in a local magazine.  I must say the photo in their ad was very enticing, however we are all aware of photoshop.  So I was fairly certain the real sandwich would not look like the photo, but was hoping it would be tasty.  I must say Hogwood did not disappoint!!  The food was not only amazing but it was beautiful as well. Just like the photo. Pork sandwich was excellent, along with the slaw added to the sandwich.  Jalapeño grits were excellent.  My husband loved his brisket and potato salad.  Their soda brand "stubborn" did not disappoint either. Loved all the flavors I tried. The service was fast and pleasant.  I will definitely go back in the very near future!!!
Hope everyone gives them a try, as we need to support good restaurants in the area.  As everyone knows we have our fair share of less than stellar ones, and those that go the extra mile deserve a shout out.

text: This is one of those places where I can see other people loving it more than I did. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. There were a couple things I liked and a couple things I probably wouldn't get again. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..
name: User

text: Amazing service Thank you Miles! And the Painkiller Pina Colada is the best here!! When you decide to dine here ask for Miles, he is attentive as he is courteous!
name: Melissa

text: Went with family on a Sunday and it was louder than I expected. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Price felt a touch high for what it was. Overall, a strong experience. The food was good and the service was easygoing.
name: User

text: Been here twice and both times have been a great experience. Got a California Burrito which comes with chorizo fries. Both really yummy! Service was exceptional, both my boyfriend and I were seated once we got there, brought drinks and food within a reasonable time.
name: Cynethia

text: I really wanted to like this place, but it disappointed me as well. I will now forever avoid all Ijji sushi restaurants as their food and service is not worth the money. I gave this Ijji location 2 stars, one more than the Prater Ijji location, because the servers brought the rolls out sparingly. Which makes it easy to enjoy what you have in front of you and the avocado doesn't sit out long to turn brown. Once again the rolls were too big to really be able to enjoy more than a few rolls even with a large party. I do not recommend this place to anyone, well any Ijji sushi location I don't recommend. Good news is that I did not get sick from eating at this location. Bad news is that their customer service sucks, they make you feel unwanted and like they are doing you a favor.

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. Inside is casual and a little cramped, but not in a terrible way. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Not cheap exactly, but not ridiculous either. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything..
name: User

text:
We were walking from one brewery to another and decided to stop in.  Solid!  Hot chicken is damn Hot! And good.

You have to try the coopers craft milk shake, it's like a Wendy's shake with whiskey.. so good.

text: This place was super fun!! My friends & I came here after dinner. The area is much nicer than bourbon street. The drinks were well priced & the band was great.
name: Sasha

text: Our visit to Bascom's was awesome! Our server (Bill) was very attentive and did a great job at making us feel welcome. The dining experience exceeded our expectations and the weekend wine deals are unheard of anywhere else. They even have a loyalty program, which explains why there were so many regulars. The portion sizes are generous and the prices are very reasonable compared to other steak houses. The Chef even stopped by to wish my husband a happy birthday! We will definitely return to Bascoms!
name: Laurel

text: The Lawless Brunch is magnificent!  I didn't have enough room for even half of the offerings; I didn't make it to the build-your-own breakfast sandwich or omelette, either.  What I DID eat was much better than standard breakfast fare. Cheesy, smoky biscuit gravy, prime rib, huge shrimp.  The caramel cinnamon rolls that come to your table hot and fresh.. oozing a buttery caramel, one of the best things I've tasted.  Shareable mimosas where they bring you a bottle of champagne on ice with bottomless carafes of three fresh juices- only $9.99 a bottle!  Who needs Vegas!?  We'll be back for sure.  My little daughter (6) was so impressed that she set up an Instagram photo of her plate.
name: Hannah

text:
New Orleans and good sushi is an oxymoron.  With that being said, I think I found the Holy Grail Hole-in-the-wall sushi hotspot on the Westbank of N'awlins! 
I came here last night to celebrate a last minute dinner with a party of 8, and I was so delighted we did. I've been to almost every popping sushi spot in New Orleans, from downtown to uptown and Metairie, and I always feel they are more targeted on the Same old rolls with different names rather than nigiri pieces or unique sushi pairings. I've had sushi from all over the US, and have eaten fish flown fresh from Japan. I was really excited to discover that Umi 2 had such a creative sushi chef that created original dishes that is foreign to New Orleans itself. 
It's located off of Holiday Dr. on the Westbank but still considered New Orleans, the plaza is pretty discreet. It has an end cap, but still I almost missed it if I didn't know what I was looking for. 
I made the reservation with the chef and he assured me he would create things off the menu. And create he did. From the interior, I was amazed how nice it was inside. Very clean and kept true to the theme. The lights were brighter than I would like, but this establishment is use to more take out than dine in. What a waste! Because it's such a great place to host a girls night out or any type of celebration. The staff was super friendly and attentive and took us a for a sushi food journey!
We ordered the Miso soup for starters. Nothing impressive but it got the job done. 
Now the Octopus ceviche was well executed with just the right amount of citrus and the texture was perfect. 4/5
The ponzu oysters was banging! 
The tuna carpaccio was also beautifully done in a style of a rose petal. Compliments to the chef/artist. 4/5
The yellowtail was freshly paired with sliced jalapeño making the bite addicting and longing for more. 5/5
We also was served fried fish ball and tofu skewers. They were one of best I've tasted. Light breading and not too oily. Flaky and crispy. 5/5
But the stand out of the night was the fresh toro. I'm a sucker for toro. They served us a generous amount and I was pleased to keep eating it while it felt buttery and melted in my mouth after I allowed it to get to room temperature. 5/5
Oh, and they even have fresh wasabi! Any reputable sushi restaurant should always carry this rather than the paste in the tube. 
All in all, this is my new go to spot for sushi when I'm in New Orleans. But this is just my opinion. But Hey! What do I know about sushi?
name: Vu

text: This place is worthwhile. There are numerous locations throughout Delaware and Pennsylvania, this review is based on multiple visits to Kennett Square location.  Liquor drinks are innovative and craft beer selection is terrific. They use local produce and offer seasonal features. I tried the General Tso's Cauliflower and highly recommend this flavorful dish. Vegetarians and carnivores alike should find something on the menu. Service is consistently good. Kids menu is offered and our family feels welcome.
name: Tiffani

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Nobody was rude or anything, it just took a while to get water refilled. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Would probably stop in again if nearby. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really.
name: User

text: Wow!  My wife and I went here last night for our 10 year anniversary and we were not disappointed.  The space looks great.  The waiter and the wait staff were awesome and the food was amazing.  My wife had the beef tenderloin and mushroom pastry.  Even cooked medium-well it simply melted in your mouth.  I had the pork tenderloin plate which was also off the chart.  We can't remember when we have had a better meal or experience in recent memory.   ...did I mention the bread?

text: Stopped in to grab some lunch, asked to use the restroom so I could wash it before I eat. Sat down for 10 minutes without anyone asking me if I would like a water, a menu or anything. I decided just to leave, maybe I'll try it again in the future So I can actually rate the quality of the food not the service.

text:
Texas Roadhouse has quickly become a favorite of my family! 

Their hand-cut steaks are amazing! These bad boys barely need a knife and definitely don't need any steak sauce! No matter which you choose, you can add some amazing sauteed mushrooms and onions. You can also add some cheese and I think something else... but why? You don't want to cover these steaks too much. You can even pick out the specific steak you want. I've never felt the need, but there is that option. 

You can also add things to your steaks and other entrees like a side of some amazing shrimp. I say go for it! You won't regret it.

Their sides are top notch! You can get several "smothered" in a variety of ways and everything I have tasted is a special treat by itself. Sides my friends or family have had are always raved about, too.

The side salads have quite a personality and come with your choice of a great variety of homemade dressings. This isn't the place to skip the side salad.

Oh! ...and the rolls and cinnamon butter are absolutely CRAZY!!! Oh my taste buds!!! 

The only appetizer we have tried so far is the Cactus Blossom. It's SO yummy and plenty for the whole family. Their sauce is a bit different than others, but definitely in a really good way! 

They have some great gluten free options, but unfortunately no gluten free rolls. 

We often try to go there during their Early Dine hours which are: Monday-Thursday until 6 pm and Friday until 3 pm. This way we can get several extras without going too overboard... and we can easily justify going more often. Win, win.

During the Early Dine hours you can get about 11 different popular meals (including a couple of steaks) for only $9.99. You definitely cannot beat that! 

You can call ahead to get in line before you arrive. Sometimes the wait can be a bit long, but it's always worth the wait. To avoid it completely, just call ahead.
name: Stephanie

text:
Redemption! The last time we tried Sperry's for lunch we were later in the afternoon and our experience was not the best. 
In the past we have enjoyed Sperry's immensely, so we tried again today for lunch. We made reservations and were seated on time, in front of the fireplace. With it being rainy and unseasonably cool outside, the fireplace was perfect.
Our server, Melissa, was very attentive our entire meal. We didn't have to ask for refills- she was there just in time, but she didn't over serve either. We didn't know she was around, until we needed something.
Today since the weather was so gloomy; we decided on soup and salad. Sperry's salad bar has just the right options but not to many. The salad bar options are all fresh.But the most delicious feature on the bar is the home made dressings- oh my, creamy and tasty.
I had French onion soup which was perfect. It was perfectly hot and the cheese was deliciously crusted over the edges of the cup. The broth was tasty and hit the spot. My wife had the clam chowder which was a great blend of seafood and potatoes. We ended the meal with a perfectly prepared French press. 
A beautiful dining room, excellent service, a delicious lunch for every course and enchanting coffee in front of the fireplace. It was a Good Friday at Sperry's!
name: Robert

text:

Ordered the risotto for lunch. I'm used to wild mushroom risotto but this one was in cioppino broth and was the perfect twist I never knew I needed. Also ordered the creme brûlée for dessert and was incredible. Overall lunch was outstanding and the staff was really nice. If I'm ever in Tampa again, I will be back.

text:
One of the best meals I've had on my trip to NOLA. Reservation was for our last night there, and anticipation was high.

Interior reminded me of old NYC fancy restaurants, the diverse staff attentive, professional and on-point. The atmosphere classy, yet accepting. Everyone looked happy to see you, and thankful for your presence.

Food... amazing.

I had the August special, appetizer, entree and desert for $39. I had a lobster bisque which made me wanna pick up the bowl and lick the remains. The lobster was cooked like its mama made the suggestion. Then I had the soft-shell crab, and I've never had this made correctly. This was amazingly good, over a slice of cornbread and a lovely un-overpowering sauce. I hated to see it leave my plate. It was hard to eat more after that, but of course I did. Desert was a mini pecan pie with a mini scoop of ice cream. I loved the pie filling, rich and lovely, but the crust was too tough to tackle, yet I excused it.

The staff were really great, attentive, organized, talkative and genuinely friendly, but then I think all the folk of NOLA are. I could see a great birthday, proposal, business meeting or anniversary here. I'm glad it represented the finale of my great vacation.
name: Allison

text:
In the past year, I've been to Thee Burger Spot 4 times (I don't eat meat very often).  Without hesitation, I say they have the best burger / cheeseburger in Tampa.

First - they'll cook your burger how you order it - even if you want it rare.  It's the juiciest and most flavorful burger for many miles around.  It's also super-fresh.  I don't know for sure but I'd guess these are hand-patted burgers with never-been-frozen meat.

They also come packed with ingredients - sauteed onions, crispy onion strings, lettuce, tomato, pickles, etc.  Dee-lish!

Okay...  a few not-so-great things about this place:  First, they charge extra for a little 1-ounce container of mayonnaise.  Come on!  There's enough people who DON'T want mayo on their burgers - so why charge extra?!

Second - their fries are mushy.  They're not crispy.  They need work.

Third - the cheese steak sandwich.  It's small and not anything to write home about.  Just pass it by.

But their burgers...  OMG dee-lish.  Best in Tampa.  Who cares about the other stuff when their burgers are so darned awesome!

Keep up the great work Thee Burger Spot!  Best burgers in Tampa!!
name: Willinator

text:
There is a small table in the front of Belly Busters, but take out and delivery is really the only way to go for breakfast and lunch at this tiny roadside shack of a South American kitchen on old Rt. 13 (Bristol Pike) in Eddington, PA. We didn't know that until after we ordered, having cozied into the few chairs around that mesa and sipped their excellent coffee. I guess they took pity on us and allowed us to stay and eat our breakfasts. Or, maybe it was me taking pictures, asking questions and letting it slip that I would write a Yelp review about the experience, that changed their minds. Thank you.

We went with a breakfast special of doubled sausage, egg and cheese sammy and morning burrito. El senor worked the grill, while la senora was barista, cashier and hostess. Couldn't tell if the young guy making deliveries was family or not. Our grub was great and a good value. The biggest surprise was the new wing of the shop dedicated to java. It was a full blown Expresso operation born from the dozen years working at Starbucks before opening their own business, complete with bottled syrups for flavored lattes and capps. 

We were fortunate to be able to hang out over breakfast and watch/listen to customers and staff interact. It was apparent that the family was proud of their success and showed appreciation to everyone who came in. Admittedly, Belly Busters is a bit of a dive, but only in the best way. The corners may be dusty, but the love and effort are tangible.
name: Gerald

text: The fried Brussels is great with the cheese; the music selection is super for rock and roll fans; the ribeyes are perfectly perfectly cooked; on top of those, their beers are fantastic!

text: This is only the second time I've been here, but it's the only place I'll go for ribs from now on.. absolutely delicious! Mike is very personable and made sure we felt welcome. text: I went here with my wife for a nice dinner. The appetizer and salad/soup was good but there was a problem with my wife's entree. The bottom of the steak was charred/burnt. These things happen and it's understandable, what's more important is how the restaurant responds to an issue that's raised like this. Well this is where it was very disappointing. Basics of customer service recovery involve acknowledging a mistake and doing whatever you can to help resolve this. Well, they apologized, took the plate with half a steak away to the chef, then the chef came to apologize. No offer for a discount, no offer for a free meal on our next visit to make it up to us, no dessert, absolutely nothing. Unfortunately they really missed the mark here on both food quality but more importantly on customer service. Purportedly being trained with Disney quality customer service did not help them here. Very very disappointed, feel like I was robbed. If anyone at Atlantis reads this and wants to reach out feel free to. Need to coach the team on service recovery.

text: We thoroughly enjoyed the whole experience of the cemetery walking tour with Justin! We got a great deal on Groupon - 2 people for $16!! - and the bar we met at had 2 for 1 Hurricanes that you can bring with you on the tour. Justin was funny, well spoken and had a lot of great details through out our walk about the neighborhoods and the cemetery itself. The bathroom stop was at a cool spot that had a great souvenir shop. Inside the actual cemetery was interesting and nicely intimate even with other tours aroung. For the price and the tour, I would recommend this if you are looking to learn more about the above ground cemeteries!
name: Jordan

text: Great restaurant and you will not leave hungry. Make sure you get there early as it does fill up and can get a little crazy to get seated. Once you are seated the will treat you very well and the food is cooked perfect. The steak is great and pork is mouth watering.
name: Mike

text: This was a neat little place, upscale food court with some good options. The menus were a bit pricey, but the food was tasty. It could've been hotter though. I liked the fancy stubborn soda options
name: Jen

text:
Oh my goodness! What a gem! Stumbled upon this place looking for a meal during the Juneteenth parade and we were pleasantly surprised! We ordered whiting plates with fries and the fish was cooked perfectly! And so much fish for $7! I was able to off of the plate for a couple meals. Our group also ordered the potato salad (risky I know) and omg it was amazing! You have to be skeptical about other peoples potato salad but this was absolutely delicious!

And if you're there, try some of the homemade juice in the fridge. We got three different flavors and they were all good! 

The owners/workers were so sweet and I truly felt at home here. We would go back in a heart beat!
name: Shakena

text: A family member wanted to try out this brewery, so we went for a late supper. There were so many great choices on the menu, I had a hard time deciding...but I finally decided on the peanut butter burger. My husband had the philly brisket sandwich, and my mother in law had the rainbow trout with mushroom risotto and zucchini. They also had a couple of beers, which they agreed were pretty good. We also ordered an appetizer, as the server said it was going to be a while before our food was coming out. We ordered the fried cheese curds. Greasy, salty, and FREAKING EXCELLENT! When we finally got our entrees, I was very impressed with the quality of the food, which was definitely not greasy like fried cheese tends to be. Although it was a long time before we received our food, the staff were very attentive, checking in on us often. Really nice and helpful staff. I gave them 4 stars, only because it took a long time to get our food, even though we were warned at the beginning of our meal. Would definitely eat here again if we're ever in the area.
name: Lindsey

text: I get the appeal, I just don't totally share it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. The fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Not bad for a quick meal. It looked better online than it did in person. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. Food was fresh and service was quick. The food was good and the service was easygoing. I kept going back and forth while eating it, which probably says everything.. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: For the price I expected a little more care. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. Ordering was easy but pickup took about ten extra minutes past the quoted time. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced. For the price I expected more than this. Pretty normal experience, nothing bad really. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable.
name: User

text: This is by far the best middle-eastern restaurant I've ever visited. Not only was the food delicious and appropriately portioned, the service was absolutely amazing. When we wanted to get more bread (because it was so delicious), the owner was super friendly and even gave us the freshly cooked bread for free. The soda was also given to us on the house. Will definitely pay another visit when I'm around.
name: Brian

text: This is our new favorite restaurant. Service with a smile and attentive. Chips , salsa and bean dip fresh. I had shrimp diablo and it was flavorful. Husband hand chicken tacos which had strips of marinated chicken. Looking forward to a return visit.
name: Sheryl

text: I haven't actually eaten here but have sat at the bar and drank beer multiple times. Their bartenders are always nice and accommodating. They have a great selection of beer from sours to stouts and porters. I enjoy trying a bunch of different kinds of beers and this is a great place to do so. I will be returning and next time will try some grub!
name: Balee

text: Love Steelbach. Best service in town, great food and amazing atmosphere. What more could you ask for? Yes, it is a little pricey-but it's a perfect excuse for a nice night out or to celebrate something special.
name: Ashley

text: Delicious every time!  Attention to detail, quality and flavor are spot on.  Yummy!   Nice relaxed atmosphere dogs are allowed.  Nice place for a beer and good food.
name: Love

text:
Yosh's is in an easy-to-find location in South Reno. Tasty sandwiches on delicious, fresh bread are their main menu items, along with numerous salads. 
I ordered the whole Coconut Shrimp Sandwich Special on Sourdough for $9.99 and my mom ordered a half sandwich Reuben. It was quite busy when we went right at 12:30, but we still were able to find good seating as it's quite spacious inside. Outdoor seating is also available. The ordering line moved quickly and it probably took about 10-15 minutes to receive our sandwiches. We both enjoyed the tastes and freshness of our sandwiches. My Coconut Shrimp sandwich had plump, perfectly cooked shrimp and Yosh's did not skimp. There were plenty of shrimp in the sandwich. Seasonings were perfect. I highly recommend.
name: Anne

text: This is a great place to get real Creole cuisine. My wife got the Blackened Chicken with garlic mashed potatoes and the corn. It was fabulous! I got the Complete Creole Dinner. This was a good option because we shared dessert. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Very good atmosphere. The table next is to us had three children. Great  place to bring a family. Kennth took great care of us.
name: Richard

text:
Great personal size pizza with a nice thin crust.  I liked being able to see the toppings to create my own.  Makes me think of how you order at Subway,  but for pizza and Painni's.  The painni I saw ordered looked good too.
Butterfinger and Blood Orange Gelato was really yummy too.   
Service was friendly and obviously everyone was excited about the Grand Opening...we went mid afternoon to avoid the lunch rush.   Wise choice for us.  Parking is street side or around the corner in a free garage.
name: Janice

text: I LOVE the food but the young staff REALLY need training and maybe even some basic life skills because everytime I've been in there it's facepalm city. I usually order from doordash if I'm craving this cause it's truly not worth having to deal with the staff.
name: Amanda

text: Super good food and really nice staff. Has a nice mix for vegetarian and non vegetarian eaters which is cool. Just a good solid meal. I would recommend.
name: Drew

text: It tasted fresh, just not especially memorable. The music was louder than it needed to be. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Delivery showed up warm, so no complaints there. Food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. The experience was more frustrating than enjoyable. Food was good and came out fast. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy.
name: User

text:
This Thai restaurant you may not know about it until you have traveled to Seminole, Florida. They hide away in the plaza corner. My experience with them is not yet 5 stars. It is about 4.5 stats. 

The restaurant has good Thai food. I was here with a friend. He got the dish not in the menu and not serve to the public. This dish is call Kapoon. It is noodle dish with intestinal, pig stomach, and many other ingredients. This is actually a Laos dish. You only have to be lucky enough to enjoy it. 

I got a dish from the menu. I have shrimp in garlic sauce. It is a good sauce. The shrimp come in 7 total quantity. They are large. The entire dish is only $11 for the dinner price. Not bad at all. I also got a dish to go. The drunken noodles with shrimp. Again, the chef has a very good wok technique. Burn on the edge and maintain the wok high BTU oil burn technique. Love it. 

My friend got the sticky rice with mango. This dish top with sesame seed and coconut milk. Look very good. I would give them the credit for good dish in reasonable price. Come and enjoy them.
name: Boon

text: Amazing place!!! Almost as good as Seattle's pike marketplace. I love all the food I've tried at the market. The place is very clean for a farmers market and smells fantastic! If only I had a bigger stomach, would love to try everything! My favorite was actually the freshly made donuts which came in tons of interesting flavors (including matcha cream and bacon).
name: Lynn

text:
This place is amazing. A must visit for any tourist. 

My favorite vendors here include divita meats which I utilize for an annual bbq, the Amish stand where I get the best OJ in the world and delicious pies, and finally there's a bunch of sandwich shops like the Jewish deli and cheesecake place. 

I go here as often as circumstances allow such as going to the auto show across the street or business at city hall.
name: Jonathan

text: This was a cute and conveniently located breakfast spot near the Brandon town center mall. My daughter had pancakes and sausage. I had an avocado egg bowl (I forget what it's called but the menu was limited so it wouldn't be hard to find). Also the menu is limited. Everything was delicious and my papoose really enjoyed her food. The cashier brought our food out to us and he was very friendly. Nice location for a casual and quick breakfast.
name: Nikita

text: Well we are a frequent visitor of the Miguel's in midtown and been to the Summit Miguel's a few times. Even though this one is larger and the menu is the same, the midtown Miguel's is still much better. Not sure why. Maybe it is because this one everyone is moving way too fast for the personal touch we receive in Midtown. Just seems they want you in and out. Food is still good but again compared to Midtown it just isn't as good. If you like hot and spicy ask for their habanero salsa. Adds the right amount of kick to the food.
name: Gary

text:
Pretty cool little place.  The owner was there and super accommodating and kind. We came way past lunch hour yet the food was spot on.  Their rendition of Pho was actually super tasty.  We asked for more fish sauce and chili paste but with those, it was perfect.  The waffle sandwich was so different and good. A little on the dry side so next time I might ask for more sauce for the sandwich but really? Different and delicious. 

The boba Smoothie was seriously one of the best.  Don't be afraid to ask for more boba they were super accommodating our love for boba. 

Check it out.  You will love it.
name: Jennifer

text: You go to a bar-type place to have a drink and a meal. You choose the most expensive glass of champagne from the menu. You get a warmish glass of champagne from a bottle that had been opened too long ago. If you can't serve a decent drink, then don't.
name: Laura

text: The soup was better than the sandwich, which I wasn't expecting. For the price I expected more than this. The wait wasn't awful, just longer than I expected for the time of day.. So yeah, the tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than i pictured from the photos. They were out of one thing I originally wanted.. Anyway, food took a while and didn't really feel worth the wait. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus.. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean.
name: User

text: The burgers were a good size and tasty. The fries had good seasoning.  They have off-brand fountain soda, which taste fine....but I prefer Coke or Pepsi brand.  The taco burger my husband ordered was advertised as having Doritos and Fritos on it, but none were to be found. While it was tasty here, it really wasn't all the rave that I expected.  It was also  pricey for  burger joint...over $22 for two burgers, one order of fries, and two off-brand fountain sodas.
name: Jaye

text: This place is a gem!! Great food and terrific people working here. I'm a super fan. I think they do a great amount of business with Postmates, but you wouldn't know it because your food will come out super fast. The people working here are nice. The parking lot is a bit tricky, but I've only been at lunch, and it's kind of an oasis in the area so the busy lot makes total sense.
name: Grace

text:
I have enjoyed their food on 3 recent occasions;2 deliveries  and one dine in.  Food is great, good prices, smaller than normal servings compared to most Asian restaurants and others but you are not left hungry. Their Korean wings are awesome.  Honestly could eat 5 orders of those alone. Hong Kong soup, super yummy,  Singapore d ij sh, great, their fried rice fantastic.  Howver, their in dining experience was absolutely awful. It was not busy when the two of us arrived.  Greated nicely, seated promptly,  our waitress approached us quickly, the food came out somewhat quickly BUT, the bring each plate as it's prepared. Okay they told us but it makes for an awkward dinner where you have your food and your date doesn't.  Once we had our meal,asked if we wanted another round, the waitress went MIA. No refreshments, ate all our food we drank all our water and beverages. Never checked on us. 15mins go by and we see our waitress which i called over to ask the status of our drinks, which she replied with a tone, I'm making my rounds now. Okay?? 15mins gone by. Hmmm. That's not a nice response.  I then replied,  that its been a while and we've just been sitting here with nothing. She responded with, do you want me to cancel your order? Quickly i replied,  yes ans ut would be appreciated if we got our check quickly.  Ok. I did give her a dig on the ladt response but seriously the owner should be ashamed of the service. Sonce then ive talked to several friends about this restaurant and they ALL say, the service is the worst. 
If your close to the restaurant,  do grubhub as you actually get better service. 
I was considering them for a 180 catering order when i first tried their food(delivery) but after the in dining service,  I decided to go with another company.
name: Tanja

text: I started eating here the first year they opened, and was excited to take my wife on one of our first dates here.  Now the whole family loves going in.  The food is awesome, even when from their food truck.  From the appetizers and soup through dessert, the variety and flavor are fantastic. The Panang Curry, Bangkok Sizzling Platter and Pad Thai are family favorites.  The Sweet rice with Mango and Thai Iced Tea are fantastic sweet treats.  The Shrimp Hot and Sour soup isn't what you might expect, but is always fantastic.  Don't forget to ask for the Spice Tray to wake up your taste buds.  Maybe we'll see you there.
name: Bob

text: Everything about this spot is awesome except for the fact that it's a smaller restaurant so you have to plan ahead and make a reservation or try and snag a seat at the bar. The bartender was great and attentive, met a super cool cat at the bar who gave us the low down on the best food spots in town and sipped one of there many creative unique drinks while eating some of the best Tapas I've ever had. Really creative food selections that hit a home run with the taste buds. Lots of options in all seafood to meat to veggie to carbs. Dessert was amazing too. Will for sure go back every time when in town!
name: Christy

text: Food took forever but ended up being better than I expected. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. Outdoor seating looked nicer than the inside honestly. The whole meal felt kind of uneven. Food was good and came out fast. Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Burgers are good. Fish sandwich was-- eeehhh. I've been there about 3 times in the last three months because my teenage kids like the chicken tenders--- which are ridiculously expensive-- about $11.00 without a drink. Twice I've had the burger and yesterday I had fish sandwich. All three times the tomatoes they've used were old and mushy, inedible, so I I remove them and ate my food without them. Place is not that clean. It's just okay. I would go back for the burger every now and then but nothing else. However, the staff is very friendly, welcoming, and with good customer service.
name: John

text: I LOVE Westside deli. They have also catered for me several times for my real estate business and showers I have had. Everything is super fresh and not the run of the mill deli. Unique sandwiches and salads etc. family owned and great service. You won't be disappointed!
name: Patti

text:
Visiting my folks and decided to try a local restaurant in their area that was a byob.   Started off with mussels which according to those who ate them as I am not a fan they were very good although small in side.   The sauce however was very flavorful.   The bread was fine but would recommend a few minutes in the oven to really make it better.   They make there own butter which I guessed right away was unsalted and mixed with honey.   The egg rolls were made with fillet and had crispy onions on the side and a delicious horseradish sauce underneath.   A must have.

Over all the menu was not too long but covered a variety of choices.   The crab cakes were a decent size and had only enough filler to keep everything together.   The Cajun tuna with crab was good.   We got two special.  First the Bronzino was light and flaky over corn and crab risotto with green beans.   My only complaint was the two bones I had the displeasure of finding.   The pork chop special was by far the best thing we ate!!   

The waitress was friendly and the service was fast but not too fast to enjoy your meal.
name: Ilene

text: We were in Indy for a family "staycation" and the hotel suggested this. Since it was Lent we just stayed pretty basic and got the family xLarge and breadsticks. The pizza was more than enough for the 4 of us. The breadsticks were really good too. Bonus, they were way faster than they quoted us!
name: Nicole

text: So I usually go on a Saturday or Sunday late afternoon to watch a band, drink and eat. This Saturday the parking lot was filled with vans, a band setup, people ,crappy food and some low end beer. It was a lot party . So there was no place to park and paid $10 to park and walked.while I like to eat and dance to this band , I can't do that . Because I want options to order food not just the one or two things they had outside. Bad idea management. I come all the time and this will now make me think twice.
name: Cherry

text: I've had more bad experiences here then I've had good. For example don't even think of coming here at night! Went here after a night out and waited 30 minutes just for drinks! We left after because waiter told us she can't take our order for at least 45. And just today we went in the place has maybe 5 tables with people and they tell us it's a 25-30 min wait! When we ask why they say "we only have two people in the kitchen". Funny though because they had about 5 people just standing around a few even on there phones. Don't waste your time or money go somewhere else!
name: Meggerzz

text: Good Sushi! Right across the street from where I live so I go there often. I recommend their special -buy one roll get second for a dollar! Nice atmosphere although we normally get to go, portions are fair too!
name: Monique

text:
This place was so good! This was our first time here, we had the trio something. Our waitress recommended, the steak was my favourite. So much flavour. 
When you first come in you get fresh made tortilla chips, and a trio of dips. One is mild and the other two on the more spicy side. Our dish came as a make your own fajita type, it included chicken, pork, steak, and one other type of sausage, cactus, a cheese. Then you build your fajita! So good! We will definitely be going back again. Really filling and if you don't eat all of your food and need extra tortillas they send them home with you! 
I wish I would've taken pictures, but trust me, you need to try if you like Mexican food!
name: Courtney

text: Nothing was terrible, it just never really came together for me. I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. Idk, everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Idk, the fries were hot and crisp but the burger itself was a little messy and kept sliding apart. Also, service was friendly, just kind of slow once the room filled up. The staff seemed tired but still polite. Food was good and came out fast. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer..
name: User

text: Parking was annoying and I was already in a bad mood by the time I got inside. Our server was nice and checked in enough without hovering. My friend liked their dish more than I liked mine.. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. The sandwich was fine, not bad, just not something I'm still thinking about two days later. Kind of landed in the middle for me. Service was friendly and everything tasted fresh.
name: User

text: Love the food, cute little place and has lots of fresh  choices . I love most all the nikka restaurants  and their asian market is really great too!!
name: S

text:
Came here on a Friday night, it didn't seem too busy, but yet our server wasn't very attentive. I know this is more of a beer place, but my mixed drink wasn't very good and didn't seem to have much alcohol in it for the $10 it costs.

It is conveniently located just off of mass ave. parking is a pain in the evening. 

They had live music which was really neat! the gentleman played a variety of music.
name: Brooke

text: Really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. The music was louder than it needed to be. The tacos tasted fresh enough, just smaller than I pictured from the photos. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Everything was tasty and the place felt clean. We shared dumplings first and those were probably the best thing on the table. Worth checking out. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Please wait to be ignored !! Came in at 6:18 pm. Hostess was talking to customer waiting for take out, did not look at us did not acknowledge we were standing there. She went to get the take out order and still no acknowledgment what's so ever. Mean while a problem with a gift card or something ? Hostess still did not even look our way !!! Walked away to the back again !! We left honestly if you want to ignore customers there are far too many burger joints around !! With a Wendy's right next door can you really afford to ignore potential customers?
name: David

text: This was a delivery order on a night when I really did not want to cook. The ramen broth had good flavor, maybe a little salty, but I still finished most of it. The food was good and the service was easygoing. No big complaints, just a nice meal. Anyway, really liked the atmosphere and the portions were decent. idk I'd try something else next time. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price..
name: User

text: Cannot say enough good things about their brunch; everything we ordered and there was 5 in our party, was absolutely delicious! All of us agreed that it was our best meal in New Orleans!
name: Judy

text: First time ordering from here and I honestly wasn't sure what to expect. Everything came out hot and the staff was friendly. Food was fresh and service was quick. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. No big complaints, just a nice meal. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. Overall, a strong experience. Pretty smooth experience from start to finish. Not bad for a quick meal. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait.
name: User

text: Ordered food online and when I arrived my order was wrong. After that I waited for about 30 mins only to be given another wrong order. I accepted the wrong order because I didn't want to wait another 30 mins for my potential right order. Food was salty and gross. Waste of money and time. I'm probably never going back. Very disappointed.
name: Ashley

text: I visited for the first time yesterday for lunch with a friend.  I had a burger and side Cesar salad, she had an entree salad with beets, shrimp and goat cheese.  We both found the food to be excellent! I can't tell you the last time I raved about a Cesar salad but this one was perfect, as was the burger.  Our server was prompt, personable and attentive.  Our water glasses were never less than half full as there was a sweet girl who kept her eye on them.  Great dining experience and I will be back!
name: Val

text:
We went on a Friday night around 7, restaurant wasn't that crowded and quite a few open tables. The restaurant itself is pretty clean but loud inside, so a bit tough to hold a conversation. We ordered the ahi poke and the pork belly ramen. It took quite a while for the food to come out and unfortunately the Poke was very subpar- there was three small cubes of ahi and double the amount of beets. Definitely not worth the $12. The ramen itself had a good broth but the noodles were undercooked and slightly crunchy (instant noodles?) And the pork was overcooked- my girlfriend just got back from Tokyo and she definitely agreed. 

 hopefully they continue to build and make things better since I really don't like to write bad reviews. On the plus side our server was very attentive and friendly.
name: Tim

text: 出品都几唔错，难得可以食到绿油油的炒青菜，牛腩嘅味道亦都相当唔错，下次有机会再嚟呢个城市都会再帮衬。交通便捷，停车方便。嚟亚利桑那大学都係5分钟车程，非常就脚，出到门口可以可以忘下远处嘅雪山，整体都好满意
name: Kenny

text: The food is great and so is the view. Waitress is nice. It's a fun place to go when you're with friends.
name: Kayla

text: Called here for take out. Got out on hold 5 consecutive times and then said "too busy come here to order" and a hang up. Being an optimist, I figured it must be a great place for Chinese food. So then I arrive only to get the same service as I did on the phone. Rude people, very unclean, but....... the food was good.
name: Terry

text:
This place is a wonderful addition to the hood. Brunch and breakfast are familiar but unique. The baba ganoush is perfectly smoky and satisfying. The omelette is lovely. 
The flatbreads are all tasty.
Of course with the attention and the wonderful reviews come the crowds. The space is beautiful but it's not a quiet place to dine as sounds truly echo. 
The pastries are a pass for me. I love a good cruller or kouign amman and am so glad they have this on the menu--I would stick with the savory on the menu.
name: Anna Marie

text:
This was our first time to Salt Public House. We had an excellent experience. Our server Karla was amazing.
The food was delicious. Fun atmosphere with games to play while you wait on your food.
My kids had the mini hot dogs with Mac n cheese and bacon. They loved them. My husband had the hero sandwich he also enjoyed it. I had the Cobb salad it was good. They have a lot of gluten free options which I was happy to see. Can't wait to go back and try something different. The menu had so many great options. The menu is much larger then what I saw posted here on yelp. 
Don't miss out on an IRB gem! Go try it out yourself you won't be disappointed.
name: Amy

text:
My boyfriend and I were craving Chinese so we ordered pick up from here over another take out nearby- just wanting to try a new place. That was a mistake. 
This was far below average. The crab Rangoon tasted like old fish- had a very fishy taste to it. The artificial krab used in it must have been very old. I tried a bite of another just to make sure and had to spit that out as well.
I had the general chicken and white rice- 3 bites in I had to spit that out as well. Something tasted very off. 
My boyfriend thought I was overreacting but had to spit his out a few bites in too. He described the flavor as "veggies sitting in trash water"
It was a waste of $30. 

The employees we're very kind though. I feel guilty writing a bad review but please just go somewhere else.
name: Samantha

text:
malvern buttery has a wonderfully airy and casual vibe with plenty of natural sunlight, delicious pastries, and friendly staff.

atmosphere was great for conversation with a friend and looking around, it was a popular spot for everyone from students and professionals doing work to moms with their kids to friends of any age catching up. it can get a bit loud so i'm not sure i could quiet study there.

the process is confusing, but there's a nice chalkboard explaining how to pay. it feels weird, but it works.

i got the tomato and cheese pastry and asked a staff member to warm it up for me (so worth the wait) who gladly helped me out! all the staff I interacted with were delightful and the pastry was perfectly flaky and a nice savory choice. At $4.50, I knew it was Main Line pricing, but it was high enough that I hesitated to order a second item.

overall, nice place to grab food with a friend, lovely staff and atmosphere, but expect main line prices!
name: Jessica

text: This is the best restaurant in Tampa Bay. The drinks are unique and carefully crafted; most recently I enjoyed the Slick Ricky. The steamed buns are amazing and everything comes well plated. The true star of this restaurant is the Crispy Duck Ramen; the restaurant can split the ramen into two bowls if you split with another person which offers more than enough food. This restaurant is exceptional. Great ambiance; perfect spot for date night.
name: Mal

text: Very good supreme pizza - one of the best I've had!  Quicker delivery than expected (beat their estimated delivery time by 20 minutes).
name: Tom

text: Long line which doesn't usually phase me and the price was not bad. The food itself was average but can definitely tell that the seafood was fresh!
name: Jennifer

text: You better be hungry when you come here!! The portions are supersized!  Stop in to fill a mid day breakfast craving, and I was completely satisfied. I am going to try the chicken and waffles on my next visit!  Definitely worth checking out.
name: Randall

text:
Came here on the 4 of July and they had a good crowd. The live music was awesome (Morgan Myles) and the food was good. We sat at the bar and ordered a few bites because we just needed something to munch on. Got the fries and Mexican Street corn. 

Tried going to the third floor but they had a private event so went to the second floor but the first floor is where it's at.
name: Rosa

text: I love their sesame chicken-- crispy on the outside and generous with the meat, sauce not too overbearing. Plus I am a shrimp fried rice snob -- let me tell ya, although their choice of shrimp isn't the jumbo but the taste is just my type!! Not the yellowish and artificial looking ones. Plus when I lived in nyc there's this restaurant that makes a mean salt and pepper squid -- finally after trying to scout around nearby restaurants I found this place. I could go on and on. If you like chicken salad, you need to try CSC.  They offer samples if you want to try a few before picking your meal.

text:
Another holiday, another search for somewhere different to have lunch with my bride.

We actually wanted to go to a different spot on Central Ave., But it was closed due to the holiday. But my trusty yelp app lead me to the Wheelhouse.

The wheelhouse is a smallish bar/pub In a nondescript small strip mall on the south side of Central Ave near Park St.

Our amiable server/bartender was Rachael, who gave us the low down on all our questions,

We started off with two different soups, my wife had wheel house wedding soup which was a surprise, having a heavy tomato base unlike any other wedding soup that we've tried. It was very hearty. I had broccoli cheese soup which was loaded with broccoli and cheddar cheese, it too was delicious. We both shared an appetizer of onion rings, which where kind of greasy but good. 

My wife ordered a chicken salad sandwich called the Flippin chicken. It was made with lettuce, tomato, and onion. She chose a apple slaw as her side. There was something especially good and a Hidden flavor that Rachael couldn't identify due to the fact that the kitchen won't disclose what it is, secret recipe, LOL.

I ordered a sandwich named DRRDy Birdy, which was a Pancko Fried chicken breast tossed in hot sauce and topped with blue cheese dressing and lettuce, tomato, and onion.

This was a great find in my opinion. We will return. And kudos to Rachael Who worked the whole restaurant by herself!!!

text:
My wife and I frequented PF Changs often when they opened this location. I would consider the menu to be Asian fusion.  Food overall is ok, but definitely not as flavorful as you might expect. May be why we're do not dune here as often. 
 
Either way, we usually start with wonton soup, which has chicken, shrimp and wontons (not everyone will like this dish).

Main courses are Changs spicy chicken, Mapo Tofu, and Mongolian beef.

Changs spicy chicken is not very spicy and oftentimes is more like sweet and sour chicken.  This is fine since our daughter loves it.  Last couple of times the chicken had a weird chewy texture?

The Mongolian beef is good especially with the large green onions/scallions.  However, beware of being overcooked as this will make the beef very chewy.

My wife loved the mapo tofu until I learned to make it at home and now we are left unimpressed by the PF Chang version.  I still like the PFC version too, but definitely not spiced like the home version.  For you vegetarians out there, you may like this dish quite a bit. 

No disrespect, but the food is "watered down" and inconsistent (different chefs?). Some of this has to do with how dishes are seasoned, both for saltiness and spice.  I get they have to tone it down based on the wide range of people they serve, but sometimes it can be bland. 

Overall service is generally good, but the lighting is definitely on the dark side.  If you're having lunch, the glare outside will make you squint a bit.   Keep in mind many of the dishes are large and can be shared.   

Want more stars? Make the flavors BOLD.  Do that and let me know.  Maybe I would come back more often!
name: David

text:
Racist Staff & Basic Food 

In town for Essence Fest and ran across this lil cafe. Read a few good reviews so we decided to try them out. Our server was condescending and passive aggressive. While taking my order he stepped away while i was in mid sentence to help someone else. Then forgot what I ordered and tried to tell me that I didn't order what I said I ordered. Once my food arrived, it was wrong, TWICE!! Then, my bestie ordered the bananas foster (one of her faves) and tried one triangle of the french toast and hated it. I tried a bite and it was basic at best. She sent it back and asked for a menu that never came. She left the restaurant and ordered food at Daisy Dukes next store (Soooo Good btw) and when she came back, the waiter still charged her for her order that she did not eat or get replaced. This has never happened to us, EVER! When she went to discuss why she was still being charged for food she had not eaten she was told the cops will be called if the bill is paid. There was no discussion of policy or rectification. Although we wanted to dispute the charges we know that white people use police officers to confront and terrorize "difficult" black folk who they feel they don't want to deal with. We've seen far too many instances of this at local eateries around the country ( ie. Waffle House, Starbucks). This was our last day in New Orleans after an amazing trip, & this lil cafe left a bad taste in our mouths, literally. We will be contacting the owners to let them know this treatment of customers is unfair and will not be tolerated. I will also be notifying my contacts at Essence Festival to let them know of the discriminatory behaviors we experienced here and to warn other Festival goers to stay clear of this establishment!

text:
[708]

This Maggianos location is located outside of the King of of Prussia mall.

We called ahead for a reservation and were promptly seated when we arrived.   There was live music in the bar area which was pretty cool.

Our waitress was very attentive and even humored my 9 year old by playing tic tac toe w/ him.

Appetizer - Crispy Zucchini Fritte which was strips of zucchini hand battered with japanese bread crumbs and fried to a golden brown, served with a zesty lemon aioli.  It was very tasty and the order was HUGE (see pic).

Dinner - Hubby had the Veal Parmigiana which he enjoyed.

I had the Chicken Francese which was chicken parmesan crust & lemon butter with crispy vesuvio potatoes.  Two nice size pieces.  I had plenty of leftovers.  

No dessert this time as we wanted to head to the mall.

This location has a Corner Bakery so you can get a snack.

I'll definitely be back.

text:

text: Visiting New Orleans to drop my niece off to College. After moving her into the dorms we decided to get some food. From the yelp reviews we decided to try and it was good. We were hungry and it did the job. The gumbo wasnt seasoned enough for me, it was missing something. Definetly not ya momma gumbo nevertheless good. Shrimp was a nice size, seasoned and fried well.

text:
When will restaurants ever train their staff on dietary restrictions? Why do state's food handlers cards classes not have a section on food allergies and dietary restrictions?

I am so tired of the "deer in the headlight" stare when I ask what they have that is Vegan? Am I really the first person to ever ask these questions? Focus! Learn the business that you are in! Ugh!

I asked if the teriyaki noodles were Vegan. Were there eggs in the noodles? What??? Is there oxygen on Pluto??? The answer, once she had to find out, was "somewhat" confidently relayed. 

As for the final presentation and flavor of the vegetable teriyaki? I honestly have seen better served at Safeway's deli counter. Completely underwhelming!!! The presentation AND flavor was "bland" to be kind. Additionally, the plate the food was served on had a design pattern that was probably applied "many" years ago as the pattern was worn out and made you definitely feel that you were eating on "old" plates. 

As for the service, the server had no confidence in taking the order or managing the table. Other than a good job on refilling the water, her unnecessary hovering was annoying. 

Will I go back? Ha! No! Never! No way!
name: Howard

text:
Since I tried my first Hot Chicken in California, Prince's was on my bucket list of places to stop because its the OG (Original) Hot Chicken place.  It lived up to my expectation and exceeded them (also jeez its hot).  We showed up on Friday right when it opened and had no wait but while we were eating, people continually came in.  I order the three piece chicken wings (two hot and one medium) with the sides of Slaw and beans (both seemed like the right choices to counter the heat in my mouth).  Medium is still hot.  To the average white person who likes siracha and says they like heat, medium seems like the right choice. If you want to feel uncomfortable and get some real heat, get Hot.  Its just a bite too hot but not something you will regret in hours. The slaw and beans were not memorable but still worth it because they countered the heat well as bites to use in between the fire I was putting in my mouth.  
My stomach did not feel really great the rest of the day but for the Hot Chicken I get to eat once every three months, absolutely worth it.

Prince's is worth the short drive if you are staying in Nashville and for anyone wondering what Hot Chicken should taste like. I have standards now and hope that restaurants keep popping up throughout the country that bring me food memories of the Majestic Prince's :)

text:
Had an impromptu dinner at Seoul Taco. Surprisingly, the place was not packed on a Saturday night. The staff were very friendly and answered our questions about the menu and gave us food suggestions as this was our first visit. We ended up getting a taco sampler (one chicken, one pork and one steak). The spicy pork and bulgogi steak were our favorites for the tacos! The chicken taco had some pineapple flavors but it wasn't our favorite.

We also tried an order of the pot stickers and one bulgogi steak burrito.  The potstickers were tasty but super tiny, so you'd need at least 2-3 orders to make up 1 regular size portion. 

The bulgogi steak burrito stole the show! The marrying of flavors of the marinated meat coupled with the veggies, rice and special sauce were extraordinary. 

It was evident that they use  fresh ingredients and authentic spices in their food. 

Overall the restaurant had a very welcoming, fun, young vibrant vibe. The decor was bright, colorful and cool. There are ample seating and clean restrooms.  

The food was fantastic and the service matched!

Highly recommend. We will definitely visit here again!

text: Food is decent but only one server actually writes the order down (Karen) and gets the order right. Drive through service is hit and miss make sure and check your order before driving off. The reason being no one writes the orders down!! If orders were right this could be a 4 star.

text: Dessert saved this a little. The menu wasn't huge, which I usually prefer.. They mixed up one side dish and fixed it pretty fast. The wings had a good kick to them but the texture was inconsistent. Nothing about the space rlly stood out, which is maybe why the food had to do more. The service was off and the meal kind of followed that energy. No big complaints, just a nice meal. It was fine, maybe a little overpriced.

I liked the soup more than the entree honestly. I can see why people like it, even if I wasn't fully sold. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Ordered a few things and liked most of it. Nothing tasted old or stale, so that's always a plus..

text: The food was delicious. I got 3 tacos: steak, short rib and Molida (ground beef). Although the food was incredible, it took over an hour for the food to come out, but to our surprise the manager comped the meal for our party of 4. With this type of service and food, I would definitely come back again!

text: Arrived at 5:45 to make it to a show at the MET by 8 with a party of 6. Ordered drinks promptly, which didn't arrive at the table until around 7 despite several requests. One member of the party never received her drink throughout the evening. Food didn't arrive until closer to 7:15 and when I finally received my meal there was a large insect in my rice; management was notified of the issue and entire meal was comped, however none of friends or myself wanted to eat after that discovery and we had to attend the concert without eating.  Overall poor experience with excessively slow service (no notice given that kitchen or bar was backed up) and the issue with the large insect.

text: The food was good and the service was easygoing. The portion size looked small at first but ended up being enough. The staff seemed tired but still polite. The food came out looking really good, tasted solid, then kind of leveled off after a few bites. Solid food, nice staff, and not much of a wait. The sauces helped more than I thought they would.. Nice little spot, decent portions too. Not terrible, just not something I'd want again soon.

She gave wine recommendations and recommended her Lemon Drop martini. I had the wine but a couple who was at our table said the Lemon Drop is fantastic so I'll try it next time. They do a 18% gratuity on all Hibachi tables, so you don't technically have to worry about tipping...but the lunch price is so low (all less than $11) and the service is so good you will probably consider it.

text: Service was excellent and the food just as good. Our servers name was Ting and she was delightful and a perfect addition to our fantastic meal. The burger was made beautifully, the garlic fries are one of a kind and the philly cheese steak was a dish to remember. Wonderful hidden gem of a restaurant highly recommend!

text: We rent bikes at Citrus Park Bikes, and today we ate here.  It was delicious and so fresh!  We will eat there every chance we get!

text: Just recently found this little Gem. If you haven't tried it you need to check it out! The food was great and the service is excellent. I had the pork tenderloin and fries along with an order of sweet chili wings. The tenderloin was absolutely huge and was cooked perfectly. I also really enjoyed the wings. The sweet chili sauce was great without the normal ranch or blue cheese for dipping. While we were eating the glasses on the table were never less than half full and the waitress was very attentive. I will absolutely be back. Can't wait to try some other stuff on the menu!

text:
We ended up pretty randomly on a Friday for lunch. We ordered the bruschetta for appetizer, and for entreè it was Meatballs and Spaghetti as well as the Rigatoni Alla Vodka. 

Flavor wise, everything was great but the Rigatoni took the cake. Portion sizes are humongous so one entreè is sufficient between two people. I really wanted to try some dessert but could barely finish what we had ordered. The vodka lemonade is also pretty good, but I was just disappointed with the wine selection and the wine recommended by the server tasted pretty diluted. 

Overall, I wasn't disappointed but this wouldn't necessarily be my go to when it comes to Italian cuisine in Philly.
name: Komal

text:
The food was delicious!  Everyone who was with us enjoyed every bite.  They have lots of unique spins on classic pub fare.  And I was pleasantly surprised that you can make almost anything your side, with just a small upcharge. 
I also loved the fact the place is good for kids, too. The kids menu is on point, they have kids eat free on Tuesdays, and there is a punch card for when you come in and get kids meals.  
The one star deduction is for speed.  There weren't a ton of people in there, but the service was a bit lacking. I don't know if it was server inexperience, or if something else was going on, but everything seemed to take a bit longer than expected.  And with kids at our table, every minute counts before the hunger bomb explodes. 
We will definitely be back. I'm looking forward to trying out some other items on the menu!
name: Nicki

text:
Well this was one big disappointment. I hate to say it but it was.

I cannot judge the sandwiches. But I will judge the desserts. They are overpriced and terribly short on time to a fault.

Yesterday I went and tried some Linzer tarts. They are HUGE. Unfortunately after taking one bite the whole thing crumbled and fell apart like one big Jenga tower. I could not eat the rest of it. text:
Love the portions. I'm a fan of their ramen. It's not an overwhelming amount of broth, it's just right. And perfect for cold dahs 
Although the dessert menu is not really that exciting.

text: It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. The host got us seated quickly, which I appreciated because we didn't have a reservation. I got the chicken bowl and it was filling, though the rice could have used a bit more seasoning. Price felt a touch high for what it was. I've paid more for worse meals, so I'm not mad about it. My pasta was decent and not overcooked, which I appreciated because that happens a lot. Pretty happy with it overall.
name: User

text: Had the fried chicken on waffle. Fried chicken was pretty good, the butter they served was magical. However that's the only highlight of our meal there. The crepe and breakfasts biscuit were quite underwhelming. Add the just so so food to the fact that the service we received was almost non-existent, we left the place a bit unsatisfied.

text: Complete tourist turnover place. The roux was nearly burned for the gumbo ya ya. The shrimp were slightly over cooked  and hard to peel and service was on the slow side. Thanks to Terrence I'm not sure we would have been served otherwise.
name: Mark

text:
I don't know what happened to this place, but it has taken a serious nosedive. I used to love coming here. In fact, a few years ago, some friends were visiting from England, and I made sure to take them to Three Monkeys for their "to-die-for" buffalo chicken pizza. At the time, it was my favorite pizza in all of STL. Far from that now, unfortunately.

My wife and I came in around 5:30pm, and the first thing I noticed was that it was absolutely dead. No cars in the parking lot, maybe one table in the dining room. Great. Tonight's first of many red flags.

Having been so many times in the past, I didn't need to look at the menu. I wanted that pizza that I've been craving. So we ordered and waited. When it came to the table, I was so excited...at first. It looked different. It looked so different that the first thing my wife said was "This is a bbq chicken pizza." After further inspection, I realized it was indeed buffalo chicken, and we started to dig in. I took one bite, and it was so burnt on the bottom, I couldn't finish the slice. It's all I could taste! We called our server back, and she went to speak with the manager. After a few minutes, she asked us if we wanted another one. Seeing as how we came specifically for that pizza, we said yes and waited for the second one. Our server also explained that the manager was making the pizza herself and we were welcome to snack on the one that was burnt in the meantime. No thank you.

When the pizza finally arrived, it looked like a disaster. Covered in grease, dark chunks of chicken with, like, a brown sauce that I assume was buffalo sauce? I don't know what kind of buffalo sauce is brown, but whatever. I was starving. The crust was now under baked, and by now, I'm seriously f-ing annoyed. I ate one slice.

Our server was very nice and very helpful, and I know the kitchen issues were not her fault. She deserves none of my ire. However, the kitchen and management should be ashamed of themselves. When I looked at the bill, they didn't comp anything, not even our drinks. I would have been much happier had they acknowledged their mistake and given me above-and-beyond customer service. Instead, they've now permanently lost my business. It's a shame, because I live within walking distance now and would have loved to become a regular.

STAY AWAY, YELPERS. This place won't last much longer anyway.
name: Angie

text:
I really like this place, especially the garlic Parmesan fries. I can't give it 5 stars though because I have had a couple of burgers here that were on the dry side. They've got ground lamb, turkey, beef, and chicken breasts for the meats and a plethora of delectable veggies and accoutrements such as bacon, blue cheese, mushrooms, etc. to make your burger just the way you want it. 
If you've not been before, give it a try and, if you can, split a burger with someone and get a small garlic fry and the onion rings. Can't go wrong!
name: Kim

text:
Take out breakfast & the health salad at the pickle bar are the only things worth getting here. I just had an early dine-in dinner of a tuna melt on rye & a soda. Got there when there were only 2 other diners. It still took 10 min before the only waitress on duty took my order. By the time I finished my sandwich the resto was half full. I didn't get my water glass until the end of my meal after asking twice. I got my glass of ice for my soda after asking 3x. Of course, only had to ask for my bill once. No one suggested or directed me to the complimentary pickle bar while I was waiting for my water and sandwich. My table wasn't cleared. And, no one asked how my meal is & if I'd like anything else. Answering phone orders was a priority to me paying my bill. I wonder why there's not more competent staff on hand on a Monday night if they get that overwhelmed...?
Poor service. Mediocre food. Won't be back for dinner.

text: Tried this spot for lunch during a work break. For the amount of food, I thought the cost was fair. The restaurant was clean, organized, and running smoothly. Service timing was efficient even though it was busy. It landed in that middle zone where you expect a little more but not a lot more. Food quality was consistent across everything we ordered. Overall, a strong experience. I've definitely had more memorable meals for the same price.. Food was fresh and service was quick.

text: Very solid meal. Glad we made reservation, since there was quite a wait even in a Tuesday night. Had the Maui ribeye and petit filet mignon, perfectly cooked rare and medium rare, as ordered. Potatoes were tasty but creamed spinach was on the salty side. Servers were gracious. Craft beer selection was meh. My three year old picky eater was happy with the cheese pizza and sundae. Would come back if in area.

text: Food quality is REALLY going down hill. burned fries, forgot sauce that requested, had to return food to have it property remade. Such a shame.. really good family but someone is dropping the ball

text:
Super disappointed in my visit here. First, the line to order was really, really long. I waited for close to 45 minutes just to order. I figured with a line like that, the food should be amazing. Not so. I split a hot, large white order with the person I was with. The fried chicken was good, but not hot or spicy at all. Like they forgot to add any seasoning. The sides were okay, the baked beans were very sweet, which isn't my preferred style, the fries were good, the southern greens were pretty flavorless.
I wasn't impressed with the food or the environment of the restaurant, it felt a lot like going to a really nice McDonald's or something.
I'd say if you are looking for a real hot chicken place, go somewhere smaller and more authentic. Boltons is right down the street, but a world apart from Hattie Bs.

text: Always stop here when we come down in the summer... Best Italian Restaurant in the area.. First stop was here, we had to take it to go bc it was a long couple days of traveling.. while I waited had to have a Birra Italia beer.. we had 2 pies and sausage and broccoli rabe app.. everything was excellent.. The lady (Tiffany) working the front of the restaurant threw in a cannoli on the house.. She was very nice and personably..  she also asked if we wanted some bruschetta while we waited...definitely recommend this place and we will be back before we go back north..

text: Such a great experience here for my first time! Everyone is just so kind and down to earth. Not to mention that the food was incredible as well! They gave me great suggestions on which appetizer to get and I was not disappointed. The host also suggested my lunch and that was outstanding. Exceeded my expectations and such a great environment!! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED eating here!

text:
We love this place! Everything we've tried so far has been delicious. My favorite dish is the Huevos Rancheros w fresh fruit. The OJ pancakes are amazing, any of the fish tacos are unique and yummy, the garlic shrimp appetizer is the bomb and I've found the best clam chowder in SB!!!! If you sit outside, wear flip flops so you can kick back and put your feet in the soft sand while you sip your beverage and watch the beautiful beach. 
Ahhhh.
name: Kirstin

text:
Such terrible service. We came for happy hour and then our server told us which food and drink items were included. When we got the bill, 2/3 items were not on happy hour. We asked to speak with a manager after the server wouldn't fix the problem, and then she returned and said it was okay, the manager would fix one item and didn't even "need" to talk to us. We asked again since one item still wasn't included and our server was saying, "I'm sorry I told you the incorrect items, but I can't do anything." Finally a manager came and after a brief but too long exchange, said he'd fix the ticket. 10 minutes later, the fixed ticket came. 5 more minutes later, our change was brought to us. 

It was my first and last time visiting.
name: Brooksie

text:
Overall this place was a fantastic experience!!!

The service was really, truly great which seems to be getting less and less common nowadays. I was going to give this place 4 stars because the coffee wasn't great and they were out of a few basic things like sparkling water and condiments, but the service more than made up for it, earning them 5 stars. Jessica took phenomenal care of us and was seriously ON TOP of everything we needed!! The warm welcome and goodbye from the hostesses were also above and beyond what my wife and I have come to expect from restaurants. This was definitely a refreshing experience overall and the service was too notch!! 

Then we have the food... ALMOST as awesome as our service!!! It combined 2 of my favorite types of food... Italian and Southern styles... SO AWESOME!!!
I had the Southern Benny which has fried green tomatoes and a biscuit in addition to a perfectly cooked poached egg, really nice hollandaise, and I forgot what type of meat, but it was delicious. Normally I would complain that there wasn't enough meat, but honestly I was so distracted by the rest of the meal that I didn't care!!
My wife had the beet and burrata salad(?) that was also really fresh and light and so full of flavor!! We swapped plates and I almost didn't want to give it back to her!!
Our friends ordered a the avocado toast which we teased her about, but it turned out to be awesome and the fried chicken biscuit which had a massive piece of fried chicken that he commented was so delicious that he almost forgot about the biscuit and eggs!! Overall, FANTASTIC food, the attached photos don't do it justice... you just need to get their food in your mouth to really  appreciate it!!

Parking wasn't bad as there's a good sized lot behind/beside it. We were there in the middle of brunch hour and still got a spot... we were told it'd be a 25-30 minute wait, but we're sat within 15 minutes so that was a nice surprise as well! The prices really weren't bad either!

Again, overall this was a fantastic, refreshing experience where the service and food quality definitely competed for center stage. I don't know why it took us a whole year to try this place!!
